sanskrit_iast: tad āhuḥ kena juhoti kasmin hūyata iti . prāṇenaiva juhoti prāṇe hūyate . tad yad etad agnīn manthanti yajamānasyaiva tat prāṇān janayanti . tad yāvad vai manthanti na tarhi prāṇiti . araṇyor evāsya tarhi prāṇā bhavanti . tasya vai mathyamānasya bhasmāvaśīyate . annam evāsya taj jāyate . annaṃ ma etad ajanīty eva tad vidyāt . dhūmo 'nu ninardati . mana evāsya taj jāyate . mano ma etad ajanīty eva tad vidyāt . aṅgāro 'nu nirvartate . cakṣur evāsya taj jāyate . cakṣur ma etad ajanīty eva tad vidyāt . sa eṣo 'ṅgāra etāni bhasmāni grasate . yathā kumāro jātas stanam abhipadyeta tathā tiryaṅ visarpati . śrotram evāsya taj jāyate . śrotraṃ ma etad ajanīty eva tad vidyāt . upari tṛṇāni dhunoti . prāṇa evāsya sa jāyate . prāṇo ma eṣo 'janīty eva tad vidyāt . bhā ity uddīpyate . vāg evāsya sā jāyate . vāṅ ma eṣājanīty eva tad vidyāt . sa etān pañca prāṇān janayate . tāṃs tredhā vyūhya devān kṛtvā teṣu juhvad āste . devā haivāsya devā bhavanti .

tad yāvad vai mantʰanti na tarhi prāṇiti .

mano ma etad ajanīty eva tad vidyāt .
cakṣur ma etad ajanīty eva tad vidyāt .
yatʰā kumāro jātas stanam abʰipadyeta tatʰā tiryaṅ visarpati .
śrotraṃ ma etad ajanīty eva tad vidyāt .

text: They ask: "By what means does one offer? Into what is the oblation made?" One offers by means of prāṇa (vital breath) alone; into prāṇa is the oblation made. When they churn these fires, they generate the vital breaths of the sacrificer himself. As long as they are churning, during that time he does not breathe. During that time his vital breaths exist in the churning sticks (araṇi). As it is being churned, ash falls down—that indeed becomes his food. One should know: "Food has been born for me from this." Smoke rumbles forth—that indeed becomes his mind. One should know: "Mind has been born for me from this." An ember comes forth—that indeed becomes his eye. One should know: "The eye has been born for me from this." This ember swallows these ashes; just as a newborn child approaches the breast, so it spreads sideways—that indeed becomes his hearing. One should know: "Hearing has been born for me from this." It shakes the grass above—that indeed becomes his breath (prāṇa). One should know: "Breath has been born for me from this." With the sound "bhā" it blazes up—that indeed becomes his speech. One should know: "Speech has been born for me from this." Thus he generates these five vital breaths. Having arranged them threefold and made them into gods, he sits offering into them. His gods indeed become the gods.
meaning: तद् आहुः केन जुहोति कस्मिन् हूयत इति . प्राणेनैव जुहोति प्राणे हूयते . तद् यद् एतद् अग्नीन् मन्थन्ति यजमानस्यैव तत् प्राणान् जनयन्ति . तद् यावद् वै मन्थन्ति न तर्हि प्राणिति . अरण्योर् एवास्य तर्हि प्राणा भवन्ति . तस्य वै मथ्यमानस्य भस्मावशीयते . अन्नम् एवास्य तज् जायते . अन्नं म एतद् अजनीत्य् एव तद् विद्यात् . धूमो ऽनु निनर्दति . मन एवास्य तज् जायते . मनो म एतद् अजनीत्य् एव तद् विद्यात् . अङ्गारो ऽनु निर्वर्तते . चक्षुर् एवास्य तज् जायते . चक्षुर् म एतद् अजनीत्य् एव तद् विद्यात् . स एषो ऽङ्गार एतानि भस्मानि ग्रसते . यथा कुमारो जातस् स्तनम् अभिपद्येत तथा तिर्यङ् विसर्पति . श्रोत्रम् एवास्य तज् जायते . श्रोत्रं म एतद् अजनीत्य् एव तद् विद्यात् . उपरि तृणानि धुनोति . प्राण एवास्य स जायते . प्राणो म एषो ऽजनीत्य् एव तद् विद्यात् . भा इत्य् उद्दीप्यते . वाग् एवास्य सा जायते . वाङ् म एषाजनीत्य् एव तद् विद्यात् . स एतान् पञ्च प्राणान् जनयते . तांस् त्रेधा व्यूह्य देवान् कृत्वा तेषु जुह्वद् आस्ते . देवा हैवास्य देवा भवन्ति .

sanskrit_iast: tad yad āhuḥ kena juhoti kasmin hūyata iti prāṇenaiva juhoti prāṇe hūyate . tad etad annaṃ prāṇe juhoti . sa eṣo 'nakāmamāra 3b fol . 1v. 5: sa eṣānakāmamāra . imān hi prāṇān abhi vardhayamānasya  vardhayamānas . teṣu juhvad āste . athaitad dha vāva brāhmaṇasya svaṃ yad dhaviḥ . tad ātman nidhatta eṣv amṛteṣu prāṇeṣu . tad asyātman nihitaṃ na pramīyate . tad yadā vai mana utkrāmati yadā prāṇo yadā cakṣur yadā śrotraṃ yadā vāg etān evāgnīn abhigacchati . athāsyedaṃ śarīram eteṣv evāgniṣv anupravidhyanti asmād vai tvam ajāyathā eṣa tvaj jāyatāṃ svāhā iti . so 'ta āhutimayo manomayaḥ prāṇamayaś cakṣurmayaś śrotramayo vāṅmaya ṛṅmayo yajurmayas sāmamayo brahmamayo hiraṇyamayo 'mṛtas saṃbhavati . amṛtā haivāsya prāṇā bhavanti . amṛtaśarīram idaṃ kurute .
sentences: tad yad āhuḥ kena juhoti kasmin hūyata iti prāṇenaiva juhoti prāṇe hūyate .
sa eṣo 'nakāmamāra 3b fol . 1v. 5: sa eṣānakāmamāra . imān hi prāṇān abʰi vardʰayamānasya 3b : vardʰayamānas . teṣu juhvad āste .
atʰaitad dʰa vāva brāhmaṇasya svaṃ yad dʰaviḥ .
tad ātman nidʰatta eṣv amr̥teṣu prāṇeṣu .
tad yadā vai mana utkrāmati yadā prāṇo yadā cakṣur yadā śrotraṃ yadā vāg etān evāgnīn abʰigaccʰati .
atʰāsyedaṃ śarīram eteṣv evāgniṣv anupravidʰyanti asmād vai tvam ajāyatʰā eṣa tvaj jāyatāṃ svāhā iti .
so 'ta āhutimayo manomayaḥ prāṇamayaś cakṣurmayaś śrotramayo vāṅmaya r̥ṅmayo yajurmayas sāmamayo brahmamayo hiraṇyamayo 'mr̥tas saṃbʰavati .
text: Regarding what they ask: "By what means does one offer? Into what is the oblation made?"—one offers by means of prāṇa alone; into prāṇa is the oblation made. Thus he offers this food into prāṇa. He who does not die unwillingly—for he nourishes these vital breaths and sits offering into them. Now this indeed is the Brahmin's own property—the oblation. He deposits it in himself, in these immortal vital breaths. What is deposited in his self does not perish. When mind departs, when breath departs, when eye departs, when ear departs, when speech departs—he approaches these very fires. Then they consign this body of his into these very fires, saying: "From this you were born; from you let this one be born, svāhā!" Thus he comes to be made of oblations, made of mind, made of breath, made of eye, made of ear, made of speech, made of ṛc-verses, made of yajus-formulas, made of sāman-chants, made of brahman, made of gold, immortal. His vital breaths become immortal. He makes this body immortal.
meaning: तद् यद् आहुः केन जुहोति कस्मिन् हूयत इति प्राणेनैव जुहोति प्राणे हूयते . तद् एतद् अन्नं प्राणे जुहोति . स एषो ऽनकाममार ३ब् fओल् . १व्. ५: स एषानकाममार . इमान् हि प्राणान् अभि वर्धयमानस्य  वर्धयमानस् . तेषु जुह्वद् आस्ते . अथैतद् ध वाव ब्राह्मणस्य स्वं यद् धविः . तद् आत्मन् निधत्त एष्व् अमृतेषु प्राणेषु . तद् अस्यात्मन् निहितं न प्रमीयते . तद् यदा वै मन उत्क्रामति यदा प्राणो यदा चक्षुर् यदा श्रोत्रं यदा वाग् एतान् एवाग्नीन् अभिगच्छति . अथास्येदं शरीरम् एतेष्व् एवाग्निष्व् अनुप्रविध्यन्ति अस्माद् वै त्वम् अजायथा एष त्वज् जायतां स्वाहा इति . सो ऽत आहुतिमयो मनोमयः प्राणमयश् चक्षुर्मयश् श्रोत्रमयो वाङ्मय ऋङ्मयो यजुर्मयस् साममयो ब्रह्ममयो हिरण्यमयो ऽमृतस् संभवति . अमृता हैवास्य प्राणा भवन्ति . अमृतशरीरम् इदं कुरुते .

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatis sahasrasaṃvatsaram āsta . sa sapta śatāni varṣāṇāṃ samāpyemām eva jitim ajayad yāsyeyaṃ jitis tām . sa svargaṃ lokam ārohan devān abravīd etāni yūyaṃ trīṇi śatāni varṣāṇāṃ samāpayātheti . tatheti . te trīṇi śatāni varṣāṇāṃ samāpya tām u eva jitim ajayan yāṃ prajāpatir ajayat . ta ete sarva eva prajāpatimātrā ayā3m ayā3m iti . te 'bruvan devaśarīrair vā idam amṛtaśarīrais samāpāma na vā idaṃ manuṣyās samāpsyanti . etemaṃ yajñaṃ saṃbharāmeti . taṃ saṃvatsaram abhisamabharan . te 'bruvan mahad vā idaṃ sam eva bharāmeti . taṃ dvādaśāham abhisamabharan . te 'bruvan mahad vā idaṃ sam eva bharāmeti . taṃ pṛṣṭhyaṃ ṣaḍaham abhisamabharan .

text: Prajāpati sat for a thousand years. Having completed seven hundred years, he won this very victory—this is that victory. Ascending to the heavenly world, he said to the gods: "Complete these three hundred years for yourselves." "So be it," they said. Having completed three hundred years, they won that very victory which Prajāpati had won. All these are measured by Prajāpati, chanting "ayām, ayām." They said: "With divine bodies, with immortal bodies, we have completed this; mortals will not be able to complete this. Let us gather together this sacrifice." They gathered it together over a year. They said: "This is indeed very great that we are gathering together." They gathered it together over a twelve-day rite. They said: "This is indeed very great that we are gathering together." They gathered it together over a six-day pṛṣṭhya rite. They said: "This is indeed very great that we are gathering together."
meaning: प्रजापतिस् सहस्रसंवत्सरम् आस्त . स सप्त शतानि वर्षाणां समाप्येमाम् एव जितिम् अजयद् यास्येयं जितिस् ताम् . स स्वर्गं लोकम् आरोहन् देवान् अब्रवीद् एतानि यूयं त्रीणि शतानि वर्षाणां समापयाथेति . तथेति . ते त्रीणि शतानि वर्षाणां समाप्य ताम् उ एव जितिम् अजयन् यां प्रजापतिर् अजयत् . त एते सर्व एव प्रजापतिमात्रा अया३म् अया३म् इति . ते ऽब्रुवन् देवशरीरैर् वा इदम् अमृतशरीरैस् समापाम न वा इदं मनुष्यास् समाप्स्यन्ति . एतेमं यज्ञं संभरामेति . तं संवत्सरम् अभिसमभरन् . ते ऽब्रुवन् महद् वा इदं सम् एव भरामेति . तं द्वादशाहम् अभिसमभरन् . ते ऽब्रुवन् महद् वा इदं सम् एव भरामेति . तं पृष्ठ्यं षडहम् अभिसमभरन् .

sanskrit_iast: taṃ trirātraṃ taṃ dvirātraṃ tam aptoryāmaṃ tam atirātraṃ taṃ vājapeyaṃ taṃ ṣoḍaśinaṃ tam ukthyaṃ tam agniṣṭomaṃ tam iṣṭipaśubandhāṃs taṃ cāturmāsyāni taṃ darśapūrṇamāsau tam ete agnihotrāhutī abhisamabharan . so 'to na parājayate . tad vā aparājitaṃ yad agnihotram . na ha vai parājayate ya evaṃ veda . sa yat purastād apa upaspṛśati satyaṃ vā āpas satyaṃ dīkṣā dīkṣaivāsya sā . agnir jyotir jyotir agnis svāhā ity aṣṭākṣareṇa juhoti . aṣṭākṣarā gāyatrī . tad eva prātaḥsavanam . manasā niṣkevalyenottarām āhutiṃ juhoti . tad eva mādhyandinaṃ savanam . upamṛṣṭe prāśnāti . tad eva tṛtīyasavanam . lelihitam iva hi tat tṛtīyasavanam . upariṣṭād apa upaspṛśati . avabhṛtha evāsya saḥ . sa yad ete sāyamāhutī juhoty etābhyām evāsyāhutibhyāṃ sarvair etair yajñakratubhir iṣṭaṃ bhavati . atha yad ete prātarāhutī juhoty etābhyām evāsyāhutibhyāṃ sarvair etair yajñakratubhir iṣṭaṃ bhavati .
sentences: taṃ trirātraṃ taṃ dvirātraṃ tam aptoryāmaṃ tam atirātraṃ taṃ vājapeyaṃ taṃ ṣoḍaśinaṃ tam uktʰyaṃ tam agniṣṭomaṃ tam iṣṭipaśubandʰāṃs taṃ cāturmāsyāni taṃ darśapūrṇamāsau tam ete agnihotrāhutī abʰisamabʰaran .
na ha vai parājayate ya evaṃ veda .
sa yat purastād apa upaspr̥śati satyaṃ vā āpas satyaṃ dīkṣā dīkṣaivāsya sā .
agnir jyotir jyotir agnis svāhā ity aṣṭākṣareṇa juhoti .
sa yad ete sāyamāhutī juhoty etābʰyām evāsyāhutibʰyāṃ sarvair etair yajñakratubʰir iṣṭaṃ bʰavati .
atʰa yad ete prātarāhutī juhoty etābʰyām evāsyāhutibʰyāṃ sarvair etair yajñakratubʰir iṣṭaṃ bʰavati .
text: They gathered it into a three-night rite, into a two-night rite, into an aptoryāma, into an atirātra, into a vājapeya, into a ṣoḍaśin, into an ukthya, into an agniṣṭoma, into iṣṭis and animal sacrifices, into the seasonal (cāturmāsya) rites, into the new and full moon sacrifices, into these two agnihotra oblations. From this one is not defeated. That which is unconquerable is the agnihotra. He who knows thus is not defeated. When he touches water beforehand, waters indeed are truth, truth is consecration (dīkṣā)—that is his consecration. With "Agni is light, light is Agni, svāhā"—with eight syllables he offers. The Gāyatrī has eight syllables. That is the morning pressing. With the silent (niṣkevalya) mind he offers the later oblation. That is the midday pressing. He eats what has been wiped clean. That is the third pressing, for the third pressing is like something licked. Afterwards he touches water. That is his concluding bath (avabhṛtha). When he offers these two evening oblations, by these two oblations his sacrifice is completed with all these sacrificial rites. When he offers these two morning oblations, by these two oblations his sacrifice is completed with all these sacrificial rites. Thus the agnihotra is without limit.
meaning: तं त्रिरात्रं तं द्विरात्रं तम् अप्तोर्यामं तम् अतिरात्रं तं वाजपेयं तं षोडशिनं तम् उक्थ्यं तम् अग्निष्टोमं तम् इष्टिपशुबन्धांस् तं चातुर्मास्यानि तं दर्शपूर्णमासौ तम् एते अग्निहोत्राहुती अभिसमभरन् . सो ऽतो न पराजयते . तद् वा अपराजितं यद् अग्निहोत्रम् . न ह वै पराजयते य एवं वेद . स यत् पुरस्ताद् अप उपस्पृशति सत्यं वा आपस् सत्यं दीक्षा दीक्षैवास्य सा . अग्निर् ज्योतिर् ज्योतिर् अग्निस् स्वाहा इत्य् अष्टाक्षरेण जुहोति . अष्टाक्षरा गायत्री . तद् एव प्रातःसवनम् . मनसा निष्केवल्येनोत्तराम् आहुतिं जुहोति . तद् एव माध्यन्दिनं सवनम् . उपमृष्टे प्राश्नाति . तद् एव तृतीयसवनम् . लेलिहितम् इव हि तत् तृतीयसवनम् . उपरिष्टाद् अप उपस्पृशति . अवभृथ एवास्य सः . स यद् एते सायमाहुती जुहोत्य् एताभ्याम् एवास्याहुतिभ्यां सर्वैर् एतैर् यज्ञक्रतुभिर् इष्टं भवति . अथ यद् एते प्रातराहुती जुहोत्य् एताभ्याम् एवास्याहुतिभ्यां सर्वैर् एतैर् यज्ञक्रतुभिर् इष्टं भवति .

sanskrit_iast: atha paśukāmas sāyaṃ paśuṣu sameteṣv agnihotraṃ juhuyāt . brahma vā agnihotram . brahmaṇaivaitat paśūn parigṛhṇāti . avisṛṣṭeṣu prātaḥ . brahma vā agnihotram . brahmaṇaivaitat paśūn parigṛhṇāti . sa etān brahmaṇobhayataḥ paśūn parigṛhṇīte . ava paśūn runddhe . bahupaśur bhavati . atha svargakāmaḥ dvau samudrāv acaryau vitatau mahāntāv āvarīvartete patheva padau iti . dvau haiva samudrāv acaryāv ahaś caiva rātriś ca . te ye naktaṃ juhvati rātrim eva te samudraṃ praviśanti . atha ya udite juhvaty ahar eva te samudraṃ praviśanti . tayor vā etayor atyayanam asti yathā vai ṣavaṃ/ṣacaṃ vā syāt setor vā saṃkramaṇam .
sentences: atʰa paśukāmas sāyaṃ paśuṣu sameteṣv agnihotraṃ juhuyāt .
atʰa svargakāmaḥ dvau samudrāv acaryau vitatau mahāntāv āvarīvartete patʰeva padau iti .
dvau haiva samudrāv acaryāv ahaś caiva rātriś ca .
te ye naktaṃ juhvati rātrim eva te samudraṃ praviśanti .
atʰa ya udite juhvaty ahar eva te samudraṃ praviśanti .
tayor vā etayor atyayanam asti yatʰā vai ṣavaṃ/ṣacaṃ vā syāt setor vā saṃkramaṇam .
text: Now, one desiring cattle should offer the agnihotra in the evening when the cattle have come together. The agnihotra is brahman. By brahman he thus encloses the cattle. In the morning, before they are released—the agnihotra is brahman. By brahman he thus encloses the cattle. Thus he encloses cattle on both sides with brahman. He confines the cattle. He becomes rich in cattle. Now, one desiring heaven: "Two oceans, difficult to cross, spread out vast, revolving like two wheels on a path"—these two difficult-to-cross oceans are day and night indeed. Those who offer at night enter night as the ocean. Those who offer after sunrise enter day as the ocean. There is a crossing point between these two, as there would be a shallow ford or a bridge crossing. After sunset but before darkness, after good dawn but before sunrise.
meaning: अथ पशुकामस् सायं पशुषु समेतेष्व् अग्निहोत्रं जुहुयात् . ब्रह्म वा अग्निहोत्रम् . ब्रह्मणैवैतत् पशून् परिगृह्णाति . अविसृष्टेषु प्रातः . ब्रह्म वा अग्निहोत्रम् . ब्रह्मणैवैतत् पशून् परिगृह्णाति . स एतान् ब्रह्मणोभयतः पशून् परिगृह्णीते . अव पशून् रुन्द्धे . बहुपशुर् भवति . अथ स्वर्गकामः द्वौ समुद्राव् अचर्यौ विततौ महान्ताव् आवरीवर्तेते पथेव पदौ इति . द्वौ हैव समुद्राव् अचर्याव् अहश् चैव रात्रिश् च . ते ये नक्तं जुह्वति रात्रिम् एव ते समुद्रं प्रविशन्ति . अथ य उदिते जुह्वत्य् अहर् एव ते समुद्रं प्रविशन्ति . तयोर् वा एतयोर् अत्ययनम् अस्ति यथा वै षवं/षचं वा स्यात् सेतोर् वा संक्रमणम् .

sanskrit_iast: atho haitau śyāmaśabalāv eva yad ahorātre . ahar vai śabalo rātriś śyāmaḥ . te ye naktaṃ juhvati rātrim eva te śyāmaṃ praviśanti . atha ya udite juhvaty ahar eva te śabalaṃ praviśanti . tayor etad evātyayanam astam ite purā tamisrāyai suvyuṣṭāyāṃ purodayāt . atho haiṣu savitaiva dyumnaḥ . savitā vai prajāpatiḥ prajāpatir viśve devāḥ . prajāpatāv evāsya tad viśveṣu deveṣu hutaṃ bhavati . tad etat prājāpatyaṃ yad agnihotram . atha yad etat prātaḥ prabhāty etasmin vai dyumne prajāpatiḥ prajāḥ prajanayāṃ cakāra . savitā vai prajāpatiḥ prajāpatir viśve devāḥ prajāpatāv evāsya tad viśveṣu deveṣu hutaṃ bhavati . tad etad vaiśvadevaṃ yad agnihotram . atho haitad ahorātre evaṃmukhaṃ saṃdhattaḥ . annaṃ vā agnihotram . annādyam evaitad ahorātrayor mukhato 'pidadhāti . evam eva punaḥ prātas saṃdhattaḥ . annaṃ vā agnihotram .
sentences: atʰo haitau śyāmaśabalāv eva yad ahorātre .
te ye naktaṃ juhvati rātrim eva te śyāmaṃ praviśanti .
atʰa ya udite juhvaty ahar eva te śabalaṃ praviśanti .
tayor etad evātyayanam astam ite purā tamisrāyai suvyuṣṭāyāṃ purodayāt .
savitā vai prajāpatiḥ prajāpatir viśve devāḥ .
prajāpatāv evāsya tad viśveṣu deveṣu hutaṃ bʰavati .
atʰa yad etat prātaḥ prabʰāty etasmin vai dyumne prajāpatiḥ prajāḥ prajanayāṃ cakāra .
savitā vai prajāpatiḥ prajāpatir viśve devāḥ prajāpatāv evāsya tad viśveṣu deveṣu hutaṃ bʰavati .
text: Now these two are Śyāma and Śabala (the two hounds of Yama)—day and night. Day is Śabala, night is Śyāma. Those who offer at night enter Śyāma who is night. Those who offer after sunrise enter Śabala who is day. The crossing point between these two is: after sunset but before darkness, after good dawn but before sunrise. Now in these (offerings) Savitṛ indeed is the splendor. Savitṛ is Prajāpati, Prajāpati is the Viśvedevas. His offering is thus made in Prajāpati, in the Viśvedevas. This agnihotra belongs to Prajāpati. And when it dawns in the morning, in this very splendor Prajāpati caused creatures to be procreated. Savitṛ is Prajāpati, Prajāpati is the Viśvedevas—his offering is thus made in Prajāpati, in the Viśvedevas. This agnihotra belongs to the Viśvedevas. Now day and night join their mouths together. The agnihotra is food. He thus places food in the mouth of day and night. Again in the morning they join together. The agnihotra is food. Having placed food in the mouth of day and night, he escapes these two repeated deaths which are day and night.
meaning: अथो हैतौ श्यामशबलाव् एव यद् अहोरात्रे . अहर् वै शबलो रात्रिश् श्यामः . ते ये नक्तं जुह्वति रात्रिम् एव ते श्यामं प्रविशन्ति . अथ य उदिते जुह्वत्य् अहर् एव ते शबलं प्रविशन्ति . तयोर् एतद् एवात्ययनम् अस्तम् इते पुरा तमिस्रायै सुव्युष्टायां पुरोदयात् . अथो हैषु सवितैव द्युम्नः . सविता वै प्रजापतिः प्रजापतिर् विश्वे देवाः . प्रजापताव् एवास्य तद् विश्वेषु देवेषु हुतं भवति . तद् एतत् प्राजापत्यं यद् अग्निहोत्रम् . अथ यद् एतत् प्रातः प्रभात्य् एतस्मिन् वै द्युम्ने प्रजापतिः प्रजाः प्रजनयां चकार . सविता वै प्रजापतिः प्रजापतिर् विश्वे देवाः प्रजापताव् एवास्य तद् विश्वेषु देवेषु हुतं भवति . तद् एतद् वैश्वदेवं यद् अग्निहोत्रम् . अथो हैतद् अहोरात्रे एवंमुखं संधत्तः . अन्नं वा अग्निहोत्रम् . अन्नाद्यम् एवैतद् अहोरात्रयोर् मुखतो ऽपिदधाति . एवम् एव पुनः प्रातस् संधत्तः . अन्नं वा अग्निहोत्रम् .

sanskrit_iast: asau vā ādityo 'staṃ yan ṣoḍhā vimrocati . vyamrucad iti ha sma vā etaṃ pūrvaṃ purāṇina ācakṣate . athaitarhi nyamrucad iti . sa vā eṣo 'staṃ yan brāhmaṇam eva śraddhayā praviśati payasā paśūṃs tejasāgnim ūrjauṣadhī rasenāpas svadhayā vanaspatīn . sa yad brāhmaṇo 'gnihotrapātrāṇi nirṇenekti yat pariceṣṭati yayaivainaṃ śraddhayā praviṣṭo bhavati tām evāsmiṃs tat saṃbharati . atha yat payo duhanti yena payasā paśūn praviṣṭo bhavati tad evāsmiṃs tat saṃbharati . atha yad aṅgārān nirūhati yena tejasāgniṃ praviṣṭo bhavati tad evāsmiṃs tat saṃbharati . atha yat tṛṇenāvadyotayati yayorjauṣadhīḥ praviṣṭo bhavati tām evāsmiṃs tat saṃbharati . atha yad apaḥ pratyānayati yena rasenāpaḥ praviṣṭo bhavati tam evāsmiṃs tat saṃbharati .
sentences: asau vā ādityo 'staṃ yan ṣoḍʰā vimrocati .
vyamrucad iti ha sma vā etaṃ pūrvaṃ purāṇina ācakṣate .
sa vā eṣo 'staṃ yan brāhmaṇam eva śraddʰayā praviśati payasā paśūṃs tejasāgnim ūrjauṣadʰī rasenāpas svadʰayā vanaspatīn .
sa yad brāhmaṇo 'gnihotrapātrāṇi nirṇenekti yat pariceṣṭati yayaivainaṃ śraddʰayā praviṣṭo bʰavati tām evāsmiṃs tat saṃbʰarati .
atʰa yat payo duhanti yena payasā paśūn praviṣṭo bʰavati tad evāsmiṃs tat saṃbʰarati .
atʰa yad aṅgārān nirūhati yena tejasāgniṃ praviṣṭo bʰavati tad evāsmiṃs tat saṃbʰarati .
atʰa yat tr̥ṇenāvadyotayati yayorjauṣadʰīḥ praviṣṭo bʰavati tām evāsmiṃs tat saṃbʰarati .
atʰa yad apaḥ pratyānayati yena rasenāpaḥ praviṣṭo bʰavati tam evāsmiṃs tat saṃbʰarati .
text: When that sun sets, it releases itself sixfold. The ancients used to say "vyamrucat" (it released itself). But nowadays they say "nyamrucat" (it set). When setting, it enters the brahman with faith, cattle with milk, fire with brilliance, plants with vigor (ūrj), waters with essence (rasa), and trees with sap (svadhā). When the brahman washes the agnihotra vessels, when he attends to them—with whatever faith (the sun) has entered, that he gathers into it. When he milks the milk—with whatever milk it has entered cattle, that he gathers into it. When he rakes out the embers—with whatever brilliance it has entered fire, that he gathers into it. When he lights it with grass—with whatever vigor it has entered plants, that he gathers into it. When he brings back water—with whatever essence it has entered waters, that he gathers into it. When he places the kindling wood—with whatever sap it has entered trees, that he gathers into it.
meaning: असौ वा आदित्यो ऽस्तं यन् षोढा विम्रोचति . व्यम्रुचद् इति ह स्म वा एतं पूर्वं पुराणिन आचक्षते . अथैतर्हि न्यम्रुचद् इति . स वा एषो ऽस्तं यन् ब्राह्मणम् एव श्रद्धया प्रविशति पयसा पशूंस् तेजसाग्निम् ऊर्जौषधी रसेनापस् स्वधया वनस्पतीन् . स यद् ब्राह्मणो ऽग्निहोत्रपात्राणि निर्णेनेक्ति यत् परिचेष्टति ययैवैनं श्रद्धया प्रविष्टो भवति ताम् एवास्मिंस् तत् संभरति . अथ यत् पयो दुहन्ति येन पयसा पशून् प्रविष्टो भवति तद् एवास्मिंस् तत् संभरति . अथ यद् अङ्गारान् निरूहति येन तेजसाग्निं प्रविष्टो भवति तद् एवास्मिंस् तत् संभरति . अथ यत् तृणेनावद्योतयति ययोर्जौषधीः प्रविष्टो भवति ताम् एवास्मिंस् तत् संभरति . अथ यद् अपः प्रत्यानयति येन रसेनापः प्रविष्टो भवति तम् एवास्मिंस् तत् संभरति .

sanskrit_iast: tam evaṃ saṃbhṛtya sāyaṃ juhoti . sa tāṃ garbhakṛto rātriṃ vasati . evam eva punas saṃbhṛtya prātar juhoti . taṃ janayati . so 'sya jāyamāna eva sarvaṃ pāpmānam apahanti . devā vai prajāpater ajāyanta . eṣa u evaṃvido jāyate . sa yāvantaṃ prajāptir lokam ajayat tāvantaṃ jayati . atho hekṣate 'yaṃ vāva māma anuṣṭhyā saṃbharati hantāyaṃ sāṅgas satanur avihruto jarasaṃ gacchatv iti . sa ha sāṅga eva satanur avihruto jarasaṃ gacchati . atho hekṣate 'yaṃ vāva mām anuṣṭhyā veda hantemam evāviśānīti . sa haivaṃvidam evāviśati . sa eṣa vā eko vīro ya eṣa tapaty eṣa indra eṣa prajāpatiḥ .
sentences: evam eva punas saṃbʰr̥tya prātar juhoti .
so 'sya jāyamāna eva sarvaṃ pāpmānam apahanti .
sa yāvantaṃ prajāptir lokam ajayat tāvantaṃ jayati .
atʰo hekṣate 'yaṃ vāva māma anuṣṭʰyā saṃbʰarati hantāyaṃ sāṅgas satanur avihruto jarasaṃ gaccʰatv iti .
sa ha sāṅga eva satanur avihruto jarasaṃ gaccʰati .
atʰo hekṣate 'yaṃ vāva mām anuṣṭʰyā veda hantemam evāviśānīti .
sa eṣa vā eko vīro ya eṣa tapaty eṣa indra eṣa prajāpatiḥ .
text: Having thus gathered (the sun's essences), he offers in the evening. He passes that night as one who makes an embryo. Again having gathered in the same way, he offers in the morning. He gives birth to it (the sun). Being born, it removes all his evil. The gods were born from Prajāpati. He who knows thus is born in the same way. Whatever world Prajāpati conquered, that he conquers. And it (the sun) thinks: "This one gathers me with proper attendance. Let him go to old age with all his limbs, with his whole body, uninjured." He indeed goes to old age with all his limbs, with his whole body, uninjured. And it thinks: "This one knows me with proper attendance. Let me enter him." It enters him who knows thus. This sun that shines is the one hero—he is Indra, he is Prajāpati. For him who knows thus and offers the agnihotra, the offering is made in him.
meaning: तम् एवं संभृत्य सायं जुहोति . स तां गर्भकृतो रात्रिं वसति . एवम् एव पुनस् संभृत्य प्रातर् जुहोति . तं जनयति . सो ऽस्य जायमान एव सर्वं पाप्मानम् अपहन्ति . देवा वै प्रजापतेर् अजायन्त . एष उ एवंविदो जायते . स यावन्तं प्रजाप्तिर् लोकम् अजयत् तावन्तं जयति . अथो हेक्षते ऽयं वाव माम अनुष्ठ्या संभरति हन्तायं साङ्गस् सतनुर् अविह्रुतो जरसं गच्छत्व् इति . स ह साङ्ग एव सतनुर् अविह्रुतो जरसं गच्छति . अथो हेक्षते ऽयं वाव माम् अनुष्ठ्या वेद हन्तेमम् एवाविशानीति . स हैवंविदम् एवाविशति . स एष वा एको वीरो य एष तपत्य् एष इन्द्र एष प्रजापतिः .

sanskrit_iast: yad dha vā ahnā pāpaṃ kriyata ādityas tat kārayati . yad rātryāgnis tat . tāv abrūtām itthaṃ ced vai bhaviṣyāvo na vai tarhi śakṣyāvaḥ prajā bhartum . hantānnam evāsāvānyonyasminn evātmānaṃ juhavāveti . sa yad ādityo 'stam ety agnāv eva tad ātmānaṃ juhoti . sa yat kiṃ cādityo 'hnā pāpaṃ karoti tad asyāgnī rātryāpahanti . ādityam udyantam agnir anūdeti . āditya eva tad ātmānaṃ juhoti . sa yat kiṃ cāgnī rātryā pāpaṃ karoti tad asyādityo 'hnāpahanti .
sentences: yad dʰa vā ahnā pāpaṃ kriyata ādityas tat kārayati .
tāv abrūtām ittʰaṃ ced vai bʰaviṣyāvo na vai tarhi śakṣyāvaḥ prajā bʰartum .
sa yad ādityo 'stam ety agnāv eva tad ātmānaṃ juhoti .
sa yat kiṃ cādityo 'hnā pāpaṃ karoti tad asyāgnī rātryāpahanti .
sa yat kiṃ cāgnī rātryā pāpaṃ karoti tad asyādityo 'hnāpahanti .
text: Whatever evil is done by day, the sun causes that to be done. Whatever is done by night, fire causes that. They said: "If we continue thus, we will not be able to support creatures. Let us offer ourselves as food into each other." When the sun sets, it offers itself into fire. Whatever evil the sun does by day, fire removes that from it at night. Fire rises up following the rising sun. It offers itself into the sun. Whatever evil fire does at night, the sun removes that from it by day. Just as a snake frees itself from its slough, just as one would draw out a reed from the muñja grass, so he frees himself from all evil who offers the agnihotra knowing thus.
meaning: यद् ध वा अह्ना पापं क्रियत आदित्यस् तत् कारयति . यद् रात्र्याग्निस् तत् . ताव् अब्रूताम् इत्थं चेद् वै भविष्यावो न वै तर्हि शक्ष्यावः प्रजा भर्तुम् . हन्तान्नम् एवासावान्योन्यस्मिन्न् एवात्मानं जुहवावेति . स यद् आदित्यो ऽस्तम् एत्य् अग्नाव् एव तद् आत्मानं जुहोति . स यत् किं चादित्यो ऽह्ना पापं करोति तद् अस्याग्नी रात्र्यापहन्ति . आदित्यम् उद्यन्तम् अग्निर् अनूदेति . आदित्य एव तद् आत्मानं जुहोति . स यत् किं चाग्नी रात्र्या पापं करोति तद् अस्यादित्यो ऽह्नापहन्ति .

sanskrit_iast: sāyamāhutyaiva yat kiṃ cāhnā pāpaṃ karoti tad asyāgnī rātryāpahanti . prātarāhutyaiva yat kiṃ ca rātryā pāpaṃ karoti tad asyādityo 'hnāpahanti . sa yathāhir ahicchavyai nirmucyeta yathā muñjād iṣīkāṃ vivṛhed evam eva sarvasmāt pāpmano nirmucyate .
sentences: sāyamāhutyaiva yat kiṃ cāhnā pāpaṃ karoti tad asyāgnī rātryāpahanti .
prātarāhutyaiva yat kiṃ ca rātryā pāpaṃ karoti tad asyādityo 'hnāpahanti .
sa yatʰāhir ahiccʰavyai nirmucyeta yatʰā muñjād iṣīkāṃ vivr̥hed evam eva sarvasmāt pāpmano nirmucyate .
text: By the evening oblation, whatever evil one does by day, fire removes that from him at night. By the morning oblation, whatever evil one does at night, the sun removes that from him by day. Just as a snake frees itself from its slough, just as one would draw out a reed from the muñja grass, so he frees himself from all evil. Just as when gold is smelted, no defect or evil remains in it, so no defect or evil remains in him who offers the agnihotra knowing thus.
meaning: सायमाहुत्यैव यत् किं चाह्ना पापं करोति तद् अस्याग्नी रात्र्यापहन्ति . प्रातराहुत्यैव यत् किं च रात्र्या पापं करोति तद् अस्यादित्यो ऽह्नापहन्ति . स यथाहिर् अहिच्छव्यै निर्मुच्येत यथा मुञ्जाद् इषीकां विवृहेद् एवम् एव सर्वस्मात् पाप्मनो निर्मुच्यते .

sanskrit_iast: atha ha smāha nagarī jānaśruteyo 'sau vā ādityo 'staṃ yann agnim eva yoniṃ praviśatīti . sa yad ete sāyamāhutī juhoty etasyaiva tad ādityasya pṛṣṭhe pratitiṣṭhati . yathobhayāpadī pratitiṣṭhet tādṛk tat . atha yad ete prātarāhutī juhoty utthāpayaty evainaṃ tābhyām . sa yathā hastī hastyāsanam upary āsīnam ādāyottiṣṭhed evam evaiṣā devatāitad vidvāṃsaṃ juhvatam ādāyodeti . sainaṃ taṃ lokaṃ gamayati ya etasyai yataḥ paraṃ nāsti . sa yat kiṃ ca parācīnam ādityāt tad amṛtaṃ tad abhijayati . atha yad arvācīnam ādityād ahorātre tad upamathnītām ito yathā reṣmṇopamathnyād evam . bahavo ha vā ādityāt parāñco lokāḥ . te 'sya sarva āptā bhavanti te jitāḥ .
sentences: atʰa ha smāha nagarī jānaśruteyo 'sau vā ādityo 'staṃ yann agnim eva yoniṃ praviśatīti .
sa yad ete sāyamāhutī juhoty etasyaiva tad ādityasya pr̥ṣṭʰe pratitiṣṭʰati .
atʰa yad ete prātarāhutī juhoty uttʰāpayaty evainaṃ tābʰyām .
sa yatʰā hastī hastyāsanam upary āsīnam ādāyottiṣṭʰed evam evaiṣā devatāitad vidvāṃsaṃ juhvatam ādāyodeti .
sainaṃ taṃ lokaṃ gamayati ya etasyai yataḥ paraṃ nāsti .
sa yat kiṃ ca parācīnam ādityāt tad amr̥taṃ tad abʰijayati .
atʰa yad arvācīnam ādityād ahorātre tad upamatʰnītām ito yatʰā reṣmṇopamatʰnyād evam .
bahavo ha vā ādityāt parāñco lokāḥ .
te 'sya sarva āptā bʰavanti te jitāḥ .
text: Now Nagarī Jānaśruteya used to say: "Yonder sun, when setting, enters fire as its womb." When one offers the two evening oblations, that rests upon the back of yonder sun. It is as if a biped were to stand firm — such is that. And when one offers the two morning oblations, by those two he causes him (the sun) to rise. Just as an elephant might rise up carrying one seated upon an elephant-seat above, so this deity rises up carrying the one who offers with this knowledge. It conveys him to that world beyond which there is nothing further. Whatever is beyond the sun — that is the immortal — that he conquers. But what is on this side of the sun — day and night — let those two churn that away, just as one might churn away with a rope. Many indeed are the worlds beyond the sun. All those become attained by him, conquered by him.
meaning: अथ ह स्माह नगरी जानश्रुतेयो ऽसौ वा आदित्यो ऽस्तं यन्न् अग्निम् एव योनिं प्रविशतीति . स यद् एते सायमाहुती जुहोत्य् एतस्यैव तद् आदित्यस्य पृष्ठे प्रतितिष्ठति . यथोभयापदी प्रतितिष्ठेत् तादृक् तत् . अथ यद् एते प्रातराहुती जुहोत्य् उत्थापयत्य् एवैनं ताभ्याम् . स यथा हस्ती हस्त्यासनम् उपर्य् आसीनम् आदायोत्तिष्ठेद् एवम् एवैषा देवताइतद् विद्वांसं जुह्वतम् आदायोदेति . सैनं तं लोकं गमयति य एतस्यै यतः परं नास्ति . स यत् किं च पराचीनम् आदित्यात् तद् अमृतं तद् अभिजयति . अथ यद् अर्वाचीनम् आदित्याद् अहोरात्रे तद् उपमथ्नीताम् इतो यथा रेष्म्णोपमथ्न्याद् एवम् . बहवो ह वा आदित्यात् पराञ्चो लोकाः . ते ऽस्य सर्व आप्ता भवन्ति ते जिताः .

sanskrit_iast: devā vai mṛtyunā samayatanta . sa yo ha sa mṛtyur agnir eva saḥ . te 'bruvann etemam jigīṣāmeti . te 'bruvann ājyāhutiṃ juhavāma tayainaṃ jigīṣāmeti . tatheti . ta ājyāhutim ajuhavuḥ . tām annam akuruta tāṃ pratyudadīpyata tasmād yatrājyāhutiṃ juhvati pratyuddīpyata eva . te 'bruvan paśvāhutiṃ juhavāma tayainaṃ jigīṣāmeti . tahteti . te paśum ālabhya medas samavadāya paśvāhutim ajuhavuḥ . tām annam akuruta tāṃ pratyudadīpyata . tasmād yatra paśvāhutiṃ juhvati pratyuddīpyata eva . te 'bruvan kṣīrāhutiṃ juhavāma tayainaṃ jigīṣāmeti . tatheti . te kṣīrāhutim ajuhavuḥ . tayainam ajayan . tasmād yatra kṣīrāhutiṃ juhvaty aṅgārā eva bhavanti .
sentences: sa yo ha sa mr̥tyur agnir eva saḥ .
tām annam akuruta tāṃ pratyudadīpyata tasmād yatrājyāhutiṃ juhvati pratyuddīpyata eva .
te paśum ālabʰya medas samavadāya paśvāhutim ajuhavuḥ .
tasmād yatra paśvāhutiṃ juhvati pratyuddīpyata eva .
tasmād yatra kṣīrāhutiṃ juhvaty aṅgārā eva bʰavanti .
text: The gods contended with Death. That Death is none other than fire. They said: "Come, let us seek to conquer him." They said: "Let us offer a ghee-oblation; by that we shall conquer him." "So be it." They offered a ghee-oblation. He made that into food; it blazed back at them. Therefore wherever one offers a ghee-oblation, it blazes up. They said: "Let us offer an animal-oblation; by that we shall conquer him." "So be it." Having immolated an animal, having collected the fat, they offered an animal-oblation. He made that into food; it blazed back at them. Therefore wherever one offers an animal-oblation, it blazes up. They said: "Let us offer a milk-oblation; by that we shall conquer him." "So be it." They offered a milk-oblation. By that they conquered him. Therefore wherever one offers a milk-oblation, only embers remain.
meaning: देवा वै मृत्युना समयतन्त . स यो ह स मृत्युर् अग्निर् एव सः . ते ऽब्रुवन्न् एतेमम् जिगीषामेति . ते ऽब्रुवन्न् आज्याहुतिं जुहवाम तयैनं जिगीषामेति . तथेति . त आज्याहुतिम् अजुहवुः . ताम् अन्नम् अकुरुत तां प्रत्युददीप्यत तस्माद् यत्राज्याहुतिं जुह्वति प्रत्युद्दीप्यत एव . ते ऽब्रुवन् पश्वाहुतिं जुहवाम तयैनं जिगीषामेति . तह्तेति . ते पशुम् आलभ्य मेदस् समवदाय पश्वाहुतिम् अजुहवुः . ताम् अन्नम् अकुरुत तां प्रत्युददीप्यत . तस्माद् यत्र पश्वाहुतिं जुह्वति प्रत्युद्दीप्यत एव . ते ऽब्रुवन् क्षीराहुतिं जुहवाम तयैनं जिगीषामेति . तथेति . ते क्षीराहुतिम् अजुहवुः . तयैनम् अजयन् . तस्माद् यत्र क्षीराहुतिं जुह्वत्य् अङ्गारा एव भवन्ति .

sanskrit_iast: te 'bruvan somāhutiṃ juhavāma tayainaṃ jigīṣāmeti . tatheti . te somenāyajanta . te somāhutim ajuhavuḥ . tayainaṃ prājayan . tasmād yatra somāhutiṃ juhvaty aṅgārā eva bhavanti . sa ya evaṃ vidvān ājyāhutiṃ ca paśvāhutiṃ juhoti priyam evāsya tena dhāmopagacchati . atha yat kṣīrāhutiṃ juhoti jayaty evainaṃ tena . atha yat somāhutiṃ juhoti yathā jitvā prajayet tādṛk tat .
sentences: tasmād yatra somāhutiṃ juhvaty aṅgārā eva bʰavanti .
sa ya evaṃ vidvān ājyāhutiṃ ca paśvāhutiṃ juhoti priyam evāsya tena dʰāmopagaccʰati .
atʰa yat kṣīrāhutiṃ juhoti jayaty evainaṃ tena .
atʰa yat somāhutiṃ juhoti yatʰā jitvā prajayet tādr̥k tat .
text: They said: "Let us offer a soma-oblation; by that we shall conquer him." "So be it." They sacrificed with soma. They offered a soma-oblation. By that they thoroughly conquered him. Therefore wherever one offers a soma-oblation, only embers remain. He who with this knowledge offers a ghee-oblation and an animal-oblation — by that he reaches only a dear station of his. But when he offers a milk-oblation, by that he conquers him (Death). And when he offers a soma-oblation — it is as when, having conquered, one conquers further; such is that.
meaning: ते ऽब्रुवन् सोमाहुतिं जुहवाम तयैनं जिगीषामेति . तथेति . ते सोमेनायजन्त . ते सोमाहुतिम् अजुहवुः . तयैनं प्राजयन् . तस्माद् यत्र सोमाहुतिं जुह्वत्य् अङ्गारा एव भवन्ति . स य एवं विद्वान् आज्याहुतिं च पश्वाहुतिं जुहोति प्रियम् एवास्य तेन धामोपगच्छति . अथ यत् क्षीराहुतिं जुहोति जयत्य् एवैनं तेन . अथ यत् सोमाहुतिं जुहोति यथा जित्वा प्रजयेत् तादृक् तत् .

sanskrit_iast: somāhutighaṭṭaḥ (?). prāṇāya tvā iti samidham abhyādadhāti . apāne 'mṛtam adhāṃ svāhā iti juhoti . atha srucam abhimṛśati hṛdayaṃ pretir saṃtatiś cakṣur ānatiś śrotram upanatir vāg āgatiḥ . pratītaṃ devebhyo juṣṭhaṃ havyam asthāt . amṛte mām adhāt . ā māṃ prāṇā viśantu bhūyase sukṛtāya iti . sa ha bhūya eva sukṛtaṃ karoti .
sentences: atʰa srucam abʰimr̥śati hr̥dayaṃ pretir saṃtatiś cakṣur ānatiś śrotram upanatir vāg āgatiḥ .
ā māṃ prāṇā viśantu bʰūyase sukr̥tāya iti .
sa ha bʰūya eva sukr̥taṃ karoti .
text: The soma-oblation section (?). "For prāṇa, thee —" he places on a log of firewood. "In the out-breath I have placed the immortal, svāhā" — he offers. Then he touches the offering-ladle: "The heart is delight, continuity is the eye, bending-near is the ear, approach is speech. The oblation, agreeable to the gods, has stood forth in what is accepted. It has placed me in the immortal. May the vital breaths enter me, for greater merit." He indeed performs greater merit.
meaning: सोमाहुतिघट्टः (?). प्राणाय त्वा इति समिधम् अभ्यादधाति . अपाने ऽमृतम् अधां स्वाहा इति जुहोति . अथ स्रुचम् अभिमृशति हृदयं प्रेतिर् संततिश् चक्षुर् आनतिश् श्रोत्रम् उपनतिर् वाग् आगतिः . प्रतीतं देवेभ्यो जुष्ठं हव्यम् अस्थात् . अमृते माम् अधात् . आ मां प्राणा विशन्तु भूयसे सुकृताय इति . स ह भूय एव सुकृतं करोति .

sanskrit_iast: tad āhur yaj jīvan puruṣaḥ karoty eva sādhu karoti pāpaṃ kā tayor duṣkṛtasukṛtayor vyāvṛttir iti . yad dha vai jīvan puruṣas sādhu karoti prāṇāṃs tad abhisaṃpadyate . atha yad duṣkṛtaṃ śarīraṃ tat . sa yad asmāl lokād evaṃvit praiti tasya prāṇena saha sukṛtam utkrāmati śarīreṇa saha duṣkṛtaṃ hīyate . tad āhur durviditaṃ vaitad yadā martyavān duṣkṛtena saha vasāt . yo vā etena jīvann eva vyāvartate tat suviditam iti .
sentences: tad āhur yaj jīvan puruṣaḥ karoty eva sādʰu karoti pāpaṃ kā tayor duṣkr̥tasukr̥tayor vyāvr̥ttir iti .
yad dʰa vai jīvan puruṣas sādʰu karoti prāṇāṃs tad abʰisaṃpadyate .
sa yad asmāl lokād evaṃvit praiti tasya prāṇena saha sukr̥tam utkrāmati śarīreṇa saha duṣkr̥taṃ hīyate .
tad āhur durviditaṃ vaitad yadā martyavān duṣkr̥tena saha vasāt .
yo vā etena jīvann eva vyāvartate tat suviditam iti .
text: On this they say: "While living, a man does both good and evil — what is the distinction between his evil deeds and good deeds?" Whatever good a man does while living, that goes to his vital breaths (prāṇas). But whatever evil he does — that goes to his body. When one who knows thus departs from this world, his good deeds depart upward together with his prāṇa; his evil deeds are left behind together with the body. On this they say: "That is hard to know, for one might dwell with evil while in a mortal body. But he who, while still living, separates himself from it by this (knowledge) — that is well known."
meaning: तद् आहुर् यज् जीवन् पुरुषः करोत्य् एव साधु करोति पापं का तयोर् दुष्कृतसुकृतयोर् व्यावृत्तिर् इति . यद् ध वै जीवन् पुरुषस् साधु करोति प्राणांस् तद् अभिसंपद्यते . अथ यद् दुष्कृतं शरीरं तत् . स यद् अस्माल् लोकाद् एवंवित् प्रैति तस्य प्राणेन सह सुकृतम् उत्क्रामति शरीरेण सह दुष्कृतं हीयते . तद् आहुर् दुर्विदितं वैतद् यदा मर्त्यवान् दुष्कृतेन सह वसात् . यो वा एतेन जीवन्न् एव व्यावर्तते तत् सुविदितम् इति .

sanskrit_iast: mano vā anu prāṇā vācam anv ātmā . sa yad vācā pūrvam āhutiṃ juhoti manasottarāṃ tad duṣkṛtasukṛte vyāvartayati . tasmād āhur naite āhutī saṃsṛjye . duṣkṛtasukṛte hy etābhyāṃ vyāvartayatīti . sa yat sāyamāhutyor vācā pūrvām āhutiṃ juhoti yad evāhnā pāpaṃ karoti tasmād eva tayā vyāvartate . atha yan manasottarāṃ yad eva rātryā pāpaṃ karoti tasmād eva tayā vyāvartate . atha yat prātarāhutyor vācā pūrvām āhutiṃ juhoti yad eva rātryā pāpaṃ karoti tasmād eva tayā vyāvartate . atha yan manasottarāṃ yad evāhnā pāpaṃ karoti tasmād eva tayā vyāvartate .
sentences: mano vā anu prāṇā vācam anv ātmā .
sa yad vācā pūrvam āhutiṃ juhoti manasottarāṃ tad duṣkr̥tasukr̥te vyāvartayati .
sa yat sāyamāhutyor vācā pūrvām āhutiṃ juhoti yad evāhnā pāpaṃ karoti tasmād eva tayā vyāvartate .
atʰa yan manasottarāṃ yad eva rātryā pāpaṃ karoti tasmād eva tayā vyāvartate .
atʰa yat prātarāhutyor vācā pūrvām āhutiṃ juhoti yad eva rātryā pāpaṃ karoti tasmād eva tayā vyāvartate .
atʰa yan manasottarāṃ yad evāhnā pāpaṃ karoti tasmād eva tayā vyāvartate .
text: The vital breaths follow the mind; the self follows speech. When one offers the first oblation with speech and the latter with the mind, he thereby separates evil deeds from good deeds. Therefore they say: "These two oblations should not be commingled, for by these two one separates evil deeds from good deeds." When, of the evening oblations, he offers the first oblation with speech, whatever evil he has done during the day — from that he thereby separates himself. And when he offers the latter with the mind, whatever evil he does during the night — from that he thereby separates himself. And when, of the morning oblations, he offers the first oblation with speech, whatever evil he has done during the night — from that he thereby separates himself. And when he offers the latter with the mind, whatever evil he does during the day — from that he thereby separates himself.
meaning: मनो वा अनु प्राणा वाचम् अन्व् आत्मा . स यद् वाचा पूर्वम् आहुतिं जुहोति मनसोत्तरां तद् दुष्कृतसुकृते व्यावर्तयति . तस्माद् आहुर् नैते आहुती संसृज्ये . दुष्कृतसुकृते ह्य् एताभ्यां व्यावर्तयतीति . स यत् सायमाहुत्योर् वाचा पूर्वाम् आहुतिं जुहोति यद् एवाह्ना पापं करोति तस्माद् एव तया व्यावर्तते . अथ यन् मनसोत्तरां यद् एव रात्र्या पापं करोति तस्माद् एव तया व्यावर्तते . अथ यत् प्रातराहुत्योर् वाचा पूर्वाम् आहुतिं जुहोति यद् एव रात्र्या पापं करोति तस्माद् एव तया व्यावर्तते . अथ यन् मनसोत्तरां यद् एवाह्ना पापं करोति तस्माद् एव तया व्यावर्तते .

sanskrit_iast: dve ha vāva yonī . devayonir haivānyā manuṣyayonir anyā . dvā u haiva lokau . devaloko haivānyo manuṣyaloko 'nyaḥ . sā yā manuṣyayonir manuṣyaloka eva saḥ . tat striyai prajananam . ato 'dhi prajāḥ prajāyante . tasmād u kalyāṇīṃ jāyām iccheta kalyāṇe ma ātmā saṃbhavād iti . tasmād u jāyāṃ jugupsen nen mama yonau mama loke 'nyas saṃbhavād iti . tasya vai saṃbhaviṣyataḥ prāṇā agre praviśanty atha retas sicyate . sa imān prāṇān ākāśān abhinirvartate . tasmād u samānasyaiva retasas sato yādṛśa eva bhavati tādṛśo jāyate . athaiṣā devayonir devaloko yad āhavanīyaḥ . eṣā ha vai devayonir devalokaḥ . tasmād yo gārhapatye juhuyād akṛtaṃ karotīty evainaṃ manyeran . sa yaj juhoti yas sādhu karoty etasyām evainad devayonāv ātmānaṃ siñcati . so 'syātmāmuṣminn āditye saṃbhavati . sa haivaṃ vidvān dvyātmā dviyoniḥ .
sentences: sā yā manuṣyayonir manuṣyaloka eva saḥ .
tasmād u kalyāṇīṃ jāyām iccʰeta kalyāṇe ma ātmā saṃbʰavād iti .
tasmād u jāyāṃ jugupsen nen mama yonau mama loke 'nyas saṃbʰavād iti .
tasya vai saṃbʰaviṣyataḥ prāṇā agre praviśanty atʰa retas sicyate .
tasmād u samānasyaiva retasas sato yādr̥śa eva bʰavati tādr̥śo jāyate .
tasmād yo gārhapatye juhuyād akr̥taṃ karotīty evainaṃ manyeran .
sa yaj juhoti yas sādʰu karoty etasyām evainad devayonāv ātmānaṃ siñcati .
text: There are indeed two wombs: one is the divine womb, the other is the human womb. And there are indeed two worlds: one is the divine world, the other is the human world. That which is the human womb — that is the human world. That is the procreative power of a woman. From that, offspring are born. Therefore one should desire a virtuous wife, thinking: "May my self be born in a good (womb)." Therefore one should guard one's wife, thinking: "Let not another be born in my womb, in my world." When one is about to be conceived, the vital breaths enter first, then the semen is poured. He develops these vital breaths from space. Therefore, though the semen is the same, whatever (nature) one possesses, such a one is born. Now this is the divine womb, the divine world — the āhavanīya fire. This indeed is the divine womb, the divine world. Therefore, if one were to offer in the gārhapatya fire, they would consider him as one who performs an improper act. When he offers — whatever good he does — he deposits his self in this very divine womb. That self of his is born in yonder sun. He who knows thus is one of two selves, two wombs.
meaning: द्वे ह वाव योनी . देवयोनिर् हैवान्या मनुष्ययोनिर् अन्या . द्वा उ हैव लोकौ . देवलोको हैवान्यो मनुष्यलोको ऽन्यः . सा या मनुष्ययोनिर् मनुष्यलोक एव सः . तत् स्त्रियै प्रजननम् . अतो ऽधि प्रजाः प्रजायन्ते . तस्माद् उ कल्याणीं जायाम् इच्छेत कल्याणे म आत्मा संभवाद् इति . तस्माद् उ जायां जुगुप्सेन् नेन् मम योनौ मम लोके ऽन्यस् संभवाद् इति . तस्य वै संभविष्यतः प्राणा अग्रे प्रविशन्त्य् अथ रेतस् सिच्यते . स इमान् प्राणान् आकाशान् अभिनिर्वर्तते . तस्माद् उ समानस्यैव रेतसस् सतो यादृश एव भवति तादृशो जायते . अथैषा देवयोनिर् देवलोको यद् आहवनीयः . एषा ह वै देवयोनिर् देवलोकः . तस्माद् यो गार्हपत्ये जुहुयाद् अकृतं करोतीत्य् एवैनं मन्येरन् . स यज् जुहोति यस् साधु करोत्य् एतस्याम् एवैनद् देवयोनाव् आत्मानं सिञ्चति . सो ऽस्यात्मामुष्मिन्न् आदित्ये संभवति . स हैवं विद्वान् द्व्यात्मा द्वियोनिः .

sanskrit_iast: tasya prāṇaḥ prathama utkrāmati . sa heyattāṃ devebhya ācaṣṭa iyad asya sādhu kṛtam iyat pāpam iti . atha hāyaṃ dhūmena sahordhva utkrāmati . tasya haitasyartavo dvārapāḥ . tebhyo haitena prabruvīta vicakṣaṇād ṛtavo reta ābhṛtam ardhamāsyaṃ prasutāt pitryāvataḥ taṃ mā puṃsi kartary erayadhvaṃ puṃsaḥ kartur mātary āsiṣikta sa upajāyopajāyamāno dvādaśena trayodaśopamāsaḥ saṃ tad vide prati tad vide 'haṃ taṃ mā ṛtavo 'mṛta ānayadhvam iti . taṃ hartava ānayante . yathā vidvān vidvāṃsaṃ yathā jānan jānantam evaṃ hainam ṛtava ānayante . taṃ hātyarjayante . sa haitam āgacchati tapantam . taṃ hāgataṃ pṛcchati kas tvam asi iti . sa yo ha nāmnā vā gotreṇa vā prabrūte taṃ hāha yas te 'yaṃ mayy ātmābhūd eṣa te saḥ iti . tasmin hātman pratipanna ṛtavas saṃpalāyya padgṛhītam apakarṣanti . tasya hāhorātre lokam āpnutaḥ . tasmād u haitena prabruvīta ko 'ham asmi suvas tvam . sa tvāṃ svargyaṃ svar agām iti . ko ha vai prajāpatiḥ . atha haivaṃvid eva suvargaḥ . sa hi suvar gacchati . taṃ hāha yas tvam asi so 'ham asmi . yo 'ham asmi sa tvam asy ehi iti . sa etam eva sukṛtarasam apyeti . tasya putrā dāyam upayanti pitaras sādhukṛtyām . sa haivaṃ vidvān dvyātmā dvidāyaḥ .
sentences: sa heyattāṃ devebʰya ācaṣṭa iyad asya sādʰu kr̥tam iyat pāpam iti .
vicakṣaṇād r̥tavo reta ābʰr̥tam ardʰamāsyaṃ prasutāt pitryāvataḥ
taṃ mā puṃsi kartary erayadʰvaṃ puṃsaḥ kartur mātary āsiṣikta
saṃ tad vide prati tad vide 'haṃ taṃ mā r̥tavo 'mr̥ta ānayadʰvam
yatʰā vidvān vidvāṃsaṃ yatʰā jānan jānantam evaṃ hainam r̥tava ānayante .
taṃ hāgataṃ pr̥ccʰati kas tvam asi iti .
sa yo ha nāmnā vā gotreṇa vā prabrūte taṃ hāha yas te 'yaṃ mayy ātmābʰūd eṣa te saḥ iti .
tasmin hātman pratipanna r̥tavas saṃpalāyya padgr̥hītam apakarṣanti .
tasmād u haitena prabruvīta ko 'ham asmi suvas tvam .
sa tvāṃ svargyaṃ svar agām iti .
taṃ hāha yas tvam asi so 'ham asmi .
yo 'ham asmi sa tvam asy ehi iti .
tasya putrā dāyam upayanti pitaras sādʰukr̥tyām .
text: His prāṇa departs first. It declares to the gods the extent of his good and evil deeds: "This much good has been done by him, this much evil." Then he rises upward together with the smoke. The seasons are the doorkeepers of that (path). To them he should declare: "From the discerning one, O seasons, the seed was brought; from the half-monthly (offering) it was impelled, from the one connected with the fathers. Send me forth to the man who is the maker; from the man, the maker, it was poured into the mother. Being born again and again, the twelfth or thirteenth month — I know that, I recognize that. O seasons, lead me to immortality." The seasons lead him. Just as a knower leads a knower, just as one who knows leads one who knows — so the seasons lead him. They convey him beyond. He arrives at that one who is shining (the sun). Him, having arrived, he (the sun) asks: "Who are you?" He who declares himself by name or gotra — to him he says: "That self of yours which was in me — this is that for you." Having recognized themselves in each other, the seasons, having gathered together, drag away the one seized by the foot. Day and night attain his world. Therefore, one should declare thus: "Who am I? You are the light. You, the heavenly one — I have gone to the light, to heaven." Who indeed is Prajāpati? He who knows thus is himself heavenly, for he goes to heaven. He (the sun) says: "Who you are, that I am. Who I am, that you are. Come." He enters into the essence of merit. His sons inherit his property; his ancestors (inherit) his good works. He who knows thus is one of two selves, two inheritances.
meaning: तस्य प्राणः प्रथम उत्क्रामति . स हेयत्तां देवेभ्य आचष्ट इयद् अस्य साधु कृतम् इयत् पापम् इति . अथ हायं धूमेन सहोर्ध्व उत्क्रामति . तस्य हैतस्यर्तवो द्वारपाः . तेभ्यो हैतेन प्रब्रुवीत विचक्षणाद् ऋतवो रेत आभृतम् अर्धमास्यं प्रसुतात् पित्र्यावतः तं मा पुंसि कर्तर्य् एरयध्वं पुंसः कर्तुर् मातर्य् आसिषिक्त स उपजायोपजायमानो द्वादशेन त्रयोदशोपमासः सं तद् विदे प्रति तद् विदे ऽहं तं मा ऋतवो ऽमृत आनयध्वम् इति . तं हर्तव आनयन्ते . यथा विद्वान् विद्वांसं यथा जानन् जानन्तम् एवं हैनम् ऋतव आनयन्ते . तं हात्यर्जयन्ते . स हैतम् आगच्छति तपन्तम् . तं हागतं पृच्छति कस् त्वम् असि इति . स यो ह नाम्ना वा गोत्रेण वा प्रब्रूते तं हाह यस् ते ऽयं मय्य् आत्माभूद् एष ते सः इति . तस्मिन् हात्मन् प्रतिपन्न ऋतवस् संपलाय्य पद्गृहीतम् अपकर्षन्ति . तस्य हाहोरात्रे लोकम् आप्नुतः . तस्माद् उ हैतेन प्रब्रुवीत को ऽहम् अस्मि सुवस् त्वम् . स त्वां स्वर्ग्यं स्वर् अगाम् इति . को ह वै प्रजापतिः . अथ हैवंविद् एव सुवर्गः . स हि सुवर् गच्छति . तं हाह यस् त्वम् असि सो ऽहम् अस्मि . यो ऽहम् अस्मि स त्वम् अस्य् एहि इति . स एतम् एव सुकृतरसम् अप्येति . तस्य पुत्रा दायम् उपयन्ति पितरस् साधुकृत्याम् . स हैवं विद्वान् द्व्यात्मा द्विदायः .

sanskrit_iast: vāg vā agnihotrī . tasyai mana eva vatsaḥ . manasā vai vācaṃ prattāṃ duhre . vatsena vai mātaraṃ prattāṃ duhre . tad vā idaṃ manaḥ pūrvam yat paścā vāg anveti tasmād vatsaṃ pūrvaṃ yantaṃ paścā mātānveti . hṛdayam eva methy upadohanī prāṇo rajjuḥ . prāṇenaiva vāk ca manaś cābhihite . rajjvā vai vatsaṃ ca mātaraṃ cābhidadhāti . tad dha janako vaideho yājñavalkyaṃ papraccha vetthāgnihotraṃ yājñavalkyā3 iti . vedeti hovāca . kim iti . paya iti . yat payo na syāt kena juhuyā iti . vrīhiyavābhyām iti . yad vrīhiyavau na syātāṃ kena juhuyā iti . yad anyad dhānyaṃ teneti . yad anyad dhānyaṃ na syāt kena juhuyā iti . āraṇyābhir oṣadhībhir iti . yad āraṇyā oṣadhayo na syuḥ kena juhuyā iti . adbhir iti . yad āpo na syuḥ kena juhuyā iti . sa hovāca na vā iha tarhi kiṃ canāsīd athaitad u hūyata iva satyaṃ śraddhāyām iti . taṃ hovāca vetthāgnihotraṃ yājñavalkya namas te 'stu sahasraṃ bhagavo dadma iti .
sentences: tad vā idaṃ manaḥ pūrvam yat paścā vāg anveti tasmād vatsaṃ pūrvaṃ yantaṃ paścā mātānveti .
hr̥dayam eva metʰy upadohanī prāṇo rajjuḥ .
rajjvā vai vatsaṃ ca mātaraṃ cābʰidadʰāti .
tad dʰa janako vaideho yājñavalkyaṃ papraccʰa vettʰāgnihotraṃ yājñavalkyā3 iti .
yat payo na syāt kena juhuyā iti .
yad vrīhiyavau na syātāṃ kena juhuyā iti .
yad anyad dʰānyaṃ na syāt kena juhuyā iti .
yad āraṇyā oṣadʰayo na syuḥ kena juhuyā iti .
yad āpo na syuḥ kena juhuyā iti .
sa hovāca na vā iha tarhi kiṃ canāsīd atʰaitad u hūyata iva satyaṃ śraddʰāyām iti .
taṃ hovāca vettʰāgnihotraṃ yājñavalkya namas te 'stu sahasraṃ bʰagavo dadma iti .
text: Speech is the agnihotra-cow. Her calf is the mind. By the mind one milks speech when she has been let loose. By the calf one milks the mother when she has been let loose. This mind goes first, and speech follows after — therefore the calf goes first and the mother follows after. The heart is the post; the milking-pail is the secondary milking vessel; prāṇa is the rope. By prāṇa, speech and mind are both tied. By the rope one ties both the calf and the mother. Then Janaka of Videha asked Yājñavalkya: "Do you know the agnihotra, Yājñavalkya?" "I know," he said. "What is it?" "Milk." "If there were no milk, with what would you offer?" "With rice and barley." "If there were no rice and barley, with what would you offer?" "With whatever other grain there is." "If there were no other grain, with what would you offer?" "With wild herbs." "If there were no wild herbs, with what would you offer?" "With water." "If there were no water, with what would you offer?" He said: "Then indeed nothing here would exist, yet even so there would be offering — namely, truth offered in faith." He (Janaka) said to him: "You know the agnihotra, Yājñavalkya. Homage to you! We give a thousand (cows), sir."
meaning: वाग् वा अग्निहोत्री . तस्यै मन एव वत्सः . मनसा वै वाचं प्रत्तां दुह्रे . वत्सेन वै मातरं प्रत्तां दुह्रे . तद् वा इदं मनः पूर्वम् यत् पश्चा वाग् अन्वेति तस्माद् वत्सं पूर्वं यन्तं पश्चा मातान्वेति . हृदयम् एव मेथ्य् उपदोहनी प्राणो रज्जुः . प्राणेनैव वाक् च मनश् चाभिहिते . रज्ज्वा वै वत्सं च मातरं चाभिदधाति . तद् ध जनको वैदेहो याज्ञवल्क्यं पप्रच्छ वेत्थाग्निहोत्रं याज्ञवल्क्या३ इति . वेदेति होवाच . किम् इति . पय इति . यत् पयो न स्यात् केन जुहुया इति . व्रीहियवाभ्याम् इति . यद् व्रीहियवौ न स्यातां केन जुहुया इति . यद् अन्यद् धान्यं तेनेति . यद् अन्यद् धान्यं न स्यात् केन जुहुया इति . आरण्याभिर् ओषधीभिर् इति . यद् आरण्या ओषधयो न स्युः केन जुहुया इति . अद्भिर् इति . यद् आपो न स्युः केन जुहुया इति . स होवाच न वा इह तर्हि किं चनासीद् अथैतद् उ हूयत इव सत्यं श्रद्धायाम् इति . तं होवाच वेत्थाग्निहोत्रं याज्ञवल्क्य नमस् ते ऽस्तु सहस्रं भगवो दद्म इति .

sanskrit_iast: - agnihotrī gṛhebhyaḥ kathā tad asya kāvyaṃ kathā saṃtato 'gnibhiḥ iti . yad agnīn ādhāyāthāpapravasati katham asyānapaproṣitaṃ bhavatīti . sa hovāca vājasaneyaḥ yo javiṣṭho bhuvaneṣu sa vidvān pravasan vide tathā tad asya kāvyaṃ tathā saṃtato 'gnibhiḥ iti . mana iti hovāca . mano vāva bhuvaneṣu javiṣṭham . manasaivāsyānapaproṣitaṃ bhavatīti ha tad uvāca . atha hainam upajagau yat sa dūraṃ paretyātha tatra pramādyat kasmin sāsya hutāhutir gṛhe yām asya juhvati iti . sa hovāca vājasaneyaḥ yo jāgāra bhuvaneṣu sa vidvān pravasan vide tasmin sāsya hutāhutir gṛhe yām asya juhvati iti . prāṇa iti hovāca . prāṇo vāva bhuvaneṣu jāgaraḥ . prāṇa evāsya sā hutāhutir bhavati . tasmād āhuḥ prāṇo 'gnihotram iti .
sentences: katʰā tad asya kāvyaṃ katʰā saṃtato 'gnibʰiḥ
yad agnīn ādʰāyātʰāpapravasati katʰam asyānapaproṣitaṃ bʰavatīti .
yo javiṣṭʰo bʰuvaneṣu sa vidvān pravasan vide
tatʰā tad asya kāvyaṃ tatʰā saṃtato 'gnibʰiḥ
yat sa dūraṃ paretyātʰa tatra pramādyat
kasmin sāsya hutāhutir gr̥he yām asya juhvati
yo jāgāra bʰuvaneṣu sa vidvān pravasan vide
tasmin sāsya hutāhutir gr̥he yām asya juhvati
text: "The agnihotrin (goes away) from his home — how then is his sacred work (maintained)? How is he connected with his fires?" — that is, when one, having established the fires, then goes on a journey, how does it remain as if he has not departed? He, the Vājasaneya, said: "He who is swiftest among beings — he, the wise one, though traveling, knows. Thus is his sacred work (maintained); thus he is connected with his fires." "It is the mind," he said. "Mind indeed is the swiftest among beings. By mind alone it remains as if he has not departed" — so he declared. Then he (Janaka) sang to him: "If he goes far away and becomes careless there, in what does his offered and unoffered oblation in his home (rest) — the one they offer for him?" The Vājasaneya said: "He who is awake among beings — he, the wise one, though traveling, knows. In that rests his offered and unoffered oblation in his home, the one they offer for him." "It is prāṇa," he said. "Prāṇa indeed is the one awake among beings. In prāṇa alone does his offered and unoffered oblation rest. Therefore they say: 'Prāṇa is the agnihotra.'"
meaning: - अग्निहोत्री गृहेभ्यः कथा तद् अस्य काव्यं कथा संततो ऽग्निभिः इति . यद् अग्नीन् आधायाथापप्रवसति कथम् अस्यानपप्रोषितं भवतीति . स होवाच वाजसनेयः यो जविष्ठो भुवनेषु स विद्वान् प्रवसन् विदे तथा तद् अस्य काव्यं तथा संततो ऽग्निभिः इति . मन इति होवाच . मनो वाव भुवनेषु जविष्ठम् . मनसैवास्यानपप्रोषितं भवतीति ह तद् उवाच . अथ हैनम् उपजगौ यत् स दूरं परेत्याथ तत्र प्रमाद्यत् कस्मिन् सास्य हुताहुतिर् गृहे याम् अस्य जुह्वति इति . स होवाच वाजसनेयः यो जागार भुवनेषु स विद्वान् प्रवसन् विदे तस्मिन् सास्य हुताहुतिर् गृहे याम् अस्य जुह्वति इति . प्राण इति होवाच . प्राणो वाव भुवनेषु जागरः . प्राण एवास्य सा हुताहुतिर् भवति . तस्माद् आहुः प्राणो ऽग्निहोत्रम् इति .

sanskrit_iast: raudraṃ gavi vāyavyam upasṛṣṭam āśvinaṃ duhyamānam agnīṣomīyaṃ dugdhaṃ pauṣṇāḥ prendavo maitraś śaro vāruṇam adhiśritaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ pratiṣṭhāpyamānaṃ vaiśvadevam unnītaṃ savituḥ prakrāntaṃ dyāvāpṛthivyor upasannam indrāgnyoḥ pūrvāhutiḥ prajāpater uttarā . tad etat saptadaśam agnihotram . saptadaśa u evā vājapeyaḥ . sa ya evaṃ vidvān agnihotraṃ juhoty ubhāv eva lokāv abhijayati yaś cāgnihotrahuto yaś ca vājapeyayājinaḥ . trayo 'gnihotre sthāṇava iti ha smāha śāṇḍilyaḥ . yad apradīptāyāṃ samidhi juhoti sa sthāṇuḥ . yad enām aparādhnoti sa sthāṇuḥ . yad ene saṃsṛjat sa sthāṇuḥ . ādīptāyai samidhas samunmukhe juhoti . atihāyottarām āhutiṃ juhoti .
sentences: raudraṃ gavi vāyavyam upasr̥ṣṭam āśvinaṃ duhyamānam agnīṣomīyaṃ dugdʰaṃ pauṣṇāḥ prendavo maitraś śaro vāruṇam adʰiśritaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ pratiṣṭʰāpyamānaṃ vaiśvadevam unnītaṃ savituḥ prakrāntaṃ dyāvāpr̥tʰivyor upasannam indrāgnyoḥ pūrvāhutiḥ prajāpater uttarā .
sa ya evaṃ vidvān agnihotraṃ juhoty ubʰāv eva lokāv abʰijayati yaś cāgnihotrahuto yaś ca vājapeyayājinaḥ .
trayo 'gnihotre stʰāṇava iti ha smāha śāṇḍilyaḥ .
yad apradīptāyāṃ samidʰi juhoti sa stʰāṇuḥ .
text: (The agnihotra-milk is) connected with Rudra when in the cow; with Vāyu when released; with the Aśvins when being milked; with Agni-and-Soma when milked; the foam-drops belong to Pūṣan; the stream to Mitra; with Varuṇa when placed on the fire; with Viṣṇu when being settled; with the All-Gods when taken off; with Savitṛ when set forth; with Heaven-and-Earth when brought near; the first oblation belongs to Indra-and-Agni; the latter to Prajāpati. This agnihotra is thus seventeenfold. And the vājapeya is likewise seventeenfold. He who with this knowledge offers the agnihotra conquers both worlds — that which is won by the agnihotra-offerer and that which is won by the vājapeya-sacrificer. "There are three stumbling-blocks in the agnihotra," said Śāṇḍilya. When one offers on a log that has not been kindled — that is a stumbling-block. When one misses it (the right moment) — that is a stumbling-block. When one mixes the two (oblations) together — that is a stumbling-block. One should offer on a kindled log, facing the opening. He should offer the latter oblation having passed beyond (the first).

text: Āruṇi the Vājasaneya, Barku the Vārṣṇa, Priya the Jānaśruteya, Buḍila Āśvatarāśvi the Vaiyāghrapadya — these five were great brahmins. They said: "This Janaka of Videha has been instructed in the agnihotra; he seems to think he surpasses us. Come, we shall engage him in discourse about the agnihotra." They went (to him). They told a student: "Announce us." He announced them. When they had been announced, he prepared separate seats, separate water, separate honey-drinks, separate lodgings, and separate fivefold honors for the five. Then one of their companions came in, having shaved his hair and beard, trimmed his nails, anointed himself with ghee, carrying a staff and sandals. He said to them: "O brahmins, how do your honors converse with us?" "You have spoken beyond us," they said. Then he first asked them: "O brahmins, how do your honors offer the agnihotra?" "You have indeed spoken beyond us," they said, "for you, being one, asked us first who are many."

text: He (Āruṇi) said: "With the thought 'Glory' — thus, O sovereign, I offer the agnihotra. Therefore I am glorious. Glory will be mine to the last among my descendants." He (Janaka) said to him: "Gautama, what is glory?" Pointing to the fire, he said: "This is glory"; and pointing to the sun: "That is glory." "I offer that yonder glory in this glory at evening; I offer this glory in that yonder glory at morning. These two will convey me to where all desires are. These two will drive away repeated death from me." "Well offered! May I be pleasing to the gods!" — so he praised. Then he asked the next: "How, sir, do you offer the agnihotra?" The Vājasaneya said: "With the thought 'Truth' — thus, O sovereign, I offer the agnihotra. Therefore I am truth. Therefore there is radiance about me when I speak truth." He (Janaka) said to him: "Yājñavalkya, what is truth?" Pointing to the fire, he said: "This is truth"; and to the sun: "That is truth." "I offer that yonder truth in this truth at evening; I offer this truth in that yonder truth at morning. These two will convey me to where all desires are. These two will drive away repeated death from me." "Well offered! May I be pleasing to the gods!" — so he praised.

Bओदेwइत्z १९७३, ७७ नोते १३. यश इत्य् अदो यश इत्य् आदित्यम् . सो ऽहम् अदो यशो ऽस्मिन् यशसि सायं जुहोमीदं यशो ऽमुष्मिन् यशसि प्रातर् जुहोमि . एताव् एव मा तद् गमयिष्यतो यत्र सर्वे कामाः . एतौ मे पुनर्मृत्युम् अपजेष्यत इति . सुहुतं देवान् राधयानि इति ह प्रशशंस . अथ हापरं पप्रच्छ : कथा भगवस् त्वम् अग्निहोत्रं जुहोषीति . स होवाच वाजसनेयः : सत्यम् इत्य् एव सम्राड् अहम् अग्निहोत्रम् जुहोमि . तस्माद् अहं सत्यम् अस्मि . तस्मान् मम सत्यम् इव वदतः प्रकाश इति . तं होवाच : याज्ञवल्क्य किं सत्यम् इति . अग्निम् उपदिशन्न् उवाचेदं सत्यम् इत्य् अदः सत्यम् इत्य् आदित्यम् . सो ऽहम् अदः सत्यम् अस्मिन्न् सत्ये सायं जुहोमीदं सत्यम् अमुष्मिन् सत्ये प्रातर् जुहोमि . एताव् एव मा तद् गमयिष्यतो यत्र सर्वे कामाः . एतौ मे पुनर्मृत्युम् अपजेष्यत इति . सुहुतं देवान् राधयानि इति हैव प्रशशंस .
