etāv eva mā tad gamayiṣyato yatra sarve kāmāḥ .
suhutam iti ha praśasyocur : varān vr̥ṇīṣva yān adāmeti .
sa hovācaiṣa eva me varo : 'ham eva yuṣmabʰyaṃ pr̥tʰak pañca sahasrāṇi śatāśvāni dadānīti .
etāni vā agnihotra upāsanāny ete kāmāḥ .
text: Barku the Vārṣṇa said: "With the thought 'The greatest and best of possessions' — thus, O sovereign, I offer the agnihotra. Therefore I possess the greatest and best of possessions. The greatest and best of possessions will be mine to the last among my descendants." He (Janaka) said to him: "Āgniveśya, what is the greatest and best of possessions?" Pointing to the fire, he said: "This is the greatest and best of possessions"; and to the sun: "That is the greatest and best of possessions." "I offer that yonder, the greatest and best of possessions, in this, the greatest and best of possessions, at evening; I offer this, the greatest and best of possessions, in that yonder, the greatest and best of possessions, at morning. These two will convey me to where all desires are. These two will drive away repeated death from me." "Well offered! May I be pleasing to the gods!" — so he praised. Then he asked the next: "How, sir, do you offer the agnihotra?" Priya the Jānaśruteya said: "With the thought 'Splendor' — thus, O sovereign, I offer the agnihotra. Therefore I am splendor. Splendor will be mine to the last among my descendants." He (Janaka) said to him: "Kāṇḍvīya, what is splendor?" Pointing to the fire, he said: "This is splendor"; and to the sun: "That is splendor." "I offer that yonder splendor in this splendor at evening; I offer this splendor in that yonder splendor at morning. These two will convey me to where all desires are. These two will drive away repeated death from me." "Well offered! May I be pleasing to the gods!" — so he praised. Then he asked the next: "How, sir, do you offer the agnihotra?" Buḍila Āśvatarāśvi the Vaiyāghrapadya said: "With the thought 'Arka and the horse-sacrifice' — thus, O sovereign, I offer the agnihotra. For arka is the food of the gods; the horse (aśva) is the sacrifice (medha), the sacrificial victim." He (Janaka) said to him: "Vaiyāghrapadya, what is the arka? What is the horse, the sacrifice, the sacrificial victim?" Pointing to the fire, he said: "This is the arka"; and to the sun: "That is the horse, the sacrifice, the sacrificial victim." "I offer that yonder horse, the sacrifice, the sacrificial victim, in this arka at evening; I offer this arka in that yonder horse, the sacrifice, the sacrificial victim, at morning. These two will convey me to where all desires are. These two will drive away repeated death from me." "Well offered!" — having praised thus, he said: "If anyone should tell me the origin and destination of the agnihotra, to him I would give a boon." They said: "Indeed, we have not taught the origin and destination of the agnihotra. You tell us the origin and destination of the agnihotra; we shall give you separately five boons." Pointing to the fire, he said: "This is the origin"; and to the sun: "That is the destination." "I offer that yonder destination in this origin at evening; I offer this origin in that yonder destination at morning. These two will convey me to where all desires are. These two will drive away repeated death from me." "Well offered!" — having praised thus, they said: "Choose the boons we are to give." He said: "This alone is my boon: I myself shall give to each of you separately five thousand (cows), each accompanied by a hundred horses." These are the meditations on the agnihotra; these are the desires (fulfilled thereby).
meaning: स होवाच बर्कुर् वार्ष्णो भूयिष्ठं श्रेष्ठं वित्तानाम् इत्य् एव सम्राड् अहम् अग्निहोत्रं जुहोमि . तस्माद् अहं भूयिष्ठं श्रेष्ठम् वित्तानाम् अस्मि . भूयिष्ठं वाव मे श्रेष्ठं वित्तानां प्रजायाम् अन्ततो भवितेति . तं होवाचाग्निवेश्य किं भूयिष्ठं श्रेष्ठं वित्तानाम् इति . अग्निम् उपदिषन्न् उवाचेदं भूयिष्ठं श्रेष्ठं वित्तानाम् इत्य् अदो भूयिष्ठं श्रेष्ठं वित्तानाम् इत्य् आदित्यम् . सो ऽहम् अदो भूयिष्ठं श्रेष्ठं वित्तानाम् अस्मिन् भूयिष्ठे श्रेष्ठे वित्तानां सायं जुहोमीदं भूयिष्ठं श्रेष्ठं वित्तानाम् अमुष्मिन् भूयिष्ठे श्रेष्ठे वित्तानाम् प्रातर् जुहोमि . एताव् एव मा तद् गमयिष्यतो यत्र सर्वे कामाः . एतौ मे पुनर्मृत्युम् अपजेष्यत इति . सुहुतं देवान् राधयानि इति हैव प्रशशंस . अथ हापरं पप्रच्छ : कथा भगवस् त्वम् अग्निहोत्रं जुहोषीति . स होवाच प्रियो जानश्रुतेयस् : तेज इत्य् एव सम्राड् अहम् अग्निहोत्रं जुहोमि तस्माद् अहं तेजो ऽस्मि . तेजो वाव मे प्रजायाम् अन्ततो भवितेति . तं होवाच काण्ड्वीय किं तेज इति . अग्निम् उपदिशन्न् उवाचेदं तेज इत्य् अदस् तेज इत्य् आदित्यम् . सो ऽहम् अदस् तेजो ऽस्मिंस् तेजसि सायं जुहोमीदं तेजो ऽमुष्मिंस् तेजसि प्रातर् जुहोमि . एताव् एव मा तद् गमयिष्यतो यत्र सर्वे कामाः . एतौ मे पुनर्मृत्युम् अपजेष्यत इति . सुहुतं देवान् राधयानि इति हैव प्रशशंस . अथ हापरं पप्रच्छ कथा भगवस् त्वम् अग्निहोत्रं जुहोषीति . २४ स होवाच बुडिल आश्वतराश्विर् वैयाघ्रपद्यो ऽर्काश्वमेधाव् इत्य् एव सम्राड् अहम् अग्निहोत्रं जुहोमि . अन्नं ह्य् एतद् देवानां यद् अर्को ऽश्वो मेधो मेध्य इति . तं होवाच वैयाघ्रपद्य को ऽर्कः को ऽश्वो मेधो मेध्य इति . अग्निम् उपदिशन्न् उवाचायम् अर्क इत्य् असाव् अश्वो मेधो मेध्य इत्य् आदित्यम् . सो ऽहम् अमुम् अश्वं मेधं मेध्यम् अस्मिन्न् अर्के सायं जुहोमीमम् अर्कम् अमुष्मिन्न् अश्वे मेधे मेध्ये प्रातर् जुहोमि . एताव् एव मा तद् गमयिष्यतो यत्र सर्वे कामाः . एतौ मे पुनर्मृत्युम् अपजेष्यत इति . सुहुतम् इति ह प्रशस्योवाच : यो ह किल मह्यम् अग्निहोत्र इतिं च गतिं ब्रूयात् तस्मा अहं वरं दद्याम् इति . ते होचुर् : न न्वै वयम् अग्निहोत्र इतिं च गतिं चानूचिमहे त्वम् अस्मभ्यम् अग्निहोत्र इतिं च गतिं च ब्रूहि वयं तुभ्यं पृथक् पञ्च वरान् दद्म इति . अग्निम् उपदिषन्न् उवाचेयम् इतिर् इत्य् असौ गतिर् इत्य् आदित्यम् . सो ऽहम् अमूं गतिम् अस्याम् इतौ सायं जुहोमीमाम् इतिम् अमुष्यां गतौ प्रातर् जुहोमि . एताव् एव मा तद् गमयिष्यतो यत्र सर्वे कामाः . एतौ मे पुनर्मृतुम् अपजेष्यत इति . सुहुतम् इति ह प्रशस्योचुर् : वरान् वृणीष्व यान् अदामेति . स होवाचैष एव मे वरो : ऽहम् एव युष्मभ्यं पृथक् पञ्च सहस्राणि शताश्वानि ददानीति . एतानि वा अग्निहोत्र उपासनान्य् एते कामाः .

sanskrit_iast: agnīn ādadhānaḥ prātar evoddhareta . dvis sāyaṃ dviḥ prātar juhoti . catasra āhutayas saṃpadyante . catuṣpadā vai paśavo ye ca grāmyā ye cāraṇyāḥ . teṣām evaitat pratyāśaṃ pratyapacayati . eṣa vai mṛtyur yad agnī rihann eva nāma . tam eva tābhir āhutibhiś śamayitvā pṛthivīṃ lokānāṃ jayaty agniṃ devaṃ devānām . agner devasya sāyujyaṃ salokatāṃ samabhyārohati ya evaṃ vidvān agnihotraṃ juhoti . sa tato dhūmam eva rathaṃ samāsthāya vāyos salokatām abhiprayāti . dvyahaṃ juhoti . aṣṭāv āhutayas saṃpadyante . aṣṭāśaphā ha vai paśavo ye ca grāmyā ye cāraṇyāḥ . teṣām evaitat pratyāśaṃ pratyapacayati . eṣa vai mṛtyur yad vāyur ajira eva nāma . tam eva tābhir āhutibhiś śamayitvāntarikṣaṃ lokānāṃ jayati vāyuṃ devaṃ devānām .
sentences: catuṣpadā vai paśavo ye ca grāmyā ye cāraṇyāḥ .
eṣa vai mr̥tyur yad agnī rihann eva nāma .
tam eva tābʰir āhutibʰiś śamayitvā pr̥tʰivīṃ lokānāṃ jayaty agniṃ devaṃ devānām .
agner devasya sāyujyaṃ salokatāṃ samabʰyārohati ya evaṃ vidvān agnihotraṃ juhoti .
sa tato dʰūmam eva ratʰaṃ samāstʰāya vāyos salokatām abʰiprayāti .
aṣṭāśapʰā ha vai paśavo ye ca grāmyā ye cāraṇyāḥ .
eṣa vai mr̥tyur yad vāyur ajira eva nāma .
tam eva tābʰir āhutibʰiś śamayitvāntarikṣaṃ lokānāṃ jayati vāyuṃ devaṃ devānām .
text: One who is establishing the fires should take them up in the morning itself. He offers twice in the evening and twice in the morning. Four oblations are thus completed. Four-footed are the domestic and wild animals. Of those he thereby wins a share in return. This Death is the fire, named "the licker" (rihan). Having appeased him with those oblations, he conquers the earth among the worlds, the god Agni among the gods. He ascends to the companionship and co-world of the god Agni — he who with this knowledge offers the agnihotra. Then, mounting the smoke as his chariot, he proceeds to the co-world of Vāyu. He offers for two days. Eight oblations are completed. Eight-hoofed are the domestic and wild animals. Of those he thereby wins a share in return. This Death is Vāyu, named "the swift one" (ajira). Having appeased him with those oblations, he conquers the atmosphere among the worlds, the god Vāyu among the gods.
meaning: अग्नीन् आदधानः प्रातर् एवोद्धरेत . द्विस् सायं द्विः प्रातर् जुहोति . चतस्र आहुतयस् संपद्यन्ते . चतुष्पदा वै पशवो ये च ग्राम्या ये चारण्याः . तेषाम् एवैतत् प्रत्याशं प्रत्यपचयति . एष वै मृत्युर् यद् अग्नी रिहन्न् एव नाम . तम् एव ताभिर् आहुतिभिश् शमयित्वा पृथिवीं लोकानां जयत्य् अग्निं देवं देवानाम् . अग्नेर् देवस्य सायुज्यं सलोकतां समभ्यारोहति य एवं विद्वान् अग्निहोत्रं जुहोति . स ततो धूमम् एव रथं समास्थाय वायोस् सलोकताम् अभिप्रयाति . द्व्यहं जुहोति . अष्टाव् आहुतयस् संपद्यन्ते . अष्टाशफा ह वै पशवो ये च ग्राम्या ये चारण्याः . तेषाम् एवैतत् प्रत्याशं प्रत्यपचयति . एष वै मृत्युर् यद् वायुर् अजिर एव नाम . तम् एव ताभिर् आहुतिभिश् शमयित्वान्तरिक्षं लोकानां जयति वायुं देवं देवानाम् .

sanskrit_iast: sa tato reṣmāṇam eva rathaṃ samāsthāyādityasya salokatām abhiprayāti . tryahaṃ juhoti . dvādaśāhutayas saṃpadyante . dvādaśa māsās saṃvatsaraḥ . saṃvatsaro vā idaṃ sarvam . yad ihāśnāti yat pibati yasmai kasmai cana prativyādadāti sarvaṃ tad asyānaśitaṃ bhavati yāvajjīvānāśakavratī bhavati . eṣa vai mṛtyur yad ādityo mrocann eva nāma . tam eva tābhir āhutibhiś śamayitvā divaṃ lokānāṃ jayaty ādityaṃ devaṃ devānām .
sentences: sa tato reṣmāṇam eva ratʰaṃ samāstʰāyādityasya salokatām abʰiprayāti .
yad ihāśnāti yat pibati yasmai kasmai cana prativyādadāti sarvaṃ tad asyānaśitaṃ bʰavati yāvajjīvānāśakavratī bʰavati .
eṣa vai mr̥tyur yad ādityo mrocann eva nāma .
tam eva tābʰir āhutibʰiś śamayitvā divaṃ lokānāṃ jayaty ādityaṃ devaṃ devānām .
text: Then, mounting a rope as his chariot, he proceeds to the co-world of the sun. He offers for three days. Twelve oblations are completed. Twelve months make a year. The year is this all. Whatever he eats here, whatever he drinks, whatever he gives to anyone — all that becomes as if uneaten by him; he becomes one who has the vow of not-eating for life. This Death is the sun, named "the setting one" (mrocan). Having appeased him with those oblations, he conquers heaven among the worlds, the god Āditya (the sun) among the gods.
meaning: स ततो रेष्माणम् एव रथं समास्थायादित्यस्य सलोकताम् अभिप्रयाति . त्र्यहं जुहोति . द्वादशाहुतयस् संपद्यन्ते . द्वादश मासास् संवत्सरः . संवत्सरो वा इदं सर्वम् . यद् इहाश्नाति यत् पिबति यस्मै कस्मै चन प्रतिव्याददाति सर्वं तद् अस्यानशितं भवति यावज्जीवानाशकव्रती भवति . एष वै मृत्युर् यद् आदित्यो म्रोचन्न् एव नाम . तम् एव ताभिर् आहुतिभिश् शमयित्वा दिवं लोकानां जयत्य् आदित्यं देवं देवानाम् .

sanskrit_iast: sa tato raśmīn eva rathaṃ samāsthāya candramasas salokatām abhiprayāti . caturahaṃ juhoti . ṣoḍaśāhutayas saṃpadyante . ṣoḍaśakalaṃ vai brahma . ṣoḍaśakalā devāḥ . ṣoḍaśakalam idaṃ sakṛt sarvam . sa yad iha ripraṃ pāpaṃ karma karoty ekayaiva tataḥ kalayā . yathā suvarṇaḥ pravṛttas tapyamānas suvarṇatām abhiniṣpadyata evam eva dviṣatsu bhrātṛvyeṣu malaṃ pāpmānaṃ pratyūhya svargaṃ lokam abhipraiti . eṣa vai śaśo ya eṣo 'ntaś candramasi . eṣa hīdaṃ sarvaṃ śāsti . eṣa vai yamo ya eṣo 'ntaś candramasi . eṣa hīdaṃ sarvaṃ yamayati . eṣa mṛtyur yad yamo 'tsyann eva nāma . tam eva tābhir āhutibhiś śamayitvorjaṃ lokānāṃ jayati yamaṃ devaṃ devānām .
sentences: sa tato raśmīn eva ratʰaṃ samāstʰāya candramasas salokatām abʰiprayāti .
sa yad iha ripraṃ pāpaṃ karma karoty ekayaiva tataḥ kalayā .
yatʰā suvarṇaḥ pravr̥ttas tapyamānas suvarṇatām abʰiniṣpadyata evam eva dviṣatsu bʰrātr̥vyeṣu malaṃ pāpmānaṃ pratyūhya svargaṃ lokam abʰipraiti .
eṣa vai śaśo ya eṣo 'ntaś candramasi .
eṣa vai yamo ya eṣo 'ntaś candramasi .
eṣa mr̥tyur yad yamo 'tsyann eva nāma .
tam eva tābʰir āhutibʰiś śamayitvorjaṃ lokānāṃ jayati yamaṃ devaṃ devānām .
text: Then, mounting the rays as his chariot, he proceeds to the co-world of the moon. He offers for four days. Sixteen oblations are completed. Brahman has sixteen parts. The gods have sixteen parts. This all at once has sixteen parts. If he performs here a foul, evil deed — from that, by a single part only (is he affected). Just as a golden (ornament) being turned and heated regains its golden nature, even so, having cast off the impurity and sin upon his hateful rivals, he goes forth to the heavenly world. That which is the hare within the moon — it rules over this all. That which is Yama within the moon — it restrains (yamayati) this all. This Death is Yama, named "the devouring one" (atsyan). Having appeased him with those oblations, he conquers nourishment (ūrj) among the worlds, the god Yama among the gods.
meaning: स ततो रश्मीन् एव रथं समास्थाय चन्द्रमसस् सलोकताम् अभिप्रयाति . चतुरहं जुहोति . षोडशाहुतयस् संपद्यन्ते . षोडशकलं वै ब्रह्म . षोडशकला देवाः . षोडशकलम् इदं सकृत् सर्वम् . स यद् इह रिप्रं पापं कर्म करोत्य् एकयैव ततः कलया . यथा सुवर्णः प्रवृत्तस् तप्यमानस् सुवर्णताम् अभिनिष्पद्यत एवम् एव द्विषत्सु भ्रातृव्येषु मलं पाप्मानं प्रत्यूह्य स्वर्गं लोकम् अभिप्रैति . एष वै शशो य एषो ऽन्तश् चन्द्रमसि . एष हीदं सर्वं शास्ति . एष वै यमो य एषो ऽन्तश् चन्द्रमसि . एष हीदं सर्वं यमयति . एष मृत्युर् यद् यमो ऽत्स्यन्न् एव नाम . तम् एव ताभिर् आहुतिभिश् शमयित्वोर्जं लोकानां जयति यमं देवं देवानाम् .

sanskrit_iast: sa tatas svadhām eva hiraṇmayīṃ nāvaṃ samāruhya prajāpates salokatām abhiprayāti . pañcāhaṃ juhoti . viṃśatir āhutayas saṃpadyante . saviṃśo vai prajāpatiḥ . eṣa vai mṛtyur yat prajāpatiḥ prabhūmān eva nāma . tam eva tābhir āhutibhiś śamayitvā nabho lokānāṃ jayati prajāpatiṃ devaṃ devānām .
sentences: sa tatas svadʰām eva hiraṇmayīṃ nāvaṃ samāruhya prajāpates salokatām abʰiprayāti .
eṣa vai mr̥tyur yat prajāpatiḥ prabʰūmān eva nāma .
tam eva tābʰir āhutibʰiś śamayitvā nabʰo lokānāṃ jayati prajāpatiṃ devaṃ devānām .
text: Then, boarding a golden ship called Svadhā, he proceeds to the co-world of Prajāpati. He offers for five days. Twenty oblations are completed. Prajāpati is of twenty (parts). This Death is Prajāpati, named "the lord of abundance" (prabhūmān). Having appeased him with those oblations, he conquers the firmament (nabhas) among the worlds, the god Prajāpati among the gods.
meaning: स ततस् स्वधाम् एव हिरण्मयीं नावं समारुह्य प्रजापतेस् सलोकताम् अभिप्रयाति . पञ्चाहं जुहोति . विंशतिर् आहुतयस् संपद्यन्ते . सविंशो वै प्रजापतिः . एष वै मृत्युर् यत् प्रजापतिः प्रभूमान् एव नाम . तम् एव ताभिर् आहुतिभिश् शमयित्वा नभो लोकानां जयति प्रजापतिं देवं देवानाम् .

sanskrit_iast: tad yad vai tannabho nāmābhīr vai sā . na hi tat prāpya kasmāc cana bibheti . tasmāt tannabhaḥ . ṣaḍahaṃ juhoti . caturviṃśatir āhutayaḥ saṃpadyante . caturviṃśatyakṣarā vai gāyatrī . caturviṃśatir vasavo devāḥ . te gāyatrīm anvāyattāḥ . tebhyo gāyatrīva vasubhyo devebhya ekaikenākṣareṇa kāmān nikāmān (atikāmān ?) duhe . evam asmai juhvate duhe . gāyatrīṃ sa chandasāṃ jayati vasūn devān devānām .
sentences: tad yad vai tannabʰo nāmābʰīr vai sā .
na hi tat prāpya kasmāc cana bibʰeti .
tebʰyo gāyatrīva vasubʰyo devebʰya ekaikenākṣareṇa kāmān nikāmān (atikāmān ?) duhe .
gāyatrīṃ sa cʰandasāṃ jayati vasūn devān devānām .
text: Now that which is called nabhas — that is fearlessness (abhī). For having reached that, one fears nothing whatsoever. Therefore it is nabhas. He offers for six days. Twenty-four oblations are completed. The gāyatrī has twenty-four syllables. Twenty-four are the Vasu gods. They are dependent upon the gāyatrī. For them the gāyatrī, like (a cow) for the Vasus, the gods, milks out desires and more desires, by each single syllable. Even so she milks for the one who offers thus. He conquers the gāyatrī among the meters, the Vasus among the gods.
meaning: तद् यद् वै तन्नभो नामाभीर् वै सा . न हि तत् प्राप्य कस्माच् चन बिभेति . तस्मात् तन्नभः . षडहं जुहोति . चतुर्विंशतिर् आहुतयः संपद्यन्ते . चतुर्विंशत्यक्षरा वै गायत्री . चतुर्विंशतिर् वसवो देवाः . ते गायत्रीम् अन्वायत्ताः . तेभ्यो गायत्रीव वसुभ्यो देवेभ्य एकैकेनाक्षरेण कामान् निकामान् (अतिकामान् ?) दुहे . एवम् अस्मै जुह्वते दुहे . गायत्रीं स छन्दसां जयति वसून् देवान् देवानाम् .

sanskrit_iast: saptāhaṃ juhoti . aṣṭāviṃśatir āhutayas saṃpadyante . aṣṭāviṃśatyakṣarā vā uṣṇik . aṣṭāviṃśatir bhṛgvaṅgiraso devāḥ . ta uṣṇiham anvāyattāḥ . tebhya uṣṇig bhṛgvaṅgirobhyo devebhya ekaikenākṣareṇa kāmān nikāmān duhe . evam asmai juhvate duhe . uṣṇihaṃ vai sa chandasāṃ jayati bhṛgvaṅgiraso devān devānām .
sentences: tebʰya uṣṇig bʰr̥gvaṅgirobʰyo devebʰya ekaikenākṣareṇa kāmān nikāmān duhe .
uṣṇihaṃ vai sa cʰandasāṃ jayati bʰr̥gvaṅgiraso devān devānām .
text: He offers for seven days. Twenty-eight oblations are completed. The uṣṇih has twenty-eight syllables. Twenty-eight are the Bhṛgv-Aṅgiras gods. They are dependent upon the uṣṇih. For them the uṣṇih, like (a cow) for the Bhṛgv-Aṅgiras gods, milks out desires and more desires, by each single syllable. Even so she milks for the one who offers thus. He conquers the uṣṇih among the meters, the Bhṛgv-Aṅgirases among the gods.
meaning: सप्ताहं जुहोति . अष्टाविंशतिर् आहुतयस् संपद्यन्ते . अष्टाविंशत्यक्षरा वा उष्णिक् . अष्टाविंशतिर् भृग्वङ्गिरसो देवाः . त उष्णिहम् अन्वायत्ताः . तेभ्य उष्णिग् भृग्वङ्गिरोभ्यो देवेभ्य एकैकेनाक्षरेण कामान् निकामान् दुहे . एवम् अस्मै जुह्वते दुहे . उष्णिहं वै स छन्दसां जयति भृग्वङ्गिरसो देवान् देवानाम् .

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭāhaṃ juhoti . dvātriṃśad āhutayas saṃpadyante . dvātriṃśadakṣarā vā anuṣṭup . dvātriṃśad viśve devāḥ . te 'nuṣṭubham anvāyattāḥ . tebhyo 'nuṣṭub viśvebhyo devebhya ekaikenākṣareṇa kāmān nikāmān duhe . evam asmai juhvate duhe . anuṣṭubhaṃ vai sa chandasāṃ jayati viśvān devān devānām .
sentences: tebʰyo 'nuṣṭub viśvebʰyo devebʰya ekaikenākṣareṇa kāmān nikāmān duhe .
anuṣṭubʰaṃ vai sa cʰandasāṃ jayati viśvān devān devānām .
text: He offers for eight days. Thirty-two oblations are completed. The anuṣṭubh indeed has thirty-two syllables. The Viśve Devāḥ are thirty-two. They are dependent upon the anuṣṭubh. For them the anuṣṭubh milks desires and fulfillments from the Viśve Devāḥ with each single syllable. Thus it milks for him who offers. He wins the anuṣṭubh among the meters, the Viśve Devāḥ among the gods.
meaning: अष्टाहं जुहोति . द्वात्रिंशद् आहुतयस् संपद्यन्ते . द्वात्रिंशदक्षरा वा अनुष्टुप् . द्वात्रिंशद् विश्वे देवाः . ते ऽनुष्टुभम् अन्वायत्ताः . तेभ्यो ऽनुष्टुब् विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्य एकैकेनाक्षरेण कामान् निकामान् दुहे . एवम् अस्मै जुह्वते दुहे . अनुष्टुभं वै स छन्दसां जयति विश्वान् देवान् देवानाम् .

sanskrit_iast: navāhaṃ juhoti . ṣaṭtriṃśad āhutayas saṃpadyante . ṣaṛtriṃśadakṣarā vai bṛhatī . ṣaṭtriṃśat sādhyā devāḥ . te bṛhatīm anvāyattāḥ . tebhyo bṛhatī sādhyebhyo devebhya akaikenākṣareṇa kāmān nikāmān duhe . evam asmai juhvate duhe . bṛhatīṃ vai sa chandasāṃ jayati sādhyān devān devānām .
sentences: tebʰyo br̥hatī sādʰyebʰyo devebʰya akaikenākṣareṇa kāmān nikāmān duhe .
br̥hatīṃ vai sa cʰandasāṃ jayati sādʰyān devān devānām .
text: He offers for nine days. Thirty-six oblations are completed. The bṛhatī indeed has thirty-six syllables. The Sādhya gods are thirty-six. They are dependent upon the bṛhatī. For them the bṛhatī milks desires and fulfillments from the Sādhya gods with each single syllable. Thus it milks for him who offers. He wins the bṛhatī among the meters, the Sādhya gods among the gods.
meaning: नवाहं जुहोति . षट्त्रिंशद् आहुतयस् संपद्यन्ते . षऋत्रिंशदक्षरा वै बृहती . षट्त्रिंशत् साध्या देवाः . ते बृहतीम् अन्वायत्ताः . तेभ्यो बृहती साध्येभ्यो देवेभ्य अकैकेनाक्षरेण कामान् निकामान् दुहे . एवम् अस्मै जुह्वते दुहे . बृहतीं वै स छन्दसां जयति साध्यान् देवान् देवानाम् .

sanskrit_iast: daśāhaṃ juhoti . catvāriṃśad āhutayas saṃpadyante . catvāriṃśadakṣarā vai paṅktiḥ . catvāriṃśan maruto devāḥ . te paṅktim anvāyattāḥ . tebhyaḥ paṅktir marudbhyo devebhya ekaikenākṣareṇa kāmān nikāmān duhe . evam asmai juhvate duhe . pāṅktiṃ vai sa chandasāṃ jayati maruto devān devānām .
sentences: tebʰyaḥ paṅktir marudbʰyo devebʰya ekaikenākṣareṇa kāmān nikāmān duhe .
pāṅktiṃ vai sa cʰandasāṃ jayati maruto devān devānām .
text: He offers for ten days. Forty oblations are completed. The paṅkti indeed has forty syllables. The Marut gods are forty. They are dependent upon the paṅkti. For them the paṅkti milks desires and fulfillments from the Marut gods with each single syllable. Thus it milks for him who offers. He wins the paṅkti among the meters, the Maruts among the gods.
meaning: दशाहं जुहोति . चत्वारिंशद् आहुतयस् संपद्यन्ते . चत्वारिंशदक्षरा वै पङ्क्तिः . चत्वारिंशन् मरुतो देवाः . ते पङ्क्तिम् अन्वायत्ताः . तेभ्यः पङ्क्तिर् मरुद्भ्यो देवेभ्य एकैकेनाक्षरेण कामान् निकामान् दुहे . एवम् अस्मै जुह्वते दुहे . पाङ्क्तिं वै स छन्दसां जयति मरुतो देवान् देवानाम् .

sanskrit_iast: ekādaśāhaṃ juhoti . catuścatvāriṃśad āhutayas saṃpadyante . catuścatvāriṃśadakṣarā vai triṣṭup . catuścatvāriṃśad rudrā devāḥ . te triṣṭubham anvāyattāḥ . tebhyas triṣṭub rudrebhyo devebhya ekaikenākṣareṇa kāmān nikāmān duhe . evam asmai juhvate duhe . triṣṭubhaṃ vai chandasāṃ jayati rudrān devān devānām .
sentences: tebʰyas triṣṭub rudrebʰyo devebʰya ekaikenākṣareṇa kāmān nikāmān duhe .
triṣṭubʰaṃ vai cʰandasāṃ jayati rudrān devān devānām .
text: He offers for eleven days. Forty-four oblations are completed. The triṣṭubh indeed has forty-four syllables. The Rudra gods are forty-four. They are dependent upon the triṣṭubh. For them the triṣṭubh milks desires and fulfillments from the Rudra gods with each single syllable. Thus it milks for him who offers. He wins the triṣṭubh among the meters, the Rudras among the gods.
meaning: एकादशाहं जुहोति . चतुश्चत्वारिंशद् आहुतयस् संपद्यन्ते . चतुश्चत्वारिंशदक्षरा वै त्रिष्टुप् . चतुश्चत्वारिंशद् रुद्रा देवाः . ते त्रिष्टुभम् अन्वायत्ताः . तेभ्यस् त्रिष्टुब् रुद्रेभ्यो देवेभ्य एकैकेनाक्षरेण कामान् निकामान् दुहे . एवम् अस्मै जुह्वते दुहे . त्रिष्टुभं वै छन्दसां जयति रुद्रान् देवान् देवानाम् .

sanskrit_iast: dvādaśāhaṃ juhoti . aṣṭācatvāriṃśad āhutayas saṃpadyante . aṣṭācatvāriṃśadakṣarā vai jagatī . aṣṭācatvāriṃśad ādityā devāḥ . te jagatīm anvāyattāḥ . tebhyo jagaty ādityebhyo devebhya ekaikenākṣareṇa kāmān nikāmān duhe . evam asmai juhvate duhe . jagatīṃ vai sa chandasāṃ jayaty ādityān devān devānām .
sentences: tebʰyo jagaty ādityebʰyo devebʰya ekaikenākṣareṇa kāmān nikāmān duhe .
jagatīṃ vai sa cʰandasāṃ jayaty ādityān devān devānām .
text: He offers for twelve days. Forty-eight oblations are completed. The jagatī indeed has forty-eight syllables. The Āditya gods are forty-eight. They are dependent upon the jagatī. For them the jagatī milks desires and fulfillments from the Āditya gods with each single syllable. Thus it milks for him who offers. He wins the jagatī among the meters, the Ādityas among the gods.
meaning: द्वादशाहं जुहोति . अष्टाचत्वारिंशद् आहुतयस् संपद्यन्ते . अष्टाचत्वारिंशदक्षरा वै जगती . अष्टाचत्वारिंशद् आदित्या देवाः . ते जगतीम् अन्वायत्ताः . तेभ्यो जगत्य् आदित्येभ्यो देवेभ्य एकैकेनाक्षरेण कामान् निकामान् दुहे . एवम् अस्मै जुह्वते दुहे . जगतीं वै स छन्दसां जयत्य् आदित्यान् देवान् देवानाम् .

sanskrit_iast: atra vai brahma na virājaty anātham aparāyaṇam anuttaram . tad vai tad agnihotraṃ dvādaśāhaṃ brahma juhuvāṃ cakāra . tad dvādaśāhaṃ hutvā kīrtiṃ yaśaḥ prajātim amṛtaṃ tad udājahāra . tad vai tad agnihotraṃ dvādaśāhaṃ brahma hutvā prajāpataye pratyūhya svargaṃ lokam abhyuccakrāma . tad vai tad agnihotraṃ dvādaśāhaṃ prajāpatir juhuvāṃ cakāra . tad dvādaśāhaṃ hutvā prajñāṃ medhāṃ mīmāṃsāṃ tapas tad udājahāra . tad vai tad agnihotraṃ dvādaśāhaṃ prajāpatir hutvā devebhyaś carṣibhyaś ca pratyūhya svargam eva lokam abhyuccakrāma . tad vai tad agnihotraṃ dvādaśāhaṃ devāś carṣayaś ca juhuvāṃ cakruḥ . tad dvādaśāhaṃ hutvā pūrvebhyo manuṣyebhyaḥ pratyūhya svargam u eva lokam abhyuccakrāmuḥ . tad vai tad agnihotraṃ dvādaśāhaṃ brahma juhuvāṃ cakāra . dvādaśāhaṃ prajāpatir dvādaśāhaṃ devāś carṣayaś ca . tad dvādaśāhaṃ-dvādaśāhaṃ hutvā kāmān nikāmān āpuḥ .
sentences: atra vai brahma na virājaty anātʰam aparāyaṇam anuttaram .
tad vai tad agnihotraṃ dvādaśāhaṃ brahma juhuvāṃ cakāra .
tad dvādaśāhaṃ hutvā kīrtiṃ yaśaḥ prajātim amr̥taṃ tad udājahāra .
tad vai tad agnihotraṃ dvādaśāhaṃ brahma hutvā prajāpataye pratyūhya svargaṃ lokam abʰyuccakrāma .
tad vai tad agnihotraṃ dvādaśāhaṃ prajāpatir juhuvāṃ cakāra .
tad dvādaśāhaṃ hutvā prajñāṃ medʰāṃ mīmāṃsāṃ tapas tad udājahāra .
tad vai tad agnihotraṃ dvādaśāhaṃ prajāpatir hutvā devebʰyaś carṣibʰyaś ca pratyūhya svargam eva lokam abʰyuccakrāma .
tad vai tad agnihotraṃ dvādaśāhaṃ devāś carṣayaś ca juhuvāṃ cakruḥ .
tad dvādaśāhaṃ hutvā pūrvebʰyo manuṣyebʰyaḥ pratyūhya svargam u eva lokam abʰyuccakrāmuḥ .
tad vai tad agnihotraṃ dvādaśāhaṃ brahma juhuvāṃ cakāra .
dvādaśāhaṃ prajāpatir dvādaśāhaṃ devāś carṣayaś ca .
tad dvādaśāhaṃ-dvādaśāhaṃ hutvā kāmān nikāmān āpuḥ .
text: Here indeed brahman did not shine forth — without support, without refuge, without anything beyond. That agnihotra, brahman offered for twelve days. Having offered for twelve days, it brought forth fame, glory, progeny, and immortality. That agnihotra, having offered for twelve days, brahman, having handed it over to Prajāpati, ascended to the heavenly world. That agnihotra, Prajāpati offered for twelve days. Having offered for twelve days, he brought forth insight, intelligence, reflection, and austerity. That agnihotra, having offered for twelve days, Prajāpati, having handed it over to the gods and the ṛṣis, ascended to the very heavenly world. That agnihotra, the gods and the ṛṣis offered for twelve days. Having offered for twelve days, they handed it over to the former men and ascended to the very heavenly world. That agnihotra, brahman offered for twelve days; Prajāpati for twelve days; the gods and the ṛṣis for twelve days. Having offered for twelve days each, they obtained desires and fulfillments.
meaning: अत्र वै ब्रह्म न विराजत्य् अनाथम् अपरायणम् अनुत्तरम् . तद् वै तद् अग्निहोत्रं द्वादशाहं ब्रह्म जुहुवां चकार . तद् द्वादशाहं हुत्वा कीर्तिं यशः प्रजातिम् अमृतं तद् उदाजहार . तद् वै तद् अग्निहोत्रं द्वादशाहं ब्रह्म हुत्वा प्रजापतये प्रत्यूह्य स्वर्गं लोकम् अभ्युच्चक्राम . तद् वै तद् अग्निहोत्रं द्वादशाहं प्रजापतिर् जुहुवां चकार . तद् द्वादशाहं हुत्वा प्रज्ञां मेधां मीमांसां तपस् तद् उदाजहार . तद् वै तद् अग्निहोत्रं द्वादशाहं प्रजापतिर् हुत्वा देवेभ्यश् चर्षिभ्यश् च प्रत्यूह्य स्वर्गम् एव लोकम् अभ्युच्चक्राम . तद् वै तद् अग्निहोत्रं द्वादशाहं देवाश् चर्षयश् च जुहुवां चक्रुः . तद् द्वादशाहं हुत्वा पूर्वेभ्यो मनुष्येभ्यः प्रत्यूह्य स्वर्गम् उ एव लोकम् अभ्युच्चक्रामुः . तद् वै तद् अग्निहोत्रं द्वादशाहं ब्रह्म जुहुवां चकार . द्वादशाहं प्रजापतिर् द्वादशाहं देवाश् चर्षयश् च . तद् द्वादशाहं-द्वादशाहं हुत्वा कामान् निकामान् आपुः .

sanskrit_iast: tad vai tad agnihotraṃ tryaham eva payasā juhuyāt . tad vā agniṣṭomasya rūpam . agniṣṭomenaivāsyeṣṭaṃ bhavati ya evaṃ vidvān agnihotraṃ juhoti . tad vai tad agnihotraṃ tryaham eva dadhnā juhuyāt . tad vai vājapeyasya rūpam . vājapeyenaivāsyeṣṭaṃ bhavati ya evaṃ vidvān agnihotraṃ juhoti . tad vai tad agnihotraṃ tryaham evājyena juhuyāt . tad vā aśvamedhasya rūpam . aśvamedhenaivāsyeṣṭaṃ bhavati ya evaṃ vidvān agnihotraṃ juhoti . tad vai tad agnihotraṃ tryaham evādbhir juhuyāt . tad vai puruṣamedhasya rūpam . puruṣamedhenaivāsyeṣṭaṃ bhavati ya evaṃ vidvān agnihotraṃ juhoti . svayam ahatavāsā yajamāno 'gnihotraṃ juhuyād ajasreṣv agniṣv apravasan . trayodaśīṃ rātriṃ somena vā paśunā veṣṭvotsṛjeta . yathā sāvasān kṛtvā prārjayet tādṛk tat . tad vai tad agnihotraṃ dvādaśāham eva pūrve manuṣyā juhuvāṃ cakruḥ .
sentences: tad vai tad agnihotraṃ tryaham eva payasā juhuyāt .
agniṣṭomenaivāsyeṣṭaṃ bʰavati ya evaṃ vidvān agnihotraṃ juhoti .
tad vai tad agnihotraṃ tryaham eva dadʰnā juhuyāt .

text: One should offer that agnihotra for just three days with milk. That is the form of the agniṣṭoma. It is as if the agniṣṭoma has been performed for him who, knowing thus, offers the agnihotra. One should offer that agnihotra for just three days with curds. That is the form of the vājapeya. It is as if the vājapeya has been performed for him who, knowing thus, offers the agnihotra. One should offer that agnihotra for just three days with ghee. That is the form of the aśvamedha. It is as if the aśvamedha has been performed for him who, knowing thus, offers the agnihotra. One should offer that agnihotra for just three days with water. That is the form of the puruṣamedha. It is as if the puruṣamedha has been performed for him who, knowing thus, offers the agnihotra. The sacrificer himself, wearing unworn garments, should offer the agnihotra while the fires are unextinguished, without traveling away from home. On the thirteenth night, having sacrificed with soma or with an animal-offering, he should release himself. It is like one who, having incurred debts, then earns enough to pay them off — such is that. That agnihotra, the former men offered for just twelve days.
meaning: तद् वै तद् अग्निहोत्रं त्र्यहम् एव पयसा जुहुयात् . तद् वा अग्निष्टोमस्य रूपम् . अग्निष्टोमेनैवास्येष्टं भवति य एवं विद्वान् अग्निहोत्रं जुहोति . तद् वै तद् अग्निहोत्रं त्र्यहम् एव दध्ना जुहुयात् . तद् वै वाजपेयस्य रूपम् . वाजपेयेनैवास्येष्टं भवति य एवं विद्वान् अग्निहोत्रं जुहोति . तद् वै तद् अग्निहोत्रं त्र्यहम् एवाज्येन जुहुयात् . तद् वा अश्वमेधस्य रूपम् . अश्वमेधेनैवास्येष्टं भवति य एवं विद्वान् अग्निहोत्रं जुहोति . तद् वै तद् अग्निहोत्रं त्र्यहम् एवाद्भिर् जुहुयात् . तद् वै पुरुषमेधस्य रूपम् . पुरुषमेधेनैवास्येष्टं भवति य एवं विद्वान् अग्निहोत्रं जुहोति . स्वयम् अहतवासा यजमानो ऽग्निहोत्रं जुहुयाद् अजस्रेष्व् अग्निष्व् अप्रवसन् . त्रयोदशीं रात्रिं सोमेन वा पशुना वेष्ट्वोत्सृजेत . यथा सावसान् कृत्वा प्रार्जयेत् तादृक् तत् . तद् वै तद् अग्निहोत्रं द्वादशाहम् एव पूर्वे मनुष्या जुहुवां चक्रुः .

sanskrit_iast: upasṛjyāgnihotrīm ity āha upasṛṣṭe dyāvāpṛthivī . rudrā upagṛhṇanti vasūnāṃ dugdham . bhūtakṛta stha nirūḍha janyaṃ bhayam ity aṅgārān nirūhati . athādhiśrayati vaiśvānarasyādhiśretam asi . agnis te tejo mā pratidhākṣīt . satyāya tvā iti . athāvadyotayati saṃ jyotiṣā jyotiḥ iti . athāpaḥ pratyānayati yas te apsu rasaḥ praviṣṭas tena saṃpṛcyasva iti . sa yad evāsya tatra diśo grasante tad evāsya tat samanvānayati antaritaṃ rakṣo 'ntaritā arātayaḥ iti . triḥ paryagni karoti . athodvāsayati divaṃ dṛṃhāntarikṣaṃ dṛṃha pṛthivīṃ dṛṃha prajāṃ paśūn juhvato me dṛha iti . bhūtakṛta stha pratyūḍhaṃ janyaṃ bhayam ity aṅgārān pratyūhati . atha sravaṃ ca srucaṃ cādāya niṣṭapati pratyuṣṭaṃ rakṣaḥ pratuṣṭā arātayaḥ iti . atha srucaṃ saṃmārṣṭi sajūr devebhyas sāyaṃyāvabhyaḥ iti sāyam . sajūr devebhyaḥ prātaryāvabhyaḥ iti prātaḥ . suvarṇāṃ tvāṃ suvarṇamayīm . hiraṇyayaṣṭir asy amṛtapalāśā sroto yajñānām iti . sroto haiva sa yajñānāṃ bhavati . athāha unneṣyāmi iti .
sentences: bʰūtakr̥ta stʰa nirūḍʰa janyaṃ bʰayam ity aṅgārān nirūhati .
atʰāpaḥ pratyānayati yas te apsu rasaḥ praviṣṭas tena saṃpr̥cyasva iti .
sa yad evāsya tatra diśo grasante tad evāsya tat samanvānayati antaritaṃ rakṣo 'ntaritā arātayaḥ iti .
atʰodvāsayati divaṃ dr̥ṃhāntarikṣaṃ dr̥ṃha pr̥tʰivīṃ dr̥ṃha prajāṃ paśūn juhvato me dr̥ha iti .
bʰūtakr̥ta stʰa pratyūḍʰaṃ janyaṃ bʰayam ity aṅgārān pratyūhati .
atʰa sravaṃ ca srucaṃ cādāya niṣṭapati pratyuṣṭaṃ rakṣaḥ pratuṣṭā arātayaḥ iti .
atʰa srucaṃ saṃmārṣṭi sajūr devebʰyas sāyaṃyāvabʰyaḥ iti sāyam .
hiraṇyayaṣṭir asy amr̥tapalāśā sroto yajñānām iti .
text: He says "Release the agnihotra cow"; heaven and earth are released. The Rudras seize the milk of the Vasus. "You are makers of what exists; the danger from enemies has been removed" — thus he removes the embers. Then he places it on the fire: "You are placed on the fire for Vaiśvānara. May Agni not burn away your splendor. For truth I (prepare) you." Then he makes it blaze up: "Light with light." Then he brings back the waters: "That sap of yours which has entered the waters, unite with it." Whatever the directions swallow of his in that (process), that he brings back together: "The rakṣas is shut out, the hostile powers are shut out." He makes the fire go around three times. Then he takes it off the fire: "Strengthen heaven, strengthen the atmosphere, strengthen the earth; strengthen progeny and cattle for me who offer." "You are makers of what exists; the danger from enemies has been driven back" — thus he pushes back the embers. Then, taking the ladle and the offering spoon, he heats them: "The rakṣas is scorched away, the hostile powers are scorched away." Then he wipes the offering spoon: "Together with the gods who come in the evening" — in the evening; "Together with the gods who come in the morning" — in the morning. "You of beautiful color, you of golden substance, you are the golden-shafted one, of immortal leaves, the stream of sacrifices." He indeed becomes the stream of sacrifices. Then he says, "I shall lift up."
meaning: उपसृज्याग्निहोत्रीम् इत्य् आह उपसृष्टे द्यावापृथिवी . रुद्रा उपगृह्णन्ति वसूनां दुग्धम् . भूतकृत स्थ निरूढ जन्यं भयम् इत्य् अङ्गारान् निरूहति . अथाधिश्रयति वैश्वानरस्याधिश्रेतम् असि . अग्निस् ते तेजो मा प्रतिधाक्षीत् . सत्याय त्वा इति . अथावद्योतयति सं ज्योतिषा ज्योतिः इति . अथापः प्रत्यानयति यस् ते अप्सु रसः प्रविष्टस् तेन संपृच्यस्व इति . स यद् एवास्य तत्र दिशो ग्रसन्ते तद् एवास्य तत् समन्वानयति अन्तरितं रक्षो ऽन्तरिता अरातयः इति . त्रिः पर्यग्नि करोति . अथोद्वासयति दिवं दृंहान्तरिक्षं दृंह पृथिवीं दृंह प्रजां पशून् जुह्वतो मे दृह इति . भूतकृत स्थ प्रत्यूढं जन्यं भयम् इत्य् अङ्गारान् प्रत्यूहति . अथ स्रवं च स्रुचं चादाय निष्टपति प्रत्युष्टं रक्षः प्रतुष्टा अरातयः इति . अथ स्रुचं संमार्ष्टि सजूर् देवेभ्यस् सायंयावभ्यः इति सायम् . सजूर् देवेभ्यः प्रातर्यावभ्यः इति प्रातः . सुवर्णां त्वां सुवर्णमयीम् . हिरण्ययष्टिर् अस्य् अमृतपलाशा स्रोतो यज्ञानाम् इति . स्रोतो हैव स यज्ञानां भवति . अथाह उन्नेष्यामि इति .

sanskrit_iast: sa yaṃ prathamaṃ sruvam unnayati tad vai darśapūrṇamāsayo rūpam . darśapūrṇamāsābhyām evāsyeṣṭaṃ bhavati ya evaṃ vidvān prathamaṃ sruvam unnayati . atha yaṃ dvitīyaṃ sruvam tad vai cāturmāsyānāṃ rūpam . cāturmāsyair evāsyeṣṭaṃ bhavati ya evam vidvān dvitīyaṃ sruvam unnayati . atha yaṃ tṛtīyaṃ sruvam unnayati tad vā iṣṭipaśubandhānāṃ rūpam . iṣṭipaśubandhair evāsyeṣṭaṃ bhavati ya evaṃ vidvāṃs tṛtīyaṃ sruvam unnayati . atha yaṃ caturthaṃ sruvam unnayati tad vai tryambakavājapeyāśvamedhānāṃ rūpam . tryambakavājapeyāśvamedhair evāsyeṣṭaṃ bhavati ya evaṃ vidvāṃś caturthaṃ sruvam unnayati . atha samidham ādāya prāṅ prati . puruṣa it samit . tam annam inddhe annasya mā tejasā svargaṃ lokaṃ gamaya . yatra devānām ṛṣīṇāṃ priyaṃ dhāma tatra ma idam agnihotraṃ gamaya iti tūṣṇīm upasādayati . atha samidham abhyādadhāti svargasya tvā lokasya saṃkramaṇaṃ hiraṇmayaṃ vaṃśaṃ dadhāmi svāhā iti . atha juhoti . sa yāṃ prathamāṃ juhoti devāṃs tayāpnoti .
sentences: sa yaṃ pratʰamaṃ sruvam unnayati tad vai darśapūrṇamāsayo rūpam .
darśapūrṇamāsābʰyām evāsyeṣṭaṃ bʰavati ya evaṃ vidvān pratʰamaṃ sruvam unnayati .
atʰa yaṃ dvitīyaṃ sruvam tad vai cāturmāsyānāṃ rūpam .
cāturmāsyair evāsyeṣṭaṃ bʰavati ya evam vidvān dvitīyaṃ sruvam unnayati .
atʰa yaṃ tr̥tīyaṃ sruvam unnayati tad vā iṣṭipaśubandʰānāṃ rūpam .
iṣṭipaśubandʰair evāsyeṣṭaṃ bʰavati ya evaṃ vidvāṃs tr̥tīyaṃ sruvam unnayati .
atʰa yaṃ caturtʰaṃ sruvam unnayati tad vai tryambakavājapeyāśvamedʰānāṃ rūpam .
tryambakavājapeyāśvamedʰair evāsyeṣṭaṃ bʰavati ya evaṃ vidvāṃś caturtʰaṃ sruvam unnayati .
tam annam inddʰe annasya mā tejasā svargaṃ lokaṃ gamaya .
yatra devānām r̥ṣīṇāṃ priyaṃ dʰāma tatra ma idam agnihotraṃ gamaya iti tūṣṇīm upasādayati .
atʰa samidʰam abʰyādadʰāti svargasya tvā lokasya saṃkramaṇaṃ hiraṇmayaṃ vaṃśaṃ dadʰāmi svāhā iti .
sa yāṃ pratʰamāṃ juhoti devāṃs tayāpnoti .
text: The first ladleful that he lifts up — that is the form of the darśapūrṇamāsa (new- and full-moon sacrifices). It is as if the darśapūrṇamāsa has been performed for him who, knowing thus, lifts up the first ladleful. The second ladleful — that is the form of the cāturmāsya (seasonal sacrifices). It is as if the cāturmāsya has been performed for him who, knowing thus, lifts up the second ladleful. The third ladleful that he lifts up — that is the form of the iṣṭi and paśubandha (animal sacrifices). It is as if the iṣṭi and paśubandha have been performed for him who, knowing thus, lifts up the third ladleful. The fourth ladleful that he lifts up — that is the form of the tryambaka, vājapeya, and aśvamedha. It is as if the tryambaka, vājapeya, and aśvamedha have been performed for him who, knowing thus, lifts up the fourth ladleful. Then, taking a fuel-stick, (he goes) eastward. The person is the fuel-stick. Him he kindles with food: "By the splendor of food, convey me to the heavenly world. Where the dear abode of the gods and ṛṣis is, there let this agnihotra convey me" — thus he silently places it down. Then he lays on the fuel-stick: "I place you as a golden rung, a crossing to the heavenly world, svāhā." Then he offers. With the first oblation that he offers, he reaches the gods.
meaning: स यं प्रथमं स्रुवम् उन्नयति तद् वै दर्शपूर्णमासयो रूपम् . दर्शपूर्णमासाभ्याम् एवास्येष्टं भवति य एवं विद्वान् प्रथमं स्रुवम् उन्नयति . अथ यं द्वितीयं स्रुवम् तद् वै चातुर्मास्यानां रूपम् . चातुर्मास्यैर् एवास्येष्टं भवति य एवम् विद्वान् द्वितीयं स्रुवम् उन्नयति . अथ यं तृतीयं स्रुवम् उन्नयति तद् वा इष्टिपशुबन्धानां रूपम् . इष्टिपशुबन्धैर् एवास्येष्टं भवति य एवं विद्वांस् तृतीयं स्रुवम् उन्नयति . अथ यं चतुर्थं स्रुवम् उन्नयति तद् वै त्र्यम्बकवाजपेयाश्वमेधानां रूपम् . त्र्यम्बकवाजपेयाश्वमेधैर् एवास्येष्टं भवति य एवं विद्वांश् चतुर्थं स्रुवम् उन्नयति . अथ समिधम् आदाय प्राङ् प्रति . पुरुष इत् समित् . तम् अन्नम् इन्द्धे अन्नस्य मा तेजसा स्वर्गं लोकं गमय . यत्र देवानाम् ऋषीणां प्रियं धाम तत्र म इदम् अग्निहोत्रं गमय इति तूष्णीम् उपसादयति . अथ समिधम् अभ्यादधाति स्वर्गस्य त्वा लोकस्य संक्रमणं हिरण्मयं वंशं दधामि स्वाहा इति . अथ जुहोति . स यां प्रथमां जुहोति देवांस् तयाप्नोति .

sanskrit_iast: athopamārṣṭi . sa yat prathamam upamārṣṭi tena gandharvāpsarasaḥ prīṇāti . taṃ gandharvāpsarasa āhuś śraddhā te mā vigāt sarvaiḥ kāmais tṛpya svargaṃ lokam āpnuhīti . atha yad dvitīyam upamārṣṭi tena grahāṃś ca pitr̥̄ṃś ca prīṇāti . taṃ grahāś ca pitaraś cāhuś śraddhā te mā vigāt sarvaiḥ kāmais tṛpya svargaṃ lokam āpnuhīti . atha yad dvir aṅgulyā prāśnāti sa yat prathamaṃ prāśnāti tena prāṇāpānau tṛpyataḥ . taṃ prāṇāpānāv āhatuś śraddhā te mā vigāt sarvaiḥ kāmais tṛpya svargaṃ lokam āpnuhīti . atha yad dvitīyaṃ prāśnāti tenodānāpānau tṛpyataḥ . tam udānāpānāv āhatuś śraddhā te mā vigāt sarvaiḥ kāmais tṛpya svargaṃ lokam āpnuhīti . atha yat srucā prāśnāti tena samānavyānau ca garbhāṃś ca prīṇāti . taṃ samānavyānau garbhāś cāhuś śraddhā te mā vigāt sarvaiḥ kāmais tṛpya svargaṃ lokam āpnuhīti . atha yat srucaṃ niraśnāti tena devajanān prīṇāti . taṃ devajanā āhuś śraddhā te mā vigāt sarvaiḥ kāmais tṛpya svargaṃ lokam āpnuhīti . atha yat srucas saṃkṣālanaṃ ninayati tena vayāṃsi prīṇāti . taṃ vayāṃsy āhuś śraddhā te mā vigāt sarvaiḥ kāmais tṛpya svargaṃ lokam āpnuhīti . atha yā etās sruco nirṇijyodīcīr apa utsiñcati tena ṛṣīn prīṇāti . tam ṛṣaya āhuś śraddhā te mā vigāt sarvaiḥ kāmais tṛpya svargaṃ lokam āpnuhīti . atha yat sthālīsaṃkṣālanaṃ ninayati tena sarpajanān prīṇāti . taṃ sarpajanā āhuś śraddhā te mā vigāt sarvaiḥ kāmais tṛpya svargaṃ lokam āpnuhīti .
sentences: sa yat pratʰamam upamārṣṭi tena gandʰarvāpsarasaḥ prīṇāti .
taṃ gandʰarvāpsarasa āhuś śraddʰā te mā vigāt sarvaiḥ kāmais tr̥pya svargaṃ lokam āpnuhīti .
atʰa yad dvitīyam upamārṣṭi tena grahāṃś ca pitr̥̄ṃś ca prīṇāti .
taṃ grahāś ca pitaraś cāhuś śraddʰā te mā vigāt sarvaiḥ kāmais tr̥pya svargaṃ lokam āpnuhīti .
atʰa yad dvir aṅgulyā prāśnāti sa yat pratʰamaṃ prāśnāti tena prāṇāpānau tr̥pyataḥ .
taṃ prāṇāpānāv āhatuś śraddʰā te mā vigāt sarvaiḥ kāmais tr̥pya svargaṃ lokam āpnuhīti .
atʰa yad dvitīyaṃ prāśnāti tenodānāpānau tr̥pyataḥ .
tam udānāpānāv āhatuś śraddʰā te mā vigāt sarvaiḥ kāmais tr̥pya svargaṃ lokam āpnuhīti .
atʰa yat srucā prāśnāti tena samānavyānau ca garbʰāṃś ca prīṇāti .
taṃ samānavyānau garbʰāś cāhuś śraddʰā te mā vigāt sarvaiḥ kāmais tr̥pya svargaṃ lokam āpnuhīti .
atʰa yat srucaṃ niraśnāti tena devajanān prīṇāti .
taṃ devajanā āhuś śraddʰā te mā vigāt sarvaiḥ kāmais tr̥pya svargaṃ lokam āpnuhīti .
atʰa yat srucas saṃkṣālanaṃ ninayati tena vayāṃsi prīṇāti .
taṃ vayāṃsy āhuś śraddʰā te mā vigāt sarvaiḥ kāmais tr̥pya svargaṃ lokam āpnuhīti .
atʰa yā etās sruco nirṇijyodīcīr apa utsiñcati tena r̥ṣīn prīṇāti .
tam r̥ṣaya āhuś śraddʰā te mā vigāt sarvaiḥ kāmais tr̥pya svargaṃ lokam āpnuhīti .
atʰa yat stʰālīsaṃkṣālanaṃ ninayati tena sarpajanān prīṇāti .
taṃ sarpajanā āhuś śraddʰā te mā vigāt sarvaiḥ kāmais tr̥pya svargaṃ lokam āpnuhīti .
text: Then he wipes (the spoon). When he wipes the first time, with that he gratifies the Gandharvas and Apsarases. The Gandharvas and Apsarases say to him: "May your faith not depart! Be satisfied with all desires; attain the heavenly world!" When he wipes the second time, with that he gratifies the Grahas and the Pitṛs. The Grahas and the Pitṛs say to him: "May your faith not depart! Be satisfied with all desires; attain the heavenly world!" Then when he eats twice with his finger — when he eats the first time, with that prāṇa and apāna are satisfied. Prāṇa and apāna say to him: "May your faith not depart! Be satisfied with all desires; attain the heavenly world!" When he eats the second time, with that udāna and apāna are satisfied. Udāna and apāna say to him: "May your faith not depart! Be satisfied with all desires; attain the heavenly world!" When he eats from the offering spoon, with that he gratifies samāna, vyāna, and the embryos. Samāna, vyāna, and the embryos say to him: "May your faith not depart! Be satisfied with all desires; attain the heavenly world!" When he licks clean the offering spoon, with that he gratifies the divine folk. The divine folk say to him: "May your faith not depart! Be satisfied with all desires; attain the heavenly world!" When he pours out the rinsing water of the spoon, with that he gratifies the birds. The birds say to him: "May your faith not depart! Be satisfied with all desires; attain the heavenly world!" When he rinses the spoons and pours out the water to the north, with that he gratifies the ṛṣis. The ṛṣis say to him: "May your faith not depart! Be satisfied with all desires; attain the heavenly world!" When he pours out the rinsing water of the pot, with that he gratifies the serpent-folk. The serpent-folk say to him: "May your faith not depart! Be satisfied with all desires; attain the heavenly world!"
meaning: अथोपमार्ष्टि . स यत् प्रथमम् उपमार्ष्टि तेन गन्धर्वाप्सरसः प्रीणाति . तं गन्धर्वाप्सरस आहुश् श्रद्धा ते मा विगात् सर्वैः कामैस् तृप्य स्वर्गं लोकम् आप्नुहीति . अथ यद् द्वितीयम् उपमार्ष्टि तेन ग्रहांश् च पित्र्̥̄ंश् च प्रीणाति . तं ग्रहाश् च पितरश् चाहुश् श्रद्धा ते मा विगात् सर्वैः कामैस् तृप्य स्वर्गं लोकम् आप्नुहीति . अथ यद् द्विर् अङ्गुल्या प्राश्नाति स यत् प्रथमं प्राश्नाति तेन प्राणापानौ तृप्यतः . तं प्राणापानाव् आहतुश् श्रद्धा ते मा विगात् सर्वैः कामैस् तृप्य स्वर्गं लोकम् आप्नुहीति . अथ यद् द्वितीयं प्राश्नाति तेनोदानापानौ तृप्यतः . तम् उदानापानाव् आहतुश् श्रद्धा ते मा विगात् सर्वैः कामैस् तृप्य स्वर्गं लोकम् आप्नुहीति . अथ यत् स्रुचा प्राश्नाति तेन समानव्यानौ च गर्भांश् च प्रीणाति . तं समानव्यानौ गर्भाश् चाहुश् श्रद्धा ते मा विगात् सर्वैः कामैस् तृप्य स्वर्गं लोकम् आप्नुहीति . अथ यत् स्रुचं निरश्नाति तेन देवजनान् प्रीणाति . तं देवजना आहुश् श्रद्धा ते मा विगात् सर्वैः कामैस् तृप्य स्वर्गं लोकम् आप्नुहीति . अथ यत् स्रुचस् संक्षालनं निनयति तेन वयांसि प्रीणाति . तं वयांस्य् आहुश् श्रद्धा ते मा विगात् सर्वैः कामैस् तृप्य स्वर्गं लोकम् आप्नुहीति . अथ या एतास् स्रुचो निर्णिज्योदीचीर् अप उत्सिञ्चति तेन ऋषीन् प्रीणाति . तम् ऋषय आहुश् श्रद्धा ते मा विगात् सर्वैः कामैस् तृप्य स्वर्गं लोकम् आप्नुहीति . अथ यत् स्थालीसंक्षालनं निनयति तेन सर्पजनान् प्रीणाति . तं सर्पजना आहुश् श्रद्धा ते मा विगात् सर्वैः कामैस् तृप्य स्वर्गं लोकम् आप्नुहीति .

sanskrit_iast: bhṛgur ha vāruṇir Einige Handschriften lesen ha vā vāruṇir . Im Lichte der ŚB-Parallele ist demnach wohl auch hier ha vai vāruṇir zu lesen . Die Verbindung der Partikeln ha vai ist besonders am Anfang von Erzählungen häufig , vgl . Delbrück AIS S . 491. Man sollte einmal die stereotypen Wendungen am Anfang von Erzählungen in der vedischen Prosa zusammenstellen und miteinander vergleichen ! anūcāna āsa . sa hāty eva pitaraṃ mene 'ti devān aty anyān brāhmaṇān anūcānān . sa ha varuṇa īkṣāṃ cakre na vai me putraḥ kiṃ cana prajānāti . hantainaṃ prajñāpayānīti . tasya ha prāṇān abhijagrāha . sa ha tatāma . sa ha tāntaḥ paraṃ lokaṃ jagāma . sa hāmuṣmin loke ājagāma . puruṣa eva puruṣaṃ saṃvṛścyāthainaṃ jaghāsa . sa hovācābhūd batedaṃ kiṃ svid idam iti . taṃ hocuḥ pitaraṃ varuṇaṃ pṛcchāsi sa ta idaṃ pravakteti . dvitīyaṃ hājagāma . puruṣa eva puruṣam ākrandayantaṃ jaghāsa . sa hovācābhūd batedaṃ kiṃ svid idam iti . taṃ hocuḥ pitaraṃ varuṇaṃ pṛcchāsi sa te idaṃ pravakteti . tṛtīyaṃ hājagāma . puruṣa eva puruṣaṃ tūṣṇīṃ vyāharantaṃ jaghāsa . sa hovācābhūd batedaṃ kiṃ svid idam iti . taṃ hocuḥ pitaraṃ varuṇaṃ pṛcchāsi sa ta idaṃ pravakteti . caturthaṃ hājagāma . dve striyau mahad vittaṃ jugupatuḥ . sa hovācābhūd batedaṃ kiṃ svid idam iti . taṃ hocuḥ pitaraṃ varuṇaṃ pṛcchāsi sa ta idaṃ pravakteti . pañcamaṃ hājagāma . lohitakulyāṃ ca ghṛtakulyāṃ ca prabāhuk syandamāne . sā yā lohitakulyāsa tāṃ kṛṣṇo nagnaḥ puruṣo musalī jugopa . atha yā ghṛtakulyā tasyai hiraṇmayāḥ puruṣā hiraṇmayaiś camasais sarvān kāmān udācire . sa hovācābhūd batedaṃ kiṃ svid idam iti . taṃ hocuḥ pitaraṃ varuṇaṃ pṛcchāsi sa ta idaṃ pravakteti . ṣaṣṭhaṃ hājagāma . pañca nadīḥ puṣkariṇīḥ puṇḍarīkiṇīr madhūdakās syandamānāḥ . tāsu nṛttagītaṃ vīṇāghoṣo 'psarasāṃ gaṇās surabhir gandho mahān ghoṣo babhūva . sa hovācābhūd batedaṃ kiṃ svid idam iti .

text: Bhṛgu, the son of Varuṇa, was a learned man. He considered himself greater than his father, greater than the gods, greater than other learned brāhmaṇas. Varuṇa reflected: "My son does not know anything (truly). Come, let me make him know." He seized his vital breaths. He fell down. Having fallen down, he went to the other world. He arrived in that other world. A man, having cut up another man, then ate him. He said: "Alas! What is this?" They said to him: "Ask your father Varuṇa; he will explain this to you." He came to a second (place). A man ate another man who was crying out. He said: "Alas! What is this?" They said to him: "Ask your father Varuṇa; he will explain this to you." He came to a third (place). A man ate another man who was silently protesting. He said: "Alas! What is this?" They said to him: "Ask your father Varuṇa; he will explain this to you." He came to a fourth (place). Two women were guarding a great treasure. He said: "Alas! What is this?" They said to him: "Ask your father Varuṇa; he will explain this to you." He came to a fifth (place). A river of blood and a river of ghee, both flowing abundantly. That river of blood — a black, naked man with a club was guarding it. But the river of ghee — golden men were scooping out all desires with golden cups from it. He said: "Alas! What is this?" They said to him: "Ask your father Varuṇa; he will explain this to you." He came to a sixth (place). Five rivers, full of lotuses, full of white lotuses, with honey-water, flowing. In them were dance and song, the sound of vīṇās, hosts of Apsarases, a fragrant scent — a great sound arose. He said: "Alas! What is this?"
