text: Then he turned back from that very place. He came to Varuṇa. (Varuṇa) said to him: "Did you arrive, son?" "I arrived, father." "Did you see, son?" "I saw, father." "What, son?" "A man, having cut up another man, then ate him." "Yes," he said. "Those who, offering the agnihotra in this world, without such knowledge, cut up trees and lay them on (the fire) — those trees, having taken human form, eat them back in the other world. What is the remedy for that?" "When one lays on the fuel-stick (with the proper mantra), that is the remedy for it; by that one is freed from that." "What was the second?" "A man ate another man who was crying out." "Yes," he said. "Those who, offering the agnihotra in this world, without such knowledge, cook animals that cry out — those animals, having taken human form, eat them back in the other world. What is the remedy for that?" "When one offers the first oblation with speech (the spoken formula), that is the remedy for it; by that one is freed from that." "What was the third?" "A man ate another man who was silently protesting." "Yes," he said. "Those who, offering the agnihotra in this world, without such knowledge, cook rice and barley that silently protest — those rice and barley plants, having taken human form, eat them back in the other world. What is the remedy for that?" "When one offers the latter oblation with the mind (silently), that is the remedy for it; by that one is freed from that." "What was the fourth?" "Two women were guarding a great treasure." "Yes," he said. "Those were indeed faith and unfaith. Those who, offering the agnihotra in this world, without such knowledge, sacrifice without faith — that goes to unfaith; what they (offer) with faith — that goes to faith. What is the remedy for that?"
meaning: स ह तत एवाववृते . स ह वरुणम् एवाजगाम . तं होवाचागास् ताता३ इति . आगां ततेति . अदर्शस् ताता३ इति . अदर्शं ततेति . किं ताता३ इति . पुरुष एव पुरुषं संवृश्च्याथैनम् अघद् इति . ओम् इति होवाच . ये वा अस्मिन् लोके ऽग्निहोत्रं जुह्वतो नैवंविदो वनस्पतीन् संवृश्च्याभ्यादधति तान् वा अमुष्मिन् लोके वनस्पतयः पुरुषरूपं कृत्वा प्रत्यदन्ति . तस्य का निष्कृतिर् इति . यद् एवैतत् समिधम् अभ्यादधाति सा तस्य निष्कृतिस् तया तद् अतिमुच्यत इति . किं द्वितीयम् इति . पुरुष एव पुरुषम् आक्रन्दयन्तम् अघद् इति . ओम् इति होवाच . ये वा अस्मिन् लोके ऽग्निहोत्रं जुह्वतो नैवंविदः पशून् आक्रन्दयतः पचन्ते तान् वा अमुष्मिन् लोके पशवः पुरुषरूपं कृत्वा प्रत्यदन्ति . तस्य का निष्कृतिर् इति . यद् एवैतद् वाचा पूर्वाम् आहुतिं जुहोति सा तस्य निष्कृतिस् तया तद् अतिमुच्यत इति . किं तृतीयम् इति . पुरुष एव पुरुषं तूष्णीं व्याहरन्तम् अघद् इति . ओम् इति होवाच . य वा अस्मिन् लोके ऽग्निहोत्रं जुह्वतो नैवंविदो व्रीहियवांस् तूष्णीं व्याहरतः पचन्ते तान् वा अमुष्मिन् लोके व्रीहियवाः पुरुषरूपं कृत्वा प्रत्यदन्ति . तस्य का निष्कृतिर् इति . यद् एवैतन् मनसोत्तराम् आहुतिं जुहोति सा तस्य निष्कृतिस् तया तद् अतिमुच्यत इति . किं चतुर्थम् इति . द्वे स्त्रियौ महद् वित्तम् अजूगुपताम् इति . ओम् इति होवाच . श्रद्धा च वै ते अश्रद्धा चाभूताम् . ये वा अस्मिन् लोके ऽग्निहोत्रं जुह्वतो नैवंविदो ऽश्रद्दधाना यजन्ते तद् अश्रद्धां गच्छति यच् छ्रद्दधानास् तच् छ्रद्धाम् . तस्य का निष्कृतिर् इति .

sanskrit_iast: kiṃ pañcamam iti . lohitakulyāṃ ca ghṛtakulyāṃ ca prabāhuk syandamāne . sā yā lohitakulyābhūt tāṃ kṛṣṇo nagnaḥ puruṣo musalī jugopa . atha yā ghṛtakulyā tasyai hiraṇmayāḥ puruṣā hiraṇmayaiś camasais sarvān kāmān udacanta iti . om iti hovāca . ye vā asmin loke 'gnihotraṃ juhvato naivaṃvido brāhmaṇasya lohitam utpīḍayanti sā sā lohitakulyā . atha ya enāṃ kṛṣṇo nagnaḥ puruṣo musaly ajūgupat krodhas sa tasyo tad evānnam iti . tasya kā niṣkṛtir iti . yad evaitat srucā prāśnāti sā tasya niṣkṛtis tayā tad atimucyata iti . atha yā etāṃ srucaṃ nirṇijyodīcīr apa utsiñcati sā sā ghṛtakulyā . tasyai hiraṇmayāḥ puruṣā hiraṇmayaiś camasais sarvān kāmān udacanta iti . kiṃ ṣaṣṭham iti . pañca nadīḥ puṣkariṇīḥ puṇḍarīkiṇīr madhūdakās syandamānāḥ . tāsu nṛttagītaṃ vīṇāghoṣo 'psarasāṃ gaṇās surabhir gandho mahān ghoṣo 'bhūd iti . om iti hovāca . mamaivaite lokā abhūvann iti . te kenābhijayyā iti . etenaiva pañcagṛhītena pañconnīteneti . sa hovāca na vai kilānyatrāgnihotrāl lokajityā avakāśo 'sti . adyaiva me agnyādheyasyopavasatha iti . tasya ha tathā cakruḥ .
sentences: lohitakulyāṃ ca gʰr̥takulyāṃ ca prabāhuk syandamāne .
sā yā lohitakulyābʰūt tāṃ kr̥ṣṇo nagnaḥ puruṣo musalī jugopa .
atʰa yā gʰr̥takulyā tasyai hiraṇmayāḥ puruṣā hiraṇmayaiś camasais sarvān kāmān udacanta iti .
ye vā asmin loke 'gnihotraṃ juhvato naivaṃvido brāhmaṇasya lohitam utpīḍayanti sā sā lohitakulyā .
atʰa ya enāṃ kr̥ṣṇo nagnaḥ puruṣo musaly ajūgupat krodʰas sa tasyo tad evānnam iti .
yad evaitat srucā prāśnāti sā tasya niṣkr̥tis tayā tad atimucyata iti .
atʰa yā etāṃ srucaṃ nirṇijyodīcīr apa utsiñcati sā sā gʰr̥takulyā .
tasyai hiraṇmayāḥ puruṣā hiraṇmayaiś camasais sarvān kāmān udacanta iti .
pañca nadīḥ puṣkariṇīḥ puṇḍarīkiṇīr madʰūdakās syandamānāḥ .
tāsu nr̥ttagītaṃ vīṇāgʰoṣo 'psarasāṃ gaṇās surabʰir gandʰo mahān gʰoṣo 'bʰūd iti .
sa hovāca na vai kilānyatrāgnihotrāl lokajityā avakāśo 'sti .
text: "What was the fifth?" "A river of blood and a river of ghee, both flowing abundantly. That which was the river of blood — a black, naked man with a club was guarding it. But the river of ghee — golden men were scooping out all desires with golden cups from it." "Yes," he said. "Those who, offering the agnihotra in this world, without such knowledge, press out the blood of a brāhmaṇa — that is that river of blood. And the black, naked man with the club who was guarding it — that is wrath; that alone is its food." "What is the remedy for that?" "When one eats from the offering spoon, that is the remedy for it; by that one is freed from that." "And when one rinses the spoon and pours out the water to the north — that is that river of ghee. From it golden men were scooping out all desires with golden cups." "What was the sixth?" "Five rivers, full of lotuses, full of white lotuses, with honey-water, flowing. In them were dance and song, the sound of vīṇās, hosts of Apsarases, a fragrant scent — a great sound arose." "Yes," he said. "Those were indeed my worlds." "By what are they to be won?" "By this very (agnihotra) taken up in five (ladles) and lifted up in five." He said: "There is indeed no possibility of winning the worlds other than through the agnihotra. Let the preparation for my fire-establishment be this very day." And so they did for him.
meaning: किं पञ्चमम् इति . लोहितकुल्यां च घृतकुल्यां च प्रबाहुक् स्यन्दमाने . सा या लोहितकुल्याभूत् तां कृष्णो नग्नः पुरुषो मुसली जुगोप . अथ या घृतकुल्या तस्यै हिरण्मयाः पुरुषा हिरण्मयैश् चमसैस् सर्वान् कामान् उदचन्त इति . ओम् इति होवाच . ये वा अस्मिन् लोके ऽग्निहोत्रं जुह्वतो नैवंविदो ब्राह्मणस्य लोहितम् उत्पीडयन्ति सा सा लोहितकुल्या . अथ य एनां कृष्णो नग्नः पुरुषो मुसल्य् अजूगुपत् क्रोधस् स तस्यो तद् एवान्नम् इति . तस्य का निष्कृतिर् इति . यद् एवैतत् स्रुचा प्राश्नाति सा तस्य निष्कृतिस् तया तद् अतिमुच्यत इति . अथ या एतां स्रुचं निर्णिज्योदीचीर् अप उत्सिञ्चति सा सा घृतकुल्या . तस्यै हिरण्मयाः पुरुषा हिरण्मयैश् चमसैस् सर्वान् कामान् उदचन्त इति . किं षष्ठम् इति . पञ्च नदीः पुष्करिणीः पुण्डरीकिणीर् मधूदकास् स्यन्दमानाः . तासु नृत्तगीतं वीणाघोषो ऽप्सरसां गणास् सुरभिर् गन्धो महान् घोषो ऽभूद् इति . ओम् इति होवाच . ममैवैते लोका अभूवन्न् इति . ते केनाभिजय्या इति . एतेनैव पञ्चगृहीतेन पञ्चोन्नीतेनेति . स होवाच न वै किलान्यत्राग्निहोत्राल् लोकजित्या अवकाशो ऽस्ति . अद्यैव मे अग्न्याधेयस्योपवसथ इति . तस्य ह तथा चक्रुः .

sanskrit_iast: eṣa vā agnir vaiśvānaro ya eṣa tapati . tasya rātris samid ahar jyotī raśmayo dhūmo nakṣatrāṇi viṣphuliṅgāś candramā aṅgārāḥ . tasminn etasminn agnau vaiśvānare 'harahar devā amṛtam apo juhvati . tasyā āhuter hutāyai somo rājā saṃbhavati . stanayitnur evāgnir vaiśvānaraḥ . tasya dyaus samid vidyuj jyotir abhrāṇi dhūmo marīcayo viṣphuliṅgā aśanir aṅgārāḥ . tasminn etasminn agnau vaiśvānare 'harahar devās somaṃ rājānaṃ juhvati . tasyā āhuter hutāyai vṛṣṭis saṃbhavati . pṛthivy evāgnir vaiśvānaraḥ . tasyāntarikṣaṃ samid agnir jyotir vāyur dhūmo marīcayo viṣphuliṅgā diśo 'ṅgārāḥ . tasminn etasminn agnau vaiśvānare 'harahar devā vṛṣṭiṃ juhvati . tasyā āhuter hutāyā annaṃ saṃbhavati . puruṣa evāgnir vaiśvānaraḥ . tasya vāk samic cakṣur jyotiḥ prāṇo dhūmo mano 'bhinando viṣphuliṅgāś śrotram aṅgārāḥ . tasminn etasminn agnau vaiśvānare 'harahar devā annaṃ juhvati . tasyā āhuter hutāyai retas saṃbhavati . stry evāgnir vaiśvānaraḥ . tasyopasthaṃ samid yonir jyotir iṣyā dhūmo 'bhinando viṣphuliṅgās saṃsparśo 'ṅgārāḥ . tasminn etasminn agnau vaiśvānare 'harahar devā reto juhvati . tasyā āhuter hutāyai puruṣas saṃbhavati . so 'tra pañcamyāṃ visṛṣṭyāṃ puruṣo devebhyo jāyate .
sentences: eṣa vā agnir vaiśvānaro ya eṣa tapati .
tasya rātris samid ahar jyotī raśmayo dʰūmo nakṣatrāṇi viṣpʰuliṅgāś candramā aṅgārāḥ .
tasminn etasminn agnau vaiśvānare 'harahar devā amr̥tam apo juhvati .
tasyā āhuter hutāyai somo rājā saṃbʰavati .
tasya dyaus samid vidyuj jyotir abʰrāṇi dʰūmo marīcayo viṣpʰuliṅgā aśanir aṅgārāḥ .
tasminn etasminn agnau vaiśvānare 'harahar devās somaṃ rājānaṃ juhvati .
tasyāntarikṣaṃ samid agnir jyotir vāyur dʰūmo marīcayo viṣpʰuliṅgā diśo 'ṅgārāḥ .
tasminn etasminn agnau vaiśvānare 'harahar devā vr̥ṣṭiṃ juhvati .
tasya vāk samic cakṣur jyotiḥ prāṇo dʰūmo mano 'bʰinando viṣpʰuliṅgāś śrotram aṅgārāḥ .
tasminn etasminn agnau vaiśvānare 'harahar devā annaṃ juhvati .
tasyopastʰaṃ samid yonir jyotir iṣyā dʰūmo 'bʰinando viṣpʰuliṅgās saṃsparśo 'ṅgārāḥ .
tasminn etasminn agnau vaiśvānare 'harahar devā reto juhvati .
so 'tra pañcamyāṃ visr̥ṣṭyāṃ puruṣo devebʰyo jāyate .
text: That Agni Vaiśvānara is he who shines yonder (the sun). His fuel-stick is night, his light is day, his smoke is the rays, his sparks are the stars, his embers are the moon. In that Agni Vaiśvānara, day after day the gods offer the immortal waters. From that oblation when offered, Soma the king comes into being. The thundercloud is Agni Vaiśvānara. His fuel-stick is the sky, his light is lightning, his smoke is the clouds, his sparks are the rays of light, his embers are the thunderbolt. In that Agni Vaiśvānara, day after day the gods offer Soma the king. From that oblation when offered, rain comes into being. The earth is Agni Vaiśvānara. Her fuel-stick is the atmosphere, her light is fire, her smoke is wind, her sparks are the rays of light, her embers are the directions. In that Agni Vaiśvānara, day after day the gods offer rain. From that oblation when offered, food comes into being. The person is Agni Vaiśvānara. His fuel-stick is speech, his light is the eye, his smoke is prāṇa, his sparks are the mind's delight, his embers are the ear. In that Agni Vaiśvānara, day after day the gods offer food. From that oblation when offered, semen comes into being. Woman is Agni Vaiśvānara. Her fuel-stick is the lap, her light is the womb, her smoke is desire, her sparks are delight, her embers are touch. In that Agni Vaiśvānara, day after day the gods offer semen. From that oblation when offered, a person comes into being. Thus at the fifth emission the person is born from the gods.
meaning: एष वा अग्निर् वैश्वानरो य एष तपति . तस्य रात्रिस् समिद् अहर् ज्योती रश्मयो धूमो नक्षत्राणि विष्फुलिङ्गाश् चन्द्रमा अङ्गाराः . तस्मिन्न् एतस्मिन्न् अग्नौ वैश्वानरे ऽहरहर् देवा अमृतम् अपो जुह्वति . तस्या आहुतेर् हुतायै सोमो राजा संभवति . स्तनयित्नुर् एवाग्निर् वैश्वानरः . तस्य द्यौस् समिद् विद्युज् ज्योतिर् अभ्राणि धूमो मरीचयो विष्फुलिङ्गा अशनिर् अङ्गाराः . तस्मिन्न् एतस्मिन्न् अग्नौ वैश्वानरे ऽहरहर् देवास् सोमं राजानं जुह्वति . तस्या आहुतेर् हुतायै वृष्टिस् संभवति . पृथिव्य् एवाग्निर् वैश्वानरः . तस्यान्तरिक्षं समिद् अग्निर् ज्योतिर् वायुर् धूमो मरीचयो विष्फुलिङ्गा दिशो ऽङ्गाराः . तस्मिन्न् एतस्मिन्न् अग्नौ वैश्वानरे ऽहरहर् देवा वृष्टिं जुह्वति . तस्या आहुतेर् हुताया अन्नं संभवति . पुरुष एवाग्निर् वैश्वानरः . तस्य वाक् समिच् चक्षुर् ज्योतिः प्राणो धूमो मनो ऽभिनन्दो विष्फुलिङ्गाश् श्रोत्रम् अङ्गाराः . तस्मिन्न् एतस्मिन्न् अग्नौ वैश्वानरे ऽहरहर् देवा अन्नं जुह्वति . तस्या आहुतेर् हुतायै रेतस् संभवति . स्त्र्य् एवाग्निर् वैश्वानरः . तस्योपस्थं समिद् योनिर् ज्योतिर् इष्या धूमो ऽभिनन्दो विष्फुलिङ्गास् संस्पर्शो ऽङ्गाराः . तस्मिन्न् एतस्मिन्न् अग्नौ वैश्वानरे ऽहरहर् देवा रेतो जुह्वति . तस्या आहुतेर् हुतायै पुरुषस् संभवति . सो ऽत्र पञ्चम्यां विसृष्ट्यां पुरुषो देवेभ्यो जायते .

sanskrit_iast: - tasyāgnir vaiśvānaraḥ . tasyauṣadhayaś ca vanaspatayaś ca samit . jyotir eva jyotiḥ . dhūma eva dhūmaḥ . viṣphuliṅgā eva viṣphuluṅgāḥ . aṅgārā evāṅgārāḥ . tasminn etasminn agnau vaiśvānare 'harahar devā puruṣaṃ juhvati . tasyā āhuter hutāyai puruṣo 'muṃ lokaṃ saṃbhavati . so 'sya lokaḥ punarutthāyai bhavati . tasya haitasya devasyāhorātre ardhamāsā māsā ṛtavas saṃvatsaro goptā ya eṣa tapati . ahorātre pracare . taṃ hartūnām eko yaḥ kūṭahasto raśminā pratyavetya pṛcchati ko 'si puruṣeti . sa kiṃ vidvān pravṛñjyāt . tasya ha praharati . tasya ha pratirāddhasya tredhā sādhukṛtyā vinaśyati . sa tṛtīyam ādatte . diśo 'nu tṛtīya vyeti . tṛtīyena sahemaṃ lokam abhyavaiti . sa yo hāsya dānajito loko bhavati tasmin niramate . tam u ha vai tato mṛtyur evāntata āpnoti . anavajito hāsya punarmṛtyur bhavati sa ya evaṃvit syāt . sa yadopatāpī syād yatrāsya samaṃ subhūmi spaṣṭaṃ syāt tad brūyād iha me 'gniṃ manthateti . īśvaro hāgado bhavitoḥ . yady u tan na yad asmāl lokāt preyād athainam ādadīran . nānāsthālyor agnī opya hareyur anvāhāryapacanād ulmukam . ādadīran yajñapātrāṇi sarpir apo dārūṇy anustaraṇīṃ kṣuraṃ nakhanikṛntanam . te yanti yatrāsya samaṃ subhūmi spaṣṭaṃ bhavati .
sentences: tasminn etasminn agnau vaiśvānare 'harahar devā puruṣaṃ juhvati .
tasyā āhuter hutāyai puruṣo 'muṃ lokaṃ saṃbʰavati .
tasya haitasya devasyāhorātre ardʰamāsā māsā r̥tavas saṃvatsaro goptā ya eṣa tapati .
taṃ hartūnām eko yaḥ kūṭahasto raśminā pratyavetya pr̥ccʰati ko 'si puruṣeti .
tasya ha pratirāddʰasya tredʰā sādʰukr̥tyā vinaśyati .
sa yo hāsya dānajito loko bʰavati tasmin niramate .
tam u ha vai tato mr̥tyur evāntata āpnoti .
anavajito hāsya punarmr̥tyur bʰavati sa ya evaṃvit syāt .
sa yadopatāpī syād yatrāsya samaṃ subʰūmi spaṣṭaṃ syāt tad brūyād iha me 'gniṃ mantʰateti .
yady u tan na yad asmāl lokāt preyād atʰainam ādadīran .
nānāstʰālyor agnī opya hareyur anvāhāryapacanād ulmukam .
ādadīran yajñapātrāṇi sarpir apo dārūṇy anustaraṇīṃ kṣuraṃ nakʰanikr̥ntanam .
te yanti yatrāsya samaṃ subʰūmi spaṣṭaṃ bʰavati .
text: His (fire) is Agni Vaiśvānara. His fuel-sticks are the herbs and trees. Light is his light. Smoke is his smoke. Sparks are his sparks. Embers are his embers. In that Agni Vaiśvānara, day after day the gods offer the person. From that oblation when offered, the person attains the other world. That world of his becomes (the basis) for rising again. Of this being, the days and nights, the half-months, the months, the seasons, and the year are the guardian — he who shines yonder. The days and nights are the pathways. Him one of the guardians of the seasons, who has a crooked hand, approaches with a ray and asks: "Who are you, O person?" Knowing what, should he declare himself? He strikes at him. When struck, his good deeds are destroyed in three parts. He (the guardian) takes a third. A third disperses following the directions. With a third he descends to this world. Whatever world of his is won by gifts, in that he delights. But death again reaches him in the end. For him there is unconquered freedom from re-death who knows thus. If he should fall ill, wherever there is level, good ground clear (of obstacles) for him, there he should say: "Churn fire for me here." He is likely to recover. But if not — if he should depart from this world — then they should take him up. Having placed the fires in two separate pots, they should carry them, along with an ember from the anvāhāryapacana fire. They should take up the sacrificial vessels, ghee, water, firewood, the spread-out hide, a razor, and nail-clippers. They go to where there is level, good ground clear (of obstacles) for him.
meaning: - तस्याग्निर् वैश्वानरः . तस्यौषधयश् च वनस्पतयश् च समित् . ज्योतिर् एव ज्योतिः . धूम एव धूमः . विष्फुलिङ्गा एव विष्फुलुङ्गाः . अङ्गारा एवाङ्गाराः . तस्मिन्न् एतस्मिन्न् अग्नौ वैश्वानरे ऽहरहर् देवा पुरुषं जुह्वति . तस्या आहुतेर् हुतायै पुरुषो ऽमुं लोकं संभवति . सो ऽस्य लोकः पुनरुत्थायै भवति . तस्य हैतस्य देवस्याहोरात्रे अर्धमासा मासा ऋतवस् संवत्सरो गोप्ता य एष तपति . अहोरात्रे प्रचरे . तं हर्तूनाम् एको यः कूटहस्तो रश्मिना प्रत्यवेत्य पृच्छति को ऽसि पुरुषेति . स किं विद्वान् प्रवृञ्ज्यात् . तस्य ह प्रहरति . तस्य ह प्रतिराद्धस्य त्रेधा साधुकृत्या विनश्यति . स तृतीयम् आदत्ते . दिशो ऽनु तृतीय व्येति . तृतीयेन सहेमं लोकम् अभ्यवैति . स यो हास्य दानजितो लोको भवति तस्मिन् निरमते . तम् उ ह वै ततो मृत्युर् एवान्तत आप्नोति . अनवजितो हास्य पुनर्मृत्युर् भवति स य एवंवित् स्यात् . स यदोपतापी स्याद् यत्रास्य समं सुभूमि स्पष्टं स्यात् तद् ब्रूयाद् इह मे ऽग्निं मन्थतेति . ईश्वरो हागदो भवितोः . यद्य् उ तन् न यद् अस्माल् लोकात् प्रेयाद् अथैनम् आददीरन् . नानास्थाल्योर् अग्नी ओप्य हरेयुर् अन्वाहार्यपचनाद् उल्मुकम् . आददीरन् यज्ञपात्राणि सर्पिर् अपो दारूण्य् अनुस्तरणीं क्षुरं नखनिकृन्तनम् . ते यन्ति यत्रास्य समं सुभूमि स्पष्टं भवति .

sanskrit_iast: athāsyāṃ diśi kūpaṃ khātvā vapanti keśaśmaśrūṇi . uptvā keśaśmaśrūṇi nakhān nikṛntanti . nakhān nikṛtya nirāntraṃ kurvanti . nirāntraṃ kṛtvā niṣpurīṣaṃ kurvanti . niṣpurīṣaṃ kṛtvā pāṃsubhiḥ kūpe purīṣam abhisaṃvapanti . pāpmānam evāsya tat pracchādayanti . prakṣālyāntrāṇi pratyavadhāyainam āharanti . tam antareṇāgnī nidhāya (?) gārhapatya ājyaṃ vilāpyotpūya caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā gatvāhavanīye samidvaty anvārabdhe juhoti ayaṃ vai tvad asmād asi tvam etad . ayaṃ te yonir asya yonis tvam . pitā putrāya lokakṛj jātavedaḥ . nayāsy enaṃ sukṛtāṃ yatra lokaḥ . asmād vai tvam ajāyathā eṣa tvaj jāyatāṃ svāhā iti .
sentences: atʰāsyāṃ diśi kūpaṃ kʰātvā vapanti keśaśmaśrūṇi .
niṣpurīṣaṃ kr̥tvā pāṃsubʰiḥ kūpe purīṣam abʰisaṃvapanti .
tam antareṇāgnī nidʰāya (?) gārhapatya ājyaṃ vilāpyotpūya caturgr̥hītaṃ gr̥hītvā gatvāhavanīye samidvaty anvārabdʰe juhoti ayaṃ vai tvad asmād asi tvam etad .
ayaṃ te yonir asya yonis tvam .
asmād vai tvam ajāyatʰā eṣa tvaj jāyatāṃ svāhā iti .
text: Then, having dug a pit in this direction, they shave his hair and beard. Having shaved the hair and beard, they trim the nails. Having trimmed the nails, they remove the entrails. Having removed the entrails, they remove the excrement. Having removed the excrement, they cover the excrement in the pit with earth. They thereby conceal his evil. Having washed the entrails and replaced them, they bring him. Having placed him between the two fires, melting ghee on the gārhapatya fire, having ladled it up, having taken a four-fold portion, having gone to the āhavanīya fire with fuel-stick in hand while (the attendant) holds on, he offers: "You are indeed from this one; this one is from you. You are his source; he is your source. As a father for a son, O Jātavedas, maker of worlds — lead him to where is the world of those who have done well. From you indeed you were born; may this one be born from you, svāhā."
meaning: अथास्यां दिशि कूपं खात्वा वपन्ति केशश्मश्रूणि . उप्त्वा केशश्मश्रूणि नखान् निकृन्तन्ति . नखान् निकृत्य निरान्त्रं कुर्वन्ति . निरान्त्रं कृत्वा निष्पुरीषं कुर्वन्ति . निष्पुरीषं कृत्वा पांसुभिः कूपे पुरीषम् अभिसंवपन्ति . पाप्मानम् एवास्य तत् प्रच्छादयन्ति . प्रक्षाल्यान्त्राणि प्रत्यवधायैनम् आहरन्ति . तम् अन्तरेणाग्नी निधाय (?) गार्हपत्य आज्यं विलाप्योत्पूय चतुर्गृहीतं गृहीत्वा गत्वाहवनीये समिद्वत्य् अन्वारब्धे जुहोति अयं वै त्वद् अस्माद् असि त्वम् एतद् . अयं ते योनिर् अस्य योनिस् त्वम् . पिता पुत्राय लोककृज् जातवेदः . नयास्य् एनं सुकृतां यत्र लोकः . अस्माद् वै त्वम् अजायथा एष त्वज् जायतां स्वाहा इति .

sanskrit_iast: athaitāṃ citāṃ cinvanti . tasyām enam ādadhati . tasya nāsikayos sruvau nidadhyād dakṣiṇahaste juhūṃ savya upabhṛtam urasi dhruvaṃ mukhe 'gnihotrahavaṇīṃ śīrṣataś camasam il̥opahavanaṃ karṇayoḥ prāśitraharaṇe udare pātrīṃ samavattadhānīm āṇḍayor dṛṣadupale śiśne śamyām upasthe kṛṣṇājinam anupṛṣṭhaṃ sphyaṃ pārśvayor musale ca śūrpe ca patta ulū-khalam . pariśiṣṭāni yajñapātrāṇy upari nidadhati . apo mṛṇmayāny abhyavaharanti dadaty evāyasmayāni . athainaṃ sarpiṣābhyutpūrayanti .
sentences: tasya nāsikayos sruvau nidadʰyād dakṣiṇahaste juhūṃ savya upabʰr̥tam urasi dʰruvaṃ mukʰe 'gnihotrahavaṇīṃ śīrṣataś camasam il̥opahavanaṃ karṇayoḥ prāśitraharaṇe udare pātrīṃ samavattadʰānīm āṇḍayor dr̥ṣadupale śiśne śamyām upastʰe kr̥ṣṇājinam anupr̥ṣṭʰaṃ spʰyaṃ pārśvayor musale ca śūrpe ca patta ulū-kʰalam .
text: Then they build this funeral pyre. On it they place him. On his nostrils they should place the two ladles; in the right hand the juhū, in the left the upabhṛt, on the chest the dhruva, on the mouth the agnihotra-offering vessel, at the head the camasa, the iḍopahavana by the ears, the prāśitraharaṇa vessels, on the belly the pātrī and the samavattadhānī, on the testicles the grinding stones, on the penis the śamyā, on the lap the black antelope skin, along the back the sphya, on the two sides the two pestles and the two winnowing baskets, on the breast the mortar. The remaining sacrificial vessels they place on top. They pour water over the earthen ones; but the metal ones they give away. Then they fill him up with ghee.
meaning: अथैतां चितां चिन्वन्ति . तस्याम् एनम् आदधति . तस्य नासिकयोस् स्रुवौ निदध्याद् दक्षिणहस्ते जुहूं सव्य उपभृतम् उरसि ध्रुवं मुखे ऽग्निहोत्रहवणीं शीर्षतश् चमसम् इल्̥ओपहवनं कर्णयोः प्राशित्रहरणे उदरे पात्रीं समवत्तधानीम् आण्डयोर् दृषदुपले शिश्ने शम्याम् उपस्थे कृष्णाजिनम् अनुपृष्ठं स्फ्यं पार्श्वयोर् मुसले च शूर्पे च पत्त उलू-खलम् . परिशिष्टानि यज्ञपात्राण्य् उपरि निदधति . अपो मृण्मयान्य् अभ्यवहरन्ति ददत्य् एवायस्मयानि . अथैनं सर्पिषाभ्युत्पूरयन्ति .

sanskrit_iast: athaitām anustaraṇīm ānayanti . tāṃprokṣya trir apasalī paryāṇāyya kūṭena hanyāt . pradakṣiṇaṃ haike paryāṇayanti . tad u tathā na kuryāt . tasyai vaspām utkhidya śīrṣṇi parivyayanti . hastayor matasnī hṛdaye hṛdayaṃ bāhvor bāhū . yathāṅgam evetarāṇy aṅgāni vicinvanti . athainaṃ carmaṇā prorṇvanti svayā tanvā samṛdhyasva iti . saṃstīryopādīpayanti . sa tathaiva cikīrṣed yathainam āhavanīyaḥ prathamo gacchet . tad enaṃ devalokaḥ pratyāgacchati . atha yathānvāhāryapacanas tad enaṃ pitṛlokaḥ pratyāgacchati . atha yathā gārhapatyas tathāsmin loke prajayā ca paśubhiś ca pratitiṣṭhati . tasyopādīptasya dhūma eva śarīraṃ dhunoti . sa yad dhunoti tasmād dhunaḥ . dhuno ha vai nāmaiśaḥ . taṃ dhūma iti parokṣam ācakṣate parokṣeṇaiva . parokṣapriyā iva hi devāḥ . dhūmād vai rātrim apyeti rātriyā ahar ahno 'pocchantīpakṣam apocchantīpakṣād āpūryamāṇapakṣam āpūryamāṇapakṣān māsam . te atra māse śarīraṃ cāsuś ca saṃgacchāte .
sentences: tāṃprokṣya trir apasalī paryāṇāyya kūṭena hanyāt .
hastayor matasnī hr̥daye hr̥dayaṃ bāhvor bāhū .
atʰainaṃ carmaṇā prorṇvanti svayā tanvā samr̥dʰyasva iti .
sa tatʰaiva cikīrṣed yatʰainam āhavanīyaḥ pratʰamo gaccʰet .
atʰa yatʰānvāhāryapacanas tad enaṃ pitr̥lokaḥ pratyāgaccʰati .
atʰa yatʰā gārhapatyas tatʰāsmin loke prajayā ca paśubʰiś ca pratitiṣṭʰati .
taṃ dʰūma iti parokṣam ācakṣate parokṣeṇaiva .
dʰūmād vai rātrim apyeti rātriyā ahar ahno 'poccʰantīpakṣam apoccʰantīpakṣād āpūryamāṇapakṣam āpūryamāṇapakṣān māsam .
te atra māse śarīraṃ cāsuś ca saṃgaccʰāte .
text: Then they bring the anustaraṇī (the cow to be spread under). Having sprinkled it, having led it around three times counter-sunwise, one should strike it with the butt-end. Some lead it around sunwise. But one should not do so. Having cut off her omentum, they wrap it around his head. On the hands (they place) the kidneys, on the heart the heart, on the arms the forelegs. They distribute the other limbs limb by limb. Then they cover him with the hide: "Be complete with your own body." Having spread (the fuel) they set it alight. He should endeavor that the āhavanīya fire reaches him first. Then the world of the gods comes to receive him. If the anvāhāryapacana (reaches him first), then the world of the fathers comes to receive him. If the gārhapatya, then he becomes established in this world with progeny and cattle. When it has been set ablaze, the smoke shakes the body. Because it shakes (dhunoti), therefore it is called dhuna. Dhuna is indeed its name. They call it dhūma ("smoke") in a cryptic way — by indirection indeed. For the gods are fond of the indirect. From the smoke he passes into the night, from the night into the day, from the day into the waning half-month, from the waning half-month into the waxing half-month, from the waxing half-month into the month. There, in the month, the body and the life-breath come together.
meaning: अथैताम् अनुस्तरणीम् आनयन्ति . तांप्रोक्ष्य त्रिर् अपसली पर्याणाय्य कूटेन हन्यात् . प्रदक्षिणं हैके पर्याणयन्ति . तद् उ तथा न कुर्यात् . तस्यै वस्पाम् उत्खिद्य शीर्ष्णि परिव्ययन्ति . हस्तयोर् मतस्नी हृदये हृदयं बाह्वोर् बाहू . यथाङ्गम् एवेतराण्य् अङ्गानि विचिन्वन्ति . अथैनं चर्मणा प्रोर्ण्वन्ति स्वया तन्वा समृध्यस्व इति . संस्तीर्योपादीपयन्ति . स तथैव चिकीर्षेद् यथैनम् आहवनीयः प्रथमो गच्छेत् . तद् एनं देवलोकः प्रत्यागच्छति . अथ यथान्वाहार्यपचनस् तद् एनं पितृलोकः प्रत्यागच्छति . अथ यथा गार्हपत्यस् तथास्मिन् लोके प्रजया च पशुभिश् च प्रतितिष्ठति . तस्योपादीप्तस्य धूम एव शरीरं धुनोति . स यद् धुनोति तस्माद् धुनः . धुनो ह वै नामैशः . तं धूम इति परोक्षम् आचक्षते परोक्षेणैव . परोक्षप्रिया इव हि देवाः . धूमाद् वै रात्रिम् अप्येति रात्रिया अहर् अह्नो ऽपोच्छन्तीपक्षम् अपोच्छन्तीपक्षाद् आपूर्यमाणपक्षम् आपूर्यमाणपक्षान् मासम् . ते अत्र मासे शरीरं चासुश् च संगच्छाते .

sanskrit_iast: taṃ pratibrūyāt vicakṣaṇād ṛtavo reta ābhṛtam ardhamāsyaṃ prasutāt pitryāvataḥ iti . yad ado vicakṣaṇaṃ somaṃ rājānaṃ juhvati tat tat . taṃ mā puṃsi kartary erayadhvam iti . puṃsi hy enam etat kartary erayante . puṃsaḥ kartur mātary āsiṣikta iti . mātari hy enam āsiñcati . sa upajāyopajāyamānas trayodaśena dvādaśopamāsaḥ iti . eṣa trayodaśo ya eṣa tapati . saṃ tad vide prati tad vide 'ham taṃ martavo 'mṛta ānayadhvaṃ dvādaśatrayodaśena pitrā tayā mātrā tayā śraddhayā tenānnādyena tena satyena ahar me pitā rātrir mātā satyam asmi taṃ martavo 'mṛta ānayadhvam iti . taṃ hartava ānayante . yathā vidvān vidvāṃsaṃ yathā jānan jānantam evaṃ hainam ṛtava ānayante . taṃ hātyarjayante . sa haiṣa na manuṣyo ya evaṃ veda . devānāṃ ha vai sa eko ya evaṃvit . taṃ ha vai manojavasaḥ pitaraś ca pitāmahāś ca pratyāgacchanti tataḥ kiṃ na āhārṣīr iti . tān pratibrūyād yat kiṃ ca puṇyam akaraṃ tad yuṣmākam iti . tasya putrā dāyam upayanti pitaras sādhukṛtyāṃ dviṣantaḥ pāpakṛtyām .
sentences: vicakṣaṇād r̥tavo reta ābʰr̥tam ardʰamāsyaṃ prasutāt pitryāvataḥ
yad ado vicakṣaṇaṃ somaṃ rājānaṃ juhvati tat tat .
puṃsi hy enam etat kartary erayante . puṃsaḥ kartur mātary āsiṣikta
saṃ tad vide prati tad vide 'ham taṃ martavo 'mr̥ta ānayadʰvaṃ dvādaśatrayodaśena pitrā
tayā mātrā tayā śraddʰayā tenānnādyena tena satyena
ahar me pitā rātrir mātā satyam asmi
yatʰā vidvān vidvāṃsaṃ yatʰā jānan jānantam evaṃ hainam r̥tava ānayante .
sa haiṣa na manuṣyo ya evaṃ veda .
devānāṃ ha vai sa eko ya evaṃvit .
taṃ ha vai manojavasaḥ pitaraś ca pitāmahāś ca pratyāgaccʰanti tataḥ kiṃ na āhārṣīr iti .
tān pratibrūyād yat kiṃ ca puṇyam akaraṃ tad yuṣmākam iti .
tasya putrā dāyam upayanti pitaras sādʰukr̥tyāṃ dviṣantaḥ pāpakr̥tyām .
text: One should answer him: "From the discerning one (the sun), seed has been gathered by the seasons, born from the half-monthly (cycle), from the realm of the fathers." That which is yonder — the discerning one — they offer Soma the king into it; that is that. "Place me in the male agent" — for they place him in the male agent. "From the male agent he has been poured into the mother" — for he (the father) pours him into the mother. "Being born and being born again, he is the thirteenth, the twelfth-monthly one" — this thirteenth is he who shines yonder (the sun). "I know that, I recognize that. O mortals, bring me to the immortal! With the twelfth and the thirteenth, with that father, with that mother, with that faith, with that food, with that truth — day is my father, night is my mother, I am truth. O mortals, bring me to the immortal!" The bearers bring him. As a knower (brings) a knower, as one who understands (brings) one who understands — so the seasons bring him. They carry him beyond. He who knows thus is indeed no longer a human being. He is one of the gods, he who knows thus. The fathers and grandfathers, swift as thought, come to receive him: "What have you brought for us?" He should answer them: "Whatever meritorious deed I performed, that is yours." His sons inherit his property, the fathers his good deeds; those who hate him (inherit) his evil deeds.
meaning: तं प्रतिब्रूयात् विचक्षणाद् ऋतवो रेत आभृतम् अर्धमास्यं प्रसुतात् पित्र्यावतः इति . यद् अदो विचक्षणं सोमं राजानं जुह्वति तत् तत् . तं मा पुंसि कर्तर्य् एरयध्वम् इति . पुंसि ह्य् एनम् एतत् कर्तर्य् एरयन्ते . पुंसः कर्तुर् मातर्य् आसिषिक्त इति . मातरि ह्य् एनम् आसिञ्चति . स उपजायोपजायमानस् त्रयोदशेन द्वादशोपमासः इति . एष त्रयोदशो य एष तपति . सं तद् विदे प्रति तद् विदे ऽहम् तं मर्तवो ऽमृत आनयध्वं द्वादशत्रयोदशेन पित्रा तया मात्रा तया श्रद्धया तेनान्नाद्येन तेन सत्येन अहर् मे पिता रात्रिर् माता सत्यम् अस्मि तं मर्तवो ऽमृत आनयध्वम् इति . तं हर्तव आनयन्ते . यथा विद्वान् विद्वांसं यथा जानन् जानन्तम् एवं हैनम् ऋतव आनयन्ते . तं हात्यर्जयन्ते . स हैष न मनुष्यो य एवं वेद . देवानां ह वै स एको य एवंवित् . तं ह वै मनोजवसः पितरश् च पितामहाश् च प्रत्यागच्छन्ति ततः किं न आहार्षीर् इति . तान् प्रतिब्रूयाद् यत् किं च पुण्यम् अकरं तद् युष्माकम् इति . तस्य पुत्रा दायम् उपयन्ति पितरस् साधुकृत्यां द्विषन्तः पापकृत्याम् .

sanskrit_iast: dīrghasattraṃ ha vā eta upayanti ye 'gnihotraṃ juhvati . etad dha vai sattraṃ jarāmūrīyam . jarayā vā hy evāsmān mucyate mṛtyunā vā . tad āhur yad etasya dīrghasattriṇo 'gnihotraṃ juhvato 'gnīn antareṇa yuktaṃ vā viyāyāt sasṃ vā careyuḥ kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti . vajro vai cakraḥ . vajro vā etasyāgnīn anveti yasyāntareṇa yuktaṃ vā viyāti saṃ vā caranti . kurvīta haiva niṣkṛtim api heṣṭyā yajeta . tad u tathā na vidyāt . imān vā eṣa lokān anuvitanute yo 'gnīn ādhatte . tasyāyam eva loko gārhapatyo bhavaty antarikṣaloko 'nvāhāryapacano 'sāv eva loka āhavanīyaḥ . kāmaṃ vā eṣu lokeṣu yuktaṃ cāyuktaṃ ca vayāṃsi saṃcaranti . sa vidyād yadi me 'pi grāma evāgnīn antareṇāyāsīn naiva ma ārtir asti na riṣṭiḥ kācaneti . trayo ha tvai grāmyāḥ paśavo 'juṣṭā durvarāha eḍakaś śvā .
sentences: dīrgʰasattraṃ ha vā eta upayanti ye 'gnihotraṃ juhvati .
jarayā vā hy evāsmān mucyate mr̥tyunā vā .
tad āhur yad etasya dīrgʰasattriṇo 'gnihotraṃ juhvato 'gnīn antareṇa yuktaṃ vā viyāyāt sasṃ vā careyuḥ kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti .
vajro vā etasyāgnīn anveti yasyāntareṇa yuktaṃ vā viyāti saṃ vā caranti .
kurvīta haiva niṣkr̥tim api heṣṭyā yajeta .
imān vā eṣa lokān anuvitanute yo 'gnīn ādʰatte .
tasyāyam eva loko gārhapatyo bʰavaty antarikṣaloko 'nvāhāryapacano 'sāv eva loka āhavanīyaḥ .
kāmaṃ vā eṣu lokeṣu yuktaṃ cāyuktaṃ ca vayāṃsi saṃcaranti .
sa vidyād yadi me 'pi grāma evāgnīn antareṇāyāsīn naiva ma ārtir asti na riṣṭiḥ kācaneti .
trayo ha tvai grāmyāḥ paśavo 'juṣṭā durvarāha eḍakaś śvā .
text: Those who offer the agnihotra undertake a long sattra-session indeed. This session indeed is the "old-age-death" one, for one is released from it either by old age or by death. Now they ask: "If, while this long-session sacrificer is offering the agnihotra, a yoked (cart) should pass between the fires, or (animals) should roam together (between them), what is the ritual act there, what is the expiation?" The wheel is a thunderbolt. The thunderbolt indeed follows the fires of him between whose (fires) a yoked (cart) passes or (animals) roam together. One should indeed perform an expiation; one should also sacrifice with an iṣṭi. But one should not think of it thus (as a catastrophe). He who establishes the fires extends these worlds. His gārhapatya becomes this world, the anvāhāryapacana becomes the world of the atmosphere, the āhavanīya becomes that world yonder. In these worlds, birds freely move about, both yoked and unyoked. One should know: "Even if (something) should pass between my fires in the village itself, there is no harm to me, no injury whatsoever." Three domestic animals, however, are unacceptable: a wild boar, a ram, and a dog.
meaning: दीर्घसत्त्रं ह वा एत उपयन्ति ये ऽग्निहोत्रं जुह्वति . एतद् ध वै सत्त्रं जरामूरीयम् . जरया वा ह्य् एवास्मान् मुच्यते मृत्युना वा . तद् आहुर् यद् एतस्य दीर्घसत्त्रिणो ऽग्निहोत्रं जुह्वतो ऽग्नीन् अन्तरेण युक्तं वा वियायात् सस्ं वा चरेयुः किं तत्र कर्म का प्रायश्चित्तिर् इति . वज्रो वै चक्रः . वज्रो वा एतस्याग्नीन् अन्वेति यस्यान्तरेण युक्तं वा वियाति सं वा चरन्ति . कुर्वीत हैव निष्कृतिम् अपि हेष्ट्या यजेत . तद् उ तथा न विद्यात् . इमान् वा एष लोकान् अनुवितनुते यो ऽग्नीन् आधत्ते . तस्यायम् एव लोको गार्हपत्यो भवत्य् अन्तरिक्षलोको ऽन्वाहार्यपचनो ऽसाव् एव लोक आहवनीयः . कामं वा एषु लोकेषु युक्तं चायुक्तं च वयांसि संचरन्ति . स विद्याद् यदि मे ऽपि ग्राम एवाग्नीन् अन्तरेणायासीन् नैव म आर्तिर् अस्ति न रिष्टिः काचनेति . त्रयो ह त्वै ग्राम्याः पशवो ऽजुष्टा दुर्वराह एडकश् श्वा .

sanskrit_iast: tad u haike chādimuṣṭim eva nivapanto yanti gārhapatyād āhavanīyād idaṃ viṣṇur vicakrame ity etayarcā . tad u tathā na kuryāt . yo ha tatra brūyād āsān nvā ayaṃ yajamānasyāvāpsīt kṣipre param āsān āvapsyate jyeṣṭhyagṛhyaṃ rotsyatīti tathā haiva syāt . ittham eva kuryāt . udapātraṃ vaivodakamaṇḍaluṃ vādāya gārhapatyād āhavanīyān ninayann iyāt idaṃ viṣṇur vicakrame ity etayaivarcā . devapavitraṃ vā etad yad ṛg devapavitram etad yad āpaḥ . tad yad evātra yajñasyāśāntaṃ bhavati yad amedhyam āpo vai tasya sarvasya śāntiḥ .
sentences: tad u haike cʰādimuṣṭim eva nivapanto yanti gārhapatyād āhavanīyād idaṃ viṣṇur vicakrame ity etayarcā .
yo ha tatra brūyād āsān nvā ayaṃ yajamānasyāvāpsīt kṣipre param āsān āvapsyate jyeṣṭʰyagr̥hyaṃ rotsyatīti tatʰā haiva syāt .
udapātraṃ vaivodakamaṇḍaluṃ vādāya gārhapatyād āhavanīyān ninayann iyāt idaṃ viṣṇur vicakrame ity etayaivarcā .
devapavitraṃ vā etad yad r̥g devapavitram etad yad āpaḥ .
tad yad evātra yajñasyāśāntaṃ bʰavati yad amedʰyam āpo vai tasya sarvasya śāntiḥ .
text: Now some, scattering only a handful of grain, go from the garhapatya to the ahavaniya with the verse 'idam visnur vicakrame' (Visnu strode forth). But one should not do it that way. For if someone were to say there, 'This sacrificer has obtained only a small portion; soon he will obtain a still smaller portion and will lose his preeminence,' it would indeed be so. One should do it in this manner: Taking a water vessel or a water jar, one should go from the garhapatya to the ahavaniya with the very same verse 'idam visnur vicakrame.' For the rc is a divine purifier; water is a divine purifier. Whatever of the sacrifice remains unquieted, whatever is impure -- water is the pacification of all that.
meaning: तद् उ हैके छादिमुष्टिम् एव निवपन्तो यन्ति गार्हपत्याद् आहवनीयाद् इदं विष्णुर् विचक्रमे इत्य् एतयर्चा . तद् उ तथा न कुर्यात् . यो ह तत्र ब्रूयाद् आसान् न्वा अयं यजमानस्यावाप्सीत् क्षिप्रे परम् आसान् आवप्स्यते ज्येष्ठ्यगृह्यं रोत्स्यतीति तथा हैव स्यात् . इत्थम् एव कुर्यात् . उदपात्रं वैवोदकमण्डलुं वादाय गार्हपत्याद् आहवनीयान् निनयन्न् इयात् इदं विष्णुर् विचक्रमे इत्य् एतयैवर्चा . देवपवित्रं वा एतद् यद् ऋग् देवपवित्रम् एतद् यद् आपः . तद् यद् एवात्र यज्ञस्याशान्तं भवति यद् अमेध्यम् आपो वै तस्य सर्वस्य शान्तिः .

sanskrit_iast: tad āhur yad etasya dīrghasattriṇo 'gnihotraṃ juhvato 'gnihotraṃ duhyamānaṃ skandet kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti . yad eva tatra sthālyāṃ pariśiṣṭaṃ syāt tena juhuyāt . yady u nīcī sthālī syād api vā bhidyeta kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti . skannaprāyaścittyai vābhimṛśya askann adhita iti . atha yad anyad vindet tena juhuyāt . yadā vai skandaty atha dhīyate . reto vai payo yonir iyam . yonyām evaitad retaḥ pratiṣṭhāpayati . anuṣṭhyāsya retas siktaṃ prajāyate ya evaṃ veda . amuto vai parjanyas skandatīhauṣadhayo vanaspatayo jāyante . puruṣād retas skandati paśubhyaḥ . tata idaṃ sarvaṃ prajātam . sa vidyād upa mā devāḥ prābhūvan prajātir me bhūyasy abhūc chreyān bhaviṣyāmīti . tathā haiva syāt . atho yatraitad vibhinnaṃ tad udapātraṃ vaivodakamaṇḍaluṃ vopaninayet bhūr bhuvas svaḥ ity etābhir vyāhṛtibhiḥ . etā vai vyāhṛtayas sarvaprāyaścittayaḥ .
sentences: tad āhur yad etasya dīrgʰasattriṇo 'gnihotraṃ juhvato 'gnihotraṃ duhyamānaṃ skandet kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti .
yad eva tatra stʰālyāṃ pariśiṣṭaṃ syāt tena juhuyāt .
yady u nīcī stʰālī syād api vā bʰidyeta kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti .
atʰa yad anyad vindet tena juhuyāt .
anuṣṭʰyāsya retas siktaṃ prajāyate ya evaṃ veda .
amuto vai parjanyas skandatīhauṣadʰayo vanaspatayo jāyante .
sa vidyād upa mā devāḥ prābʰūvan prajātir me bʰūyasy abʰūc cʰreyān bʰaviṣyāmīti .
atʰo yatraitad vibʰinnaṃ tad udapātraṃ vaivodakamaṇḍaluṃ vopaninayet bʰūr bʰuvas svaḥ ity etābʰir vyāhr̥tibʰiḥ .
text: They ask: If, while this performer of the long sattra is offering the agnihotra and the agnihotra milk being milked should spill, what is the procedure, what is the expiation? Whatever remains in the pot, with that he should offer. But if the pot should overturn or break, what is the procedure, what is the expiation? For the expiation of spilling, he should touch it saying 'askann adhita' (it has not spilled). Then whatever else he obtains, with that he should offer. For when it spills, it is deposited. Semen is milk; this earth is the womb. He thus establishes the semen in the womb. His semen, having been shed, generates offspring -- he who knows thus. From above Parjanya spills down; here below plants and trees are born. From a man semen spills forth; from that, cattle come. From that all this has been born. He should know: 'The gods have favored me; my progeny has become more abundant; I shall become better.' It would indeed be so. Now, wherever it is broken, one should bring near a water vessel or a water jar with the utterances bhur bhuvas svah. These utterances are the expiation for everything.
meaning: तद् आहुर् यद् एतस्य दीर्घसत्त्रिणो ऽग्निहोत्रं जुह्वतो ऽग्निहोत्रं दुह्यमानं स्कन्देत् किं तत्र कर्म का प्रायश्चित्तिर् इति . यद् एव तत्र स्थाल्यां परिशिष्टं स्यात् तेन जुहुयात् . यद्य् उ नीची स्थाली स्याद् अपि वा भिद्येत किं तत्र कर्म का प्रायश्चित्तिर् इति . स्कन्नप्रायश्चित्त्यै वाभिमृश्य अस्कन्न् अधित इति . अथ यद् अन्यद् विन्देत् तेन जुहुयात् . यदा वै स्कन्दत्य् अथ धीयते . रेतो वै पयो योनिर् इयम् . योन्याम् एवैतद् रेतः प्रतिष्ठापयति . अनुष्ठ्यास्य रेतस् सिक्तं प्रजायते य एवं वेद . अमुतो वै पर्जन्यस् स्कन्दतीहौषधयो वनस्पतयो जायन्ते . पुरुषाद् रेतस् स्कन्दति पशुभ्यः . तत इदं सर्वं प्रजातम् . स विद्याद् उप मा देवाः प्राभूवन् प्रजातिर् मे भूयस्य् अभूच् छ्रेयान् भविष्यामीति . तथा हैव स्यात् . अथो यत्रैतद् विभिन्नं तद् उदपात्रं वैवोदकमण्डलुं वोपनिनयेत् भूर् भुवस् स्वः इत्य् एताभिर् व्याहृतिभिः . एता वै व्याहृतयस् सर्वप्रायश्चित्तयः .

sanskrit_iast: athaitāni kapālāni saṃcitya yatrāhavanīyasya bhasmoddhṛtaṃ syāt tad upanikiret . etad evātra karma . atho khalv āhur yat prāca uddrutasya skandet kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti . yad eva tatra sruci pariśiṣṭaṃ syāt tena juhuyāt . yady u nīcī sruk syād api vā bhidyeta kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti . tasyoktaḥ pratyabhimarśaḥ . tad u haike tata eva pratyetyonnayanti . tad u tathā na kuryāt . yo ha tatra brūyād yad anenāghnihotreṇācikīrṣīn nyavṛtat tasmān nāsyedaṃ svargyam iva bhaviṣyatīti tathā haiva syāt . ittham eva kuryāt . yatraiva skandet tad upaviśet . athāsmin sthālīm āhareyus sravaṃ ca srucaṃ ca nirṇijya . tad ada evāsyonneṣyāmīty uktaṃ bhavati . atha yathonnītam unnīya samidham ādāya prāk preyāt . tad yathā pratyutthāyāmitrān paced evam evaitad avṛttiṃ pāpmānam apahatyāhutiṃ prāpnoti . tad u haika upeva labhante . ahutaṃ tasya yasyāgnihotrocchiṣṭena juhvati yātayāmaṃ hy etad iti vadantaḥ . tad u tathā na vidyāt .
sentences: atʰaitāni kapālāni saṃcitya yatrāhavanīyasya bʰasmoddʰr̥taṃ syāt tad upanikiret .
atʰo kʰalv āhur yat prāca uddrutasya skandet kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti .
yad eva tatra sruci pariśiṣṭaṃ syāt tena juhuyāt .
yady u nīcī sruk syād api vā bʰidyeta kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti .
tad u haike tata eva pratyetyonnayanti .
yo ha tatra brūyād yad anenāgʰnihotreṇācikīrṣīn nyavr̥tat tasmān nāsyedaṃ svargyam iva bʰaviṣyatīti tatʰā haiva syāt .
atʰāsmin stʰālīm āhareyus sravaṃ ca srucaṃ ca nirṇijya .
atʰa yatʰonnītam unnīya samidʰam ādāya prāk preyāt .
tad yatʰā pratyuttʰāyāmitrān paced evam evaitad avr̥ttiṃ pāpmānam apahatyāhutiṃ prāpnoti .
ahutaṃ tasya yasyāgnihotroccʰiṣṭena juhvati yātayāmaṃ hy etad iti vadantaḥ .
text: Then, having gathered together those potsherds, one should deposit them where the ashes of the ahavaniya have been taken out. This is the procedure for that case. Now they also ask: If it should spill while being carried eastward after being taken up, what is the procedure, what is the expiation? Whatever remains in the ladle, with that he should offer. But if the ladle should overturn or break, what is the procedure, what is the expiation? The counter-touching for that has been stated. Now some, returning from there, take it up again. But one should not do it that way. For if someone were to say there, 'What he intended to accomplish with the agnihotra has turned back; therefore his heavenly world will not come about,' it would indeed be so. One should do it in this manner: Wherever it spills, there one should sit down. Then they should bring him a pot and a ladle and a spoon, having rinsed them. It is then said, 'I shall take it up from here.' Then, having taken it up as prescribed, taking a fuel stick, he should go forth eastward. Just as one who rises up would defeat enemies, even so, having struck away the non-return and the evil, he reaches the oblation. Now some do obtain it while seated. 'Unoffered is that of him who offers with the remainder of the agnihotra, for it is exhausted,' they say. But one should not know it thus.
meaning: अथैतानि कपालानि संचित्य यत्राहवनीयस्य भस्मोद्धृतं स्यात् तद् उपनिकिरेत् . एतद् एवात्र कर्म . अथो खल्व् आहुर् यत् प्राच उद्द्रुतस्य स्कन्देत् किं तत्र कर्म का प्रायश्चित्तिर् इति . यद् एव तत्र स्रुचि परिशिष्टं स्यात् तेन जुहुयात् . यद्य् उ नीची स्रुक् स्याद् अपि वा भिद्येत किं तत्र कर्म का प्रायश्चित्तिर् इति . तस्योक्तः प्रत्यभिमर्शः . तद् उ हैके तत एव प्रत्येत्योन्नयन्ति . तद् उ तथा न कुर्यात् . यो ह तत्र ब्रूयाद् यद् अनेनाघ्निहोत्रेणाचिकीर्षीन् न्यवृतत् तस्मान् नास्येदं स्वर्ग्यम् इव भविष्यतीति तथा हैव स्यात् . इत्थम् एव कुर्यात् . यत्रैव स्कन्देत् तद् उपविशेत् . अथास्मिन् स्थालीम् आहरेयुस् स्रवं च स्रुचं च निर्णिज्य . तद् अद एवास्योन्नेष्यामीत्य् उक्तं भवति . अथ यथोन्नीतम् उन्नीय समिधम् आदाय प्राक् प्रेयात् . तद् यथा प्रत्युत्थायामित्रान् पचेद् एवम् एवैतद् अवृत्तिं पाप्मानम् अपहत्याहुतिं प्राप्नोति . तद् उ हैक उपेव लभन्ते . अहुतं तस्य यस्याग्निहोत्रोच्छिष्टेन जुह्वति यातयामं ह्य् एतद् इति वदन्तः . तद् उ तथा न विद्यात् .

sanskrit_iast: tad āhur yad etasya dīrghasattriṇo 'gnihotraṃ juhvato 'gnihotraṃ duhyamānam amedhyam āpadyeta kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti . tad u haike hotavyam eva manyante na vai devāḥ kasmāc cana bībhatsanta iti vadantaḥ . tad u tathā na vidyāt . puruṣo nveva bībhatseyād bībhatsate bībhatsāntā3 id u devāḥ . ittham eva kuryāt . gārhapatyasyaivoṣṇaṃ bhasma nirūhya tasminn enat tūṣṇīṃ ninayet . tan na hutaṃ nāhutam . adbhir anuninayet . adbhir evainad āpnoti . atha yad anyad vindet tena juhuyāt . atho khalv āhur yad dugdham amedhyam āpadyeta kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti . yeṣv evāṅgāreṣv adhiśrayiṣyan syāt tān eva pratyūhya teṣv evainat tūṣṇīṃ ninayet . tan na hutaṃ nāhutam . adbhir anuninayet . adbhir evainad āpnoti . atha yad anyad vindet tena juhuyāt . atho khalv āhur yad adhiśritam amedhyam āpadyeta kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti . yeṣv evāṅgāreṣv adhiśritaṃ syāt tān eva pratyūhya teṣv evainat tūṣṇīṃ ninayet . tan na hutaṃ nāhutam . yad ahainat teṣu ninayati tena hutaṃ yad v enāṃs teno evānugamayati teno ahutam . adbhir anuninayet . adbhir evainad āpnoti .

text: They ask: If, while this performer of the long sattra is offering the agnihotra and the agnihotra milk being milked should become impure, what is the procedure, what is the expiation? Now some think it should indeed be offered, saying, 'The gods do not feel disgust at anything.' But one should not know it thus. A man indeed might feel disgust; the gods too feel disgust at what is disgusting. One should do it in this manner: Having scraped out the hot ashes of the garhapatya, one should silently pour it into that. It is neither offered nor unoffered. One should pour water after it. By water one purifies it. Then whatever else one obtains, with that one should offer. Now they also ask: If the milk that has been milked should become impure, what is the procedure, what is the expiation? One should push back the very coals on which one was about to heat it and silently pour it on them. It is neither offered nor unoffered. One should pour water after it. By water one purifies it. Then whatever else one obtains, with that one should offer. Now they also ask: If what has been placed on the fire should become impure, what is the procedure, what is the expiation? One should push back the very coals on which it was placed and silently pour it on them. It is neither offered nor unoffered. In that one pours it on them, thereby it is offered; in that one lets them follow it, thereby it is unoffered. One should pour water after it. By water one purifies it.
meaning: तद् आहुर् यद् एतस्य दीर्घसत्त्रिणो ऽग्निहोत्रं जुह्वतो ऽग्निहोत्रं दुह्यमानम् अमेध्यम् आपद्येत किं तत्र कर्म का प्रायश्चित्तिर् इति . तद् उ हैके होतव्यम् एव मन्यन्ते न वै देवाः कस्माच् चन बीभत्सन्त इति वदन्तः . तद् उ तथा न विद्यात् . पुरुषो न्वेव बीभत्सेयाद् बीभत्सते बीभत्सान्ता३ इद् उ देवाः . इत्थम् एव कुर्यात् . गार्हपत्यस्यैवोष्णं भस्म निरूह्य तस्मिन्न् एनत् तूष्णीं निनयेत् . तन् न हुतं नाहुतम् . अद्भिर् अनुनिनयेत् . अद्भिर् एवैनद् आप्नोति . अथ यद् अन्यद् विन्देत् तेन जुहुयात् . अथो खल्व् आहुर् यद् दुग्धम् अमेध्यम् आपद्येत किं तत्र कर्म का प्रायश्चित्तिर् इति . येष्व् एवाङ्गारेष्व् अधिश्रयिष्यन् स्यात् तान् एव प्रत्यूह्य तेष्व् एवैनत् तूष्णीं निनयेत् . तन् न हुतं नाहुतम् . अद्भिर् अनुनिनयेत् . अद्भिर् एवैनद् आप्नोति . अथ यद् अन्यद् विन्देत् तेन जुहुयात् . अथो खल्व् आहुर् यद् अधिश्रितम् अमेध्यम् आपद्येत किं तत्र कर्म का प्रायश्चित्तिर् इति . येष्व् एवाङ्गारेष्व् अधिश्रितं स्यात् तान् एव प्रत्यूह्य तेष्व् एवैनत् तूष्णीं निनयेत् . तन् न हुतं नाहुतम् . यद् अहैनत् तेषु निनयति तेन हुतं यद् व् एनांस् तेनो एवानुगमयति तेनो अहुतम् . अद्भिर् अनुनिनयेत् . अद्भिर् एवैनद् आप्नोति .

sanskrit_iast: - yat prāg uddrutam amedhyam āpadyeta kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti . tad u haike hotavyam eva manyante pretam etan naitasyāhomaḥ kalpata iti vadantaḥ . atha haike 'dbhir abhyāsicya parāsiñcanti . tad u tathā na kuryāt . yo ha tatra brūyāt parāṅ vā ayam idam agnihotram asiñcat parāsekṣyate 'yaṃ yajamāna iti tathā haiva syāt . ittham eva kuryāt . āhavanīya eva samidham abhyādhāyāhavanīyasyaivoṣṇaṃ bhasma nirūhya tasminn enat tūṣṇīṃ ninayet . tan na hutaṃ nāhutam . adbhir anuninayet . adbhir evainad āpnoti . atha yad anyad vindet tena juhuyāt . atho khalv āhur yad avavarṣet kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti . sa vidyād upariṣṭān mā śukram āgāt prajātir me bhūyasy abhūc chreyān bhaviṣyāmīti . tathā haiva syāt . atho khalv āhur yat pūrvasyām āhutau hutāyām aṅgārā anugaccheyuḥ kvottarāṃ juhuyād iti . ya eva tatra śakalo 'ntikas syāt tam adhyasya (?) juhuyāt . dāraudārau hy agniḥ . sa yadi tasyāṃ na tiṣṭhed dhiraṇyam abhijuhuyāt . agner vā etad reto yad dhiraṇyam . ya u vai pitā sa putraḥ .
sentences: - yat prāg uddrutam amedʰyam āpadyeta kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti .
tad u haike hotavyam eva manyante pretam etan naitasyāhomaḥ kalpata iti vadantaḥ .
yo ha tatra brūyāt parāṅ vā ayam idam agnihotram asiñcat parāsekṣyate 'yaṃ yajamāna iti tatʰā haiva syāt .
āhavanīya eva samidʰam abʰyādʰāyāhavanīyasyaivoṣṇaṃ bʰasma nirūhya tasminn enat tūṣṇīṃ ninayet .
atʰa yad anyad vindet tena juhuyāt .
atʰo kʰalv āhur yad avavarṣet kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti .
sa vidyād upariṣṭān mā śukram āgāt prajātir me bʰūyasy abʰūc cʰreyān bʰaviṣyāmīti .
atʰo kʰalv āhur yat pūrvasyām āhutau hutāyām aṅgārā anugaccʰeyuḥ kvottarāṃ juhuyād iti .
ya eva tatra śakalo 'ntikas syāt tam adʰyasya (?) juhuyāt .
sa yadi tasyāṃ na tiṣṭʰed dʰiraṇyam abʰijuhuyāt .
agner vā etad reto yad dʰiraṇyam .
ya u vai pitā sa putraḥ .
text: If what has been carried eastward should become impure, what is the procedure, what is the expiation? Now some think it should indeed be offered, saying, 'This has departed; no offering applies to it.' And some sprinkle it away with water. But one should not do it that way. For if someone were to say there, 'This man has poured away the agnihotra in the wrong direction; this sacrificer will be poured away,' it would indeed be so. One should do it in this manner: Having placed a fuel stick on the ahavaniya itself, having scraped out the hot ashes of the ahavaniya, one should silently pour it into that. It is neither offered nor unoffered. One should pour water after it. By water one purifies it. Then whatever else one obtains, with that one should offer. Now they also ask: If it should rain, what is the procedure, what is the expiation? He should know: 'From above, brightness has come upon me; my progeny has become more abundant; I shall become better.' It would indeed be so. Now they also ask: If, when the first oblation has been offered, coals should follow, where should one offer the second? On whatever fragment of coal is nearest, placing it on that, one should offer. For fire is in each piece of wood. If it does not stay on that, one should offer gold upon it. Gold is the seed of Agni. He who is the father is also the son.
meaning: - यत् प्राग् उद्द्रुतम् अमेध्यम् आपद्येत किं तत्र कर्म का प्रायश्चित्तिर् इति . तद् उ हैके होतव्यम् एव मन्यन्ते प्रेतम् एतन् नैतस्याहोमः कल्पत इति वदन्तः . अथ हैके ऽद्भिर् अभ्यासिच्य परासिञ्चन्ति . तद् उ तथा न कुर्यात् . यो ह तत्र ब्रूयात् पराङ् वा अयम् इदम् अग्निहोत्रम् असिञ्चत् परासेक्ष्यते ऽयं यजमान इति तथा हैव स्यात् . इत्थम् एव कुर्यात् . आहवनीय एव समिधम् अभ्याधायाहवनीयस्यैवोष्णं भस्म निरूह्य तस्मिन्न् एनत् तूष्णीं निनयेत् . तन् न हुतं नाहुतम् . अद्भिर् अनुनिनयेत् . अद्भिर् एवैनद् आप्नोति . अथ यद् अन्यद् विन्देत् तेन जुहुयात् . अथो खल्व् आहुर् यद् अववर्षेत् किं तत्र कर्म का प्रायश्चित्तिर् इति . स विद्याद् उपरिष्टान् मा शुक्रम् आगात् प्रजातिर् मे भूयस्य् अभूच् छ्रेयान् भविष्यामीति . तथा हैव स्यात् . अथो खल्व् आहुर् यत् पूर्वस्याम् आहुतौ हुतायाम् अङ्गारा अनुगच्छेयुः क्वोत्तरां जुहुयाद् इति . य एव तत्र शकलो ऽन्तिकस् स्यात् तम् अध्यस्य (?) जुहुयात् . दारौदारौ ह्य् अग्निः . स यदि तस्यां न तिष्ठेद् धिरण्यम् अभिजुहुयात् . अग्नेर् वा एतद् रेतो यद् धिरण्यम् . य उ वै पिता स पुत्रः .

sanskrit_iast: - yad adhiśrite yajamāno mriyeta kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti . paryādhāyaivainad viṣyandayet . etad evātra karma . atho khalv eṣaiva sarveṣāṃ haviryajñānāṃ prāyaścittiḥ . atho khalv āhur yat prācy uddrute yajamāno mriyeta kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti . yad evādaś caturgṛhītam ādiṣṭaṃ syāt tatraivainad abhyunnayet . etad evātra karma . atho khalv āhur yat pūrvasyām āhutau hutāyāṃ yajamāno mriyeta kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti . tad u haike hotavyam eva manyante kṛtsnaṃ vā etasyāgnihotraṃ hutaṃ bhavati yasya pūrvā hutāhutir bhavatīti vadantaḥ . tad u tathā na vidyāt . na vai pretasyāgnihotraṃ juhoti . yad evādayaś caturgṛhītam ādiṣṭaṃ syāt tatraivainad abhyunnayet .
sentences: - yad adʰiśrite yajamāno mriyeta kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti .
atʰo kʰalv eṣaiva sarveṣāṃ haviryajñānāṃ prāyaścittiḥ .
atʰo kʰalv āhur yat prācy uddrute yajamāno mriyeta kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti .
yad evādaś caturgr̥hītam ādiṣṭaṃ syāt tatraivainad abʰyunnayet .
atʰo kʰalv āhur yat pūrvasyām āhutau hutāyāṃ yajamāno mriyeta kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti .
tad u haike hotavyam eva manyante kr̥tsnaṃ vā etasyāgnihotraṃ hutaṃ bʰavati yasya pūrvā hutāhutir bʰavatīti vadantaḥ .
yad evādayaś caturgr̥hītam ādiṣṭaṃ syāt tatraivainad abʰyunnayet .
text: If, when the milk has been placed on the fire, the sacrificer should die, what is the procedure, what is the expiation? Having heaped fuel around it, one should let it boil over. This is the procedure for that case. And indeed this is the expiation for all haviryajñas. Now they also ask: If, after the milk has been carried eastward, the sacrificer should die, what is the procedure, what is the expiation? Where the four-ladled ghee has been designated, there one should pour it up. This is the procedure for that case. Now they also ask: If, when the first oblation has been offered, the sacrificer should die, what is the procedure, what is the expiation? Now some think it should indeed be offered, saying, 'The agnihotra of him whose first oblation has been offered becomes complete.' But one should not know it thus. For one does not offer the agnihotra for one who has died. Where the four-ladled ghee has been designated, there one should pour it up.
meaning: - यद् अधिश्रिते यजमानो म्रियेत किं तत्र कर्म का प्रायश्चित्तिर् इति . पर्याधायैवैनद् विष्यन्दयेत् . एतद् एवात्र कर्म . अथो खल्व् एषैव सर्वेषां हविर्यज्ञानां प्रायश्चित्तिः . अथो खल्व् आहुर् यत् प्राच्य् उद्द्रुते यजमानो म्रियेत किं तत्र कर्म का प्रायश्चित्तिर् इति . यद् एवादश् चतुर्गृहीतम् आदिष्टं स्यात् तत्रैवैनद् अभ्युन्नयेत् . एतद् एवात्र कर्म . अथो खल्व् आहुर् यत् पूर्वस्याम् आहुतौ हुतायां यजमानो म्रियेत किं तत्र कर्म का प्रायश्चित्तिर् इति . तद् उ हैके होतव्यम् एव मन्यन्ते कृत्स्नं वा एतस्याग्निहोत्रं हुतं भवति यस्य पूर्वा हुताहुतिर् भवतीति वदन्तः . तद् उ तथा न विद्यात् . न वै प्रेतस्याग्निहोत्रं जुहोति . यद् एवादयश् चतुर्गृहीतम् आदिष्टं स्यात् तत्रैवैनद् अभ्युन्नयेत् .

sanskrit_iast: tad āhur yad etasya dīrghasattriṇo 'gnihotraṃ juhvato 'gnihotrī duhyamānopaviśet kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti . tām u haike yajuṣotthāpayanti . avṛttiṃ vā eṣā yajamānasya pāpmānaṃ pratidṛśyopaviśati yasyāgnihotrī duhyamānopavisati . tām utthāpayanti ud asthād devy aditiḥ iti . iyaṃ vai devy aditiḥ . imām evāsmai tad utthāpayanti . āyur yajñapatāv adhāt ity āyur evāsmiṃs tad dadhati . mitrāya varuṇāya ca iti prāṇāpānau nvai mitrāvaruṇau prāṇāpānāv evāsmiṃs tad dadhati . tāṃ tasyām evāhutau hutāyāṃ brāhmaṇāya dadati .
sentences: tad āhur yad etasya dīrgʰasattriṇo 'gnihotraṃ juhvato 'gnihotrī duhyamānopaviśet kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti .
avr̥ttiṃ vā eṣā yajamānasya pāpmānaṃ pratidr̥śyopaviśati yasyāgnihotrī duhyamānopavisati .
tām uttʰāpayanti ud astʰād devy aditiḥ iti .
āyur yajñapatāv adʰāt ity āyur evāsmiṃs tad dadʰati .
mitrāya varuṇāya ca iti prāṇāpānau nvai mitrāvaruṇau prāṇāpānāv evāsmiṃs tad dadʰati .
tāṃ tasyām evāhutau hutāyāṃ brāhmaṇāya dadati .
text: They ask: If, while this performer of the long sattra is offering the agnihotra, the agnihotra cow should sit down while being milked, what is the procedure, what is the expiation? Now some raise her up with a yajus formula. For she sits down having seen the non-return, the evil of the sacrificer -- she whose agnihotra cow sits down while being milked. They raise her up with 'ud asthad devy aditih' (The goddess Aditi has risen). This earth is the goddess Aditi. They raise this earth for him thereby. 'ayur yajnapatav adhat' (She has placed life in the lord of the sacrifice) -- thereby they place life in him. 'mitraya varunaya ca' (For Mitra and Varuna) -- Mitra and Varuna are the in-breath and the out-breath; thereby they place the in-breath and the out-breath in him. That cow, when that oblation has been offered, they give to a brahmana.
meaning: तद् आहुर् यद् एतस्य दीर्घसत्त्रिणो ऽग्निहोत्रं जुह्वतो ऽग्निहोत्री दुह्यमानोपविशेत् किं तत्र कर्म का प्रायश्चित्तिर् इति . ताम् उ हैके यजुषोत्थापयन्ति . अवृत्तिं वा एषा यजमानस्य पाप्मानं प्रतिदृश्योपविशति यस्याग्निहोत्री दुह्यमानोपविसति . ताम् उत्थापयन्ति उद् अस्थाद् देव्य् अदितिः इति . इयं वै देव्य् अदितिः . इमाम् एवास्मै तद् उत्थापयन्ति . आयुर् यज्ञपताव् अधात् इत्य् आयुर् एवास्मिंस् तद् दधति . मित्राय वरुणाय च इति प्राणापानौ न्वै मित्रावरुणौ प्राणापानाव् एवास्मिंस् तद् दधति . तां तस्याम् एवाहुतौ हुतायां ब्राह्मणाय ददति .

sanskrit_iast: tad u hovāca vājasaneyo 'śraddadhānebhyo haibhyo gaur apakrāmati . ārtyāhutiṃ (?) vidhyanti . ittham eva kuryāt . daṇḍam eva labdhvā tenaināṃ vipiṣyotthāpayet . tad yathā vā ado dhāvayato 'śvataro gadāyate yukto vā balīvarda upaviśati tena daṇḍaprajitena tottraprajitena yam adhvānaṃ kāmayate taṃ samaśnute . evam evaitayā daṇḍaprajitayā tottraprajitayā yaṃ svargaṃ lokaṃ kāmayate taṃ samaśnute . tām ātmann eva kurvīta .
sentences: tad u hovāca vājasaneyo 'śraddadʰānebʰyo haibʰyo gaur apakrāmati .
tad yatʰā vā ado dʰāvayato 'śvataro gadāyate yukto vā balīvarda upaviśati tena daṇḍaprajitena tottraprajitena yam adʰvānaṃ kāmayate taṃ samaśnute .
evam evaitayā daṇḍaprajitayā tottraprajitayā yaṃ svargaṃ lokaṃ kāmayate taṃ samaśnute .
text: Now Vajasaneya said: 'From those who lack faith the cow withdraws. They destroy the oblation through distress.' One should do it in this manner: Having simply taken a stick, one should beat her with it and make her rise. Just as a mule going along becomes weary, or a yoked bull sits down, and with a stick-driven, goad-driven animal one reaches whatever path one desires -- even so with this stick-driven, goad-driven cow one reaches whatever heavenly world one desires. One should keep her for oneself.
meaning: तद् उ होवाच वाजसनेयो ऽश्रद्दधानेभ्यो हैभ्यो गौर् अपक्रामति . आर्त्याहुतिं (?) विध्यन्ति . इत्थम् एव कुर्यात् . दण्डम् एव लब्ध्वा तेनैनां विपिष्योत्थापयेत् . तद् यथा वा अदो धावयतो ऽश्वतरो गदायते युक्तो वा बलीवर्द उपविशति तेन दण्डप्रजितेन तोत्त्रप्रजितेन यम् अध्वानं कामयते तं समश्नुते . एवम् एवैतया दण्डप्रजितया तोत्त्रप्रजितया यं स्वर्गं लोकं कामयते तं समश्नुते . ताम् आत्मन्न् एव कुर्वीत .

sanskrit_iast: tad āhur yad etasya dīrghasattriṇo 'gnihotraṃ juhvato 'gnihotrīvatso naśyet kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti . tad u hovācāruṇir dyaur vā agnihotrī tasyā āditya eva vatsa iyam evāgnihotrasthālī . na ha vā evaṃvido 'gnihotrīvatso naśyati . kva hy eṣa naśyet . no vā evaṃvido 'gnihotraṃ duhyamānaṃ skandati . asyāṃ hy evaṃ pratitiṣṭhati . no vā evaṃvido 'gnihotrī duhyamānopaviśati . yadā vā eṣā suvṛṣṭaṃ varṣaty abhiniṣadyeva (?) batāvarṣīd ity enām āhuḥ . atho khalv āhur yad eṣā lohitaṃ duhīta kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti . avṛttiṃ vā eṣā yajamānasya pāpmānaṃ pratidṛśya duhe yā lohitaṃ duhe . sa vyutkrāmate 'tyuktvānvāhāryapacanaṃ paricchādayitavai brūyāt . tad adhiśritya mekṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā śrapayet . tattad eva tūṣṇīṃ ninayet . anirukto vai prajāpatiḥ . prājāpatyam agnihotram . atho bhūr bhuvam svar ity etābhir vyāhṛtibhiḥ . etā vai vyāhṛtayas sarvaprāyaścittayaḥ .
sentences: tad āhur yad etasya dīrgʰasattriṇo 'gnihotraṃ juhvato 'gnihotrīvatso naśyet kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti .
tad u hovācāruṇir dyaur vā agnihotrī tasyā āditya eva vatsa iyam evāgnihotrastʰālī .
yadā vā eṣā suvr̥ṣṭaṃ varṣaty abʰiniṣadyeva (?) batāvarṣīd ity enām āhuḥ .
atʰo kʰalv āhur yad eṣā lohitaṃ duhīta kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti .
avr̥ttiṃ vā eṣā yajamānasya pāpmānaṃ pratidr̥śya duhe yā lohitaṃ duhe .
atʰo bʰūr bʰuvam svar ity etābʰir vyāhr̥tibʰiḥ .
text: They ask: If, while this performer of the long sattra is offering the agnihotra, the calf of the agnihotra cow should be lost, what is the procedure, what is the expiation? Aruni said: 'Heaven is the agnihotra cow; the sun is her calf; this earth is the agnihotra pot. The calf of the agnihotra cow of one who knows thus is never lost. For where could it be lost? Nor does the agnihotra milk of one who knows thus spill while being milked, for it is thus established on this earth. Nor does the agnihotra cow of one who knows thus sit down while being milked. When she rains well, they say of her, having indeed sat down, she has truly rained.' Now they also ask: If she should yield blood, what is the procedure, what is the expiation? For she yields blood having seen the non-return, the evil of the sacrificer. He departs. Having spoken beyond, one should say to cover the anvaharya-pacana fire. Having placed it on the fire and having made a stirring stick, one should cook it. That one should silently pour out. For Prajapati is unexpressed; the agnihotra belongs to Prajapati. Or with the utterances bhur bhuvas svah. These utterances are the expiation for everything.
meaning: तद् आहुर् यद् एतस्य दीर्घसत्त्रिणो ऽग्निहोत्रं जुह्वतो ऽग्निहोत्रीवत्सो नश्येत् किं तत्र कर्म का प्रायश्चित्तिर् इति . तद् उ होवाचारुणिर् द्यौर् वा अग्निहोत्री तस्या आदित्य एव वत्स इयम् एवाग्निहोत्रस्थाली . न ह वा एवंविदो ऽग्निहोत्रीवत्सो नश्यति . क्व ह्य् एष नश्येत् . नो वा एवंविदो ऽग्निहोत्रं दुह्यमानं स्कन्दति . अस्यां ह्य् एवं प्रतितिष्ठति . नो वा एवंविदो ऽग्निहोत्री दुह्यमानोपविशति . यदा वा एषा सुवृष्टं वर्षत्य् अभिनिषद्येव (?) बतावर्षीद् इत्य् एनाम् आहुः . अथो खल्व् आहुर् यद् एषा लोहितं दुहीत किं तत्र कर्म का प्रायश्चित्तिर् इति . अवृत्तिं वा एषा यजमानस्य पाप्मानं प्रतिदृश्य दुहे या लोहितं दुहे . स व्युत्क्रामते ऽत्युक्त्वान्वाहार्यपचनं परिच्छादयितवै ब्रूयात् . तद् अधिश्रित्य मेक्षणं कृत्वा श्रपयेत् . तत्तद् एव तूष्णीं निनयेत् . अनिरुक्तो वै प्रजापतिः . प्राजापत्यम् अग्निहोत्रम् . अथो भूर् भुवम् स्वर् इत्य् एताभिर् व्याहृतिभिः . एता वै व्याहृतयस् सर्वप्रायश्चित्तयः .

sanskrit_iast: - yad agnayo 'nugaccheyuḥ kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti . tam u haika ulmukād eva nirmanthanti . yato vai manuṣyasyāntato naśyati tato vāva sa tasya prāyaścittim icchata iti vadantaḥ . tad u tathā na vidyāt . ulmukaṃ hy eva tata ādāya cared ulmukasya vāvavraścam . ittham eva kuryāt . ulmukād evāpacchidyāraṇyor abhivimanthat . upāha taṃ kāmam āpnoti ya ulmukamathya (?) upo taṃ yo 'raṇyoḥ . atho khalv āhur yad āhavanīya uddhṛto 'nugacchet kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti . ananugato vā eṣa tāvad bhavati yāvad gārhapatyo nānugacchati . sa yady api bahv iva kṛtvo 'nugacchet punaḥpunar evainam uddharet . etad evātra karma . atho khalv āhur yad āhavanīya uddhṛte gārhapatyo 'nugacchet kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti . tam u haike tata eva prāñcam uddharanti . tad u tathā na kuryāt . yo ha tatra brūyāt prāco nvā ayaṃ yajamānasya prāṇān prāvṛkṣan mariṣyaty ayaṃ yajamāna iti tathā haiva syāt . tam u haike tata eva pratyañcam āharanti . prāṇo vai gṛhapatyo 'pāna āhavanīyaḥ . saṃvidānau vā imau prāṇāpānāv annam atta iti vadantaḥ . atho gṛho vai gṛhapatyaḥ . pratiṣṭho vai gṛhāḥ . sa ya enaṃ tatra brūyāt pra nvā ayam asyai pratiṣṭhāyā acyoṣṭa mariṣyaty ayaṃ yajamāna iti tathā haiva syāt . tam u haike gārhapatya eva mathitvopasamādadhati . tad u tathā na kuryāt . yo ha tatra brūyād agnāv adhy agnim ajījanat kṣipre 'sya dviṣan bhrātṛvyo janiṣyata iti tathā haiva syāt . tam u haike 'nugamayya manthanti . tad u tathā na kuryāt . yo ha tatra brūyād api yat pariśiṣṭam abhūt tad ajījasan nāsya dāyādaś cana pariśekṣyata iti tathā haiva syāt . ittham eva kuryāt . araṇyor eva samārohayeta ayaṃ te yonir ṛtviyo yato jāto arocathāḥ taṃ jānann agna ārohāthā no vardhayā rayim athā vardhayā giraḥ iti vā . sa udavasāya juhvad vaset . navāvasāne hāsyobhayatorātraṃ hutaṃ bhavati no kāṃ cana paricakṣāṃ kurute . sa prātar bhasmoddhṛtya śakṛtpiṇḍena parilipya yathāyatham agnīn ādadhīta .
sentences: - yad agnayo 'nugaccʰeyuḥ kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti .
tam u haika ulmukād eva nirmantʰanti .
yato vai manuṣyasyāntato naśyati tato vāva sa tasya prāyaścittim iccʰata iti vadantaḥ .
ulmukaṃ hy eva tata ādāya cared ulmukasya vāvavraścam .
upāha taṃ kāmam āpnoti ya ulmukamatʰya (?) upo taṃ yo 'raṇyoḥ .
atʰo kʰalv āhur yad āhavanīya uddʰr̥to 'nugaccʰet kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti .
ananugato vā eṣa tāvad bʰavati yāvad gārhapatyo nānugaccʰati .
sa yady api bahv iva kr̥tvo 'nugaccʰet punaḥpunar evainam uddʰaret .
atʰo kʰalv āhur yad āhavanīya uddʰr̥te gārhapatyo 'nugaccʰet kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti .
tam u haike tata eva prāñcam uddʰaranti .
yo ha tatra brūyāt prāco nvā ayaṃ yajamānasya prāṇān prāvr̥kṣan mariṣyaty ayaṃ yajamāna iti tatʰā haiva syāt .
tam u haike tata eva pratyañcam āharanti .
saṃvidānau vā imau prāṇāpānāv annam atta iti vadantaḥ .
sa ya enaṃ tatra brūyāt pra nvā ayam asyai pratiṣṭʰāyā acyoṣṭa mariṣyaty ayaṃ yajamāna iti tatʰā haiva syāt .
tam u haike gārhapatya eva matʰitvopasamādadʰati .
yo ha tatra brūyād agnāv adʰy agnim ajījanat kṣipre 'sya dviṣan bʰrātr̥vyo janiṣyata iti tatʰā haiva syāt .
yo ha tatra brūyād api yat pariśiṣṭam abʰūt tad ajījasan nāsya dāyādaś cana pariśekṣyata iti tatʰā haiva syāt .
ayaṃ te yonir r̥tviyo yato jāto arocatʰāḥ
taṃ jānann agna ārohātʰā no vardʰayā rayim atʰā vardʰayā giraḥ
navāvasāne hāsyobʰayatorātraṃ hutaṃ bʰavati no kāṃ cana paricakṣāṃ kurute .
sa prātar bʰasmoddʰr̥tya śakr̥tpiṇḍena parilipya yatʰāyatʰam agnīn ādadʰīta .
text: If the fires should follow (i.e., spread uncontrollably), what is the procedure, what is the expiation? Now some churn a new fire from the firebrand itself, saying, 'From whatever quarter a man's fire is ultimately lost, from that quarter one should seek its expiation.' But one should not know it thus. For one would simply take the firebrand from there and carry it, or cut a piece from the firebrand. One should do it in this manner: Having split off a piece from the firebrand, one should churn it in the fire-sticks. He attains the desire of one who churns from a firebrand, and also of one who churns from the fire-sticks. Now they also ask: If the āhavanīya, after being taken up, should follow (spread), what is the procedure, what is the expiation? It is not yet lost as long as the gārhapatya does not follow. Even if it follows many times, one should take it up again and again. This is the procedure for that case. Now they also ask: If, when the āhavanīya has been taken up, the gārhapatya should follow, what is the procedure, what is the expiation? Now some carry it forward from there in an eastward direction. But one should not do it that way. For if someone were to say there, 'This man has torn away the vital breaths of the sacrificer in the forward direction; this sacrificer will die,' it would indeed be so. Now some bring it back from there in a westward direction, saying, 'The gārhapatya is the prāṇa, the āhavanīya is the apāna. These two, prāṇa and apāna, being in accord, eat food.' And also: 'The gārhapatya is the house. Houses are the foundation. He who would say there, "This man has been dislodged from his foundation; this sacrificer will die," it would indeed be so.' Now some, having churned in the gārhapatya itself, pile it up. But one should not do it that way. For if someone were to say, 'He has generated fire upon fire; soon a hostile rival will be born to him,' it would indeed be so. Now some, having let it go out, churn. But one should not do it that way. For if someone were to say, 'Even what remained he has destroyed; not even an heir of his will survive,' it would indeed be so. One should do it in this manner: One should mount it upon the fire-sticks with 'ayaṃ te yonir ṛtviyo yato jāto arocathāḥ taṃ jānann agna ārohāthā no vardhayā rayim athā vardhayā giraḥ' (This is your womb, O seasonal one, from which, being born, you shone forth. Knowing that, O Agni, mount up; then increase our wealth, then increase our hymns). He should dwell offering the oblation at the new settlement. At a new settlement, his oblation is offered for both nights; he commits no omission of anyone. In the morning, having removed the ashes, having smeared with a lump of cow dung, he should establish the fires as before.
meaning: - यद् अग्नयो ऽनुगच्छेयुः किं तत्र कर्म का प्रायश्चित्तिर् इति . तम् उ हैक उल्मुकाद् एव निर्मन्थन्ति . यतो वै मनुष्यस्यान्ततो नश्यति ततो वाव स तस्य प्रायश्चित्तिम् इच्छत इति वदन्तः . तद् उ तथा न विद्यात् . उल्मुकं ह्य् एव तत आदाय चरेद् उल्मुकस्य वावव्रश्चम् . इत्थम् एव कुर्यात् . उल्मुकाद् एवापच्छिद्यारण्योर् अभिविमन्थत् . उपाह तं कामम् आप्नोति य उल्मुकमथ्य (?) उपो तं यो ऽरण्योः . अथो खल्व् आहुर् यद् आहवनीय उद्धृतो ऽनुगच्छेत् किं तत्र कर्म का प्रायश्चित्तिर् इति . अननुगतो वा एष तावद् भवति यावद् गार्हपत्यो नानुगच्छति . स यद्य् अपि बह्व् इव कृत्वो ऽनुगच्छेत् पुनःपुनर् एवैनम् उद्धरेत् . एतद् एवात्र कर्म . अथो खल्व् आहुर् यद् आहवनीय उद्धृते गार्हपत्यो ऽनुगच्छेत् किं तत्र कर्म का प्रायश्चित्तिर् इति . तम् उ हैके तत एव प्राञ्चम् उद्धरन्ति . तद् उ तथा न कुर्यात् . यो ह तत्र ब्रूयात् प्राचो न्वा अयं यजमानस्य प्राणान् प्रावृक्षन् मरिष्यत्य् अयं यजमान इति तथा हैव स्यात् . तम् उ हैके तत एव प्रत्यञ्चम् आहरन्ति . प्राणो वै गृहपत्यो ऽपान आहवनीयः . संविदानौ वा इमौ प्राणापानाव् अन्नम् अत्त इति वदन्तः . अथो गृहो वै गृहपत्यः . प्रतिष्ठो वै गृहाः . स य एनं तत्र ब्रूयात् प्र न्वा अयम् अस्यै प्रतिष्ठाया अच्योष्ट मरिष्यत्य् अयं यजमान इति तथा हैव स्यात् . तम् उ हैके गार्हपत्य एव मथित्वोपसमादधति . तद् उ तथा न कुर्यात् . यो ह तत्र ब्रूयाद् अग्नाव् अध्य् अग्निम् अजीजनत् क्षिप्रे ऽस्य द्विषन् भ्रातृव्यो जनिष्यत इति तथा हैव स्यात् . तम् उ हैके ऽनुगमय्य मन्थन्ति . तद् उ तथा न कुर्यात् . यो ह तत्र ब्रूयाद् अपि यत् परिशिष्टम् अभूत् तद् अजीजसन् नास्य दायादश् चन परिशेक्ष्यत इति तथा हैव स्यात् . इत्थम् एव कुर्यात् . अरण्योर् एव समारोहयेत अयं ते योनिर् ऋत्वियो यतो जातो अरोचथाः तं जानन्न् अग्न आरोहाथा नो वर्धया रयिम् अथा वर्धया गिरः इति वा . स उदवसाय जुह्वद् वसेत् . नवावसाने हास्योभयतोरात्रं हुतं भवति नो कां चन परिचक्षां कुरुते . स प्रातर् भस्मोद्धृत्य शकृत्पिण्डेन परिलिप्य यथायथम् अग्नीन् आदधीत .

sanskrit_iast: - abhy astam iyāt kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti . etasmād dha vai viśve devā apakrāmanti yasyāhavanīyam anuddhṛtam abhy astam eti . sa darbheṇa suvarṇaṃ hiraṇyaṃ prabadhya paścād dharet . tad etasya rūpaṃ kriyate ya eṣa tapati . ahno vā etad rūpam . tad ahno rūpaṃ kriyate . athedhmam ādīpya prāñcam hareyuḥ . tam upasamādhāya caturgṛhītam ājyaṃ gṛhītvā viśvebhyo devebhyas svāhā iti juhuyāt . tad yathā vā ada āvasathavāsinaṃ kruddhaṃ yantam ukṣavehatā vānumantrayetānyena vā priyeṇa dhāmnaivam eva tad viśvān devān anumantrayate . te hāsmai sarva evākruddhā bhavanti .
sentences: - abʰy astam iyāt kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti .
etasmād dʰa vai viśve devā apakrāmanti yasyāhavanīyam anuddʰr̥tam abʰy astam eti .
sa darbʰeṇa suvarṇaṃ hiraṇyaṃ prabadʰya paścād dʰaret .
tad etasya rūpaṃ kriyate ya eṣa tapati .
tam upasamādʰāya caturgr̥hītam ājyaṃ gr̥hītvā viśvebʰyo devebʰyas svāhā iti juhuyāt .
tad yatʰā vā ada āvasatʰavāsinaṃ kruddʰaṃ yantam ukṣavehatā vānumantrayetānyena vā priyeṇa dʰāmnaivam eva tad viśvān devān anumantrayate .
text: If the sun should set (while the āhavanīya is not yet taken up), what is the procedure, what is the expiation? All the gods withdraw from him whose āhavanīya has not been taken up when the sun sets. He should tie a gold piece with a darbha grass blade and carry it behind. The form of him who shines yonder is thus fashioned. It is the form of the day. The form of the day is thus fashioned. Then, having lit a fuel stick, they should carry it eastward. Having piled it up, having taken four-ladled ghee, he should offer with 'viśvebhyo devebhyas svāhā' (To all the gods, svāhā!). Just as one would address an angry householder coming with a gift of an ox-load, or with some other pleasing thing, even so one thereby addresses all the gods. They all become unangered toward him.
meaning: - अभ्य् अस्तम् इयात् किं तत्र कर्म का प्रायश्चित्तिर् इति . एतस्माद् ध वै विश्वे देवा अपक्रामन्ति यस्याहवनीयम् अनुद्धृतम् अभ्य् अस्तम् एति . स दर्भेण सुवर्णं हिरण्यं प्रबध्य पश्चाद् धरेत् . तद् एतस्य रूपं क्रियते य एष तपति . अह्नो वा एतद् रूपम् . तद् अह्नो रूपं क्रियते . अथेध्मम् आदीप्य प्राञ्चम् हरेयुः . तम् उपसमाधाय चतुर्गृहीतम् आज्यं गृहीत्वा विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यस् स्वाहा इति जुहुयात् . तद् यथा वा अद आवसथवासिनं क्रुद्धं यन्तम् उक्षवेहता वानुमन्त्रयेतान्येन वा प्रियेण धाम्नैवम् एव तद् विश्वान् देवान् अनुमन्त्रयते . ते हास्मै सर्व एवाक्रुद्धा भवन्ति .

sanskrit_iast: abhyudīyāt kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti . etasmād dha vai viśve devā apakrāmanti yasyāhavanīyam anuddhṛtam abhyudeti . sa darbheṇa rajataṃ hiraṇyaṃ prabadhya purastād dharet . tac candramaso rūpaṃ kriyate . rātrer vā etad rūpam . tad rātre rūpaṃ kriyate . athedhmam ādīpyānvañcaṃ hareyuḥ . tam upasamādhāya caturgṛhītam ājyaṃ gṛhītvā viśvebhyo devebhyas svāhā iti juhuyāt . yatra vai dīptaṃ tatraitad iha gārhapatya ity eva vidvān uddharet . asāv eva bandhu . atha haika āhur ete ha vai svargaṃ lokaṃ paśyanto juhvati ya ādityam iti .
sentences: abʰyudīyāt kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti .
etasmād dʰa vai viśve devā apakrāmanti yasyāhavanīyam anuddʰr̥tam abʰyudeti .
sa darbʰeṇa rajataṃ hiraṇyaṃ prabadʰya purastād dʰaret .
tam upasamādʰāya caturgr̥hītam ājyaṃ gr̥hītvā viśvebʰyo devebʰyas svāhā iti juhuyāt .
yatra vai dīptaṃ tatraitad iha gārhapatya ity eva vidvān uddʰaret .
atʰa haika āhur ete ha vai svargaṃ lokaṃ paśyanto juhvati ya ādityam iti .
text: If the sun should rise (while the āhavanīya is not yet taken up), what is the procedure, what is the expiation? All the gods withdraw from him whose āhavanīya has not been taken up when the sun rises. He should tie a silver piece with a darbha grass blade and carry it in front. The form of the moon is thus fashioned. It is the form of the night. The form of the night is thus fashioned. Then, having lit a fuel stick, they should carry it westward. Having piled it up, having taken four-ladled ghee, he should offer with 'viśvebhyo devebhyas svāhā' (To all the gods, svāhā!). Where there is a flame, there one should take it up as 'Here is the gārhapatya,' knowing thus. That one yonder is the kinsman. Now some say: 'They who offer looking toward the sun, they indeed offer seeing the heavenly world.'
meaning: अभ्युदीयात् किं तत्र कर्म का प्रायश्चित्तिर् इति . एतस्माद् ध वै विश्वे देवा अपक्रामन्ति यस्याहवनीयम् अनुद्धृतम् अभ्युदेति . स दर्भेण रजतं हिरण्यं प्रबध्य पुरस्ताद् धरेत् . तच् चन्द्रमसो रूपं क्रियते . रात्रेर् वा एतद् रूपम् . तद् रात्रे रूपं क्रियते . अथेध्मम् आदीप्यान्वञ्चं हरेयुः . तम् उपसमाधाय चतुर्गृहीतम् आज्यं गृहीत्वा विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यस् स्वाहा इति जुहुयात् . यत्र वै दीप्तं तत्रैतद् इह गार्हपत्य इत्य् एव विद्वान् उद्धरेत् . असाव् एव बन्धु . अथ हैक आहुर् एते ह वै स्वर्गं लोकं पश्यन्तो जुह्वति य आदित्यम् इति .

sanskrit_iast: yad agnayas saṃsṛjyeran kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti . sa yadi parastād anyo 'bhidahann eyāt sa vidyāt parastān mā śukram āgāt prajātir me bhūyasy abhūc chreyān bhaviṣyāmīti . tathā haiva syāt . yadi tv asya hṛdayaṃ vilikhed agnaye vivicaya iṣṭiṃ nirvapet . etā eva pañcadaśa sāmidhenīr vārtraghnāv ājyabhāgau virājau saṃyājye . athaite yājyāpuronuvākye vi te viṣvag vātajūtāso agne bhāmāsaś śuce śucayaś caranti tuvimrakṣāso divyā navagvā vanā vananti dhṛṣatā rujantaḥ iti . atha yājyā tvām agne mānuṣīr īl̥ate viśo hotrāvidaṃ viviciṃ ratnadhātamam guhā santaṃ subhaga viśvadarśataṃ tuviṣmaṇasaṃ suyajaṃ ghṛtaśriyam iti . atho hainayā pāpmanā vyāvṛtsyamāno yajeta . kṣipre haiva pāpmano vyāvartate . yadi tv ayam ito 'bhidahann eyād agnaye saṃvargāyeṣṭiṃ nirvapet .
sentences: yad agnayas saṃsr̥jyeran kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti .
sa yadi parastād anyo 'bʰidahann eyāt sa vidyāt parastān mā śukram āgāt prajātir me bʰūyasy abʰūc cʰreyān bʰaviṣyāmīti .
yadi tv asya hr̥dayaṃ vilikʰed agnaye vivicaya iṣṭiṃ nirvapet .
etā eva pañcadaśa sāmidʰenīr vārtragʰnāv ājyabʰāgau virājau saṃyājye .
vi te viṣvag vātajūtāso agne bʰāmāsaś śuce śucayaś caranti
tuvimrakṣāso divyā navagvā vanā vananti dʰr̥ṣatā rujantaḥ
tvām agne mānuṣīr īl̥ate viśo hotrāvidaṃ viviciṃ ratnadʰātamam
guhā santaṃ subʰaga viśvadarśataṃ tuviṣmaṇasaṃ suyajaṃ
yadi tv ayam ito 'bʰidahann eyād agnaye saṃvargāyeṣṭiṃ nirvapet .
text: If the fires should come together (merge), what is the procedure, what is the expiation? If another fire should come from beyond, burning toward him, he should know: 'From beyond, brightness has come upon me; my progeny has become more abundant; I shall become better.' It would indeed be so. But if it should wound his heart, he should offer an iṣṭi to Agni Vivici. These are the fifteen kindling verses, the two ājyabhāgas in vārtraghna mode, the two virāj verses as saṃyājyas. And these are the yājyā and puronuvākyā: 'vi te viṣvag vātajūtāso agne bhāmāsaś śuce śucayaś caranti tuvimrakṣāso divyā navagvā vanā vananti dhṛṣatā rujantaḥ' (Your flames, O Agni, driven by the wind, blazing, bright ones move in all directions; the divine Navagvas, bold destroyers, overthrow the forests, shattering them). And the yājyā: 'tvām agne mānuṣīr īl̥ate viśo hotrāvidaṃ viviciṃ ratnadhātamam guhā santaṃ subhaga viśvadarśataṃ tuviṣmaṇasaṃ suyajaṃ ghṛtaśriyam' (You, O Agni, the human clans praise, the knower of the offering, the discriminator, the best bestower of treasures, hidden, fortunate, visible to all, of great power, easy to worship, splendid with ghee). And he who wishes to turn away from evil should sacrifice with this. He quickly turns away from evil. But if this fire should come from here, burning toward the other, he should offer an iṣṭi to Agni Saṃvarga.
meaning: यद् अग्नयस् संसृज्येरन् किं तत्र कर्म का प्रायश्चित्तिर् इति . स यदि परस्ताद् अन्यो ऽभिदहन्न् एयात् स विद्यात् परस्तान् मा शुक्रम् आगात् प्रजातिर् मे भूयस्य् अभूच् छ्रेयान् भविष्यामीति . तथा हैव स्यात् . यदि त्व् अस्य हृदयं विलिखेद् अग्नये विविचय इष्टिं निर्वपेत् . एता एव पञ्चदश सामिधेनीर् वार्त्रघ्नाव् आज्यभागौ विराजौ संयाज्ये . अथैते याज्यापुरोनुवाक्ये वि ते विष्वग् वातजूतासो अग्ने भामासश् शुचे शुचयश् चरन्ति तुविम्रक्षासो दिव्या नवग्वा वना वनन्ति धृषता रुजन्तः इति . अथ याज्या त्वाम् अग्ने मानुषीर् ईल्̥अते विशो होत्राविदं विविचिं रत्नधातमम् गुहा सन्तं सुभग विश्वदर्शतं तुविष्मणसं सुयजं घृतश्रियम् इति . अथो हैनया पाप्मना व्यावृत्स्यमानो यजेत . क्षिप्रे हैव पाप्मनो व्यावर्तते . यदि त्व् अयम् इतो ऽभिदहन्न् एयाद् अग्नये संवर्गायेष्टिं निर्वपेत् .

sanskrit_iast: mā no asmin mahādhane parā varg bhārabhṛd yathā saṃ vargaṃ saṃ rayiṃ jaya iti . atha yājyā parasyā adhi saṃvato avaraṃ abhy ā tara yatrāham asmi taṃ ava iti . atho hainayā yad bhrātṛvyasya saṃvivṛkṣeta tatkāmo yajeta . kṣipre haivāsya saṃvṛṅkte . atho khalv āhur yad agnāv agnim abhyuddharet kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti . agnaye 'gnimata iṣṭiṃ nirvapet . etā eva pañcadaśa sāmidhenīr vārtraghnāv ājyabhāgau virājau saṃyājye . athaite yājyāpuronuvākye agnināgnis samidhyate kavir gṛhapatir yuvā havyavāḍ juhvāsyaḥ iti . atha yājyā tvaṃ hy agne agninā vipro vipreṇa san satā sakhā sakhyā samidhyase iti . atho hainayā brahmavarcasakāmo yajeta . tejasvī haiva brahmavarcasī bhavati . atho khalv āhur yad āhavanīyagārhapatyau saṃsṛjyeyātāṃ kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti . agnaye vītaya iṣṭiṃ nirvapet . etā eva pañcadaśa sāmidhenīr vārtraghnāv ājyabhāgau virājau saṃyājye . athaite yājyāpuronuvākye agna ā yāhi vītaye gṛṇāno havyadātaye ni hotā satsi barhiṣi iti . atha yājyā yo agniṃ devavītaye haviṣmam āvivāsati tasmai pāvaka mṛḍaya iti .
sentences: mā no asmin mahādʰane parā varg bʰārabʰr̥d yatʰā
parasyā adʰi saṃvato avaraṃ abʰy ā tara
atʰo hainayā yad bʰrātr̥vyasya saṃvivr̥kṣeta tatkāmo yajeta .
atʰo kʰalv āhur yad agnāv agnim abʰyuddʰaret kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti .
etā eva pañcadaśa sāmidʰenīr vārtragʰnāv ājyabʰāgau virājau saṃyājye .
tvaṃ hy agne agninā vipro vipreṇa san satā
atʰo kʰalv āhur yad āhavanīyagārhapatyau saṃsr̥jyeyātāṃ kiṃ tatra karma kā prāyaścittir iti .
etā eva pañcadaśa sāmidʰenīr vārtragʰnāv ājyabʰāgau virājau saṃyājye .
agna ā yāhi vītaye gr̥ṇāno havyadātaye
text: 'ma no asmin mahadhane para varg bharabhrd yatha sam vargam sam rayim jaya' (Do not let us be overcome in this great contest like a burden-bearer; win together the spoils, win together the wealth). And the yajya: 'parasya adhi samvato avaram abhy a tara yatraham asmi tam ava' (From beyond the boundary, cross over to the nearer side; protect that where I am). And he who wishes to devour his rival's possessions should sacrifice with this desire. He quickly devours his. Now they also ask: If one should take up fire upon fire, what is the procedure, what is the expiation? He should offer an isti to Agni Agnimat. These are the fifteen kindling verses, the two ajyabhagas in vartraghna mode, the two viraj verses as samyajyas. And these are the yajya and puronuvakya: 'agninagnis samidhyate kavir grhapatir yuva havyavad juhvasyah' (By Agni is Agni kindled -- the poet, the householder, the young one, the oblation-bearer with offering-mouth).
