And the yajya: 'tvam hy agne agnina vipro viprena san sata sakha sakhya samidhyase' (For you, O Agni, by Agni, inspired one by inspired one, being true by truth, friend by friendship, are kindled). And he who desires brahmavarcas should sacrifice with this. He becomes splendid, full of brahmavarcas. Now they also ask: If the ahavaniya and garhapatya should come together, what is the procedure, what is the expiation? He should offer an isti to Agni Vita. These are the fifteen kindling verses, the two ajyabhagas in vartraghna mode, the two viraj verses as samyajyas. And these are the yajya and puronuvakya: 'agna a yahi vitaye grnano havyadataye ni hota satsi barhisi' (O Agni, come for the feast, being praised, for the giving of oblations; sit down, O invoker, on the barhis). And the yajya: 'yo agnim devavitaye havishmam avivasti tasmai pavaka mrdaya' (He who serves Agni with oblations for the feast of the gods -- to him, O purifier, be gracious).
meaning: मा नो अस्मिन् महाधने परा वर्ग् भारभृद् यथा सं वर्गं सं रयिं जय इति . अथ याज्या परस्या अधि संवतो अवरं अभ्य् आ तर यत्राहम् अस्मि तं अव इति . अथो हैनया यद् भ्रातृव्यस्य संविवृक्षेत तत्कामो यजेत . क्षिप्रे हैवास्य संवृङ्क्ते . अथो खल्व् आहुर् यद् अग्नाव् अग्निम् अभ्युद्धरेत् किं तत्र कर्म का प्रायश्चित्तिर् इति . अग्नये ऽग्निमत इष्टिं निर्वपेत् . एता एव पञ्चदश सामिधेनीर् वार्त्रघ्नाव् आज्यभागौ विराजौ संयाज्ये . अथैते याज्यापुरोनुवाक्ये अग्निनाग्निस् समिध्यते कविर् गृहपतिर् युवा हव्यवाड् जुह्वास्यः इति . अथ याज्या त्वं ह्य् अग्ने अग्निना विप्रो विप्रेण सन् सता सखा सख्या समिध्यसे इति . अथो हैनया ब्रह्मवर्चसकामो यजेत . तेजस्वी हैव ब्रह्मवर्चसी भवति . अथो खल्व् आहुर् यद् आहवनीयगार्हपत्यौ संसृज्येयातां किं तत्र कर्म का प्रायश्चित्तिर् इति . अग्नये वीतय इष्टिं निर्वपेत् . एता एव पञ्चदश सामिधेनीर् वार्त्रघ्नाव् आज्यभागौ विराजौ संयाज्ये . अथैते याज्यापुरोनुवाक्ये अग्न आ याहि वीतये गृणानो हव्यदातये नि होता सत्सि बर्हिषि इति . अथ याज्या यो अग्निं देववीतये हविष्मम् आविवासति तस्मै पावक मृडय इति .

sanskrit_iast: prajananaṃ jyotir agnir devatānāṃ jyotir virāṭ chandasāṃ jyotir virāḍ vācaḥ . agnau saṃtiṣṭhate . virājaṃ saṃpadyate . tasmād eṣa jyotir ucyate . dvau stomau prātassavanaṃ vahato yathā cakṣuś ca prāṇaś ca tathā tat . dvau stomau mādhyandinaṃ savanaṃ vahato yathā ca śrotraṃ ca bāhū ca tathā tat . dvau stomau tṛtīyasavanaṃ vahato yathā madhyaṃ ca pratiṣṭhā ca tathā tat . hiṃkāreṇa vai jyotiṣā devās trivṛte brahmavarcasāya jyotir adadhuḥ . trivṛtā brahmavarcasena pañcadaśāyaujase vīryāya jyotir adadhuḥ . pañcadaśenaujasā vīryeṇa saptadaśāya prajāyai paśubhyaḥ prajananāya jyotir adadhuḥ . saptadaśena prajayā paśubhiḥ prajanenaikaviṃśāya pratiṣṭhāyai jyotir adadhuḥ . stomo vā etat stome jyotir dadhad eti . tasmāj jyotiṣṭoma ity ākhyāyate . atha yat stomas stomaṃ savanam abhipraṇayati tasmāj jyotiṣṭoma ity ākhyāyate .
sentences: prajananaṃ jyotir agnir devatānāṃ jyotir virāṭ cʰandasāṃ jyotir virāḍ vācaḥ .
dvau stomau prātassavanaṃ vahato yatʰā cakṣuś ca prāṇaś ca tatʰā tat .
dvau stomau mādʰyandinaṃ savanaṃ vahato yatʰā ca śrotraṃ ca bāhū ca tatʰā tat .
dvau stomau tr̥tīyasavanaṃ vahato yatʰā madʰyaṃ ca pratiṣṭʰā ca tatʰā tat .
hiṃkāreṇa vai jyotiṣā devās trivr̥te brahmavarcasāya jyotir adadʰuḥ .
trivr̥tā brahmavarcasena pañcadaśāyaujase vīryāya jyotir adadʰuḥ .
pañcadaśenaujasā vīryeṇa saptadaśāya prajāyai paśubʰyaḥ prajananāya jyotir adadʰuḥ .
saptadaśena prajayā paśubʰiḥ prajanenaikaviṃśāya pratiṣṭʰāyai jyotir adadʰuḥ .
stomo vā etat stome jyotir dadʰad eti .
atʰa yat stomas stomaṃ savanam abʰipraṇayati tasmāj jyotiṣṭoma ity ākʰyāyate .
text: The gayatri is the light of procreation and of the deities; the viraj is the light of the metres; the viraj is the light of speech. It is established in Agni. It attains the viraj. Therefore it is called 'light.' Two stomas carry the morning pressing, just as the eye and the breath -- so is that. Two stomas carry the midday pressing, just as the ear and the arms -- so is that. Two stomas carry the third pressing, just as the middle and the foundation -- so is that. With the himkara, with light, the gods placed light in the trivrt for brahmavarcas. With the trivrt, with brahmavarcas, they placed light in the pancadasa for vigor and strength. With the pancadasa, with vigor and strength, they placed light in the saptadasa for offspring, for cattle, for procreation. With the saptadasa, with offspring, with cattle, with procreation, they placed light in the ekavimsa for firm foundation. This is a stoma placing light in stoma after stoma. Therefore it is called jyotistoma. And because stoma after stoma carries forward each pressing, therefore it is called jyotistoma.
meaning: प्रजननं ज्योतिर् अग्निर् देवतानां ज्योतिर् विराट् छन्दसां ज्योतिर् विराड् वाचः . अग्नौ संतिष्ठते . विराजं संपद्यते . तस्माद् एष ज्योतिर् उच्यते . द्वौ स्तोमौ प्रातस्सवनं वहतो यथा चक्षुश् च प्राणश् च तथा तत् . द्वौ स्तोमौ माध्यन्दिनं सवनं वहतो यथा च श्रोत्रं च बाहू च तथा तत् . द्वौ स्तोमौ तृतीयसवनं वहतो यथा मध्यं च प्रतिष्ठा च तथा तत् . हिंकारेण वै ज्योतिषा देवास् त्रिवृते ब्रह्मवर्चसाय ज्योतिर् अदधुः . त्रिवृता ब्रह्मवर्चसेन पञ्चदशायौजसे वीर्याय ज्योतिर् अदधुः . पञ्चदशेनौजसा वीर्येण सप्तदशाय प्रजायै पशुभ्यः प्रजननाय ज्योतिर् अदधुः . सप्तदशेन प्रजया पशुभिः प्रजनेनैकविंशाय प्रतिष्ठायै ज्योतिर् अदधुः . स्तोमो वा एतत् स्तोमे ज्योतिर् दधद् एति . तस्माज् ज्योतिष्टोम इत्य् आख्यायते . अथ यत् स्तोमस् स्तोमं सवनम् अभिप्रणयति तस्माज् ज्योतिष्टोम इत्य् आख्यायते .

sanskrit_iast: asthūrir vā eṣa yajñaḥ puruṣasaṃmitaḥ . yatkāma enam āharate sam asmai kāma ṛdhyate . asthūriṇā hi tatra gacchati yatra jigamiṣati . prajāpatir yat prajā asṛjata tā agniṣṭomenāsṛjata . daśamena ca vai sa tā agniṣṭomasya stotreṇāsṛjata daśamena ca māsā saṃvatsarasya . tā dvādaśena caivāgniṣṭomasya stotreṇa paryagṛhṇād dvādaśena ca māsā saṃvatsarasya . tasmāt paśavo daśamāso garbhān bibhrati . ta ekādaśam anuprajāyante . na kā cana dvādaśam atiharati . parigṛhītā hi tena . tāsāṃ parigṛhītānām aśvataro 'tyapravata (?). tasyānuhāya reta ādatta . tad gardabhe nyamārṭ tad baḍabāyāṃ tat paśuṣu tad oṣadhīṣu . tasmād gardabho dviretās tasmād baḍabā dviretāḥ . tasmāt paśavo dvau dvau janayanti . tasmād oṣadhayo 'nabhyaktā rebhanti . tasmād aśvataro barhiṣi na deyaḥ . ati hy aplavatāpa hy akrāmat . āttaretā hy aprajā hi . ṣoḍaśinas stotre deyaḥ . atirikto vai ṣoḍaśi stotrāṇām atirikto 'śvataraḥ paśūnām . atirikta evā tad atiriktaṃ dadhati yajñasya salomatāyai . sa ya evaṃ vidvān agniṣṭomenodgāyati prājātāḥ prajā janayati pari prajātā gṛhṇāti . jyeṣṭhayajño vā eṣa prajāpatiyajño yad agniṣṭomaḥ .
sentences: yatkāma enam āharate sam asmai kāma r̥dʰyate .
astʰūriṇā hi tatra gaccʰati yatra jigamiṣati .
prajāpatir yat prajā asr̥jata tā agniṣṭomenāsr̥jata .
daśamena ca vai sa tā agniṣṭomasya stotreṇāsr̥jata daśamena ca māsā saṃvatsarasya .
tā dvādaśena caivāgniṣṭomasya stotreṇa paryagr̥hṇād dvādaśena ca māsā saṃvatsarasya .
tad gardabʰe nyamārṭ tad baḍabāyāṃ tat paśuṣu tad oṣadʰīṣu .
tasmād gardabʰo dviretās tasmād baḍabā dviretāḥ .
atirikto vai ṣoḍaśi stotrāṇām atirikto 'śvataraḥ paśūnām .
atirikta evā tad atiriktaṃ dadʰati yajñasya salomatāyai .
sa ya evaṃ vidvān agniṣṭomenodgāyati prājātāḥ prajā janayati pari prajātā gr̥hṇāti .
jyeṣṭʰayajño vā eṣa prajāpatiyajño yad agniṣṭomaḥ .
text: This sacrifice is light, proportioned to the person. Whatever desire one performs it for, that desire is fulfilled for him, for with a light vehicle one goes wherever one wishes to go. When Prajāpati created creatures, he created them with the agniṣṭoma. With the tenth stotra of the agniṣṭoma he created them, and with the tenth month of the year. With the twelfth stotra of the agniṣṭoma he enclosed them, and with the twelfth month of the year. Therefore cattle carry embryos for ten months. They are born in the eleventh. None carries beyond the twelfth, for they are enclosed by that. Of those enclosed ones, the mule escaped beyond. He took its semen by following it. He deposited it in the donkey, in the mare, in cattle, in plants. Therefore the donkey has double semen; therefore the mare has double semen. Therefore cattle give birth to two at a time. Therefore plants grow without being anointed. Therefore the mule should not be given as the barhis offering, for it escaped beyond, it departed. Its semen was taken away; it is barren. It should be given at the ṣoḍaśin stotra. For the ṣoḍaśin is the surplus of the stotras, and the mule is the surplus of cattle. He thus places the surplus upon the surplus, for the completeness of the sacrifice. He who, knowing thus, chants the udgītha with the agniṣṭoma generates creatures that are born and encloses those that are born. The agniṣṭoma is the foremost sacrifice, the sacrifice of Prajāpati.
meaning: अस्थूरिर् वा एष यज्ञः पुरुषसंमितः . यत्काम एनम् आहरते सम् अस्मै काम ऋध्यते . अस्थूरिणा हि तत्र गच्छति यत्र जिगमिषति . प्रजापतिर् यत् प्रजा असृजत ता अग्निष्टोमेनासृजत . दशमेन च वै स ता अग्निष्टोमस्य स्तोत्रेणासृजत दशमेन च मासा संवत्सरस्य . ता द्वादशेन चैवाग्निष्टोमस्य स्तोत्रेण पर्यगृह्णाद् द्वादशेन च मासा संवत्सरस्य . तस्मात् पशवो दशमासो गर्भान् बिभ्रति . त एकादशम् अनुप्रजायन्ते . न का चन द्वादशम् अतिहरति . परिगृहीता हि तेन . तासां परिगृहीतानाम् अश्वतरो ऽत्यप्रवत (?). तस्यानुहाय रेत आदत्त . तद् गर्दभे न्यमार्ट् तद् बडबायां तत् पशुषु तद् ओषधीषु . तस्माद् गर्दभो द्विरेतास् तस्माद् बडबा द्विरेताः . तस्मात् पशवो द्वौ द्वौ जनयन्ति . तस्माद् ओषधयो ऽनभ्यक्ता रेभन्ति . तस्माद् अश्वतरो बर्हिषि न देयः . अति ह्य् अप्लवताप ह्य् अक्रामत् . आत्तरेता ह्य् अप्रजा हि . षोडशिनस् स्तोत्रे देयः . अतिरिक्तो वै षोडशि स्तोत्राणाम् अतिरिक्तो ऽश्वतरः पशूनाम् . अतिरिक्त एवा तद् अतिरिक्तं दधति यज्ञस्य सलोमतायै . स य एवं विद्वान् अग्निष्टोमेनोद्गायति प्राजाताः प्रजा जनयति परि प्रजाता गृह्णाति . ज्येष्ठयज्ञो वा एष प्रजापतियज्ञो यद् अग्निष्टोमः .

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatir vāvedam agra āsīt . mano ha vai prajāpatir devatā . so 'kāmayata bahuḥ syāṃ prajāyeya bhūmānaṃ gaccheyam iti . sa śīrṣata eva mukhatas trivṛtaṃ stomam asṛjata gāyatrīṃ chando rathantaraṃ sāmāgniṃ devatāṃ brāhmaṇaṃ manuṣyam ajaṃ paśum . tasmād brāhmaṇo gāyatrīchandā āgneyo devatayā . tasmād u mukhaṃ prajānām . mukhād dhy enam asṛjata . so 'kāmayata praiva jāyeyeti . sa bāhubhyām evorasaḥ pañcadaśaṃ stomam asṛjata triṣṭubhaṃ chando bṛhat sāmendraṃ devatāṃ rājanyaṃ manuṣyam aśvaṃ paśum . tasmād rājanyas triṣṭupchandā aindro devatayā . tasmād u bāhubhyāṃ vīryaṃ karoti . bāhubhyāṃ hy enam uraso vīryād asṛjata .
sentences: so 'kāmayata bahuḥ syāṃ prajāyeya bʰūmānaṃ gaccʰeyam iti .
sa śīrṣata eva mukʰatas trivr̥taṃ stomam asr̥jata gāyatrīṃ cʰando ratʰantaraṃ sāmāgniṃ devatāṃ brāhmaṇaṃ manuṣyam ajaṃ paśum .
sa bāhubʰyām evorasaḥ pañcadaśaṃ stomam asr̥jata triṣṭubʰaṃ cʰando br̥hat sāmendraṃ devatāṃ rājanyaṃ manuṣyam aśvaṃ paśum .
bāhubʰyāṃ hy enam uraso vīryād asr̥jata .
text: Prajāpati alone was this universe in the beginning. Mind was Prajāpati, the deity. He desired: 'May I become many; may I procreate; may I attain abundance.' From his head, from his mouth, he created the trivṛt stoma, the gāyatrī metre, the rathantara sāman, Agni as deity, the brāhmaṇa among men, and the goat among animals. Therefore the brāhmaṇa has the gāyatrī as his metre, Agni as his deity. Therefore he is the foremost of creatures, for he created him from the mouth. He desired: 'May I procreate further.' From his arms, from his chest, he created the pañcadaśa stoma, the triṣṭubh metre, the bṛhat sāman, Indra as deity, the kṣatriya among men, and the horse among animals. Therefore the kṣatriya has the triṣṭubh as his metre, Indra as his deity. Therefore he performs deeds of valor with his arms, for he created him from the arms, from the chest, from valor.
meaning: प्रजापतिर् वावेदम् अग्र आसीत् . मनो ह वै प्रजापतिर् देवता . सो ऽकामयत बहुः स्यां प्रजायेय भूमानं गच्छेयम् इति . स शीर्षत एव मुखतस् त्रिवृतं स्तोमम् असृजत गायत्रीं छन्दो रथन्तरं सामाग्निं देवतां ब्राह्मणं मनुष्यम् अजं पशुम् . तस्माद् ब्राह्मणो गायत्रीछन्दा आग्नेयो देवतया . तस्माद् उ मुखं प्रजानाम् . मुखाद् ध्य् एनम् असृजत . सो ऽकामयत प्रैव जायेयेति . स बाहुभ्याम् एवोरसः पञ्चदशं स्तोमम् असृजत त्रिष्टुभं छन्दो बृहत् सामेन्द्रं देवतां राजन्यं मनुष्यम् अश्वं पशुम् . तस्माद् राजन्यस् त्रिष्टुप्छन्दा ऐन्द्रो देवतया . तस्माद् उ बाहुभ्यां वीर्यं करोति . बाहुभ्यां ह्य् एनम् उरसो वीर्याद् असृजत .

sanskrit_iast: sa udarād eva madhyatas saptadaśaṃ stomam asṛjata jagatīṃ chando vāmadevyaṃ sāma viśvān devān devatāṃ vaiśyaṃ manuṣyaṃ gāṃ paśum . tasmād vaiśyo jagatīchandā vaiśvadevo devatayā . tasmād u prajaniṣṇuḥ . udarād dhy enaṃ prajananād asṛjata . so 'kāmayata praiva jāyeyeti . sa padbhyām eva pratiṣṭhāyā ekaviṃśaṃ stomam asṛjatānuṣṭubhaṃ chando yajñāyajñīyaṃ sāma na kāṃ cana devatāṃ śūdraṃ manuṣyasm aviṃ paśum . tasmāc chūdro 'nuṣṭupchandā veśmapatidevaḥ . tasmād u pādāvanejyenaiva jijīviṣati . padbhyāṃ hy enaṃ pratiṣṭhāyā asṛjata . etayā vai sṛṣṭyā prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata . sa ya etad evaṃ veda bhūmānam eva prajayā paśubhir gacchati . tasmād v etaṃ yajñaṃ bhūyiṣṭhaṃ praśaṃsanti yad agniṣṭomam .
sentences: sa udarād eva madʰyatas saptadaśaṃ stomam asr̥jata jagatīṃ cʰando vāmadevyaṃ sāma viśvān devān devatāṃ vaiśyaṃ manuṣyaṃ gāṃ paśum .
sa padbʰyām eva pratiṣṭʰāyā ekaviṃśaṃ stomam asr̥jatānuṣṭubʰaṃ cʰando yajñāyajñīyaṃ sāma na kāṃ cana devatāṃ śūdraṃ manuṣyasm aviṃ paśum .
etayā vai sr̥ṣṭyā prajāpatiḥ prajā asr̥jata .
sa ya etad evaṃ veda bʰūmānam eva prajayā paśubʰir gaccʰati .
tasmād v etaṃ yajñaṃ bʰūyiṣṭʰaṃ praśaṃsanti yad agniṣṭomam .
text: From his belly, from the middle, he created the saptadasa stoma, the jagati metre, the vamadeya saman, the Visve Devah as deity, the vaisya among men, and the cow among animals. Therefore the vaisya has the jagati as his metre, the Visve Devah as his deity. Therefore he is prolific, for he was created from the belly, from the organ of procreation. He desired: 'May I procreate further.' From his feet, from his foundation, he created the ekavimsa stoma, the anustubh metre, the yajnayajniya saman, no particular deity, the sudra among men, and the sheep among animals. Therefore the sudra has the anustubh as his metre, the master of the house as his god. Therefore he seeks to live by washing feet, for he was created from the feet, from the foundation. With this creation Prajapati created creatures. He who knows this thus attains abundance through offspring and cattle. Therefore they praise this sacrifice most of all -- the agnistoma.
meaning: स उदराद् एव मध्यतस् सप्तदशं स्तोमम् असृजत जगतीं छन्दो वामदेव्यं साम विश्वान् देवान् देवतां वैश्यं मनुष्यं गां पशुम् . तस्माद् वैश्यो जगतीछन्दा वैश्वदेवो देवतया . तस्माद् उ प्रजनिष्णुः . उदराद् ध्य् एनं प्रजननाद् असृजत . सो ऽकामयत प्रैव जायेयेति . स पद्भ्याम् एव प्रतिष्ठाया एकविंशं स्तोमम् असृजतानुष्टुभं छन्दो यज्ञायज्ञीयं साम न कां चन देवतां शूद्रं मनुष्यस्म् अविं पशुम् . तस्माच् छूद्रो ऽनुष्टुप्छन्दा वेश्मपतिदेवः . तस्माद् उ पादावनेज्येनैव जिजीविषति . पद्भ्यां ह्य् एनं प्रतिष्ठाया असृजत . एतया वै सृष्ट्या प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत . स य एतद् एवं वेद भूमानम् एव प्रजया पशुभिर् गच्छति . तस्माद् व् एतं यज्ञं भूयिष्ठं प्रशंसन्ति यद् अग्निष्टोमम् .

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatiḥ prajābhya ūrjaṃ vyabhajat . tad udumbaras samabhavat . prajāpatir udgātā prājāpatya udumbaraḥ . vṛṇute 'nyān ṛtvijo nodgātāram . yad udgātā prathamena karmaṇaudumbarīm anvārabhate svayaiva tad devatayātmānam ārtvijyāya vṛṇīte . tām anvārabhate āyoṣ ṭvā sadane sādayāmy avataś chāyāyāṃ samudrasya hṛdaye . namas samudrāya namas samudrasya cakṣase . mā mā yonorvāṃ hāsīḥ iti . yad āha āyoṣ ṭvā sadane sādayāmi iti yajño vā āyus tasyaitat sadanaṃ kriyate . avataś chāyāyām iti . yajño vā avatiḥ . tasyaiṣā chāyā kriyate yat sadaḥ . samudrasya hṛdaye iti . madhyato vā ātmano hṛdayam . tasmān madhyatas sadasa audumbarīm īyate . namas samudrāya namas samudrasya cakṣase iti . vāg vai samudro manas samudrasya cakṣaḥ . etābhyām evaitad devatābhyāṃ namaskaroti . ārtvijyaṃ kariṣyan mā mā yonorvāṃ hāsīḥ iti sāma vai yonorvāṃ sāmna evaitan namaskaroti . ārtvijyaṃ kariṣyan nainaṃsāmāvahate . na sāmanyām ārtim ārchati . na sāmno hīyate ya evaṃ vidvān sāmne namaskaroti .
sentences: yad udgātā pratʰamena karmaṇaudumbarīm anvārabʰate svayaiva tad devatayātmānam ārtvijyāya vr̥ṇīte .
tām anvārabʰate āyoṣ ṭvā sadane sādayāmy avataś cʰāyāyāṃ samudrasya hr̥daye .
yad āha āyoṣ ṭvā sadane sādayāmi iti yajño vā āyus tasyaitat sadanaṃ kriyate .
namas samudrāya namas samudrasya cakṣase iti .
vāg vai samudro manas samudrasya cakṣaḥ .
ārtvijyaṃ kariṣyan mā mā yonorvāṃ hāsīḥ iti sāma vai yonorvāṃ sāmna evaitan namaskaroti .
na sāmno hīyate ya evaṃ vidvān sāmne namaskaroti .
text: Prajapati distributed vigor to his creatures. That became the udumbara wood. Prajapati is the udgatr; the udumbara belongs to Prajapati. He chooses the other priests but not the udgatr. When the udgatr grasps the udumbari post with his first ritual act, he thereby chooses himself for the priestly office through his own deity. He grasps it saying: 'ayos tva sadane sadayami avatas chayayam samudrasya hrdaye namas samudraya namas samudrasya caksase ma ma yonorvam hasih' (I seat you in the seat of life, in the shade of the well, in the heart of the ocean. Homage to the ocean, homage to the eye of the ocean. May the yonorvam not abandon me). When he says 'ayos tva sadane sadayami,' the sacrifice is ayus (life); its seat is thus made. 'avatas chayayam' -- the sacrifice is the well; the sacrificial hall is its shade. 'samudrasya hrdaye' -- the heart is in the middle of the self; therefore the udumbari is placed in the middle of the hall. 'namas samudraya namas samudrasya caksase' -- speech is the ocean, mind is the eye of the ocean. To these two deities he makes obeisance. 'ma ma yonorvam hasih' -- about to perform the priestly office: the saman is the yonorvam; to the saman he makes this obeisance. About to perform the priestly office, the saman does not carry him away. He does not come to harm through the saman. He is not diminished in the saman -- he who, knowing thus, makes obeisance to the saman.
meaning: प्रजापतिः प्रजाभ्य ऊर्जं व्यभजत् . तद् उदुम्बरस् समभवत् . प्रजापतिर् उद्गाता प्राजापत्य उदुम्बरः . वृणुते ऽन्यान् ऋत्विजो नोद्गातारम् . यद् उद्गाता प्रथमेन कर्मणौदुम्बरीम् अन्वारभते स्वयैव तद् देवतयात्मानम् आर्त्विज्याय वृणीते . ताम् अन्वारभते आयोष् ट्वा सदने सादयाम्य् अवतश् छायायां समुद्रस्य हृदये . नमस् समुद्राय नमस् समुद्रस्य चक्षसे . मा मा योनोर्वां हासीः इति . यद् आह आयोष् ट्वा सदने सादयामि इति यज्ञो वा आयुस् तस्यैतत् सदनं क्रियते . अवतश् छायायाम् इति . यज्ञो वा अवतिः . तस्यैषा छाया क्रियते यत् सदः . समुद्रस्य हृदये इति . मध्यतो वा आत्मनो हृदयम् . तस्मान् मध्यतस् सदस औदुम्बरीम् ईयते . नमस् समुद्राय नमस् समुद्रस्य चक्षसे इति . वाग् वै समुद्रो मनस् समुद्रस्य चक्षः . एताभ्याम् एवैतद् देवताभ्यां नमस्करोति . आर्त्विज्यं करिष्यन् मा मा योनोर्वां हासीः इति साम वै योनोर्वां साम्न एवैतन् नमस्करोति . आर्त्विज्यं करिष्यन् नैनंसामावहते . न सामन्याम् आर्तिम् आर्छति . न साम्नो हीयते य एवं विद्वान् साम्ने नमस्करोति .

sanskrit_iast: prajāpater vā etad udaraṃ yat sadaḥ . ūrg udumbaraḥ . yan madhyatas sadasa audumbarīm īyate madhyata evaitat prajānām annam ūrjaṃ dadhāti . tasmān madhyato 'śanam aśitaṃ dhinoti . tasmād yatraiṣā yātayāmnī kriyate tat prajā aśanāyukā bhavanti . poṣukā ha tvai bhavanti . upaspṛśyāṃ nopaspṛśyām iti mīmāṃsante . sarvaṃ vāvedam ātmanvat . yas tvā annam abhīva kāmayate tam evaitad bhūyiṣṭhaṃ dveṣṭi . yad upaspṛśed annādyaṃ prathamet . yan nopaspṛśed annādyād ātmānam antaryāt . upaspṛśya nasvāspṛṣṭenaivodgeyan nānnādyaṃ prathamati nānnādyād ātmānam antareti . sāma devānām annam ūrg udumbaraḥ . yad udgātaudumbarīṃ śrayate sāmann evaitad devānām annam ūrjaṃ dadhāti .
sentences: prajāpater vā etad udaraṃ yat sadaḥ .
yan madʰyatas sadasa audumbarīm īyate madʰyata evaitat prajānām annam ūrjaṃ dadʰāti .
tasmād yatraiṣā yātayāmnī kriyate tat prajā aśanāyukā bʰavanti .
yas tvā annam abʰīva kāmayate tam evaitad bʰūyiṣṭʰaṃ dveṣṭi .
upaspr̥śya nasvāspr̥ṣṭenaivodgeyan nānnādyaṃ pratʰamati nānnādyād ātmānam antareti .
yad udgātaudumbarīṃ śrayate sāmann evaitad devānām annam ūrjaṃ dadʰāti .
text: The sacrificial hall is the belly of Prajapati. The udumbara is vigor. When the udumbari is placed in the middle of the hall, one thereby places food and vigor in the middle of the creatures. Therefore food eaten in the middle nourishes. Therefore where this becomes used up, there the creatures become hungry. But they do become well-nourished. They deliberate whether it should be touched or not touched. Everything here is indeed endowed with a self. He who desires food as if greedily -- him it hates most. If one were to touch it, one would lose one's food. If one were not to touch it, one would exclude oneself from food. Having touched it but chanting as if not having touched -- he neither loses his food nor excludes himself from food. The saman is the food of the gods; the udumbara is vigor. When the udgatr leans on the udumbari, he thereby places food and vigor in the saman of the gods.
meaning: प्रजापतेर् वा एतद् उदरं यत् सदः . ऊर्ग् उदुम्बरः . यन् मध्यतस् सदस औदुम्बरीम् ईयते मध्यत एवैतत् प्रजानाम् अन्नम् ऊर्जं दधाति . तस्मान् मध्यतो ऽशनम् अशितं धिनोति . तस्माद् यत्रैषा यातयाम्नी क्रियते तत् प्रजा अशनायुका भवन्ति . पोषुका ह त्वै भवन्ति . उपस्पृश्यां नोपस्पृश्याम् इति मीमांसन्ते . सर्वं वावेदम् आत्मन्वत् . यस् त्वा अन्नम् अभीव कामयते तम् एवैतद् भूयिष्ठं द्वेष्टि . यद् उपस्पृशेद् अन्नाद्यं प्रथमेत् . यन् नोपस्पृशेद् अन्नाद्याद् आत्मानम् अन्तर्यात् . उपस्पृश्य नस्वास्पृष्टेनैवोद्गेयन् नान्नाद्यं प्रथमति नान्नाद्याद् आत्मानम् अन्तरेति . साम देवानाम् अन्नम् ऊर्ग् उदुम्बरः . यद् उद्गातौदुम्बरीं श्रयते सामन्न् एवैतद् देवानाम् अन्नम् ऊर्जं दधाति .

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatir udgātorg udumbaraḥ . sa eṣa ūrji śritaḥ prajāpatiḥ prajābhya ūrjam annādyaṃ vibhajati . udaṅṅ āsīna udgāyati . udīcīm eva tad diśam ūrjā bhājayati . pratyaṅṅ āsīnaḥ prastauti . pratīcīm eva tad diśam ūrjā bhājayati . dakṣiṇāsinaḥ pratiharati . dakṣiṇām eva tad diśam ūrjā bhājayati . prāñco 'nya ṛtvija ārtvijyaṃ kurvanti . prācīm eva tad diśam ūrjā bhājayanti . tasmād eṣā diśāṃ vīryavattamopajīvanīyatamā bhūyiṣṭhaiḥ prītā . tasmād yat prajā avṛttiṃ nīyanti prācīr eva yanti . eṣā hi diśāṃ vīryavattamopajīvanīyatamā bhūyiṣṭhaiḥ prītā . yad udīcīnadevatyā udgātāro 'tha kasmād viparyāvṛtya diśa ārtvijyaṃ kurvantīty āhuḥ . brūyād diśām abhiṣṭyai diśām abhipretyai . tasmāt sarvāsu dikṣv annaṃ vidyata iti . ud divaṃ stabhānāntarikṣaṃ pṛṇa pṛthivīm upareṇa dṛṃha . dyutānas tvā māruto minotu mitrāvaruṇayor dhruveṇa dharmaṇā . ghṛtena dyāvāpṛthivī ā prīṇīthām . supippalā oṣadhīḥ kṛdhi svāhā ity audumbarīm abhijuhoti .
sentences: sa eṣa ūrji śritaḥ prajāpatiḥ prajābʰya ūrjam annādyaṃ vibʰajati .
udīcīm eva tad diśam ūrjā bʰājayati .
pratīcīm eva tad diśam ūrjā bʰājayati .
dakṣiṇām eva tad diśam ūrjā bʰājayati .
prācīm eva tad diśam ūrjā bʰājayanti .
tasmād eṣā diśāṃ vīryavattamopajīvanīyatamā bʰūyiṣṭʰaiḥ prītā .
tasmād yat prajā avr̥ttiṃ nīyanti prācīr eva yanti .
eṣā hi diśāṃ vīryavattamopajīvanīyatamā bʰūyiṣṭʰaiḥ prītā .
yad udīcīnadevatyā udgātāro 'tʰa kasmād viparyāvr̥tya diśa ārtvijyaṃ kurvantīty āhuḥ .
tasmāt sarvāsu dikṣv annaṃ vidyata iti .
ud divaṃ stabʰānāntarikṣaṃ pr̥ṇa pr̥tʰivīm upareṇa dr̥ṃha .
dyutānas tvā māruto minotu mitrāvaruṇayor dʰruveṇa dʰarmaṇā .
supippalā oṣadʰīḥ kr̥dʰi svāhā ity audumbarīm abʰijuhoti .
text: Prajāpati is the udgātṛ; the udumbara is vigor. This Prajāpati, established upon vigor, distributes vigor and food to his creatures. Sitting facing north, he chants. Thereby he endows the northern direction with vigor. Sitting facing west, he performs the prastāva. Thereby he endows the western direction with vigor. Sitting facing south, he performs the pratihāra. Thereby he endows the southern direction with vigor. The other priests face east while performing the priestly office. Thereby they endow the eastern direction with vigor. Therefore this is the most vigorous, the most sustaining of the directions, favored by the most. Therefore when creatures are led to destruction, they go eastward, for this is the most vigorous, the most sustaining of the directions, favored by the most. 'If the udgātṛs have deities of the north, then why do they perform the priestly office turning to the opposite directions?' they ask. One should say: 'For the conquest of the directions, for the attainment of the directions. Therefore food is found in all directions.' He offers upon the udumbarī with: 'ud divaṃ stabhānāntarikṣaṃ pṛṇa pṛthivīm upareṇa dṛṃha dyutānas tvā māruto minotu mitrāvaruṇayor dhruveṇa dharmaṇā ghṛtena dyāvāpṛthivī ā prīṇīthām supippalā oṣadhīḥ kṛdhi svāhā' (Prop up heaven, fill the atmosphere, make firm the earth from above. May the shining Māruta establish you by the firm ordinance of Mitra and Varuṇa. May heaven and earth be pleased with ghee. Make the plants rich in fruit. Svāhā!).
meaning: प्रजापतिर् उद्गातोर्ग् उदुम्बरः . स एष ऊर्जि श्रितः प्रजापतिः प्रजाभ्य ऊर्जम् अन्नाद्यं विभजति . उदङ्ङ् आसीन उद्गायति . उदीचीम् एव तद् दिशम् ऊर्जा भाजयति . प्रत्यङ्ङ् आसीनः प्रस्तौति . प्रतीचीम् एव तद् दिशम् ऊर्जा भाजयति . दक्षिणासिनः प्रतिहरति . दक्षिणाम् एव तद् दिशम् ऊर्जा भाजयति . प्राञ्चो ऽन्य ऋत्विज आर्त्विज्यं कुर्वन्ति . प्राचीम् एव तद् दिशम् ऊर्जा भाजयन्ति . तस्माद् एषा दिशां वीर्यवत्तमोपजीवनीयतमा भूयिष्ठैः प्रीता . तस्माद् यत् प्रजा अवृत्तिं नीयन्ति प्राचीर् एव यन्ति . एषा हि दिशां वीर्यवत्तमोपजीवनीयतमा भूयिष्ठैः प्रीता . यद् उदीचीनदेवत्या उद्गातारो ऽथ कस्माद् विपर्यावृत्य दिश आर्त्विज्यं कुर्वन्तीत्य् आहुः . ब्रूयाद् दिशाम् अभिष्ट्यै दिशाम् अभिप्रेत्यै . तस्मात् सर्वासु दिक्ष्व् अन्नं विद्यत इति . उद् दिवं स्तभानान्तरिक्षं पृण पृथिवीम् उपरेण दृंह . द्युतानस् त्वा मारुतो मिनोतु मित्रावरुणयोर् ध्रुवेण धर्मणा . घृतेन द्यावापृथिवी आ प्रीणीथाम् . सुपिप्पला ओषधीः कृधि स्वाहा इत्य् औदुम्बरीम् अभिजुहोति .

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata . so 'gnim api mukhād asisṛkṣata . so 'gnir mukhād bībhatsamāna ūrdhvaṃ uddrutya mastiṣkam uddhatyāsṛjyata . taṃ devāś carṣayaś copasametyābruvan vitunno 'yaṃ mastiṣko māmuyā bhūt karavāmemaṃ kasyāṃ citācitīti . te bṛhaspatim abruvan somam asmin gṛhāṇeti . sa bṛhaspatir abravīt sa vā ayaṃ krūra ivāpūto 'medhyo 'śṛtaṃkṛta iti . vayaṃ ta etaṃ pūtaṃ medhyaṃ śṛtaṃkṛtaṃ kurma ity abruvan . taṃ vai ma āharateti . tatheti . tam asmai prāyacchan . taṃ pratyagṛhṇāt devasya tvā savituḥ prasave 'śvinor bāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ pratigṛhṇāmi iti . devāṅgair vāvainaṃ tat pratyagṛhṇāt . taṃ pratigṛhyāpavayat vasavas tvā punantu gāyatreṇa chandasā suprajāvaniṃ rāyas poṣavanim rudrās tvā punantu traiṣṭubhena chandasā suprajāvaniṃ rāyas poṣavanim ādityās tvā punantu jāgatena chandasā suprajāvaniṃ rāyas poṣavanim iti . chandobhiś ca vāvainaṃ tad devatābhiś cāpavayat . taṃ pavayitvā paścād akṣaṃ sādayati bārhaspatyam asi vānaspatyaṃ prajāpater mūrdhātyāyupātram iti . yad āha bārhaspatyam asi iti bṛhaspatir hy etam agre pratyagṛhṇāt . yad āha vānaspatyam iti vanaspatibhyo hy enam adhikurvanti . yad āha prajāpater mūrdhā iti prajāpater hy eṣa mūrdhāsīt . yad āha atyāyupātram ity ati hy etad anyāni pātrāṇi pātram . yad etad devapātraṃ prathamaṃ yujyata uttamaṃ vimucyate tenaivāty anyāni pātrāṇi . pra śreyasaḥ pātram āpnoti ya evaṃ veda .
sentences: so 'gnir mukʰād bībʰatsamāna ūrdʰvaṃ uddrutya mastiṣkam uddʰatyāsr̥jyata .
taṃ devāś carṣayaś copasametyābruvan vitunno 'yaṃ mastiṣko māmuyā bʰūt karavāmemaṃ kasyāṃ citācitīti .
te br̥haspatim abruvan somam asmin gr̥hāṇeti .
sa br̥haspatir abravīt sa vā ayaṃ krūra ivāpūto 'medʰyo 'śr̥taṃkr̥ta iti .
vayaṃ ta etaṃ pūtaṃ medʰyaṃ śr̥taṃkr̥taṃ kurma ity abruvan .
taṃ pratyagr̥hṇāt devasya tvā savituḥ prasave 'śvinor bāhubʰyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābʰyāṃ pratigr̥hṇāmi iti .

taṃ pratigr̥hyāpavayat vasavas tvā punantu gāyatreṇa cʰandasā suprajāvaniṃ rāyas poṣavanim rudrās tvā punantu traiṣṭubʰena cʰandasā suprajāvaniṃ rāyas poṣavanim ādityās tvā punantu jāgatena cʰandasā suprajāvaniṃ rāyas poṣavanim
cʰandobʰiś ca vāvainaṃ tad devatābʰiś cāpavayat .
taṃ pavayitvā paścād akṣaṃ sādayati bārhaspatyam asi vānaspatyaṃ prajāpater mūrdʰātyāyupātram iti .
yad āha bārhaspatyam asi iti br̥haspatir hy etam agre pratyagr̥hṇāt .
yad āha vānaspatyam iti vanaspatibʰyo hy enam adʰikurvanti .
yad āha prajāpater mūrdʰā iti prajāpater hy eṣa mūrdʰāsīt .
yad āha atyāyupātram ity ati hy etad anyāni pātrāṇi pātram .
yad etad devapātraṃ pratʰamaṃ yujyata uttamaṃ vimucyate tenaivāty anyāni pātrāṇi .
pra śreyasaḥ pātram āpnoti ya evaṃ veda .
text: Prajapati created creatures. He wished to emit Agni from his mouth. That Agni, shrinking from the mouth, burst upward, shattered the skull, and was emitted. The gods and rsis, having come together, said: 'This skull of ours is shattered; let it not remain so. Let us make it into something, placing it upon something.' They said to Brhaspati: 'Receive Soma in it.' Brhaspati said: 'But this is as if fierce, unpurified, impure, uncooked.' 'We shall make it purified, pure, cooked for you,' they said. 'Then bring it to me,' he said. 'So be it.' They gave it to him. He received it with: 'devasya tva savituh prasave asvinor bahubhyam pusno hastabhyam pratigrhnimi' (I receive you with the impulse of god Savitr, with the arms of the Asvins, with the hands of Pusan). With divine limbs he thus received it. Having received it, he purified it: 'vasavas tva punantu gayatrena chandasa suprajavaniim rayas posavanim rudras tva punantu traistubhena chandasa suprajavaniim rayas posavanim adityas tva punantu jagatena chandasa suprajavaniim rayas posavanim' (May the Vasus purify you with the gayatri metre, for good progeny, for increase of wealth. May the Rudras purify you with the traistubha metre, for good progeny, for increase of wealth. May the Adityas purify you with the jagata metre, for good progeny, for increase of wealth). With metres and deities he thus purified it. Having purified it, he placed it behind the axle, saying: 'barhaspatyam asi vanaspatyam prajapater murdhatyayupatram' (You are of Brhaspati, made of wood, the head of Prajapati, the vessel surpassing in life). When he says 'barhaspatyam asi,' it is because Brhaspati first received it. When he says 'vanaspatyam,' it is because they make it from a tree. When he says 'prajapater murdha,' it is because it was the head of Prajapati. When he says 'atyayupatram,' it is because this vessel surpasses other vessels. Because this divine vessel is yoked first and unyoked last, it thereby surpasses all other vessels. He who knows thus attains a superior vessel.
meaning: प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत . सो ऽग्निम् अपि मुखाद् असिसृक्षत . सो ऽग्निर् मुखाद् बीभत्समान ऊर्ध्वं उद्द्रुत्य मस्तिष्कम् उद्धत्यासृज्यत . तं देवाश् चर्षयश् चोपसमेत्याब्रुवन् वितुन्नो ऽयं मस्तिष्को मामुया भूत् करवामेमं कस्यां चिताचितीति . ते बृहस्पतिम् अब्रुवन् सोमम् अस्मिन् गृहाणेति . स बृहस्पतिर् अब्रवीत् स वा अयं क्रूर इवापूतो ऽमेध्यो ऽशृतंकृत इति . वयं त एतं पूतं मेध्यं शृतंकृतं कुर्म इत्य् अब्रुवन् . तं वै म आहरतेति . तथेति . तम् अस्मै प्रायच्छन् . तं प्रत्यगृह्णात् देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवे ऽश्विनोर् बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्यां प्रतिगृह्णामि इति . देवाङ्गैर् वावैनं तत् प्रत्यगृह्णात् . तं प्रतिगृह्यापवयत् वसवस् त्वा पुनन्तु गायत्रेण छन्दसा सुप्रजावनिं रायस् पोषवनिम् रुद्रास् त्वा पुनन्तु त्रैष्टुभेन छन्दसा सुप्रजावनिं रायस् पोषवनिम् आदित्यास् त्वा पुनन्तु जागतेन छन्दसा सुप्रजावनिं रायस् पोषवनिम् इति . छन्दोभिश् च वावैनं तद् देवताभिश् चापवयत् . तं पवयित्वा पश्चाद् अक्षं सादयति बार्हस्पत्यम् असि वानस्पत्यं प्रजापतेर् मूर्धात्यायुपात्रम् इति . यद् आह बार्हस्पत्यम् असि इति बृहस्पतिर् ह्य् एतम् अग्रे प्रत्यगृह्णात् . यद् आह वानस्पत्यम् इति वनस्पतिभ्यो ह्य् एनम् अधिकुर्वन्ति . यद् आह प्रजापतेर् मूर्धा इति प्रजापतेर् ह्य् एष मूर्धासीत् . यद् आह अत्यायुपात्रम् इत्य् अति ह्य् एतद् अन्यानि पात्राणि पात्रम् . यद् एतद् देवपात्रं प्रथमं युज्यत उत्तमं विमुच्यते तेनैवात्य् अन्यानि पात्राणि . प्र श्रेयसः पात्रम् आप्नोति य एवं वेद .

sanskrit_iast: namaḥ pitṛbhyaḥ pūrvasadbhyo namas sākaṃniṣadbhyaḥ yujye vācaṃ śatapadīṃ gāye sahasravartanīm gāyatraṃ traiṣṭubhaṃ jagad viśvā rūpāṇi saṃbhṛtam devā okāṃsi cakrire iti . yat namaḥ pitṛbhyaḥ pūrvasadbhyaḥ iti pitaro vā atra pūrva upasīdanti . na tebhya evaitan namaskaroti namas sākaṃniṣadbhyaḥ iti yair eva brāhmaṇais sahopasīdaty ārtvijyaṃ kariṣyaṃs tebhya evaitan namaskaroti . yujye vācaṃ śatapadīm iti vācam evaitac chatapadīṃ yuṅkte . gāye sahasravartanīm itiyuktām evainām etat sahasravartanīṃ bhūtāṃ gāyati . gāyatraṃ traiṣṭubhaṃ jagat iti etāni vai trīṇi savanāni tāny evaitāny ātman parigṛhṇīte .
sentences: gāyatraṃ traiṣṭubʰaṃ jagad viśvā rūpāṇi saṃbʰr̥tam
yat namaḥ pitr̥bʰyaḥ pūrvasadbʰyaḥ iti pitaro vā atra pūrva upasīdanti .
na tebʰya evaitan namaskaroti namas sākaṃniṣadbʰyaḥ iti yair eva brāhmaṇais sahopasīdaty ārtvijyaṃ kariṣyaṃs tebʰya evaitan namaskaroti .
yujye vācaṃ śatapadīm iti vācam evaitac cʰatapadīṃ yuṅkte .
gāye sahasravartanīm itiyuktām evainām etat sahasravartanīṃ bʰūtāṃ gāyati .
gāyatraṃ traiṣṭubʰaṃ jagat iti etāni vai trīṇi savanāni tāny evaitāny ātman parigr̥hṇīte .
text: 'namah pitrbhyah purvasadbhyo namas sakamnisadbhyah yujye vacam satapadiim gaye sahasravartaniim gayatram traistubham jagad visva rupani sambhrtam deva okansi cakrire' (Homage to the fathers who sat before; homage to those who sit together. I yoke the hundred-footed speech; I sing the thousand-pathed. The gayatra, the traistubha, the jagata -- all forms assembled -- the gods have made their dwellings). When he says 'namah pitrbhyah purvasadbhyah,' the fathers sit there before; to them he makes obeisance. 'namas sakamnisadbhyah' -- to the very brahmanas with whom he sits together, about to perform the priestly office, to them he makes this obeisance. 'yujye vacam satapadiim' -- he thereby yokes speech with its hundred feet. 'gaye sahasravartaniim' -- he sings it thus yoked, become thousand-pathed. 'gayatram traistubham jagat' -- these are the three pressings; he thereby takes hold of them upon himself.
meaning: नमः पितृभ्यः पूर्वसद्भ्यो नमस् साकंनिषद्भ्यः युज्ये वाचं शतपदीं गाये सहस्रवर्तनीम् गायत्रं त्रैष्टुभं जगद् विश्वा रूपाणि संभृतम् देवा ओकांसि चक्रिरे इति . यत् नमः पितृभ्यः पूर्वसद्भ्यः इति पितरो वा अत्र पूर्व उपसीदन्ति . न तेभ्य एवैतन् नमस्करोति नमस् साकंनिषद्भ्यः इति यैर् एव ब्राह्मणैस् सहोपसीदत्य् आर्त्विज्यं करिष्यंस् तेभ्य एवैतन् नमस्करोति . युज्ये वाचं शतपदीम् इति वाचम् एवैतच् छतपदीं युङ्क्ते . गाये सहस्रवर्तनीम् इतियुक्ताम् एवैनाम् एतत् सहस्रवर्तनीं भूतां गायति . गायत्रं त्रैष्टुभं जगत् इति एतानि वै त्रीणि सवनानि तान्य् एवैतान्य् आत्मन् परिगृह्णीते .

sanskrit_iast: kusurvindo hauddālakis somānām ujjagau . tam u hāsitamṛgā kaśyapānāṃ putrā ūcuḥ ko nu no 'yaṃ nṛśaṃsako 'nta udgāyaty etemam anuvyāhariṣyāma iti . te 'nuvyāhariṣyanta āstāvam upaseduḥ . sa hovāca namo brāhmaṇā astu purā vā aham adya prātaranuvākād gāyatreṇa viśvarūpāsu yajñaṃ samasthāpayam . sa yathā gobhir gavāyam itvā śramaṇam abalam anusaṃnuded evaṃ vāvedaṃ yajñaśarīram anusaṃnudāma iti . te hotthāya pravavrajur namo 'smai brāhmaṇāyāstu vidāṃ vā ayam idaṃ cakāreti .
sentences: tam u hāsitamr̥gā kaśyapānāṃ putrā ūcuḥ ko nu no 'yaṃ nr̥śaṃsako 'nta udgāyaty etemam anuvyāhariṣyāma iti .
sa hovāca namo brāhmaṇā astu purā vā aham adya prātaranuvākād gāyatreṇa viśvarūpāsu yajñaṃ samastʰāpayam .
sa yatʰā gobʰir gavāyam itvā śramaṇam abalam anusaṃnuded evaṃ vāvedaṃ yajñaśarīram anusaṃnudāma iti .
te hottʰāya pravavrajur namo 'smai brāhmaṇāyāstu vidāṃ vā ayam idaṃ cakāreti .
text: Kusurvinda Hauddālaki chanted the udgītha at a soma sacrifice. The sons of Asitamṛga of the Kaśyapa clan said to him: 'Who is this cruel one who chants among us? Let us challenge him.' They approached the āstāva to make the challenge. He said: 'Let there be homage to the brāhmaṇa. Even before today, before the morning recitation, I established the sacrifice in all forms through the gāyatra. Just as one who has gone among cows to find a wild ox might drive along a weary, feeble one, even so we are driving along this body of the sacrifice.' They rose up and departed, saying, 'Let there be homage to that brāhmaṇa! He indeed has accomplished this.'
meaning: कुसुर्विन्दो हौद्दालकिस् सोमानाम् उज्जगौ . तम् उ हासितमृगा कश्यपानां पुत्रा ऊचुः को नु नो ऽयं नृशंसको ऽन्त उद्गायत्य् एतेमम् अनुव्याहरिष्याम इति . ते ऽनुव्याहरिष्यन्त आस्तावम् उपसेदुः . स होवाच नमो ब्राह्मणा अस्तु पुरा वा अहम् अद्य प्रातरनुवाकाद् गायत्रेण विश्वरूपासु यज्ञं समस्थापयम् . स यथा गोभिर् गवायम् इत्वा श्रमणम् अबलम् अनुसंनुदेद् एवं वावेदं यज्ञशरीरम् अनुसंनुदाम इति . ते होत्थाय प्रवव्रजुर् नमो ऽस्मै ब्राह्मणायास्तु विदां वा अयम् इदं चकारेति .

sanskrit_iast: tad āhuḥ adhvaryo kiṃ stutaṃ stotraṃ hotā prātaranuvākenānvaśaṃsīt iti . akarma vayaṃ tad yad asmākaṃ karma ity āha hotāraṃ pṛcchata iti . hotaḥ kiṃ stutaṃ stotraṃ prātaranuvākenānvaśaṃsīḥ iti . akarma vayaṃ tad yad asmākaṃ karma ity āha udgātāraṃ pṛcchata iti . udgātaḥ kiṃ stutaṃ stotraṃ hotā prātaranuvākenānvaśaṃsīt iti . akarma vayaṃ tad yad asmākaṃ karma iti brūyād agāsiṣma yad atra geyam iti . taṃ yadi brūyuḥ tamāṃsi vā agāsīr na jyotīṃṣi agāsiṣaṃ yuṣmān eva tamasā pāpmanā vidhyāni iti .
sentences: tad āhuḥ adʰvaryo kiṃ stutaṃ stotraṃ hotā prātaranuvākenānvaśaṃsīt iti .
akarma vayaṃ tad yad asmākaṃ karma ity āha hotāraṃ pr̥ccʰata iti .
hotaḥ kiṃ stutaṃ stotraṃ prātaranuvākenānvaśaṃsīḥ iti .
akarma vayaṃ tad yad asmākaṃ karma ity āha udgātāraṃ pr̥ccʰata iti .
udgātaḥ kiṃ stutaṃ stotraṃ hotā prātaranuvākenānvaśaṃsīt iti .
akarma vayaṃ tad yad asmākaṃ karma iti brūyād agāsiṣma yad atra geyam iti .
taṃ yadi brūyuḥ tamāṃsi vā agāsīr na jyotīṃṣi agāsiṣaṃ yuṣmān eva tamasā pāpmanā vidʰyāni iti .
text: They ask: 'Adhvaryu, which stotra was praised that the hotṛ recited with the morning litany?' He says: 'We have done what was our work,' and says, 'Ask the hotṛ.' 'Hotṛ, which stotra was praised that you recited with the morning litany?' He says: 'We have done what was our work,' and says, 'Ask the udgātṛ.' 'Udgātṛ, which stotra was praised that the hotṛ recited with the morning litany?' He should say: 'We have done what was our work,' and 'We have sung what was to be sung here.' If they should say to him, 'You have sung the darknesses, not the lights,' he should reply: 'I have sung them; I should strike you with darkness and evil.'
meaning: तद् आहुः अध्वर्यो किं स्तुतं स्तोत्रं होता प्रातरनुवाकेनान्वशंसीत् इति . अकर्म वयं तद् यद् अस्माकं कर्म इत्य् आह होतारं पृच्छत इति . होतः किं स्तुतं स्तोत्रं प्रातरनुवाकेनान्वशंसीः इति . अकर्म वयं तद् यद् अस्माकं कर्म इत्य् आह उद्गातारं पृच्छत इति . उद्गातः किं स्तुतं स्तोत्रं होता प्रातरनुवाकेनान्वशंसीत् इति . अकर्म वयं तद् यद् अस्माकं कर्म इति ब्रूयाद् अगासिष्म यद् अत्र गेयम् इति . तं यदि ब्रूयुः तमांसि वा अगासीर् न ज्योतींषि अगासिषं युष्मान् एव तमसा पाप्मना विध्यानि इति .

sanskrit_iast: paścāt prāñca upasīdanti . vācam evaitan mukhato 'varundhate . yat purastāt prāñca upasīdeyur vācaṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ kurvīran . vāg eṣām upadāsukā syāt . vāg vai devebhyo 'pākrāmat . sā vanaspatīn prāviśat . saiṣa yākṣe . yad adho'dho 'kṣaṃ droṇakalaśaṃ prohanti daivīm evaitad vācam avarunddhe . udgātāra udgīthāyādho'dho 'kṣaṃ droṇakalaśaṃ prohanti . asmād evaital lokād dviṣantaṃ bhrātṛvyam antareti ya evaṃ veda . nākṣam upaspṛśet . yad akṣam upaspṛśed bhrātṛvye śriyam ṛñjyāt . antarā cakrau prohati . tasmād yad antarā cakrāv anasas tad upajīvanīyatamam .
sentences: yat purastāt prāñca upasīdeyur vācaṃ pr̥ṣṭʰataḥ kurvīran .
yad adʰo'dʰo 'kṣaṃ droṇakalaśaṃ prohanti daivīm evaitad vācam avarunddʰe .
asmād evaital lokād dviṣantaṃ bʰrātr̥vyam antareti ya evaṃ veda .
yad akṣam upaspr̥śed bʰrātr̥vye śriyam r̥ñjyāt .
tasmād yad antarā cakrāv anasas tad upajīvanīyatamam .
text: They sit down facing east from behind. Thereby they secure speech from the mouth. If they were to sit down facing east from in front, they would turn speech to the back. Speech would be apt to depart from them. Speech withdrew from the gods. She entered the trees. She is in the axle. When they push the axle down into the droṇakalaśa, they thereby secure the divine speech. The chanting priests push the axle down into the droṇakalaśa for the udgītha. He who knows thus excludes from this world the hating rival. One should not touch the axle. If one were to touch the axle, one would direct prosperity to the rival. One pushes it between the two wheels. Therefore what is between the two wheels of a cart is the most sustaining.
meaning: पश्चात् प्राञ्च उपसीदन्ति . वाचम् एवैतन् मुखतो ऽवरुन्धते . यत् पुरस्तात् प्राञ्च उपसीदेयुर् वाचं पृष्ठतः कुर्वीरन् . वाग् एषाम् उपदासुका स्यात् . वाग् वै देवेभ्यो ऽपाक्रामत् . सा वनस्पतीन् प्राविशत् . सैष याक्षे . यद् अधोऽधो ऽक्षं द्रोणकलशं प्रोहन्ति दैवीम् एवैतद् वाचम् अवरुन्द्धे . उद्गातार उद्गीथायाधोऽधो ऽक्षं द्रोणकलशं प्रोहन्ति . अस्माद् एवैतल् लोकाद् द्विषन्तं भ्रातृव्यम् अन्तरेति य एवं वेद . नाक्षम् उपस्पृशेत् . यद् अक्षम् उपस्पृशेद् भ्रातृव्ये श्रियम् ऋञ्ज्यात् . अन्तरा चक्रौ प्रोहति . तस्माद् यद् अन्तरा चक्राव् अनसस् तद् उपजीवनीयतमम् .

sanskrit_iast: vasavo vā etam agre prauhan . te 'śrāmyan . te rudrān āhvayan . taṃ rudrāḥ prauhan . te 'śrāmyan . ta ādityān āhvayan . tam ādityāḥ prauhan . taṃ prohati vasavas tvā prohantu gāyatreṇa chandasā . rudrās tvā prohantu traiṣṭubhena chandasā . ādityās tvā prohantu jāgatena chandasā iti . devatānām evainaṃ tat prauḍhim anuprohati . devasya tvā savituḥ prasave 'śvinor bāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ prohāmi iti vā prohet . devāṅgair evainaṃ tat prohati . bṛhaspatir vā etam agre prauhat . sa rūpeṇa varcasā vyārdhyata . sa aikṣata kāsya prāyaścittir iti . tāṃ droṇakalaśa eva paryapaśyat . tam abhyamṛśat tanūpā asi tanvaṃ me pāhi . varcodhā asi varco me dhehi . āyurdhā asy ayur me dhehi . vayodhā asi vayo me dhehi iti . yad evāsya tatrātmano mīyate tad etenāpyāyanam . etenaivodgātābhimṛśati tanūpā asi tanvaṃ me pāhi . varcodhā asi varco me dhehi . āyurdhā asy ayur me dhehi . vayodhā asi vayo me dhehi iti . yad evāsyātrātmano mīyate tad etenaivāpyāyate . dvayaṃ vāvedaṃ brahma caiva kṣatraṃ ca . tad ubhayaṃ droṇakalaśe .
sentences: taṃ prohati vasavas tvā prohantu gāyatreṇa cʰandasā .
ādityās tvā prohantu jāgatena cʰandasā iti .
devasya tvā savituḥ prasave 'śvinor bāhubʰyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābʰyāṃ prohāmi iti vā prohet .
tam abʰyamr̥śat tanūpā asi tanvaṃ me pāhi .
vayodʰā asi vayo me dʰehi iti .
yad evāsya tatrātmano mīyate tad etenāpyāyanam .
etenaivodgātābʰimr̥śati tanūpā asi tanvaṃ me pāhi .
vayodʰā asi vayo me dʰehi iti .
dvayaṃ vāvedaṃ brahma caiva kṣatraṃ ca .
text: The Vasus first pushed this forward. They became weary. They called upon the Rudras. The Rudras pushed it forward. They became weary. They called upon the Ādityas. The Ādityas pushed it forward. One pushes it saying: 'vasavas tvā prohantu gāyatreṇa chandasā rudrās tvā prohantu traiṣṭubhena chandasā ādityās tvā prohantu jāgatena chandasā' (May the Vasus push you forward with the gāyatrī metre. May the Rudras push you forward with the traiṣṭubha metre. May the Ādityas push you forward with the jāgata metre). Thereby one pushes it forward in the manner of the gods' pushing. Or one may push it saying: 'devasya tvā savituḥ prasave 'śvinor bāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ prohāmi' (I push you forward with the impulse of god Savitṛ, with the arms of the Aśvins, with the hands of Pūṣan). Thereby one pushes it forward with divine limbs. Bṛhaspati first pushed this forward. He became diminished in form and splendor. He reflected: 'What is the expiation for this?' He found it in the droṇakalaśa itself. He touched it, saying: 'tanūpā asi tanvaṃ me pāhi varcodhā asi varco me dhehi āyurdhā asy ayur me dhehi vayodhā asi vayo me dhehi' (You are the protector of the body; protect my body. You are the bestower of splendor; bestow splendor on me. You are the bestower of life; bestow life on me. You are the bestower of vigor; bestow vigor on me). Whatever of his self was diminished there, that is the means of restoration. The udgātṛ likewise touches it: 'tanūpā asi tanvaṃ me pāhi...' Whatever of his self is diminished there, that is restored thereby. This world is twofold: the brahman and the kṣatra. Both are in the droṇakalaśa.
meaning: वसवो वा एतम् अग्रे प्रौहन् . ते ऽश्राम्यन् . ते रुद्रान् आह्वयन् . तं रुद्राः प्रौहन् . ते ऽश्राम्यन् . त आदित्यान् आह्वयन् . तम् आदित्याः प्रौहन् . तं प्रोहति वसवस् त्वा प्रोहन्तु गायत्रेण छन्दसा . रुद्रास् त्वा प्रोहन्तु त्रैष्टुभेन छन्दसा . आदित्यास् त्वा प्रोहन्तु जागतेन छन्दसा इति . देवतानाम् एवैनं तत् प्रौढिम् अनुप्रोहति . देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवे ऽश्विनोर् बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्यां प्रोहामि इति वा प्रोहेत् . देवाङ्गैर् एवैनं तत् प्रोहति . बृहस्पतिर् वा एतम् अग्रे प्रौहत् . स रूपेण वर्चसा व्यार्ध्यत . स ऐक्षत कास्य प्रायश्चित्तिर् इति . तां द्रोणकलश एव पर्यपश्यत् . तम् अभ्यमृशत् तनूपा असि तन्वं मे पाहि . वर्चोधा असि वर्चो मे धेहि . आयुर्धा अस्य् अयुर् मे धेहि . वयोधा असि वयो मे धेहि इति . यद् एवास्य तत्रात्मनो मीयते तद् एतेनाप्यायनम् . एतेनैवोद्गाताभिमृशति तनूपा असि तन्वं मे पाहि . वर्चोधा असि वर्चो मे धेहि . आयुर्धा अस्य् अयुर् मे धेहि . वयोधा असि वयो मे धेहि इति . यद् एवास्यात्रात्मनो मीयते तद् एतेनैवाप्यायते . द्वयं वावेदं ब्रह्म चैव क्षत्रं च . तद् उभयं द्रोणकलशे .

sanskrit_iast: saṃmukhān grāvṇaḥ kṛtvābhimṛśati śyenā ajirā ṛtasya garbhāḥ prayuto napātaḥ parvatānāṃ kakubha ā nas taṃ vīraṃ vahata yaṃ bahava upajīvāmo abhiśastikṛtam anabhiśastenyam anyasyābhiśastyāḥ kartāram iti . ā haivāsya vīro jāyate 'bhiśastikṛd anabhiśastenyo 'nyasyābhiśastyāḥ kartā . droṇakalaśam adhyūhati idam ahaṃ māṃ brahmavarcase 'dhyūhāmi iti . yady asyāvaruddho rājanyas syād vimukhān grāvṇaḥ kṛtvā tūṣṇīṃ droṇakalaśam adhyūhya tam avahvārayan dakṣiṇā nirūhet idam aham amuṃ viśo nirūhāmīdam asya rāṣṭraṃ nyubjāmi iti nyañcaṃ droṇakalaśaṃ nyubjet . saṃmukhān grāvṇaḥ kṛtvā yo 'sya rājanyas syāt tasya nāma gṛhītvā droṇakalaśam adhyūhet idam aham amuṃ viśy adhyūhāmi iti . apetaro rudhyate 'vetaro gacchati . sa yady enam avagatya nādriyeta taṃ kāmayeta atraivāntar avaruddho 'stv iti . vimukhān grāvṇaḥ kṛtvā tūṣṇīṃ droṇakalaśam adhyūhya imā pāṃśusavanaḥ iti grāvā . tam upariṣṭād abhinidadhyāt idam aham amuṣmin viśy adhyūhāmi iti . abhiprakṣīṇānāhīnaṃ vitiṣṭhati . sa yady enaṃ viditvopadhāved asmin vāvedaṃ brāhmaṇe 'dhyāsa yad idam asmai vacane vaceti . saṃmukhān grāvṇaḥ kṛtvā droṇakalaśam adhyūhet idam aham amuṃ viśy adhyūhāmi iti .
sentences: saṃmukʰān grāvṇaḥ kr̥tvābʰimr̥śati śyenā ajirā r̥tasya garbʰāḥ prayuto napātaḥ parvatānāṃ kakubʰa ā nas taṃ vīraṃ vahata yaṃ bahava upajīvāmo abʰiśastikr̥tam anabʰiśastenyam anyasyābʰiśastyāḥ kartāram iti .
ā haivāsya vīro jāyate 'bʰiśastikr̥d anabʰiśastenyo 'nyasyābʰiśastyāḥ kartā .
droṇakalaśam adʰyūhati idam ahaṃ māṃ brahmavarcase 'dʰyūhāmi iti .

yady asyāvaruddʰo rājanyas syād vimukʰān grāvṇaḥ kr̥tvā tūṣṇīṃ droṇakalaśam adʰyūhya tam avahvārayan dakṣiṇā nirūhet idam aham amuṃ viśo nirūhāmīdam asya rāṣṭraṃ nyubjāmi iti nyañcaṃ droṇakalaśaṃ nyubjet .
saṃmukʰān grāvṇaḥ kr̥tvā yo 'sya rājanyas syāt tasya nāma gr̥hītvā droṇakalaśam adʰyūhet idam aham amuṃ viśy adʰyūhāmi iti .
sa yady enam avagatya nādriyeta taṃ kāmayeta atraivāntar avaruddʰo 'stv iti .
vimukʰān grāvṇaḥ kr̥tvā tūṣṇīṃ droṇakalaśam adʰyūhya imā pāṃśusavanaḥ iti grāvā .
tam upariṣṭād abʰinidadʰyāt idam aham amuṣmin viśy adʰyūhāmi iti .
sa yady enaṃ viditvopadʰāved asmin vāvedaṃ brāhmaṇe 'dʰyāsa yad idam asmai vacane vaceti .
saṃmukʰān grāvṇaḥ kr̥tvā droṇakalaśam adʰyūhet idam aham amuṃ viśy adʰyūhāmi iti .
text: Having turned the pressing stones face to face, he touches them saying: 'syena ajira rtasya garbhah prayuto napatah parvatanaam kakubha a nas tam viram vahata yam bahava upajivanmo abhisastikrtam anabhisastenyam anyasyabhisastyah kartaram' (Swift eagles, embryos of rta, progeny of the mountain peaks--bring to us that hero upon whom many depend, the maker of accusations against others, himself beyond accusation, the maker of accusations against others). Indeed a hero is born to him--a maker of accusations, himself beyond accusation, a maker of accusations against others. He raises the dronakalasa, saying: 'idam aham mam brahmavarcase 'dhyuhami' (I raise myself up in brahmavarcas). If he has a ksatriya who opposes him, having turned the pressing stones away, he should silently raise the dronakalasa, remove that one to the south, and say: 'idam aham amum viso niruhami idam asya rastram nyubjami' (I remove that one from the people; I overturn his kingdom). He should overturn the dronakalasa downward. Having turned the pressing stones face to face, taking the name of his ksatriya, he should raise the dronakalasa saying: 'idam aham amum visy adhyuhami' (I raise that one upon the people). The other is restrained; the other prevails. If, having noticed him, the other should disregard him, and he should wish, 'Let him remain confined right here,' having turned the stones away, he should silently raise the dronakalasa, and these pressing stones are like heaps of sand. He should place it on top saying: 'idam aham amusmin visy adhyuhami' (I raise upon that people). He prevails over the one whose strength is consumed, for a long time. And if that one, having found out, should come running, he would say: 'In this brahmana indeed dwells whatever is in this word of his.' Having turned the stones face to face, he should raise the dronakalasa saying: 'idam aham amum visy adhyuhami' (I raise that one upon the people).
meaning: संमुखान् ग्राव्णः कृत्वाभिमृशति श्येना अजिरा ऋतस्य गर्भाः प्रयुतो नपातः पर्वतानां ककुभ आ नस् तं वीरं वहत यं बहव उपजीवामो अभिशस्तिकृतम् अनभिशस्तेन्यम् अन्यस्याभिशस्त्याः कर्तारम् इति . आ हैवास्य वीरो जायते ऽभिशस्तिकृद् अनभिशस्तेन्यो ऽन्यस्याभिशस्त्याः कर्ता . द्रोणकलशम् अध्यूहति इदम् अहं मां ब्रह्मवर्चसे ऽध्यूहामि इति . यद्य् अस्यावरुद्धो राजन्यस् स्याद् विमुखान् ग्राव्णः कृत्वा तूष्णीं द्रोणकलशम् अध्यूह्य तम् अवह्वारयन् दक्षिणा निरूहेत् इदम् अहम् अमुं विशो निरूहामीदम् अस्य राष्ट्रं न्युब्जामि इति न्यञ्चं द्रोणकलशं न्युब्जेत् . संमुखान् ग्राव्णः कृत्वा यो ऽस्य राजन्यस् स्यात् तस्य नाम गृहीत्वा द्रोणकलशम् अध्यूहेत् इदम् अहम् अमुं विश्य् अध्यूहामि इति . अपेतरो रुध्यते ऽवेतरो गच्छति . स यद्य् एनम् अवगत्य नाद्रियेत तं कामयेत अत्रैवान्तर् अवरुद्धो ऽस्त्व् इति . विमुखान् ग्राव्णः कृत्वा तूष्णीं द्रोणकलशम् अध्यूह्य इमा पांशुसवनः इति ग्रावा . तम् उपरिष्टाद् अभिनिदध्यात् इदम् अहम् अमुष्मिन् विश्य् अध्यूहामि इति . अभिप्रक्षीणानाहीनं वितिष्ठति . स यद्य् एनं विदित्वोपधावेद् अस्मिन् वावेदं ब्राह्मणे ऽध्यास यद् इदम् अस्मै वचने वचेति . संमुखान् ग्राव्णः कृत्वा द्रोणकलशम् अध्यूहेत् इदम् अहम् अमुं विश्य् अध्यूहामि इति .

sanskrit_iast: rāṣṭraṃ vai droṇakalaśo viśo grāvāṇaḥ . yad droṇakalaśaś śithilas syād rāṣṭraṃ śithilaṃ syāt . tad anu viśo viśam anu yajamāno yajamānam anu prajāḥ . taṃ dṛṃhati devī tvā dhiṣaṇe nipātāṃ dhruve sadasi sīdeṣa ūrje sīda iti . ime vai devī dhiṣaṇe idaṃ dhruvaṃ sadaḥ . ebhir evainaṃ tal lokair dṛṃhati iṣa ūrje sīda iti varṣaṃ vā iṣe yad upariṣṭād varṣasyaidhate tad ūrje tad evaitenāvarunddhe . svarbhānur vā āsura ādityaṃ tamasāvidhyat . taṃ devāś carṣayaś cābhiṣajyan . te 'trim abruvann ṛṣe tvam idam apajahīti . tatheti . tad atri apāhan . te 'bruvan yo nas tamasā viddhebhyo jyotir avidaj jyotir asya bhāgadheyam astv iti , tad etad atrihiraṇyaṃ hriyate . śatamānaṃ ha sma purā hriyate . athaitarhi yāvad eva kiyac ca dadati tat . etad dha vāva sarveṣu lokeṣu jyotir yad dhiraṇyam .
sentences: yad droṇakalaśaś śitʰilas syād rāṣṭraṃ śitʰilaṃ syāt .
tad anu viśo viśam anu yajamāno yajamānam anu prajāḥ .
taṃ dr̥ṃhati devī tvā dʰiṣaṇe nipātāṃ dʰruve sadasi sīdeṣa ūrje sīda iti .
ime vai devī dʰiṣaṇe idaṃ dʰruvaṃ sadaḥ .
ebʰir evainaṃ tal lokair dr̥ṃhati iṣa ūrje sīda iti varṣaṃ vā iṣe yad upariṣṭād varṣasyaidʰate tad ūrje tad evaitenāvarunddʰe .
te 'trim abruvann r̥ṣe tvam idam apajahīti .
te 'bruvan yo nas tamasā viddʰebʰyo jyotir avidaj jyotir asya bʰāgadʰeyam astv iti , tad etad atrihiraṇyaṃ hriyate .
atʰaitarhi yāvad eva kiyac ca dadati tat .
etad dʰa vāva sarveṣu lokeṣu jyotir yad dʰiraṇyam .
text: The dronakalasa is the kingdom; the pressing stones are the people. If the dronakalasa were loose, the kingdom would be loose. Following that, the people after the people, the sacrificer after the sacrificer, the offspring after that. He makes it firm: 'devi tva dhisane nipatam dhruve sadasi sida isa urje sida' (May the two divine dhisanas support you. Sit in the firm seat. Sit for nourishment and vigor). These two are the divine dhisanas; this is the firm seat. With these worlds he makes it firm. 'isa urje sida' -- rain is for nourishment; what thrives above the rain is for vigor. Thereby he secures that. Svarbhanu the Asura struck the sun with darkness. The gods and rsis tried to heal him. They said to Atri: 'O rsi, you remove this.' 'So be it.' Atri removed it. They said: 'For him who found light for us who were struck by darkness, let light be his portion.' That is the Atri gold that is brought. Formerly a gold piece of a hundred weight was brought. But now they give whatever amount they give. Gold is indeed the light in all the worlds.
meaning: राष्ट्रं वै द्रोणकलशो विशो ग्रावाणः . यद् द्रोणकलशश् शिथिलस् स्याद् राष्ट्रं शिथिलं स्यात् . तद् अनु विशो विशम् अनु यजमानो यजमानम् अनु प्रजाः . तं दृंहति देवी त्वा धिषणे निपातां ध्रुवे सदसि सीदेष ऊर्जे सीद इति . इमे वै देवी धिषणे इदं ध्रुवं सदः . एभिर् एवैनं तल् लोकैर् दृंहति इष ऊर्जे सीद इति वर्षं वा इषे यद् उपरिष्टाद् वर्षस्यैधते तद् ऊर्जे तद् एवैतेनावरुन्द्धे . स्वर्भानुर् वा आसुर आदित्यं तमसाविध्यत् . तं देवाश् चर्षयश् चाभिषज्यन् . ते ऽत्रिम् अब्रुवन्न् ऋषे त्वम् इदम् अपजहीति . तथेति . तद् अत्रि अपाहन् . ते ऽब्रुवन् यो नस् तमसा विद्धेभ्यो ज्योतिर् अविदज् ज्योतिर् अस्य भागधेयम् अस्त्व् इति , तद् एतद् अत्रिहिरण्यं ह्रियते . शतमानं ह स्म पुरा ह्रियते . अथैतर्हि यावद् एव कियच् च ददति तत् . एतद् ध वाव सर्वेषु लोकेषु ज्योतिर् यद् धिरण्यम् .

sanskrit_iast: sa yat prathamam apāhan sā kṛṣṇāvir abhavat . yad dvitīyam apāhan sā dhūmrāvir abhavat . yat tṛtīyam apāhan sā phālguny avir abhavat . sa yaṃ kāmayeta pāpīyān syāt iti kṛṣṇam asya pavitre 'pyasyet pāpīyān eva bhavati . atha yaṃ kāmayeta nārvāṅ na paras syād iti dhūmram asya pavitre 'pyasyen naivārvāṅ na paro bhavati . atha yaṃ kāmayeta śreyān syād rucam aśnuvīteti phālgunam asya pavitraṃ kuryāc chreyān eva bhavati rucam aśnute . asti hi tatrāpy ādityasya nyaktam . tad antareṣe avahṛtya saṃmārṣṭi vasavas tvā saṃmṛjantu gāyatreṇa chandasā . rudrās tvā saṃmṛjantu traiṣṭubhena chandasā . ādityās tvā saṃmṛjantu jāgatena chandasā iti . tad tad udīcīnadaśaṃ pavitravatyā vitanoti pavitraṃ te vitataṃ brahmaṇas pate iti samaṣṭyai . tapoṣ pavitraṃ vitataṃ divas pade iti svargakāmasya . arūrucad uṣasaḥ pṛśnir agrayuḥ iti prajākāmasya . sarvābhir eva vitanuyād eteṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ kāmānām upāptyai . rājānam ānayati . tam abhimantrayate sa pavasva sudhāmā devānām abhi praiyāṇi dhāma . trir devebhyo 'pavathās trir ādityebhyas trir aṅgirobhyaḥ . yena turyeṇa brahmaṇā bṛhaspataye 'pavathās tena mahyaṃ pavasva . sa naḥ pavasva śaṃ gave śaṃ janāya śam arvate śaṃ rājann oṣadhībhyaḥ iti . śam evodgātre bhavati śaṃ yajamānāya śaṃ prajābhyaḥ . adhvaryur āgrāyaṇaṃ grahaṃ gṛhṇan hiṃkaroti . tad eva hiṃkṛtaṃ bhavati . athodgātraikarco gāyatraṃ gāyati uccā te jātam andhasā iti . sa ud ity eveto devebhyo havyaṃ vahati divi sad bhūmy ā dade ity amuto vṛṣṭim ācyāvayati . tāv imau lokau savāsinau karoti . tāv asmai kāmaṃ pinvāte .
sentences: sa yat pratʰamam apāhan sā kr̥ṣṇāvir abʰavat .
yad dvitīyam apāhan sā dʰūmrāvir abʰavat .
yat tr̥tīyam apāhan sā pʰālguny avir abʰavat .
sa yaṃ kāmayeta pāpīyān syāt iti kr̥ṣṇam asya pavitre 'pyasyet pāpīyān eva bʰavati .
atʰa yaṃ kāmayeta nārvāṅ na paras syād iti dʰūmram asya pavitre 'pyasyen naivārvāṅ na paro bʰavati .
atʰa yaṃ kāmayeta śreyān syād rucam aśnuvīteti pʰālgunam asya pavitraṃ kuryāc cʰreyān eva bʰavati rucam aśnute .
tad antareṣe avahr̥tya saṃmārṣṭi vasavas tvā saṃmr̥jantu gāyatreṇa cʰandasā .
ādityās tvā saṃmr̥jantu jāgatena cʰandasā iti .
tad tad udīcīnadaśaṃ pavitravatyā vitanoti pavitraṃ te vitataṃ brahmaṇas pate iti samaṣṭyai .
tapoṣ pavitraṃ vitataṃ divas pade iti svargakāmasya .
arūrucad uṣasaḥ pr̥śnir agrayuḥ iti prajākāmasya .
sarvābʰir eva vitanuyād eteṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ kāmānām upāptyai .
tam abʰimantrayate sa pavasva sudʰāmā devānām abʰi praiyāṇi dʰāma .
trir devebʰyo 'pavatʰās trir ādityebʰyas trir aṅgirobʰyaḥ .
yena turyeṇa brahmaṇā br̥haspataye 'pavatʰās tena mahyaṃ pavasva .
sa naḥ pavasva śaṃ gave śaṃ janāya śam arvate
śam evodgātre bʰavati śaṃ yajamānāya śaṃ prajābʰyaḥ .
atʰodgātraikarco gāyatraṃ gāyati uccā te jātam andʰasā iti .
sa ud ity eveto devebʰyo havyaṃ vahati divi sad bʰūmy ā dade ity amuto vr̥ṣṭim ācyāvayati .
text: When he first removed it, that was the black appearance. When he removed it a second time, that was the smoky appearance. When he removed it a third time, that was the pale-reddish appearance. He whom one wishes to become worse -- one should cast black into his filter; he becomes worse. He whom one wishes to be neither better nor worse -- one should cast smoky into his filter; he becomes neither better nor worse. He whom one wishes to become better and attain splendor -- one should make his filter pale-reddish; he becomes better and attains splendor. For there too the touch of the sun is present. Having carried it between, he wipes it: 'vasavas tva sammrjantu gayatrena chandasa rudras tva sammrjantu traistubhena chandasa adityas tva sammrjantu jagatena chandasa' (May the Vasus wipe you with the gayatri metre. May the Rudras wipe you with the traistubha metre. May the Adityas wipe you with the jagata metre). Then he spreads the filter with its fringes pointing north: 'pavitram te vitatam brahmanaspate' (Your filter is spread, O lord of prayer) -- for completeness. 'tapos pavitram vitatam divas pade' (The filter of heat is spread in the seat of heaven) -- for one desiring heaven. 'arurucad usasah prsnir agrayuh' (The speckled one of dawn has shone forth, going first) -- for one desiring offspring. One should spread it with all of them, for the attainment of all these desires. He brings the king Soma. He addresses it: 'sa pavasva sudhama devanam abhi praiyani dhama trir devebhyo pavathas trir adityebhyas trir angirobhyah yena turyena brahmana brhaspataye pavathas tena mahyam pavasva sa nah pavasva sam gave sam janaya sam arvate sam rajann osadhibhyah' (Flow, O you of good abode, toward the excellent abode of the gods. Thrice purify for the gods, thrice for the Adityas, thrice for the Angirases. With that fourth prayer with which you purify for Brhaspati, with that purify for me. Purify for us for the good of the cow, for the good of the people, for the good of the steed, for the good, O king, of the plants). It is good for the udgatr, good for the sacrificer, good for the offspring. The adhvaryu, taking the agrayaṇa cup, performs the himkara. That becomes the himkara. Then the udgatr sings the gayatra in a single verse: 'ucca te jatam andhasa' (Born on high with the pressed juice). With 'ud' (upward) he carries the offering to the gods from here; with 'divi sad bhumy a dade' (seated in heaven, he took hold on earth) he brings rain down from above. He thus makes these two worlds co-dwellers. They yield desire for him.
meaning: स यत् प्रथमम् अपाहन् सा कृष्णाविर् अभवत् . यद् द्वितीयम् अपाहन् सा धूम्राविर् अभवत् . यत् तृतीयम् अपाहन् सा फाल्गुन्य् अविर् अभवत् . स यं कामयेत पापीयान् स्यात् इति कृष्णम् अस्य पवित्रे ऽप्यस्येत् पापीयान् एव भवति . अथ यं कामयेत नार्वाङ् न परस् स्याद् इति धूम्रम् अस्य पवित्रे ऽप्यस्येन् नैवार्वाङ् न परो भवति . अथ यं कामयेत श्रेयान् स्याद् रुचम् अश्नुवीतेति फाल्गुनम् अस्य पवित्रं कुर्याच् छ्रेयान् एव भवति रुचम् अश्नुते . अस्ति हि तत्राप्य् आदित्यस्य न्यक्तम् . तद् अन्तरेषे अवहृत्य संमार्ष्टि वसवस् त्वा संमृजन्तु गायत्रेण छन्दसा . रुद्रास् त्वा संमृजन्तु त्रैष्टुभेन छन्दसा . आदित्यास् त्वा संमृजन्तु जागतेन छन्दसा इति . तद् तद् उदीचीनदशं पवित्रवत्या वितनोति पवित्रं ते विततं ब्रह्मणस् पते इति समष्ट्यै . तपोष् पवित्रं विततं दिवस् पदे इति स्वर्गकामस्य . अरूरुचद् उषसः पृश्निर् अग्रयुः इति प्रजाकामस्य . सर्वाभिर् एव वितनुयाद् एतेषां सर्वेषां कामानाम् उपाप्त्यै . राजानम् आनयति . तम् अभिमन्त्रयते स पवस्व सुधामा देवानाम् अभि प्रैयाणि धाम . त्रिर् देवेभ्यो ऽपवथास् त्रिर् आदित्येभ्यस् त्रिर् अङ्गिरोभ्यः . येन तुर्येण ब्रह्मणा बृहस्पतये ऽपवथास् तेन मह्यं पवस्व . स नः पवस्व शं गवे शं जनाय शम् अर्वते शं राजन्न् ओषधीभ्यः इति . शम् एवोद्गात्रे भवति शं यजमानाय शं प्रजाभ्यः . अध्वर्युर् आग्रायणं ग्रहं गृह्णन् हिंकरोति . तद् एव हिंकृतं भवति . अथोद्गात्रैकर्चो गायत्रं गायति उच्चा ते जातम् अन्धसा इति . स उद् इत्य् एवेतो देवेभ्यो हव्यं वहति दिवि सद् भूम्य् आ ददे इत्य् अमुतो वृष्टिम् आच्यावयति . ताव् इमौ लोकौ सवासिनौ करोति . ताव् अस्मै कामं पिन्वाते .

sanskrit_iast: krūram iva vā etad yajñasya kurvanti yad dhavidhāne grāvabhis somaṃ rājānaṃ hatvā bahiṣpavamānaṃ sarpanti . kā tasya prāyaścittir ity āhur apa upaspṛśeyuḥ . āpo vai sarvasya śāntiḥ . adbhir evainat tac chamayanti . vāg vā etasmā agre 'dhvane 'tandrāyata bahiṣpavamānaṃ sarpantī . tāṃ prajāpatir abravīd bhāgadheyaṃ te karomy atha sarpeti . bahiṣpavamānaṃ sarpsyan homaṃ juhuyāt juṣṭo vāco bhūyāsaṃ juṣṭo vācaspatyuḥ . devi vāg yat te vāco madhumat tasmin mā dhāḥ . svāhā sarasvatyai iti . yat sarasvatyai svāhā iti juhuyād vācaṃ sarasvatīṃ svāhākāreṇa parigṛhṇīyāt . atha yat svāhā sarasvatyai iti juhoti vācaṃ tad uttarāṃ svāhākārād dadhāti . tayā parigṛhītayā yajñaṃ tanute . vācā hy ūrdhvo yajñas tāyate . vekurā nāmāsi preṣitā divyāya karmaṇe śivā nas suyamā bhava . satyāśīr yajamānāya svāhā iti vā juhuyāt . vāg vai vekurā . brahma vāk .
sentences: krūram iva vā etad yajñasya kurvanti yad dʰavidʰāne grāvabʰis somaṃ rājānaṃ hatvā bahiṣpavamānaṃ sarpanti .
kā tasya prāyaścittir ity āhur apa upaspr̥śeyuḥ .
vāg vā etasmā agre 'dʰvane 'tandrāyata bahiṣpavamānaṃ sarpantī .
tāṃ prajāpatir abravīd bʰāgadʰeyaṃ te karomy atʰa sarpeti .
bahiṣpavamānaṃ sarpsyan homaṃ juhuyāt juṣṭo vāco bʰūyāsaṃ juṣṭo vācaspatyuḥ .
devi vāg yat te vāco madʰumat tasmin mā dʰāḥ .
yat sarasvatyai svāhā iti juhuyād vācaṃ sarasvatīṃ svāhākāreṇa parigr̥hṇīyāt .
atʰa yat svāhā sarasvatyai iti juhoti vācaṃ tad uttarāṃ svāhākārād dadʰāti .
vekurā nāmāsi preṣitā divyāya karmaṇe śivā nas suyamā bʰava .
satyāśīr yajamānāya svāhā iti vā juhuyāt .
text: It is as if something cruel is done to the sacrifice when, in the havirdhana, having slain King Soma with the pressing stones, they proceed to the bahispavamana. What is the expiation for that? they say. They should touch water. Water is the pacification of all. With water they thereby pacify it. Speech indeed first became wearied for that journey, proceeding to the bahispavamana. Prajapati said to her: 'I shall make a share for you; then proceed.' One about to proceed to the bahispavamana should offer the oblation: 'justo vaco bhuyasam justo vacaspatyuh devi vag yat te vaco madhumat tasmin ma dhah svaha sarasvatyai' (May I be pleasing to Speech, pleasing to the lord of Speech. O divine Speech, whatever of your speech is sweet, in that place me. Svaha to Sarasvati!). If one should offer with 'sarasvatyai svaha,' one would encompass Speech, Sarasvati, with the svahakara. But since one offers with 'svaha sarasvatyai,' one places Speech beyond the svahakara. With her thus encompassed, one extends the sacrifice. For the sacrifice is stretched upward by speech. Or one may offer: 'vekura namasi presita divyaya karmane siva nas suyama bhava satyasir yajamanaya svaha' (You are named Vekura, sent forth for the divine work. Be auspicious to us, easy to guide. With true blessings for the sacrificer, svaha!). Speech is indeed Vekura. Speech is brahman.
meaning: क्रूरम् इव वा एतद् यज्ञस्य कुर्वन्ति यद् धविधाने ग्रावभिस् सोमं राजानं हत्वा बहिष्पवमानं सर्पन्ति . का तस्य प्रायश्चित्तिर् इत्य् आहुर् अप उपस्पृशेयुः . आपो वै सर्वस्य शान्तिः . अद्भिर् एवैनत् तच् छमयन्ति . वाग् वा एतस्मा अग्रे ऽध्वने ऽतन्द्रायत बहिष्पवमानं सर्पन्ती . तां प्रजापतिर् अब्रवीद् भागधेयं ते करोम्य् अथ सर्पेति . बहिष्पवमानं सर्प्स्यन् होमं जुहुयात् जुष्टो वाचो भूयासं जुष्टो वाचस्पत्युः . देवि वाग् यत् ते वाचो मधुमत् तस्मिन् मा धाः . स्वाहा सरस्वत्यै इति . यत् सरस्वत्यै स्वाहा इति जुहुयाद् वाचं सरस्वतीं स्वाहाकारेण परिगृह्णीयात् . अथ यत् स्वाहा सरस्वत्यै इति जुहोति वाचं तद् उत्तरां स्वाहाकाराद् दधाति . तया परिगृहीतया यज्ञं तनुते . वाचा ह्य् ऊर्ध्वो यज्ञस् तायते . वेकुरा नामासि प्रेषिता दिव्याय कर्मणे शिवा नस् सुयमा भव . सत्याशीर् यजमानाय स्वाहा इति वा जुहुयात् . वाग् वै वेकुरा . ब्रह्म वाक् .

sanskrit_iast: araṇyam iva vā ete yanti ye bahiṣpavamānaṃ sarpanti . tān īśvaro rakṣo vā hantor anyā vā naṃṣṭṛā . atha dvitīyāṃ juhoti sūryo mā devo divyebhyo rakṣobhyaḥ pātu vāta āntarikṣebhyo 'gniḥ pārthivebhyas svāhā iti . ya evaiṣāṃ lokānām adhipatayas tebhya evaitad ātmānaṃ paridāya sarpati nārtim ārchati . prajāpatir yad yajñam asṛjata taṃ havirdhāna evāsṛjata . sa sṛṣṭa udaṅ prādravat . tam etad atrāptvāstuvan . yatraitad udañcayitvā bahiṣpavamānena stuvanti yajñam evaitad āptvā stuvanti . yo vai daivyaṃ vājinaṃ veda vājī bhavati . yajño vāva daivyo vājī . ya in nu mānuṣaṃ vājinam aśāntam asaṃmṛṣṭam ārohati tam in nu sa hinasti vā pra vā kṣiṇoti .
sentences: araṇyam iva vā ete yanti ye bahiṣpavamānaṃ sarpanti .
tān īśvaro rakṣo vā hantor anyā vā naṃṣṭr̥ā .
atʰa dvitīyāṃ juhoti sūryo mā devo divyebʰyo rakṣobʰyaḥ pātu vāta āntarikṣebʰyo 'gniḥ pārtʰivebʰyas svāhā iti .
ya evaiṣāṃ lokānām adʰipatayas tebʰya evaitad ātmānaṃ paridāya sarpati nārtim ārcʰati .
prajāpatir yad yajñam asr̥jata taṃ havirdʰāna evāsr̥jata .
yatraitad udañcayitvā bahiṣpavamānena stuvanti yajñam evaitad āptvā stuvanti .
yo vai daivyaṃ vājinaṃ veda vājī bʰavati .
ya in nu mānuṣaṃ vājinam aśāntam asaṃmr̥ṣṭam ārohati tam in nu sa hinasti vā pra vā kṣiṇoti .
text: Those who proceed to the bahispavamana go as if into the wilderness. They are liable to be struck by raksas or some other destructive force. Then he offers a second oblation: 'suryo ma devo divyebhyo raksobhyah patu vata antarikshebhyo gnih parthivebhyah svaha' (May the god Surya protect me from the celestial raksas, Vayu from those of the atmosphere, Agni from those of the earth, svaha!). Having entrusted himself to the very lords of these worlds, he proceeds without coming to harm. When Prajapati created the sacrifice, he created it in the havirdhana itself. That created sacrifice ran northward. Having overtaken it there, they praised it. When they carry it northward and praise it with the bahispavamana, they thereby overtake the sacrifice and praise it. He who knows the divine steed becomes a steed himself. The sacrifice is indeed the divine steed. He who mounts an untamed, ungroomed human steed -- that steed indeed injures or destroys him.
meaning: अरण्यम् इव वा एते यन्ति ये बहिष्पवमानं सर्पन्ति . तान् ईश्वरो रक्षो वा हन्तोर् अन्या वा नंष्टृआ . अथ द्वितीयां जुहोति सूर्यो मा देवो दिव्येभ्यो रक्षोभ्यः पातु वात आन्तरिक्षेभ्यो ऽग्निः पार्थिवेभ्यस् स्वाहा इति . य एवैषां लोकानाम् अधिपतयस् तेभ्य एवैतद् आत्मानं परिदाय सर्पति नार्तिम् आर्छति . प्रजापतिर् यद् यज्ञम् असृजत तं हविर्धान एवासृजत . स सृष्ट उदङ् प्राद्रवत् . तम् एतद् अत्राप्त्वास्तुवन् . यत्रैतद् उदञ्चयित्वा बहिष्पवमानेन स्तुवन्ति यज्ञम् एवैतद् आप्त्वा स्तुवन्ति . यो वै दैव्यं वाजिनं वेद वाजी भवति . यज्ञो वाव दैव्यो वाजी . य इन् नु मानुषं वाजिनम् अशान्तम् असंमृष्टम् आरोहति तम् इन् नु स हिनस्ति वा प्र वा क्षिणोति .

sanskrit_iast: adhvaryuḥ prastaraṃ haran sarpati . tam anumantrayate etad ahaṃ daivyaṃ vājinaṃ saṃmārjmi iti . saṃmṛṣṭam evainaṃ śāntam ārohati nārtim ārchati . devakṣetraṃ vā eṣo 'dhyavasyati yas somasyodgāyati . ya in nu mānuṣāya kṣetrapataye 'procyāvasyati tam in nu sa hinasti vā pra vā yāpayati . atha kiṃ yo daivyāya kṣetrapataye 'procyāvasyāt . somodgāyodgāya soma ity āha . somo vai devānāṃ kṣetrapatiḥ . somāyaiva tad devānāṃ kṣetrapataye procyodgāyati nārtim ārchati . mahyaṃ tejase mahyaṃ brahmavarcasāya mahyam annādyāya mahyaṃ bhūmne mahyaṃ puṣṭyai mahyaṃ prajananāya prajānāṃ bhūmne prajānāṃ puṣṭyai prajānāṃ prajananāya somasya rājño rājyāya mama grāmaṇeyāya iti . grāvo ha smāha maitreyaḥ kiṃ mam ekasmā āgāsyāmi kim ekasmā iti . etena ha sma vai sa tad āha somodgāyodgāya somedam amuṣmā idam amuṣmai iti . te ha smāsmai kāmās samṛdhyante . devapāśā vā ete vitāyante yad dhiṣṇyā agnayo vihriyante . tān yo vidvān abhyavaiti devapāśān pratimuñcate . eṣā vai yajñasya dvār yad antarāgnīdhraṃ ca cātvālaṃ ca . tayābhyaveyāt . tayodeyāt . dhā vai nāma vediḥ . tām abhyavayan brūyāt dhā asi sudhāṃ me dhehi . āyuṣmantas tvad varcasvanta udgeṣma iti .
sentences: tam anumantrayate etad ahaṃ daivyaṃ vājinaṃ saṃmārjmi iti .
saṃmr̥ṣṭam evainaṃ śāntam ārohati nārtim ārcʰati .
ya in nu mānuṣāya kṣetrapataye 'procyāvasyati tam in nu sa hinasti vā pra vā yāpayati .
somāyaiva tad devānāṃ kṣetrapataye procyodgāyati nārtim ārcʰati .

mahyaṃ tejase mahyaṃ brahmavarcasāya mahyam annādyāya mahyaṃ bʰūmne mahyaṃ puṣṭyai mahyaṃ prajananāya prajānāṃ bʰūmne prajānāṃ puṣṭyai prajānāṃ prajananāya somasya rājño rājyāya mama grāmaṇeyāya iti .
grāvo ha smāha maitreyaḥ kiṃ mam ekasmā āgāsyāmi kim ekasmā iti .
etena ha sma vai sa tad āha somodgāyodgāya somedam amuṣmā idam amuṣmai iti .
devapāśā vā ete vitāyante yad dʰiṣṇyā agnayo vihriyante .
tān yo vidvān abʰyavaiti devapāśān pratimuñcate .
eṣā vai yajñasya dvār yad antarāgnīdʰraṃ ca cātvālaṃ ca .
tām abʰyavayan brūyāt dʰā asi sudʰāṃ me dʰehi .
text: The adhvaryu proceeds carrying the prastara. He addresses it: 'etad aham daivyam vajinam sammaarjmi' (I now groom this divine steed). He thus mounts it groomed and tamed, and does not come to harm. He who chants the udgitha of the Soma indeed settles on the field of the gods. He who settles on the field of a human lord without announcement -- that lord indeed injures or drives him away. But what of one who settles on the field of the divine lord without announcement? He says: 'somodgayodgaya soma' (Soma, chant! Chant, O Soma!). Soma is the lord of the divine field. Having thus announced to Soma, the lord of the divine field, he chants and does not come to harm. 'For my tejas, for my brahmavarcas, for my food, for my abundance, for my prosperity, for my procreation, for the abundance of my offspring, for the prosperity of my offspring, for the procreation of my offspring, for the sovereignty of King Soma, for my leadership of the people.' Grava Maitreya used to say: 'Why should I sin against just one? Why against just one?' For he used to say thus: 'somodgayodgaya soma, this for so-and-so, this for so-and-so.' Those desires of his were indeed fulfilled. The fire-hearths are as divine snares spread out when the dhisnya fires are distributed. He who, knowing thus, passes among them unlooses the divine snares. This is indeed the door of the sacrifice: what is between the agnidhra hearth and the catvala. One should enter by that. One should exit by that. Dha (establisher) is indeed the name of the vedi. Entering it, one should say: 'dha asi sudham me dhehi ayusmantastvad varcasvanta udgesma' (You are the Establisher. Establish good fortune for me. May we rise from you endowed with life and splendor).
meaning: अध्वर्युः प्रस्तरं हरन् सर्पति . तम् अनुमन्त्रयते एतद् अहं दैव्यं वाजिनं संमार्ज्मि इति . संमृष्टम् एवैनं शान्तम् आरोहति नार्तिम् आर्छति . देवक्षेत्रं वा एषो ऽध्यवस्यति यस् सोमस्योद्गायति . य इन् नु मानुषाय क्षेत्रपतये ऽप्रोच्यावस्यति तम् इन् नु स हिनस्ति वा प्र वा यापयति . अथ किं यो दैव्याय क्षेत्रपतये ऽप्रोच्यावस्यात् . सोमोद्गायोद्गाय सोम इत्य् आह . सोमो वै देवानां क्षेत्रपतिः . सोमायैव तद् देवानां क्षेत्रपतये प्रोच्योद्गायति नार्तिम् आर्छति . मह्यं तेजसे मह्यं ब्रह्मवर्चसाय मह्यम् अन्नाद्याय मह्यं भूम्ने मह्यं पुष्ट्यै मह्यं प्रजननाय प्रजानां भूम्ने प्रजानां पुष्ट्यै प्रजानां प्रजननाय सोमस्य राज्ञो राज्याय मम ग्रामणेयाय इति . ग्रावो ह स्माह मैत्रेयः किं मम् एकस्मा आगास्यामि किम् एकस्मा इति . एतेन ह स्म वै स तद् आह सोमोद्गायोद्गाय सोमेदम् अमुष्मा इदम् अमुष्मै इति . ते ह स्मास्मै कामास् समृध्यन्ते . देवपाशा वा एते वितायन्ते यद् धिष्ण्या अग्नयो विह्रियन्ते . तान् यो विद्वान् अभ्यवैति देवपाशान् प्रतिमुञ्चते . एषा वै यज्ञस्य द्वार् यद् अन्तराग्नीध्रं च चात्वालं च . तयाभ्यवेयात् . तयोदेयात् . धा वै नाम वेदिः . ताम् अभ्यवयन् ब्रूयात् धा असि सुधां मे धेहि . आयुष्मन्तस् त्वद् वर्चस्वन्त उद्गेष्म इति .

sanskrit_iast: prāṇān vai tat saṃtatya svargaṃ lokaṃ sarpanti yad antar havirdhāne grahān gṛhītvā bahiṣpavamānaṃ sarpanti . saṃtatās sarpanti . saṃtata iva vai svargo lokaḥ . svargasyaiva lokasya saṃtatyā avyavacchedāya . prāvabhrā iva sarpanti . pratikūlam iva vā itas svargo lokaḥ . tad yathā vā adaḥ pratikūlam udyan prāvabhra iva bhavaty evam evaitat . svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyā anapavyādhāya . adhvaryuḥ prathamas sarpati prāṇo yajñasya . tasmād yad avacchidyeran prāṇād avacchidyeran pramāyukās syuḥ . prastotā dvitīyas sarpati mukhaṃ sāmnaḥ . tasmād yad avacchidyeran mukhyaṃ ārtim ārcheyuḥ . udgātā tṛtīyas sarpati sarvadevatyaḥ prajāpatiḥ . tasmād yad avacchidyeran sarvajyāniṃ jīyeran . pratihartā caturthas sarpati turīyaṃ sāmnaḥ . tasmād yad avacchideraṃs turīyeṇātmano yātayeyuḥ . yajamānaḥ pañcamas sarpati . pāṅkto yajñaḥ pāṅktāḥ paśavaḥ .
sentences: prāṇān vai tat saṃtatya svargaṃ lokaṃ sarpanti yad antar havirdʰāne grahān gr̥hītvā bahiṣpavamānaṃ sarpanti .
pratikūlam iva vā itas svargo lokaḥ .
tad yatʰā vā adaḥ pratikūlam udyan prāvabʰra iva bʰavaty evam evaitat .
tasmād yad avaccʰidyeran prāṇād avaccʰidyeran pramāyukās syuḥ .
tasmād yad avaccʰidyeran mukʰyaṃ ārtim ārcʰeyuḥ .
text: They proceed to the bahispavamana extending the vital breaths toward the heavenly world, carrying the cups from the havirdhana. They proceed continuously. The heavenly world is indeed continuous. For the continuity of the heavenly world, for its non-interruption. They proceed as if stooping forward. The heavenly world is as if against the slope from here. Just as one going uphill against the slope stoops forward -- even so is that. For the attainment of the heavenly world, for its non-missing. The adhvaryu proceeds first; he is the prana of the sacrifice. Therefore if they were to be separated from him, they would be separated from the prana and would be subject to premature death. The prastotr proceeds second; he is the mouth of the saman. Therefore if they were to be separated from him, they would come to harm in what is foremost. The udgatr proceeds third; he is all-devatied, Prajapati. Therefore if they were to be separated from him, they would be deprived of everything. The pratihartr proceeds fourth; he is the fourth part of the saman. Therefore if they were to be separated from him, they would be tormented by the fourth part of themselves. The sacrificer proceeds fifth. The sacrifice is fivefold; cattle are fivefold.
meaning: प्राणान् वै तत् संतत्य स्वर्गं लोकं सर्पन्ति यद् अन्तर् हविर्धाने ग्रहान् गृहीत्वा बहिष्पवमानं सर्पन्ति . संततास् सर्पन्ति . संतत इव वै स्वर्गो लोकः . स्वर्गस्यैव लोकस्य संतत्या अव्यवच्छेदाय . प्रावभ्रा इव सर्पन्ति . प्रतिकूलम् इव वा इतस् स्वर्गो लोकः . तद् यथा वा अदः प्रतिकूलम् उद्यन् प्रावभ्र इव भवत्य् एवम् एवैतत् . स्वर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्या अनपव्याधाय . अध्वर्युः प्रथमस् सर्पति प्राणो यज्ञस्य . तस्माद् यद् अवच्छिद्येरन् प्राणाद् अवच्छिद्येरन् प्रमायुकास् स्युः . प्रस्तोता द्वितीयस् सर्पति मुखं साम्नः . तस्माद् यद् अवच्छिद्येरन् मुख्यं आर्तिम् आर्छेयुः . उद्गाता तृतीयस् सर्पति सर्वदेवत्यः प्रजापतिः . तस्माद् यद् अवच्छिद्येरन् सर्वज्यानिं जीयेरन् . प्रतिहर्ता चतुर्थस् सर्पति तुरीयं साम्नः . तस्माद् यद् अवच्छिदेरंस् तुरीयेणात्मनो यातयेयुः . यजमानः पञ्चमस् सर्पति . पाङ्क्तो यज्ञः पाङ्क्ताः पशवः .

sanskrit_iast: brahmā ṣaṣṭhas sarpati . ṣaḍ vai chandāṃsi . chandobhir eva tad rakṣaḥ pāpmānam apaghnate . sarvaṃ vāvaitad brahma . yad brahmā paścād bhavati brahmaṇaiva tad rakṣaḥ pāpmānam apahatya svargaṃ lokaṃ sarpanti . prastaraṃ harantas sarpanti . yajamāno vai prastaro barhiḥ prajāḥ . yad uparyupari barhiḥ prastaraṃ haranti yajamānam eva tat prajāsv adhyūhanti . tasmād yajamāna uparyupary evānyāḥ prajāḥ . yad upāsyet svargaloko yajamānas syād avāsmāl lokāc chidyeta . yad atyasyed asmin loke pratitiṣṭhed ava svargāl lokāc chidyeta . tad āhur ardhātmā vā eṣa yajamānasya yat patnī . yat sā bahirvedi bhavati tenāsmāl lokān nāvacchidyate . upaivāsyed ity uta vai patnī na bhavati . atho yady api syād upaivānyad asyed aty anyad asyet .
sentences: cʰandobʰir eva tad rakṣaḥ pāpmānam apagʰnate .
yad brahmā paścād bʰavati brahmaṇaiva tad rakṣaḥ pāpmānam apahatya svargaṃ lokaṃ sarpanti .
yad uparyupari barhiḥ prastaraṃ haranti yajamānam eva tat prajāsv adʰyūhanti .
yad upāsyet svargaloko yajamānas syād avāsmāl lokāc cʰidyeta .
yad atyasyed asmin loke pratitiṣṭʰed ava svargāl lokāc cʰidyeta .
tad āhur ardʰātmā vā eṣa yajamānasya yat patnī .
yat sā bahirvedi bʰavati tenāsmāl lokān nāvaccʰidyate .
upaivāsyed ity uta vai patnī na bʰavati .
atʰo yady api syād upaivānyad asyed aty anyad asyet .
text: The brahman proceeds sixth. Six are the metres. With the metres they thereby strike away the raksas, the evil. All this is indeed brahman. Since the brahman is behind, with brahman itself they strike away the raksas, the evil, and proceed to the heavenly world. They proceed carrying the prastara. The sacrificer is the prastara; the barhis is the offspring. Since they carry the prastara above the barhis, they thereby raise the sacrificer above the offspring. Therefore the sacrificer is always above other offspring. If one were to sit down (during the procession), the sacrificer would become one whose heavenly world exists, but he would be cut off from this world. If one were to overshoot, he would be established in this world but cut off from the heavenly world. They say: 'The wife is indeed half the self of the sacrificer. Since she remains outside the vedi, he is not cut off from this world.' He should indeed sit down -- and yet the wife may not be present. Also, even if she is present, he should sit down for one and overshoot for another.
meaning: ब्रह्मा षष्ठस् सर्पति . षड् वै छन्दांसि . छन्दोभिर् एव तद् रक्षः पाप्मानम् अपघ्नते . सर्वं वावैतद् ब्रह्म . यद् ब्रह्मा पश्चाद् भवति ब्रह्मणैव तद् रक्षः पाप्मानम् अपहत्य स्वर्गं लोकं सर्पन्ति . प्रस्तरं हरन्तस् सर्पन्ति . यजमानो वै प्रस्तरो बर्हिः प्रजाः . यद् उपर्युपरि बर्हिः प्रस्तरं हरन्ति यजमानम् एव तत् प्रजास्व् अध्यूहन्ति . तस्माद् यजमान उपर्युपर्य् एवान्याः प्रजाः . यद् उपास्येत् स्वर्गलोको यजमानस् स्याद् अवास्माल् लोकाच् छिद्येत . यद् अत्यस्येद् अस्मिन् लोके प्रतितिष्ठेद् अव स्वर्गाल् लोकाच् छिद्येत . तद् आहुर् अर्धात्मा वा एष यजमानस्य यत् पत्नी . यत् सा बहिर्वेदि भवति तेनास्माल् लोकान् नावच्छिद्यते . उपैवास्येद् इत्य् उत वै पत्नी न भवति . अथो यद्य् अपि स्याद् उपैवान्यद् अस्येद् अत्य् अन्यद् अस्येत् .

sanskrit_iast: ādityo vā etad atrāgra āsīd yatraitac cātvālam ado 'gniḥ . sa idaṃ sarvaṃ prātapat . tasya devāḥ pradāhād abibhayuḥ . te 'bruvan sarvaṃ vā ayam idaṃ pradhakṣyati vīmau pariharāmeti . tam atas tisṛbhir ādadata tisṛbhir antarikṣāt tisṛbhir divam agamayan . sa tataḥ parāṅ evātapat . ta etad āvad uttamam akṣaram apaśyan . tenainam arvāñcam akurvan . tata etad arvāṅ tapati . aiteno evāvatākṣareṇāgnim asmin loke 'dadhuḥ . sa yaṃ kāmayeta yajamānas svargalokas syād iti cātvālam evainam avakhyāpyodgāyet . tam atas tisṛbhir evādadate tisṛbhir antarikṣāt tisṛbhir divaṃ gamayanti . sadaiva sarvābhis stuyur athottamām agre brūyād athāvarām athāvarām . tās sarvā arvācīḥ . tad u vā āhus satraitat pratyavarūḍhaṃ svargakāmyā vai yajata iti .
sentences: ādityo vā etad atrāgra āsīd yatraitac cātvālam ado 'gniḥ .
te 'bruvan sarvaṃ vā ayam idaṃ pradʰakṣyati vīmau pariharāmeti .
tam atas tisr̥bʰir ādadata tisr̥bʰir antarikṣāt tisr̥bʰir divam agamayan .
ta etad āvad uttamam akṣaram apaśyan .
sa yaṃ kāmayeta yajamānas svargalokas syād iti cātvālam evainam avakʰyāpyodgāyet .
tam atas tisr̥bʰir evādadate tisr̥bʰir antarikṣāt tisr̥bʰir divaṃ gamayanti .
sadaiva sarvābʰis stuyur atʰottamām agre brūyād atʰāvarām atʰāvarām .
tad u vā āhus satraitat pratyavarūḍʰaṃ svargakāmyā vai yajata iti .
text: The sun was indeed here at first, where the catvala is on this side and the fire on that. He heated everything here. The gods feared his burning. They said: 'He will burn up all this. Let us remove him.' They took him up from here with three verses, from the atmosphere with three, and made him go to heaven with three. From there he then shone outward. They saw this last syllable 'a.' With that they turned him hitherward. From then on he shines hitherward. With this very syllable 'a' of the well they placed fire in this world. He who wishes 'May this sacrificer attain the heavenly world' should, having announced it at the catvala, chant the udgitha. They take him up from here with three, from the atmosphere with three, and make him go to heaven with three.
