One should indeed praise with all of them continuously, but should speak the last one first, then the next lower, then the next lower. They are all directed hitherward. But they say: 'This is entirely a return; for they indeed sacrifice desiring heaven.'
meaning: आदित्यो वा एतद् अत्राग्र आसीद् यत्रैतच् चात्वालम् अदो ऽग्निः . स इदं सर्वं प्रातपत् . तस्य देवाः प्रदाहाद् अबिभयुः . ते ऽब्रुवन् सर्वं वा अयम् इदं प्रधक्ष्यति वीमौ परिहरामेति . तम् अतस् तिसृभिर् आददत तिसृभिर् अन्तरिक्षात् तिसृभिर् दिवम् अगमयन् . स ततः पराङ् एवातपत् . त एतद् आवद् उत्तमम् अक्षरम् अपश्यन् . तेनैनम् अर्वाञ्चम् अकुर्वन् . तत एतद् अर्वाङ् तपति . ऐतेनो एवावताक्षरेणाग्निम् अस्मिन् लोके ऽदधुः . स यं कामयेत यजमानस् स्वर्गलोकस् स्याद् इति चात्वालम् एवैनम् अवख्याप्योद्गायेत् . तम् अतस् तिसृभिर् एवाददते तिसृभिर् अन्तरिक्षात् तिसृभिर् दिवं गमयन्ति . सदैव सर्वाभिस् स्तुयुर् अथोत्तमाम् अग्रे ब्रूयाद् अथावराम् अथावराम् . तास् सर्वा अर्वाचीः . तद् उ वा आहुस् सत्रैतत् प्रत्यवरूढं स्वर्गकाम्या वै यजत इति .

sanskrit_iast: rathantaravarṇām uttamāṃ gāyanti . iyaṃ vai rathantaram . asyām evaitat pratitiṣṭhati . prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata . tā enaṃ sṛṣṭā annakāśinīr abhitas samantaṃ paryaviśan . tābhyo hiṃkāreṇānnādyam asṛjata . tad oṃkāreṇa sṛṣṭam avārayata . prajāpatir eṣa yad udgātā . tam etat prajā annakāśinīr abhitas samantaṃ pariviśanti . tābhyo hiṃkāreṇaivānnādyaṃ sṛjate . tad oṃkāreṇa sṛṣṭaṃ vārayate . sa yad dhiṃkṛtyenoṃkuryāt parāṅ devānnādyam iyāt . yat sāma prathamam abhivyāharet kṣatraṃ balam ṛcchet . kṣatraṃ hi sāma . yad ṛcaṃ prathamam abhivyāhared viśaṃ balam ṛcchet . viḍ ḍhy ṛk . yad yajuḥ prathamam abhivyāharati brahma vai yajur brahmavarcasam etat karoti . bhūr bhuvas svaḥ . madhu kariṣyāmi . madhu janayiṣyāmi . madhu bhaviṣyati . bhadraṃbhadram . iṣam ūrjam iti . yad bhūr bhuvas svaḥ ity etad vai brahmaitad yajuḥ . yat madhu kariṣyāmi iti prajā vai madhu tā eva tat karoti . yat madhu janayiṣyāmi iti praivainās taj janayati . yat madhu bhaviṣyati iti bhūtim evainās tad gamayati . bhadraṃbhadram iti yad vai puruṣasya vit tad bhadraṃ gṛhā bhadraṃ prajā bhadraṃ paśavo bhadraṃ tad evaitenāvarunddhe .
sentences: tā enaṃ sr̥ṣṭā annakāśinīr abʰitas samantaṃ paryaviśan .
tam etat prajā annakāśinīr abʰitas samantaṃ pariviśanti .
sa yad dʰiṃkr̥tyenoṃkuryāt parāṅ devānnādyam iyāt .
yat sāma pratʰamam abʰivyāharet kṣatraṃ balam r̥ccʰet .
yad r̥caṃ pratʰamam abʰivyāhared viśaṃ balam r̥ccʰet .
yad yajuḥ pratʰamam abʰivyāharati brahma vai yajur brahmavarcasam etat karoti .
yad bʰūr bʰuvas svaḥ ity etad vai brahmaitad yajuḥ .
yat madʰu kariṣyāmi iti prajā vai madʰu tā eva tat karoti .
yat madʰu janayiṣyāmi iti praivainās taj janayati .
yat madʰu bʰaviṣyati iti bʰūtim evainās tad gamayati .
bʰadraṃbʰadram iti yad vai puruṣasya vit tad bʰadraṃ gr̥hā bʰadraṃ prajā bʰadraṃ paśavo bʰadraṃ tad evaitenāvarunddʰe .
text: They sing the last verse in the rathantara melody. This world is indeed the rathantara. In this world one thereby finds firm foundation. Prajapati created creatures. Those creatures, when created, hungry, sat around him on all sides. For them he created food with the himkara. That food, once created, he stopped with the omkara. The udgatr is Prajapati. The creatures, hungry, sit around him on all sides. For them he creates food with the himkara. That food, once created, he stops with the omkara. If, having made the himkara, he were to make the omkara, food would go away from the gods. If he were to utter the saman first, he would reach the power of the ksatra. For the saman is the ksatra. If he were to utter the rc first, he would reach the power of the vis (people). For the rc is the vis. Since he utters the yajus first -- the yajus is brahman -- he thereby makes brahmavarcas. 'Bhur bhuvas svah. I shall make sweetness. I shall generate sweetness. There will be sweetness. Auspicious, auspicious. Nourishment and vigor.' When he says 'bhur bhuvas svah,' that is this brahman, this yajus. When he says 'I shall make sweetness,' creatures are indeed sweetness; he thereby makes them. When he says 'I shall generate sweetness,' he thereby generates them. When he says 'There will be sweetness,' he thereby leads them to prosperity. 'Auspicious, auspicious' -- whatever is a man's possession, that is auspicious: the house is auspicious, the offspring are auspicious, the cattle are auspicious. That he thereby secures.
meaning: रथन्तरवर्णाम् उत्तमां गायन्ति . इयं वै रथन्तरम् . अस्याम् एवैतत् प्रतितिष्ठति . प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत . ता एनं सृष्टा अन्नकाशिनीर् अभितस् समन्तं पर्यविशन् . ताभ्यो हिंकारेणान्नाद्यम् असृजत . तद् ॐकारेण सृष्टम् अवारयत . प्रजापतिर् एष यद् उद्गाता . तम् एतत् प्रजा अन्नकाशिनीर् अभितस् समन्तं परिविशन्ति . ताभ्यो हिंकारेणैवान्नाद्यं सृजते . तद् ॐकारेण सृष्टं वारयते . स यद् धिंकृत्येन्ॐकुर्यात् पराङ् देवान्नाद्यम् इयात् . यत् साम प्रथमम् अभिव्याहरेत् क्षत्रं बलम् ऋच्छेत् . क्षत्रं हि साम . यद् ऋचं प्रथमम् अभिव्याहरेद् विशं बलम् ऋच्छेत् . विड् ढ्य् ऋक् . यद् यजुः प्रथमम् अभिव्याहरति ब्रह्म वै यजुर् ब्रह्मवर्चसम् एतत् करोति . भूर् भुवस् स्वः . मधु करिष्यामि . मधु जनयिष्यामि . मधु भविष्यति . भद्रंभद्रम् . इषम् ऊर्जम् इति . यद् भूर् भुवस् स्वः इत्य् एतद् वै ब्रह्मैतद् यजुः . यत् मधु करिष्यामि इति प्रजा वै मधु ता एव तत् करोति . यत् मधु जनयिष्यामि इति प्रैवैनास् तज् जनयति . यत् मधु भविष्यति इति भूतिम् एवैनास् तद् गमयति . भद्रंभद्रम् इति यद् वै पुरुषस्य वित् तद् भद्रं गृहा भद्रं प्रजा भद्रं पशवो भद्रं तद् एवैतेनावरुन्द्धे .

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatiṃ kalpayitvodgāyet . yo ha vai prajāpatiṃ kalpayitvodgāyati kalpate 'smai diśaḥ pradiśa ādiśo vidiśa uddiśo diśa iti . diśo vai prajāpatiḥ . prajāpatim eva tat kalpayitvodgāyati . kalpate 'smai ya evaṃ veda . kapivano ha smāha bhauvāyanaḥ kiṃ te yajñaṃ gacchanti yad eva somasyābhakṣayitvā pra vā sarpanti pra vā dhāvayantīti . bahiṣpavamānam upasanneṣu brūyād yaṃ brahmāṇaṃ śucim iva manyetāharahas tam iti . tena samupahūyāthānumantrayeta yo devānām iha somapītho 'smin yajñe barhiṣi vedyām tasyedaṃ bhakṣayāmasi iti . yadi ca ha pradhāvayati yadi ca nātha hāsya bhakṣita eva devas somo bhavati . etadāyatanā vā āraṇyāḥ paśavaḥ . yad bahiṣpavamānam araṇye stuvanti tasmād āraṇyāḥ paśavo 'raṇyaṃ sacante . parācīṣu stuvanti . tasmād āraṇyāḥ paśavo 'raṇyād evāraṇyam abhiprerate . ekarūpāsu stuvanti . tasmād āraṇyāḥ paśava ekarūpāḥ . āvad uttamam akṣaraṃ bhavati . tasmād ekaiko 'nyo 'calo grāme 'dhigamyate . atho araṇye hataṃ grāmam abhyavaharanti . stutvoddravanti . yajamānam eva tat svargaṃ lokaṃ gamayanti . bāhūn udgṛhṇanti . yajamānam eva tat svarge loke samādadhati . te vai tad anṛtaṃ kurvanti ye martyaṃ santam amṛtatvaṃ gamayanti . te rūpeṇa varcasā vyṛdhyante . sa ya etad evānya uttiṣṭhet tam uttiṣṭhantam ārabhyānūttiṣṭhet . na rūpeṇa varcasā vyṛdhyate nārtim ārchati . bhaviṣyad vijānīyāt . yady etāḥ prajā dodruvā iva syur dodruvo yogakṣemo bhaviṣyati . tayāyam udgātodagāsīd iti vidyāt . yady u śāntā iva syuś śānto yogakṣemo bhaviṣyati . tathāyam udgātodagāsīd iti vidyāt .
sentences: yo ha vai prajāpatiṃ kalpayitvodgāyati kalpate 'smai diśaḥ pradiśa ādiśo vidiśa uddiśo diśa iti .
kapivano ha smāha bʰauvāyanaḥ kiṃ te yajñaṃ gaccʰanti yad eva somasyābʰakṣayitvā pra vā sarpanti pra vā dʰāvayantīti .
bahiṣpavamānam upasanneṣu brūyād yaṃ brahmāṇaṃ śucim iva manyetāharahas tam iti .
yo devānām iha somapītʰo 'smin yajñe barhiṣi vedyām
yadi ca ha pradʰāvayati yadi ca nātʰa hāsya bʰakṣita eva devas somo bʰavati .
yad bahiṣpavamānam araṇye stuvanti tasmād āraṇyāḥ paśavo 'raṇyaṃ sacante .
yajamānam eva tat svargaṃ lokaṃ gamayanti .
yajamānam eva tat svarge loke samādadʰati .
te vai tad anr̥taṃ kurvanti ye martyaṃ santam amr̥tatvaṃ gamayanti .
sa ya etad evānya uttiṣṭʰet tam uttiṣṭʰantam ārabʰyānūttiṣṭʰet .
na rūpeṇa varcasā vyr̥dʰyate nārtim ārcʰati .
yady etāḥ prajā dodruvā iva syur dodruvo yogakṣemo bʰaviṣyati .
yady u śāntā iva syuś śānto yogakṣemo bʰaviṣyati .
text: One should chant the udgitha having arranged Prajapati. He who chants having arranged Prajapati -- for him the directions, the intermediate directions, the upper directions, the side directions, and the upward directions are arranged. The directions are indeed Prajapati. Having arranged Prajapati, one thus chants. It is arranged for him who knows thus. Kapivana Bhauvaayana used to say: 'What good is it that they go to the sacrifice if they proceed or run forward without even having tasted the Soma?' One about to proceed to the bahispavamana should say: 'Whichever brahmana one considers to be pure, bring him every day.' Having summoned him thus, one should bless him: 'yo devanam iha somapitho smin yajne barhisi vedyam tasyedam bhaksayamasi' (That drink of Soma which belongs to the gods here, at this sacrifice, on the barhis, on the vedi -- of that we partake). Whether he runs forward or not, the divine Soma has been tasted by him. Wild animals have this (the bahispavamana) as their abode. Because they praise the bahispavamana in the wilderness, wild animals therefore frequent the wilderness. They praise in verses directed away. Therefore wild animals move from wilderness to wilderness. They praise in verses of uniform color. Therefore wild animals are of uniform color. The last syllable is 'a.' Therefore each single other kind of animal is found in the village. And what is killed in the wilderness they bring to the village. Having praised, they run back. They thereby send the sacrificer to the heavenly world. They raise their arms. They thereby establish the sacrificer in the heavenly world. But they indeed do something untrue, those who send a mortal to immortality. They become diminished in form and splendor. Now, if another who knows thus should rise up, one should rise up grasping him as he rises. One does not become diminished in form and splendor, nor does one come to harm. One should discern what is about to happen. If the creatures should appear as if agitated, the livelihood will be agitated. One should know: 'Thus has this udgatr chanted.' If they should appear as if calm, the livelihood will be calm. One should know: 'Thus has this udgatr chanted.'
meaning: प्रजापतिं कल्पयित्वोद्गायेत् . यो ह वै प्रजापतिं कल्पयित्वोद्गायति कल्पते ऽस्मै दिशः प्रदिश आदिशो विदिश उद्दिशो दिश इति . दिशो वै प्रजापतिः . प्रजापतिम् एव तत् कल्पयित्वोद्गायति . कल्पते ऽस्मै य एवं वेद . कपिवनो ह स्माह भौवायनः किं ते यज्ञं गच्छन्ति यद् एव सोमस्याभक्षयित्वा प्र वा सर्पन्ति प्र वा धावयन्तीति . बहिष्पवमानम् उपसन्नेषु ब्रूयाद् यं ब्रह्माणं शुचिम् इव मन्येताहरहस् तम् इति . तेन समुपहूयाथानुमन्त्रयेत यो देवानाम् इह सोमपीथो ऽस्मिन् यज्ञे बर्हिषि वेद्याम् तस्येदं भक्षयामसि इति . यदि च ह प्रधावयति यदि च नाथ हास्य भक्षित एव देवस् सोमो भवति . एतदायतना वा आरण्याः पशवः . यद् बहिष्पवमानम् अरण्ये स्तुवन्ति तस्माद् आरण्याः पशवो ऽरण्यं सचन्ते . पराचीषु स्तुवन्ति . तस्माद् आरण्याः पशवो ऽरण्याद् एवारण्यम् अभिप्रेरते . एकरूपासु स्तुवन्ति . तस्माद् आरण्याः पशव एकरूपाः . आवद् उत्तमम् अक्षरं भवति . तस्माद् एकैको ऽन्यो ऽचलो ग्रामे ऽधिगम्यते . अथो अरण्ये हतं ग्रामम् अभ्यवहरन्ति . स्तुत्वोद्द्रवन्ति . यजमानम् एव तत् स्वर्गं लोकं गमयन्ति . बाहून् उद्गृह्णन्ति . यजमानम् एव तत् स्वर्गे लोके समादधति . ते वै तद् अनृतं कुर्वन्ति ये मर्त्यं सन्तम् अमृतत्वं गमयन्ति . ते रूपेण वर्चसा व्यृध्यन्ते . स य एतद् एवान्य उत्तिष्ठेत् तम् उत्तिष्ठन्तम् आरभ्यानूत्तिष्ठेत् . न रूपेण वर्चसा व्यृध्यते नार्तिम् आर्छति . भविष्यद् विजानीयात् . यद्य् एताः प्रजा दोद्रुवा इव स्युर् दोद्रुवो योगक्षेमो भविष्यति . तयायम् उद्गातोदगासीद् इति विद्यात् . यद्य् उ शान्ता इव स्युश् शान्तो योगक्षेमो भविष्यति . तथायम् उद्गातोदगासीद् इति विद्यात् .

sanskrit_iast: upāsmai gāyatā naraḥ iti grtāmakāmo bhūtikāmaḥ prajananakāmaḥ pratipadaṃ kurvīta . asyai vāvedam upagāyanti . upa vāvedam asyāṃ sarvam upaivāsyāṃ prajayā paśubhiḥ prajāyate ya evaṃ veda . naro ha vai devaviśaḥ kṣatraṃ soma induḥ . viśaṃ caivaitena kṣatraṃ cāvarunddhe . abhi devaṃ iyakṣate iti sarvā evaitena devatā anantarāyam abhiyajate . upo ṣu jātam apturam iti prajākāmaḥ pratipadaṃ kurvīta . upeva vā ātman prajayā paśubhiḥ prajāyate . etāṃ evāparedyuḥ pratipadaṃ kurvīta . apturam iti hy asyā āptvā śreyāṃsaṃ vasīyān ātmanā bhavati . gobhir bhaṅgaṃ pariṣkṛtam iti . yajño vai gobhir bhaṅgaḥ paśavaḥ pariṣkṛtaḥ . yajñaṃ caivaitena paśūṃś cāvarunddhe . induṃ devā ayāsiṣuḥ iti . yajamāno vai somo rājendus stomā devāḥ .
sentences: upāsmai gāyatā naraḥ iti grtāmakāmo bʰūtikāmaḥ prajananakāmaḥ pratipadaṃ kurvīta .
upa vāvedam asyāṃ sarvam upaivāsyāṃ prajayā paśubʰiḥ prajāyate ya evaṃ veda .
naro ha vai devaviśaḥ kṣatraṃ soma induḥ .
abʰi devaṃ iyakṣate iti sarvā evaitena devatā anantarāyam abʰiyajate .
upo ṣu jātam apturam iti prajākāmaḥ pratipadaṃ kurvīta .
upeva vā ātman prajayā paśubʰiḥ prajāyate .
apturam iti hy asyā āptvā śreyāṃsaṃ vasīyān ātmanā bʰavati .
yajño vai gobʰir bʰaṅgaḥ paśavaḥ pariṣkr̥taḥ .
yajamāno vai somo rājendus stomā devāḥ .
text: 'upa asmai gayata narah' (Sing to him, O men!) -- one desiring fame, prosperity, and procreation should use this as the pratipad. It is to this earth that one sings. Everything is indeed upon this earth. One procreates offspring and cattle upon this earth -- he who knows thus. Nara indeed means the divine people; the ksatra is Soma Indu. By this one secures both the vis and the ksatra. 'abhi devam iyaksate' (They approach the god reverently) -- by this one worships all the deities without obstacle. 'upo su jatam apturam' (Come to the one born, the fulfiller) -- one desiring offspring should use this as the pratipad. One procreates offspring and cattle upon oneself. One should use this same pratipad the following day. For through 'apturam' (the fulfiller) one becomes better and wealthier. 'gobhir bhangam pariskrtam' (Adorned with cows, the portion) -- the sacrifice is indeed the 'bhanga' with cows, the cattle are what adorns it. By this one secures both the sacrifice and cattle. 'indum deva ayasisuh' (The gods desired the drop) -- the sacrificer is Soma the King, Indu; the stomas are the gods.
meaning: उपास्मै गायता नरः इति ग्र्तामकामो भूतिकामः प्रजननकामः प्रतिपदं कुर्वीत . अस्यै वावेदम् उपगायन्ति . उप वावेदम् अस्यां सर्वम् उपैवास्यां प्रजया पशुभिः प्रजायते य एवं वेद . नरो ह वै देवविशः क्षत्रं सोम इन्दुः . विशं चैवैतेन क्षत्रं चावरुन्द्धे . अभि देवं इयक्षते इति सर्वा एवैतेन देवता अनन्तरायम् अभियजते . उपो षु जातम् अप्तुरम् इति प्रजाकामः प्रतिपदं कुर्वीत . उपेव वा आत्मन् प्रजया पशुभिः प्रजायते . एतां एवापरेद्युः प्रतिपदं कुर्वीत . अप्तुरम् इति ह्य् अस्या आप्त्वा श्रेयांसं वसीयान् आत्मना भवति . गोभिर् भङ्गं परिष्कृतम् इति . यज्ञो वै गोभिर् भङ्गः पशवः परिष्कृतः . यज्ञं चैवैतेन पशूंश् चावरुन्द्धे . इन्दुं देवा अयासिषुः इति . यजमानो वै सोमो राजेन्दुस् स्तोमा देवाः .

sanskrit_iast: pavasva vāco agriyaḥ iti śraiṣṭhyakāmaḥ pratipadaṃ kurvīta . prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata . tā enaṃ sṛṣṭā nāpācāyan . so 'kāmayata śraiṣṭhyam āsāṃ prajānāṃ gaccheyam iti . sa etāṃ pratipadam apaśyat . tayāstuta . tato vai sa tāsāṃ prajānāṃ śraiṣṭhyam agacchat . gacchati svānāṃ śraiṣṭhyaṃ ya evaṃ veda . eṣo ha vai samṛddhā stotriyā yasyai pavasva ityārambhaḥ . samṛddhayaivāsya stotriyayā stutaṃ bhavati . yo vai daivyaṃ mithunaṃ veda pra mithunena jāyate . pavasva iti ca vācaḥ iti ca daivyaṃ mithunam . pra mithunena jāyate ya evaṃ veda . sarveṣāṃ vā eṣā trayāṇāṃ sāmnāṃ pratipat pavasva iti vāmadevyasya vācaḥ iti rathantarasya agriyaḥ iti bṛhataḥ . sarveṣām asya sāmnāṃ pratipadā stutaṃ bhavati . soma citrābhir ūtibhiḥ iti somo vai devānāṃ citraṃ somenaiva devānāṃ citreṇa bahur bhavati prajāyate .
sentences: pavasva vāco agriyaḥ iti śraiṣṭʰyakāmaḥ pratipadaṃ kurvīta .
so 'kāmayata śraiṣṭʰyam āsāṃ prajānāṃ gaccʰeyam iti .
tato vai sa tāsāṃ prajānāṃ śraiṣṭʰyam agaccʰat .
gaccʰati svānāṃ śraiṣṭʰyaṃ ya evaṃ veda .
eṣo ha vai samr̥ddʰā stotriyā yasyai pavasva ityārambʰaḥ .
yo vai daivyaṃ mitʰunaṃ veda pra mitʰunena jāyate .
pavasva iti ca vācaḥ iti ca daivyaṃ mitʰunam .
pra mitʰunena jāyate ya evaṃ veda .
sarveṣāṃ vā eṣā trayāṇāṃ sāmnāṃ pratipat pavasva iti vāmadevyasya vācaḥ iti ratʰantarasya agriyaḥ iti br̥hataḥ .
sarveṣām asya sāmnāṃ pratipadā stutaṃ bʰavati .
soma citrābʰir ūtibʰiḥ iti somo vai devānāṃ citraṃ somenaiva devānāṃ citreṇa bahur bʰavati prajāyate .
text: 'pavasva vaco agriyah' (Flow forth, O foremost of speech!) -- one desiring preeminence should use this as the pratipad. Prajapati created creatures. Those creatures, when created, did not honor him. He desired: 'May I attain preeminence among these creatures.' He saw this pratipad. He praised with it. Thereby he attained preeminence among those creatures. He attains preeminence among his own -- he who knows thus. This is indeed the complete stotriya, whose beginning is 'pavasva.' His praise is done with a complete stotriya. He who knows the divine couple procreates through the couple. 'pavasva' and 'vacah' are the divine couple. He procreates through the couple -- he who knows thus. This is the pratipad of all three samans: 'pavasva' belongs to the vamadeya, 'vacah' to the rathantara, 'agriyah' to the brhat. His praise is accomplished with the pratipad of all the samans. 'soma citrabhir utibhih' (Soma, with brilliant aids) -- Soma is indeed the marvelous among the gods; by Soma, the marvelous of the gods, one becomes abundant, one procreates.
meaning: पवस्व वाचो अग्रियः इति श्रैष्ठ्यकामः प्रतिपदं कुर्वीत . प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत . ता एनं सृष्टा नापाचायन् . सो ऽकामयत श्रैष्ठ्यम् आसां प्रजानां गच्छेयम् इति . स एतां प्रतिपदम् अपश्यत् . तयास्तुत . ततो वै स तासां प्रजानां श्रैष्ठ्यम् अगच्छत् . गच्छति स्वानां श्रैष्ठ्यं य एवं वेद . एषो ह वै समृद्धा स्तोत्रिया यस्यै पवस्व इत्यारम्भः . समृद्धयैवास्य स्तोत्रियया स्तुतं भवति . यो वै दैव्यं मिथुनं वेद प्र मिथुनेन जायते . पवस्व इति च वाचः इति च दैव्यं मिथुनम् . प्र मिथुनेन जायते य एवं वेद . सर्वेषां वा एषा त्रयाणां साम्नां प्रतिपत् पवस्व इति वामदेव्यस्य वाचः इति रथन्तरस्य अग्रियः इति बृहतः . सर्वेषाम् अस्य साम्नां प्रतिपदा स्तुतं भवति . सोम चित्राभिर् ऊतिभिः इति सोमो वै देवानां चित्रं सोमेनैव देवानां चित्रेण बहुर् भवति प्रजायते .

sanskrit_iast: pavasvendo vṛṣā sutaḥ iti jane pratiṣṭhākāmaḥ pratipadaṃ kurvīta . kṛdhī no yaśaso janaḥ iti hy asyai yaśasy eva jane bhavati . vṛṣā sutaḥ iti vṛṣeva vai prajanitevādhipatir iva tasyāṃ janatāyāṃ bhavati yasyām ṛdhyate . vṛṣevaiva prajanitevādhipatir iva tasyāṃ janatāyāṃ bhāti yasyāṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda . sarvo ha vai jane bubhūṣate 'rātīyati . viśvā apa dviṣo jahi iti viśvā evaitena dviṣo 'pahate . tayā pavasva dhārayā iti saṃgrāmaṃ saṃyatiṣyamānasya pratipadaṃ kuryāt . yayā gāva ihāgaman janyāsa upa no gṛhān iti janyā vā eṣa gā ājihīrṣati yas saṃgrāmaṃ saṃyatate . ā janyā gā harati . etām eva pratipadaṃ kurvīta saniṃ praiṣyan . janyā vā eṣa gā ājihīrṣati yas saniṃ praiti . ā janyā gā haraty upainaṃ janyā gāvo namanti ya evaṃ veda . agna āyūṃṣi pavase ity āmayāvinaḥ pratipadaṃ kuryāt . agniṃ vā etasya śarīram apyeti vāyuṃ prāṇaḥ . agninaivāsya pavamānena śarīraṃ prāṇena saṃdadhāti . etām evaṃ pratipadaṃ kurvīran yeṣāṃ dīkṣitānāṃ pramīyate . apūtā iva vā ete 'medhyā manyante yeṣāṃ dīkṣitānāṃ pramīyate .
sentences: pavasvendo vr̥ṣā sutaḥ iti jane pratiṣṭʰākāmaḥ pratipadaṃ kurvīta .
kr̥dʰī no yaśaso janaḥ iti hy asyai yaśasy eva jane bʰavati .
vr̥ṣā sutaḥ iti vr̥ṣeva vai prajanitevādʰipatir iva tasyāṃ janatāyāṃ bʰavati yasyām r̥dʰyate .
vr̥ṣevaiva prajanitevādʰipatir iva tasyāṃ janatāyāṃ bʰāti yasyāṃ bʰavati ya evaṃ veda .
viśvā apa dviṣo jahi iti viśvā evaitena dviṣo 'pahate .
tayā pavasva dʰārayā iti saṃgrāmaṃ saṃyatiṣyamānasya pratipadaṃ kuryāt .
yayā gāva ihāgaman janyāsa upa no gr̥hān iti janyā vā eṣa gā ājihīrṣati yas saṃgrāmaṃ saṃyatate .
etām eva pratipadaṃ kurvīta saniṃ praiṣyan .
janyā vā eṣa gā ājihīrṣati yas saniṃ praiti .
ā janyā gā haraty upainaṃ janyā gāvo namanti ya evaṃ veda .
agna āyūṃṣi pavase ity āmayāvinaḥ pratipadaṃ kuryāt .
agniṃ vā etasya śarīram apyeti vāyuṃ prāṇaḥ .
etām evaṃ pratipadaṃ kurvīran yeṣāṃ dīkṣitānāṃ pramīyate .
apūtā iva vā ete 'medʰyā manyante yeṣāṃ dīkṣitānāṃ pramīyate .
text: 'pavasvendo vrsa sutah' (Flow, O drop, pressed out as bull!) -- one desiring firm establishment among people should use this as the pratipad. 'krdhi no yasaso jane' (Make us famous among the people) -- for through this one becomes famous among the people. 'vrsa sutah' (the bull pressed out) -- like a bull, like a progenitor, like a chief, he becomes in that community in which he prospers. Like a bull, like a progenitor, like a chief, he shines in that community in which he lives -- he who knows thus. Everyone indeed desires to thrive among the people and gives gifts. 'visva apa dviso jahi' (Strike away all hatreds!) -- by this one strikes away all hatreds. 'taya pavasva dharaya' (With that stream flow forth!) -- one should use this as the pratipad for one about to engage in battle. 'yaya gava ihagaman janyasa upa no grhan' (By which the cows came here, of foreign people, to our houses) -- he who goes to battle indeed wishes to seize the foreign cows. He seizes the foreign cows. One should use this same pratipad when about to go on a raid. He who goes on a raid indeed wishes to seize the foreign cows. He seizes the foreign cows; the foreign cows bow down to him -- he who knows thus. 'agna ayumsi pavase' (O Agni, you purify lifespans) -- one should use this as the pratipad for one who is ill. For Agni is what his body comes to, Vayu is what his breath comes to. By Agni, the pavamana, one joins together his body and his breath. One should use this same pratipad for those among the consecrated who have died. For those among the consecrated who have died consider themselves as if unpurified, impure.
meaning: पवस्वेन्दो वृषा सुतः इति जने प्रतिष्ठाकामः प्रतिपदं कुर्वीत . कृधी नो यशसो जनः इति ह्य् अस्यै यशस्य् एव जने भवति . वृषा सुतः इति वृषेव वै प्रजनितेवाधिपतिर् इव तस्यां जनतायां भवति यस्याम् ऋध्यते . वृषेवैव प्रजनितेवाधिपतिर् इव तस्यां जनतायां भाति यस्यां भवति य एवं वेद . सर्वो ह वै जने बुभूषते ऽरातीयति . विश्वा अप द्विषो जहि इति विश्वा एवैतेन द्विषो ऽपहते . तया पवस्व धारया इति संग्रामं संयतिष्यमानस्य प्रतिपदं कुर्यात् . यया गाव इहागमन् जन्यास उप नो गृहान् इति जन्या वा एष गा आजिहीर्षति यस् संग्रामं संयतते . आ जन्या गा हरति . एताम् एव प्रतिपदं कुर्वीत सनिं प्रैष्यन् . जन्या वा एष गा आजिहीर्षति यस् सनिं प्रैति . आ जन्या गा हरत्य् उपैनं जन्या गावो नमन्ति य एवं वेद . अग्न आयूंषि पवसे इत्य् आमयाविनः प्रतिपदं कुर्यात् . अग्निं वा एतस्य शरीरम् अप्येति वायुं प्राणः . अग्निनैवास्य पवमानेन शरीरं प्राणेन संदधाति . एताम् एवं प्रतिपदं कुर्वीरन् येषां दीक्षितानां प्रमीयते . अपूता इव वा एते ऽमेध्या मन्यन्ते येषां दीक्षितानां प्रमीयते .

sanskrit_iast: - brahmavarcasakāmaḥ . agnir vai devānāṃ brahmā . agninaiva devānāṃ brahmaṇā varcasī bhavati . etām eva pratipadaṃ kurvītābhicaran . agnir vai devānāṃ brahmā . agninaiva devānāṃ brahmaṇā yaṃ dveṣṭi taṃ stṛṇute . etām eva pratipadaṃ kurvītānnādyakāmaḥ . ā suvorjam iṣaṃ ca naḥ iti hy asyā iṣaṃ caivaitenorjaṃ cāvarunddhe . etām eva pratipadaṃ kurvītābhicaryamāṇaḥ . yo vā abhicarati yo 'bhidāsati yaḥ pāpaṃ kāmayate sa vai ducchunaḥ . āre bādhasva ducchunām ity ārād evaitena dviṣantaṃ pāpmānaṃ bhrātṛvyam avāñcam apabādhate . davidyutatyā rucā iti brahmavarcasakāmaḥ pratipadaṃ kurvīta . davidyutatī vai gāyatrī . gāyatrī brahmavarcasam ojo vīryaṃ triṣṭup prajananaṃ jagatī . brahmavarcasy ojasvī vīryavān prajayā paśubhir jāyate ya evaṃ veda . pariṣṭobhantyā kṛpā somāś śukrā gavāśiraḥ iti . yajño vai somāś śukrāḥ paśavo gavāśiraḥ . yajñaṃ caivaitena paśūṃś cāvarunddhe . asya pratnām anu dyutam iti pratipadaṃ kurvīta yasya pitā vā pitāmaho vā śreyān syād athātmanā pāpīyān iva manyeta . yaivāsya pitryā paitāmahī śrīs tām evāśnute . śukraṃ duduhre ahrayaḥ iti . yajño vai śukraḥ paśavo 'hrayaḥ . yajñaṃ caivaitena paśūṃś cāvarunddhe . payas sahasrasām ṛṣim iti .
sentences: agninaiva devānāṃ brahmaṇā yaṃ dveṣṭi taṃ str̥ṇute .
ā suvorjam iṣaṃ ca naḥ iti hy asyā iṣaṃ caivaitenorjaṃ cāvarunddʰe .
yo vā abʰicarati yo 'bʰidāsati yaḥ pāpaṃ kāmayate sa vai duccʰunaḥ .
āre bādʰasva duccʰunām ity ārād evaitena dviṣantaṃ pāpmānaṃ bʰrātr̥vyam avāñcam apabādʰate .
davidyutatyā rucā iti brahmavarcasakāmaḥ pratipadaṃ kurvīta .
gāyatrī brahmavarcasam ojo vīryaṃ triṣṭup prajananaṃ jagatī .
brahmavarcasy ojasvī vīryavān prajayā paśubʰir jāyate ya evaṃ veda .
pariṣṭobʰantyā kr̥pā somāś śukrā gavāśiraḥ iti .
yajño vai somāś śukrāḥ paśavo gavāśiraḥ .
asya pratnām anu dyutam iti pratipadaṃ kurvīta yasya pitā vā pitāmaho vā śreyān syād atʰātmanā pāpīyān iva manyeta .
yaivāsya pitryā paitāmahī śrīs tām evāśnute .
text: One desiring brahmavarcas should use this. Agni is indeed the brahman among the gods. By Agni, the brahman of the gods, one becomes resplendent. One should use this same pratipad when practicing sorcery. Agni is indeed the brahman among the gods. By Agni, the brahman of the gods, one subdues whomever one hates. One should use this same pratipad when desiring food. 'a suvorjam isam ca nah' (Bring us vigor and nourishment!) -- for through this one secures both nourishment and vigor. One should use this same pratipad when being attacked by sorcery. He who practices sorcery, he who attacks, he who desires evil -- he is indeed inauspicious. 'are badhasva ducchunam' (Drive away the inauspicious one far off!) -- by this one drives away far off the hating rival, the evil one, downward. 'davidyutatya ruca' (With flashing splendor) -- one desiring brahmavarcas should use this as the pratipad. The gayatri is indeed flashing. The gayatri is brahmavarcas; vigor and strength are the tristubh; procreation is the jagati. One becomes endowed with brahmavarcas, vigor, strength, offspring, and cattle -- he who knows thus. 'paristobhantya krpa somaas sukra gavasirah' (The bright somas, mixed with milk, resound on all sides) -- the sacrifice is indeed the bright somas; cattle are what is mixed with milk. By this one secures both the sacrifice and cattle. 'asya pratnam anu dyutam' (Following his ancient splendor) -- one should use this as the pratipad he whose father or grandfather was more eminent, but who considers himself inferior. He attains that very paternal and ancestral glory. 'sukram duduhre ahrayah' (The unblushing ones milked forth the bright one) -- the sacrifice is indeed the bright one; cattle are the unblushing ones. By this one secures both the sacrifice and cattle. 'payas sahasrasam rsim' (The milk, the thousandfold rsi).
meaning: - ब्रह्मवर्चसकामः . अग्निर् वै देवानां ब्रह्मा . अग्निनैव देवानां ब्रह्मणा वर्चसी भवति . एताम् एव प्रतिपदं कुर्वीताभिचरन् . अग्निर् वै देवानां ब्रह्मा . अग्निनैव देवानां ब्रह्मणा यं द्वेष्टि तं स्तृणुते . एताम् एव प्रतिपदं कुर्वीतान्नाद्यकामः . आ सुवोर्जम् इषं च नः इति ह्य् अस्या इषं चैवैतेनोर्जं चावरुन्द्धे . एताम् एव प्रतिपदं कुर्वीताभिचर्यमाणः . यो वा अभिचरति यो ऽभिदासति यः पापं कामयते स वै दुच्छुनः . आरे बाधस्व दुच्छुनाम् इत्य् आराद् एवैतेन द्विषन्तं पाप्मानं भ्रातृव्यम् अवाञ्चम् अपबाधते . दविद्युतत्या रुचा इति ब्रह्मवर्चसकामः प्रतिपदं कुर्वीत . दविद्युतती वै गायत्री . गायत्री ब्रह्मवर्चसम् ओजो वीर्यं त्रिष्टुप् प्रजननं जगती . ब्रह्मवर्चस्य् ओजस्वी वीर्यवान् प्रजया पशुभिर् जायते य एवं वेद . परिष्टोभन्त्या कृपा सोमाश् शुक्रा गवाशिरः इति . यज्ञो वै सोमाश् शुक्राः पशवो गवाशिरः . यज्ञं चैवैतेन पशूंश् चावरुन्द्धे . अस्य प्रत्नाम् अनु द्युतम् इति प्रतिपदं कुर्वीत यस्य पिता वा पितामहो वा श्रेयान् स्याद् अथात्मना पापीयान् इव मन्येत . यैवास्य पित्र्या पैतामही श्रीस् ताम् एवाश्नुते . शुक्रं दुदुह्रे अह्रयः इति . यज्ञो वै शुक्रः पशवो ऽह्रयः . यज्ञं चैवैतेन पशूंश् चावरुन्द्धे . पयस् सहस्रसाम् ऋषिम् इति .

sanskrit_iast: ete asṛgram indavaḥ iti bahūnāṃ saṃyajamānānāṃ pratipadaṃ kuryāt . ete ity evainān jyaiṣṭhyāyābhivadati chandasaivainān rūpiṇā samāvadbhājaḥ karoti . samāvaty enān yajñasyāśīr āgacchati . prajāpatir yat prajā asṛjata tā enayaiva pratipadāsṛjata . ete ity eva devān asṛjata asṛgram iti manuṣyān indavaḥ iti pitr̥̄n tiraḥ pavitram iti grahān āśavaḥ iti stomān viśvāni ity ukthāni abhi saubhagā ity evainān jātān saubhāgyenābhyānak . prajāpatir eva bhūtaḥ prajās sṛjate ya evaṃ vidvān etayā pratipadodgāyati . atho hainās tat saubhāgyenaivābhyānakti . asṛkṣata pra vājinaḥ iti trayāṇāṃ saṃyajamānānāṃ pratipadaṃ kuryāt . chandasaivainān rūpiṇā samāvadbhājaḥ karoti . samāvaty enān yajñasyāśīr āgacchati . gavyā somāso aśvayā iti goaśvam evaibhya etenāvarunddhe . śukrāso vīrayāśavaḥ iti yajño vai śukraḥ prajā vīro yajñaṃ caivaibhya etena prajāṃ cāvarunddhe . yuvaṃ hi sthaḥ svaḥpatī iti dvayos samyajamānayoḥ pratipadaṃ kuryāt . chandasaivainau rūpiṇā samāvadbhājau karoti .
sentences: ete asr̥gram indavaḥ iti bahūnāṃ saṃyajamānānāṃ pratipadaṃ kuryāt .
ete ity evainān jyaiṣṭʰyāyābʰivadati cʰandasaivainān rūpiṇā samāvadbʰājaḥ karoti .
prajāpatir yat prajā asr̥jata tā enayaiva pratipadāsr̥jata .
ete ity eva devān asr̥jata asr̥gram iti manuṣyān indavaḥ iti pitr̥̄n tiraḥ pavitram iti grahān āśavaḥ iti stomān viśvāni ity uktʰāni abʰi saubʰagā ity evainān jātān saubʰāgyenābʰyānak .
prajāpatir eva bʰūtaḥ prajās sr̥jate ya evaṃ vidvān etayā pratipadodgāyati .
asr̥kṣata pra vājinaḥ iti trayāṇāṃ saṃyajamānānāṃ pratipadaṃ kuryāt .
gavyā somāso aśvayā iti goaśvam evaibʰya etenāvarunddʰe .
śukrāso vīrayāśavaḥ iti yajño vai śukraḥ prajā vīro yajñaṃ caivaibʰya etena prajāṃ cāvarunddʰe .
yuvaṃ hi stʰaḥ svaḥpatī iti dvayos samyajamānayoḥ pratipadaṃ kuryāt .
text: 'ete asrgram indavah' (These drops have flowed forth) -- one should use this as the pratipad when many are sacrificing together. With 'ete' (these) he addresses them for preeminence; he makes them sharers in it through the metre endowed with form. The blessing of the sacrifice comes to them together. When Prajapati created creatures, he created them with this very pratipad. With 'ete' (these) he created the gods; with 'asrgram' (they flowed forth) the humans; with 'indavah' (the drops) the fathers; with 'tirah pavitram' (through the filter) the cups; with 'asavah' (the swift ones) the stomas; with 'visvani' (all) the ukthas; with 'abhi saubhaga' (toward good fortune) he anointed them, once born, with good fortune. Prajapati himself, having become, creates creatures -- he who, knowing thus, chants the udgitha with this pratipad. And thereby he anoints them with good fortune. 'asrksata pra vajinah' (The swift ones flowed forth) -- one should use this as the pratipad when three are sacrificing together. He makes them sharers through the metre endowed with form. The blessing of the sacrifice comes to them together. 'gavya somaso asvaya' (The somas desiring cows, desiring horses) -- by this one secures for them cows and horses. 'sukraso virayasavah' (The bright ones, swiftly seeking heroes) -- the sacrifice is indeed the bright one; the offspring is the hero. By this one secures for them both the sacrifice and offspring. 'yuvam hi sthah svahpati' (For you two are lords of well-being) -- one should use this as the pratipad when two are sacrificing together. He makes them sharers through the metre endowed with form.
meaning: एते असृग्रम् इन्दवः इति बहूनां संयजमानानां प्रतिपदं कुर्यात् . एते इत्य् एवैनान् ज्यैष्ठ्यायाभिवदति छन्दसैवैनान् रूपिणा समावद्भाजः करोति . समावत्य् एनान् यज्ञस्याशीर् आगच्छति . प्रजापतिर् यत् प्रजा असृजत ता एनयैव प्रतिपदासृजत . एते इत्य् एव देवान् असृजत असृग्रम् इति मनुष्यान् इन्दवः इति पित्र्̥̄न् तिरः पवित्रम् इति ग्रहान् आशवः इति स्तोमान् विश्वानि इत्य् उक्थानि अभि सौभगा इत्य् एवैनान् जातान् सौभाग्येनाभ्यानक् . प्रजापतिर् एव भूतः प्रजास् सृजते य एवं विद्वान् एतया प्रतिपदोद्गायति . अथो हैनास् तत् सौभाग्येनैवाभ्यानक्ति . असृक्षत प्र वाजिनः इति त्रयाणां संयजमानानां प्रतिपदं कुर्यात् . छन्दसैवैनान् रूपिणा समावद्भाजः करोति . समावत्य् एनान् यज्ञस्याशीर् आगच्छति . गव्या सोमासो अश्वया इति गोअश्वम् एवैभ्य एतेनावरुन्द्धे . शुक्रासो वीरयाशवः इति यज्ञो वै शुक्रः प्रजा वीरो यज्ञं चैवैभ्य एतेन प्रजां चावरुन्द्धे . युवं हि स्थः स्वःपती इति द्वयोस् सम्यजमानयोः प्रतिपदं कुर्यात् . छन्दसैवैनौ रूपिणा समावद्भाजौ करोति .

sanskrit_iast: indraś ca soma gopatī īśānā pipyataṃ dhiyaḥ iti . indraś ca vai somaś cākāmayetāṃ sarvāsāṃ prajānām aiśvaryam ādhipatyam aśnuvīvahīti . tāv etāṃ pratipadam apaśyatām . tayāstuvatām . tato vai tau sarvāsāṃ prajānām aiśvaryam ādhipatyam āśnuvātām . aśnute ha vai svānām aiśvaryam ādhipatyam etayā pratipadā tuṣṭuvānaḥ . indrāyendo marutvate iti rājanyabandhoḥ pratipadaṃ kuryāt . aindro vai rājanyo mārutīr viśaḥ . kṣatrāyaiva tad viśam anuvartmānaṃ kurvanti . tasmāt kṣatrasya viḍ anuvartmā . yo jināti na jīyate iti vā jināty eva na jīyate . hanti śatrum abhītya ity anyato vātyevābhītya śatruṃ hanti nainaṃ śatruḥ pratyudyāmī bhavati . sa pavasva sahasrajit iti . yo vai sarvaṃ jayati vijayate saḥ . sarvajit sarvam eva jayati .
sentences: indraś ca soma gopatī īśānā pipyataṃ dʰiyaḥ iti .
indraś ca vai somaś cākāmayetāṃ sarvāsāṃ prajānām aiśvaryam ādʰipatyam aśnuvīvahīti .
tato vai tau sarvāsāṃ prajānām aiśvaryam ādʰipatyam āśnuvātām .
aśnute ha vai svānām aiśvaryam ādʰipatyam etayā pratipadā tuṣṭuvānaḥ .
indrāyendo marutvate iti rājanyabandʰoḥ pratipadaṃ kuryāt .
yo jināti na jīyate iti vā jināty eva na jīyate .
hanti śatrum abʰītya ity anyato vātyevābʰītya śatruṃ hanti nainaṃ śatruḥ pratyudyāmī bʰavati .
yo vai sarvaṃ jayati vijayate saḥ .
text: 'indras ca soma gopati isana pipyatam dhiyah' (Indra and Soma, lords of cattle, inspiring, nourish the hymns!) -- Indra and Soma desired: 'May we attain the sovereignty and lordship over all creatures.' They saw this pratipad. They praised with it. Thereby they attained the sovereignty and lordship over all creatures. He attains sovereignty and lordship over his own -- he who praises with this pratipad, knowing thus. 'indrayendo marutvate' (For Indra accompanied by the Maruts, O drop!) -- one should use this as the pratipad for a rajanyabandhu (one connected to the ksatriya class). The rajanya belongs to Indra; the vis (people) belong to the Maruts. One thereby makes the vis follow the ksatra. Therefore the vis follows the ksatra. 'yo jinati na jiyate' (He who conquers and is not conquered) -- he conquers and is not conquered. 'hanti satrum abhitya' (He slays the enemy, having approached) -- having approached from wherever, he slays the enemy; the enemy does not become one who advances against him. 'sa pavasva sahasrajit' (Flow forth, O thousand-conquering one!) -- he who conquers everything is the one who conquers all. He conquers all, he conquers everything.
meaning: इन्द्रश् च सोम गोपती ईशाना पिप्यतं धियः इति . इन्द्रश् च वै सोमश् चाकामयेतां सर्वासां प्रजानाम् ऐश्वर्यम् आधिपत्यम् अश्नुवीवहीति . ताव् एतां प्रतिपदम् अपश्यताम् . तयास्तुवताम् . ततो वै तौ सर्वासां प्रजानाम् ऐश्वर्यम् आधिपत्यम् आश्नुवाताम् . अश्नुते ह वै स्वानाम् ऐश्वर्यम् आधिपत्यम् एतया प्रतिपदा तुष्टुवानः . इन्द्रायेन्दो मरुत्वते इति राजन्यबन्धोः प्रतिपदं कुर्यात् . ऐन्द्रो वै राजन्यो मारुतीर् विशः . क्षत्रायैव तद् विशम् अनुवर्त्मानं कुर्वन्ति . तस्मात् क्षत्रस्य विड् अनुवर्त्मा . यो जिनाति न जीयते इति वा जिनात्य् एव न जीयते . हन्ति शत्रुम् अभीत्य इत्य् अन्यतो वात्येवाभीत्य शत्रुं हन्ति नैनं शत्रुः प्रत्युद्यामी भवति . स पवस्व सहस्रजित् इति . यो वै सर्वं जयति विजयते सः . सर्वजित् सर्वम् एव जयति .

sanskrit_iast: apaghnan pavate mṛdhaḥ ity abhiśasyamānasya pratipadaṃ kuryāt . mṛdho vā etam ajuṣṭās sacante yam abhiśaṃsanti . apa pāpīr mṛdho hate . apa somo arāvṇaḥ iti . arāvāṇa iva hy etaṃ sacante yam abhiśaṃsanti . gacchann indrasya niṣkṛtam iti . anindriyo vā eṣo 'padevo bhavati yam abhiśaṃsanti . indriyāvantam evainam etena sadevaṃ kurvanti . āgnāvāruṇīm āmayāvino jyogāmayāvinaḥ pratipadaṃ kuryāt . agninā vā eṣa varuṇena gṛhīto bhavati ya āmayāvī jyogāmayāvī . agninaivainam āgneyān muñcanti varuṇena vāruṇāt . yasyāṃ varṣīyasyām ṛci hrasīyo hrasīyasyāṃ vā varṣīyas tāṃ ānāyakāmaḥ pratipadaṃ kurvīta . varṣīyasā vā eṣa hrasīyaḥ prepsyatīti hrasīyasā varṣīyaḥ . pra hrasīyasā varṣīya āpnoti ya evaṃ veda . eṣa devo amartyaḥ iti pratipadaṃ kurvīta yaḥ kāmayetāham evaikadhā śreṣṭhas svānāṃ syāṃ rucam aśnuvīyeti . eṣa eṣaḥ ity evaināṃ jyeṣṭhyāya śreṣṭhyāyābhivadati . ekadhaiva śreṣṭhas svānāṃ bhavati rucam aśnute . īśvaro ha tv asyāparaḥ prajāyām etādṛṅ vīro nājanitoḥ . eṣa eva nāto 'nya itīva hy enaṃ vāg abhivadati . tad u tv etan na tathā . devo amartyaḥ iti vā āha . adevaś ca ha vai sa martyaś ca yasya vīrasya sato vīro vīryavān nājāyate . atha ha vai sa eva devas so 'martyao yasya vīrasya sato vīro vīryavān ājāyate .
sentences: apagʰnan pavate mr̥dʰaḥ ity abʰiśasyamānasya pratipadaṃ kuryāt .
mr̥dʰo vā etam ajuṣṭās sacante yam abʰiśaṃsanti .
arāvāṇa iva hy etaṃ sacante yam abʰiśaṃsanti .
anindriyo vā eṣo 'padevo bʰavati yam abʰiśaṃsanti .
agninā vā eṣa varuṇena gr̥hīto bʰavati ya āmayāvī jyogāmayāvī .
yasyāṃ varṣīyasyām r̥ci hrasīyo hrasīyasyāṃ vā varṣīyas tāṃ ānāyakāmaḥ pratipadaṃ kurvīta .
varṣīyasā vā eṣa hrasīyaḥ prepsyatīti hrasīyasā varṣīyaḥ .
pra hrasīyasā varṣīya āpnoti ya evaṃ veda .
eṣa devo amartyaḥ iti pratipadaṃ kurvīta yaḥ kāmayetāham evaikadʰā śreṣṭʰas svānāṃ syāṃ rucam aśnuvīyeti .
eṣa eṣaḥ ity evaināṃ jyeṣṭʰyāya śreṣṭʰyāyābʰivadati .
ekadʰaiva śreṣṭʰas svānāṃ bʰavati rucam aśnute .
īśvaro ha tv asyāparaḥ prajāyām etādr̥ṅ vīro nājanitoḥ .
eṣa eva nāto 'nya itīva hy enaṃ vāg abʰivadati .
tad u tv etan na tatʰā .
adevaś ca ha vai sa martyaś ca yasya vīrasya sato vīro vīryavān nājāyate .
atʰa ha vai sa eva devas so 'martyao yasya vīrasya sato vīro vīryavān ājāyate .
text: 'apaghnan pavate mrdhah' (He flows forth, striking away hostilities) -- one should use this as the pratipad for one who is being accused. For hostile, unwelcome forces attend him whom they accuse. 'He strikes away the evil hostilities. Soma strikes away the niggardly' -- for niggardly ones, as it were, attend him whom they accuse. 'gacchann indrasya niskrtam' (Going to Indra's redemption) -- for he who is being accused becomes devoid of Indra, devoid of deity. By this one makes him endowed with Indra, accompanied by deity. One should use the agni-varuṇa pratipad for one who is ill, who is long ill. For one who is ill, who is long ill, is seized by Agni and Varuna. By the agneya verses one releases him from Agni, by the varuṇa verses from Varuna. When the longer rc has the shorter verse, or the shorter has the longer -- one desiring to bring something should use that as the pratipad. For the shorter seeks to obtain from the longer, the longer from the shorter. The shorter attains from the longer -- he who knows thus. 'esa devo amartyah' (This god is immortal) -- one should use this as the pratipad he who desires: 'May I alone be the foremost among my own; may I attain splendor.' With 'esa esah' (this, this) he addresses it for supremacy and preeminence. He becomes the foremost among his own and attains splendor. But it is likely that no hero equal to him will be born among his descendants. 'This one and no other' -- so speech seems to address him. But it is not really so. For he says 'devo amartyah' (god, immortal). He is indeed godless and mortal whose hero, being a hero, does not beget a heroic son. But he is truly a god and immortal whose hero, being a hero, begets a heroic son.
meaning: अपघ्नन् पवते मृधः इत्य् अभिशस्यमानस्य प्रतिपदं कुर्यात् . मृधो वा एतम् अजुष्टास् सचन्ते यम् अभिशंसन्ति . अप पापीर् मृधो हते . अप सोमो अराव्णः इति . अरावाण इव ह्य् एतं सचन्ते यम् अभिशंसन्ति . गच्छन्न् इन्द्रस्य निष्कृतम् इति . अनिन्द्रियो वा एषो ऽपदेवो भवति यम् अभिशंसन्ति . इन्द्रियावन्तम् एवैनम् एतेन सदेवं कुर्वन्ति . आग्नावारुणीम् आमयाविनो ज्योगामयाविनः प्रतिपदं कुर्यात् . अग्निना वा एष वरुणेन गृहीतो भवति य आमयावी ज्योगामयावी . अग्निनैवैनम् आग्नेयान् मुञ्चन्ति वरुणेन वारुणात् . यस्यां वर्षीयस्याम् ऋचि ह्रसीयो ह्रसीयस्यां वा वर्षीयस् तां आनायकामः प्रतिपदं कुर्वीत . वर्षीयसा वा एष ह्रसीयः प्रेप्स्यतीति ह्रसीयसा वर्षीयः . प्र ह्रसीयसा वर्षीय आप्नोति य एवं वेद . एष देवो अमर्त्यः इति प्रतिपदं कुर्वीत यः कामयेताहम् एवैकधा श्रेष्ठस् स्वानां स्यां रुचम् अश्नुवीयेति . एष एषः इत्य् एवैनां ज्येष्ठ्याय श्रेष्ठ्यायाभिवदति . एकधैव श्रेष्ठस् स्वानां भवति रुचम् अश्नुते . ईश्वरो ह त्व् अस्यापरः प्रजायाम् एतादृङ् वीरो नाजनितोः . एष एव नातो ऽन्य इतीव ह्य् एनं वाग् अभिवदति . तद् उ त्व् एतन् न तथा . देवो अमर्त्यः इति वा आह . अदेवश् च ह वै स मर्त्यश् च यस्य वीरस्य सतो वीरो वीर्यवान् नाजायते . अथ ह वै स एव देवस् सो ऽमर्त्यओ यस्य वीरस्य सतो वीरो वीर्यवान् आजायते .

sanskrit_iast: devāsurā aspardhanta . te devā vajraṃ kṣurapavim asṛjanta puruṣam eva . tam asurān abhyavṛñjan . so 'surān apohya devān abhyāvartata . tasmād devā abibhayuḥ . tam abhipadya tredhā samaśṛṇan . sa tredhā saṃśīrṇa ud evātiṣṭhat . tam ārabhya paryaikṣanta . tasmin devatāś chandāṃsi puruṣe praviṣṭā apaśyan . te 'bruvan devatā vai chandāṃsīmā asmin puruṣe praviṣṭhāḥ . asmin vā ayaṃ loke puṇyaṃ jīvitveṣṭāpūrtena tapasā sukṛtenāsmān anvāgamiṣyatīti . te vai tathā karavāmety abruvan yathā no nānvāgacchād iti .
sentences: te devā vajraṃ kṣurapavim asr̥janta puruṣam eva .
tasmin devatāś cʰandāṃsi puruṣe praviṣṭā apaśyan .
te 'bruvan devatā vai cʰandāṃsīmā asmin puruṣe praviṣṭʰāḥ .
asmin vā ayaṃ loke puṇyaṃ jīvitveṣṭāpūrtena tapasā sukr̥tenāsmān anvāgamiṣyatīti .
te vai tatʰā karavāmety abruvan yatʰā no nānvāgaccʰād iti .
text: The gods and asuras were in conflict. The gods fashioned the thunderbolt, the razor-edged one -- the person himself. They hurled him against the asuras. He, having driven back the asuras, turned back against the gods. Therefore the gods feared him. Having seized him, they broke him into three parts. Broken into three parts, he rose up again. They seized him and examined him. They saw that the deities and metres had entered into this person. They said: 'The deities and metres have entered into this person. By the meritorious life he lives in this world -- by ista and purta, by tapas and good deeds -- he will follow after us.' They said: 'Let us act in such a way that he does not follow after us.'
meaning: देवासुरा अस्पर्धन्त . ते देवा वज्रं क्षुरपविम् असृजन्त पुरुषम् एव . तम् असुरान् अभ्यवृञ्जन् . सो ऽसुरान् अपोह्य देवान् अभ्यावर्तत . तस्माद् देवा अबिभयुः . तम् अभिपद्य त्रेधा समशृणन् . स त्रेधा संशीर्ण उद् एवातिष्ठत् . तम् आरभ्य पर्यैक्षन्त . तस्मिन् देवताश् छन्दांसि पुरुषे प्रविष्टा अपश्यन् . ते ऽब्रुवन् देवता वै छन्दांसीमा अस्मिन् पुरुषे प्रविष्ठाः . अस्मिन् वा अयं लोके पुण्यं जीवित्वेष्टापूर्तेन तपसा सुकृतेनास्मान् अन्वागमिष्यतीति . ते वै तथा करवामेत्य् अब्रुवन् यथा नो नान्वागच्छाद् इति .

sanskrit_iast: - svapnaṃ tandrīṃ manyum aśanayām akṣakāmyāṃ strīkāmyām iti . ete ha vai pāpmānaḥ puruṣam asmin loke sacante . ya etad agne tīrtvāsmin loke sādhu cikīrṣāt tat tvam asmin loke dhīpsatād ity agnim asmin loke 'dadhuḥ . vāyum antarikṣa ādityaṃ divi . ugradevo ha smāha rājanir nāhaṃ manuṣyāyārātīyāmi yān asmai trīn devānāṃ śreṣṭhān arātīyato 'śṛṇom . arātītamarātītaṃ hy eva tasmai yasmā etā devatā arātīyantīti . atho hāsmā etā devatā nārātīyanti ya evaṃ veda . atho ha tam eva dhīpsanti ya evaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ dhīpsatīti .
sentences: - svapnaṃ tandrīṃ manyum aśanayām akṣakāmyāṃ strīkāmyām iti .
ete ha vai pāpmānaḥ puruṣam asmin loke sacante .
ya etad agne tīrtvāsmin loke sādʰu cikīrṣāt tat tvam asmin loke dʰīpsatād ity agnim asmin loke 'dadʰuḥ .
ugradevo ha smāha rājanir nāhaṃ manuṣyāyārātīyāmi yān asmai trīn devānāṃ śreṣṭʰān arātīyato 'śr̥ṇom .
arātītamarātītaṃ hy eva tasmai yasmā etā devatā arātīyantīti .
atʰo hāsmā etā devatā nārātīyanti ya evaṃ veda .
atʰo ha tam eva dʰīpsanti ya evaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ dʰīpsatīti .
text: Sleep, weariness, anger, hunger, the desire for gambling, the desire for women -- these are the evils that attend a person in this world. 'O Agni, whatever of good one who has crossed beyond these wishes to accomplish in this world, do you frustrate that for him in this world' -- thus they placed Agni in this world; Vayu in the atmosphere; Aditya in heaven. Ugradeva the Rajanir used to say: 'I do not bear ill will toward any man, for I hear of three foremost of the gods who bear ill will toward him. Indeed the greatest ill will is borne toward him against whom these deities bear ill will.' But these deities do not bear ill will toward him who knows thus. And they indeed frustrate the one who would frustrate one who knows thus.
meaning: - स्वप्नं तन्द्रीं मन्युम् अशनयाम् अक्षकाम्यां स्त्रीकाम्याम् इति . एते ह वै पाप्मानः पुरुषम् अस्मिन् लोके सचन्ते . य एतद् अग्ने तीर्त्वास्मिन् लोके साधु चिकीर्षात् तत् त्वम् अस्मिन् लोके धीप्सताद् इत्य् अग्निम् अस्मिन् लोके ऽदधुः . वायुम् अन्तरिक्ष आदित्यं दिवि . उग्रदेवो ह स्माह राजनिर् नाहं मनुष्यायारातीयामि यान् अस्मै त्रीन् देवानां श्रेष्ठान् अरातीयतो ऽशृणोम् . अरातीतमरातीतं ह्य् एव तस्मै यस्मा एता देवता अरातीयन्तीति . अथो हास्मा एता देवता नारातीयन्ति य एवं वेद . अथो ह तम् एव धीप्सन्ति य एवं विद्वांसं धीप्सतीति .

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ prāṇam eva gāyatryāvṛñjata cakṣus triṣṭubhā śrotraṃ jagatyā vācam anuṣṭubhā . asmād evainān lokād gāyatryāntarāyann antarikṣāt triṣṭubhāmuṣmāj jagatyā paśubhyo 'nuṣṭubhā . tān sarvasmād evāntarāyan . tato vai devā abhavan parāsurāḥ . bhavaty ātmanā parāsya dviṣan bhrātṛvyo bhavati ya evaṃ veda . yad devā asurān adhūrvaṃs tad dhurāṃ dhūstvam . dhūrvati dviṣantaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ ya evaṃ veda . prajāpatir yat prajā asṛjata tā dhūrbhir evāsṛjata . reta eva retasyayāsiñcat prāṇaṃ gāyatryā samairayac cakṣus triṣṭubhā śrotraṃ jagatyā vācam anuṣṭubhā . ātmānam eva paṅktyā pratyupādadhāt .
sentences: teṣāṃ prāṇam eva gāyatryāvr̥ñjata cakṣus triṣṭubʰā śrotraṃ jagatyā vācam anuṣṭubʰā .
asmād evainān lokād gāyatryāntarāyann antarikṣāt triṣṭubʰāmuṣmāj jagatyā paśubʰyo 'nuṣṭubʰā .
bʰavaty ātmanā parāsya dviṣan bʰrātr̥vyo bʰavati ya evaṃ veda .
yad devā asurān adʰūrvaṃs tad dʰurāṃ dʰūstvam .
dʰūrvati dviṣantaṃ bʰrātr̥vyaṃ ya evaṃ veda .
prajāpatir yat prajā asr̥jata tā dʰūrbʰir evāsr̥jata .
reta eva retasyayāsiñcat prāṇaṃ gāyatryā samairayac cakṣus triṣṭubʰā śrotraṃ jagatyā vācam anuṣṭubʰā .
text: Of those, they wrested away the prana with the gayatri, sight with the tristubh, hearing with the jagati, speech with the anustubh. From this world they cut them off with the gayatri, from the atmosphere with the tristubh, from yonder world with the jagati, from cattle with the anustubh. They cut them off from everything. Thereby the gods prevailed and the asuras were defeated. He prevails by himself; his hating rival is defeated -- he who knows thus. When the gods overwhelmed the asuras, that was the 'dhura' nature of the dhuras (yoke-pieces). He overwhelms the hating rival -- he who knows thus. When Prajapati created creatures, he created them with the dhuras themselves. He poured seed with the retasya (seed-chant); he set the prana in motion with the gayatri, sight with the tristubh, hearing with the jagati, speech with the anustubh. The self he established with the pankti.
meaning: तेषां प्राणम् एव गायत्र्यावृञ्जत चक्षुस् त्रिष्टुभा श्रोत्रं जगत्या वाचम् अनुष्टुभा . अस्माद् एवैनान् लोकाद् गायत्र्यान्तरायन्न् अन्तरिक्षात् त्रिष्टुभामुष्माज् जगत्या पशुभ्यो ऽनुष्टुभा . तान् सर्वस्माद् एवान्तरायन् . ततो वै देवा अभवन् परासुराः . भवत्य् आत्मना परास्य द्विषन् भ्रातृव्यो भवति य एवं वेद . यद् देवा असुरान् अधूर्वंस् तद् धुरां धूस्त्वम् . धूर्वति द्विषन्तं भ्रातृव्यं य एवं वेद . प्रजापतिर् यत् प्रजा असृजत ता धूर्भिर् एवासृजत . रेत एव रेतस्ययासिञ्चत् प्राणं गायत्र्या समैरयच् चक्षुस् त्रिष्टुभा श्रोत्रं जगत्या वाचम् अनुष्टुभा . आत्मानम् एव पङ्क्त्या प्रत्युपादधात् .

sanskrit_iast: retasyāṃ gāyati . retas tat siñcati . saṃtatam iva gāyati . satatim iva vai retaḥ . parokṣam eva prathame gāyati . parokṣam iva vai retaḥ . narcam upaspṛśet . yad ṛcam upaspṛśed reto vicchindyāt . tryudāsāṃ gāyati . prāṇam eva prathamenodāsena parigṛhṇāty apānaṃ dvitīyena vyānaṃ tṛtīyena . tryudāsāṃ gāyati . ātmānam eva prathamenodāsena parigṛhṇāti jāyāṃ dvitīyena prajāṃ tṛtīyena . tryudāsāṃ gāyati . imam eva lokaṃ prathamenodāsenābhyārohaty antarikṣaṃ dvitīyenamuṃ tṛtīyena . sa yo haivaṃ vidvāṃs tryudāsāṃ gāyaty abhi ha bhrātṛvyalokāya vijayate . sa yo bhrātṛvyalokaṃ cicchitsed dvyudāsām eva gāyet . oṣam asya dviṣan bhrātṛvyaḥ parābhavati śriyam ātmanāśnute . īśvaro ha tu pramāyuko bhavitoḥ . prāṇebhyo hy eti tryudāsāyai . sa tathaiva cikīrṣed yathā sarvam āyur iyāt . anyena bhrātṛvyalokaṃ cicchitsed . tryudāsām eva gāyet . na hiṃkuryāt .
sentences: prāṇam eva pratʰamenodāsena parigr̥hṇāty apānaṃ dvitīyena vyānaṃ tr̥tīyena .
ātmānam eva pratʰamenodāsena parigr̥hṇāti jāyāṃ dvitīyena prajāṃ tr̥tīyena .
imam eva lokaṃ pratʰamenodāsenābʰyārohaty antarikṣaṃ dvitīyenamuṃ tr̥tīyena .
sa yo haivaṃ vidvāṃs tryudāsāṃ gāyaty abʰi ha bʰrātr̥vyalokāya vijayate .
sa yo bʰrātr̥vyalokaṃ ciccʰitsed dvyudāsām eva gāyet .
oṣam asya dviṣan bʰrātr̥vyaḥ parābʰavati śriyam ātmanāśnute .
sa tatʰaiva cikīrṣed yatʰā sarvam āyur iyāt .
text: He sings the retasya. Thereby he deposits the seed. He sings continuously. For the seed is as if continuous. He sings the first part in a veiled manner. For the seed is as if veiled. He should not touch the rc. If he were to touch the rc, he would cut off the seed. He sings with three 'udasa' sections. With the first udasa he encompasses the prana, with the second the apana, with the third the vyana. He sings with three udasa sections. With the first udasa he encompasses the self, with the second the wife, with the third the offspring. He sings with three udasa sections. With the first udasa he ascends this world, with the second the atmosphere, with the third yonder world. He who, knowing thus, sings with three udasa sections conquers the world of the rival. He who wishes to cut off the rival's world should sing with only two udasa sections. His hating rival perishes quickly; he himself attains glory. But one is liable to be subject to premature death. For one departs from the vital breaths by omitting the third udasa. One should therefore act in such a way that one lives the full span of life. One should cut off the rival's world by other means. One should sing with three udasa sections. One should not make the himkara.
meaning: रेतस्यां गायति . रेतस् तत् सिञ्चति . संततम् इव गायति . सततिम् इव वै रेतः . परोक्षम् एव प्रथमे गायति . परोक्षम् इव वै रेतः . नर्चम् उपस्पृशेत् . यद् ऋचम् उपस्पृशेद् रेतो विच्छिन्द्यात् . त्र्युदासां गायति . प्राणम् एव प्रथमेनोदासेन परिगृह्णात्य् अपानं द्वितीयेन व्यानं तृतीयेन . त्र्युदासां गायति . आत्मानम् एव प्रथमेनोदासेन परिगृह्णाति जायां द्वितीयेन प्रजां तृतीयेन . त्र्युदासां गायति . इमम् एव लोकं प्रथमेनोदासेनाभ्यारोहत्य् अन्तरिक्षं द्वितीयेनमुं तृतीयेन . स यो हैवं विद्वांस् त्र्युदासां गायत्य् अभि ह भ्रातृव्यलोकाय विजयते . स यो भ्रातृव्यलोकं चिच्छित्सेद् द्व्युदासाम् एव गायेत् . ओषम् अस्य द्विषन् भ्रातृव्यः पराभवति श्रियम् आत्मनाश्नुते . ईश्वरो ह तु प्रमायुको भवितोः . प्राणेभ्यो ह्य् एति त्र्युदासायै . स तथैव चिकीर्षेद् यथा सर्वम् आयुर् इयात् . अन्येन भ्रातृव्यलोकं चिच्छित्सेद् . त्र्युदासाम् एव गायेत् . न हिंकुर्यात् .

sanskrit_iast: tad āhur hiṃkāreṇa vai prajāpatiḥ prajābhyo 'nnādyam asṛjata . yan na hiṃkuryād aśanāyukāḥ prajās syuḥ . hiṃkuryād eva ... bhūḥ iti . yan na hiṃkāraṃ visṛjati tena reto vicchinatti na hiṃkāram antaretīti . tad u vā āhuḥ mamṛdīya iva vā ato reto dāruṇatara iva . hiṃkāro 'pi vainad vālena vicchindyāt . hiṃkārasyaiva kāle hiṃkāraṃ manasā dhyāyet . tan na reto vicchinatti na hiṃkāram antaretīti . bhūḥ iti nidhanaṃ karoti . prajāpatir yad agre vyāharat sa bhūḥ ity eva vyāharat . sa imām asṛjata .
sentences: tad āhur hiṃkāreṇa vai prajāpatiḥ prajābʰyo 'nnādyam asr̥jata .
yan na hiṃkuryād aśanāyukāḥ prajās syuḥ .
yan na hiṃkāraṃ visr̥jati tena reto viccʰinatti na hiṃkāram antaretīti .
tad u vā āhuḥ mamr̥dīya iva vā ato reto dāruṇatara iva .
tan na reto viccʰinatti na hiṃkāram antaretīti .
prajāpatir yad agre vyāharat sa bʰūḥ ity eva vyāharat .
text: They say: 'By the himkara Prajapati created food for the creatures. If one were not to make the himkara, the creatures would be hungry.' One should indeed make the himkara ... with 'bhuh.' 'If one does not release the himkara, one thereby cuts off the seed; it does not pass beyond the himkara,' they say. But they also say: 'From here the seed is as if crushed, as if made more harsh. The himkara could cut it off even with a hair.' At the very moment of the himkara, one should meditate on the himkara with the mind. That does not cut off the seed, nor does it fail to pass beyond the himkara. He makes the final syllable 'bhuh.' When Prajapati first spoke, he spoke 'bhuh.' He thereby created this earth.
meaning: तद् आहुर् हिंकारेण वै प्रजापतिः प्रजाभ्यो ऽन्नाद्यम् असृजत . यन् न हिंकुर्याद् अशनायुकाः प्रजास् स्युः . हिंकुर्याद् एव ... भूः इति . यन् न हिंकारं विसृजति तेन रेतो विच्छिनत्ति न हिंकारम् अन्तरेतीति . तद् उ वा आहुः ममृदीय इव वा अतो रेतो दारुणतर इव . हिंकारो ऽपि वैनद् वालेन विच्छिन्द्यात् . हिंकारस्यैव काले हिंकारं मनसा ध्यायेत् . तन् न रेतो विच्छिनत्ति न हिंकारम् अन्तरेतीति . भूः इति निधनं करोति . प्रजापतिर् यद् अग्रे व्याहरत् स भूः इत्य् एव व्याहरत् . स इमाम् असृजत .

sanskrit_iast: gāyatrīṃ gāyati . prāṇo vai gāyatrī . tasyai dve akṣare vyatiṣajati . prāṇāpānāv eva tad vyatiṣajati . tasmāt prāṇāpānau vyatiṣaktau prajā anusaṃcarata ā ca parā cāyātayāmānau . sat iti nidhanaṃ karoti . prāṇo vai san . prāṇa eva tat pratitiṣṭhati . triṣṭubhaṃ gāyati . cakṣur vai triṣṭup . tasyai dve akṣare dyotayati . cakṣuṣī eva tad dadhāti . tasmād yukte iva cakṣuṣī . jyotiḥ iti nidhanaṃ karoti . cakṣur vai jyotiḥ . cakṣuṣy eva tat pratitiṣṭhati . jagatīṃ gāyati . śrotraṃ vai jagatī . tasyai catvāry akṣarāṇi dyotayati . śrotram eva tad dadhāti . śrotre dve pariśravaṇe dve . tasmāt samānatra san sarvā anudiśaś śṛṇoty api parāṅ yan paścād vadataś śṛṇoti . il̥ā iti nidhanaṃ karoti . paśavo vā il̥ā . paśuṣv etat pratitiṣṭhati . anuṣṭubham gāyati . vāg vā anuṣṭup . tām arvācīm abhinudan gāyati vāco 'napakramāya . yat parācīm apanudan gāyed vācaṃ pradhamed vāg asmād apakrāmukā syāt . tāṃ yad arvācīm abhunudan gāyaty ātmann eva tad vācaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati . tasyai niruktaṃ cāniruktaṃ ca pade gāyati . niruktena vai vāco bhuñjate 'niruktam asyā upajīvanīyam . bhuṅkte vācopa caināṃ jīvati ya evaṃ veda . sa yan niruktam eva gāyed vadeyur eva prajā na tūṣṇīm āsīran . atha yad aniruktaṃ gāyed tūṣṇīm eva prajā āsīran na vadeyuḥ . yasmān niruktaṃ cāniruktaṃ ca pade gāyati tasmāt prajā vadanti ca tūṣṇīṃ cāsate . vāk iti nidhanaṃ karoti . vāg vai brahma . vācy eva tad brahman pratitiṣṭhati . paṅktiṃ gāyati . ṛtavo vai paṅktiḥ . tasyai ṣaḍ akṣarāṇi dyotayati . ṣaḍ vā ṛtavaḥ .
sentences: tasmāt prāṇāpānau vyatiṣaktau prajā anusaṃcarata ā ca parā cāyātayāmānau .
tasmāt samānatra san sarvā anudiśaś śr̥ṇoty api parāṅ yan paścād vadataś śr̥ṇoti .
yat parācīm apanudan gāyed vācaṃ pradʰamed vāg asmād apakrāmukā syāt .
tāṃ yad arvācīm abʰunudan gāyaty ātmann eva tad vācaṃ pratiṣṭʰāpayati .
tasyai niruktaṃ cāniruktaṃ ca pade gāyati .
niruktena vai vāco bʰuñjate 'niruktam asyā upajīvanīyam .
bʰuṅkte vācopa caināṃ jīvati ya evaṃ veda .
sa yan niruktam eva gāyed vadeyur eva prajā na tūṣṇīm āsīran .
atʰa yad aniruktaṃ gāyed tūṣṇīm eva prajā āsīran na vadeyuḥ .
yasmān niruktaṃ cāniruktaṃ ca pade gāyati tasmāt prajā vadanti ca tūṣṇīṃ cāsate .
text: He sings the gayatri. The prana is indeed the gayatri. He interweaves two syllables of it. He thereby interweaves the prana and apana. Therefore the prana and apana, interwoven, accompany creatures as they move to and fro, not becoming exhausted. He makes 'sat' the final syllable. The prana is indeed 'sat' (being). In the prana it thereby finds firm foundation. He sings the tristubh. Sight is indeed the tristubh. He illuminates two syllables of it. He thereby establishes the two eyes. Therefore the two eyes are as if yoked. He makes 'jyotih' the final syllable. Sight is indeed light. In sight it thereby finds firm foundation. He sings the jagati. Hearing is indeed the jagati. He illuminates four syllables of it. He thereby establishes hearing -- two ears and two channels of hearing. Therefore, being in the same place, one hears in all directions; even when turned away, one hears one who speaks from behind. He makes 'ila' the final syllable. Cattle are indeed ila. In cattle it thereby finds firm foundation. He sings the anustubh. Speech is indeed the anustubh. He sings it pushing it toward himself, so that speech may not depart. If he were to sing it pushing it away, he would blow speech away; speech would be apt to depart from him. Since he sings it pushing it toward himself, he thereby establishes speech in the self. He sings both the expressed and the unexpressed parts of its verse. By the expressed one enjoys speech; the unexpressed is that on which one subsists. He enjoys speech and lives on it -- he who knows thus. If he were to sing only the expressed, creatures would only speak and never be silent. If he were to sing only the unexpressed, creatures would only be silent and never speak. Since he sings both the expressed and unexpressed parts, therefore creatures both speak and are silent. He makes 'vak' (speech) the final syllable. Speech is indeed brahman. In speech it thereby finds firm foundation in brahman. He sings the pankti. The seasons are indeed the pankti. He illuminates six syllables of it. Six are the seasons.
meaning: गायत्रीं गायति . प्राणो वै गायत्री . तस्यै द्वे अक्षरे व्यतिषजति . प्राणापानाव् एव तद् व्यतिषजति . तस्मात् प्राणापानौ व्यतिषक्तौ प्रजा अनुसंचरत आ च परा चायातयामानौ . सत् इति निधनं करोति . प्राणो वै सन् . प्राण एव तत् प्रतितिष्ठति . त्रिष्टुभं गायति . चक्षुर् वै त्रिष्टुप् . तस्यै द्वे अक्षरे द्योतयति . चक्षुषी एव तद् दधाति . तस्माद् युक्ते इव चक्षुषी . ज्योतिः इति निधनं करोति . चक्षुर् वै ज्योतिः . चक्षुष्य् एव तत् प्रतितिष्ठति . जगतीं गायति . श्रोत्रं वै जगती . तस्यै चत्वार्य् अक्षराणि द्योतयति . श्रोत्रम् एव तद् दधाति . श्रोत्रे द्वे परिश्रवणे द्वे . तस्मात् समानत्र सन् सर्वा अनुदिशश् शृणोत्य् अपि पराङ् यन् पश्चाद् वदतश् शृणोति . इल्̥आ इति निधनं करोति . पशवो वा इल्̥आ . पशुष्व् एतत् प्रतितिष्ठति . अनुष्टुभम् गायति . वाग् वा अनुष्टुप् . ताम् अर्वाचीम् अभिनुदन् गायति वाचो ऽनपक्रमाय . यत् पराचीम् अपनुदन् गायेद् वाचं प्रधमेद् वाग् अस्माद् अपक्रामुका स्यात् . तां यद् अर्वाचीम् अभुनुदन् गायत्य् आत्मन्न् एव तद् वाचं प्रतिष्ठापयति . तस्यै निरुक्तं चानिरुक्तं च पदे गायति . निरुक्तेन वै वाचो भुञ्जते ऽनिरुक्तम् अस्या उपजीवनीयम् . भुङ्क्ते वाचोप चैनां जीवति य एवं वेद . स यन् निरुक्तम् एव गायेद् वदेयुर् एव प्रजा न तूष्णीम् आसीरन् . अथ यद् अनिरुक्तं गायेद् तूष्णीम् एव प्रजा आसीरन् न वदेयुः . यस्मान् निरुक्तं चानिरुक्तं च पदे गायति तस्मात् प्रजा वदन्ति च तूष्णीं चासते . वाक् इति निधनं करोति . वाग् वै ब्रह्म . वाच्य् एव तद् ब्रह्मन् प्रतितिष्ठति . पङ्क्तिं गायति . ऋतवो वै पङ्क्तिः . तस्यै षड् अक्षराणि द्योतयति . षड् वा ऋतवः .

sanskrit_iast: tad āhus samadam iva vā etac chandobhyaḥ kurvanti yad gāyatre sati prātassavane sarvāṇi chandāṃsy abhigīyante yodhukāḥ prajā bhavantīti . sa yaḥ kāmayeta śāntāḥ prajā edherann iti na dhuro vigāyet . apaśīrṣāṇaṃ tu yajñaṃ yajamānasya kuryād anṛtena dakṣiṇāḥ pratigṛhṇīyāt . brahma vai karad iti vai yajamāno dakṣiṇā dadāti . sa tathaiva cikīrṣed yathā nāpaśīrṣāṇaṃ yajñaṃ yajamānasya kuryān nānṛtena dakṣiṇāḥ pratigṛhṇīyāt . vy eva gāyet . yas tvā enā vijigāsan na śaknoti vigātum ārtim ārcchati . yadi retasyāṃ na śaknoti vigātum aretaska ātmanā bhavati aretaskā garbhā jāyante . yadi gāyatrīṃ na śaknoti vigātuṃ pramāyuka ātmanā bhavati mṛtā garbhā jāyante . yadi triṣṭubhaṃ na śaknoti vigātum andha ātmanā bhavaty andhā garbhā jāyante . yadi jagatīṃ na śaknoti vigātuṃ badhira ātmanā bhavati badhirā garbhā jāyante . yady anuṣṭubhaṃ na śaknoti vigātum ajihva ātmanā bhavati ajihvā garbhā jāyante . yadi paṅktiṃ na śaknoti vigātum ṛtavo lubhyanti . sa ya enā nāśaṃseta vigātuṃ parokṣeṇaivainās sa rūpeṇa gāyet .
sentences: tad āhus samadam iva vā etac cʰandobʰyaḥ kurvanti yad gāyatre sati prātassavane sarvāṇi cʰandāṃsy abʰigīyante yodʰukāḥ prajā bʰavantīti .
sa yaḥ kāmayeta śāntāḥ prajā edʰerann iti na dʰuro vigāyet .
apaśīrṣāṇaṃ tu yajñaṃ yajamānasya kuryād anr̥tena dakṣiṇāḥ pratigr̥hṇīyāt .
brahma vai karad iti vai yajamāno dakṣiṇā dadāti .
sa tatʰaiva cikīrṣed yatʰā nāpaśīrṣāṇaṃ yajñaṃ yajamānasya kuryān nānr̥tena dakṣiṇāḥ pratigr̥hṇīyāt .
yas tvā enā vijigāsan na śaknoti vigātum ārtim ārccʰati .
yadi retasyāṃ na śaknoti vigātum aretaska ātmanā bʰavati aretaskā garbʰā jāyante .
yadi gāyatrīṃ na śaknoti vigātuṃ pramāyuka ātmanā bʰavati mr̥tā garbʰā jāyante .
yadi triṣṭubʰaṃ na śaknoti vigātum andʰa ātmanā bʰavaty andʰā garbʰā jāyante .
yadi jagatīṃ na śaknoti vigātuṃ badʰira ātmanā bʰavati badʰirā garbʰā jāyante .
yady anuṣṭubʰaṃ na śaknoti vigātum ajihva ātmanā bʰavati ajihvā garbʰā jāyante .
yadi paṅktiṃ na śaknoti vigātum r̥tavo lubʰyanti .
sa ya enā nāśaṃseta vigātuṃ parokṣeṇaivainās sa rūpeṇa gāyet .
text: They say: It is as if they create a battle for the metres when, during the gayatra morning pressing, all the metres are sung over -- the creatures become warlike. He who desires that creatures should thrive in peace should not sing the dhuras elaborately. But he would make the sacrifice headless for the sacrificer; he would receive the sacrificial fees falsely. 'I shall perform the brahman' -- with this thought the sacrificer gives the fees. One should therefore act so that one neither makes the sacrifice headless for the sacrificer nor receives the fees falsely. One should indeed sing them elaborately. But he who tries to sing them elaborately and cannot, comes to harm. If he cannot elaborate the retasya, he becomes seedless himself and seedless offspring are born. If he cannot elaborate the gayatri, he becomes subject to premature death and dead offspring are born. If he cannot elaborate the tristubh, he becomes blind and blind offspring are born. If he cannot elaborate the jagati, he becomes deaf and deaf offspring are born. If he cannot elaborate the anustubh, he becomes tongueless and tongueless offspring are born. If he cannot elaborate the pankti, the seasons become confused. He who does not expect to be able to elaborate them should sing them in an indirect manner.
meaning: तद् आहुस् समदम् इव वा एतच् छन्दोभ्यः कुर्वन्ति यद् गायत्रे सति प्रातस्सवने सर्वाणि छन्दांस्य् अभिगीयन्ते योधुकाः प्रजा भवन्तीति . स यः कामयेत शान्ताः प्रजा एधेरन्न् इति न धुरो विगायेत् . अपशीर्षाणं तु यज्ञं यजमानस्य कुर्याद् अनृतेन दक्षिणाः प्रतिगृह्णीयात् . ब्रह्म वै करद् इति वै यजमानो दक्षिणा ददाति . स तथैव चिकीर्षेद् यथा नापशीर्षाणं यज्ञं यजमानस्य कुर्यान् नानृतेन दक्षिणाः प्रतिगृह्णीयात् . व्य् एव गायेत् . यस् त्वा एना विजिगासन् न शक्नोति विगातुम् आर्तिम् आर्च्छति . यदि रेतस्यां न शक्नोति विगातुम् अरेतस्क आत्मना भवति अरेतस्का गर्भा जायन्ते . यदि गायत्रीं न शक्नोति विगातुं प्रमायुक आत्मना भवति मृता गर्भा जायन्ते . यदि त्रिष्टुभं न शक्नोति विगातुम् अन्ध आत्मना भवत्य् अन्धा गर्भा जायन्ते . यदि जगतीं न शक्नोति विगातुं बधिर आत्मना भवति बधिरा गर्भा जायन्ते . यद्य् अनुष्टुभं न शक्नोति विगातुम् अजिह्व आत्मना भवति अजिह्वा गर्भा जायन्ते . यदि पङ्क्तिं न शक्नोति विगातुम् ऋतवो लुभ्यन्ति . स य एना नाशंसेत विगातुं परोक्षेणैवैनास् स रूपेण गायेत् .

sanskrit_iast: gāyatryāṃ prastutāyāṃ gāyatram eva gāyan pṛthivīṃ manasā gacchet . prāṇyāpānyānyāt . sat iti nidhanaṃ karoti . parokṣeṇaivainān tad rūpeṇa gāyati . triṣṭubhi stutāyāṃ gāyatram eva gāyann antarikṣaṃ manasā gacchet . didṛkṣetaivākṣibhyām . jyotiḥ iti nidhanaṃ karoti . parokṣeṇaivainān tad rūpeṇa gāyati . jagatyāṃ prastutāyāṃ gāyatram eva gāyan diśaḥ paśūn manasā gacchet . śuśrūṣetaiva karṇābhyām . il̥ā iti nidhanaṃ karoti . parokṣeṇaivainān tad rūpeṇa gāyati . anuṣṭubhi prastutāyāṃ gāyatram eva gāyan divaṃ manasā gacchet . vācā gāyan vāk iti nidhanaṃ karoti . parokṣeṇaivainān tad rūpeṇa gāyati . paṅktyāṃ prastutāyāṃ gāyatram eva gāyan ṛtūn manasā gacchet . parokṣeṇaivainān tad rūpeṇa gāyati . oṣam evaitad uttamaṃ tṛcaṃ gāyati . prajanano vā eṣa tṛcaḥ . oṣam eva prajayā paśubhiḥ prajāyate ya evaṃ veda . prajāpatir yat prajā asṛjata tā etenaiva tṛcenāsṛjata . pavamānasya te kave vājin sargā asṛkṣata iti sargaśa evāsṛjata . asṛgraṃ vāre avyaye iti cāsṛjata . tāsāṃ sṛṣṭānāṃ parāvāpād abibhet . sa etām uttamāṃ samudravatīm apaśyat . tayaināḥ acchā samudram indavaḥ ity eva samudreṇa samantaṃ pariṇyadadhāt . tā asya na paropyanta . nāsya vittaṃ paropyate ya evaṃ veda . agmann ṛtasya yonim ā iti . grahā ha vā ṛtasya yoniḥ .
sentences: gāyatryāṃ prastutāyāṃ gāyatram eva gāyan pr̥tʰivīṃ manasā gaccʰet .
triṣṭubʰi [pra]stutāyāṃ gāyatram eva gāyann antarikṣaṃ manasā gaccʰet .
jagatyāṃ prastutāyāṃ gāyatram eva gāyan diśaḥ paśūn manasā gaccʰet .
anuṣṭubʰi prastutāyāṃ gāyatram eva gāyan divaṃ manasā gaccʰet .
vācā gāyan vāk iti nidʰanaṃ karoti .
paṅktyāṃ prastutāyāṃ gāyatram eva gāyan r̥tūn manasā gaccʰet .
oṣam eva prajayā paśubʰiḥ prajāyate ya evaṃ veda .
prajāpatir yat prajā asr̥jata tā etenaiva tr̥cenāsr̥jata .
pavamānasya te kave vājin sargā asr̥kṣata iti sargaśa evāsr̥jata .
tayaināḥ accʰā samudram indavaḥ ity eva samudreṇa samantaṃ pariṇyadadʰāt .
nāsya vittaṃ paropyate ya evaṃ veda .
text: When the gayatri is being praised, singing the gayatra itself, one should go with the mind to the earth. One should breathe in and out. He makes 'sat' the final syllable. Thereby he sings them in an indirect manner. When the tristubh is being praised, singing the gayatra itself, one should go with the mind to the atmosphere. One should desire to see with the eyes. He makes 'jyotih' the final syllable. Thereby he sings them in an indirect manner. When the jagati is being praised, singing the gayatra itself, one should go with the mind to the directions and the cattle. One should desire to hear with the ears. He makes 'ila' the final syllable. When the anustubh is being praised, singing the gayatra itself, one should go with the mind to heaven. Singing with speech, he makes 'vak' the final syllable. When the pankti is being praised, singing the gayatra itself, one should go with the mind to the seasons. He sings the last trca for prosperity. This trca is indeed for procreation. One prospers through offspring and cattle -- he who knows thus. When Prajapati created creatures, he created them with this very trca. 'pavamānasya te kave vājin sargā asṛkṣata' -- he created them in successive emissions. Those created ones he feared would be lost. He saw this last verse with the ocean. With it -- 'acchā samudram indavaḥ' -- he enclosed them all around with the ocean. His wealth is not lost -- he who knows thus. 'agann rtasya yonim a' -- the cups are indeed the womb of rta.
meaning: गायत्र्यां प्रस्तुतायां गायत्रम् एव गायन् पृथिवीं मनसा गच्छेत् . प्राण्यापान्यान्यात् . सत् इति निधनं करोति . परोक्षेणैवैनान् तद् रूपेण गायति . त्रिष्टुभि स्तुतायां गायत्रम् एव गायन्न् अन्तरिक्षं मनसा गच्छेत् . दिदृक्षेतैवाक्षिभ्याम् . ज्योतिः इति निधनं करोति . परोक्षेणैवैनान् तद् रूपेण गायति . जगत्यां प्रस्तुतायां गायत्रम् एव गायन् दिशः पशून् मनसा गच्छेत् . शुश्रूषेतैव कर्णाभ्याम् . इल्̥आ इति निधनं करोति . परोक्षेणैवैनान् तद् रूपेण गायति . अनुष्टुभि प्रस्तुतायां गायत्रम् एव गायन् दिवं मनसा गच्छेत् . वाचा गायन् वाक् इति निधनं करोति . परोक्षेणैवैनान् तद् रूपेण गायति . पङ्क्त्यां प्रस्तुतायां गायत्रम् एव गायन् ऋतून् मनसा गच्छेत् . परोक्षेणैवैनान् तद् रूपेण गायति . ओषम् एवैतद् उत्तमं तृचं गायति . प्रजननो वा एष तृचः . ओषम् एव प्रजया पशुभिः प्रजायते य एवं वेद . प्रजापतिर् यत् प्रजा असृजत ता एतेनैव तृचेनासृजत . पवमानस्य ते कवे वाजिन् सर्गा असृक्षत इति सर्गश एवासृजत . असृग्रं वारे अव्यये इति चासृजत . तासां सृष्टानां परावापाद् अबिभेत् . स एताम् उत्तमां समुद्रवतीम् अपश्यत् . तयैनाः अच्छा समुद्रम् इन्दवः इत्य् एव समुद्रेण समन्तं परिण्यदधात् . ता अस्य न परोप्यन्त . नास्य वित्तं परोप्यते य एवं वेद . अग्मन्न् ऋतस्य योनिम् आ इति . ग्रहा ह वा ऋतस्य योनिः .

sanskrit_iast: devāsurā vā eṣu lokeṣv aspardhantāsmin bhuvane . te devā akāmayantemān lokān jayemāsurān spardhāṃ bhrātṛvyān iti . ta etāny ājyāni stotrāṇy apaśyan . tair astuvata . tair imān ājayan . imān eva lokam āgneyenājayann antarikṣaṃ maitrāvaruṇenāmum aindreṇa diśa evaindrāgnena . tad yad imān lokān ājayaṃs tad ājyānām ājyatvam . emān lokān jayati spardhāṃ dviṣantaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ ya evaṃ veda . te devā abruvan vīmāni bhajāmahā iti . teṣāṃ ha vibhāge na samapādayan . te 'bruvan ājim eṣām ayāma giriṃ kāṣṭhāṃ kṛtveti . yad abruvan ājim eṣām ayāmeti tad eṣāṃ dvitīyam ājyatvam .
sentences: devāsurā vā eṣu lokeṣv aspardʰantāsmin bʰuvane .
te devā akāmayantemān lokān jayemāsurān spardʰāṃ bʰrātr̥vyān iti .
imān eva lokam āgneyenājayann antarikṣaṃ maitrāvaruṇenāmum aindreṇa diśa evaindrāgnena .
tad yad imān lokān ājayaṃs tad ājyānām ājyatvam .
emān lokān jayati spardʰāṃ dviṣantaṃ bʰrātr̥vyaṃ ya evaṃ veda .
te devā abruvan vīmāni bʰajāmahā iti .
te 'bruvan ājim eṣām ayāma giriṃ kāṣṭʰāṃ kr̥tveti .
yad abruvan ājim eṣām ayāmeti tad eṣāṃ dvitīyam ājyatvam .
text: The gods and asuras were in conflict over these worlds, in this realm. The gods desired: 'May we conquer these worlds; may we conquer the asuras, our rivals.' They saw these ajya stotras. They praised with them. With them they conquered these worlds. With the agneya they conquered this world; with the maitravaruṇa the atmosphere; with the aindra yonder world; with the aindragna the directions. Because they conquered these worlds, that is the ajya nature of the ajyas. He conquers these worlds, conquers the hating rival -- he who knows thus. The gods said: 'Let us divide these.' In dividing them they could not come to agreement. They said: 'Let us run a race for them, making the mountain the goal.' Because they said 'Let us run a race for them,' that is their second ajya nature.
meaning: देवासुरा वा एषु लोकेष्व् अस्पर्धन्तास्मिन् भुवने . ते देवा अकामयन्तेमान् लोकान् जयेमासुरान् स्पर्धां भ्रातृव्यान् इति . त एतान्य् आज्यानि स्तोत्राण्य् अपश्यन् . तैर् अस्तुवत . तैर् इमान् आजयन् . इमान् एव लोकम् आग्नेयेनाजयन्न् अन्तरिक्षं मैत्रावरुणेनामुम् ऐन्द्रेण दिश एवैन्द्राग्नेन . तद् यद् इमान् लोकान् आजयंस् तद् आज्यानाम् आज्यत्वम् . एमान् लोकान् जयति स्पर्धां द्विषन्तं भ्रातृव्यं य एवं वेद . ते देवा अब्रुवन् वीमानि भजामहा इति . तेषां ह विभागे न समपादयन् . ते ऽब्रुवन् आजिम् एषाम् अयाम गिरिं काष्ठां कृत्वेति . यद् अब्रुवन् आजिम् एषाम् अयामेति तद् एषां द्वितीयम् आज्यत्वम् .

sanskrit_iast: teṣāṃ paccho 'sṛjyanta . teṣām agniḥ prathama udajayat . atha mitrāvaruṇāv athendraḥ . athaikam anujjitam āsīt . tad indro 'ved agnir vāvedam ujjeṣyatīti . so 'bravīd agne yatara āvayor idam ujjayāt tan nau sahāsad iti . tatheti . tad agnir udajayat . tad enayos sahābhavad adhyardham anyasya stotram adhyardham anyasya . aindrāgno yajñaḥ . sa ya evam etā devānām ujjitīr veda yatra kāmayata ud iha jayeyam ity ut tatra jayati . tad āhur yad ājyāni sarvāṇi samānanidhanāni kenājāmi kriyanta iti . nānādevatyānīti brūyāt tenājāmīti . atho yan nānārūpāṇīti brūyāt teno eveti . te vā ete paśava eva . yad ājyāny antasadasaṃ stuvanti tasmād grāmyāḥ paśavo 'ntar grāme nyokasaḥ . parācīṣu punar abhyāvartanta . tasmād grāmyāḥ paśavaḥ parāñcaḥ prātaḥ prerate te sāyaṃ samāvartante . nānārūpāsu stuvanti . tasmād grāmyāḥ paśavo nānārūpāḥ . nānādevatyāsu stuvanti . tasmād grāmyāḥ paśavo nānā .
sentences: so 'bravīd agne yatara āvayor idam ujjayāt tan nau sahāsad iti .
tad enayos sahābʰavad adʰyardʰam anyasya stotram adʰyardʰam anyasya .
sa ya evam etā devānām ujjitīr veda yatra kāmayata ud iha jayeyam ity ut tatra jayati .
tad āhur yad ājyāni sarvāṇi samānanidʰanāni kenājāmi kriyanta iti .
atʰo yan nānārūpāṇīti brūyāt teno eveti .
yad ājyāny antasadasaṃ stuvanti tasmād grāmyāḥ paśavo 'ntar grāme nyokasaḥ .
tasmād grāmyāḥ paśavaḥ parāñcaḥ prātaḥ prerate te sāyaṃ samāvartante .
text: They were released simultaneously for them all. Among them Agni first won. Then Mitra and Varuna, then Indra. One remained unwon. Indra knew: 'Agni will win this.' He said: 'Agni, whichever of us two wins this, let it belong to both of us.' 'So be it.' Agni won it. That became shared by both of them -- half the stotra of one, half of the other. The sacrifice belongs to Indra and Agni. He who knows thus these victories of the gods -- wherever he desires 'May I win here,' there he wins. They say: Since the ajyas all have the same final syllable, by what are they made non-uniform? One should reply: 'By having different deities' -- thereby they are made non-uniform. Or one should say: 'By having different forms.' These are indeed cattle. Since they praise the ajyas within the sacrificial hall, therefore domestic animals dwell within the village. They turn back in the outward-directed verses. Therefore domestic animals go outward in the morning and return in the evening. They praise in verses of different forms. Therefore domestic animals are of different forms. They praise in verses of different deities. Therefore domestic animals are diverse.
meaning: तेषां पच्छो ऽसृज्यन्त . तेषाम् अग्निः प्रथम उदजयत् . अथ मित्रावरुणाव् अथेन्द्रः . अथैकम् अनुज्जितम् आसीत् . तद् इन्द्रो ऽवेद् अग्निर् वावेदम् उज्जेष्यतीति . सो ऽब्रवीद् अग्ने यतर आवयोर् इदम् उज्जयात् तन् नौ सहासद् इति . तथेति . तद् अग्निर् उदजयत् . तद् एनयोस् सहाभवद् अध्यर्धम् अन्यस्य स्तोत्रम् अध्यर्धम् अन्यस्य . ऐन्द्राग्नो यज्ञः . स य एवम् एता देवानाम् उज्जितीर् वेद यत्र कामयत उद् इह जयेयम् इत्य् उत् तत्र जयति . तद् आहुर् यद् आज्यानि सर्वाणि समाननिधनानि केनाजामि क्रियन्त इति . नानादेवत्यानीति ब्रूयात् तेनाजामीति . अथो यन् नानारूपाणीति ब्रूयात् तेनो एवेति . ते वा एते पशव एव . यद् आज्यान्य् अन्तसदसं स्तुवन्ति तस्माद् ग्राम्याः पशवो ऽन्तर् ग्रामे न्योकसः . पराचीषु पुनर् अभ्यावर्तन्त . तस्माद् ग्राम्याः पशवः पराञ्चः प्रातः प्रेरते ते सायं समावर्तन्ते . नानारूपासु स्तुवन्ति . तस्माद् ग्राम्याः पशवो नानारूपाः . नानादेवत्यासु स्तुवन्ति . तस्माद् ग्राम्याः पशवो नाना .

sanskrit_iast: devāsurās saṃyattā jyoṅ na vyajayanta . teṣv asureṣv idaṃ sarvam āsīt . athaikam evākṣaraṃ deveṣv āsīt . vāg eva . so 'gnir abravīd ahaṃ vā idam adarśaṃ yathedaṃ jeṣyāmīti . tad vai brūhīty abruvan . so 'bravīd akṣareṇaivedaṃ sarvaṃ saṃnidhāya dhurādhuram āsajāmeti . yad abravīd akṣareṇaivedaṃ sarvaṃ saṃnidhāya dhurādhuram āsajāmeti tad ājyadhurām ājyadhūstvam . te 'kṣareṇaivedaṃ sarvaṃ saṃnidhāya dhurādhuram āsajan . tān ajayan . jayati spardhāṃ dviṣantaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ ya evaṃ veda . sa yadītarā dhuro vigāyed vy evājyadhuro gāyet . sa yo haivaṃ vidvān saṃgrāmayos saṃnihitayor brūyād akṣareṇa tvā saṃnidadhāmīti paraṃ grāmaṃ sa haiva taṃ grāmaṃ jayati . atho yasminn evaṃvid grāme bhavati sa u haiva taṃ grāmaṃ jayati . te devā abruvan vīmāni bhajāmahā iti .
sentences: so 'gnir abravīd ahaṃ vā idam adarśaṃ yatʰedaṃ jeṣyāmīti .
so 'bravīd akṣareṇaivedaṃ sarvaṃ saṃnidʰāya dʰurādʰuram āsajāmeti .
yad abravīd akṣareṇaivedaṃ sarvaṃ saṃnidʰāya dʰurādʰuram āsajāmeti tad ājyadʰurām ājyadʰūstvam .
jayati spardʰāṃ dviṣantaṃ bʰrātr̥vyaṃ ya evaṃ veda .
sa yadītarā dʰuro vigāyed vy evājyadʰuro gāyet .
sa yo haivaṃ vidvān saṃgrāmayos saṃnihitayor brūyād akṣareṇa tvā saṃnidadʰāmīti paraṃ grāmaṃ sa haiva taṃ grāmaṃ jayati .
atʰo yasminn evaṃvid grāme bʰavati sa u haiva taṃ grāmaṃ jayati .
te devā abruvan vīmāni bʰajāmahā iti .
text: The gods and asuras, having joined battle, for a long time could not win. Among those asuras was all this. Only one syllable was among the gods -- speech itself. Agni said: 'I have seen how we shall conquer this.' 'Tell us,' they said. He said: 'Having gathered all this together with just the one syllable, let us yoke yoke-piece to yoke-piece.' Because he said 'Having gathered all this together with the syllable, let us yoke yoke-piece to yoke-piece,' that is the ajyadhura nature of the ajya yoke-piece. Having gathered all this together with just the one syllable, they yoked yoke-piece to yoke-piece. They conquered them. He conquers the rival, the hating kinsman -- he who knows thus. If one should elaborate the other yoke-pieces, one should certainly elaborate the ajya yoke-piece. He who, knowing thus, when two armies are drawn up, would say 'With the syllable I bind you together' -- he indeed conquers that other village. And in whichever village one who knows thus dwells, he indeed conquers that village. The gods said: 'Let us divide these.'
meaning: देवासुरास् संयत्ता ज्योङ् न व्यजयन्त . तेष्व् असुरेष्व् इदं सर्वम् आसीत् . अथैकम् एवाक्षरं देवेष्व् आसीत् . वाग् एव . सो ऽग्निर् अब्रवीद् अहं वा इदम् अदर्शं यथेदं जेष्यामीति . तद् वै ब्रूहीत्य् अब्रुवन् . सो ऽब्रवीद् अक्षरेणैवेदं सर्वं संनिधाय धुराधुरम् आसजामेति . यद् अब्रवीद् अक्षरेणैवेदं सर्वं संनिधाय धुराधुरम् आसजामेति तद् आज्यधुराम् आज्यधूस्त्वम् . ते ऽक्षरेणैवेदं सर्वं संनिधाय धुराधुरम् आसजन् . तान् अजयन् . जयति स्पर्धां द्विषन्तं भ्रातृव्यं य एवं वेद . स यदीतरा धुरो विगायेद् व्य् एवाज्यधुरो गायेत् . स यो हैवं विद्वान् संग्रामयोस् संनिहितयोर् ब्रूयाद् अक्षरेण त्वा संनिदधामीति परं ग्रामं स हैव तं ग्रामं जयति . अथो यस्मिन्न् एवंविद् ग्रामे भवति स उ हैव तं ग्रामं जयति . ते देवा अब्रुवन् वीमानि भजामहा इति .

sanskrit_iast: sa teṣāṃ sakṛd evaṃ sarveṣām asṛjyanta . teṣām agnir evodajayat . tasyāpagamanam agatasyākṣo 'chidyata . tasya rathacakraṃ patitvā kṛṣṇādhikāṃ kośāntena paryavartata . tam abruvann īkṣitvānnādo vā ayaṃ śreṣṭho bhaviṣyati pāpmā vā asya paryavartīti . sa yo haivaṃ vidvān parivartayate 'nnāda eva śreṣṭhas svānāṃ bhavaty atho hāsya taṃ pāpmānam eva parivartayanti . so 'gnir ujjitya prādravat . tam indro 'bravīt saha nāv astv iti . nety abravīt . yad vā eko gṛhyāṇāṃ vindate sarveṣāṃ vai tat saha bhavati . sahaiva nāv astv iti . nety evābravīt . sa vai mābhi cid avekṣasveti . tam abhyavaikṣata . so 'bravīt sāntvāya mābhyavaikṣiṣṭhās saha nāv abhūd iti . yaṃyaṃ nv evāham abhyavekṣiṣya ity abravīt tenatenaiva me saha bhavaiṣyatīti . nety evābravīt .
sentences: sa teṣāṃ sakr̥d evaṃ sarveṣām asr̥jyanta .
tasya ratʰacakraṃ patitvā kr̥ṣṇādʰikāṃ kośāntena paryavartata .
tam abruvann īkṣitvānnādo vā ayaṃ śreṣṭʰo bʰaviṣyati pāpmā vā asya paryavartīti .
sa yo haivaṃ vidvān parivartayate 'nnāda eva śreṣṭʰas svānāṃ bʰavaty atʰo hāsya taṃ pāpmānam eva parivartayanti .
tam indro 'bravīt saha nāv astv iti .
yad vā eko gr̥hyāṇāṃ vindate sarveṣāṃ vai tat saha bʰavati .
so 'bravīt sāntvāya mābʰyavaikṣiṣṭʰās saha nāv abʰūd iti .
yaṃyaṃ nv evāham abʰyavekṣiṣya ity abravīt tenatenaiva me saha bʰavaiṣyatīti .
text: They were released simultaneously for all of them. Among them Agni alone won. As he was departing after winning, his axle broke. His chariot wheel, having fallen off, rolled around with the tip of the hub making a dark track. They said, looking at it: 'Either this one will become the foremost food-eater, or his evil has turned around.' He who, knowing thus, turns around becomes the foremost food-eater among his own; and they turn his evil around for him. Agni, having won, ran off. Indra said to him: 'Let it be shared between us.' 'No,' he said. 'Whatever one of the household members obtains, that indeed belongs to all of them together. Let it be shared between us.' 'No,' he said again. 'Do but look at me,' he said. He looked at him. He said: 'You have looked at me with conciliation; it has become shared between us.' 'Whomever I look at,' he said, 'with him it shall be shared.' 'No,' he said again.
meaning: स तेषां सकृद् एवं सर्वेषाम् असृज्यन्त . तेषाम् अग्निर् एवोदजयत् . तस्यापगमनम् अगतस्याक्षो ऽछिद्यत . तस्य रथचक्रं पतित्वा कृष्णाधिकां कोशान्तेन पर्यवर्तत . तम् अब्रुवन्न् ईक्षित्वान्नादो वा अयं श्रेष्ठो भविष्यति पाप्मा वा अस्य पर्यवर्तीति . स यो हैवं विद्वान् परिवर्तयते ऽन्नाद एव श्रेष्ठस् स्वानां भवत्य् अथो हास्य तं पाप्मानम् एव परिवर्तयन्ति . सो ऽग्निर् उज्जित्य प्राद्रवत् . तम् इन्द्रो ऽब्रवीत् सह नाव् अस्त्व् इति . नेत्य् अब्रवीत् . यद् वा एको गृह्याणां विन्दते सर्वेषां वै तत् सह भवति . सहैव नाव् अस्त्व् इति . नेत्य् एवाब्रवीत् . स वै माभि चिद् अवेक्षस्वेति . तम् अभ्यवैक्षत . सो ऽब्रवीत् सान्त्वाय माभ्यवैक्षिष्ठास् सह नाव् अभूद् इति . यंयं न्व् एवाहम् अभ्यवेक्षिष्य इत्य् अब्रवीत् तेनतेनैव मे सह भवैष्यतीति . नेत्य् एवाब्रवीत् .

sanskrit_iast: tau vai pṛcchāvahā iti . tau prajāpatāv apṛcchetām . sa prajāpatir abravīt sāntvāya vai vāṃ tvam etam abhyavaikṣiṣṭhās sahaiva vām abhūd iti . tatheti . tad enayos sahābhavad adhyardham anyasya stotram adhyardham anyasya . aindrāgno yajñaḥ . tau mitrāvaruṇau prāṇāpānau paśubhyo 'pākrāmatām anuvī manyamānau nāvābhyām anuvībhyāṃ paśavaḥ prāṇiṣyantīti . te paśavo 'prāṇanta ādhmāyamānā aśerata . tad ābhyām ācakṣatāpa mitrāvaruṇau prāṇāpānau paśubhyo 'tāmiṣṭhāṃ ta ime 'prāṇanta ādhmāyamānāś śerata iti . tāv ādrutyābrūtāṃ prāṇantu nau yuvābhyāṃ paśava iti . nāvābhyām anuvībhyām ity abrūtām . tābhyām etaṃ maitrāvaruṇam ājyam avākalpayan . tato vai tābhyāṃ paśavaḥ prāṇan . sa ya evam etām agner ujjitiṃ veda yatra kāmayata ud iha jayeyam ity ut tatra jayati . ya u evaitām indrasyārdhitāṃ veda yatra kāmayata ud iha jayeyam ity ut tatra jayati .
sentences: sa prajāpatir abravīt sāntvāya vai vāṃ tvam etam abʰyavaikṣiṣṭʰās sahaiva vām abʰūd iti .
tad enayos sahābʰavad adʰyardʰam anyasya stotram adʰyardʰam anyasya .
