tau mitrāvaruṇau prāṇāpānau paśubʰyo 'pākrāmatām anuvī manyamānau nāvābʰyām anuvībʰyāṃ paśavaḥ prāṇiṣyantīti .
tad ābʰyām ācakṣatāpa mitrāvaruṇau prāṇāpānau paśubʰyo 'tāmiṣṭʰāṃ ta ime 'prāṇanta ādʰmāyamānāś śerata iti .
tāv ādrutyābrūtāṃ prāṇantu nau yuvābʰyāṃ paśava iti .
sa ya evam etām agner ujjitiṃ veda yatra kāmayata ud iha jayeyam ity ut tatra jayati .
ya u evaitām indrasyārdʰitāṃ veda yatra kāmayata ud iha jayeyam ity ut tatra jayati .
text: 'Let us ask,' they said. They asked Prajapati. Prajapati said: 'You have looked at him with conciliation; it has indeed become shared between you.' 'So be it.' That became shared by both of them -- half the stotra of one, half of the other. The sacrifice belongs to Indra and Agni. Mitra and Varuna, the prana and apana, withdrew from the cattle, thinking 'Without us, the cattle will not breathe.' Those cattle, not breathing, lay swelling up. They told the two: 'Mitra and Varuna, the prana and apana, have withdrawn from the cattle; these cattle, not breathing, lie swelling up.' They came running and said: 'Let the cattle breathe through you.' 'Only through us,' they said. For them they arranged this maitravaruna ajya. Thereby the cattle breathed through them. He who knows this victory of Agni -- wherever he desires 'May I win here,' there he wins. And he who knows this compromise of Indra -- wherever he desires 'May I win here,' there he wins.
meaning: तौ वै पृच्छावहा इति . तौ प्रजापताव् अपृच्छेताम् . स प्रजापतिर् अब्रवीत् सान्त्वाय वै वां त्वम् एतम् अभ्यवैक्षिष्ठास् सहैव वाम् अभूद् इति . तथेति . तद् एनयोस् सहाभवद् अध्यर्धम् अन्यस्य स्तोत्रम् अध्यर्धम् अन्यस्य . ऐन्द्राग्नो यज्ञः . तौ मित्रावरुणौ प्राणापानौ पशुभ्यो ऽपाक्रामताम् अनुवी मन्यमानौ नावाभ्याम् अनुवीभ्यां पशवः प्राणिष्यन्तीति . ते पशवो ऽप्राणन्त आध्मायमाना अशेरत . तद् आभ्याम् आचक्षताप मित्रावरुणौ प्राणापानौ पशुभ्यो ऽतामिष्ठां त इमे ऽप्राणन्त आध्मायमानाश् शेरत इति . ताव् आद्रुत्याब्रूतां प्राणन्तु नौ युवाभ्यां पशव इति . नावाभ्याम् अनुवीभ्याम् इत्य् अब्रूताम् . ताभ्याम् एतं मैत्रावरुणम् आज्यम् अवाकल्पयन् . ततो वै ताभ्यां पशवः प्राणन् . स य एवम् एताम् अग्नेर् उज्जितिं वेद यत्र कामयत उद् इह जयेयम् इत्य् उत् तत्र जयति . य उ एवैताम् इन्द्रस्यार्धितां वेद यत्र कामयत उद् इह जयेयम् इत्य् उत् तत्र जयति .

sanskrit_iast: tāni vā etāny aindrāgnāny eva sarvāṇi yad ājyāni . āgneyīṣu stuvanti . tenāgneyaṃ gāyatrī chandas tenāgneyaṃ pañcadaśastomas tenaindram . tad etad aindrāgnam eva maitrāvaruṇīṣu stuvanti . tena maitrāvaruṇaṃ gāyatrī chandas tenaigneyaṃ pañcadaśastomas tenaindram . tad etad aindrāgnam evaindrīṣu stuvanti . tenaindraṃ gāyatrī chandaḥ . aindrāgnam evaindrāgnīṣu stuvanti . tenaindrāgnaṃ gāyatrī chandas . tenāgneyaṃ pañcadaśastomas tenaindram . tad etad aindrāgnam evaindrāgnīṣu stuvanti . tenaindrāgnaṃ gāyatrī chandas tenāgneyaṃ pañcadaśastomas tenaindram . tad etad aindrāgnam eva . indrāgnī yajñasya devatā .
sentences: tāni vā etāny aindrāgnāny eva sarvāṇi yad ājyāni .
tenāgneyaṃ gāyatrī cʰandas tenāgneyaṃ pañcadaśastomas tenaindram .
tad etad aindrāgnam eva maitrāvaruṇīṣu stuvanti .
tena maitrāvaruṇaṃ gāyatrī cʰandas tenaigneyaṃ pañcadaśastomas tenaindram .
tenaindrāgnaṃ gāyatrī cʰandas tenāgneyaṃ pañcadaśastomas tenaindram .
text: All these ajyas are indeed of Indra and Agni. They praise in agneya verses. Thereby it is agneya; the gayatri is the metre, thereby agneya; the pancadasa is the stoma, thereby it belongs to Indra. This is aindragna. They praise in maitravaruna verses. Thereby it is maitravaruna; the gayatri is the metre, thereby agneya; the pancadasa is the stoma, thereby it belongs to Indra. This is aindragna. They praise in aindra verses. Thereby it belongs to Indra; the gayatri is the metre. They praise in aindragna verses. Thereby it is aindragna; the gayatri is the metre, the pancadasa stoma thereby agneya, thereby it belongs to Indra. This is aindragna. Indra and Agni are the deities of the sacrifice.
meaning: तानि वा एतान्य् ऐन्द्राग्नान्य् एव सर्वाणि यद् आज्यानि . आग्नेयीषु स्तुवन्ति . तेनाग्नेयं गायत्री छन्दस् तेनाग्नेयं पञ्चदशस्तोमस् तेनैन्द्रम् . तद् एतद् ऐन्द्राग्नम् एव मैत्रावरुणीषु स्तुवन्ति . तेन मैत्रावरुणं गायत्री छन्दस् तेनैग्नेयं पञ्चदशस्तोमस् तेनैन्द्रम् . तद् एतद् ऐन्द्राग्नम् एवैन्द्रीषु स्तुवन्ति . तेनैन्द्रं गायत्री छन्दः . ऐन्द्राग्नम् एवैन्द्राग्नीषु स्तुवन्ति . तेनैन्द्राग्नं गायत्री छन्दस् . तेनाग्नेयं पञ्चदशस्तोमस् तेनैन्द्रम् . तद् एतद् ऐन्द्राग्नम् एवैन्द्राग्नीषु स्तुवन्ति . तेनैन्द्राग्नं गायत्री छन्दस् तेनाग्नेयं पञ्चदशस्तोमस् तेनैन्द्रम् . तद् एतद् ऐन्द्राग्नम् एव . इन्द्राग्नी यज्ञस्य देवता .

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata . tā aprāṇā asṛjata . tābhya etenaiva sāmnā prāṇam adadhāt . prāṇo vai gāyatram . sarvam āyur eti ya evaṃ veda . tāḥ prāṇaṃ vividānā rakṣāṃsy anvasacanta . tā etad eva sāma gāyann atrāyata . yad gāyann atrāyata tad gayatrasya gāyatratvam . trāyata enaṃ sarvasmāt pāpmano ya evaṃ veda . tad ūrdhvam iva geyam . ūrdhvo vai svargo lokaḥ . svargasyaiva lokasya samaṣṭyai . tryāvṛd geyam . trayo vā ime lokāḥ . eṣāṃ lokānām āptyai . tryudāsaṃ geyam . trayo vai prāṇāpānavyānāḥ . teṣāṃ saṃtatyai . sam asmai prāṇāpānavyānās tāyante ya evaṃ veda . tryāvṛd geyam . trayo vā ime lokāḥ . eṣāṃ lokānāṃ saṃtatyai .
sentences: sarvam āyur eti ya evaṃ veda .
tā etad eva sāma gāyann atrāyata .
yad gāyann atrāyata tad gayatrasya gāyatratvam .
trāyata enaṃ sarvasmāt pāpmano ya evaṃ veda .
sam asmai prāṇāpānavyānās tāyante ya evaṃ veda .
text: Prajapati created creatures. He created them without breath. With this very saman he placed breath in them. The prana is indeed the gayatra. He lives the full span of life -- he who knows thus. Having obtained breath, raksas pursued them. Singing this very saman, he protected them. Because he protected them while singing, that is the gayatra nature of the gayatra. It protects him from all evil -- he who knows thus. It should be sung as if upward. The heavenly world is indeed above. For the attainment of the heavenly world. It should be sung with triple repetition. Three are these worlds. For the attainment of these worlds. It should be sung with three risings. Three are the prana, apana, and vyana. For their continuity. The prana, apana, and vyana are extended for him -- he who knows thus. It should be sung with triple repetition. Three are these worlds. For the continuity of these worlds.
meaning: प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत . ता अप्राणा असृजत . ताभ्य एतेनैव साम्ना प्राणम् अदधात् . प्राणो वै गायत्रम् . सर्वम् आयुर् एति य एवं वेद . ताः प्राणं विविदाना रक्षांस्य् अन्वसचन्त . ता एतद् एव साम गायन्न् अत्रायत . यद् गायन्न् अत्रायत तद् गयत्रस्य गायत्रत्वम् . त्रायत एनं सर्वस्मात् पाप्मनो य एवं वेद . तद् ऊर्ध्वम् इव गेयम् . ऊर्ध्वो वै स्वर्गो लोकः . स्वर्गस्यैव लोकस्य समष्ट्यै . त्र्यावृद् गेयम् . त्रयो वा इमे लोकाः . एषां लोकानाम् आप्त्यै . त्र्युदासं गेयम् . त्रयो वै प्राणापानव्यानाः . तेषां संतत्यै . सम् अस्मै प्राणापानव्यानास् तायन्ते य एवं वेद . त्र्यावृद् गेयम् . त्रयो वा इमे लोकाः . एषां लोकानां संतत्यै .

sanskrit_iast: pitṛdevatyaṃ tv asya nopagantavā ity āhuḥ . etad dha vā asya pitṛdevatyaṃ yat tāntīkaroti . yadi sāmi tāmyen madhya ṛco 'vānyāt . prāṇo vā ṛk prāṇo gāyatram . prāṇasyatan madhye prāṇaṃ samānayate . yady u ca iyāt prāṇāpānavyānān gāyet . prāṇa iti dve akṣare apāna iti trīṇi vyāna iti trīṇi . tad aṣṭau saṃpadyante . aṣṭākṣarā gāyatrī . tena gāyatryai naiti . sāmno 'ntar araṇyaṃ nāvetyam . yo ha vai sāmno 'ntar araṇyam avaiti sarvajyāniṃ vā jīyate pra vā mīyate . etad dha vai sāmno 'ntar araṇyaṃ yat prastutam anabhisvaritam ādīyate . svareṇa saṃpādyodgāyet . etad vai sāmnas svaṃ yat svaraḥ . svenaivainat tat samardhayati . etad vai sāmno 'nnādyaṃ yat svarāḥ . annādyenaivainat tat samardhayati . etad vai sāmna āyatanaṃ yat svaraḥ . āyatanenaivainat tat samardhayati . etad vai sāmnaḥ priyaṃ dhāma yat svaraḥ .
sentences: pitr̥devatyaṃ tv asya nopagantavā ity āhuḥ .
etad dʰa vā asya pitr̥devatyaṃ yat tāntīkaroti .
yady u ca iyāt prāṇāpānavyānān gāyet .
prāṇa iti dve akṣare apāna iti trīṇi vyāna iti trīṇi .
yo ha vai sāmno 'ntar araṇyam avaiti sarvajyāniṃ vā jīyate pra vā mīyate .
etad dʰa vai sāmno 'ntar araṇyaṃ yat prastutam anabʰisvaritam ādīyate .
etad vai sāmnas svaṃ yat svaraḥ .
etad vai sāmna āyatanaṃ yat svaraḥ .
etad vai sāmnaḥ priyaṃ dʰāma yat svaraḥ .
text: They say that one should not approach its pitr-devatya aspect. This is indeed its pitr-devatya aspect -- when one makes the tantikara. If one comes to a stop, one should descend in the middle of the rc. The prana is the rc; the prana is the gayatra. In the middle of the prana one thereby brings the prana together. And if one should proceed, one should sing the prana, apana, and vyana -- 'prana' is two syllables, 'apana' is three, 'vyana' is three. That makes eight. The gayatri has eight syllables. By that one does not depart from the gayatri. One should not enter the wilderness of the saman. He who enters the wilderness of the saman either loses everything or dies. This is indeed the wilderness of the saman: when what has been begun is taken up without the accent. One should complete it with the svara and then chant the udgitha. The svara is indeed the own nature of the saman. By its own nature one thereby fulfills it. The svara is indeed the food of the saman. By food one thereby fulfills it. The svara is indeed the abode of the saman. By its abode one thereby fulfills it. The svara is indeed the beloved dwelling of the saman.
meaning: पितृदेवत्यं त्व् अस्य नोपगन्तवा इत्य् आहुः . एतद् ध वा अस्य पितृदेवत्यं यत् तान्तीकरोति . यदि सामि ताम्येन् मध्य ऋचो ऽवान्यात् . प्राणो वा ऋक् प्राणो गायत्रम् . प्राणस्यतन् मध्ये प्राणं समानयते . यद्य् उ च इयात् प्राणापानव्यानान् गायेत् . प्राण इति द्वे अक्षरे अपान इति त्रीणि व्यान इति त्रीणि . तद् अष्टौ संपद्यन्ते . अष्टाक्षरा गायत्री . तेन गायत्र्यै नैति . साम्नो ऽन्तर् अरण्यं नावेत्यम् . यो ह वै साम्नो ऽन्तर् अरण्यम् अवैति सर्वज्यानिं वा जीयते प्र वा मीयते . एतद् ध वै साम्नो ऽन्तर् अरण्यं यत् प्रस्तुतम् अनभिस्वरितम् आदीयते . स्वरेण संपाद्योद्गायेत् . एतद् वै साम्नस् स्वं यत् स्वरः . स्वेनैवैनत् तत् समर्धयति . एतद् वै साम्नो ऽन्नाद्यं यत् स्वराः . अन्नाद्येनैवैनत् तत् समर्धयति . एतद् वै साम्न आयतनं यत् स्वरः . आयतनेनैवैनत् तत् समर्धयति . एतद् वै साम्नः प्रियं धाम यत् स्वरः .

sanskrit_iast: devān vai yajñasyāhutir nāgacchat . sa prajāpatir āiksata kathaṃ nu devān yajñasyāhutir gacched iti . sa ete dve akṣare gāyatryā udakhidat . sa eva dvyakṣaro vaṣaṭkāro 'bhavat tato vai devān yajñasyāhutir agacchat . annaṃ vai vaṣaṭkāraḥ . atty annaṃ ya evaṃ veda . indro vṛtrāya vajram udayacchat . tasyaite akṣare cakrāv āstām . vajro vā eṣaḥ . ya ete nispṛśed vajraṃ nispṛśet . yo vai dugdhād dugdham upaiti na sa āpyāyate . atha yo 'dugdhād dugdham upaiti sa āpyāyate . dugdhād vā eṣa dugdham upaiti ya ete akṣare upaiti . tasmād ete akṣare nopetye . yasya vai sarvā gāyatrī gīyate sarvam asya gṛhe adhigamyate . yasyo nāgīyata īśvaro rūkṣo bhavitoḥ . anyatarad akṣaram avagṛhya vācaṃ caturviṃśīm upeyāt .
sentences: sa prajāpatir āiksata katʰaṃ nu devān yajñasyāhutir gaccʰed iti .
sa ete dve akṣare gāyatryā udakʰidat .
sa eva dvyakṣaro vaṣaṭkāro 'bʰavat tato vai devān yajñasyāhutir agaccʰat .
yo vai dugdʰād dugdʰam upaiti na sa āpyāyate .
atʰa yo 'dugdʰād dugdʰam upaiti sa āpyāyate .
dugdʰād vā eṣa dugdʰam upaiti ya ete akṣare upaiti .
yasya vai sarvā gāyatrī gīyate sarvam asya gr̥he adʰigamyate .
anyatarad akṣaram avagr̥hya vācaṃ caturviṃśīm upeyāt .
text: The oblation of the sacrifice did not reach the gods. Prajapati reflected: 'How might the oblation of the sacrifice reach the gods?' He extracted these two syllables from the gayatri. That very two-syllabled vasatkara came into being. Thereby the oblation of the sacrifice reached the gods. The vasatkara is indeed food. He eats food -- he who knows thus. Indra raised the thunderbolt against Vrtra. These two syllables were its two wheels. This is indeed the thunderbolt. He who touches these would touch the thunderbolt. He who goes from milked to milked does not thrive. But he who goes from unmilked to milked does thrive. He who approaches these two syllables goes from milked to milked. Therefore these two syllables should not be approached. For him whose entire gayatri is sung, everything in his house is obtained. For him whose gayatri is not sung, he is liable to become impoverished. One should, holding back one of the two syllables, approach the twenty-fourth speech.
meaning: देवान् वै यज्ञस्याहुतिर् नागच्छत् . स प्रजापतिर् आइक्सत कथं नु देवान् यज्ञस्याहुतिर् गच्छेद् इति . स एते द्वे अक्षरे गायत्र्या उदखिदत् . स एव द्व्यक्षरो वषट्कारो ऽभवत् ततो वै देवान् यज्ञस्याहुतिर् अगच्छत् . अन्नं वै वषट्कारः . अत्त्य् अन्नं य एवं वेद . इन्द्रो वृत्राय वज्रम् उदयच्छत् . तस्यैते अक्षरे चक्राव् आस्ताम् . वज्रो वा एषः . य एते निस्पृशेद् वज्रं निस्पृशेत् . यो वै दुग्धाद् दुग्धम् उपैति न स आप्यायते . अथ यो ऽदुग्धाद् दुग्धम् उपैति स आप्यायते . दुग्धाद् वा एष दुग्धम् उपैति य एते अक्षरे उपैति . तस्माद् एते अक्षरे नोपेत्ये . यस्य वै सर्वा गायत्री गीयते सर्वम् अस्य गृहे अधिगम्यते . यस्यो नागीयत ईश्वरो रूक्षो भवितोः . अन्यतरद् अक्षरम् अवगृह्य वाचं चतुर्विंशीम् उपेयात् .

sanskrit_iast: yo vā aṃśum ekākṣaraṃ vedānnāda eva śreṣṭhas svānām bhavati . atho saha eva tasyai janatāyā udgāyati . vāg vā aṃśur ekākṣaraḥ . tad eva gāyatram . gāyatryai prastutāyai yad āder uttaram akṣaraṃ sa sthāṇuḥ . yas tad udgāyann ārabhate sthāṇum ārabhate . ya enaṃ nirharati gāyatrīṃ chidrāṃ karoti . gāyatrīṃ chidrāṃ anu yajñas sravati yajñam anu yajamāno yajamānam anu prajāḥ . sadhryaśvo ha smāha taigmāyudhiḥ ka u svid adya rasadihāv urasi nimradiṣyata iti . ete ha vai rasadihau ye ete gāyatryā uttame akṣare . yas te udgāyann ārabhate rasadihāv urasi nimardate . ya u ene nirharati gāyatrīṃ chidrāṃ karoti .
sentences: yo vā aṃśum ekākṣaraṃ vedānnāda eva śreṣṭʰas svānām bʰavati .
atʰo saha eva tasyai janatāyā udgāyati .
gāyatryai prastutāyai yad āder uttaram akṣaraṃ sa stʰāṇuḥ .
yas tad udgāyann ārabʰate stʰāṇum ārabʰate .
ya enaṃ nirharati gāyatrīṃ cʰidrāṃ karoti .
gāyatrīṃ cʰidrāṃ anu yajñas sravati yajñam anu yajamāno yajamānam anu prajāḥ .
sadʰryaśvo ha smāha taigmāyudʰiḥ ka u svid adya rasadihāv urasi nimradiṣyata iti .
ete ha vai rasadihau ye ete gāyatryā uttame akṣare .
yas te udgāyann ārabʰate rasadihāv urasi nimardate .
ya u ene nirharati gāyatrīṃ cʰidrāṃ karoti .
text: He who knows the single-syllabled ray becomes the foremost food-eater among his own. And he chants the udgitha together with that community. Speech is indeed the single-syllabled ray. That is the gayatra. When the gayatri is being praised, the syllable after the beginning is the pillar. He who, while chanting the udgitha, grasps that, grasps the pillar. He who removes it makes the gayatri full of holes. Through the holed gayatri the sacrifice leaks away, after the sacrifice the sacrificer, after the sacrificer the offspring. Sadhryasva Taigmayudhi used to say: 'Who today will press the two rasadihau into the chest?' These are indeed the two rasadihau -- the last two syllables of the gayatri. He who, while chanting the udgitha, grasps them, presses the two rasadihau into the chest. He who removes them makes the gayatri full of holes.
meaning: यो वा अंशुम् एकाक्षरं वेदान्नाद एव श्रेष्ठस् स्वानाम् भवति . अथो सह एव तस्यै जनताया उद्गायति . वाग् वा अंशुर् एकाक्षरः . तद् एव गायत्रम् . गायत्र्यै प्रस्तुतायै यद् आदेर् उत्तरम् अक्षरं स स्थाणुः . यस् तद् उद्गायन्न् आरभते स्थाणुम् आरभते . य एनं निर्हरति गायत्रीं छिद्रां करोति . गायत्रीं छिद्रां अनु यज्ञस् स्रवति यज्ञम् अनु यजमानो यजमानम् अनु प्रजाः . सध्र्यश्वो ह स्माह तैग्मायुधिः क उ स्विद् अद्य रसदिहाव् उरसि निम्रदिष्यत इति . एते ह वै रसदिहौ ये एते गायत्र्या उत्तमे अक्षरे . यस् ते उद्गायन्न् आरभते रसदिहाव् उरसि निमर्दते . य उ एने निर्हरति गायत्रीं छिद्रां करोति .

sanskrit_iast: tāni sarvāṇy aksarāṇy uddhṛtya vācaṃ dadhyāt . vāg vai brahma . tad yathā carmaṇā kṛtikaṇṭakān Ich halte mittlerweile die hier vorliegende Lesart kṛtikaṇṭaka - "messer(scharfer) Dorn " für die richtige . Anders Caland 1919 Par . 168 Anm . 11 zur Parallelstelle 2,422 (342,24) und Bodewitz 1990, 240 note 36. prāvṛtyātīyād evam evaitad vācā brahmaṇā yajñasthāṇuṃ pramṛdya svasty atikrāmati nārtim ārchati . ava vā etat pratihartā sāmnaś chidyate yad gāyatrasya na pratiharati . prastūyamānaṃ manasā pratihiṃkuryāt . apānya vāk iti brūyāt . tathā sāmno nāvacchidyate nārtim ārchati . yo vā akṣaram aṃśumad veda vahanty enam aṃśumatīs saṃyuktāḥ . vāg vā akṣaram . tasyai prāṇa evāṃśuḥ .
sentences: tāni sarvāṇy aksarāṇy uddʰr̥tya vācaṃ dadʰyāt .

tad yatʰā carmaṇā kr̥tikaṇṭakān Ich halte mittlerweile die hier vorliegende Lesart kr̥tikaṇṭaka - "messer(scharfer) Dorn " für die richtige . Anders Caland 1919 Par . 168 Anm . 11 zur Parallelstelle 2,422 (342,24) und Bodewitz 1990, 240 note 36. prāvr̥tyātīyād evam evaitad vācā brahmaṇā yajñastʰāṇuṃ pramr̥dya svasty atikrāmati nārtim ārcʰati .
ava vā etat pratihartā sāmnaś cʰidyate yad gāyatrasya na pratiharati .
yo vā akṣaram aṃśumad veda vahanty enam aṃśumatīs saṃyuktāḥ .
text: Having extracted all those syllables, one should place speech. Speech is indeed brahman. Just as one would cover oneself with a leather hide and pass through thorns, even so, with speech, with brahman, one passes beyond the stump of the sacrifice without difficulty and does not come to harm. The pratihartr is indeed cut off from the saman if he does not perform the pratihara of the gayatra. When the prastava is being sung, one should mentally make the pratihimkara. One should say 'apanya vak' (away, speech!). Thus one is not cut off from the saman and does not come to harm. He who knows the syllable endowed with a ray -- the ray-endowed ones carry him, yoked together. Speech is indeed the syllable. Its ray is the prana.
meaning: तानि सर्वाण्य् अक्सराण्य् उद्धृत्य वाचं दध्यात् . वाग् वै ब्रह्म . तद् यथा चर्मणा कृतिकण्टकान् Iछ् हल्ते मित्त्लेर्wएइले दिए हिएर् वोर्लिएगेन्दे Lएसर्त् कृतिकण्टक - "मेस्सेर्(स्छर्fएर्) Dओर्न् " füर् दिए रिछ्तिगे . Aन्देर्स् Cअलन्द् १९१९ Pअर् . १६८ Aन्म् . ११ zउर् Pअरल्लेल्स्तेल्ले २,४२२ (३४२,२४) उन्द् Bओदेwइत्z १९९०, २४० नोते ३६. प्रावृत्यातीयाद् एवम् एवैतद् वाचा ब्रह्मणा यज्ञस्थाणुं प्रमृद्य स्वस्त्य् अतिक्रामति नार्तिम् आर्छति . अव वा एतत् प्रतिहर्ता साम्नश् छिद्यते यद् गायत्रस्य न प्रतिहरति . प्रस्तूयमानं मनसा प्रतिहिंकुर्यात् . अपान्य वाक् इति ब्रूयात् . तथा साम्नो नावच्छिद्यते नार्तिम् आर्छति . यो वा अक्षरम् अंशुमद् वेद वहन्त्य् एनम् अंशुमतीस् संयुक्ताः . वाग् वा अक्षरम् . तस्यै प्राण एवांशुः .

sanskrit_iast: marutvatīḥ pratipado bhavanti . marutvantaṃ grahaṃ gṛhṇanti marutvān vā indro vṛtram ahan vārtrahatyāya . uccā te jātam andhasā ity andhasvatīr bhavanti . ahar vā andhaḥ . ahna evārambhaḥ . yajño vā andhaḥ . yajñasyaivārambhaḥ . trīṇi yajñe 'ndhāṃsīti ha sma pūrve brāhmaṇā mīmāṃsante uccā te jātam andhasā , vasor mandānam andhasaḥ , purojitī vo andhasaḥ iti . trayaḥ paśuṣu bhogāḥ prātar madhyandine sāyam . tān evaitenāvarunddhe . imau vai lokau saha santau vyaitām . tayor na kiṃ cana samapatat . te devamanuṣyā āśanāyan . itaḥpradānād dhi te devā jīvanty amutaḥpradānān manuṣyāḥ . sa etāḥ prajāpatir ṛco 'paśyad uccā te jātam andhasā iti . sa ud ity eveto devebhyo havyam avahat divi sad bhūmy ā dade ity amuto vṛṣṭim ācyāvayat . tāv imau lokau savāsināv akarot . tāv asmai kāmaṃ apinvātām . kāmam asmā imau lokau pinvāte ya evaṃ veda .
sentences: marutvantaṃ grahaṃ gr̥hṇanti marutvān vā indro vr̥tram ahan vārtrahatyāya .
uccā te jātam andʰasā ity andʰasvatīr bʰavanti .
trīṇi yajñe 'ndʰāṃsīti ha sma pūrve brāhmaṇā mīmāṃsante uccā te jātam andʰasā , vasor mandānam andʰasaḥ , purojitī vo andʰasaḥ iti .
trayaḥ paśuṣu bʰogāḥ prātar madʰyandine sāyam .
imau vai lokau saha santau vyaitām .
itaḥpradānād dʰi te devā jīvanty amutaḥpradānān manuṣyāḥ .
sa etāḥ prajāpatir r̥co 'paśyad uccā te jātam andʰasā iti .
sa ud ity eveto devebʰyo havyam avahat divi sad bʰūmy ā dade ity amuto vr̥ṣṭim ācyāvayat .
kāmam asmā imau lokau pinvāte ya evaṃ veda .
text: The pratipads are accompanied by the Maruts. They take the marutvat cup, for Indra accompanied by the Maruts slew Vrtra -- for the slaying of Vrtra. 'ucca te jatam andhasa' (Born on high with the pressed juice) -- the verses contain andhas (soma juice). The day is indeed andhas. It is the taking hold of the day. Or the sacrifice is andhas. It is the taking hold of the sacrifice. The ancient brahmanas deliberated: 'Three are the andhas in the sacrifice' -- 'ucca te jatam andhasa,' 'vasor mandanam andhasah,' 'purojiti vo andhasah.' Three are the enjoyments of cattle: in the morning, at midday, in the evening. These one thereby secures. These two worlds, being together, separated. Nothing passed between them. The gods and humans hungered. For the gods live by giving from here; humans by giving from beyond. Prajapati saw these verses: 'ucca te jatam andhasa.' With 'ud' he carried the offering upward to the gods; with 'divi sad bhumy a dade' he brought rain down from beyond. He made these two worlds co-dwellers. They yielded desire for him. These two worlds yield desire for him -- he who knows thus.
meaning: मरुत्वतीः प्रतिपदो भवन्ति . मरुत्वन्तं ग्रहं गृह्णन्ति मरुत्वान् वा इन्द्रो वृत्रम् अहन् वार्त्रहत्याय . उच्चा ते जातम् अन्धसा इत्य् अन्धस्वतीर् भवन्ति . अहर् वा अन्धः . अह्न एवारम्भः . यज्ञो वा अन्धः . यज्ञस्यैवारम्भः . त्रीणि यज्ञे ऽन्धांसीति ह स्म पूर्वे ब्राह्मणा मीमांसन्ते उच्चा ते जातम् अन्धसा , वसोर् मन्दानम् अन्धसः , पुरोजिती वो अन्धसः इति . त्रयः पशुषु भोगाः प्रातर् मध्यन्दिने सायम् . तान् एवैतेनावरुन्द्धे . इमौ वै लोकौ सह सन्तौ व्यैताम् . तयोर् न किं चन समपतत् . ते देवमनुष्या आशनायन् . इतःप्रदानाद् धि ते देवा जीवन्त्य् अमुतःप्रदानान् मनुष्याः . स एताः प्रजापतिर् ऋचो ऽपश्यद् उच्चा ते जातम् अन्धसा इति . स उद् इत्य् एवेतो देवेभ्यो हव्यम् अवहत् दिवि सद् भूम्य् आ ददे इत्य् अमुतो वृष्टिम् आच्यावयत् . ताव् इमौ लोकौ सवासिनाव् अकरोत् . ताव् अस्मै कामं अपिन्वाताम् . कामम् अस्मा इमौ लोकौ पिन्वाते य एवं वेद .

sanskrit_iast: athāmahīyavam . prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata . tā anaśanā asṛjata . tā aśanāyantīr anyānyām ādan . sa prajāpatir aikṣata kathaṃ nu ma imāḥ prajā nāśanāyeyur iti . sa etat sāmāpaśyat . tenābhyo 'nnādyaṃ prāyacchad varṣam evāpanidhanena . tābhyo 'varṣad eva nodagṛhṇāt . sa etan nidhanam apaśyat . tad upait . tata ābhya udagṛhṇāt . etasya ha vā idaṃ sāmnaḥ krator varṣati ca parjanya uc ca gṛhṇāti . yo vṛṣṭikāmas syād etenaivāpanidhanena stuvīta . varṣuko hāsmai parjanyo bhavati . sa yady atīva varṣed etad eva nidhanam upeyād ud ahāsmai gṛhṇāti . varṣati ca hāsmai parjanya uc ca gṛhṇāti ya evaṃ veda . tā yad enaṃ prajās suhitā aśitā āmahīyanta tad āmahīyavasyāmahīyavatvam . ainaṃ bhāryās suhitās suhitaṃ mahīyante ya evaṃ veda . tā enam annaṃ vividānā nāpācāyan . sadhamādam ivaivāsan . annaṃ hi śrīḥ . so 'śocat . sa nāmahīyata . sa aikṣata kathaṃ nv imā ahaṃ prajās sṛjeya tā mā sṛṣṭā nāpacāyeyur iti . sa etat sāmāpaśyat .
sentences: sa prajāpatir aikṣata katʰaṃ nu ma imāḥ prajā nāśanāyeyur iti .
etasya ha vā idaṃ sāmnaḥ krator varṣati ca parjanya uc ca gr̥hṇāti .
sa yady atīva varṣed etad eva nidʰanam upeyād ud ahāsmai gr̥hṇāti .
varṣati ca hāsmai parjanya uc ca gr̥hṇāti ya evaṃ veda .
tā yad enaṃ prajās suhitā aśitā āmahīyanta tad āmahīyavasyāmahīyavatvam .
ainaṃ bʰāryās suhitās suhitaṃ mahīyante ya evaṃ veda .
sa aikṣata katʰaṃ nv imā ahaṃ prajās sr̥jeya tā mā sr̥ṣṭā nāpacāyeyur iti .
text: Now the amahiyava. Prajapati created creatures. He created them without food. Hungry, they devoured one another. Prajapati reflected: 'How might these creatures of mine not be hungry?' He saw this saman. With it he gave them food; with its apa-nidhana he gave rain. He rained for them but did not make the rain cease. He saw this nidhana. He used it. Thereby the rain ceased for them. By the power of this saman it both rains and ceases. He who desires rain should praise with this apa-nidhana. Parjanya becomes rainy for him. If it rains too much, he should use this nidhana; the rain ceases for him. It both rains and ceases for him -- he who knows thus. Because the creatures, well-fed and satisfied, honored him, that is the amahiyava nature of the amahiyava. His dependents, well-nourished, honor him well-nourished -- he who knows thus. But those creatures, having obtained food, did not honor him. They were as at a drinking party. For food is glory. He grieved. He was not honored. He reflected: 'How might I create creatures that, once created, would not dishonor me?' He saw this saman.
meaning: अथामहीयवम् . प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत . ता अनशना असृजत . ता अशनायन्तीर् अन्यान्याम् आदन् . स प्रजापतिर् ऐक्षत कथं नु म इमाः प्रजा नाशनायेयुर् इति . स एतत् सामापश्यत् . तेनाभ्यो ऽन्नाद्यं प्रायच्छद् वर्षम् एवापनिधनेन . ताभ्यो ऽवर्षद् एव नोदगृह्णात् . स एतन् निधनम् अपश्यत् . तद् उपैत् . तत आभ्य उदगृह्णात् . एतस्य ह वा इदं साम्नः क्रतोर् वर्षति च पर्जन्य उच् च गृह्णाति . यो वृष्टिकामस् स्याद् एतेनैवापनिधनेन स्तुवीत . वर्षुको हास्मै पर्जन्यो भवति . स यद्य् अतीव वर्षेद् एतद् एव निधनम् उपेयाद् उद् अहास्मै गृह्णाति . वर्षति च हास्मै पर्जन्य उच् च गृह्णाति य एवं वेद . ता यद् एनं प्रजास् सुहिता अशिता आमहीयन्त तद् आमहीयवस्यामहीयवत्वम् . ऐनं भार्यास् सुहितास् सुहितं महीयन्ते य एवं वेद . ता एनम् अन्नं विविदाना नापाचायन् . सधमादम् इवैवासन् . अन्नं हि श्रीः . सो ऽशोचत् . स नामहीयत . स ऐक्षत कथं न्व् इमा अहं प्रजास् सृजेय ता मा सृष्टा नापचायेयुर् इति . स एतत् सामापश्यत् .

sanskrit_iast: sa stauṣe ity eva nidhanam upait . tā atoṣayat . tā asya vaśam āyan . toṣayati dviṣato bhrātṛvyān vaśam asya svā āyanti ya evaṃ veda . sa yad āmahīyamānā apaśyat tad āmahīyavasyāmahīyavatvam . yad v evainā vaśe kṛtvāmahīyata tad v evāmahīyavasyāmahīyavatvam . āsvān vaśe kṛtvā mahīyate ya evaṃ veda . tad ye 'sya svā avaśīkṛtā iva syur etad evaiṣāṃ madhya āsīno 'dhīyīta . vaśa evainān kurute . uttarakuravo hāhur avaṣaṭkṛtasyaiva somasya kurupañcālā bhakṣayantīti . ekaikasyai devatāyai hotā vaṣaṭkaroti sarvābhya udgātā . sarvadevatyo hy udgātā . āmahīyavasya nidhanena vaṣaṭkuryād iti . vaṣaṭkṛtasyaiva somasya bhakṣayanti . tad u ha smāha mārjaś śailano bhrātṛvyān vāva nidhanena toṣayatīti . purastād eva nidhanasya vaṣaṭkuryāt vauṣaḍ bhūmī o dadā iti .
sentences: sa stauṣe ity eva nidʰanam upait .
toṣayati dviṣato bʰrātr̥vyān vaśam asya svā āyanti ya evaṃ veda .
sa yad āmahīyamānā apaśyat tad āmahīyavasyāmahīyavatvam .
yad v evainā vaśe kr̥tvāmahīyata tad v evāmahīyavasyāmahīyavatvam .
āsvān vaśe kr̥tvā mahīyate ya evaṃ veda .
tad ye 'sya svā avaśīkr̥tā iva syur etad evaiṣāṃ madʰya āsīno 'dʰīyīta .
uttarakuravo hāhur avaṣaṭkr̥tasyaiva somasya kurupañcālā bʰakṣayantīti .
ekaikasyai devatāyai hotā vaṣaṭkaroti sarvābʰya udgātā .
tad u ha smāha mārjaś śailano bʰrātr̥vyān vāva nidʰanena toṣayatīti .
purastād eva nidʰanasya vaṣaṭkuryāt vauṣaḍ bʰūmī o dadā iti .
text: He used the nidhana 'stause' (I praise). He gratified them. They came under his control. He gratifies the hating rivals; his own come under his control -- he who knows thus. Because he saw it while being honored, that is the amahiyava nature of the amahiyava. Or because he was honored after bringing them under his control, that is the amahiyava nature of the amahiyava. Having brought his own under his control, one is honored -- he who knows thus. If his own should be as if unsubmissive, one should recite this while sitting in their midst. One thereby makes them submissive. The Uttarakurus say: 'The Kurupancalas partake only of Soma for which the vasat has not been pronounced.' The hotr pronounces the vasat for each deity individually; the udgatr for all. For the udgatr belongs to all the deities. One should pronounce the vasat with the nidhana of the amahiyava. Thus they partake of Soma for which the vasat has been pronounced. But Marja Sailana used to say: 'With the nidhana one gratifies the rivals.' One should pronounce the vasat before the nidhana: 'vausad bhumi o dada.'
meaning: स स्तौषे इत्य् एव निधनम् उपैत् . ता अतोषयत् . ता अस्य वशम् आयन् . तोषयति द्विषतो भ्रातृव्यान् वशम् अस्य स्वा आयन्ति य एवं वेद . स यद् आमहीयमाना अपश्यत् तद् आमहीयवस्यामहीयवत्वम् . यद् व् एवैना वशे कृत्वामहीयत तद् व् एवामहीयवस्यामहीयवत्वम् . आस्वान् वशे कृत्वा महीयते य एवं वेद . तद् ये ऽस्य स्वा अवशीकृता इव स्युर् एतद् एवैषां मध्य आसीनो ऽधीयीत . वश एवैनान् कुरुते . उत्तरकुरवो हाहुर् अवषट्कृतस्यैव सोमस्य कुरुपञ्चाला भक्षयन्तीति . एकैकस्यै देवतायै होता वषट्करोति सर्वाभ्य उद्गाता . सर्वदेवत्यो ह्य् उद्गाता . आमहीयवस्य निधनेन वषट्कुर्याद् इति . वषट्कृतस्यैव सोमस्य भक्षयन्ति . तद् उ ह स्माह मार्जश् शैलनो भ्रातृव्यान् वाव निधनेन तोषयतीति . पुरस्ताद् एव निधनस्य वषट्कुर्यात् वौषड् भूमी ओ ददा इति .

sanskrit_iast: yo vai yajñasyodhar veda duhe yajñam . pavamāno vāva yajñaḥ . tasya gāyatry evodhaḥ . gāyatrīṃ caturṛcāṃ kuryāt . yajñasyaiva tad ūdhar dadhāti duhe yajñam . yo vai yajñasya pratiṣṭhāṃ veda prati yajñaṃ sthāpayati praty ātmanā tiṣṭhati . pavamāno vāva yajñaḥ . tasya gāyatry eva pratiṣṭhā . gāyatrīṃ caturṛcāṃ kuryād yajñasyaiva tat pratiṣṭhāṃ dadhāti . prati yajñaṃ sthāpayati praty ātmanā tiṣṭhati . uccā te jātam andhasā , asya pratnām anu dyutam , enā viśvāny arya ā ity etāsu gāyatraṃ kuryāt . tāsv āmahīyavam . sa yad dhāyyāṃ caturthīṃ dadhāti tena caturṛcaṃ bhavati pratitiṣṭhatībhaḥ .
sentences: yo vai yajñasyodʰar veda duhe yajñam .
yajñasyaiva tad ūdʰar dadʰāti duhe yajñam .
yo vai yajñasya pratiṣṭʰāṃ veda prati yajñaṃ stʰāpayati praty ātmanā tiṣṭʰati .
gāyatrīṃ caturr̥cāṃ kuryād yajñasyaiva tat pratiṣṭʰāṃ dadʰāti .
prati yajñaṃ stʰāpayati praty ātmanā tiṣṭʰati .
uccā te jātam andʰasā , asya pratnām anu dyutam , enā viśvāny arya ā ity etāsu gāyatraṃ kuryāt .
sa yad dʰāyyāṃ caturtʰīṃ dadʰāti tena caturr̥caṃ bʰavati pratitiṣṭʰatībʰaḥ .
text: He who knows the udder of the sacrifice milks the sacrifice. The pavamana is indeed the sacrifice. Its udder is the gayatri. One should make the gayatri of four verses. One thereby places the udder of the sacrifice; one milks the sacrifice. He who knows the foundation of the sacrifice establishes the sacrifice and stands firm himself. The pavamana is indeed the sacrifice. The gayatri is its foundation. One should make the gayatri of four verses; one thereby places the foundation of the sacrifice. One establishes the sacrifice and stands firm oneself. 'ucca te jatam andhasa,' 'asya pratnam anu dyutam,' 'ena visvany arya a' -- in these one should make the gayatra. In them the amahiyava. When one places the dhayya as the fourth, it thereby becomes a four-verse group and finds firm foundation.
meaning: यो वै यज्ञस्योधर् वेद दुहे यज्ञम् . पवमानो वाव यज्ञः . तस्य गायत्र्य् एवोधः . गायत्रीं चतुरृचां कुर्यात् . यज्ञस्यैव तद् ऊधर् दधाति दुहे यज्ञम् . यो वै यज्ञस्य प्रतिष्ठां वेद प्रति यज्ञं स्थापयति प्रत्य् आत्मना तिष्ठति . पवमानो वाव यज्ञः . तस्य गायत्र्य् एव प्रतिष्ठा . गायत्रीं चतुरृचां कुर्याद् यज्ञस्यैव तत् प्रतिष्ठां दधाति . प्रति यज्ञं स्थापयति प्रत्य् आत्मना तिष्ठति . उच्चा ते जातम् अन्धसा , अस्य प्रत्नाम् अनु द्युतम् , एना विश्वान्य् अर्य आ इत्य् एतासु गायत्रं कुर्यात् . तास्व् आमहीयवम् . स यद् धाय्यां चतुर्थीं दधाति तेन चतुरृचं भवति प्रतितिष्ठतीभः .

sanskrit_iast: trīṇi ha vai chandāṃsi yajñaṃ vahanti gāyatrī triṣṭub jagatī . tad evānuṣṭub āntād anvāyattā . tayā devās svargaṃ lokam ajigāṃsan . tayā na vyāpnuvan . tasyāṃ catuṣpadaḥ paśūn upādadhur gāṃ cāśvaṃ cājāṃ cāviṃ ca . tayā vyāpnuvan . te 'bruvan svargaṃ lokaṃ gatvā bṛhatī vā iyam abhūd yayedaṃ vyāpāmeti . tad eva bṛhatyai bṛhatītvam . na tataḥ purā bṛhatī nāma chanda āsa . sā vā eṣā paśava eva yad bṛhatī . yena nidhanam upayanti tena prastauti . teno eva punar ādim ādatte . tasmāt paśavo yata eva prajāyante tatas saṃbhavanti . te tata eva punaḥ prajāyante . na bṛhatyā vaṣaṭkuryād paśūnām apravargāya .
sentences: trīṇi ha vai cʰandāṃsi yajñaṃ vahanti gāyatrī triṣṭub jagatī .
tasyāṃ catuṣpadaḥ paśūn upādadʰur gāṃ cāśvaṃ cājāṃ cāviṃ ca .
te 'bruvan svargaṃ lokaṃ gatvā br̥hatī vā iyam abʰūd yayedaṃ vyāpāmeti .
na tataḥ purā br̥hatī nāma cʰanda āsa .
sā vā eṣā paśava eva yad br̥hatī .
tasmāt paśavo yata eva prajāyante tatas saṃbʰavanti .
text: Three metres indeed carry the sacrifice: the gayatri, tristubh, and jagati. The anustubh is attached to their end. With it the gods wished to reach the heavenly world. They did not succeed. In it they placed four-footed animals: the cow, the horse, the goat, and the sheep. Thereby they succeeded. They said: 'Having reached the heavenly world, this has become the brhati by which we have succeeded.' That is the brhati nature of the brhati. Before that, there was no metre called brhati. This brhati is indeed cattle. With that by which they approach the nidhana, with that the prastotr begins the prastava. With that again he takes up the beginning. Therefore cattle come into being from the very place where they are born. From that very place they are born again. One should not pronounce the vasat with the brhati, lest the cattle be driven away.
meaning: त्रीणि ह वै छन्दांसि यज्ञं वहन्ति गायत्री त्रिष्टुब् जगती . तद् एवानुष्टुब् आन्ताद् अन्वायत्ता . तया देवास् स्वर्गं लोकम् अजिगांसन् . तया न व्याप्नुवन् . तस्यां चतुष्पदः पशून् उपादधुर् गां चाश्वं चाजां चाविं च . तया व्याप्नुवन् . ते ऽब्रुवन् स्वर्गं लोकं गत्वा बृहती वा इयम् अभूद् ययेदं व्यापामेति . तद् एव बृहत्यै बृहतीत्वम् . न ततः पुरा बृहती नाम छन्द आस . सा वा एषा पशव एव यद् बृहती . येन निधनम् उपयन्ति तेन प्रस्तौति . तेनो एव पुनर् आदिम् आदत्ते . तस्मात् पशवो यत एव प्रजायन्ते ततस् संभवन्ति . ते तत एव पुनः प्रजायन्ते . न बृहत्या वषट्कुर्याद् पशूनाम् अप्रवर्गाय .

sanskrit_iast: devā vā asurān hatvāpūtā ivāmedhyā amanyanta . te 'kāmayanta pūtā medhyāś śṛtās syāma gacchema svargaṃ lokam iti . ta etā ṛco 'paśyan . tābhir apunata . punānas soma dhārayāpo vasāno arṣasi iti . āpo vai pavitram . adbhir evāpunata . ā ratnadhā yonim ṛtasya sīdasi iti . antarikṣaṃ vā ṛtam . antarikṣam evaitenātyāyan . utso devo hiraṇyayaḥ iti . asau vai loka utso devaḥ . amum evaitena lokam upāsīdan . tato vai te pūtā medhyāś śṛtā abhavann agacchan svargaṃ lokam .
sentences: devā vā asurān hatvāpūtā ivāmedʰyā amanyanta .
te 'kāmayanta pūtā medʰyāś śr̥tās syāma gaccʰema svargaṃ lokam iti .
punānas soma dʰārayāpo vasāno arṣasi iti .
ā ratnadʰā yonim r̥tasya sīdasi iti .
tato vai te pūtā medʰyāś śr̥tā abʰavann agaccʰan svargaṃ lokam .
text: The gods, having slain the asuras, considered themselves as if impure, unclean. They desired: 'May we become purified, clean, mature; may we reach the heavenly world.' They saw these verses. With them they purified themselves. 'punanas soma dharayapo vasano arsasi' (Purifying yourself, O Soma, you flow clothed in waters) -- water is indeed a purifier; with water they purified themselves. 'a ratnadha yonim rtasya sidasi' (You sit down in the womb of rta, the giver of treasure) -- the atmosphere is indeed rta; by this they crossed over the atmosphere. 'utso devo hiranyayah' (The divine golden spring) -- yonder world is indeed the divine spring; by this they approached yonder world. Thereby they became purified, clean, mature, and reached the heavenly world.
meaning: देवा वा असुरान् हत्वापूता इवामेध्या अमन्यन्त . ते ऽकामयन्त पूता मेध्याश् शृतास् स्याम गच्छेम स्वर्गं लोकम् इति . त एता ऋचो ऽपश्यन् . ताभिर् अपुनत . पुनानस् सोम धारयापो वसानो अर्षसि इति . आपो वै पवित्रम् . अद्भिर् एवापुनत . आ रत्नधा योनिम् ऋतस्य सीदसि इति . अन्तरिक्षं वा ऋतम् . अन्तरिक्षम् एवैतेनात्यायन् . उत्सो देवो हिरण्ययः इति . असौ वै लोक उत्सो देवः . अमुम् एवैतेन लोकम् उपासीदन् . ततो वै ते पूता मेध्याश् शृता अभवन्न् अगच्छन् स्वर्गं लोकम् .

sanskrit_iast: tāsu rauravam . agnir vai rūrur etat sāmāpaśyat . yad agnī rūrur etat sāmāpaśyat tad rauravasya rauravatvam . rūra itivṛdhraḥ paśukāmas tapo 'tapyata . sa etat sāmāpaśyat . tenāstuta . sa etām il̥āṃ upait . paśavo vā il̥ā . tato vai paśūn avārunddha . tad etat paśavyaṃ sāma . ava paśūn runddhe bahupaśur bhavati ya evaṃ veda . yad u rūra itivṛdhro 'paśyat tasmād v eva rauravam ity ākhyāyate . atha yaudhājayam . indro vai yudhājīvann etat sāmāpaśyat . yad indro yudhājīvann etat sāmāpaśyat tad yaudhājayasya yaudhājayatvam . ayudha iva dviṣantaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ jayati ya evaṃ veda . yudhājīvo vaiśvāmitraḥ pratiṣṭhākāmas tapo 'tapyata . sa etat sāmāpaśyat . tenāstuta . tato vai sa pratyatiṣṭhat . tad etat pratiṣṭhā sāma . pratitiṣṭhati ya evaṃ veda .
sentences: yad agnī rūrur etat sāmāpaśyat tad rauravasya rauravatvam .
ava paśūn runddʰe bahupaśur bʰavati ya evaṃ veda .
yad u rūra itivr̥dʰro 'paśyat tasmād v eva rauravam ity ākʰyāyate .
yad indro yudʰājīvann etat sāmāpaśyat tad yaudʰājayasya yaudʰājayatvam .
ayudʰa iva dviṣantaṃ bʰrātr̥vyaṃ jayati ya evaṃ veda .
text: Among those verses, the raurava saman. Agni, as Ruru, saw this saman. Because Agni as Ruru saw this saman, that is the raurava nature of the raurava. Ruru Itivrdhra, desiring cattle, performed tapas. He saw this saman. He praised with it. He used this ila. Cattle are indeed ila. Thereby he secured cattle. This is a saman for cattle. He secures cattle, becomes rich in cattle -- he who knows thus. Because Ruru Itivrdhra saw it, it is called raurava. Now the yaudhajaya. Indra, living by warfare, saw this saman. Because Indra, living by warfare, saw this saman, that is the yaudhajaya nature of the yaudhajaya. He conquers the hating rival as if effortlessly -- he who knows thus. Yudhajiva Vaisvamitra, desiring firm foundation, performed tapas. He saw this saman. He praised with it. Thereby he found firm foundation. This is a saman of firm foundation. He finds firm foundation -- he who knows thus.
meaning: तासु रौरवम् . अग्निर् वै रूरुर् एतत् सामापश्यत् . यद् अग्नी रूरुर् एतत् सामापश्यत् तद् रौरवस्य रौरवत्वम् . रूर इतिवृध्रः पशुकामस् तपो ऽतप्यत . स एतत् सामापश्यत् . तेनास्तुत . स एताम् इल्̥आं उपैत् . पशवो वा इल्̥आ . ततो वै पशून् अवारुन्द्ध . तद् एतत् पशव्यं साम . अव पशून् रुन्द्धे बहुपशुर् भवति य एवं वेद . यद् उ रूर इतिवृध्रो ऽपश्यत् तस्माद् व् एव रौरवम् इत्य् आख्यायते . अथ यौधाजयम् . इन्द्रो वै युधाजीवन्न् एतत् सामापश्यत् . यद् इन्द्रो युधाजीवन्न् एतत् सामापश्यत् तद् यौधाजयस्य यौधाजयत्वम् . अयुध इव द्विषन्तं भ्रातृव्यं जयति य एवं वेद . युधाजीवो वैश्वामित्रः प्रतिष्ठाकामस् तपो ऽतप्यत . स एतत् सामापश्यत् . तेनास्तुत . ततो वै स प्रत्यतिष्ठत् . तद् एतत् प्रतिष्ठा साम . प्रतितिष्ठति य एवं वेद .

sanskrit_iast: yaudhājayena vai devā asurān saṃvicya rauraveṇaiṣāṃ ravamāṇānāṃ svam ādadata . yaudhājayenaiva dviṣantaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ saṃvicya rauraveṇāsya ravamāṇasya svam ādatte ya evaṃ veda . rauraveṇa vai devā ūrdhvās svargaṃ lokam ārohan . tān asurā o vā ity evānvārohan . tad devāḥ pratyabudhyanta . ta etaṃ stobham apaśyan . tenainān o hā u vā ity avāco 'vāghnan . utso devo hirā hā u vā iti bhūmispṛśa evākurvan . antagatam iva sāmāsīt . ūrdhvas svargo loka eva yacchet . ūrdhvaṃ pratihārād udgātā . svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai . ṇyāyā au ho vā ho il̥ā iti . svareṇaiva saṃtatya svargaṃ lokaṃ samaśnute . etāvanti ha khalu vai sāmāny etāvatī sāmakl̥ptir etāvān u sāmabandhuḥ . svāraṃ bhavati . prāṇo vai svaraḥ . atha nidhanavat . ātmā vai nidhanam . athail̥am . paśavo vā il̥ā . prāṇam ātmānaṃ paśūṃs tān evaitat saṃdadhāti .
sentences: yaudʰājayena vai devā asurān saṃvicya rauraveṇaiṣāṃ ravamāṇānāṃ svam ādadata .
yaudʰājayenaiva dviṣantaṃ bʰrātr̥vyaṃ saṃvicya rauraveṇāsya ravamāṇasya svam ādatte ya evaṃ veda .
rauraveṇa vai devā ūrdʰvās svargaṃ lokam ārohan .
tān asurā o vā ity evānvārohan .
tenainān o hā u vā ity avāco 'vāgʰnan .
utso devo hirā hā u vā iti bʰūmispr̥śa evākurvan .
ṇyāyā au ho vā ho il̥ā iti .
etāvanti ha kʰalu vai sāmāny etāvatī sāmakl̥ptir etāvān u sāmabandʰuḥ .
prāṇam ātmānaṃ paśūṃs tān evaitat saṃdadʰāti .
text: With the yaudhajaya the gods, having overcome the asuras, took their property from them as they cried out, with the raurava. With the yaudhajaya one overcomes the hating rival; with the raurava one takes his property from him as he cries out -- he who knows thus. With the raurava the gods ascended upward to the heavenly world. The asuras followed them up, saying 'o va.' The gods became aware of this. They saw this stobha. With it they struck the asuras down, saying 'o ha u va.' 'utso devo hira ha u va' -- they made them touch the ground. The saman was as if ended. One should direct it upward to the heavenly world itself. The udgatr should go upward from the pratihara. For the attainment of the heavenly world. 'nyaya au ho va ho ila' -- by the svara itself one extends and attains the heavenly world. These are indeed all the samans; this is the arrangement of the saman; this is the connection of the saman. It has the svara. The prana is the svara. It has the nidhana. The self is the nidhana. It has the ila. Cattle are ila. One thereby joins together the prana, the self, and cattle.
meaning: यौधाजयेन वै देवा असुरान् संविच्य रौरवेणैषां रवमाणानां स्वम् आददत . यौधाजयेनैव द्विषन्तं भ्रातृव्यं संविच्य रौरवेणास्य रवमाणस्य स्वम् आदत्ते य एवं वेद . रौरवेण वै देवा ऊर्ध्वास् स्वर्गं लोकम् आरोहन् . तान् असुरा ओ वा इत्य् एवान्वारोहन् . तद् देवाः प्रत्यबुध्यन्त . त एतं स्तोभम् अपश्यन् . तेनैनान् ओ हा उ वा इत्य् अवाचो ऽवाघ्नन् . उत्सो देवो हिरा हा उ वा इति भूमिस्पृश एवाकुर्वन् . अन्तगतम् इव सामासीत् . ऊर्ध्वस् स्वर्गो लोक एव यच्छेत् . ऊर्ध्वं प्रतिहाराद् उद्गाता . स्वर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै . ण्याया औ हो वा हो इल्̥आ इति . स्वरेणैव संतत्य स्वर्गं लोकं समश्नुते . एतावन्ति ह खलु वै सामान्य् एतावती सामक्ल्̥प्तिर् एतावान् उ सामबन्धुः . स्वारं भवति . प्राणो वै स्वरः . अथ निधनवत् . आत्मा वै निधनम् . अथैल्̥अम् . पशवो वा इल्̥आ . प्राणम् आत्मानं पशूंस् तान् एवैतत् संदधाति .

sanskrit_iast: dve u ha vāva sāmanī stobhavac caivāstobhavac ca . tayor yat stobhavat tat kṣatram atha yad astobhavat tad brahma . ubhayaṃ brahma ca kṣatraṃ cāvarunddhe ya evaṃ veda . atha yaudhājayaṃ triṇidhanaṃ savanānāṃ kl̥ptyai . pavamānena vai devebhyo 'nnādyaṃ pradīyate . tan madhyenidhanaṃ bhavaty annādyasya viśeṣāya . yad dhi devebhyas sarvam annādyaṃ pradīyate na tad ihānnadyaṃ pariśiṣyeta yan manuṣyāś ca paśavaś copajīveyuḥ . tad yan madhyenidhanaṃ bhavaty annādyasyaiva viśeṣāya . devānāṃ vā asurā yajñaveśasam acikīrṣan . yāvaty etad dakṣiṇānāṃ kāle na stuvanti na śaṃsanti . tad devāḥ pratyabudhyanta . ta etat sāmāpaśyan . tenāstuvata . te prātassavanam eva prathamena nidhanena paryagṛhṇan mādhyaṃdinaṃ dvitīyena tṛtīyasavanaṃ tṛtīyena . tān eva vajrān udayacchan . tān eva vajrān udyatān asurā nopādhṛṣṇuvan . tato vai devā abhavan parāsurāḥ . bhavaty ātmanā parāsya dviṣan bhrātṛvyo bhavati ya evaṃ veda .
sentences: dve u ha vāva sāmanī stobʰavac caivāstobʰavac ca .
tayor yat stobʰavat tat kṣatram atʰa yad astobʰavat tad brahma .
ubʰayaṃ brahma ca kṣatraṃ cāvarunddʰe ya evaṃ veda .
yad dʰi devebʰyas sarvam annādyaṃ pradīyate na tad ihānnadyaṃ pariśiṣyeta yan manuṣyāś ca paśavaś copajīveyuḥ .
tad yan madʰyenidʰanaṃ bʰavaty annādyasyaiva viśeṣāya .
yāvaty etad dakṣiṇānāṃ kāle na stuvanti na śaṃsanti .
te prātassavanam eva pratʰamena nidʰanena paryagr̥hṇan mādʰyaṃdinaṃ dvitīyena tr̥tīyasavanaṃ tr̥tīyena .
tān eva vajrān udyatān asurā nopādʰr̥ṣṇuvan .
bʰavaty ātmanā parāsya dviṣan bʰrātr̥vyo bʰavati ya evaṃ veda .
text: There are indeed two kinds of samans: with stobha and without stobha. Of these, that which has the stobha is the ksatra; that which is without the stobha is the brahman. One secures both brahman and ksatra -- he who knows thus. Now the yaudhajaya has three nidhanas, for the arrangement of the pressings. By the pavamana, food is indeed given to the gods. The nidhana is in the middle, for the differentiation of food. For if all food were given to the gods, no food would remain here for humans and cattle to live on. Therefore the nidhana is in the middle -- for the differentiation of food. The asuras wished to disrupt the sacrifice-arrangement of the gods. During all the time of the dakshinas they neither praise nor recite. The gods became aware of this. They saw this saman. They praised with it. With the first nidhana they encompassed the morning pressing; with the second, the midday pressing; with the third, the third pressing. They thereby raised the thunderbolts. Those thunderbolts, once raised, the asuras could not withstand. Thereby the gods prevailed and the asuras were defeated. He prevails himself; his hating rival is defeated -- he who knows thus.
meaning: द्वे उ ह वाव सामनी स्तोभवच् चैवास्तोभवच् च . तयोर् यत् स्तोभवत् तत् क्षत्रम् अथ यद् अस्तोभवत् तद् ब्रह्म . उभयं ब्रह्म च क्षत्रं चावरुन्द्धे य एवं वेद . अथ यौधाजयं त्रिणिधनं सवनानां क्ल्̥प्त्यै . पवमानेन वै देवेभ्यो ऽन्नाद्यं प्रदीयते . तन् मध्येनिधनं भवत्य् अन्नाद्यस्य विशेषाय . यद् धि देवेभ्यस् सर्वम् अन्नाद्यं प्रदीयते न तद् इहान्नद्यं परिशिष्येत यन् मनुष्याश् च पशवश् चोपजीवेयुः . तद् यन् मध्येनिधनं भवत्य् अन्नाद्यस्यैव विशेषाय . देवानां वा असुरा यज्ञवेशसम् अचिकीर्षन् . यावत्य् एतद् दक्षिणानां काले न स्तुवन्ति न शंसन्ति . तद् देवाः प्रत्यबुध्यन्त . त एतत् सामापश्यन् . तेनास्तुवत . ते प्रातस्सवनम् एव प्रथमेन निधनेन पर्यगृह्णन् माध्यंदिनं द्वितीयेन तृतीयसवनं तृतीयेन . तान् एव वज्रान् उदयच्छन् . तान् एव वज्रान् उद्यतान् असुरा नोपाधृष्णुवन् . ततो वै देवा अभवन् परासुराः . भवत्य् आत्मना परास्य द्विषन् भ्रातृव्यो भवति य एवं वेद .

sanskrit_iast: devāsurās saṃyattā jyoṅ na vyajayanta . bṛhaspatir devānāṃ purohita āsīd uśanā kāvyo 'surāṇām . tad yad evāvastād brahmākriyata tat parastād akriyata . tat samānaṃ brahma na vyajayata . teṣāṃ ha triśīrṣā gandharvo vijayasyāvet . sa herṣyur āsa . tasya hāpsv antar naunagaraṃ pariplavam āsa . tad indro 'nvabudhyata triśīrṣā vai nau vijayasya vedeti . tasya jāyām upārcchad etasyaiva vijayasya kāmāya . tām abravīt pṛcchatāt patiṃ ya ime devāsurās saṃyattā jyog abhūvan katara eṣāṃ jeṣyantīti . tad dhaiva saṃvadamānāv ājagāma . sa ha tad eva naumaṇḍa upaśiśleṣa jalāyukā vā tṛṇakaṃ vā bhūtvā .
sentences: br̥haspatir devānāṃ purohita āsīd uśanā kāvyo 'surāṇām .
tad yad evāvastād brahmākriyata tat parastād akriyata .
tasya hāpsv antar naunagaraṃ pariplavam āsa .
tad indro 'nvabudʰyata triśīrṣā vai nau vijayasya vedeti .
tasya jāyām upārccʰad etasyaiva vijayasya kāmāya .
tām abravīt pr̥ccʰatāt patiṃ ya ime devāsurās saṃyattā jyog abʰūvan katara eṣāṃ jeṣyantīti .
sa ha tad eva naumaṇḍa upaśiśleṣa jalāyukā vā tr̥ṇakaṃ vā bʰūtvā .
text: The gods and asuras, having joined battle, for a long time could not win. Brhaspati was the purohita of the gods; Usanas Kavya of the asuras. Whatever ritual act was performed on this side was also performed on that side. With the same ritual knowledge they could not win. A three-headed gandharva knew the means of their victory. He was envious. He had a floating boat-city in the waters. Indra realized: 'The three-headed one knows the means of victory.' He approached his wife for the sake of this very victory. He said to her: 'Ask your husband -- these gods and asuras who have been in conflict for a long time, which of them will win?' He arrived just as they were conversing. He clung to that very deck of the boat, having become a leech or a straw.
meaning: देवासुरास् संयत्ता ज्योङ् न व्यजयन्त . बृहस्पतिर् देवानां पुरोहित आसीद् उशना काव्यो ऽसुराणाम् . तद् यद् एवावस्ताद् ब्रह्माक्रियत तत् परस्ताद् अक्रियत . तत् समानं ब्रह्म न व्यजयत . तेषां ह त्रिशीर्षा गन्धर्वो विजयस्यावेत् . स हेर्ष्युर् आस . तस्य हाप्स्व् अन्तर् नौनगरं परिप्लवम् आस . तद् इन्द्रो ऽन्वबुध्यत त्रिशीर्षा वै नौ विजयस्य वेदेति . तस्य जायाम् उपार्च्छद् एतस्यैव विजयस्य कामाय . ताम् अब्रवीत् पृच्छतात् पतिं य इमे देवासुरास् संयत्ता ज्योग् अभूवन् कतर एषां जेष्यन्तीति . तद् धैव संवदमानाव् आजगाम . स ह तद् एव नौमण्ड उपशिश्लेष जलायुका वा तृणकं वा भूत्वा .

sanskrit_iast: moccair iti hovāca karṇinī vai bhūmir iti . tad idam apy etarhy āhur moccaiḥ karṇinī vai bhūmir iti . neti hovāca brūhy eveti . sa hovāca brāhmaṇāv imau samaṃ vidatur bṛhaspatir ayaṃ deveṣūśanā kāvyo 'sureṣu . tau yat kurutas tat samam eva yacchati . yā itara āhutīr juhoti tā itaraḥ . tās sametya yathāyatham eva punar viparāyanti . tayor yataro yatarān upasameṣyati te jeṣyantīti . tad dhaivendro 'nubudhya śuko bhūtvotpapāta . taṃ hānvīkṣya patantam uvāca yeṣām asau haritavarṇakaḥ patati te jeṣyantīti . sa hośanasaṃ kāvyam ājagāmāsureṣu . taṃ hovācarṣe kam imaṃ janaṃ vardhayasy asmākaṃ vai tvam asi vayaṃ vā tavāsmān abhyupāvartasveti . katheti hovāca kena mopamantrayasa iti . yā imā virocanasya prāhlādeḥ kāmadughas tābhir iti . tatheti . tābhir ha pra tv ity eva pradudruvatuḥ . tau hāsurā anvavajahire . tau hānvājagmuḥ . sa hovācarṣe 'nu vai nāv ime 'surā āgmann iti .
sentences: moccair iti hovāca karṇinī vai bʰūmir iti .
tad idam apy etarhy āhur moccaiḥ karṇinī vai bʰūmir iti .
sa hovāca brāhmaṇāv imau samaṃ vidatur br̥haspatir ayaṃ deveṣūśanā kāvyo 'sureṣu .
tau yat kurutas tat samam eva yaccʰati .
yā itara āhutīr juhoti tā itaraḥ .
tās sametya yatʰāyatʰam eva punar viparāyanti .
tayor yataro yatarān upasameṣyati te jeṣyantīti .
taṃ hānvīkṣya patantam uvāca yeṣām asau haritavarṇakaḥ patati te jeṣyantīti .
taṃ hovācarṣe kam imaṃ janaṃ vardʰayasy asmākaṃ vai tvam asi vayaṃ vā tavāsmān abʰyupāvartasveti .
yā imā virocanasya prāhlādeḥ kāmadugʰas tābʰir iti .
tābʰir ha pra tv ity eva pradudruvatuḥ .
sa hovācarṣe 'nu vai nāv ime 'surā āgmann iti .
text: 'Not so loud,' she said, 'for the earth has ears.' Even today they say: 'Not so loud, for the earth has ears.' 'No,' she said, 'speak out.' He said: 'These two brahmanas know equally -- this Brhaspati among the gods and Usanas Kavya among the asuras. What one does, the other matches exactly. Whatever offerings one offers, the other does the same. They meet and return again as before. Whichever of the two sides the other joins, they will win.' Indra, having understood this, became a parrot and flew up. Seeing him fly, he said: 'Those to whom that green-colored one flies, they will win.' He went to Usanas Kavya among the asuras. He said to him: 'O rsi, which people are you supporting? You are ours, and we are yours. Come over to us.' 'How?' he said. 'With what do you entreat me?' 'With these wish-fulfilling cows of Virocana, the son of Prahlada.' 'So be it.' With them they both ran away. The asuras abandoned them. The asuras pursued them. He said: 'O rsi, the asuras have followed us.'
meaning: मोच्चैर् इति होवाच कर्णिनी वै भूमिर् इति . तद् इदम् अप्य् एतर्ह्य् आहुर् मोच्चैः कर्णिनी वै भूमिर् इति . नेति होवाच ब्रूह्य् एवेति . स होवाच ब्राह्मणाव् इमौ समं विदतुर् बृहस्पतिर् अयं देवेषूशना काव्यो ऽसुरेषु . तौ यत् कुरुतस् तत् समम् एव यच्छति . या इतर आहुतीर् जुहोति ता इतरः . तास् समेत्य यथायथम् एव पुनर् विपरायन्ति . तयोर् यतरो यतरान् उपसमेष्यति ते जेष्यन्तीति . तद् धैवेन्द्रो ऽनुबुध्य शुको भूत्वोत्पपात . तं हान्वीक्ष्य पतन्तम् उवाच येषाम् असौ हरितवर्णकः पतति ते जेष्यन्तीति . स होशनसं काव्यम् आजगामासुरेषु . तं होवाचर्षे कम् इमं जनं वर्धयस्य् अस्माकं वै त्वम् असि वयं वा तवास्मान् अभ्युपावर्तस्वेति . कथेति होवाच केन मोपमन्त्रयस इति . या इमा विरोचनस्य प्राह्लादेः कामदुघस् ताभिर् इति . तथेति . ताभिर् ह प्र त्व् इत्य् एव प्रदुद्रुवतुः . तौ हासुरा अन्ववजहिरे . तौ हान्वाजग्मुः . स होवाचर्षे ऽनु वै नाव् इमे ऽसुरा आग्मन्न् इति .

sanskrit_iast: svāyudhaḥ pavate deva indur aśastihā vṛjanā rakṣamāṇaḥ pitā devānāṃ janitā sudakṣo viṣṭambho divo dharuṇaḥ pṛthivyāḥ (RV 9,87,2) iti . ā divo viṣṭambham ucchiśriyatuḥ . taṃ haivāsurā nātīyuḥ . tau hābhiḥ kāmadughābhir devān ājagmatuḥ . tau hāgatau mahayāṃ cakrire ṛṣir vipraḥ puraetā janānām ṛbhur dhīra uśanā kāvyena sa cid viveda nihitaṃ yad āsām apīcyaṃ guhyaṃ nāma gonām (RV 9,87,3) iti . tā etāḥ paśavyā ṛcaḥ . ava paśūn runddhe bahupaśur bhavaty etābhir ṛgbhis tuṣṭuvānaḥ . tāsv auśanam . uśanā vai kāvyo deveṣv amartyaṃ gandharvalokam aicchata . sa etat sāmāpaśyat . tenātuta . tato vai sa deveṣv amartyaṃ gandharvalokam āśnuta . tad etal lokavit sāma . aśnute deveṣv amartyaṃ gandharvalokam etena tuṣṭuvānaḥ . yad uśanā kāvyo 'paśyat tasmād auśanam ity ākhyāyate . tat svāraṃ bhavati . svareṇa vai devebhyo 'ntato 'nnādyaṃ pradīyate . ṛksamaṃ pavamānānte bhavati . narcā sāmātirecayanti narcaṃ sāmnā . tad yad iheva ceheva ca pavamane na stuvata etasyaiva samatāyai samaṃ kl̥ptyai . padānusvāraṃ purastād gāyatraṃ bhavati padānusvāram upariṣṭāt pavamānānte . tasmād ubhayataḥprāṇāḥ prajā ūrdhvāś cāvācīś ca . dviṣāmnī gāyatrī . yo 'yam avāṅ prāṇa eṣa eva saḥ . tasmād etena dvayaṃ prāṇena karoti bhasma ca karoti vātaṃ ca . dviṣāmnī bṛhatī . yo 'yaṃ prāṅ prāṇa eṣa eva saḥ . tasmād etena dvayaṃ prāṇena karoti retaś ca siñcati mehati ca . ekasāmnī triṣṭup . nābhir eva sā . tasyām ekaṃ sāma .
sentences: svāyudʰaḥ pavate deva indur aśastihā vr̥janā rakṣamāṇaḥ
pitā devānāṃ janitā sudakṣo viṣṭambʰo divo dʰaruṇaḥ pr̥tʰivyāḥ (RV 9,87,2) iti .
r̥ṣir vipraḥ puraetā janānām r̥bʰur dʰīra uśanā kāvyena
sa cid viveda nihitaṃ yad āsām apīcyaṃ guhyaṃ nāma gonām (RV 9,87,3)
ava paśūn runddʰe bahupaśur bʰavaty etābʰir r̥gbʰis tuṣṭuvānaḥ .
uśanā vai kāvyo deveṣv amartyaṃ gandʰarvalokam aiccʰata .
tato vai sa deveṣv amartyaṃ gandʰarvalokam āśnuta .
aśnute deveṣv amartyaṃ gandʰarvalokam etena tuṣṭuvānaḥ .
yad uśanā kāvyo 'paśyat tasmād auśanam ity ākʰyāyate .
tad yad iheva ceheva ca pavamane na stuvata etasyaiva samatāyai samaṃ kl̥ptyai .
padānusvāraṃ purastād gāyatraṃ bʰavati padānusvāram upariṣṭāt pavamānānte .
tasmād ubʰayataḥprāṇāḥ prajā ūrdʰvāś cāvācīś ca .
yo 'yam avāṅ prāṇa eṣa eva saḥ .
tasmād etena dvayaṃ prāṇena karoti bʰasma ca karoti vātaṃ ca .
yo 'yaṃ prāṅ prāṇa eṣa eva saḥ .
tasmād etena dvayaṃ prāṇena karoti retaś ca siñcati mehati ca .
text: 'svayudhah pavate deva indur asastiha vrjana raksamanah pita devanam janita sudakso vistambho divo dharunah prthivyah' (RV 9.87.2: The self-armed divine drop purifies himself, slaying curses, guarding the people, father of the gods, skilled begetter, the pillar of heaven, the support of earth). They rose up to the pillar of heaven. The asuras could not pass beyond that. With those wish-fulfilling cows they came to the gods. Upon their arrival they were honored: 'rsir viprah pureta jananam rbhur dhira usana kavyena sa cid viveda nihitam yad asam apicyam guhyam nama gonam' (RV 9.87.3: The seer, the inspired one, the leader of the people, the skilful, wise Usanas with his poetic power -- he indeed found what was hidden of those, the secret, concealed name of the cows). These are verses pertaining to cattle. He secures cattle, becomes rich in cattle -- he who praises with these verses. Among them, the ausana. Usanas Kavya desired the immortal gandharva-world among the gods. He saw this saman. He praised with it. Thereby he attained the immortal gandharva-world among the gods. This is a world-finding saman. He attains the immortal gandharva-world among the gods -- he who praises with this. Because Usanas Kavya saw it, it is called ausana. It has the svara. By the svara, food is given to the gods lastly. The rc equals the saman at the end of the pavamana. They do not make the saman exceed the rc, nor the rc the saman. Because they do not praise here and here in the pavamana, it is for this very equality, for balanced arrangement. The gayatra has the padanusvara in front, the padanusvara at the end of the pavamana. Therefore creatures have breath on both sides, both those going up and those going down. The gayatri has two samans. That which is the downward breath -- that is this. Therefore by this breath one does two things: one makes ash and one makes wind. The brhati has two samans. That which is the upward breath -- that is this. Therefore by this breath one does two things: one sheds semen and one urinates. The tristubh has one saman. It is indeed the navel. In it is one saman.
meaning: स्वायुधः पवते देव इन्दुर् अशस्तिहा वृजना रक्षमाणः पिता देवानां जनिता सुदक्षो विष्टम्भो दिवो धरुणः पृथिव्याः (RV ९,८७,२) इति . आ दिवो विष्टम्भम् उच्छिश्रियतुः . तं हैवासुरा नातीयुः . तौ हाभिः कामदुघाभिर् देवान् आजग्मतुः . तौ हागतौ महयां चक्रिरे ऋषिर् विप्रः पुरएता जनानाम् ऋभुर् धीर उशना काव्येन स चिद् विवेद निहितं यद् आसाम् अपीच्यं गुह्यं नाम गोनाम् (RV ९,८७,३) इति . ता एताः पशव्या ऋचः . अव पशून् रुन्द्धे बहुपशुर् भवत्य् एताभिर् ऋग्भिस् तुष्टुवानः . तास्व् औशनम् . उशना वै काव्यो देवेष्व् अमर्त्यं गन्धर्वलोकम् ऐच्छत . स एतत् सामापश्यत् . तेनातुत . ततो वै स देवेष्व् अमर्त्यं गन्धर्वलोकम् आश्नुत . तद् एतल् लोकवित् साम . अश्नुते देवेष्व् अमर्त्यं गन्धर्वलोकम् एतेन तुष्टुवानः . यद् उशना काव्यो ऽपश्यत् तस्माद् औशनम् इत्य् आख्यायते . तत् स्वारं भवति . स्वरेण वै देवेभ्यो ऽन्ततो ऽन्नाद्यं प्रदीयते . ऋक्समं पवमानान्ते भवति . नर्चा सामातिरेचयन्ति नर्चं साम्ना . तद् यद् इहेव चेहेव च पवमने न स्तुवत एतस्यैव समतायै समं क्ल्̥प्त्यै . पदानुस्वारं पुरस्ताद् गायत्रं भवति पदानुस्वारम् उपरिष्टात् पवमानान्ते . तस्माद् उभयतःप्राणाः प्रजा ऊर्ध्वाश् चावाचीश् च . द्विषाम्नी गायत्री . यो ऽयम् अवाङ् प्राण एष एव सः . तस्माद् एतेन द्वयं प्राणेन करोति भस्म च करोति वातं च . द्विषाम्नी बृहती . यो ऽयं प्राङ् प्राण एष एव सः . तस्माद् एतेन द्वयं प्राणेन करोति रेतश् च सिञ्चति मेहति च . एकसाम्नी त्रिष्टुप् . नाभिर् एव सा . तस्याम् एकं साम .

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatir yad bṛhadrathantare asṛjata sa mana evāgre bṛhad apaśyat . vācaṃ rathantaram abhivyāharat . tad yad vācaṃ rathantaram abhivyāharat tasmād rathantaraṃ pūrvaṃ yogam ānaśe . atha yan mano 'gre bṛhad apaśyat tasmād u bṛhadrathantare ity ākhyāyete . mano vai pūrvam atha vāk . mano vai bṛhad vāg rathantaram . ṛg vai rathantaraṃ sāma bṛhat . brahma vai rathantaraṃ kṣatraṃ bṛhat . idaṃ vai rathantaram ado bṛhat . yad vā ejata iva tad rāthantaraṃ yad upasthitaṃ tad bārhatam . ye vā anyatodantāḥ paśavas te rāthantarā ya ubhayatodantās te bārhatāḥ . yā vai tiraścī vidyut sā rāthantarī yordhvā sā bārhatī . rathantarasya mahimnas saṃbhṛtya rathantareṇodgāyet yas te agnau mahimā yas te rathe yas te mahimā stanayitnau ya u te vāte yas te mahimā tena saṃbhava rathantara draviṇasvan na edhi iti .
sentences: prajāpatir yad br̥hadratʰantare asr̥jata sa mana evāgre br̥had apaśyat .
tad yad vācaṃ ratʰantaram abʰivyāharat tasmād ratʰantaraṃ pūrvaṃ yogam ānaśe .
atʰa yan mano 'gre br̥had apaśyat tasmād u br̥hadratʰantare ity ākʰyāyete .
yad vā ejata iva tad rātʰantaraṃ yad upastʰitaṃ tad bārhatam .
ye vā anyatodantāḥ paśavas te rātʰantarā ya ubʰayatodantās te bārhatāḥ .
yā vai tiraścī vidyut sā rātʰantarī yordʰvā sā bārhatī .
ratʰantarasya mahimnas saṃbʰr̥tya ratʰantareṇodgāyet yas te agnau mahimā yas te ratʰe yas te mahimā stanayitnau ya u te vāte yas te mahimā tena saṃbʰava ratʰantara draviṇasvan na edʰi iti .
text: When Prajapati created the brhat and rathantara, he first saw the brhat with the mind. He uttered the rathantara with speech. Because he uttered the rathantara with speech, therefore the rathantara was first yoked. But because he first saw the brhat with the mind, therefore they are called brhad-rathantare (brhat and rathantara). Mind is indeed prior, then speech. Mind is the brhat; speech is the rathantara. The rc is the rathantara; the saman is the brhat. Brahman is the rathantara; ksatra is the brhat. This world is the rathantara; yonder world is the brhat. What trembles, as it were, that is rathantara; what is fixed, that is brhat. Animals with teeth on one side only are rathantara; those with teeth on both sides are brhat. Horizontal lightning is rathantara; vertical lightning is brhat. One should chant the rathantara having gathered together the greatness of the rathantara: 'Whatever greatness of yours is in fire, whatever in the chariot, whatever greatness in thunder, whatever in the wind, whatever is your greatness -- with that come together, O rathantara; become rich in wealth.'
meaning: प्रजापतिर् यद् बृहद्रथन्तरे असृजत स मन एवाग्रे बृहद् अपश्यत् . वाचं रथन्तरम् अभिव्याहरत् . तद् यद् वाचं रथन्तरम् अभिव्याहरत् तस्माद् रथन्तरं पूर्वं योगम् आनशे . अथ यन् मनो ऽग्रे बृहद् अपश्यत् तस्माद् उ बृहद्रथन्तरे इत्य् आख्यायेते . मनो वै पूर्वम् अथ वाक् . मनो वै बृहद् वाग् रथन्तरम् . ऋग् वै रथन्तरं साम बृहत् . ब्रह्म वै रथन्तरं क्षत्रं बृहत् . इदं वै रथन्तरम् अदो बृहत् . यद् वा एजत इव तद् राथन्तरं यद् उपस्थितं तद् बार्हतम् . ये वा अन्यतोदन्ताः पशवस् ते राथन्तरा य उभयतोदन्तास् ते बार्हताः . या वै तिरश्ची विद्युत् सा राथन्तरी योर्ध्वा सा बार्हती . रथन्तरस्य महिम्नस् संभृत्य रथन्तरेणोद्गायेत् यस् ते अग्नौ महिमा यस् ते रथे यस् ते महिमा स्तनयित्नौ य उ ते वाते यस् ते महिमा तेन संभव रथन्तर द्रविणस्वन् न एधि इति .

sanskrit_iast: devāsurā aspardhanta . te devā vajraṃ kṣurapavim asṛjanta puruṣam eva . tam asurān abhyavṛñjan . so 'surān apohya devān abhyāvartata . tasmād devā abibhayuḥ . tam abhipadya bṛhadrathantarayoḥ prauhan . sa eṣa vajraḥ kṣurapavir bṛhadrathantarayoḥ puruṣa eva . sa yaṃ dviṣyād bṛhadrathantarayor enam mukhe 'pidadhyāt . yadi rāthantaras somas syād rathantare prastute brūyāt namo mātre pṛthivyai rathantara mā mā hiṃsīḥ iti . yadi bārhatas somas syād bṛhati prastute brūyāt divaṃ pitaram upaśraye bṛhan mā mā hiṃsīḥ iti . athānumantrayeta prāṇair amuṣya prāṇān vṛṅkṣva . takṣaṇena tekṣaṇīyasāyur asya prāṇān vṛṅkṣva . kruddha enaṃ manyunā daṇḍena jahi . dhanur enam ātatyeṣvā vidhya iti . bṛhadrathantarayor evainaṃ mukhe 'pidadhāti . yaṃ dveṣṭi taṃ purā saṃvatsarāt prāṇo jahāti . yo vai devarathaṃ veda rathī bhavati .
sentences: te devā vajraṃ kṣurapavim asr̥janta puruṣam eva .
sa eṣa vajraḥ kṣurapavir br̥hadratʰantarayoḥ puruṣa eva .
sa yaṃ dviṣyād br̥hadratʰantarayor enam mukʰe 'pidadʰyāt .
yadi rātʰantaras somas syād ratʰantare prastute brūyāt namo mātre pr̥tʰivyai ratʰantara mā mā hiṃsīḥ iti .
yadi bārhatas somas syād br̥hati prastute brūyāt divaṃ pitaram upaśraye br̥han mā mā hiṃsīḥ iti .
yaṃ dveṣṭi taṃ purā saṃvatsarāt prāṇo jahāti .
yo vai devaratʰaṃ veda ratʰī bʰavati .
text: The gods and asuras were in conflict. The gods fashioned the thunderbolt, the razor-edged one -- the person himself. They hurled him against the asuras. He, having driven back the asuras, turned back against the gods. Therefore the gods feared him. Having seized him, they drove him into the brhat and rathantara. This thunderbolt, the razor-edged one in the brhat and rathantara, is the person himself. He whom one hates -- one should place him in the mouth of the brhat and rathantara. If the soma is rathantara, when the rathantara is being praised one should say: 'Homage to mother Earth, O rathantara, do not harm me.' If the soma is brhat, when the brhat is being praised one should say: 'I take refuge in father Heaven, O brhat, do not harm me.' Then one should recite the formula: 'With the vital breaths wrest away the vital breaths of so-and-so. With the axe cut away his life and breaths. Angry, strike him with fury and the rod. Having strung the bow, pierce him with the arrow.' One thereby places him in the mouth of the brhat and rathantara. He whom one hates, him the prana abandons before a year is out. He who knows the divine chariot becomes a charioteer.
meaning: देवासुरा अस्पर्धन्त . ते देवा वज्रं क्षुरपविम् असृजन्त पुरुषम् एव . तम् असुरान् अभ्यवृञ्जन् . सो ऽसुरान् अपोह्य देवान् अभ्यावर्तत . तस्माद् देवा अबिभयुः . तम् अभिपद्य बृहद्रथन्तरयोः प्रौहन् . स एष वज्रः क्षुरपविर् बृहद्रथन्तरयोः पुरुष एव . स यं द्विष्याद् बृहद्रथन्तरयोर् एनम् मुखे ऽपिदध्यात् . यदि राथन्तरस् सोमस् स्याद् रथन्तरे प्रस्तुते ब्रूयात् नमो मात्रे पृथिव्यै रथन्तर मा मा हिंसीः इति . यदि बार्हतस् सोमस् स्याद् बृहति प्रस्तुते ब्रूयात् दिवं पितरम् उपश्रये बृहन् मा मा हिंसीः इति . अथानुमन्त्रयेत प्राणैर् अमुष्य प्राणान् वृङ्क्ष्व . तक्षणेन तेक्षणीयसायुर् अस्य प्राणान् वृङ्क्ष्व . क्रुद्ध एनं मन्युना दण्डेन जहि . धनुर् एनम् आतत्येष्वा विध्य इति . बृहद्रथन्तरयोर् एवैनं मुखे ऽपिदधाति . यं द्वेष्टि तं पुरा संवत्सरात् प्राणो जहाति . यो वै देवरथं वेद रथी भवति .

sanskrit_iast: auśanakāve āṇī naudhasakāleye vandhurādhiṣṭhānaṃ vāmadevyam upastho yajñāyajñīyam adhyāsthātā sa eṣa puruṣaḥ . eṣa vai devarathaḥ . rathī bhavati ya evaṃ veda . yadi rāthantaras somas syād bṛhan nāntaryāt . yadi bārhatas somas syād rathantaraṃ nāntaryāt . ho vai bṛhadrāthantaram . rathantare prastute ho ity uktvādim ādadīta . bṛhad eva tad rathantarasya mukhato yunakti . ā vai rathantaraṃ bārhatam . bṛhati prastute ā ity uktvādim ādadīta . rathantaram eva tad bṛhato mukhato yunakti . asthūriṃ devarathaṃ karoti prati yajñaṃ sthāpayati praty ātmanā tiṣṭhati . eṣa vai devaratho yad rathantaram .
sentences: auśanakāve āṇī naudʰasakāleye vandʰurādʰiṣṭʰānaṃ vāmadevyam upastʰo yajñāyajñīyam adʰyāstʰātā sa eṣa puruṣaḥ .
yadi rātʰantaras somas syād br̥han nāntaryāt .
yadi bārhatas somas syād ratʰantaraṃ nāntaryāt .
ratʰantare prastute ho ity uktvādim ādadīta .
br̥had eva tad ratʰantarasya mukʰato yunakti .
br̥hati prastute ā ity uktvādim ādadīta .
ratʰantaram eva tad br̥hato mukʰato yunakti .
astʰūriṃ devaratʰaṃ karoti prati yajñaṃ stʰāpayati praty ātmanā tiṣṭʰati .
text: The ausana and kavya are the pins; the naudhasa and kaleya are the rail and platform; the vamadeya is the seat; the yajnayajniya is the one who mounts -- that is this person. This is the divine chariot. He becomes a charioteer -- he who knows thus. If the soma is rathantara, one should not omit the brhat. If the soma is brhat, one should not omit the rathantara. 'Ho' belongs to the brhat-rathantara. When the rathantara is being praised, having said 'ho,' one should take up the beginning. One thereby yokes the brhat from the front of the rathantara. 'A' belongs to the rathantara of the brhat. When the brhat is being praised, having said 'a,' one should take up the beginning. One thereby yokes the rathantara from the front of the brhat. One makes the divine chariot smooth; one establishes the sacrifice; one stands firm oneself. This is indeed the divine chariot -- the rathantara.
meaning: औशनकावे आणी नौधसकालेये वन्धुराधिष्ठानं वामदेव्यम् उपस्थो यज्ञायज्ञीयम् अध्यास्थाता स एष पुरुषः . एष वै देवरथः . रथी भवति य एवं वेद . यदि राथन्तरस् सोमस् स्याद् बृहन् नान्तर्यात् . यदि बार्हतस् सोमस् स्याद् रथन्तरं नान्तर्यात् . हो वै बृहद्राथन्तरम् . रथन्तरे प्रस्तुते हो इत्य् उक्त्वादिम् आददीत . बृहद् एव तद् रथन्तरस्य मुखतो युनक्ति . आ वै रथन्तरं बार्हतम् . बृहति प्रस्तुते आ इत्य् उक्त्वादिम् आददीत . रथन्तरम् एव तद् बृहतो मुखतो युनक्ति . अस्थूरिं देवरथं करोति प्रति यज्ञं स्थापयति प्रत्य् आत्मना तिष्ठति . एष वै देवरथो यद् रथन्तरम् .

sanskrit_iast: ekam akṣaraṃ stobhati . tasmād areṇāreṇa rathaḥ pratitiṣṭhann eti . dve akṣare stobhati . dve rathasya pakṣasī . pakṣābhyām eva tad devarathaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati . trīṇy akṣarāṇi stobhati . dvipād vai yajamāna ātmā tṛtīyaḥ . yajamāna eva tat pratitiṣṭhati . atho traya ime lokāḥ . tān eva tad āpnoti . catvāry akṣarāṇi stobhati . catasro diśaś catuṣpādāḥ paśavaḥ . dikṣu caitat paśuṣu ca pratitiṣṭhati . pañcākṣarāṇi stobhati . pāṅkto yajñaḥ pāṅktāḥ paśavaḥ . yajñe caitat paśuṣu ca pratitiṣṭhati . ṣaḍ akṣarāṇi stobhati . ṣaḍ vā ṛtavaḥ . ṛtuṣv eva tat pratitiṣṭhati . atho ṣaḍ vai chandāṃsi . tāny eva tad āpnoti . saptākṣarāṇi stobhati . saptapadā vai śakvaryaḥ . śākvarāḥ paśavaḥ . paśuṣv eva tac chakvaryāṃ pratitiṣṭhati . atho sapta caturuttarāṇi chandāṃsi sapta mukhyāḥ prāṇāḥ . tāny eva tad āpnoti . aṣṭāv akṣarāṇi stobhati . aṣṭākṣarā vai gāyatrī . tejo brahmavarcasaṃ gāyatrī . tejasy eva tad brahmavarcase pratitiṣṭhati .
sentences: atʰo sapta caturuttarāṇi cʰandāṃsi sapta mukʰyāḥ prāṇāḥ .
text: One inserts one syllable as a stobha. Therefore a chariot goes along resting on each point. Two syllables as stobha. Two are the sides of the chariot. By the two sides one thereby establishes the divine chariot. Three syllables as stobha. The sacrificer is two-footed; the self is the third. The sacrificer thereby finds firm foundation. Also, three are these worlds; one thereby attains them. Four syllables as stobha. Four are the directions; four-footed are the animals. One thereby finds firm foundation in the directions and in cattle. Five syllables as stobha. The sacrifice is fivefold; cattle are fivefold. One thereby finds firm foundation in the sacrifice and in cattle. Six syllables as stobha. Six are the seasons. One thereby finds firm foundation in the seasons. Also, six are the metres; one thereby attains them. Seven syllables as stobha. The sakvaryas have seven feet. Sakvara animals are cattle. One thereby finds firm foundation in cattle, in the sakvari. Also, seven are the metres increasing by four; seven are the chief vital breaths. One thereby attains them. Eight syllables as stobha. The gayatri has eight syllables. The gayatri is tejas and brahmavarcas. One thereby finds firm foundation in tejas and brahmavarcas.
meaning: एकम् अक्षरं स्तोभति . तस्माद् अरेणारेण रथः प्रतितिष्ठन्न् एति . द्वे अक्षरे स्तोभति . द्वे रथस्य पक्षसी . पक्षाभ्याम् एव तद् देवरथं प्रतिष्ठापयति . त्रीण्य् अक्षराणि स्तोभति . द्विपाद् वै यजमान आत्मा तृतीयः . यजमान एव तत् प्रतितिष्ठति . अथो त्रय इमे लोकाः . तान् एव तद् आप्नोति . चत्वार्य् अक्षराणि स्तोभति . चतस्रो दिशश् चतुष्पादाः पशवः . दिक्षु चैतत् पशुषु च प्रतितिष्ठति . पञ्चाक्षराणि स्तोभति . पाङ्क्तो यज्ञः पाङ्क्ताः पशवः . यज्ञे चैतत् पशुषु च प्रतितिष्ठति . षड् अक्षराणि स्तोभति . षड् वा ऋतवः . ऋतुष्व् एव तत् प्रतितिष्ठति . अथो षड् वै छन्दांसि . तान्य् एव तद् आप्नोति . सप्ताक्षराणि स्तोभति . सप्तपदा वै शक्वर्यः . शाक्वराः पशवः . पशुष्व् एव तच् छक्वर्यां प्रतितिष्ठति . अथो सप्त चतुरुत्तराणि छन्दांसि सप्त मुख्याः प्राणाः . तान्य् एव तद् आप्नोति . अष्टाव् अक्षराणि स्तोभति . अष्टाक्षरा वै गायत्री . तेजो ब्रह्मवर्चसं गायत्री . तेजस्य् एव तद् ब्रह्मवर्चसे प्रतितिष्ठति .

sanskrit_iast: navākṣarāṇi stobhati . nava vai puruṣe prāṇāḥ . prāṇān evaitad dviṣato bhrātṛvyasya vṛñjyāt . prāṇān ātman dhatte . atho trivṛta eva stomasya stotram āpnoti . daśākṣarāṇi stobhati . daśākṣarā virāḍ annaṃ virāṭ . virājy eva tad annādye pratitiṣṭhati . atho daśa prāṇāḥ . tān eva tad āpnoti . ekādaśākṣarāṇi stobhati . ekādaśākṣarā triṣṭup . indriyaṃ vīryaṃ triṣṭup . indriya eva tad vīrye pratitiṣṭhati . dvādaśākṣarāṇi stobhati . dvādaśākṣarā vai jagatī . paśavo jagatī . paśuṣv eva taj jagatyāṃ pratitiṣṭhati . atho dvādaśa māsāḥ . tān eva tad āpnoti . trayodaśākṣarāṇi stobhati . ya evāsāv adhicaras trayodaśo māsa tam eva tad āpnoti . caturdaśākṣarāṇi stobhati . saṃvatsaro vai caturdaśaḥ . saṃvatsara eva tat pratitiṣṭhati . pañcadaśākṣarāṇi stobhati . pañcadaśa vā ardhamāsasya rātrayaḥ . ardhamāsaśa eva saṃvatsaram āpnoti . ṣoḍaśākṣarāṇi stobhati . ṣoḍaśakalo vai puruṣaḥ . kalā eva tad dviṣantaṃ pāpmānaṃ bhrātṛvyam avāñcam apavahanti śriyam ātmanāśnute . atho ṣoḍaśina eva stobhasya stotram āpnoti . saptadaśākṣarāṇi stobhati . prajāpatir vai saptadaśaḥ .
sentences: atʰo trivr̥ta eva stomasya stotram āpnoti .
ya evāsāv adʰicaras trayodaśo māsa tam eva tad āpnoti .
kalā eva tad dviṣantaṃ pāpmānaṃ bʰrātr̥vyam avāñcam apavahanti śriyam ātmanāśnute .
atʰo ṣoḍaśina eva stobʰasya stotram āpnoti .
text: Nine syllables as stobha. Nine are the vital breaths in a person. One thereby wrests away the vital breaths of the hating rival. One places the vital breaths in oneself. Also, one thereby attains the trivrt stoma stotra. Ten syllables as stobha. The viraj has ten syllables; food is the viraj. One thereby finds firm foundation in the viraj, in food. Also, ten are the vital breaths; one thereby attains them. Eleven syllables as stobha. The tristubh has eleven syllables. Indra-power and heroic strength are the tristubh. One thereby finds firm foundation in Indra-power and heroic strength. Twelve syllables as stobha. The jagati has twelve syllables. Cattle are the jagati. One thereby finds firm foundation in cattle, in the jagati. Also, twelve are the months; one thereby attains them. Thirteen syllables as stobha. That intercalary thirteenth month -- one thereby attains it. Fourteen syllables as stobha. The year is indeed the fourteenth. One thereby finds firm foundation in the year. Fifteen syllables as stobha. Fifteen are the nights of the half-month. One thereby attains the year by half-months. Sixteen syllables as stobha. The person has sixteen parts. The parts carry the hating, evil rival downward; one oneself attains glory. Also, one thereby attains the sodasin stoma stotra. Seventeen syllables as stobha. Prajapati is indeed the seventeenth.
meaning: नवाक्षराणि स्तोभति . नव वै पुरुषे प्राणाः . प्राणान् एवैतद् द्विषतो भ्रातृव्यस्य वृञ्ज्यात् . प्राणान् आत्मन् धत्ते . अथो त्रिवृत एव स्तोमस्य स्तोत्रम् आप्नोति . दशाक्षराणि स्तोभति . दशाक्षरा विराड् अन्नं विराट् . विराज्य् एव तद् अन्नाद्ये प्रतितिष्ठति . अथो दश प्राणाः . तान् एव तद् आप्नोति . एकादशाक्षराणि स्तोभति . एकादशाक्षरा त्रिष्टुप् . इन्द्रियं वीर्यं त्रिष्टुप् . इन्द्रिय एव तद् वीर्ये प्रतितिष्ठति . द्वादशाक्षराणि स्तोभति . द्वादशाक्षरा वै जगती . पशवो जगती . पशुष्व् एव तज् जगत्यां प्रतितिष्ठति . अथो द्वादश मासाः . तान् एव तद् आप्नोति . त्रयोदशाक्षराणि स्तोभति . य एवासाव् अधिचरस् त्रयोदशो मास तम् एव तद् आप्नोति . चतुर्दशाक्षराणि स्तोभति . संवत्सरो वै चतुर्दशः . संवत्सर एव तत् प्रतितिष्ठति . पञ्चदशाक्षराणि स्तोभति . पञ्चदश वा अर्धमासस्य रात्रयः . अर्धमासश एव संवत्सरम् आप्नोति . षोडशाक्षराणि स्तोभति . षोडशकलो वै पुरुषः . कला एव तद् द्विषन्तं पाप्मानं भ्रातृव्यम् अवाञ्चम् अपवहन्ति श्रियम् आत्मनाश्नुते . अथो षोडशिन एव स्तोभस्य स्तोत्रम् आप्नोति . सप्तदशाक्षराणि स्तोभति . प्रजापतिर् वै सप्तदशः .

sanskrit_iast: etad anyat stobhet . ṛcam eva na gāyet . sa yad ṛcam eva gāyati tena rathantarasya rūpān naiti . ṛg ghi rathantaraṃ sāma bṛhat . yady u stobhed aṣṭāv evākṣarāṇi stobhet . tad v eva saṃmīlate . svar dṛśaṃ prativipaśyec cakṣuṣo 'pravarhāya . yad īśānam indra iti pratihared īśāno yajamānasya paśūn abhimānukas syāt . atha yat śānam indra iti pratiharati neśāno yajamānasya paśūn abhimanyate śāntāḥ prajā edhante . pratihārepratihāra udgāta il̥ā it brūyāt . paśavo vā il̥āyatanaṃ rathantaram . āyatana eva tad etān paśūn pratiṣṭhāpayati . nasthuṣaḥ iti brūyāt . yat tasthuṣaḥ iti brūyāt sthāyukāsya śrīs syāt . atha yat nasthuṣaḥ ity āha nāsya śrīs tiṣthati paśavo 'sya svāyātena yānti . bṛhadrathantare vyāvartayet . yad dha vai bṛhadrathantare na vyāvartayed yathā mahāvṛkṣau samṛtya śākhā vipariśṛṇīta evaṃ prajāḥ paśūn vipariśṛṇīyātām . ho vā hā vai bṛhad o vā hā rathantaram .
sentences: sa yad r̥cam eva gāyati tena ratʰantarasya rūpān naiti .
yady u stobʰed aṣṭāv evākṣarāṇi stobʰet .
yad īśānam indra iti pratihared īśāno yajamānasya paśūn abʰimānukas syāt .
atʰa yat śānam indra iti pratiharati neśāno yajamānasya paśūn abʰimanyate śāntāḥ prajā edʰante .
āyatana eva tad etān paśūn pratiṣṭʰāpayati .
yat tastʰuṣaḥ iti brūyāt stʰāyukāsya śrīs syāt .
atʰa yat nastʰuṣaḥ ity āha nāsya śrīs tiṣtʰati paśavo 'sya svāyātena yānti .
yad dʰa vai br̥hadratʰantare na vyāvartayed yatʰā mahāvr̥kṣau samr̥tya śākʰā vipariśr̥ṇīta evaṃ prajāḥ paśūn vipariśr̥ṇīyātām .
ho vā hā vai br̥had o vā hā ratʰantaram .
text: One should insert something else as stobha but should not sing the rc itself. For if one sings the rc itself, one thereby does not depart from the form of the rathantara. For the rc is the rathantara, the saman is the brhat. If one inserts stobha, one should insert exactly eight syllables. That too comes together. One should look back at the sun so as not to lose sight. If one should perform the pratihara with 'isanam indra' (O ruling Indra), the ruler would be hostile to the sacrificer's cattle. But since one performs the pratihara with 'sanam indra' (O peaceful Indra), the ruler is not hostile to the sacrificer's cattle; creatures thrive in peace. At each pratihara the udgatr should say 'ila' (refreshment). Cattle are indeed ila; the rathantara is the abode. One thereby establishes these cattle in their abode. One should say 'nasthusah' (not standing). If one were to say 'tasthusah' (standing), one's prosperity would be stationary. But when one says 'nasthusah,' one's prosperity does not stand still; one's cattle go by their own path. One should differentiate the brhat and rathantara. If one were not to differentiate the brhat and rathantara, it would be as if two great trees meeting were to break each other's branches -- so would offspring and cattle be broken. 'Ho va ha' is indeed the brhat; 'o va ha' is the rathantara.
meaning: एतद् अन्यत् स्तोभेत् . ऋचम् एव न गायेत् . स यद् ऋचम् एव गायति तेन रथन्तरस्य रूपान् नैति . ऋग् घि रथन्तरं साम बृहत् . यद्य् उ स्तोभेद् अष्टाव् एवाक्षराणि स्तोभेत् . तद् व् एव संमीलते . स्वर् दृशं प्रतिविपश्येच् चक्षुषो ऽप्रवर्हाय . यद् ईशानम् इन्द्र इति प्रतिहरेद् ईशानो यजमानस्य पशून् अभिमानुकस् स्यात् . अथ यत् शानम् इन्द्र इति प्रतिहरति नेशानो यजमानस्य पशून् अभिमन्यते शान्ताः प्रजा एधन्ते . प्रतिहारेप्रतिहार उद्गात इल्̥आ इत् ब्रूयात् . पशवो वा इल्̥आयतनं रथन्तरम् . आयतन एव तद् एतान् पशून् प्रतिष्ठापयति . नस्थुषः इति ब्रूयात् . यत् तस्थुषः इति ब्रूयात् स्थायुकास्य श्रीस् स्यात् . अथ यत् नस्थुषः इत्य् आह नास्य श्रीस् तिष्थति पशवो ऽस्य स्वायातेन यान्ति . बृहद्रथन्तरे व्यावर्तयेत् . यद् ध वै बृहद्रथन्तरे न व्यावर्तयेद् यथा महावृक्षौ समृत्य शाखा विपरिशृणीत एवं प्रजाः पशून् विपरिशृणीयाताम् . हो वा हा वै बृहद् ओ वा हा रथन्तरम् .

sanskrit_iast: yathā syād evaṃ bubhūṣann upeyāt . yathā syād evaṃ bhrātṛvyavān . jayaty ātmanā parāsya dviṣan bhrātṛvyo bhavati ya evaṃ veda . bṛhadrathantare yad asṛjyetāṃ tābhyām bhīṣā prajāḥ paśava udavepanta . te ātmānam eva paryaikṣetāṃ kiṃ nu nāv idaṃ krūraṃ ivātmano yasmād bhīṣā prajāḥ paśava udavepiṣateti . te nidhane evāpaśyatām . te araṇye nidhāya grāmam abhyavaitām . tad eva svakṛtam iriṇam abhavat . tasmād āhur na svakṛtam iriṇam adhyavaseyam . īśvaraḥ pāpīyān bhavitor yat svakṛtam iriṇam adhyavasyatīti . bṛhadrathantarayor ha vā etan nidhanābhyāṃ nirdagdham . te ha vā ete grāmageye evāpanidhane yad bṛhadrathantare .
sentences: jayaty ātmanā parāsya dviṣan bʰrātr̥vyo bʰavati ya evaṃ veda .
br̥hadratʰantare yad asr̥jyetāṃ tābʰyām bʰīṣā prajāḥ paśava udavepanta .
te ātmānam eva paryaikṣetāṃ kiṃ nu nāv idaṃ krūraṃ ivātmano yasmād bʰīṣā prajāḥ paśava udavepiṣateti .
tasmād āhur na svakr̥tam iriṇam adʰyavaseyam .
īśvaraḥ pāpīyān bʰavitor yat svakr̥tam iriṇam adʰyavasyatīti .
br̥hadratʰantarayor ha vā etan nidʰanābʰyāṃ nirdagdʰam .
te ha vā ete grāmageye evāpanidʰane yad br̥hadratʰantare .
text: One who desires to become should approach accordingly. One who has a rival should approach accordingly. He prevails himself; his hating rival is defeated -- he who knows thus. When the brhat and rathantara were created, creatures and cattle trembled with fear of them. They examined themselves: 'What is this cruel thing about us that creatures and cattle trembled with fear?' They found it was in the nidhanas. Having deposited the nidhanas in the wilderness, they went to the village. That very place became a self-made desert. Therefore they say: 'One should not settle on a self-made desert. One is liable to become worse who settles on a self-made desert.' For it was burned by the nidhanas of the brhat and rathantara. These brhat and rathantara, when sung in the village, have their nidhanas removed.
meaning: यथा स्याद् एवं बुभूषन्न् उपेयात् . यथा स्याद् एवं भ्रातृव्यवान् . जयत्य् आत्मना परास्य द्विषन् भ्रातृव्यो भवति य एवं वेद . बृहद्रथन्तरे यद् असृज्येतां ताभ्याम् भीषा प्रजाः पशव उदवेपन्त . ते आत्मानम् एव पर्यैक्षेतां किं नु नाव् इदं क्रूरं इवात्मनो यस्माद् भीषा प्रजाः पशव उदवेपिषतेति . ते निधने एवापश्यताम् . ते अरण्ये निधाय ग्रामम् अभ्यवैताम् . तद् एव स्वकृतम् इरिणम् अभवत् . तस्माद् आहुर् न स्वकृतम् इरिणम् अध्यवसेयम् . ईश्वरः पापीयान् भवितोर् यत् स्वकृतम् इरिणम् अध्यवस्यतीति . बृहद्रथन्तरयोर् ह वा एतन् निधनाभ्यां निर्दग्धम् . ते ह वा एते ग्रामगेये एवापनिधने यद् बृहद्रथन्तरे .

sanskrit_iast: aṣṭākṣareṇa prastauti . dvyakṣareṇottare prastauty abhikrāntyā anapabhraṃśāya . aṣṭākṣareṇa prastauti . dvyakṣareṇottare prastauti . dvipādam eva tad aṣṭāśapheṣu paśuṣv adhyūhati . tasmād dvipād aṣṭāśaphān paśūn adhitiṣṭhati . aṣṭāksareṇa prastauti . dvyakṣareṇottare dve prastauti . tad dvādaśa saṃpadyante . dvādaśa māsās saṃvatsaraḥ . saṃvatsaraḥ prajāpatir yajñaḥ . saṃvatsaram evaitena prajāpatiṃ yajñam āpnoti . akṣareṣṭhaṃ rathantaraṃ karoti . tasmād areṇāreṇa rathaḥ pratitiṣṭhann eti . rathantareṇa vai devā saṃvicya bṛhatā jālenevābhinyaubjan . rathantareṇaiva dviṣantaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ saṃvicya bṛhatā jālenevābhinyubjati ya evaṃ veda . rathantareṇa vai devā ūrdhvās svargaṃ lokam āyan . tāny asurarakṣasāni nava navataya imān lokān avṛṇvan . rathā ha nāmāsuḥ . te devā rathantareṇaiva stutvā rathantaraṃ samāruhya svargaṃ lokam agacchan . te 'bruvann atāriṣma vā imān rathān iti . tad eva rathantarasya rathantaratvam .
sentences: dvipādam eva tad aṣṭāśapʰeṣu paśuṣv adʰyūhati .
ratʰantareṇa vai devā saṃvicya br̥hatā jālenevābʰinyaubjan .
ratʰantareṇaiva dviṣantaṃ bʰrātr̥vyaṃ saṃvicya br̥hatā jālenevābʰinyubjati ya evaṃ veda .
ratʰantareṇa vai devā ūrdʰvās svargaṃ lokam āyan .
tāny asurarakṣasāni nava navataya imān lokān avr̥ṇvan .
te devā ratʰantareṇaiva stutvā ratʰantaraṃ samāruhya svargaṃ lokam agaccʰan .
te 'bruvann atāriṣma vā imān ratʰān iti .
