sanskrit_iast: tad u hovāca jānaśruteyo vīryaṃ vā etat sāmno yan nidhanam . tad vikṣubhnuyus tad viyuñjyur yan nānopeyuḥ . sārdham evopetyāni sāmnaḥ savīryatvāyeti . tāni caturakṣarāṇi bhavanti . yāś catasro diśo 'smin loke tāsu sarvāsu pratitiṣṭhāma yāś catasro diśo 'ntarikṣe loke tāsu sarvāsu pratitiṣṭhāma yāś catasro 'muṣmin loke tāsu sarvāsu pratitiṣṭhāmeti . aurdhvasadmanena ha khalu vai rātriḥ pṛṣṭhinīdaṃ vai rathantaram antarikṣaṃ vāmadevyam ada eva bṛhat . ya u ha vā eṣāṃ lokānāṃ śreṣṭhās te pṛṣṭhāni . teṣām eko bhavati ya evaṃ veda . prajātir ha khalu vā ūrdhvasama .
sentences: tad u hovāca jānaśruteyo vīryaṃ vā etat sāmno yan nidʰanam .
tad vikṣubʰnuyus tad viyuñjyur yan nānopeyuḥ .
yāś catasro diśo 'smin loke tāsu sarvāsu pratitiṣṭʰāma yāś catasro diśo 'ntarikṣe loke tāsu sarvāsu pratitiṣṭʰāma yāś catasro 'muṣmin loke tāsu sarvāsu pratitiṣṭʰāmeti .
aurdʰvasadmanena ha kʰalu vai rātriḥ pr̥ṣṭʰinīdaṃ vai ratʰantaram antarikṣaṃ vāmadevyam ada eva br̥hat .
ya u ha vā eṣāṃ lokānāṃ śreṣṭʰās te pr̥ṣṭʰāni .
teṣām eko bʰavati ya evaṃ veda .
text: But Jānaśruteya said: 'The power of the sāman is indeed the nidhana. They would weaken it, they would unyoke it, if they were to approach the nidhanas separately. They should be approached together, for the full power of the sāman.' These have four syllables each. 'In all the four quarters of this world may we be established, in all the four quarters of the atmospheric world may we be established, in all the four quarters of the yonder world may we be established.' By the aurdhvasadmana indeed the night has pṛṣṭha-sāmans. This world is the rathantara, the atmosphere is the vāmadevya, that yonder world is the bṛhat. Those who are the foremost of these worlds are the pṛṣṭhas. He who knows thus becomes one of them. The ūrdhvasama is indeed a producer of offspring.
meaning: तद् उ होवाच जानश्रुतेयो वीर्यं वा एतत् साम्नो यन् निधनम् . तद् विक्षुभ्नुयुस् तद् वियुञ्ज्युर् यन् नानोपेयुः . सार्धम् एवोपेत्यानि साम्नः सवीर्यत्वायेति . तानि चतुरक्षराणि भवन्ति . याश् चतस्रो दिशो ऽस्मिन् लोके तासु सर्वासु प्रतितिष्ठाम याश् चतस्रो दिशो ऽन्तरिक्षे लोके तासु सर्वासु प्रतितिष्ठाम याश् चतस्रो ऽमुष्मिन् लोके तासु सर्वासु प्रतितिष्ठामेति . और्ध्वसद्मनेन ह खलु वै रात्रिः पृष्ठिनीदं वै रथन्तरम् अन्तरिक्षं वामदेव्यम् अद एव बृहत् . य उ ह वा एषां लोकानां श्रेष्ठास् ते पृष्ठानि . तेषाम् एको भवति य एवं वेद . प्रजातिर् ह खलु वा ऊर्ध्वसम .

sanskrit_iast: ā tū na indra kṣumantam iti vaiṇavam.veṇur vai vaiśvāmitro 'kāmayatāgryo mukhyo brahmavarcasī syām iti . sa etat sāmāpaśyat . tenāstuta . tato vai so 'gryo mukhyo brahmavarcasy abhavat . agryo mukhyo brahmavarcasī bhavati ya evaṃ veda . yad veṇur vaiśvāmitro 'paśyat tasmād vaiṇavam ity ākhyāyate . tad v evācakṣata āpālam iti . apālā ha vā ātreyī tilakā vāruśchavir vāpy āsa . sākāmayatāpa pāpaṃ varṇaṃ hanīyeti . saitat sāmāpaśyat . tenāstuta . sā tīrtham abhyavayatī somāṃśum avindat . taṃ samakhādat . tasyai ha grāvāṇa iva dantā ūduḥ . sa indra ādravad grāvāṇo vai vadantīti . sābhivyāharat kanyā vār avāyatī somam api srutāvidat astaṃ bharanty abravīd indrāya sunavai tvā śakrāya sunavai tvā iti . asyai vā idaṃ grāvāṇa iva dantā vadantīti viditvendraḥ parāṅ āvartata . tam abravīd asau ya eṣi vīrako gṛhaṃ-gṛhaṃ vicākaśat imaṃ jambhasutaṃ piba dhānāvantaṃ karambhiṇam apūpavantam ukthinam iti . anādriyamāṇaivaitam abravīd ā cana tvā cikitsāmo 'dhi cana tvā nemasi iti . purā mā sārdhayarcāpālā stautīty apaparyāvartata . śanair iva śanakair ivendrāyendo pari srava ity evāsyai mukhāt somaṃ niradhayat .
sentences: ā tū na indra kṣumantam iti vaiṇavam.veṇur vai vaiśvāmitro 'kāmayatāgryo mukʰyo brahmavarcasī syām iti .
tato vai so 'gryo mukʰyo brahmavarcasy abʰavat .
agryo mukʰyo brahmavarcasī bʰavati ya evaṃ veda .
yad veṇur vaiśvāmitro 'paśyat tasmād vaiṇavam ity ākʰyāyate .
apālā ha vā ātreyī tilakā vāruścʰavir vāpy āsa .
tasyai ha grāvāṇa iva dantā ūduḥ .
sa indra ādravad grāvāṇo vai vadantīti .
kanyā vār avāyatī somam api srutāvidat
astaṃ bʰaranty abravīd indrāya sunavai tvā śakrāya sunavai tvā
asyai vā idaṃ grāvāṇa iva dantā vadantīti viditvendraḥ parāṅ āvartata .
asau ya eṣi vīrako gr̥haṃ-gr̥haṃ vicākaśat
