text: 'ā tū na indra kṣumantam' — this is the vaiṇava. Veṇu Vaiśvāmitra desired: 'May I be foremost, chief, and possessed of brahma-radiance.' He saw this sāman. He praised with it. From that he became foremost, chief, and possessed of brahma-radiance. He who knows thus becomes foremost, chief, and possessed of brahma-radiance. Because Veṇu Vaiśvāmitra saw it, therefore it is called vaiṇava. They also call it the āpāla. Apālā Ātreyī was afflicted with a skin disease (tilaka) or had a rough complexion. She desired: 'May I remove the bad complexion.' She saw this sāman. She praised with it. While going down to a ford, she found a soma shoot. She chewed it. Her teeth pressed it like pressing stones. Indra came running, thinking: 'Pressing stones are sounding!' She spoke forth: 'A maiden going to the water found a soma shoot already flowing. Carrying it home she said: I shall press you for Indra, I shall press you for Śakra.' 'This one's teeth sound like pressing stones!' — thus knowing, Indra turned away. She said to him: 'You there, you hero who go gazing from house to house — drink this pressed by teeth, with grain, with gruel, with cake, rich in praise.' Undaunted, she said: 'We do not harm you, nor do we spite you.' 'Before she overwhelms me with her praise, Apālā is praising me!' — he turned back. 'Slowly, slowly, O drop, flow around for Indra' — thus he sucked the soma from her mouth.
meaning: आ तू न इन्द्र क्षुमन्तम् इति वैणवम्.वेणुर् वै वैश्वामित्रो ऽकामयताग्र्यो मुख्यो ब्रह्मवर्चसी स्याम् इति . स एतत् सामापश्यत् . तेनास्तुत . ततो वै सो ऽग्र्यो मुख्यो ब्रह्मवर्चस्य् अभवत् . अग्र्यो मुख्यो ब्रह्मवर्चसी भवति य एवं वेद . यद् वेणुर् वैश्वामित्रो ऽपश्यत् तस्माद् वैणवम् इत्य् आख्यायते . तद् व् एवाचक्षत आपालम् इति . अपाला ह वा आत्रेयी तिलका वारुश्छविर् वाप्य् आस . साकामयताप पापं वर्णं हनीयेति . सैतत् सामापश्यत् . तेनास्तुत . सा तीर्थम् अभ्यवयती सोमांशुम् अविन्दत् . तं समखादत् . तस्यै ह ग्रावाण इव दन्ता ऊदुः . स इन्द्र आद्रवद् ग्रावाणो वै वदन्तीति . साभिव्याहरत् कन्या वार् अवायती सोमम् अपि स्रुताविदत् अस्तं भरन्त्य् अब्रवीद् इन्द्राय सुनवै त्वा शक्राय सुनवै त्वा इति . अस्यै वा इदं ग्रावाण इव दन्ता वदन्तीति विदित्वेन्द्रः पराङ् आवर्तत . तम् अब्रवीद् असौ य एषि वीरको गृहं-गृहं विचाकशत् इमं जम्भसुतं पिब धानावन्तं करम्भिणम् अपूपवन्तम् उक्थिनम् इति . अनाद्रियमाणैवैतम् अब्रवीद् आ चन त्वा चिकित्सामो ऽधि चन त्वा नेमसि इति . पुरा मा सार्धयर्चापाला स्तौतीत्य् अपपर्यावर्तत . शनैर् इव शनकैर् इवेन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव इत्य् एवास्यै मुखात् सोमं निरधयत् .

sanskrit_iast: tām abravīd apāle kiṃkāmāsīti . sābravīd imāni trīṇi viṣṭapā tānīndra vi rohaya śiras tatasyorvarām ād idaṃ ma upodire sarvā tā romaśā kṛdhi iti . khalatir hāsyai pitāsa . taṃ hākhalatiṃ cakāra . urvarā hāsya na jajñe . so ha jajñe . upasthe hāsyai romāṇi nāsuḥ . tāny u ha jajñire . tāṃ khe rathasyātyabṛhat . sā godhābhavat . tāṃ khe 'naso 'tyabṛhat . sā kṛkalāsy abhavat . tāṃ khe yugasyātyabṛhat . sā saṃśliṣṭikābhavat . tad eṣābhyanūcyate khe rathasya khe 'nasaḥ khe yugasya śatakrato apālām indra triṣ pūtvy akṛṇoḥ sūryatvacam iti . tasyai ha yat kalyāṇatamaṃ rūpāṇāṃ tad rūpam āsa . tad etat kāmasani sāma . etaṃ vai sā kāmam akāmayata . so 'syai kāmaḥ samārdhyata . yatkāma evaitena sāmnā stute sam asmai sa kāma ṛdhyate .
sentences: imāni trīṇi viṣṭapā tānīndra vi rohaya
śiras tatasyorvarām ād idaṃ ma upodire
kʰe ratʰasya kʰe 'nasaḥ kʰe yugasya śatakrato
apālām indra triṣ pūtvy akr̥ṇoḥ sūryatvacam
tasyai ha yat kalyāṇatamaṃ rūpāṇāṃ tad rūpam āsa .
yatkāma evaitena sāmnā stute sam asmai sa kāma r̥dʰyate .
text: He said to her: 'Apālā, what do you desire?' She said: 'These three surfaces — O Indra, make them grow: the head of my father, his field, and this area of mine below — make all those hairy.' For her father was bald. He made him not-bald. His field had not grown. It then grew. On her body below, hair had not grown. It then grew. He drew her through the hole of the chariot. She became a chameleon (godhā). He drew her through the hole of the cart. She became a lizard (kṛkalāsī). He drew her through the hole of the yoke. She became a saṃśliṣṭikā (shed-skin). Thus is this recited about her: 'Through the hole of the chariot, the hole of the cart, the hole of the yoke, O Śatakratu, you purified Apālā three times, making her sun-skinned.' Of her forms, the most beautiful became her form. This is a desire-fulfilling sāman. She desired this desire. That desire was fulfilled for her. Whatever desire one has when praising with this sāman, that desire is fulfilled for him.
meaning: ताम् अब्रवीद् अपाले किंकामासीति . साब्रवीद् इमानि त्रीणि विष्टपा तानीन्द्र वि रोहय शिरस् ततस्योर्वराम् आद् इदं म उपोदिरे सर्वा ता रोमशा कृधि इति . खलतिर् हास्यै पितास . तं हाखलतिं चकार . उर्वरा हास्य न जज्ञे . सो ह जज्ञे . उपस्थे हास्यै रोमाणि नासुः . तान्य् उ ह जज्ञिरे . तां खे रथस्यात्यबृहत् . सा गोधाभवत् . तां खे ऽनसो ऽत्यबृहत् . सा कृकलास्य् अभवत् . तां खे युगस्यात्यबृहत् . सा संश्लिष्टिकाभवत् . तद् एषाभ्यनूच्यते खे रथस्य खे ऽनसः खे युगस्य शतक्रतो अपालाम् इन्द्र त्रिष् पूत्व्य् अकृणोः सूर्यत्वचम् इति . तस्यै ह यत् कल्याणतमं रूपाणां तद् रूपम् आस . तद् एतत् कामसनि साम . एतं वै सा कामम् अकामयत . सो ऽस्यै कामः समार्ध्यत . यत्काम एवैतेन साम्ना स्तुते सम् अस्मै स काम ऋध्यते .

sanskrit_iast: abhi tvā vṛṣabhā sute ity ārṣabham . indro vā akāmayatarṣabhaḥ sarvāsāṃ prajānāṃ syām ṛṣabhatāṃ gaccheyam iti . sa etat sāmāpaśyat . tenāstuta . tato vai sa ṛṣabhaḥ sarvāsāṃ prajānām abhavad ṛṣabhatāṃ agacchat . tad evārṣabhasyārṣabhatvam . ṛṣabha eva svānāṃ bhavaty ṛṣabhatāṃ gacchati ya evaṃ veda . tad v evācakṣate daivodāsam iti . divodāso vai vādhryaśvir akāmayatobhayaṃ brahma ca kṣatraṃ cāvarundhīya rājā sann ṛṣiḥ syām iti . sa etat sāmāpaśyat . tenāstuta . tato vai sa ubhayaṃ brahma ca kṣatraṃ cāvārunddha rājā sann ṛṣir abhavat . ubhayam eva brahma ca kṣatraṃ cāvarunddhe rājā sann ṛṣir bhavati ya evaṃ veda .
sentences: abʰi tvā vr̥ṣabʰā sute ity ārṣabʰam .
indro vā akāmayatarṣabʰaḥ sarvāsāṃ prajānāṃ syām r̥ṣabʰatāṃ gaccʰeyam iti .
tato vai sa r̥ṣabʰaḥ sarvāsāṃ prajānām abʰavad r̥ṣabʰatāṃ agaccʰat .
r̥ṣabʰa eva svānāṃ bʰavaty r̥ṣabʰatāṃ gaccʰati ya evaṃ veda .
divodāso vai vādʰryaśvir akāmayatobʰayaṃ brahma ca kṣatraṃ cāvarundʰīya rājā sann r̥ṣiḥ syām iti .
tato vai sa ubʰayaṃ brahma ca kṣatraṃ cāvārunddʰa rājā sann r̥ṣir abʰavat .
ubʰayam eva brahma ca kṣatraṃ cāvarunddʰe rājā sann r̥ṣir bʰavati ya evaṃ veda .
text: 'abhi tvā vṛṣabhā sute' — this is the ārṣabha. Indra desired: 'May I be the bull of all creatures, may I attain bull-hood.' He saw this sāman. He praised with it. From that he became the bull of all creatures and attained bull-hood. That is the ārṣabha-nature of the ārṣabha. He who knows thus becomes the bull among his own people and attains bull-hood. They also call it the daivodāsa. Divodāsa Vādhryaśvi desired: 'May I secure both brahman and kṣatra, being a king may I become a ṛṣi.' He saw this sāman. He praised with it. From that he secured both brahman and kṣatra; being a king he became a ṛṣi. He who knows thus secures both brahman and kṣatra; being a king he becomes a ṛṣi.
meaning: अभि त्वा वृषभा सुते इत्य् आर्षभम् . इन्द्रो वा अकामयतर्षभः सर्वासां प्रजानां स्याम् ऋषभतां गच्छेयम् इति . स एतत् सामापश्यत् . तेनास्तुत . ततो वै स ऋषभः सर्वासां प्रजानाम् अभवद् ऋषभतां अगच्छत् . तद् एवार्षभस्यार्षभत्वम् . ऋषभ एव स्वानां भवत्य् ऋषभतां गच्छति य एवं वेद . तद् व् एवाचक्षते दैवोदासम् इति . दिवोदासो वै वाध्र्यश्विर् अकामयतोभयं ब्रह्म च क्षत्रं चावरुन्धीय राजा सन्न् ऋषिः स्याम् इति . स एतत् सामापश्यत् . तेनास्तुत . ततो वै स उभयं ब्रह्म च क्षत्रं चावारुन्द्ध राजा सन्न् ऋषिर् अभवत् . उभयम् एव ब्रह्म च क्षत्रं चावरुन्द्धे राजा सन्न् ऋषिर् भवति य एवं वेद .

sanskrit_iast: idaṃ vaso sutam andhaḥ iti gāram . devebhyo vā asurā garān prākiran . tān avidvāṃso 'girann annam eva manyamānāḥ . te garagiro 'manyanta . te 'kāmayantāpemān garān gīrṇān hanīmahīti . ta etat sāmāpaśyan . tenāstuvata . tenemān garān gīrṇān apāghnata . ta eveme girayo 'bhavan . tad yad garān gīrṇān apāghnata tad eva gārasya gāratvam . sa yo garagīr manyetāpratigṛhyasya pratigṛhyānāśyānnasyānnam aśitvā sa etena stuvīta . apa haiva taṃ garaṃ gīrṇaṃ hate . yad enena kiṃ ca pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavati tad apahate . tad ail̥am acchāvākasāma bhavati . paśavo vā il̥ā .
sentences: idaṃ vaso sutam andʰaḥ iti gāram .
tad yad garān gīrṇān apāgʰnata tad eva gārasya gāratvam .
sa yo garagīr manyetāpratigr̥hyasya pratigr̥hyānāśyānnasyānnam aśitvā sa etena stuvīta .
apa haiva taṃ garaṃ gīrṇaṃ hate .
yad enena kiṃ ca pāpaṃ kr̥taṃ bʰavati tad apahate .
text: 'idaṃ vaso sutam andhaḥ' — this is the gāra. The asuras scattered poisons (gara) before the gods. Those unknowing ones swallowed them, thinking it to be food. They became poison-swallowers. They desired: 'May we destroy these swallowed poisons.' They saw this sāman. They praised with it. With it they destroyed the swallowed poisons. Those became these mountains (girayo). Because they destroyed (apāghnata) the swallowed poisons (garān gīrṇān), that is the gāra-nature of the gāra. If one who considers himself a poison-swallower — having accepted what should not be accepted, having eaten food that should not be eaten — praises with this, he destroys the swallowed poison. Whatever evil has been done by him, that he removes. This is an aiḍa acchāvāka-sāman. Cattle are indeed iḍā.
meaning: इदं वसो सुतम् अन्धः इति गारम् . देवेभ्यो वा असुरा गरान् प्राकिरन् . तान् अविद्वांसो ऽगिरन्न् अन्नम् एव मन्यमानाः . ते गरगिरो ऽमन्यन्त . ते ऽकामयन्तापेमान् गरान् गीर्णान् हनीमहीति . त एतत् सामापश्यन् . तेनास्तुवत . तेनेमान् गरान् गीर्णान् अपाघ्नत . त एवेमे गिरयो ऽभवन् . तद् यद् गरान् गीर्णान् अपाघ्नत तद् एव गारस्य गारत्वम् . स यो गरगीर् मन्येताप्रतिगृह्यस्य प्रतिगृह्यानाश्यान्नस्यान्नम् अशित्वा स एतेन स्तुवीत . अप हैव तं गरं गीर्णं हते . यद् एनेन किं च पापं कृतं भवति तद् अपहते . तद् ऐल्̥अम् अच्छावाकसाम भवति . पशवो वा इल्̥आ .

sanskrit_iast: idaṃ hy anv ojasā it ghṛtaścunnidhanam . ghṛtaścutā ca vai madhuścutā ca devā yatra yatraiṣāṃ yajñasyopādasyat tad āpyāyayanta . tasmād āhuḥ somasyaivāṃśur āpyāyasveti . upadastevaiṣā yad rātriḥ . tad yad ghṛtaścunnidhanaṃ bhavaty aivainam etena pyāyayanti . ghṛtaścuc ca vai madhuścuc cāṅgirasāṃ svargaṃ lokaṃ yatām ahīyetām . tāv akāmayetām anūtpateva svargaṃ lokam iti . tau tapo 'tapyetām . tāv ete sāmanī apaśyatām . tābhyām astuvātām . tau stutvaiva ghṛtaścute madhuścuta ity eva svargaṃ lokam anūdapatatām . anto vai payasāṃ ghṛtam antaḥ svargo lokānām . anto vai rasānāṃ madhv antaḥ svargo lokānām . antyābhyāṃ vāva tau tat sāmabhyām antyaṃ svargaṃ lokam āśnuvātām . antyābhyām evaitat sāmabhyām antyaṃ svargaṃ lokam aśnute ya evaṃ veda . paśavo ha khalu vai ghṛtaścutaḥ paśavo madhuścutaḥ . paśūn vāva tau tad etābhyām avārundhātām . tair u paśubhir iṣṭvā svargam eva lokam agacchatām . te ete paśavye svargye sāmanī .
sentences: idaṃ hy anv ojasā it gʰr̥taścunnidʰanam .
gʰr̥taścutā ca vai madʰuścutā ca devā yatra yatraiṣāṃ yajñasyopādasyat tad āpyāyayanta .
tad yad gʰr̥taścunnidʰanaṃ bʰavaty aivainam etena pyāyayanti .
gʰr̥taścuc ca vai madʰuścuc cāṅgirasāṃ svargaṃ lokaṃ yatām ahīyetām .
tāv akāmayetām anūtpateva svargaṃ lokam iti .
tau stutvaiva gʰr̥taścute madʰuścuta ity eva svargaṃ lokam anūdapatatām .
anto vai payasāṃ gʰr̥tam antaḥ svargo lokānām .
anto vai rasānāṃ madʰv antaḥ svargo lokānām .
antyābʰyāṃ vāva tau tat sāmabʰyām antyaṃ svargaṃ lokam āśnuvātām .
antyābʰyām evaitat sāmabʰyām antyaṃ svargaṃ lokam aśnute ya evaṃ veda .
paśavo ha kʰalu vai gʰr̥taścutaḥ paśavo madʰuścutaḥ .
paśūn vāva tau tad etābʰyām avārundʰātām .
tair u paśubʰir iṣṭvā svargam eva lokam agaccʰatām .
text: 'idaṃ hy anv ojasā' — this has the ghṛtaścut-nidhana (ghee-dripping ending). The Ghṛtaścut and Madhuścut gods — wherever a portion of the sacrifice diminished, they replenished it. Therefore they say: 'The soma drop, swell!' This night is like something diminished. Because the nidhana is ghṛtaścut, they thereby replenish it. Ghṛtaścut and Madhuścut, of the Āṅgirasas, were left behind when the others went to the heavenly world. They desired: 'May we fly up after them to the heavenly world.' They practiced tapas. They saw these two sāmans. They praised with them. Having praised with 'ghṛtaścute, madhuścute,' they flew up to the heavenly world. Ghee is indeed the innermost of milks, and the heavenly world is the innermost of worlds. Honey is indeed the innermost of juices, and the heavenly world is the innermost of worlds. With those two innermost sāmans they attained the innermost heavenly world. He who knows thus attains the innermost heavenly world with those two innermost sāmans. Cattle are indeed the ghṛtaścut; cattle are the madhuścut. They indeed won cattle with these two. And having sacrificed with those cattle, they went to the heavenly world. These two are sāmans for winning cattle and for reaching heaven.
meaning: इदं ह्य् अन्व् ओजसा इत् घृतश्चुन्निधनम् . घृतश्चुता च वै मधुश्चुता च देवा यत्र यत्रैषां यज्ञस्योपादस्यत् तद् आप्याययन्त . तस्माद् आहुः सोमस्यैवांशुर् आप्यायस्वेति . उपदस्तेवैषा यद् रात्रिः . तद् यद् घृतश्चुन्निधनं भवत्य् ऐवैनम् एतेन प्याययन्ति . घृतश्चुच् च वै मधुश्चुच् चाङ्गिरसां स्वर्गं लोकं यताम् अहीयेताम् . ताव् अकामयेताम् अनूत्पतेव स्वर्गं लोकम् इति . तौ तपो ऽतप्येताम् . ताव् एते सामनी अपश्यताम् . ताभ्याम् अस्तुवाताम् . तौ स्तुत्वैव घृतश्चुते मधुश्चुत इत्य् एव स्वर्गं लोकम् अनूदपतताम् . अन्तो वै पयसां घृतम् अन्तः स्वर्गो लोकानाम् . अन्तो वै रसानां मध्व् अन्तः स्वर्गो लोकानाम् . अन्त्याभ्यां वाव तौ तत् सामभ्याम् अन्त्यं स्वर्गं लोकम् आश्नुवाताम् . अन्त्याभ्याम् एवैतत् सामभ्याम् अन्त्यं स्वर्गं लोकम् अश्नुते य एवं वेद . पशवो ह खलु वै घृतश्चुतः पशवो मधुश्चुतः . पशून् वाव तौ तद् एताभ्याम् अवारुन्धाताम् . तैर् उ पशुभिर् इष्ट्वा स्वर्गम् एव लोकम् अगच्छताम् . ते एते पशव्ये स्वर्ग्ये सामनी .

sanskrit_iast: yajñastanau vā ete sāmanī . etābhyām vā indro yajñaṃ sarvān kāmān adugdha . duhe ha vai yajñaṃ sarvān kāmān ya evaṃ veda . yajurnidhanaṃ vā etayor anyatarat sāmanidhanam anyatarat . tad yad ghṛtaścunnidhanaṃ tad yajurnidhanam atha yan madhuścunnidhanaṃ tat sāmanidhanam . yā yajuṣaś ca sāmnaś cardhir ṛdhnoti tām ṛddhim āpnoti tān kāmān ya evaṃ veda . tad āhur yad ājyena divā caranty atha kenaiṣāṃ rātrir ājyavatī bhavatīti . ghṛtaścunnidhaneneti brūyāt . etena ha vai rātrir ājyavatī bhavati .
sentences: etābʰyām vā indro yajñaṃ sarvān kāmān adugdʰa .
duhe ha vai yajñaṃ sarvān kāmān ya evaṃ veda .
yajurnidʰanaṃ vā etayor anyatarat sāmanidʰanam anyatarat .
tad yad gʰr̥taścunnidʰanaṃ tad yajurnidʰanam atʰa yan madʰuścunnidʰanaṃ tat sāmanidʰanam .
yā yajuṣaś ca sāmnaś cardʰir r̥dʰnoti tām r̥ddʰim āpnoti tān kāmān ya evaṃ veda .
tad āhur yad ājyena divā caranty atʰa kenaiṣāṃ rātrir ājyavatī bʰavatīti .
etena ha vai rātrir ājyavatī bʰavati .
text: These two sāmans are indeed the teats of the sacrifice. With these two Indra milked all desires from the sacrifice. He who knows thus milks all desires from the sacrifice. One of these two has a yajus-nidhana, the other has a sāman-nidhana. The ghṛtaścut-nidhana is the yajus-nidhana; the madhuścut-nidhana is the sāman-nidhana. He who knows thus attains that prosperity which the yajus and the sāman jointly achieve; he obtains those desires. They say: 'When they perform with ājya during the day, by what does the night become ājya-possessing?' One should answer: 'By the ghṛtaścut-nidhana.' By this indeed the night becomes ājya-possessing.
meaning: यज्ञस्तनौ वा एते सामनी . एताभ्याम् वा इन्द्रो यज्ञं सर्वान् कामान् अदुग्ध . दुहे ह वै यज्ञं सर्वान् कामान् य एवं वेद . यजुर्निधनं वा एतयोर् अन्यतरत् सामनिधनम् अन्यतरत् . तद् यद् घृतश्चुन्निधनं तद् यजुर्निधनम् अथ यन् मधुश्चुन्निधनं तत् सामनिधनम् . या यजुषश् च साम्नश् चर्धिर् ऋध्नोति ताम् ऋद्धिम् आप्नोति तान् कामान् य एवं वेद . तद् आहुर् यद् आज्येन दिवा चरन्त्य् अथ केनैषां रात्रिर् आज्यवती भवतीति . घृतश्चुन्निधनेनेति ब्रूयात् . एतेन ह वै रात्रिर् आज्यवती भवति .

sanskrit_iast: atha maidhātitham . kāṇvāyanāḥ sattrād utthāyāyanta āyuñjānāḥ . kāṇvāyanāḥ sattrād utthāyāyanta āyuñjānāḥ . te hodgīthā iti kimudvatyaitadvanām (?) urvārubahuvṛttam aśanāyanta upeyuḥ . te 'kāmayantemān eva paśūn bhūtān utsṛjemahīti . sa etan medhātithiḥ kāṇvaḥ sāmāpaśyat . tenopanyaṣīdan ā tv etā ni ṣīdatendram abhi pra gāyata , sakhāyaḥ stomavāhasaḥ purūtamaṃ purūṇām īśānaṃ vāryāṇām , indraṃ some sacā sute sa ghā no yoga ā bhuvat sa rāye sa purandhyām iti . paśavo vai rayiḥ . tato vai te tān paśūn bhūtān udasṛjanta . hiṃkāreṇa haivainān utsasṛjire . te haite 'tra paścād urvārupṛśnaya iti paśavaḥ . tad etat paśūnām utsṛṣṭiḥ sāma . ava paśūn runddhe bahupaśur bhavati ya evaṃ veda .
sentences: te hodgītʰā iti kimudvatyaitadvanām (?) urvārubahuvr̥ttam aśanāyanta upeyuḥ .
ā tv etā ni ṣīdatendram abʰi pra gāyata , sakʰāyaḥ stomavāhasaḥ
purūtamaṃ purūṇām īśānaṃ vāryāṇām , indraṃ some sacā sute
sa gʰā no yoga ā bʰuvat sa rāye sa purandʰyām
tato vai te tān paśūn bʰūtān udasr̥janta .
te haite 'tra paścād urvārupr̥śnaya iti paśavaḥ .
ava paśūn runddʰe bahupaśur bʰavati ya evaṃ veda .
text: Now the maidhātitha. The Kāṇvāyanas, having risen from the sattra-session, came traveling. The Kāṇvāyanas, having risen from the sattra-session, came traveling. They — having sung 'hodgīthā iti' — approached a field with many gourds (urvāru), being hungry. They desired: 'Let us set these existing cattle free.' Medhātithi Kāṇva saw this sāman. With it they sat down: 'ā tv etā ni ṣīdatendram abhi pra gāyata, sakhāyaḥ stomavāhasaḥ purūtamaṃ purūṇām īśānaṃ vāryāṇām, indraṃ some sacā sute sa ghā no yoga ā bhuvat sa rāye sa purandhyām.' Cattle are indeed wealth. From that they set those existing cattle free. With the hiṃkāra alone they set them free. Those cattle there afterward are 'the gourd-speckled ones' (urvārupṛśnayaḥ). This is the sāman for the release of cattle. He who knows thus wins cattle and becomes rich in cattle.
meaning: अथ मैधातिथम् . काण्वायनाः सत्त्राद् उत्थायायन्त आयुञ्जानाः . काण्वायनाः सत्त्राद् उत्थायायन्त आयुञ्जानाः . ते होद्गीथा इति किमुद्वत्यैतद्वनाम् (?) उर्वारुबहुवृत्तम् अशनायन्त उपेयुः . ते ऽकामयन्तेमान् एव पशून् भूतान् उत्सृजेमहीति . स एतन् मेधातिथिः काण्वः सामापश्यत् . तेनोपन्यषीदन् आ त्व् एता नि षीदतेन्द्रम् अभि प्र गायत , सखायः स्तोमवाहसः पुरूतमं पुरूणाम् ईशानं वार्याणाम् , इन्द्रं सोमे सचा सुते स घा नो योग आ भुवत् स राये स पुरन्ध्याम् इति . पशवो वै रयिः . ततो वै ते तान् पशून् भूतान् उदसृजन्त . हिंकारेण हैवैनान् उत्ससृजिरे . ते हैते ऽत्र पश्चाद् उर्वारुपृश्नय इति पशवः . तद् एतत् पशूनाम् उत्सृष्टिः साम . अव पशून् रुन्द्धे बहुपशुर् भवति य एवं वेद .

sanskrit_iast: atha saumedham . devā vā asurān hatvāpūtā ivāmedhyā amanyanta . te 'kāmayanta pūtā medhyāḥ syāmeti . ta etat sāmāpaśyan . tenāstuvata . tato vai pūtā medhyā abhavan . te 'bruvan sumedhyā vā abhūmeti . tad eva saumedhasya saumedhatvam . pūto medhyo bhavati ya evaṃ veda . tad v evācakṣate paurvatithim iti . pūrvatithir vā ārcanānasaś śyāvāśvāt kanīyān . so 'kāmayatāva paśūn rundhīya bhūmānaṃ paśūnāṃ gaccheyam iti . sa etat sāmāpaśyat . tenāstuta ā ghā gamad yadi śravat sahasriṇībhir ūtibhiḥ iti . sahasram eva paśūn avārunddha bhūmānaṃ paśūnām agacchat . tad etat paśavyaṃ sāma . ava paśūn runddhe bhūmānaṃ paśūnāṃ gacchati ya evaṃ veda . yad u pūrvatithir ārcanāsaso 'paśyat tasmāt paurvatithim ity ākhyāyate . indra suteṣu someṣu ity uṣṇiho bhavanti . devapurā vā eṣā yad uṣṇihaḥ .
sentences: devā vā asurān hatvāpūtā ivāmedʰyā amanyanta .
pūto medʰyo bʰavati ya evaṃ veda .
so 'kāmayatāva paśūn rundʰīya bʰūmānaṃ paśūnāṃ gaccʰeyam iti .
ā gʰā gamad yadi śravat sahasriṇībʰir ūtibʰiḥ
sahasram eva paśūn avārunddʰa bʰūmānaṃ paśūnām agaccʰat .
ava paśūn runddʰe bʰūmānaṃ paśūnāṃ gaccʰati ya evaṃ veda .
yad u pūrvatitʰir ārcanāsaso 'paśyat tasmāt paurvatitʰim ity ākʰyāyate .
indra suteṣu someṣu ity uṣṇiho bʰavanti .
text: Now the saumedha. The gods, having slain the asuras, felt as if impure and unclean. They desired: 'May we be pure and clean.' They saw this sāman. They praised with it. From that they became pure and clean. They said: 'We have become truly pure (sumedhyāḥ).' That is the saumedha-nature of the saumedha. He who knows thus becomes pure and clean. They also call it the paurvatitha. Pūrvatithi Ārcanānasa was younger than Śyāvāśva. He desired: 'May I win cattle, may I attain abundance of cattle.' He saw this sāman. He praised with it: 'ā ghā gamad yadi śravat sahasriṇībhir ūtibhiḥ.' He won a thousand cattle and attained abundance of cattle. This is a cattle-winning sāman. He who knows thus wins cattle and attains abundance of cattle. Because Pūrvatithi Ārcanānasa saw it, therefore it is called paurvatitha. 'indra suteṣu someṣu' — these are uṣṇih verses. The uṣṇih is indeed the fortress of the gods.
meaning: अथ सौमेधम् . देवा वा असुरान् हत्वापूता इवामेध्या अमन्यन्त . ते ऽकामयन्त पूता मेध्याः स्यामेति . त एतत् सामापश्यन् . तेनास्तुवत . ततो वै पूता मेध्या अभवन् . ते ऽब्रुवन् सुमेध्या वा अभूमेति . तद् एव सौमेधस्य सौमेधत्वम् . पूतो मेध्यो भवति य एवं वेद . तद् व् एवाचक्षते पौर्वतिथिम् इति . पूर्वतिथिर् वा आर्चनानसश् श्यावाश्वात् कनीयान् . सो ऽकामयताव पशून् रुन्धीय भूमानं पशूनां गच्छेयम् इति . स एतत् सामापश्यत् . तेनास्तुत आ घा गमद् यदि श्रवत् सहस्रिणीभिर् ऊतिभिः इति . सहस्रम् एव पशून् अवारुन्द्ध भूमानं पशूनाम् अगच्छत् . तद् एतत् पशव्यं साम . अव पशून् रुन्द्धे भूमानं पशूनां गच्छति य एवं वेद . यद् उ पूर्वतिथिर् आर्चनाससो ऽपश्यत् तस्मात् पौर्वतिथिम् इत्य् आख्यायते . इन्द्र सुतेषु सोमेषु इत्य् उष्णिहो भवन्ति . देवपुरा वा एषा यद् उष्णिहः .

sanskrit_iast: tāsu kautsam . kutsaś ca luśaś cendraṃ vyahvayetām . sa kutsasya havam āgacchat . taṃ śatena vārdhrībhir āṇḍayor abadhnāt . taṃ luśo 'bhyavadat svavṛjaṃ hi tvām aham indra śuśravānānudaṃ vṛṣabha radhracodanam pra muñcasva pari kutsād ihā gahi kim u tvāvān muṣkayor baddha āsate iti . tāḥ sarvāḥ saṃlupya luśam abhi prādravat . taṃ kutsaḥ indra suteṣu someṣu ity anvāhvayat . tam abhyāvartata . taṃ luśaḥ indrā hoyī hāve hoyī iti . tāv antarātiṣṭhat . tāv abravīd aṃśam āharethām ātmanā vām anyatarasya pāsyāmi mahimnānyatarasyeti . tatheti . tāv aṃśam āharetām ātmānam anyatara udajayan mahimānam anyataraḥ . ātmānaṃ kutsa udajayan mahimānaṃ luśaḥ . ātmanānyatarasyāpiban mahimnānyatarasya . ātmanā kutsasyāpiban mahimnā luśasya . ubhā u ha tvāva tasya tāv ātmānāu yad ātmā ca mahimā ca . tad etat sendraṃ sāma . sendro hāsya sadevo yajño bhavaty abhy asyendro yajñam āvartate nāsyendro yajñād apakrāmati ya evaṃ veda . yad u kutso 'paśyat tasmāt kautsam ity ākhyāyate . tad ail̥am acchāvākasāma bhavati . paśavo vā il̥ā .
sentences: svavr̥jaṃ hi tvām aham indra śuśravānānudaṃ vr̥ṣabʰa radʰracodanam
pra muñcasva pari kutsād ihā gahi kim u tvāvān muṣkayor baddʰa āsate
tāḥ sarvāḥ saṃlupya luśam abʰi prādravat .
taṃ kutsaḥ indra suteṣu someṣu ity anvāhvayat .
taṃ luśaḥ indrā hoyī hāve hoyī iti .
tāv abravīd aṃśam āharetʰām ātmanā vām anyatarasya pāsyāmi mahimnānyatarasyeti .
tāv aṃśam āharetām ātmānam anyatara udajayan mahimānam anyataraḥ .
ubʰā u ha tvāva tasya tāv ātmānāu yad ātmā ca mahimā ca .
sendro hāsya sadevo yajño bʰavaty abʰy asyendro yajñam āvartate nāsyendro yajñād apakrāmati ya evaṃ veda .
yad u kutso 'paśyat tasmāt kautsam ity ākʰyāyate .
text: In these is the kautsa sāman. Kutsa and Luśa were both calling upon Indra. He came to the call of Kutsa. Luśa tied him by the testicles with a hundred leather straps. Luśa addressed him: 'I have heard, O Indra, that you are self-willed, O bull, urger of the sluggish — free yourself! Come away from Kutsa here. Why should one like you sit bound by the testicles?' Tearing off all those straps, he ran toward Luśa. Then Kutsa called him with 'indra suteṣu someṣu.' He turned back to him. Then Luśa called 'indrā hoyī hāve hoyī.' He stood between them both. He said to them: 'Bring an offering-portion. I shall drink of one of you with my self (ātman), of the other with my greatness (mahiman).' 'So be it.' They each brought a portion. One won the ātman, the other the mahiman. Kutsa won the ātman, Luśa the mahiman. He drank of one with the ātman, of the other with the mahiman — of Kutsa with the ātman, of Luśa with the mahiman. Both of those are indeed his two selves — the ātman and the mahiman. This is a sāman united with Indra (sendra). He who knows thus has Indra present at his sacrifice, Indra turns toward his sacrifice, Indra does not depart from his sacrifice. Because Kutsa saw it, therefore it is called kautsa. This is an aiḍa acchāvāka-sāman. Cattle are indeed iḍā.
meaning: तासु कौत्सम् . कुत्सश् च लुशश् चेन्द्रं व्यह्वयेताम् . स कुत्सस्य हवम् आगच्छत् . तं शतेन वार्ध्रीभिर् आण्डयोर् अबध्नात् . तं लुशो ऽभ्यवदत् स्ववृजं हि त्वाम् अहम् इन्द्र शुश्रवानानुदं वृषभ रध्रचोदनम् प्र मुञ्चस्व परि कुत्साद् इहा गहि किम् उ त्वावान् मुष्कयोर् बद्ध आसते इति . ताः सर्वाः संलुप्य लुशम् अभि प्राद्रवत् . तं कुत्सः इन्द्र सुतेषु सोमेषु इत्य् अन्वाह्वयत् . तम् अभ्यावर्तत . तं लुशः इन्द्रा होयी हावे होयी इति . ताव् अन्तरातिष्ठत् . ताव् अब्रवीद् अंशम् आहरेथाम् आत्मना वाम् अन्यतरस्य पास्यामि महिम्नान्यतरस्येति . तथेति . ताव् अंशम् आहरेताम् आत्मानम् अन्यतर उदजयन् महिमानम् अन्यतरः . आत्मानं कुत्स उदजयन् महिमानं लुशः . आत्मनान्यतरस्यापिबन् महिम्नान्यतरस्य . आत्मना कुत्सस्यापिबन् महिम्ना लुशस्य . उभा उ ह त्वाव तस्य ताव् आत्मानाउ यद् आत्मा च महिमा च . तद् एतत् सेन्द्रं साम . सेन्द्रो हास्य सदेवो यज्ञो भवत्य् अभ्य् अस्येन्द्रो यज्ञम् आवर्तते नास्येन्द्रो यज्ञाद् अपक्रामति य एवं वेद . यद् उ कुत्सो ऽपश्यत् तस्मात् कौत्सम् इत्य् आख्यायते . तद् ऐल्̥अम् अच्छावाकसाम भवति . पशवो वा इल्̥आ .

sanskrit_iast: tad āhū rathantaram eva prathame tṛce syād vāmadevyaṃ dvitīye bṛhat tṛtīya eṣāṃ lokānāṃ samārohāyeti . ime vai lokā etāni sāmāni . ayam eva loko rathantaram antarikṣaṃ vāmadevyam asāv eva bṛhat . tasmād evam eva kāryam eṣāṃ lokāṇāṃ samārohāyeti . prāṇavyānodānā ha khalu vā etāni sāmāni . prāṇa eva rathantaraṃ vyāno vāmadevyam udāno bṛhat . tasmād evam eva kāryaṃ prāṇavyānodānānāṃ saṃtatyā avyavacchedāyeti . atha yaḥ kāmayeta prajā me śreyasī syād iti rathantaram eva prathame tṛce kuryād vāmadevam uttarayoḥ . prajāpatir vai vāmadevyam . prajāpatim eva tat svaram antata upayanti prajananāya . bṛhatā śrīkāmaḥ svargakāmaḥ stuvīta . śrīr vai svargo lokaḥ . bṛhad aśnute śriyaṃ gacchati svargaṃ lokaṃ ya evaṃ veda . atho ha bhrātṛvyalokam eva nāvajahāti . bhrātṛvyabhājanam iva hy eṣā yad rātriḥ . rathantareṇa pratiṣṭhākāmaḥ stuvīta . pratiṣṭhā vai rathantaram . praty eva tiṣṭhati . gāyatrīṣu saṃdhinā brahmavarcasakāmaḥ stuvīta . brahma vai gāyatrī . brahmavarcasy eva bhavati . kakupsu puruṣakāmaḥ . puruṣo vai kakup . puruṣavān eva bhavati . uṣṇikṣu paśukāmaḥ . paśavo vā uṣṇik . paśumān eva bhavati . virāṭsv annādyakāmaḥ . annaṃ vai virāṭ . annāda eva bhavati . anuṣṭupsu pratiṣṭhākāmaḥ . pratiṣṭhā vā anuṣṭup . praty eva tiṣṭhati . paṅktiṣu yajñakāmaḥ . yaḥ kāmayeta punar mā yajña upanamed iti . yajño vai paṅktiḥ . punar evainaṃ yajña upanamati . triṣṭupsv ojaskāmo vīryakāmaḥ . ojo vai vīryaṃ triṣṭup . ojasvy eva vīryavān bhavati . jagatīṣu paśukāmaḥ . paśavo vai jagatī . paśumān eva bhavati . tad āhur ekasmin vāvaitasya chandasy ekasmin kāme stutaṃ bhavati ya evaṃ stute . athaitasya sarveṣu chandassu sarveṣu kāmeṣu stutaṃ bhavati yo bṛhatīṣu stute . bṛhatīṃ hy evaitāni sarvāṇi chandāṃsy abhisaṃpadyanta iti . gāyatrī ca jagatī ca te dve bṛhatyau . uṣṇik ca triṣṭup ca te dve bṛhatyau . anuṣṭup ca paṅktiś ca te dve bṛhatyau . bṛhaty eva bṛhatī .
sentences: tad āhū ratʰantaram eva pratʰame tr̥ce syād vāmadevyaṃ dvitīye br̥hat tr̥tīya eṣāṃ lokānāṃ samārohāyeti .
ayam eva loko ratʰantaram antarikṣaṃ vāmadevyam asāv eva br̥hat .
tasmād evam eva kāryam eṣāṃ lokāṇāṃ samārohāyeti .
prāṇavyānodānā ha kʰalu vā etāni sāmāni .
prāṇa eva ratʰantaraṃ vyāno vāmadevyam udāno br̥hat .
tasmād evam eva kāryaṃ prāṇavyānodānānāṃ saṃtatyā avyavaccʰedāyeti .
atʰa yaḥ kāmayeta prajā me śreyasī syād iti ratʰantaram eva pratʰame tr̥ce kuryād vāmadevam uttarayoḥ .
prajāpatim eva tat svaram antata upayanti prajananāya .
br̥had aśnute śriyaṃ gaccʰati svargaṃ lokaṃ ya evaṃ veda .
bʰrātr̥vyabʰājanam iva hy eṣā yad rātriḥ .
yaḥ kāmayeta punar mā yajña upanamed iti .
tad āhur ekasmin vāvaitasya cʰandasy ekasmin kāme stutaṃ bʰavati ya evaṃ stute .
atʰaitasya sarveṣu cʰandassu sarveṣu kāmeṣu stutaṃ bʰavati yo br̥hatīṣu stute .
br̥hatīṃ hy evaitāni sarvāṇi cʰandāṃsy abʰisaṃpadyanta iti .
gāyatrī ca jagatī ca te dve br̥hatyau .
uṣṇik ca triṣṭup ca te dve br̥hatyau .
anuṣṭup ca paṅktiś ca te dve br̥hatyau .
text: On this they say: 'The rathantara should be in the first tṛca, the vāmadevya in the second, the bṛhat in the third — for the ascending of these worlds.' These worlds are indeed these sāmans. This world is the rathantara, the atmosphere is the vāmadevya, the yonder world is the bṛhat. Therefore it should be done thus, for the ascending of these worlds. These sāmans are indeed prāṇa, vyāna, and udāna. The prāṇa is the rathantara, the vyāna is the vāmadevya, the udāna is the bṛhat. Therefore it should be done thus, for the continuity and unbrokenness of prāṇa, vyāna, and udāna. But one who desires 'may my offspring be better' should place the rathantara in the first tṛca and the vāmadevya in the latter two. Prajāpati is the vāmadevya. One thereby approaches Prajāpati with his own note at the end, for procreation. One desiring splendor and the heavenly world should praise with the bṛhat. Splendor is the heavenly world. He who knows thus attains splendor and reaches the heavenly world with the bṛhat. Also, one should not abandon the realm of the rival. For this night is like a share belonging to the rival. One desiring firm standing should praise with the rathantara. The ratianthara is firm standing. He stands firm. One desiring brahma-radiance should praise with the saṃdhi in gāyatrīs. The gāyatrī is brahman. He becomes possessed of brahma-radiance. In kakubhs, one desiring men. Man is the kakubh. He becomes possessed of men. In uṣṇihs, one desiring cattle. Cattle are the uṣṇih. He becomes rich in cattle. In virāj verses, one desiring food. Food is the virāj. He becomes a food-eater. In anuṣṭubhs, one desiring firm standing. The anuṣṭubh is firm standing. He stands firm. In paṅktis, one desiring sacrifice — one who desires 'may the sacrifice come to me again.' The sacrifice is the paṅkti. The sacrifice comes to him again. In triṣṭubhs, one desiring force and power. Force and power are the triṣṭubh. He becomes forceful and powerful. In jagatīs, one desiring cattle. Cattle are the jagatī. He becomes rich in cattle. On this they say: 'For one who praises thus, the praise is accomplished in but one meter, for one desire. But for one who praises in bṛhatīs, the praise is accomplished in all meters, for all desires.' For all these meters converge upon the bṛhatī. The gāyatrī and jagatī together are two bṛhatīs. The uṣṇih and triṣṭubh together are two bṛhatīs. The anuṣṭubh and paṅkti together are two bṛhatīs. The bṛhatī itself is a bṛhatī.
meaning: तद् आहू रथन्तरम् एव प्रथमे तृचे स्याद् वामदेव्यं द्वितीये बृहत् तृतीय एषां लोकानां समारोहायेति . इमे वै लोका एतानि सामानि . अयम् एव लोको रथन्तरम् अन्तरिक्षं वामदेव्यम् असाव् एव बृहत् . तस्माद् एवम् एव कार्यम् एषां लोकाणां समारोहायेति . प्राणव्यानोदाना ह खलु वा एतानि सामानि . प्राण एव रथन्तरं व्यानो वामदेव्यम् उदानो बृहत् . तस्माद् एवम् एव कार्यं प्राणव्यानोदानानां संतत्या अव्यवच्छेदायेति . अथ यः कामयेत प्रजा मे श्रेयसी स्याद् इति रथन्तरम् एव प्रथमे तृचे कुर्याद् वामदेवम् उत्तरयोः . प्रजापतिर् वै वामदेव्यम् . प्रजापतिम् एव तत् स्वरम् अन्तत उपयन्ति प्रजननाय . बृहता श्रीकामः स्वर्गकामः स्तुवीत . श्रीर् वै स्वर्गो लोकः . बृहद् अश्नुते श्रियं गच्छति स्वर्गं लोकं य एवं वेद . अथो ह भ्रातृव्यलोकम् एव नावजहाति . भ्रातृव्यभाजनम् इव ह्य् एषा यद् रात्रिः . रथन्तरेण प्रतिष्ठाकामः स्तुवीत . प्रतिष्ठा वै रथन्तरम् . प्रत्य् एव तिष्ठति . गायत्रीषु संधिना ब्रह्मवर्चसकामः स्तुवीत . ब्रह्म वै गायत्री . ब्रह्मवर्चस्य् एव भवति . ककुप्सु पुरुषकामः . पुरुषो वै ककुप् . पुरुषवान् एव भवति . उष्णिक्षु पशुकामः . पशवो वा उष्णिक् . पशुमान् एव भवति . विराट्स्व् अन्नाद्यकामः . अन्नं वै विराट् . अन्नाद एव भवति . अनुष्टुप्सु प्रतिष्ठाकामः . प्रतिष्ठा वा अनुष्टुप् . प्रत्य् एव तिष्ठति . पङ्क्तिषु यज्ञकामः . यः कामयेत पुनर् मा यज्ञ उपनमेद् इति . यज्ञो वै पङ्क्तिः . पुनर् एवैनं यज्ञ उपनमति . त्रिष्टुप्स्व् ओजस्कामो वीर्यकामः . ओजो वै वीर्यं त्रिष्टुप् . ओजस्व्य् एव वीर्यवान् भवति . जगतीषु पशुकामः . पशवो वै जगती . पशुमान् एव भवति . तद् आहुर् एकस्मिन् वावैतस्य छन्दस्य् एकस्मिन् कामे स्तुतं भवति य एवं स्तुते . अथैतस्य सर्वेषु छन्दस्सु सर्वेषु कामेषु स्तुतं भवति यो बृहतीषु स्तुते . बृहतीं ह्य् एवैतानि सर्वाणि छन्दांस्य् अभिसंपद्यन्त इति . गायत्री च जगती च ते द्वे बृहत्यौ . उष्णिक् च त्रिष्टुप् च ते द्वे बृहत्यौ . अनुष्टुप् च पङ्क्तिश् च ते द्वे बृहत्यौ . बृहत्य् एव बृहती .

sanskrit_iast: tad āhur yat trivṛd eva stomānāṃ laghiṣṭho rathantaraṃ sāmnām āśvinam u vai śastrāṇāṃ gariṣṭham atha kasmāt trivṛd eva stomānāṃ rathantaraṃ sāmnām āśvinasya śastraṃ pratyudyantum arhata iti . sa brūyāt prāṇo vai trivṛtaḥ . prāṇeṣv idaṃ sarvaṃ pratiṣṭḥitam . prāṇā idaṃ sarvaṃ pratyudyacchanti . prāṇā idaṃ sarvaṃ pratiprati . ime vai lokās trivṛtaḥ . eṣv idaṃ lokeṣu sarvaṃ pratiṣṭḥitam . ima idaṃ lokāḥ sarvaṃ pratyudyacchanti . ima idaṃ lokāḥ sarvaṃ pratiprati . vāg vai rathantaram . vācīdaṃ sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam . vāg idaṃ sarvaṃ pratyudyacchati . vāg idaṃ sarvaṃ pratiprati . iyaṃ vai rathantaram . asyām idaṃ sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam . iyam idaṃ sarvaṃ pratyudyacchati . iyam idaṃ sarvaṃ pratiprati .
sentences: tad āhur yat trivr̥d eva stomānāṃ lagʰiṣṭʰo ratʰantaraṃ sāmnām āśvinam u vai śastrāṇāṃ gariṣṭʰam atʰa kasmāt trivr̥d eva stomānāṃ ratʰantaraṃ sāmnām āśvinasya śastraṃ pratyudyantum arhata iti .
text: On this they say: 'If the trivṛt is the lightest of stomas, the rathantara the (lightest) of sāmans, and the āśvina is the weightiest of śastras, then why is the trivṛt stoma with the rathantara sāman able to rise up against the āśvina recitation?' One should answer: 'The trivṛt is the vital breaths. Everything rests upon the vital breaths. The vital breaths uphold everything. The vital breaths support everything. These worlds are the trivṛt. Everything rests upon these worlds. These worlds uphold everything. These worlds support everything. Speech is the rathantara. Everything rests upon speech. Speech upholds everything. Speech supports everything. This earth is the rathantara. Everything rests upon this earth. This earth upholds everything. This earth supports everything.'
meaning: तद् आहुर् यत् त्रिवृद् एव स्तोमानां लघिष्ठो रथन्तरं साम्नाम् आश्विनम् उ वै शस्त्राणां गरिष्ठम् अथ कस्मात् त्रिवृद् एव स्तोमानां रथन्तरं साम्नाम् आश्विनस्य शस्त्रं प्रत्युद्यन्तुम् अर्हत इति . स ब्रूयात् प्राणो वै त्रिवृतः . प्राणेष्व् इदं सर्वं प्रतिष्ट्ःइतम् . प्राणा इदं सर्वं प्रत्युद्यच्छन्ति . प्राणा इदं सर्वं प्रतिप्रति . इमे वै लोकास् त्रिवृतः . एष्व् इदं लोकेषु सर्वं प्रतिष्ट्ःइतम् . इम इदं लोकाः सर्वं प्रत्युद्यच्छन्ति . इम इदं लोकाः सर्वं प्रतिप्रति . वाग् वै रथन्तरम् . वाचीदं सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम् . वाग् इदं सर्वं प्रत्युद्यच्छति . वाग् इदं सर्वं प्रतिप्रति . इयं वै रथन्तरम् . अस्याम् इदं सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम् . इयम् इदं सर्वं प्रत्युद्यच्छति . इयम् इदं सर्वं प्रतिप्रति .

sanskrit_iast: tad āhur yat pavamānavanto 'nye yajñakratavo 'tha kenaiṣāṃ rātriḥ pavamānavatī bhavatīti . rathantareṇa saṃdhineti brūyāt . etena ha vai rātriḥ pavamānavatī bhavati . tena sakṛd dhiṃkṛtena parācā stuvate . sakṛd dhy eva purastāt trivṛte hiṃkurvanti yat prāyaṇaṃ tad udayanam asad iti . retaḥsiktir ha tvai pūrvas trivṛt prajāpatir uttaraḥ . ātmā vai prajā paśava etāni tṛcāni . prajāpatir vai rathantaram . yathā reta eva siktaṃ syān na prajāyate tādṛk tad yat sakṛd dhiṃkṛtaiḥ stuvīran . tad yat tṛcāya tṛcāya hiṃkurvanti prajātyā eva . bahur bhavati prajāyate ya evaṃ veda . atho haiṣām eka eva paryāya āyatanavān syād anāyatanau dvau syātāṃ yat sakṛd dhiṃkṛtaiḥ stuvīran . tad yat tṛcāya tṛcāya hiṃkurvanti tenaivaiṣāṃ sarvarātrir āyatanavatī pavamānavatī bhavati . yathā vā ahas tathā rātrir yathā rātris tathāhaḥ . pūrvāhṇo madhyaṃdino 'parāhṇaḥ pūrvarātro madhyarātro 'parātraḥ .
sentences: tad āhur yat pavamānavanto 'nye yajñakratavo 'tʰa kenaiṣāṃ rātriḥ pavamānavatī bʰavatīti .
etena ha vai rātriḥ pavamānavatī bʰavati .
sakr̥d dʰy eva purastāt trivr̥te hiṃkurvanti yat prāyaṇaṃ tad udayanam asad iti .
retaḥsiktir ha tvai pūrvas trivr̥t prajāpatir uttaraḥ .
ātmā vai prajā paśava etāni tr̥cāni .
yatʰā reta eva siktaṃ syān na prajāyate tādr̥k tad yat sakr̥d dʰiṃkr̥taiḥ stuvīran .
tad yat tr̥cāya tr̥cāya hiṃkurvanti prajātyā eva .
bahur bʰavati prajāyate ya evaṃ veda .
atʰo haiṣām eka eva paryāya āyatanavān syād anāyatanau dvau syātāṃ yat sakr̥d dʰiṃkr̥taiḥ stuvīran .
tad yat tr̥cāya tr̥cāya hiṃkurvanti tenaivaiṣāṃ sarvarātrir āyatanavatī pavamānavatī bʰavati .
yatʰā vā ahas tatʰā rātrir yatʰā rātris tatʰāhaḥ .
text: On this they say: 'Other sacrificial rites have pavamāna chants, but by what does the night become pavamāna-possessing?' One should answer: 'By the rāthantara saṃdhi.' By this indeed the night becomes pavamāna-possessing. With a single hiṃkāra they praise turning away. For at the beginning of the trivṛt they make only one hiṃkāra — what is the commencement is also the conclusion. The first trivṛt is indeed the emission of seed, Prajāpati is the latter. The self, offspring, and cattle are these tṛcas. Prajāpati is the rathantara. If they were to praise with only a single hiṃkāra, it would be as if seed were emitted but no offspring were born — such would that be. But because they make a hiṃkāra for each tṛca, it is for procreation. He who knows thus becomes many and procreates. Also, only one of their paryāyas would have a foundation, and two would be without foundation, if they were to praise with single hiṃkāras. But because they make a hiṃkāra for each tṛca, by that the entire night becomes one with a foundation and possessing pavamāna chants. As the day is, so is the night; as the night is, so is the day. The forenoon, the midday, and the afternoon correspond to the first part of the night, the midnight, and the last part of the night.
meaning: तद् आहुर् यत् पवमानवन्तो ऽन्ये यज्ञक्रतवो ऽथ केनैषां रात्रिः पवमानवती भवतीति . रथन्तरेण संधिनेति ब्रूयात् . एतेन ह वै रात्रिः पवमानवती भवति . तेन सकृद् धिंकृतेन पराचा स्तुवते . सकृद् ध्य् एव पुरस्तात् त्रिवृते हिंकुर्वन्ति यत् प्रायणं तद् उदयनम् असद् इति . रेतःसिक्तिर् ह त्वै पूर्वस् त्रिवृत् प्रजापतिर् उत्तरः . आत्मा वै प्रजा पशव एतानि तृचानि . प्रजापतिर् वै रथन्तरम् . यथा रेत एव सिक्तं स्यान् न प्रजायते तादृक् तद् यत् सकृद् धिंकृतैः स्तुवीरन् . तद् यत् तृचाय तृचाय हिंकुर्वन्ति प्रजात्या एव . बहुर् भवति प्रजायते य एवं वेद . अथो हैषाम् एक एव पर्याय आयतनवान् स्याद् अनायतनौ द्वौ स्यातां यत् सकृद् धिंकृतैः स्तुवीरन् . तद् यत् तृचाय तृचाय हिंकुर्वन्ति तेनैवैषां सर्वरात्रिर् आयतनवती पवमानवती भवति . यथा वा अहस् तथा रात्रिर् यथा रात्रिस् तथाहः . पूर्वाह्णो मध्यंदिनो ऽपराह्णः पूर्वरात्रो मध्यरात्रो ऽपरात्रः .

sanskrit_iast: tad āhur yad ekaviṃśam anu sarve yajñakratavaḥ saṃtiṣṭhante 'ty u vā ekaviṃśāny ukthāni rātrir ety atha kenaiṣām ekaviṃśam anu rātriḥ saṃtiṣṭhata iti . sa brūyād yad evaita ekaviṃśatiś ca trivṛto bhavanti nava caikaviṃśā iti . atha ha smāha bhāllaveyaḥ ka u svid adyobhayatojyotiṣā yajñakratunā yakṣyata iti . eṣa ha vā ubhayatojyotir yajñakratur yad atirātraḥ . trivṛt purastād bahiṣpavamānaṃ bhavati trivṛd upariṣṭād rāthantaraḥ saṃdhiḥ . agnir vai pūrvas trivṛd āditya uttaraḥ . agninā vā ayaṃ loko jyotiṣmān ādityenāsau . ubhayatojyotiṣāsya yajñakratuneṣṭaṃ bhavati jyotiṣmān asmiṃś ca loke 'muṣmiṃś ca bhavati ya evaṃ veda . tau vā etau brahma caiva kṣatraṃ ca . brahma vai trivṛt kṣatraṃ pañcadaśaḥ . tad etad brahma ca kṣatraṃ ca saṃdhāya rātriṃ vahataḥ . tad etad brahma ca kṣatraṃ ca saṃdhāyāntataḥ pāpmānam apahataḥ . tad yad etau stomāv antataḥ kriyete  pāpmānaṃ hate ya evaṃ veda . tau yad gāyatrīṃ saṃpadyete - tejo vai brahmavarcasaṃ gāyatrī - tejasy eva tad brahmavarcase pratitiṣṭhati . atho yajamānam eva tad āyuṣi pratiṣṭhāpayati sarvāyuṣṭvāya . prāṇo hi gāyatrī .
sentences: tad āhur yad ekaviṃśam anu sarve yajñakratavaḥ saṃtiṣṭʰante 'ty u vā ekaviṃśāny uktʰāni rātrir ety atʰa kenaiṣām ekaviṃśam anu rātriḥ saṃtiṣṭʰata iti .
sa brūyād yad evaita ekaviṃśatiś ca trivr̥to bʰavanti nava caikaviṃśā iti .
atʰa ha smāha bʰāllaveyaḥ ka u svid adyobʰayatojyotiṣā yajñakratunā yakṣyata iti .
eṣa ha vā ubʰayatojyotir yajñakratur yad atirātraḥ .
trivr̥t purastād bahiṣpavamānaṃ bʰavati trivr̥d upariṣṭād rātʰantaraḥ saṃdʰiḥ .
agnir vai pūrvas trivr̥d āditya uttaraḥ .
agninā vā ayaṃ loko jyotiṣmān ādityenāsau .
ubʰayatojyotiṣāsya yajñakratuneṣṭaṃ bʰavati jyotiṣmān asmiṃś ca loke 'muṣmiṃś ca bʰavati ya evaṃ veda .
tau vā etau brahma caiva kṣatraṃ ca .
tad etad brahma ca kṣatraṃ ca saṃdʰāya rātriṃ vahataḥ .
tad etad brahma ca kṣatraṃ ca saṃdʰāyāntataḥ pāpmānam apahataḥ .
tad yad etau stomāv antataḥ kriyete [pāpmāna evāpahatyai .
apa] pāpmānaṃ hate ya evaṃ veda .
tau yad gāyatrīṃ saṃpadyete - tejo vai brahmavarcasaṃ gāyatrī - tejasy eva tad brahmavarcase pratitiṣṭʰati .
atʰo yajamānam eva tad āyuṣi pratiṣṭʰāpayati sarvāyuṣṭvāya .
text: On this they say: 'All sacrificial rites are concluded in accordance with the twenty-one (ekaviṃśa), but the ukthāni of the night go beyond twenty-one. By what then does the night conclude in accordance with the twenty-one?' One should answer: 'By the fact that these twenty-one are trivṛts and nine are ekaviṃśas.' Then Bhāllaveyaḥ used to say: 'Who today will sacrifice with a yajñakratu that has light on both sides?' This atirātra is indeed the yajñakratu with light on both sides. The bahiṣpavamāna at the beginning is trivṛt; the rāthantara saṃdhi at the end is trivṛt. Agni is the first trivṛt, Āditya the latter. By Agni this world is luminous; by Āditya that yonder world. His sacrifice is performed with a yajñakratu having light on both sides. He who knows thus becomes luminous in both this world and the other. These two are indeed brahman and kṣatra. The trivṛt is brahman, the pañcadaśa is kṣatra. Having joined brahman and kṣatra, they carry the night. Having joined brahman and kṣatra, they destroy evil at the end. Because these two stomas are placed at the ends, he who knows thus destroys evil. When these two attain the gāyatrī — the gāyatrī is tejas and brahma-radiance — one stands firm in tejas and brahma-radiance. Also, one thereby establishes the sacrificer in life for the sake of full lifespan. For the gāyatrī is the vital breath.
meaning: तद् आहुर् यद् एकविंशम् अनु सर्वे यज्ञक्रतवः संतिष्ठन्ते ऽत्य् उ वा एकविंशान्य् उक्थानि रात्रिर् एत्य् अथ केनैषाम् एकविंशम् अनु रात्रिः संतिष्ठत इति . स ब्रूयाद् यद् एवैत एकविंशतिश् च त्रिवृतो भवन्ति नव चैकविंशा इति . अथ ह स्माह भाल्लवेयः क उ स्विद् अद्योभयतोज्योतिषा यज्ञक्रतुना यक्ष्यत इति . एष ह वा उभयतोज्योतिर् यज्ञक्रतुर् यद् अतिरात्रः . त्रिवृत् पुरस्ताद् बहिष्पवमानं भवति त्रिवृद् उपरिष्टाद् राथन्तरः संधिः . अग्निर् वै पूर्वस् त्रिवृद् आदित्य उत्तरः . अग्निना वा अयं लोको ज्योतिष्मान् आदित्येनासौ . उभयतोज्योतिषास्य यज्ञक्रतुनेष्टं भवति ज्योतिष्मान् अस्मिंश् च लोके ऽमुष्मिंश् च भवति य एवं वेद . तौ वा एतौ ब्रह्म चैव क्षत्रं च . ब्रह्म वै त्रिवृत् क्षत्रं पञ्चदशः . तद् एतद् ब्रह्म च क्षत्रं च संधाय रात्रिं वहतः . तद् एतद् ब्रह्म च क्षत्रं च संधायान्ततः पाप्मानम् अपहतः . तद् यद् एतौ स्तोमाव् अन्ततः क्रियेते  पाप्मानं हते य एवं वेद . तौ यद् गायत्रीं संपद्येते - तेजो वै ब्रह्मवर्चसं गायत्री - तेजस्य् एव तद् ब्रह्मवर्चसे प्रतितिष्ठति . अथो यजमानम् एव तद् आयुषि प्रतिष्ठापयति सर्वायुष्ट्वाय . प्राणो हि गायत्री .

sanskrit_iast: virāṭsaṃpadaiva yajñena yajetety āhuḥ . annaṃ vai virāṭ . annaṃ ha vai devānāṃ somo rājā . annam eva tat kṛtvā devebhyaḥ somaṃ rājānaṃ prayacchati . na ha vā eṣo 'nabhiṣuto devānām annam . tam etad abhiṣutyānnaṃ kṛtvā devebhyaḥ prayacchati . yad dha vā iha devebhyaḥ karoti tad asmai devāḥ kurvanti . ta enaṃ samṛddhāḥ prajayā paśubhir annādyena samardhayanti . virāṇ nātiyaṣṭavyety āhuḥ . yo ha vai virājam atiyajate punar ha so 'muṣmin loke yajamāna āste . sa rūkṣaḥ paruṣo virājaṃ saṃpipādayiṣann īpsann anāpnuvann āste . kva hi tad āpsyati yad ito 'nāptvā praiti . paruṣān iva hāsīnān asito daivala uvāca ka eta āsata iti . ye virājam atyayajāmahīti hocuḥ .
sentences: annaṃ ha vai devānāṃ somo rājā .
annam eva tat kr̥tvā devebʰyaḥ somaṃ rājānaṃ prayaccʰati .
na ha vā eṣo 'nabʰiṣuto devānām annam .
tam etad abʰiṣutyānnaṃ kr̥tvā devebʰyaḥ prayaccʰati .
yad dʰa vā iha devebʰyaḥ karoti tad asmai devāḥ kurvanti .
ta enaṃ samr̥ddʰāḥ prajayā paśubʰir annādyena samardʰayanti .
yo ha vai virājam atiyajate punar ha so 'muṣmin loke yajamāna āste .
sa rūkṣaḥ paruṣo virājaṃ saṃpipādayiṣann īpsann anāpnuvann āste .
kva hi tad āpsyati yad ito 'nāptvā praiti .
paruṣān iva hāsīnān asito daivala uvāca ka eta āsata iti .
text: They say one should sacrifice with a sacrifice that attains the virāj completion. Food is the virāj. Soma the king is indeed the food of the gods. One thereby makes it into food and offers Soma the king to the gods. For this soma, when it has not been pressed, is not the food of the gods. By pressing it and making it food, one offers it to the gods. What one does here for the gods, that the gods do for him. They enrich him abundantly with offspring, cattle, and food. They say the virāj should not be exceeded. He who exceeds the virāj sits sacrificing again in the other world. Rough and harsh, trying to complete the virāj, desiring but not obtaining, he sits. For how shall he obtain there what he departs from here without obtaining? Asita Daivala said to those sitting there as if rough: 'Who are these sitting here?' 'We are those who exceeded the virāj in sacrifice,' they said.
meaning: विराट्संपदैव यज्ञेन यजेतेत्य् आहुः . अन्नं वै विराट् . अन्नं ह वै देवानां सोमो राजा . अन्नम् एव तत् कृत्वा देवेभ्यः सोमं राजानं प्रयच्छति . न ह वा एषो ऽनभिषुतो देवानाम् अन्नम् . तम् एतद् अभिषुत्यान्नं कृत्वा देवेभ्यः प्रयच्छति . यद् ध वा इह देवेभ्यः करोति तद् अस्मै देवाः कुर्वन्ति . त एनं समृद्धाः प्रजया पशुभिर् अन्नाद्येन समर्धयन्ति . विराण् नातियष्टव्येत्य् आहुः . यो ह वै विराजम् अतियजते पुनर् ह सो ऽमुष्मिन् लोके यजमान आस्ते . स रूक्षः परुषो विराजं संपिपादयिषन्न् ईप्सन्न् अनाप्नुवन्न् आस्ते . क्व हि तद् आप्स्यति यद् इतो ऽनाप्त्वा प्रैति . परुषान् इव हासीनान् असितो दैवल उवाच क एत आसत इति . ये विराजम् अत्ययजामहीति होचुः .

sanskrit_iast: puraś cakraṃ patho bile taṃ cakram abhivartate yo 'saṃpannena yajate pāko yajñena devayur yad dadāti tad evāsya na lokam abhigacchati iti . pākāḥ santo 'vijānanto 'devāyateti haināṃs tad uvāca ye virājam atyayajadhvam iti . tad āhuḥ kuto yajñam atathāḥ kvainaṃ pratyatiṣṭhipa iti . yata evainam atasīti brūyāt tad evainaṃ pratyatiṣṭhipam iti . puruṣād dha vai yajñas tāyate puruṣe pratitiṣṭhati . atha ha hṛtsvāśayā āllakeyo mahāvṛṣo rājā putraṃ dīkṣayāṃ cakāra . tasya ha somaśuṣmaḥ sātyayajñir udgīthāyoḍha āsa . tam u ha mahāvṛṣāṇāṃ dūtā āsasrur āgaccha samitir vā iyam iti . tad dha pradhāvayann uvācodgātar etaṃ te putraṃ paridadānīti . sa heṣṭvā punar ājagāma . sa hovācodgātaḥ kva yajñaṃ pratyatiṣṭhipaḥ kva yajamānaṃ kvāsya paśūn iti . tad dha na pratyuvāca . sa hovāca punar me putraṃ dīkṣayata na vai vidma yatra me putram akṛd iti . tam u ha punar dīkṣayāṃ cakruḥ . tasya ha svayam evojjagau .
sentences: pāko yajñena devayur yad dadāti tad evāsya
pākāḥ santo 'vijānanto 'devāyateti haināṃs tad uvāca ye virājam atyayajadʰvam iti .
tad āhuḥ kuto yajñam atatʰāḥ kvainaṃ pratyatiṣṭʰipa iti .
yata evainam atasīti brūyāt tad evainaṃ pratyatiṣṭʰipam iti .
puruṣād dʰa vai yajñas tāyate puruṣe pratitiṣṭʰati .
atʰa ha hr̥tsvāśayā āllakeyo mahāvr̥ṣo rājā putraṃ dīkṣayāṃ cakāra .
tasya ha somaśuṣmaḥ sātyayajñir udgītʰāyoḍʰa āsa .
tam u ha mahāvr̥ṣāṇāṃ dūtā āsasrur āgaccʰa samitir vā iyam iti .
tad dʰa pradʰāvayann uvācodgātar etaṃ te putraṃ paridadānīti .
sa hovācodgātaḥ kva yajñaṃ pratyatiṣṭʰipaḥ kva yajamānaṃ kvāsya paśūn iti .
sa hovāca punar me putraṃ dīkṣayata na vai vidma yatra me putram akr̥d iti .
tam u ha punar dīkṣayāṃ cakruḥ .
text: 'The wheel turns before on the edge of the path — the wheel turns against him who sacrifices with an incomplete rite, the simple man who seeks the gods through sacrifice. What he gives, that alone goes to him; he does not reach the world.' 'Being simple, unknowing, not approaching the gods' — thus he said to those who exceeded the virāj in sacrifice. On this they say: 'From where did you start the sacrifice? Where did you establish it again?' One should answer: 'From where I started it, there I established it again.' For the sacrifice is born from the person and rests upon the person. Now Hṛtsvāśaya Āllakeya, the great king Mahāvṛṣa, had his son consecrated for the sacrifice. Somaśuṣman Sātyayajñi was appointed as his udgātṛ. The messengers of Mahāvṛṣa came running to him: 'Come, there is an assembly.' He, sending him off quickly, said: 'Udgātṛ, I entrust this son to you.' Having sacrificed, he came back. He said: 'Udgātṛ, where did you establish the sacrifice? Where the sacrificer? Where his cattle?' He could not answer. He said: 'Consecrate my son again, for we do not know what he did with my son.' They consecrated him again. This time he sang the udgītha himself.
meaning: पुरश् चक्रं पथो बिले तं चक्रम् अभिवर्तते यो ऽसंपन्नेन यजते पाको यज्ञेन देवयुर् यद् ददाति तद् एवास्य न लोकम् अभिगच्छति इति . पाकाः सन्तो ऽविजानन्तो ऽदेवायतेति हैनांस् तद् उवाच ये विराजम् अत्ययजध्वम् इति . तद् आहुः कुतो यज्ञम् अतथाः क्वैनं प्रत्यतिष्ठिप इति . यत एवैनम् अतसीति ब्रूयात् तद् एवैनं प्रत्यतिष्ठिपम् इति . पुरुषाद् ध वै यज्ञस् तायते पुरुषे प्रतितिष्ठति . अथ ह हृत्स्वाशया आल्लकेयो महावृषो राजा पुत्रं दीक्षयां चकार . तस्य ह सोमशुष्मः सात्ययज्ञिर् उद्गीथायोढ आस . तम् उ ह महावृषाणां दूता आसस्रुर् आगच्छ समितिर् वा इयम् इति . तद् ध प्रधावयन्न् उवाचोद्गातर् एतं ते पुत्रं परिददानीति . स हेष्ट्वा पुनर् आजगाम . स होवाचोद्गातः क्व यज्ञं प्रत्यतिष्ठिपः क्व यजमानं क्वास्य पशून् इति . तद् ध न प्रत्युवाच . स होवाच पुनर् मे पुत्रं दीक्षयत न वै विद्म यत्र मे पुत्रम् अकृद् इति . तम् उ ह पुनर् दीक्षयां चक्रुः . तस्य ह स्वयम् एवोज्जगौ .

sanskrit_iast: etad dha vai paramaṃ vācaḥ krāntaṃ yad daśeti . etāvad dha paramaṃ vāk cakrame . tad yat paramaṃ vācaḥ krāntaṃ tat sarvam āpnavānīti . atha yad ata ūrdhvaṃ viṃśatiś śataṃ sahasram ity aṅgāny evāsyai tāni parvāṇi . vāca eva sā prabhūtiḥ . tad u hātraiva sarvāṃ virājam āpnoti . puruṣasaṃpad dha khalu vā eṣā daśākṣarā virāṭ . daśa puruṣe prāṇāḥ . sā vā eṣaitāsām eva navatiśatasya stotriyāṇāṃ praśaṃsā . navatiśataṃ hy evaiṣo 'gniṣṭomaḥ saṃstuto bhavati . kṛtaṃ tad yad aśītiśatam . kṛtam id u daśa kṛtaṃ sat . tad u ha kurava āhur dvāpara eṣa yan navatiśataṃ stotriyās trayāṇām ayānām adhamaḥ . kṛtaṃ vai tretādvāparam . dve stotriye upaprastutye . sa kṛtastomaḥ saṃpadyate . kṛtena taj jayati yaj jigīṣati . kṛtenodbhinatti . atho pakṣāv etau yat pavamānau . tāv eva tat samau karoti . atho viśvajyotir eva yajñakratur bhavati . atho dvyatiṣṭutaḥ . tāv eva virājaḥ stanau .
sentences: etad dʰa vai paramaṃ vācaḥ krāntaṃ yad daśeti .
tad yat paramaṃ vācaḥ krāntaṃ tat sarvam āpnavānīti .
atʰa yad ata ūrdʰvaṃ viṃśatiś śataṃ sahasram ity aṅgāny evāsyai tāni parvāṇi .
tad u hātraiva sarvāṃ virājam āpnoti .
puruṣasaṃpad dʰa kʰalu vā eṣā daśākṣarā virāṭ .
sā vā eṣaitāsām eva navatiśatasya stotriyāṇāṃ praśaṃsā .
kr̥tam id u daśa kr̥taṃ sat .
tad u ha kurava āhur dvāpara eṣa yan navatiśataṃ stotriyās trayāṇām ayānām adʰamaḥ .
text: This is indeed the furthest extent of speech — ten. Speech has gone this far as its maximum. 'May I attain all that which is the furthest extent of speech.' Now what is beyond — twenty, hundred, thousand — those are merely its limbs and joints. That is the prolixity of speech. One obtains the entire virāj right here. This ten-syllabled virāj is indeed the human measure (puruṣasaṃpad). A person has ten vital breaths. This is indeed the praise of these one hundred and ninety stotriyas. For this agniṣṭoma, when fully praised, amounts to one hundred and ninety. The completed measure is one hundred and eighty. Ten indeed is the accomplished (kṛta). That which is accomplished is kṛta. The Kurus say: 'This one hundred and ninety stotriyas is dvāpara — the lowest of the three paths.' Kṛta, tretā, and dvāpara — there are two stotriyas that are additionally praised. It thereby amounts to the kṛta-stoma. By the kṛta one conquers what one wishes to conquer. By the kṛta one pierces through. Also, the two pavamānas are like two wings. One thereby makes them equal. Also, the yajñakratu becomes all-luminous. Also, it is doubly praised. These two are the teats of the virāj.
meaning: एतद् ध वै परमं वाचः क्रान्तं यद् दशेति . एतावद् ध परमं वाक् चक्रमे . तद् यत् परमं वाचः क्रान्तं तत् सर्वम् आप्नवानीति . अथ यद् अत ऊर्ध्वं विंशतिश् शतं सहस्रम् इत्य् अङ्गान्य् एवास्यै तानि पर्वाणि . वाच एव सा प्रभूतिः . तद् उ हात्रैव सर्वां विराजम् आप्नोति . पुरुषसंपद् ध खलु वा एषा दशाक्षरा विराट् . दश पुरुषे प्राणाः . सा वा एषैतासाम् एव नवतिशतस्य स्तोत्रियाणां प्रशंसा . नवतिशतं ह्य् एवैषो ऽग्निष्टोमः संस्तुतो भवति . कृतं तद् यद् अशीतिशतम् . कृतम् इद् उ दश कृतं सत् . तद् उ ह कुरव आहुर् द्वापर एष यन् नवतिशतं स्तोत्रियास् त्रयाणाम् अयानाम् अधमः . कृतं वै त्रेताद्वापरम् . द्वे स्तोत्रिये उपप्रस्तुत्ये . स कृतस्तोमः संपद्यते . कृतेन तज् जयति यज् जिगीषति . कृतेनोद्भिनत्ति . अथो पक्षाव् एतौ यत् पवमानौ . ताव् एव तत् समौ करोति . अथो विश्वज्योतिर् एव यज्ञक्रतुर् भवति . अथो द्व्यतिष्टुतः . ताव् एव विराजः स्तनौ .

sanskrit_iast: tad u ha smāha kahol̥aḥ kauṣītakeyo dīrghastanī bata teṣāṃ virāḍ yeṣāṃ stotriye virājaḥ stanāv iti . api nūnam etāṃ virājaṃ prativeśato duhre iti ha smāha . akṣaryām evaitāṃ saṃpadaṃ devā upāsata . tām ṛṣaya upāsata . tām u eva vayaṃ paro'vara upāsmahe . etāsām eva navatiśatasya stotriyāṇāṃ pañca ca sahasrāṇy ā catvāriṃśatāny ā dvāsaptatir akṣarāṇi . tad ye eva te dvāsaptatitame akṣare tāv eva virājaḥ stanau . sa dvipād yajamānaḥ pratiṣṭhityā iti . tad āhur yad dvāparaḥ stomo 'tha kena kṛtastoma iti . akṣarair iti brūyāt . atho stotrair iti . atho stutaśastrair iti . atho yad daśakṛtam iti brūyāt teno eva kṛtastoma iti .
sentences: tad u ha smāha kahol̥aḥ kauṣītakeyo dīrgʰastanī bata teṣāṃ virāḍ yeṣāṃ stotriye virājaḥ stanāv iti .
api nūnam etāṃ virājaṃ prativeśato duhre iti ha smāha .
tām u eva vayaṃ paro'vara upāsmahe .
etāsām eva navatiśatasya stotriyāṇāṃ pañca ca sahasrāṇy ā catvāriṃśatāny ā dvāsaptatir akṣarāṇi .
tad ye eva te dvāsaptatitame akṣare tāv eva virājaḥ stanau .
tad āhur yad dvāparaḥ stomo 'tʰa kena kr̥tastoma iti .
atʰo yad daśakr̥tam iti brūyāt teno eva kr̥tastoma iti .
text: On this Kahoḍa Kauṣītakeya used to say: 'Long-teated indeed is the virāj of those whose stotriyas are the teats of the virāj.' 'Even now people milk this virāj from their neighbor,' he used to say. The gods worshipped this completion by syllables. The ṛṣis worshipped it. And we later ones also worship it. Of these one hundred and ninety stotriyas, there are five thousand and forty-two and seventy-two syllables. Those two which are at the seventy-second syllable — they are the two teats of the virāj. The sacrificer, being two-footed, stands for firm foundation. On this they say: 'If the stoma is dvāpara, by what does it become kṛtastoma?' One should answer: 'By the syllables.' Also: 'By the stotras.' Also: 'By the stuta-śastras.' Also: 'Because it is tenfold kṛta, it is therefore kṛtastoma.'
meaning: तद् उ ह स्माह कहोल्̥अः कौषीतकेयो दीर्घस्तनी बत तेषां विराड् येषां स्तोत्रिये विराजः स्तनाव् इति . अपि नूनम् एतां विराजं प्रतिवेशतो दुह्रे इति ह स्माह . अक्षर्याम् एवैतां संपदं देवा उपासत . ताम् ऋषय उपासत . ताम् उ एव वयं परोऽवर उपास्महे . एतासाम् एव नवतिशतस्य स्तोत्रियाणां पञ्च च सहस्राण्य् आ चत्वारिंशतान्य् आ द्वासप्ततिर् अक्षराणि . तद् ये एव ते द्वासप्ततितमे अक्षरे ताव् एव विराजः स्तनौ . स द्विपाद् यजमानः प्रतिष्ठित्या इति . तद् आहुर् यद् द्वापरः स्तोमो ऽथ केन कृतस्तोम इति . अक्षरैर् इति ब्रूयात् . अथो स्तोत्रैर् इति . अथो स्तुतशस्त्रैर् इति . अथो यद् दशकृतम् इति ब्रूयात् तेनो एव कृतस्तोम इति .

sanskrit_iast: āpo vā idam agre mahat salilam āsīt . tad apām evaiśvaryam āsīt . yad apām evaiśvaryam āsīd apāṃ rājyam apām annādyaṃ tad agnir abhyadhyāyan mamedam aiśvaryaṃ mama rājyaṃ mamānnādyaṃ syād iti . sa etām agniṣṭomasaṃpadam apaśyat . tayemā apo vyudauhad ūrdhvaś cāvācīś ca . sa etam eva dinaṃdinaṃ stomaṃ gāyan kevalīdam annādyam akuruta . sa navabhir ekaviṃśair amūr ūrdhvā udatabhnot . tāḥ pareṇa divaṃ paryauhat . tā etāḥ paryūḍhā ṛtuśo varṣantīs tiṣṭhanti . ekaviṃśatyā trivṛdbhir imā avācīr abhyatiṣṭhat .
sentences: āpo vā idam agre mahat salilam āsīt .
yad apām evaiśvaryam āsīd apāṃ rājyam apām annādyaṃ tad agnir abʰyadʰyāyan mamedam aiśvaryaṃ mama rājyaṃ mamānnādyaṃ syād iti .
tayemā apo vyudauhad ūrdʰvaś cāvācīś ca .
sa etam eva dinaṃdinaṃ stomaṃ gāyan kevalīdam annādyam akuruta .
sa navabʰir ekaviṃśair amūr ūrdʰvā udatabʰnot .
tā etāḥ paryūḍʰā r̥tuśo varṣantīs tiṣṭʰanti .
text: In the beginning this was a great ocean of waters. Sovereignty belonged to the waters alone. Since sovereignty, kingship, and food belonged to the waters, Agni meditated: 'May this sovereignty, this kingship, this food be mine.' He saw this agniṣṭoma-completion. With it he divided these waters, both the upward and the downward ones. Singing this very stoma day after day, he made this food entirely his own. With nine ekaviṃśas he propped up those upper waters. He drove them beyond heaven. Those driven-away waters stand there, raining season by season. With twenty-one trivṛts he stood over these lower waters.
meaning: आपो वा इदम् अग्रे महत् सलिलम् आसीत् . तद् अपाम् एवैश्वर्यम् आसीत् . यद् अपाम् एवैश्वर्यम् आसीद् अपां राज्यम् अपाम् अन्नाद्यं तद् अग्निर् अभ्यध्यायन् ममेदम् ऐश्वर्यं मम राज्यं ममान्नाद्यं स्याद् इति . स एताम् अग्निष्टोमसंपदम् अपश्यत् . तयेमा अपो व्युदौहद् ऊर्ध्वश् चावाचीश् च . स एतम् एव दिनंदिनं स्तोमं गायन् केवलीदम् अन्नाद्यम् अकुरुत . स नवभिर् एकविंशैर् अमूर् ऊर्ध्वा उदतभ्नोत् . ताः परेण दिवं पर्यौहत् . ता एताः पर्यूढा ऋतुशो वर्षन्तीस् तिष्ठन्ति . एकविंशत्या त्रिवृद्भिर् इमा अवाचीर् अभ्यतिष्ठत् .

sanskrit_iast: tiṣṭhantīr eke sravantīr eke . sa evam etā apo vyūhya vinudyāsmin loke 'nnam ādat . tan nālpakaṃ na madhyamaṃ na mahad ivānnādyam abhyatyaricyata . evam eva dviṣantaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ vyūhya vinudyāsmin loke 'nnam atti tan nālpakaṃ na madhyamaṃ na mahad ivānnādyam abhyatiricyate ya evaṃ veda . tam etam annaṃ jigīvāṃsaṃ sarve devā abhisamagacchanta . te vai tan nāvindanta . yā hy asau yajñāyajñīyasyaikaviṃśī tām āsu bahiṣpavamānīsu navasu pratyupadhāya śaye 'nanto bhūtvā parigṛhyaitad annādyam . atho yathā pātre 'ṅgārā optāḥ syur evam evaiṣu lokeṣv adṛśyo 'nanta āsa .
sentences: sa evam etā apo vyūhya vinudyāsmin loke 'nnam ādat .
tan nālpakaṃ na madʰyamaṃ na mahad ivānnādyam abʰyatyaricyata .
evam eva dviṣantaṃ bʰrātr̥vyaṃ vyūhya vinudyāsmin loke 'nnam atti tan nālpakaṃ na madʰyamaṃ na mahad ivānnādyam abʰyatiricyate ya evaṃ veda .
tam etam annaṃ jigīvāṃsaṃ sarve devā abʰisamagaccʰanta .
yā hy asau yajñāyajñīyasyaikaviṃśī tām āsu bahiṣpavamānīsu navasu pratyupadʰāya śaye 'nanto bʰūtvā parigr̥hyaitad annādyam .
atʰo yatʰā pātre 'ṅgārā optāḥ syur evam evaiṣu lokeṣv adr̥śyo 'nanta āsa .
text: Some standing, some flowing. Having thus divided and driven apart these waters, he took the food in this world. That food did not diminish — neither the small, nor the medium, nor the great amount of food was exceeded. He who knows thus, having divided and driven apart the rival kinsman, eats food in this world — that food does not diminish, neither the small, nor the medium, nor the great. All the gods gathered around him who had conquered this food. They did not find him. For he lay hidden among these nine bahiṣpavamānīs, having placed that ekaviṃśī of the yajñāyajñīya upon them, having become infinite, holding that food enclosed. Just as embers placed in a vessel — so in these worlds he was invisible, infinite.
meaning: तिष्ठन्तीर् एके स्रवन्तीर् एके . स एवम् एता अपो व्यूह्य विनुद्यास्मिन् लोके ऽन्नम् आदत् . तन् नाल्पकं न मध्यमं न महद् इवान्नाद्यम् अभ्यत्यरिच्यत . एवम् एव द्विषन्तं भ्रातृव्यं व्यूह्य विनुद्यास्मिन् लोके ऽन्नम् अत्ति तन् नाल्पकं न मध्यमं न महद् इवान्नाद्यम् अभ्यतिरिच्यते य एवं वेद . तम् एतम् अन्नं जिगीवांसं सर्वे देवा अभिसमगच्छन्त . ते वै तन् नाविन्दन्त . या ह्य् असौ यज्ञायज्ञीयस्यैकविंशी ताम् आसु बहिष्पवमानीसु नवसु प्रत्युपधाय शये ऽनन्तो भूत्वा परिगृह्यैतद् अन्नाद्यम् . अथो यथा पात्रे ऽङ्गारा ओप्ताः स्युर् एवम् एवैषु लोकेष्व् अदृश्यो ऽनन्त आस .

sanskrit_iast: taṃ vasavo gāyatryā chandasā gāyatreṇa sāmnā prātaḥsavanenāstuvan . tāṃs tasminn eva savana upāhvayata . taṃ rudrās triṣṭubhā chandasā traiṣṭubhena sāmnā mādhyaṃdinena savanenāstuvan . tāṃs tasminn eva savana upāhvayata . tam ādityā jagatyā chandasā jāgatena sāmnā tṛtīyasavanenāstuvan . tāṃs tasminn eva savana upāhvayata . taṃ viśve devā vāṅ manaś ca prajāpatir anuṣṭubhā chandasā yajñāyajñīyena sāmnāstuvan . tāṃs tasminn eva stotra upāhvayata .
sentences: taṃ vasavo gāyatryā cʰandasā gāyatreṇa sāmnā prātaḥsavanenāstuvan .
taṃ rudrās triṣṭubʰā cʰandasā traiṣṭubʰena sāmnā mādʰyaṃdinena savanenāstuvan .
tam ādityā jagatyā cʰandasā jāgatena sāmnā tr̥tīyasavanenāstuvan .
taṃ viśve devā vāṅ manaś ca prajāpatir anuṣṭubʰā cʰandasā yajñāyajñīyena sāmnāstuvan .
text: The Vasus praised him with the gāyatrī meter, the gāyatra sāman, and the morning pressing. He invited them at that very pressing. The Rudras praised him with the triṣṭubh meter, the traiṣṭubha sāman, and the midday pressing. He invited them at that very pressing. The Ādityas praised him with the jagatī meter, the jāgata sāman, and the third pressing. He invited them at that very pressing. The Viśve Devāḥ — speech and mind — and Prajāpati praised him with the anuṣṭubh meter and the yajñāyajñīya sāman. He invited them at that very stotra.
meaning: तं वसवो गायत्र्या छन्दसा गायत्रेण साम्ना प्रातःसवनेनास्तुवन् . तांस् तस्मिन्न् एव सवन उपाह्वयत . तं रुद्रास् त्रिष्टुभा छन्दसा त्रैष्टुभेन साम्ना माध्यंदिनेन सवनेनास्तुवन् . तांस् तस्मिन्न् एव सवन उपाह्वयत . तम् आदित्या जगत्या छन्दसा जागतेन साम्ना तृतीयसवनेनास्तुवन् . तांस् तस्मिन्न् एव सवन उपाह्वयत . तं विश्वे देवा वाङ् मनश् च प्रजापतिर् अनुष्टुभा छन्दसा यज्ञायज्ञीयेन साम्नास्तुवन् . तांस् तस्मिन्न् एव स्तोत्र उपाह्वयत .

sanskrit_iast: śaśvad dha te parābhūtā devānām aśanayā . atha ya enam anvāyatanta ima etarhi pariśiṣṭāḥ . ta u evāparyuṣi bhavitāraḥ . sa haiṣa vaiśvadevaḥ stomaḥ . viśveṣāṃ haiva devānāṃ purā stoma āsa . tena yad agnim astuvan sāsyāgniṣṭomatā . agniṃ hainenāstuvan . stuvate hainena svā stuvate 'raṇā . stuvate hainena jane svā ya evaṃ veda . sa haiṣa navaikaviṃśān abhisaṃpadyate dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavas traya ime lokā asāv āditya ekaviṃśaḥ . ekā stotriyātiricyate . yajamāno haiva so 'tiricyate yo vaivaṃ veda . yathā ha girau jyotir bhāyād eva tasyāṃ janatāyāṃ bhāti yasyāṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda . sa u evaikaviṃśatis trivṛto 'bhisaṃpadyate . agnir vai trivṛt . tad yad vai kiṃ ca trivṛt tat sarvam agnim evābhisaṃpadyate . yāś ca ha mahatyaḥ saṃpado yāś ca kṣullakās tā ha sarvā evaṃvidam abhisaṃpadyante . sarva enaṃ kāmā abhisaṃpadyante ya evaṃ veda . sa eṣa ekaviṃśatyā trivṛdbhir amuṣminn āditye pratiṣṭhito navabhir asāv ekaviṃśair asmin . tāv etāv evam anyo'nyasmin pratiṣṭhitau .
sentences: śaśvad dʰa te parābʰūtā devānām aśanayā .
atʰa ya enam anvāyatanta ima etarhi pariśiṣṭāḥ .
viśveṣāṃ haiva devānāṃ purā stoma āsa .
stuvate hainena jane svā ya evaṃ veda .
sa haiṣa navaikaviṃśān abʰisaṃpadyate dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavas traya ime lokā asāv āditya ekaviṃśaḥ .
yajamāno haiva so 'tiricyate yo vaivaṃ veda .
yatʰā ha girau jyotir bʰāyād eva tasyāṃ janatāyāṃ bʰāti yasyāṃ bʰavati ya evaṃ veda .
tad yad vai kiṃ ca trivr̥t tat sarvam agnim evābʰisaṃpadyate .
yāś ca ha mahatyaḥ saṃpado yāś ca kṣullakās tā ha sarvā evaṃvidam abʰisaṃpadyante .
sarva enaṃ kāmā abʰisaṃpadyante ya evaṃ veda .
sa eṣa ekaviṃśatyā trivr̥dbʰir amuṣminn āditye pratiṣṭʰito navabʰir asāv ekaviṃśair asmin .
text: Repeatedly were those vanquished who partook of the gods' food without knowledge. But those who followed him are these who remain now. And they will be imperishable. This is indeed the Vaiśvadeva stoma. It was formerly the stoma of all the gods. Because they praised Agni with it, that is its agniṣṭoma character. They praised Agni with it. He who praises with it praises his own and also strangers. He praises among people, his own, who knows thus. This amounts to nine ekaviṃśas: twelve months, five seasons, these three worlds, and that sun as the twenty-first. One stotriyā is left over. The sacrificer himself is that surplus — he who knows thus. Just as a light would shine on a mountain, so he shines in that community in which he lives, who knows thus. And this also amounts to twenty-one trivṛts. The trivṛt is Agni. Whatever is trivṛt, all that amounts to Agni. Both the great accomplishments and the small — they all converge upon one who knows thus. All desires converge upon him who knows thus. This is established in that sun by twenty-one trivṛts, and that sun is established in this by nine ekaviṃśas. These two are thus established in one another.
meaning: शश्वद् ध ते पराभूता देवानाम् अशनया . अथ य एनम् अन्वायतन्त इम एतर्हि परिशिष्टाः . त उ एवापर्युषि भवितारः . स हैष वैश्वदेवः स्तोमः . विश्वेषां हैव देवानां पुरा स्तोम आस . तेन यद् अग्निम् अस्तुवन् सास्याग्निष्टोमता . अग्निं हैनेनास्तुवन् . स्तुवते हैनेन स्वा स्तुवते ऽरणा . स्तुवते हैनेन जने स्वा य एवं वेद . स हैष नवैकविंशान् अभिसंपद्यते द्वादश मासाः पञ्चर्तवस् त्रय इमे लोका असाव् आदित्य एकविंशः . एका स्तोत्रियातिरिच्यते . यजमानो हैव सो ऽतिरिच्यते यो वैवं वेद . यथा ह गिरौ ज्योतिर् भायाद् एव तस्यां जनतायां भाति यस्यां भवति य एवं वेद . स उ एवैकविंशतिस् त्रिवृतो ऽभिसंपद्यते . अग्निर् वै त्रिवृत् . तद् यद् वै किं च त्रिवृत् तत् सर्वम् अग्निम् एवाभिसंपद्यते . याश् च ह महत्यः संपदो याश् च क्षुल्लकास् ता ह सर्वा एवंविदम् अभिसंपद्यन्ते . सर्व एनं कामा अभिसंपद्यन्ते य एवं वेद . स एष एकविंशत्या त्रिवृद्भिर् अमुष्मिन्न् आदित्ये प्रतिष्ठितो नवभिर् असाव् एकविंशैर् अस्मिन् . ताव् एताव् एवम् अन्योऽन्यस्मिन् प्रतिष्ठितौ .

sanskrit_iast: nāsāv astam eti nāyam anugacchati . imam evāsāv abhy astam eti . tad asyāstatvam . imaṃ hy evāsāv abhy astam ety amum evāyam abhyanugacchati . tad amuṣyāmutvam . amuṃ hy evāyam abhyanugacchati . na hāstam eti nānugacchati ya evaṃ veda . te haite savāsinyau devate . gacchati haitābhyāṃ savāsitvam . atho hāsyaite eva devate . eṣu lokeṣu sarvapāpmānam apaghnatyau tiṣṭhataḥ . yāvad u ha vā ayam agnir asmin loke dīpyate tāvad amuṣmin loka ādityaḥ . na haiva tāvad evaṃvido lokaḥ kṣayyaḥ . yathā ha vā idam āyatanam āyatanī prepsed evam imaṃ lokam āpaḥ prepsanti yāś cāmūr yāś cemāḥ . tā yan na saṃbhindanty etasyaiva stomasya kartoḥ . eṣa evaināḥ stomo vidadate . sa yo nvāvaikasya rājyasya trātā dvayor yas trayāṇāṃ lokī vāva sa tena manyeta . antye tu sa loky asad yas teṣām eko 'sad ye 'sya lokasya trātāraḥ . asya ha sa lokasya trātr̥̄ṇām eko bhavati ya evaṃ veda . tena lokī saḥ .
sentences: imaṃ hy evāsāv abʰy astam ety amum evāyam abʰyanugaccʰati .
na hāstam eti nānugaccʰati ya evaṃ veda .
yāvad u ha vā ayam agnir asmin loke dīpyate tāvad amuṣmin loka ādityaḥ .
na haiva tāvad evaṃvido lokaḥ kṣayyaḥ .
yatʰā ha vā idam āyatanam āyatanī prepsed evam imaṃ lokam āpaḥ prepsanti yāś cāmūr yāś cemāḥ .
tā yan na saṃbʰindanty etasyaiva stomasya kartoḥ .
sa yo nvāvaikasya rājyasya trātā dvayor yas trayāṇāṃ lokī vāva sa tena manyeta .
antye tu sa loky asad yas teṣām eko 'sad ye 'sya lokasya trātāraḥ .
asya ha sa lokasya trātr̥̄ṇām eko bʰavati ya evaṃ veda .
text: That sun does not set, nor does this fire follow it. Rather, that sun sets toward this fire. That is its setting (astatva). For that sun sets toward this fire, and this fire follows toward that sun. That is the other-worldliness of that sun. For this fire follows toward that sun. Neither does it set nor follow for one who knows thus. These two deities dwell together. One attains co-dwelling with them. Also, these two deities of his stand in these worlds destroying all evil. For as long as this fire burns in this world, so long does the sun shine in the other world. The world of one who knows thus is never destroyed. Just as waters seek to reach a foundation, so these waters — both those above and those below — seek to reach this world. That they do not break through is the work of this stoma. This stoma holds them apart. Now, one who is the protector of a single kingdom, of two, of three — he might consider himself a lord of worlds. But the ultimate lord of worlds would be one of those who are the protectors of this world. He who knows thus becomes one of the protectors of this world. Thereby he is a lord of worlds.
meaning: नासाव् अस्तम् एति नायम् अनुगच्छति . इमम् एवासाव् अभ्य् अस्तम् एति . तद् अस्यास्तत्वम् . इमं ह्य् एवासाव् अभ्य् अस्तम् एत्य् अमुम् एवायम् अभ्यनुगच्छति . तद् अमुष्यामुत्वम् . अमुं ह्य् एवायम् अभ्यनुगच्छति . न हास्तम् एति नानुगच्छति य एवं वेद . ते हैते सवासिन्यौ देवते . गच्छति हैताभ्यां सवासित्वम् . अथो हास्यैते एव देवते . एषु लोकेषु सर्वपाप्मानम् अपघ्नत्यौ तिष्ठतः . यावद् उ ह वा अयम् अग्निर् अस्मिन् लोके दीप्यते तावद् अमुष्मिन् लोक आदित्यः . न हैव तावद् एवंविदो लोकः क्षय्यः . यथा ह वा इदम् आयतनम् आयतनी प्रेप्सेद् एवम् इमं लोकम् आपः प्रेप्सन्ति याश् चामूर् याश् चेमाः . ता यन् न संभिन्दन्त्य् एतस्यैव स्तोमस्य कर्तोः . एष एवैनाः स्तोमो विददते . स यो न्वावैकस्य राज्यस्य त्राता द्वयोर् यस् त्रयाणां लोकी वाव स तेन मन्येत . अन्त्ये तु स लोक्य् असद् यस् तेषाम् एको ऽसद् ये ऽस्य लोकस्य त्रातारः . अस्य ह स लोकस्य त्रात्र्̥̄णाम् एको भवति य एवं वेद . तेन लोकी सः .

sanskrit_iast: tasya vā etasyāgniṣṭomasya gāyatrīm eva prātaḥsavanam saṃpadyate triṣṭubhaṃ mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ jagatīṃ tṛtīyasavanam . tad etat svayaṃsaṃpannaṃ prātaḥsavanam . gāyatram eva sarvam . atha catvāri chandāṃsi mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ gāyatrī bṛhatī kakup triṣṭup . tasyā etasyai kakubho 'ṣṭāviṃśatyakṣarāyai viṃśatim akṣarāṇi gāyatryām upadadhāti . sā triṣṭup saṃpadyate . atha yāny aṣṭāv atiricyante tāni bṛhatyām upadadhāti . sā triṣṭup saṃpadyate . triṣṭub eva triṣṭup . atha ṣaṭ chandāṃsi tṛtīyasavanaṃ gāyatry uṣṇikkakubhāv anuṣṭub jagatī bṛhatī . tasyā etasyai gāyatryai caturviṃśatyakṣarāyai viṃśatim akṣarāṇi kakubhy upadadhāti . sā jagatī saṃpadyate . atha yāni catvāry atiricyante tāny uṣṇihy upadadhāti . sā dvātriṃśadakṣarānuṣṭup saṃpadyate . anuṣṭub evānuṣṭup . tāṃ dvedhā vyūhati . tasyai ṣoḍaśākṣarāṇy anuṣṭubhy upadadhāti . sā jagatī saṃpadyate . svayam eva parastāj jagatī . atha yāni ṣoḍaśātiricyante tāni yajñāyajñīyasya bṛhatyām upadadhāti . sā dvāpañcāśadakṣarā jagatī saṃpadyate . catvāry akṣarāṇi jagatīm atiyanti ya ete catuṣpādāḥ paśavaḥ . atho stanā eva virājo dohaḥ . atho pratiṣṭhaiva . yathā catuṣpadī pratiṣṭhāt tathā . tad v atraivānuvyeti .
sentences: tasya vā etasyāgniṣṭomasya gāyatrīm eva prātaḥsavanam saṃpadyate triṣṭubʰaṃ mādʰyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ jagatīṃ tr̥tīyasavanam .
atʰa catvāri cʰandāṃsi mādʰyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ gāyatrī br̥hatī kakup triṣṭup .
tasyā etasyai kakubʰo 'ṣṭāviṃśatyakṣarāyai viṃśatim akṣarāṇi gāyatryām upadadʰāti .
atʰa yāny aṣṭāv atiricyante tāni br̥hatyām upadadʰāti .
atʰa ṣaṭ cʰandāṃsi tr̥tīyasavanaṃ gāyatry uṣṇikkakubʰāv anuṣṭub jagatī br̥hatī .
tasyā etasyai gāyatryai caturviṃśatyakṣarāyai viṃśatim akṣarāṇi kakubʰy upadadʰāti .
atʰa yāni catvāry atiricyante tāny uṣṇihy upadadʰāti .
atʰa yāni ṣoḍaśātiricyante tāni yajñāyajñīyasya br̥hatyām upadadʰāti .
catvāry akṣarāṇi jagatīm atiyanti ya ete catuṣpādāḥ paśavaḥ .
text: Of this agniṣṭoma, the morning pressing amounts to the gāyatrī, the midday pressing to the triṣṭubh, the third pressing to the jagatī. The morning pressing is self-completing — it is entirely gāyatra. But the midday pressing has four meters: gāyatrī, bṛhatī, kakubh, and triṣṭubh. Of this kakubh of twenty-eight syllables, one places twenty syllables upon the gāyatrī. It becomes a triṣṭubh. The eight that remain, one places upon the bṛhatī. It becomes a triṣṭubh. The triṣṭubh itself is a triṣṭubh. The third pressing has six meters: gāyatrī, uṣṇih, kakubh, anuṣṭubh, jagatī, and bṛhatī. Of this gāyatrī of twenty-four syllables, one places twenty syllables upon the kakubh. It becomes a jagatī. The four that remain, one places upon the uṣṇih. It becomes an anuṣṭubh of thirty-two syllables. The anuṣṭubh itself is an anuṣṭubh. One divides it in two. Of that, one places sixteen syllables upon the anuṣṭubh. It becomes a jagatī. The jagatī beyond stands on its own. The sixteen that remain, one places upon the bṛhatī of the yajñāyajñīya. It becomes a jagatī of fifty-two syllables. Four syllables exceed the jagatī — these are the four-footed animals. Also, these are the teats of the virāj, the milking. Also, this is firm foundation. Just as the four-footed stands firm, so does this. And it resolves right here.
meaning: तस्य वा एतस्याग्निष्टोमस्य गायत्रीम् एव प्रातःसवनम् संपद्यते त्रिष्टुभं माध्यंदिनं सवनं जगतीं तृतीयसवनम् . तद् एतत् स्वयंसंपन्नं प्रातःसवनम् . गायत्रम् एव सर्वम् . अथ चत्वारि छन्दांसि माध्यंदिनं सवनं गायत्री बृहती ककुप् त्रिष्टुप् . तस्या एतस्यै ककुभो ऽष्टाविंशत्यक्षरायै विंशतिम् अक्षराणि गायत्र्याम् उपदधाति . सा त्रिष्टुप् संपद्यते . अथ यान्य् अष्टाव् अतिरिच्यन्ते तानि बृहत्याम् उपदधाति . सा त्रिष्टुप् संपद्यते . त्रिष्टुब् एव त्रिष्टुप् . अथ षट् छन्दांसि तृतीयसवनं गायत्र्य् उष्णिक्ककुभाव् अनुष्टुब् जगती बृहती . तस्या एतस्यै गायत्र्यै चतुर्विंशत्यक्षरायै विंशतिम् अक्षराणि ककुभ्य् उपदधाति . सा जगती संपद्यते . अथ यानि चत्वार्य् अतिरिच्यन्ते तान्य् उष्णिह्य् उपदधाति . सा द्वात्रिंशदक्षरानुष्टुप् संपद्यते . अनुष्टुब् एवानुष्टुप् . तां द्वेधा व्यूहति . तस्यै षोडशाक्षराण्य् अनुष्टुभ्य् उपदधाति . सा जगती संपद्यते . स्वयम् एव परस्ताज् जगती . अथ यानि षोडशातिरिच्यन्ते तानि यज्ञायज्ञीयस्य बृहत्याम् उपदधाति . सा द्वापञ्चाशदक्षरा जगती संपद्यते . चत्वार्य् अक्षराणि जगतीम् अतियन्ति य एते चतुष्पादाः पशवः . अथो स्तना एव विराजो दोहः . अथो प्रतिष्ठैव . यथा चतुष्पदी प्रतिष्ठात् तथा . तद् व् अत्रैवानुव्येति .

sanskrit_iast: yajñāyajñīya ekam . gāyatraṃ vai prātaḥsavanaṃ traiṣṭubhaṃ mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ jāgataṃ tṛtīyasavanam . brahmaṇo 'sya sataḥ kṣatrasyeva prakāśo bhavati vaiśyasyeva rayiḥ puṣṭir ya evaṃ veda . tasyo evākṣaraśo gāyatrīm eva prātaḥsavanaṃ saṃpadyate triṣṭubhaṃ mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ jagatīṃ tṛtīyasavanam . ekānnasaptatiḥ prātaḥsavanasya stotriyāṣ ṣaṣṭis triṣṭubho mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ caturviṃśatiś ca jagatīs tṛtīyasavanam . ekā va kakup . puruṣo vai kakup . sa ha sa yajamāna evaitasyāṃ saṃpady adhyūḍhaḥ . tad v atraivānuvyeti . na kiṃ canātiricyate . ekasyai kakubho 'ṣṭāviṃśatyakṣarāyai catvāry akṣarāṇy ādāya vāmadevyasya nyūne trīṇy upadadhāti yajñāyajñīya ekam . atha yā gāyatrī pariśiṣyate tām ada ekānnasaptatyāṃ prātaḥsavanasya stotriyāsu pratyupadadhāti . tad u hānantam .
sentences: yajñāyajñīya ekam . gāyatraṃ vai prātaḥsavanaṃ traiṣṭubʰaṃ mādʰyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ jāgataṃ tr̥tīyasavanam .
brahmaṇo 'sya sataḥ kṣatrasyeva prakāśo bʰavati vaiśyasyeva rayiḥ puṣṭir ya evaṃ veda .
tasyo evākṣaraśo gāyatrīm eva prātaḥsavanaṃ saṃpadyate triṣṭubʰaṃ mādʰyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ jagatīṃ tr̥tīyasavanam .
ekānnasaptatiḥ prātaḥsavanasya stotriyāṣ ṣaṣṭis triṣṭubʰo mādʰyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ caturviṃśatiś ca jagatīs tr̥tīyasavanam .
sa ha sa yajamāna evaitasyāṃ saṃpady adʰyūḍʰaḥ .
ekasyai kakubʰo 'ṣṭāviṃśatyakṣarāyai catvāry akṣarāṇy ādāya vāmadevyasya nyūne trīṇy upadadʰāti yajñāyajñīya ekam .
atʰa yā gāyatrī pariśiṣyate tām ada ekānnasaptatyāṃ prātaḥsavanasya stotriyāsu pratyupadadʰāti .
text: The yajñāyajñīya is one. The morning pressing is gāyatra, the midday pressing is traiṣṭubha, the third pressing is jāgata. For one who knows thus, there is the brilliance of a brāhmaṇa, the splendor of a kṣatriya, the wealth and nourishment of a vaiśya. Of this, by syllable count, the morning pressing amounts to the gāyatrī, the midday pressing to the triṣṭubh, the third pressing to the jagatī. The stotriyas of the morning pressing are sixty-nine; sixty triṣṭubhs make the midday pressing; and twenty-four jagatīs make the third pressing. There is one kakubh. Man is the kakubh. The sacrificer is mounted upon this completion. And it resolves right here. Nothing is left over. Taking four syllables from one kakubh of twenty-eight syllables, one places three upon the deficit of the vāmadevya, and one upon the yajñāyajñīya. And the gāyatrī that remains, one places it back among the sixty-nine stotriyas of the morning pressing. And that is endless.
meaning: यज्ञायज्ञीय एकम् . गायत्रं वै प्रातःसवनं त्रैष्टुभं माध्यंदिनं सवनं जागतं तृतीयसवनम् . ब्रह्मणो ऽस्य सतः क्षत्रस्येव प्रकाशो भवति वैश्यस्येव रयिः पुष्टिर् य एवं वेद . तस्यो एवाक्षरशो गायत्रीम् एव प्रातःसवनं संपद्यते त्रिष्टुभं माध्यंदिनं सवनं जगतीं तृतीयसवनम् . एकान्नसप्ततिः प्रातःसवनस्य स्तोत्रियाष् षष्टिस् त्रिष्टुभो माध्यंदिनं सवनं चतुर्विंशतिश् च जगतीस् तृतीयसवनम् . एका व ककुप् . पुरुषो वै ककुप् . स ह स यजमान एवैतस्यां संपद्य् अध्यूढः . तद् व् अत्रैवानुव्येति . न किं चनातिरिच्यते . एकस्यै ककुभो ऽष्टाविंशत्यक्षरायै चत्वार्य् अक्षराण्य् आदाय वामदेव्यस्य न्यूने त्रीण्य् उपदधाति यज्ञायज्ञीय एकम् . अथ या गायत्री परिशिष्यते ताम् अद एकान्नसप्तत्यां प्रातःसवनस्य स्तोत्रियासु प्रत्युपदधाति . तद् उ हानन्तम् .

sanskrit_iast: tasyo eva dve savane bṛhatīṃ saṃpadyete . yathaiva purā tṛtīyasavanaṃ tathā tṛtīyasavanam . ekānnasaptatiḥ prātaḥsavanasya stotriyāḥ . tāṣ ṣaṭcatvāriṃśad bṛhatyaḥ saṃpadyante . yā hi tisro gāyatryas te dve bṛhatyau . na tāṣ ṣaṭcatvāriṃśad bṛhatyaḥ saṃpadyante . tad etad āyad eva prātaḥsavanaṃ bṛhatīm abhisaṃpadyate . yasmād āyad eva prātaḥsavanaṃ bṛhatīm abhisaṃpadyate tasmād brāhmaṇo jāyamāna eva lokī jāyate . taṃ vā tvai caraṇena bhūyāṃsaṃ kurute taṃ vā kanīyāṃsam . athaitad dvau mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ saṃpādayata udgātā ca hotā ca . catvāri chandāṃsy udgātā yunakti . tāni ca hotānuśaṃsaty upa ca trīṇy āharaty anuṣṭubhaṃ paṅktīṃ jagatīm . gāyatrī ca jagatī ca te dve bṛhatyau . uṣṇik ca triṣṭup ca te dve bṛhatyau . anuṣṭup ca paṅktiś ca te dve bṛhatyau . bṛhaty eva bṛhatī . yasmād etad dvau mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ saṃpādayatas tasmād rājanyasya kāryo loka iṣṭāpūrtena śraddhayā brahmaṇyatayā . atha yasmād yathaiva purā tṛtīyasavanaṃ tasmād u brāhmaṇāc ca rājanyāc ca vaiśyo lokī .
sentences: tasyo eva dve savane br̥hatīṃ saṃpadyete .
yā hi tisro gāyatryas te dve br̥hatyau .
