taṃ vā tvai caraṇena bʰūyāṃsaṃ kurute taṃ vā kanīyāṃsam .
atʰaitad dvau mādʰyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ saṃpādayata udgātā ca hotā ca .
tāni ca hotānuśaṃsaty upa ca trīṇy āharaty anuṣṭubʰaṃ paṅktīṃ jagatīm .
gāyatrī ca jagatī ca te dve br̥hatyau .
uṣṇik ca triṣṭup ca te dve br̥hatyau .
anuṣṭup ca paṅktiś ca te dve br̥hatyau .
yasmād etad dvau mādʰyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ saṃpādayatas tasmād rājanyasya kāryo loka iṣṭāpūrtena śraddʰayā brahmaṇyatayā .
atʰa yasmād yatʰaiva purā tr̥tīyasavanaṃ tasmād u brāhmaṇāc ca rājanyāc ca vaiśyo lokī .
text: Of this, two pressings amount to the bṛhatī. The third pressing remains as before. The stotriyas of the morning pressing are sixty-nine. They amount to forty-six bṛhatīs. For three gāyatrīs equal two bṛhatīs. They do not exactly amount to forty-six bṛhatīs. But thus the morning pressing approaches and amounts to the bṛhatī. Because the morning pressing naturally amounts to the bṛhatī, therefore the brāhmaṇa, being born, is born as a lord of worlds. His conduct makes him either greater or lesser. Now two persons bring the midday pressing to completion: the udgātṛ and the hotṛ. The udgātṛ yokes four meters. Those the hotṛ recites after, and he brings in three more: anuṣṭubh, paṅkti, and jagatī. The gāyatrī and jagatī are two bṛhatīs. The uṣṇih and triṣṭubh are two bṛhatīs. The anuṣṭubh and paṅkti are two bṛhatīs. The bṛhatī itself is a bṛhatī. Because these two bring the midday pressing to completion, therefore the world of the rājanya must be made through iṣṭāpūrta, through faith, through devotion to brahman. And because the third pressing remains as before, therefore the vaiśya too is a lord of worlds, after the brāhmaṇa and the rājanya.
meaning: तस्यो एव द्वे सवने बृहतीं संपद्येते . यथैव पुरा तृतीयसवनं तथा तृतीयसवनम् . एकान्नसप्ततिः प्रातःसवनस्य स्तोत्रियाः . ताष् षट्चत्वारिंशद् बृहत्यः संपद्यन्ते . या हि तिस्रो गायत्र्यस् ते द्वे बृहत्यौ . न ताष् षट्चत्वारिंशद् बृहत्यः संपद्यन्ते . तद् एतद् आयद् एव प्रातःसवनं बृहतीम् अभिसंपद्यते . यस्माद् आयद् एव प्रातःसवनं बृहतीम् अभिसंपद्यते तस्माद् ब्राह्मणो जायमान एव लोकी जायते . तं वा त्वै चरणेन भूयांसं कुरुते तं वा कनीयांसम् . अथैतद् द्वौ माध्यंदिनं सवनं संपादयत उद्गाता च होता च . चत्वारि छन्दांस्य् उद्गाता युनक्ति . तानि च होतानुशंसत्य् उप च त्रीण्य् आहरत्य् अनुष्टुभं पङ्क्तीं जगतीम् . गायत्री च जगती च ते द्वे बृहत्यौ . उष्णिक् च त्रिष्टुप् च ते द्वे बृहत्यौ . अनुष्टुप् च पङ्क्तिश् च ते द्वे बृहत्यौ . बृहत्य् एव बृहती . यस्माद् एतद् द्वौ माध्यंदिनं सवनं संपादयतस् तस्माद् राजन्यस्य कार्यो लोक इष्टापूर्तेन श्रद्धया ब्रह्मण्यतया . अथ यस्माद् यथैव पुरा तृतीयसवनं तस्माद् उ ब्राह्मणाच् च राजन्याच् च वैश्यो लोकी .

sanskrit_iast: kl̥ptaṃ ha vai lokaṃ yajamāno 'bhijāyate . apa eva prathamasya tṛcasya prathamayā stotriyayā jayati bhūmiṃ dvitīyāgniṃ tṛtīyayā . antarikṣam eva dvitīyasya ca tṛcasya prathamayā stotriyayā jayati vāyuṃ dvitīyayā prāṇaṃ tṛtīyayā . divam eva tṛtīyasya tṛcasya prathamayā stotriyayā jayati ādityaṃ dvitīyayā nakṣatrāṇi tṛtīyayā . navaitā bahiṣpavamānyo bhavanti nava devalokāḥ . tān evaitābhir āpnoti . tā etās tisro virājo daivī yajñiyā mānuṣī . etāsu ha sucittiś śailano janakaṃ vaidehaṃ samūdesa hovāca śraddhā māvidad ṛtvijo me hvayantv iti . tasmai ha kurupañcālān ṛtvija ūhuḥ . teṣu hāgateṣu śailano bibhayāṃ cakāra gacchadbrāhmaṇā ivodantyān vāhino laghūyed iti . sa hovāca samrāḍ vākyaṃ me 'stīti . tisro vā imā virājo tṛpyantīḥ sarvakāmā annābhidhānāḥ . tāsu sma tvā yo 'ntar avadadhāti taṃ smaivodgātāraṃ vṛṇīṣva . sa vāva teṣāṃ kāmānām abhivoḍhā ya etāsu kāmāḥ .
sentences: apa eva pratʰamasya tr̥casya pratʰamayā stotriyayā jayati bʰūmiṃ dvitīyāgniṃ tr̥tīyayā .
antarikṣam eva dvitīyasya ca tr̥casya pratʰamayā stotriyayā jayati vāyuṃ dvitīyayā prāṇaṃ tr̥tīyayā .
divam eva tr̥tīyasya tr̥casya pratʰamayā stotriyayā jayati ādityaṃ dvitīyayā nakṣatrāṇi tr̥tīyayā .
tā etās tisro virājo daivī yajñiyā mānuṣī .
etāsu ha sucittiś śailano janakaṃ vaidehaṃ samūdesa hovāca śraddʰā māvidad r̥tvijo me hvayantv iti .
teṣu hāgateṣu śailano bibʰayāṃ cakāra gaccʰadbrāhmaṇā ivodantyān vāhino lagʰūyed iti .
tisro vā imā virājo tr̥pyantīḥ sarvakāmā annābʰidʰānāḥ .
tāsu sma tvā yo 'ntar avadadʰāti taṃ smaivodgātāraṃ vr̥ṇīṣva .
sa vāva teṣāṃ kāmānām abʰivoḍʰā ya etāsu kāmāḥ .
text: The sacrificer is born into a world already prepared. With the first stotriyā of the first tṛca he conquers the earth; with the second, Agni; with the third. With the first stotriyā of the second tṛca he conquers the atmosphere; with the second, Vāyu; with the third, Prāṇa. With the first stotriyā of the third tṛca he conquers heaven; with the second, Āditya; with the third, the stars. These nine bahiṣpavamānīs correspond to nine divine worlds. With these one attains them. These are three virājs: divine, sacrificial, and human. In these, Sucitti Śailāna approached Janaka Vaideha and said: 'Faith has found me; let my priests call me.' They brought him priests from among the Kuru-Pañcālas. When they arrived, Śailāna became afraid, thinking: 'These Brahmins coming might be like those who consume offerings and depart swiftly.' He said: 'O sovereign, I have a word. There are three virājs that, when full, contain all desires with food as their covering. Whichever udgātṛ places you within them — him you should choose as your udgātṛ. He indeed will be the conveyor of those desires that are in these.'
meaning: क्ल्̥प्तं ह वै लोकं यजमानो ऽभिजायते . अप एव प्रथमस्य तृचस्य प्रथमया स्तोत्रियया जयति भूमिं द्वितीयाग्निं तृतीयया . अन्तरिक्षम् एव द्वितीयस्य च तृचस्य प्रथमया स्तोत्रियया जयति वायुं द्वितीयया प्राणं तृतीयया . दिवम् एव तृतीयस्य तृचस्य प्रथमया स्तोत्रियया जयति आदित्यं द्वितीयया नक्षत्राणि तृतीयया . नवैता बहिष्पवमान्यो भवन्ति नव देवलोकाः . तान् एवैताभिर् आप्नोति . ता एतास् तिस्रो विराजो दैवी यज्ञिया मानुषी . एतासु ह सुचित्तिश् शैलनो जनकं वैदेहं समूदेस होवाच श्रद्धा माविदद् ऋत्विजो मे ह्वयन्त्व् इति . तस्मै ह कुरुपञ्चालान् ऋत्विज ऊहुः . तेषु हागतेषु शैलनो बिभयां चकार गच्छद्ब्राह्मणा इवोदन्त्यान् वाहिनो लघूयेद् इति . स होवाच सम्राड् वाक्यं मे ऽस्तीति . तिस्रो वा इमा विराजो तृप्यन्तीः सर्वकामा अन्नाभिधानाः . तासु स्म त्वा यो ऽन्तर् अवदधाति तं स्मैवोद्गातारं वृणीष्व . स वाव तेषां कामानाम् अभिवोढा य एतासु कामाः .

sanskrit_iast: atha ha pradhāvayāṃ cakāra . tasmin na preṣyann aimān (?) ha sma pṛcchaty āsāṃ virājām ṛddhim . te ha sma nābhyāpayanti . ya u ha smābhyāpayantīti yāṃ ha smaikām abhyāpayanti (?). sa ha smarate brāhmaṇaṃ batāhaṃ brāḥmaṇam etāsu mīmāṃsamānam apaśyam accha dhāvata śailanam iti . tad vyacanaṃ hāsa yathā śailana iyeṣa . tā etās tisro virājo daivī yajñiyā mānuṣī . saiṣā daivī virāḍ yad ime lokāḥ . sā nyūnā . yajamānāvadhānāyaiva tan nyūnā . tad antar yajamānam avadadhāti . tasyā etasyai candramā evāpidhānam . etad dhi devānāṃ pratyakṣam annādyaṃ yac candramāḥ . athaiṣā yajñiyā virāḍ yad etā bahiṣpavamānyaḥ . sā nyūnā . yajamānāvadhānāyaiva tan nyūnā . tad antar yajamānam avadadhāti . tasyā etasyai hiṃkāra evāpidhānam . hiṃkāreṇa hy eva devebhyo 'ntato 'nnādyaṃ pradīyate . athaiṣā mānuṣī virāḍ yad ime puruṣe prāṇāḥ . sā nyūnā . sa u eva yajamānapratyakṣam . tan nyūnā . tasyā etasyā annam evāpidhānam . (?)  nābhir vā etās tisro virājaḥ . abhi ha tān kāmān āpnoti ya etāsu kāmā . api tv iha teṣu bhavaty ati ha punarmṛtyuṃ mucyate . bahupuruṣam asmin loke 'nnam atti . na hy etad ekapuruṣāyānnādyaṃ yad etāsu . yad dha vai kiṃ cedam asmin loka ātmanvat tad dha sarvaṃ mṛtyur evābhivyādāya tiṣṭhati . sa yo ha sa mṛtyuḥ saṃvatsara eva saḥ . tasya hartava eva mukhāni . tad yad vai kiṃ ca mriyate na hāsyānṛtau mriyate ya evaṃ veda .

text: Then he sent forth an inquiry. Not commanding them, he asked them about the fulfillment of these virājs. They could not achieve it. Those who claimed they could achieve it could achieve only one. He remembered: 'I once saw a brāhmaṇa pondering these — run to Śailāna!' This became an open matter, as Śailāna wished. These are the three virājs: divine, sacrificial, and human. The divine virāj is these worlds. It is deficient — deficient precisely for placing the sacrificer within. One places the sacrificer within it. The moon is its covering. For the moon is the visible food of the gods. The sacrificial virāj is these bahiṣpavamānī verses. It is deficient — deficient precisely for placing the sacrificer within. One places the sacrificer within it. The hiṃkāra is its covering. For by the hiṃkāra food is finally given to the gods. The human virāj is these vital breaths in the person. It is deficient — that indeed is evident to the sacrificer. It is deficient. Food is its covering. These three virājs are indeed the navel. He attains those desires that are in these. He even partakes of them here, and he is freed from re-death. He eats food meant for many persons in this world. For the food in these is not for a single person. Whatever here in this world possesses a self — all that Mṛtyu (Death) stands with jaws open to devour. And he who is that Mṛtyu is the saṃvatsara (year) itself. The seasons are its mouths. Whatever dies — it does not die out of season for one who knows thus.
meaning: अथ ह प्रधावयां चकार . तस्मिन् न प्रेष्यन्न् ऐमान् (?) ह स्म पृच्छत्य् आसां विराजाम् ऋद्धिम् . ते ह स्म नाभ्यापयन्ति . य उ ह स्माभ्यापयन्तीति यां ह स्मैकाम् अभ्यापयन्ति (?). स ह स्मरते ब्राह्मणं बताहं ब्राःमणम् एतासु मीमांसमानम् अपश्यम् अच्छ धावत शैलनम् इति . तद् व्यचनं हास यथा शैलन इयेष . ता एतास् तिस्रो विराजो दैवी यज्ञिया मानुषी . सैषा दैवी विराड् यद् इमे लोकाः . सा न्यूना . यजमानावधानायैव तन् न्यूना . तद् अन्तर् यजमानम् अवदधाति . तस्या एतस्यै चन्द्रमा एवापिधानम् . एतद् धि देवानां प्रत्यक्षम् अन्नाद्यं यच् चन्द्रमाः . अथैषा यज्ञिया विराड् यद् एता बहिष्पवमान्यः . सा न्यूना . यजमानावधानायैव तन् न्यूना . तद् अन्तर् यजमानम् अवदधाति . तस्या एतस्यै हिंकार एवापिधानम् . हिंकारेण ह्य् एव देवेभ्यो ऽन्ततो ऽन्नाद्यं प्रदीयते . अथैषा मानुषी विराड् यद् इमे पुरुषे प्राणाः . सा न्यूना . स उ एव यजमानप्रत्यक्षम् . तन् न्यूना . तस्या एतस्या अन्नम् एवापिधानम् . (?)  नाभिर् वा एतास् तिस्रो विराजः . अभि ह तान् कामान् आप्नोति य एतासु कामा . अपि त्व् इह तेषु भवत्य् अति ह पुनर्मृत्युं मुच्यते . बहुपुरुषम् अस्मिन् लोके ऽन्नम् अत्ति . न ह्य् एतद् एकपुरुषायान्नाद्यं यद् एतासु . यद् ध वै किं चेदम् अस्मिन् लोक आत्मन्वत् तद् ध सर्वं मृत्युर् एवाभिव्यादाय तिष्ठति . स यो ह स मृत्युः संवत्सर एव सः . तस्य हर्तव एव मुखानि . तद् यद् वै किं च म्रियते न हास्यानृतौ म्रियते य एवं वेद .

sanskrit_iast: tā etā nava bahiṣpavamānyaḥ . tāṣ ṣaḍ bṛhatyaḥ . ṣaḍ u mṛtyor mukhāny ṛtava eva . atha ha vā etāni mṛtyor mukhāni bṛhaty eva prativibhavitum arhati nānyac chandaḥ . sa bṛhatyaivartor mukham apidadhāti bṛhatyartor bṛhatyartoḥ . sa yathā samena viṣamam atītya pratyavekṣetaivam evaitaṃ mṛtyuṃ parāṅ atītya pratyavekṣate . tam eva taṃ trivṛtaṃ vajram upapravartayati . sa eṣo 'harahar imān lokān anuvartate . tad dha smāha nagarī jānaśruteyo na haiva tāvad devāsuraṃ bhavitā yāvad eṣa trivṛd vajro 'harahar imān lokān anuvartata {iti} . ūrdhvā hy ayam agnir dīpyate tiryaṅṅ ayaṃ vāyuḥ pavate 'rvāṅ asāv ādityas tapati . ta ete 'nimeṣam anyonyam īkṣante . katham eteṣv evaṃ satsu devāsuraṃ syād iti .
sentences: ṣaḍ u mr̥tyor mukʰāny r̥tava eva .
atʰa ha vā etāni mr̥tyor mukʰāni br̥haty eva prativibʰavitum arhati nānyac cʰandaḥ .
sa br̥hatyaivartor mukʰam apidadʰāti br̥hatyartor br̥hatyartoḥ .
sa yatʰā samena viṣamam atītya pratyavekṣetaivam evaitaṃ mr̥tyuṃ parāṅ atītya pratyavekṣate .
tam eva taṃ trivr̥taṃ vajram upapravartayati .
tad dʰa smāha nagarī jānaśruteyo na haiva tāvad devāsuraṃ bʰavitā yāvad eṣa trivr̥d vajro 'harahar imān lokān anuvartata {iti} .
ūrdʰvā hy ayam agnir dīpyate tiryaṅṅ ayaṃ vāyuḥ pavate 'rvāṅ asāv ādityas tapati .
katʰam eteṣv evaṃ satsu devāsuraṃ syād iti .
text: These nine bahiṣpavamānīs — they are six bṛhatīs. Six are the mouths of Mṛtyu, the seasons indeed. Now the bṛhatī alone is able to close these mouths of Mṛtyu; no other meter can. With the bṛhatī one closes the mouth of each season, season by season. Just as one who has crossed uneven ground on level ground would look back — so one looks back having crossed beyond this Mṛtyu. One then rolls forth that trivṛt vajra. This trivṛt vajra revolves through these worlds day after day. On this Nagarī Jānaśruteya used to say: 'There will never be a war between gods and asuras as long as this trivṛt vajra revolves through these worlds day after day.' For this fire burns upward, this wind blows sideways, and that sun shines downward. These three gaze at one another without blinking. How could there be a war between gods and asuras when it is so?
meaning: ता एता नव बहिष्पवमान्यः . ताष् षड् बृहत्यः . षड् उ मृत्योर् मुखान्य् ऋतव एव . अथ ह वा एतानि मृत्योर् मुखानि बृहत्य् एव प्रतिविभवितुम् अर्हति नान्यच् छन्दः . स बृहत्यैवर्तोर् मुखम् अपिदधाति बृहत्यर्तोर् बृहत्यर्तोः . स यथा समेन विषमम् अतीत्य प्रत्यवेक्षेतैवम् एवैतं मृत्युं पराङ् अतीत्य प्रत्यवेक्षते . तम् एव तं त्रिवृतं वज्रम् उपप्रवर्तयति . स एषो ऽहरहर् इमान् लोकान् अनुवर्तते . तद् ध स्माह नगरी जानश्रुतेयो न हैव तावद् देवासुरं भविता यावद् एष त्रिवृद् वज्रो ऽहरहर् इमान् लोकान् अनुवर्तत {इति} . ऊर्ध्वा ह्य् अयम् अग्निर् दीप्यते तिर्यङ्ङ् अयं वायुः पवते ऽर्वाङ् असाव् आदित्यस् तपति . त एते ऽनिमेषम् अन्योन्यम् ईक्षन्ते . कथम् एतेष्व् एवं सत्सु देवासुरं स्याद् इति .

sanskrit_iast: tad āhuḥ sa vādya yajeta sa vānyaṃ yājayed yaś catuḥṣṭomena yājayan sarvastomena yājayati . navaitā bahiṣpavamānyo bhavanti . tāsāṃ saptaviṃśatiḥ padāni . tena triṇavaṃ stomaṃ nāntaryanti . navaivaitā bahiṣpavamānyo bhavanti . caturviṃśatyakṣarā gāyatrī . tat trayastriṃśat . tena trayastriṃśaṃ stomaṃ nāntaryanti . etad vai catuḥṣṭomena yājayati . yo vai stomānām avamaṃ paramaṃ veda gacchati paramatām . trivṛd vāva stomānām avamas trivṛt paramaḥ . tad u hovāca barkur vārṣṇas trivṛtaṃ stomaṃ trayastriṃśaṃ bhavantam apaśyaṃ tasmād ahaṃ paramatām agaccham iti . gacchati paramatāṃ ya evaṃ veda . atha ha smāhāruṇiḥ kiṃ so 'bhicaret kiṃ vābhicāryamāṇa ādriyeta ya etaṃ trivṛtaṃ vajraṃ tribhṛṣṭim acchidram acchambaṭkāriṇam aharahar imān lokān anuvartamānaṃ veda . svayam abhicarito vāva sa yam evaṃvid dveṣṭi yo vaivaṃvidaṃ dveṣṭīti . eṣa u evainaṃ trivṛd vajras tribhṛṣṭir acchidro 'cchambaṭkāry aharahar imān lokān anuvartamāno 'bhivartate . tasya na bhūtyā alpikeva canāśāsti parāparaiva bhavatīti . 248 tad u ha smāhopajīvaḥ khāl̥āyano 'ham evaitaṃ trivṛtaṃ vajraṃ pratyakṣaṃ veda tasmād yam ahaṃ dveṣmi yo māṃ dveṣṭi tāv ubhau śvaḥ śva eva pāpīyāṃsau bhavata iti . agnir vā asya lokasya vajro vāyur antarikṣasyādityo divaḥ . tad id adhyātmam . yo 'gnir vāg eva sā yo vāyuḥ prāṇa eva sa ya ādityaś cakṣur eva tat . tasmād yad ahaṃ dviṣantam abhivadāmi yad abhiprāṇimi yad abhivīkṣe vajram evāhaṃ tasmai taṃ praharāmi . tasya na śremṇo 'lpikeva canāśāsti . etā u evainaṃ devatā dhūrvanti ya evaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ dhūrvatīti . atha ha smāha śvetaketur āruṇeyo yathāśvasya śvetasya kṛṣṇakarṇasyetthādānītasya rūpaṃ syād evam evāham etasya stomasya rūpaṃ veda . tāvad dṛśenyaṃ tāvad vapuṣeṇyam . tasmān māṃ ya eva pūrvāhṇe didṛkṣante te 'parāhṇe didṛkṣante naiva sudṛśenyam iva santam . nāha kadā cana cakṣuṣmantaṃ paryemīti . tad u hovāca śāṭyāyaniḥ ko 'śvaś śvetaḥ kim ekam iti . yathaivāsyāgne rūpaṃ yathā tviṣir yathāsya vāyor yathāmuṣyādityasyaivam evaitasya stomasya rūpam evaṃ tviṣiḥ . tad evaitat prajā abhiparivārya didṛkṣamāṇās tiṣṭhanti . tasmād bahiṣpavamāne ye ca vijānanti ye ca na te sarve 'nīśānā abhiparivārya didṛkṣamānās tiṣṭhantīti . atho haitā yaśa evāpy anyāsāṃ devatānām . tāsām etad indriyaṃ vīryaṃ rasas tejaḥ saṃbhṛtaṃ yad etā bahiṣpavamānyaḥ .
sentences: tad āhuḥ sa vādya yajeta sa vānyaṃ yājayed yaś catuḥṣṭomena yājayan sarvastomena yājayati .
yo vai stomānām avamaṃ paramaṃ veda gaccʰati paramatām .
trivr̥d vāva stomānām avamas trivr̥t paramaḥ .

atʰa ha smāhāruṇiḥ kiṃ so 'bʰicaret kiṃ vābʰicāryamāṇa ādriyeta ya etaṃ trivr̥taṃ vajraṃ tribʰr̥ṣṭim accʰidram accʰambaṭkāriṇam aharahar imān lokān anuvartamānaṃ veda .

tasya na bʰūtyā alpikeva canāśāsti parāparaiva bʰavatīti .

agnir vā asya lokasya vajro vāyur antarikṣasyādityo divaḥ .
yo 'gnir vāg eva sā yo vāyuḥ prāṇa eva sa ya ādityaś cakṣur eva tat .
tasmād yad ahaṃ dviṣantam abʰivadāmi yad abʰiprāṇimi yad abʰivīkṣe vajram evāhaṃ tasmai taṃ praharāmi .
etā u evainaṃ devatā dʰūrvanti ya evaṃ vidvāṃsaṃ dʰūrvatīti .
atʰa ha smāha śvetaketur āruṇeyo yatʰāśvasya śvetasya kr̥ṣṇakarṇasyettʰādānītasya rūpaṃ syād evam evāham etasya stomasya rūpaṃ veda .

text: On this they say: 'He should sacrifice himself, or have another sacrifice, who, having one sacrifice with the four stomas, sacrifices with all stomas.' These nine bahiṣpavamānīs have twenty-seven pādas. Thereby the triṇava stoma is not missed. These nine bahiṣpavamānīs — the gāyatrī has twenty-four syllables — that makes thirty-three. Thereby the trayastriṃśa stoma is not missed. This is what 'sacrificing with the four stomas' means. He who knows the lowest and the highest of stomas attains supremacy. The trivṛt is indeed the lowest of stomas, and the trivṛt is the highest. Barku Vārṣṇa said: 'I saw the trivṛt stoma becoming trayastriṃśa — therefore I attained supremacy.' He who knows thus attains supremacy. Āruṇi used to say: 'Why should he perform sorcery, or why should one being ensorcelled worry, who knows this trivṛt vajra, three-pointed, without fissure, resounding, revolving through these worlds day after day? He upon whom one who knows thus looks with hatred is himself ensorcelled; and he who hates one who knows thus is ensorcelled.' This trivṛt vajra, three-pointed, without fissure, resounding, revolving through these worlds day after day, turns against him. Not even the slightest hope of prosperity remains for him — he only declines further and further. 1.248: On this Upajīva Khāḍāyana used to say: 'I know this trivṛt vajra directly — therefore whoever I hate, whoever hates me, both become worse day after day.' Agni is the vajra of this world, Vāyu of the atmosphere, Āditya of heaven. Now as to the self: Agni is speech, Vāyu is breath, Āditya is sight. Therefore when I speak against a hater, when I breathe against him, when I look at him — I hurl the vajra at him. Not the slightest hope of prosperity remains for him. These very deities destroy one who would destroy one who knows thus. Śvetaketu Āruṇeya used to say: 'Just as one might describe the appearance of a white horse with black ears, brought from such-and-such a place, so do I know the form of this stoma. So worthy of seeing, so worthy of beholding. Therefore those who wish to see me in the forenoon wish to see me also in the afternoon, as though they cannot see enough of me. I never pass by a man of vision unnoticed.' Śāṭyāyani said: 'What is the white horse? What is the one?' 'Just as the form and brightness of Agni, of Vāyu, of that Āditya — so is the form and brightness of this stoma. Creatures stand around it, gazing, wishing to behold it. Therefore at the bahiṣpavamāna, both those who understand and those who do not stand around, powerless, wishing to behold it.' Also, these are indeed the glory of the other deities as well. Their energy, power, essence, and brilliance are concentrated in these bahiṣpavamānīs.
meaning: तद् आहुः स वाद्य यजेत स वान्यं याजयेद् यश् चतुःष्टोमेन याजयन् सर्वस्तोमेन याजयति . नवैता बहिष्पवमान्यो भवन्ति . तासां सप्तविंशतिः पदानि . तेन त्रिणवं स्तोमं नान्तर्यन्ति . नवैवैता बहिष्पवमान्यो भवन्ति . चतुर्विंशत्यक्षरा गायत्री . तत् त्रयस्त्रिंशत् . तेन त्रयस्त्रिंशं स्तोमं नान्तर्यन्ति . एतद् वै चतुःष्टोमेन याजयति . यो वै स्तोमानाम् अवमं परमं वेद गच्छति परमताम् . त्रिवृद् वाव स्तोमानाम् अवमस् त्रिवृत् परमः . तद् उ होवाच बर्कुर् वार्ष्णस् त्रिवृतं स्तोमं त्रयस्त्रिंशं भवन्तम् अपश्यं तस्माद् अहं परमताम् अगच्छम् इति . गच्छति परमतां य एवं वेद . अथ ह स्माहारुणिः किं सो ऽभिचरेत् किं वाभिचार्यमाण आद्रियेत य एतं त्रिवृतं वज्रं त्रिभृष्टिम् अच्छिद्रम् अच्छम्बट्कारिणम् अहरहर् इमान् लोकान् अनुवर्तमानं वेद . स्वयम् अभिचरितो वाव स यम् एवंविद् द्वेष्टि यो वैवंविदं द्वेष्टीति . एष उ एवैनं त्रिवृद् वज्रस् त्रिभृष्टिर् अच्छिद्रो ऽच्छम्बट्कार्य् अहरहर् इमान् लोकान् अनुवर्तमानो ऽभिवर्तते . तस्य न भूत्या अल्पिकेव चनाशास्ति परापरैव भवतीति . २४८ तद् उ ह स्माहोपजीवः खाल्̥आयनो ऽहम् एवैतं त्रिवृतं वज्रं प्रत्यक्षं वेद तस्माद् यम् अहं द्वेष्मि यो मां द्वेष्टि ताव् उभौ श्वः श्व एव पापीयांसौ भवत इति . अग्निर् वा अस्य लोकस्य वज्रो वायुर् अन्तरिक्षस्यादित्यो दिवः . तद् इद् अध्यात्मम् . यो ऽग्निर् वाग् एव सा यो वायुः प्राण एव स य आदित्यश् चक्षुर् एव तत् . तस्माद् यद् अहं द्विषन्तम् अभिवदामि यद् अभिप्राणिमि यद् अभिवीक्षे वज्रम् एवाहं तस्मै तं प्रहरामि . तस्य न श्रेम्णो ऽल्पिकेव चनाशास्ति . एता उ एवैनं देवता धूर्वन्ति य एवं विद्वांसं धूर्वतीति . अथ ह स्माह श्वेतकेतुर् आरुणेयो यथाश्वस्य श्वेतस्य कृष्णकर्णस्येत्थादानीतस्य रूपं स्याद् एवम् एवाहम् एतस्य स्तोमस्य रूपं वेद . तावद् दृशेन्यं तावद् वपुषेण्यम् . तस्मान् मां य एव पूर्वाह्णे दिदृक्षन्ते ते ऽपराह्णे दिदृक्षन्ते नैव सुदृशेन्यम् इव सन्तम् . नाह कदा चन चक्षुष्मन्तं पर्येमीति . तद् उ होवाच शाट्यायनिः को ऽश्वश् श्वेतः किम् एकम् इति . यथैवास्याग्ने रूपं यथा त्विषिर् यथास्य वायोर् यथामुष्यादित्यस्यैवम् एवैतस्य स्तोमस्य रूपम् एवं त्विषिः . तद् एवैतत् प्रजा अभिपरिवार्य दिदृक्षमाणास् तिष्ठन्ति . तस्माद् बहिष्पवमाने ये च विजानन्ति ये च न ते सर्वे ऽनीशाना अभिपरिवार्य दिदृक्षमानास् तिष्ठन्तीति . अथो हैता यश एवाप्य् अन्यासां देवतानाम् . तासाम् एतद् इन्द्रियं वीर्यं रसस् तेजः संभृतं यद् एता बहिष्पवमान्यः .

sanskrit_iast: tad āhur yat puruṣo yoṣāṃ saṃbhaviṣyan parokṣaṃ nilayanam icchate 'nta evānye paśavo 'nyonyasya skandanti kiṃ tad yajñe kriyate yasmāt tat tatheti . sa brūyād yasmāt trivṛt stomo bahiṣpavamāne prāṅ ivotkramya dhiṣṇyebhyo nilīya gāyatrīṃ skandati madhya evānya ṛtvijo dhiṣṇyānāṃ yad anta āsate tasmāt tat tatheti . trivṛtaṃ hi stomaṃ puruṣo 'nvāyatto dhiṣṇyān anye paśava iti . tad v evāhur yat sa trivṛt stomo gāyatrīṃ skandati kiṃ sā tataḥ prajanayatīti . il̥āntaṃ yajñaṃ saptanābhim iti brūyāt . gāyatrī garbhaṃ dhatte . sā puronuvākyāṃ prajanayati puronuvākyā yājyāṃ yājyā vaṣaṭkāraṃ vaṣaṭkāra āhutīr āhutayo dakṣiṇā dakṣiṇāḥ svargaṃ lokam . tad yathā vittaṃ pravāhaṃ kṣipraṃ pravahed evam evainam etā devatāḥ svargāya lokāya pravahanti . trivṛd evainaṃ stomo gāyatryai prayacchati gāyatrī puronuvākyāyai puronuvākyā yājyāyai yājyā vaṣaṭkārāya vaṣaṭkāra āhutībhya āhutayo dakṣiṇābhyo dakṣiṇāḥ svargaṃ lokaṃ gamayanti . sa eṣa il̥ānto yajñaḥ saptanābhiḥ . tasya ha trivṛd eva stomo nābhir gāyatrī nābhiḥ puronuvākyā nābhir yājyā nābhir vaṣaṭkāro nābhir āhutayo nābhir dakṣiṇā nābhiḥ .
sentences: tad āhur yat puruṣo yoṣāṃ saṃbʰaviṣyan parokṣaṃ nilayanam iccʰate 'nta evānye paśavo 'nyonyasya skandanti kiṃ tad yajñe kriyate yasmāt tat tatʰeti .
sa brūyād yasmāt trivr̥t stomo bahiṣpavamāne prāṅ ivotkramya dʰiṣṇyebʰyo nilīya gāyatrīṃ skandati madʰya evānya r̥tvijo dʰiṣṇyānāṃ yad anta āsate tasmāt tat tatʰeti .
trivr̥taṃ hi stomaṃ puruṣo 'nvāyatto dʰiṣṇyān anye paśava iti .
tad v evāhur yat sa trivr̥t stomo gāyatrīṃ skandati kiṃ sā tataḥ prajanayatīti .
sā puronuvākyāṃ prajanayati puronuvākyā yājyāṃ yājyā vaṣaṭkāraṃ vaṣaṭkāra āhutīr āhutayo dakṣiṇā dakṣiṇāḥ svargaṃ lokam .
tad yatʰā vittaṃ pravāhaṃ kṣipraṃ pravahed evam evainam etā devatāḥ svargāya lokāya pravahanti .
trivr̥d evainaṃ stomo gāyatryai prayaccʰati gāyatrī puronuvākyāyai puronuvākyā yājyāyai yājyā vaṣaṭkārāya vaṣaṭkāra āhutībʰya āhutayo dakṣiṇābʰyo dakṣiṇāḥ svargaṃ lokaṃ gamayanti .
tasya ha trivr̥d eva stomo nābʰir gāyatrī nābʰiḥ puronuvākyā nābʰir yājyā nābʰir vaṣaṭkāro nābʰir āhutayo nābʰir dakṣiṇā nābʰiḥ .
text: On this they say: 'When a man about to unite with a woman seeks a hidden place, while other animals mount one another openly — what in the sacrifice corresponds to this?' One should answer: 'Because the trivṛt stoma at the bahiṣpavamāna, stepping forward as it were, hides itself from the dhiṣṇya fires and mounts the gāyatrī, while the other priests sit in the middle at their dhiṣṇya fires — therefore it is so.' For the person corresponds to the trivṛt stoma, the dhiṣṇyas to the other animals. On this they also say: 'When this trivṛt stoma mounts the gāyatrī, what does she produce from that?' One should answer: 'A sacrifice ending in iḍā, with seven navels.' The gāyatrī receives the seed. She produces the puronuvākyā; the puronuvākyā produces the yājyā; the yājyā produces the vaṣaṭkāra; the vaṣaṭkāra produces the oblations; the oblations produce the dakṣiṇās; the dakṣiṇās lead to the heavenly world. Just as wealth, when set in motion, would flow swiftly — so these deities carry him swiftly to the heavenly world. The trivṛt stoma gives him to the gāyatrī, the gāyatrī to the puronuvākyā, the puronuvākyā to the yājyā, the yājyā to the vaṣaṭkāra, the vaṣaṭkāra to the oblations, the oblations to the dakṣiṇās, and the dakṣiṇās convey him to the heavenly world. This is the sacrifice ending in iḍā with seven navels. Its navels are: the trivṛt stoma, the gāyatrī, the puronuvākyā, the yājyā, the vaṣaṭkāra, the oblations, and the dakṣiṇā.
meaning: तद् आहुर् यत् पुरुषो योषां संभविष्यन् परोक्षं निलयनम् इच्छते ऽन्त एवान्ये पशवो ऽन्योन्यस्य स्कन्दन्ति किं तद् यज्ञे क्रियते यस्मात् तत् तथेति . स ब्रूयाद् यस्मात् त्रिवृत् स्तोमो बहिष्पवमाने प्राङ् इवोत्क्रम्य धिष्ण्येभ्यो निलीय गायत्रीं स्कन्दति मध्य एवान्य ऋत्विजो धिष्ण्यानां यद् अन्त आसते तस्मात् तत् तथेति . त्रिवृतं हि स्तोमं पुरुषो ऽन्वायत्तो धिष्ण्यान् अन्ये पशव इति . तद् व् एवाहुर् यत् स त्रिवृत् स्तोमो गायत्रीं स्कन्दति किं सा ततः प्रजनयतीति . इल्̥आन्तं यज्ञं सप्तनाभिम् इति ब्रूयात् . गायत्री गर्भं धत्ते . सा पुरोनुवाक्यां प्रजनयति पुरोनुवाक्या याज्यां याज्या वषट्कारं वषट्कार आहुतीर् आहुतयो दक्षिणा दक्षिणाः स्वर्गं लोकम् . तद् यथा वित्तं प्रवाहं क्षिप्रं प्रवहेद् एवम् एवैनम् एता देवताः स्वर्गाय लोकाय प्रवहन्ति . त्रिवृद् एवैनं स्तोमो गायत्र्यै प्रयच्छति गायत्री पुरोनुवाक्यायै पुरोनुवाक्या याज्यायै याज्या वषट्काराय वषट्कार आहुतीभ्य आहुतयो दक्षिणाभ्यो दक्षिणाः स्वर्गं लोकं गमयन्ति . स एष इल्̥आन्तो यज्ञः सप्तनाभिः . तस्य ह त्रिवृद् एव स्तोमो नाभिर् गायत्री नाभिः पुरोनुवाक्या नाभिर् याज्या नाभिर् वषट्कारो नाभिर् आहुतयो नाभिर् दक्षिणा नाभिः .

sanskrit_iast: pañcadaśāny ājyāni bhavanti pañcadaśāpūryamāṇasyārdhamāsasya rātrayaḥ . tad eva tenāpnoti . daśa hastyā aṅgulayaś catvāry ūrvaṣṭhīvāni yad ūrdhvaṃ nābhes tat pañcadaśam . tad evātropasaṃdadhāti . pañcadaśo mādhyaṃdinaḥ pañcadaśāpocchato 'rdhamāsasya rātrayaḥ . tad eva tenāpnoti . daśa padyā aṅgulayaś catvāry ūrvaṣṭhīvāni yad avācīnaṃ nābhes tat pañcadaśam . tad evātropasaṃdadhāti . saptadaśāni prṣṭhāni . dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavaḥ . tad eva tenāpnoti . daśa hastyā aṅgulayaḥ sapta śīrṣan prāṇāḥ . tat saptadaśam . tad evātropasaṃdadhāti . saptadaśārbhavaḥ . dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavaḥ . tad eva tenābhipūrvam āpnoti . daśa padyā aṅgulayaś catvāry ūrvaṣṭhīvāni trayo 'vācaḥ prāṇāḥ . tat saptadaśam . tad evātropasaṃdadhāti . ekaviṃśam agniṣṭomasāma . dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavas traya ime lokā asāv āditya ekaviṃśaḥ . tad eva tenāpnoti . daśa hastyā aṅgulayo daśa padyā ātmaikaviṃśaḥ .
sentences: daśa hastyā aṅgulayaś catvāry ūrvaṣṭʰīvāni yad ūrdʰvaṃ nābʰes tat pañcadaśam .
daśa padyā aṅgulayaś catvāry ūrvaṣṭʰīvāni yad avācīnaṃ nābʰes tat pañcadaśam .
daśa hastyā aṅgulayaḥ sapta śīrṣan prāṇāḥ .
daśa padyā aṅgulayaś catvāry ūrvaṣṭʰīvāni trayo 'vācaḥ prāṇāḥ .
dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavas traya ime lokā asāv āditya ekaviṃśaḥ .
daśa hastyā aṅgulayo daśa padyā ātmaikaviṃśaḥ .
text: The ājya chants are fifteen; fifteen are the nights of the waxing half-month. With that one attains it. Ten are the fingers of the hand, four are the thighs and knees, and what is above the navel is the fifteenth. One thereby joins that here. The midday pressing is fifteenfold; fifteen are the nights of the waning half-month. With that one attains it. Ten are the toes, four are the thighs and knees, and what is below the navel is the fifteenth. One thereby joins that here. The pṛṣṭha chants are seventeen. Twelve months and five seasons make seventeen. With that one attains it. Ten are the fingers of the hand, seven are the breaths in the head. That makes seventeen. One thereby joins that here. The arbhava chants are seventeen. Twelve months and five seasons. With that one attains the former. Ten are the toes, four are the thighs and knees, three are the lower breaths. That makes seventeen. One thereby joins that here. The agniṣṭomasāman is twenty-one. Twelve months, five seasons, these three worlds, and that sun make twenty-one. With that one attains it. Ten are the fingers of the hand, ten are the toes, the self is the twenty-first.
meaning: पञ्चदशान्य् आज्यानि भवन्ति पञ्चदशापूर्यमाणस्यार्धमासस्य रात्रयः . तद् एव तेनाप्नोति . दश हस्त्या अङ्गुलयश् चत्वार्य् ऊर्वष्ठीवानि यद् ऊर्ध्वं नाभेस् तत् पञ्चदशम् . तद् एवात्रोपसंदधाति . पञ्चदशो माध्यंदिनः पञ्चदशापोच्छतो ऽर्धमासस्य रात्रयः . तद् एव तेनाप्नोति . दश पद्या अङ्गुलयश् चत्वार्य् ऊर्वष्ठीवानि यद् अवाचीनं नाभेस् तत् पञ्चदशम् . तद् एवात्रोपसंदधाति . सप्तदशानि प्र्ष्ठानि . द्वादश मासाः पञ्चर्तवः . तद् एव तेनाप्नोति . दश हस्त्या अङ्गुलयः सप्त शीर्षन् प्राणाः . तत् सप्तदशम् . तद् एवात्रोपसंदधाति . सप्तदशार्भवः . द्वादश मासाः पञ्चर्तवः . तद् एव तेनाभिपूर्वम् आप्नोति . दश पद्या अङ्गुलयश् चत्वार्य् ऊर्वष्ठीवानि त्रयो ऽवाचः प्राणाः . तत् सप्तदशम् . तद् एवात्रोपसंदधाति . एकविंशम् अग्निष्टोमसाम . द्वादश मासाः पञ्चर्तवस् त्रय इमे लोका असाव् आदित्य एकविंशः . तद् एव तेनाप्नोति . दश हस्त्या अङ्गुलयो दश पद्या आत्मैकविंशः .

sanskrit_iast: sa haivaṃ vidvān ahorātrayor ardhamāsaśo māsaśa ṛtuśaḥ saṃvatsaraśa etasmin sarvasminn ātmānam upasaṃdhāya taṃ mṛtyuṃ tarati yaḥ svarge loke . na haivaṃvit punar mriyate . tasya harṅmayāny asthāni bhavanti sāmamayāni māṃsāni . sa eṣo 'pahatapāpmā dhūtaśarīro 'tītyaitaṃ mṛtyuṃ śarīraṃ dhūnute . athaite daivī ca mānuṣī ca virājau . tayor eṣa etad ādityo 'dhyūḍhas tapati . catasro diśaś catvāro 'vāntaradeśā dvāv imau lokau . eṣā daivī virāṭ . atha mānuṣī . catvāro 'ttāraṣ ṣaḍ ādyāḥ . brāhmaṇaś ca rājanyaś ca vaiśyaś ca śūdraś caite 'ttāraḥ . gauś cāśvaś cājāś cāviś ca vrīhiś ca yavaś caita ādyāḥ . etayor eṣa etad ādityo 'dhyūḍhas tapati . tan na śoko na himo nāśanāyati na pipāsati nāsya kā canāvṛttir asti .
sentences: sa haivaṃ vidvān ahorātrayor ardʰamāsaśo māsaśa r̥tuśaḥ saṃvatsaraśa etasmin sarvasminn ātmānam upasaṃdʰāya taṃ mr̥tyuṃ tarati yaḥ svarge loke .
tasya harṅmayāny astʰāni bʰavanti sāmamayāni māṃsāni .
sa eṣo 'pahatapāpmā dʰūtaśarīro 'tītyaitaṃ mr̥tyuṃ śarīraṃ dʰūnute .
atʰaite daivī ca mānuṣī ca virājau .
catasro diśaś catvāro 'vāntaradeśā dvāv imau lokau .
brāhmaṇaś ca rājanyaś ca vaiśyaś ca śūdraś caite 'ttāraḥ .
gauś cāśvaś cājāś cāviś ca vrīhiś ca yavaś caita ādyāḥ .
tan na śoko na himo nāśanāyati na pipāsati nāsya kā canāvr̥ttir asti .
text: He who, knowing thus, joining himself to this entirety — by half-months, by months, by seasons, by the year — to day and night, crosses over that Mṛtyu, who is in the heavenly world. One who knows thus does not die again. His bones become made of ṛc-verses, his flesh made of sāmans. This one, with evil destroyed, with body shaken off — having crossed beyond this Mṛtyu, he shakes off the body. Now these two are the divine and the human virājs. Upon these two that sun shines, mounted. The four directions, the four intermediate directions, and these two worlds — this is the divine virāj. Now the human: four are the eaters, six are the eaten. The brāhmaṇa, the rājanya, the vaiśya, and the śūdra — these are the eaters. The cow, the horse, the goat, the sheep, rice, and barley — these are the eaten. Upon these two that sun shines, mounted. There is no sorrow, no cold, no hunger, no thirst, and no turning back for him.
meaning: स हैवं विद्वान् अहोरात्रयोर् अर्धमासशो मासश ऋतुशः संवत्सरश एतस्मिन् सर्वस्मिन्न् आत्मानम् उपसंधाय तं मृत्युं तरति यः स्वर्गे लोके . न हैवंवित् पुनर् म्रियते . तस्य हर्ङ्मयान्य् अस्थानि भवन्ति साममयानि मांसानि . स एषो ऽपहतपाप्मा धूतशरीरो ऽतीत्यैतं मृत्युं शरीरं धूनुते . अथैते दैवी च मानुषी च विराजौ . तयोर् एष एतद् आदित्यो ऽध्यूढस् तपति . चतस्रो दिशश् चत्वारो ऽवान्तरदेशा द्वाव् इमौ लोकौ . एषा दैवी विराट् . अथ मानुषी . चत्वारो ऽत्तारष् षड् आद्याः . ब्राह्मणश् च राजन्यश् च वैश्यश् च शूद्रश् चैते ऽत्तारः . गौश् चाश्वश् चाजाश् चाविश् च व्रीहिश् च यवश् चैत आद्याः . एतयोर् एष एतद् आदित्यो ऽध्यूढस् तपति . तन् न शोको न हिमो नाशनायति न पिपासति नास्य का चनावृत्तिर् अस्ति .

sanskrit_iast: yajamānaṃ ha vā etad udgātā reto bhūtaṃ siñcati yad bahiṣpavamānaṃ gāyati . mana eva retasyayā samīrayati prāṇaṃ gāyatryā cakṣus triṣṭubhā śrotraṃ jagatyā vācam anuṣṭubhā . ātmānam eva paṅktyā pratyupadadhāti . atha yad etad uttamaṃ tṛcaṃ janmaiva tat . praiva tena janayati . yasmād etad ghoṣīvopabdimad iva gāyate tasmād ghoṣīvopabdimad iva garbhā jāyante . tad uvā āhur aghoṣam eva geyam . yadā vai vijāyamānā krūrikurute 'tha sā ghoṣaṃ karoti . atho śanair iva vā aghoṣam iva mahāhṛṣṭir vijāyate . atho haitat satyaṃ yad gāyatram . tasya saṃpadaṃ lobhayed yad rathantaravarṇāṃ abhyasyet . tasmād aghoṣam eva geyam iti . athāgneyam ājyam ekadevatyam . pretir eva sā . atha maitrāvaruṇaṃ dvidevatyam . pratiṣṭhitir eva sā . athaindram ekadevatyam . pretir eva sā . athaindrāgnaṃ dvidevatyam . sā vā eṣā pretiś caiva pratiṣṭhitiś ca . pratitiṣṭhati ya evaṃ veda . trivṛtpañcadaśābhyāṃ puruṣo 'smin loke pratiṣṭhitaḥ . sa yam eva harati sa trivṛd yena pratitiṣṭhati sa pañcadaśaḥ . tau vā etāv ubhāv eva trivṛtāv ubhau pañcadaśau . tejo vai brahmavarcasaṃ trivṛt stoma ojo vīryaṃ pañcadaśaḥ .
sentences: yajamānaṃ ha vā etad udgātā reto bʰūtaṃ siñcati yad bahiṣpavamānaṃ gāyati .
mana eva retasyayā samīrayati prāṇaṃ gāyatryā cakṣus triṣṭubʰā śrotraṃ jagatyā vācam anuṣṭubʰā .
atʰa yad etad uttamaṃ tr̥caṃ janmaiva tat .
yasmād etad gʰoṣīvopabdimad iva gāyate tasmād gʰoṣīvopabdimad iva garbʰā jāyante .
tad uvā āhur agʰoṣam eva geyam .
yadā vai vijāyamānā krūrikurute 'tʰa sā gʰoṣaṃ karoti .
atʰo śanair iva vā agʰoṣam iva mahāhr̥ṣṭir vijāyate .
tasya saṃpadaṃ lobʰayed yad ratʰantaravarṇāṃ abʰyasyet .
sā vā eṣā pretiś caiva pratiṣṭʰitiś ca .
sa yam eva harati sa trivr̥d yena pratitiṣṭʰati sa pañcadaśaḥ .
tau vā etāv ubʰāv eva trivr̥tāv ubʰau pañcadaśau .
tejo vai brahmavarcasaṃ trivr̥t stoma ojo vīryaṃ pañcadaśaḥ .
text: The udgātṛ indeed pours the semen that has become the yajamāna when he sings the bahiṣpavamāna. With the retasyā he stirs up the mind; with the gāyatrī, the prāṇa; with the triṣṭubh, the eye; with the jagatī, the ear; with the anuṣṭubh, speech. With the paṅkti he restores the self. Now the final tṛca is indeed the birth. With it he generates forth. Because it is sung with noise and rumble, therefore offspring are born with noise and rumble. On this they say: it should be sung without noise. For when a woman giving birth cries out in pain, then she makes noise. But softly, as it were, without noise, one gives birth with great joy. Moreover, that which is gāyatra is truth. One would spoil its correspondence if one were to practice it with rathantara-coloring. Therefore it should be sung without noise. Now the āgneya ājya has one deity. That is a going forth. The maitrāvaruṇa has two deities. That is a firm standing. The aindra has one deity. That is a going forth. The aindrāgna has two deities. That is both a going forth and a firm standing. He who knows thus stands firm. By the trivṛt and pañcadaśa, a person is established in this world. That which he carries is the trivṛt; that by which he stands firm is the pañcadaśa. These two are both trivṛt and both pañcadaśa. The trivṛt stoma is splendor and brahmic glory; the pañcadaśa is vigor and heroic strength.
meaning: यजमानं ह वा एतद् उद्गाता रेतो भूतं सिञ्चति यद् बहिष्पवमानं गायति . मन एव रेतस्यया समीरयति प्राणं गायत्र्या चक्षुस् त्रिष्टुभा श्रोत्रं जगत्या वाचम् अनुष्टुभा . आत्मानम् एव पङ्क्त्या प्रत्युपदधाति . अथ यद् एतद् उत्तमं तृचं जन्मैव तत् . प्रैव तेन जनयति . यस्माद् एतद् घोषीवोपब्दिमद् इव गायते तस्माद् घोषीवोपब्दिमद् इव गर्भा जायन्ते . तद् उवा आहुर् अघोषम् एव गेयम् . यदा वै विजायमाना क्रूरिकुरुते ऽथ सा घोषं करोति . अथो शनैर् इव वा अघोषम् इव महाहृष्टिर् विजायते . अथो हैतत् सत्यं यद् गायत्रम् . तस्य संपदं लोभयेद् यद् रथन्तरवर्णां अभ्यस्येत् . तस्माद् अघोषम् एव गेयम् इति . अथाग्नेयम् आज्यम् एकदेवत्यम् . प्रेतिर् एव सा . अथ मैत्रावरुणं द्विदेवत्यम् . प्रतिष्ठितिर् एव सा . अथैन्द्रम् एकदेवत्यम् . प्रेतिर् एव सा . अथैन्द्राग्नं द्विदेवत्यम् . सा वा एषा प्रेतिश् चैव प्रतिष्ठितिश् च . प्रतितिष्ठति य एवं वेद . त्रिवृत्पञ्चदशाभ्यां पुरुषो ऽस्मिन् लोके प्रतिष्ठितः . स यम् एव हरति स त्रिवृद् येन प्रतितिष्ठति स पञ्चदशः . तौ वा एताव् उभाव् एव त्रिवृताव् उभौ पञ्चदशौ . तेजो वै ब्रह्मवर्चसं त्रिवृत् स्तोम ओजो वीर्यं पञ्चदशः .
