text: Now the gāyatrī of the midday pavamāna: the downward prāṇa is this very one. In it are two sāmans. Therefore with this prāṇa one does two things: one makes ashes and one makes wind. The prastāvas are separate, the nidhanas are separate, with a hiṃkāra in between. Therefore the one does not overpower the other. For by this they are kept apart. Now the bṛhatī: the forward prāṇa is this very one. In it are two sāmans. Therefore with this prāṇa one does two things: one discharges semen and one urinates. The prastāvas are separate, the nidhanas are separate, with a hiṃkāra in between. Therefore the one does not overpower the other. For by this they are kept apart. Now the triṣṭubh: that is the navel. In it is one sāman. Therefore with this one prāṇa one does only one thing: that which one exhales from the vital breaths. Now the pṛṣṭha-sāmans: the pṛṣṭha-sāmans are indriya and vīrya. Therefore whatever beings share the spine -- of cattle, horses, or humans -- the spine is the strongest part. For the pṛṣṭha-sāmans are indriya and vīrya. They are in the bṛhatī meters. Therefore these ribs, as it were bṛhatīs, and the cattle, as it were bṛhatīs, come together at the back. Now the gāyatrī of the ārbhava pavamāna: prāṇa is this very one. In it are two sāmans. Therefore with prāṇa one does two things: one breathes in and breathes out. The prastāvas are separate, the nidhanas are separate, with a hiṃkāra in between. Therefore the one does not overpower the other. For by this they are kept apart. Now the uṣṇih and kakubh: those are the two eyes. The meter is the same. There are two sāmans. Therefore the two eyes see the same. They are in three-footed verses. Therefore the eye is threefold: the white, the dark, and the pupil. They are in the parovarīyas verses. Therefore a person sees what is far away. The prastāvas are separate, the nidhanas are separate, with a hiṃkāra in between. Therefore the two eyes differ in power. Now the anuṣṭubh: that is speech. In it are two sāmans. Therefore with speech one does two things: one eats food with it and one speaks with it. The prastāvas are separate, the nidhanas are separate, with a hiṃkāra in between. Therefore one does not speak everything as truth with speech, nor everything as untruth. For by this they are kept apart. Now the jagatī: that is the ear. In it is one sāman. Therefore with the ear one does only one thing: that which one hears. It is in a four-footed verse. Therefore, being in one place, one hears in all directions. Even when turned away, one hears what is spoken from behind. Now the yajñāyajñīya: that is the head. The head is mounted upon the other limbs. The yajñāyajñīya is mounted upon the other stotras. He who knows thus is mounted above his own people. The head is above the other limbs. The yajñāyajñīya is above the other stotras. He who knows thus is above his own people. This sacrifice is directly the one whose evil has been struck away. There is no blame nor evil-doing for him. If one should interrupt him at the bahiṣpavamāna, one should say: 'You have spoiled the semen of the sacrifice, O sacrifice-spoiler; your offspring shall be without semen.' If one should interrupt him at the one-deity ājya, one should say: 'You have spoiled the going forth of the sacrifice, O sacrifice-spoiler; you shall die when you go to the world of the departed.' If one should interrupt him at the two-deity ājya, one should say: 'You have spoiled the firm standing of the sacrifice, O sacrifice-spoiler; you shall be without firm standing.' If one should interrupt him at the gāyatrī of the midday pavamāna, one should say: 'You have spoiled the downward prāṇa of the sacrifice, O sacrifice-spoiler; ruin shall destroy you.' Or one should say: 'Hemorrhage shall destroy you.' If one should interrupt him at the bṛhatī, one should say: 'You have spoiled the generative organ of the sacrifice, O sacrifice-spoiler; urinary obstruction shall destroy you.' Or one should say: 'You shall be without semen.' If one should interrupt him at the triṣṭubh, one should say: 'You have spoiled the navel of the sacrifice, O sacrifice-spoiler; a convulsion shall destroy you.' If one should interrupt him at the pṛṣṭha-sāmans, one should say: 'You have spoiled the indriya and vīrya of the sacrifice, O sacrifice-spoiler; the thunderbolt shall destroy you.'
meaning: अथ माध्यंदिनस्य पवमानस्य गायत्री . यो ऽयम् अवाङ् प्राण एष एव सः . तस्यां द्वे सामनी . तस्माद् एतेन द्वयं प्राणेन करोति भस्म च करोति वातं च . नाना प्रस्तावौ नाना निधने हिंकारो ऽन्तरेण . तस्मान् नेतर इतरम् अनुनिनर्दति नेतर इतरम् . एतेन हि तद् विहृतम् . अथ बृहती . यो ऽयं प्राङ् प्राण एष एव सः . तस्यां द्वे सामनी . तस्माद् एतेन द्वयं प्राणेन करोति रेतश् च सिञ्चति मेहति च . नाना प्रस्तावौ नाना निधने हिंकारो ऽन्तरेण . तस्मान् नेतर इतरम् अनुनिनर्दति नेतर इतरम् . एतेन हि तद् विहृतम् . अथ त्रिष्टुप् . नाभिर् एव सा . तस्याम् एकं साम . तस्माद् एतेनैकम् एव प्राणेन करोति यद् एव प्राणान् उदनतो ऽनूदनिति . अथ पृष्ट्ःआनि . इन्द्रियं वै वीर्यं पृष्ठानि . तस्माद् ये के चानूकभाजो गोर् अश्वस्य पुरुषस्य तेषाम् अनूकम् एव बलिष्ठम् . इन्द्रियं ह्य् एतद् वीर्यं यत् पृष्ठानि . तानि बृहतीषु भवन्ति . तस्माद् इमा बृहतीर् इव कीकसा बृहतीर् इव पशवः पृष्ठम् अभिसमायन्ति . अथार्भवस्य पवमानस्य गायत्री . यो ऽयं प्राण एष एव सः . तस्यां द्वे सामनी . तस्माद् द्वयं प्राणेन करोति प्राण्यापानिति . नाना प्रस्तावौ नाना निधने हिंकारो ऽन्तरेण . तस्मान् नेतर इतरम् अनुनिनर्दति नेतर इतरम् . एतेन हि तद् विहृतम् . अथोष्णिक्ककुभौ . चक्षुषी ते . समानं छन्दः . द्वे सामनी . तस्माद् द्वे अक्ष्यौ समानं पश्यतः . त्रिपदोर् ऋचोर् भवतः . तस्मात् त्रिवृच् चक्षुश् शुक्लं कृष्णं कनीनिका . परोवरीस्योर् ऋचोर् भवतः . तस्मात् परोवरीयः पुरुषः पश्यति . नाना प्रस्तावो नाना निधने हिंकारो ऽन्तरेण . तस्मान् नानावीर्ये चक्षुषी . अथानुष्टुभ् . वाग् एव सा . तस्यां द्वे सामनी . तस्माद् द्वयं वाचा करोत्य् अन्नं चैनयात्ति वदति च . नाना प्रस्तावो नाना निधने हिंकारो ऽन्तरेण . तस्मान् न सर्वं सत्यं वाचा वदति न सर्वम् अनृतम् . एतेन हि तद् विहृतम् . अथ जगती . श्रोत्रम् एव तत् . तस्याम् एकं साम . तस्माद् एतेनैकम् एव श्रोत्रेण करोति यद् एव श्र्णोति . चतुष्पदायाम् ऋचि भवति . तस्मात् समानत्र सन् सर्वा अनु दिशश् शृणोति . अपि पराङ् यन् पश्चाद् वदतश् शृणोति . अथ यज्ञायज्ञीयम् . शिर एव तत् . अध्यूढं वा एतद् अन्येष्व् अङ्गेषु यच् छिरः . अध्यूढम् अन्येषु स्तोत्रेषु यज्ञायज्ञीयम् . अध्यूढो ऽन्येषु स्वेषु भवति य एवं वेद . उपरि वा एतद् अन्येभ्यो ऽङ्गेभ्यो यच् छिरः . उपर्य् अन्येभ्यः स्तोत्रेभ्यो यज्ञायज्ञीयम् . उपर्य् अन्येभ्यः स्वेभ्यो भवति य एवं वेद . स एषो ऽपहतपाप्मा यज्ञ एव प्रत्यक्षम् . तस्य ह नोपवदंश् च न पापं कर्तास्ति . यद्य् एनं बहिष्पवमाने ऽनुव्याहरेद् यज्ञस्य रेतः सिक्तम् अचीक्ल्̥पं यज्ञमारो ऽरेतस्का ते प्रजा भविष्यतीत्य् एनं ब्रूयात् . यद्य् एनम् एकदेवत्य आज्ये ऽनुव्याहरेद् यज्ञस्य प्रेतिम् अचीक्ल्̥पं यज्ञमारः प्रेत्य जने मरिष्यसीत्य् एनं ब्रूयात् . यद्य् एनं द्विदेवत्य आज्ये ऽनुव्याहरेद् यज्ञस्य प्रतिष्ठाम् अचीक्ल्̥पं यज्ञमारो ऽप्रतिष्ट्ःइतो भविष्यसीत्य् एनं ब्रूयात् . यद्य् एनं माध्यंदिनस्य पवमानस्य गायत्र्याम् अनुव्याहरेद् यज्ञस्यावाञ्चं प्राणम् अचीक्ल्̥पं यज्ञमारो विघातस् त्वा हनिष्यतीत्य् एनं ब्रूयात् . अथो ह ब्रूयाद् अवस्रावस् त्वा हनिष्यतीति . यद्य् एनं बृहत्याम् अनुव्याहरेद् यज्ञस्य शिश्नम् अचीक्ल्̥पं यज्ञमारो मूत्रग्राहस् त्वा हनिष्यतीत्य् एनं ब्रूयात् . अथो ह ब्रूयाद् अरेतस्को भविष्यसीति . यद्य् एनं त्रिष्टुभ्य् अनुव्याहरेद् यज्ञस्य नाभिम् अचीक्ल्̥पं यज्ञमार उदावर्तस् त्व हनिष्यतीत्य् एनं ब्रूयात् . यद्य् एनं पृष्ठेष्व् अनुव्याहरेद् यज्ञस्येन्द्रियं वीर्यम् अचीक्ल्̥पं यज्ञमारो वज्रस् त्वा हनिष्यतीत्य् एनं ब्रूयात् .

sanskrit_iast: yady enam ārbhavasya pavamānasya gāyatryām anuvyāhared yajñasya prāṇam acīkl̥paṃ yajñamāraḥ prāṇas tvā hāsyatīty enaṃ brūyāt . atho ha brūyāt pramāyuko bhaviṣyasīti . yady enam uṣṇikkakubhor anuvyāhared yajñasya cakṣuṣī acīkl̥paṃ yajñamāro 'ndho bhaviṣyasīty enaṃ brūyāt . yady enam anuṣṭubhy anuvyāhared yajñasya vācam acīkl̥paṃ yajñamāro vāk te 'pakramiṣyatīty enaṃ brūyāt . atho ha brūyād aśanayā mariṣyasīti . yady enaṃ jagatyām anuvyāhared yajñasya śrotram acīkl̥paṃ yajñamāro badhiro bhaviṣyasīty enaṃ brūyāt .
sentences: yady enam ārbʰavasya pavamānasya gāyatryām anuvyāhared yajñasya prāṇam acīkl̥paṃ yajñamāraḥ prāṇas tvā hāsyatīty enaṃ brūyāt .
yady enam uṣṇikkakubʰor anuvyāhared yajñasya cakṣuṣī acīkl̥paṃ yajñamāro 'ndʰo bʰaviṣyasīty enaṃ brūyāt .
yady enam anuṣṭubʰy anuvyāhared yajñasya vācam acīkl̥paṃ yajñamāro vāk te 'pakramiṣyatīty enaṃ brūyāt .
yady enaṃ jagatyām anuvyāhared yajñasya śrotram acīkl̥paṃ yajñamāro badʰiro bʰaviṣyasīty enaṃ brūyāt .
text: If one should interrupt him at the gāyatrī of the ārbhava pavamāna, one should say: 'You have spoiled the prāṇa of the sacrifice, O sacrifice-spoiler; prāṇa shall leave you.' Or one should say: 'You shall be one whose life is cut short.' If one should interrupt him at the uṣṇih and kakubh, one should say: 'You have spoiled the two eyes of the sacrifice, O sacrifice-spoiler; you shall become blind.' If one should interrupt him at the anuṣṭubh, one should say: 'You have spoiled the speech of the sacrifice, O sacrifice-spoiler; speech shall depart from you.' Or one should say: 'You shall die of hunger.' If one should interrupt him at the jagatī, one should say: 'You have spoiled the ear of the sacrifice, O sacrifice-spoiler; you shall become deaf.'
meaning: यद्य् एनम् आर्भवस्य पवमानस्य गायत्र्याम् अनुव्याहरेद् यज्ञस्य प्राणम् अचीक्ल्̥पं यज्ञमारः प्राणस् त्वा हास्यतीत्य् एनं ब्रूयात् . अथो ह ब्रूयात् प्रमायुको भविष्यसीति . यद्य् एनम् उष्णिक्ककुभोर् अनुव्याहरेद् यज्ञस्य चक्षुषी अचीक्ल्̥पं यज्ञमारो ऽन्धो भविष्यसीत्य् एनं ब्रूयात् . यद्य् एनम् अनुष्टुभ्य् अनुव्याहरेद् यज्ञस्य वाचम् अचीक्ल्̥पं यज्ञमारो वाक् ते ऽपक्रमिष्यतीत्य् एनं ब्रूयात् . अथो ह ब्रूयाद् अशनया मरिष्यसीति . यद्य् एनं जगत्याम् अनुव्याहरेद् यज्ञस्य श्रोत्रम् अचीक्ल्̥पं यज्ञमारो बधिरो भविष्यसीत्य् एनं ब्रूयात् .

sanskrit_iast: ete ha vai prativyāhārāḥ . na haivaṃvid yajñiyām ārtim ārchati . ya evainam upavadati sa ārtim ārchati . sa ya enam upavadet taṃ brūyāt pūrṇam evāham etaṃ sāṅgaṃ satanuṃ sarvaṃ yajñaṃ veda sa yat tvam atronaṃ vettha tat tvayaivāpidadhānīti . sa evārtim ārchati ya evaṃ vidvāṃsam upavadati . sa eṣa prajāpatir agniṣṭomo 'mūm ekaviṃśīṃ yajñāyajñīyasyāsu bahiṣpavamānīsu navasu pratyupadhāya śaya etā dviṣṭanā virājo duhānaḥ pañca pañcadaśāni pañca saptadaśāni . tā eva pañca dvātriṃśinīr virājaḥ . duhre ha vai virājaṃ sarvān kāmān ya evaṃ veda . na haivaṃvido 'nṛtaṃ cana vadato yajñaḥ sravati . sravati ha vā anṛtaṃ vadato yajño 'tho ha pūyati . no ha tv evaṃvido yajñaḥ sravati na pūyati . tasmāt kurupañcālā dviṣṭanāṃ {na} duhre . prajāpater hi sā . tasmād v anya udantā  duhre . na hi te tāṃ viduḥ .
sentences: ya evainam upavadati sa ārtim ārcʰati .
sa ya enam upavadet taṃ brūyāt pūrṇam evāham etaṃ sāṅgaṃ satanuṃ sarvaṃ yajñaṃ veda sa yat tvam atronaṃ vettʰa tat tvayaivāpidadʰānīti .
sa evārtim ārcʰati ya evaṃ vidvāṃsam upavadati .
sa eṣa prajāpatir agniṣṭomo 'mūm ekaviṃśīṃ yajñāyajñīyasyāsu bahiṣpavamānīsu navasu pratyupadʰāya śaya etā dviṣṭanā virājo duhānaḥ pañca pañcadaśāni pañca saptadaśāni .
duhre ha vai virājaṃ sarvān kāmān ya evaṃ veda .
na haivaṃvido 'nr̥taṃ cana vadato yajñaḥ sravati .
sravati ha vā anr̥taṃ vadato yajño 'tʰo ha pūyati .
no ha tv evaṃvido yajñaḥ sravati na pūyati .
text: These are the counter-declarations. He who knows thus does not come to grief concerning the sacrifice. He who speaks against him comes to grief. If someone should speak against him, he should say: 'I know this sacrifice fully, with all its limbs and body, completely. Whatever gap you find in it, I shall fill that with yourself.' He who speaks against one who knows thus comes to grief himself. This agniṣṭoma is Prajāpati, having placed this twenty-first yajñāyajñīya upon these nine bahiṣpavamāna verses, lying down, milking these doubled virāj meters -- five of fifteen each and five of seventeen each. These are five virāj meters of thirty-two each. He who knows thus milks from the virāj all desires. The sacrifice of one who knows thus does not leak, even when he speaks untruth. The sacrifice of one who speaks untruth leaks, and it putrefies. But the sacrifice of one who knows thus neither leaks nor putrefies. Therefore the Kuru-Pañcālas milk the doubled form, for it belongs to Prajāpati. Therefore others milk it differently, for they do not know it.
meaning: एते ह वै प्रतिव्याहाराः . न हैवंविद् यज्ञियाम् आर्तिम् आर्छति . य एवैनम् उपवदति स आर्तिम् आर्छति . स य एनम् उपवदेत् तं ब्रूयात् पूर्णम् एवाहम् एतं साङ्गं सतनुं सर्वं यज्ञं वेद स यत् त्वम् अत्रोनं वेत्थ तत् त्वयैवापिदधानीति . स एवार्तिम् आर्छति य एवं विद्वांसम् उपवदति . स एष प्रजापतिर् अग्निष्टोमो ऽमूम् एकविंशीं यज्ञायज्ञीयस्यासु बहिष्पवमानीसु नवसु प्रत्युपधाय शय एता द्विष्टना विराजो दुहानः पञ्च पञ्चदशानि पञ्च सप्तदशानि . ता एव पञ्च द्वात्रिंशिनीर् विराजः . दुह्रे ह वै विराजं सर्वान् कामान् य एवं वेद . न हैवंविदो ऽनृतं चन वदतो यज्ञः स्रवति . स्रवति ह वा अनृतं वदतो यज्ञो ऽथो ह पूयति . नो ह त्व् एवंविदो यज्ञः स्रवति न पूयति . तस्मात् कुरुपञ्चाला द्विष्टनां {न} दुह्रे . प्रजापतेर् हि सा . तस्माद् व् अन्य उदन्ता  दुह्रे . न हि ते तां विदुः .

sanskrit_iast: - parimaṇḍalo bhūtvānanto bhūtvā śaye . tadanukṛtīdam apy anyā devatā parimaṇḍalāḥ . parimaṇḍala ādityaḥ parimaṇḍalaś candramāḥ parimaṇḍalā dyauḥ parimaṇḍalam antarikṣaṃ parimaṇḍaleyaṃ pṛthivī . api yad idaṃ puruṣe divyaṃ tat parimaṇḍalam . etasyaiva nyaṅgam anunyañjānaḥ parimaṇḍalāṃ mahatīm anantāṃ śriyaṃ jayati ya evaṃ veda . sa eṣa yajña ūrdhva eva puruṣam anvāyattaḥ . tasya pādāv eva bahiṣpavamānam . imāny eva catvāry ūrvaṣṭhīvāny ājyāni . yad arvācīnaṃ nābheḥ sa trichandā mādhyaṃdinaḥ . pṛṣṭhāny eva pṛṣṭhāni . ayam ārbhava idam agniṣṭomasāma . tad dha nagariṇaṃ dālbhyaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ papraccha kadryaṅ yajña iti . sa hovācordhva eva puruṣam anvāyatta iti . evaṃ ha tad uvāca . sa ya evam etad ūrdhvam ātman yajñaṃ tāyamānaṃ vedordhva eva prajayā paśubhī rohann eti . ya u enaṃ pratyañcaṃ veda pratyaṅbhūtir bhavati . tasyedam eva bahiṣpavamānam imāny ājyāny ayaṃ mādhyaṃdinaḥ pṛṣṭhāny eva pṛṣṭhāny ayam ārbhavaḥ pratiṣṭhaiva yajñāyajñīyam . pratyaṅbhūtir bhavati .
sentences: parimaṇḍala ādityaḥ parimaṇḍalaś candramāḥ parimaṇḍalā dyauḥ parimaṇḍalam antarikṣaṃ parimaṇḍaleyaṃ pr̥tʰivī .
api yad idaṃ puruṣe divyaṃ tat parimaṇḍalam .
etasyaiva nyaṅgam anunyañjānaḥ parimaṇḍalāṃ mahatīm anantāṃ śriyaṃ jayati ya evaṃ veda .
sa eṣa yajña ūrdʰva eva puruṣam anvāyattaḥ .
yad arvācīnaṃ nābʰeḥ sa tricʰandā mādʰyaṃdinaḥ .
tad dʰa nagariṇaṃ dālbʰyaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ papraccʰa kadryaṅ yajña iti .
sa hovācordʰva eva puruṣam anvāyatta iti .
sa ya evam etad ūrdʰvam ātman yajñaṃ tāyamānaṃ vedordʰva eva prajayā paśubʰī rohann eti .
ya u enaṃ pratyañcaṃ veda pratyaṅbʰūtir bʰavati .
tasyedam eva bahiṣpavamānam imāny ājyāny ayaṃ mādʰyaṃdinaḥ pr̥ṣṭʰāny eva pr̥ṣṭʰāny ayam ārbʰavaḥ pratiṣṭʰaiva yajñāyajñīyam .
text: Having become circular, having become infinite, he lies down. In imitation of this, other divinities too are circular. The sun is circular, the moon is circular, the sky is circular, the atmosphere is circular, this earth is circular. Even that which is divine in a person is circular. Imitating his characteristics, one who knows thus wins a circular, great, infinite prosperity. This sacrifice is spread out upward following the person. Its feet are the bahiṣpavamāna. These four thighs and knees are the ājyas. What is below the navel is the three-metered midday chant. The pṛṣṭha-sāmans are the back itself. This is the ārbhava; this is the agniṣṭoma-sāman. Nagarin Dālbhya was asked by a brāhmaṇa: 'In what direction does the sacrifice extend?' He said: 'It is spread upward following the person.' Thus he spoke. He who knows this sacrifice as extending upward upon the self goes upward, ascending with offspring and cattle. And he who knows it in the reverse direction becomes one turned backwards. For him this bahiṣpavamāna, these ājyas, this midday chant, the pṛṣṭha-sāmans as the back itself, this ārbhava, and the yajñāyajñīya as the firm standing -- he becomes one turned backwards.
meaning: - परिमण्डलो भूत्वानन्तो भूत्वा शये . तदनुकृतीदम् अप्य् अन्या देवता परिमण्डलाः . परिमण्डल आदित्यः परिमण्डलश् चन्द्रमाः परिमण्डला द्यौः परिमण्डलम् अन्तरिक्षं परिमण्डलेयं पृथिवी . अपि यद् इदं पुरुषे दिव्यं तत् परिमण्डलम् . एतस्यैव न्यङ्गम् अनुन्यञ्जानः परिमण्डलां महतीम् अनन्तां श्रियं जयति य एवं वेद . स एष यज्ञ ऊर्ध्व एव पुरुषम् अन्वायत्तः . तस्य पादाव् एव बहिष्पवमानम् . इमान्य् एव चत्वार्य् ऊर्वष्ठीवान्य् आज्यानि . यद् अर्वाचीनं नाभेः स त्रिछन्दा माध्यंदिनः . पृष्ठान्य् एव पृष्ठानि . अयम् आर्भव इदम् अग्निष्टोमसाम . तद् ध नगरिणं दाल्भ्यं ब्राह्मणः पप्रच्छ कद्र्यङ् यज्ञ इति . स होवाचोर्ध्व एव पुरुषम् अन्वायत्त इति . एवं ह तद् उवाच . स य एवम् एतद् ऊर्ध्वम् आत्मन् यज्ञं तायमानं वेदोर्ध्व एव प्रजया पशुभी रोहन्न् एति . य उ एनं प्रत्यञ्चं वेद प्रत्यङ्भूतिर् भवति . तस्येदम् एव बहिष्पवमानम् इमान्य् आज्यान्य् अयं माध्यंदिनः पृष्ठान्य् एव पृष्ठान्य् अयम् आर्भवः प्रतिष्ठैव यज्ञायज्ञीयम् . प्रत्यङ्भूतिर् भवति .

sanskrit_iast: tasyaiṣa ślokaḥ yad asya pūrvam aparaṃ tad asya yad v asyāparaṃ tad v asya pūrvam aher iva sarpaṇaṃ śākalasya na vijānāmi yatarat purastāt iti . śakalo ha gaupāyano yajñaṃ mimāna iyāya . sa ha smaitan na vijānāti katarad yajñasya pūrvaṃ katarad aparaṃ katarad aṇīyaḥ katarad sthavīya iti . tad āhuḥ kuto yajñasyāniṣṭham iti . yato variṣṭham iti . kuto variṣṭham iti . yato 'ṇiṣṭham iti . bahiṣpavamānam vāva prati yajño 'ṇiṣṭhaḥ . tad idaṃ pādāv avocat . pādau vai prati puruṣo 'ṇiṣṭhaḥ . tad vai variṣṭhaḥ . padbhyāṃ hy eti . kuto variṣṭha iti . yato 'ṇiṣṭha iti . yajñāyajñīyam vāva prati yajño 'ṇiṣṭhaḥ . tad idaṃ śiro 'vocat . śiro vai prati puruṣo 'ṇiṣṭhaḥ . tad vai variṣṭhaḥ . akṣibhyāṃ hi paśyann eti . tad āhur yad ūrdhvo yajñas tāyeta devā eva jīveyur na manuṣyāḥ . yad arvāṅ tāyeta manuṣyā eva jīveyur na devā iti . ūrdhvaś ca ha vai yajñas tāyate 'rvāṅ cātho ha tiryaṅ . tad yat pṛccheyuḥ kadryaṅ yajña ity ūrdhva iti brūyād atho arvāṅ ity atho tiryaṅṅ iti . sarvā eva diśa iti brūyāt . sarvā u ha vai evaṃvido yajñas tato bhavati . kurupañcālā ha brahmodyam ūdire . te ha śvānaṃ saṃveṣṭitaṃ śayānam upeyuḥ . te hocur asmin nv eva no vijayo 'dhy astv iti . te ha pañcālāḥ kurūn papracchuḥ kim asya yajñasyeveti . tad dha na pratyūcuḥ . sa hovāca vasiṣṭhaś caikitāneyo yathā vā asāv ado 'mūm ekaviṃśīṃ yajñāyajñīyasyāsu bahiṣpavamānīṣu navasu pratyupadhāya śaya evaṃ vā ayam idam ubhāv antau saṃdhāya śaye . tasya vā ayaṃ yajñakrator anayā śayyayo rūpaṃ nigacchatīti . tasmād idam anarthyaṃ santaṃ bibhṛteti .
sentences: yad asya pūrvam aparaṃ tad asya
yad v asyāparaṃ tad v asya pūrvam
śakalo ha gaupāyano yajñaṃ mimāna iyāya .
sa ha smaitan na vijānāti katarad yajñasya pūrvaṃ katarad aparaṃ katarad aṇīyaḥ katarad stʰavīya iti .
tad āhur yad ūrdʰvo yajñas tāyeta devā eva jīveyur na manuṣyāḥ .
yad arvāṅ tāyeta manuṣyā eva jīveyur na devā iti .
ūrdʰvaś ca ha vai yajñas tāyate 'rvāṅ cātʰo ha tiryaṅ .
tad yat pr̥ccʰeyuḥ kadryaṅ yajña ity ūrdʰva iti brūyād atʰo arvāṅ ity atʰo tiryaṅṅ iti .
sarvā u ha vai evaṃvido yajñas tato bʰavati .
te ha śvānaṃ saṃveṣṭitaṃ śayānam upeyuḥ .
te hocur asmin nv eva no vijayo 'dʰy astv iti .
te ha pañcālāḥ kurūn papraccʰuḥ kim asya yajñasyeveti .
sa hovāca vasiṣṭʰaś caikitāneyo yatʰā vā asāv ado 'mūm ekaviṃśīṃ yajñāyajñīyasyāsu bahiṣpavamānīṣu navasu pratyupadʰāya śaya evaṃ vā ayam idam ubʰāv antau saṃdʰāya śaye .
tasya vā ayaṃ yajñakrator anayā śayyayo rūpaṃ nigaccʰatīti .
text: Of this there is this verse: 'What is its front is its rear, and what is its rear is its front. Like the crawling of a snake, I do not know of Śakala which is the front.' Śakala Gaupāyana went about measuring the sacrifice. He indeed could not understand which is the front of the sacrifice, which the rear, which the thinner, which the thicker. On this they say: 'From where is the sacrifice thinnest?' 'From where it is thickest.' 'From where is it thickest?' 'From where it is thinnest.' The sacrifice is thinnest toward the bahiṣpavamāna. This represents the feet. A person is thinnest toward the feet. Yet that is the thickest, for one goes with the feet. 'From where is it thickest?' 'From where it is thinnest.' The sacrifice is thinnest toward the yajñāyajñīya. This represents the head. A person is thinnest toward the head. Yet that is the thickest, for one goes seeing with the eyes. On this they say: 'If the sacrifice were extended upward, the gods alone would live, not humans. If it were extended downward, humans alone would live, not the gods.' The sacrifice is extended both upward and downward, and also sideways. If they should ask, 'In what direction is the sacrifice?' one should say 'upward,' and also 'downward,' and also 'sideways.' One should say 'in all directions.' The sacrifice of one who knows thus extends in all directions. The Kuru-Pañcālas engaged in a theological debate. They came upon a dog lying curled up. They said: 'Let our victory rest upon this.' The Pañcālas asked the Kurus: 'What is this, namely, the sacrifice?' They could not answer. Then Vasiṣṭha Caikitāneya said: 'Just as that one lies having placed this twenty-first yajñāyajñīya upon these nine bahiṣpavamāna verses, so this one lies having joined both ends. This sacrifice-ritual has its form in this manner of lying.' Therefore they maintain this one, though it seems purposeless.
meaning: तस्यैष श्लोकः यद् अस्य पूर्वम् अपरं तद् अस्य यद् व् अस्यापरं तद् व् अस्य पूर्वम् अहेर् इव सर्पणं शाकलस्य न विजानामि यतरत् पुरस्तात् इति . शकलो ह गौपायनो यज्ञं मिमान इयाय . स ह स्मैतन् न विजानाति कतरद् यज्ञस्य पूर्वं कतरद् अपरं कतरद् अणीयः कतरद् स्थवीय इति . तद् आहुः कुतो यज्ञस्यानिष्ठम् इति . यतो वरिष्ठम् इति . कुतो वरिष्ठम् इति . यतो ऽणिष्ठम् इति . बहिष्पवमानम् वाव प्रति यज्ञो ऽणिष्ठः . तद् इदं पादाव् अवोचत् . पादौ वै प्रति पुरुषो ऽणिष्ठः . तद् वै वरिष्ठः . पद्भ्यां ह्य् एति . कुतो वरिष्ठ इति . यतो ऽणिष्ठ इति . यज्ञायज्ञीयम् वाव प्रति यज्ञो ऽणिष्ठः . तद् इदं शिरो ऽवोचत् . शिरो वै प्रति पुरुषो ऽणिष्ठः . तद् वै वरिष्ठः . अक्षिभ्यां हि पश्यन्न् एति . तद् आहुर् यद् ऊर्ध्वो यज्ञस् तायेत देवा एव जीवेयुर् न मनुष्याः . यद् अर्वाङ् तायेत मनुष्या एव जीवेयुर् न देवा इति . ऊर्ध्वश् च ह वै यज्ञस् तायते ऽर्वाङ् चाथो ह तिर्यङ् . तद् यत् पृच्छेयुः कद्र्यङ् यज्ञ इत्य् ऊर्ध्व इति ब्रूयाद् अथो अर्वाङ् इत्य् अथो तिर्यङ्ङ् इति . सर्वा एव दिश इति ब्रूयात् . सर्वा उ ह वै एवंविदो यज्ञस् ततो भवति . कुरुपञ्चाला ह ब्रह्मोद्यम् ऊदिरे . ते ह श्वानं संवेष्टितं शयानम् उपेयुः . ते होचुर् अस्मिन् न्व् एव नो विजयो ऽध्य् अस्त्व् इति . ते ह पञ्चालाः कुरून् पप्रच्छुः किम् अस्य यज्ञस्येवेति . तद् ध न प्रत्यूचुः . स होवाच वसिष्ठश् चैकितानेयो यथा वा असाव् अदो ऽमूम् एकविंशीं यज्ञायज्ञीयस्यासु बहिष्पवमानीषु नवसु प्रत्युपधाय शय एवं वा अयम् इदम् उभाव् अन्तौ संधाय शये . तस्य वा अयं यज्ञक्रतोर् अनया शय्ययो रूपं निगच्छतीति . तस्माद् इदम् अनर्थ्यं सन्तं बिभृतेति .

sanskrit_iast: dvir ha vai yajamāno jāyate mithunād anyaj jāyate yajñād anyat . tad yan mithunāj jāyate tad asmai lokāya jāyate . atha yad yajñāj jāyate tad amuṣmai lokāya jāyate gandharvalokāya jāyate devalokāya jāyate svargalokāya jāyate . yajño vai yajamāno yajñaḥ somo rājā . tad yad dhavirdhāne grāvabhis somaṃ rājānam abhiṣuṇvanti yajamānam eva tad retaḥ kurvanti . prajāpatir eṣa yad udgātā . sa tvaṣṭā sa retasaḥ sektā sa rūpāṇāṃ vikartā . tad yad bahiṣpavamāne retasyāṃ gāyati yajamānam eva tad reto bhūtaṃ siñcati . yad ṛcam asāmnīṃ gāyed asthy eva jāyate na māṃsam . yat sāmānṛcaṃ gāyen māṃsam eva jāyate nāsthi . ṛcaṃ sāmnābhiliptāṃ gāyati . tasmāl lomnā tvacā māṃsena puruṣo 'bhilipto jāyate . tasyāṃ na hiṃkuryāt . yad dhiṃkuryād vajreṇa hiṃkāreṇa reto vicchindyāt . yo hi tad api vālena vīyāt sa evainad vicchindyāt . tām adhīyan gāyet . yad anadhīyan gāyed aretaskā garbhā jāyeran .
sentences: dvir ha vai yajamāno jāyate mitʰunād anyaj jāyate yajñād anyat .
tad yan mitʰunāj jāyate tad asmai lokāya jāyate .
atʰa yad yajñāj jāyate tad amuṣmai lokāya jāyate gandʰarvalokāya jāyate devalokāya jāyate svargalokāya jāyate .
yajño vai yajamāno yajñaḥ somo rājā .
tad yad dʰavirdʰāne grāvabʰis somaṃ rājānam abʰiṣuṇvanti yajamānam eva tad retaḥ kurvanti .
sa tvaṣṭā sa retasaḥ sektā sa rūpāṇāṃ vikartā .
tad yad bahiṣpavamāne retasyāṃ gāyati yajamānam eva tad reto bʰūtaṃ siñcati .
yad r̥cam asāmnīṃ gāyed astʰy eva jāyate na māṃsam .
yat sāmānr̥caṃ gāyen māṃsam eva jāyate nāstʰi .
tasmāl lomnā tvacā māṃsena puruṣo 'bʰilipto jāyate .
yad dʰiṃkuryād vajreṇa hiṃkāreṇa reto viccʰindyāt .
yo hi tad api vālena vīyāt sa evainad viccʰindyāt .
yad anadʰīyan gāyed aretaskā garbʰā jāyeran .
text: Twice indeed the yajamāna is born: once from a couple, once from the sacrifice. That which is born from a couple is born for this world. That which is born from the sacrifice is born for the other world -- for the world of the gandharvas, for the world of the gods, for the heavenly world. The yajamāna is the sacrifice; the sacrifice is Soma the king. When they press Soma the king with the pressing stones in the havirdhāna, they make the yajamāna into semen. The udgātṛ is Prajāpati. He is Tvaṣṭṛ, the discharger of semen, the fashioner of forms. When he sings the retasyā at the bahiṣpavamāna, he pours the yajamāna as semen that has come into being. If he were to sing a verse without a sāman, only bone would be born, not flesh. If he were to sing a sāman without a verse, only flesh would be born, not bone. He sings the verse anointed with the sāman. Therefore a person is born covered with hair, skin, and flesh. In it he should not make a hiṃkāra. If he were to make a hiṃkāra, he would sever the semen with the thunderbolt of the hiṃkāra. For even if one were to split it with a hair, one would sever it. He should sing it flowing. If he were to sing it not flowing, offspring would be born without semen.
meaning: द्विर् ह वै यजमानो जायते मिथुनाद् अन्यज् जायते यज्ञाद् अन्यत् . तद् यन् मिथुनाज् जायते तद् अस्मै लोकाय जायते . अथ यद् यज्ञाज् जायते तद् अमुष्मै लोकाय जायते गन्धर्वलोकाय जायते देवलोकाय जायते स्वर्गलोकाय जायते . यज्ञो वै यजमानो यज्ञः सोमो राजा . तद् यद् धविर्धाने ग्रावभिस् सोमं राजानम् अभिषुण्वन्ति यजमानम् एव तद् रेतः कुर्वन्ति . प्रजापतिर् एष यद् उद्गाता . स त्वष्टा स रेतसः सेक्ता स रूपाणां विकर्ता . तद् यद् बहिष्पवमाने रेतस्यां गायति यजमानम् एव तद् रेतो भूतं सिञ्चति . यद् ऋचम् असाम्नीं गायेद् अस्थ्य् एव जायते न मांसम् . यत् सामानृचं गायेन् मांसम् एव जायते नास्थि . ऋचं साम्नाभिलिप्तां गायति . तस्माल् लोम्ना त्वचा मांसेन पुरुषो ऽभिलिप्तो जायते . तस्यां न हिंकुर्यात् . यद् धिंकुर्याद् वज्रेण हिंकारेण रेतो विच्छिन्द्यात् . यो हि तद् अपि वालेन वीयात् स एवैनद् विच्छिन्द्यात् . ताम् अधीयन् गायेत् . यद् अनधीयन् गायेद् अरेतस्का गर्भा जायेरन् .

sanskrit_iast: gāyatrīṃ gāyati . prāṇo vai gāyatrī . tasyai dve akṣare vyatiṣajati . prāṇāpānāv eva tad vyatiṣajati . tasmāt prāṇāpānau tad vyatiṣaktau prajā anusaṃcarata ā ca parā cāyātayāmānau . tām adhīyan gāyet . yad anadhīyan gāyen mṛtā garbhā jāyeran . mṛtā ha vai durudgātur vartanyāṃ garbhā jāyante . triṣṭubhaṃ gāyati . cakṣur vai triṣṭup . tasyai dve akṣare dyotayati . cakṣuṣī eva tad dadhāti . tasmād yukte iva cakṣuṣī . tām adhīyan gāyet . yad anadhīyan gāyed andhā garbhā jāyeran . andhā ha vai durudgātur vartanyāṃ garbhā jāyante . jagatīṃ gāyati . śrotraṃ vai jagatī . tasyai catvāry akṣarāṇi dyotayati . śrotram eva tad dadhāti . śrotre dve pariśravaṇe dve . tasmāt samānatra san sarvā anudiśaś śṛṇoti . api parāṅ yan paścād vadataś śṛṇoti . tām adhīyan gāyet . yad anadhīyan gāyed badhirā garbhā jāyeran . badhirā ha vai durudgātur vartanyāṃ garbhā jāyante . anuṣṭubhaṃ gāyati . vāg vā anuṣṭup . tām arvācīm abhinudan gāyati vāco 'napakrāmāya . yat parācīm apanudan gāyed vācaṃ pradhamed vāg asmād apakrāmukā syāt . tāṃ yad arvācīm abhinudan gāyaty ātmann eva tad vācaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati . tasyai niruktaṃ cāniruktaṃ ca pade gāyati . niruktena vai vāco bhuñjate 'niruktam asyā upajīvanīyam . bhuṅkte vācopa cainaṃ jīvati ya evaṃ veda . sa yan niruktam eva gāyed vadeyur eva prajā na tūṣṇīm āsīran . atha yad aniruktaṃ gāyet tūṣṇīm eva prajā āsīran na vadeyuḥ .
sentences: tasmāt prāṇāpānau tad vyatiṣaktau prajā anusaṃcarata ā ca parā cāyātayāmānau .
yad anadʰīyan gāyen mr̥tā garbʰā jāyeran .
mr̥tā ha vai durudgātur vartanyāṃ garbʰā jāyante .
yad anadʰīyan gāyed andʰā garbʰā jāyeran .
andʰā ha vai durudgātur vartanyāṃ garbʰā jāyante .
tasmāt samānatra san sarvā anudiśaś śr̥ṇoti .
api parāṅ yan paścād vadataś śr̥ṇoti .
yad anadʰīyan gāyed badʰirā garbʰā jāyeran .
badʰirā ha vai durudgātur vartanyāṃ garbʰā jāyante .
yat parācīm apanudan gāyed vācaṃ pradʰamed vāg asmād apakrāmukā syāt .
tāṃ yad arvācīm abʰinudan gāyaty ātmann eva tad vācaṃ pratiṣṭʰāpayati .
tasyai niruktaṃ cāniruktaṃ ca pade gāyati .
niruktena vai vāco bʰuñjate 'niruktam asyā upajīvanīyam .
bʰuṅkte vācopa cainaṃ jīvati ya evaṃ veda .
sa yan niruktam eva gāyed vadeyur eva prajā na tūṣṇīm āsīran .
atʰa yad aniruktaṃ gāyet tūṣṇīm eva prajā āsīran na vadeyuḥ .
text: He sings a gāyatrī. Prāṇa is the gāyatrī. He interweaves two syllables of it. Thereby he interweaves the prāṇa and apāna. Therefore the prāṇa and apāna, being interwoven, accompany creatures back and forth without ceasing. He should sing it flowing. If he were to sing it not flowing, offspring would be born dead. Indeed, offspring are born dead in the channel of a bad udgātṛ. He sings a triṣṭubh. The eye is the triṣṭubh. He makes two syllables of it flash. Thereby he places the two eyes. Therefore the two eyes are as if yoked together. He should sing it flowing. If he were to sing it not flowing, offspring would be born blind. Indeed, offspring are born blind in the channel of a bad udgātṛ. He sings a jagatī. The ear is the jagatī. He makes four syllables of it flash. Thereby he places the ear -- two ears and two passages. Therefore, being in one place, one hears in all directions. Even when turned away, one hears what is spoken from behind. He should sing it flowing. If he were to sing it not flowing, offspring would be born deaf. Indeed, offspring are born deaf in the channel of a bad udgātṛ. He sings an anuṣṭubh. Speech is the anuṣṭubh. He sings it pushing it toward oneself, for the non-departure of speech. If he were to sing it pushing it away, he would blow away speech; speech would depart from him. By singing it pushing it toward oneself, he establishes speech in the self. He sings its two feet as both articulate and inarticulate. For by the articulate one enjoys speech; the inarticulate is its means of sustenance. He who knows thus enjoys speech and it sustains him. If he were to sing only the articulate, creatures would only speak and never be silent. If he were to sing the inarticulate, creatures would only be silent and never speak.
meaning: गायत्रीं गायति . प्राणो वै गायत्री . तस्यै द्वे अक्षरे व्यतिषजति . प्राणापानाव् एव तद् व्यतिषजति . तस्मात् प्राणापानौ तद् व्यतिषक्तौ प्रजा अनुसंचरत आ च परा चायातयामानौ . ताम् अधीयन् गायेत् . यद् अनधीयन् गायेन् मृता गर्भा जायेरन् . मृता ह वै दुरुद्गातुर् वर्तन्यां गर्भा जायन्ते . त्रिष्टुभं गायति . चक्षुर् वै त्रिष्टुप् . तस्यै द्वे अक्षरे द्योतयति . चक्षुषी एव तद् दधाति . तस्माद् युक्ते इव चक्षुषी . ताम् अधीयन् गायेत् . यद् अनधीयन् गायेद् अन्धा गर्भा जायेरन् . अन्धा ह वै दुरुद्गातुर् वर्तन्यां गर्भा जायन्ते . जगतीं गायति . श्रोत्रं वै जगती . तस्यै चत्वार्य् अक्षराणि द्योतयति . श्रोत्रम् एव तद् दधाति . श्रोत्रे द्वे परिश्रवणे द्वे . तस्मात् समानत्र सन् सर्वा अनुदिशश् शृणोति . अपि पराङ् यन् पश्चाद् वदतश् शृणोति . ताम् अधीयन् गायेत् . यद् अनधीयन् गायेद् बधिरा गर्भा जायेरन् . बधिरा ह वै दुरुद्गातुर् वर्तन्यां गर्भा जायन्ते . अनुष्टुभं गायति . वाग् वा अनुष्टुप् . ताम् अर्वाचीम् अभिनुदन् गायति वाचो ऽनपक्रामाय . यत् पराचीम् अपनुदन् गायेद् वाचं प्रधमेद् वाग् अस्माद् अपक्रामुका स्यात् . तां यद् अर्वाचीम् अभिनुदन् गायत्य् आत्मन्न् एव तद् वाचं प्रतिष्ठापयति . तस्यै निरुक्तं चानिरुक्तं च पदे गायति . निरुक्तेन वै वाचो भुञ्जते ऽनिरुक्तम् अस्या उपजीवनीयम् . भुङ्क्ते वाचोप चैनं जीवति य एवं वेद . स यन् निरुक्तम् एव गायेद् वदेयुर् एव प्रजा न तूष्णीम् आसीरन् . अथ यद् अनिरुक्तं गायेत् तूष्णीम् एव प्रजा आसीरन् न वदेयुः .

sanskrit_iast: tāṃ balavad upabdimatīṃ nighātaṃ gāyet . nighnad iva ha khalu vā etac chando yad anuṣṭup . anuṣṭubhā vai vācā chandasā devā asurān avāco 'vāghnan . tāṃ yad balavad upabdimatīṃ nighātaṃ gāyati - bhrātṛvyo vai pāpmā - bhrātṛvyam etat pāpmānam avācam avahanti śriyam ātmanāśnute . tām adhīyan gāyet . yad anadhīyan gāyed ajihvā garbhā jāyeran . ajihvā ha vai durudgātur vartanyāṃ garbhā jāyante . paṅktim gāyati . ṛtavo vai paṅktiḥ . tāṃ gāyatrīm eva prasṛtāṃ gāyati . tasmād garbhā jāyamānāḥ prasāryante . tām adhīyan gāyet . yad anadhīyan gāyet sāmi garbhāḥ pateyuḥ . sāmi ha vai durudgātur vartanyāṃ garbhā patanti . atha yad etad uttamaṃ tṛcaṃ janmaiva tat . praiva tena janayati . mano vai retasyā prāṇo gāyatrī cakṣus triṣṭup śrotraṃ jagatī vāg anuṣṭup . sa yo mano retasyeti vidvān udgāyati mahāmanā manasvy asmād ājāyate . {atha yaḥ prāṇo gāyatrīti vidvān udgāyati mahāmanā manasvy asmād ājāyate. } atha yaḥ prāṇo gāyatrīti vidvān udgāyati sarvam āyur eti . atha yo 'smād ājāyate sa sarvam āyur eti . atha yaś cakṣus triṣṭub iti vidvān udgāyaty ahrītamukhī paśyo dṛṣṭyāsmād ājāyate darśanīyaḥ .
sentences: nigʰnad iva ha kʰalu vā etac cʰando yad anuṣṭup .
anuṣṭubʰā vai vācā cʰandasā devā asurān avāco 'vāgʰnan .
tāṃ yad balavad upabdimatīṃ nigʰātaṃ gāyati - bʰrātr̥vyo vai pāpmā - bʰrātr̥vyam etat pāpmānam avācam avahanti śriyam ātmanāśnute .
yad anadʰīyan gāyed ajihvā garbʰā jāyeran .
ajihvā ha vai durudgātur vartanyāṃ garbʰā jāyante .
yad anadʰīyan gāyet sāmi garbʰāḥ pateyuḥ .
sāmi ha vai durudgātur vartanyāṃ garbʰā patanti .
atʰa yad etad uttamaṃ tr̥caṃ janmaiva tat .
mano vai retasyā prāṇo gāyatrī cakṣus triṣṭup śrotraṃ jagatī vāg anuṣṭup .
sa yo mano retasyeti vidvān udgāyati mahāmanā manasvy asmād ājāyate .
{atʰa yaḥ prāṇo gāyatrīti vidvān udgāyati mahāmanā manasvy asmād ājāyate. } atʰa yaḥ prāṇo gāyatrīti vidvān udgāyati sarvam āyur eti .
atʰa yo 'smād ājāyate sa sarvam āyur eti .
atʰa yaś cakṣus triṣṭub iti vidvān udgāyaty ahrītamukʰī paśyo dr̥ṣṭyāsmād ājāyate darśanīyaḥ .
text: He should sing it with force, with rumble, with emphasis. The anuṣṭubh is indeed a meter that strikes. With the anuṣṭubh, with speech as the meter, the gods struck down the asuras. By singing it with force, with rumble, with emphasis -- the hostile rival is indeed evil -- he strikes down the hostile rival, the evil one, and attains prosperity for himself. He should sing it flowing. If he were to sing it not flowing, offspring would be born without tongues. Indeed, offspring are born without tongues in the channel of a bad udgātṛ. He sings a paṅkti. The seasons are the paṅkti. He sings it as an extended gāyatrī. Therefore offspring being born are stretched out. He should sing it flowing. If he were to sing it not flowing, offspring would fall prematurely. Indeed, offspring fall prematurely in the channel of a bad udgātṛ. Now the final tṛca is indeed the birth. With it he generates forth. Mind is the retasyā, prāṇa is the gāyatrī, the eye is the triṣṭubh, the ear is the jagatī, speech is the anuṣṭubh. He who, knowing that mind is the retasyā, sings the udgītha -- a great-minded, mindful one is born from him. He who, knowing that prāṇa is the gāyatrī, sings the udgītha -- he lives a full life. And he who is born from him lives a full life. He who, knowing that the eye is the triṣṭubh, sings the udgītha -- one with an unashamed face, seeing, with good vision, is born from him, one who is handsome.
meaning: तां बलवद् उपब्दिमतीं निघातं गायेत् . निघ्नद् इव ह खलु वा एतच् छन्दो यद् अनुष्टुप् . अनुष्टुभा वै वाचा छन्दसा देवा असुरान् अवाचो ऽवाघ्नन् . तां यद् बलवद् उपब्दिमतीं निघातं गायति - भ्रातृव्यो वै पाप्मा - भ्रातृव्यम् एतत् पाप्मानम् अवाचम् अवहन्ति श्रियम् आत्मनाश्नुते . ताम् अधीयन् गायेत् . यद् अनधीयन् गायेद् अजिह्वा गर्भा जायेरन् . अजिह्वा ह वै दुरुद्गातुर् वर्तन्यां गर्भा जायन्ते . पङ्क्तिम् गायति . ऋतवो वै पङ्क्तिः . तां गायत्रीम् एव प्रसृतां गायति . तस्माद् गर्भा जायमानाः प्रसार्यन्ते . ताम् अधीयन् गायेत् . यद् अनधीयन् गायेत् सामि गर्भाः पतेयुः . सामि ह वै दुरुद्गातुर् वर्तन्यां गर्भा पतन्ति . अथ यद् एतद् उत्तमं तृचं जन्मैव तत् . प्रैव तेन जनयति . मनो वै रेतस्या प्राणो गायत्री चक्षुस् त्रिष्टुप् श्रोत्रं जगती वाग् अनुष्टुप् . स यो मनो रेतस्येति विद्वान् उद्गायति महामना मनस्व्य् अस्माद् आजायते . {अथ यः प्राणो गायत्रीति विद्वान् उद्गायति महामना मनस्व्य् अस्माद् आजायते. } अथ यः प्राणो गायत्रीति विद्वान् उद्गायति सर्वम् आयुर् एति . अथ यो ऽस्माद् आजायते स सर्वम् आयुर् एति . अथ यश् चक्षुस् त्रिष्टुब् इति विद्वान् उद्गायत्य् अह्रीतमुखी पश्यो दृष्ट्यास्माद् आजायते दर्शनीयः .

sanskrit_iast: - sabheyaḥ . evaṃ hy etat kurupañcālā aviduḥ . tasmāt kurupañcāleṣu sarvair vīraiḥ saha vīra ājāyate . atha yarhy etad udantāḥ purā nāvediṣus tasmād udanteṣu purā sarvair vīraiḥ saha vīro nājani . atha yata idam udantān evaṃvidaś ca sacanta evaṃvidaś cainān yājayanti tato hārvācīnam udanteṣu sarvair vīraḥ saha vīra ājāyate . kurupañcālā ha brahmodyam ūdire . te ha pañcālāḥ kurūn papracchuḥ kiṃ vayaṃ tad yajñe 'kurma yenāsmāsu sarvair vīraiḥ saha vīra ājāyata iti . tad dha na pratyūcuḥ . tena hainān jigyuḥ . te yat pratyavakṣyan yasmād vayam evaṃvidaś ca sma evaṃvidaś ca no yājayanti tenāsmāsu sarvair vīraiḥ saha vīra ājāyata iti . sarvair ha vā asmād vīraiḥ saha vīra ājāyate ya evaṃ veda .
sentences: - sabʰeyaḥ . evaṃ hy etat kurupañcālā aviduḥ .
tasmāt kurupañcāleṣu sarvair vīraiḥ saha vīra ājāyate .
atʰa yarhy etad udantāḥ purā nāvediṣus tasmād udanteṣu purā sarvair vīraiḥ saha vīro nājani .
atʰa yata idam udantān evaṃvidaś ca sacanta evaṃvidaś cainān yājayanti tato hārvācīnam udanteṣu sarvair vīraḥ saha vīra ājāyate .
te ha pañcālāḥ kurūn papraccʰuḥ kiṃ vayaṃ tad yajñe 'kurma yenāsmāsu sarvair vīraiḥ saha vīra ājāyata iti .
te yat pratyavakṣyan yasmād vayam evaṃvidaś ca sma evaṃvidaś ca no yājayanti tenāsmāsu sarvair vīraiḥ saha vīra ājāyata iti .
sarvair ha vā asmād vīraiḥ saha vīra ājāyate ya evaṃ veda .
text: Fit for the assembly. For thus the Kuru-Pañcālas knew it. Therefore among the Kuru-Pañcālas, a hero is born together with all heroic qualities. But when the outlying peoples formerly did not know this, therefore among the outlying peoples formerly a hero was not born together with all heroic qualities. But since those who know thus have associated with the outlying peoples and those who know thus perform sacrifices for them, from that time onward among the outlying peoples too a hero is born together with all heroic qualities. The Kuru-Pañcālas engaged in a theological debate. The Pañcālas asked the Kurus: 'What is it that we do in the sacrifice by which a hero is born among us together with all heroic qualities?' They could not answer. By this they were defeated. If they had replied: 'Because those who know thus exist among us, and those who know thus perform sacrifices for us, therefore a hero is born among us together with all heroic qualities' -- a hero is indeed born together with all heroic qualities from him who knows thus.
meaning: - सभेयः . एवं ह्य् एतत् कुरुपञ्चाला अविदुः . तस्मात् कुरुपञ्चालेषु सर्वैर् वीरैः सह वीर आजायते . अथ यर्ह्य् एतद् उदन्ताः पुरा नावेदिषुस् तस्माद् उदन्तेषु पुरा सर्वैर् वीरैः सह वीरो नाजनि . अथ यत इदम् उदन्तान् एवंविदश् च सचन्त एवंविदश् चैनान् याजयन्ति ततो हार्वाचीनम् उदन्तेषु सर्वैर् वीरः सह वीर आजायते . कुरुपञ्चाला ह ब्रह्मोद्यम् ऊदिरे . ते ह पञ्चालाः कुरून् पप्रच्छुः किं वयं तद् यज्ञे ऽकुर्म येनास्मासु सर्वैर् वीरैः सह वीर आजायत इति . तद् ध न प्रत्यूचुः . तेन हैनान् जिग्युः . ते यत् प्रत्यवक्ष्यन् यस्माद् वयम् एवंविदश् च स्म एवंविदश् च नो याजयन्ति तेनास्मासु सर्वैर् वीरैः सह वीर आजायत इति . सर्वैर् ह वा अस्माद् वीरैः सह वीर आजायते य एवं वेद .

sanskrit_iast: kuravaḥ . gāyatraṃ vai prātaḥsavanaṃ traiṣṭubhaṃ mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ jāgataṃ tṛtīyasavanam . tad evānuṣṭub anvāyattā . sa yad gāyatre sati prātaḥsavane gāyatrīṃ gāyati - brahma vai gāyatrī brahma prātaḥsavanaṃ - sva eva tad āyatane brahma dadhāti . atha yat triṣṭubhaṃ gāyati - kṣatraṃ vai triṣṭup . etāni vai kṣatre śilpāni hastī niṣko 'śvatarīratho 'śvaratho rukmaḥ kaṃsaḥ - tāny eva tad āhṛtya brahmaṇy anakti . atha yaj jagatīṃ gāyati - viḍ vai jagatī . etāni vai viśi śilpāni go'śvaṃ hastihiraṇyam ajāvikaṃ vrīhiyavās tilamāṣāḥ sarpiḥ kṣīraṃ rayiḥ puṣṭis - tāny eva tad āhṛtya brahmaṇy anakti . tad evānuṣṭub anvāyattā .
sentences: gāyatraṃ vai prātaḥsavanaṃ traiṣṭubʰaṃ mādʰyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ jāgataṃ tr̥tīyasavanam .
sa yad gāyatre sati prātaḥsavane gāyatrīṃ gāyati - brahma vai gāyatrī brahma prātaḥsavanaṃ - sva eva tad āyatane brahma dadʰāti .
atʰa yat triṣṭubʰaṃ gāyati - kṣatraṃ vai triṣṭup .
etāni vai kṣatre śilpāni hastī niṣko 'śvatarīratʰo 'śvaratʰo rukmaḥ kaṃsaḥ - tāny eva tad āhr̥tya brahmaṇy anakti .
atʰa yaj jagatīṃ gāyati - viḍ vai jagatī .
etāni vai viśi śilpāni go'śvaṃ hastihiraṇyam ajāvikaṃ vrīhiyavās tilamāṣāḥ sarpiḥ kṣīraṃ rayiḥ puṣṭis - tāny eva tad āhr̥tya brahmaṇy anakti .
text: The Kurus. The morning pressing is gāyatra, the midday pressing is traiṣṭubha, the third pressing is jāgata. The anuṣṭubh is connected with them all. When, at the morning pressing being gāyatra, he sings a gāyatrī -- brahman is the gāyatrī, brahman is the morning pressing -- he places the brahman in its own seat. When he sings a triṣṭubh -- kṣatra is the triṣṭubh; these are the ornaments of the kṣatra: the elephant, the gold necklace, the mule-chariot, the horse-chariot, the gold plate, the bronze vessel -- he gathers these and anoints the brahman with them. When he sings a jagatī -- the viś is the jagatī; these are the ornaments of the commoners: cattle and horses, elephants and gold, goats and sheep, rice and barley, sesame and beans, ghee, milk, wealth, nourishment -- he gathers these and anoints the brahman with them. The anuṣṭubh is connected with them all.
meaning: कुरवः . गायत्रं वै प्रातःसवनं त्रैष्टुभं माध्यंदिनं सवनं जागतं तृतीयसवनम् . तद् एवानुष्टुब् अन्वायत्ता . स यद् गायत्रे सति प्रातःसवने गायत्रीं गायति - ब्रह्म वै गायत्री ब्रह्म प्रातःसवनं - स्व एव तद् आयतने ब्रह्म दधाति . अथ यत् त्रिष्टुभं गायति - क्षत्रं वै त्रिष्टुप् . एतानि वै क्षत्रे शिल्पानि हस्ती निष्को ऽश्वतरीरथो ऽश्वरथो रुक्मः कंसः - तान्य् एव तद् आहृत्य ब्रह्मण्य् अनक्ति . अथ यज् जगतीं गायति - विड् वै जगती . एतानि वै विशि शिल्पानि गोऽश्वं हस्तिहिरण्यम् अजाविकं व्रीहियवास् तिलमाषाः सर्पिः क्षीरं रयिः पुष्टिस् - तान्य् एव तद् आहृत्य ब्रह्मण्य् अनक्ति . तद् एवानुष्टुब् अन्वायत्ता .

sanskrit_iast: tad yathā tūṣṇīṃ kaśanair (Bodewitz : tūṇiṃ kaṣaṇair) vihanyād evam evaitāni sarvāṇi śilpāny āhṛtya brahmaṇy anakti . tasmād vigeyā iti . yato ha vā idam etā vigīyante tato hedaṃ brāhmaṇā jīyante . atha yarhi etā na vijagur annādyā ha brāhmaṇā āsuḥ . ekāpaccādevā harvāśata ekaśakaṭe vaśe hasmad amathitvā satyayajñaḥ pauluṣir yāti( ?). atha yata idam etā vigīyante tato haitāni śilpāni brāhmaṇeṣv adhigamyante . gāyatrīṃ purastād gāyati gāyatrīm upariṣṭāt . brahma vai gāyatrī . brahmaṇaiva tad etāny ubhayataś śilpāni parigṛhṇāti . brahmaṇā hainam etāny ubhayataś śilpāni parigṛhītāny upatiṣṭhante ya evaṃ veda . na vigeyā ity āhuḥ pañcālāḥ . svayaṃ vigītā vā etā yad dhuraḥ . anusavanaṃ vā etā vigāyann abhyārohati . atha yad enān pāpī kīrttir anūttiṣṭhati vyagāsiṣur iti .
sentences: tad yatʰā tūṣṇīṃ kaśanair (Bodewitz : tūṇiṃ kaṣaṇair) vihanyād evam evaitāni sarvāṇi śilpāny āhr̥tya brahmaṇy anakti .
yato ha vā idam etā vigīyante tato hedaṃ brāhmaṇā jīyante .
atʰa yarhi etā na vijagur annādyā ha brāhmaṇā āsuḥ .
ekāpaccādevā harvāśata ekaśakaṭe vaśe hasmad amatʰitvā satyayajñaḥ pauluṣir yāti( ?).
atʰa yata idam etā vigīyante tato haitāni śilpāni brāhmaṇeṣv adʰigamyante .
brahmaṇaiva tad etāny ubʰayataś śilpāni parigr̥hṇāti .
brahmaṇā hainam etāny ubʰayataś śilpāni parigr̥hītāny upatiṣṭʰante ya evaṃ veda .
svayaṃ vigītā vā etā yad dʰuraḥ .
atʰa yad enān pāpī kīrttir anūttiṣṭʰati vyagāsiṣur iti .
text: Just as one would beat a quiver with arrows, so he gathers all these ornaments and anoints the brahman with them. Therefore they are to be sung apart. For from the time these are sung apart, the brāhmaṇas are being conquered. But when these were not sung apart, the brāhmaṇas were food-eaters. Dwelling in one-village settlements, Satyayajña Pauluṣi used to go about having churned from a single cart, as it were. But from the time these are sung apart, these ornaments are found among the brāhmaṇas. He sings a gāyatrī at the beginning and a gāyatrī at the end. Brahman is the gāyatrī. With brahman he encompasses all these ornaments on both sides. These ornaments, encompassed by brahman on both sides, attend upon him who knows thus. 'They should not be sung apart,' say the Pañcālas. 'These are self-separated, being the yoke-pieces. Pressing by pressing one ascends by singing them apart. But the bad reputation follows them -- they have sung apart!'
meaning: तद् यथा तूष्णीं कशनैर् (Bओदेwइत्z : तूणिं कषणैर्) विहन्याद् एवम् एवैतानि सर्वाणि शिल्पान्य् आहृत्य ब्रह्मण्य् अनक्ति . तस्माद् विगेया इति . यतो ह वा इदम् एता विगीयन्ते ततो हेदं ब्राह्मणा जीयन्ते . अथ यर्हि एता न विजगुर् अन्नाद्या ह ब्राह्मणा आसुः . एकापच्चादेवा हर्वाशत एकशकटे वशे हस्मद् अमथित्वा सत्ययज्ञः पौलुषिर् याति( ?). अथ यत इदम् एता विगीयन्ते ततो हैतानि शिल्पानि ब्राह्मणेष्व् अधिगम्यन्ते . गायत्रीं पुरस्ताद् गायति गायत्रीम् उपरिष्टात् . ब्रह्म वै गायत्री . ब्रह्मणैव तद् एतान्य् उभयतश् शिल्पानि परिगृह्णाति . ब्रह्मणा हैनम् एतान्य् उभयतश् शिल्पानि परिगृहीतान्य् उपतिष्ठन्ते य एवं वेद . न विगेया इत्य् आहुः पञ्चालाः . स्वयं विगीता वा एता यद् धुरः . अनुसवनं वा एता विगायन्न् अभ्यारोहति . अथ यद् एनान् पापी कीर्त्तिर् अनूत्तिष्ठति व्यगासिषुर् इति .

sanskrit_iast: tiṣṭhata iti . gāyatraṃ vai prātaḥsavanaṃ traiṣṭubhaṃ mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ jāgataṃ tṛtīyasavanam . tad evānuṣṭup anvāyattā . sa yad gāyatre sati prātaḥsavane gāyatrīṃ gāyati - brahma vai gāyatrī - brahmaiva tad brāhmaṇasya sve 'nvābhajati . so 'syāditsata upajihīrṣate . atho asyaiva tat . sve 'nu hy enam ābhajati . atha yat triṣṭubhaṃ gāyati - kṣatraṃ vai triṣṭup - kṣatriyam eva tad brāhmaṇasya sve 'nvābhajati . so 'syāditsata upajihīrṣate . atho asyaiva tat . sve 'nu hy enam ābhajati . atha yaj jagatīṃ gāyati - viḍ vai jagatī - vaiśyam eva tad brāhmaṇasya sve 'nvābhajati . so 'syāditsata upajihīrṣate . atho asyaiva tat . sve 'nu hy enam ābhajati . tad evānuṣṭup anvāyattā . atha yad anuṣṭubhaṃ gāyati - ānuṣṭubho vai śūdraḥ - śūdram eva tad brāhmaṇasya sve 'nvābhajati . so 'syāditsata upajihīrṣate . atho asyaiva tat . sve 'nu hy enam ābhajati . yady āvir nātho pākenaiva lipsate . tasmān na vigeyā iti . yato ha vā idam etā vigīyante tato hedaṃ brāhmaṇā jīyante .
sentences: gāyatraṃ vai prātaḥsavanaṃ traiṣṭubʰaṃ mādʰyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ jāgataṃ tr̥tīyasavanam .
sa yad gāyatre sati prātaḥsavane gāyatrīṃ gāyati - brahma vai gāyatrī - brahmaiva tad brāhmaṇasya sve 'nvābʰajati .
atʰa yat triṣṭubʰaṃ gāyati - kṣatraṃ vai triṣṭup - kṣatriyam eva tad brāhmaṇasya sve 'nvābʰajati .
atʰa yaj jagatīṃ gāyati - viḍ vai jagatī - vaiśyam eva tad brāhmaṇasya sve 'nvābʰajati .
atʰa yad anuṣṭubʰaṃ gāyati - ānuṣṭubʰo vai śūdraḥ - śūdram eva tad brāhmaṇasya sve 'nvābʰajati .
yato ha vā idam etā vigīyante tato hedaṃ brāhmaṇā jīyante .
text: 'Let them stand,' they say. The morning pressing is gāyatra, the midday pressing is traiṣṭubha, the third pressing is jāgata. The anuṣṭubh is connected with them all. When, at the morning pressing being gāyatra, he sings a gāyatrī -- brahman is the gāyatrī -- he gives the brāhmaṇa a share in his own domain, the brahman. That one desires to take it from him. But it is his own, for he gives him a share in his own domain. When he sings a triṣṭubh -- kṣatra is the triṣṭubh -- he gives the kṣatriya a share in the brāhmaṇa's own domain. That one desires to take it from him. But it is his own, for he gives him a share in his own domain. When he sings a jagatī -- the viś is the jagatī -- he gives the vaiśya a share in the brāhmaṇa's own domain. That one desires to take it from him. But it is his own, for he gives him a share in his own domain. The anuṣṭubh is connected with them all. When he sings an anuṣṭubh -- the śūdra belongs to the anuṣṭubh -- he gives the śūdra a share in the brāhmaṇa's own domain. That one desires to take it from him. But it is his own, for he gives him a share in his own domain. If there is no visible protector, one seeks to obtain by simplicity alone. Therefore they should not be sung apart. For from the time these are sung apart, the brāhmaṇas are being conquered.
meaning: तिष्ठत इति . गायत्रं वै प्रातःसवनं त्रैष्टुभं माध्यंदिनं सवनं जागतं तृतीयसवनम् . तद् एवानुष्टुप् अन्वायत्ता . स यद् गायत्रे सति प्रातःसवने गायत्रीं गायति - ब्रह्म वै गायत्री - ब्रह्मैव तद् ब्राह्मणस्य स्वे ऽन्वाभजति . सो ऽस्यादित्सत उपजिहीर्षते . अथो अस्यैव तत् . स्वे ऽनु ह्य् एनम् आभजति . अथ यत् त्रिष्टुभं गायति - क्षत्रं वै त्रिष्टुप् - क्षत्रियम् एव तद् ब्राह्मणस्य स्वे ऽन्वाभजति . सो ऽस्यादित्सत उपजिहीर्षते . अथो अस्यैव तत् . स्वे ऽनु ह्य् एनम् आभजति . अथ यज् जगतीं गायति - विड् वै जगती - वैश्यम् एव तद् ब्राह्मणस्य स्वे ऽन्वाभजति . सो ऽस्यादित्सत उपजिहीर्षते . अथो अस्यैव तत् . स्वे ऽनु ह्य् एनम् आभजति . तद् एवानुष्टुप् अन्वायत्ता . अथ यद् अनुष्टुभं गायति - आनुष्टुभो वै शूद्रः - शूद्रम् एव तद् ब्राह्मणस्य स्वे ऽन्वाभजति . सो ऽस्यादित्सत उपजिहीर्षते . अथो अस्यैव तत् . स्वे ऽनु ह्य् एनम् आभजति . यद्य् आविर् नाथो पाकेनैव लिप्सते . तस्मान् न विगेया इति . यतो ह वा इदम् एता विगीयन्ते ततो हेदं ब्राह्मणा जीयन्ते .

sanskrit_iast: gāyatraṃ vai prātaḥsavanaṃ traiṣṭubhaṃ mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ jāgataṃ tṛtīyasavanam . tad evānuṣṭup anvāyattā . sa yad gāyatraṃ sat prātaḥsavanaṃ sarvam eva gāyatraṃ gāyati brahmaṇa eva taṃ kevalam uddhāram uddharati . so 'sya brahmaṇaḥ kevala uddhāra uddhṛto bhavati . atha yat traiṣṭubhaṃ san mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ gāyatreṇaivānupratipadyate brāhmaṇam eva tat kṣatriyasya sve 'nvābhajati . so 'smai ditsati śraddhayā karmaṇopacāreṇa . yadā vai kṣatriyaṃ śraddhā vindati brāhmaṇam vāva sa tarhīcchati . so 'smai dadāti . atha yaj jāgataṃ sat tṛtīyasavanaṃ gāyatreṇaivānupratipadyate brāhmaṇam eva tat vaiśyasya sve 'nvābhajati . so 'smai ditsati śraddhayā karmaṇopacāreṇa . yadā vai vaiśyaṃ śraddhā vindati brāhmaṇam vāva sa tarhīcchati . so 'smai dadāti . tad evānuṣṭub anvāyattā . atha yad anuṣṭubhaṃ gāyati - ānuṣṭubho vai śūdraḥ - brāhmaṇam eva tac chūdrasya sve 'nvābhajati . so 'smai ditsati śraddhayā karmaṇopacāreṇa . yadā vai śūdraṃ śraddhā vindati brāhmaṇam vāva sa tarhīcchati . so 'smai dadāti . kevalaṃ svaṃ kurute 'pitvī kṣatre bhavaty apitvī viśi . yāty antaḥsthāṃ nāntaḥsthāyāṃ jīyate . upa hainaṃ śataṃ pariskandās tiṣṭhante 'tho bhūyāṃso ya evaṃ vidvān dhuro na vigāyatīti . sa yadi vigāyed ado vidvān vigāyet . yady u na vigāyed idaṃ vidvān na vigāyet .
sentences: gāyatraṃ vai prātaḥsavanaṃ traiṣṭubʰaṃ mādʰyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ jāgataṃ tr̥tīyasavanam .
sa yad gāyatraṃ sat prātaḥsavanaṃ sarvam eva gāyatraṃ gāyati brahmaṇa eva taṃ kevalam uddʰāram uddʰarati .
so 'sya brahmaṇaḥ kevala uddʰāra uddʰr̥to bʰavati .
atʰa yat traiṣṭubʰaṃ san mādʰyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ gāyatreṇaivānupratipadyate brāhmaṇam eva tat kṣatriyasya sve 'nvābʰajati .
yadā vai kṣatriyaṃ śraddʰā vindati brāhmaṇam vāva sa tarhīccʰati .
atʰa yaj jāgataṃ sat tr̥tīyasavanaṃ gāyatreṇaivānupratipadyate brāhmaṇam eva tat vaiśyasya sve 'nvābʰajati .
yadā vai vaiśyaṃ śraddʰā vindati brāhmaṇam vāva sa tarhīccʰati .
atʰa yad anuṣṭubʰaṃ gāyati - ānuṣṭubʰo vai śūdraḥ - brāhmaṇam eva tac cʰūdrasya sve 'nvābʰajati .
yadā vai śūdraṃ śraddʰā vindati brāhmaṇam vāva sa tarhīccʰati .
kevalaṃ svaṃ kurute 'pitvī kṣatre bʰavaty apitvī viśi .
upa hainaṃ śataṃ pariskandās tiṣṭʰante 'tʰo bʰūyāṃso ya evaṃ vidvān dʰuro na vigāyatīti .
sa yadi vigāyed ado vidvān vigāyet .
yady u na vigāyed idaṃ vidvān na vigāyet .
text: The morning pressing is gāyatra, the midday pressing is traiṣṭubha, the third pressing is jāgata. The anuṣṭubh is connected with them all. When, the morning pressing being gāyatra, he sings everything as gāyatra, he draws out a pure portion of the brahman alone. That pure portion of the brahman is drawn out for him. When the midday pressing being traiṣṭubha, he approaches it with the gāyatra, he gives the brāhmaṇa a share in the kṣatriya's own domain. That one wishes to give to him, out of faith, by service and attention. For when faith seizes a kṣatriya, it is a brāhmaṇa he then desires. He gives to him. When the third pressing being jāgata, he approaches it with the gāyatra, he gives the brāhmaṇa a share in the vaiśya's own domain. That one wishes to give to him, out of faith, by service and attention. For when faith seizes a vaiśya, it is a brāhmaṇa he then desires. He gives to him. The anuṣṭubh is connected with them all. When he sings an anuṣṭubh -- the śūdra belongs to the anuṣṭubh -- he gives the brāhmaṇa a share in the śūdra's own domain. That one wishes to give to him, out of faith, by service and attention. For when faith seizes a śūdra, it is a brāhmaṇa he then desires. He gives to him. He makes his own complete; he has a share in the kṣatra; he has a share in the viś. He goes to the intermediate position and is not defeated in the intermediate position. A hundred attendants stand around him, and even more, for one who, knowing thus, does not sing the yoke-pieces apart. If he should sing apart, he should do so knowing one thing. If he should not sing apart, he should not do so knowing the other.
meaning: गायत्रं वै प्रातःसवनं त्रैष्टुभं माध्यंदिनं सवनं जागतं तृतीयसवनम् . तद् एवानुष्टुप् अन्वायत्ता . स यद् गायत्रं सत् प्रातःसवनं सर्वम् एव गायत्रं गायति ब्रह्मण एव तं केवलम् उद्धारम् उद्धरति . सो ऽस्य ब्रह्मणः केवल उद्धार उद्धृतो भवति . अथ यत् त्रैष्टुभं सन् माध्यंदिनं सवनं गायत्रेणैवानुप्रतिपद्यते ब्राह्मणम् एव तत् क्षत्रियस्य स्वे ऽन्वाभजति . सो ऽस्मै दित्सति श्रद्धया कर्मणोपचारेण . यदा वै क्षत्रियं श्रद्धा विन्दति ब्राह्मणम् वाव स तर्हीच्छति . सो ऽस्मै ददाति . अथ यज् जागतं सत् तृतीयसवनं गायत्रेणैवानुप्रतिपद्यते ब्राह्मणम् एव तत् वैश्यस्य स्वे ऽन्वाभजति . सो ऽस्मै दित्सति श्रद्धया कर्मणोपचारेण . यदा वै वैश्यं श्रद्धा विन्दति ब्राह्मणम् वाव स तर्हीच्छति . सो ऽस्मै ददाति . तद् एवानुष्टुब् अन्वायत्ता . अथ यद् अनुष्टुभं गायति - आनुष्टुभो वै शूद्रः - ब्राह्मणम् एव तच् छूद्रस्य स्वे ऽन्वाभजति . सो ऽस्मै दित्सति श्रद्धया कर्मणोपचारेण . यदा वै शूद्रं श्रद्धा विन्दति ब्राह्मणम् वाव स तर्हीच्छति . सो ऽस्मै ददाति . केवलं स्वं कुरुते ऽपित्वी क्षत्रे भवत्य् अपित्वी विशि . यात्य् अन्तःस्थां नान्तःस्थायां जीयते . उप हैनं शतं परिस्कन्दास् तिष्ठन्ते ऽथो भूयांसो य एवं विद्वान् धुरो न विगायतीति . स यदि विगायेद् अदो विद्वान् विगायेत् . यद्य् उ न विगायेद् इदं विद्वान् न विगायेत् .

sanskrit_iast: retasyāṃ gāyati . retas tat siñcati . tad retaḥ siktaṃ gāyatryodvardhayati varṣīyasā chandasā . tat triṣṭubhodvardhayati varṣīyasā chandasā . taj jagatyodvardhayati varṣīyasaiva chandasā . tad yad varṣīyasā varṣīyasā chandasodvardhayati tasmād vardhamānasya bhūyo bhūyo vīryaṃ bhavati . anuṣṭubhā niṣṭhaṃ gacchati hrasīyasaiva chandasā . tasmād uttaravayase pratitarām ivāvavardhate . paṅktyā niṣṭhāṃ gacchati . tasmāt pañcame māsi garbhā vikriyante . anuṣṭubhā vācā niṣṭhāṃ gacchati . tasmād u jīrṇasya vācaṃ śuśrūṣante . śiro vā etad yajñasya yad bahiṣpavamānam . tad vai tat .
sentences: tad retaḥ siktaṃ gāyatryodvardʰayati varṣīyasā cʰandasā .
tad yad varṣīyasā varṣīyasā cʰandasodvardʰayati tasmād vardʰamānasya bʰūyo bʰūyo vīryaṃ bʰavati .
śiro vā etad yajñasya yad bahiṣpavamānam .
text: He sings the retasyā. That pours the semen. That semen, once poured, he raises up with the gāyatrī, with a larger meter. He raises it up with the triṣṭubh, with a larger meter. He raises it up with the jagatī, with a larger meter still. Because he raises it up with progressively larger meters, therefore as one grows, one's vigor increases more and more. With the anuṣṭubh he brings it to completion, with a smaller meter. Therefore in later age one diminishes progressively, as it were. With the paṅkti he brings it to completion. Therefore in the fifth month embryos undergo transformation. With the anuṣṭubh, with speech, he brings it to completion. Therefore even of an old person they listen to the speech. The head of the sacrifice is the bahiṣpavamāna. That is it.
meaning: रेतस्यां गायति . रेतस् तत् सिञ्चति . तद् रेतः सिक्तं गायत्र्योद्वर्धयति वर्षीयसा छन्दसा . तत् त्रिष्टुभोद्वर्धयति वर्षीयसा छन्दसा . तज् जगत्योद्वर्धयति वर्षीयसैव छन्दसा . तद् यद् वर्षीयसा वर्षीयसा छन्दसोद्वर्धयति तस्माद् वर्धमानस्य भूयो भूयो वीर्यं भवति . अनुष्टुभा निष्ठं गच्छति ह्रसीयसैव छन्दसा . तस्माद् उत्तरवयसे प्रतितराम् इवाववर्धते . पङ्क्त्या निष्ठां गच्छति . तस्मात् पञ्चमे मासि गर्भा विक्रियन्ते . अनुष्टुभा वाचा निष्ठां गच्छति . तस्माद् उ जीर्णस्य वाचं शुश्रूषन्ते . शिरो वा एतद् यज्ञस्य यद् बहिष्पवमानम् . तद् वै तत् .

sanskrit_iast: - gāyatrīṃ gāyati . prāṇo vai gāyatraḥ . gāyatraṃ śira eva . tadāyatano vai prāṇo yac chiraḥ . sva eva tadāyatane prāṇaṃ dadhāti . triṣṭubhaṃ gāyati . cakṣur vai triṣṭup . tām eva tad āhṛtya śīrṣan niyunakti . yan niyunakti tasmān niyuktam iva cakṣuḥ . tām anyatrāyatanāṃ satīṃ niyunakti . tasmād uta jīvata eva cakṣur apakrāmati . jagatīṃ gāyati . śrotraṃ vai jagatī . tām eva tad āhṛtya śīrṣan niyunakti . yan niyunakti tasmān niyuktam iva śrotraṃ . tām anyatrāyatanāṃ satīṃ niyunakti tṛtīyasavanāyatanām . tāṃ yad anyatrāyatanāṃ satīṃ niyunakti tasmād uta jīvata eva śrotram apakrāmati . anuṣṭubhaṃ gāyati . vāg vā anuṣṭup . tām eva tad āhṛtya śīrṣan niyunakti . yan niyunakti tasmān niyukteva vāk . tām anyatrāyatanāṃ satīṃ niyunakti tṛtīyasavanāyatanāṃ vā sarvāyatanāṃ vā . tāṃ yad anyatrāyatanāṃ satīṃ niyunakti tasmād uta jīvata eva vāg apakrāmati .
sentences: tām eva tad āhr̥tya śīrṣan niyunakti .
yan niyunakti tasmān niyuktam iva cakṣuḥ .
tasmād uta jīvata eva cakṣur apakrāmati .
tām eva tad āhr̥tya śīrṣan niyunakti .
yan niyunakti tasmān niyuktam iva śrotraṃ .
tāṃ yad anyatrāyatanāṃ satīṃ niyunakti tasmād uta jīvata eva śrotram apakrāmati .
tām eva tad āhr̥tya śīrṣan niyunakti .
tām anyatrāyatanāṃ satīṃ niyunakti tr̥tīyasavanāyatanāṃ vā sarvāyatanāṃ vā .
tāṃ yad anyatrāyatanāṃ satīṃ niyunakti tasmād uta jīvata eva vāg apakrāmati .
text: He sings a gāyatrī. Prāṇa is the gāyatra. The gāyatra is the head. Prāṇa has its seat in the head. He places the prāṇa in its own seat. He sings a triṣṭubh. The eye is the triṣṭubh. He brings it and yokes it to the head. Because he yokes it, the eye is as if yoked. He yokes it being from another seat. Therefore even during life the eye departs. He sings a jagatī. The ear is the jagatī. He brings it and yokes it to the head. Because he yokes it, the ear is as if yoked. He yokes it being from another seat, from the seat of the third pressing. Because he yokes it being from another seat, therefore even during life the ear departs. He sings an anuṣṭubh. Speech is the anuṣṭubh. He brings it and yokes it to the head. Because he yokes it, speech is as if yoked. He yokes it being from another seat, from the seat of the third pressing or from every seat. Because he yokes it being from another seat, therefore even during life speech departs.
meaning: - गायत्रीं गायति . प्राणो वै गायत्रः . गायत्रं शिर एव . तदायतनो वै प्राणो यच् छिरः . स्व एव तदायतने प्राणं दधाति . त्रिष्टुभं गायति . चक्षुर् वै त्रिष्टुप् . ताम् एव तद् आहृत्य शीर्षन् नियुनक्ति . यन् नियुनक्ति तस्मान् नियुक्तम् इव चक्षुः . ताम् अन्यत्रायतनां सतीं नियुनक्ति . तस्माद् उत जीवत एव चक्षुर् अपक्रामति . जगतीं गायति . श्रोत्रं वै जगती . ताम् एव तद् आहृत्य शीर्षन् नियुनक्ति . यन् नियुनक्ति तस्मान् नियुक्तम् इव श्रोत्रं . ताम् अन्यत्रायतनां सतीं नियुनक्ति तृतीयसवनायतनाम् . तां यद् अन्यत्रायतनां सतीं नियुनक्ति तस्माद् उत जीवत एव श्रोत्रम् अपक्रामति . अनुष्टुभं गायति . वाग् वा अनुष्टुप् . ताम् एव तद् आहृत्य शीर्षन् नियुनक्ति . यन् नियुनक्ति तस्मान् नियुक्तेव वाक् . ताम् अन्यत्रायतनां सतीं नियुनक्ति तृतीयसवनायतनां वा सर्वायतनां वा . तां यद् अन्यत्रायतनां सतीं नियुनक्ति तस्माद् उत जीवत एव वाग् अपक्रामति .

sanskrit_iast: tad āhuḥ kiṃ tad yajñe kriyate yasmāj jīvata evānye prāṇā apakrāmanti na prāṇa iti . sa brūyād yasmāt sva āyatane gāyatrīṃ gāyati tasmād yāvaj jīvati tāvat prāṇo nāpakrāmatīti . atha ha vai dhurāṃ vijñāś ca saṃjñāś ca . mano vai retasyā prāṇo gāyatrī cakṣus triṣṭup śrotraṃ jagatī vāg anuṣṭup . manasā suhārdasaṃ ca durhārdasaṃ ca vijānāti . prāṇena surabhi cāsurabhi ca vijānāti . cakṣuṣā darśanīyaṃ cādarśanīyaṃ ca vijānāti . śrotreṇa śravaṇīyaṃ cāśravaṇīyaṃ ca vijānāti . vācā svādu cāsvādu ca vijānāti . etā iha vijñāḥ . vi ha vai jñāyate śreyān bhavati ya evaṃ veda . tā u eva saṃjñāḥ .
sentences: tad āhuḥ kiṃ tad yajñe kriyate yasmāj jīvata evānye prāṇā apakrāmanti na prāṇa iti .
sa brūyād yasmāt sva āyatane gāyatrīṃ gāyati tasmād yāvaj jīvati tāvat prāṇo nāpakrāmatīti .
atʰa ha vai dʰurāṃ vijñāś ca saṃjñāś ca .
mano vai retasyā prāṇo gāyatrī cakṣus triṣṭup śrotraṃ jagatī vāg anuṣṭup .
manasā suhārdasaṃ ca durhārdasaṃ ca vijānāti .
vi ha vai jñāyate śreyān bʰavati ya evaṃ veda .
text: On this they say: 'What is it that is done in the sacrifice by which other vital breaths depart even during life, but not prāṇa?' One should say: 'Because he sings the gāyatrī in its own seat, therefore as long as one lives, prāṇa does not depart.' Now the yoke-pieces have both distinguishings and identifyings. Mind is the retasyā, prāṇa is the gāyatrī, the eye is the triṣṭubh, the ear is the jagatī, speech is the anuṣṭubh. With the mind one distinguishes the well-disposed and the ill-disposed. With the prāṇa one distinguishes the fragrant and the non-fragrant. With the eye one distinguishes the handsome and the ugly. With the ear one distinguishes the pleasant to hear and the unpleasant to hear. With speech one distinguishes the sweet and the unsweet. These are the distinguishings here. He who knows thus becomes distinguished, becomes superior. These same are also the identifyings.
meaning: तद् आहुः किं तद् यज्ञे क्रियते यस्माज् जीवत एवान्ये प्राणा अपक्रामन्ति न प्राण इति . स ब्रूयाद् यस्मात् स्व आयतने गायत्रीं गायति तस्माद् यावज् जीवति तावत् प्राणो नापक्रामतीति . अथ ह वै धुरां विज्ञाश् च संज्ञाश् च . मनो वै रेतस्या प्राणो गायत्री चक्षुस् त्रिष्टुप् श्रोत्रं जगती वाग् अनुष्टुप् . मनसा सुहार्दसं च दुर्हार्दसं च विजानाति . प्राणेन सुरभि चासुरभि च विजानाति . चक्षुषा दर्शनीयं चादर्शनीयं च विजानाति . श्रोत्रेण श्रवणीयं चाश्रवणीयं च विजानाति . वाचा स्वादु चास्वादु च विजानाति . एता इह विज्ञाः . वि ह वै ज्ञायते श्रेयान् भवति य एवं वेद . ता उ एव संज्ञाः .

sanskrit_iast: tasya manasā mano dhyāyet . gāyatryāṃ prastutāyāṃ yasya kāmayeta tasya prāṇena prāṇaṃ dhyāyet . triṣṭubhi prastutāyāṃ yasya kāmayeta tasya cakṣuṣā cakṣur dhyāyet . jagatyāṃ prastutāyāṃ yasya kāmayeta tasya śrotreṇa śrotraṃ dhyāyet . anuṣṭubhi prastutāyāṃ yasya kāmayeta tasya vācā vācaṃ dhyāyet . etā u ha saṃjñāḥ . saṃ ha vai tena jānīte yena kāmayate 'nena saṃjānīyeti ya evaṃ veda . athaitā devadhuraś ca manuṣyadhuraś ca saṃdadhāti . mano vai manuṣyadhūr āpo devadhūḥ . retasyāyāṃ prastutāyāṃ manasāpaḥ saṃdadhyāt . tad antarā yajamānasya mano 'vayātayet . prāṇo vai manuṣyadhūr vāyur devadhūḥ . gāyatryāṃ prastutāyāṃ prāṇena vāyuṃ saṃdadhyāt . tad antarā yajamānasya prāṇam avayātayet . cakṣur vai manuṣyadhūr ādityo devadhūḥ . triṣṭubhi prastutāyāṃ cakṣuṣādityam saṃdadhyāt . tad antarā yajamānasya cakṣur avayātayet . śrotraṃ vai manuṣyadhūr diśo devadhūḥ . jagatyāṃ prastutāyāṃ śrotreṇa diśaḥ saṃdadhyāt . tad antarā yajamānasya śrotram avayātayet . vāg vai manuṣyadhūr pṛthivī devadhūḥ . anuṣṭubhi prastutāyāṃ vācā pṛthivīṃ saṃdadhyāt . tad antarā yajamānasya vācam avayātayet . etad vai devadhuraś ca manuṣyadhuraś ca saṃdadhāte . tad vai devadhuraś ca manuṣyadhuraś ca saṃdhāya taṃ mṛtyuṃ tarati yaḥ svargaloke . na haivaṃvit punar mriyate .
sentences: gāyatryāṃ prastutāyāṃ yasya kāmayeta tasya prāṇena prāṇaṃ dʰyāyet .
triṣṭubʰi prastutāyāṃ yasya kāmayeta tasya cakṣuṣā cakṣur dʰyāyet .
jagatyāṃ prastutāyāṃ yasya kāmayeta tasya śrotreṇa śrotraṃ dʰyāyet .
anuṣṭubʰi prastutāyāṃ yasya kāmayeta tasya vācā vācaṃ dʰyāyet .
saṃ ha vai tena jānīte yena kāmayate 'nena saṃjānīyeti ya evaṃ veda .
atʰaitā devadʰuraś ca manuṣyadʰuraś ca saṃdadʰāti .
etad vai devadʰuraś ca manuṣyadʰuraś ca saṃdadʰāte .
tad vai devadʰuraś ca manuṣyadʰuraś ca saṃdʰāya taṃ mr̥tyuṃ tarati yaḥ svargaloke .
text: With his mind one should meditate upon the mind. When the gāyatrī is being chanted, one should meditate upon the prāṇa of whomever one desires with one's own prāṇa. When the triṣṭubh is being chanted, one should meditate upon the eye of whomever one desires with one's own eye. When the jagatī is being chanted, one should meditate upon the ear of whomever one desires with one's own ear. When the anuṣṭubh is being chanted, one should meditate upon the speech of whomever one desires with one's own speech. These are the identifyings. He who knows thus identifies with whomever he desires -- 'Let me identify with this one by this means.' Now he joins together these divine and human yoke-pieces. Mind is the human yoke; the waters are the divine yoke. When the retasyā is being chanted, one should join the mind with the waters. Meanwhile one should direct the yajamāna's mind. Prāṇa is the human yoke; Vāyu is the divine yoke. When the gāyatrī is being chanted, one should join prāṇa with Vāyu. Meanwhile one should direct the yajamāna's prāṇa. The eye is the human yoke; Āditya is the divine yoke. When the triṣṭubh is being chanted, one should join the eye with Āditya. Meanwhile one should direct the yajamāna's eye. The ear is the human yoke; the quarters are the divine yoke. When the jagatī is being chanted, one should join the ear with the quarters. Meanwhile one should direct the yajamāna's ear. Speech is the human yoke; the earth is the divine yoke. When the anuṣṭubh is being chanted, one should join speech with the earth. Meanwhile one should direct the yajamāna's speech. This is how the divine and human yoke-pieces are joined together. Having joined the divine and human yoke-pieces, one crosses beyond that death which is in the heavenly world. He who knows thus does not die again.
meaning: तस्य मनसा मनो ध्यायेत् . गायत्र्यां प्रस्तुतायां यस्य कामयेत तस्य प्राणेन प्राणं ध्यायेत् . त्रिष्टुभि प्रस्तुतायां यस्य कामयेत तस्य चक्षुषा चक्षुर् ध्यायेत् . जगत्यां प्रस्तुतायां यस्य कामयेत तस्य श्रोत्रेण श्रोत्रं ध्यायेत् . अनुष्टुभि प्रस्तुतायां यस्य कामयेत तस्य वाचा वाचं ध्यायेत् . एता उ ह संज्ञाः . सं ह वै तेन जानीते येन कामयते ऽनेन संजानीयेति य एवं वेद . अथैता देवधुरश् च मनुष्यधुरश् च संदधाति . मनो वै मनुष्यधूर् आपो देवधूः . रेतस्यायां प्रस्तुतायां मनसापः संदध्यात् . तद् अन्तरा यजमानस्य मनो ऽवयातयेत् . प्राणो वै मनुष्यधूर् वायुर् देवधूः . गायत्र्यां प्रस्तुतायां प्राणेन वायुं संदध्यात् . तद् अन्तरा यजमानस्य प्राणम् अवयातयेत् . चक्षुर् वै मनुष्यधूर् आदित्यो देवधूः . त्रिष्टुभि प्रस्तुतायां चक्षुषादित्यम् संदध्यात् . तद् अन्तरा यजमानस्य चक्षुर् अवयातयेत् . श्रोत्रं वै मनुष्यधूर् दिशो देवधूः . जगत्यां प्रस्तुतायां श्रोत्रेण दिशः संदध्यात् . तद् अन्तरा यजमानस्य श्रोत्रम् अवयातयेत् . वाग् वै मनुष्यधूर् पृथिवी देवधूः . अनुष्टुभि प्रस्तुतायां वाचा पृथिवीं संदध्यात् . तद् अन्तरा यजमानस्य वाचम् अवयातयेत् . एतद् वै देवधुरश् च मनुष्यधुरश् च संदधाते . तद् वै देवधुरश् च मनुष्यधुरश् च संधाय तं मृत्युं तरति यः स्वर्गलोके . न हैवंवित् पुनर् म्रियते .

sanskrit_iast: athaiteṣāṃ mahatāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ samuditam āruṇer jīvalasya kārīrāder aṣāḍhasya sāvayasyendradyumnasya bhāllaveyasyeti . jīvalaś ca ha kārīrādir indradyumnaś ca bhāllaveyas tau hāruṇer ācāryasya sabhāgāv ājagmatuḥ . te hāṣāḍhasya gṛheṣu śiśyire . sa hovācāṣāḍha ām āruṇe yat sahaiva brahmacaryam acarāva sahānvabravīvahy atha kenedaṃ tvam asmān atyanūciṣe . yad idaṃ tvam iyatpriyaḥ kīrter iyatpriyaś cakṣuṣaḥ iyatpriyaḥ saner asi kena tvam idaṃ prāpitheti . sa hovāca dhūrṣv evāhaṃ tad upāsa iti . kiṃ tvaṃ tad dhūrṣūpāssa iti . priyam iti . ya āsāṃ priyam upāste kiṃ sa bhavatīti . priya eva sa kīrter priyaś cakṣuṣaḥ priyaḥ saner bhavatīti . evam eva tvam asīti hocuḥ . atha hocur jīvalaṃ kārīrādiṃ yad idaṃ tvam eva tasyārdhasya śreṣṭho 'si yasminn asy api tvā rājāno 'dhastād upāsate kena tvam idaṃ prāpitheti . sa hovāca dhūrṣv evāhaṃ tad upāsa iti . kiṃ tvaṃ tad dhūrṣūpāssa iti . śriyam iti . ya āsāṃ śriyam upāste kiṃ sa bhavatīti . yasminn evārdhe bhavati tasya śreṣṭho bhavaty apy enaṃ rājāno 'dhastād upāsata iti . evam eva tvam asīti hocuḥ . atha hocur aṣāḍhaṃ sāvayasaṃ yat tvaṃ śārkarākṣāṇāṃ vāva grāmaṇy evāsi kena tvam idaṃ prāpitheti . sa hovāca dhūrṣv evāhaṃ tad upāsa iti . kiṃ tvaṃ tad dhūrṣūpāssa iti . jātam iti . ya āsāṃ jātam upāste kiṃ sa bhavatīti . yatraiva sajāto bhavati tad grāmaṇīr bhavatīti . evam eva tvam asīti hocuḥ . atha hocur indradyumnaṃ bhāllaveyaṃ yad idaṃ tavopary upary anyān kīrtiś carati vivacanam evāsi kena tvam idaṃ prāpitheti . sa hovāca dhūrṣv evāhaṃ tad upāsa iti . kiṃ tvaṃ tad dhūrṣūpāssa iti . yaśa iti . ya āsāṃ yaśa upāste kiṃ sa bhavatīti . upary upary evānyān kīrtiś carati vivacanam eva bhavatīti . evam eva tvam asīti hocuḥ .
