etad vai tviṣe rūpam etad apaciteḥ .
text: They ask: 'What is the support (vidhṛti) of this sacrifice, and what is its honour (apaciti)?' One should reply: 'The fact that from one pressing to the next it does not remain the same — since a different pressing arises each time — that is the support and the honour of this sacrifice.' They say the opening verse should be 'davidyutatyā ruce.' This is a leading (gaṇinī) opening verse, of many forms. 'Groups (gaṇa), as it were, follow one who attains prosperity.' But others say the opening verses should be 'pavasva vāco agriya' and 'upāsmai gāyatā nare' — these are the leading opening verses of many forms. For here both sāmans are performed. Therefore these are the opening verses to be used. Both bṛhat and rathantara are used. Brahman is rathantara; kṣatra is bṛhat. Both brahman and kṣatra are the form of honour. The Bhadra and Śreyasī are used — for through bhadra (auspiciousness) the gods became auspicious, and through śreyas (excellence) they attained prosperity. The Saha and Mahasī are used — for through saha (force) the gods overcame the Asuras, and through mahas (greatness) they became great. The Bharga and Yaśasī are used — for through bhargas (splendour) the gods became splendid, and through yaśas (glory) they attained glory. The Utsedha and Niṣedha are used — for through utsedha the gods pushed up what was to be raised, and through niṣedha they restrained what was to be restrained. The Sadoviśīya and Viśoviśīya are used — for through sadoviśīya the gods settled among the people, and through viśoviśīya they became kings of every community. The Dharma and Vidharmaṇī are used — for through dharma the gods became dharma, and through vidharman they struck away what was contrary to dharma. In this sacrifice, two-footed atichanda (hypermetric) verses are used — both the longest and the shortest metres. Cattle are the metres. Therefore cattle of both kinds — the largest and the smallest — attend upon the prosperous one. Cattle of both kinds attend upon him, who knows thus. Its dakṣiṇā is a chariot drawn by four horses. All the horses are worth a hundred. He (the sacrificer) wears a gold necklace (niṣka) and a trembling ornament (prāvepa), all ornaments; he is radiant. His cover is of tiger skin, his shield of leopard skin, his quiver of bear skin. The one who mounts it wears sword-armour, fully armed, with an armed charioteer, surrounded, with two guards posted. The charioteer wears a niṣka and a garland. This is the form of splendour; this is the form of honour. In this sacrifice he gives wealth that commands honour. 'May I, honoured, give honoured wealth.'
meaning: तद् आहुः कैतस्य यज्ञस्य विधृतिः कापचितिर् इति . स ब्रूयाद् यद् एव सवनात् सवनं न समैति . यद् अमैव सवनं संपद्यते सैवैतस्य यज्ञस्य विधृतिस् सापचितिर् इति . तस्य आहुर् दविद्युतत्या रुचे त्य् एव प्रतिपदं कार्याम् . एषा वै गणिनी प्रतिपद् बहुरूपा . गणा इव वै तं सचन्ते य श्रियम् अश्नुत इति . तद् उ वा आहुः पवस्व वाचो अग्रिय उपास्मै गायता नर इत्य् एते एव प्रतिपदौ कार्ये . एते वाव गणिन्यौ प्रतिपदौ बहुरूपे . अथो उभे ह्य् अत्र सामनी क्रियेते . तस्माद् एते एव प्रतिपदौ कार्ये इति . बृहद्रथन्तरे भवतः . ब्रह्म वै रथन्तरं क्षत्रं बृहत् . ब्रह्म च वै क्षत्रं चापचिते रूपम् . भद्रश्रेयसी भवतः . भद्रेण वै देवा भद्रा अभवञ् छ्रेयसा श्रियम् अगच्छन् . सहोमहसी भवतः . सहसा वै देवा असुरान् असहन्त . महसा महो ऽभवन् . भर्गयशसी भवतः . भर्गेण वै देवा भर्गो ऽभवन् . यशसा यशो ऽगच्छन् . उत्सेधनिषेधौ भवतः . उत्सेधेन वै देवा औत्सेध्यम् उदसेधन् . निषेधेन निषेध्यं न्यषेधन् . सदोविशीयं च विशोविशीयं च भवतः . सदोविशीयेन वै देवा विशम् असीदन् . विशोविशीयेन विशो विशो राजानो ऽभवन् . धर्मविधर्मणी भवतः . धर्मेण वै देवा धर्मो ऽभवन् . विधर्मणा विधर्मापाघ्नत . तस्मिन् एता उभयीर् द्विपदातिच्छन्दसः क्रियन्ते ज्येष्ठानि च ह्रसिष्ठानि च छन्दांसि . पशवो वै छन्दांसि . तस्माद् भूतम् उभये पशव उपतिष्ठन्ते ज्येष्ठाश् च ह्रसिष्ठाश् च . उभये ह वा एनं पशव उपतिष्ठन्ते ज्येष्ठाश् च ह्रसिष्ठाश् च य एवं वेद . तस्याश्वरथश् चतुर्युग् दक्षिणा भवति . सर्वे शतक्रियो ऽश्वाः . स रुक्मी प्रावेपी सर्वाभरण्य् अंशुमान् भवति . तस्य वैयाघ्रः परिवारो भवति द्वैपो धन्वधिर् आर्क्ष उपासङ्गः . खाड्गकवचो ऽध्यास्थाता भवति संनद्धस् संनद्धसारथिर् आवृतः प्रतिहिताभ्याम् . निष्की स्रग्वी संग्रहीता भवति . एतद् वै त्विषे रूपम् एतद् अपचितेः . तस्मिन्न् एतद् अपचितं धनं ददाति . अपचिता एवापचितं धनं ददानीति .

sanskrit_iast: athaitāv abhibhūś ca vinuttiś ca . devāsurā aspardhanta . te devā akāmayantābhīmān asurān bhavemeti . ta etat abhibhuvaṃ yajñam apaśyan . tam āharan . tenāyajanta . tenāsurān abhyabhavan . yad abhyabhavaṃs tad abhibhuvo 'bhibhūtvam . abhi ha vai dviṣantaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda . tasya trivṛtāv abhito bhavataḥ . brahma vai trivṛt . brahmaṇā vā enāṃs tad abhyabhavan . brahmaṇaiva dviṣantaṃ bhrātṛvyam abhibhavati ya evaṃ veda . te jitās trastriṃśam eva pitaraṃ prajāpatiṃ prāpadyanta . yathā jyeṣṭhāyāṃ variṣṭhāyāṃ puri pariyateraṃs tathā tān akāmayantāta enān vinudemahīti . ta etaṃ vinuttiṃ yajñam apaśyan . tam āharan . tenāyajanta . tata enān vyanudanta . yad vyanudanta tad vinutter vinuttitvam . vi ha vai dviṣantaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ nudate ya evaṃ veda . tasya trivṛtau madhye bhavataḥ . brahma vai trivṛt . brahmaṇā vā enāṃs tad vyanudanta .
sentences: abʰi ha vai dviṣantaṃ bʰrātr̥vyaṃ bʰavati ya evaṃ veda .
brahmaṇaiva dviṣantaṃ bʰrātr̥vyam abʰibʰavati ya evaṃ veda .
te jitās trastriṃśam eva pitaraṃ prajāpatiṃ prāpadyanta .
yatʰā jyeṣṭʰāyāṃ variṣṭʰāyāṃ puri pariyateraṃs tatʰā tān akāmayantāta enān vinudemahīti .
vi ha vai dviṣantaṃ bʰrātr̥vyaṃ nudate ya evaṃ veda .
text: Now these are the Abhibhu (the overpowering) and the Vinuitti (the expelling). The gods and Asuras competed. The gods desired: 'May we overpower these Asuras.' They saw this Abhibhu sacrifice, brought it, and sacrificed with it. Thereby they overpowered the Asuras. Because they overpowered (abhyabhavan), that is the Abhibhu's quality of being Abhibhu. One overpowers the hostile rival, who knows thus. Its two outer stomas are trivrt. Brahman is trivrt. Through brahman they overpowered them. Through brahman one overpowers the hostile rival, who knows thus. Those (Asuras), defeated, took refuge with the thirty-three-fold, with their father Prajapati. As one might go around the greatest, most excellent fortress -- thus they desired: 'Let us now expel them.' They saw this Vinuitti sacrifice, brought it, and sacrificed with it. Thereupon they expelled them. Because they expelled (vyanudanta), that is the Vinuitti's quality of being Vinuitti. One expels the hostile rival, who knows thus. Its two middle stomas are trivrt. Brahman is trivrt. Through brahman they expelled them.
meaning: अथैताव् अभिभूश् च विनुत्तिश् च . देवासुरा अस्पर्धन्त . ते देवा अकामयन्ताभीमान् असुरान् भवेमेति . त एतत् अभिभुवं यज्ञम् अपश्यन् . तम् आहरन् . तेनायजन्त . तेनासुरान् अभ्यभवन् . यद् अभ्यभवंस् तद् अभिभुवो ऽभिभूत्वम् . अभि ह वै द्विषन्तं भ्रातृव्यं भवति य एवं वेद . तस्य त्रिवृताव् अभितो भवतः . ब्रह्म वै त्रिवृत् . ब्रह्मणा वा एनांस् तद् अभ्यभवन् . ब्रह्मणैव द्विषन्तं भ्रातृव्यम् अभिभवति य एवं वेद . ते जितास् त्रस्त्रिंशम् एव पितरं प्रजापतिं प्रापद्यन्त . यथा ज्येष्ठायां वरिष्ठायां पुरि परियतेरंस् तथा तान् अकामयन्तात एनान् विनुदेमहीति . त एतं विनुत्तिं यज्ञम् अपश्यन् . तम् आहरन् . तेनायजन्त . तत एनान् व्यनुदन्त . यद् व्यनुदन्त तद् विनुत्तेर् विनुत्तित्वम् . वि ह वै द्विषन्तं भ्रातृव्यं नुदते य एवं वेद . तस्य त्रिवृतौ मध्ये भवतः . ब्रह्म वै त्रिवृत् . ब्रह्मणा वा एनांस् तद् व्यनुदन्त .

sanskrit_iast: atho āhur agnir evaiṣa yat trivṛt stomaḥ . tad yathā bhramalān saṃpannān agninābhyauṣed evam evaināṃs tat trivṛtā agninā stomena trayastriṃśābhyām ubhayata upamāryābhyauṣan . te vipalayyemām upāsarpann iti . tato vai devā abhavan parāsurāḥ . bhavaty ātmanā parāsya dviṣan bhrātṛvyo bhavati ya evaṃ veda . atho āhuḥ purodhākāma evainena yajeta yad abhibhūr iti . tasya trivṛtāv abhito bhavatas trayastriṃśau madhye . brahma vai trivṛt kṣatraṃ trayastriṃśaḥ . brahmaṇaiva tad ubhayataḥ kṣatraṃ parigṛhṇāti . yado vai brahmaṇā kṣatraṃ parigṛhṇāty atha sa tasya purodhāṃ gacchati . gacchati purodhāṃ pura enaṃ dadhate . atho āhur antasthākāma evainena yajeta yad vinuttir iti . tasya trivṛttau madhye bhavatas trayastriṃśāv abhitaḥ . brahma vai trivṛt kṣatraṃ trayastriṃśaḥ . kṣatreṇaiva tad ubhayato brahma parigṛhṇāti . yado vai kṣatreṇa brahma parigṛhṇāty atha sa tasyāntasthāṃ tiṣṭhati . tiṣṭhaty antasthāṃ nāntasthāyāṃ jīyate .
sentences: atʰo āhur agnir evaiṣa yat trivr̥t stomaḥ .
tad yatʰā bʰramalān saṃpannān agninābʰyauṣed evam evaināṃs tat trivr̥tā agninā stomena trayastriṃśābʰyām ubʰayata upamāryābʰyauṣan .
bʰavaty ātmanā parāsya dviṣan bʰrātr̥vyo bʰavati ya evaṃ veda .
atʰo āhuḥ purodʰākāma evainena yajeta yad abʰibʰūr iti .
tasya trivr̥tāv abʰito bʰavatas trayastriṃśau madʰye .
yado vai brahmaṇā kṣatraṃ parigr̥hṇāty atʰa sa tasya purodʰāṃ gaccʰati .
atʰo āhur antastʰākāma evainena yajeta yad vinuttir iti .
tasya trivr̥ttau madʰye bʰavatas trayastriṃśāv abʰitaḥ .
yado vai kṣatreṇa brahma parigr̥hṇāty atʰa sa tasyāntastʰāṃ tiṣṭʰati .
text: Others say: 'The trivrt stoma is Agni. Just as one would burn assembled enemies with fire, so with this trivrt-Agni-stoma they scorched them, crushing them from both sides with the two thirty-three-folds.' They (the Asuras), scattered, crept toward this (world), saying: 'Let us approach this one.' Thereupon the gods prevailed and the Asuras were defeated. One prevails oneself, and his hostile rival is defeated, who knows thus. Others say: 'One desiring the office of purohita should sacrifice with the Abhibhu.' Its two outer stomas are trivrt, and the two middle are thirty-three-fold. Brahman is trivrt; kshatra is thirty-three-fold. Through brahman he encompasses kshatra on both sides. When brahman encompasses kshatra, one attains the office of purohita. He attains the purodha; they place him at the front. Others say: 'One desiring to be an intimate counsellor should sacrifice with the Vinuitti.' Its two middle stomas are trivrt, and the two outer are thirty-three-fold. Brahman is trivrt; kshatra is thirty-three-fold. Through kshatra he encompasses brahman on both sides. When kshatra encompasses brahman, one stands in the intimate position. He holds the intimate position and is not dislodged from it.
meaning: अथो आहुर् अग्निर् एवैष यत् त्रिवृत् स्तोमः . तद् यथा भ्रमलान् संपन्नान् अग्निनाभ्यौषेद् एवम् एवैनांस् तत् त्रिवृता अग्निना स्तोमेन त्रयस्त्रिंशाभ्याम् उभयत उपमार्याभ्यौषन् . ते विपलय्येमाम् उपासर्पन्न् इति . ततो वै देवा अभवन् परासुराः . भवत्य् आत्मना परास्य द्विषन् भ्रातृव्यो भवति य एवं वेद . अथो आहुः पुरोधाकाम एवैनेन यजेत यद् अभिभूर् इति . तस्य त्रिवृताव् अभितो भवतस् त्रयस्त्रिंशौ मध्ये . ब्रह्म वै त्रिवृत् क्षत्रं त्रयस्त्रिंशः . ब्रह्मणैव तद् उभयतः क्षत्रं परिगृह्णाति . यदो वै ब्रह्मणा क्षत्रं परिगृह्णात्य् अथ स तस्य पुरोधां गच्छति . गच्छति पुरोधां पुर एनं दधते . अथो आहुर् अन्तस्थाकाम एवैनेन यजेत यद् विनुत्तिर् इति . तस्य त्रिवृत्तौ मध्ये भवतस् त्रयस्त्रिंशाव् अभितः . ब्रह्म वै त्रिवृत् क्षत्रं त्रयस्त्रिंशः . क्षत्रेणैव तद् उभयतो ब्रह्म परिगृह्णाति . यदो वै क्षत्रेण ब्रह्म परिगृह्णात्य् अथ स तस्यान्तस्थां तिष्ठति . तिष्ठत्य् अन्तस्थां नान्तस्थायां जीयते .

sanskrit_iast: tasya vā etasyābhibhuvas trivṛtāv abhito bhavatas trayastriṃśau madhye . tayoṣ ṣaṭṣaṣṭi stotryāḥ . tato yāṣ ṣaṣṭir āsandī sā . atha yāś catasra āsandīpādās te . atha ye dve yajamāna evaiṣa dvipād etasyāṃ rājāsandyām adhyūḍhaḥ . gacchati rājyaṃ ya evaṃ veda . yady asmin loke nātha vā amuṣmin . atho āhur yasya dvāv etau trivṛtau madhye madhye sā hed vā apy āsandīti . madhye vinateva vā āsandī . madhye vinata ivaiṣa . sā ha vai suṣimattarā yā madhye vinatā . gacchati rājyaṃ ya evaṃ veda yady asmin loke nātha vā amuṣmin . atho āhuḥ punar asau hed vā etau yajñakratū iti . ṣaḍ vā etayor iti ūrdhvā stomā udyanti . ṣaḍ amuto 'rvāñcaś ṣaḍbhir evete ūrdhvaṃ svargaṃ lokaṃ gacchati praty evāmutaṣ ṣaḍbhir avarohati gacchati svargaṃ lokaṃ praty asmin loke tiṣṭhati . atho ha veda yo 'sāv āsaṃ so 'yam asmīti punar haivāsmin loka ājāyate .
sentences: tasya vā etasyābʰibʰuvas trivr̥tāv abʰito bʰavatas trayastriṃśau madʰye .
atʰa ye dve yajamāna evaiṣa dvipād etasyāṃ rājāsandyām adʰyūḍʰaḥ .
yady asmin loke nātʰa vā amuṣmin .
atʰo āhur yasya dvāv etau trivr̥tau madʰye madʰye sā hed vā apy āsandīti .
sā ha vai suṣimattarā yā madʰye vinatā .
gaccʰati rājyaṃ ya evaṃ veda yady asmin loke nātʰa vā amuṣmin .
atʰo āhuḥ punar asau hed vā etau yajñakratū iti .
ṣaḍ vā etayor iti ūrdʰvā stomā udyanti .
ṣaḍ amuto 'rvāñcaś ṣaḍbʰir evete ūrdʰvaṃ svargaṃ lokaṃ gaccʰati praty evāmutaṣ ṣaḍbʰir avarohati gaccʰati svargaṃ lokaṃ praty asmin loke tiṣṭʰati .
atʰo ha veda yo 'sāv āsaṃ so 'yam asmīti punar haivāsmin loka ājāyate .
text: Of this Abhibhu, the two outer stomas are trivrt and the two middle are thirty-three-fold. Their stotriyas number sixty-six. Of these, sixty are the seat (asandi). The four are the legs of the seat. The two represent the sacrificer himself -- he is two-footed, enthroned upon this royal seat. He attains kingship, who knows thus -- either in this world or in the other. Others say: 'He whose two trivrats are in the middle -- that is the seat.' For a seat that is curved in the middle is, as it were, depressed in the middle. Like a seat depressed in the middle, he is (seated). And a seat that is curved in the middle is more comfortable. He attains kingship, who knows thus -- either in this world or in the other. Others say: 'These two sacrificial rites are like a return journey.' For six stomas rise upward in each. With six he goes upward to the heavenly world; with six he descends back from there. He goes to the heavenly world and stands again in this world. And he knows: 'He who I was there, I am this one here' -- for he is born again in this world.
meaning: तस्य वा एतस्याभिभुवस् त्रिवृताव् अभितो भवतस् त्रयस्त्रिंशौ मध्ये . तयोष् षट्षष्टि स्तोत्र्याः . ततो याष् षष्टिर् आसन्दी सा . अथ याश् चतस्र आसन्दीपादास् ते . अथ ये द्वे यजमान एवैष द्विपाद् एतस्यां राजासन्द्याम् अध्यूढः . गच्छति राज्यं य एवं वेद . यद्य् अस्मिन् लोके नाथ वा अमुष्मिन् . अथो आहुर् यस्य द्वाव् एतौ त्रिवृतौ मध्ये मध्ये सा हेद् वा अप्य् आसन्दीति . मध्ये विनतेव वा आसन्दी . मध्ये विनत इवैष . सा ह वै सुषिमत्तरा या मध्ये विनता . गच्छति राज्यं य एवं वेद यद्य् अस्मिन् लोके नाथ वा अमुष्मिन् . अथो आहुः पुनर् असौ हेद् वा एतौ यज्ञक्रतू इति . षड् वा एतयोर् इति ऊर्ध्वा स्तोमा उद्यन्ति . षड् अमुतो ऽर्वाञ्चश् षड्भिर् एवेते ऊर्ध्वं स्वर्गं लोकं गच्छति प्रत्य् एवामुतष् षड्भिर् अवरोहति गच्छति स्वर्गं लोकं प्रत्य् अस्मिन् लोके तिष्ठति . अथो ह वेद यो ऽसाव् आसं सो ऽयम् अस्मीति पुनर् हैवास्मिन् लोक आजायते .

sanskrit_iast: tayor vā etayos saha trivṛtau saha pañcadaśau saha saptadaśau sahaikaviṃśau saha triñavau saha trayastriṃśau . sa yathā dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ pratitiṣṭhann iyād evam evaitābhyāṃ svarge loke pratitiṣṭhati . atho āhur anviṣṭīnāṃ hed vā etau yajñakratū iti . sa yas saṃvatsarabhṛtā vāsaṃvatsarabhṛtā vāgninā cityena yajeta sa etābhyāṃ yajeta . sadyo haivāsya saṃvatsara ṛtuśo māsaśo 'rdhamāsaśo 'nviṣṭo bhavati . tad yat pṛṣṭhyasya ṣaḍahasya stomā bhavanty ṛtavo vai pṛṣṭhāni . saṃvatsara ṛtavas tenartuśaḥ . atha yad dvādaśa stotrāṇi bhavanti dvādaśa māsās saṃvatsaras tena māsaśaḥ . atha yac caturviṃśati stutaśastrāṇi bhavanti caturviṃśatyardhamāsas saṃvatsaras tenārdhamāsaśaḥ .
sentences: tayor vā etayos saha trivr̥tau saha pañcadaśau saha saptadaśau sahaikaviṃśau saha triñavau saha trayastriṃśau .
sa yatʰā dvābʰyāṃ dvābʰyāṃ pratitiṣṭʰann iyād evam evaitābʰyāṃ svarge loke pratitiṣṭʰati .
atʰo āhur anviṣṭīnāṃ hed vā etau yajñakratū iti .
sa yas saṃvatsarabʰr̥tā vāsaṃvatsarabʰr̥tā vāgninā cityena yajeta sa etābʰyāṃ yajeta .
sadyo haivāsya saṃvatsara r̥tuśo māsaśo 'rdʰamāsaśo 'nviṣṭo bʰavati .
tad yat pr̥ṣṭʰyasya ṣaḍahasya stomā bʰavanty r̥tavo vai pr̥ṣṭʰāni .
atʰa yad dvādaśa stotrāṇi bʰavanti dvādaśa māsās saṃvatsaras tena māsaśaḥ .
atʰa yac caturviṃśati stutaśastrāṇi bʰavanti caturviṃśatyardʰamāsas saṃvatsaras tenārdʰamāsaśaḥ .
text: Of these two, the trivrats are together, the pancadashas together, the saptadashas together, the ekavimshatas together, the trinavas together, the trayastrimshatas together. Just as one walking would step on two feet at a time, even so one is established in the heavenly world through these two. Others say: 'These two sacrificial rites are meant for those seeking investigation (anvishti).' He who would sacrifice with a year-long or non-year-long fire-altar (agnicayana) should sacrifice with these two. Instantly his year becomes investigated -- season by season, month by month, half-month by half-month. Since the stomas of the six-day prsthya cycle are used -- the prsthas are the seasons; the seasons are the year -- thereby season by season. Since there are twelve stotras -- twelve months make the year -- thereby month by month. Since there are twenty-four stuta-shastras -- twenty-four half-months make the year -- thereby half-month by half-month.
meaning: तयोर् वा एतयोस् सह त्रिवृतौ सह पञ्चदशौ सह सप्तदशौ सहैकविंशौ सह त्रिञवौ सह त्रयस्त्रिंशौ . स यथा द्वाभ्यां द्वाभ्यां प्रतितिष्ठन्न् इयाद् एवम् एवैताभ्यां स्वर्गे लोके प्रतितिष्ठति . अथो आहुर् अन्विष्टीनां हेद् वा एतौ यज्ञक्रतू इति . स यस् संवत्सरभृता वासंवत्सरभृता वाग्निना चित्येन यजेत स एताभ्यां यजेत . सद्यो हैवास्य संवत्सर ऋतुशो मासशो ऽर्धमासशो ऽन्विष्टो भवति . तद् यत् पृष्ठ्यस्य षडहस्य स्तोमा भवन्त्य् ऋतवो वै पृष्ठानि . संवत्सर ऋतवस् तेनर्तुशः . अथ यद् द्वादश स्तोत्राणि भवन्ति द्वादश मासास् संवत्सरस् तेन मासशः . अथ यच् चतुर्विंशति स्तुतशस्त्राणि भवन्ति चतुर्विंशत्यर्धमासस् संवत्सरस् तेनार्धमासशः .

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣa manustomaḥ . manur vā akāmayata bahuḥ prajayā paśubhiḥ prajāyeya mānavīḥ prajās sṛjeyeti . sa etaṃ yajñam apaśyat . tam āharat . tenāyajata . tato vai sa bahuḥ prajayā paśubhiḥ prājāyata . tā imā mānavīḥ prajā asṛjata . sa yaḥ kāmayeta bahuḥ prajayā paśubhiḥ prajāyeya mānavīḥ prajāḥ sṛjeyeti sa etena yajeta . bahur eva prajayā paśubhiḥ prajāyate mānavīḥ prajās sṛjate . tasya pṛṣṭhyasya ṣaḍahasya stomā bhavanti . ṛtavo vai pṛṣṭhāni . saṃvatsara ṛtavaḥ . saṃvatsaraḥ prajananam . sa yaḥ prajananaṃ sa mā prajanayād iti . tasyobhaye stomā bhavanty ayujaś ca yugmantaś caiva . tad vai daivyaṃ mithunaṃ prajananaṃ yad ubhaye stomāḥ . tad yad daivyaṃ mithunaṃ prajananaṃ tan mā prajanayād iti . tasya vyatiṣaktā stomā bhavanti vyatiṣaktād vai mithunāt prajāḥ paśavaḥ prajāyante prajātyā eva . tasyobhe bṛhadrathantare sāmanī bhavataḥ . etad vai daivyaṃ mithunaṃ prajananaṃ yad ubhe bṛhadrathantare . tad yad daivyaṃ mithunaṃ prajananaṃ tan mā prajanayād iti . tasya chandomāḥ pavamānā bhavanti . paśavo vai chandomāḥ . paśavaḥ prajananam . tad yat prajananaṃ tan mā prajanayād iti . tasya mānavaṃ brahmasāma bhavati . brahma vai brahmasāma . yajamānakāmo eṣa yad brahmasāma sva eva tad āyatane yajamānaṃ kāmais samardhayanti . sa ukthyo bhavati . prajā vai paśava ukthāni . prajā vai paśavaḥ prajananam .
sentences: manur vā akāmayata bahuḥ prajayā paśubʰiḥ prajāyeya mānavīḥ prajās sr̥jeyeti .
tato vai sa bahuḥ prajayā paśubʰiḥ prājāyata .
sa yaḥ kāmayeta bahuḥ prajayā paśubʰiḥ prajāyeya mānavīḥ prajāḥ sr̥jeyeti sa etena yajeta .
bahur eva prajayā paśubʰiḥ prajāyate mānavīḥ prajās sr̥jate .
sa yaḥ prajananaṃ sa mā prajanayād iti .
tasyobʰaye stomā bʰavanty ayujaś ca yugmantaś caiva .
tad vai daivyaṃ mitʰunaṃ prajananaṃ yad ubʰaye stomāḥ .
tad yad daivyaṃ mitʰunaṃ prajananaṃ tan mā prajanayād iti .
tasya vyatiṣaktā stomā bʰavanti vyatiṣaktād vai mitʰunāt prajāḥ paśavaḥ prajāyante prajātyā eva .
etad vai daivyaṃ mitʰunaṃ prajananaṃ yad ubʰe br̥hadratʰantare .
tad yad daivyaṃ mitʰunaṃ prajananaṃ tan mā prajanayād iti .
tad yat prajananaṃ tan mā prajanayād iti .
yajamānakāmo eṣa yad brahmasāma sva eva tad āyatane yajamānaṃ kāmais samardʰayanti .
text: Now this is the Manustoma. Manu desired: 'May I be born abundantly with offspring and cattle; may I create the races of Manu (manavi prajah).' He saw this sacrifice, brought it, and sacrificed with it. Thereupon he was born abundantly with offspring and cattle. He created these races of Manu. He who desires: 'May I be born abundantly with offspring and cattle; may I create the races of Manu' -- he should sacrifice with this. Its stomas follow the six-day prsthya cycle. The prsthas are the seasons. The seasons are the year. The year is procreation. 'May that which is procreation cause me to procreate.' Its stomas are of both kinds -- odd and even. That is the divine pair, the procreative one -- that the stomas are of both kinds. 'May that divine pair, that procreation, cause me to procreate.' Its stomas are interwoven (vyatishakta). From an interwoven pair, offspring and cattle are born -- for the sake of progeny. Both brhat and rathantara are its samans. That is the divine pair, the procreative one -- that both brhat and rathantara (are used). 'May that divine pair, that procreation, cause me to procreate.' Its pavamanas have the chandoma (metre-characterized) samans. Cattle are the chandoma. Cattle are procreation. 'May that which is procreation cause me to procreate.' Its brahmasaman is the Manava. Brahman is the brahmasaman. The brahmasaman serves the desire of the sacrificer. In its own seat they satisfy the sacrificer with desires. It is an ukthya, for offspring and cattle are the uktha chants. Offspring and cattle are procreation.
meaning: अथैष मनुस्तोमः . मनुर् वा अकामयत बहुः प्रजया पशुभिः प्रजायेय मानवीः प्रजास् सृजेयेति . स एतं यज्ञम् अपश्यत् . तम् आहरत् . तेनायजत . ततो वै स बहुः प्रजया पशुभिः प्राजायत . ता इमा मानवीः प्रजा असृजत . स यः कामयेत बहुः प्रजया पशुभिः प्रजायेय मानवीः प्रजाः सृजेयेति स एतेन यजेत . बहुर् एव प्रजया पशुभिः प्रजायते मानवीः प्रजास् सृजते . तस्य पृष्ठ्यस्य षडहस्य स्तोमा भवन्ति . ऋतवो वै पृष्ठानि . संवत्सर ऋतवः . संवत्सरः प्रजननम् . स यः प्रजननं स मा प्रजनयाद् इति . तस्योभये स्तोमा भवन्त्य् अयुजश् च युग्मन्तश् चैव . तद् वै दैव्यं मिथुनं प्रजननं यद् उभये स्तोमाः . तद् यद् दैव्यं मिथुनं प्रजननं तन् मा प्रजनयाद् इति . तस्य व्यतिषक्ता स्तोमा भवन्ति व्यतिषक्ताद् वै मिथुनात् प्रजाः पशवः प्रजायन्ते प्रजात्या एव . तस्योभे बृहद्रथन्तरे सामनी भवतः . एतद् वै दैव्यं मिथुनं प्रजननं यद् उभे बृहद्रथन्तरे . तद् यद् दैव्यं मिथुनं प्रजननं तन् मा प्रजनयाद् इति . तस्य छन्दोमाः पवमाना भवन्ति . पशवो वै छन्दोमाः . पशवः प्रजननम् . तद् यत् प्रजननं तन् मा प्रजनयाद् इति . तस्य मानवं ब्रह्मसाम भवति . ब्रह्म वै ब्रह्मसाम . यजमानकामो एष यद् ब्रह्मसाम स्व एव तद् आयतने यजमानं कामैस् समर्धयन्ति . स उक्थ्यो भवति . प्रजा वै पशव उक्थानि . प्रजा वै पशवः प्रजननम् .

text: Others say: 'This is indeed one of the rites for those seeking investigation.' He who would sacrifice with a year-long or non-year-long fire-altar should sacrifice with this. Instantly his year becomes investigated -- season by season, half-month by half-month, month by month, night by night. Since the stomas follow the six-day prsthya cycle -- the prsthas are the seasons; the seasons are the year -- thereby season by season. Since there are fifteen stotras -- fifteen are the nights of a half-month -- thereby half-month by half-month. Since there are thirty stuta-shastras -- thirty are the nights of a month -- thereby month by month. Since there are three hundred stotriyas -- so many are the nights of the year -- thereby night by night. Instantly his year becomes investigated, who knows thus. Prajanya desired: 'May I go to the heavenly world.' He saw this second Manustoma, brought it, and sacrificed with it. Its stomas follow the six-day prsthya cycle -- the prsthas are the seasons; the seasons are the year; the year is the heavenly world -- for the attainment of the heavenly world. Its stomas ascend progressively -- for the heavenly world is above -- for the attainment of the heavenly world. Both brhat and rathantara are its samans -- they are heavenly -- for the attainment of the heavenly world. Its pavamanas have the chandoma samans -- cattle are the chandoma; cattle are the heavenly world -- for the attainment of the heavenly world. Its brahmasaman is the twenty-five-fold (pancavimsha). Food is the twenty-five-fold. The brahmasaman serves the desire of the sacrificer. In its own seat they satisfy the sacrificer with food. It is an ukthya, for offspring and cattle are the uktha chants.
meaning: अथो आहुर् अन्विष्टीनां हेद् वा एष एको यज्ञक्रतुर् इति . स यस् संवत्सरभृता वासंवत्सरभृता वाग्निना चित्येन यजेत स एतेन यजेत . सद्यो हैवास्य संवत्सर ऋतुशो ऽर्धमासशो मासशो रात्रिशो ऽन्विष्टो भवति . तद् यत् पृष्ठ्यस्य षडहस्य स्तोमा भवन्त्य् ऋतवो वै पृष्ठानि संवत्सर ऋतवस् तेनर्तुशः . अथ यत् पञ्चदश स्तोत्राणि भवन्ति पञ्चदश वार्धमासस्य रात्रयस् तेनार्धमासशः . अथ यत् त्रिंशत् स्तुतशस्त्राणि भवन्ति त्रिंशन् मासस्य रात्रयस् तेन मासशः . अथ यत् त्रीणि शतानि स्तोत्रिया भवन्ति तावतीः संवत्सरस्य रात्रयस् तेन रात्रिशः . सद्यो हैवास्य संवत्सरो ऽन्विष्टो भवति य एवं वेद . ताः प्रजन्याकामयत स्वर्गं लोकं गच्छेयम् इति . स एतम् उत्तरम् मनुस्तोमम् अपश्यत् . तम् आहरत् . तेनायजत . तस्य पृष्ठ्यस्य षडहस्य स्तोमा भवन्त्य् ऋतवो वै पृष्ठानि . संवत्सर ऋतवः . संवत्सर स्वर्गो लोक स्वर्गस्यैव लोकस्य समष्ट्यै . तस्योर्ध्वा स्तोमा भवन्त्य् ऊर्ध्वो वै स्वर्गो लोक स्वर्गस्यैव लोकस्य समष्ट्यै . तस्योभे बृहद्रथन्तरे सामनी भवत स्वर्ग्ये स्वर्गस्यैव लोकस्य समष्ट्यै . तस्य छन्दोमाः पवमाना भवन्ति पशवो वै छन्दोमाः . पशव स्वर्गो लोक स्वर्गस्यैव लोकस्य समष्ट्यै . तस्य पञ्चविंशं ब्रह्मसाम भवति . अन्नं वै पञ्चविंशम् . यजमानकामो वा एष यद् ब्रह्मसाम . स्व एव तद् आयतने यजमानम् अन्नाद्येन समर्धयन्ति . स उक्थ्यो भवति प्रजा वै पशव उक्थानि .

sanskrit_iast: atho āhur anviṣṭīnāṃ hed vā eṣa eko yajñakratur iti . tata eva rātrim upayanti . atirātreṇa vai devā ūrdhvā svargaṃ lokam āyan . te svargaṃ lokaṃ gatvā sārdham evāvyavasitā āsata . diśo 'prajānānās te akāmayanta diśaḥ prajānīyāmeti . ahorātrayor ha vai parastāt svargo lokaḥ . ta etāny upariṣṭād rātreś catvāri stotrāṇy apaśyan . tair astuvata . tair eva stutvā diśaḥ prājānan . tato vai te yatra yatra svargasya lokasyākāmayanta tat tad vyavāsyan . yatra yatra ha vai svargasya lokasya kāmayate tat tad vyavasyati ya evaṃ vedeti ha smāha jānaśruteyaḥ . atha ha smāha vaitahavyaḥ . prajāpatiḥ paśūn asṛjata . te 'smāt sṛṣṭāḥ prādravan . tān agniṣṭomenāvivārayiṣata . te tad atyādravan . tān ukthyenāvivārayiṣata . te tad atyādravan . tān ṣoḍaśināvivārayiṣata . te tad aty evādravan . tān paryāyaiḥ paryāyam ait . yat paryāyaiḥ paryāyam ait tat paryāyāṇāṃ paryāyatvam . tān āśvinena kratunā paryagṛhṇāt . teṣāṃ parigṛhītānāṃ yathā kṣudrā matsyā akṣor akṣy atiśīyerann evam eva ye kṣudrāḥ paśava āsus te 'tiśeduḥ . tān akāmayatāptvainān ātman yaccheyam iti . sa etāny upariṣṭād rātreś catvāri stotrāṇy apaśyat . tair astuta . tair evainān āptvātmany ayacchat . yad āptvātmany ayacchat tasmād aptoryāmaḥ .
sentences: atʰo āhur anviṣṭīnāṃ hed vā eṣa eko yajñakratur iti .
atirātreṇa vai devā ūrdʰvā svargaṃ lokam āyan .
te svargaṃ lokaṃ gatvā sārdʰam evāvyavasitā āsata .
ahorātrayor ha vai parastāt svargo lokaḥ .
ta etāny upariṣṭād rātreś catvāri stotrāṇy apaśyan .
tato vai te yatra yatra svargasya lokasyākāmayanta tat tad vyavāsyan .
yatra yatra ha vai svargasya lokasya kāmayate tat tad vyavasyati ya evaṃ vedeti ha smāha jānaśruteyaḥ .
yat paryāyaiḥ paryāyam ait tat paryāyāṇāṃ paryāyatvam .
teṣāṃ parigr̥hītānāṃ yatʰā kṣudrā matsyā akṣor akṣy atiśīyerann evam eva ye kṣudrāḥ paśava āsus te 'tiśeduḥ .
sa etāny upariṣṭād rātreś catvāri stotrāṇy apaśyat .
text:
Others say: 'This is indeed one of the rites for those seeking investigation.' From there (i.e. from the ukthya) they proceed into the night. Through the atirātra the gods went upward to the heavenly world. Having reached the heavenly world, they remained all together, unsettled. Not knowing the directions, they desired: 'May we know the directions.' For the heavenly world is beyond day and night. They saw these four stotras above the night. They chanted with them. Having chanted with them, they knew the directions. Thereupon, wherever they wished in the heavenly world, they settled. Wherever one wishes in the heavenly world, one settles, who knows thus — so said Jānaśruteya.

But Vaitahavya said: Prajāpati created cattle. Once created, they ran away from him. He tried to stop them with the agniṣṭoma. They ran past that. He tried to stop them with the ukthya. They ran past that. He tried to stop them with the ṣoḍaśin. They ran past that too. He pursued them with the paryāyas, circuit by circuit. Because he went circuit by circuit (paryāya), that is the paryāyas' quality of being paryāya. With the Āśvina rite he enclosed them. Of those enclosed, just as small fish might slip through between the meshes — so the small cattle slipped through. He desired: 'Having seized them, may I keep them in myself.' He saw these four stotras above the night. He chanted with them. Having thereby seized them, he kept them within himself. Because he seized and kept (āptva ayacchat), therefore it is called Aptoryāma.
meaning: अथो आहुर् अन्विष्टीनां हेद् वा एष एको यज्ञक्रतुर् इति . तत एव रात्रिम् उपयन्ति . अतिरात्रेण वै देवा ऊर्ध्वा स्वर्गं लोकम् आयन् . ते स्वर्गं लोकं गत्वा सार्धम् एवाव्यवसिता आसत . दिशो ऽप्रजानानास् ते अकामयन्त दिशः प्रजानीयामेति . अहोरात्रयोर् ह वै परस्तात् स्वर्गो लोकः . त एतान्य् उपरिष्टाद् रात्रेश् चत्वारि स्तोत्राण्य् अपश्यन् . तैर् अस्तुवत . तैर् एव स्तुत्वा दिशः प्राजानन् . ततो वै ते यत्र यत्र स्वर्गस्य लोकस्याकामयन्त तत् तद् व्यवास्यन् . यत्र यत्र ह वै स्वर्गस्य लोकस्य कामयते तत् तद् व्यवस्यति य एवं वेदेति ह स्माह जानश्रुतेयः . अथ ह स्माह वैतहव्यः . प्रजापतिः पशून् असृजत . ते ऽस्मात् सृष्टाः प्राद्रवन् . तान् अग्निष्टोमेनाविवारयिषत . ते तद् अत्याद्रवन् . तान् उक्थ्येनाविवारयिषत . ते तद् अत्याद्रवन् . तान् षोडशिनाविवारयिषत . ते तद् अत्य् एवाद्रवन् . तान् पर्यायैः पर्यायम् ऐत् . यत् पर्यायैः पर्यायम् ऐत् तत् पर्यायाणां पर्यायत्वम् . तान् आश्विनेन क्रतुना पर्यगृह्णात् . तेषां परिगृहीतानां यथा क्षुद्रा मत्स्या अक्षोर् अक्ष्य् अतिशीयेरन्न् एवम् एव ये क्षुद्राः पशव आसुस् ते ऽतिशेदुः . तान् अकामयताप्त्वैनान् आत्मन् यच्छेयम् इति . स एतान्य् उपरिष्टाद् रात्रेश् चत्वारि स्तोत्राण्य् अपश्यत् . तैर् अस्तुत . तैर् एवैनान् आप्त्वात्मन्य् अयच्छत् . यद् आप्त्वात्मन्य् अयच्छत् तस्माद् अप्तोर्यामः .

sanskrit_iast: tā dvāṣaṣṭi stotriyās saṃpadyante . tato yāṣ ṣaṣṭis sā virāṭ . paśavo virāṭ . atha ye dve yajamāna evaiṣa dvipāt parastāt paryūḍhaḥ . paśūnāṃ guptyai paśūnām aparāvāpāya . nāsya vittaṃ paropyate ya evaṃ veda . atho āhur ekam evaitat stotraṃ sat tac caturdhā vihṛtya stuyuṣ ṣaḍbhir eva hotre stuyuṣ ṣaḍbhir maitrāvaruṇāya ṣaḍbhir brāhmaṇācchaṃsine ṣaḍbhir acchāvākāya . tad u hotaivānuśaṃsed iti . tāś caturviṃśati stotryās saṃpadyante . caturviṃśatyardhamāsas saṃvatsaraḥ . saṃvatsaraḥ prajāpatiḥ . prajāpatir evaiṣa parastāt paryūḍhaḥ . paśūnāṃ guptyai paśūnām aparāvāpāya . nāsya vittaṃ paropyate ya evaṃ veda . tad u vā āhus trivṛt pañcadaśaṃ saptadaśam ekaviṃśam ity evaitāni stotrāṇi syuḥ . ekaviṃśaṃ vā anu sarve yajñakratavas saṃtiṣṭhante . atho eṣa vāva dṛḍhaḥ pratiṣṭhita stomo yad ekaviṃśaḥ . tasmād ekaviṃśa eva stomo 'ntataḥ kārya iti .
sentences: atʰa ye dve yajamāna evaiṣa dvipāt parastāt paryūḍʰaḥ .
nāsya vittaṃ paropyate ya evaṃ veda .
atʰo āhur ekam evaitat stotraṃ sat tac caturdʰā vihr̥tya stuyuṣ ṣaḍbʰir eva hotre stuyuṣ ṣaḍbʰir maitrāvaruṇāya ṣaḍbʰir brāhmaṇāccʰaṃsine ṣaḍbʰir accʰāvākāya .
nāsya vittaṃ paropyate ya evaṃ veda .
tad u vā āhus trivr̥t pañcadaśaṃ saptadaśam ekaviṃśam ity evaitāni stotrāṇi syuḥ .
ekaviṃśaṃ vā anu sarve yajñakratavas saṃtiṣṭʰante .
atʰo eṣa vāva dr̥ḍʰaḥ pratiṣṭʰita stomo yad ekaviṃśaḥ .
tasmād ekaviṃśa eva stomo 'ntataḥ kārya iti .
text: The stotriyas number sixty-two. Of these, sixty are the viraj. Cattle are the viraj. The two represent the sacrificer himself -- he is two-footed, encompassed from beyond. This is for the guarding of cattle, so cattle do not fall away. His wealth is not carried off, who knows thus. Others say: 'This is a single stotra that is divided into four: six (stotriyas) are chanted for the Hotr, six for the Maitravaruna, six for the Brahmanacchamsin, six for the Acchavaka. But the Hotr alone should do the recitation.' These make twenty-four stotriyas. Twenty-four half-months make the year. The year is Prajapati. Prajapati is encompassed from beyond -- for the guarding of cattle, so cattle do not fall away. His wealth is not carried off, who knows thus. Others say: 'The stomas should be simply trivrt, pancadasha, saptadasha, ekavimsaha.' For all sacrificial rites conclude with the twenty-one-fold. And the twenty-one-fold is the firm, established stoma. Therefore the twenty-one-fold stoma should be used at the end.
meaning: ता द्वाषष्टि स्तोत्रियास् संपद्यन्ते . ततो याष् षष्टिस् सा विराट् . पशवो विराट् . अथ ये द्वे यजमान एवैष द्विपात् परस्तात् पर्यूढः . पशूनां गुप्त्यै पशूनाम् अपरावापाय . नास्य वित्तं परोप्यते य एवं वेद . अथो आहुर् एकम् एवैतत् स्तोत्रं सत् तच् चतुर्धा विहृत्य स्तुयुष् षड्भिर् एव होत्रे स्तुयुष् षड्भिर् मैत्रावरुणाय षड्भिर् ब्राह्मणाच्छंसिने षड्भिर् अच्छावाकाय . तद् उ होतैवानुशंसेद् इति . ताश् चतुर्विंशति स्तोत्र्यास् संपद्यन्ते . चतुर्विंशत्यर्धमासस् संवत्सरः . संवत्सरः प्रजापतिः . प्रजापतिर् एवैष परस्तात् पर्यूढः . पशूनां गुप्त्यै पशूनाम् अपरावापाय . नास्य वित्तं परोप्यते य एवं वेद . तद् उ वा आहुस् त्रिवृत् पञ्चदशं सप्तदशम् एकविंशम् इत्य् एवैतानि स्तोत्राणि स्युः . एकविंशं वा अनु सर्वे यज्ञक्रतवस् संतिष्ठन्ते . अथो एष वाव दृढः प्रतिष्ठित स्तोमो यद् एकविंशः . तस्माद् एकविंश एव स्तोमो ऽन्ततः कार्य इति .

sanskrit_iast: abhi tvā vṛṣabhā suta ity ārṣabham . abhīti rathantarasya rūpam . tena rathantarasya rūpān na yanti . yad adya kac ca vṛtrahann iti śākalaṃ hiṃkāravad vāmadevyasya rūpam . tena vāmadevyasya rūpān na yanti . tam indraṃ vājayāmasī ty edāvasunidhanaṃ (?) bahirnidhanaṃ bṛhato rūpam . tena bṛhato rūpān na yanty atho paśavo vai vasu paśūnām evāvaruddhyai . atho haināṃs tad idaṃ vasv ity evāptvopeyāy edaṃ viṣṇur vicakrama itīl̥ānāṃ saṃkṣāraḥ paśavo vā il̥ānāṃ saṃkṣāraḥ paśūnām evāvaruddhyai . etad dha vā enāṃs tan nijuhva ehīl̥ā ehīl̥ā iti paśavo vā il̥ā tasmād etāny atiriktokthāni kāryāṇīti . tad u hovāca tāṇḍyaḥ prajāpatiḥ paśūn asṛjata . te 'smāt sṛṣṭā apākrāman . so 'gnim abravīd etān me vārayasveti . tān sa jarābodhīyena nāvārayata . sa indram abravīd etān me vārayasyeti . tān sa satrāsāhīyena nāvārayata . sa īśānaṃ devam abravīd etān me vārayasveti . tān sa mārgīyaveṇa naivāvārayata . sa viṣṇum abravīd etān me vārayasveti . tān sa vaiṣṇavīṣu vāravantīyenaivāvārayata . yad avārayata tad vāravantīyasya vāravantīyatvam .
sentences: abʰi tvā vr̥ṣabʰā suta ity ārṣabʰam .
yad adya kac ca vr̥trahann iti śākalaṃ hiṃkāravad vāmadevyasya rūpam .
tam indraṃ vājayāmasī ty edāvasunidʰanaṃ (?) bahirnidʰanaṃ br̥hato rūpam .
tena br̥hato rūpān na yanty atʰo paśavo vai vasu paśūnām evāvaruddʰyai .
atʰo haināṃs tad idaṃ vasv ity evāptvopeyāy edaṃ viṣṇur vicakrama itīl̥ānāṃ saṃkṣāraḥ paśavo vā il̥ānāṃ saṃkṣāraḥ paśūnām evāvaruddʰyai .
etad dʰa vā enāṃs tan nijuhva ehīl̥ā ehīl̥ā iti paśavo vā il̥ā tasmād etāny atiriktoktʰāni kāryāṇīti .
tad u hovāca tāṇḍyaḥ prajāpatiḥ paśūn asr̥jata .
sa indram abravīd etān me vārayasyeti .
sa īśānaṃ devam abravīd etān me vārayasveti .
sa viṣṇum abravīd etān me vārayasveti .
text: On (the verse) 'abhi tva vrshabha sutah' -- that is the Arshabha. 'Abhi' is the form of the rathantara. Thereby they do not depart from the form of the rathantara. 'Yad adya kac ca vrtrahan' -- the Shakala with himkara is the form of the vamadeya. Thereby they do not depart from the form of the vamadeya. 'Tam indram vajayamasi' -- the Edavasu-nidhana, with the nidhanam outside (bahirnidhana), is the form of the brhat. Thereby they do not depart from the form of the brhat. And cattle are wealth (vasu) -- for the obtaining of cattle. Having seized them as 'this wealth,' he approaches. 'Idam vishnur vicakrame' -- this is the samkshara of the ida. Cattle are the samkshara of the ida -- for the obtaining of cattle. This is what calls them: 'Come, Ida! Come, Ida!' Cattle are Ida. Therefore these additional uktha chants should be used. But Tandya said: 'Prajapati created cattle. Once created, they departed from him. He said to Agni: "Restrain these for me." He did not restrain them with the Jarabodha saman. He said to Indra: "Restrain these for me." He did not restrain them with the Satrasahiya. He said to Ishana Deva: "Restrain these for me." He did not restrain them even with the Margiyavena. He said to Vishnu: "Restrain these for me." He restrained them on the Vaishnavi (verses) with the Varavantiya itself. Because he restrained (avarayata), that is the Varavantiya's quality of being Varavantiya.'
meaning: अभि त्वा वृषभा सुत इत्य् आर्षभम् . अभीति रथन्तरस्य रूपम् . तेन रथन्तरस्य रूपान् न यन्ति . यद् अद्य कच् च वृत्रहन्न् इति शाकलं हिंकारवद् वामदेव्यस्य रूपम् . तेन वामदेव्यस्य रूपान् न यन्ति . तम् इन्द्रं वाजयामसी त्य् एदावसुनिधनं (?) बहिर्निधनं बृहतो रूपम् . तेन बृहतो रूपान् न यन्त्य् अथो पशवो वै वसु पशूनाम् एवावरुद्ध्यै . अथो हैनांस् तद् इदं वस्व् इत्य् एवाप्त्वोपेयाय् एदं विष्णुर् विचक्रम इतील्̥आनां संक्षारः पशवो वा इल्̥आनां संक्षारः पशूनाम् एवावरुद्ध्यै . एतद् ध वा एनांस् तन् निजुह्व एहील्̥आ एहील्̥आ इति पशवो वा इल्̥आ तस्माद् एतान्य् अतिरिक्तोक्थानि कार्याणीति . तद् उ होवाच ताण्ड्यः प्रजापतिः पशून् असृजत . ते ऽस्मात् सृष्टा अपाक्रामन् . सो ऽग्निम् अब्रवीद् एतान् मे वारयस्वेति . तान् स जराबोधीयेन नावारयत . स इन्द्रम् अब्रवीद् एतान् मे वारयस्येति . तान् स सत्रासाहीयेन नावारयत . स ईशानं देवम् अब्रवीद् एतान् मे वारयस्वेति . तान् स मार्गीयवेण नैवावारयत . स विष्णुम् अब्रवीद् एतान् मे वारयस्वेति . तान् स वैष्णवीषु वारवन्तीयेनैवावारयत . यद् अवारयत तद् वारवन्तीयस्य वारवन्तीयत्वम् .

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣa gosavaḥ . svargakāmo haitena yajeta . sa vā eṣa ṣaṭtriṃśo bhavati . ṣaṭtriṃśadakṣarā vai bṛhatī . bṛhatī svargo lokaḥ sāmrājyaṃ . bṛhatyām eva tat svarge loke sāmrājye pratitiṣṭhanto yanti . bṛhaty u ha vā imān sarvān lokān akṣarair vyāpnoti daśabhir evākṣarair imaṃ lokaṃ vyāpnoti daśabhir antarikṣaṃ daśabhir amuṃ caturbhir diśo dvābhyām ahorātre . sā yemāṃl lokān vyāpnoti tayemāṃl lokān vyāpnavānīti . tasya stotraṃ stotraṃ caturaś caturas trivṛto 'bhisaṃpadyate . trivṛtaṃ vā anye stomā abhisaṃpadyante trivṛt svargaṃ lokam . sa yathā kṣiprāśvena caturyujā yatra jigamiṣet tad gacched evam evaitena svargaṃ lokaṃ gacchati . tasyobhe bṛhadrathantare sāmanī bhavata svargye svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai . sa ukthyo bhavati prajā vai paśava ukthāni . prajā vai paśava svargo loka svargasyaiva lokasya samaṣṭyai . tasya dvādaśa sahasrāṇi dakṣiṇā bhavanti dvādaśa māsās saṃvatsaras saṃvatsara svargo loka svargasyaiva lokasya samaṣṭyai . tasya vratam . upa mātaram iyād upa svasāram upa sagotrām . upāhvaryodakam ācāmed upāhvarya tṛṇāny āchindyāt . yatra yatrainaṃ viṣṭhā vindet tat tad vitiṣṭheta . anaḍuho ha lokaṃ jayati . tena haitena janako vaideho iyakṣāṃ cakre . tam u ha brāhmaṇā abhito niṣeduḥ . sa ha papraccha ka stoma iti . sa hovāca sudakṣiṇaḥ kṣaimir nāyaṃ trivṛd evāhur iti . tasya kiṃ vrataṃ kā dakṣiṇā iti . tasmā u haitat provāca . sa hovāca ud evāsya dakṣiṇā āśaṃse vrataṃ tv evāsya nodāśaṃsa iti . teno ha sa nopadadharṣa yaṣṭum . teno ha puṇyakeśo yaudhenir īje śaibyo rājā . taṃ ha sabhāyām eva viṣṭhā viveda . sa ha tad evodāvṛṇāna uvāca sthavirayajño vāva kilāyam āsa . sthavira evānena yajñena yajeta . sthavirasya hy evedaṃ sarvam anujñātam iti . sa haiṣa sthavirayajña eva .
sentences: br̥hatyām eva tat svarge loke sāmrājye pratitiṣṭʰanto yanti .
br̥haty u ha vā imān sarvān lokān akṣarair vyāpnoti daśabʰir evākṣarair imaṃ lokaṃ vyāpnoti daśabʰir antarikṣaṃ daśabʰir amuṃ caturbʰir diśo dvābʰyām ahorātre .
sā yemāṃl lokān vyāpnoti tayemāṃl lokān vyāpnavānīti .
tasya stotraṃ stotraṃ caturaś caturas trivr̥to 'bʰisaṃpadyate .
trivr̥taṃ vā anye stomā abʰisaṃpadyante trivr̥t svargaṃ lokam .
sa yatʰā kṣiprāśvena caturyujā yatra jigamiṣet tad gaccʰed evam evaitena svargaṃ lokaṃ gaccʰati .
tasyobʰe br̥hadratʰantare sāmanī bʰavata svargye svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai .
sa uktʰyo bʰavati prajā vai paśava uktʰāni .
prajā vai paśava svargo loka svargasyaiva lokasya samaṣṭyai .
tasya dvādaśa sahasrāṇi dakṣiṇā bʰavanti dvādaśa māsās saṃvatsaras saṃvatsara svargo loka svargasyaiva lokasya samaṣṭyai .
upa mātaram iyād upa svasāram upa sagotrām .
yatra yatrainaṃ viṣṭʰā vindet tat tad vitiṣṭʰeta .
tena haitena janako vaideho iyakṣāṃ cakre .
tam u ha brāhmaṇā abʰito niṣeduḥ .
sa ha papraccʰa ka stoma iti .
sa hovāca sudakṣiṇaḥ kṣaimir nāyaṃ trivr̥d evāhur iti .
tasya kiṃ vrataṃ kā dakṣiṇā iti .
sa hovāca ud evāsya dakṣiṇā āśaṃse vrataṃ tv evāsya nodāśaṃsa iti .
teno ha puṇyakeśo yaudʰenir īje śaibyo rājā .
taṃ ha sabʰāyām eva viṣṭʰā viveda .
sa ha tad evodāvr̥ṇāna uvāca stʰavirayajño vāva kilāyam āsa .
stʰavirasya hy evedaṃ sarvam anujñātam iti .
text: Now this is the Gosava sacrifice. One desiring heaven should sacrifice with this. It has the thirty-six-fold (stoma). The brhati has thirty-six syllables. The brhati is the heavenly world, imperial sovereignty (samrajya). Established in the brhati, in the heavenly world, in imperial sovereignty, they proceed. The brhati pervades all these worlds with its syllables: with ten syllables it pervades this world, with ten the atmosphere, with ten yonder world, with four the directions, with two the day and night. 'As she pervades these worlds, so may I pervade these worlds.' At each stotra, four trivrats are attained. Other stomas attain the trivrt; the trivrt is the heavenly world. Just as with a swift four-yoked horse one would go wherever one wishes -- so one goes to the heavenly world with this. Both brhat and rathantara are its samans -- they are heavenly, for the attainment of the heavenly world. It is an ukthya, for offspring and cattle are the uktha chants; offspring and cattle are the heavenly world -- for the attainment of the heavenly world. Its dakshina consists of twelve thousand (cows). Twelve months make the year; the year is the heavenly world -- for the attainment of the heavenly world. Its observance (vrata) is: he should go to his mother, go to his sister, go to a woman of his gotra (clan). He should drink water lapping it up; he should tear grass with his teeth. Wherever excrement overtakes him, there he should void it. He conquers the world of the bull (anadvan). Janaka of Videha wished to sacrifice with this. The brahmanas sat around him. He asked: 'What is the stoma?' Sudakshina said: 'The Kshaimas say it is simply the trivrt.' 'What is its observance, what is its dakshina?' He told him that. He (Janaka) said: 'I can venture the dakshina, but I cannot venture the observance.' Therefore he did not dare to sacrifice with it. Punyakesha Yaudheni, a Shaibya king, sacrificed with it. Excrement overtook him right in the assembly hall. Having just risen, he said: 'This was indeed an old man's sacrifice. Only an old man should sacrifice with this rite, for everything is permitted to an old man.' This is indeed the Old Man's Sacrifice.
meaning: अथैष गोसवः . स्वर्गकामो हैतेन यजेत . स वा एष षट्त्रिंशो भवति . षट्त्रिंशदक्षरा वै बृहती . बृहती स्वर्गो लोकः साम्राज्यं . बृहत्याम् एव तत् स्वर्गे लोके साम्राज्ये प्रतितिष्ठन्तो यन्ति . बृहत्य् उ ह वा इमान् सर्वान् लोकान् अक्षरैर् व्याप्नोति दशभिर् एवाक्षरैर् इमं लोकं व्याप्नोति दशभिर् अन्तरिक्षं दशभिर् अमुं चतुर्भिर् दिशो द्वाभ्याम् अहोरात्रे . सा येमांल् लोकान् व्याप्नोति तयेमांल् लोकान् व्याप्नवानीति . तस्य स्तोत्रं स्तोत्रं चतुरश् चतुरस् त्रिवृतो ऽभिसंपद्यते . त्रिवृतं वा अन्ये स्तोमा अभिसंपद्यन्ते त्रिवृत् स्वर्गं लोकम् . स यथा क्षिप्राश्वेन चतुर्युजा यत्र जिगमिषेत् तद् गच्छेद् एवम् एवैतेन स्वर्गं लोकं गच्छति . तस्योभे बृहद्रथन्तरे सामनी भवत स्वर्ग्ये स्वर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै . स उक्थ्यो भवति प्रजा वै पशव उक्थानि . प्रजा वै पशव स्वर्गो लोक स्वर्गस्यैव लोकस्य समष्ट्यै . तस्य द्वादश सहस्राणि दक्षिणा भवन्ति द्वादश मासास् संवत्सरस् संवत्सर स्वर्गो लोक स्वर्गस्यैव लोकस्य समष्ट्यै . तस्य व्रतम् . उप मातरम् इयाद् उप स्वसारम् उप सगोत्राम् . उपाह्वर्योदकम् आचामेद् उपाह्वर्य तृणान्य् आछिन्द्यात् . यत्र यत्रैनं विष्ठा विन्देत् तत् तद् वितिष्ठेत . अनडुहो ह लोकं जयति . तेन हैतेन जनको वैदेहो इयक्षां चक्रे . तम् उ ह ब्राह्मणा अभितो निषेदुः . स ह पप्रच्छ क स्तोम इति . स होवाच सुदक्षिणः क्षैमिर् नायं त्रिवृद् एवाहुर् इति . तस्य किं व्रतं का दक्षिणा इति . तस्मा उ हैतत् प्रोवाच . स होवाच उद् एवास्य दक्षिणा आशंसे व्रतं त्व् एवास्य नोदाशंस इति . तेनो ह स नोपदधर्ष यष्टुम् . तेनो ह पुण्यकेशो यौधेनिर् ईजे शैब्यो राजा . तं ह सभायाम् एव विष्ठा विवेद . स ह तद् एवोदावृणान उवाच स्थविरयज्ञो वाव किलायम् आस . स्थविर एवानेन यज्ञेन यजेत . स्थविरस्य ह्य् एवेदं सर्वम् अनुज्ञातम् इति . स हैष स्थविरयज्ञ एव .

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣa vivadhaḥ . paśukāmo haitena yajeta . sa vā eṣa ṣaṭ ca paṅktīr abhisaṃpadyate daśa ca stotryāḥ . tato yāṣ ṣaṭ paṅktayaḥ paśavas te . atha yā daśa stotryāḥ paśūnām eva sa dohaḥ . paya evaiṣāṃ tat . te u eva dve pañca pañca pañcinyau paṅktyau saṃpadyete . ta u te paśava eva . tasya saviṃśaṃ prātassavanaṃ bhavati sadaśaṃ mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ saviṃśaṃ tṛtīyasavanam . tad yathā ha vai vivadhasyobhayatas saguru savivadhatāyai tādṛk tad yat sadaśaṃ mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ bhavati . saviṃśe abhitaḥ pūrvārdhaṃ ca jaghanārdhaṃ ca bhūyiṣṭhaṃ bhājayanti . tasmāt paśavaḥ pūrvārdhena ca jaghanārdhena ca bhūyiṣṭhaṃ bhājayanti . vahanti pūrvārdhena duhre ca jaghanārdhena pra ca janayanti . ubhayaṃ dhenupayasaṃ cānaḍutpayasaṃ cāvarundhe ya evaṃ veda . tasminn u ha tarhy ubhe bṛhadrathantare kuryur dvayā u ha vai paśavo rāthantarā anye bārhatā anye . ye ha vā anyatodantāḥ paśavas te rāthantarā ya ubhayatodantās te bārhatā ubhayeṣām eva paśūnām avaruddhyai . sa ukthyo bhavati paśavo vā ukthāni paśūnām evāvaruddhyai .
sentences: sa vā eṣa ṣaṭ ca paṅktīr abʰisaṃpadyate daśa ca stotryāḥ .
tato yāṣ ṣaṭ paṅktayaḥ paśavas te .
atʰa yā daśa stotryāḥ paśūnām eva sa dohaḥ .
te u eva dve pañca pañca pañcinyau paṅktyau saṃpadyete .
tasya saviṃśaṃ prātassavanaṃ bʰavati sadaśaṃ mādʰyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ saviṃśaṃ tr̥tīyasavanam .
tad yatʰā ha vai vivadʰasyobʰayatas saguru savivadʰatāyai tādr̥k tad yat sadaśaṃ mādʰyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ bʰavati .
saviṃśe abʰitaḥ pūrvārdʰaṃ ca jagʰanārdʰaṃ ca bʰūyiṣṭʰaṃ bʰājayanti .
tasmāt paśavaḥ pūrvārdʰena ca jagʰanārdʰena ca bʰūyiṣṭʰaṃ bʰājayanti .
vahanti pūrvārdʰena duhre ca jagʰanārdʰena pra ca janayanti .
ubʰayaṃ dʰenupayasaṃ cānaḍutpayasaṃ cāvarundʰe ya evaṃ veda .
tasminn u ha tarhy ubʰe br̥hadratʰantare kuryur dvayā u ha vai paśavo rātʰantarā anye bārhatā anye .
ye ha vā anyatodantāḥ paśavas te rātʰantarā ya ubʰayatodantās te bārhatā ubʰayeṣām eva paśūnām avaruddʰyai .
sa uktʰyo bʰavati paśavo vā uktʰāni paśūnām evāvaruddʰyai .
text: Now this is the Vivadha sacrifice (the carrying-yoke sacrifice). One desiring cattle should sacrifice with this. It attains six panktis and ten stotriyas. The six panktis are cattle. The ten stotriyas are the milking of cattle -- that is their milk. These two (groups of) five make two pankti groups of five. And those are the cattle. Its morning pressing has the twenty-fold, the midday pressing has the ten-fold, the third pressing has the twenty-fold. Just as a carrying-yoke (vivadha) is heavy on both sides -- such is it, for the midday pressing has the ten-fold, which is the carrying-yoke's quality. In the twenty-folds on either side, the front half and the rear half receive the larger share. Therefore cattle provide the larger share with their front half and rear half. They carry with the front half; they are milked and procreate with the rear half. One obtains both -- the milk of cows and the milk of oxen -- who knows thus. In this case, both brhat and rathantara should be used, for cattle are of two kinds: some belong to the rathantara, others to the brhat. Those with teeth on one side only belong to the rathantara; those with teeth on both sides belong to the brhat -- for obtaining both kinds of cattle. It is an ukthya, for cattle are the uktha chants -- for the obtaining of cattle.
meaning: अथैष विवधः . पशुकामो हैतेन यजेत . स वा एष षट् च पङ्क्तीर् अभिसंपद्यते दश च स्तोत्र्याः . ततो याष् षट् पङ्क्तयः पशवस् ते . अथ या दश स्तोत्र्याः पशूनाम् एव स दोहः . पय एवैषां तत् . ते उ एव द्वे पञ्च पञ्च पञ्चिन्यौ पङ्क्त्यौ संपद्येते . त उ ते पशव एव . तस्य सविंशं प्रातस्सवनं भवति सदशं माध्यंदिनं सवनं सविंशं तृतीयसवनम् . तद् यथा ह वै विवधस्योभयतस् सगुरु सविवधतायै तादृक् तद् यत् सदशं माध्यंदिनं सवनं भवति . सविंशे अभितः पूर्वार्धं च जघनार्धं च भूयिष्ठं भाजयन्ति . तस्मात् पशवः पूर्वार्धेन च जघनार्धेन च भूयिष्ठं भाजयन्ति . वहन्ति पूर्वार्धेन दुह्रे च जघनार्धेन प्र च जनयन्ति . उभयं धेनुपयसं चानडुत्पयसं चावरुन्धे य एवं वेद . तस्मिन्न् उ ह तर्ह्य् उभे बृहद्रथन्तरे कुर्युर् द्वया उ ह वै पशवो राथन्तरा अन्ये बार्हता अन्ये . ये ह वा अन्यतोदन्ताः पशवस् ते राथन्तरा य उभयतोदन्तास् ते बार्हता उभयेषाम् एव पशूनाम् अवरुद्ध्यै . स उक्थ्यो भवति पशवो वा उक्थानि पशूनाम् एवावरुद्ध्यै .

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣa sadyaḥkrīḥ . te vṛtā nāpākrāman . ta etyāyājayan . tebhya etāṃ vācaṃ val̥avāṃ śvetāṃ bhūtāṃ aśvābhidhānyabhihitām ānayann imāṃ pratigṛhṇīteti . te 'bruvan śreyasīyam asman no imām udyaṃsyāma iti . sā kruddhā na mā pratyagṛhṇann iti siṃhy ubhayatomukhī bhūtvordhvodakrāmat . sobhayān devāsurān antarātiṣṭhad yaṃ devānām upāpnod yaṃ asurāṇāṃ tam ādadānā . tām upaiva devā amantrayantopāsurāḥ . sā devān abhyupāvartamānābravīt kiṃ me tata syād yad vo 'bhyupāvarteyeti . pūrvāṃ tvāgner āhutir aśnuvīteti . tām adhvare 'vākalpayan . saiṣottaravediḥ .
sentences: tebʰya etāṃ vācaṃ val̥avāṃ śvetāṃ bʰūtāṃ aśvābʰidʰānyabʰihitām ānayann imāṃ pratigr̥hṇīteti .
te 'bruvan śreyasīyam asman no imām udyaṃsyāma iti .
sā kruddʰā na mā pratyagr̥hṇann iti siṃhy ubʰayatomukʰī bʰūtvordʰvodakrāmat .
sobʰayān devāsurān antarātiṣṭʰad yaṃ devānām upāpnod yaṃ asurāṇāṃ tam ādadānā .
sā devān abʰyupāvartamānābravīt kiṃ me tata syād yad vo 'bʰyupāvarteyeti .
text: Now this is the Sadyahkri (same-day purchase). Those (priests) who had been chosen did not withdraw. They came and performed the sacrifice. For them they brought this speech -- a white mare, manifest, yoked with horses -- (saying): 'Accept this.' They said: 'This is better than us; we will carry this up.' She, angered (that they did not accept her), became a two-faced lioness and rose upward, saying: 'They did not accept me.' She stood between both gods and Asuras, seizing whomever she reached of the gods and whomever of the Asuras. The gods addressed her from one side, the Asuras from the other. As she was turning toward the gods, she said: 'What would be mine if I were to turn toward you?' 'The first offering before Agni shall reach you.' They assigned her a place in the sacrifice. She is this uttaravedi (high altar).
meaning: अथैष सद्यःक्रीः . ते वृता नापाक्रामन् . त एत्यायाजयन् . तेभ्य एतां वाचं वल्̥अवां श्वेतां भूतां अश्वाभिधान्यभिहिताम् आनयन्न् इमां प्रतिगृह्णीतेति . ते ऽब्रुवन् श्रेयसीयम् अस्मन् नो इमाम् उद्यंस्याम इति . सा क्रुद्धा न मा प्रत्यगृह्णन्न् इति सिंह्य् उभयतोमुखी भूत्वोर्ध्वोदक्रामत् . सोभयान् देवासुरान् अन्तरातिष्ठद् यं देवानाम् उपाप्नोद् यं असुराणां तम् आददाना . ताम् उपैव देवा अमन्त्रयन्तोपासुराः . सा देवान् अभ्युपावर्तमानाब्रवीत् किं मे तत स्याद् यद् वो ऽभ्युपावर्तेयेति . पूर्वां त्वाग्नेर् आहुतिर् अश्नुवीतेति . ताम् अध्वरे ऽवाकल्पयन् . सैषोत्तरवेदिः .

sanskrit_iast: dhārayanty agniṃ vyādhārayanty uttaravedim . etad enāṃ tat pūrvām agner āhutir aśnute . athaitebhya etam ādityā ādityam evāśvaṃ śvetaṃ bhūtam aśvābhidhānyabhihitam ānayann imam u vai pratigṛhṇīteti . te 'bruvan śreyān u vāvāyam asman no vāvemam udyaṃsyāma iti . tān devāś carṣayaś copasametyābruvan vicchetsyante vā adakṣiṇā yajñāḥ pratigṛhṇīteti . tad eṣābhyanūcyate ādityā ha jaritar aṅgirobhyo 'śvaṃ dakṣiṇām anayaṃs taṃ ha jaritar na pratyāyaṃs taṃ ha jaritar na pratyagṛhṇaṃs
sentences: etad enāṃ tat pūrvām agner āhutir aśnute .
atʰaitebʰya etam ādityā ādityam evāśvaṃ śvetaṃ bʰūtam aśvābʰidʰānyabʰihitam ānayann imam u vai pratigr̥hṇīteti .
te 'bruvan śreyān u vāvāyam asman no vāvemam udyaṃsyāma iti .
tān devāś carṣayaś copasametyābruvan viccʰetsyante vā adakṣiṇā yajñāḥ pratigr̥hṇīteti .
ādityā ha jaritar aṅgirobʰyo 'śvaṃ dakṣiṇām anayaṃs
taṃ ha jaritar na pratyāyaṃs taṃ ha jaritar na pratyagr̥hṇaṃs
text: They uphold Agni; they set up the uttaravedi. Thereby the first offering of Agni reaches her (the uttaravedi). Then for these (priests) they brought this Aditya -- a white horse, manifest, yoked with horses -- (saying): 'Now accept this.' They said: 'This one too is better than us; we will carry this one up.' The gods and the rshis came together and said: 'Sacrifices without dakshinas will be cut off. Accept this.' This is proclaimed in the verse: 'The Adityas, O singer, brought the horse as dakshina to the Angirases. That, O singer, they did not bring back. That, O singer, they did not accept.'
meaning: धारयन्त्य् अग्निं व्याधारयन्त्य् उत्तरवेदिम् . एतद् एनां तत् पूर्वाम् अग्नेर् आहुतिर् अश्नुते . अथैतेभ्य एतम् आदित्या आदित्यम् एवाश्वं श्वेतं भूतम् अश्वाभिधान्यभिहितम् आनयन्न् इमम् उ वै प्रतिगृह्णीतेति . ते ऽब्रुवन् श्रेयान् उ वावायम् अस्मन् नो वावेमम् उद्यंस्याम इति . तान् देवाश् चर्षयश् चोपसमेत्याब्रुवन् विच्छेत्स्यन्ते वा अदक्षिणा यज्ञाः प्रतिगृह्णीतेति . तद् एषाभ्यनूच्यते आदित्या ह जरितर् अङ्गिरोभ्यो ऽश्वं दक्षिणाम् अनयंस् तं ह जरितर् न प्रत्यायंस् तं ह जरितर् न प्रत्यगृह्णंस्

sanskrit_iast: ādityā rudrā vasavas tvel̥ata idaṃ rādhaḥ pratigṛhṇīhy aṅgira idaṃ rādho bṛhat pṛthu devā dadatu vo varam tad vo astu sucetanaṃ yuṣme astu dive dive praty eva gṛbhāyata ity evainān pratyagrāhayan . tato vā ādityāḥ pūrve svargaṃ lokam āgacchan ahīyantāṅgirasaḥ . sa yo bhrātṛvyavān syād yo 'bhicared ya spardheta sa etena yajeta . hīyate 'sya pāpmā bhrātṛvyo gacchati svargaṃ lokam . yavorvarā vedir bhavati . sā hi purākṛtā bhavati . yavānām uttaravediḥ . yavair vā ādityā aṅgirasāṃ yajñam ayuvata . yad yajñaṃ yavair ayuvata tad yavānāṃ yavatvam . yavair eva dviṣato bhrātṛvyasya yajñaṃ yute . khalevalā yūpa sphyāgro bhavaty aindraḥ . vijityai saha paśū ālabhante samaṣṭyai . pumān gaus somakrayaṇo bhavati vīryaṃ vai pumān vīryavanto 'sāmeti . sāṇḍo bhavati sendratvāya . kuṃbhyā vasatīvaryyo bhavanti yaḥ purejānas tasya gṛhebhyaḥ . tā hi purāgṛhītā bhavanti . sarpiṣmantam aśitvā nipadyate . yam evāmuṃ dīkṣaṇīyam aśnāti sa evāsya so 'śito bhavati . priyāyai jāyāyā antarorū śete 'nipadyamānaḥ . tapasyam evāsya tad dhiraṇyam mukha ādhāya śete . satyaṃ vai hiraṇyam .
sentences: ādityā rudrā vasavas tvel̥ata idaṃ rādʰaḥ pratigr̥hṇīhy aṅgira
idaṃ rādʰo br̥hat pr̥tʰu devā dadatu vo varam
yuṣme astu dive dive praty eva gr̥bʰāyata
tato vā ādityāḥ pūrve svargaṃ lokam āgaccʰan ahīyantāṅgirasaḥ .
sa yo bʰrātr̥vyavān syād yo 'bʰicared ya spardʰeta sa etena yajeta .
hīyate 'sya pāpmā bʰrātr̥vyo gaccʰati svargaṃ lokam .
yavair vā ādityā aṅgirasāṃ yajñam ayuvata .
yad yajñaṃ yavair ayuvata tad yavānāṃ yavatvam .
yavair eva dviṣato bʰrātr̥vyasya yajñaṃ yute .
pumān gaus somakrayaṇo bʰavati vīryaṃ vai pumān vīryavanto 'sāmeti .
kuṃbʰyā vasatīvaryyo bʰavanti yaḥ purejānas tasya gr̥hebʰyaḥ .
yam evāmuṃ dīkṣaṇīyam aśnāti sa evāsya so 'śito bʰavati .
tapasyam evāsya tad dʰiraṇyam mukʰa ādʰāya śete .
text:
'Ādityas, Rudras, Vasus implored: "Accept this gift, O Aṅgiras. This gift is great and broad. May the gods give you a boon. May that be well-understood by you. May it be yours day by day. Accept it back!"' — thus they made them accept it. Thereupon the Ādityas first went to the heavenly world; the Aṅgirases were left behind.

He who has a hostile rival, who is bewitched, who is challenged — he should sacrifice with this. His evil and his rival are left behind; he goes to the heavenly world. The altar is a barley field. For it is already prepared. The uttaravedi is of barley. With barley the Ādityas joined (ayuvata) the sacrifice of the Aṅgirases. Because they joined the sacrifice with barley (yava), that is the barley's quality of being barley. With barley one yokes (joins) the sacrifice of the hostile rival.

The sacrificial post is a khalevala (pillar), pointed like a sphya, belonging to Indra — for conquering. Together with the animal offerings they achieve completeness. The Soma-purchasing (animal) is a male bull — for a male is strength: 'May we have strength.' It is a breeding bull (sāṇḍa) — for having Indra's quality. The vasatīvarī waters are from a pot, from the house of the one who was born first. For those are already collected. Having eaten food with ghee, he lies down. Whatever that consecration-food is that he eats — that is his food eaten. He lies between the thighs of his dear wife, without lying down (fully). That is his austerity. He lies down with gold placed in his mouth. Gold is truth. Thereby truth is spoken for him.
meaning: आदित्या रुद्रा वसवस् त्वेल्̥अत इदं राधः प्रतिगृह्णीह्य् अङ्गिर इदं राधो बृहत् पृथु देवा ददतु वो वरम् तद् वो अस्तु सुचेतनं युष्मे अस्तु दिवे दिवे प्रत्य् एव गृभायत इत्य् एवैनान् प्रत्यग्राहयन् . ततो वा आदित्याः पूर्वे स्वर्गं लोकम् आगच्छन् अहीयन्ताङ्गिरसः . स यो भ्रातृव्यवान् स्याद् यो ऽभिचरेद् य स्पर्धेत स एतेन यजेत . हीयते ऽस्य पाप्मा भ्रातृव्यो गच्छति स्वर्गं लोकम् . यवोर्वरा वेदिर् भवति . सा हि पुराकृता भवति . यवानाम् उत्तरवेदिः . यवैर् वा आदित्या अङ्गिरसां यज्ञम् अयुवत . यद् यज्ञं यवैर् अयुवत तद् यवानां यवत्वम् . यवैर् एव द्विषतो भ्रातृव्यस्य यज्ञं युते . खलेवला यूप स्फ्याग्रो भवत्य् ऐन्द्रः . विजित्यै सह पशू आलभन्ते समष्ट्यै . पुमान् गौस् सोमक्रयणो भवति वीर्यं वै पुमान् वीर्यवन्तो ऽसामेति . साण्डो भवति सेन्द्रत्वाय . कुंभ्या वसतीवर्य्यो भवन्ति यः पुरेजानस् तस्य गृहेभ्यः . ता हि पुरागृहीता भवन्ति . सर्पिष्मन्तम् अशित्वा निपद्यते . यम् एवामुं दीक्षणीयम् अश्नाति स एवास्य सो ऽशितो भवति . प्रियायै जायाया अन्तरोरू शेते ऽनिपद्यमानः . तपस्यम् एवास्य तद् धिरण्यम् मुख आधाय शेते . सत्यं वै हिरण्यम् .

sanskrit_iast: aśva śveto dakṣiṇā bhavati svargyo vā aśva svargasyaiva lokasya samaṣṭyai . aśvarathas somapravāko bhavati yojanaṃ paramam . etad dha vai paramāṇām adhvānām avamaṃ yad yojanam avamānāṃ vā paramam . tasmin dadhidṛtir upāvahito bhavati . tasya yat sarpis saṃpatati tad ājyakuṃbhe 'vāsyanti . tad dhi sadyojam iva dvikrośam itthaṃ dvikrośam ittham ṛtvijo vinihitā bhavanti . ta enaṃ prātar upasametya yājayanti . sa juhvat trir nimīlayati trir vīkṣate .
sentences: aśva śveto dakṣiṇā bʰavati svargyo vā aśva svargasyaiva lokasya samaṣṭyai .
etad dʰa vai paramāṇām adʰvānām avamaṃ yad yojanam avamānāṃ vā paramam .
tasya yat sarpis saṃpatati tad ājyakuṃbʰe 'vāsyanti .
tad dʰi sadyojam iva dvikrośam ittʰaṃ dvikrośam ittʰam r̥tvijo vinihitā bʰavanti .
sa juhvat trir nimīlayati trir vīkṣate .
text: A white horse is the sacrificial gift (dakṣiṇā), for the horse belongs to the heavenly world — for the attainment of the heavenly world. A horse-drawn chariot, [used for] the soma-procurement, travels one yojana at most. This is indeed the lowest of the greatest distances, or the greatest of the lowest. Upon it a skin-bag of curds is placed. Whatever clarified butter (sarpis) collects from it, they pour into the ghee-pot. For [this sacrifice is performed] as if in a single day — the priests are stationed at two krośas distance on each side. They come to him in the morning and make him sacrifice. While offering, he closes his eyes three times and opens them three times.
meaning: अश्व श्वेतो दक्षिणा भवति स्वर्ग्यो वा अश्व स्वर्गस्यैव लोकस्य समष्ट्यै . अश्वरथस् सोमप्रवाको भवति योजनं परमम् . एतद् ध वै परमाणाम् अध्वानाम् अवमं यद् योजनम् अवमानां वा परमम् . तस्मिन् दधिदृतिर् उपावहितो भवति . तस्य यत् सर्पिस् संपतति तद् आज्यकुंभे ऽवास्यन्ति . तद् धि सद्योजम् इव द्विक्रोशम् इत्थं द्विक्रोशम् इत्थम् ऋत्विजो विनिहिता भवन्ति . त एनं प्रातर् उपसमेत्य याजयन्ति . स जुह्वत् त्रिर् निमीलयति त्रिर् वीक्षते .

sanskrit_iast: sa trivṛd rathantarasāmā bhavati brahma vai trivṛt . brahma rathantaraṃ brahmaṇā svargaṃ lokaṃ gacchāmeti . atho āhus trivṛd eva bṛhatsāma syād iti . brahma vai trivṛt kṣatraṃ bṛhat . brahmaṇā ca kṣatreṇa ca saṃyugbhyāṃ svargaṃ lokaṃ gacchāmeti . tad u vā āhus trivṛd eva rathantasāmā syāt . brahma vai trivṛt . brahma vai rathantaram . brahma vai svargasya lokasyeśe . tasmiṃs trivṛd eva rathantarasāmā syād iti . tasminn āhur iyavanti sāmāni kāryāṇy iyavadbhir vai devā svargaṃ lokam agacchann iyavadbhi svargaṃ lokaṃ gacchāmeti . atho āhur yāny evāgniyonīni sāmāni tāni kāryāṇi . aśṛta iva vā eṣa yat sadyaḥkrīḥ . agnir vā aśṛtasya śrapayiteti . tad u vā āhur agniṣṭomasāmāny eva kāryāṇīti . etāni vā agniyonīni yad agniṣṭomasāmāni . tasmād agniṣṭomasāmāny eva kāryāṇīti . athaiṣa Die Ed .: kāryāṇy - ityathaiṣa . kṣiprāt kṣepīyān kṣiprāt kṣepīya svargaṃ lokaṃ gacchāmeti . tasya dvādaśa stotrāṇi bhavanti dvādaśa māsās saṃvatsaras saṃvatsara svargo loka svargasyaiva lokasya samaṣṭyai . tasya caturviṃśati stutaśastrāṇi bhavanti caturviṃśatyardhamāsas saṃvatsaraḥ .
sentences: sa trivr̥d ratʰantarasāmā bʰavati brahma vai trivr̥t .
brahma ratʰantaraṃ brahmaṇā svargaṃ lokaṃ gaccʰāmeti .
atʰo āhus trivr̥d eva br̥hatsāma syād iti .
brahmaṇā ca kṣatreṇa ca saṃyugbʰyāṃ svargaṃ lokaṃ gaccʰāmeti .
tad u vā āhus trivr̥d eva ratʰantasāmā syāt .
tasmiṃs trivr̥d eva ratʰantarasāmā syād iti .
tasminn āhur iyavanti sāmāni kāryāṇy iyavadbʰir vai devā svargaṃ lokam agaccʰann iyavadbʰi svargaṃ lokaṃ gaccʰāmeti .
atʰo āhur yāny evāgniyonīni sāmāni tāni kāryāṇi .
aśr̥ta iva vā eṣa yat sadyaḥkrīḥ .
tad u vā āhur agniṣṭomasāmāny eva kāryāṇīti .
atʰaiṣa Die Ed .: kāryāṇy - ityatʰaiṣa . kṣiprāt kṣepīyān kṣiprāt kṣepīya svargaṃ lokaṃ gaccʰāmeti .
tasya dvādaśa stotrāṇi bʰavanti dvādaśa māsās saṃvatsaras saṃvatsara svargo loka svargasyaiva lokasya samaṣṭyai .
tasya caturviṃśati stutaśastrāṇi bʰavanti caturviṃśatyardʰamāsas saṃvatsaraḥ .
text: It (the sacrifice) has the trivṛt (threefold) stoma with the rathantara sāman. Brahman is the trivṛt; brahman is the rathantara — 'By brahman may we go to the heavenly world.' And they say it should be trivṛt with the bṛhat sāman: 'Brahman is the trivṛt, kṣatra (ruling power) is the bṛhat — by both brahman and kṣatra conjoined may we go to the heavenly world.' But they also say it should be trivṛt with the rathantara sāman: 'Brahman is the trivṛt, brahman is the rathantara; brahman rules the heavenly world; therefore it should be trivṛt with the rathantara sāman.' They say a certain number of sāmans should be performed: 'With a certain number the gods went to the heavenly world; with that same number may we go to the heavenly world.' And they say: 'Only those sāmans that have their origin in Agni (agniyoni) should be performed. He who performs the sadyaḥkrī (one-day sacrifice) is, as it were, uncooked (aśṛta); Agni is the cooker of the uncooked.' But they also say: 'Only agniṣṭoma-sāmans should be performed, for the agniṣṭoma-sāmans are those that have their origin in Agni; therefore only agniṣṭoma-sāmans should be performed.' 'Swifter than the swift, swifter than the swift — may we go to the heavenly world.' It has twelve stotras — twelve months make a year, the year is the heavenly world — for the attainment of the heavenly world. It has twenty-four stuta-śastras — twenty-four half-months make a year.
meaning: स त्रिवृद् रथन्तरसामा भवति ब्रह्म वै त्रिवृत् . ब्रह्म रथन्तरं ब्रह्मणा स्वर्गं लोकं गच्छामेति . अथो आहुस् त्रिवृद् एव बृहत्साम स्याद् इति . ब्रह्म वै त्रिवृत् क्षत्रं बृहत् . ब्रह्मणा च क्षत्रेण च संयुग्भ्यां स्वर्गं लोकं गच्छामेति . तद् उ वा आहुस् त्रिवृद् एव रथन्तसामा स्यात् . ब्रह्म वै त्रिवृत् . ब्रह्म वै रथन्तरम् . ब्रह्म वै स्वर्गस्य लोकस्येशे . तस्मिंस् त्रिवृद् एव रथन्तरसामा स्याद् इति . तस्मिन्न् आहुर् इयवन्ति सामानि कार्याण्य् इयवद्भिर् वै देवा स्वर्गं लोकम् अगच्छन्न् इयवद्भि स्वर्गं लोकं गच्छामेति . अथो आहुर् यान्य् एवाग्नियोनीनि सामानि तानि कार्याणि . अशृत इव वा एष यत् सद्यःक्रीः . अग्निर् वा अशृतस्य श्रपयितेति . तद् उ वा आहुर् अग्निष्टोमसामान्य् एव कार्याणीति . एतानि वा अग्नियोनीनि यद् अग्निष्टोमसामानि . तस्माद् अग्निष्टोमसामान्य् एव कार्याणीति . अथैष Dइए Eद् .: कार्याण्य् - इत्यथैष . क्षिप्रात् क्षेपीयान् क्षिप्रात् क्षेपीय स्वर्गं लोकं गच्छामेति . तस्य द्वादश स्तोत्राणि भवन्ति द्वादश मासास् संवत्सरस् संवत्सर स्वर्गो लोक स्वर्गस्यैव लोकस्य समष्ट्यै . तस्य चतुर्विंशति स्तुतशस्त्राणि भवन्ति चतुर्विंशत्यर्धमासस् संवत्सरः .

sanskrit_iast: athaitāv anukriyau . ādityāś ca vā aṅgirasaś ca svarge loke 'spardhanta . ta ādityāḥ pūrve svargaṃ lokam agacchan . te 'ṅgiraso 'kāmayanta vayam api taṃ lokaṃ gacchema yam ādityā agmann iti . ta etaṃ yajñam apaśyan . tam eva santaṃ parokṣeṇaiva tam āharan . tenāyajanta . te val̥avām eva śvetāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ nītvādityais salokā abhavan . te haita ādityāś cāṅgirasaś ca salokāḥ . saloko ha vā ādityaiś cāṅgirobhiś ca bhavati ya evaṃ veda . atho āhur yasmād eva śreyān bhrātṛvya syāt so 'nena yajeteti . pūrvapreta iva ha vā eṣa ya śreyān . pūrvapretān iva vā etena te tān āpnuvan .
sentences: ādityāś ca vā aṅgirasaś ca svarge loke 'spardʰanta .
ta ādityāḥ pūrve svargaṃ lokam agaccʰan .
te 'ṅgiraso 'kāmayanta vayam api taṃ lokaṃ gaccʰema yam ādityā agmann iti .
tam eva santaṃ parokṣeṇaiva tam āharan .
te val̥avām eva śvetāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ nītvādityais salokā abʰavan .
te haita ādityāś cāṅgirasaś ca salokāḥ .
saloko ha vā ādityaiś cāṅgirobʰiś ca bʰavati ya evaṃ veda .
atʰo āhur yasmād eva śreyān bʰrātr̥vya syāt so 'nena yajeteti .
pūrvapreta iva ha vā eṣa ya śreyān .
pūrvapretān iva vā etena te tān āpnuvan .
text: Now these two are the anukriyas (imitative rites). The Ādityas and the Aṅgirasas competed in the heavenly world. The Ādityas went first to the heavenly world. The Aṅgirasas desired: 'May we too go to that world which the Ādityas reached.' They saw this sacrifice. They brought it, though it already existed, in a hidden manner. They sacrificed with it. Having led a white mare as the dakṣiṇā, they became co-dwellers with the Ādityas. So these Ādityas and Aṅgirasas share the same world. He who knows thus shares the same world with the Ādityas and Aṅgirasas. And they say: 'He from whom a superior rival (bhrātṛvya) arises — he should sacrifice with this.' For the superior one is, as it were, one who has died before. By this [sacrifice] they, as it were, reached those who had died before.
meaning: अथैताव् अनुक्रियौ . आदित्याश् च वा अङ्गिरसश् च स्वर्गे लोके ऽस्पर्धन्त . त आदित्याः पूर्वे स्वर्गं लोकम् अगच्छन् . ते ऽङ्गिरसो ऽकामयन्त वयम् अपि तं लोकं गच्छेम यम् आदित्या अग्मन्न् इति . त एतं यज्ञम् अपश्यन् . तम् एव सन्तं परोक्षेणैव तम् आहरन् . तेनायजन्त . ते वल्̥अवाम् एव श्वेतां दक्षिणां नीत्वादित्यैस् सलोका अभवन् . ते हैत आदित्याश् चाङ्गिरसश् च सलोकाः . सलोको ह वा आदित्यैश् चाङ्गिरोभिश् च भवति य एवं वेद . अथो आहुर् यस्माद् एव श्रेयान् भ्रातृव्य स्यात् सो ऽनेन यजेतेति . पूर्वप्रेत इव ह वा एष य श्रेयान् . पूर्वप्रेतान् इव वा एतेन ते तान् आप्नुवन् .

sanskrit_iast: godhūmorvarā vedir bhavati . sā hi purākṛtā bhavati . godhūmānām uttaravediḥ parokṣatāyai . khalevalā yūpa sphyāgro bhavaty aindraḥ . vijityai saha paśū ālabhante samaṣṭyai . strīgaus somakrayaṇī bhavati parokṣatāyai . kuṃbhyā vasatīvaryo bhavanti yaḥ purejānas tasya gṛhebhyaḥ . tā hi purāgṛhītā bhavanti . sarpiṣmantam aśitvā nipadyate . yam evāmuṃ dīkṣaṇīyam aśnāti sa evāsya so 'śito bhavati . priyāyai jāyāyā antarorū śete 'nipadyamānaḥ . tapasyam evāsya tad dhiraṇyam mukha ādhāya śete . satyaṃ vai hiraṇyam . satyam evāsya tad uditaṃ bhavati . rajataṃ bhavati parokṣatāyai . val̥avā śvetā dakṣiṇā bhavati parokṣatāyai . aśvatarīrathas somapravāko bhavati traipadaṃ paramaṃ parokṣatāyai . tasmin dadhidṛtir upāvahito bhavati . tasya yat sarpis saṃpatati tad ājyakuṃbhe 'vāsyanti . tad dhi sadyojam ivādhyardhakrośe 'dhyardhakrośa ṛtvijo vinihitā bhavanti . ta enaṃ prātar upasametya yājayanti . sa juhvat trir nimīlayati trir vīkṣate . tā eva dīkṣopasadaḥ . sa vā eṣo 'ṣṭādaśapavamāno bhavati . parokṣaṃ trivṛt . agniṣṭomayajñā vā ādityā ukthyayajñā aṅgirasaḥ . sa eṣa ukthyo nidānena sann agniṣṭomaḥ pratyāhriyate kṣipratāyai . athaiṣa caturviṃśapavamāno bhavati . parokṣaṃ trivṛd u eva .
sentences: kuṃbʰyā vasatīvaryo bʰavanti yaḥ purejānas tasya gr̥hebʰyaḥ .
yam evāmuṃ dīkṣaṇīyam aśnāti sa evāsya so 'śito bʰavati .
tapasyam evāsya tad dʰiraṇyam mukʰa ādʰāya śete .
aśvatarīratʰas somapravāko bʰavati traipadaṃ paramaṃ parokṣatāyai .
tasya yat sarpis saṃpatati tad ājyakuṃbʰe 'vāsyanti .
tad dʰi sadyojam ivādʰyardʰakrośe 'dʰyardʰakrośa r̥tvijo vinihitā bʰavanti .
sa juhvat trir nimīlayati trir vīkṣate .
sa eṣa uktʰyo nidānena sann agniṣṭomaḥ pratyāhriyate kṣipratāyai .
text: A wheat-field serves as the vedi (altar ground), for it is already prepared. Wheat [serves as] the uttaravedi, for the sake of hiddenness. A post made of khalevala wood, pointed like a sphya (wooden sword), belongs to Indra — for the sake of conquest. Animals are immolated together [with the soma], for the sake of completeness. A cow serves as the soma-purchasing [animal], for the sake of hiddenness. The vasatīvarī waters come from the house of whoever was born first — for they are already collected. Having eaten food mixed with ghee, he lies down. Whatever dīkṣaṇīya meal he eats — that counts as his eating. He lies between the thighs of his beloved wife, without actually lying down. As an act of tapas, he lies with gold placed in his mouth. Gold is truth; thus truth is spoken for him. Silver is [used] for the sake of hiddenness. A white mare is the dakṣiṇā, for the sake of hiddenness. A mule-chariot is used for the soma-procurement, one and a half [yojanas] at most, for the sake of hiddenness. Upon it a skin-bag of curds is placed. Whatever clarified butter collects from it, they pour into the ghee-pot. For [this sacrifice is performed] as if in a single day — the priests are stationed at one and a half krośas on each side. They come to him in the morning and make him sacrifice. While offering, he closes his eyes three times and opens them three times. Those are the dīkṣā and upasad days. This one has eighteen pavamāna [stotras]. The trivṛt is hidden. The Ādityas had agniṣṭoma sacrifices; the Aṅgirasas had ukthya sacrifices. This ukthya, though such by its connection, is turned back to an agniṣṭoma for the sake of swiftness. Then this one has twenty-four pavamāna [stotras]. The trivṛt is likewise hidden.
meaning: गोधूमोर्वरा वेदिर् भवति . सा हि पुराकृता भवति . गोधूमानाम् उत्तरवेदिः परोक्षतायै . खलेवला यूप स्फ्याग्रो भवत्य् ऐन्द्रः . विजित्यै सह पशू आलभन्ते समष्ट्यै . स्त्रीगौस् सोमक्रयणी भवति परोक्षतायै . कुंभ्या वसतीवर्यो भवन्ति यः पुरेजानस् तस्य गृहेभ्यः . ता हि पुरागृहीता भवन्ति . सर्पिष्मन्तम् अशित्वा निपद्यते . यम् एवामुं दीक्षणीयम् अश्नाति स एवास्य सो ऽशितो भवति . प्रियायै जायाया अन्तरोरू शेते ऽनिपद्यमानः . तपस्यम् एवास्य तद् धिरण्यम् मुख आधाय शेते . सत्यं वै हिरण्यम् . सत्यम् एवास्य तद् उदितं भवति . रजतं भवति परोक्षतायै . वल्̥अवा श्वेता दक्षिणा भवति परोक्षतायै . अश्वतरीरथस् सोमप्रवाको भवति त्रैपदं परमं परोक्षतायै . तस्मिन् दधिदृतिर् उपावहितो भवति . तस्य यत् सर्पिस् संपतति तद् आज्यकुंभे ऽवास्यन्ति . तद् धि सद्योजम् इवाध्यर्धक्रोशे ऽध्यर्धक्रोश ऋत्विजो विनिहिता भवन्ति . त एनं प्रातर् उपसमेत्य याजयन्ति . स जुह्वत् त्रिर् निमीलयति त्रिर् वीक्षते . ता एव दीक्षोपसदः . स वा एषो ऽष्टादशपवमानो भवति . परोक्षं त्रिवृत् . अग्निष्टोमयज्ञा वा आदित्या उक्थ्ययज्ञा अङ्गिरसः . स एष उक्थ्यो निदानेन सन्न् अग्निष्टोमः प्रत्याह्रियते क्षिप्रतायै . अथैष चतुर्विंशपवमानो भवति . परोक्षं त्रिवृद् उ एव .

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣa parikrīḥ . khaṇḍikaś ca haudbhāriḥ keśī ca dārbhyaḥ pāñcāleṣu paspṛdhāte . sa ha khaṇḍikaḥ keśinam abhiprajighāya . sadyaḥkriyā vai syo yakṣyata iti . atha haitena procya bhrātṛvyāya yajante . tasya haite brāhmaṇā āsur ahīnā āśvatthiḥ keśī sātyakāmir gaṅginā rāhakṣito luśākapiḥ khārgalir iti . te hainam upasameyuḥ . sa ha dhyāyan niṣasāda . taṃ hocuḥ kiṃ nu rājanyo dhyāyatīti . sa hovāca na hi me dhyeyam Dieselbe Ausdrucksweise in 2,100 (201 ,16f. ). yūyaṃ brāhmaṇā anubrūthādityāś cāṅgirasaś ca svarge loke 'spardhanta . ta ādityāḥ pūrve svargaṃ lokam agacchann ahīyantāṅgirasa iti .
sentences: kʰaṇḍikaś ca haudbʰāriḥ keśī ca dārbʰyaḥ pāñcāleṣu paspr̥dʰāte .
tasya haite brāhmaṇā āsur ahīnā āśvattʰiḥ keśī sātyakāmir gaṅginā rāhakṣito luśākapiḥ kʰārgalir iti .
taṃ hocuḥ kiṃ nu rājanyo dʰyāyatīti .
sa hovāca na hi me dʰyeyam Dieselbe Ausdrucksweise in 2,100 (201 ,16f. ).
yūyaṃ brāhmaṇā anubrūtʰādityāś cāṅgirasaś ca svarge loke 'spardʰanta .
ta ādityāḥ pūrve svargaṃ lokam agaccʰann ahīyantāṅgirasa iti .
text: Now this is the parikrī (surrounding purchase). Khaṇḍika Haudbhāri and Keśin Dārbhya competed among the Pañcālas. Khaṇḍika attacked Keśin [thinking]: 'He will sacrifice with the sadyaḥkrī (one-day rite).' Then, having declared this, they sacrifice against a rival. His brāhmaṇas were: Ahīna Āśvatthī, Keśin Sātyakāmi, Gaṅginā Rāhakṣita, Luśākapi, and Khārgali. They approached him. He sat down in thought. They said: 'Why does the rājanya sit thinking?' He said: 'I have reason indeed to think. You brāhmaṇas, tell me — the Ādityas and the Aṅgirasas competed in the heavenly world; the Ādityas went first to the heavenly world; the Aṅgirasas were left behind.'
meaning: अथैष परिक्रीः . खण्डिकश् च हौद्भारिः केशी च दार्भ्यः पाञ्चालेषु पस्पृधाते . स ह खण्डिकः केशिनम् अभिप्रजिघाय . सद्यःक्रिया वै स्यो यक्ष्यत इति . अथ हैतेन प्रोच्य भ्रातृव्याय यजन्ते . तस्य हैते ब्राह्मणा आसुर् अहीना आश्वत्थिः केशी सात्यकामिर् गङ्गिना राहक्षितो लुशाकपिः खार्गलिर् इति . ते हैनम् उपसमेयुः . स ह ध्यायन् निषसाद . तं होचुः किं नु राजन्यो ध्यायतीति . स होवाच न हि मे ध्येयम् Dइएसेल्बे Aउस्द्रुच्क्स्wएइसे इन् २,१०० (२०१ ,१६f. ). यूयं ब्राह्मणा अनुब्रूथादित्याश् चाङ्गिरसश् च स्वर्गे लोके ऽस्पर्धन्त . त आदित्याः पूर्वे स्वर्गं लोकम् अगच्छन्न् अहीयन्ताङ्गिरस इति .

sanskrit_iast: tam u vai māyaṃ khaṇḍiko 'bhiprāhaiṣīt sayaḥkriyā vai syo yakṣyata iti . sa eva nūnaṃ bhaviṣyati parā syo bhaviṣyatīty evaitad dhyāyāmīti . taṃ hocuḥ parikrīr iti vā ayaṃ yajñakratur asti . tena tvā yājayāmeti . tatheti . tena hainaṃ yājayāṃ cakruḥ . tasya vā etasya tṛcasya tṛcasyaikaikayā stuvanti . brahma vai prathamā stotriyā kṣatraṃ dvitīyā viṭ tṛtīyā . avalamba u ha vai brahmaṇaḥ kṣatraṃ ca viṭ ca . kṣatraṃ co ha vai viśaṃ cānu bhrātṛvyalokaḥ . sa ye dve avaciccheda bhrātṛvyalokam eva tad avaciccheda . ātmā vai prathamā stotriyā jāyā dvitīyā prajā tṛtīyā . avalamba u ha vā ātmano jāyā ca prajā ca . jāyāṃ co ha vai prajāṃ cānu bhrātṛvyalokaḥ .
sentences: tam u vai māyaṃ kʰaṇḍiko 'bʰiprāhaiṣīt sayaḥkriyā vai syo yakṣyata iti .
sa eva nūnaṃ bʰaviṣyati parā syo bʰaviṣyatīty evaitad dʰyāyāmīti .
taṃ hocuḥ parikrīr iti vā ayaṃ yajñakratur asti .
tasya vā etasya tr̥casya tr̥casyaikaikayā stuvanti .
brahma vai pratʰamā stotriyā kṣatraṃ dvitīyā viṭ tr̥tīyā .
avalamba u ha vai brahmaṇaḥ kṣatraṃ ca viṭ ca .
kṣatraṃ co ha vai viśaṃ cānu bʰrātr̥vyalokaḥ .
sa ye dve avaciccʰeda bʰrātr̥vyalokam eva tad avaciccʰeda .
ātmā vai pratʰamā stotriyā jāyā dvitīyā prajā tr̥tīyā .
avalamba u ha vā ātmano jāyā ca prajā ca .
jāyāṃ co ha vai prajāṃ cānu bʰrātr̥vyalokaḥ .
text: 'This Khaṇḍika has attacked me [thinking]: "He will sacrifice with the sadyaḥkrī." He will now become [successful], and I shall be finished — this is what I am thinking about.' They said to him: 'There is a sacrificial rite called parikrī. With that we shall make you sacrifice.' 'So be it.' They made him sacrifice with it. Of that [rite], with each ṛc of each tṛca they chant. The first stotriyā is brahman, the second is kṣatra, the third is viś (the people). Kṣatra and viś indeed depend upon brahman. And the rival's domain follows kṣatra and viś. By cutting off the two [latter], he cut off the rival's domain. The first stotriyā is the self, the second is the wife, the third is offspring. Wife and offspring indeed depend upon the self. And the rival's domain follows wife and offspring.
meaning: तम् उ वै मायं खण्डिको ऽभिप्राहैषीत् सयःक्रिया वै स्यो यक्ष्यत इति . स एव नूनं भविष्यति परा स्यो भविष्यतीत्य् एवैतद् ध्यायामीति . तं होचुः परिक्रीर् इति वा अयं यज्ञक्रतुर् अस्ति . तेन त्वा याजयामेति . तथेति . तेन हैनं याजयां चक्रुः . तस्य वा एतस्य तृचस्य तृचस्यैकैकया स्तुवन्ति . ब्रह्म वै प्रथमा स्तोत्रिया क्षत्रं द्वितीया विट् तृतीया . अवलम्ब उ ह वै ब्रह्मणः क्षत्रं च विट् च . क्षत्रं चो ह वै विशं चानु भ्रातृव्यलोकः . स ये द्वे अवचिच्छेद भ्रातृव्यलोकम् एव तद् अवचिच्छेद . आत्मा वै प्रथमा स्तोत्रिया जाया द्वितीया प्रजा तृतीया . अवलम्ब उ ह वा आत्मनो जाया च प्रजा च . जायां चो ह वै प्रजां चानु भ्रातृव्यलोकः .

sanskrit_iast: tato vai sa khaṇḍikaṃ niḥsārayāṃ cakāra . tato vai keśī dārbhyo 'bhavat parā khaṇḍikaḥ . bhavaty ātmanā parāsya dviṣan bhrātṛvyo bhavati ya evaṃ veda . tasya tisṛṣu bahiṣpavamānaṃ bhavati catasṛṣv ājyāni pañcasu mādhyaṃdinaḥ pavamānaś catasṛṣu pṛṣṭhāni saptasv ārbhavaḥ pavamāna ekasyām agniṣṭomasāma . tāś caturviṃśati stotryās saṃpadyante . caturviṃśatyardhamāsas saṃvatsaraḥ . saṃvatsarād eva tat khaṇḍikam audbhāriṃ keśī dārbhyo nunude saṃvatsarād antariyāya .
sentences: tato vai sa kʰaṇḍikaṃ niḥsārayāṃ cakāra .
tato vai keśī dārbʰyo 'bʰavat parā kʰaṇḍikaḥ .
bʰavaty ātmanā parāsya dviṣan bʰrātr̥vyo bʰavati ya evaṃ veda .
tasya tisr̥ṣu bahiṣpavamānaṃ bʰavati catasr̥ṣv ājyāni pañcasu mādʰyaṃdinaḥ pavamānaś catasr̥ṣu pr̥ṣṭʰāni saptasv ārbʰavaḥ pavamāna ekasyām agniṣṭomasāma .
saṃvatsarād eva tat kʰaṇḍikam audbʰāriṃ keśī dārbʰyo nunude saṃvatsarād antariyāya .
text: Then he drove Khaṇḍika out. Thus Keśin Dārbhya prevailed, and Khaṇḍika perished. He prevails by his own self, and his hateful rival perishes — he who knows thus. Of it, the bahiṣpavamāna is in three [stotriyas], the ājyas in four, the mādhyaṃdina pavamāna in five, the pṛṣṭhas in four, the ārbhava pavamāna in seven, the agniṣṭoma-sāman in one. Those amount to twenty-four stotriyas. Twenty-four half-months make a year. From the year itself Keśin Dārbhya expelled Khaṇḍika Haudbhāri; from the year he excluded him.
meaning: ततो वै स खण्डिकं निःसारयां चकार . ततो वै केशी दार्भ्यो ऽभवत् परा खण्डिकः . भवत्य् आत्मना परास्य द्विषन् भ्रातृव्यो भवति य एवं वेद . तस्य तिसृषु बहिष्पवमानं भवति चतसृष्व् आज्यानि पञ्चसु माध्यंदिनः पवमानश् चतसृषु पृष्ठानि सप्तस्व् आर्भवः पवमान एकस्याम् अग्निष्टोमसाम . ताश् चतुर्विंशति स्तोत्र्यास् संपद्यन्ते . चतुर्विंशत्यर्धमासस् संवत्सरः . संवत्सराद् एव तत् खण्डिकम् औद्भारिं केशी दार्भ्यो नुनुदे संवत्सराद् अन्तरियाय .

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣa ekatrikaḥ . prajananakāmo haitena yajeta . prajāpatir vā akāmayata bahuḥ prajayā paśubhiḥ prajāyeyemāṃ vyaṣṭiṃ vyaśnuvīyeti . sa etaṃ yajñam apaśyat . tam āharat . tenāyajata . sa aikṣata kena stuvīyeti . sa ātmānam apaśyat . tenāstuta sa aikṣata kena nveva stuvīyeti . sa prāṇāpānavyānān apaśyat . tair astuta . sa ātmanā sa prāṇāpānavyānais sa ātmanā sa prāṇāpānavyānais sa evam eva viparyāsaṃ yajñaṃ samasthāpayat . tato vai sa bahuḥ prajayā paśubhiḥ prājāyatemāṃ Die Ed . ohne Augment . vyaṣṭiṃ vyāśnuta yāsyeyam .
sentences: prajāpatir vā akāmayata bahuḥ prajayā paśubʰiḥ prajāyeyemāṃ vyaṣṭiṃ vyaśnuvīyeti .
tenāstuta sa aikṣata kena nveva stuvīyeti .
sa ātmanā sa prāṇāpānavyānais sa ātmanā sa prāṇāpānavyānais sa evam eva viparyāsaṃ yajñaṃ samastʰāpayat .
tato vai sa bahuḥ prajayā paśubʰiḥ prājāyatemāṃ Die Ed . ohne Augment . vyaṣṭiṃ vyāśnuta yāsyeyam .
text: Now this is the ekatrika. One desiring offspring should sacrifice with this. Prajāpati desired: 'May I be abundant in offspring and cattle; may I attain this fulfillment.' He saw this sacrifice. He brought it. He sacrificed with it. He considered: 'With what shall I chant?' He saw his own self. With that he chanted. He considered: 'With what else shall I chant?' He saw prāṇa, apāna, and vyāna. With those he chanted. With the self, then with prāṇa, apāna, and vyāna, then with the self, then with prāṇa, apāna, and vyāna — thus he established the sacrifice in alternation. Then he became abundant in offspring and cattle, and attained this fulfillment, which is his.
meaning: अथैष एकत्रिकः . प्रजननकामो हैतेन यजेत . प्रजापतिर् वा अकामयत बहुः प्रजया पशुभिः प्रजायेयेमां व्यष्टिं व्यश्नुवीयेति . स एतं यज्ञम् अपश्यत् . तम् आहरत् . तेनायजत . स ऐक्षत केन स्तुवीयेति . स आत्मानम् अपश्यत् . तेनास्तुत स ऐक्षत केन न्वेव स्तुवीयेति . स प्राणापानव्यानान् अपश्यत् . तैर् अस्तुत . स आत्मना स प्राणापानव्यानैस् स आत्मना स प्राणापानव्यानैस् स एवम् एव विपर्यासं यज्ञं समस्थापयत् . ततो वै स बहुः प्रजया पशुभिः प्राजायतेमां Dइए Eद् . ओह्ने Aउग्मेन्त् . व्यष्टिं व्याश्नुत यास्येयम् .
