sanskrit_iast: tena haitenodaraś śāṇḍilya iyakṣāṃ cakre . tasya ha manasy evāsa ekatrikeṇa yajeyeti . na ha tu kasmai canovāca . atha hāsya jāyā gandharviṇy āsa . tāṃ hāyaṃ gandharva upanyeyāya . tāṃ hovācaikatrika iti vai yajñakratur dāruṇa ivāsti . tena vai te patir yakṣyata iti . sā heyaṃ patiṃ papracchaikatrika iti vai yajñakratur dāruṇa ivāsti . satyaṃ tvaṃ tena yakṣyasā3 iti . sa hovāca yad aham idam naiva kasmai canāvocaṃ manasy eva me 'bhūt kas ta idam avocad iti . yo māyaṃ gandharva upanyaitīti . taṃ vai tvaṃ pṛcchatād iti hovāca . yaṣṭavyaṃ tenā3 na yaṣṭavyā3m iti . taṃ ha papraccha yaṣṭavyaṃ tenā3 na yaṣṭavyā3m iti . sa hovāca yathā vā enaṃ sa vedaivam enaṃ vayaṃ vidmaḥ . yas tv asyetthaṃ stotraṃ vidyāt sa enena yajeteti yathainenādaḥ prajāpatis tuṣṭuve .
sentences: tasya ha manasy evāsa ekatrikeṇa yajeyeti .
tāṃ hovācaikatrika iti vai yajñakratur dāruṇa ivāsti .
tena vai te patir yakṣyata iti .
sā heyaṃ patiṃ papraccʰaikatrika iti vai yajñakratur dāruṇa ivāsti .
sa hovāca yad aham idam naiva kasmai canāvocaṃ manasy eva me 'bʰūt kas ta idam avocad iti .
taṃ vai tvaṃ pr̥ccʰatād iti hovāca .
taṃ ha papraccʰa yaṣṭavyaṃ tenā3 na yaṣṭavyā3m iti .
sa hovāca yatʰā vā enaṃ sa vedaivam enaṃ vayaṃ vidmaḥ .
yas tv asyettʰaṃ stotraṃ vidyāt sa enena yajeteti yatʰainenādaḥ prajāpatis tuṣṭuve .
text: Udara Śāṇḍilya wished to sacrifice with this. It was in his mind: 'I should sacrifice with the ekatrika.' But he told no one. Now his wife was possessed by a gandharva. That gandharva approached her. He said to her: 'There is a sacrificial rite called ekatrika which is, as it were, dangerous. Your husband is going to sacrifice with it.' She asked her husband: 'There is a sacrificial rite called ekatrika which is, as it were, dangerous. Is it true that you will sacrifice with it?' He said: 'This was only in my mind — I told no one. Who told you this?' 'The gandharva who visits me.' He said: 'You should ask him: should one sacrifice with it or not?' She asked him: 'Should one sacrifice with it or not?' He said: 'We know it just as he knows it. But one who would know the proper manner of its chanting — he should sacrifice with it' — that is, in the way Prajāpati chanted with it.
meaning: तेन हैतेनोदरश् शाण्डिल्य इयक्षां चक्रे . तस्य ह मनस्य् एवास एकत्रिकेण यजेयेति . न ह तु कस्मै चनोवाच . अथ हास्य जाया गन्धर्विण्य् आस . तां हायं गन्धर्व उपन्येयाय . तां होवाचैकत्रिक इति वै यज्ञक्रतुर् दारुण इवास्ति . तेन वै ते पतिर् यक्ष्यत इति . सा हेयं पतिं पप्रच्छैकत्रिक इति वै यज्ञक्रतुर् दारुण इवास्ति . सत्यं त्वं तेन यक्ष्यसा३ इति . स होवाच यद् अहम् इदम् नैव कस्मै चनावोचं मनस्य् एव मे ऽभूत् कस् त इदम् अवोचद् इति . यो मायं गन्धर्व उपन्यैतीति . तं वै त्वं पृच्छताद् इति होवाच . यष्टव्यं तेना३ न यष्टव्या३म् इति . तं ह पप्रच्छ यष्टव्यं तेना३ न यष्टव्या३म् इति . स होवाच यथा वा एनं स वेदैवम् एनं वयं विद्मः . यस् त्व् अस्येत्थं स्तोत्रं विद्यात् स एनेन यजेतेति यथैनेनादः प्रजापतिस् तुष्टुवे .

sanskrit_iast: śaśvad dhodaraś śāṇḍilyas tenaiva paṇāyyatāṃ jagāma yad asya manasy evāsaikatrikeṇa yajeyeti . sa vā eṣo 'nyatara iva yajñakratus supaṇāyyo vaineneṣṭvā bhavati supāpīyān vā . tasyaikasyāṃ bahiṣpavamānaṃ saṃpadyate upāsmai gāyatā nara iti . tisṛṣu mādhyaṃdinaḥ pavamāno gāyatram eva gāyatryām utsedhas satobṛhatyām saivel̥ā tan nidhanam āuśanam eva triṣṭubhi . etasyām ārbhavaḥ pavamāno 'yā rucā hariṇyā punāna iti . etasyām aticchandasi gāyatrapārśvam . sa eva svaras tan nidhanam . saptapadā bhavati . sapta vai chandāṃsi . aticchandā vai sarvāṇi chandāṃsy abhibhavati . tad asya tat sarvāṇy eva chandāṃsy upetāni bhavanti . tad āhuḥ pañcanidhanam eva vāmadevyaṃ kāryam . pañcachandā ārbhavaḥ pavamānas saptasāmā . yad aha pañcanidhanāni tena chandāṃsi prati vibhavati . yad u vai saptapadā tena sāmāny atreva vibhavatīti . tad u vā āhur gāyatrapārśvam eva kāryam . sa eva svaras tan nidhanam . ātmā vai svaraḥ prajā nidhanam . etad eva samṛddhataram iva yad gāyatrapārśvam . tasmād gāyatrapārśvam eva kāryam iti . tāś caturviṃśati stotryās saṃpadyante . caturviṃśatyardhamāsas saṃvatsaraḥ . saṃvatsaraḥ prajananam .
sentences: śaśvad dʰodaraś śāṇḍilyas tenaiva paṇāyyatāṃ jagāma yad asya manasy evāsaikatrikeṇa yajeyeti .
sa vā eṣo 'nyatara iva yajñakratus supaṇāyyo vaineneṣṭvā bʰavati supāpīyān vā .
tasyaikasyāṃ bahiṣpavamānaṃ saṃpadyate upāsmai gāyatā nara iti .
tisr̥ṣu mādʰyaṃdinaḥ pavamāno gāyatram eva gāyatryām utsedʰas satobr̥hatyām saivel̥ā tan nidʰanam āuśanam eva triṣṭubʰi .
etasyām ārbʰavaḥ pavamāno 'yā rucā hariṇyā punāna iti .
tad asya tat sarvāṇy eva cʰandāṃsy upetāni bʰavanti .
tad āhuḥ pañcanidʰanam eva vāmadevyaṃ kāryam .
yad aha pañcanidʰanāni tena cʰandāṃsi prati vibʰavati .
yad u vai saptapadā tena sāmāny atreva vibʰavatīti .
tad u vā āhur gāyatrapārśvam eva kāryam .
etad eva samr̥ddʰataram iva yad gāyatrapārśvam .
text: Udara Śāṇḍilya continued to wander about seeking instruction, since it was in his mind: 'I should sacrifice with the ekatrika.' This sacrificial rite is, as it were, of a double nature — having sacrificed with it, one either becomes exceedingly prosperous or exceedingly wretched. Of it, the bahiṣpavamāna is obtained in one [stotriyā]: 'Sing unto him, O men' (upāsmai gāyata nara). The mādhyaṃdina pavamāna is in three [stotriyas]: the gāyatra [tune] in the gāyatrī [metre]; the crescendo (utsedha) in the satobṛhatī; the same melody, that is the nidhana; the auśana in the triṣṭubh. The ārbhava pavamāna is in this [stotriyā]: 'With this radiance, O golden one, purify' (ayā rucā hariṇyā punāna). In this aticchandas the gāyatrapārśva [is used]. That same svara is the nidhana. It has seven feet (saptapadā). Seven are the metres. The aticchandas indeed surpasses all metres; thus all the metres are attained by it. They say: 'The vāmadevya should be made with five nidhanas. The ārbhava pavamāna has five metres and seven sāmans. By making five nidhanas, one distributes the metres; by the seven feet, one distributes the sāmans right there.' But they also say: 'Only the gāyatrapārśva should be used. That same svara is the nidhana. The self is the svara; offspring is the nidhana. The gāyatrapārśva is, as it were, more complete. Therefore only the gāyatrapārśva should be used.' Those amount to twenty-four stotriyas. Twenty-four half-months make a year. The year is procreation.
meaning: शश्वद् धोदरश् शाण्डिल्यस् तेनैव पणाय्यतां जगाम यद् अस्य मनस्य् एवासैकत्रिकेण यजेयेति . स वा एषो ऽन्यतर इव यज्ञक्रतुस् सुपणाय्यो वैनेनेष्ट्वा भवति सुपापीयान् वा . तस्यैकस्यां बहिष्पवमानं संपद्यते उपास्मै गायता नर इति . तिसृषु माध्यंदिनः पवमानो गायत्रम् एव गायत्र्याम् उत्सेधस् सतोबृहत्याम् सैवेल्̥आ तन् निधनम् आउशनम् एव त्रिष्टुभि . एतस्याम् आर्भवः पवमानो ऽया रुचा हरिण्या पुनान इति . एतस्याम् अतिच्छन्दसि गायत्रपार्श्वम् . स एव स्वरस् तन् निधनम् . सप्तपदा भवति . सप्त वै छन्दांसि . अतिच्छन्दा वै सर्वाणि छन्दांस्य् अभिभवति . तद् अस्य तत् सर्वाण्य् एव छन्दांस्य् उपेतानि भवन्ति . तद् आहुः पञ्चनिधनम् एव वामदेव्यं कार्यम् . पञ्चछन्दा आर्भवः पवमानस् सप्तसामा . यद् अह पञ्चनिधनानि तेन छन्दांसि प्रति विभवति . यद् उ वै सप्तपदा तेन सामान्य् अत्रेव विभवतीति . तद् उ वा आहुर् गायत्रपार्श्वम् एव कार्यम् . स एव स्वरस् तन् निधनम् . आत्मा वै स्वरः प्रजा निधनम् . एतद् एव समृद्धतरम् इव यद् गायत्रपार्श्वम् . तस्माद् गायत्रपार्श्वम् एव कार्यम् इति . ताश् चतुर्विंशति स्तोत्र्यास् संपद्यन्ते . चतुर्विंशत्यर्धमासस् संवत्सरः . संवत्सरः प्रजननम् .

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣa bṛhaspatisavaḥ . prajāpatiḥ prajās sasṛjānas sa vyasraṃsata . so 'nnaṃ bhūto 'śayat . tasya sarve devā mamatvina āsan mama mameti . te 'bruvan vīdaṃ bhajāmahā iti . tasya vibhāge na samapādayan . te 'bruvan ājim asyāyāmeti . ta ājim āyan . sa bṛhaspatir ājisaraṇaṃ panthānam apaśyat . sa pūrvaḥ parītya rathena vṛtvātiṣṭhat . te devās tan nāvindan yenātyasariṣyan . śaśvad dha yāvān eva rathayānāya tāvān ājir āsa . tato vai sa tam ājim udajayat . yad bṛhaspatir udajayat tasmād bṛhaspatisavaḥ . tam ājim ujjigivāṃsam indro 'bravīt puras tvā dadhe . mām anena yajñena yājayeti . tatheti . taṃ puro 'dhatta . tenainam ayājayat . tato vā indras sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ śraiṣṭhyam agacchat . gacchati svānāṃ śraiṣṭhyaṃ ya evaṃ veda . sa vā eṣa dvayor eva yajño brāhmaṇasya caiva rājanyasya ca . yad bṛhasoatir udajayat tena brāhmaṇasya . yad indro 'yajata teno rājanyasya . sa u hendrasyaivaikasya purohita āsa netareṣāṃ devānām . so 'kāmayata sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ purodhāṃ gaccheyam iti . sa etenaiva yajñenāyajata . tato vai sa sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ purodhām agacchat .
sentences: tasya sarve devā mamatvina āsan mama mameti .
śaśvad dʰa yāvān eva ratʰayānāya tāvān ājir āsa .
tato vai sa tam ājim udajayat .
tam ājim ujjigivāṃsam indro 'bravīt puras tvā dadʰe .
tato vā indras sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ śraiṣṭʰyam agaccʰat .
gaccʰati svānāṃ śraiṣṭʰyaṃ ya evaṃ veda .
sa vā eṣa dvayor eva yajño brāhmaṇasya caiva rājanyasya ca .
sa u hendrasyaivaikasya purohita āsa netareṣāṃ devānām .
so 'kāmayata sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ purodʰāṃ gaccʰeyam iti .
tato vai sa sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ purodʰām agaccʰat .
text: Now this is the bṛhaspatisava. Prajāpati, having created creatures, collapsed. Having become food, he lay down. All the gods claimed ownership of him, [each saying] 'mine, mine!' They said: 'Let us divide this.' In dividing him they could not agree. They said: 'Let us run a race for him.' They ran a race. Bṛhaspati saw the path for the race-course. Having gone around first, he stood blocking [the way] with his chariot. The gods could not find [a way] by which they could overtake him. The race was always as long as the chariot-course. Thus he won that race. Because Bṛhaspati won (udajayat), it is called the bṛhaspatisava. Indra said to him, the winner of the race: 'I place you foremost. Make me sacrifice with this rite.' 'So be it.' He placed him foremost. He made him sacrifice with it. Then Indra attained supremacy over all the gods. He attains supremacy over his own people who knows thus. This sacrifice is indeed for two only — for a brāhmaṇa and for a rājanya (kṣatriya). Because Bṛhaspati won, it belongs to the brāhmaṇa. Because Indra sacrificed, it belongs to the rājanya. Now he (Bṛhaspati) was the purohita of Indra alone, not of the other gods. He desired: 'May I attain the position of purohita of all the gods.' He sacrificed with this very sacrifice. Then he attained the position of purohita of all the gods.
meaning: अथैष बृहस्पतिसवः . प्रजापतिः प्रजास् ससृजानस् स व्यस्रंसत . सो ऽन्नं भूतो ऽशयत् . तस्य सर्वे देवा ममत्विन आसन् मम ममेति . ते ऽब्रुवन् वीदं भजामहा इति . तस्य विभागे न समपादयन् . ते ऽब्रुवन् आजिम् अस्यायामेति . त आजिम् आयन् . स बृहस्पतिर् आजिसरणं पन्थानम् अपश्यत् . स पूर्वः परीत्य रथेन वृत्वातिष्ठत् . ते देवास् तन् नाविन्दन् येनात्यसरिष्यन् . शश्वद् ध यावान् एव रथयानाय तावान् आजिर् आस . ततो वै स तम् आजिम् उदजयत् . यद् बृहस्पतिर् उदजयत् तस्माद् बृहस्पतिसवः . तम् आजिम् उज्जिगिवांसम् इन्द्रो ऽब्रवीत् पुरस् त्वा दधे . माम् अनेन यज्ञेन याजयेति . तथेति . तं पुरो ऽधत्त . तेनैनम् अयाजयत् . ततो वा इन्द्रस् सर्वेषां देवानां श्रैष्ठ्यम् अगच्छत् . गच्छति स्वानां श्रैष्ठ्यं य एवं वेद . स वा एष द्वयोर् एव यज्ञो ब्राह्मणस्य चैव राजन्यस्य च . यद् बृहसोअतिर् उदजयत् तेन ब्राह्मणस्य . यद् इन्द्रो ऽयजत तेनो राजन्यस्य . स उ हेन्द्रस्यैवैकस्य पुरोहित आस नेतरेषां देवानाम् . सो ऽकामयत सर्वेषां देवानां पुरोधां गच्छेयम् इति . स एतेनैव यज्ञेनायजत . ततो वै स सर्वेषां देवानां पुरोधाम् अगच्छत् .

sanskrit_iast: sa trivṛd rathantarasāmā bhavati . brahma vai trivṛd brahma rathantaram . brahmaṇā vāva sa tad brahmavarcasam ārdhnot . brahmaṇaiva brahmavarcasam ṛdhnoti ya evaṃ veda . tasya trayastriṃśad dakṣiṇā bhavanti . trayastriṃśad vai devatāḥ . devatānām eva purodhām āśnuta . aśvaś catustriṃśaḥ . prajāpater vā etad rūpaṃ yad aśvaḥ . saprajāpatikānām eva tena devatānāṃ purodhām āśnuta . tasyaitā yathāpūrvam anusavanaṃ dakṣiṇā dadāty aṣṭau prātassavane dadāty ekādaśa mādhyaṃdine savane dvādaśa tṛtīyasavane 'nūbaṃdhyāyām ekām udavasānīyāyām ekām . anusavanam aśvaṃ tṛtīyaśaḥ . tad yā aṣṭau prātassavane dadāty aṣṭau vasavo vasūnām eva purodhām āśnuta . atha yā ekādaśa mādhyaṃdine savan ekādaśa rudrā rudrāṇām eva tena purodhām āśnuta . atha yā dvādaśa tṛtīyasavane dvādaśādityā ādityānām eva tena purodhām āśnuta . atha yām anūbaṃdhyāyām ekāṃ mitrāvaruṇayor eva tena purodhām āśnuta . atha yām udavasānīyāyām ekāṃ karma karma me dakṣiṇāvad asad iti .
sentences: brahmaṇā vāva sa tad brahmavarcasam ārdʰnot .
brahmaṇaiva brahmavarcasam r̥dʰnoti ya evaṃ veda .
prajāpater vā etad rūpaṃ yad aśvaḥ .
saprajāpatikānām eva tena devatānāṃ purodʰām āśnuta .
tasyaitā yatʰāpūrvam anusavanaṃ dakṣiṇā dadāty aṣṭau prātassavane dadāty ekādaśa mādʰyaṃdine savane dvādaśa tr̥tīyasavane 'nūbaṃdʰyāyām ekām udavasānīyāyām ekām .
tad yā aṣṭau prātassavane dadāty aṣṭau vasavo vasūnām eva purodʰām āśnuta .
atʰa yā ekādaśa mādʰyaṃdine savan ekādaśa rudrā rudrāṇām eva tena purodʰām āśnuta .
atʰa yā dvādaśa tr̥tīyasavane dvādaśādityā ādityānām eva tena purodʰām āśnuta .
atʰa yām anūbaṃdʰyāyām ekāṃ mitrāvaruṇayor eva tena purodʰām āśnuta .
atʰa yām udavasānīyāyām ekāṃ karma karma me dakṣiṇāvad asad iti .
text: It has the trivṛt (threefold) stoma with the rathantara sāman. Brahman is the trivṛt; brahman is the rathantara. By brahman he achieved that brahmavarcas (brilliance of sacred knowledge). By brahman one achieves brahmavarcas — he who knows thus. Its dakṣiṇās (gifts) are thirty-three. Thirty-three are the deities; thus he attains the position of purohita among the deities. The horse is the thirty-fourth. The horse is the form of Prajāpati. By that he attains the position of purohita among the deities including Prajāpati. He gives these dakṣiṇās in order, pressing by pressing: he gives eight at the morning pressing, eleven at the midday pressing, twelve at the third pressing, one at the anūbandhyā, and one at the udavasānīya. The horse [is given] at each pressing, a third [each time]. The eight he gives at the morning pressing — eight are the Vasus; thus he attains the position of purohita among the Vasus. The eleven at the midday pressing — eleven are the Rudras; thus he attains the position of purohita among the Rudras. The twelve at the third pressing — twelve are the Ādityas; thus he attains the position of purohita among the Ādityas. The one at the anūbandhyā — by that he attains the position of purohita of Mitra and Varuṇa. The one at the udavasānīya — 'May every rite of mine be accompanied by a dakṣiṇā.'
meaning: स त्रिवृद् रथन्तरसामा भवति . ब्रह्म वै त्रिवृद् ब्रह्म रथन्तरम् . ब्रह्मणा वाव स तद् ब्रह्मवर्चसम् आर्ध्नोत् . ब्रह्मणैव ब्रह्मवर्चसम् ऋध्नोति य एवं वेद . तस्य त्रयस्त्रिंशद् दक्षिणा भवन्ति . त्रयस्त्रिंशद् वै देवताः . देवतानाम् एव पुरोधाम् आश्नुत . अश्वश् चतुस्त्रिंशः . प्रजापतेर् वा एतद् रूपं यद् अश्वः . सप्रजापतिकानाम् एव तेन देवतानां पुरोधाम् आश्नुत . तस्यैता यथापूर्वम् अनुसवनं दक्षिणा ददात्य् अष्टौ प्रातस्सवने ददात्य् एकादश माध्यंदिने सवने द्वादश तृतीयसवने ऽनूबंध्यायाम् एकाम् उदवसानीयायाम् एकाम् . अनुसवनम् अश्वं तृतीयशः . तद् या अष्टौ प्रातस्सवने ददात्य् अष्टौ वसवो वसूनाम् एव पुरोधाम् आश्नुत . अथ या एकादश माध्यंदिने सवन् एकादश रुद्रा रुद्राणाम् एव तेन पुरोधाम् आश्नुत . अथ या द्वादश तृतीयसवने द्वादशादित्या आदित्यानाम् एव तेन पुरोधाम् आश्नुत . अथ याम् अनूबंध्यायाम् एकां मित्रावरुणयोर् एव तेन पुरोधाम् आश्नुत . अथ याम् उदवसानीयायाम् एकां कर्म कर्म मे दक्षिणावद् असद् इति .

sanskrit_iast: tad āhur manasaiva prātassavane dadyān manasā tṛtīyasavane mādhyaṃdina eva savane dadyād iti . tad u vā āhur atīrthaṃ vai prātasavanaṃ dakṣiṇānām atīrthaṃ tṛtīyasavanam . mādhyaṃdina eva savane dadyāt . tad eva tīrthaṃ tad āyatanam . naivetarayoḥ savanayor manasā cana dadad ādriyeteti . brahmaṇe 'śvaṃ dadāti . brahmaṇo hy evaikadakṣiṇā . tad yadā mādhyaṃdinīyāś camasāḥ pratiṣṭherann atha jaghanenāhavanīyaṃ prācīnagrīvaṃ kṛṣṇājinam upastṛṇīteti brūyād udīcīnagrīvaṃ vā . tad yajamāna āste sa hutānāṃ camasānām unmārṣṭi devasya tvā savituḥ prasave 'śvinor bāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ sarasvatyai tvā vāco yantur yantreṇa bṛhaspates tvā sāmrājyena brahmaṇābhiṣiñcāmī ti . mukhaṃ vimārṣṭi . sa somābhiṣiktas tejasvī brahmavarcasī bhavati .
sentences: tad āhur manasaiva prātassavane dadyān manasā tr̥tīyasavane mādʰyaṃdina eva savane dadyād iti .
tad u vā āhur atīrtʰaṃ vai prātasavanaṃ dakṣiṇānām atīrtʰaṃ tr̥tīyasavanam .
naivetarayoḥ savanayor manasā cana dadad ādriyeteti .
tad yadā mādʰyaṃdinīyāś camasāḥ pratiṣṭʰerann atʰa jagʰanenāhavanīyaṃ prācīnagrīvaṃ kr̥ṣṇājinam upastr̥ṇīteti brūyād udīcīnagrīvaṃ vā .
tad yajamāna āste sa hutānāṃ camasānām unmārṣṭi devasya tvā savituḥ prasave 'śvinor bāhubʰyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābʰyāṃ sarasvatyai tvā vāco yantur yantreṇa br̥haspates tvā sāmrājyena brahmaṇābʰiṣiñcāmī ti .
text: They say: 'He should give at the morning pressing only in thought, and at the third pressing in thought; he should actually give at the midday pressing.' But they also say: 'The morning pressing is not the proper occasion (tīrtha) for dakṣiṇās, nor is the third pressing. He should give at the midday pressing alone; that is the proper occasion, that is the foundation. He should not even in thought give at the other two pressings.' He gives the horse to the brahman-priest, for the horse is the single dakṣiṇā of the brahman. When the midday cups have been set down, he should say: 'Spread a black antelope skin south of the āhavanīya fire, with the neck pointing east' — or 'with the neck pointing north.' The sacrificer sits on it and wipes the offered cups: 'By the impulse of the god Savitṛ, with the arms of the Aśvins, with the hands of Pūṣan, with Sarasvatī's restraint of speech, the restraining one, with the sovereign power of Bṛhaspati, with brahman I anoint you.' He wipes his face. He who is anointed with soma becomes radiant and full of brahmavarcas.
meaning: तद् आहुर् मनसैव प्रातस्सवने दद्यान् मनसा तृतीयसवने माध्यंदिन एव सवने दद्याद् इति . तद् उ वा आहुर् अतीर्थं वै प्रातसवनं दक्षिणानाम् अतीर्थं तृतीयसवनम् . माध्यंदिन एव सवने दद्यात् . तद् एव तीर्थं तद् आयतनम् . नैवेतरयोः सवनयोर् मनसा चन ददद् आद्रियेतेति . ब्रह्मणे ऽश्वं ददाति . ब्रह्मणो ह्य् एवैकदक्षिणा . तद् यदा माध्यंदिनीयाश् चमसाः प्रतिष्ठेरन्न् अथ जघनेनाहवनीयं प्राचीनग्रीवं कृष्णाजिनम् उपस्तृणीतेति ब्रूयाद् उदीचीनग्रीवं वा . तद् यजमान आस्ते स हुतानां चमसानाम् उन्मार्ष्टि देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवे ऽश्विनोर् बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्यां सरस्वत्यै त्वा वाचो यन्तुर् यन्त्रेण बृहस्पतेस् त्वा साम्राज्येन ब्रह्मणाभिषिञ्चामी ति . मुखं विमार्ष्टि . स सोमाभिषिक्तस् तेजस्वी ब्रह्मवर्चसी भवति .

sanskrit_iast: tasyāṣṭaśataṃ stotriyā bhavanti . tato yac chataṃ sā virāṭ . kṣatraṃ virāṭ . atha yā aṣṭau sā gāyatrī . tejo brahmavarcasaṃ gāyatrī . teja eva tad brahmavarcasaṃ kṣatrasya purastād dadhāti . tasmād brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyasya purohitaḥ . sa yaḥ purodhākāma syāt sa etena yajetāśnute purodhām . taṃ haika ekachandasam eva kurvanti gāyatram eva sarvam gāyatro vai bṛhaspatiḥ . brahma vai gāyatrī . brahma bṛhaspatir brahmaṇā vā brahmavarcasam ṛdhnavāmeti . te ye ha te tathā kurvanty agniṃ caiva tena devatānām upāpnuvanti gāyatrīṃ ca chanda imaṃ ca lokam . antaritā haiṣām itarāś ca devatā bhavantītarāṇi ca chandāṃsītare ca devā itare ca lokā itare ca kāmāḥ . tasmād yathāchandasam eva kāryaṃ sarvāsāṃ devatānāṃ sarveṣāṃ chandasāṃ sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ sarveṣāṃ lokānāṃ sarveṣāṃ kāmānām upāptyai . tasya bṛhad bārhaspatyam ādiṣṭasāmārbhave pavamāne bhavati . bṛhaspatisavo hy eṣaḥ .
sentences: teja eva tad brahmavarcasaṃ kṣatrasya purastād dadʰāti .
sa yaḥ purodʰākāma syāt sa etena yajetāśnute purodʰām .
taṃ haika ekacʰandasam eva kurvanti gāyatram eva sarvam gāyatro vai br̥haspatiḥ .
brahma br̥haspatir brahmaṇā vā brahmavarcasam r̥dʰnavāmeti .
te ye ha te tatʰā kurvanty agniṃ caiva tena devatānām upāpnuvanti gāyatrīṃ ca cʰanda imaṃ ca lokam .
antaritā haiṣām itarāś ca devatā bʰavantītarāṇi ca cʰandāṃsītare ca devā itare ca lokā itare ca kāmāḥ .
tasmād yatʰācʰandasam eva kāryaṃ sarvāsāṃ devatānāṃ sarveṣāṃ cʰandasāṃ sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ sarveṣāṃ lokānāṃ sarveṣāṃ kāmānām upāptyai .
tasya br̥had bārhaspatyam ādiṣṭasāmārbʰave pavamāne bʰavati .
text: Of this [sacrifice] there are eight hundred stotriyas. Of them, the hundred is the virāṭ. Kṣatra is the virāṭ. And the eight — that is the gāyatrī. Tejas and brahmavarcas are the gāyatrī. He thus places tejas and brahmavarcas before the kṣatra. Therefore the brāhmaṇa is the purohita (placed in front) of the kṣatriya. He who desires the position of purohita should sacrifice with this; he attains the position of purohita. Some make it entirely of one metre — all gāyatrī, for Bṛhaspati belongs to the gāyatrī; brahman is the gāyatrī, brahman is Bṛhaspati — 'By brahman we shall achieve brahmavarcas.' But those who do so attain only Agni among the deities, and the gāyatrī among the metres, and this world. The other deities are shut off from them, and the other metres, and the other gods, and the other worlds, and the other desires. Therefore it should be done according to the proper metres, for the attainment of all deities, all metres, all gods, all worlds, and all desires. The bṛhat bārhaspatya serves as the designated sāman (ādiṣṭa-sāman) in the ārbhava pavamāna, for this is the bṛhaspatisava.
meaning: तस्याष्टशतं स्तोत्रिया भवन्ति . ततो यच् छतं सा विराट् . क्षत्रं विराट् . अथ या अष्टौ सा गायत्री . तेजो ब्रह्मवर्चसं गायत्री . तेज एव तद् ब्रह्मवर्चसं क्षत्रस्य पुरस्ताद् दधाति . तस्माद् ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियस्य पुरोहितः . स यः पुरोधाकाम स्यात् स एतेन यजेताश्नुते पुरोधाम् . तं हैक एकछन्दसम् एव कुर्वन्ति गायत्रम् एव सर्वम् गायत्रो वै बृहस्पतिः . ब्रह्म वै गायत्री . ब्रह्म बृहस्पतिर् ब्रह्मणा वा ब्रह्मवर्चसम् ऋध्नवामेति . ते ये ह ते तथा कुर्वन्त्य् अग्निं चैव तेन देवतानाम् उपाप्नुवन्ति गायत्रीं च छन्द इमं च लोकम् . अन्तरिता हैषाम् इतराश् च देवता भवन्तीतराणि च छन्दांसीतरे च देवा इतरे च लोका इतरे च कामाः . तस्माद् यथाछन्दसम् एव कार्यं सर्वासां देवतानां सर्वेषां छन्दसां सर्वेषां देवानां सर्वेषां लोकानां सर्वेषां कामानाम् उपाप्त्यै . तस्य बृहद् बार्हस्पत्यम् आदिष्टसामार्भवे पवमाने भवति . बृहस्पतिसवो ह्य् एषः .

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣa indrāgnyoḥ kulāyaḥ . indrāgnī vā akāmayetāṃ sadṛśānām eva satāṃ devānāṃ śreṣṭhatāṃ gaccheva samānena yajñena samānīm ṛddhim ṛdhnuyāveti . tāv etaṃ yajñam apśyatām . tam āharatām . tenāyajetām . tato vai tau sadṛśānām eva satāṃ devānāṃ śreṣṭhatām agacchatāṃ samānena yajñena samānīm ṛddhim ārdhnutām . tad brahma vā agniḥ . kṣatram indraḥ . sa vā eṣa trivṛt pañcadaśo bhavati . brahma vai trivṛt . kṣatraṃ pañcadaśaḥ . trivṛtaivāgni śreṣṭhatām agacchat pañcadaśenendraḥ . tasyobhe bṛhadrathantare sāmanī bhavataḥ . brahma vai rathantaraṃ kṣatraṃ bṛhat . rathantareṇaivāgni śreṣṭhatām agacchad bṛhatendraḥ . tau yau brāhmaṇaś ca rājanyaś ca kāmayeyātāṃ sadṛśānām eva satāṃ svānāṃ śreṣṭhatāṃ gaccheva samānena yajñena samānīm ṛddhim ṛdhnuyāveti tāv etena yajeyātām . sadṛśānām eva satāṃ svānāṃ śreṣṭhatāṃ gacchatas samānena yajñena samānīm ṛddhim ṛdhnutaḥ . trivṛtaiva brāhmaṇa śreṣṭhatāṃ gacchati pañcadaśena rājanyaḥ .
sentences: indrāgnī vā akāmayetāṃ sadr̥śānām eva satāṃ devānāṃ śreṣṭʰatāṃ gaccʰeva samānena yajñena samānīm r̥ddʰim r̥dʰnuyāveti .
tato vai tau sadr̥śānām eva satāṃ devānāṃ śreṣṭʰatām agaccʰatāṃ samānena yajñena samānīm r̥ddʰim ārdʰnutām .
sa vā eṣa trivr̥t pañcadaśo bʰavati .
tau yau brāhmaṇaś ca rājanyaś ca kāmayeyātāṃ sadr̥śānām eva satāṃ svānāṃ śreṣṭʰatāṃ gaccʰeva samānena yajñena samānīm r̥ddʰim r̥dʰnuyāveti tāv etena yajeyātām .
sadr̥śānām eva satāṃ svānāṃ śreṣṭʰatāṃ gaccʰatas samānena yajñena samānīm r̥ddʰim r̥dʰnutaḥ .
trivr̥taiva brāhmaṇa śreṣṭʰatāṃ gaccʰati pañcadaśena rājanyaḥ .
text: Now this is the kulāya (nest-rite) of Indra and Agni. Indra and Agni desired: 'Being equals among the gods, may we attain supremacy; by the same sacrifice may we achieve the same prosperity.' They saw this sacrifice. They brought it. They sacrificed with it. Then, being equals among the gods, they attained supremacy; by the same sacrifice they achieved the same prosperity. Agni is brahman; Indra is kṣatra. This [sacrifice] is trivṛt and pañcadaśa (threefold and fifteenfold). Brahman is the trivṛt; kṣatra is the pañcadaśa. By the trivṛt Agni attained supremacy; by the pañcadaśa Indra. It has both bṛhat and rathantara as its sāmans. Brahman is the rathantara; kṣatra is the bṛhat. By the rathantara Agni attained supremacy; by the bṛhat Indra. When a brāhmaṇa and a rājanya (kṣatriya) desire: 'Being equals among our own people, may we attain supremacy; by the same sacrifice may we achieve the same prosperity' — they should sacrifice with this. Being equals among their own people, they attain supremacy; by the same sacrifice they achieve the same prosperity. By the trivṛt the brāhmaṇa attains supremacy; by the pañcadaśa the rājanya.
meaning: अथैष इन्द्राग्न्योः कुलायः . इन्द्राग्नी वा अकामयेतां सदृशानाम् एव सतां देवानां श्रेष्ठतां गच्छेव समानेन यज्ञेन समानीम् ऋद्धिम् ऋध्नुयावेति . ताव् एतं यज्ञम् अप्श्यताम् . तम् आहरताम् . तेनायजेताम् . ततो वै तौ सदृशानाम् एव सतां देवानां श्रेष्ठताम् अगच्छतां समानेन यज्ञेन समानीम् ऋद्धिम् आर्ध्नुताम् . तद् ब्रह्म वा अग्निः . क्षत्रम् इन्द्रः . स वा एष त्रिवृत् पञ्चदशो भवति . ब्रह्म वै त्रिवृत् . क्षत्रं पञ्चदशः . त्रिवृतैवाग्नि श्रेष्ठताम् अगच्छत् पञ्चदशेनेन्द्रः . तस्योभे बृहद्रथन्तरे सामनी भवतः . ब्रह्म वै रथन्तरं क्षत्रं बृहत् . रथन्तरेणैवाग्नि श्रेष्ठताम् अगच्छद् बृहतेन्द्रः . तौ यौ ब्राह्मणश् च राजन्यश् च कामयेयातां सदृशानाम् एव सतां स्वानां श्रेष्ठतां गच्छेव समानेन यज्ञेन समानीम् ऋद्धिम् ऋध्नुयावेति ताव् एतेन यजेयाताम् . सदृशानाम् एव सतां स्वानां श्रेष्ठतां गच्छतस् समानेन यज्ञेन समानीम् ऋद्धिम् ऋध्नुतः . त्रिवृतैव ब्राह्मण श्रेष्ठतां गच्छति पञ्चदशेन राजन्यः .

sanskrit_iast: - tasmād indrāgnyoḥ kulāyaḥ . tad āhus satre tad vyatiṣaktaṃ yat trivṛtpañcadaśam . trivṛtpañcadaśam ity evaitāni stotrāṇi vyatiṣaktāni bhavanti . ṣaḍ eva trivṛnti stotrāṇi syuḥ ṣaṭ pañcadaśānīti . yāny evārvāñci mādhyaṃdināt tāny eva trivṛnti syur yāny ūrdhvaṃ tāni pañcadaśānīti . pañcadaśas tv eva mādhyaṃdinaḥ syāt trivṛd dhotuḥ pṛṣṭham . tasmin pañcadaśe mādhyamdine rathantaram avakalpayanti . brahma vai rathantaraṃ kṣatraṃ pañcadaśaḥ . brahmaiva tat kṣatre pratiṣṭhāpayanti . atha yat trivṛd dhotuḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati brahma vai trivṛt kṣatraṃ bṛhat kṣatram eva tad brahman pratiṣṭhāpayanti . tāv etāv evam anyo 'nyasmin pratiṣṭhāya śreṣṭhatām agacchatām . tayor haitayor ajayyam eva . ajayyāṃ ha vai kīrtim ajayyāṃ śriyam ajayyaṃ svargaṃ lokaṃ jayati ya evaṃ veda . yad v evaite trivṛtpañcadaśe stotre vyatiṣakte bhavato vyatiṣaktād vai mithunāt prajāḥ paśavaḥ prajāyante prajātyā eva . atho prāṇā vai stomā vyatiṣaktā vā ime prāṇā anirmārgāya . tasmāt trivṛtpañcadaśāny evaitāni stotrāṇi vyatiṣaktāni syur iti . tasyaindrāgnaṃ sāmādiṣṭasāma mādhyaṃdine pavamāne bhavati . indrāgnyor hy eṣa yajñaḥ .
sentences: tad āhus satre tad vyatiṣaktaṃ yat trivr̥tpañcadaśam .
trivr̥tpañcadaśam ity evaitāni stotrāṇi vyatiṣaktāni bʰavanti .
ṣaḍ eva trivr̥nti stotrāṇi syuḥ ṣaṭ pañcadaśānīti .
yāny evārvāñci mādʰyaṃdināt tāny eva trivr̥nti syur yāny ūrdʰvaṃ tāni pañcadaśānīti .
pañcadaśas tv eva mādʰyaṃdinaḥ syāt trivr̥d dʰotuḥ pr̥ṣṭʰam .
atʰa yat trivr̥d dʰotuḥ pr̥ṣṭʰaṃ bʰavati brahma vai trivr̥t kṣatraṃ br̥hat kṣatram eva tad brahman pratiṣṭʰāpayanti .
tāv etāv evam anyo 'nyasmin pratiṣṭʰāya śreṣṭʰatām agaccʰatām .
ajayyāṃ ha vai kīrtim ajayyāṃ śriyam ajayyaṃ svargaṃ lokaṃ jayati ya evaṃ veda .
yad v evaite trivr̥tpañcadaśe stotre vyatiṣakte bʰavato vyatiṣaktād vai mitʰunāt prajāḥ paśavaḥ prajāyante prajātyā eva .
atʰo prāṇā vai stomā vyatiṣaktā vā ime prāṇā anirmārgāya .
tasmāt trivr̥tpañcadaśāny evaitāni stotrāṇi vyatiṣaktāni syur iti .
text: Therefore it is the kulāya of Indra and Agni. They say: 'In a sattra, the interweaving of trivṛt and pañcadaśa is needed — the stotras are interwoven as trivṛt-pañcadaśa.' 'There should be six trivṛt stotras and six pañcadaśa ones.' 'Those before the midday [pressing] should be trivṛt; those after should be pañcadaśa.' 'But the midday should be pañcadaśa; the hotṛ's pṛṣṭha should be trivṛt.' In that pañcadaśa midday, they arrange the rathantara. Brahman is the rathantara; kṣatra is the pañcadaśa. They thus establish brahman in kṣatra. And the hotṛ's pṛṣṭha being trivṛt — brahman is the trivṛt, kṣatra is the bṛhat — they thus establish kṣatra in brahman. Those two, established in each other in this way, attained supremacy. Of those two, it is indeed unconquerable. He who knows thus wins unconquerable fame, unconquerable glory, and the unconquerable heavenly world. And because these two stotras, trivṛt and pañcadaśa, are interwoven — from an interwoven coupling offspring and cattle are born, for the sake of procreation. Moreover, the prāṇas are the stomas, and these prāṇas are interwoven — for non-obstruction. Therefore these stotras should be interwoven as trivṛt-pañcadaśa. The aindrāgna (belonging to Indra and Agni) sāman serves as the ādiṣṭa-sāman in the midday pavamāna, for this sacrifice belongs to Indra and Agni.
meaning: - तस्माद् इन्द्राग्न्योः कुलायः . तद् आहुस् सत्रे तद् व्यतिषक्तं यत् त्रिवृत्पञ्चदशम् . त्रिवृत्पञ्चदशम् इत्य् एवैतानि स्तोत्राणि व्यतिषक्तानि भवन्ति . षड् एव त्रिवृन्ति स्तोत्राणि स्युः षट् पञ्चदशानीति . यान्य् एवार्वाञ्चि माध्यंदिनात् तान्य् एव त्रिवृन्ति स्युर् यान्य् ऊर्ध्वं तानि पञ्चदशानीति . पञ्चदशस् त्व् एव माध्यंदिनः स्यात् त्रिवृद् धोतुः पृष्ठम् . तस्मिन् पञ्चदशे माध्यम्दिने रथन्तरम् अवकल्पयन्ति . ब्रह्म वै रथन्तरं क्षत्रं पञ्चदशः . ब्रह्मैव तत् क्षत्रे प्रतिष्ठापयन्ति . अथ यत् त्रिवृद् धोतुः पृष्ठं भवति ब्रह्म वै त्रिवृत् क्षत्रं बृहत् क्षत्रम् एव तद् ब्रह्मन् प्रतिष्ठापयन्ति . ताव् एताव् एवम् अन्यो ऽन्यस्मिन् प्रतिष्ठाय श्रेष्ठताम् अगच्छताम् . तयोर् हैतयोर् अजय्यम् एव . अजय्यां ह वै कीर्तिम् अजय्यां श्रियम् अजय्यं स्वर्गं लोकं जयति य एवं वेद . यद् व् एवैते त्रिवृत्पञ्चदशे स्तोत्रे व्यतिषक्ते भवतो व्यतिषक्ताद् वै मिथुनात् प्रजाः पशवः प्रजायन्ते प्रजात्या एव . अथो प्राणा वै स्तोमा व्यतिषक्ता वा इमे प्राणा अनिर्मार्गाय . तस्मात् त्रिवृत्पञ्चदशान्य् एवैतानि स्तोत्राणि व्यतिषक्तानि स्युर् इति . तस्यैन्द्राग्नं सामादिष्टसाम माध्यंदिने पवमाने भवति . इन्द्राग्न्योर् ह्य् एष यज्ञः .

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣo 'gniṣṭut . indraṃ vai bhūtāni paryacakṣata triśīrṣāṇaṃ tvāṣṭram avadhīd yatīn sālāvṛkebhyaḥ prādād arurmukhān avadhīd bṛhaspateḥ pratyavadhīt saṃdhāṃ saṃhitaṃ atītya namucer āsurasya śiraḥ prācchaitsīd ity etebhyo devakilbiṣebhyas . sa hāraṇya eva cacārānabhyavayan devān . sa u ha devān uvāca yājayata meti . neti hocuḥ . etā vai tvayā saṃdhā atītā etāni devakilbiṣāṇi kṛtāni na tvā yājayiṣyāma iti . atho hāsyāgnir eva sakhitama ivāsa deveṣu . sa u hāgnim uvāca tvaṃ mā yajayeti . tatheti hovāca . sa vai nu taṃ deveṣv icchāmi yena tvā saha yājayeyam iti . sa ha taṃ deveṣu na viveda yenainaṃ sahāyājayiṣyat . sa hovāca na vai nu taṃ deveṣu vindāmi yena tvā saha yājayeyam iti . taṃ vai mā tvam eva yājayeti . tatheti . so 'gnir ātmana evādhy etam agniṣṭutam atanuta . tenainam ayājayat . tasya sadyas sarvaṃ pāpmānaṃ niradahat . sa yathāhir ahicchavyai nirmucyeta yathā muñjād iṣīkāṃ vivṛhed evam eva sarvasmāt pāpmano niramucyata . sa eṣo 'pahatapāpmā tapaty eṣa ha vā indraḥ . sa ya uktokta syād yo 'bhyākhyāyeta sa etena yajeta . sadyo haivāsya sarvaṃ pāpmānaṃ nirdahati .
sentences: indraṃ vai bʰūtāni paryacakṣata triśīrṣāṇaṃ tvāṣṭram avadʰīd yatīn sālāvr̥kebʰyaḥ prādād arurmukʰān avadʰīd br̥haspateḥ pratyavadʰīt saṃdʰāṃ saṃhitaṃ atītya namucer āsurasya śiraḥ prāccʰaitsīd ity etebʰyo devakilbiṣebʰyas .
sa u ha devān uvāca yājayata meti .
etā vai tvayā saṃdʰā atītā etāni devakilbiṣāṇi kr̥tāni na tvā yājayiṣyāma iti .
atʰo hāsyāgnir eva sakʰitama ivāsa deveṣu .
sa u hāgnim uvāca tvaṃ mā yajayeti .
sa vai nu taṃ deveṣv iccʰāmi yena tvā saha yājayeyam iti .
sa ha taṃ deveṣu na viveda yenainaṃ sahāyājayiṣyat .
sa hovāca na vai nu taṃ deveṣu vindāmi yena tvā saha yājayeyam iti .
taṃ vai mā tvam eva yājayeti .
so 'gnir ātmana evādʰy etam agniṣṭutam atanuta .
sa yatʰāhir ahiccʰavyai nirmucyeta yatʰā muñjād iṣīkāṃ vivr̥hed evam eva sarvasmāt pāpmano niramucyata .
sa eṣo 'pahatapāpmā tapaty eṣa ha vā indraḥ .
sa ya uktokta syād yo 'bʰyākʰyāyeta sa etena yajeta .
text: Now this is the agniṣṭut. Beings reviled Indra [saying]: 'He slew the three-headed one, the son of Tvaṣṭṛ; he gave the yatis to the wolves; he slew the arurmukhans; he stole back from Bṛhaspati; he broke the agreement and cut off the head of Namuci the asura' — for these divine offenses (devakilbiṣa). He wandered in the forest, not approaching the gods. He said to the gods: 'Sacrifice for me.' 'No,' they said. 'You have broken these agreements, you have committed these divine offenses; we shall not sacrifice for you.' But Agni was, as it were, his closest friend among the gods. He said to Agni: 'You sacrifice for me.' 'So be it,' he said. 'But I seek among the gods one with whom I may sacrifice for you.' He did not find among the gods one with whom he could sacrifice for him. He said: 'I cannot find among the gods one with whom I might sacrifice for you.' 'Then you yourself sacrifice for me.' 'So be it.' Agni extended this agniṣṭut from his own self. With it he sacrificed for him. Instantly it burned away all his evil. Just as a snake frees itself from its slough, just as one draws out an iṣīkā reed from muñja grass, so he freed himself from all evil. He who shines yonder, freed from evil — he is indeed Indra. He who is denounced, who is accused — he should sacrifice with this. Instantly it burns away all his evil.
meaning: अथैषो ऽग्निष्टुत् . इन्द्रं वै भूतानि पर्यचक्षत त्रिशीर्षाणं त्वाष्ट्रम् अवधीद् यतीन् सालावृकेभ्यः प्रादाद् अरुर्मुखान् अवधीद् बृहस्पतेः प्रत्यवधीत् संधां संहितं अतीत्य नमुचेर् आसुरस्य शिरः प्राच्छैत्सीद् इत्य् एतेभ्यो देवकिल्बिषेभ्यस् . स हारण्य एव चचारानभ्यवयन् देवान् . स उ ह देवान् उवाच याजयत मेति . नेति होचुः . एता वै त्वया संधा अतीता एतानि देवकिल्बिषाणि कृतानि न त्वा याजयिष्याम इति . अथो हास्याग्निर् एव सखितम इवास देवेषु . स उ हाग्निम् उवाच त्वं मा यजयेति . तथेति होवाच . स वै नु तं देवेष्व् इच्छामि येन त्वा सह याजयेयम् इति . स ह तं देवेषु न विवेद येनैनं सहायाजयिष्यत् . स होवाच न वै नु तं देवेषु विन्दामि येन त्वा सह याजयेयम् इति . तं वै मा त्वम् एव याजयेति . तथेति . सो ऽग्निर् आत्मन एवाध्य् एतम् अग्निष्टुतम् अतनुत . तेनैनम् अयाजयत् . तस्य सद्यस् सर्वं पाप्मानं निरदहत् . स यथाहिर् अहिच्छव्यै निर्मुच्येत यथा मुञ्जाद् इषीकां विवृहेद् एवम् एव सर्वस्मात् पाप्मनो निरमुच्यत . स एषो ऽपहतपाप्मा तपत्य् एष ह वा इन्द्रः . स य उक्तोक्त स्याद् यो ऽभ्याख्यायेत स एतेन यजेत . सद्यो हैवास्य सर्वं पाप्मानं निर्दहति .

sanskrit_iast: sa yo mukhena pāpaṃ kṛtvā manyeta trivṛtāgniṣṭutā yajeta . eṣa ha vai mukhena pāpaṃ karoti yo 'vādyaṃ vadati . mukhaṃ vai trivṛt stomānām . mukhād eva tena pāpmānam apaghnate . atha yo bāhubhyāṃ pāpaṃ kṛtvā manyeta pañcadaśenāgniṣṭutā yajeta . eṣa ha vai bāhubhyāṃ pāpaṃ karoti yo 'nighātyasya nihanti . bāhū vai pañcadaśa stomānām . bāhubhyām eva tena pāpmānam apaghnate . atha udareṇa pāpaṃ kṛtvā manyeta saptadaśenāgniṣṭutāyajeta . eṣa ha vā udareṇa pāpaṃ karoti yo 'nāśyānnasyānnam atti . udaraṃ vai saptadaśa stomānām . udarād eva tena pāpmānam apaghnate . atha yaḥ padbhyām pāpaṃ kṛtvā manyeta ekaviṃśenāgniṣṭutā yajeta . eṣa ha vai padbhyāṃ pāpaṃ karoti yo janam eti . pratiṣṭhā vā ekaviṃśa stomānām . padbhyām eva tena pāpmānam apaghnate . atho āhur ya evāyaṃ jyotiṣṭomo 'gniṣṭomas tenaiva yajeteti . tasya yat trivṛd bahiṣpavamānaṃ bhavati mukhād eva tena pāpmānam apaghnate . atha yat pañcadaśāny ājyāni bhavanti pañcadaśo mādhyaṃdino bāhubhyāṃ eva tena pāpmānam apaghnate . atha yat saptadaśāni pṛṣṭhāni bhavanti saptadaśa ārbhava udarād eva tena pāpmānam apaghnate .
sentences: sa yo mukʰena pāpaṃ kr̥tvā manyeta trivr̥tāgniṣṭutā yajeta .
eṣa ha vai mukʰena pāpaṃ karoti yo 'vādyaṃ vadati .
atʰa yo bāhubʰyāṃ pāpaṃ kr̥tvā manyeta pañcadaśenāgniṣṭutā yajeta .
eṣa ha vai bāhubʰyāṃ pāpaṃ karoti yo 'nigʰātyasya nihanti .
atʰa udareṇa pāpaṃ kr̥tvā manyeta saptadaśenāgniṣṭutāyajeta .
eṣa ha vā udareṇa pāpaṃ karoti yo 'nāśyānnasyānnam atti .
atʰa yaḥ padbʰyām pāpaṃ kr̥tvā manyeta ekaviṃśenāgniṣṭutā yajeta .
eṣa ha vai padbʰyāṃ pāpaṃ karoti yo janam eti .
atʰo āhur ya evāyaṃ jyotiṣṭomo 'gniṣṭomas tenaiva yajeteti .
tasya yat trivr̥d bahiṣpavamānaṃ bʰavati mukʰād eva tena pāpmānam apagʰnate .
atʰa yat pañcadaśāny ājyāni bʰavanti pañcadaśo mādʰyaṃdino bāhubʰyāṃ eva tena pāpmānam apagʰnate .
atʰa yat saptadaśāni pr̥ṣṭʰāni bʰavanti saptadaśa ārbʰava udarād eva tena pāpmānam apagʰnate .
text: He who thinks he has done evil with his mouth should sacrifice with the trivṛt agniṣṭut. He indeed does evil with his mouth who speaks what should not be spoken. The trivṛt is the mouth of the stomas. From the mouth he thereby drives away evil. He who thinks he has done evil with his arms should sacrifice with the pañcadaśa agniṣṭut. He indeed does evil with his arms who strikes one who should not be struck. The pañcadaśa is the arms of the stomas. From the arms he thereby drives away evil. He who thinks he has done evil with his belly should sacrifice with the saptadaśa agniṣṭut. He indeed does evil with his belly who eats the food of one whose food should not be eaten. The saptadaśa is the belly of the stomas. From the belly he thereby drives away evil. He who thinks he has done evil with his feet should sacrifice with the ekaviṃśa agniṣṭut. He indeed does evil with his feet who goes among people [with ill intent]. The ekaviṃśa is the foundation (feet) of the stomas. From the feet he thereby drives away evil. But they say: 'One should sacrifice with the very jyotiṣṭoma agniṣṭoma.' Of it, the trivṛt bahiṣpavamāna — from the mouth he thereby drives away evil. The pañcadaśa ājyas and the pañcadaśa midday — from the arms he thereby drives away evil. The saptadaśa pṛṣṭhas and the saptadaśa ārbhava — from the belly he thereby drives away evil.
meaning: स यो मुखेन पापं कृत्वा मन्येत त्रिवृताग्निष्टुता यजेत . एष ह वै मुखेन पापं करोति यो ऽवाद्यं वदति . मुखं वै त्रिवृत् स्तोमानाम् . मुखाद् एव तेन पाप्मानम् अपघ्नते . अथ यो बाहुभ्यां पापं कृत्वा मन्येत पञ्चदशेनाग्निष्टुता यजेत . एष ह वै बाहुभ्यां पापं करोति यो ऽनिघात्यस्य निहन्ति . बाहू वै पञ्चदश स्तोमानाम् . बाहुभ्याम् एव तेन पाप्मानम् अपघ्नते . अथ उदरेण पापं कृत्वा मन्येत सप्तदशेनाग्निष्टुतायजेत . एष ह वा उदरेण पापं करोति यो ऽनाश्यान्नस्यान्नम् अत्ति . उदरं वै सप्तदश स्तोमानाम् . उदराद् एव तेन पाप्मानम् अपघ्नते . अथ यः पद्भ्याम् पापं कृत्वा मन्येत एकविंशेनाग्निष्टुता यजेत . एष ह वै पद्भ्यां पापं करोति यो जनम् एति . प्रतिष्ठा वा एकविंश स्तोमानाम् . पद्भ्याम् एव तेन पाप्मानम् अपघ्नते . अथो आहुर् य एवायं ज्योतिष्टोमो ऽग्निष्टोमस् तेनैव यजेतेति . तस्य यत् त्रिवृद् बहिष्पवमानं भवति मुखाद् एव तेन पाप्मानम् अपघ्नते . अथ यत् पञ्चदशान्य् आज्यानि भवन्ति पञ्चदशो माध्यंदिनो बाहुभ्यां एव तेन पाप्मानम् अपघ्नते . अथ यत् सप्तदशानि पृष्ठानि भवन्ति सप्तदश आर्भव उदराद् एव तेन पाप्मानम् अपघ्नते .

sanskrit_iast: trivṛtā tejaskāmo brahmavarcasakāmo 'gniṣṭutā yajeta pañcadaśena vīryakāmas saptadaśena paśukāmaḥ prajananakāma ekaviṃśena pratiṣṭhākāmas triṇavenaujaskāmas trayastriṃśena śrīkāmaḥ . tad u vā āhur vadanam evaitat sarvaṃ ya evāyaṃ catuṣṭomo 'gniṣṭomaḥ . tenaiva yajeteti . ayaṃ vai trivṛd ayaṃ pañcadaśo 'yaṃ saptadaśo 'yam ekaviṃśaḥ . imān vai prāṇān agnir anvāyattaḥ . sa yo 'nūcānas san na viroceta sa etena yajeteti . yathā ha vai niṣkaś śamalagṛhīta evaṃ sa yo 'nūcānas san na virocate . agnā u vā etaṃ prāsyanti yam agniṣṭutā yājayanti . tad yathā niṣkaṃ śamalagṛhītam agnau prāsya tasyāyoghanena sarvaṃ śamalaṃ nirhanyād evaṃ haivāsya sarvaṃ pāpmānaṃ nirghnanti . so 'pahatapāpmā tejasvī brahmavarcasī bhavati . atho āhur yasminn eva paśavye sati paśavo na rameran sa enena yajeteti . yathā ha vai jaratkaṣa evaṃ sa yasmin paśavye sati paśavo na ramante . tasya revatīṣv agniṣṭomasāma bhavati . āpo vai revatayaḥ .
sentences: trivr̥tā tejaskāmo brahmavarcasakāmo 'gniṣṭutā yajeta pañcadaśena vīryakāmas saptadaśena paśukāmaḥ prajananakāma ekaviṃśena pratiṣṭʰākāmas triṇavenaujaskāmas trayastriṃśena śrīkāmaḥ .
tad u vā āhur vadanam evaitat sarvaṃ ya evāyaṃ catuṣṭomo 'gniṣṭomaḥ .
ayaṃ vai trivr̥d ayaṃ pañcadaśo 'yaṃ saptadaśo 'yam ekaviṃśaḥ .
sa yo 'nūcānas san na viroceta sa etena yajeteti .
yatʰā ha vai niṣkaś śamalagr̥hīta evaṃ sa yo 'nūcānas san na virocate .
agnā u vā etaṃ prāsyanti yam agniṣṭutā yājayanti .
tad yatʰā niṣkaṃ śamalagr̥hītam agnau prāsya tasyāyogʰanena sarvaṃ śamalaṃ nirhanyād evaṃ haivāsya sarvaṃ pāpmānaṃ nirgʰnanti .
atʰo āhur yasminn eva paśavye sati paśavo na rameran sa enena yajeteti .
yatʰā ha vai jaratkaṣa evaṃ sa yasmin paśavye sati paśavo na ramante .
text: He who desires tejas (radiance) and brahmavarcas should sacrifice with the trivṛt agniṣṭut; he who desires strength with the pañcadaśa; he who desires cattle, desiring offspring, with the saptadaśa; he who desires a firm foundation with the ekaviṃśa; he who desires vigour with the triṇava; he who desires glory with the trayastriṃśa. But they say this is all mere talk; one should sacrifice with the very catuṣṭoma agniṣṭoma: 'This is the trivṛt, this the pañcadaśa, this the saptadaśa, this the ekaviṃśa. Agni is dependent on these prāṇas.' He who, being learned, does not shine forth — he should sacrifice with this. Just as a gold ornament (niṣka) tarnished with impurity, so is he who, being learned, does not shine forth. They cast him, as it were, into Agni when they make him sacrifice with the agniṣṭut. Just as one, having cast a tarnished gold ornament into fire, would hammer out all its impurity with a hammer — so they strike out all his evil. He becomes freed from evil, radiant, and full of brahmavarcas. And they say: 'He in whose cattle-pen, though it exists, cattle do not stay — he should sacrifice with this.' For he is, as it were, a dried-up thicket — one in whose cattle-pen cattle do not stay. The agniṣṭoma-sāman is set to the revatī verses. The revatīs are the waters.
meaning: त्रिवृता तेजस्कामो ब्रह्मवर्चसकामो ऽग्निष्टुता यजेत पञ्चदशेन वीर्यकामस् सप्तदशेन पशुकामः प्रजननकाम एकविंशेन प्रतिष्ठाकामस् त्रिणवेनौजस्कामस् त्रयस्त्रिंशेन श्रीकामः . तद् उ वा आहुर् वदनम् एवैतत् सर्वं य एवायं चतुष्टोमो ऽग्निष्टोमः . तेनैव यजेतेति . अयं वै त्रिवृद् अयं पञ्चदशो ऽयं सप्तदशो ऽयम् एकविंशः . इमान् वै प्राणान् अग्निर् अन्वायत्तः . स यो ऽनूचानस् सन् न विरोचेत स एतेन यजेतेति . यथा ह वै निष्कश् शमलगृहीत एवं स यो ऽनूचानस् सन् न विरोचते . अग्ना उ वा एतं प्रास्यन्ति यम् अग्निष्टुता याजयन्ति . तद् यथा निष्कं शमलगृहीतम् अग्नौ प्रास्य तस्यायोघनेन सर्वं शमलं निर्हन्याद् एवं हैवास्य सर्वं पाप्मानं निर्घ्नन्ति . सो ऽपहतपाप्मा तेजस्वी ब्रह्मवर्चसी भवति . अथो आहुर् यस्मिन्न् एव पशव्ये सति पशवो न रमेरन् स एनेन यजेतेति . यथा ह वै जरत्कष एवं स यस्मिन् पशव्ये सति पशवो न रमन्ते . तस्य रेवतीष्व् अग्निष्टोमसाम भवति . आपो वै रेवतयः .

sanskrit_iast: tad yathā jaratkakṣam agninopadīpya tam adbhir upasiñcet tasmin kalyāṇya oṣadhayo jāyeraṃs tāsu paśavo ramerann evaṃ haivāsmin sarve paśavo ramante . tasy āgna āyūṃṣi pavasa ity eṣāgnipāvamānī pratipad bhavati . tad āhur vīva vā etaiḥ prāṇair ṛdhyante ye pāvamānībhiḥ pratipadyanta iti . tad yad eṣāgnipāvamānī pratipad bhavatīti prāṇo vai vāyuḥ prāṇair eva tat samṛdhyante . agne pāvaka rociṣe ty annaṃ vai pāvakam annādyenaivainaṃ tat samardhayanti . atho vāyur vai pāvakaḥ prāṇo vai vāyur abhipūrvam evainaṃ tat prāṇais samardhayanti . agniś śucivratatama ity aśucir iva vā eṣa bhavati yo 'bhyākhyāyate . śucim evainam etena pūtaṃ medhyaṃ kurvanti . tasya yajñāyajñā vo 'gnaya ity etā mādhyaṃdinasya pavamānasya bṛhatyo bhavanti . agnā u vā etaṃ prāsyanti yam agniṣṭutā yājayanti . uta trātā tanūnām ity agnaya eva tad vaiśvānarāya yajamānas tanvaṃ paridatte . tasya pāhi no agna ekaye ty etāsu nārmedhasyarkṣu rathantaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati . etābhir vai nṛmedhā auśijo 'gner harāṃsy apairayata . agner evaitābhir harāṃsy aperayate . tasya śaṃ no devīr abhiṣṭaya ity etāsv aponaptriyāsv agniṣṭomasāma bhavati . āpo vā aponaptriyaḥ .
sentences: tad yatʰā jaratkakṣam agninopadīpya tam adbʰir upasiñcet tasmin kalyāṇya oṣadʰayo jāyeraṃs tāsu paśavo ramerann evaṃ haivāsmin sarve paśavo ramante .
tasy āgna āyūṃṣi pavasa ity eṣāgnipāvamānī pratipad bʰavati .
tad āhur vīva vā etaiḥ prāṇair r̥dʰyante ye pāvamānībʰiḥ pratipadyanta iti .
tad yad eṣāgnipāvamānī pratipad bʰavatīti prāṇo vai vāyuḥ prāṇair eva tat samr̥dʰyante .
agne pāvaka rociṣe ty annaṃ vai pāvakam annādyenaivainaṃ tat samardʰayanti .
atʰo vāyur vai pāvakaḥ prāṇo vai vāyur abʰipūrvam evainaṃ tat prāṇais samardʰayanti .
agniś śucivratatama ity aśucir iva vā eṣa bʰavati yo 'bʰyākʰyāyate .
śucim evainam etena pūtaṃ medʰyaṃ kurvanti .
tasya yajñāyajñā vo 'gnaya ity etā mādʰyaṃdinasya pavamānasya br̥hatyo bʰavanti .
agnā u vā etaṃ prāsyanti yam agniṣṭutā yājayanti .
uta trātā tanūnām ity agnaya eva tad vaiśvānarāya yajamānas tanvaṃ paridatte .
tasya pāhi no agna ekaye ty etāsu nārmedʰasyarkṣu ratʰantaraṃ pr̥ṣṭʰaṃ bʰavati .
etābʰir vai nr̥medʰā auśijo 'gner harāṃsy apairayata .
tasya śaṃ no devīr abʰiṣṭaya ity etāsv aponaptriyāsv agniṣṭomasāma bʰavati .
text: Just as, having set fire to a dried-up thicket, one would sprinkle it with water, and in it good plants would grow, and in them cattle would stay — so indeed all cattle come to stay with him. Its opening verse (pratipad) of the Agni-pavamāna is 'O Agni, you purify our lives' (agna āyūṃṣi pavase). They say: 'Those who begin with pāvamānī verses are indeed well-endowed with prāṇas.' Because this is the Agni-pāvamānī opening — prāṇa is indeed Vāyu — they are thereby enriched with prāṇas. 'O Agni Pāvaka, you shine' (agne pāvaka rociṣe) — pāvaka is food; they thereby endow him with food. Or, Vāyu is pāvaka; prāṇa is Vāyu — they thereby endow him progressively with prāṇas. 'O Agni, of most pure observance' (agniś śucivratatama) — for he who is accused is, as it were, impure; by this they make him pure, cleansed, and fit for sacrifice. The bṛhatīs of the midday pavamāna are 'O fires of sacrifice upon sacrifice' (yajñāyajñā vo agnaye). They cast him, as it were, into Agni when they make him sacrifice with the agniṣṭut. 'And protector of our bodies' (uta trātā tanūnām) — by this the sacrificer entrusts his body to Agni Vaiśvānara. The rathantara pṛṣṭha is set to the verses of Nṛmedha, son of Uśij: 'Protect us, O Agni, with a single [defense]' (pāhi no agna ekayā). With these [verses] Nṛmedha Auśija drove away the fiery missiles of Agni; with these one drives away the fiery missiles of Agni. The agniṣṭoma-sāman is set to the āponaptrīya verses: 'May the divine [waters] be for our welfare' (śaṃ no devīr abhiṣṭaye). The āponaptrīya verses belong to the waters.
meaning: तद् यथा जरत्कक्षम् अग्निनोपदीप्य तम् अद्भिर् उपसिञ्चेत् तस्मिन् कल्याण्य ओषधयो जायेरंस् तासु पशवो रमेरन्न् एवं हैवास्मिन् सर्वे पशवो रमन्ते . तस्य् आग्न आयूंषि पवस इत्य् एषाग्निपावमानी प्रतिपद् भवति . तद् आहुर् वीव वा एतैः प्राणैर् ऋध्यन्ते ये पावमानीभिः प्रतिपद्यन्त इति . तद् यद् एषाग्निपावमानी प्रतिपद् भवतीति प्राणो वै वायुः प्राणैर् एव तत् समृध्यन्ते . अग्ने पावक रोचिषे त्य् अन्नं वै पावकम् अन्नाद्येनैवैनं तत् समर्धयन्ति . अथो वायुर् वै पावकः प्राणो वै वायुर् अभिपूर्वम् एवैनं तत् प्राणैस् समर्धयन्ति . अग्निश् शुचिव्रततम इत्य् अशुचिर् इव वा एष भवति यो ऽभ्याख्यायते . शुचिम् एवैनम् एतेन पूतं मेध्यं कुर्वन्ति . तस्य यज्ञायज्ञा वो ऽग्नय इत्य् एता माध्यंदिनस्य पवमानस्य बृहत्यो भवन्ति . अग्ना उ वा एतं प्रास्यन्ति यम् अग्निष्टुता याजयन्ति . उत त्राता तनूनाम् इत्य् अग्नय एव तद् वैश्वानराय यजमानस् तन्वं परिदत्ते . तस्य पाहि नो अग्न एकये त्य् एतासु नार्मेधस्यर्क्षु रथन्तरं पृष्ठं भवति . एताभिर् वै नृमेधा औशिजो ऽग्नेर् हरांस्य् अपैरयत . अग्नेर् एवैताभिर् हरांस्य् अपेरयते . तस्य शं नो देवीर् अभिष्टय इत्य् एतास्व् अपोनप्त्रियास्व् अग्निष्टोमसाम भवति . आपो वा अपोनप्त्रियः .

sanskrit_iast: tad yathāgnidagdham adbhir abhiṣiñcet tādṛg eva tac chāntyai . tad āhur yo vā agnidagdham adbhir abhiṣiñcati bhūyo vaitat pramṛcyati kilāsaṃ  vā bhavati . ā no yajñaṃ divispṛśaṃ vāyo yāhi sumanmabhir ity etāsv eva vāyumatīṣu kāryaṃ vāyur vai śāntiś śāntyā evānirdāhāyeti . tad āhur yo vā āgnīn upadīpya vātenopavājayati bhūyo vai tad dīpyate . dīptir vāvaiṣeti . tad u vā āhus tad vāva yajamāna icched yat sa dīpyeta . yad u dīptyai vāyur eva dīptyai . yad u śāntyai vāyur eva śāntyai . tasmād etāsv eva vāyumatīṣu kāryam iti . tasyājā ca hiraṇyaṃ ca dakṣiṇā . āgneyī vā ajāgneyaṃ hiraṇyam . atho āhur anaḍvān dakṣiṇeti . vahati vā anaḍvān vahaty agnir devebhyo haviḥ .
sentences: tad yatʰāgnidagdʰam adbʰir abʰiṣiñcet tādr̥g eva tac cʰāntyai .
tad āhur yo vā agnidagdʰam adbʰir abʰiṣiñcati bʰūyo vaitat pramr̥cyati kilāsaṃ [saṃ] vā bʰavati .
ā no yajñaṃ divispr̥śaṃ vāyo yāhi sumanmabʰir ity etāsv eva vāyumatīṣu kāryaṃ vāyur vai śāntiś śāntyā evānirdāhāyeti .
tad āhur yo vā āgnīn upadīpya vātenopavājayati bʰūyo vai tad dīpyate .
tad u vā āhus tad vāva yajamāna iccʰed yat sa dīpyeta .
yad u dīptyai vāyur eva dīptyai .
yad u śāntyai vāyur eva śāntyai .
tasmād etāsv eva vāyumatīṣu kāryam iti .
vahati vā anaḍvān vahaty agnir devebʰyo haviḥ .
text: Just as one would sprinkle water on what has been burnt by fire — such is this, for the sake of pacification. They say: 'He who sprinkles water on what has been burnt by fire — thereby he afflicts it further; it becomes kilāsa (a skin disease).' 'O Vāyu, come to our sacrifice reaching heaven, with good thoughts' (ā no yajñaṃ divispṛśam vāyo yāhi sumanmabhiḥ) — it should be done in these Vāyu-verses, for Vāyu is peace, for the sake of peace, to avoid [further] burning.' They say: 'He who, having kindled fires, fans them with wind — it burns all the more; this is [just more] blazing.' But they also say: 'The sacrificer would indeed desire that he should blaze forth. Whether for blazing, Vāyu serves for blazing; whether for peace, Vāyu serves for peace. Therefore it should be done in these Vāyu-verses.' The dakṣiṇā for this is a she-goat and gold. A she-goat belongs to Agni; gold belongs to Agni. And they say: 'A bull (anaḍvān) is the dakṣiṇā.' For a bull carries, and Agni carries the oblation for the gods.
meaning: तद् यथाग्निदग्धम् अद्भिर् अभिषिञ्चेत् तादृग् एव तच् छान्त्यै . तद् आहुर् यो वा अग्निदग्धम् अद्भिर् अभिषिञ्चति भूयो वैतत् प्रमृच्यति किलासं  वा भवति . आ नो यज्ञं दिविस्पृशं वायो याहि सुमन्मभिर् इत्य् एतास्व् एव वायुमतीषु कार्यं वायुर् वै शान्तिश् शान्त्या एवानिर्दाहायेति . तद् आहुर् यो वा आग्नीन् उपदीप्य वातेनोपवाजयति भूयो वै तद् दीप्यते . दीप्तिर् वावैषेति . तद् उ वा आहुस् तद् वाव यजमान इच्छेद् यत् स दीप्येत . यद् उ दीप्त्यै वायुर् एव दीप्त्यै . यद् उ शान्त्यै वायुर् एव शान्त्यै . तस्माद् एतास्व् एव वायुमतीषु कार्यम् इति . तस्याजा च हिरण्यं च दक्षिणा . आग्नेयी वा अजाग्नेयं हिरण्यम् . अथो आहुर् अनड्वान् दक्षिणेति . वहति वा अनड्वान् वहत्य् अग्निर् देवेभ्यो हविः .

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣa indrastomaḥ . indro vā akāmayata sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ śreṣṭhatāṃ gaccheyam iti . sa etaṃ yajñam apaśyat . tam āharat . tenāyajata . tato vai sa sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ śreṣṭhatām agacchat . gacchati svānāṃ śreṣṭhatāṃ ya evaṃ veda . indre ha vā agre yajña āsa . śrīr ha vā asmiṃs tad āsa . yajña u ha vāva devānāṃ śrīḥ . tam u ha vṛtro 'bhivavṛdhe . sa devān upādhāvad yuṣmābhir balenemaṃ vṛtraṃ hanānīti . tam abruvan sa vai no yas te 'yaṃ niṣkevalyo yajñas taṃ prayaccheti . tasmād rājani vijigīṣamāṇe viṣaḥ pradānam icchante . tasmād u rājā vijigīṣamāṇo viśa eva pradānaṃ prayacchati . sa vasubhya eva prātassavanaṃ prāyacchad rudrebhyo mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanam ādityebhyas tṛtīyasavanaṃ viśvebhyaś ca devebhyaḥ . tair balenendro vṛtram ahan . ajayan devā asurān . sa vṛtraṃ hatvā vijitya pṛthag evaiṣāṃ imā śriyo dīpyamānā apaśyat . tam abhiśastir avindan . sa aikṣata kathaṃ nv aham eṣām imā śriyas saṃvṛñjīyeti . sa etenaiva yajñenāyajata . tenaiṣāṃ sarvā śriyas samavṛṅkta .
sentences: indro vā akāmayata sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ śreṣṭʰatāṃ gaccʰeyam iti .
tato vai sa sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ śreṣṭʰatām agaccʰat .
gaccʰati svānāṃ śreṣṭʰatāṃ ya evaṃ veda .
indre ha vā agre yajña āsa .
śrīr ha vā asmiṃs tad āsa .
yajña u ha vāva devānāṃ śrīḥ .
sa devān upādʰāvad yuṣmābʰir balenemaṃ vr̥traṃ hanānīti .
tam abruvan sa vai no yas te 'yaṃ niṣkevalyo yajñas taṃ prayaccʰeti .
tasmād rājani vijigīṣamāṇe viṣaḥ pradānam iccʰante .
tasmād u rājā vijigīṣamāṇo viśa eva pradānaṃ prayaccʰati .
sa vasubʰya eva prātassavanaṃ prāyaccʰad rudrebʰyo mādʰyaṃdinaṃ savanam ādityebʰyas tr̥tīyasavanaṃ viśvebʰyaś ca devebʰyaḥ .
sa vr̥traṃ hatvā vijitya pr̥tʰag evaiṣāṃ imā śriyo dīpyamānā apaśyat .
sa aikṣata katʰaṃ nv aham eṣām imā śriyas saṃvr̥ñjīyeti .
text: Now this is the indrastoma. Indra desired: 'May I attain supremacy over all the gods.' He saw this sacrifice. He brought it. He sacrificed with it. Then he attained supremacy over all the gods. He attains supremacy over his own people who knows thus. The sacrifice was originally Indra's. Glory (śrī) was in it. For the sacrifice is indeed the glory of the gods. But Vṛtra overwhelmed him. He ran to the gods: 'With your strength I shall slay this Vṛtra.' They said: 'Give us that exclusive sacrifice (niṣkevalya) of yours.' Therefore, when a king wishes to conquer, the people (viś) seek a gift. And therefore the king who wishes to conquer gives a gift to the people. He gave the morning pressing to the Vasus, the midday pressing to the Rudras, the third pressing to the Ādityas and to all the gods. With their strength Indra slew Vṛtra. The gods conquered the asuras. Having slain Vṛtra and conquered, he saw these glories of theirs shining separately. Reproach came upon him. He considered: 'How might I gather these glories of theirs to myself?' He sacrificed with this very sacrifice. Thereby he gathered all their glories to himself.
meaning: अथैष इन्द्रस्तोमः . इन्द्रो वा अकामयत सर्वेषां देवानां श्रेष्ठतां गच्छेयम् इति . स एतं यज्ञम् अपश्यत् . तम् आहरत् . तेनायजत . ततो वै स सर्वेषां देवानां श्रेष्ठताम् अगच्छत् . गच्छति स्वानां श्रेष्ठतां य एवं वेद . इन्द्रे ह वा अग्रे यज्ञ आस . श्रीर् ह वा अस्मिंस् तद् आस . यज्ञ उ ह वाव देवानां श्रीः . तम् उ ह वृत्रो ऽभिववृधे . स देवान् उपाधावद् युष्माभिर् बलेनेमं वृत्रं हनानीति . तम् अब्रुवन् स वै नो यस् ते ऽयं निष्केवल्यो यज्ञस् तं प्रयच्छेति . तस्माद् राजनि विजिगीषमाणे विषः प्रदानम् इच्छन्ते . तस्माद् उ राजा विजिगीषमाणो विश एव प्रदानं प्रयच्छति . स वसुभ्य एव प्रातस्सवनं प्रायच्छद् रुद्रेभ्यो माध्यंदिनं सवनम् आदित्येभ्यस् तृतीयसवनं विश्वेभ्यश् च देवेभ्यः . तैर् बलेनेन्द्रो वृत्रम् अहन् . अजयन् देवा असुरान् . स वृत्रं हत्वा विजित्य पृथग् एवैषां इमा श्रियो दीप्यमाना अपश्यत् . तम् अभिशस्तिर् अविन्दन् . स ऐक्षत कथं न्व् अहम् एषाम् इमा श्रियस् संवृञ्जीयेति . स एतेनैव यज्ञेनायजत . तेनैषां सर्वा श्रियस् समवृङ्क्त .

sanskrit_iast: sa aindrīṣv eva sarvo bhavati . aindrīṣv eva prātassavanaṃ bhavaty aindrīṣu mādhyaṃdianaṃ savanam aindrīṣu tṛtīyasavanam . tad yad gāyatraṃ sat prātassavanam aindrīṣu kriyate vasūnām eva tena yajñaṃ samavṛṅkta . atha yat traiṣṭubhaṃ san mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanam aindrīṣu kriyate rudrāṇām eva tena yajñaṃ samavṛṅkta . atha yaj jāgataṃ sat tṛtīyasavanam aindrīṣu kriyata ādityānām eva tena yajñaṃ samavṛṅkta viśveṣāṃ ca devānām . ta enam āttayajñā upāsīdan viśas te 'sāma yajñe no 'nvābhajeti yathā bhartāraṃ bhāryā upasīdanti tathā . sa vasūn eva prātassavane 'nvābhajad rudrān mādhyaṃdine savana ādityāṃs tṛtīyasavane viśvāṃś ca devān . yathā rājā vijitya sve vitte bhāryān anvābhajed evam evaināṃs tad anvābhajat . tasmād indrāya vasumate rudravata ādityavate viśvadevyāvata ity anvāhus . sa pañcadaśo bhavati . vajro vai pañcadaśaḥ . vajra indraḥ . aindra eṣa yajñas tat tatsalakṣma kriyate . sa ukthyo bhavati . viḍ vā ukthāni . kṣatram eva tad viśy adhyūhanti . tasmāt kṣatriyo viśy adhyūḍhaḥ . saya śrīkāma syāt sa etena yajeta .
sentences: aindrīṣv eva prātassavanaṃ bʰavaty aindrīṣu mādʰyaṃdianaṃ savanam aindrīṣu tr̥tīyasavanam .
tad yad gāyatraṃ sat prātassavanam aindrīṣu kriyate vasūnām eva tena yajñaṃ samavr̥ṅkta .
atʰa yat traiṣṭubʰaṃ san mādʰyaṃdinaṃ savanam aindrīṣu kriyate rudrāṇām eva tena yajñaṃ samavr̥ṅkta .
atʰa yaj jāgataṃ sat tr̥tīyasavanam aindrīṣu kriyata ādityānām eva tena yajñaṃ samavr̥ṅkta viśveṣāṃ ca devānām .
ta enam āttayajñā upāsīdan viśas te 'sāma yajñe no 'nvābʰajeti yatʰā bʰartāraṃ bʰāryā upasīdanti tatʰā .
sa vasūn eva prātassavane 'nvābʰajad rudrān mādʰyaṃdine savana ādityāṃs tr̥tīyasavane viśvāṃś ca devān .
yatʰā rājā vijitya sve vitte bʰāryān anvābʰajed evam evaināṃs tad anvābʰajat .
tasmād indrāya vasumate rudravata ādityavate viśvadevyāvata ity anvāhus .
aindra eṣa yajñas tat tatsalakṣma kriyate .
saya śrīkāma syāt sa etena yajeta .
text: It is entirely in aindrī (Indra-related) [verses]. The morning pressing is in aindrī [verses], the midday pressing is in aindrī [verses], the third pressing is in aindrī [verses]. Because the morning pressing, though gāyatra in form, is done in aindrī verses — thereby he gathered to himself the sacrifice of the Vasus. Because the midday pressing, though traiṣṭubha in form, is done in aindrī verses — thereby he gathered to himself the sacrifice of the Rudras. Because the third pressing, though jāgata in form, is done in aindrī verses — thereby he gathered to himself the sacrifice of the Ādityas and all the gods. They, their sacrifice taken away, approached him [saying]: 'We are your people (viś); give us a share in the sacrifice' — as wives approach a husband. He gave the Vasus a share at the morning pressing, the Rudras at the midday pressing, the Ādityas at the third pressing, and all the gods. Just as a king, having conquered, would give his dependents a share in his wealth, so he gave them a share. Therefore they recite: 'To Indra, accompanied by the Vasus, by the Rudras, by the Ādityas, by the Viśvedevas.' It is pañcadaśa (fifteenfold). The vajra (thunderbolt) is the pañcadaśa; the vajra is Indra. This sacrifice belongs to Indra; therefore it is made to bear his mark. It is ukthya. The ukthāni are the viś (people). Kṣatra is thus placed upon the viś. Therefore the kṣatriya is placed above the viś. He who desires glory (śrī) should sacrifice with this.
meaning: स ऐन्द्रीष्व् एव सर्वो भवति . ऐन्द्रीष्व् एव प्रातस्सवनं भवत्य् ऐन्द्रीषु माध्यंदिअनं सवनम् ऐन्द्रीषु तृतीयसवनम् . तद् यद् गायत्रं सत् प्रातस्सवनम् ऐन्द्रीषु क्रियते वसूनाम् एव तेन यज्ञं समवृङ्क्त . अथ यत् त्रैष्टुभं सन् माध्यंदिनं सवनम् ऐन्द्रीषु क्रियते रुद्राणाम् एव तेन यज्ञं समवृङ्क्त . अथ यज् जागतं सत् तृतीयसवनम् ऐन्द्रीषु क्रियत आदित्यानाम् एव तेन यज्ञं समवृङ्क्त विश्वेषां च देवानाम् . त एनम् आत्तयज्ञा उपासीदन् विशस् ते ऽसाम यज्ञे नो ऽन्वाभजेति यथा भर्तारं भार्या उपसीदन्ति तथा . स वसून् एव प्रातस्सवने ऽन्वाभजद् रुद्रान् माध्यंदिने सवन आदित्यांस् तृतीयसवने विश्वांश् च देवान् . यथा राजा विजित्य स्वे वित्ते भार्यान् अन्वाभजेद् एवम् एवैनांस् तद् अन्वाभजत् . तस्माद् इन्द्राय वसुमते रुद्रवत आदित्यवते विश्वदेव्यावत इत्य् अन्वाहुस् . स पञ्चदशो भवति . वज्रो वै पञ्चदशः . वज्र इन्द्रः . ऐन्द्र एष यज्ञस् तत् तत्सलक्ष्म क्रियते . स उक्थ्यो भवति . विड् वा उक्थानि . क्षत्रम् एव तद् विश्य् अध्यूहन्ति . तस्मात् क्षत्रियो विश्य् अध्यूढः . सय श्रीकाम स्यात् स एतेन यजेत .

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣa vighanaḥ . prajāpatir devān asṛjata vasūn rudrān ādityān . tebhyo yajñaṃ cemāṃś ca lokān prāyacchat . vasubhya eva prātassavanaṃ prāyacchad rudrebhyo mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanam ādityebhyas tṛtīyasavanam . vasubhya evemaṃ lokaṃ prāyacchad rudrebhyo 'ntarikṣam ādityebhyo 'mum . athendram asṛjata . sa idam eṣāṃ sarvam vibhaktam apaśyat . so 'bravīd yad idam eṣāṃ sarvaṃ vibhaktam atha kasmai mām asṛṣṭhā iti . eteṣāṃ tvā ity abravīc chraiṣṭhyāyādhipatyāyāsṛkṣīti . so 'haṃ katham eṣāṃ śreṣṭho 'dhipati syām iti . parehy enān brūhīty abravīd yuṣmākaṃ mā prajāpati śraiṣṭhyāyādhipatyāyāsṛṣṭeti . sa etyābravīd yuṣmākaṃ mā prajāpati śraiṣṭhyāyādhipatyāyāsṛṣṭeti . te 'bruvan vayaṃ vāva śreṣṭhā smo vayam adhipatayo ye jyeṣṭhā sma iti nājānan . sa punar etyābravīn na vā amī taj jānanti yat tvam āttheti . sa etaṃ yajñam apaśyat . tam āharat . tenainam ayājayat . sa heṣṭvaiva sarvā mṛdho vyahata . yad vyahata tad vighanasya vighanatvam .
sentences: prajāpatir devān asr̥jata vasūn rudrān ādityān .
tebʰyo yajñaṃ cemāṃś ca lokān prāyaccʰat .
vasubʰya eva prātassavanaṃ prāyaccʰad rudrebʰyo mādʰyaṃdinaṃ savanam ādityebʰyas tr̥tīyasavanam .
vasubʰya evemaṃ lokaṃ prāyaccʰad rudrebʰyo 'ntarikṣam ādityebʰyo 'mum .
sa idam eṣāṃ sarvam vibʰaktam apaśyat .
so 'bravīd yad idam eṣāṃ sarvaṃ vibʰaktam atʰa kasmai mām asr̥ṣṭʰā iti .
so 'haṃ katʰam eṣāṃ śreṣṭʰo 'dʰipati syām iti .
parehy enān brūhīty abravīd yuṣmākaṃ mā prajāpati śraiṣṭʰyāyādʰipatyāyāsr̥ṣṭeti .
sa etyābravīd yuṣmākaṃ mā prajāpati śraiṣṭʰyāyādʰipatyāyāsr̥ṣṭeti .
te 'bruvan vayaṃ vāva śreṣṭʰā smo vayam adʰipatayo ye jyeṣṭʰā sma iti nājānan .
sa punar etyābravīn na vā amī taj jānanti yat tvam āttʰeti .
text: Now this is the vighana (striking down). Prajāpati created the gods — the Vasus, the Rudras, and the Ādityas. He gave them the sacrifice and these worlds. To the Vasus he gave the morning pressing; to the Rudras the midday pressing; to the Ādityas the third pressing. To the Vasus he gave this world; to the Rudras the atmosphere; to the Ādityas the world beyond. Then he created Indra. He (Indra) saw that all this of theirs had been distributed. He said: 'Since all this of theirs has been distributed, for what purpose did you create me?' 'I created you for supremacy and sovereignty over these,' he said. 'How then shall I be their chief and sovereign?' 'Go and tell them: Prajāpati created me for supremacy and sovereignty over you.' He went and said: 'Prajāpati created me for supremacy and sovereignty over you.' They said: 'We are the chiefs, we are the sovereigns, we who are the eldest' — they did not acknowledge him. He returned and said: 'They do not acknowledge what you say.' He (Prajāpati) saw this sacrifice. He brought it. He made him sacrifice with it. Having sacrificed, he struck down all opposition. Because he struck down (vyahata), that is the vighana-ness of the vighana.
meaning: अथैष विघनः . प्रजापतिर् देवान् असृजत वसून् रुद्रान् आदित्यान् . तेभ्यो यज्ञं चेमांश् च लोकान् प्रायच्छत् . वसुभ्य एव प्रातस्सवनं प्रायच्छद् रुद्रेभ्यो माध्यंदिनं सवनम् आदित्येभ्यस् तृतीयसवनम् . वसुभ्य एवेमं लोकं प्रायच्छद् रुद्रेभ्यो ऽन्तरिक्षम् आदित्येभ्यो ऽमुम् . अथेन्द्रम् असृजत . स इदम् एषां सर्वम् विभक्तम् अपश्यत् . सो ऽब्रवीद् यद् इदम् एषां सर्वं विभक्तम् अथ कस्मै माम् असृष्ठा इति . एतेषां त्वा इत्य् अब्रवीच् छ्रैष्ठ्यायाधिपत्यायासृक्षीति . सो ऽहं कथम् एषां श्रेष्ठो ऽधिपति स्याम् इति . परेह्य् एनान् ब्रूहीत्य् अब्रवीद् युष्माकं मा प्रजापति श्रैष्ठ्यायाधिपत्यायासृष्टेति . स एत्याब्रवीद् युष्माकं मा प्रजापति श्रैष्ठ्यायाधिपत्यायासृष्टेति . ते ऽब्रुवन् वयं वाव श्रेष्ठा स्मो वयम् अधिपतयो ये ज्येष्ठा स्म इति नाजानन् . स पुनर् एत्याब्रवीन् न वा अमी तज् जानन्ति यत् त्वम् आत्थेति . स एतं यज्ञम् अपश्यत् . तम् आहरत् . तेनैनम् अयाजयत् . स हेष्ट्वैव सर्वा मृधो व्यहत . यद् व्यहत तद् विघनस्य विघनत्वम् .

sanskrit_iast: taṃ vijigyānaṃ sarve devā abhitas samantaṃ paryaviśan vasavaḥ purastād rudrā dakṣiṇata ādityāḥ paścān maruta uttarato viśve devā upariṣṭāt sādhyāś cāptyāś cāhdastād abhito 'ṅgirasaḥ . eṣā vai daivī śrīr daivā sabhā daivī saṃsat . gacchati ha vā etāṃ daivīṃ śriyaṃ daivīṃsabhāṃ daivīṃ saṃsadaṃ ya evaṃ veda . sa vā eṣa ṣaḍ bṛhatīr abhisaṃpadyate . ṣaḍ vā ṛtavas saṃvatsaraśrīḥ . śriyāṃ vāvainaṃ tad adhyauhat . sa eṣa ṛtuṣu ca saṃvatsare caitasyāṃ śriyām adhyūḍhas tapati . tasya pratnaṃ pīyūṣaṃ pūrvaṃ yad ukthyam ity etāḥ satobṛhatayo bhavanti gāyatrībhājanam . brahma vai gāyatrī . kṣatraṃ bṛhatī . brahmaiva tad yaśasānakti .
sentences: taṃ vijigyānaṃ sarve devā abʰitas samantaṃ paryaviśan vasavaḥ purastād rudrā dakṣiṇata ādityāḥ paścān maruta uttarato viśve devā upariṣṭāt sādʰyāś cāptyāś cāhdastād abʰito 'ṅgirasaḥ .
eṣā vai daivī śrīr daivā sabʰā daivī saṃsat .
gaccʰati ha vā etāṃ daivīṃ śriyaṃ daivīṃsabʰāṃ daivīṃ saṃsadaṃ ya evaṃ veda .
sa vā eṣa ṣaḍ br̥hatīr abʰisaṃpadyate .
sa eṣa r̥tuṣu ca saṃvatsare caitasyāṃ śriyām adʰyūḍʰas tapati .
tasya pratnaṃ pīyūṣaṃ pūrvaṃ yad uktʰyam ity etāḥ satobr̥hatayo bʰavanti gāyatrībʰājanam .
text: Him, the conqueror, all the gods surrounded on every side: the Vasus from the east, the Rudras from the south, the Ādityas from the west, the Maruts from the north, the Viśvedevas from above, the Sādhyas and the Āptyas from below, and the Aṅgirasas on both sides. This is the divine glory (śrī), the divine assembly (sabhā), the divine council (saṃsat). He who knows thus attains this divine glory, divine assembly, and divine council. This amounts to six bṛhatīs. Six are the seasons; the year is glory. He was thus elevated into glory. He who shines yonder is elevated in the seasons, in the year, in this glory. The satobṛhatī verses are 'His ancient essence, the first, which is ukthya' (pratnaṃ pīyūṣaṃ pūrvaṃ yad ukthyam) — they serve as the gāyatrī portion. Brahman is the gāyatrī; kṣatra is the bṛhatī. He thereby anoints brahman with glory.
meaning: तं विजिग्यानं सर्वे देवा अभितस् समन्तं पर्यविशन् वसवः पुरस्ताद् रुद्रा दक्षिणत आदित्याः पश्चान् मरुत उत्तरतो विश्वे देवा उपरिष्टात् साध्याश् चाप्त्याश् चाह्दस्ताद् अभितो ऽङ्गिरसः . एषा वै दैवी श्रीर् दैवा सभा दैवी संसत् . गच्छति ह वा एतां दैवीं श्रियं दैवींसभां दैवीं संसदं य एवं वेद . स वा एष षड् बृहतीर् अभिसंपद्यते . षड् वा ऋतवस् संवत्सरश्रीः . श्रियां वावैनं तद् अध्यौहत् . स एष ऋतुषु च संवत्सरे चैतस्यां श्रियाम् अध्यूढस् तपति . तस्य प्रत्नं पीयूषं पूर्वं यद् उक्थ्यम् इत्य् एताः सतोबृहतयो भवन्ति गायत्रीभाजनम् . ब्रह्म वै गायत्री . क्षत्रं बृहती . ब्रह्मैव तद् यशसानक्ति .

sanskrit_iast: tāsu vyatiṣaktāsu stuvanti vyatiṣaktād vai mithunāt prajāḥ paśavaḥ prajāyante prajātyā eva . atho vyatiṣakto vai puruṣaḥ pāpmabhiḥ . vyatiṣaktābhir eva tad vyatiṣaktān pāpmano 'pahate . tāsu gāyatram uktabrāhmaṇam . athāmahīyavam uktabrāhmaṇam . atha sauparṇam uktabrāhmaṇam . atha satrāsāhīyaṃ vijityai . satrā tam abhiṣahātai yo 'syābhiṣahyo 'sad iti . athotsedhaniṣedhau pāpavasyasasyaivotsiddhyai ca niṣiddhyai ca . atha viśoviśīyaṃ ca sadoviśīyaṃ ca . viśoviśīyena vā indro devān abhyārohat . tān sadoviśam ity eva sadoviśīyena viśam akuruta . athaitās triṣṭubho bhavanti . tāsu brahmasāma . brahma vai brahmasāma . kṣatraṃ triṣṭup . yajamānakāmo vā eṣa yad brahmasāma .
sentences: tāsu vyatiṣaktāsu stuvanti vyatiṣaktād vai mitʰunāt prajāḥ paśavaḥ prajāyante prajātyā eva .
tān sadoviśam ity eva sadoviśīyena viśam akuruta .
text: They chant in interwoven fashion — from an interwoven coupling offspring and cattle are born, for the sake of procreation. Moreover, a person is interwoven with evils; with interwoven [chants] one drives away the interwoven evils. Among them, the gāyatra, with its brāhmaṇa stated. Then the amahīyava, with its brāhmaṇa stated. Then the sauparṇa, with its brāhmaṇa stated. Then the satrāsāhīya — for conquest; may he completely overpower whoever would be his adversary. Then the utsedha and niṣedha — for the repelling and suppressing of evil fortune. Then the viśoviśīya and the sadoviśīya. By the viśoviśīya Indra rose above the gods. By the sadoviśīya he made them sit together in the assembly (sadoviśam), making them his subjects. Then there are triṣṭubh [verses]. Among them is the brahmasāman. Brahman is the brahmasāman; kṣatra is the triṣṭubh. The brahmasāman is the wish of the sacrificer.
meaning: तासु व्यतिषक्तासु स्तुवन्ति व्यतिषक्ताद् वै मिथुनात् प्रजाः पशवः प्रजायन्ते प्रजात्या एव . अथो व्यतिषक्तो वै पुरुषः पाप्मभिः . व्यतिषक्ताभिर् एव तद् व्यतिषक्तान् पाप्मनो ऽपहते . तासु गायत्रम् उक्तब्राह्मणम् . अथामहीयवम् उक्तब्राह्मणम् . अथ सौपर्णम् उक्तब्राह्मणम् . अथ सत्रासाहीयं विजित्यै . सत्रा तम् अभिषहातै यो ऽस्याभिषह्यो ऽसद् इति . अथोत्सेधनिषेधौ पापवस्यसस्यैवोत्सिद्ध्यै च निषिद्ध्यै च . अथ विशोविशीयं च सदोविशीयं च . विशोविशीयेन वा इन्द्रो देवान् अभ्यारोहत् . तान् सदोविशम् इत्य् एव सदोविशीयेन विशम् अकुरुत . अथैतास् त्रिष्टुभो भवन्ति . तासु ब्रह्मसाम . ब्रह्म वै ब्रह्मसाम . क्षत्रं त्रिष्टुप् . यजमानकामो वा एष यद् ब्रह्मसाम .

sanskrit_iast: tāḥ padabrāhmaṇā bhavanti . tad id āsa bhuvaneṣu jyeṣṭham iti prajāpatir hi saḥ . prajāpatir hy eṣa bhuvaneṣu jyeṣṭhaḥ . yato jajña ugras tveṣanṛmṇa iti indro ha saḥ . sadyo jajñāno ni riṇāti śatrūn iti sadyo hy eva sa jajñānas sarvā mṛdho vyahata . anu yaṃ viśve madanty ūmā ity ṛtavo vā ūmās ta evainaṃ tad anumadanti . vāvṛdhānaś śavasā bhūryojāś śatrur dāsāya bhiyasaṃ dadhātī tīndro ha saḥ . avyanaś ca vyanaś ca sasni saṃ te navanta prabhṛtā madeṣv iti yac ca ha vai vyaniti yac ca na tat sarvam etasyaiva śriyai tat sthānam . tve kratum vṛñjanti viśve dvir yad ete trir bhavanty ūmā iti ṛtavo vā ūmās ta evaite dvis trir bhavanti . svādo svādīya svādunā sṛjā sam iti prajā vai svāduḥ prajāyai yā prajā sā svādo svādu . adaḥ su madhu madhunābhi yodhīr iti prajā vai madhu prajāyai yā prajā sā madhor madhu . api ha prajāyai prajāṃ paśyate ya evaṃ veda .
sentences: tad id āsa bʰuvaneṣu jyeṣṭʰam iti prajāpatir hi saḥ .
yato jajña ugras tveṣanr̥mṇa iti indro ha saḥ .
sadyo jajñāno ni riṇāti śatrūn iti sadyo hy eva sa jajñānas sarvā mr̥dʰo vyahata .
anu yaṃ viśve madanty ūmā ity r̥tavo vā ūmās ta evainaṃ tad anumadanti .
vāvr̥dʰānaś śavasā bʰūryojāś śatrur dāsāya bʰiyasaṃ dadʰātī tīndro ha saḥ .
avyanaś ca vyanaś ca sasni saṃ te navanta prabʰr̥tā madeṣv iti yac ca ha vai vyaniti yac ca na tat sarvam etasyaiva śriyai tat stʰānam .
tve kratum vr̥ñjanti viśve dvir yad ete trir bʰavanty ūmā iti r̥tavo vā ūmās ta evaite dvis trir bʰavanti .
svādo svādīya svādunā sr̥jā sam iti prajā vai svāduḥ prajāyai yā prajā sā svādo svādu .
adaḥ su madʰu madʰunābʰi yodʰīr iti prajā vai madʰu prajāyai yā prajā sā madʰor madʰu .
api ha prajāyai prajāṃ paśyate ya evaṃ veda .
text: They have pada-brāhmaṇas (word-by-word explanations). 'That was the greatest among beings' (tad id āsa bhuvaneṣu jyeṣṭham) — that is Prajāpati, for Prajāpati is the greatest among beings. 'From whom was born the fierce one of terrifying strength' (yato jajña ugras tveṣanṛmṇaḥ) — that is Indra. 'As soon as born he destroys his enemies' (sadyo jajñāno ni riṇāti śatrūn) — for as soon as he was born he struck down all opposition. 'Whom all the seasons gladly praise' (anu yaṃ viśve madanty ūmāḥ) — the ūmās are the seasons; they praise him. 'Growing great in strength, of mighty vigour, he puts fear into the enemy' (vāvṛdhānaś śavasā bhūryojāḥ śatrur dāsāya bhiyasaṃ dadhāti) — that is Indra. 'Both the unmoving and the moving yield to you; your praises flow forth in exhilaration' (avyanaś ca vyanaś ca sasni saṃ te navanta prabhṛtā madeṣu) — whatever moves and what does not move, all that is the seat of his glory. 'In you they offer their resolves; twice and thrice come the seasons' (tve kratum api vṛñjanti viśve dvir yad ete trir bhavanty ūmāḥ) — the ūmās are the seasons; they come twice and thrice. 'O sweet one, mix the sweeter with the sweet' (svādo svādīyaḥ svādunā sṛjā sam) — offspring is the sweet; for the offspring that is offspring, that is 'the sweet of the sweet.' 'With that honey contend with honey' (adaḥ su madhu madhunābhi yodhīḥ) — offspring is honey; for the offspring that is offspring, that is 'honey of honey.' He who knows thus indeed sees offspring from offspring.
meaning: ताः पदब्राह्मणा भवन्ति . तद् इद् आस भुवनेषु ज्येष्ठम् इति प्रजापतिर् हि सः . प्रजापतिर् ह्य् एष भुवनेषु ज्येष्ठः . यतो जज्ञ उग्रस् त्वेषनृम्ण इति इन्द्रो ह सः . सद्यो जज्ञानो नि रिणाति शत्रून् इति सद्यो ह्य् एव स जज्ञानस् सर्वा मृधो व्यहत . अनु यं विश्वे मदन्त्य् ऊमा इत्य् ऋतवो वा ऊमास् त एवैनं तद् अनुमदन्ति . वावृधानश् शवसा भूर्योजाश् शत्रुर् दासाय भियसं दधाती तीन्द्रो ह सः . अव्यनश् च व्यनश् च सस्नि सं ते नवन्त प्रभृता मदेष्व् इति यच् च ह वै व्यनिति यच् च न तत् सर्वम् एतस्यैव श्रियै तत् स्थानम् . त्वे क्रतुम् वृञ्जन्ति विश्वे द्विर् यद् एते त्रिर् भवन्त्य् ऊमा इति ऋतवो वा ऊमास् त एवैते द्विस् त्रिर् भवन्ति . स्वादो स्वादीय स्वादुना सृजा सम् इति प्रजा वै स्वादुः प्रजायै या प्रजा सा स्वादो स्वादु . अदः सु मधु मधुनाभि योधीर् इति प्रजा वै मधु प्रजायै या प्रजा सा मधोर् मधु . अपि ह प्रजायै प्रजां पश्यते य एवं वेद .

sanskrit_iast: athaitāni gonāmāni bhavanti paśavo vai gonāmāni paśūnām evāvaruddhyai . ekapadā prathamā bhavati tripade uttare dve . tāni saptapadāni saṃpadyante . saptapadā vai śakvaryaḥ . śākvarāḥ paśavaḥ . abhipūrvāṇām eva paśūnām avaruddhyai . tad āhur apāvamānyo na pavamāne kāryā iti . tad u vā āhuḥ pāvamānya evāmuṣya vā etāś candramasa ṛcaḥ . eṣa vai pavamāna eṣa somo rājā . tasmāt kāryā eveti . sumanmā vasvī rantī sūnarī surūpa vṛṣann ā gahi imau bhadrau dhuryāv abhi tāv imā upasarpataḥ nīva śīrṣāṇi mṛḍhvaṃ madhya āpasya tiṣṭhati śṛṅgebhir daśabhir diśan iti ye ha vā eta ādityasya raśmaya etāni ha vā etasya śṛṅgāṇi . madhya u ha vā eṣa etad apām . tāsu vāravatīyam . yad anena karmaṇāvārutsmahi tan no vāravantīyena vāritam antata upatiṣṭhātā iti . tad u vā āhur yad vāvānyā vāṅ nātivadati tad etasyāhno 'gniṣṭomasāma kāryam . yajñāyajñīyaṃ vāvānyā vāṅ nātivadati . vāg vai yajñāyajñīyam . kuto hi vāg vācam ativadiṣyati .
sentences: atʰaitāni gonāmāni bʰavanti paśavo vai gonāmāni paśūnām evāvaruddʰyai .
ekapadā pratʰamā bʰavati tripade uttare dve .
tad āhur apāvamānyo na pavamāne kāryā iti .
tad u vā āhuḥ pāvamānya evāmuṣya vā etāś candramasa r̥caḥ .
eṣa vai pavamāna eṣa somo rājā .
sumanmā vasvī rantī sūnarī surūpa vr̥ṣann ā gahi
imau bʰadrau dʰuryāv abʰi tāv imā upasarpataḥ
nīva śīrṣāṇi mr̥ḍʰvaṃ madʰya āpasya tiṣṭʰati
iti ye ha vā eta ādityasya raśmaya etāni ha vā etasya śr̥ṅgāṇi .
madʰya u ha vā eṣa etad apām .
yad anena karmaṇāvārutsmahi tan no vāravantīyena vāritam antata upatiṣṭʰātā iti .
tad u vā āhur yad vāvānyā vāṅ nātivadati tad etasyāhno 'gniṣṭomasāma kāryam .
text: Then there are go-nāman (cow-named) [verses]; cattle are the go-nāmans, for the securing of cattle. The first is one-footed (ekapadā); the next two are three-footed (tripadā). They amount to seven feet. The śakvarīs have seven feet. Cattle belong to the śakvarīs — for the securing of cattle from the very beginning. They say the apāvamānī [verses] should not be performed in the pavamāna. But they also say: 'They should be pāvamānīs; these are the verses of yonder moon. He is the pavamāna; he is King Soma; therefore they should be performed.' 'O one of good thoughts, O rich one, O delightful one, O beautiful one, O bull, come!' (sumanmā vasvī rantī sūnarī surūpa vṛṣann ā gahi); 'These two auspicious draft-animals' (imau bhadrau dhuryāv); 'These two attendants approach' (abhi tāv imā upasarpataḥ); 'Bow down your heads' (nīva śīrṣāṇi mṛḍhvam); 'He stands in the middle of the waters' (madhya āpasya tiṣṭhati); 'With ten horns pointing to the directions' (śṛṅgebhir daśabhir diśan) — the rays of the sun are indeed his horns. And he stands in the very middle of the waters. Among them is the vāravantīya [sāman]. 'Whatever we have enclosed by this rite — may the vāravantīya protect it for us, standing at the end.' But they also say: 'Whatever speech no other speech surpasses — that should be the agniṣṭoma-sāman of this day. The yajñāyajñīya is that which no other speech surpasses. For the yajñāyajñīya is speech. How could speech surpass speech?'
meaning: अथैतानि गोनामानि भवन्ति पशवो वै गोनामानि पशूनाम् एवावरुद्ध्यै . एकपदा प्रथमा भवति त्रिपदे उत्तरे द्वे . तानि सप्तपदानि संपद्यन्ते . सप्तपदा वै शक्वर्यः . शाक्वराः पशवः . अभिपूर्वाणाम् एव पशूनाम् अवरुद्ध्यै . तद् आहुर् अपावमान्यो न पवमाने कार्या इति . तद् उ वा आहुः पावमान्य एवामुष्य वा एताश् चन्द्रमस ऋचः . एष वै पवमान एष सोमो राजा . तस्मात् कार्या एवेति . सुमन्मा वस्वी रन्ती सूनरी सुरूप वृषन्न् आ गहि इमौ भद्रौ धुर्याव् अभि ताव् इमा उपसर्पतः नीव शीर्षाणि मृढ्वं मध्य आपस्य तिष्ठति शृङ्गेभिर् दशभिर् दिशन् इति ये ह वा एत आदित्यस्य रश्मय एतानि ह वा एतस्य शृङ्गाणि . मध्य उ ह वा एष एतद् अपाम् . तासु वारवतीयम् . यद् अनेन कर्मणावारुत्स्महि तन् नो वारवन्तीयेन वारितम् अन्तत उपतिष्ठाता इति . तद् उ वा आहुर् यद् वावान्या वाङ् नातिवदति तद् एतस्याह्नो ऽग्निष्टोमसाम कार्यम् . यज्ञायज्ञीयं वावान्या वाङ् नातिवदति . वाग् वै यज्ञायज्ञीयम् . कुतो हि वाग् वाचम् अतिवदिष्यति .

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣa vaiśvadevaḥ . prajananakāmo haitena yajeta . prajāpatir vā akāmayata bahuḥ prajayā paśubhiḥ prajāyeya vaiśvadevīḥ prajās sṛjeyeti . sa etaṃ yajñam apaśyat . tam āharat . tenāyajata . tato vai sa bahuḥ prajayā paśubhiḥ prājāyata vaiśvadevīḥ prajā asṛjata . sa yat kāmayeta bahuḥ prajayā paśubhiḥ prajāyeya vaiśvadevīḥ prajās sṛjeyeti sa etena yajeta . bahur eva prajayā paśubhiḥ prajāyate vaiśvadevīḥ prajās sṛjate . tad yad eṣa vaiśvadevo bhavati vaiśvadevīnām eva prajānāṃ sṛṣṭyai . sa sarva eva vaiśvadevīṣu bhavati vaiśvadevīnām eva prajānāṃ prajātyai . sa trivṛd bhavati nyūnaṃ vai trivṛt . nyūnaṃ prajananam tad yat prajananaṃ tan mā prajanayād iti . tasya rathantaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati prajananaṃ vai rathantaraṃ tad yat prajananaṃ tan mā prajanayād iti . sa ukthyo bhavati prajā vai paśava ukthāni .
sentences: prajāpatir vā akāmayata bahuḥ prajayā paśubʰiḥ prajāyeya vaiśvadevīḥ prajās sr̥jeyeti .
tato vai sa bahuḥ prajayā paśubʰiḥ prājāyata vaiśvadevīḥ prajā asr̥jata .
sa yat kāmayeta bahuḥ prajayā paśubʰiḥ prajāyeya vaiśvadevīḥ prajās sr̥jeyeti sa etena yajeta .
bahur eva prajayā paśubʰiḥ prajāyate vaiśvadevīḥ prajās sr̥jate .
tad yad eṣa vaiśvadevo bʰavati vaiśvadevīnām eva prajānāṃ sr̥ṣṭyai .
sa sarva eva vaiśvadevīṣu bʰavati vaiśvadevīnām eva prajānāṃ prajātyai .
sa trivr̥d bʰavati nyūnaṃ vai trivr̥t .
nyūnaṃ prajananam tad yat prajananaṃ tan mā prajanayād iti .
tasya ratʰantaraṃ pr̥ṣṭʰaṃ bʰavati prajananaṃ vai ratʰantaraṃ tad yat prajananaṃ tan mā prajanayād iti .
sa uktʰyo bʰavati prajā vai paśava uktʰāni .
text: Now this is the vaiśvadeva (all-gods rite). One desiring offspring should sacrifice with this. Prajāpati desired: 'May I become abundant in offspring and cattle; may I create creatures belonging to all the gods (vaiśvadevī).' He saw this sacrifice. He brought it. He sacrificed with it. Then he became abundant in offspring and cattle; he created creatures belonging to all the gods. He who should desire: 'May I become abundant in offspring and cattle; may I create vaiśvadevī creatures' — he should sacrifice with this. He becomes abundant in offspring and cattle; he creates vaiśvadevī creatures. Because this is the vaiśvadeva, it is for the creation of vaiśvadevī creatures. It is entirely in vaiśvadevī [verses], for the procreation of vaiśvadevī creatures. It is trivṛt (threefold). The trivṛt is diminished, as it were; procreation is diminished, as it were — 'May that which is procreation cause me to procreate.' Its pṛṣṭha is the rathantara, for procreation is the rathantara — 'May that which is procreation cause me to procreate.' It is ukthya, for offspring and cattle are the ukthāni.
meaning: अथैष वैश्वदेवः . प्रजननकामो हैतेन यजेत . प्रजापतिर् वा अकामयत बहुः प्रजया पशुभिः प्रजायेय वैश्वदेवीः प्रजास् सृजेयेति . स एतं यज्ञम् अपश्यत् . तम् आहरत् . तेनायजत . ततो वै स बहुः प्रजया पशुभिः प्राजायत वैश्वदेवीः प्रजा असृजत . स यत् कामयेत बहुः प्रजया पशुभिः प्रजायेय वैश्वदेवीः प्रजास् सृजेयेति स एतेन यजेत . बहुर् एव प्रजया पशुभिः प्रजायते वैश्वदेवीः प्रजास् सृजते . तद् यद् एष वैश्वदेवो भवति वैश्वदेवीनाम् एव प्रजानां सृष्ट्यै . स सर्व एव वैश्वदेवीषु भवति वैश्वदेवीनाम् एव प्रजानां प्रजात्यै . स त्रिवृद् भवति न्यूनं वै त्रिवृत् . न्यूनं प्रजननम् तद् यत् प्रजननं तन् मा प्रजनयाद् इति . तस्य रथन्तरं पृष्ठं भवति प्रजननं वै रथन्तरं तद् यत् प्रजननं तन् मा प्रजनयाद् इति . स उक्थ्यो भवति प्रजा वै पशव उक्थानि .

sanskrit_iast: atho āhus saptadaśa eva syād iti prajāpatir vai saptadaśaḥ . prajāpatiḥ prajananaṃ sa yaḥ prajananaṃ sa mā prajanayād iti . atho āhus triṇava eva syād iti . trayo ha te trivṛtaḥ . nyānaṃ vai trivṛt . nyūnaṃ prajananam . tad yat prajananaṃ tan mā prajanayād iti . atho āhus trayastriṃśa eva syād iti . prajāpatir vai trayastriṃśaḥ . prajāpatiḥ prajananam . sa yaḥ prajananaṃ sa mā prajanayād iti . tad u vā āhus saptadaśa eva syāt . eṣa ha vāva prajāpatir yat saptadaśaḥ . tasmāt saptadaśa eva syād iti . sa u eva trivṛtaṃ ca stomaṃ gāyatrīṃ ca chando 'bhisaṃpadyate . etad vai daivyaṃ mithunaṃ prajananaṃ yat trivṛc ca stomo gāyatrī ca chandaḥ . tad yad daivyaṃ mithunaṃ prajananaṃ tan mā prajanayād iti . sa ukthyo bhavati viḍ vā ukthāni vaiśvadevīnām eva prajānāṃ prajātyai . sa haiṣa bhūr eva nāma yajñakratuḥ . etena ha vai yajñeneṣṭvā prajāpatir abhavat . yad abhavat tasmād bhūḥ . bhavati ya evaṃ veda . sa vā eṣa vaiśyasyeva yajño brāhmaṇasyāgniṣṭud rājanyasyendrastomaḥ . yarhi vā etair evaṃ vyākṛtair ījire proktā ha sma manuṣyā vijñāyante . brāhmaṇo vadati rājanyo vadati vaiśyo vadatīti .
sentences: atʰo āhus saptadaśa eva syād iti prajāpatir vai saptadaśaḥ .
prajāpatiḥ prajananaṃ sa yaḥ prajananaṃ sa mā prajanayād iti .
atʰo āhus triṇava eva syād iti .
tad yat prajananaṃ tan mā prajanayād iti .
atʰo āhus trayastriṃśa eva syād iti .
sa yaḥ prajananaṃ sa mā prajanayād iti .
tad u vā āhus saptadaśa eva syāt .
eṣa ha vāva prajāpatir yat saptadaśaḥ .
