sa u eva trivr̥taṃ ca stomaṃ gāyatrīṃ ca cʰando 'bʰisaṃpadyate .
etad vai daivyaṃ mitʰunaṃ prajananaṃ yat trivr̥c ca stomo gāyatrī ca cʰandaḥ .
tad yad daivyaṃ mitʰunaṃ prajananaṃ tan mā prajanayād iti .
sa uktʰyo bʰavati viḍ vā uktʰāni vaiśvadevīnām eva prajānāṃ prajātyai .
sa haiṣa bʰūr eva nāma yajñakratuḥ .
etena ha vai yajñeneṣṭvā prajāpatir abʰavat .
sa vā eṣa vaiśyasyeva yajño brāhmaṇasyāgniṣṭud rājanyasyendrastomaḥ .
yarhi vā etair evaṃ vyākr̥tair ījire proktā ha sma manuṣyā vijñāyante .
brāhmaṇo vadati rājanyo vadati vaiśyo vadatīti .
text: And they say: 'It should be saptadaśa (seventeenfold), for Prajāpati is the saptadaśa; Prajāpati is procreation — may that which is procreation cause me to procreate.' And they say: 'It should be triṇava (twenty-sevenfold), for those are three trivṛts. The trivṛt is diminished; procreation is diminished — may that which is procreation cause me to procreate.' And they say: 'It should be trayastriṃśa (thirty-threefold), for Prajāpati is the trayastriṃśa; Prajāpati is procreation — may that which is procreation cause me to procreate.' But they say: 'It should be saptadaśa, for Prajāpati is indeed the saptadaśa; therefore it should be saptadaśa.' It amounts to the trivṛt stoma and the gāyatrī metre. This is the divine couple (mithuna) of procreation — the trivṛt stoma and the gāyatrī metre — 'May that which is the divine couple of procreation cause me to procreate.' It is ukthya; the ukthāni are the viś (people), for the procreation of vaiśvadevī creatures. This sacrificial rite is called bhū. By sacrificing with this sacrifice, Prajāpati came into being (abhavat). Because he came into being, it is [called] bhū. He who knows thus comes into being. This sacrifice is, as it were, for the vaiśya, as the agniṣṭut is for the brāhmaṇa and the indrastoma for the rājanya. When they sacrificed with these distinct [rites], humans were known and distinguished: 'A brāhmaṇa speaks; a rājanya speaks; a vaiśya speaks.'
meaning: अथो आहुस् सप्तदश एव स्याद् इति प्रजापतिर् वै सप्तदशः . प्रजापतिः प्रजननं स यः प्रजननं स मा प्रजनयाद् इति . अथो आहुस् त्रिणव एव स्याद् इति . त्रयो ह ते त्रिवृतः . न्यानं वै त्रिवृत् . न्यूनं प्रजननम् . तद् यत् प्रजननं तन् मा प्रजनयाद् इति . अथो आहुस् त्रयस्त्रिंश एव स्याद् इति . प्रजापतिर् वै त्रयस्त्रिंशः . प्रजापतिः प्रजननम् . स यः प्रजननं स मा प्रजनयाद् इति . तद् उ वा आहुस् सप्तदश एव स्यात् . एष ह वाव प्रजापतिर् यत् सप्तदशः . तस्मात् सप्तदश एव स्याद् इति . स उ एव त्रिवृतं च स्तोमं गायत्रीं च छन्दो ऽभिसंपद्यते . एतद् वै दैव्यं मिथुनं प्रजननं यत् त्रिवृच् च स्तोमो गायत्री च छन्दः . तद् यद् दैव्यं मिथुनं प्रजननं तन् मा प्रजनयाद् इति . स उक्थ्यो भवति विड् वा उक्थानि वैश्वदेवीनाम् एव प्रजानां प्रजात्यै . स हैष भूर् एव नाम यज्ञक्रतुः . एतेन ह वै यज्ञेनेष्ट्वा प्रजापतिर् अभवत् . यद् अभवत् तस्माद् भूः . भवति य एवं वेद . स वा एष वैश्यस्येव यज्ञो ब्राह्मणस्याग्निष्टुद् राजन्यस्येन्द्रस्तोमः . यर्हि वा एतैर् एवं व्याकृतैर् ईजिरे प्रोक्ता ह स्म मनुष्या विज्ञायन्ते . ब्राह्मणो वदति राजन्यो वदति वैश्यो वदतीति .

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣa upahavyaḥ . prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata . tāsāṃ sṛṣṭānāṃ nāven no eva prajā aviduḥ prajāpatir no 'sṛṣṭeti . sa aikṣata kathaṃ nv imā ahaṃ prajās sṛjeya tāsāṃ sṛṣṭānāṃ na vidyām iti . sa etaṃ yajñam apaśyat . tam āharat . tenāyajata . tato 'nenaiva tā upāhvayata . yad upāhvayata tad upahavyasyopahavyatvam . sa saptadaśo 'niruktāsu bhavati . yathā ha vai vanākakṣā evaṃ saptadaśo 'niruktāsu . sa yathā vanākakṣān parītyāvirbhaved evam evaitābhir dṛṣṭavatībhir āvirbabhūva . yad adarṣi gātuvittama ity etāsu dṛṣṭavatīṣv agniṣṭomasāma bhavati . tato vai taṃ tā avidur asya vai vayaṃ smo 'yaṃ vā asmākam āseti . atho hābhyo 'nnam eva bhūto dadṛśe . tā enam annakāśinīḥ prajā abhyupāvavṛtuḥ . tad yasmād rājanyād viśo 'pakrāmeyur brāhmaṇād vā sajātās sa etena yajeta . tasminn ṛtvija upahvayeta .
sentences: tāsāṃ sr̥ṣṭānāṃ nāven no eva prajā aviduḥ prajāpatir no 'sr̥ṣṭeti .
sa aikṣata katʰaṃ nv imā ahaṃ prajās sr̥jeya tāsāṃ sr̥ṣṭānāṃ na vidyām iti .
yatʰā ha vai vanākakṣā evaṃ saptadaśo 'niruktāsu .
sa yatʰā vanākakṣān parītyāvirbʰaved evam evaitābʰir dr̥ṣṭavatībʰir āvirbabʰūva .
yad adarṣi gātuvittama ity etāsu dr̥ṣṭavatīṣv agniṣṭomasāma bʰavati .
tato vai taṃ tā avidur asya vai vayaṃ smo 'yaṃ vā asmākam āseti .
tad yasmād rājanyād viśo 'pakrāmeyur brāhmaṇād vā sajātās sa etena yajeta .
text: Now this is the upahavya (summoning rite). Prajāpati created creatures. Of those created, none knew: 'Prajāpati created us.' He considered: 'How might I create these creatures so that, once created, they would know me?' He saw this sacrifice. He brought it. He sacrificed with it. Then by this very [sacrifice] he summoned them. Because he summoned (upāhvayata), that is the upahavya-ness of the upahavya. It is saptadaśa (seventeenfold), in unspecified (anirukta) [verses]. The saptadaśa in unspecified verses is, as it were, a forest thicket. Just as one would emerge from a forest thicket, so he emerged by these verses containing [the root] dṛś (seeing). 'He has been seen, the best finder of the path' (yad adarṣi gātuvittama) — in these verses containing 'seeing,' the agniṣṭoma-sāman is set. Then they knew him: 'We are indeed his; he is indeed ours.' And he appeared to them as food. Those creatures, seeing food, turned toward him. He from whom the viś (subjects) would depart — whether a rājanya or a brāhmaṇa from whom kinsmen [depart] — he should sacrifice with this. He should summon the priests for it.
meaning: अथैष उपहव्यः . प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत . तासां सृष्टानां नावेन् नो एव प्रजा अविदुः प्रजापतिर् नो ऽसृष्टेति . स ऐक्षत कथं न्व् इमा अहं प्रजास् सृजेय तासां सृष्टानां न विद्याम् इति . स एतं यज्ञम् अपश्यत् . तम् आहरत् . तेनायजत . ततो ऽनेनैव ता उपाह्वयत . यद् उपाह्वयत तद् उपहव्यस्योपहव्यत्वम् . स सप्तदशो ऽनिरुक्तासु भवति . यथा ह वै वनाकक्षा एवं सप्तदशो ऽनिरुक्तासु . स यथा वनाकक्षान् परीत्याविर्भवेद् एवम् एवैताभिर् दृष्टवतीभिर् आविर्बभूव . यद् अदर्षि गातुवित्तम इत्य् एतासु दृष्टवतीष्व् अग्निष्टोमसाम भवति . ततो वै तं ता अविदुर् अस्य वै वयं स्मो ऽयं वा अस्माकम् आसेति . अथो हाभ्यो ऽन्नम् एव भूतो ददृशे . ता एनम् अन्नकाशिनीः प्रजा अभ्युपाववृतुः . तद् यस्माद् राजन्याद् विशो ऽपक्रामेयुर् ब्राह्मणाद् वा सजातास् स एतेन यजेत . तस्मिन्न् ऋत्विज उपह्वयेत .

sanskrit_iast: tasya rathantaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati . annaṃ vai rathantaram . atho hāsmin bahv eva pakvānnaṃ dadyāt . tā enam annakāśinīḥ prajā abhyupāvartante . prajāpatir yajñam asṛjata . taṃ devebhyaḥ prāyacchat . sa yajñaṃ pradāya riricāno 'manyata . sa aikṣata kathaṃ nv aham imaṃ yajñaṃ punar upahvayeyeti . sa etenaiva yajñenāyajata . tenainaṃ punar upāhvayata . yad upāhvayata tad v evopahavyasyopahavyatvam . tad yaṃ sakṛdiṣṭinaṃ yajño nopanamet sa etena yajeta . apakrānto ha vā etasmād yajño bhavati . yaṃ sakṛdiṣṭinaṃ yajño nopanamaty etena haivainaṃ punar upahvayate .
sentences: atʰo hāsmin bahv eva pakvānnaṃ dadyāt .
sa aikṣata katʰaṃ nv aham imaṃ yajñaṃ punar upahvayeyeti .
tad yaṃ sakr̥diṣṭinaṃ yajño nopanamet sa etena yajeta .
apakrānto ha vā etasmād yajño bʰavati .
yaṃ sakr̥diṣṭinaṃ yajño nopanamaty etena haivainaṃ punar upahvayate .
text: Its pṛṣṭha is the rathantara, for the rathantara is food. And one should give him much cooked food. Those creatures, seeing food, turn back to him. Prajāpati created the sacrifice. He gave it to the gods. Having given away the sacrifice, he felt diminished. He considered: 'How might I summon this sacrifice back?' He sacrificed with this very sacrifice. By it he summoned it back. Because he summoned (upāhvayata), that too is the upahavya-ness of the upahavya. He whom, having sacrificed once, the sacrifice does not approach again — he should sacrifice with this. The sacrifice has departed from him — from one whom, having sacrificed once, the sacrifice does not approach. By this he summons it back.
meaning: तस्य रथन्तरं पृष्ठं भवति . अन्नं वै रथन्तरम् . अथो हास्मिन् बह्व् एव पक्वान्नं दद्यात् . ता एनम् अन्नकाशिनीः प्रजा अभ्युपावर्तन्ते . प्रजापतिर् यज्ञम् असृजत . तं देवेभ्यः प्रायच्छत् . स यज्ञं प्रदाय रिरिचानो ऽमन्यत . स ऐक्षत कथं न्व् अहम् इमं यज्ञं पुनर् उपह्वयेयेति . स एतेनैव यज्ञेनायजत . तेनैनं पुनर् उपाह्वयत . यद् उपाह्वयत तद् व् एवोपहव्यस्योपहव्यत्वम् . तद् यं सकृदिष्टिनं यज्ञो नोपनमेत् स एतेन यजेत . अपक्रान्तो ह वा एतस्माद् यज्ञो भवति . यं सकृदिष्टिनं यज्ञो नोपनमत्य् एतेन हैवैनं पुनर् उपह्वयते .

sanskrit_iast: dvayā u ha vā agre prājāpatyā āsur devāś caivāsurāś ca . tato hābhirādhayattarā iva devā āsur anabhirādhayattarā ivāsurāḥ . sa prajāpatir akāmayata devā eva syuḥ parāsurā bhaveyur iti . sa etaṃ yajñam apaśyat . tam āharat . tenāyajata . tasmin devān upāhvayata . athāsurān dīrghavaṃśenāntaragṛhṇāt . tato vai devā abhavan parāsurāḥ . bhavaty ātmanā parāsya dviṣan bhrātṛvyo bhavati ya evaṃ veda . sa yo bhrātṛvyavān syād yo 'bhicared ya spardheta sa etena yajeta . tad ye 'sya pratikāmīnā ivartvija syus tān upahvayeta . athetarān dīrghavaṃśenāntargṛhṇīyāt .
sentences: dvayā u ha vā agre prājāpatyā āsur devāś caivāsurāś ca .
tato hābʰirādʰayattarā iva devā āsur anabʰirādʰayattarā ivāsurāḥ .
sa prajāpatir akāmayata devā eva syuḥ parāsurā bʰaveyur iti .
bʰavaty ātmanā parāsya dviṣan bʰrātr̥vyo bʰavati ya evaṃ veda .
sa yo bʰrātr̥vyavān syād yo 'bʰicared ya spardʰeta sa etena yajeta .
tad ye 'sya pratikāmīnā ivartvija syus tān upahvayeta .
text: In the beginning there were two kinds of Prājāpatya beings — gods and asuras. Of them, the gods were, as it were, more successful; the asuras less successful. Prajāpati desired: 'May the gods prevail; may the asuras perish.' He saw this sacrifice. He brought it. He sacrificed with it. In it he summoned the gods. And the asuras he shut out with the long pole (dīrghavaṃśa). Then the gods prevailed and the asuras perished. He prevails by his own self; his hateful rival perishes — he who knows thus. He who has a rival, who is attacked by sorcery, who has a competitor — he should sacrifice with this. Those of his priests who are, as it were, favorable to him — them he should summon. The others he should shut out with the long pole.
meaning: द्वया उ ह वा अग्रे प्राजापत्या आसुर् देवाश् चैवासुराश् च . ततो हाभिराधयत्तरा इव देवा आसुर् अनभिराधयत्तरा इवासुराः . स प्रजापतिर् अकामयत देवा एव स्युः परासुरा भवेयुर् इति . स एतं यज्ञम् अपश्यत् . तम् आहरत् . तेनायजत . तस्मिन् देवान् उपाह्वयत . अथासुरान् दीर्घवंशेनान्तरगृह्णात् . ततो वै देवा अभवन् परासुराः . भवत्य् आत्मना परास्य द्विषन् भ्रातृव्यो भवति य एवं वेद . स यो भ्रातृव्यवान् स्याद् यो ऽभिचरेद् य स्पर्धेत स एतेन यजेत . तद् ये ऽस्य प्रतिकामीना इवर्त्विज स्युस् तान् उपह्वयेत . अथेतरान् दीर्घवंशेनान्तर्गृह्णीयात् .

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣa tīvrasomaḥ . prajākāmo haitena yajeta . tanur iva ha vā eṣa yo 'prajaḥ . prajayo ha vai puruṣas tīvro bahulaḥ . prajayā tīvro bahulo 'sānīti . atho āhuḥ paśukāma evainena yajeteti . tanur iva ha vā eṣa yo 'paśuḥ . paśubhir ha vai puruṣas tīvro bahulaḥ . paśubhis tīvro bahulo 'sānīti . sa saptadaśo bhavati . eṣa ha vai tīvro bahulo yat saptadaśaḥ . prajayā paśubhis tīvro bahulo 'sānīti . tasyobhe bṛhadrathantare sāmanī bhavataḥ . ete ha vai tīvre bahule yad ubhe bṛhadrathantare . prajayā paśubhis tīvro bahulo 'sānīti . tasya vaḍavā garbhiṇī dakṣiṇā bhavati . eṣā ha vai tīvrā bahulā yad vaḍavā . tīvrā tena bahulā yad garbhiṇī . tīvrā tena bahulā yad ubhayatodatī . tīvrā tena bahulā yad ekā satī bahvīr gā arhati . prajayā paśubhis tīvro bahulo 'sānīti . atho āhur dhenuśatam evāsya nānāvatsaṃ dakṣiṇā syād iti . etad dha vai tīvraṃ bahulaṃ yad dhenuśatam . tīvraṃ tena bahulaṃ yac chatam . tīvraṃ tena bahulam yad asya payaḥ . tīvraṃ tena bahulaṃ yad asya vatsāḥ .
sentences: tanur iva ha vā eṣa yo 'prajaḥ .
prajayo ha vai puruṣas tīvro bahulaḥ .
tanur iva ha vā eṣa yo 'paśuḥ .
paśubʰir ha vai puruṣas tīvro bahulaḥ .
eṣa ha vai tīvro bahulo yat saptadaśaḥ .
ete ha vai tīvre bahule yad ubʰe br̥hadratʰantare .
eṣā ha vai tīvrā bahulā yad vaḍavā .
tīvrā tena bahulā yad ekā satī bahvīr gā arhati .
atʰo āhur dʰenuśatam evāsya nānāvatsaṃ dakṣiṇā syād iti .
etad dʰa vai tīvraṃ bahulaṃ yad dʰenuśatam .
tīvraṃ tena bahulam yad asya payaḥ .
tīvraṃ tena bahulaṃ yad asya vatsāḥ .
text: Now this is the tīvrasoma (intense soma). One desiring offspring should sacrifice with this. He who is without offspring is, as it were, thin. Through offspring a man becomes intense (tīvra) and abundant (bahula) — 'May I become intense and abundant through offspring.' And they say: 'One desiring cattle should sacrifice with this. He who is without cattle is, as it were, thin. Through cattle a man becomes intense and abundant — may I become intense and abundant through cattle.' It is saptadaśa (seventeenfold), for the saptadaśa is indeed intense and abundant — 'May I become intense and abundant through offspring and cattle.' It has both bṛhat and rathantara as its sāmans, for those two are intense and abundant — 'May I become intense and abundant through offspring and cattle.' Its dakṣiṇā is a pregnant mare. A mare is intense and abundant; she is intense and abundant because she is pregnant; she is intense and abundant because she has teeth on both sides; she is intense and abundant because, being one, she is worth many cows — 'May I become intense and abundant through offspring and cattle.' And they say: 'His dakṣiṇā should be a hundred cows with different calves.' A hundred cows are indeed intense and abundant: intense and abundant because they are a hundred; intense and abundant because of their milk; intense and abundant because of their calves.
meaning: अथैष तीव्रसोमः . प्रजाकामो हैतेन यजेत . तनुर् इव ह वा एष यो ऽप्रजः . प्रजयो ह वै पुरुषस् तीव्रो बहुलः . प्रजया तीव्रो बहुलो ऽसानीति . अथो आहुः पशुकाम एवैनेन यजेतेति . तनुर् इव ह वा एष यो ऽपशुः . पशुभिर् ह वै पुरुषस् तीव्रो बहुलः . पशुभिस् तीव्रो बहुलो ऽसानीति . स सप्तदशो भवति . एष ह वै तीव्रो बहुलो यत् सप्तदशः . प्रजया पशुभिस् तीव्रो बहुलो ऽसानीति . तस्योभे बृहद्रथन्तरे सामनी भवतः . एते ह वै तीव्रे बहुले यद् उभे बृहद्रथन्तरे . प्रजया पशुभिस् तीव्रो बहुलो ऽसानीति . तस्य वडवा गर्भिणी दक्षिणा भवति . एषा ह वै तीव्रा बहुला यद् वडवा . तीव्रा तेन बहुला यद् गर्भिणी . तीव्रा तेन बहुला यद् उभयतोदती . तीव्रा तेन बहुला यद् एका सती बह्वीर् गा अर्हति . प्रजया पशुभिस् तीव्रो बहुलो ऽसानीति . अथो आहुर् धेनुशतम् एवास्य नानावत्सं दक्षिणा स्याद् इति . एतद् ध वै तीव्रं बहुलं यद् धेनुशतम् . तीव्रं तेन बहुलं यच् छतम् . तीव्रं तेन बहुलम् यद् अस्य पयः . तीव्रं तेन बहुलं यद् अस्य वत्साः .

sanskrit_iast: indro vṛtraṃ vajreṇādhyasya nāstṛṣīti manyamānaḥ parāṃ parāvatam agacchat . taṃ devā anvaicchan . taṃ nānvavindan . te 'bruvann abhiṣuṇavāmaiva . tata āgamiṣyatīti . te 'bhyaṣuṇvan . teṣāṃ ha sarvam eva prātassavanaṃ nājagāma . te ha sma camasān urasy upanigrāham abhyunnayante ned apendrasya somasya bhakṣayāmeti . sa u ha mādhyaṃdine savana ājagāma . te hotkrodaṃ cakrire yathā śreṣṭhiny āgata utkrodaṃ kurvate tathā . tad u vā āhur acchāvākasyed vāva stotre prātassavana ājagāma . antarito vai tathā yajñād abhaviṣyad yad acchāvākasya stotre prātassavane nāgamiṣyad iti . tasmād etasya yajñasyācchāvākasya stotre bhakṣayanti . tasmād v acchāvākāyobhāv adhvaryū pratyāgṛhṇītaḥ sarve camasādhvaryavaḥ . utkrodam eva tat kurvate . tad yasmāc chrīr apakrāmet sa etena yajeta . śrīr vai teṣāṃ sāpākrāmad yad eṣāṃ śreṣṭhy apākrāmat . tām etenaivānvavindan .
sentences: indro vr̥traṃ vajreṇādʰyasya nāstr̥ṣīti manyamānaḥ parāṃ parāvatam agaccʰat .
teṣāṃ ha sarvam eva prātassavanaṃ nājagāma .
te ha sma camasān urasy upanigrāham abʰyunnayante ned apendrasya somasya bʰakṣayāmeti .
sa u ha mādʰyaṃdine savana ājagāma .
te hotkrodaṃ cakrire yatʰā śreṣṭʰiny āgata utkrodaṃ kurvate tatʰā .
tad u vā āhur accʰāvākasyed vāva stotre prātassavana ājagāma .
antarito vai tatʰā yajñād abʰaviṣyad yad accʰāvākasya stotre prātassavane nāgamiṣyad iti .
tasmād v accʰāvākāyobʰāv adʰvaryū pratyāgr̥hṇītaḥ sarve camasādʰvaryavaḥ .
tad yasmāc cʰrīr apakrāmet sa etena yajeta .
śrīr vai teṣāṃ sāpākrāmad yad eṣāṃ śreṣṭʰy apākrāmat .
text: Indra, having struck Vṛtra with his vajra, thinking 'I have not vanquished him,' went to the farthest distance. The gods searched for him. They did not find him. They said: 'Let us just press the soma; he will come from there.' They pressed. He did not come for the entire morning pressing. They raised the cups to their chests, holding them close, [saying:] 'Let us not drink of the soma without Indra.' But he came at the midday pressing. They made a joyful clamor, as people make a joyful clamor when the chief has arrived. But they say: 'He came at the very stotra of the acchāvāka priest, at the morning pressing. He would have been excluded from the sacrifice had he not come at the stotra of the acchāvāka at the morning pressing.' Therefore at this sacrifice they partake at the stotra of the acchāvāka. Therefore both adhvaryus receive back [the cups] for the acchāvāka, and all the cup-bearing adhvaryus. They make the joyful clamor. He from whom glory (śrī) departs should sacrifice with this. For their glory departed when their chief departed. By this very [sacrifice] they found it again.
meaning: इन्द्रो वृत्रं वज्रेणाध्यस्य नास्तृषीति मन्यमानः परां परावतम् अगच्छत् . तं देवा अन्वैच्छन् . तं नान्वविन्दन् . ते ऽब्रुवन्न् अभिषुणवामैव . तत आगमिष्यतीति . ते ऽभ्यषुण्वन् . तेषां ह सर्वम् एव प्रातस्सवनं नाजगाम . ते ह स्म चमसान् उरस्य् उपनिग्राहम् अभ्युन्नयन्ते नेद् अपेन्द्रस्य सोमस्य भक्षयामेति . स उ ह माध्यंदिने सवन आजगाम . ते होत्क्रोदं चक्रिरे यथा श्रेष्ठिन्य् आगत उत्क्रोदं कुर्वते तथा . तद् उ वा आहुर् अच्छावाकस्येद् वाव स्तोत्रे प्रातस्सवन आजगाम . अन्तरितो वै तथा यज्ञाद् अभविष्यद् यद् अच्छावाकस्य स्तोत्रे प्रातस्सवने नागमिष्यद् इति . तस्माद् एतस्य यज्ञस्याच्छावाकस्य स्तोत्रे भक्षयन्ति . तस्माद् व् अच्छावाकायोभाव् अध्वर्यू प्रत्यागृह्णीतः सर्वे चमसाध्वर्यवः . उत्क्रोदम् एव तत् कुर्वते . तद् यस्माच् छ्रीर् अपक्रामेत् स एतेन यजेत . श्रीर् वै तेषां सापाक्रामद् यद् एषां श्रेष्ठ्य् अपाक्रामत् . ताम् एतेनैवान्वविन्दन् .

sanskrit_iast: triśīrṣā ha vai tvāṣṭra āsa . tasya ha trīṇi mukhāny āsus somapānam ekaṃ surāpānam ekam annādanam ekam . prastauti ha smaikenaikena gāyati pratiharaty ekenāśrāvayaty ekena pratyāśrāvayaty ekena śaṃsaty ekena . sa ha smaikāky evānuparisarpaṃ sarvaṃ yajñaṃ saṃsthāpayati . sa heyadvīryāvān āsa . sa u hāsurīputra āsa . sa ha sma pratyakṣaṃ devebhyo vadati parokṣam asurebhyaḥ . yasmā u ha vā bhūyaḥ kāmayate tasmai parokṣaṃ vadati . tasmād u hendro bibhayāṃ cakāra yac cāsurīputra āsa yad u ceyadvīryāvān āsa . sa hekṣāṃ cakre 'suryo vā ayam āsurīputraḥ . sa pratyakṣam asmabhyaṃ vadati parokṣam asurebhyaḥ .
sentences: tasya ha trīṇi mukʰāny āsus somapānam ekaṃ surāpānam ekam annādanam ekam .
prastauti ha smaikenaikena gāyati pratiharaty ekenāśrāvayaty ekena pratyāśrāvayaty ekena śaṃsaty ekena .
sa ha smaikāky evānuparisarpaṃ sarvaṃ yajñaṃ saṃstʰāpayati .
sa ha sma pratyakṣaṃ devebʰyo vadati parokṣam asurebʰyaḥ .
yasmā u ha vā bʰūyaḥ kāmayate tasmai parokṣaṃ vadati .
tasmād u hendro bibʰayāṃ cakāra yac cāsurīputra āsa yad u ceyadvīryāvān āsa .
sa hekṣāṃ cakre 'suryo vā ayam āsurīputraḥ .
sa pratyakṣam asmabʰyaṃ vadati parokṣam asurebʰyaḥ .
text: Triśīrṣā Tvāṣṭra (the three-headed son of Tvaṣṭṛ) indeed had three mouths: one for soma-drinking, one for surā-drinking, and one for food-eating. With one he would chant the prastāva, with one he would sing, with one he would make the pratihāra, with one he would call out the āśrāvaya, with one he would respond with the pratyāśrāvaya, with one he would recite the śastra. He alone, going around, would bring the entire sacrifice to completion. He was of such great power. And he was the son of an Asura woman. He would speak openly to the gods and secretly to the Asuras. To whomever he was more favorably disposed, to him he would speak secretly. Therefore Indra feared him, both because he was the son of an Asura woman and because he was of such great power. He reflected: 'This one is of Asura nature, being the son of an Asura woman. He speaks openly to us and secretly to the Asuras.'
meaning: त्रिशीर्षा ह वै त्वाष्ट्र आस . तस्य ह त्रीणि मुखान्य् आसुस् सोमपानम् एकं सुरापानम् एकम् अन्नादनम् एकम् . प्रस्तौति ह स्मैकेनैकेन गायति प्रतिहरत्य् एकेनाश्रावयत्य् एकेन प्रत्याश्रावयत्य् एकेन शंसत्य् एकेन . स ह स्मैकाक्य् एवानुपरिसर्पं सर्वं यज्ञं संस्थापयति . स हेयद्वीर्यावान् आस . स उ हासुरीपुत्र आस . स ह स्म प्रत्यक्षं देवेभ्यो वदति परोक्षम् असुरेभ्यः . यस्मा उ ह वा भूयः कामयते तस्मै परोक्षं वदति . तस्माद् उ हेन्द्रो बिभयां चकार यच् चासुरीपुत्र आस यद् उ चेयद्वीर्यावान् आस . स हेक्षां चक्रे ऽसुर्यो वा अयम् आसुरीपुत्रः . स प्रत्यक्षम् अस्मभ्यं वदति परोक्षम् असुरेभ्यः .

sanskrit_iast: tasya ha vajreṇa śīrṣāṇi praciccheda . tāny eva vayāṃsy abhavan . tad yat somapānam āsīt sa kapiñjalo 'bhavat . tasmāt sa babhrur iva . babhrur iva hi somaḥ . atha yat surāpānam āsīt sa kalaviṅko 'bhavat . tasmāt sa matta ivāvakrandati . atha yad annādanam āsīt sa tittirir abhavat . tasmāt sa bahurūpa iva . bahurūpam iva hy annam . tasmād u tasya vṛścikaś śaṅkuliṣṭha ity etad annam . sa tvaṣṭā hataputro 'pendraṃ somam ājahre .
sentences: tad yat somapānam āsīt sa kapiñjalo 'bʰavat .
atʰa yat surāpānam āsīt sa kalaviṅko 'bʰavat .
atʰa yad annādanam āsīt sa tittirir abʰavat .
tasmād u tasya vr̥ścikaś śaṅkuliṣṭʰa ity etad annam .
text: He cut off his heads with the vajra. They became birds. That which was the soma-drinking head became the kapiñjala (francolin partridge). Therefore it is brownish, for soma is brownish. Then that which was the surā-drinking head became the kalaviṅka (sparrow). Therefore it cries out as if intoxicated. Then that which was the food-eating head became the tittiri (partridge). Therefore it is of many colors, for food is of many colors. Therefore its food is vṛścika (scorpion) and śaṅkuliṣṭha. Tvaṣṭṛ, whose son had been slain, drew soma away from Indra.
meaning: तस्य ह वज्रेण शीर्षाणि प्रचिच्छेद . तान्य् एव वयांस्य् अभवन् . तद् यत् सोमपानम् आसीत् स कपिञ्जलो ऽभवत् . तस्मात् स बभ्रुर् इव . बभ्रुर् इव हि सोमः . अथ यत् सुरापानम् आसीत् स कलविङ्को ऽभवत् . तस्मात् स मत्त इवावक्रन्दति . अथ यद् अन्नादनम् आसीत् स तित्तिरिर् अभवत् . तस्मात् स बहुरूप इव . बहुरूपम् इव ह्य् अन्नम् . तस्माद् उ तस्य वृश्चिकश् शङ्कुलिष्ठ इत्य् एतद् अन्नम् . स त्वष्टा हतपुत्रो ऽपेन्द्रं सोमम् आजह्रे .

sanskrit_iast: taṃ ha vajrahasto 'bhidudrāva . sa tvaṣṭā pratyaṅ patitvā patnīḥ prapede . taṃ ha tatra nānuprapede . tasmāt tvaṣṭāraṃ patnīṣu saṃyajanti . tasmād u patnīḥ prapannaṃ na hanyāt . udeyāyendraḥ . sa havirdhānayor eva droṇakalaśe somaṃ rājānaṃ saṃpavitum upeyāya . taṃ ha droṇakalaśenaiva pratidhāya pītvā pravavrāja . anūdeyāya tvaṣṭā . sa ha papracchāsti kiṃcit pariśiṣṭā3m iti . asty ayaṃ saṃsrāva iti hocuḥ . taṃ hāgnau pravartayāṃ cakār endraśatrur vardhasva svāhe ti . taṃ yat prāvartayat sa eva vṛtro 'bhavat . sa vartamāna evāgnīṣomāv abhisaṃbabhūva . tasmād āhur agnīṣomāv asuryāv iti . sa ha smeṣumātram ūrdhvam udardati . tato ha smānāvacchāṃ kṣitis (?). sa trayīṃ vidyāṃ sarvāṃ śriyaṃ sarvam annādyam api yad idaṃ trirātre sahasraṃ procyate tad abhisaṃbabhūva . tasya hedaṃ sarvaṃ balikṛd āsa . kīlālaṃ ha smāsmai nadyo vahanti . atha hābhiyugvāno nāmāṣṭau devānāṃ sahacarā āsur aṣṭau pitr̥̄ṇām aṣṭau manuṣyāṇām aṣṭāv asurāṇām . teṣāṃ ha smendro māyayāṣṭamo bhavati vṛtraṃ jighāṃsan . tasmād u hainam indra eva jaghāna yad indraśatrur vardhasva svāhe ti pravartayāṃ cakāra . /atha yad dha prāvartayiṣyad indrasya śatrur vardhasva svāhe ti - Hier liegt ein weiterer Fall der Unterbrechung eines zusammengehörigen Satzes durch die Kapitelzählung im # JB

text: Indra, vajra in hand, rushed upon him. Tvaṣṭṛ, fleeing backward, took refuge among the wives. Indra did not follow him there. Therefore they offer to Tvaṣṭṛ among the wives (in the patnīsaṃyāja). Therefore one should not slay one who has taken refuge among women. Indra went up. He approached the droṇakalaśa in the havirdhāna shed to drink soma, the king. Having held it back with the droṇakalaśa itself, he drank and departed. Tvaṣṭṛ came up after him. He asked: 'Is anything left over?' 'There is this saṃsrāva (residue),' they said. He poured that into the fire with the formula 'indraśatru (O enemy of Indra), grow! svāhā!' That which he poured forth became Vṛtra. Even as it was growing, it encompassed Agni and Soma. Therefore they say 'Agni and Soma are of Asura nature.' It would shoot up the height of an arrow-shot. Thence there was no respite for creatures. He encompassed the threefold knowledge, all prosperity, all food—even the thousand that is recited in the trirātra, he encompassed that. Everything here was his tribute-payer. The rivers carried kīlāla (sweet drink) for him. Now there were companions called Abhiyugvānas—eight of the gods, eight of the Fathers, eight of men, eight of the Asuras. Among them Indra became the eighth by māyā, seeking to slay Vṛtra. Therefore it was Indra alone who slew him, because he had poured it with the formula 'indraśatru (O enemy of Indra), grow! svāhā!' But had he poured it with 'indrasya śatru (O enemy of Indra [with genitive]), grow! svāhā!'—[here the text notes a case of sentence-interruption by chapter division in the JB]
meaning: तं ह वज्रहस्तो ऽभिदुद्राव . स त्वष्टा प्रत्यङ् पतित्वा पत्नीः प्रपेदे . तं ह तत्र नानुप्रपेदे . तस्मात् त्वष्टारं पत्नीषु संयजन्ति . तस्माद् उ पत्नीः प्रपन्नं न हन्यात् . उदेयायेन्द्रः . स हविर्धानयोर् एव द्रोणकलशे सोमं राजानं संपवितुम् उपेयाय . तं ह द्रोणकलशेनैव प्रतिधाय पीत्वा प्रवव्राज . अनूदेयाय त्वष्टा . स ह पप्रच्छास्ति किंचित् परिशिष्टा३म् इति . अस्त्य् अयं संस्राव इति होचुः . तं हाग्नौ प्रवर्तयां चकार् एन्द्रशत्रुर् वर्धस्व स्वाहे ति . तं यत् प्रावर्तयत् स एव वृत्रो ऽभवत् . स वर्तमान एवाग्नीषोमाव् अभिसंबभूव . तस्माद् आहुर् अग्नीषोमाव् असुर्याव् इति . स ह स्मेषुमात्रम् ऊर्ध्वम् उदर्दति . ततो ह स्मानावच्छां क्षितिस् (?). स त्रयीं विद्यां सर्वां श्रियं सर्वम् अन्नाद्यम् अपि यद् इदं त्रिरात्रे सहस्रं प्रोच्यते तद् अभिसंबभूव . तस्य हेदं सर्वं बलिकृद् आस . कीलालं ह स्मास्मै नद्यो वहन्ति . अथ हाभियुग्वानो नामाष्टौ देवानां सहचरा आसुर् अष्टौ पित्र्̥̄णाम् अष्टौ मनुष्याणाम् अष्टाव् असुराणाम् . तेषां ह स्मेन्द्रो माययाष्टमो भवति वृत्रं जिघांसन् . तस्माद् उ हैनम् इन्द्र एव जघान यद् इन्द्रशत्रुर् वर्धस्व स्वाहे ति प्रवर्तयां चकार . /अथ यद् ध प्रावर्तयिष्यद् इन्द्रस्य शत्रुर् वर्धस्व स्वाहे ति - Hइएर् लिएग्त् एइन् wएइतेरेर् Fअल्ल् देर् Uन्तेर्ब्रेछुन्ग् एइनेस् zउसम्मेन्गेह्öरिगेन् Sअत्zएस् दुर्छ् दिए Kअपितेल्zäह्लुन्ग् इम् # JB

sanskrit_iast: - śaśvad dhainaṃ nāhaniṣyat . tam ayam indraṃ somo rājā pīto 'nupahūto 'hinot . tasya ha sarvebhya eva chidrebhyaḥ preyāya mukhād eva na . tasmād u ha bhiṣajya āsa . tasya yad avāg iyāya saiva surāvāriṭakā babhūva . yac chiśnāt sā parisruk . trir niraṣṭhīvat . tad yat prathamaṃ niraṣṭhīvat tad eva karkandhv abhavad yad dvitīyaṃ tad badaraṃ yat tṛtīyaṃ tat kvalam . tasmād eteṣām annaṃ caiva rasāḥ . khāṭkṛtya caturthaṃ niraṣṭhīvat . tad evāmram abhavat . tam evaṃ santaṃ devā abhito niṣeduḥ . ayaṃ na eko vīro 'bhūt . sa itthaṃ nyagāt . kva bhavāma iti . sa hovāca na vai vidma yatra bhūmeti . kim iti . cukṣūṣāmi vā iti . atha ha sma tataḥ purā kṣutvaiva mriyante . taṃ hocuḥ kṣuhi jīveti tvā vakṣyāma iti . sa ha cukṣāva . taṃ ha jīvety ūcuḥ . sa ha jijīva . tasmād idam apy etarhi cukṣvāṃsam āhur jīveti .
sentences: tam ayam indraṃ somo rājā pīto 'nupahūto 'hinot .
tasya ha sarvebʰya eva cʰidrebʰyaḥ preyāya mukʰād eva na .
tasya yad avāg iyāya saiva surāvāriṭakā babʰūva .
tad yat pratʰamaṃ niraṣṭʰīvat tad eva karkandʰv abʰavad yad dvitīyaṃ tad badaraṃ yat tr̥tīyaṃ tat kvalam .
tam evaṃ santaṃ devā abʰito niṣeduḥ .
sa hovāca na vai vidma yatra bʰūmeti .
atʰa ha sma tataḥ purā kṣutvaiva mriyante .
taṃ hocuḥ kṣuhi jīveti tvā vakṣyāma iti .
tasmād idam apy etarhi cukṣvāṃsam āhur jīveti .
text: —he would never have been able to slay him. Soma, the king, having been drunk but not properly invited, injured this Indra. It flowed out from all his openings, but not from his mouth. Therefore there was a need for healing. That which flowed downward became the surāvāriṭakā plant. That which came from the śiśna (penis) became the parisruk (overflow libation). He spat out three times. That which he spat out the first time became the karkandhū (jujube); the second, the badara (Indian jujube); the third, the kvala (a type of jujube). Therefore these have both food and juice. Making a 'khāṭ' sound, he spat a fourth time. That became the āmra (mango). The gods sat around him in this condition. 'This one hero of ours has fallen thus. Where shall we be?' He said: 'We truly do not know where we shall be.' 'Why?' 'I am about to sneeze.' Now before that time, creatures would die merely from sneezing. They said to him: 'Sneeze! We shall say to you "live!"' He sneezed. They said 'Live!' to him. He lived. Therefore even now, when someone sneezes, they say 'live!' to him.
meaning: - शश्वद् धैनं नाहनिष्यत् . तम् अयम् इन्द्रं सोमो राजा पीतो ऽनुपहूतो ऽहिनोत् . तस्य ह सर्वेभ्य एव छिद्रेभ्यः प्रेयाय मुखाद् एव न . तस्माद् उ ह भिषज्य आस . तस्य यद् अवाग् इयाय सैव सुरावारिटका बभूव . यच् छिश्नात् सा परिस्रुक् . त्रिर् निरष्ठीवत् . तद् यत् प्रथमं निरष्ठीवत् तद् एव कर्कन्ध्व् अभवद् यद् द्वितीयं तद् बदरं यत् तृतीयं तत् क्वलम् . तस्माद् एतेषाम् अन्नं चैव रसाः . खाट्कृत्य चतुर्थं निरष्ठीवत् . तद् एवाम्रम् अभवत् . तम् एवं सन्तं देवा अभितो निषेदुः . अयं न एको वीरो ऽभूत् . स इत्थं न्यगात् . क्व भवाम इति . स होवाच न वै विद्म यत्र भूमेति . किम् इति . चुक्षूषामि वा इति . अथ ह स्म ततः पुरा क्षुत्वैव म्रियन्ते . तं होचुः क्षुहि जीवेति त्वा वक्ष्याम इति . स ह चुक्षाव . तं ह जीवेत्य् ऊचुः . स ह जिजीव . तस्माद् इदम् अप्य् एतर्हि चुक्ष्वांसम् आहुर् जीवेति .

sanskrit_iast: - tāv eva siṃhāv abhavatām . yad akṣibhyāṃ tau śārdūlau yat karṇābhyāṃ tau vṛkau vailūṣau yad upapakṣābhyāṃ tāv apāṣṭihau . tasmād ete vayasāṃ vīryāvattarāḥ . indro hy eteṣām ājānam . atha yad avāg iyāya tad idaṃ kṣudraṃ śvāpadaṃ babhūva . sa ha viṣiktaś śiśye . api ha tṛṇair abhivilūḍha āsa . taṃ hocuḥ kvevāsi kveva tvā bhiṣajyāma iti . tasmād idam apy etarhi upatāpinaṃ pṛcchanti kveva te rujati kveva te bhiṣajyāma iti . sa ha tṛṇāny abhiparidiśann uvācedam ivaiva mābhito 'smīdam ivaiva mābhito bhiṣajyateti . tad agnim abruvann idaṃ daheti . tad agnir adahat . tat parjanyam abruvann idam abhi varṣeti . tat parjanyo 'bhyavarṣat . tat kalyāṇy oṣadhayo 'jāyanta . tā dhenūbhir ādhayan . tat payo 'duhan . ta etaṃ yajñam apaśyan . tam āharan . tenainam ayājayan . tasya pratidhuk prātassavane 'vānayan . pratīva vā anenādhāyīti tasmāt pratidhuk . śritaṃ mādhyaṃdine savane 'śreṣṭeva vā aneneti tasmāc chritam . dadhi tṛtīyasavane 'dādhīva vā aneneti tasmād dadhi . sa yathā ca ha pura āsātitarāṃ ha tata āsa . sa yas somavāmī vā somātipavito vā syāt sa etena yajeta . yathā ca ha purā bhavaty atitarāṃ ha tato bhavati . tasmād u ha somavāminaṃ vā somātipavitaṃ vā na paricakṣīta .
sentences: yad akṣibʰyāṃ tau śārdūlau yat karṇābʰyāṃ tau vr̥kau vailūṣau yad upapakṣābʰyāṃ tāv apāṣṭihau .
atʰa yad avāg iyāya tad idaṃ kṣudraṃ śvāpadaṃ babʰūva .
taṃ hocuḥ kvevāsi kveva tvā bʰiṣajyāma iti .
tasmād idam apy etarhi upatāpinaṃ pr̥ccʰanti kveva te rujati kveva te bʰiṣajyāma iti .
sa ha tr̥ṇāny abʰiparidiśann uvācedam ivaiva mābʰito 'smīdam ivaiva mābʰito bʰiṣajyateti .
tat parjanyam abruvann idam abʰi varṣeti .
śritaṃ mādʰyaṃdine savane 'śreṣṭeva vā aneneti tasmāc cʰritam .
dadʰi tr̥tīyasavane 'dādʰīva vā aneneti tasmād dadʰi .
sa yatʰā ca ha pura āsātitarāṃ ha tata āsa .
sa yas somavāmī vā somātipavito vā syāt sa etena yajeta .
yatʰā ca ha purā bʰavaty atitarāṃ ha tato bʰavati .
tasmād u ha somavāminaṃ vā somātipavitaṃ vā na paricakṣīta .
text: Those two (eyes) became lions. That which came from the eyes became the two śārdūlas (tigers); that from the ears, the two vṛkas (wolves) called vailūṣa; that from the sides, the two apāṣṭihas (a kind of bird). Therefore these are the most powerful among birds, for Indra was their origin. Then that which flowed downward became these small wild animals. He lay there drained. He was even covered over with grass. They said: 'Where are you? Where shall we heal you?' Therefore even now they ask a sick person: 'Where does it hurt? Where shall we treat you?' He said, pointing around at the grass: 'It is as if I am surrounded by this; heal me all around this.' They said to Agni: 'Burn this.' Agni burned it. They said to Parjanya: 'Rain upon this.' Parjanya rained upon it. Auspicious herbs grew. They nursed them with cows. They milked milk from them. They saw this sacrifice. They brought it. With it they made him sacrifice. The pratidhuk (first milk) they offered at the morning pressing—'It is as if he were replenished by this,' therefore the pratidhuk. The cooked milk at the midday pressing—'It is as if he were heated by this,' therefore cooked milk. Curds at the third pressing—'It is as if he were thickened by this,' therefore curds. He became even better than he had been before. He who has vomited soma or who has over-filtered soma should sacrifice with this. He becomes even better than he was before. Therefore one should not despise one who has vomited soma or over-filtered soma.
meaning: - ताव् एव सिंहाव् अभवताम् . यद् अक्षिभ्यां तौ शार्दूलौ यत् कर्णाभ्यां तौ वृकौ वैलूषौ यद् उपपक्षाभ्यां ताव् अपाष्टिहौ . तस्माद् एते वयसां वीर्यावत्तराः . इन्द्रो ह्य् एतेषाम् आजानम् . अथ यद् अवाग् इयाय तद् इदं क्षुद्रं श्वापदं बभूव . स ह विषिक्तश् शिश्ये . अपि ह तृणैर् अभिविलूढ आस . तं होचुः क्वेवासि क्वेव त्वा भिषज्याम इति . तस्माद् इदम् अप्य् एतर्हि उपतापिनं पृच्छन्ति क्वेव ते रुजति क्वेव ते भिषज्याम इति . स ह तृणान्य् अभिपरिदिशन्न् उवाचेदम् इवैव माभितो ऽस्मीदम् इवैव माभितो भिषज्यतेति . तद् अग्निम् अब्रुवन्न् इदं दहेति . तद् अग्निर् अदहत् . तत् पर्जन्यम् अब्रुवन्न् इदम् अभि वर्षेति . तत् पर्जन्यो ऽभ्यवर्षत् . तत् कल्याण्य् ओषधयो ऽजायन्त . ता धेनूभिर् आधयन् . तत् पयो ऽदुहन् . त एतं यज्ञम् अपश्यन् . तम् आहरन् . तेनैनम् अयाजयन् . तस्य प्रतिधुक् प्रातस्सवने ऽवानयन् . प्रतीव वा अनेनाधायीति तस्मात् प्रतिधुक् . श्रितं माध्यंदिने सवने ऽश्रेष्टेव वा अनेनेति तस्माच् छ्रितम् . दधि तृतीयसवने ऽदाधीव वा अनेनेति तस्माद् दधि . स यथा च ह पुर आसातितरां ह तत आस . स यस् सोमवामी वा सोमातिपवितो वा स्यात् स एतेन यजेत . यथा च ह पुरा भवत्य् अतितरां ह ततो भवति . तस्माद् उ ह सोमवामिनं वा सोमातिपवितं वा न परिचक्षीत .

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣa ṛtapeyaḥ . devebhyo vā ūrg annādyam udakrāmat . somāhutir ha vā ebhyas soccakrāma . so eva virāṭ . te devā abruvann etemāṃ virājam anvicchāmeti . te tatpo 'tapyanta . ta etāṃ virājaṃ yajñam apaśyan . tam āharanta . tam abhy adīkṣanta . ta ekam ahar nāśnan . tasyai niyānam anvapaśyan . te 'bruvan bhūyo nv eva tapas tapyāmahā iti . te dvitīyam ahar nāśnan . tasyai ghoṣam upāśṛṇvan . te 'bruvan bhūyo nv eva tapas tapyāmahā iti . te tṛtīyam ahar nāśnan . tāṃ parāpaśyan yathā mahāntaṃ girim udīkṣitaṃ yathā vā mahad abhram evam . tām abhikrāmam apakrāmam abhyatsaran . ya u ha vai mṛgaṃ parāṅ evābhitsarati nainaṃ sa gṛhṇāti . atha ya enam abhikrāmam apakrāmam abhitsarati sa evainaṃ gṛhṇāti . tāṃ daśamenaivāhnāvarundhata . daśākṣarā virāṭ . annaṃ virāṭ .
sentences: te devā abruvann etemāṃ virājam anviccʰāmeti .
te 'bruvan bʰūyo nv eva tapas tapyāmahā iti .
te 'bruvan bʰūyo nv eva tapas tapyāmahā iti .
tāṃ parāpaśyan yatʰā mahāntaṃ girim udīkṣitaṃ yatʰā vā mahad abʰram evam .
ya u ha vai mr̥gaṃ parāṅ evābʰitsarati nainaṃ sa gr̥hṇāti .
atʰa ya enam abʰikrāmam apakrāmam abʰitsarati sa evainaṃ gr̥hṇāti .
text: Now this is the ṛtapeya. From the gods, vigor and food-eating departed. The soma libation, the virāj, departed from them. The gods said: 'Come, let us seek this virāj.' They performed tapas. They saw this sacrifice, the virāj. They brought it. They consecrated themselves for it. They did not eat for one day. They perceived her trail. They said: 'Let us perform still more tapas.' They did not eat for a second day. They heard her sound. They said: 'Let us perform still more tapas.' They did not eat for a third day. They saw her in the distance—as one might look up at a great mountain, or like a great cloud. They pursued her, approaching and retreating. He who chases a wild animal only going forward does not catch it. But he who pursues it approaching and retreating catches it. They obtained her on the tenth day. The virāj has ten syllables. Food is the virāj.
meaning: अथैष ऋतपेयः . देवेभ्यो वा ऊर्ग् अन्नाद्यम् उदक्रामत् . सोमाहुतिर् ह वा एभ्यस् सोच्चक्राम . सो एव विराट् . ते देवा अब्रुवन्न् एतेमां विराजम् अन्विच्छामेति . ते तत्पो ऽतप्यन्त . त एतां विराजं यज्ञम् अपश्यन् . तम् आहरन्त . तम् अभ्य् अदीक्षन्त . त एकम् अहर् नाश्नन् . तस्यै नियानम् अन्वपश्यन् . ते ऽब्रुवन् भूयो न्व् एव तपस् तप्यामहा इति . ते द्वितीयम् अहर् नाश्नन् . तस्यै घोषम् उपाशृण्वन् . ते ऽब्रुवन् भूयो न्व् एव तपस् तप्यामहा इति . ते तृतीयम् अहर् नाश्नन् . तां परापश्यन् यथा महान्तं गिरिम् उदीक्षितं यथा वा महद् अभ्रम् एवम् . ताम् अभिक्रामम् अपक्रामम् अभ्यत्सरन् . य उ ह वै मृगं पराङ् एवाभित्सरति नैनं स गृह्णाति . अथ य एनम् अभिक्रामम् अपक्रामम् अभित्सरति स एवैनं गृह्णाति . तां दशमेनैवाह्नावरुन्धत . दशाक्षरा विराट् . अन्नं विराट् .

sanskrit_iast: tasyāpaś ca ghṛtaṃ ca vratam . aśarīrā vā āpo 'śarīraṃ ghṛtam aśarīrā svadhā . aśarīreṇāśarīrāṃ svadhām avaruṇadhāmahā iti . etāvaccho vratayati . etāvatī vai puruṣasya mātrā net puruṣam ativratayānīti . atho haitat parvaśa evātmano 'ṅgāni pratisaṃdadhāti . sarpiṣmān antareṇa bhavati samaṣṭyai . saptadaśastomo bhavati . prajāpatir vai saptadaśaḥ . prajāpatir naṣṭasyānuvettā . sa yo naṣṭasyānuvettā tenemāṃ svadhām anuvindāmeti . tasyobhe bṛhadrathantare sāmnī bhavato yady asmin loke rathantareṇānuvindāma yady antarikṣe vāmadevyena yady amuṣmin loke bṛhateti . tasyaudumbaras somacamaso dakṣiṇā bhavaty ūrg vā annam udumbara ūrja evānnādyasyāvaruddhyai .
sentences: aśarīrā vā āpo 'śarīraṃ gʰr̥tam aśarīrā svadʰā .
etāvatī vai puruṣasya mātrā net puruṣam ativratayānīti .
sa yo naṣṭasyānuvettā tenemāṃ svadʰām anuvindāmeti .
tasyobʰe br̥hadratʰantare sāmnī bʰavato yady asmin loke ratʰantareṇānuvindāma yady antarikṣe vāmadevyena yady amuṣmin loke br̥hateti .
tasyaudumbaras somacamaso dakṣiṇā bʰavaty ūrg vā annam udumbara ūrja evānnādyasyāvaruddʰyai .
text: Water and ghee are her observance. Water is bodiless; ghee is bodiless; svadhā is bodiless. 'With the bodiless let us secure the bodiless svadhā.' One observes the vow for this much—for this is the measure of a person, 'lest I over-observe the vow beyond the person.' And thereby one reassembles one's limbs, joint by joint. One has ghee in between, for the sake of completeness. The stoma is saptadaśa (seventeen-fold). Prajāpati is saptadaśa. Prajāpati is the finder of what is lost. 'May he who is the finder of what is lost, by him let us find this svadhā.' Both Bṛhat and Rathantara are its sāmans—'If in this world we find it with the Rathantara, or in the atmosphere with the Vāmadevya, or in yonder world with the Bṛhat.' Its dakṣiṇā is a soma cup made of udumbara wood—for vigor and food are the udumbara; for the securing of vigor and food-eating.
meaning: तस्यापश् च घृतं च व्रतम् . अशरीरा वा आपो ऽशरीरं घृतम् अशरीरा स्वधा . अशरीरेणाशरीरां स्वधाम् अवरुणधामहा इति . एतावच्छो व्रतयति . एतावती वै पुरुषस्य मात्रा नेत् पुरुषम् अतिव्रतयानीति . अथो हैतत् पर्वश एवात्मनो ऽङ्गानि प्रतिसंदधाति . सर्पिष्मान् अन्तरेण भवति समष्ट्यै . सप्तदशस्तोमो भवति . प्रजापतिर् वै सप्तदशः . प्रजापतिर् नष्टस्यानुवेत्ता . स यो नष्टस्यानुवेत्ता तेनेमां स्वधाम् अनुविन्दामेति . तस्योभे बृहद्रथन्तरे साम्नी भवतो यद्य् अस्मिन् लोके रथन्तरेणानुविन्दाम यद्य् अन्तरिक्षे वामदेव्येन यद्य् अमुष्मिन् लोके बृहतेति . तस्यौदुम्बरस् सोमचमसो दक्षिणा भवत्य् ऊर्ग् वा अन्नम् उदुम्बर ऊर्ज एवान्नाद्यस्यावरुद्ध्यै .

sanskrit_iast: taṃ brahmaṇe dadāti . brahmaṇo hy evaikadakṣiṇā . tad āhur huto deyā3 ahutā3 iti . ahuta ity āhuḥ . yātayāmeva vai tathā syād yad dhutaṃ dadyād iti . tad u vā āhur huta eva deyaḥ . devānāṃ vā eṣa bhāgaḥ . ko devānāṃ bhāgaṃ dātum arhati . tasmād dhuta eva deya iti . yādṛg aha vā asmin loke 'nnaṃ dadāti tādṛg asyāmuṣmin loke 'nnaṃ bhavati . etad u ha vā amuṣmin loke paramam annādyaṃ yat somapīthaḥ . eṣā haivāsya somāhutir amuṣmin loke 'nnaṃ bhavati . ṛtaṃ satyaṃ vadanto bhakṣayanti . ṛtena hi te tāṃ satyenānvavindan . ṛtam amṛtam ity āha . ṛtena hi te tad amṛtam anvavindan . o yi jvarā oyi jūhe ti sāmanidhane bhavato vācas satye . vāco hi te tāṃ satyenānvavindan . tena haitenāthodivo gārgya īje keśī dārbhya ṛjiśvā vātavāta iti . sa harjiśvā vātavāto 'vatatāma . tam u ha vṛṣaśuṣmeṇa kumāreṇārjiśvanenāktākṣeṇopaniṣedur yady ayam u riṣyaty anenedaṃ samāpayiṣyāma iti . sa ha tatāma . sa ha tāntaḥ paraṃ lokaṃ jagāma .
sentences: tad āhur huto deyā3 ahutā3 iti .
yātayāmeva vai tatʰā syād yad dʰutaṃ dadyād iti .
tad u vā āhur huta eva deyaḥ .
yādr̥g aha vā asmin loke 'nnaṃ dadāti tādr̥g asyāmuṣmin loke 'nnaṃ bʰavati .
etad u ha vā amuṣmin loke paramam annādyaṃ yat somapītʰaḥ .
eṣā haivāsya somāhutir amuṣmin loke 'nnaṃ bʰavati .
r̥tena hi te tad amr̥tam anvavindan .
o yi jvarā oyi jūhe ti sāmanidʰane bʰavato vācas satye .
tena haitenātʰodivo gārgya īje keśī dārbʰya r̥jiśvā vātavāta iti .
tam u ha vr̥ṣaśuṣmeṇa kumāreṇārjiśvanenāktākṣeṇopaniṣedur yady ayam u riṣyaty anenedaṃ samāpayiṣyāma iti .
sa ha tāntaḥ paraṃ lokaṃ jagāma .
text: One gives it to the brahman priest, for the brahman alone has a single dakṣiṇā. They say about that: 'Should it be given after being offered into the fire, or without being offered?' They say 'without being offered,' for 'It would be used up if one were to give what has been offered.' But others say: 'It should be given after being offered, for this is the share of the gods. Who is able to give away the share of the gods? Therefore it should be given after being offered.' Whatever kind of food one gives in this world, such food one has in the other world. The highest food in the other world is soma-drinking. This soma libation becomes his food in the other world. They consume it speaking ṛta and satya, for with ṛta and satya they found it. He says 'ṛtam amṛtam' (ṛta is immortality), for with ṛta they found that amṛta. 'O yi jvarā oyi jūhe'—these are the sāma-endings, the truths of speech, for with truth of speech they found it. With this, Athodiva Gārgya sacrificed, as did Keśī Dārbhya and Ṛjiśvā Vātavāta. Ṛjiśvā Vātavāta became weakened. They seated the boy Vṛṣaśuṣma, a descendant of Ṛjiśva, with anointed eyes, beside him, thinking: 'If this one perishes, with this one we shall complete it.' He became weakened. He, being weakened, went to the other world.
meaning: तं ब्रह्मणे ददाति . ब्रह्मणो ह्य् एवैकदक्षिणा . तद् आहुर् हुतो देया३ अहुता३ इति . अहुत इत्य् आहुः . यातयामेव वै तथा स्याद् यद् धुतं दद्याद् इति . तद् उ वा आहुर् हुत एव देयः . देवानां वा एष भागः . को देवानां भागं दातुम् अर्हति . तस्माद् धुत एव देय इति . यादृग् अह वा अस्मिन् लोके ऽन्नं ददाति तादृग् अस्यामुष्मिन् लोके ऽन्नं भवति . एतद् उ ह वा अमुष्मिन् लोके परमम् अन्नाद्यं यत् सोमपीथः . एषा हैवास्य सोमाहुतिर् अमुष्मिन् लोके ऽन्नं भवति . ऋतं सत्यं वदन्तो भक्षयन्ति . ऋतेन हि ते तां सत्येनान्वविन्दन् . ऋतम् अमृतम् इत्य् आह . ऋतेन हि ते तद् अमृतम् अन्वविन्दन् . ओ यि ज्वरा ओयि जूहे ति सामनिधने भवतो वाचस् सत्ये . वाचो हि ते तां सत्येनान्वविन्दन् . तेन हैतेनाथोदिवो गार्ग्य ईजे केशी दार्भ्य ऋजिश्वा वातवात इति . स हर्जिश्वा वातवातो ऽवतताम . तम् उ ह वृषशुष्मेण कुमारेणार्जिश्वनेनाक्ताक्षेणोपनिषेदुर् यद्य् अयम् उ रिष्यत्य् अनेनेदं समापयिष्याम इति . स ह तताम . स ह तान्तः परं लोकं जगाम .

sanskrit_iast: tasya ha kalyāṇo loka āsa . sa hovāca tata kasyāyaṃ loka iti . mameti hovāca . atha hānyo lokaḥ kalyāṇatara āsa . kasyo asāv iti . taveti hovāca . sa hovāca tata yat tvaṃ mad bhūyo dadivān asi bhūyas te mad anūktam atha kathaṃ tavāyaṃ loko 'sau mameti . sa hovāca vratopayoddhyo vai kila putrakāsau loka āsa . vratopayodhitara eva nau tvam asi . tasmād ayaṃ mama loko 'sau taveti . gaccheti hovāca saṃ vāvāpsyasi yaṃ vāva kāmaṃ kamitāsi sa te kāmas samardhitā . vakritās tv evāṅgulīḥ kurutād iti . sa ha samāpa . sa ha samāpyovācāpipātra eva syo brāhmaṇānām astv iti . sa hāpipātra eva brāhmaṇānām āsa .
sentences: sa hovāca tata kasyāyaṃ loka iti .
sa hovāca tata yat tvaṃ mad bʰūyo dadivān asi bʰūyas te mad anūktam atʰa katʰaṃ tavāyaṃ loko 'sau mameti .
sa hovāca vratopayoddʰyo vai kila putrakāsau loka āsa .
gaccʰeti hovāca saṃ vāvāpsyasi yaṃ vāva kāmaṃ kamitāsi sa te kāmas samardʰitā .
sa ha samāpyovācāpipātra eva syo brāhmaṇānām astv iti .
text: His world was beautiful. He said: 'Father, whose world is this?' 'Mine,' he said. Then there was another world, more beautiful. 'Whose is that?' 'Yours,' he said. He said: 'Father, since you have given more than I, and more has been recited for you than for me, how is it that this world is yours and that one is mine?' He said: 'That world, my son, was to be won by observance of vows. You are more accomplished in vow-observance than we. Therefore this world is mine and that one yours.' 'Go,' he said, 'you will obtain it, and whatever desire you shall desire, that desire shall be fulfilled for you. But let him make curved fingers.' He recovered. Having recovered, he said: 'Let there be a drinking vessel for the brāhmaṇas.' And there was indeed a drinking vessel for the brāhmaṇas.
meaning: तस्य ह कल्याणो लोक आस . स होवाच तत कस्यायं लोक इति . ममेति होवाच . अथ हान्यो लोकः कल्याणतर आस . कस्यो असाव् इति . तवेति होवाच . स होवाच तत यत् त्वं मद् भूयो ददिवान् असि भूयस् ते मद् अनूक्तम् अथ कथं तवायं लोको ऽसौ ममेति . स होवाच व्रतोपयोद्ध्यो वै किल पुत्रकासौ लोक आस . व्रतोपयोधितर एव नौ त्वम् असि . तस्माद् अयं मम लोको ऽसौ तवेति . गच्छेति होवाच सं वावाप्स्यसि यं वाव कामं कमितासि स ते कामस् समर्धिता . वक्रितास् त्व् एवाङ्गुलीः कुरुताद् इति . स ह समाप . स ह समाप्योवाचापिपात्र एव स्यो ब्राह्मणानाम् अस्त्व् इति . स हापिपात्र एव ब्राह्मणानाम् आस .

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣa citistomaḥ . prajananakāmo yajeta . tasya pṛṣṭhyasya ṣaḍahasya stomā bhavanty ṛtavo vai pṛṣṭhāni . saṃvatsara ṛtavaḥ . saṃvatsaraḥ prajananaṃ sa yaḥ prajananaṃ sa mā prajanayād iti . tasyobhaye stomā bhavanty ayujaś ca yugmantaś ca . etad vai daivyaṃ mithunaṃ prajananaṃ yad ubhaye stomāḥ . tad yad daivyaṃ mithunaṃ prajananaṃ tan mā prajanayād iti . tasyobhe bṛhadrathantare sāmanī bhavataḥ . etat vai daivyaṃ mithunaṃ prajananaṃ yad ubhe bṛhadrathantare . tad yad daivyaṃ mithunaṃ prajananaṃ tan mā prajanayād iti . tasya dvādaśa stotrāṇi bhavanti dvādaśa māsās saṃvatsaraḥ . saṃvatsaraḥ prajananaṃ sa yaḥ prajananaṃ sa mā prajanayād iti . tasya caturviṃśati stutaśastrāṇi bhavanti caturviṃśatyardhamāsas saṃvatsaraḥ . saṃvatsaraḥ prajananaṃ sa yaḥ prajananaṃ sa mā prajanayād iti . atho āhu svargakāma evainena yajeteti . tasya pṛṣṭhyasya ṣaḍahasya stomā bhavanty ṛtavo vai pṛṣṭhāni . saṃvatsara ṛtavaḥ . saṃvatsara svargo loka svargasyaiva lokasya samaṣṭyai . tasyordhvā stomā bhavanty ūrdhvo vai svargo loka svargasyaiva lokasya samaṣṭyai . tasyobhe bṛhadrathantare sāmanī bhavata svargye svargasyaiva lokasya samaṣṭyai . tasya dvādaśa stotrāṇi bhavanti dvādaśa māsās saṃvatsaraḥ . saṃvatsara svargo loka svargasyaiva lokasya samaṣṭyai . tasya caturviṃśati stutaśastrāṇi bhavanti caturviṃśatyardhamāsas saṃvatsaraḥ .

text: Now this is the citistoma. One desiring offspring should sacrifice with it. Its stomas are those of the pṛṣṭhya ṣaḍaha (six-day period with pṛṣṭha sāmans). The pṛṣṭhas are the seasons. The seasons are the saṃvatsara (year). The saṃvatsara is procreation. 'May that which is procreation cause me to procreate.' Its stomas are of both kinds—odd and even. This is the divine pairing, the procreation, that the stomas are of both kinds. 'May that which is the divine pairing, the procreation, cause me to procreate.' Both Bṛhat and Rathantara are its sāmans. This is the divine pairing, the procreation, that both Bṛhat and Rathantara are used. 'May that which is the divine pairing, the procreation, cause me to procreate.' Its stotrāṇi (chants) are twelve—twelve months make the saṃvatsara. The saṃvatsara is procreation. 'May that which is procreation cause me to procreate.' Its stutaśastrāṇi (chant-recitation pairs) are twenty-four—twenty-four half-months make the saṃvatsara. The saṃvatsara is procreation. 'May that which is procreation cause me to procreate.' Others say one desiring heaven should sacrifice with it. Its stomas are those of the pṛṣṭhya ṣaḍaha. The pṛṣṭhas are the seasons; the seasons are the saṃvatsara; the saṃvatsara is the heavenly world—for the attainment of the heavenly world. Its stomas are ascending—for the heavenly world is above—for the attainment of the heavenly world. Both Bṛhat and Rathantara are its sāmans—they belong to heaven—for the attainment of the heavenly world. Its stotrāṇi are twelve—twelve months make the saṃvatsara. The saṃvatsara is the heavenly world—for the attainment of the heavenly world. Its stutaśastrāṇi are twenty-four—twenty-four half-months make the saṃvatsara.
meaning: अथैष चितिस्तोमः . प्रजननकामो यजेत . तस्य पृष्ठ्यस्य षडहस्य स्तोमा भवन्त्य् ऋतवो वै पृष्ठानि . संवत्सर ऋतवः . संवत्सरः प्रजननं स यः प्रजननं स मा प्रजनयाद् इति . तस्योभये स्तोमा भवन्त्य् अयुजश् च युग्मन्तश् च . एतद् वै दैव्यं मिथुनं प्रजननं यद् उभये स्तोमाः . तद् यद् दैव्यं मिथुनं प्रजननं तन् मा प्रजनयाद् इति . तस्योभे बृहद्रथन्तरे सामनी भवतः . एतत् वै दैव्यं मिथुनं प्रजननं यद् उभे बृहद्रथन्तरे . तद् यद् दैव्यं मिथुनं प्रजननं तन् मा प्रजनयाद् इति . तस्य द्वादश स्तोत्राणि भवन्ति द्वादश मासास् संवत्सरः . संवत्सरः प्रजननं स यः प्रजननं स मा प्रजनयाद् इति . तस्य चतुर्विंशति स्तुतशस्त्राणि भवन्ति चतुर्विंशत्यर्धमासस् संवत्सरः . संवत्सरः प्रजननं स यः प्रजननं स मा प्रजनयाद् इति . अथो आहु स्वर्गकाम एवैनेन यजेतेति . तस्य पृष्ठ्यस्य षडहस्य स्तोमा भवन्त्य् ऋतवो वै पृष्ठानि . संवत्सर ऋतवः . संवत्सर स्वर्गो लोक स्वर्गस्यैव लोकस्य समष्ट्यै . तस्योर्ध्वा स्तोमा भवन्त्य् ऊर्ध्वो वै स्वर्गो लोक स्वर्गस्यैव लोकस्य समष्ट्यै . तस्योभे बृहद्रथन्तरे सामनी भवत स्वर्ग्ये स्वर्गस्यैव लोकस्य समष्ट्यै . तस्य द्वादश स्तोत्राणि भवन्ति द्वादश मासास् संवत्सरः . संवत्सर स्वर्गो लोक स्वर्गस्यैव लोकस्य समष्ट्यै . तस्य चतुर्विंशति स्तुतशस्त्राणि भवन्ति चतुर्विंशत्यर्धमासस् संवत्सरः .

sanskrit_iast: tasya dvyuttarāṇy uttarāni stotrāṇi bhavanti . dvipād vai yajamānaḥ . yajamānam eva tat svarge loke pratiṣṭhāpayati . atho āhur iṣṭake evaite upadhīyeta iti . atho dyāvāpṛthivī evātho bṛhadrathantare evātho ahorātrāv evātho avasrāvāv evātho avacchādāv eva . chadir iva ha khalu vā eṣa yajñakratuḥ . na ha vai chadiṣmato gṛhān ativarṣati . nainaṃ pāpmātivarṣati ya evaṃ veda . atho āhur anviṣṭīnāṃ hed vā eṣa eko yajñakratur iti . sa yas saṃvatsarabhṛtā vāsaṃvatsarabhṛtā vāgninā cityena yajeta sa etena yajeta . sadyo haivāsya saṃvatsara ṛtuśo māsaśo 'rdhamāsaśo rātriśo 'nviṣṭo bhavati . tad yat pṛṣṭhyasya ṣaḍahasya stomā bhavanty ṛtavo vai pṛṣṭhāni saṃvatsara ṛtavas tenartuśaḥ . atha yad dvādaśa stotrāṇi bhavanti dvādaśa māsās saṃvatsaras tena māsaśaḥ . atha yac caturviṃśati stutaśastrāṇi bhavanti caturviṃśatyardhamāsas saṃvatsaras tenārdhamāsaśaḥ . atha yat trīṇi ṣaṣṭiśatāni stotryā bhavanti tāvatīs saṃvatsarasya rātrayas tena rātriśaḥ .

atʰo āhur iṣṭake evaite upadʰīyeta iti .
atʰo dyāvāpr̥tʰivī evātʰo br̥hadratʰantare evātʰo ahorātrāv evātʰo avasrāvāv evātʰo avaccʰādāv eva .

na ha vai cʰadiṣmato gr̥hān ativarṣati .
atʰo āhur anviṣṭīnāṃ hed vā eṣa eko yajñakratur iti .
sa yas saṃvatsarabʰr̥tā vāsaṃvatsarabʰr̥tā vāgninā cityena yajeta sa etena yajeta .
sadyo haivāsya saṃvatsara r̥tuśo māsaśo 'rdʰamāsaśo rātriśo 'nviṣṭo bʰavati .
tad yat pr̥ṣṭʰyasya ṣaḍahasya stomā bʰavanty r̥tavo vai pr̥ṣṭʰāni saṃvatsara r̥tavas tenartuśaḥ .
atʰa yad dvādaśa stotrāṇi bʰavanti dvādaśa māsās saṃvatsaras tena māsaśaḥ .
atʰa yac caturviṃśati stutaśastrāṇi bʰavanti caturviṃśatyardʰamāsas saṃvatsaras tenārdʰamāsaśaḥ .
atʰa yat trīṇi ṣaṣṭiśatāni stotryā bʰavanti tāvatīs saṃvatsarasya rātrayas tena rātriśaḥ .
text: Its upper stotrāṇi increase by two. The yajamāna (sacrificer) is two-footed. Thereby one establishes the yajamāna in the heavenly world. Others say: 'These are like bricks being laid.' And also they are heaven and earth, and also Bṛhat and Rathantara, and also day and night, and also the two pourings, and also the two coverings. This sacrificial rite is like a roof. Just as rain does not pass through a roofed house, so evil does not rain upon him who knows thus. Others say: 'This is the one sacrificial rite among the anviṣṭi rites.' He who would sacrifice with fire built up over a year or without a year should sacrifice with this. Immediately his year becomes sought out season by season, month by month, half-month by half-month, night by night. Because the stomas are those of the pṛṣṭhya ṣaḍaha—the pṛṣṭhas are the seasons, the seasons the saṃvatsara—thereby season by season. Because there are twelve stotrāṇi—twelve months make the saṃvatsara—thereby month by month. Because there are twenty-four stutaśastrāṇi—twenty-four half-months make the saṃvatsara—thereby half-month by half-month. Because the stotryā verses number three hundred and sixty, and that is the number of nights in the saṃvatsara—thereby night by night.
meaning: तस्य द्व्युत्तराण्य् उत्तरानि स्तोत्राणि भवन्ति . द्विपाद् वै यजमानः . यजमानम् एव तत् स्वर्गे लोके प्रतिष्ठापयति . अथो आहुर् इष्टके एवैते उपधीयेत इति . अथो द्यावापृथिवी एवाथो बृहद्रथन्तरे एवाथो अहोरात्राव् एवाथो अवस्रावाव् एवाथो अवच्छादाव् एव . छदिर् इव ह खलु वा एष यज्ञक्रतुः . न ह वै छदिष्मतो गृहान् अतिवर्षति . नैनं पाप्मातिवर्षति य एवं वेद . अथो आहुर् अन्विष्टीनां हेद् वा एष एको यज्ञक्रतुर् इति . स यस् संवत्सरभृता वासंवत्सरभृता वाग्निना चित्येन यजेत स एतेन यजेत . सद्यो हैवास्य संवत्सर ऋतुशो मासशो ऽर्धमासशो रात्रिशो ऽन्विष्टो भवति . तद् यत् पृष्ठ्यस्य षडहस्य स्तोमा भवन्त्य् ऋतवो वै पृष्ठानि संवत्सर ऋतवस् तेनर्तुशः . अथ यद् द्वादश स्तोत्राणि भवन्ति द्वादश मासास् संवत्सरस् तेन मासशः . अथ यच् चतुर्विंशति स्तुतशस्त्राणि भवन्ति चतुर्विंशत्यर्धमासस् संवत्सरस् तेनार्धमासशः . अथ यत् त्रीणि षष्टिशतानि स्तोत्र्या भवन्ति तावतीस् संवत्सरस्य रात्रयस् तेन रात्रिशः .

sanskrit_iast: athaitau rāśi-marāyau . prajananakāmo haitābhyāṃ yajeta . prajāpatir vā akāmayata bahuḥ prajayā paśubhiḥ prajāyeya . dvandvaṃ prajāḥ paśūn sṛjeyeti . sa etau yajñāv apaśyat . tāv āharata . tābhyām ayajata . tato vai sa bahuḥ prajayā paśubhiḥ prājāyata . dvandvaṃ prajāḥ paśūn asṛjata . sa yaḥ kāmayeta bahuḥ prajayā paśubhiḥ prajāyeya dvandvaṃ prajāḥ paśūn sṛjeyeti sa etābhyāṃ yajeta . bahur eva prajayā paśubhiḥ prajāyate dvandvaṃ prajāḥ paśūn sṛjate . sa rāśiś catuścatvāriṃśo bhavati rathantarasāmā . brahma vai rathantaraṃ kṣatraṃ catuścatvāriṃśaḥ . brahmaṇā ca kṣatreṇa ca sayugbhyāṃ bahuḥ prajayā paśubhiḥ prajāyā iti . yad v evaitāni stotrāṇi bahulāny udapadyanta iva tasmād rāśiḥ . aṣṭācatvāriṃśo marāyo bhavati bṛhatsāmā . brahma vā aṣṭācatvāriṃśaḥ kṣatraṃ bṛhat . dve hi te gāyatryau yad aṣṭācatvāriṃśaḥ . brahmaṇā ca kṣatreṇa ca sayugbhyāṃ bahuḥ prajayā paśubhiḥ prajāyā iti . yad v evaitāni stotrāṇi jyāyāṃsīva ca bhavanti tasmān marāyaḥ .
sentences: prajāpatir vā akāmayata bahuḥ prajayā paśubʰiḥ prajāyeya .
tato vai sa bahuḥ prajayā paśubʰiḥ prājāyata .
sa yaḥ kāmayeta bahuḥ prajayā paśubʰiḥ prajāyeya dvandvaṃ prajāḥ paśūn sr̥jeyeti sa etābʰyāṃ yajeta .
bahur eva prajayā paśubʰiḥ prajāyate dvandvaṃ prajāḥ paśūn sr̥jate .
brahmaṇā ca kṣatreṇa ca sayugbʰyāṃ bahuḥ prajayā paśubʰiḥ prajāyā iti .
yad v evaitāni stotrāṇi bahulāny udapadyanta iva tasmād rāśiḥ .
dve hi te gāyatryau yad aṣṭācatvāriṃśaḥ .
brahmaṇā ca kṣatreṇa ca sayugbʰyāṃ bahuḥ prajayā paśubʰiḥ prajāyā iti .
yad v evaitāni stotrāṇi jyāyāṃsīva ca bʰavanti tasmān marāyaḥ .
text: Now these are the rāśi and marāya rites. One desiring offspring should sacrifice with these two. Prajāpati desired: 'May I become many with offspring and cattle. May I create offspring and cattle in pairs.' He saw these two sacrifices. He brought them. He sacrificed with them. Thereby he became many with offspring and cattle. He created offspring and cattle in pairs. He who desires 'May I become many with offspring and cattle; may I create offspring and cattle in pairs' should sacrifice with these two. He becomes many with offspring and cattle; he creates offspring and cattle in pairs. The rāśi is forty-four-fold with the Rathantara sāman. The Rathantara is brahman; forty-four is kṣatra. 'With brahman and kṣatra yoked together, may I become many with offspring and cattle.' Or because these stotrāṇi arise as if in abundance, therefore it is called rāśi ('heap'). The marāya is forty-eight-fold with the Bṛhat sāman. Forty-eight is brahman; the Bṛhat is kṣatra—for those are two Gāyatrīs that make forty-eight. 'With brahman and kṣatra yoked together, may I become many with offspring and cattle.' Or because these stotrāṇi become as if greater, therefore it is called marāya.
meaning: अथैतौ राशि-मरायौ . प्रजननकामो हैताभ्यां यजेत . प्रजापतिर् वा अकामयत बहुः प्रजया पशुभिः प्रजायेय . द्वन्द्वं प्रजाः पशून् सृजेयेति . स एतौ यज्ञाव् अपश्यत् . ताव् आहरत . ताभ्याम् अयजत . ततो वै स बहुः प्रजया पशुभिः प्राजायत . द्वन्द्वं प्रजाः पशून् असृजत . स यः कामयेत बहुः प्रजया पशुभिः प्रजायेय द्वन्द्वं प्रजाः पशून् सृजेयेति स एताभ्यां यजेत . बहुर् एव प्रजया पशुभिः प्रजायते द्वन्द्वं प्रजाः पशून् सृजते . स राशिश् चतुश्चत्वारिंशो भवति रथन्तरसामा . ब्रह्म वै रथन्तरं क्षत्रं चतुश्चत्वारिंशः . ब्रह्मणा च क्षत्रेण च सयुग्भ्यां बहुः प्रजया पशुभिः प्रजाया इति . यद् व् एवैतानि स्तोत्राणि बहुलान्य् उदपद्यन्त इव तस्माद् राशिः . अष्टाचत्वारिंशो मरायो भवति बृहत्सामा . ब्रह्म वा अष्टाचत्वारिंशः क्षत्रं बृहत् . द्वे हि ते गायत्र्यौ यद् अष्टाचत्वारिंशः . ब्रह्मणा च क्षत्रेण च सयुग्भ्यां बहुः प्रजया पशुभिः प्रजाया इति . यद् व् एवैतानि स्तोत्राणि ज्यायांसीव च भवन्ति तस्मान् मरायः .

sanskrit_iast: tau vā etau bhūmaiva stomānām . tau yau bhūmā stomānāṃ tābhyāṃ bahuḥ prajayā paśubhiḥ prajāyā iti . tayos saha dīkṣā saha krayas sahopasadaḥ . krītvā tu nānopanahyanti . nānrtvijo bhavanti . tad āhus saṃsavo vā eṣa yan nānartvijo bhavanti . yan nvāva dūrāt saṃsūyate tad aramaṇīyam . atha kiṃ yad antikāt samānā evartvija syur iti . no ha tu tathā sadyas saṃtiṣṭheyātāṃ nānaivartvija syuḥ . te vāva samānaṃ pravaraṃ pravṛṇate samānīm āśiṣam āśāsate . tasmān nānaivartvija syur iti . atho āhū rāśinaiva pūrveṇeṣṭvāvabhṛtād udetya marāyāya dīkṣeteti . ayamau ha tu tathā syātām . samānī hi yamayor yonis saha jāyete saha vardhete . tasmāt sahaiva syātām iti . tābhyāṃ haitābhyām ugrāyudho mānaścitta īje . atho alando vātsyas tayor ha paraśśatā anyasmin samā āsuḥ paraśśatā anyasmin . tathā bahur ha prajajñāte .
sentences: tau yau bʰūmā stomānāṃ tābʰyāṃ bahuḥ prajayā paśubʰiḥ prajāyā iti .
tayos saha dīkṣā saha krayas sahopasadaḥ .
tad āhus saṃsavo vā eṣa yan nānartvijo bʰavanti .
yan nvāva dūrāt saṃsūyate tad aramaṇīyam .
atʰa kiṃ yad antikāt samānā evartvija syur iti .
no ha tu tatʰā sadyas saṃtiṣṭʰeyātāṃ nānaivartvija syuḥ .
te vāva samānaṃ pravaraṃ pravr̥ṇate samānīm āśiṣam āśāsate .
atʰo āhū rāśinaiva pūrveṇeṣṭvāvabʰr̥tād udetya marāyāya dīkṣeteti .
samānī hi yamayor yonis saha jāyete saha vardʰete .
atʰo alando vātsyas tayor ha paraśśatā anyasmin samā āsuḥ paraśśatā anyasmin .
text: These two are indeed the fullness of stomas. 'With those two which are the fullness of stomas, may I become many with offspring and cattle.' Their dīkṣā (consecration) is together, their purchase is together, their upasad days are together. But after the purchase they do not tie on (the sacrificial animal) together. Their priests are different. They say: 'This is a fault, that the priests are different. What is joined from afar is pleasing. But what if they were nearby and had the same priests?' But they would not be completed on the same day that way; the priests should indeed be different. They do pronounce the same pravara (lineage recitation) and utter the same benediction. Therefore the priests should be different. Others say: 'Having sacrificed with the rāśi first, one should, after coming up from the avabhṛtha bath, consecrate oneself for the marāya.' But then they would be like twins. For twins have the same origin—they are born together, they grow together. Therefore they should be performed together. With these two, Ugrāyudha Mānascitta sacrificed. And also Alanda Vātsya. In one of them there were over a hundred (offspring), in the other over a hundred. Thus he produced many offspring.
meaning: तौ वा एतौ भूमैव स्तोमानाम् . तौ यौ भूमा स्तोमानां ताभ्यां बहुः प्रजया पशुभिः प्रजाया इति . तयोस् सह दीक्षा सह क्रयस् सहोपसदः . क्रीत्वा तु नानोपनह्यन्ति . नान्र्त्विजो भवन्ति . तद् आहुस् संसवो वा एष यन् नानर्त्विजो भवन्ति . यन् न्वाव दूरात् संसूयते तद् अरमणीयम् . अथ किं यद् अन्तिकात् समाना एवर्त्विज स्युर् इति . नो ह तु तथा सद्यस् संतिष्ठेयातां नानैवर्त्विज स्युः . ते वाव समानं प्रवरं प्रवृणते समानीम् आशिषम् आशासते . तस्मान् नानैवर्त्विज स्युर् इति . अथो आहू राशिनैव पूर्वेणेष्ट्वावभृताद् उदेत्य मरायाय दीक्षेतेति . अयमौ ह तु तथा स्याताम् . समानी हि यमयोर् योनिस् सह जायेते सह वर्धेते . तस्मात् सहैव स्याताम् इति . ताभ्यां हैताभ्याम् उग्रायुधो मानश्चित्त ईजे . अथो अलन्दो वात्स्यस् तयोर् ह परश्शता अन्यस्मिन् समा आसुः परश्शता अन्यस्मिन् . तथा बहुर् ह प्रजज्ञाते .

sanskrit_iast: athaite jyotir gaur āyur iti stomā bhavanti . gaur āyur askandat . tato jyotir ajāyata . ayaṃ vai loka āyur asau gaur idam evāntarikṣaṃ jyotiḥ . tam etaṃ purastād akurvātāṃ yathā putram evam . ito vā ayam ūrdhvo loko 'rvāṅ asāv amutaḥ . tad idam enayoḥ purastāj jyotiḥ paryūḍhaṃ tena paśyāmaḥ . tau yogam upaprayantāv antam abhi jyotir vyudauhatām . sa yathā pitarau putraṃ pūrvaṃ yantaṃ paścād anviyātāṃ tādṛk tat .  etan mithunī stomā bhavanti yad yujyante . madhye vai jāyāpatyoḥ putraḥ śete . tau yathā mithunībhaviṣyantāv itthād vetthād vā putraṃ parihareyātāṃ tādṛg evaitat . ta eta ūnātiriktā mithunā prajanaya stomāḥ . sa yaḥ kāmayeta bahuḥ prajayā paśubhiḥ prajāyeyeti sa etair yajeta .
sentences: atʰaite jyotir gaur āyur iti stomā bʰavanti .
ayaṃ vai loka āyur asau gaur idam evāntarikṣaṃ jyotiḥ .
tam etaṃ purastād akurvātāṃ yatʰā putram evam .
ito vā ayam ūrdʰvo loko 'rvāṅ asāv amutaḥ .
tad idam enayoḥ purastāj jyotiḥ paryūḍʰaṃ tena paśyāmaḥ .
tau yogam upaprayantāv antam abʰi jyotir vyudauhatām .
sa yatʰā pitarau putraṃ pūrvaṃ yantaṃ paścād anviyātāṃ tādr̥k tat .
[tad] etan mitʰunī stomā bʰavanti yad yujyante .
tau yatʰā mitʰunībʰaviṣyantāv ittʰād vettʰād vā putraṃ parihareyātāṃ tādr̥g evaitat .
ta eta ūnātiriktā mitʰunā prajanaya stomāḥ .
sa yaḥ kāmayeta bahuḥ prajayā paśubʰiḥ prajāyeyeti sa etair yajeta .
text: Now these are the stomas called jyotis, go, and āyus. Go (the cow) ran away from āyus (life). From that, jyotis (light) was born. This world is āyus; yonder world is go; this intermediate space is jyotis. They placed this one in front, like a son. This world rises upward from here; that one extends down from there. Thus this light is placed in front between them—by it we see. The two, approaching their union, produced the light at the boundary. Just as two parents follow after a son who goes first, such is this. These become paired stomas when they are yoked. In the middle, between husband and wife, the son lies. Just as a couple about to unite might move the son from this side or that side, such is this. These are the unequal-paired procreative stomas. He who desires 'May I become many with offspring and cattle' should sacrifice with these.
meaning: अथैते ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुर् इति स्तोमा भवन्ति . गौर् आयुर् अस्कन्दत् . ततो ज्योतिर् अजायत . अयं वै लोक आयुर् असौ गौर् इदम् एवान्तरिक्षं ज्योतिः . तम् एतं पुरस्ताद् अकुर्वातां यथा पुत्रम् एवम् . इतो वा अयम् ऊर्ध्वो लोको ऽर्वाङ् असाव् अमुतः . तद् इदम् एनयोः पुरस्ताज् ज्योतिः पर्यूढं तेन पश्यामः . तौ योगम् उपप्रयन्ताव् अन्तम् अभि ज्योतिर् व्युदौहताम् . स यथा पितरौ पुत्रं पूर्वं यन्तं पश्चाद् अन्वियातां तादृक् तत् .  एतन् मिथुनी स्तोमा भवन्ति यद् युज्यन्ते . मध्ये वै जायापत्योः पुत्रः शेते . तौ यथा मिथुनीभविष्यन्ताव् इत्थाद् वेत्थाद् वा पुत्रं परिहरेयातां तादृग् एवैतत् . त एत ऊनातिरिक्ता मिथुना प्रजनय स्तोमाः . स यः कामयेत बहुः प्रजया पशुभिः प्रजायेयेति स एतैर् यजेत .

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣa śunaskarṇastomaḥ . śunaskarṇo ha vai vārṣṇyakaḥ puṇyakṛd apāpakṛd āsa . sa ha cakame puṇyam evāsmin loke kṛtvāpāpaṃkṛtya svargaṃ lokaṃ gaccheyam iti . sa etaṃ yajñam apaśyat . tam āharat . tenāyajata . tato vai sa puṇyam evāsmin loke kṛtvāpāpaṃkṛtya svargaṃ lokam agacchat . sa yaḥ puṇyakṛt kāmayeta puṇyam evāsmin loke kṛtvāpāpaṃkṛtya svargaṃ lokaṃ gaccheyam iti sa etena yajeta . puṇyam evāsmin loke kṛtvāpāpaṃkṛtya svargaṃ lokaṃ gacchati . sa trivṛd bhavati . parāṅ iva ha vā eṣaḥ . svargam eva lokam abhinirmṛṣṭo yat trivṛt stomaḥ . parāṅ evaitena svargaṃ lokam eti . tasya parāñcy eva stotrāṇi bhavanti parāñci śastrāṇi parāñci pṛṣṭhāni parācīr viṣṭutayaḥ . parāṅ eva sarvo bhavati .
sentences: śunaskarṇo ha vai vārṣṇyakaḥ puṇyakr̥d apāpakr̥d āsa .
sa ha cakame puṇyam evāsmin loke kr̥tvāpāpaṃkr̥tya svargaṃ lokaṃ gaccʰeyam iti .
tato vai sa puṇyam evāsmin loke kr̥tvāpāpaṃkr̥tya svargaṃ lokam agaccʰat .
sa yaḥ puṇyakr̥t kāmayeta puṇyam evāsmin loke kr̥tvāpāpaṃkr̥tya svargaṃ lokaṃ gaccʰeyam iti sa etena yajeta .
puṇyam evāsmin loke kr̥tvāpāpaṃkr̥tya svargaṃ lokaṃ gaccʰati .
svargam eva lokam abʰinirmr̥ṣṭo yat trivr̥t stomaḥ .
tasya parāñcy eva stotrāṇi bʰavanti parāñci śastrāṇi parāñci pr̥ṣṭʰāni parācīr viṣṭutayaḥ .
text: Now this is the Śunaskarṇa-stoma. Śunaskarṇa Vārṣṇyaka was a doer of good and a non-doer of evil. He desired: 'Having done good in this world and having done no evil, may I go to the heavenly world.' He saw this sacrifice. He brought it. He sacrificed with it. Thereby, having done good in this world and having done no evil, he went to the heavenly world. He who is a doer of good and desires 'Having done good in this world and having done no evil, may I go to the heavenly world' should sacrifice with this. Having done good in this world and having done no evil, he goes to the heavenly world. It is trivṛt (nine-fold). He is as if departing. One who is cleansed toward the heavenly world—that is the trivṛt stoma. With it he goes to the heavenly world as if departing. Its stotrāṇi face away, its śastrāṇi face away, its pṛṣṭhāni face away, its viṣṭutis face away. Everything faces away.
meaning: अथैष शुनस्कर्णस्तोमः . शुनस्कर्णो ह वै वार्ष्ण्यकः पुण्यकृद् अपापकृद् आस . स ह चकमे पुण्यम् एवास्मिन् लोके कृत्वापापंकृत्य स्वर्गं लोकं गच्छेयम् इति . स एतं यज्ञम् अपश्यत् . तम् आहरत् . तेनायजत . ततो वै स पुण्यम् एवास्मिन् लोके कृत्वापापंकृत्य स्वर्गं लोकम् अगच्छत् . स यः पुण्यकृत् कामयेत पुण्यम् एवास्मिन् लोके कृत्वापापंकृत्य स्वर्गं लोकं गच्छेयम् इति स एतेन यजेत . पुण्यम् एवास्मिन् लोके कृत्वापापंकृत्य स्वर्गं लोकं गच्छति . स त्रिवृद् भवति . पराङ् इव ह वा एषः . स्वर्गम् एव लोकम् अभिनिर्मृष्टो यत् त्रिवृत् स्तोमः . पराङ् एवैतेन स्वर्गं लोकम् एति . तस्य पराञ्च्य् एव स्तोत्राणि भवन्ति पराञ्चि शस्त्राणि पराञ्चि पृष्ठानि पराचीर् विष्टुतयः . पराङ् एव सर्वो भवति .

sanskrit_iast: tasya vāmadevyaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati svāram . svārāṇi sarvāṇi sāmāny avakalpayanti . prāṇo vai svaraḥ . prāṇair eva tat prāṇān udgātā yajamānasya nisvarati . tad āhur yajñāyajñīyasya stotre jaghanena gārhapatyaṃ dakṣiṇā prāvṛtya nipadyeta . tata eva svargaṃ lokam etīti . tad u vā āhur vikarṣo vai tathā yajñasya bhavati yad asaṃsthite nipadyeta . yadaiva sarvaṃ karma saṃtiṣṭheta yadā vaśayā careyuḥ . atha jaghanenāhavanīyaṃ dakṣiṇā prāvṛtya nipadyeta . tata eva svargaṃ lokam etīti . asau vā āditya āhavanīyaḥ . eṣa vai svargo lokaḥ .
sentences: prāṇair eva tat prāṇān udgātā yajamānasya nisvarati .
tad āhur yajñāyajñīyasya stotre jagʰanena gārhapatyaṃ dakṣiṇā prāvr̥tya nipadyeta .
tad u vā āhur vikarṣo vai tatʰā yajñasya bʰavati yad asaṃstʰite nipadyeta .
yadaiva sarvaṃ karma saṃtiṣṭʰeta yadā vaśayā careyuḥ .
text: Its pṛṣṭha is the vāmadevya, which is svāra. They arrange all the sāmans as svāra. The svara is indeed prāṇa. By means of the prāṇas the udgātṛ thereby breathes out the prāṇas of the sacrificer. On this they say: at the stotra of the yajñāyajñīya, one should lie down behind the gārhapatya, wrapping oneself to the right. From there one goes to the heavenly world. But on this they also say: that would be a disruption of the sacrifice, if one were to lie down before its completion. Only when all the ritual acts have been completed, when they would move about freely -- then one should lie down behind the āhavanīya, wrapping oneself to the right. From there one goes to the heavenly world. That sun yonder is the āhavanīya. He is indeed the heavenly world.
meaning: तस्य वामदेव्यं पृष्ठं भवति स्वारम् . स्वाराणि सर्वाणि सामान्य् अवकल्पयन्ति . प्राणो वै स्वरः . प्राणैर् एव तत् प्राणान् उद्गाता यजमानस्य निस्वरति . तद् आहुर् यज्ञायज्ञीयस्य स्तोत्रे जघनेन गार्हपत्यं दक्षिणा प्रावृत्य निपद्येत . तत एव स्वर्गं लोकम् एतीति . तद् उ वा आहुर् विकर्षो वै तथा यज्ञस्य भवति यद् असंस्थिते निपद्येत . यदैव सर्वं कर्म संतिष्ठेत यदा वशया चरेयुः . अथ जघनेनाहवनीयं दक्षिणा प्रावृत्य निपद्येत . तत एव स्वर्गं लोकम् एतीति . असौ वा आदित्य आहवनीयः . एष वै स्वर्गो लोकः .

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣa manustomaḥ . manuś ca vai yamaś ca vaivasvatāv āstām . so 'kāmayata manur asmai māṃ lokāya rājyāya devās suvīrann amuṣmai yamam iti . sa etaṃ yajñam apaśyat . tam āharat . tenāyajata . tato vai tam asmai lokāya rājyāya devā asuvatāmuṣmai yamam . sa vā eṣa sadaśo bhavati . saṃdaṃśo ha vā eṣa yat sadaśaḥ . sa yathā saṃdaṃśena saṃdaśya hared evam evainam etena saṃdaṃśena saṃdaśyāsmāl lokād amuṃ lokaṃ jahāra . tasya rathantaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati . vajro vai rathantaram . vajreṇaivainaṃ tad asmāl lokād amuṃ lokam abhinirjaghāna . sa yo bhrātṛvyavān syād yo 'bhicared ya spardheta sa etena yajeta vajreṇaivainaṃ tad asmāl lokād amuṃ lokam abhinirhanti .
sentences: manuś ca vai yamaś ca vaivasvatāv āstām .
so 'kāmayata manur asmai māṃ lokāya rājyāya devās suvīrann amuṣmai yamam iti .
tato vai tam asmai lokāya rājyāya devā asuvatāmuṣmai yamam .
saṃdaṃśo ha vā eṣa yat sadaśaḥ .
sa yatʰā saṃdaṃśena saṃdaśya hared evam evainam etena saṃdaṃśena saṃdaśyāsmāl lokād amuṃ lokaṃ jahāra .
vajreṇaivainaṃ tad asmāl lokād amuṃ lokam abʰinirjagʰāna .
sa yo bʰrātr̥vyavān syād yo 'bʰicared ya spardʰeta sa etena yajeta vajreṇaivainaṃ tad asmāl lokād amuṃ lokam abʰinirhanti .
text: Now this is the manustoma. Manu and Yama, the two sons of Vivasvat, were there. Manu desired: 'May the gods grant me sovereignty for this world, and Yama for the other world.' He saw this sacrifice. He brought it. He sacrificed with it. Thereupon the gods granted him sovereignty for this world, and Yama for the other world. This sacrifice has the sadaśa stoma. The sadaśa is indeed a pair of tongs. Just as one would seize something with tongs and carry it away, so with these tongs he seized him and carried him from this world to the other world. Its pṛṣṭha is the rathantara. The rathantara is indeed the vajra. With the vajra he struck him forth from this world to the other world. He who has a rival, he who would practice sorcery, he who would compete -- he should sacrifice with this. With the vajra he thereby strikes his rival forth from this world to the other world.
meaning: अथैष मनुस्तोमः . मनुश् च वै यमश् च वैवस्वताव् आस्ताम् . सो ऽकामयत मनुर् अस्मै मां लोकाय राज्याय देवास् सुवीरन्न् अमुष्मै यमम् इति . स एतं यज्ञम् अपश्यत् . तम् आहरत् . तेनायजत . ततो वै तम् अस्मै लोकाय राज्याय देवा असुवतामुष्मै यमम् . स वा एष सदशो भवति . संदंशो ह वा एष यत् सदशः . स यथा संदंशेन संदश्य हरेद् एवम् एवैनम् एतेन संदंशेन संदश्यास्माल् लोकाद् अमुं लोकं जहार . तस्य रथन्तरं पृष्ठं भवति . वज्रो वै रथन्तरम् . वज्रेणैवैनं तद् अस्माल् लोकाद् अमुं लोकम् अभिनिर्जघान . स यो भ्रातृव्यवान् स्याद् यो ऽभिचरेद् य स्पर्धेत स एतेन यजेत वज्रेणैवैनं तद् अस्माल् लोकाद् अमुं लोकम् अभिनिर्हन्ति .

sanskrit_iast: jamadagnes saptahaṃ vidrathaṃ cakṣūṃṣīti . yāny abhicaraṇīyasya rūpaṃ sāmāni tāni . stomam eva tadrūpeṇa samardhayanti . atho āhur annādyakāma evainena yajeteti . sarvo ha vā anyo virājam atiṣṭauti . eṣa ha vāva virājaṃ nātiṣṭauti yo daśabhi stute . daśākṣarā virāṭ . annaṃ virāṭ . virāja evānnādyasyāvaruddhyai . tasya rathantaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavaty annaṃ vai rathantaram annādyasyaivāvaruddhyai . tasminn etāni sāmāny avakalpayanty arkārkapuṣpe dairghaśravasam iti yāny annādyasya rūpaṃ sāmāni tāni .
sentences: sarvo ha vā anyo virājam atiṣṭauti .
eṣa ha vāva virājaṃ nātiṣṭauti yo daśabʰi stute .
tasya ratʰantaraṃ pr̥ṣṭʰaṃ bʰavaty annaṃ vai ratʰantaram annādyasyaivāvaruddʰyai .
tasminn etāni sāmāny avakalpayanty arkārkapuṣpe dairgʰaśravasam iti yāny annādyasya rūpaṃ sāmāni tāni .
text: Of Jamadagni: the seven-day rite called vidratham, 'the eyes.' Those sāmans which have the character of sorcery -- those are they. They complete the stoma with their corresponding form. But they also say: one desiring food should sacrifice with this. Everyone else indeed exceeds the virāj in chanting. But he who chants with ten does not exceed the virāj. The virāj has ten syllables. The virāj is food. It is for the securing of food from the virāj. Its pṛṣṭha is the rathantara. The rathantara is indeed food -- for the securing of food. In it they arrange these sāmans: the arka, the arkapuṣpa, and the dairghaśravasa -- those sāmans which have the form of food, those are they.
meaning: जमदग्नेस् सप्तहं विद्रथं चक्षूंषीति . यान्य् अभिचरणीयस्य रूपं सामानि तानि . स्तोमम् एव तद्रूपेण समर्धयन्ति . अथो आहुर् अन्नाद्यकाम एवैनेन यजेतेति . सर्वो ह वा अन्यो विराजम् अतिष्टौति . एष ह वाव विराजं नातिष्टौति यो दशभि स्तुते . दशाक्षरा विराट् . अन्नं विराट् . विराज एवान्नाद्यस्यावरुद्ध्यै . तस्य रथन्तरं पृष्ठं भवत्य् अन्नं वै रथन्तरम् अन्नाद्यस्यैवावरुद्ध्यै . तस्मिन्न् एतानि सामान्य् अवकल्पयन्त्य् अर्कार्कपुष्पे दैर्घश्रवसम् इति यान्य् अन्नाद्यस्य रूपं सामानि तानि .

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣa gāyatraḥ . tasya trivṛti prātassavane pañcadaśam acchāvākasyājyaṃ saptadaśaṃ mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanam ekaviṃśaṃ tṛtīyasavanam . ukthyo yajña ubhayasāmanī . purodhākāmo haitena yajeta . tad yat trivṛti prātassavane pañcadaśam acchāvākasyājyaṃ bhavati brahma vai trivṛt kṣatraṃ pañcadaśo brahmaiva tat kṣatrasya purastād dadhāti . tasmād brāḥmaṇaḥ kṣatriyasya purohitaḥ . atho haitat brahmaṇa eva kṣatram anuvartma karoti . saptadaśaṃ mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanam . viḍ vai saptadaśaḥ . eṣa u ha vai dvitīyo rājā yat purohitaḥ . viśo vā eṣa aiśvaryam ādhipatyaṃ gacchati ya śriyam aśnute . viśa aiśvaryam ādhipatyaṃ gacchānīti tasmāt saptadaśaṃ mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ bhavati .
sentences: tasya trivr̥ti prātassavane pañcadaśam accʰāvākasyājyaṃ saptadaśaṃ mādʰyaṃdinaṃ savanam ekaviṃśaṃ tr̥tīyasavanam .
tad yat trivr̥ti prātassavane pañcadaśam accʰāvākasyājyaṃ bʰavati brahma vai trivr̥t kṣatraṃ pañcadaśo brahmaiva tat kṣatrasya purastād dadʰāti .
atʰo haitat brahmaṇa eva kṣatram anuvartma karoti .
eṣa u ha vai dvitīyo rājā yat purohitaḥ .
viśo vā eṣa aiśvaryam ādʰipatyaṃ gaccʰati ya śriyam aśnute .
viśa aiśvaryam ādʰipatyaṃ gaccʰānīti tasmāt saptadaśaṃ mādʰyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ bʰavati .
text: Now this is the gāyatra. In it, the trivṛt is in the morning pressing, the pañcadaśa is the ājya of the acchāvāka, the saptadaśa is the midday pressing, and the ekaviṃśa is the third pressing. The sacrifice is ukthya, with both sāmans. One desiring the office of purohita should sacrifice with this. That the trivṛt is in the morning pressing and the pañcadaśa is the ājya of the acchāvāka—the trivṛt is brahman, the pañcadaśa is kṣatra; thus he places brahman before kṣatra. Therefore the brāhmaṇa is the purohita of the kṣatriya. And thereby he makes kṣatra follow in the path of brahman. The saptadaśa is the midday pressing. The saptadaśa is the viś. This purohita is indeed a second king. He who attains prosperity reaches the lordship and sovereignty of the viś. 'May I attain the lordship and sovereignty of the viś'—therefore the saptadaśa is the midday pressing.
meaning: अथैष गायत्रः . तस्य त्रिवृति प्रातस्सवने पञ्चदशम् अच्छावाकस्याज्यं सप्तदशं माध्यंदिनं सवनम् एकविंशं तृतीयसवनम् . उक्थ्यो यज्ञ उभयसामनी . पुरोधाकामो हैतेन यजेत . तद् यत् त्रिवृति प्रातस्सवने पञ्चदशम् अच्छावाकस्याज्यं भवति ब्रह्म वै त्रिवृत् क्षत्रं पञ्चदशो ब्रह्मैव तत् क्षत्रस्य पुरस्ताद् दधाति . तस्माद् ब्राःमणः क्षत्रियस्य पुरोहितः . अथो हैतत् ब्रह्मण एव क्षत्रम् अनुवर्त्म करोति . सप्तदशं माध्यंदिनं सवनम् . विड् वै सप्तदशः . एष उ ह वै द्वितीयो राजा यत् पुरोहितः . विशो वा एष ऐश्वर्यम् आधिपत्यं गच्छति य श्रियम् अश्नुते . विश ऐश्वर्यम् आधिपत्यं गच्छानीति तस्मात् सप्तदशं माध्यंदिनं सवनं भवति .

sanskrit_iast: tasya rathantaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati bṛhad brahmasāma . brahma vai rathantaram . kṣatraṃ bṛhat . brahmaiva tat kṣatrasya purastād dadhāti . tasmād brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyasya purohitaḥ . atho haitat brahmaṇa eva kṣatram anuvartma karoti . sa ukthyo bhavati . viḍ vā ukthāni . eṣa u ha vai dvitīyo rājā yat purohitaḥ . viśa u vā eṣa aiśvaryam ādhipatyaṃ gacchati ya śriyam aśnute . viśa aiśvaryam ādhipatyaṃ gacchānīti tasmād ukthyo bhavati . atho haitad brahmaṇe caiva kṣatrāya ca viśam anuyuvam karoti . tāny ekaviṃśāni bhavanti . dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavas traya ime lokā asāv āditya ekaviṃśaḥ . eṣa u ha vai śrīḥ . etām eva tac chriyam antato 'bhyārohati . sa u eva sarvas saṃstuto gāyatrīm evābhisaṃpadyate . brahma vai gāyatrī . yado vai brahmavarcasam ṛdhnoty atha sa tasya purodhāṃ gacchati . sa yadā purodhāṃ gacched atha kāmayetācyāvyo 'syai purodhāyai syāṃ na cyaveyety etasyaiva sataḥ pañcadaśaṃ brāhmaṇācchaṃsina ājyaṃ kuryāt tat . brahma vai trivṛt . kṣatraṃ pañcadaśaḥ . tad etad brahmaṇobhayataḥ kṣatraṃ parigṛhṇāti .
sentences: tasya ratʰantaraṃ pr̥ṣṭʰaṃ bʰavati br̥had brahmasāma .
atʰo haitat brahmaṇa eva kṣatram anuvartma karoti .
eṣa u ha vai dvitīyo rājā yat purohitaḥ .
viśa u vā eṣa aiśvaryam ādʰipatyaṃ gaccʰati ya śriyam aśnute .
viśa aiśvaryam ādʰipatyaṃ gaccʰānīti tasmād uktʰyo bʰavati .
atʰo haitad brahmaṇe caiva kṣatrāya ca viśam anuyuvam karoti .
dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavas traya ime lokā asāv āditya ekaviṃśaḥ .
sa u eva sarvas saṃstuto gāyatrīm evābʰisaṃpadyate .
yado vai brahmavarcasam r̥dʰnoty atʰa sa tasya purodʰāṃ gaccʰati .
sa yadā purodʰāṃ gaccʰed atʰa kāmayetācyāvyo 'syai purodʰāyai syāṃ na cyaveyety etasyaiva sataḥ pañcadaśaṃ brāhmaṇāccʰaṃsina ājyaṃ kuryāt tat .
text: Its pṛṣṭha is the rathantara; the bṛhat is the brahmasāma. The rathantara is indeed brahman. The bṛhat is kṣatra. Thus he places brahman before kṣatra. Therefore the brāhmaṇa is the purohita of the kṣatriya. And thereby he makes kṣatra follow in the path of brahman. It is ukthya. The ukthāni are indeed the viś. This purohita is indeed a second king. He who attains prosperity reaches the lordship and sovereignty of the viś. 'May I attain the lordship and sovereignty of the viś'—therefore it is ukthya. And thereby he makes the viś a yoke-companion for both brahman and kṣatra. They become ekaviṃśa. Twelve months, five seasons, three worlds, and that sun yonder—ekaviṃśa is the twenty-first. He is indeed śrī (prosperity). Thus at the end he ascends to that very śrī. And the entire chant resolves into the gāyatrī. The gāyatrī is indeed brahman. When one attains brahmavarcas, then one obtains the office of purohita. When one obtains the office of purohita, one should desire: 'May I be irremovable from this office of purohita, may I not be displaced.' From this very arrangement, one should make the pañcadaśa the ājya of the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin. The trivṛt is brahman. The pañcadaśa is kṣatra. Thus he grasps kṣatra on both sides with brahman.
meaning: तस्य रथन्तरं पृष्ठं भवति बृहद् ब्रह्मसाम . ब्रह्म वै रथन्तरम् . क्षत्रं बृहत् . ब्रह्मैव तत् क्षत्रस्य पुरस्ताद् दधाति . तस्माद् ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियस्य पुरोहितः . अथो हैतत् ब्रह्मण एव क्षत्रम् अनुवर्त्म करोति . स उक्थ्यो भवति . विड् वा उक्थानि . एष उ ह वै द्वितीयो राजा यत् पुरोहितः . विश उ वा एष ऐश्वर्यम् आधिपत्यं गच्छति य श्रियम् अश्नुते . विश ऐश्वर्यम् आधिपत्यं गच्छानीति तस्माद् उक्थ्यो भवति . अथो हैतद् ब्रह्मणे चैव क्षत्राय च विशम् अनुयुवम् करोति . तान्य् एकविंशानि भवन्ति . द्वादश मासाः पञ्चर्तवस् त्रय इमे लोका असाव् आदित्य एकविंशः . एष उ ह वै श्रीः . एताम् एव तच् छ्रियम् अन्ततो ऽभ्यारोहति . स उ एव सर्वस् संस्तुतो गायत्रीम् एवाभिसंपद्यते . ब्रह्म वै गायत्री . यदो वै ब्रह्मवर्चसम् ऋध्नोत्य् अथ स तस्य पुरोधां गच्छति . स यदा पुरोधां गच्छेद् अथ कामयेताच्याव्यो ऽस्यै पुरोधायै स्यां न च्यवेयेत्य् एतस्यैव सतः पञ्चदशं ब्राह्मणाच्छंसिन आज्यं कुर्यात् तत् . ब्रह्म वै त्रिवृत् . क्षत्रं पञ्चदशः . तद् एतद् ब्रह्मणोभयतः क्षत्रं परिगृह्णाति .

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣa gautamasya catuṣṭomaḥ . gautamo vā akāmayatāva paśūn rundhīya bhūmānaṃ paśūnāṃ gaccheyam iti . sa etaṃ yajñam apaśyat . tam āharat . tenāyajata . tato vai so 'va paśūn arundha bhūmānaṃ paśūnām agacchat . sa yaḥ kāmayetāva paśūn rundhīya bhūmānaṃ paśūnām gaccheyam iti sa etena yajeta . ava haiva paśūn runddhe bhūmānaṃ paśūnāṃ gacchati .
