sanskrit_iast: vācā hy apūtam amedhyaṃ vadanti . teṣām indriyaṃ vīryaṃ vāco 'pakrāmati . tad yad anuṣṭup pratipad bhavati abhipūrvam eva tad vācā samṛdhyante . so vā arbudasyarkṣu bhavati . arbudo vai sarpa etābhir mṛtāṃ tvacam apāhata . mriyante iva vā ete ye vrātyāṃ dhāvayanti . uta hi sthaviratarasyānta āhanasyaṃ vadanti .
sentences: tad yad anuṣṭup pratipad bʰavati abʰipūrvam eva tad vācā samr̥dʰyante .
arbudo vai sarpa etābʰir mr̥tāṃ tvacam apāhata .
mriyante iva vā ete ye vrātyāṃ dʰāvayanti .
text: For by speech they utter what is impure and unclean. Their vigor and power departs from their speech. Because the introductory verse is anuṣṭubh, they thereby succeed through speech from the very beginning. It belongs to the verses of Arbuda. Arbuda was indeed a serpent. With these verses he shed his dead skin. Those who perform the vrātyā race die, as it were. And they say that even of an elder, one speaks of 'the end of life.'
meaning: वाचा ह्य् अपूतम् अमेध्यं वदन्ति . तेषाम् इन्द्रियं वीर्यं वाचो ऽपक्रामति . तद् यद् अनुष्टुप् प्रतिपद् भवति अभिपूर्वम् एव तद् वाचा समृध्यन्ते . सो वा अर्बुदस्यर्क्षु भवति . अर्बुदो वै सर्प एताभिर् मृतां त्वचम् अपाहत . म्रियन्ते इव वा एते ये व्रात्यां धावयन्ति . उत हि स्थविरतरस्यान्त आहनस्यं वदन्ति .

sanskrit_iast: so vā āgneyī bhavati . agnir vai lokānāṃ prajñapayitā . sa yo lokānāṃ prajñapayitā sa no lokān prajñapayād iti . na hi te agne tanvai krūraṃ viveda martya iti yad iha krūram aśāntam acāriṣma tad etayāpahanāmahā iti . kapir bibhasti tejanaṃ punar jarāyu gaur ive ti punar evaitayāpiyanti . agne viśvebhir agnibhir iti vaiśvāgnam ājyaṃ bhavati . agnayo vai viśve devāḥ . viśvān eva tena devān apiyanti . tad ānuṣṭubhaṃ bhavati savanamukhe savanamukhe vācā samṛdhyāmahā iti . tat trivṛd bhavati brahma vai trivṛt . brahmaṇo vā ete vyṛdhyante ye vrātyāṃ dhāvayanti . rājaputrā iti hy enān ācakṣate . tad yat trivṛd bhavati brahmaṇaiva tat samṛdhyante . pañcadaśaṃ maitrāvaruṇasya . kṣatraṃ vai pañcadaśaḥ . apabhraṃśo ha vai brahmaṇaḥ kṣatram . kṣatreṇaiva tat samṛdhyante . saptadaśaṃ brāhmaṇācchaṃsinaḥ . prajāpatir vai saptadaśaḥ . prajāpatinaiva tat samṛdhyante . ṣoḍaśam acchāvākasya . indriyaṃ vai vīryaṃ ṣoḍaśī .
sentences: sa yo lokānāṃ prajñapayitā sa no lokān prajñapayād iti .
na hi te agne tanvai krūraṃ viveda martya iti yad iha krūram aśāntam acāriṣma tad etayāpahanāmahā iti .
kapir bibʰasti tejanaṃ punar jarāyu gaur ive ti punar evaitayāpiyanti .
agne viśvebʰir agnibʰir iti vaiśvāgnam ājyaṃ bʰavati .
tad ānuṣṭubʰaṃ bʰavati savanamukʰe savanamukʰe vācā samr̥dʰyāmahā iti .
tat trivr̥d bʰavati brahma vai trivr̥t .
brahmaṇo vā ete vyr̥dʰyante ye vrātyāṃ dʰāvayanti .
tad yat trivr̥d bʰavati brahmaṇaiva tat samr̥dʰyante .
text: It is āgneyī. Agni is the one who makes the worlds known. 'May he who makes the worlds known make the worlds known to us.' 'For not to thy body, O Agni, does a mortal know cruelty' -- 'whatever cruel and unpeaceful thing we have done here, may we remove that by this verse.' 'The monkey fears the pointed stick; the cow returns to the afterbirth' -- by this very verse they return. 'O Agni, with all fires' -- the ājya is vaiśvāgna. The Viśve Devas are indeed all the fires. By it they thus approach all the gods. It is anuṣṭubh at the opening of each pressing -- 'may we succeed through speech at each pressing-opening.' It is trivṛt. Brahman is the trivṛt. Those who perform the vrātyā race fail in brahman. For people call them rājaputras ('sons of kings'). Because it is trivṛt, they thereby succeed through brahman. The maitrāvaruṇa's is pañcadaśa. Kṣatra is the pañcadaśa. Kṣatra is indeed the offshoot of brahman. They thereby succeed through kṣatra. The brāhmaṇācchaṃsin's is saptadaśa. Prajāpati is the saptadaśa. They thereby succeed through Prajāpati. The acchāvāka's is ṣoḍaśa. Vigor and power are the ṣoḍaśī.
meaning: सो वा आग्नेयी भवति . अग्निर् वै लोकानां प्रज्ञपयिता . स यो लोकानां प्रज्ञपयिता स नो लोकान् प्रज्ञपयाद् इति . न हि ते अग्ने तन्वै क्रूरं विवेद मर्त्य इति यद् इह क्रूरम् अशान्तम् अचारिष्म तद् एतयापहनामहा इति . कपिर् बिभस्ति तेजनं पुनर् जरायु गौर् इवे ति पुनर् एवैतयापियन्ति . अग्ने विश्वेभिर् अग्निभिर् इति वैश्वाग्नम् आज्यं भवति . अग्नयो वै विश्वे देवाः . विश्वान् एव तेन देवान् अपियन्ति . तद् आनुष्टुभं भवति सवनमुखे सवनमुखे वाचा समृध्यामहा इति . तत् त्रिवृद् भवति ब्रह्म वै त्रिवृत् . ब्रह्मणो वा एते व्यृध्यन्ते ये व्रात्यां धावयन्ति . राजपुत्रा इति ह्य् एनान् आचक्षते . तद् यत् त्रिवृद् भवति ब्रह्मणैव तत् समृध्यन्ते . पञ्चदशं मैत्रावरुणस्य . क्षत्रं वै पञ्चदशः . अपभ्रंशो ह वै ब्रह्मणः क्षत्रम् . क्षत्रेणैव तत् समृध्यन्ते . सप्तदशं ब्राह्मणाच्छंसिनः . प्रजापतिर् वै सप्तदशः . प्रजापतिनैव तत् समृध्यन्ते . षोडशम् अच्छावाकस्य . इन्द्रियं वै वीर्यं षोडशी .

sanskrit_iast: athaite uṣṇikkakubhau mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanam abhi pratyāharanti . prajā vai chandasām uṣṇikkakubhau . tayor bṛhato mārutasya sāmanī bhavataḥ . dyautāne vā devasāme . chandāṃsi vai svargo lokaḥ . sa yathā priyaṃ putram ārabhya yācet sakhā vā sakhāyam anusaṃvidam evam evaitat sarvāṇi chandāṃsy ārabhya madhyato viyanti . tayor anyatarasyāṃ brahmasāma . brahma vai brahmasāma . yajamānakāmo vā eṣa yad brahmasāma . sva eva tad āyatane yajamānaṃ kāmais samardhayanti . saptadaśaṃ hotuḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati . prajāpatir vai saptadaśaḥ . prajāpatim evaitan madhyato viyanti . ekaviṃśaṃ maitrāvaruṇasya . dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavas traya ime lokā asāv āditya ekaviṃśaḥ . etam evaitan madhyato viyanti . triṇavaṃ brāhmaṇācchaṃsinaḥ . triṇavā ime lokāḥ . imān evaital lokān madhyato viyanti . ṣoḍaśam acchāvākasya . indriyaṃ vai vīryaṃ ṣoḍaśī . indriyeṇaiva tad vīryeṇa samṛdhyante . ṣoḍaśam u evādo 'cchāvākasya . tad dvātriṃśat . dvātriṃśadakṣarānuṣṭup .
sentences: atʰaite uṣṇikkakubʰau mādʰyaṃdinaṃ savanam abʰi pratyāharanti .
sa yatʰā priyaṃ putram ārabʰya yācet sakʰā vā sakʰāyam anusaṃvidam evam evaitat sarvāṇi cʰandāṃsy ārabʰya madʰyato viyanti .
sva eva tad āyatane yajamānaṃ kāmais samardʰayanti .
dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavas traya ime lokā asāv āditya ekaviṃśaḥ .
text: Then these uṣṇik and kakubh metres carry over to the midday pressing. The uṣṇik and kakubh are the offspring among metres. Of those two, the sāmans are of the bṛhat and the māruta. Those two are the divine sāmans of heaven. The metres are indeed the heavenly world. Just as one would request a dear son, or a friend would ask a companion through mutual acquaintance -- so, taking hold of all the metres, they part company in the middle. Of those two, one has the brahmasāma. The brahmasāma is brahman. The desire of the sacrificer is indeed the brahmasāma. In its own abode they thereby fulfill the sacrificer with desires. The hotṛ's pṛṣṭha is saptadaśa. Prajāpati is the saptadaśa. They thereby part company in the middle through Prajāpati. The maitrāvaruṇa's is ekaviṃśa. Twelve months, five seasons, three worlds, and that sun yonder -- ekaviṃśa is the twenty-first. They thereby part company in the middle through this very one. The brāhmaṇācchaṃsin's is triṇava. These worlds are triṇava. They thereby part company in the middle through these very worlds. The acchāvāka's is ṣoḍaśa. Vigor and power are the ṣoḍaśī. They thereby succeed through vigor and power. The acchāvāka's is again ṣoḍaśa. That makes thirty-two. The anuṣṭubh has thirty-two syllables.
meaning: अथैते उष्णिक्ककुभौ माध्यंदिनं सवनम् अभि प्रत्याहरन्ति . प्रजा वै छन्दसाम् उष्णिक्ककुभौ . तयोर् बृहतो मारुतस्य सामनी भवतः . द्यौताने वा देवसामे . छन्दांसि वै स्वर्गो लोकः . स यथा प्रियं पुत्रम् आरभ्य याचेत् सखा वा सखायम् अनुसंविदम् एवम् एवैतत् सर्वाणि छन्दांस्य् आरभ्य मध्यतो वियन्ति . तयोर् अन्यतरस्यां ब्रह्मसाम . ब्रह्म वै ब्रह्मसाम . यजमानकामो वा एष यद् ब्रह्मसाम . स्व एव तद् आयतने यजमानं कामैस् समर्धयन्ति . सप्तदशं होतुः पृष्ठं भवति . प्रजापतिर् वै सप्तदशः . प्रजापतिम् एवैतन् मध्यतो वियन्ति . एकविंशं मैत्रावरुणस्य . द्वादश मासाः पञ्चर्तवस् त्रय इमे लोका असाव् आदित्य एकविंशः . एतम् एवैतन् मध्यतो वियन्ति . त्रिणवं ब्राह्मणाच्छंसिनः . त्रिणवा इमे लोकाः . इमान् एवैतल् लोकान् मध्यतो वियन्ति . षोडशम् अच्छावाकस्य . इन्द्रियं वै वीर्यं षोडशी . इन्द्रियेणैव तद् वीर्येण समृध्यन्ते . षोडशम् उ एवादो ऽच्छावाकस्य . तद् द्वात्रिंशत् . द्वात्रिंशदक्षरानुष्टुप् .

sanskrit_iast: athaitā nadaṃ va odatīnām ity uṣṇihābhājanam ārbhave pavamāne kriyante . tās saptākṣarapadā bhavanti . sapta prāṇāḥ . prāṇair eva tat samṛdhyamānā yanti . prāṇeṣu pratitiṣṭhanti . uta hy ahiṃsyaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ hiṃsanti śrotriyaṃ vā gṛhamedhinaṃ vā . tad yat saptākṣarapadā bhavanti prāṇair eva tat samṛdhyante . tāś catuṣpadā bhavanti pratiṣṭhāyai . catuṣpadīva pratyaṣṭhād iti vā āhuḥ . supratiṣṭhitaṃ tāsv abhīvartaḥ . vāg vā abhīvartaḥ . vāco vā ete vyṛdhyante ye vrātyāṃ dhāvayanti . tad yad abhīvarto bhavati vācaiva tat samṛdhyante . agna ā yāhy agnibhir ity agniṣṭomasāma bhavati . agnayo vai sarve devāḥ . sarvān eva tena devān apiyanti . tat trayastriṃśaṃ bhavati . trayastriṃśad vai sarvā devatāḥ .
sentences: atʰaitā nadaṃ va odatīnām ity uṣṇihābʰājanam ārbʰave pavamāne kriyante .
uta hy ahiṃsyaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ hiṃsanti śrotriyaṃ vā gr̥hamedʰinaṃ vā .
tad yat saptākṣarapadā bʰavanti prāṇair eva tat samr̥dʰyante .
vāco vā ete vyr̥dʰyante ye vrātyāṃ dʰāvayanti .
tad yad abʰīvarto bʰavati vācaiva tat samr̥dʰyante .
agna ā yāhy agnibʰir ity agniṣṭomasāma bʰavati .
text: Then these verses 'nadaṃ va odatīnām' in uṣṇih metre are employed in the ārbhava pavamāna. They have seven-syllable feet. The prāṇas are seven. Going forth fulfilled with the prāṇas, they stand firm in the prāṇas. For they also injure a brāhmaṇa who should not be injured, whether a learned one or a householder. Because they have seven-syllable feet, they thereby succeed through the prāṇas. They have four feet, for firm foundation. 'He stood firm on four feet,' they say. Well-established among them is the abhīvarta. Speech is the abhīvarta. Those who perform the vrātyā race fail in speech. Because the abhīvarta occurs, they thereby succeed through speech. 'O Agni, come hither with the fires' -- the agniṣṭomasāma occurs. All the gods are fires. By it they thus approach all the gods. It is trayastriṃśa. Thirty-three are indeed all the deities.
meaning: अथैता नदं व ओदतीनाम् इत्य् उष्णिहाभाजनम् आर्भवे पवमाने क्रियन्ते . तास् सप्ताक्षरपदा भवन्ति . सप्त प्राणाः . प्राणैर् एव तत् समृध्यमाना यन्ति . प्राणेषु प्रतितिष्ठन्ति . उत ह्य् अहिंस्यं ब्राह्मणं हिंसन्ति श्रोत्रियं वा गृहमेधिनं वा . तद् यत् सप्ताक्षरपदा भवन्ति प्राणैर् एव तत् समृध्यन्ते . ताश् चतुष्पदा भवन्ति प्रतिष्ठायै . चतुष्पदीव प्रत्यष्ठाद् इति वा आहुः . सुप्रतिष्ठितं तास्व् अभीवर्तः . वाग् वा अभीवर्तः . वाचो वा एते व्यृध्यन्ते ये व्रात्यां धावयन्ति . तद् यद् अभीवर्तो भवति वाचैव तत् समृध्यन्ते . अग्न आ याह्य् अग्निभिर् इत्य् अग्निष्टोमसाम भवति . अग्नयो वै सर्वे देवाः . सर्वान् एव तेन देवान् अपियन्ति . तत् त्रयस्त्रिंशं भवति . त्रयस्त्रिंशद् वै सर्वा देवताः .

sanskrit_iast: tāḥ keśinīr bhavanti . ūrjo napātaṃ ghṛtakeśam īmahe 'gniṃ yajñeṣu pūrvyam iti keśair iva hy ete caranti . athaiṣa kuṣītagṛhapatīnām aiṣīkapāvānāṃ ṣoḍaśapavamānaḥ . indriyaṃ vai vīryaṃ ṣoḍaśī . ārabhamāṇā evendriyeṇa vīryeṇa samṛdhyāmahā iti . trīṇi pañcadaśāny ājyāni bhavanti . kṣatraṃ vai pañcadaśaḥ . kṣatreṇaiva tat samṛdhyante . ṣoḍaśam acchāvākasya . indriyaṃ vai vīryaṃ ṣoḍaśī . indriyeṇaiva tad vīryeṇa samṛdhyante . ṣoḍaśo mādhyaṃdinaḥ . tad dvātriṃśat . dvātriṃśadakṣarānuṣṭup . yo 'nuṣṭubhi kāmas sa na upāpto 'sad iti . trīṇi saptadaśāni pṛṣṭhāni bhavanti . prajāpatir vai saptadaśaḥ . prajāpatinaiva tat samṛdhyante . ṣoḍaśam acchāvākasya . indriyaṃ vai vīryaṃ ṣoḍaśī . indriyeṇaiva tad vīryeṇa samṛdhyante . ṣoḍaśa ārbhavaḥ . tad dvātriṃśad . dvātriṃśadakṣarānuṣṭup . yo 'nuṣṭubhi kāmas sa na upāpto 'sad iti . ekaviṃśam agniṣṭomasāma . dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavas traya ime lokā asāv āditya ekaviṃśaḥ .
sentences: ūrjo napātaṃ gʰr̥takeśam īmahe 'gniṃ yajñeṣu pūrvyam iti keśair iva hy ete caranti .
yo 'nuṣṭubʰi kāmas sa na upāpto 'sad iti .
yo 'nuṣṭubʰi kāmas sa na upāpto 'sad iti .
dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavas traya ime lokā asāv āditya ekaviṃśaḥ .
text: They are keśinī verses. 'We invoke Agni, kin of vigor, ghee-haired, the ancient one at sacrifices' -- for they go about as if with flowing hair. Then this is the rite of the Kuṣītaka householders who use reed-cups, with sixteen pavamānas. Vigor and power are the ṣoḍaśī. 'Already at the beginning may we succeed through vigor and power.' Three ājyas are pañcadaśa. Kṣatra is the pañcadaśa. They thereby succeed through kṣatra. The acchāvāka's is ṣoḍaśa. Vigor and power are the ṣoḍaśī. They thereby succeed through vigor and power. The midday is ṣoḍaśa. That makes thirty-two. The anuṣṭubh has thirty-two syllables. 'Whatever desire is in the anuṣṭubh, may that be attained for us.' Three pṛṣṭhas are saptadaśa. Prajāpati is the saptadaśa. They thereby succeed through Prajāpati. The acchāvāka's is ṣoḍaśa. Vigor and power are the ṣoḍaśī. They thereby succeed through vigor and power. The ārbhava is ṣoḍaśa. That makes thirty-two. The anuṣṭubh has thirty-two syllables. 'Whatever desire is in the anuṣṭubh, may that be attained for us.' The agniṣṭomasāma is ekaviṃśa. Twelve months, five seasons, three worlds, and that sun yonder -- ekaviṃśa is the twenty-first.
meaning: ताः केशिनीर् भवन्ति . ऊर्जो नपातं घृतकेशम् ईमहे ऽग्निं यज्ञेषु पूर्व्यम् इति केशैर् इव ह्य् एते चरन्ति . अथैष कुषीतगृहपतीनाम् ऐषीकपावानां षोडशपवमानः . इन्द्रियं वै वीर्यं षोडशी . आरभमाणा एवेन्द्रियेण वीर्येण समृध्यामहा इति . त्रीणि पञ्चदशान्य् आज्यानि भवन्ति . क्षत्रं वै पञ्चदशः . क्षत्रेणैव तत् समृध्यन्ते . षोडशम् अच्छावाकस्य . इन्द्रियं वै वीर्यं षोडशी . इन्द्रियेणैव तद् वीर्येण समृध्यन्ते . षोडशो माध्यंदिनः . तद् द्वात्रिंशत् . द्वात्रिंशदक्षरानुष्टुप् . यो ऽनुष्टुभि कामस् स न उपाप्तो ऽसद् इति . त्रीणि सप्तदशानि पृष्ठानि भवन्ति . प्रजापतिर् वै सप्तदशः . प्रजापतिनैव तत् समृध्यन्ते . षोडशम् अच्छावाकस्य . इन्द्रियं वै वीर्यं षोडशी . इन्द्रियेणैव तद् वीर्येण समृध्यन्ते . षोडश आर्भवः . तद् द्वात्रिंशद् . द्वात्रिंशदक्षरानुष्टुप् . यो ऽनुष्टुभि कामस् स न उपाप्तो ऽसद् इति . एकविंशम् अग्निष्टोमसाम . द्वादश मासाः पञ्चर्तवस् त्रय इमे लोका असाव् आदित्य एकविंशः .

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣa kaniṣṭhānām agrakāmāṇām . tasya trivṛtas sataś caturviṃśaṃ bahiṣpavamānam . te ye kaniṣṭhā agrakāmā syus ta etena yajeran . tad yat trivṛtas sataś caturviṃśaṃ bahiṣpavamānaṃ bhavati caturviṃśatyardhamāsas saṃvatsaraḥ . saṃvatsaro vā agraṃ jyaiṣṭhyaṃ sa yo 'graṃ jyaiṣṭhyaṃ sa no 'graṃ jyaiṣṭhyaṃ gamayād iti . sa trivṛd bhavati . trivṛd vai stomānām agraṃ jyaiṣṭhyam . sa yo 'graṃ jyaiṣṭhyaṃ sa no 'graṃ jyaiṣṭhyaṃ gamayād iti . sa gāyatrīṣu bhavati . gāyatrī vai chandasām agraṃ jyaiṣṭhyam . sā yāgraṃ jyaiṣṭhyaṃ sā no 'graṃ jyaiṣṭhyaṃ gamayād iti . tasya rathantaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati . rathantaraṃ vai pṛṣṭhānām agraṃ jyaiṣṭhyam . tad yad agraṃ jyaiṣṭhyaṃ tan no 'graṃ jyaiṣṭhyaṃ gamayād iti . tasya dvādaśa stotrāṇi bhavanti . dvādaśa māsās saṃvatsaraḥ . saṃvatsaro vā agraṃ jyaiṣṭhyam . sa yo 'graṃ jyaiṣṭhyaṃ sa no 'graṃ jyaiṣṭhyaṃ gamayād iti . tasya caturviṃśati stutaśastrāṇi bhavanti . caturviṃśatyardhamāsas saṃvatsaraḥ . saṃvatsaro vā agraṃ jyaiṣṭhyam . sa yo 'graṃ jyaiṣṭhyaṃ sa no 'graṃ jyaiṣṭhyaṃ gamayād iti .
sentences: te ye kaniṣṭʰā agrakāmā syus ta etena yajeran .
tad yat trivr̥tas sataś caturviṃśaṃ bahiṣpavamānaṃ bʰavati caturviṃśatyardʰamāsas saṃvatsaraḥ .
saṃvatsaro vā agraṃ jyaiṣṭʰyaṃ sa yo 'graṃ jyaiṣṭʰyaṃ sa no 'graṃ jyaiṣṭʰyaṃ gamayād iti .
sa yo 'graṃ jyaiṣṭʰyaṃ sa no 'graṃ jyaiṣṭʰyaṃ gamayād iti .
sā yāgraṃ jyaiṣṭʰyaṃ sā no 'graṃ jyaiṣṭʰyaṃ gamayād iti .
tad yad agraṃ jyaiṣṭʰyaṃ tan no 'graṃ jyaiṣṭʰyaṃ gamayād iti .
sa yo 'graṃ jyaiṣṭʰyaṃ sa no 'graṃ jyaiṣṭʰyaṃ gamayād iti .
sa yo 'graṃ jyaiṣṭʰyaṃ sa no 'graṃ jyaiṣṭʰyaṃ gamayād iti .
text: Now this is the rite for younger brothers who desire preeminence. Its bahiṣpavamāna is caturviṃśa from a base of trivṛt. Those who are younger brothers desiring preeminence should sacrifice with this. Because the bahiṣpavamāna is caturviṃśa from a base of trivṛt -- twenty-four half-months make a year; the year is preeminence and seniority -- 'may he who is preeminence and seniority lead us to preeminence and seniority.' It is trivṛt. The trivṛt is the preeminence and seniority among stomas. 'May he who is preeminence and seniority lead us to preeminence and seniority.' It is in gāyatrī verses. The gāyatrī is the preeminence and seniority among metres. 'May she who is preeminence and seniority lead us to preeminence and seniority.' Its pṛṣṭha is the rathantara. The rathantara is the preeminence and seniority among pṛṣṭhas. 'May that which is preeminence and seniority lead us to preeminence and seniority.' It has twelve stotras. Twelve months make a year. The year is preeminence and seniority. 'May he who is preeminence and seniority lead us to preeminence and seniority.' It has twenty-four stuta-śastras. Twenty-four half-months make a year. The year is preeminence and seniority. 'May he who is preeminence and seniority lead us to preeminence and seniority.'
meaning: अथैष कनिष्ठानाम् अग्रकामाणाम् . तस्य त्रिवृतस् सतश् चतुर्विंशं बहिष्पवमानम् . ते ये कनिष्ठा अग्रकामा स्युस् त एतेन यजेरन् . तद् यत् त्रिवृतस् सतश् चतुर्विंशं बहिष्पवमानं भवति चतुर्विंशत्यर्धमासस् संवत्सरः . संवत्सरो वा अग्रं ज्यैष्ठ्यं स यो ऽग्रं ज्यैष्ठ्यं स नो ऽग्रं ज्यैष्ठ्यं गमयाद् इति . स त्रिवृद् भवति . त्रिवृद् वै स्तोमानाम् अग्रं ज्यैष्ठ्यम् . स यो ऽग्रं ज्यैष्ठ्यं स नो ऽग्रं ज्यैष्ठ्यं गमयाद् इति . स गायत्रीषु भवति . गायत्री वै छन्दसाम् अग्रं ज्यैष्ठ्यम् . सा याग्रं ज्यैष्ठ्यं सा नो ऽग्रं ज्यैष्ठ्यं गमयाद् इति . तस्य रथन्तरं पृष्ठं भवति . रथन्तरं वै पृष्ठानाम् अग्रं ज्यैष्ठ्यम् . तद् यद् अग्रं ज्यैष्ठ्यं तन् नो ऽग्रं ज्यैष्ठ्यं गमयाद् इति . तस्य द्वादश स्तोत्राणि भवन्ति . द्वादश मासास् संवत्सरः . संवत्सरो वा अग्रं ज्यैष्ठ्यम् . स यो ऽग्रं ज्यैष्ठ्यं स नो ऽग्रं ज्यैष्ठ्यं गमयाद् इति . तस्य चतुर्विंशति स्तुतशस्त्राणि भवन्ति . चतुर्विंशत्यर्धमासस् संवत्सरः . संवत्सरो वा अग्रं ज्यैष्ठ्यम् . स यो ऽग्रं ज्यैष्ठ्यं स नो ऽग्रं ज्यैष्ठ्यं गमयाद् इति .

sanskrit_iast: athaite cāturmāsyāḥ . prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata . tā asya sṛṣṭāḥ parābhavan . tad idaṃ sarīsṛpam abhavad yad anyat sarpebhyaḥ . sa dvitīyā asṛjata . tā asya paraivābhavan . te matsyā abhavan . sa tṛtīyā asṛjata . tā asya paraivābhavan . tāni vayāṃsy abhavan . sa aikṣata yā imās trayīḥ prajā asṛkṣy ṛte brahmaṇa ṛte 'nnādyād ṛte yajñāt parā tā abhūvan . hanto nv eva brahmaṇo 'nnādyād yajñāt prajās sṛjā iti . so 'nnādyam ātmann adhatta . tad abhyastanayat . tat prāk praiṣat . tau stanāv abhavatām . yad abhyastanayat tat stanayo stanatvam . tad atyakṣarat . tat kṣīram abhavat . yad atyakṣarat tat kṣīrasya kṣīratvam . vrīhiyavau ha vāva sa tad ātman dadhe . tad etad vrīhiyavayoḥ kṣīram .
sentences: tad idaṃ sarīsr̥pam abʰavad yad anyat sarpebʰyaḥ .
sa aikṣata yā imās trayīḥ prajā asr̥kṣy r̥te brahmaṇa r̥te 'nnādyād r̥te yajñāt parā tā abʰūvan .
hanto nv eva brahmaṇo 'nnādyād yajñāt prajās sr̥jā iti .
vrīhiyavau ha vāva sa tad ātman dadʰe .
text: Now these are the cāturmāsyas (seasonal rites). Prajāpati created creatures. Those creatures of his, once created, perished. All the creeping things came into being, everything other than serpents. He created a second set. Those too perished. They became fish. He created a third set. Those too perished. They became birds. He reflected: 'Those three sets of creatures that I created -- without brahman, without food, without sacrifice -- they perished. Let me now create creatures with brahman, food, and sacrifice.' He placed food in himself. He thundered over it. He sent it forth. That became the two breasts. Because he thundered (abhyastanayat), that is the thunder-nature (stanatvam) of thunder (stanaya). It flowed forth. That became milk. Because it flowed forth (atyakṣarat), that is the milk-nature (kṣīratvam) of milk (kṣīra). What he placed in himself was indeed rice and barley. That is the milk of rice and barley.
meaning: अथैते चातुर्मास्याः . प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत . ता अस्य सृष्टाः पराभवन् . तद् इदं सरीसृपम् अभवद् यद् अन्यत् सर्पेभ्यः . स द्वितीया असृजत . ता अस्य परैवाभवन् . ते मत्स्या अभवन् . स तृतीया असृजत . ता अस्य परैवाभवन् . तानि वयांस्य् अभवन् . स ऐक्षत या इमास् त्रयीः प्रजा असृक्ष्य् ऋते ब्रह्मण ऋते ऽन्नाद्याद् ऋते यज्ञात् परा ता अभूवन् . हन्तो न्व् एव ब्रह्मणो ऽन्नाद्याद् यज्ञात् प्रजास् सृजा इति . सो ऽन्नाद्यम् आत्मन्न् अधत्त . तद् अभ्यस्तनयत् . तत् प्राक् प्रैषत् . तौ स्तनाव् अभवताम् . यद् अभ्यस्तनयत् तत् स्तनयो स्तनत्वम् . तद् अत्यक्षरत् . तत् क्षीरम् अभवत् . यद् अत्यक्षरत् तत् क्षीरस्य क्षीरत्वम् . व्रीहियवौ ह वाव स तद् आत्मन् दधे . तद् एतद् व्रीहियवयोः क्षीरम् .

sanskrit_iast: sa etāṃś cāturmāsyān yajñān apaśyat . tān āharat . tair ayajata . tair imāḥ prajā asṛjata . yā imā stanavatīs tābhyo 'nnādyaṃ prāyacchat . tā asyānnavatīḥ prajā abhavan . sa yaḥ kāmayeta bahuḥ prajayā paśubhiḥ prajāyeyānnavatīr ma imāḥ prajā syur iti sa etair yajeta . bahur eva prajayā paśubhiḥ prajāyate 'nnavatīr asya prajā bhavanti . tad eṣābhyanūcyate . tisro ha prajā atyāyam īyur ny anyā arkam abhito viviśyuḥ bṛhad dha tasthau rajaso vimāne pavamāno harita ā viveśa iti . tad yad āha tisro ha prajā atyāyam īyur iti yā eva tāḥ prajā atyāyam āyaṃs tā eva tāḥ . ny anyā arkam abhito viviśyur ity agnir vā arkas tam imāḥ prajā abhito viṣṭāḥ . bṛhad dha tasthau rajaso vimāne pavamāno harita ā viveśe ti . diśo vai haritaḥ . tā ayaṃ vāyuḥ pavamāna āviṣṭa iti vājasaneyaḥ . athaikādaśākṣī . tisro ha prajā atyāyam īyur iti . yā eva tāḥ prajā atyāyam āyaṃs tā etāḥ . ny anyā arkam abhito viviśyur ity annaṃ vā arkas tad imāḥ prajā abhito viṣṭāḥ . bṛhad dha tasthau rajaso vimāna iti . mano vai bṛhat . tad idaṃ rajaso vimāne madhya ātmano hṛdayaṃ tat . pavamāno harita ā viveśe ti . prajā vai haritaḥ .
sentences: sa yaḥ kāmayeta bahuḥ prajayā paśubʰiḥ prajāyeyānnavatīr ma imāḥ prajā syur iti sa etair yajeta .
bahur eva prajayā paśubʰiḥ prajāyate 'nnavatīr asya prajā bʰavanti .
tad yad āha tisro ha prajā atyāyam īyur iti yā eva tāḥ prajā atyāyam āyaṃs tā eva tāḥ .
ny anyā arkam abʰito viviśyur ity agnir vā arkas tam imāḥ prajā abʰito viṣṭāḥ .
br̥had dʰa tastʰau rajaso vimāne pavamāno harita ā viveśe ti .
tā ayaṃ vāyuḥ pavamāna āviṣṭa iti vājasaneyaḥ .
tisro ha prajā atyāyam īyur iti .
yā eva tāḥ prajā atyāyam āyaṃs tā etāḥ .
ny anyā arkam abʰito viviśyur ity annaṃ vā arkas tad imāḥ prajā abʰito viṣṭāḥ .
br̥had dʰa tastʰau rajaso vimāna iti .
tad idaṃ rajaso vimāne madʰya ātmano hr̥dayaṃ tat .
text: He saw these cāturmāsya sacrifices. He brought them. He sacrificed with them. By them he created these creatures. Those creatures that have breasts -- to them he gave food. Those creatures of his became possessed of food. He who desires 'May I be abundant in offspring and cattle, may my creatures be possessed of food' should sacrifice with these. He indeed becomes abundant in offspring and cattle; his creatures become possessed of food. On this there is a verse recited: 'Three kinds of creatures passed beyond; others entered around the arka (fire). Lofty it stood at the edge of space; Pavamāna entered the green ones.' When it says 'three kinds of creatures passed beyond' -- those are the very creatures that passed beyond. 'Others entered around the arka' -- Agni is the arka; these creatures are ranged around him. 'Lofty it stood at the edge of space; Pavamāna entered the green ones' -- the green ones are the directions; this wind, as Pavamāna, has entered them -- so says the Vājasaneyin. According to the eleven-syllable interpretation: 'Three kinds of creatures passed beyond' -- those are the very creatures that passed beyond. 'Others entered around the arka' -- food is the arka; these creatures are ranged around food. 'Lofty it stood at the edge of space' -- mind is the bṛhat; it stands in the middle of the self, in the heart, at the edge of space. 'Pavamāna entered the green ones' -- creatures are the green ones.
meaning: स एतांश् चातुर्मास्यान् यज्ञान् अपश्यत् . तान् आहरत् . तैर् अयजत . तैर् इमाः प्रजा असृजत . या इमा स्तनवतीस् ताभ्यो ऽन्नाद्यं प्रायच्छत् . ता अस्यान्नवतीः प्रजा अभवन् . स यः कामयेत बहुः प्रजया पशुभिः प्रजायेयान्नवतीर् म इमाः प्रजा स्युर् इति स एतैर् यजेत . बहुर् एव प्रजया पशुभिः प्रजायते ऽन्नवतीर् अस्य प्रजा भवन्ति . तद् एषाभ्यनूच्यते . तिस्रो ह प्रजा अत्यायम् ईयुर् न्य् अन्या अर्कम् अभितो विविश्युः बृहद् ध तस्थौ रजसो विमाने पवमानो हरित आ विवेश इति . तद् यद् आह तिस्रो ह प्रजा अत्यायम् ईयुर् इति या एव ताः प्रजा अत्यायम् आयंस् ता एव ताः . न्य् अन्या अर्कम् अभितो विविश्युर् इत्य् अग्निर् वा अर्कस् तम् इमाः प्रजा अभितो विष्टाः . बृहद् ध तस्थौ रजसो विमाने पवमानो हरित आ विवेशे ति . दिशो वै हरितः . ता अयं वायुः पवमान आविष्ट इति वाजसनेयः . अथैकादशाक्षी . तिस्रो ह प्रजा अत्यायम् ईयुर् इति . या एव ताः प्रजा अत्यायम् आयंस् ता एताः . न्य् अन्या अर्कम् अभितो विविश्युर् इत्य् अन्नं वा अर्कस् तद् इमाः प्रजा अभितो विष्टाः . बृहद् ध तस्थौ रजसो विमान इति . मनो वै बृहत् . तद् इदं रजसो विमाने मध्य आत्मनो हृदयं तत् . पवमानो हरित आ विवेशे ति . प्रजा वै हरितः .

sanskrit_iast: so 'kāmayata vaiśvadevīḥ prajās sṛjeyeti . sa etaṃ vaiśvadevaṃ yajñam apaśyat . tam āharat . tenāyajata . tena vaiśvadevīḥ prajā asṛjata . sa yaḥ kāmayeta vaiśvadevīḥ prajās sṛjeyeti sa etena yajeta . vaiśvadevīr eva prajās sṛjate . sa trivṛd rathantarasāmā bhavati . brahma vai trivṛt . brahma rathantaram . brahmaṇā vā enās tad asṛjata . brahmaṇaiva prajās sṛjate ya evaṃ veda . tasyāgneyaś ca bārhaspatyaś ca paśū bhavataḥ . brahma vā agniḥ . brahma bṛhaspatiḥ . brahmaṇā vā enās tad abhipūrvam asṛjata . brahmaṇaivābhipūrvaṃ prajās sṛjate ya evaṃ veda . tasya maitrāvaruṇy anūbandhyā bhavati . mitro vai yajñasya sviṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāti varuṇo duriṣṭam . tad yan maitrāvaruṇy anūbandhyā bhavati punar evāsmai mitro dadāti . sviṣṭam asmai varuṇaḥ karoti . dyāvāpṛthivyopālaṃbhyā bhavati . dyāvāpṛthivī vā āikṣetāṃ yad vā ayam idaṃ sṛjata āvaṃ vā ayam idaṃ pratiṣṭhe paśyan sṛjate hantāsmin bhāgadheyam icchāvahā iti . te 'smin bhāgadheyam aicchetām . tābhyām etāṃ dyāvāpṛthivyām upālaṃbhyām akalpayat . tad yad etā dyāvāpṛthivyopālaṃbhyā bhavati dyāvāpṛthivī evaitena bhāgadheyena niravadayante .
sentences: sa yaḥ kāmayeta vaiśvadevīḥ prajās sr̥jeyeti sa etena yajeta .
brahmaṇaiva prajās sr̥jate ya evaṃ veda .
tasyāgneyaś ca bārhaspatyaś ca paśū bʰavataḥ .
brahmaṇā vā enās tad abʰipūrvam asr̥jata .
brahmaṇaivābʰipūrvaṃ prajās sr̥jate ya evaṃ veda .
mitro vai yajñasya sviṣṭaṃ gr̥hṇāti varuṇo duriṣṭam .
tad yan maitrāvaruṇy anūbandʰyā bʰavati punar evāsmai mitro dadāti .
dyāvāpr̥tʰivī vā āikṣetāṃ yad vā ayam idaṃ sr̥jata āvaṃ vā ayam idaṃ pratiṣṭʰe paśyan sr̥jate hantāsmin bʰāgadʰeyam iccʰāvahā iti .
tad yad etā dyāvāpr̥tʰivyopālaṃbʰyā bʰavati dyāvāpr̥tʰivī evaitena bʰāgadʰeyena niravadayante .
text: He desired: 'May I create creatures belonging to the Viśve Devas.' He saw this vaiśvadeva sacrifice. He brought it. He sacrificed with it. By it he created creatures belonging to the Viśve Devas. He who desires 'May I create creatures belonging to the Viśve Devas' should sacrifice with this. He indeed creates creatures belonging to the Viśve Devas. It has the trivṛt stoma with the rathantara sāman. Brahman is the trivṛt. Brahman is the rathantara. By brahman he created them. He who knows thus creates creatures by brahman. Its animal offerings are āgneya and bārhaspatya. Brahman is Agni. Brahman is Bṛhaspati. By brahman he created them from the very beginning. He who knows thus creates creatures from the very beginning by brahman. Its anūbandhyā is maitrāvaruṇī. Mitra seizes what is well-offered of the sacrifice; Varuṇa seizes what is ill-offered. Because the anūbandhyā is maitrāvaruṇī, Mitra gives back to him; Varuṇa makes it well-offered for him. The upālaṃbhyā (supplementary offering) belongs to Dyāvāpṛthivī. Dyāvāpṛthivī observed: 'He is creating this -- does he create it as established upon us? Come, let us seek our share in him.' They sought their share in him. For them he arranged this upālaṃbhyā for Dyāvāpṛthivī. Because this upālaṃbhyā belongs to Dyāvāpṛthivī, Dyāvāpṛthivī are thereby satisfied with their share.
meaning: सो ऽकामयत वैश्वदेवीः प्रजास् सृजेयेति . स एतं वैश्वदेवं यज्ञम् अपश्यत् . तम् आहरत् . तेनायजत . तेन वैश्वदेवीः प्रजा असृजत . स यः कामयेत वैश्वदेवीः प्रजास् सृजेयेति स एतेन यजेत . वैश्वदेवीर् एव प्रजास् सृजते . स त्रिवृद् रथन्तरसामा भवति . ब्रह्म वै त्रिवृत् . ब्रह्म रथन्तरम् . ब्रह्मणा वा एनास् तद् असृजत . ब्रह्मणैव प्रजास् सृजते य एवं वेद . तस्याग्नेयश् च बार्हस्पत्यश् च पशू भवतः . ब्रह्म वा अग्निः . ब्रह्म बृहस्पतिः . ब्रह्मणा वा एनास् तद् अभिपूर्वम् असृजत . ब्रह्मणैवाभिपूर्वं प्रजास् सृजते य एवं वेद . तस्य मैत्रावरुण्य् अनूबन्ध्या भवति . मित्रो वै यज्ञस्य स्विष्टं गृह्णाति वरुणो दुरिष्टम् . तद् यन् मैत्रावरुण्य् अनूबन्ध्या भवति पुनर् एवास्मै मित्रो ददाति . स्विष्टम् अस्मै वरुणः करोति . द्यावापृथिव्योपालंभ्या भवति . द्यावापृथिवी वा आइक्षेतां यद् वा अयम् इदं सृजत आवं वा अयम् इदं प्रतिष्ठे पश्यन् सृजते हन्तास्मिन् भागधेयम् इच्छावहा इति . ते ऽस्मिन् भागधेयम् ऐच्छेताम् . ताभ्याम् एतां द्यावापृथिव्याम् उपालंभ्याम् अकल्पयत् . तद् यद् एता द्यावापृथिव्योपालंभ्या भवति द्यावापृथिवी एवैतेन भागधेयेन निरवदयन्ते .

sanskrit_iast: tā asya prajās sṛṣṭā varuṇasya yavam ādan . tā varuṇo varuṇapāśenāgṛhṇāt . sa aikṣata yā amūḥ pūrvāḥ prajā asṛkṣi parā tā abhūvan . yadīmāḥ parābhavanti kva tato bhavāni haintainā abhito bhiṣajyānīti . sa etau dvidivau varuṇapraghāsāv apaśyat . tāv āharat . tābhyām ayajata . tābhyām enā varuṇīyād enaso vyamuñcat . tad yad etau dvidivau varuṇapraghāsau bhavato varuṇīyād evaitābhyām enasaḥ prajā muñcati . marutvatī pūrvasyāhna pratipad bhavati . āgneyaś ca mārutaś ca paśū . tā asya prajā varuṇagṛhītā maruto randhrāṇy anvavapātino vyamimathiṣanta . tad yan marutvatī pratipad bhavati maruta evaitena bhāgadheyena niravadāyante . āgneyapaśur yajño vā agnir ned yajñād agner ayāmeti . kavaty uttarasyāhnaḥ pratipad bhavati kāyopālambhyā prajāpatir vai kaḥ prajāpatim eva tad antataḥ prīṇanti . prajāpatir vā aikṣata kaṃ vai prajābhyo bhūvaṃ kam ātmane 'sānīti . sa etāṃ kavatīṃ pratipadam apaśyat kāyām upālaṃbhyām . tato vai sa kaṃ prajābhyo 'bhavat kam ātmane . kaṃ haiva prajābhyo bhavati kam ātmane ya evaṃ veda .
sentences: tā asya prajās sr̥ṣṭā varuṇasya yavam ādan .
sa aikṣata yā amūḥ pūrvāḥ prajā asr̥kṣi parā tā abʰūvan .
yadīmāḥ parābʰavanti kva tato bʰavāni haintainā abʰito bʰiṣajyānīti .
tad yad etau dvidivau varuṇapragʰāsau bʰavato varuṇīyād evaitābʰyām enasaḥ prajā muñcati .
tā asya prajā varuṇagr̥hītā maruto randʰrāṇy anvavapātino vyamimatʰiṣanta .
tad yan marutvatī pratipad bʰavati maruta evaitena bʰāgadʰeyena niravadāyante .
āgneyapaśur yajño vā agnir ned yajñād agner ayāmeti .
kavaty uttarasyāhnaḥ pratipad bʰavati kāyopālambʰyā prajāpatir vai kaḥ prajāpatim eva tad antataḥ prīṇanti .
prajāpatir vā aikṣata kaṃ vai prajābʰyo bʰūvaṃ kam ātmane 'sānīti .
sa etāṃ kavatīṃ pratipadam apaśyat kāyām upālaṃbʰyām .
tato vai sa kaṃ prajābʰyo 'bʰavat kam ātmane .
kaṃ haiva prajābʰyo bʰavati kam ātmane ya evaṃ veda .
text: Those creatures of his, once created, ate the barley of Varuṇa. Varuṇa seized them with the varuṇa-noose. He reflected: 'Those earlier creatures that I created perished. If these also perish, what shall I then become? Let me indeed heal them.' He saw these two days of the varuṇapraghāsas. He brought them. He sacrificed with them. By them he released the creatures from varuṇa-guilt and sin. Because these two days of the varuṇapraghāsas occur, by them he releases creatures from varuṇa-sin. The introductory verse of the first day is marutvatī. The animal offerings are āgneya and māruta. Those creatures of his, seized by Varuṇa -- the Maruts, descending through openings, freed them by force. Because the introductory verse is marutvatī, the Maruts are thereby satisfied with their share. The āgneya animal -- the sacrifice is Agni -- 'lest we depart from the sacrifice, from Agni.' The introductory verse of the second day is kavatī; the upālaṃbhyā is kā. Prajāpati is ka. Thereby they gratify Prajāpati at the end. Prajāpati reflected: 'What happiness may I be to my creatures, what happiness may I secure for myself?' He saw this kavatī introductory verse and the kā upālaṃbhyā. Thereupon he became happiness for his creatures and happiness for himself. He who knows thus becomes happiness for his creatures and happiness for himself.
meaning: ता अस्य प्रजास् सृष्टा वरुणस्य यवम् आदन् . ता वरुणो वरुणपाशेनागृह्णात् . स ऐक्षत या अमूः पूर्वाः प्रजा असृक्षि परा ता अभूवन् . यदीमाः पराभवन्ति क्व ततो भवानि हैन्तैना अभितो भिषज्यानीति . स एतौ द्विदिवौ वरुणप्रघासाव् अपश्यत् . ताव् आहरत् . ताभ्याम् अयजत . ताभ्याम् एना वरुणीयाद् एनसो व्यमुञ्चत् . तद् यद् एतौ द्विदिवौ वरुणप्रघासौ भवतो वरुणीयाद् एवैताभ्याम् एनसः प्रजा मुञ्चति . मरुत्वती पूर्वस्याह्न प्रतिपद् भवति . आग्नेयश् च मारुतश् च पशू . ता अस्य प्रजा वरुणगृहीता मरुतो रन्ध्राण्य् अन्ववपातिनो व्यमिमथिषन्त . तद् यन् मरुत्वती प्रतिपद् भवति मरुत एवैतेन भागधेयेन निरवदायन्ते . आग्नेयपशुर् यज्ञो वा अग्निर् नेद् यज्ञाद् अग्नेर् अयामेति . कवत्य् उत्तरस्याह्नः प्रतिपद् भवति कायोपालम्भ्या प्रजापतिर् वै कः प्रजापतिम् एव तद् अन्ततः प्रीणन्ति . प्रजापतिर् वा ऐक्षत कं वै प्रजाभ्यो भूवं कम् आत्मने ऽसानीति . स एतां कवतीं प्रतिपदम् अपश्यत् कायाम् उपालंभ्याम् . ततो वै स कं प्रजाभ्यो ऽभवत् कम् आत्मने . कं हैव प्रजाभ्यो भवति कम् आत्मने य एवं वेद .

sanskrit_iast: atha yad vāruṇo nirvaruṇatāyā eva . tā asya prajā varuṇān mumucānā vṛtraḥ pāpmāgṛhṇāt . sa aikṣata hanto nv evainā abhito bhiṣajyānīti . sa etāṃs tridivān sākamedhān apaśyat . tān āharat . tair ayajata . tair enā vṛtrāt pāpmano 'bhyamuñcat . tad yad ete tridivās sākamedhā bhavanti vṛtrād evaitaiḥ pāpmanaḥ prajā muñcati . tā asya prajā vṛtrāt pāpmano mumucānās sarvās sākaṃ samaidhayanta . yat sākaṃ samaidhayanta tat sākamedhānāṃ sākamedhatvam . sākaṃ ha vai prajayā paśubhir edhate ya evaṃ veda . anīkavatī prathamasyāhnaḥ pratipad bhavati . āgneyaḥ paśuḥ . agninā vā anīkenendro vṛtraṃ pāpmānam ahan . tad yad anīkavatī pratipad bhavaty agninānīkena vṛtraṃ pāpmānaṃ hanānīti . agninaivānīkena dviṣantaṃ pāpmānaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ hanti ya evaṃ veda . krīḍanī dvitīyasyāhnaḥ pratipad bhavati . āgneyaś caindrāgnaś ca paśū . tad yat krīḍanī pratipad bhavati yad eva prajā vṛtrāt pāpmano mumucānā ākrīḍanta tasmāt krīḍanī . atho hendro vṛtraṃ haniṣyan maruta uvāca paraśuvadhahastā mām abhitaḥ parikrīḍata sa vītabhīr vṛtraṃ pāpmānaṃ hanānīti . tam u ha marutaḥ paraśuvadhahastā abhitaḥ paricikrīḍuḥ . sa ha vītabhīr vṛtraṃ pāpmānam ahan . vītabhīr ha vai dviṣantaṃ pāpmānaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ hanti ya evaṃ veda .
sentences: tā asya prajā varuṇān mumucānā vr̥traḥ pāpmāgr̥hṇāt .
sa aikṣata hanto nv evainā abʰito bʰiṣajyānīti .
tad yad ete tridivās sākamedʰā bʰavanti vr̥trād evaitaiḥ pāpmanaḥ prajā muñcati .
tā asya prajā vr̥trāt pāpmano mumucānās sarvās sākaṃ samaidʰayanta .
yat sākaṃ samaidʰayanta tat sākamedʰānāṃ sākamedʰatvam .
sākaṃ ha vai prajayā paśubʰir edʰate ya evaṃ veda .
agninā vā anīkenendro vr̥traṃ pāpmānam ahan .
tad yad anīkavatī pratipad bʰavaty agninānīkena vr̥traṃ pāpmānaṃ hanānīti .
agninaivānīkena dviṣantaṃ pāpmānaṃ bʰrātr̥vyaṃ hanti ya evaṃ veda .
tad yat krīḍanī pratipad bʰavati yad eva prajā vr̥trāt pāpmano mumucānā ākrīḍanta tasmāt krīḍanī .
atʰo hendro vr̥traṃ haniṣyan maruta uvāca paraśuvadʰahastā mām abʰitaḥ parikrīḍata sa vītabʰīr vr̥traṃ pāpmānaṃ hanānīti .
tam u ha marutaḥ paraśuvadʰahastā abʰitaḥ paricikrīḍuḥ .
sa ha vītabʰīr vr̥traṃ pāpmānam ahan .
vītabʰīr ha vai dviṣantaṃ pāpmānaṃ bʰrātr̥vyaṃ hanti ya evaṃ veda .
text: And because it is vāruṇa, it is for freedom from Varuṇa. Those creatures of his, being released from Varuṇa -- Vṛtra, the evil one, seized them. He reflected: 'Let me indeed heal them.' He saw these three days of the sākamedhās. He brought them. He sacrificed with them. By them he released them from Vṛtra, from evil. Because these three days of the sākamedhās occur, by them he releases creatures from Vṛtra, from evil. Those creatures of his, being released from Vṛtra, from evil, all thrived together. Because they thrived together (sākaṃ samaidhayanta), that is the sākamedha-nature of the sākamedhās. He who knows thus thrives together with offspring and cattle. The introductory verse of the first day is anīkavatī. The animal offering is āgneya. With the face (anīka) of Agni, Indra slew Vṛtra, the evil one. Because the introductory verse is anīkavatī -- 'with the face of Agni may I slay Vṛtra, the evil one.' He who knows thus slays the hating, evil rival with the face of Agni. The introductory verse of the second day is krīḍanī. The animal offerings are āgneya and aindrāgna. Because the introductory verse is krīḍanī -- when the creatures, released from Vṛtra and evil, sported about, therefore it is krīḍanī. And Indra, about to slay Vṛtra, said to the Maruts: 'With axes and clubs in hand, sport around me, so that I, fearless, may slay Vṛtra the evil one.' The Maruts, with axes and clubs in hand, sported around him. Then, fearless, he slew Vṛtra the evil one. He who knows thus, fearless, slays the hating, evil rival.
meaning: अथ यद् वारुणो निर्वरुणताया एव . ता अस्य प्रजा वरुणान् मुमुचाना वृत्रः पाप्मागृह्णात् . स ऐक्षत हन्तो न्व् एवैना अभितो भिषज्यानीति . स एतांस् त्रिदिवान् साकमेधान् अपश्यत् . तान् आहरत् . तैर् अयजत . तैर् एना वृत्रात् पाप्मनो ऽभ्यमुञ्चत् . तद् यद् एते त्रिदिवास् साकमेधा भवन्ति वृत्राद् एवैतैः पाप्मनः प्रजा मुञ्चति . ता अस्य प्रजा वृत्रात् पाप्मनो मुमुचानास् सर्वास् साकं समैधयन्त . यत् साकं समैधयन्त तत् साकमेधानां साकमेधत्वम् . साकं ह वै प्रजया पशुभिर् एधते य एवं वेद . अनीकवती प्रथमस्याह्नः प्रतिपद् भवति . आग्नेयः पशुः . अग्निना वा अनीकेनेन्द्रो वृत्रं पाप्मानम् अहन् . तद् यद् अनीकवती प्रतिपद् भवत्य् अग्निनानीकेन वृत्रं पाप्मानं हनानीति . अग्निनैवानीकेन द्विषन्तं पाप्मानं भ्रातृव्यं हन्ति य एवं वेद . क्रीडनी द्वितीयस्याह्नः प्रतिपद् भवति . आग्नेयश् चैन्द्राग्नश् च पशू . तद् यत् क्रीडनी प्रतिपद् भवति यद् एव प्रजा वृत्रात् पाप्मनो मुमुचाना आक्रीडन्त तस्मात् क्रीडनी . अथो हेन्द्रो वृत्रं हनिष्यन् मरुत उवाच परशुवधहस्ता माम् अभितः परिक्रीडत स वीतभीर् वृत्रं पाप्मानं हनानीति . तम् उ ह मरुतः परशुवधहस्ता अभितः परिचिक्रीडुः . स ह वीतभीर् वृत्रं पाप्मानम् अहन् . वीतभीर् ह वै द्विषन्तं पाप्मानं भ्रातृव्यं हन्ति य एवं वेद .

sanskrit_iast: atha yad aindrāgno brahma vā agniḥ . kṣatram indro brahmaṇā ca ha vāva sa tat kṣatreṇa ca sayugbhyāṃ vṛtraṃ pāpmānaṃ hanānīti . brahmaṇā ca haiva kṣatreṇa ca sayugbhyāṃ dviṣantaṃ pāpmānaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ hanti ya evaṃ veda . vaiśvakarmaṇī tṛtīyasyāhnaḥ pratipad bhavati . vaiśvakarmaṇy upālaṃbhyāgneyaś ca māhendraś ca paśū . tad yad vaiśvakarmaṇī pratipad bhavati vaiśvakarmaṇy upālaṃbhyā prajāpatir vai viśvakarmā prajāpatim eva tad antataḥ prīṇanti . atho yad eva prajā vṛtrāt pāpmano mumucānā viśvaṃ karmopākramanta tasmād vaiśvakarmaṇī .
sentences: atʰa yad aindrāgno brahma vā agniḥ .
kṣatram indro brahmaṇā ca ha vāva sa tat kṣatreṇa ca sayugbʰyāṃ vr̥traṃ pāpmānaṃ hanānīti .
brahmaṇā ca haiva kṣatreṇa ca sayugbʰyāṃ dviṣantaṃ pāpmānaṃ bʰrātr̥vyaṃ hanti ya evaṃ veda .
vaiśvakarmaṇy upālaṃbʰyāgneyaś ca māhendraś ca paśū .
tad yad vaiśvakarmaṇī pratipad bʰavati vaiśvakarmaṇy upālaṃbʰyā prajāpatir vai viśvakarmā prajāpatim eva tad antataḥ prīṇanti .
atʰo yad eva prajā vr̥trāt pāpmano mumucānā viśvaṃ karmopākramanta tasmād vaiśvakarmaṇī .
text: And because it is aindrāgna -- brahman is Agni, kṣatra is Indra -- 'with brahman and kṣatra yoked together may I slay Vṛtra the evil one.' He who knows thus slays the hating, evil rival with brahman and kṣatra yoked together. The introductory verse of the third day is vaiśvakarmaṇī. The upālaṃbhyā is vaiśvakarmaṇī. The animal offerings are āgneya and māhendra. Because the introductory verse is vaiśvakarmaṇī and the upālaṃbhyā is vaiśvakarmaṇī -- Prajāpati is Viśvakarman; thereby they gratify Prajāpati at the end. And because the creatures, released from Vṛtra and evil, undertook all kinds of work (viśvaṃ karma), therefore it is vaiśvakarmaṇī.
meaning: अथ यद् ऐन्द्राग्नो ब्रह्म वा अग्निः . क्षत्रम् इन्द्रो ब्रह्मणा च ह वाव स तत् क्षत्रेण च सयुग्भ्यां वृत्रं पाप्मानं हनानीति . ब्रह्मणा च हैव क्षत्रेण च सयुग्भ्यां द्विषन्तं पाप्मानं भ्रातृव्यं हन्ति य एवं वेद . वैश्वकर्मणी तृतीयस्याह्नः प्रतिपद् भवति . वैश्वकर्मण्य् उपालंभ्याग्नेयश् च माहेन्द्रश् च पशू . तद् यद् वैश्वकर्मणी प्रतिपद् भवति वैश्वकर्मण्य् उपालंभ्या प्रजापतिर् वै विश्वकर्मा प्रजापतिम् एव तद् अन्ततः प्रीणन्ति . अथो यद् एव प्रजा वृत्रात् पाप्मनो मुमुचाना विश्वं कर्मोपाक्रमन्त तस्माद् वैश्वकर्मणी .

sanskrit_iast: atha yan māhendraḥ . indro ha vā eṣa purā vṛtrasya vadhād āsa . sa vṛtraṃ hatvā mahendro 'bhavat . bhūyo hy eva jyāyasā karmaṇā 'bhyaśnute . tasmād u rājānaṃ vijitinam ācakṣate mahārāja iti . athaiṣa śunāsīryo yad vā indrasya vṛtraṃ jaghnuṣa indriyaṃ vīryam āsīt tac chunam . yat saṃvatsarasya prajitasya payas tat sīram . tad yad indrasya vṛtraṃ jaghnuṣa indriyaṃ vīryaṃ yat saṃvatsarasya prajitasya payas tad ubhayam avaruṇadhāmahā iti . saṃvatsarasad dha khalu vā eṣa yaś cāturmāsyayājī . tasya śunāsīryaṃ me mahāvrataṃ bhājanam . sa yāvat saṃvatsareṇa mahāvratavatāvarunddhe tāvad avarunddhe ya evaṃ veda . tasya saurī pratipad bhavati saury upālaṃbhyā . asau vā ādityaḥ . sūrya eṣa indraḥ . aindraṃ mahāvrataṃ tat tatsalakṣma kriyate . ṛtuṣu ha khalu vā eṣa saṃvatsaraṃ svargaṃ lokam apyeti yaś cāturmāsyayājī . sa vasantam eva prathamenāhnāpyeti grīṣmaṃ dvitīyena varṣās tṛtīyena śaradaṃ caturthena hemantaṃ pañcamena śiśiraṃ ṣaṣṭhena . saṃvatsaram eva śunāsīryeṇāpyeti . sa sarvastomo bhavati . sarvaṃ hi tad yat sarvastomaḥ . sarvam evaitenāpyeti . tasya tryeṇī śalalī bhavati lauhāyasaḥ kṣuraḥ . sa caturṣu caturṣu māssu keśān parivartayate 'nantatāyā asau vā ādityo 'nantaḥ . ananto vā asau bhūtvedaṃ sarvam abhyaśnute 'nanto bhūtvedaṃ sarvam abhyaśnavā iti .
sentences: indro ha vā eṣa purā vr̥trasya vadʰād āsa .
tasmād u rājānaṃ vijitinam ācakṣate mahārāja iti .
atʰaiṣa śunāsīryo yad vā indrasya vr̥traṃ jagʰnuṣa indriyaṃ vīryam āsīt tac cʰunam .
yat saṃvatsarasya prajitasya payas tat sīram .
tad yad indrasya vr̥traṃ jagʰnuṣa indriyaṃ vīryaṃ yat saṃvatsarasya prajitasya payas tad ubʰayam avaruṇadʰāmahā iti .
saṃvatsarasad dʰa kʰalu vā eṣa yaś cāturmāsyayājī .
sa yāvat saṃvatsareṇa mahāvratavatāvarunddʰe tāvad avarunddʰe ya evaṃ veda .
tasya saurī pratipad bʰavati saury upālaṃbʰyā .
r̥tuṣu ha kʰalu vā eṣa saṃvatsaraṃ svargaṃ lokam apyeti yaś cāturmāsyayājī .
sa vasantam eva pratʰamenāhnāpyeti grīṣmaṃ dvitīyena varṣās tr̥tīyena śaradaṃ caturtʰena hemantaṃ pañcamena śiśiraṃ ṣaṣṭʰena .
tasya tryeṇī śalalī bʰavati lauhāyasaḥ kṣuraḥ .
sa caturṣu caturṣu māssu keśān parivartayate 'nantatāyā asau vā ādityo 'nantaḥ .
ananto vā asau bʰūtvedaṃ sarvam abʰyaśnute 'nanto bʰūtvedaṃ sarvam abʰyaśnavā iti .
text: And because it is māhendra -- before the slaying of Vṛtra, Indra was what he was. Having slain Vṛtra, he became Mahendra ('great Indra'). For by a greater deed one attains a higher status. Therefore they call a victorious king 'Mahārāja.' Then this is the śunāsīrya. Whatever vigor and power Indra had after slaying Vṛtra -- that is śuna. Whatever sap the year has when it goes forth -- that is sīra. 'May we secure both -- the vigor and power of Indra who slew Vṛtra and the sap of the year going forth.' He who performs the cāturmāsya sacrifices is indeed a year-dweller. His śunāsīrya is a share of the mahāvrata. Whatever one secures by the mahāvrata over the course of a year, that much one secures who knows thus. Its introductory verse is saurī; the upālaṃbhyā is saurī. That sun yonder is Sūrya. This Indra is Sūrya. The mahāvrata belongs to Indra. That which has the same characteristic is made. He who performs the cāturmāsyas attains the year, the heavenly world, through the seasons. He attains spring by the first day, summer by the second, the rains by the third, autumn by the fourth, the cool season by the fifth, winter by the sixth. He attains the year by the śunāsīrya. It is sarvastoma. For all that is the sarvastoma. By it he attains everything. His razor is a three-pointed śalalī of iron. Every four months he cuts his hair, for endlessness. That sun yonder is endless. He who, being endless, has attained all this -- 'being endless, may I attain all this.'
meaning: अथ यन् माहेन्द्रः . इन्द्रो ह वा एष पुरा वृत्रस्य वधाद् आस . स वृत्रं हत्वा महेन्द्रो ऽभवत् . भूयो ह्य् एव ज्यायसा कर्मणा ऽभ्यश्नुते . तस्माद् उ राजानं विजितिनम् आचक्षते महाराज इति . अथैष शुनासीर्यो यद् वा इन्द्रस्य वृत्रं जघ्नुष इन्द्रियं वीर्यम् आसीत् तच् छुनम् . यत् संवत्सरस्य प्रजितस्य पयस् तत् सीरम् . तद् यद् इन्द्रस्य वृत्रं जघ्नुष इन्द्रियं वीर्यं यत् संवत्सरस्य प्रजितस्य पयस् तद् उभयम् अवरुणधामहा इति . संवत्सरसद् ध खलु वा एष यश् चातुर्मास्ययाजी . तस्य शुनासीर्यं मे महाव्रतं भाजनम् . स यावत् संवत्सरेण महाव्रतवतावरुन्द्धे तावद् अवरुन्द्धे य एवं वेद . तस्य सौरी प्रतिपद् भवति सौर्य् उपालंभ्या . असौ वा आदित्यः . सूर्य एष इन्द्रः . ऐन्द्रं महाव्रतं तत् तत्सलक्ष्म क्रियते . ऋतुषु ह खलु वा एष संवत्सरं स्वर्गं लोकम् अप्येति यश् चातुर्मास्ययाजी . स वसन्तम् एव प्रथमेनाह्नाप्येति ग्रीष्मं द्वितीयेन वर्षास् तृतीयेन शरदं चतुर्थेन हेमन्तं पञ्चमेन शिशिरं षष्ठेन . संवत्सरम् एव शुनासीर्येणाप्येति . स सर्वस्तोमो भवति . सर्वं हि तद् यत् सर्वस्तोमः . सर्वम् एवैतेनाप्येति . तस्य त्र्येणी शलली भवति लौहायसः क्षुरः . स चतुर्षु चतुर्षु मास्सु केशान् परिवर्तयते ऽनन्तताया असौ वा आदित्यो ऽनन्तः . अनन्तो वा असौ भूत्वेदं सर्वम् अभ्यश्नुते ऽनन्तो भूत्वेदं सर्वम् अभ्यश्नवा इति .

sanskrit_iast: athaite dvirātrāḥ . haviṣmāṃś S . die Parallele 3,28 (366 ,10ff. ). ca vai haviṣkṛc cāṅgirasāv āstām . tāv asmin loke strīcaryam pramattau carantāv ṛṣayo 'ṅgirasaḥ pitaraś ca pitāmahāś ca sukṛto hitvā svargaṃ lokam āyan . tau yadā sā caryā paraid athākāmayetāṃ kathaṃ nv id yatra nāv ṛṣayo 'ṅgirasaḥ pitaraś ca pitāmahāś ca sukṛta svargaṃ lokam itās tad anugaccheveti . tau tapo 'tapyetām . tāv etad dvirātraṃ yajñam apaśyatām . tam āharetām . tenāyajetām . tato vai tau yatrainayor ṛṣayo 'ṅgirasaḥ pitaraś ca pitāmahāś ca sukṛta svargam lokam itā āsaṃs tad anvagacchatām . sa yaḥkāmayeta yatra me pitaraś ca pitāmahāś ca sukṛta svargaṃ lokaṃ itās tad anugaccheyam iti sa etena yajeta . yatra haivāsya pitaraś ca pitāmahāś ca sukṛta svargaṃ lokam itā bhavanti tad evānugacchati . atho āhur yasmād eva śreyān bhrātṛvya syāt sa enena yajeteti . pūrvapreta iva ha vā eṣa ya śreyān . pūrvapretān iva vā etena tau tān āpnutām . āptvā śreyāṃsaṃ vasīyān ātmanā bhavati . atho āhuḥ prajākāma evainena yajeteti . ātmā vai pūrvam ahaḥ prajottaram .
sentences: haviṣmāṃś S . die Parallele 3,28 (366 ,10ff. ). ca vai haviṣkr̥c cāṅgirasāv āstām .
tāv asmin loke strīcaryam pramattau carantāv r̥ṣayo 'ṅgirasaḥ pitaraś ca pitāmahāś ca sukr̥to hitvā svargaṃ lokam āyan .
tau yadā sā caryā paraid atʰākāmayetāṃ katʰaṃ nv id yatra nāv r̥ṣayo 'ṅgirasaḥ pitaraś ca pitāmahāś ca sukr̥ta svargaṃ lokam itās tad anugaccʰeveti .
tato vai tau yatrainayor r̥ṣayo 'ṅgirasaḥ pitaraś ca pitāmahāś ca sukr̥ta svargam lokam itā āsaṃs tad anvagaccʰatām .
sa yaḥkāmayeta yatra me pitaraś ca pitāmahāś ca sukr̥ta svargaṃ lokaṃ itās tad anugaccʰeyam iti sa etena yajeta .
yatra haivāsya pitaraś ca pitāmahāś ca sukr̥ta svargaṃ lokam itā bʰavanti tad evānugaccʰati .
atʰo āhur yasmād eva śreyān bʰrātr̥vya syāt sa enena yajeteti .
pūrvapreta iva ha vā eṣa ya śreyān .
pūrvapretān iva vā etena tau tān āpnutām .
text: Now these are the dvirātras (two-night rites). Haviṣmān and Haviṣkṛt were two Aṅgirasas. While they were living carelessly in this world, engaged in the pursuit of women, the ṛṣis, the Aṅgirasas, fathers and grandfathers, the meritorious ones, went to the heavenly world, leaving them behind. When that conduct ceased, they desired: 'How may we follow to where our ṛṣis, Aṅgirasas, fathers and grandfathers, the meritorious ones, have gone to the heavenly world?' They performed austerity. They saw this dvirātra sacrifice. They brought it. They sacrificed with it. Thereupon they followed to where their ṛṣis, Aṅgirasas, fathers and grandfathers, the meritorious ones, had gone to the heavenly world. He who desires 'May I follow to where my fathers and grandfathers, the meritorious ones, have gone to the heavenly world' should sacrifice with this. He indeed follows to where his fathers and grandfathers, the meritorious ones, have gone to the heavenly world. And they say: he from whom a rival is greater should sacrifice with this. For one who is greater is as if having died before. With this those two reached those who had died before, as it were. Having reached one who is greater, one becomes greater oneself. And they say: one desiring offspring should sacrifice with this. The self is the first day; offspring is the second.
meaning: अथैते द्विरात्राः . हविष्मांश् S . दिए Pअरल्लेले ३,२८ (३६६ ,१०ff. ). च वै हविष्कृच् चाङ्गिरसाव् आस्ताम् . ताव् अस्मिन् लोके स्त्रीचर्यम् प्रमत्तौ चरन्ताव् ऋषयो ऽङ्गिरसः पितरश् च पितामहाश् च सुकृतो हित्वा स्वर्गं लोकम् आयन् . तौ यदा सा चर्या परैद् अथाकामयेतां कथं न्व् इद् यत्र नाव् ऋषयो ऽङ्गिरसः पितरश् च पितामहाश् च सुकृत स्वर्गं लोकम् इतास् तद् अनुगच्छेवेति . तौ तपो ऽतप्येताम् . ताव् एतद् द्विरात्रं यज्ञम् अपश्यताम् . तम् आहरेताम् . तेनायजेताम् . ततो वै तौ यत्रैनयोर् ऋषयो ऽङ्गिरसः पितरश् च पितामहाश् च सुकृत स्वर्गम् लोकम् इता आसंस् तद् अन्वगच्छताम् . स यःकामयेत यत्र मे पितरश् च पितामहाश् च सुकृत स्वर्गं लोकं इतास् तद् अनुगच्छेयम् इति स एतेन यजेत . यत्र हैवास्य पितरश् च पितामहाश् च सुकृत स्वर्गं लोकम् इता भवन्ति तद् एवानुगच्छति . अथो आहुर् यस्माद् एव श्रेयान् भ्रातृव्य स्यात् स एनेन यजेतेति . पूर्वप्रेत इव ह वा एष य श्रेयान् . पूर्वप्रेतान् इव वा एतेन तौ तान् आप्नुताम् . आप्त्वा श्रेयांसं वसीयान् आत्मना भवति . अथो आहुः प्रजाकाम एवैनेन यजेतेति . आत्मा वै पूर्वम् अहः प्रजोत्तरम् .

sanskrit_iast: suduṣṣaja iva ha khalu vā eṣa yajñakratur yad dvirātraḥ . yadi jyotir agniṣṭomaḥ pūrvam ahar bhavati sarvastomo 'tirātra uttaraṃ stotrāṇi vicchindanti . atha yadi jyotir agniṣṭomaḥ pūrvam ahar bhavati sarvastoma u evātirātra uttaraṃ stotrāṇi vicchindanti . atha yadi jyotir ukthyaḥ pūrvam ahar bhavati sarvastoma u evātirātra uttaraṃ yajñamukhaṃ chambaṭkurvanti . tad yaj jyotir bhavati tena yajñamukhaṃ na chambaṭkurvanti . atha yad ukthyas tena stotrāṇi na vicchindanti . āpta iva ha khalu vā eṣa yajñakratur yo virājam abhisaṃpannaḥ . sa punar ārambhyo bhavati . tyad yad uttarasyāhnaś caturviṃśaṃ bahiṣpavamānaṃ bhavati caturviṃśatyardhamāsas saṃvatsaraḥ . saṃvatsaro yajño yajñam evaitad yajñamukha ārabhante . atho caturviṃśatyakṣarā vai gāyatrī . gāyatryo vā āptaṃ yajñakratuṃ punas tanvate . no hy anyā gāyatryā āptaṃ yajñakratum udyantum arhati . tad āhuḥ kathaṃ na catuścatvāriṃśo nāṣṭācatvāriṃśo mukhaṃ yugmatāṃ stomānāṃ bhavitum arhati . kathaṃ caturviṃśa eveti . sa brūyāt tripadā vai gāyatrī . tat tripadā pratipadyanta iti . sarvastomo 'tirātro bhavati sarveṣāṃ lokānām abhijityā abhikrāntyai . sarvaṃ hīdaṃ stomā eva .
sentences: suduṣṣaja iva ha kʰalu vā eṣa yajñakratur yad dvirātraḥ .
yadi jyotir agniṣṭomaḥ pūrvam ahar bʰavati sarvastomo 'tirātra uttaraṃ stotrāṇi viccʰindanti .
atʰa yadi jyotir agniṣṭomaḥ pūrvam ahar bʰavati sarvastoma u evātirātra uttaraṃ stotrāṇi viccʰindanti .
atʰa yadi jyotir uktʰyaḥ pūrvam ahar bʰavati sarvastoma u evātirātra uttaraṃ yajñamukʰaṃ cʰambaṭkurvanti .
tad yaj jyotir bʰavati tena yajñamukʰaṃ na cʰambaṭkurvanti .
atʰa yad uktʰyas tena stotrāṇi na viccʰindanti .
āpta iva ha kʰalu vā eṣa yajñakratur yo virājam abʰisaṃpannaḥ .
tyad yad uttarasyāhnaś caturviṃśaṃ bahiṣpavamānaṃ bʰavati caturviṃśatyardʰamāsas saṃvatsaraḥ .
saṃvatsaro yajño yajñam evaitad yajñamukʰa ārabʰante .
gāyatryo vā āptaṃ yajñakratuṃ punas tanvate .
no hy anyā gāyatryā āptaṃ yajñakratum udyantum arhati .
tad āhuḥ katʰaṃ na catuścatvāriṃśo nāṣṭācatvāriṃśo mukʰaṃ yugmatāṃ stomānāṃ bʰavitum arhati .
sarvastomo 'tirātro bʰavati sarveṣāṃ lokānām abʰijityā abʰikrāntyai .
text: This dvirātra is indeed a difficult sacrifice-form to accomplish. If a jyotis agniṣṭoma is the first day, with a sarvastoma atirātra as the second -- they break up the stotras. And if a jyotis agniṣṭoma is the first day, with a sarvastoma atirātra as the second -- they still break up the stotras. And if a jyotis ukthya is the first day, with a sarvastoma atirātra as the second -- they make the sacrifice-opening defective. But if it is jyotis, they do not make the sacrifice-opening defective. And if it is ukthya, they do not break up the stotras. This sacrifice-form that has attained the virāj is as if complete. It must then be begun again. Because the bahiṣpavamāna of the second day is caturviṃśa -- twenty-four half-months make a year; the year is the sacrifice -- thereby they begin the sacrifice at the sacrifice-opening. And the gāyatrī has twenty-four syllables. By the gāyatrīs a completed sacrifice-form is re-woven. For no other than a gāyatrī is able to raise up a completed sacrifice-form. On this they say: 'How is it that neither the forty-fourth nor the forty-eighth can be the opening of even-numbered stomas? Why only the caturviṃśa?' One should say: 'The gāyatrī has three feet. With three feet they take the first step.' The atirātra is sarvastoma, for the conquering and surpassing of all worlds. For all this is indeed the stomas.
meaning: सुदुष्षज इव ह खलु वा एष यज्ञक्रतुर् यद् द्विरात्रः . यदि ज्योतिर् अग्निष्टोमः पूर्वम् अहर् भवति सर्वस्तोमो ऽतिरात्र उत्तरं स्तोत्राणि विच्छिन्दन्ति . अथ यदि ज्योतिर् अग्निष्टोमः पूर्वम् अहर् भवति सर्वस्तोम उ एवातिरात्र उत्तरं स्तोत्राणि विच्छिन्दन्ति . अथ यदि ज्योतिर् उक्थ्यः पूर्वम् अहर् भवति सर्वस्तोम उ एवातिरात्र उत्तरं यज्ञमुखं छम्बट्कुर्वन्ति . तद् यज् ज्योतिर् भवति तेन यज्ञमुखं न छम्बट्कुर्वन्ति . अथ यद् उक्थ्यस् तेन स्तोत्राणि न विच्छिन्दन्ति . आप्त इव ह खलु वा एष यज्ञक्रतुर् यो विराजम् अभिसंपन्नः . स पुनर् आरम्भ्यो भवति . त्यद् यद् उत्तरस्याह्नश् चतुर्विंशं बहिष्पवमानं भवति चतुर्विंशत्यर्धमासस् संवत्सरः . संवत्सरो यज्ञो यज्ञम् एवैतद् यज्ञमुख आरभन्ते . अथो चतुर्विंशत्यक्षरा वै गायत्री . गायत्र्यो वा आप्तं यज्ञक्रतुं पुनस् तन्वते . नो ह्य् अन्या गायत्र्या आप्तं यज्ञक्रतुम् उद्यन्तुम् अर्हति . तद् आहुः कथं न चतुश्चत्वारिंशो नाष्टाचत्वारिंशो मुखं युग्मतां स्तोमानां भवितुम् अर्हति . कथं चतुर्विंश एवेति . स ब्रूयात् त्रिपदा वै गायत्री . तत् त्रिपदा प्रतिपद्यन्त इति . सर्वस्तोमो ऽतिरात्रो भवति सर्वेषां लोकानाम् अभिजित्या अभिक्रान्त्यै . सर्वं हीदं स्तोमा एव .

sanskrit_iast: vicchinna iva ha khalu vā eṣa yajñakratur yad dvirātraḥ . gāyatrīṃ pūrvam ahas saṃpadyate triṣṭubham uttaram . atha kva jagatī cānuṣṭup cety āhuḥ . gāyatrīṃ caiva pūrvam ahas saṃpādayet triṣṭubhaṃ ca jagatīṃ cānuṣṭubhaṃ cottaraṃ chandasāṃ saṃtatyā avyavacchedāya . uccā te jātam andhase ty andhasvatīr bhavaty andhasvad vai jagatyai rūpaṃ tena jagatyai rūpān na yanti . vaikhānasaṃ bhavati jāgataṃ sāma . tenaiva jagatyai rūpān na yanti . ye dve sāmanī tayor anyatarad bhavati yathobhayāpadī pratitiṣṭhet tādṛk tat . suvar jyotir bhavati . suvar vai pūrvam ahar jyotir uttaram ahnor eva santatyā ahnos samārambhāya . hāviṣmatahāviṣkṛte svargye sāmanī svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai . tad āhuḥ kṣipre sāmanī yad ubhe kuryur īśvaro yajamānaṃ purāyuṣaḥ pramathitor anādṛtya hi tāv imaṃ lokam amum eva lokam abhisaṃpraitām iti . hāviṣmatam evottarasyāhna uktheṣu brahmasāma kuryuḥ .
sentences: viccʰinna iva ha kʰalu vā eṣa yajñakratur yad dvirātraḥ .
gāyatrīṃ pūrvam ahas saṃpadyate triṣṭubʰam uttaram .
atʰa kva jagatī cānuṣṭup cety āhuḥ .
gāyatrīṃ caiva pūrvam ahas saṃpādayet triṣṭubʰaṃ ca jagatīṃ cānuṣṭubʰaṃ cottaraṃ cʰandasāṃ saṃtatyā avyavaccʰedāya .
uccā te jātam andʰase ty andʰasvatīr bʰavaty andʰasvad vai jagatyai rūpaṃ tena jagatyai rūpān na yanti .
ye dve sāmanī tayor anyatarad bʰavati yatʰobʰayāpadī pratitiṣṭʰet tādr̥k tat .
suvar vai pūrvam ahar jyotir uttaram ahnor eva santatyā ahnos samārambʰāya .
hāviṣmatahāviṣkr̥te svargye sāmanī svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai .
tad āhuḥ kṣipre sāmanī yad ubʰe kuryur īśvaro yajamānaṃ purāyuṣaḥ pramatʰitor anādr̥tya hi tāv imaṃ lokam amum eva lokam abʰisaṃpraitām iti .
text: This dvirātra is a sacrifice-form that is, as it were, interrupted. The first day is completed in the gāyatrī, the second in the triṣṭubh. But where are the jagatī and anuṣṭubh, they ask. One should complete the first day in the gāyatrī and the second in the triṣṭubh, jagatī, and anuṣṭubh -- for the continuity of the metres, to avoid interruption. 'High born is thy pressing' -- there are verses containing andhas; the andhas-bearing form is that of the jagatī; thereby they do not depart from the jagatī form. The vaikhānasa occurs, a jāgata sāman. Thereby too they do not depart from the jagatī form. Of the two sāmans, one of the two occurs -- just as one would stand firmly on both feet, such is that. 'Light, brilliance' (suvar jyotis) occurs. Suvar is the first day, jyotis the second -- for the continuity of the days, for the joining of the days. The hāviṣmata and hāviṣkṛta are heavenly sāmans, for the attainment of the heavenly world. On this they say: both sāmans are swift; if both were used, the sacrificer might be snatched away before his time -- for disregarding this world, those two went directly to the other world. One should use the hāviṣmata only in the uktha stotras of the second day as the brahmasāma.
meaning: विच्छिन्न इव ह खलु वा एष यज्ञक्रतुर् यद् द्विरात्रः . गायत्रीं पूर्वम् अहस् संपद्यते त्रिष्टुभम् उत्तरम् . अथ क्व जगती चानुष्टुप् चेत्य् आहुः . गायत्रीं चैव पूर्वम् अहस् संपादयेत् त्रिष्टुभं च जगतीं चानुष्टुभं चोत्तरं छन्दसां संतत्या अव्यवच्छेदाय . उच्चा ते जातम् अन्धसे त्य् अन्धस्वतीर् भवत्य् अन्धस्वद् वै जगत्यै रूपं तेन जगत्यै रूपान् न यन्ति . वैखानसं भवति जागतं साम . तेनैव जगत्यै रूपान् न यन्ति . ये द्वे सामनी तयोर् अन्यतरद् भवति यथोभयापदी प्रतितिष्ठेत् तादृक् तत् . सुवर् ज्योतिर् भवति . सुवर् वै पूर्वम् अहर् ज्योतिर् उत्तरम् अह्नोर् एव सन्तत्या अह्नोस् समारम्भाय . हाविष्मतहाविष्कृते स्वर्ग्ये सामनी स्वर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै . तद् आहुः क्षिप्रे सामनी यद् उभे कुर्युर् ईश्वरो यजमानं पुरायुषः प्रमथितोर् अनादृत्य हि ताव् इमं लोकम् अमुम् एव लोकम् अभिसंप्रैताम् इति . हाविष्मतम् एवोत्तरस्याह्न उक्थेषु ब्रह्मसाम कुर्युः .

sanskrit_iast: atha yasyaitasya jyotir ukthyaḥ pūrvam ahar bhavaty āyur atirātra uttaram eteno hābhipratāraṇa īje rājā prajākāmaś ca khalatī ca daivovātī avacicchitsamānaḥ . tato vai so 'va khalatī daivovātī acchintta . imām iyatīṃ prajām adhyagacchat . trīṇy anyasyātiricyante dvābhyām anya ūnaḥ . trīṇi tāni puṃso 'tiriktāni yais sa prajanayati . dve te striyā ūne yatas sā prajāyate . tad etan mithunaṃ prajananaṃ kriyate . mithunena prajananena prajāyate ya evaṃ veda . tā ubhe stotryās saṃpadyante sapta ca śatāny ekaviṃśatiś ca tāvanti saṃvatsarasyāhorātrāṇi . ahorātre vai kṛtsnaḥ prajāpatiḥ kṛtsnaṃ prajāpatim ṛdhnavāma kṛtsno naḥ prajāpatir upeto 'sad iti . atha yaikā stotryātiricyate yajamānaloko haiva saḥ . śaśvad dhainaṃ brāḥmaṇa uvāca nāsyāparaḥ prajāyām etādṛṅ vīro 'nājānitoḥ .
sentences: atʰa yasyaitasya jyotir uktʰyaḥ pūrvam ahar bʰavaty āyur atirātra uttaram eteno hābʰipratāraṇa īje rājā prajākāmaś ca kʰalatī ca daivovātī avaciccʰitsamānaḥ .
tato vai so 'va kʰalatī daivovātī accʰintta .
trīṇi tāni puṃso 'tiriktāni yais sa prajanayati .
dve te striyā ūne yatas sā prajāyate .
mitʰunena prajananena prajāyate ya evaṃ veda .
tā ubʰe stotryās saṃpadyante sapta ca śatāny ekaviṃśatiś ca tāvanti saṃvatsarasyāhorātrāṇi .
ahorātre vai kr̥tsnaḥ prajāpatiḥ kr̥tsnaṃ prajāpatim r̥dʰnavāma kr̥tsno naḥ prajāpatir upeto 'sad iti .
atʰa yaikā stotryātiricyate yajamānaloko haiva saḥ .
śaśvad dʰainaṃ brāḥmaṇa uvāca nāsyāparaḥ prajāyām etādr̥ṅ vīro 'nājānitoḥ .
text: Now in this rite, a jyotis ukthya is the first day and an āyus atirātra is the second. With this Abhipratāraṇa the king sacrificed, being a desirer of offspring and a bald-headed descendant of Daivovāta, being about to cut off his lineage. Thereupon he indeed cut off the lineage of the bald Daivovāta. He obtained this much offspring. Three are surplus in the one, two are lacking in the other. Those three are the surplus of the male by which he procreates. Those two are the deficiency of the female from which she gives birth. Thus a procreative couple is made. He who knows thus procreates through the couple. Both stotriyas together total seven hundred and twenty-one. That many are the days and nights of the year. 'Prajāpati is complete in day and night; may we attain the complete Prajāpati; may the complete Prajāpati be with us.' And the one stotriyā that is surplus -- that is the world of the sacrificer. The brāhmaṇa has said of this in succession: 'No such hero shall be born in his lineage hereafter.'
meaning: अथ यस्यैतस्य ज्योतिर् उक्थ्यः पूर्वम् अहर् भवत्य् आयुर् अतिरात्र उत्तरम् एतेनो हाभिप्रतारण ईजे राजा प्रजाकामश् च खलती च दैवोवाती अवचिच्छित्समानः . ततो वै सो ऽव खलती दैवोवाती अच्छिन्त्त . इमाम् इयतीं प्रजाम् अध्यगच्छत् . त्रीण्य् अन्यस्यातिरिच्यन्ते द्वाभ्याम् अन्य ऊनः . त्रीणि तानि पुंसो ऽतिरिक्तानि यैस् स प्रजनयति . द्वे ते स्त्रिया ऊने यतस् सा प्रजायते . तद् एतन् मिथुनं प्रजननं क्रियते . मिथुनेन प्रजननेन प्रजायते य एवं वेद . ता उभे स्तोत्र्यास् संपद्यन्ते सप्त च शतान्य् एकविंशतिश् च तावन्ति संवत्सरस्याहोरात्राणि . अहोरात्रे वै कृत्स्नः प्रजापतिः कृत्स्नं प्रजापतिम् ऋध्नवाम कृत्स्नो नः प्रजापतिर् उपेतो ऽसद् इति . अथ यैका स्तोत्र्यातिरिच्यते यजमानलोको हैव सः . शश्वद् धैनं ब्राःमण उवाच नास्यापरः प्रजायाम् एतादृङ् वीरो ऽनाजानितोः .

sanskrit_iast: tad dhānubudhyovāca yathādaivaṃ tyasya prajāyā astu . khalatī devedevo 'haṃ daivovātī avācchitsīti . tathā hainaṃ tāv abhitepatus tathābhiśuśucatuḥ . tad idaṃ tad eva . ime hābhipratāraṇā iyanto no aparas tādṛṅ vīra ājāyate . atha yasyaitasyatrivṛtpañcadaśābhyāṃ viparyāsam . pūrvam ahar agniṣṭomo bhavati . sarvastomo 'tirātra uttaram . prajananakāmo haitena yajeta . trivṛtpañcadaśau stomau bhavata ūnātiriktau mithunau prajanī . ūnam anyasyātiriktam anyasya . ūnātiriktād vai mithunāt prajāḥ paśavaḥ prajāyante . tat tatprajananaṃ kriyate . tasya rathantaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati . prajananaṃ vai rathantaram . tat tatprajananaṃ kriyate . tasya dvādaśa stotrāṇi bhavanti . dvādaśa māsās saṃvatsaraḥ . saṃvatsaraḥ prajananam . tat tatprajananaṃ kriyate . tasya caturviṃśati stutaśastrāṇi bhavanti . caturviṃśatyardhamāsas saṃvatsaraḥ . saṃvatsaraḥ prajananam . tat tad abhipūrvaṃ prajananaṃ kriyate . pra prajayā paśubhir jāyate ya evaṃ veda . sarvastomo 'tirātro bhavati sarveṣāṃ lokānām abhijityā abhikrāntyai . sarvaṃ hīdaṃ stomā eva .
sentences: tad dʰānubudʰyovāca yatʰādaivaṃ tyasya prajāyā astu .
ime hābʰipratāraṇā iyanto no aparas tādr̥ṅ vīra ājāyate .
trivr̥tpañcadaśau stomau bʰavata ūnātiriktau mitʰunau prajanī .
ūnātiriktād vai mitʰunāt prajāḥ paśavaḥ prajāyante .
pra prajayā paśubʰir jāyate ya evaṃ veda .
sarvastomo 'tirātro bʰavati sarveṣāṃ lokānām abʰijityā abʰikrāntyai .
text: On this Ānubudhya said: 'May it be as fate decrees for his offspring. The bald Daivovāta -- I cut off his lineage.' Thus those two tormented him and scorched him. This is that very thing. These descendants of Abhipratāraṇa are this many; no such hero is born among them. Now in this rite with the trivṛt and pañcadaśa in reverse order: the first day is an agniṣṭoma; the sarvastoma atirātra is the second. One desiring offspring should sacrifice with this. The two stomas are the trivṛt and pañcadaśa, deficient and surplus, a procreative couple. One is deficient, the other surplus. From the deficient-and-surplus couple, offspring and cattle are born. Thus procreation is accomplished. Its pṛṣṭha is the rathantara. The rathantara is procreation. Thus procreation is accomplished. It has twelve stotras. Twelve months make a year. The year is procreation. Thus procreation is accomplished. It has twenty-four stuta-śastras. Twenty-four half-months make a year. The year is procreation. Thus from the very beginning procreation is accomplished. He who knows thus procreates abundantly in offspring and cattle. The atirātra is sarvastoma, for the conquering and surpassing of all worlds. For all this is indeed the stomas.
meaning: तद् धानुबुध्योवाच यथादैवं त्यस्य प्रजाया अस्तु . खलती देवेदेवो ऽहं दैवोवाती अवाच्छित्सीति . तथा हैनं ताव् अभितेपतुस् तथाभिशुशुचतुः . तद् इदं तद् एव . इमे हाभिप्रतारणा इयन्तो नो अपरस् तादृङ् वीर आजायते . अथ यस्यैतस्यत्रिवृत्पञ्चदशाभ्यां विपर्यासम् . पूर्वम् अहर् अग्निष्टोमो भवति . सर्वस्तोमो ऽतिरात्र उत्तरम् . प्रजननकामो हैतेन यजेत . त्रिवृत्पञ्चदशौ स्तोमौ भवत ऊनातिरिक्तौ मिथुनौ प्रजनी . ऊनम् अन्यस्यातिरिक्तम् अन्यस्य . ऊनातिरिक्ताद् वै मिथुनात् प्रजाः पशवः प्रजायन्ते . तत् तत्प्रजननं क्रियते . तस्य रथन्तरं पृष्ठं भवति . प्रजननं वै रथन्तरम् . तत् तत्प्रजननं क्रियते . तस्य द्वादश स्तोत्राणि भवन्ति . द्वादश मासास् संवत्सरः . संवत्सरः प्रजननम् . तत् तत्प्रजननं क्रियते . तस्य चतुर्विंशति स्तुतशस्त्राणि भवन्ति . चतुर्विंशत्यर्धमासस् संवत्सरः . संवत्सरः प्रजननम् . तत् तद् अभिपूर्वं प्रजननं क्रियते . प्र प्रजया पशुभिर् जायते य एवं वेद . सर्वस्तोमो ऽतिरात्रो भवति सर्वेषां लोकानाम् अभिजित्या अभिक्रान्त्यै . सर्वं हीदं स्तोमा एव .

sanskrit_iast: atha yasyaitasya trivṛt pañcadaśaḥ saptadaśa iti pūrvam ahar bhavaty ekaviṃśas triṇavas trayastriṃśa ity uttaraṃ svargakāmo haitena yajeta . ūrdhvā ete stomā bhavanti . ūrdhvo vai svargo lokaḥ . svargasyaiva lokasya samaṣṭyai . abhikrāntastomā bhavanti . abhikrāntena ha vai yajñasya bhuñjate . etena ha vai tad dhaviṣmāṃś ca haviṣkṛc ca sadya svargaṃ lokam īyatuḥ . tasya parāñcy eva stotrāṇi bhavanti parāñci śastrāṇi bhavanti parāñci pṛṣṭhāni parācīr viṣṭutayaḥ parāṅ eva sarvo bhavati . tena haitenottaravayasy eva yajeta yademaṃ lokaṃ na pratyavakāṅkṣed yadāsmin loke na nidhitsed yadāsmāl lokād amum eva lokam abhisaṃprajigāṃset . sa hainena yajeta . iṣṭvā haiva svargaṃ lokam eti . tasminn u ha tarhy ubhe hāviṣmatahāviṣkṛte kuryu svargye svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai . tasyāhus sapta ca śatāni viṃśatiś ca stotryās saṃpādayeyur iti . tāvanti saṃvatsarasyāhorātrāṇi . saṃvatsarād eva tan na yanti . atho āhur yāvatīr evaitasya jyotir gaur āyur iti tryahasya stotryās tāvatīr asya stotryās saṃpādayeyur iti . tena tryaharūpān na yanti . atho āhus sahasram evāsya stotryās saṃpādayeyur iti . sahasraṃ vai trirātrasya stotryāḥ . trirātrarūpād eva tan na yanti .
sentences: atʰa yasyaitasya trivr̥t pañcadaśaḥ saptadaśa iti pūrvam ahar bʰavaty ekaviṃśas triṇavas trayastriṃśa ity uttaraṃ svargakāmo haitena yajeta .
etena ha vai tad dʰaviṣmāṃś ca haviṣkr̥c ca sadya svargaṃ lokam īyatuḥ .
tasya parāñcy eva stotrāṇi bʰavanti parāñci śastrāṇi bʰavanti parāñci pr̥ṣṭʰāni parācīr viṣṭutayaḥ parāṅ eva sarvo bʰavati .
tena haitenottaravayasy eva yajeta yademaṃ lokaṃ na pratyavakāṅkṣed yadāsmin loke na nidʰitsed yadāsmāl lokād amum eva lokam abʰisaṃprajigāṃset .
tasminn u ha tarhy ubʰe hāviṣmatahāviṣkr̥te kuryu svargye svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai .
tasyāhus sapta ca śatāni viṃśatiś ca stotryās saṃpādayeyur iti .
atʰo āhur yāvatīr evaitasya jyotir gaur āyur iti tryahasya stotryās tāvatīr asya stotryās saṃpādayeyur iti .
atʰo āhus sahasram evāsya stotryās saṃpādayeyur iti .
text: Now in this rite, the first day has the trivṛt, pañcadaśa, and saptadaśa; the second has the ekaviṃśa, triṇava, and trayastriṃśa. One desiring the heavenly world should sacrifice with this. These stomas are ascending. The heavenly world is above. It is for the attainment of the heavenly world. The stomas are surpassing. For by surpassing one enjoys the sacrifice. By this, Haviṣmān and Haviṣkṛt went directly to the heavenly world. Its stotras are directed away, its śastras are directed away, its pṛṣṭhas are directed away, its viṣṭutis are directed away -- everything is directed away. Therefore one should sacrifice with this only in later life, when one does not look back at this world, when one does not wish to store up in this world, when one wishes to go directly from this world to the other world. Having sacrificed, one goes to the heavenly world. At that time both the hāviṣmata and hāviṣkṛta should be used as heavenly sāmans, for the attainment of the heavenly world. On this they say: its stotriyas should total seven hundred and twenty. That many are the days and nights of the year. From the year they thereby do not depart. And they say: whatever are the stotriyas of the three-day jyotis-go-āyus, that many should be its stotriyas. Thereby they do not depart from the three-day form. And they say: its stotriyas should total a thousand. A thousand are the stotriyas of the trirātra. Thereby they do not depart from the trirātra form.
meaning: अथ यस्यैतस्य त्रिवृत् पञ्चदशः सप्तदश इति पूर्वम् अहर् भवत्य् एकविंशस् त्रिणवस् त्रयस्त्रिंश इत्य् उत्तरं स्वर्गकामो हैतेन यजेत . ऊर्ध्वा एते स्तोमा भवन्ति . ऊर्ध्वो वै स्वर्गो लोकः . स्वर्गस्यैव लोकस्य समष्ट्यै . अभिक्रान्तस्तोमा भवन्ति . अभिक्रान्तेन ह वै यज्ञस्य भुञ्जते . एतेन ह वै तद् धविष्मांश् च हविष्कृच् च सद्य स्वर्गं लोकम् ईयतुः . तस्य पराञ्च्य् एव स्तोत्राणि भवन्ति पराञ्चि शस्त्राणि भवन्ति पराञ्चि पृष्ठानि पराचीर् विष्टुतयः पराङ् एव सर्वो भवति . तेन हैतेनोत्तरवयस्य् एव यजेत यदेमं लोकं न प्रत्यवकाङ्क्षेद् यदास्मिन् लोके न निधित्सेद् यदास्माल् लोकाद् अमुम् एव लोकम् अभिसंप्रजिगांसेत् . स हैनेन यजेत . इष्ट्वा हैव स्वर्गं लोकम् एति . तस्मिन्न् उ ह तर्ह्य् उभे हाविष्मतहाविष्कृते कुर्यु स्वर्ग्ये स्वर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै . तस्याहुस् सप्त च शतानि विंशतिश् च स्तोत्र्यास् संपादयेयुर् इति . तावन्ति संवत्सरस्याहोरात्राणि . संवत्सराद् एव तन् न यन्ति . अथो आहुर् यावतीर् एवैतस्य ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुर् इति त्र्यहस्य स्तोत्र्यास् तावतीर् अस्य स्तोत्र्यास् संपादयेयुर् इति . तेन त्र्यहरूपान् न यन्ति . अथो आहुस् सहस्रम् एवास्य स्तोत्र्यास् संपादयेयुर् इति . सहस्रं वै त्रिरात्रस्य स्तोत्र्याः . त्रिरात्ररूपाद् एव तन् न यन्ति .

sanskrit_iast: athaite trirātrāḥ . trirātreṇa vai devā eṣu lokeṣv ārdhnuvaṃs trirātreṇa svargaṃ lokam āyan . vāg vai trirātraḥ . vāco rūpeṇājyāni cāhāni ca vibhajyante . ekākṣarā vai vāk tryakṣaram akṣaram . akṣarasya rūpeṇa vibhajyante . trayo gandharvāḥ . teṣām eṣā bhaktir agneḥ pṛthivī vāyor antarikṣam asāv S . 2,243 (264,34) yathā vā asau dyaur evaṃ saḥ . ādityasya dyauḥ . tad eṣābhyanūcyate trayaḥ kṛṇvanti bhuvaneṣu retas tisraḥ prajā āryā jyotiragrāḥ trayo gharmāsa uṣasaṃ sacante sarvaṃ it taṃ anu vidur vasiṣṭhāḥ iti .
sentences: trirātreṇa vai devā eṣu lokeṣv ārdʰnuvaṃs trirātreṇa svargaṃ lokam āyan .
teṣām eṣā bʰaktir agneḥ pr̥tʰivī vāyor antarikṣam asāv S . 2,243 (264,34) yatʰā vā asau dyaur evaṃ saḥ . ādityasya dyauḥ .
trayaḥ kr̥ṇvanti bʰuvaneṣu retas tisraḥ prajā āryā jyotiragrāḥ
trayo gʰarmāsa uṣasaṃ sacante sarvaṃ it taṃ anu vidur vasiṣṭʰāḥ
text: Now these are the trirātras (three-night rites). By the trirātra the gods succeeded in these worlds; by the trirātra they went to the heavenly world. Speech is the trirātra. The ājyas and the days are distributed by the form of speech. Speech has one syllable with three phonemes. They are distributed by the form of the phoneme. There are three gandharvas. Their shares are: of Agni, this earth; of Vāyu, the atmosphere; of that one (Āditya), just as heaven is yonder, so is he; of Āditya, heaven. On this there is a verse recited: 'Three make seed in the worlds; three kinds of creatures, noble, having light as their foremost; three fires follow the dawn; the Vasiṣṭhas know all of this.'

text: The Vasus, Rudras, and Ādityas -- the light that goes before them is that sun yonder. 'Three fires follow the dawn' -- Agni follows the dawn, Vāyu follows the dawn, Āditya follows the dawn. 'The Vasiṣṭhas know all of this' -- those brāhmaṇas who have learned are the Vasiṣṭhas; they indeed know all of this. This is the extent of the trirātra. The gāyatra is prāṇa, the traiṣṭubha is sight, the jāgata is hearing. Three couples -- in them a couple consists of two; what is born from the couple is the third. Indra raised the vajra against Vṛtra. Viṣṇu stood by him. He said: 'There is in this one a certain tejas, vigor, and power. Let me bring that to you. Do not strike me.' 'So be it.' He gave it to him. Viṣṇu accepted it. He raised the vajra a second time. Viṣṇu stood by him. He said: 'There is in this one a certain tejas, vigor, and power. Let me bring that to you. Do not strike me.' 'So be it.' He gave it to him. Viṣṇu accepted it. He raised the vajra a third time. Viṣṇu stood by him. He said: 'There is in this one a certain tejas, vigor, and power. Let me bring that to you. Do not strike me.' 'So be it.' He gave it to him. Viṣṇu accepted it.

text: 'Let us two ask,' they said. They asked Prajāpati. To them he declared by this verse: 'Both of you have conquered, neither is defeated; neither of the two is defeated. When Indra and Viṣṇu competed, they divided the thousand threefold.' 'Two shares are yours,' he said to Indra. 'One-third is yours,' to Viṣṇu. He gave them this thousand. The recipient of it should be: to one who is of good family and learned, he should give on the first day. Just as this earth -- he is established; firmly established is this one. To one who is without family but learned, he should give on the second day. Just as this atmosphere -- people know of the atmosphere; they know his knowledge. To one who is of good family but unlearned, he should give on the third day. Just as heaven yonder -- people know of heaven; they know his family. Day after day, gifts of ten are given. The virāj has ten syllables. The sacrifice is vairāja. That same virāj is distributed in parts. Day after day, hundreds are given. The measure of the sacrifice is a hundred. That same measure is distributed. Three hundred and thirty-three on the first day, three hundred and thirty-three on the second day, three hundred and thirty-three on the third day. Then there is this thousandth, triple-formed, double-deitied.
meaning: तौ वै पृच्छावहा इति . तौ ह प्रजापताव् अपृच्छेताम् . ताभ्याम् हैतया व्युवाच उभा जिग्यथुर् न परा जयेथे न परा जिग्ये कतरश् चनैनोः इन्द्रश् च विष्णो यद् अपस्पृधेथां त्रेधा सहस्रं वि तद् ऐरयेथाम् इति . द्वौ तव भागाव् इतीन्द्रम् अब्रवीत् तृतीयं तवेति विष्णुम् . एतद् आभ्याम् तत् सहस्रं प्रायच्छत् . तस्यैषाप्तिर् यो बन्धुमान् अनूचान स्यात् तस्मै प्रथमे ऽहनि दद्यात् . यथा इयं पृथिव्य् एवं सः . प्रतिष्ट्ःइता वा इयं प्रतिष्ठितस् सः . अथ यो ऽबन्धुर् अनूचान स्यात् तस्मै द्वितीये ऽहन् दद्यात् . यथा वा इदम् अन्तरिक्षम् एवम् सः . अन्तरिक्षम् इति वा इदं विदुर् वेदं तस्य विदुः . अथ यो बन्धुमान् अननूचान स्यात् तस्मै तृतीये ऽहनि दद्यात् . यथा वा असौ द्यौर् एवं सः . द्यौर् इति वा अमुं विदुर् बन्धु तस्य विदुः . अन्वहं दशतो दीयन्ते . दशाक्षरा विराट् . वैराजो यज्ञः . सैव सा व्यवच्छिन्ना दीयते . अन्वहं शतानि दीयन्ते . एषा वै यज्ञस्य मात्रा यच् छतम् . सैव सा व्यवच्छिन्ना दीयते . त्रयस्त्रिंशतं च त्रीणि च शतानि प्रथमे ऽहनि दद्यात् . त्रयस्त्रिंशतं च त्रीणि च शतानि द्वितीये ऽहनि दद्यात् . त्रयस्त्रिंशतं च त्रीणि च शतानि तृतीये ऽहनि दद्यात् . अथैषा सहस्रतमी त्रिरूपा द्विदेवत्या .

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatir vā idam agra āsīt . nānyaṃ dvitīyaṃ paśyamānas tasya vāg eva svam āsīd vāg dvitīyā sa aikṣata hantemāṃ vācaṃ visṛjai . iyaṃ vāvedaṃ visṛṣṭā sarvaṃ vibhavanty eṣyantīti . tāṃ vāg ity eva vyasṛjata . sordhvodātanod yathāpāṃ dhārā santataivam . tasyā ety ekam akṣaram acchinat . tad idam abhavat . abhūd vā idam iti . tad bhūmer bhūmitvam . keti dvitīyam . tad idam antarikṣam abhavat . antareva vā idam ubhayam abhūd iti . tad antarikṣasyāntarikṣatvam . ho iti tṛtīyam ūrdhvam udāsyat . tad dyaur abhavat . adyutad iva vā ada iti . tad divo divatvam . prajāpatir vā idam agra ekākṣarāṃ vācaṃ tredhā vyabhajat . ta ime lokā abhavan ṛkṣā anupajīvanīyāḥ . so 'śocat so 'tapyata . sa aikṣata katham ime lokā loma gṛhṇīyuḥ katham upajīvanavanta syur iti . sa etaṃ trirātraṃ yajñam apaśyat . tam āharat . tenāyajata . tam eṣu lokeṣv anvāyātayat . tato vā ime lokā lomāgṛhṇaṃs tata upajīvanavanto 'bhavan . trirātrasya ha khalu vā idaṃ puṣṭhaṃ trirātrasyodaraṇaṃ yad eṣu lokeṣv adhi .
