text: Prajāpati alone existed in the beginning. Not seeing any other, his own was speech alone; speech was his second. He reflected: 'Let me send forth this speech. This speech, once sent forth, will pervade all this.' He sent forth speech as 'vāk.' It rose upward continuously like a stream of water. Of it, he cut one syllable: 'e.' That became this world. 'This indeed came to be (abhūt)' -- that is the earth-nature (bhūmitva) of the earth (bhūmi). 'K' was the second syllable. That became this atmosphere. 'This was indeed between (antar) both' -- that is the atmosphere-nature (antarikṣatva) of the atmosphere (antarikṣa). 'Ho' was the third syllable, which rose upward. That became heaven. 'It shone forth, as it were (adyutat)' -- that is the heaven-nature (divatva) of heaven (div). Prajāpati in the beginning divided the one-syllable speech threefold. These worlds came into being -- barren, uninhabitable. He grieved. He performed austerity. He reflected: 'How may these worlds take on a covering? How may they become inhabitable?' He saw this trirātra sacrifice. He brought it. He sacrificed with it. He extended it through these worlds. Thereupon these worlds took on a covering; thereupon they became inhabitable. This is indeed nourished by the trirātra; this is expanded by the trirātra -- whatever exists in these worlds.
meaning: प्रजापतिर् वा इदम् अग्र आसीत् . नान्यं द्वितीयं पश्यमानस् तस्य वाग् एव स्वम् आसीद् वाग् द्वितीया स ऐक्षत हन्तेमां वाचं विसृजै . इयं वावेदं विसृष्टा सर्वं विभवन्त्य् एष्यन्तीति . तां वाग् इत्य् एव व्यसृजत . सोर्ध्वोदातनोद् यथापां धारा सन्ततैवम् . तस्या एत्य् एकम् अक्षरम् अच्छिनत् . तद् इदम् अभवत् . अभूद् वा इदम् इति . तद् भूमेर् भूमित्वम् . केति द्वितीयम् . तद् इदम् अन्तरिक्षम् अभवत् . अन्तरेव वा इदम् उभयम् अभूद् इति . तद् अन्तरिक्षस्यान्तरिक्षत्वम् . हो इति तृतीयम् ऊर्ध्वम् उदास्यत् . तद् द्यौर् अभवत् . अद्युतद् इव वा अद इति . तद् दिवो दिवत्वम् . प्रजापतिर् वा इदम् अग्र एकाक्षरां वाचं त्रेधा व्यभजत् . त इमे लोका अभवन् ऋक्षा अनुपजीवनीयाः . सो ऽशोचत् सो ऽतप्यत . स ऐक्षत कथम् इमे लोका लोम गृह्णीयुः कथम् उपजीवनवन्त स्युर् इति . स एतं त्रिरात्रं यज्ञम् अपश्यत् . तम् आहरत् . तेनायजत . तम् एषु लोकेष्व् अन्वायातयत् . ततो वा इमे लोका लोमागृह्णंस् तत उपजीवनवन्तो ऽभवन् . त्रिरात्रस्य ह खलु वा इदं पुष्ठं त्रिरात्रस्योदरणं यद् एषु लोकेष्व् अधि .

sanskrit_iast: yatho ha vai maṇau maṇisūtram otaṃ syād evam eṣu lokeṣu trirātra otaḥ . śobhate 'sya mukhaṃ ya evaṃ veda . eṣā ha khalu vai pratyakṣaṃ vāg yaj jihvāgreṇaitad vāco vadati yad eti . madhyenaitad vāco vadati yad keti . sarvayaitad vāco raso 'dhy ūrdhva udvadati yad dho iti . ho iti hi sarvā vāk . tad yad etāni rūpāṇy ājyeṣu cāhassu ca niyujyante . mukhata evaitad vācaṃ visṛjante mukhato yājñiyaṃ karma . prajāpatir yad vācaṃ vyasṛjata sākṣarad eva . tasyā ety eva prathamam akṣaraṃ kṣeti dvitīyaṃ rad iti tṛtīyam . tad yena yena vai rūpeṇa prajāpatir vācaṃ vyasṛjata tena tena rūpeṇājyāny ārabhyante tena tenāhāny āpyante . akṣareṣṭhā ha khalu vā eṣa yajño yas trirātraḥ . akṣaraṃ tryakṣaraṃ . tryakṣaras trirātraḥ . akṣaraṃ trirātraḥ .
sentences: yatʰo ha vai maṇau maṇisūtram otaṃ syād evam eṣu lokeṣu trirātra otaḥ .
eṣā ha kʰalu vai pratyakṣaṃ vāg yaj jihvāgreṇaitad vāco vadati yad eti .
sarvayaitad vāco raso 'dʰy ūrdʰva udvadati yad dʰo iti .
tad yad etāni rūpāṇy ājyeṣu cāhassu ca niyujyante .
mukʰata evaitad vācaṃ visr̥jante mukʰato yājñiyaṃ karma .
prajāpatir yad vācaṃ vyasr̥jata sākṣarad eva .
tasyā ety eva pratʰamam akṣaraṃ kṣeti dvitīyaṃ rad iti tr̥tīyam .
tad yena yena vai rūpeṇa prajāpatir vācaṃ vyasr̥jata tena tena rūpeṇājyāny ārabʰyante tena tenāhāny āpyante .
akṣareṣṭʰā ha kʰalu vā eṣa yajño yas trirātraḥ .
text: Just as a gem-thread would be strung through a gem, so the trirātra is strung through these worlds. His face shines who knows thus. This is indeed perceptible speech -- what one speaks with the tip of the tongue, that is the speech of 'e.' What one speaks with the middle of the tongue, that is the speech of 'k.' The essence of all speech rises upward when one says 'ho.' For 'ho' is all speech. Because these forms are employed in the ājyas and the days, they send forth speech from the very mouth -- from the mouth comes the sacrificial act. When Prajāpati sent forth speech, it flowed forth as syllables. Of it, 'e' was the first syllable, 'kṣ' the second, 'ra' the third. By whatever form Prajāpati sent forth speech, by that very form the ājyas are begun, by that form the days are completed. The trirātra is indeed a sacrifice established on syllables. The syllable is three-phonemed. Three-phonemed is the trirātra. The syllable is the trirātra.
meaning: यथो ह वै मणौ मणिसूत्रम् ओतं स्याद् एवम् एषु लोकेषु त्रिरात्र ओतः . शोभते ऽस्य मुखं य एवं वेद . एषा ह खलु वै प्रत्यक्षं वाग् यज् जिह्वाग्रेणैतद् वाचो वदति यद् एति . मध्येनैतद् वाचो वदति यद् केति . सर्वयैतद् वाचो रसो ऽध्य् ऊर्ध्व उद्वदति यद् धो इति . हो इति हि सर्वा वाक् . तद् यद् एतानि रूपाण्य् आज्येषु चाहस्सु च नियुज्यन्ते . मुखत एवैतद् वाचं विसृजन्ते मुखतो याज्ञियं कर्म . प्रजापतिर् यद् वाचं व्यसृजत साक्षरद् एव . तस्या एत्य् एव प्रथमम् अक्षरं क्षेति द्वितीयं रद् इति तृतीयम् . तद् येन येन वै रूपेण प्रजापतिर् वाचं व्यसृजत तेन तेन रूपेणाज्यान्य् आरभ्यन्ते तेन तेनाहान्य् आप्यन्ते . अक्षरेष्ठा ह खलु वा एष यज्ञो यस् त्रिरात्रः . अक्षरं त्र्यक्षरं . त्र्यक्षरस् त्रिरात्रः . अक्षरं त्रिरात्रः .

sanskrit_iast: idam eva prathamenāhnā vyakarod yad asyām āyattamūlam idaṃ dvitīyena yat prāṇad ejaty adas tṛtīyena yad varṣati yan nakṣatrāṇi yad amuṃ lokaṃ bheje . mahāvrataṃ vā etad yad eṣa trirātrasya . yāny eteṣām ahnāṃ bahiṣpavamānāni tac chiraḥ . ye 'bhito 'hanī tau pakṣau . yan madhyamam ahas sa ātmā . agniṣṭomasāmāny eva puccham . atho āhur yad evāsāv udeti tac chiraḥ . ye 'bhito 'hanī tau pakṣau . yan madhyamam ahas sa ātmā . agnir eva puccham . atho āhur ya evāsāv udeti tac chiraḥ . ye 'bhito 'hanī tau pakṣau . yan madhyamam ahas sa ātmā .
sentences: idam eva pratʰamenāhnā vyakarod yad asyām āyattamūlam idaṃ dvitīyena yat prāṇad ejaty adas tr̥tīyena yad varṣati yan nakṣatrāṇi yad amuṃ lokaṃ bʰeje .
mahāvrataṃ vā etad yad eṣa trirātrasya .
yāny eteṣām ahnāṃ bahiṣpavamānāni tac cʰiraḥ .
atʰo āhur yad evāsāv udeti tac cʰiraḥ .
atʰo āhur ya evāsāv udeti tac cʰiraḥ .
text: By the first day he fashioned this world -- whatever is rooted upon it. By the second, that which breathes and moves. By the third, the yonder world -- that which rains, the stars, and whatever share belongs to the yonder world. This is indeed the mahāvrata of this trirātra. The bahiṣpavamānas of these days are its head. The two outer days are its wings. The middle day is its body. The agniṣṭomasāmans are its tail. And they say: the sun as it rises is its head. The two outer days are its wings. The middle day is its body. Agni is its tail. And they say: the sun as it rises is its head. The two outer days are its wings. The middle day is its body.
meaning: इदम् एव प्रथमेनाह्ना व्यकरोद् यद् अस्याम् आयत्तमूलम् इदं द्वितीयेन यत् प्राणद् एजत्य् अदस् तृतीयेन यद् वर्षति यन् नक्षत्राणि यद् अमुं लोकं भेजे . महाव्रतं वा एतद् यद् एष त्रिरात्रस्य . यान्य् एतेषाम् अह्नां बहिष्पवमानानि तच् छिरः . ये ऽभितो ऽहनी तौ पक्षौ . यन् मध्यमम् अहस् स आत्मा . अग्निष्टोमसामान्य् एव पुच्छम् . अथो आहुर् यद् एवासाव् उदेति तच् छिरः . ये ऽभितो ऽहनी तौ पक्षौ . यन् मध्यमम् अहस् स आत्मा . अग्निर् एव पुच्छम् . अथो आहुर् य एवासाव् उदेति तच् छिरः . ये ऽभितो ऽहनी तौ पक्षौ . यन् मध्यमम् अहस् स आत्मा .

sanskrit_iast: vāgdevatyaṃ vai trirātrasya prathamam ahaḥ prāṇadevatyaṃ dvitīyaṃ cakṣurdevatyaṃ tṛtīyam . tad āhuḥ kiyāṃs trirātra iti . iyān iti brūyāt . iyad dhy evaitad iti . atho iyān iti brūyāt . iyad dhy evaitad iti . tad āhur arvāṅ trirātrā3ḥ parā3ṅ iti . parāṅ iti brūyāt . parāṅ hi vadati parāṅ prāṇiti parāṅ paśyati parāṅ chṛṇoti . atho ha brūyād arvāñ ca parāñ ceti . arvāñ ca hi parāñ ca vadaty arvāñ ca parāñ ca prāṇity arvāñ ca parāñ ca paśyaty arvāñ ca parāñ ca śṛṇoti . tad āhur ekas trirātrā3u dvā3u trayā3 iti . eka iti brūyāt . eko hy evaiṣa yat prāṇo 'pāno vyāna iti . tad āhur ekaṃ bhūyā3s sahasrā3m iti . ekam iti brūyāt .
sentences: vāgdevatyaṃ vai trirātrasya pratʰamam ahaḥ prāṇadevatyaṃ dvitīyaṃ cakṣurdevatyaṃ tr̥tīyam .
tad āhur arvāṅ trirātrā3ḥ parā3ṅ iti .
parāṅ hi vadati parāṅ prāṇiti parāṅ paśyati parāṅ cʰr̥ṇoti .
atʰo ha brūyād arvāñ ca parāñ ceti .
arvāñ ca hi parāñ ca vadaty arvāñ ca parāñ ca prāṇity arvāñ ca parāñ ca paśyaty arvāñ ca parāñ ca śr̥ṇoti .
tad āhur ekas trirātrā3u dvā3u trayā3 iti .
eko hy evaiṣa yat prāṇo 'pāno vyāna iti .
tad āhur ekaṃ bʰūyā3s sahasrā3m iti .
text: The first day of the trirātra has speech as its deity; the second has prāṇa; the third has sight. On this they ask: 'How great is the trirātra?' One should say: 'This great' -- for it is just this great. And one should say: 'This great' -- for it is just this great. On this they ask: 'Is the trirātra directed hither or directed away?' One should say: 'Directed away.' For one speaks away, breathes away, sees away, hears away. But one should say: 'Both hither and away.' For one speaks both hither and away, breathes both hither and away, sees both hither and away, hears both hither and away. On this they ask: 'Is the trirātra one, two, or three?' One should say: 'One.' For this is indeed one -- prāṇa, apāna, and vyāna. On this they ask: 'Is it one, many, or a thousand?' One should say: 'One.'
meaning: वाग्देवत्यं वै त्रिरात्रस्य प्रथमम् अहः प्राणदेवत्यं द्वितीयं चक्षुर्देवत्यं तृतीयम् . तद् आहुः कियांस् त्रिरात्र इति . इयान् इति ब्रूयात् . इयद् ध्य् एवैतद् इति . अथो इयान् इति ब्रूयात् . इयद् ध्य् एवैतद् इति . तद् आहुर् अर्वाङ् त्रिरात्रा३ः परा३ङ् इति . पराङ् इति ब्रूयात् . पराङ् हि वदति पराङ् प्राणिति पराङ् पश्यति पराङ् छृणोति . अथो ह ब्रूयाद् अर्वाञ् च पराञ् चेति . अर्वाञ् च हि पराञ् च वदत्य् अर्वाञ् च पराञ् च प्राणित्य् अर्वाञ् च पराञ् च पश्यत्य् अर्वाञ् च पराञ् च शृणोति . तद् आहुर् एकस् त्रिरात्रा३उ द्वा३उ त्रया३ इति . एक इति ब्रूयात् . एको ह्य् एवैष यत् प्राणो ऽपानो व्यान इति . तद् आहुर् एकं भूया३स् सहस्रा३म् इति . एकम् इति ब्रूयात् .

sanskrit_iast: vāg eveti . gāyatraṃ vai trirātrasya prathamam ahas traiṣṭubhaṃ dvitīyaṃ jāgataṃ tṛtīyam . yad vā anyasya trirātrasya viloma tas asya saloma yas asya saloma tad anyasya viloma . tad yad etat paraṃ sad ahar avaraṃ kriyate yajamānāyaiva tat paśūn prajanayanti na hy amuṣmiṃl loke paśavaḥ prajāyante . ete ha khalu vai chandasāṃ vīryavattame yad gāyatrī ca triṣṭup ca . tad yad gāyatrī ca triṣṭup cābhito bhavato madhye paśavo jagatī vīryavadbhyām evaitac chandobhyāṃ yajamānāyobhayataḥ paśūn parigṛhṇanty aparāvāpāya . nāsya vittaṃ paropyate ya evaṃ veda . asāv eva trirātro yo 'sau tapati . sa yathodety evam asya prathamam ahar yathā madhyandina evaṃ dvitīyam yathāstam ety evaṃ tṛtīyam .
sentences: gāyatraṃ vai trirātrasya pratʰamam ahas traiṣṭubʰaṃ dvitīyaṃ jāgataṃ tr̥tīyam .
yad vā anyasya trirātrasya viloma tas asya saloma yas asya saloma tad anyasya viloma .
tad yad etat paraṃ sad ahar avaraṃ kriyate yajamānāyaiva tat paśūn prajanayanti na hy amuṣmiṃl loke paśavaḥ prajāyante .
ete ha kʰalu vai cʰandasāṃ vīryavattame yad gāyatrī ca triṣṭup ca .
tad yad gāyatrī ca triṣṭup cābʰito bʰavato madʰye paśavo jagatī vīryavadbʰyām evaitac cʰandobʰyāṃ yajamānāyobʰayataḥ paśūn parigr̥hṇanty aparāvāpāya .
nāsya vittaṃ paropyate ya evaṃ veda .
sa yatʰodety evam asya pratʰamam ahar yatʰā madʰyandina evaṃ dvitīyam yatʰāstam ety evaṃ tr̥tīyam .
text: 'It is speech alone.' The first day of the trirātra is gāyatra, the second is traiṣṭubha, the third is jāgata. What in one trirātra runs against the grain, in this one runs with the grain; what in this runs with the grain, in the other runs against the grain. When this latter day is made the former -- they generate cattle for the sacrificer, for cattle are not born in the other world. These are indeed the most powerful of the metres -- the gāyatrī and the triṣṭubh. Because the gāyatrī and triṣṭubh are on both sides with the cattle -- the jagatī -- in the middle, they enclose cattle for the sacrificer on both sides with the most powerful metres, to prevent their departure. His wealth is not lost who knows thus. That sun yonder is this trirātra. As it rises, so is its first day; as it reaches midday, so is the second; as it sets, so is the third.
meaning: वाग् एवेति . गायत्रं वै त्रिरात्रस्य प्रथमम् अहस् त्रैष्टुभं द्वितीयं जागतं तृतीयम् . यद् वा अन्यस्य त्रिरात्रस्य विलोम तस् अस्य सलोम यस् अस्य सलोम तद् अन्यस्य विलोम . तद् यद् एतत् परं सद् अहर् अवरं क्रियते यजमानायैव तत् पशून् प्रजनयन्ति न ह्य् अमुष्मिंल् लोके पशवः प्रजायन्ते . एते ह खलु वै छन्दसां वीर्यवत्तमे यद् गायत्री च त्रिष्टुप् च . तद् यद् गायत्री च त्रिष्टुप् चाभितो भवतो मध्ये पशवो जगती वीर्यवद्भ्याम् एवैतच् छन्दोभ्यां यजमानायोभयतः पशून् परिगृह्णन्त्य् अपरावापाय . नास्य वित्तं परोप्यते य एवं वेद . असाव् एव त्रिरात्रो यो ऽसौ तपति . स यथोदेत्य् एवम् अस्य प्रथमम् अहर् यथा मध्यन्दिन एवं द्वितीयम् यथास्तम् एत्य् एवं तृतीयम् .

sanskrit_iast: indro vai marutas sahasram S . auch 2,300 (289 ,5f. ) etena ha vai tad enenendrāgnī marutaḥ sahasraṃ jigyatuḥ . ajinot svāṃ viśaṃ somāya rājñe pratiprocya . tadanukṛtīdam apy etarhi rājñe pratiprocya viśaṃ jinvanti . tad yamo 'nvabudhyata sahasram ajyāsiṣṭām iti . sa āgacchat . sa etyābravīd upa māsmin sahasre hvayethām iti . tatheti . tam upāhvayetām . sa yamo 'smin sahasre 'pi gām apaśyat sahasrasya gavāṃ payo bibhratīm . tām abravīd iyam eva mama yuvayor etad itarad iti . tāv itarāv abrūtāṃ yad vāva tvam etasyāṃ paśyasi tad āvaṃ paśyāva iti so 'bravīt tayā vā etā eva vikaravāmahā iti . te tayaiva vyakurvata . te 'bruvann aṃśān āharāmahai yasmai naḥ prathamaiṣyati . te 'ṃśān āharanta . somasya prathamait . athendrasyātha yamasya .
sentences: indro vai marutas sahasram S . auch 2,300 (289 ,5f. ) etena ha vai tad enenendrāgnī marutaḥ sahasraṃ jigyatuḥ . ajinot svāṃ viśaṃ somāya rājñe pratiprocya .
tadanukr̥tīdam apy etarhi rājñe pratiprocya viśaṃ jinvanti .
sa etyābravīd upa māsmin sahasre hvayetʰām iti .
sa yamo 'smin sahasre 'pi gām apaśyat sahasrasya gavāṃ payo bibʰratīm .
tām abravīd iyam eva mama yuvayor etad itarad iti .
tāv itarāv abrūtāṃ yad vāva tvam etasyāṃ paśyasi tad āvaṃ paśyāva iti so 'bravīt tayā vā etā eva vikaravāmahā iti .
te 'bruvann aṃśān āharāmahai yasmai naḥ pratʰamaiṣyati .
text: Indra won a thousand from the Maruts. By this, Indrāgnī won a thousand from the Maruts. He won his own viś for king Soma by declaring it. In imitation of that, even now they win the viś for a king by declaring it. Yama learned of this: 'A thousand has been won.' He came. Coming, he said: 'Invite me to share in this thousand.' 'So be it.' They invited him. Yama saw in this thousand a cow bearing the milk of a thousand cows. He said: 'This one is mine; the rest is yours.' The other two said: 'Whatever you see in it, we see that too.' He said: 'Let us divide it by means of her.' They divided it by her. They said: 'Let us draw lots; to whomever it falls first.' They drew lots. It fell to Soma first, then to Indra, then to Yama.

text: They said to her: 'Give forth for Soma with a third of yourself and a third of the thousand.' She came forth, brown, tawny-eyed, with a third of herself and a third of the thousand. She is the soma-purchasing cow. With a third of herself and a third of the thousand, king Soma is bought. They made her enter the waters again. They said: 'Give forth for Indra with a third of yourself and a third of the thousand.' She came forth, speckled, with a prominent back, with a third of herself and a third of the thousand. She is the one given for Indra. With a third of herself and a third of the thousand, she is given. They made her enter the waters again. They said: 'Give forth for Yama with a third of yourself and a third of the thousand.' She came forth -- smoky, with a dewlap, shorter in front and taller behind, old, with a curved mouth and crooked horns -- with a third of herself and a third of the thousand. She is the anustaraṇī (the cow spread upon the funeral pyre). With a third of herself and a third of the thousand, the anustaraṇī is prepared.
meaning: ताम् अब्रुवन् सोमायोदेहि तृतीयेन चात्मनस् तृतीयेन च सहस्रस्येति . सा बभ्रुः पिङ्गाक्ष्य् उदैत् तृतीयेन चात्मनस् तृतीयेन च सहस्रस्य . सैषा सोमक्रयणी . तृतीयेन च ह वै तस्यै तृतीयेन च सहस्रस्य सह सोमो राजा क्रीतो भवति . ताम् पुनर् एवाप्सु प्रावेशयन् . ताम् अब्रुवन्न् इन्द्रायोदेहि तृतीयेन चात्मनस् तृतीयेन च सहस्रस्येति . सा शबली पष्ठौह्य् उदैत् तृतीयेन चात्मनस् तृतीयेन च सहस्रस्य . सैषेन्द्रेष्या दीयते . तृतीयेन च ह वै तस्यै तृतीयेन च सहस्रस्य सह सा दत्ता भवति . ताम् पुनर् एवाप्सु प्रावेशयन् . ताम् अब्रुवन् यमायोदेहि तृतीयेन चात्मनस् तृतीयेन च सहस्रस्येति . सा धूम्रा दित्यौह्य् उदैद् ईर्मतो ह्रसीयसी पश्चाद् वर्षीयसी जरती वाकुष्ठाशृङ्गी तृतीयेन चात्मनस् तृतीयेन च सहस्रस्य . सैषानुस्तरणी . तृतीयेन च ह वै तस्यै तृतीयेन च सहस्रस्य सह सानुस्तरणी कृता भवति .

text: On this they say: 'There is no room for a thousand in the other world. It is for the self alone, not for the self.' On this they ask: 'How far is the heavenly world from here?' One should say: 'As far as a thousand cows, cow upon cow, standing one on top of another.' And also: 'As far as a thousand breaths breathing together.' And: 'As far as a thousand āśvinas (day-and-night units).' And: 'As far as a thousand yojanas.' And: 'As far as a thousand day-units.' By the cow he attains it by the cow itself. That speckled cow with the prominent back -- she stands in the other world as a wish-fulfilling cow for him who knows thus. He leads the gift back to the tārpya-place, for the reunion with the thousand. For when the thousand was created, the tārpya was its origin. Because he leads the gift back to the tārpya-place, he thereby reunites the thousand with its origin. The thousand stands beside him who has given it, reunited with its origin, for him who knows thus. To that cow which would be the thousandth, he should whisper in its ear: 'Iḷā, Rāntī, Mahī, Viśruti, Śukrā, Candrā, Havyā, Kāmyā, Aditi, Sarasvatī -- these are thy names, O inviolable one; tell the gods that we are meritorious.' She indeed declares him meritorious among the gods. He makes her smell the vessel: 'Smell the vessel; may the drops enter thee for my sake; do thou milk for us a thousand, broad-streamed, rich in milk.'

text: Prajāpati alone existed in the beginning. He desired: 'May I become many, may I be reproduced, may I reach abundance.' He performed austerity. He created speech. From speech he fashioned the cow. He reflected: 'I have enough to create from. If I create, I would obtain food from what I create. Let me create.' He created the Vasus, the Rudras, and the Ādityas. The Vasus approached him: 'Let this be ours.' To them he gave this cow. They guarded it for a year. In a year she bore for them three hundred and thirty-three. She was born again. The Rudras approached him: 'Let this be ours.' To them he gave this cow. They guarded it for a year. In a year she bore for them three hundred and thirty-three. She was born again. The Ādityas approached him: 'Let this be ours.' To them he gave this cow. They guarded it for a year. In a year she bore for them three hundred and thirty-three. That became a thousand. She is the thousandth. She was born again. He who, knowing thus, guards cattle -- his cattle indeed multiply to a thousand. Therefore cattle should be guarded by one who knows thus. They said: 'We have enough, with which to sacrifice by means of a thousand.'

sanskrit_iast: tat sārdhaṃ sahasraṃ samākurvan . tad eṣāṃ sahasraṃ saṃkhyāna evaikasyai gor nodabhavat . te 'bruvan prajāpatim evemāṃ sahasratamīṃ yācāmahā iti . te prajāpatim eva tāṃ sahasratamīm ayācanta . sa prajāpatir aikṣata yady ebhyaḥ pradāsyāmi rekṣye yady ebhyo na pradāsyāmy ūnam eṣāṃ sahasraṃ bhaviṣyati . haintainān sahaivānayābhyupayānīti . tān abravīt sahaiva vo 'ham anayābhyupayānīti . tatheti . tāṃs tayaiva sahābhyupait . ta etaṃ trirātraṃ yajñam apaśyat . tam āharanta . so 'bravīt samenā3nena yajñena yakṣāmahā3 asamenā3 iti . samenety abruvan . yat samenety abruvan sama eva tad varṣam akurvata same rāṣṭraṃ saṃjñāṃ eva tad akurvata . atha yad avakṣyann asamenety asama eva varṣam abhaviṣyad asame rāṣṭram asaṃjñābhaviṣyat . te kena sameṣyāma iti . yajñāyajñīyeneti . tasmād yajñāyajñīyenaiva saṃyanti . vāg vai yajñāyajñīyam . vāg ime lokāḥ . vācaiva tad vācam ārohan So wegen 2,264 (273,34). te trayastriṃśataṃ ca trīṇi ca śatāni prathame 'hann adaduḥ . tenāsmin loke vasubhir arādhnot . trayastriṃśataṃ ca trīṇi ca śatāni dvitīye 'hann adaduḥ . tenāsmin antarikṣe loke rudrair arādhnot . trayastriṃśataṃ ca trīṇi ca śatāni tṛtīye 'hann adaduḥ . tenāmuṣmin loka ādityair arādhnot .

text: They gathered the thousand together. But the thousand came to one cow short in the count. They said: 'Let us ask Prajāpati for this thousandth cow.' They asked Prajāpati for the thousandth. Prajāpati reflected: 'If I give it to them, I shall be diminished. If I do not give it to them, their thousand will be incomplete. Let me go together with them along with her.' He said to them: 'I shall go together with you along with her.' 'So be it.' He went together with them along with her. They saw this trirātra sacrifice. They brought it. He said: 'Shall we sacrifice with this sacrifice in agreement or in disagreement?' 'In agreement,' they said. Because they said 'in agreement,' they thereby made the seasons equal, the kingdom equal; they established concord. But had they said 'in disagreement,' the seasons would have been unequal, the kingdom unequal; there would have been discord. 'By what shall we come to agreement?' 'By the yajñāyajñīya.' Therefore they come to agreement through the yajñāyajñīya. Speech is the yajñāyajñīya. Speech is these worlds. By speech they ascended to speech. They gave three hundred and thirty-three on the first day. By that he succeeded in this world with the Vasus. They gave three hundred and thirty-three on the second day. By that he succeeded in the atmospheric world with the Rudras. They gave three hundred and thirty-three on the third day. By that he succeeded in the yonder world with the Ādityas.
meaning: तत् सार्धं सहस्रं समाकुर्वन् . तद् एषां सहस्रं संख्यान एवैकस्यै गोर् नोदभवत् . ते ऽब्रुवन् प्रजापतिम् एवेमां सहस्रतमीं याचामहा इति . ते प्रजापतिम् एव तां सहस्रतमीम् अयाचन्त . स प्रजापतिर् ऐक्षत यद्य् एभ्यः प्रदास्यामि रेक्ष्ये यद्य् एभ्यो न प्रदास्याम्य् ऊनम् एषां सहस्रं भविष्यति . हैन्तैनान् सहैवानयाभ्युपयानीति . तान् अब्रवीत् सहैव वो ऽहम् अनयाभ्युपयानीति . तथेति . तांस् तयैव सहाभ्युपैत् . त एतं त्रिरात्रं यज्ञम् अपश्यत् . तम् आहरन्त . सो ऽब्रवीत् समेना३नेन यज्ञेन यक्षामहा३ असमेना३ इति . समेनेत्य् अब्रुवन् . यत् समेनेत्य् अब्रुवन् सम एव तद् वर्षम् अकुर्वत समे राष्ट्रं संज्ञां एव तद् अकुर्वत . अथ यद् अवक्ष्यन्न् असमेनेत्य् असम एव वर्षम् अभविष्यद् असमे राष्ट्रम् असंज्ञाभविष्यत् . ते केन समेष्याम इति . यज्ञायज्ञीयेनेति . तस्माद् यज्ञायज्ञीयेनैव संयन्ति . वाग् वै यज्ञायज्ञीयम् . वाग् इमे लोकाः . वाचैव तद् वाचम् आरोहन् Sओ wएगेन् २,२६४ (२७३,३४). ते त्रयस्त्रिंशतं च त्रीणि च शतानि प्रथमे ऽहन्न् अददुः . तेनास्मिन् लोके वसुभिर् अराध्नोत् . त्रयस्त्रिंशतं च त्रीणि च शतानि द्वितीये ऽहन्न् अददुः . तेनास्मिन् अन्तरिक्षे लोके रुद्रैर् अराध्नोत् . त्रयस्त्रिंशतं च त्रीणि च शतानि तृतीये ऽहन्न् अददुः . तेनामुष्मिन् लोक आदित्यैर् अराध्नोत् .

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatir yad agre sahasram asṛjata tat prajābhyaḥ prāyacchad etad vas saheti . yat sahety abravīt tat sahasrasya sahasratvam . tasmād u ha sahasrīva satir eva syāt . saheti hy abravīt . sā yo hainas tatrāvāsyamāno brūyād ā te sahasrasya payo dada iti tathā haiva syāt . te devā īśānaṃ devam abruvaṃs tvaṃ vai na śreṣṭho 'si . tam uddhāram uddharasveti . sa etāni trīṇi sāmāni sahasrasya rasaṃ prāvahatarttanidhanam īnidhanaṃ triṇidhanam iti . tāni vā etāni sāmāni sahasratrirātreṇa kāryāṇīśānasya devasyoddhāra uddhṛtāni . ud uddhāraṃ harata uddhāryo bhavati ya evaṃ veda . tasmād etāni sāmāni sahasratrirātreṇa kāryāṇīśānasya devasyākhalasya sāmānīśvaro yajamānasya paśūn abhimantor iti . aparasam iva tu hāsya sahasraṃ dattaṃ syāt . kāryāṇy eva sahasrasya dharatāyai . prajāptir yad devebhyas sahasraṃ prāyacchat tad apratīkṣamāṇā evādan . tad devebhyo 'dyamānaṃ tiro 'bhavat . tad anvamantrayanta . tad abravīt kṣayād vai bibhemīti . nety abruvan . tathā vai tvātsyāmo yathā no 'dyamānaṃ pīyamānaṃ na kṣeṣyasa iti . tasmai vai ma ṛtaṃ kuruteti . tasmā ṛtanidhanenaivartam akurvan īnidhanenādayan pra caivainat triṇidhanenājanayann akṣitiṃ cāsmā akurvan .
