text: When Prajāpati first created the thousand, he gave it to the creatures, saying 'This is yours -- with it (saha).' Because he said 'saha,' that is the thousand-nature (sahasratva) of a thousand (sahasra). Therefore one who has a thousand should be as if possessing togetherness. For he said 'saha.' He who would say to the one being pressed: 'May I give thee the milk of the thousand' -- so indeed it would be. The gods said to Īśāna, the god: 'Thou art the best among us. Make the selection for thyself.' He selected these three sāmans -- the essence of the thousand: the ṛttanidhana, the īnidhana, and the triṇidhana. These sāmans are to be performed with the thousand-trirātra; they are the selected portion of Īśāna, the god. He who knows thus has his selection made. Therefore these sāmans are to be performed with the thousand-trirātra; they are the sāmans of Īśāna, the god, of the threshing-floor. He who is master of the sacrificer's cattle can bless them. But if his thousand were given incompletely, the sāmans should still be performed, for the maintenance of the thousand. When Prajāpati gave the thousand to the gods, they consumed it without acknowledging receipt. It disappeared while being consumed by the gods. They recited mantras over it. It said: 'I fear exhaustion.' 'No,' they said. 'We shall treat thee so that, being consumed and drunk, thou shalt not be exhausted.' 'Then make ṛta for me.' By the ṛttanidhana they made ṛta for it; by the īnidhana they nourished it; by the triṇidhana they caused it to be reproduced and made it imperishable.
meaning: प्रजापतिर् यद् अग्रे सहस्रम् असृजत तत् प्रजाभ्यः प्रायच्छद् एतद् वस् सहेति . यत् सहेत्य् अब्रवीत् तत् सहस्रस्य सहस्रत्वम् . तस्माद् उ ह सहस्रीव सतिर् एव स्यात् . सहेति ह्य् अब्रवीत् . सा यो हैनस् तत्रावास्यमानो ब्रूयाद् आ ते सहस्रस्य पयो दद इति तथा हैव स्यात् . ते देवा ईशानं देवम् अब्रुवंस् त्वं वै न श्रेष्ठो ऽसि . तम् उद्धारम् उद्धरस्वेति . स एतानि त्रीणि सामानि सहस्रस्य रसं प्रावहतर्त्तनिधनम् ईनिधनं त्रिणिधनम् इति . तानि वा एतानि सामानि सहस्रत्रिरात्रेण कार्याणीशानस्य देवस्योद्धार उद्धृतानि . उद् उद्धारं हरत उद्धार्यो भवति य एवं वेद . तस्माद् एतानि सामानि सहस्रत्रिरात्रेण कार्याणीशानस्य देवस्याखलस्य सामानीश्वरो यजमानस्य पशून् अभिमन्तोर् इति . अपरसम् इव तु हास्य सहस्रं दत्तं स्यात् . कार्याण्य् एव सहस्रस्य धरतायै . प्रजाप्तिर् यद् देवेभ्यस् सहस्रं प्रायच्छत् तद् अप्रतीक्षमाणा एवादन् . तद् देवेभ्यो ऽद्यमानं तिरो ऽभवत् . तद् अन्वमन्त्रयन्त . तद् अब्रवीत् क्षयाद् वै बिभेमीति . नेत्य् अब्रुवन् . तथा वै त्वात्स्यामो यथा नो ऽद्यमानं पीयमानं न क्षेष्यस इति . तस्मै वै म ऋतं कुरुतेति . तस्मा ऋतनिधनेनैवर्तम् अकुर्वन् ईनिधनेनादयन् प्र चैवैनत् त्रिणिधनेनाजनयन्न् अक्षितिं चास्मा अकुर्वन् .

sanskrit_iast: anvaham ājidohāni bhavanti . prāṇā vā ājidohāni . yad anvaham ājidohāni bhavanti . prāṇeṣv eva tat pratitiṣṭhati . anvaham ājidohāni bhavanti . paśavo vā ājidohāni . yad anvaham ājidohāni bhavanti paśuṣv eva tat pratitiṣṭhati . anvaham ājidohāni bhavanti . ime vai lokā ājidohāni . yad anvaham ājidohāni bhavanty eṣv eva tal lokeṣu pratitiṣṭhati . agnir ājidohaṃ vāyur ājidoham asāv āditya ājidoham . yad anvaham ājidohāni bhavanty etāsv eva tad devatāsu pratitiṣṭhati . ime vai lokā ājayo nāma . eteṣām ete dohāḥ . duha imān lokān ya evaṃ veda . anvaham arkā bhavanty annaṃ vā arko 'nnādyasyaivāvaruddhyai . svāśirām arkaḥ prathame 'hani bhavati . āpo vai svāśiraḥ . annam u vā āpaḥ . no vā anavaso 'dhvānaṃ samaśnute . agner arko dvitīye 'hani bhavati . antarikṣāyatanaṃ vai dvitīyam ahaḥ . astam evāntarikṣaṃ tamassahacayāni rakṣāṃsy agnir vai rakṣasām apahantā rakṣasām evāpahatyai . dīrghatamaso 'rkas tṛtīye 'hani bhavati . jāgato vai dīrghatamaso 'rkaḥ . jāgataṃ tṛtīyam ahaḥ .
sentences: yad anvaham ājidohāni bʰavanti paśuṣv eva tat pratitiṣṭʰati .
yad anvaham ājidohāni bʰavanty eṣv eva tal lokeṣu pratitiṣṭʰati .
agnir ājidohaṃ vāyur ājidoham asāv āditya ājidoham .
yad anvaham ājidohāni bʰavanty etāsv eva tad devatāsu pratitiṣṭʰati .
duha imān lokān ya evaṃ veda .
anvaham arkā bʰavanty annaṃ vā arko 'nnādyasyaivāvaruddʰyai .
astam evāntarikṣaṃ tamassahacayāni rakṣāṃsy agnir vai rakṣasām apahantā rakṣasām evāpahatyai .
text: Day after day there are ājidoha chants. The prāṇas are the ājidohas. Because the ājidohas occur day after day, he thereby stands firm in the prāṇas. Day after day there are ājidoha chants. Cattle are the ājidohas. Because the ājidohas occur day after day, he thereby stands firm in cattle. Day after day there are ājidoha chants. These worlds are the ājidohas. Because the ājidohas occur day after day, he thereby stands firm in these worlds. Agni is the ājidoha, Vāyu is the ājidoha, that sun yonder is the ājidoha. Because the ājidohas occur day after day, he thereby stands firm in these deities. These worlds are indeed called ājis ('contests'). These are their milkings. He who knows thus milks these worlds. Day after day there are arkas. Food is the arka -- for the securing of food. The svāśiras arka is on the first day. The waters are svāśiras. Food is the waters. For one without a resting-place cannot complete a journey. The arka of Agni is on the second day. The second day has its abode in the atmosphere. The atmosphere is full of darkness, of demons accompanying the dark. Agni is the slayer of demons -- for the slaying of demons. The arka of Dīrghatamas is on the third day. The arka of Dīrghatamas is jāgata. The third day is jāgata.
meaning: अन्वहम् आजिदोहानि भवन्ति . प्राणा वा आजिदोहानि . यद् अन्वहम् आजिदोहानि भवन्ति . प्राणेष्व् एव तत् प्रतितिष्ठति . अन्वहम् आजिदोहानि भवन्ति . पशवो वा आजिदोहानि . यद् अन्वहम् आजिदोहानि भवन्ति पशुष्व् एव तत् प्रतितिष्ठति . अन्वहम् आजिदोहानि भवन्ति . इमे वै लोका आजिदोहानि . यद् अन्वहम् आजिदोहानि भवन्त्य् एष्व् एव तल् लोकेषु प्रतितिष्ठति . अग्निर् आजिदोहं वायुर् आजिदोहम् असाव् आदित्य आजिदोहम् . यद् अन्वहम् आजिदोहानि भवन्त्य् एतास्व् एव तद् देवतासु प्रतितिष्ठति . इमे वै लोका आजयो नाम . एतेषाम् एते दोहाः . दुह इमान् लोकान् य एवं वेद . अन्वहम् अर्का भवन्त्य् अन्नं वा अर्को ऽन्नाद्यस्यैवावरुद्ध्यै . स्वाशिराम् अर्कः प्रथमे ऽहनि भवति . आपो वै स्वाशिरः . अन्नम् उ वा आपः . नो वा अनवसो ऽध्वानं समश्नुते . अग्नेर् अर्को द्वितीये ऽहनि भवति . अन्तरिक्षायतनं वै द्वितीयम् अहः . अस्तम् एवान्तरिक्षं तमस्सहचयानि रक्षांस्य् अग्निर् वै रक्षसाम् अपहन्ता रक्षसाम् एवापहत्यै . दीर्घतमसो ऽर्कस् तृतीये ऽहनि भवति . जागतो वै दीर्घतमसो ऽर्कः . जागतं तृतीयम् अहः .

sanskrit_iast: anvahaṃ sauparṇāni bhavanti svargyāṇi svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai . tad āhuḥ kṣiprāṇi sāmānīśvaro yajamānaṃ purāyuṣaḥ pramathitoḥ . dve eva kārye patanāyaiveti . saṃ vā enaṃ tat sādhayantīty āhuḥ . ekam eva kāryaṃ samaṣṭyā eveti . kim u ya enaṃ pramathnīyur api sarvāṇy eva kāryāṇi . trirātreṇa vai devā ūrdhvā svargaṃ lokam āyan . sa eṣām asaṃgṛhīto vīvāvṛhyata . taṃ gāyatrapārśveṇaivodastabhnuvan saṃtaninā samatanvan saṃkṛtinā samakurvaṃs triṣandhinā samadadhuḥ śrāyantīyena samaśrīṇann ariṣṭenāriṣṭatām agamayan . tad yad etāni sāmāni bhavanti trirātrasyaivottabdhyai trirātrasya santatyai trirātrasya saṃkṛtyai trirātrasya saṃhityai trirātrasya saṃśrityai trirātrasyāriṣṭatāyai . ail̥aṃ kakubhi svāram uṣṇihi .
sentences: anvahaṃ sauparṇāni bʰavanti svargyāṇi svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai .
tad āhuḥ kṣiprāṇi sāmānīśvaro yajamānaṃ purāyuṣaḥ pramatʰitoḥ .
saṃ vā enaṃ tat sādʰayantīty āhuḥ .
kim u ya enaṃ pramatʰnīyur api sarvāṇy eva kāryāṇi .
trirātreṇa vai devā ūrdʰvā svargaṃ lokam āyan .
taṃ gāyatrapārśveṇaivodastabʰnuvan saṃtaninā samatanvan saṃkr̥tinā samakurvaṃs triṣandʰinā samadadʰuḥ śrāyantīyena samaśrīṇann ariṣṭenāriṣṭatām agamayan .
tad yad etāni sāmāni bʰavanti trirātrasyaivottabdʰyai trirātrasya santatyai trirātrasya saṃkr̥tyai trirātrasya saṃhityai trirātrasya saṃśrityai trirātrasyāriṣṭatāyai .
text: Day after day there are sauparṇa chants -- heavenly, for the attainment of the heavenly world. On this they say: swift sāmans may snatch the sacrificer away before his time. Only two should be performed -- for flight alone. But they say: they bring him to completion. Only one should be performed -- for completion alone. And what of those that might snatch him away? All should be performed. By the trirātra the gods went upward to the heavenly world. Their trirātra, not being held together, was about to fall apart. They propped it up with the gāyatra section; with the saṃtanin they wove it together; with the saṃkṛtin they made it whole; with the triṣandhi they joined it together; with the śrāyantīya they cooked it together; with the ariṣṭa they brought it to a state of unharmed-ness. Because these sāmans occur, they are for the propping up of the trirātra, for its weaving together, for its wholeness, for its joining, for its cooking together, for its unharmed-ness. The aila is in the kakubh; the svāra is in the uṣṇih.
meaning: अन्वहं सौपर्णानि भवन्ति स्वर्ग्याणि स्वर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै . तद् आहुः क्षिप्राणि सामानीश्वरो यजमानं पुरायुषः प्रमथितोः . द्वे एव कार्ये पतनायैवेति . सं वा एनं तत् साधयन्तीत्य् आहुः . एकम् एव कार्यं समष्ट्या एवेति . किम् उ य एनं प्रमथ्नीयुर् अपि सर्वाण्य् एव कार्याणि . त्रिरात्रेण वै देवा ऊर्ध्वा स्वर्गं लोकम् आयन् . स एषाम् असंगृहीतो वीवावृह्यत . तं गायत्रपार्श्वेणैवोदस्तभ्नुवन् संतनिना समतन्वन् संकृतिना समकुर्वंस् त्रिषन्धिना समदधुः श्रायन्तीयेन समश्रीणन्न् अरिष्टेनारिष्टताम् अगमयन् . तद् यद् एतानि सामानि भवन्ति त्रिरात्रस्यैवोत्तब्ध्यै त्रिरात्रस्य सन्तत्यै त्रिरात्रस्य संकृत्यै त्रिरात्रस्य संहित्यै त्रिरात्रस्य संश्रित्यै त्रिरात्रस्यारिष्टतायै . ऐल्̥अं ककुभि स्वारम् उष्णिहि .

sanskrit_iast: ṣaṭ ca vai gāyatrī prathamam ahas saṃpadyate daśa ca stotryāḥ . ṣaṭ ca vai triṣṭubho dvitīyam ahas saṃpadyata ekāṃ ca stotryām . atha yat tṛtīyam ahas tasya dve savane jagatīs saṃpadyate 'nuṣṭubhaḥ . tṛtīyasavanam ekaviṃśaṣ ṣoḍaśī . ṣoḍaśī vai pūrvayor ahnor apitvam aicchata . ṣoḍaśini pūrve 'hanī apitvam aicchetām . tam etābhir ekādaśabhi stotryābhir upasaṃparāitām . sa ānuṣṭubhaṣ ṣoḍaśī samapadyata . sa yo vai ṣoḍaśinaṃ pūrvayor ahnor apitvinaṃ veda ṣoḍaśini pūrve 'hanī apitvinī apitvī ha tatra bhavati yatra kāmayate 'pitvī ha syām iti . tad āhu stomair eva pṛṣṭhyaṃ ṣaḍaham āpnoti saṃpadā chandomān rātryā daśamam ahar iti . sa yavadvādaśāhena (?) dakṣiṇāvatāvarunddhe ya evaṃ veda . athaiṣā sahasratamī tāṃ yad dadyād ricyetānu garbhāś śuṣyeyur yan na dadyād ūnam asya sahasraṃ dattaṃ syāt . kalāṃ cādeyaṃ ca na dadyāt . tan mithunam . tad anu prajāyate . tad āhur adattaṃ vai tathā bhavaty uta vai kalām evānv avajayati . tat tat kalāṃ vānu sahasraṃ iyāt . kalāvānu sahasraṃ tat tad avijñānaṃ datvaivainām adyayā gavā niṣkrīṇīyād iti . tad u vā āhur dattaṃ vai tathā bhavati . gaur itarā gaur itarorṇāsūtrasyaivanām āvikasya yāvad arhantīm manyeta tāvatā niṣkrīṇīyād iti . ūrṇāsūtram u vai goḥ kiñcid iva . dattam asya sahasraṃ bhavati nātmanā ricyate . sa yathā vāgarayā vā rajjvā vā vrajaṃ paritanuyād evam evaitat paśūn parigṛhṇīte 'parāvāpāya .
sentences: ṣaṭ ca vai gāyatrī pratʰamam ahas saṃpadyate daśa ca stotryāḥ .
ṣaṭ ca vai triṣṭubʰo dvitīyam ahas saṃpadyata ekāṃ ca stotryām .
atʰa yat tr̥tīyam ahas tasya dve savane jagatīs saṃpadyate 'nuṣṭubʰaḥ .
ṣoḍaśī vai pūrvayor ahnor apitvam aiccʰata .
sa yo vai ṣoḍaśinaṃ pūrvayor ahnor apitvinaṃ veda ṣoḍaśini pūrve 'hanī apitvinī apitvī ha tatra bʰavati yatra kāmayate 'pitvī ha syām iti .
tad āhu stomair eva pr̥ṣṭʰyaṃ ṣaḍaham āpnoti saṃpadā cʰandomān rātryā daśamam ahar iti .
sa yavadvādaśāhena (?) dakṣiṇāvatāvarunddʰe ya evaṃ veda .
atʰaiṣā sahasratamī tāṃ yad dadyād ricyetānu garbʰāś śuṣyeyur yan na dadyād ūnam asya sahasraṃ dattaṃ syāt .
tad āhur adattaṃ vai tatʰā bʰavaty uta vai kalām evānv avajayati .
tat tat kalāṃ vānu sahasraṃ iyāt .
kalāvānu sahasraṃ tat tad avijñānaṃ datvaivainām adyayā gavā niṣkrīṇīyād iti .
tad u vā āhur dattaṃ vai tatʰā bʰavati .
gaur itarā gaur itarorṇāsūtrasyaivanām āvikasya yāvad arhantīm manyeta tāvatā niṣkrīṇīyād iti .
ūrṇāsūtram u vai goḥ kiñcid iva .
dattam asya sahasraṃ bʰavati nātmanā ricyate .
sa yatʰā vāgarayā vā rajjvā vā vrajaṃ paritanuyād evam evaitat paśūn parigr̥hṇīte 'parāvāpāya .
text: The first day completes six gāyatrī stotriyas and ten more. The second day completes six triṣṭubh stotriyas and one more. As for the third day, its two pressings complete jagatīs; the anuṣṭubhs complete the third. The third pressing is ekaviṃśa with ṣoḍaśī. The ṣoḍaśī sought a place in the first two days. The first two days sought a place for the ṣoḍaśī. They approached it with these eleven stotriyas. It became the ṣoḍaśī in anuṣṭubh. He who knows the ṣoḍaśī as having a place in the first two days, and the first two days as having a place for the ṣoḍaśī -- he has a place wherever he desires to have a place. On this they say: by the stomas one attains the pṛṣṭhya ṣaḍaha; by the completion, the chandoma; by the night, the tenth day. He who knows thus secures whatever the dvādaśāha with dakṣiṇā secures. Then there is this thousandth cow. If one were to give it, succeeding generations would dry up. If one were not to give it, his thousand would be given incompletely. One should not give the fraction and the balance. That is a couple. From that, reproduction follows. On this they say: it is as good as not given, and one simply loses the fraction. The thousand might be overtaken by the fraction. The fraction might overtake the thousand. Without anyone knowing, having given it, one should buy it back with another cow for as much as one thinks fitting -- with woolen thread, with sheep's wool. Wool is indeed something of a cow. His thousand is then given, and he is not diminished himself. Just as one would enclose a pen with a creeper or a rope, so he thereby encloses cattle, to prevent their departure.
meaning: षट् च वै गायत्री प्रथमम् अहस् संपद्यते दश च स्तोत्र्याः . षट् च वै त्रिष्टुभो द्वितीयम् अहस् संपद्यत एकां च स्तोत्र्याम् . अथ यत् तृतीयम् अहस् तस्य द्वे सवने जगतीस् संपद्यते ऽनुष्टुभः . तृतीयसवनम् एकविंशष् षोडशी . षोडशी वै पूर्वयोर् अह्नोर् अपित्वम् ऐच्छत . षोडशिनि पूर्वे ऽहनी अपित्वम् ऐच्छेताम् . तम् एताभिर् एकादशभि स्तोत्र्याभिर् उपसंपराइताम् . स आनुष्टुभष् षोडशी समपद्यत . स यो वै षोडशिनं पूर्वयोर् अह्नोर् अपित्विनं वेद षोडशिनि पूर्वे ऽहनी अपित्विनी अपित्वी ह तत्र भवति यत्र कामयते ऽपित्वी ह स्याम् इति . तद् आहु स्तोमैर् एव पृष्ठ्यं षडहम् आप्नोति संपदा छन्दोमान् रात्र्या दशमम् अहर् इति . स यवद्वादशाहेन (?) दक्षिणावतावरुन्द्धे य एवं वेद . अथैषा सहस्रतमी तां यद् दद्याद् रिच्येतानु गर्भाश् शुष्येयुर् यन् न दद्याद् ऊनम् अस्य सहस्रं दत्तं स्यात् . कलां चादेयं च न दद्यात् . तन् मिथुनम् . तद् अनु प्रजायते . तद् आहुर् अदत्तं वै तथा भवत्य् उत वै कलाम् एवान्व् अवजयति . तत् तत् कलां वानु सहस्रं इयात् . कलावानु सहस्रं तत् तद् अविज्ञानं दत्वैवैनाम् अद्यया गवा निष्क्रीणीयाद् इति . तद् उ वा आहुर् दत्तं वै तथा भवति . गौर् इतरा गौर् इतरोर्णासूत्रस्यैवनाम् आविकस्य यावद् अर्हन्तीम् मन्येत तावता निष्क्रीणीयाद् इति . ऊर्णासूत्रम् उ वै गोः किञ्चिद् इव . दत्तम् अस्य सहस्रं भवति नात्मना रिच्यते . स यथा वागरया वा रज्ज्वा वा व्रजं परितनुयाद् एवम् एवैतत् पशून् परिगृह्णीते ऽपरावापाय .

sanskrit_iast: śabali samudro 'sy akṣitir brahmadevī prathamjā ṛtasyaikam akṣaraṃ kṣarasi vibhāvary abhīmān lokān amṛtaṃ duhānā tāṃ tvā vidma sarame dīdyānām akṣitiṃ devebhyo bhāsā tapantīm . tejo 'si śukram asy amṛtam asy annam asi mahad asy eṣāsi mahi tāṃ tvā tathā veda . tasyāṃ tvayy etāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ nidadhe 'kṣitim akṣīyamāṇāṃ śriyaṃ devānāṃ bṛhaj jyotir vasānāṃ prajānāṃ śaciṣṭhām āvṛtam anugeṣam iti . eṣā ha vai śaciṣṭhāvṛd yad asāv ādityaḥ . tasyā ete dve pade ahaś caiva rātriś ca satyaṃ cānṛtaṃ ca . tad dhāsyā etat satyaṃ padaṃ yad ahaḥ . tad etad atyāyu nāma .
sentences: śabali samudro 'sy akṣitir brahmadevī pratʰamjā r̥tasyaikam akṣaraṃ kṣarasi vibʰāvary abʰīmān lokān amr̥taṃ duhānā tāṃ tvā vidma sarame dīdyānām akṣitiṃ devebʰyo bʰāsā tapantīm .
tejo 'si śukram asy amr̥tam asy annam asi mahad asy eṣāsi mahi tāṃ tvā tatʰā veda .
tasyāṃ tvayy etāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ nidadʰe 'kṣitim akṣīyamāṇāṃ śriyaṃ devānāṃ br̥haj jyotir vasānāṃ prajānāṃ śaciṣṭʰām āvr̥tam anugeṣam iti .
eṣā ha vai śaciṣṭʰāvr̥d yad asāv ādityaḥ .
tasyā ete dve pade ahaś caiva rātriś ca satyaṃ cānr̥taṃ ca .
tad dʰāsyā etat satyaṃ padaṃ yad ahaḥ .
text: 'O speckled one, thou art the ocean, imperishable, divine of brahman, first-born of ṛta, thou flowest as one syllable, O radiant one; thou, milking immortality for these worlds -- we know thee, O Saramā, shining, imperishable, blazing for the gods with thy light. Thou art tejas, thou art śukra, thou art immortal, thou art food, thou art greatness, thou art eṣā, thou art mahī -- we know thee as such. In thee, upon thee, I place this gift -- imperishable, undecaying, the glory of the gods, clad in great light, the most potent among creatures, an envelopment, a chant of praise.' That sun yonder is indeed the most potent envelopment. Its two feet are day and night, truth and untruth. That foot of hers which is truth is day. That is called atyāyu by name.
meaning: शबलि समुद्रो ऽस्य् अक्षितिर् ब्रह्मदेवी प्रथम्जा ऋतस्यैकम् अक्षरं क्षरसि विभावर्य् अभीमान् लोकान् अमृतं दुहाना तां त्वा विद्म सरमे दीद्यानाम् अक्षितिं देवेभ्यो भासा तपन्तीम् . तेजो ऽसि शुक्रम् अस्य् अमृतम् अस्य् अन्नम् असि महद् अस्य् एषासि महि तां त्वा तथा वेद . तस्यां त्वय्य् एतां दक्षिणां निदधे ऽक्षितिम् अक्षीयमाणां श्रियं देवानां बृहज् ज्योतिर् वसानां प्रजानां शचिष्ठाम् आवृतम् अनुगेषम् इति . एषा ह वै शचिष्ठावृद् यद् असाव् आदित्यः . तस्या एते द्वे पदे अहश् चैव रात्रिश् च सत्यं चानृतं च . तद् धास्या एतत् सत्यं पदं यद् अहः . तद् एतद् अत्यायु नाम .

sanskrit_iast: athāsyā etat pṛśni śabalaṃ padaṃ yad rātriḥ . sa yo hāsya etat pṛśni śabalaṃ padaṃ veda pṛśnir eva prajayā paśubhi śriyā kīrtyāyuṣā bhavati . tad yathāgniṃ dīpyamānam upavājanenopavājayed evam evaitad brāhmaṇa ātmānaṃ saṃśyate satyaṃ vadan . sa satyam eva vadet satyaṃ caret satyaṃ cikīrṣet satyam eva bhavati . uta tv enam anṛtasya kāmo vindej jīvanakāmyā vā strīkāmyā vā narmakāmyā vā sakhikāmyā vā . rātryāṃ vā hainac chāyāyāṃ vā vadet . tathā hainaṃ tan na druṇīte/druṇāti . sve hy enad āyatane vadati . pṛthvī bekura iti .
sentences: atʰāsyā etat pr̥śni śabalaṃ padaṃ yad rātriḥ .
sa yo hāsya etat pr̥śni śabalaṃ padaṃ veda pr̥śnir eva prajayā paśubʰi śriyā kīrtyāyuṣā bʰavati .
tad yatʰāgniṃ dīpyamānam upavājanenopavājayed evam evaitad brāhmaṇa ātmānaṃ saṃśyate satyaṃ vadan .
sa satyam eva vadet satyaṃ caret satyaṃ cikīrṣet satyam eva bʰavati .
uta tv enam anr̥tasya kāmo vindej jīvanakāmyā vā strīkāmyā vā narmakāmyā vā sakʰikāmyā vā .
rātryāṃ vā hainac cʰāyāyāṃ vā vadet .
text: And that foot of hers which is speckled and mottled is night. He who knows this speckled, mottled foot of hers becomes speckled -- rich in offspring, cattle, prosperity, fame, and length of life. Just as one would fan a blazing fire with fuel, so a brāhmaṇa fans himself by speaking truth. He should speak only truth, practice truth, desire truth -- he indeed becomes truth. But if the desire for untruth should seize him -- whether for the sake of livelihood, for the sake of a woman, for the sake of jest, or for the sake of a friend -- he should speak it at night or in the shade. Then it does not harm him. For he speaks it in its own abode. 'The earth is bekura.'
meaning: अथास्या एतत् पृश्नि शबलं पदं यद् रात्रिः . स यो हास्य एतत् पृश्नि शबलं पदं वेद पृश्निर् एव प्रजया पशुभि श्रिया कीर्त्यायुषा भवति . तद् यथाग्निं दीप्यमानम् उपवाजनेनोपवाजयेद् एवम् एवैतद् ब्राह्मण आत्मानं संश्यते सत्यं वदन् . स सत्यम् एव वदेत् सत्यं चरेत् सत्यं चिकीर्षेत् सत्यम् एव भवति . उत त्व् एनम् अनृतस्य कामो विन्देज् जीवनकाम्या वा स्त्रीकाम्या वा नर्मकाम्या वा सखिकाम्या वा . रात्र्यां वा हैनच् छायायां वा वदेत् . तथा हैनं तन् न द्रुणीते/द्रुणाति . स्वे ह्य् एनद् आयतने वदति . पृथ्वी बेकुर इति .

sanskrit_iast: agne devāṇāṃ hotas tvaṃ devānāṃ hotāsy ahaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ sa na idaṃ brūhi yathedaṃ bhaviṣyati na sāma samaiti na stotryā no me lokās saṃkrāmanti varīyān yajamānasya loko bhavati . yat sāma sameyād yat stotryo yad ime lokās saṃkrāmeyur aṃhīyān yajamānasya loka syāt . gāyatraṃ samaiti . prāṇo vai gāyatram . sarvatra hy eva prāṇaḥ samaiti . yajñāyajñīyaṃ samaiti . vāg vai yajñāyajñīyam . sarvatra hy eva vāk ca prāṇaś ca sametaḥ . dve sāmanī sameto dvipād yajamānaḥ pratiṣṭhityai .
sentences: agne devāṇāṃ hotas tvaṃ devānāṃ hotāsy ahaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ sa na idaṃ brūhi yatʰedaṃ bʰaviṣyati na sāma samaiti na stotryā no me lokās saṃkrāmanti varīyān yajamānasya loko bʰavati .
yat sāma sameyād yat stotryo yad ime lokās saṃkrāmeyur aṃhīyān yajamānasya loka syāt .
sarvatra hy eva vāk ca prāṇaś ca sametaḥ .
dve sāmanī sameto dvipād yajamānaḥ pratiṣṭʰityai .
text: 'O Agni, hotṛ of the gods, thou art the hotṛ of the gods; I am the hotṛ of men. Tell us this: how it will be. The sāman does not meet, nor the stotriyas, nor do my worlds come together -- the world of the sacrificer becomes wider. If the sāman were to meet, if the stotriyas were to meet, if these worlds were to come together -- the world of the sacrificer would become narrower.' The gāyatra meets. Prāṇa is the gāyatra. For prāṇa meets everywhere. The yajñāyajñīya meets. Speech is the yajñāyajñīya. For speech and prāṇa meet everywhere. Two sāmans meet. The sacrificer is two-footed -- for firm standing.
meaning: अग्ने देवाणां होतस् त्वं देवानां होतास्य् अहं मनुष्याणां स न इदं ब्रूहि यथेदं भविष्यति न साम समैति न स्तोत्र्या नो मे लोकास् संक्रामन्ति वरीयान् यजमानस्य लोको भवति . यत् साम समेयाद् यत् स्तोत्र्यो यद् इमे लोकास् संक्रामेयुर् अंहीयान् यजमानस्य लोक स्यात् . गायत्रं समैति . प्राणो वै गायत्रम् . सर्वत्र ह्य् एव प्राणः समैति . यज्ञायज्ञीयं समैति . वाग् वै यज्ञायज्ञीयम् . सर्वत्र ह्य् एव वाक् च प्राणश् च समेतः . द्वे सामनी समेतो द्विपाद् यजमानः प्रतिष्ठित्यै .

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatir vāvedam agra āsīt . so 'kāmayata bahuḥ syāṃ prajāyeya bhūmānaṃ gaccheyam iti . so 'śocat . so 'tapyata . taṃ śocantaṃ tapyamānaṃ prāṇā abhyavadan vayaṃ vā imaṃ yajñam adṛśma tena tvā yājayāmeti . so 'bravīt taṃ katham adrāṣṭa katamam adrāṣṭeti . te 'bruvann āśrāvayāstu śrauṣaṭ . yajaye yajāmahe . vauṣaḍ ity etam adṛśmeti . so 'ved adṛśan vā iti . yat pañcāsan pāṅkto yajñaḥ . tenāved adṛśan vā iti . teṣām u yat pañcānāṃ satāṃ saptadaśākṣarāṇy āsan saptadaśaḥ prajāpatiḥ prājāpatyo yajñaḥ . teno evāved adṛśan vāveti . so 'bravīt te kena hoṣyāmaḥ kasmin hoṣyāma iti . te 'bruvaṃs tavaiva vapām utkhidya tāṃ tavaiva hṛdaye 'gnau sarvahutāṃ hoṣyāma iti . te prajāpater eva vapām udakhidan . vācam eva teṣāṃ prāṇa evāśrāvayad apānaḥ pratyāśrāvayat . mana eva hotāsīt . prajāpatir eva caturtho brahmā dakṣiṇata āsta . tāṃ prajāpater eva hṛdaye 'gnau sarvahutāṃ ajuhavuḥ . tāṃ yad avapaṃs tad vapāyai vapātvam . yad vo enāṃ tad ajuhavus tad enām avapan . tasmād u ha vaptavyam eva .
sentences: so 'kāmayata bahuḥ syāṃ prajāyeya bʰūmānaṃ gaccʰeyam iti .
taṃ śocantaṃ tapyamānaṃ prāṇā abʰyavadan vayaṃ vā imaṃ yajñam adr̥śma tena tvā yājayāmeti .
so 'bravīt taṃ katʰam adrāṣṭa katamam adrāṣṭeti .
teṣām u yat pañcānāṃ satāṃ saptadaśākṣarāṇy āsan saptadaśaḥ prajāpatiḥ prājāpatyo yajñaḥ .
so 'bravīt te kena hoṣyāmaḥ kasmin hoṣyāma iti .
te 'bruvaṃs tavaiva vapām utkʰidya tāṃ tavaiva hr̥daye 'gnau sarvahutāṃ hoṣyāma iti .
vācam eva teṣāṃ prāṇa evāśrāvayad apānaḥ pratyāśrāvayat .
prajāpatir eva caturtʰo brahmā dakṣiṇata āsta .
tāṃ prajāpater eva hr̥daye 'gnau sarvahutāṃ ajuhavuḥ .
tāṃ yad avapaṃs tad vapāyai vapātvam .
yad vo enāṃ tad ajuhavus tad enām avapan .
text: Prajāpati alone existed in the beginning. He desired: 'May I become many, may I be reproduced, may I reach abundance.' He grieved. He performed austerity. As he grieved and performed austerity, the prāṇas addressed him: 'We have seen this sacrifice; by it we shall make thee sacrifice.' He said: 'How did you see it? Which one did you see?' They said: 'Āśrāvaya -- astu śrauṣaṭ -- yajāmahe -- yajaye -- vauṣaṭ -- this is what we saw.' He knew: 'They have indeed seen it.' Because they were five, the sacrifice is fivefold. He knew: 'They have indeed seen it.' And because these five had seventeen syllables -- the saptadaśa is Prajāpati, the sacrifice is prājāpatya. He thereby knew: 'They have indeed seen it.' He said: 'With what shall we offer? In what shall we offer?' They said: 'Having cut out thy own vapā (omentum), we shall offer it, a complete oblation, in the fire of thy own heart.' They cut out the vapā of Prajāpati himself. Speech itself made the āśrāvaya; prāṇa itself was the one who called; apāna made the response. Mind itself was the hotṛ. Prajāpati himself was the fourth, the brahman priest, seated on the south. They offered it, a complete oblation, in the fire of Prajāpati's own heart. Because they offered it, that is the vapā-nature of the vapā. Because they offered it, they placed it. Therefore one should indeed offer the vapā.
meaning: प्रजापतिर् वावेदम् अग्र आसीत् . सो ऽकामयत बहुः स्यां प्रजायेय भूमानं गच्छेयम् इति . सो ऽशोचत् . सो ऽतप्यत . तं शोचन्तं तप्यमानं प्राणा अभ्यवदन् वयं वा इमं यज्ञम् अदृश्म तेन त्वा याजयामेति . सो ऽब्रवीत् तं कथम् अद्राष्ट कतमम् अद्राष्टेति . ते ऽब्रुवन्न् आश्रावयास्तु श्रौषट् . यजये यजामहे . वौषड् इत्य् एतम् अदृश्मेति . सो ऽवेद् अदृशन् वा इति . यत् पञ्चासन् पाङ्क्तो यज्ञः . तेनावेद् अदृशन् वा इति . तेषाम् उ यत् पञ्चानां सतां सप्तदशाक्षराण्य् आसन् सप्तदशः प्रजापतिः प्राजापत्यो यज्ञः . तेनो एवावेद् अदृशन् वावेति . सो ऽब्रवीत् ते केन होष्यामः कस्मिन् होष्याम इति . ते ऽब्रुवंस् तवैव वपाम् उत्खिद्य तां तवैव हृदये ऽग्नौ सर्वहुतां होष्याम इति . ते प्रजापतेर् एव वपाम् उदखिदन् . वाचम् एव तेषां प्राण एवाश्रावयद् अपानः प्रत्याश्रावयत् . मन एव होतासीत् . प्रजापतिर् एव चतुर्थो ब्रह्मा दक्षिणत आस्त . तां प्रजापतेर् एव हृदये ऽग्नौ सर्वहुतां अजुहवुः . तां यद् अवपंस् तद् वपायै वपात्वम् . यद् वो एनां तद् अजुहवुस् तद् एनाम् अवपन् . तस्माद् उ ह वप्तव्यम् एव .

sanskrit_iast: - śveto lomaśas tūparo lapsugy anyatodaṃś catuṣpād ajāyata . tasmin sarvāṇi rūpāṇi paryapaśyan . te 'bruvann imāni vā asmin sarvāṇi rūpāṇi . etemam evālabhāmahā iti . te tam ālabhanta . teṣāṃ prāṇa evāśrāvayad apānaḥ pratyāśrāvayat . mana eva hotāsīt . prajāpatir eva caturtho brahmā dakṣiṇata āsta . taṃ prajāpater eva hṛdaye 'gnau sarvahutaṃ ajuhavuḥ . tasmād dhutād agnir devatājāyata . tad ṛco vedaḥ . anu vāyur devatājāyata . tad yajūṃṣi vedaḥ . anv ādityo devatājāyata . tat sāmāni vedaḥ . anv ete ca trayo devānāṃ śreṣṭhā ajāyantaitāś ca tisro viyāḥ . śaśvad dhaitāvad eva prajāpatinā sṛṣṭam . athaitābhir eva devatābhir idam itarat sarvam . te 'bruvan yena naḥ pitā prajāpatir yajñeneṣṭvārātsīt tena yajāmahā iti . te tam āharanta . teṣāṃ vāyur evāśrāvayad ādityaḥ pratyāśrāvayat . agnir eva hotāsīt .
sentences: - śveto lomaśas tūparo lapsugy anyatodaṃś catuṣpād ajāyata .
te 'bruvann imāni vā asmin sarvāṇi rūpāṇi .
prajāpatir eva caturtʰo brahmā dakṣiṇata āsta .
taṃ prajāpater eva hr̥daye 'gnau sarvahutaṃ ajuhavuḥ .
anv ete ca trayo devānāṃ śreṣṭʰā ajāyantaitāś ca tisro viyāḥ .
atʰaitābʰir eva devatābʰir idam itarat sarvam .
te 'bruvan yena naḥ pitā prajāpatir yajñeneṣṭvārātsīt tena yajāmahā iti .
text: A white, hairy, four-footed animal was born, with long ears and teeth on one side. In it they saw all forms. They said: 'All forms are in this one. Let us sacrifice this very one.' They sacrificed it. Prāṇa made the āśrāvaya; apāna made the response. Mind was the hotṛ. Prajāpati was the fourth, the brahman priest, seated on the south. They offered it, a complete oblation, in the fire of Prajāpati's heart. From that offering, Agni was born as a deity. That is the Ṛc Veda. After him, Vāyu was born as a deity. That is the Yajus Veda. After him, Āditya was born as a deity. That is the Sāma Veda. After them, these three foremost among the gods were born, and these three expanses. Only this much was created by Prajāpati directly. But by these very deities, all the rest was created. They said: 'With the same sacrifice by which our father Prajāpati sacrificed and succeeded, let us sacrifice.' They brought it. Vāyu made the āśrāvaya; Āditya made the response. Agni was the hotṛ.
meaning: - श्वेतो लोमशस् तूपरो लप्सुग्य् अन्यतोदंश् चतुष्पाद् अजायत . तस्मिन् सर्वाणि रूपाणि पर्यपश्यन् . ते ऽब्रुवन्न् इमानि वा अस्मिन् सर्वाणि रूपाणि . एतेमम् एवालभामहा इति . ते तम् आलभन्त . तेषां प्राण एवाश्रावयद् अपानः प्रत्याश्रावयत् . मन एव होतासीत् . प्रजापतिर् एव चतुर्थो ब्रह्मा दक्षिणत आस्त . तं प्रजापतेर् एव हृदये ऽग्नौ सर्वहुतं अजुहवुः . तस्माद् धुताद् अग्निर् देवताजायत . तद् ऋचो वेदः . अनु वायुर् देवताजायत . तद् यजूंषि वेदः . अन्व् आदित्यो देवताजायत . तत् सामानि वेदः . अन्व् एते च त्रयो देवानां श्रेष्ठा अजायन्तैताश् च तिस्रो वियाः . शश्वद् धैतावद् एव प्रजापतिना सृष्टम् . अथैताभिर् एव देवताभिर् इदम् इतरत् सर्वम् . ते ऽब्रुवन् येन नः पिता प्रजापतिर् यज्ञेनेष्ट्वारात्सीत् तेन यजामहा इति . ते तम् आहरन्त . तेषां वायुर् एवाश्रावयद् आदित्यः प्रत्याश्रावयत् . अग्निर् एव होतासीत् .

sanskrit_iast: ta eva caturhotāram āsata . ete ha vāva caturhotāro yān imān āhuś caturhotr̥̄n . teṣāṃ sahasratamyām āhutyāṃ gaur ājāyata . tasyāṃ sarvān bhogān paryapaśyan ye ke ca gavi bhogās tān . te 'bruvann ime vā asyāṃ sarve bhogāḥ . etemām eva pra ṇo janayeti bravāmeti . tām abruvan pra ṇo janayeti . sā trayastriṃśataṃ ca trīṇi ca śatāny āgnaye Lies doch wohl so statt agnaye . prājanayat . trayastriṃśataṃ ca trīṇi ca śatāni vāyave prājanayat . trayastriṃśataṃ ca trīṇi ca śatāni ādityāya prājanayat . tat sahasram abhavat . saiva sahasratamī . tāṃ punar ājāyata . sa yo haivaṃ vidvān gā rakṣate pra haivāsya sahasram āpnuvanti . tasmād u haivaṃvidā rakṣitavyā eva gāvaḥ . te 'bruvann alaṃ vai tasmai smo yan nānāśo viparetya yajamānā āsīmahy eta nānāśo viparetya yajamānā āsāmahā iti . te nānāśo viparetya yajamānā āsata . te naiva śreyāṃso 'bhavan na pāpīyāṃsaḥ . te 'bruvan na vai śreyāṃso 'bhūma na pāpīyāṃsaḥ .
sentences: ete ha vāva caturhotāro yān imān āhuś caturhotr̥̄n .
tasyāṃ sarvān bʰogān paryapaśyan ye ke ca gavi bʰogās tān .
te 'bruvann ime vā asyāṃ sarve bʰogāḥ .
etemām eva pra ṇo janayeti bravāmeti .
sā trayastriṃśataṃ ca trīṇi ca śatāny āgnaye Lies doch wohl so statt agnaye . prājanayat .
trayastriṃśataṃ ca trīṇi ca śatāni vāyave prājanayat .
trayastriṃśataṃ ca trīṇi ca śatāni ādityāya prājanayat .
sa yo haivaṃ vidvān gā rakṣate pra haivāsya sahasram āpnuvanti .
tasmād u haivaṃvidā rakṣitavyā eva gāvaḥ .
te 'bruvann alaṃ vai tasmai smo yan nānāśo viparetya yajamānā āsīmahy eta nānāśo viparetya yajamānā āsāmahā iti .
te 'bruvan na vai śreyāṃso 'bʰūma na pāpīyāṃsaḥ .
text: Those same four sat as the caturhotṛs. These are indeed the caturhotṛs whom they speak of as the 'four hotṛs.' At their thousandth oblation, a cow was born. In her they saw all enjoyments -- whatever enjoyments are in a cow. They said: 'All enjoyments are in this one. Let us tell her to produce for us.' They said to her: 'Produce for us.' She produced three hundred and thirty-three for Agni. She produced three hundred and thirty-three for Vāyu. She produced three hundred and thirty-three for Āditya. That became a thousand. She is the thousandth. She was born again. He who, knowing thus, guards cattle -- his cattle indeed multiply to a thousand. Therefore cattle should be guarded by one who knows thus. They said: 'We have enough; let us not go separately in different directions as sacrificers. Let us go separately in different directions as sacrificers.' They went separately in different directions as sacrificers. They became neither better nor worse. They said: 'We have become neither better nor worse.'
meaning: त एव चतुर्होतारम् आसत . एते ह वाव चतुर्होतारो यान् इमान् आहुश् चतुर्होत्र्̥̄न् . तेषां सहस्रतम्याम् आहुत्यां गौर् आजायत . तस्यां सर्वान् भोगान् पर्यपश्यन् ये के च गवि भोगास् तान् . ते ऽब्रुवन्न् इमे वा अस्यां सर्वे भोगाः . एतेमाम् एव प्र णो जनयेति ब्रवामेति . ताम् अब्रुवन् प्र णो जनयेति . सा त्रयस्त्रिंशतं च त्रीणि च शतान्य् आग्नये Lइएस् दोछ् wओह्ल् सो स्तत्त् अग्नये . प्राजनयत् . त्रयस्त्रिंशतं च त्रीणि च शतानि वायवे प्राजनयत् . त्रयस्त्रिंशतं च त्रीणि च शतानि आदित्याय प्राजनयत् . तत् सहस्रम् अभवत् . सैव सहस्रतमी . तां पुनर् आजायत . स यो हैवं विद्वान् गा रक्षते प्र हैवास्य सहस्रम् आप्नुवन्ति . तस्माद् उ हैवंविदा रक्षितव्या एव गावः . ते ऽब्रुवन्न् अलं वै तस्मै स्मो यन् नानाशो विपरेत्य यजमाना आसीमह्य् एत नानाशो विपरेत्य यजमाना आसामहा इति . ते नानाशो विपरेत्य यजमाना आसत . ते नैव श्रेयांसो ऽभवन् न पापीयांसः . ते ऽब्रुवन् न वै श्रेयांसो ऽभूम न पापीयांसः .

sanskrit_iast: tat sārdhaṃ sahasraṃ samākurvan . tad eṣāṃ sahasraṃ saṃkhyāna ekasyai gor nodabhavat . te 'bruvan prajāpatim evemāṃ sahasratamīṃ yācāmahā iti . te prajāpatim eva tāṃ sahasratamīm ayācanta . sa prajāpatir aikṣata yady ebhyaḥ pradāsyāmi rekṣye yady ebhyo na pradāsyāmy ūnam eṣāṃ sahasraṃ bhaviṣyati . haintainān sahaivānayābhyupayānīti . tān abravīt sahaiva vo 'ham anayābhyupayānīti . tatheti . tāṃs tayaiva sahābhyupait . ta etaṃ trirātraṃ yajñam apaśyat . tam āharanta . so 'bravīt samenā3nena yajñena yakṣāmahā3 asamenā3 iti . samenety abruvan . yat samenety abruvan sama eva tad varṣam akurvata same rāṣṭraṃ saṃjñāṃ eva tad akurvata . atha yad avakṣyann asamenety asama eva varṣam abhaviṣyad asame rāṣṭram asaṃjñābhaviṣyat . te kena sameṣyāma iti . yajñāyajñīyeneti . tasmād yajñāyajñīyenaiva saṃyanti . vāg vai yajñāyajñīyam . vāg ime lokāḥ . vācaiva tad vācam ārohan . te trayastriṃśataṃ ca trīṇi ca śatāni prathame 'hann adaduḥ . tenāsmin loke 'gnir arādhnot . trayastriṃśataṃ ca trīṇi ca śatāni dvitīye 'hann adaduḥ . tenāsmin antarikṣe loke vāyur arādhnot . trayastriṃśataṃ ca trīṇi ca śatāni tṛtīye 'hann adaduḥ . tenāmuṣmin loka ādityo 'rādhnot .
sentences: tad eṣāṃ sahasraṃ saṃkʰyāna ekasyai gor nodabʰavat .
te 'bruvan prajāpatim evemāṃ sahasratamīṃ yācāmahā iti .
te prajāpatim eva tāṃ sahasratamīm ayācanta .
sa prajāpatir aikṣata yady ebʰyaḥ pradāsyāmi rekṣye yady ebʰyo na pradāsyāmy ūnam eṣāṃ sahasraṃ bʰaviṣyati .
so 'bravīt samenā3nena yajñena yakṣāmahā3 asamenā3 iti .
yat samenety abruvan sama eva tad varṣam akurvata same rāṣṭraṃ saṃjñāṃ eva tad akurvata .
atʰa yad avakṣyann asamenety asama eva varṣam abʰaviṣyad asame rāṣṭram asaṃjñābʰaviṣyat .
te trayastriṃśataṃ ca trīṇi ca śatāni pratʰame 'hann adaduḥ .
trayastriṃśataṃ ca trīṇi ca śatāni dvitīye 'hann adaduḥ .
trayastriṃśataṃ ca trīṇi ca śatāni tr̥tīye 'hann adaduḥ .
text: They gathered the thousand together. But the thousand came to one cow short in the count. They said: 'Let us ask Prajāpati for this thousandth cow.' They asked Prajāpati for the thousandth. Prajāpati reflected: 'If I give it to them, I shall be diminished. If I do not give it to them, their thousand will be incomplete. Let me go together with them along with her.' He said to them: 'I shall go together with you along with her.' 'So be it.' He went together with them along with her. They saw this trirātra sacrifice. They brought it. He said: 'Shall we sacrifice with this sacrifice in agreement or in disagreement?' 'In agreement,' they said. Because they said 'in agreement,' they thereby made the seasons equal, the kingdom equal; they established concord. But had they said 'in disagreement,' the seasons would have been unequal, the kingdom unequal; there would have been discord. 'By what shall we come to agreement?' 'By the yajñāyajñīya.' Therefore they come to agreement through the yajñāyajñīya. Speech is the yajñāyajñīya. Speech is these worlds. By speech they ascended to speech. They gave three hundred and thirty-three on the first day. By that, Agni succeeded in this world. They gave three hundred and thirty-three on the second day. By that, Vāyu succeeded in the atmospheric world. They gave three hundred and thirty-three on the third day. By that, Āditya succeeded in the yonder world.
meaning: तत् सार्धं सहस्रं समाकुर्वन् . तद् एषां सहस्रं संख्यान एकस्यै गोर् नोदभवत् . ते ऽब्रुवन् प्रजापतिम् एवेमां सहस्रतमीं याचामहा इति . ते प्रजापतिम् एव तां सहस्रतमीम् अयाचन्त . स प्रजापतिर् ऐक्षत यद्य् एभ्यः प्रदास्यामि रेक्ष्ये यद्य् एभ्यो न प्रदास्याम्य् ऊनम् एषां सहस्रं भविष्यति . हैन्तैनान् सहैवानयाभ्युपयानीति . तान् अब्रवीत् सहैव वो ऽहम् अनयाभ्युपयानीति . तथेति . तांस् तयैव सहाभ्युपैत् . त एतं त्रिरात्रं यज्ञम् अपश्यत् . तम् आहरन्त . सो ऽब्रवीत् समेना३नेन यज्ञेन यक्षामहा३ असमेना३ इति . समेनेत्य् अब्रुवन् . यत् समेनेत्य् अब्रुवन् सम एव तद् वर्षम् अकुर्वत समे राष्ट्रं संज्ञां एव तद् अकुर्वत . अथ यद् अवक्ष्यन्न् असमेनेत्य् असम एव वर्षम् अभविष्यद् असमे राष्ट्रम् असंज्ञाभविष्यत् . ते केन समेष्याम इति . यज्ञायज्ञीयेनेति . तस्माद् यज्ञायज्ञीयेनैव संयन्ति . वाग् वै यज्ञायज्ञीयम् . वाग् इमे लोकाः . वाचैव तद् वाचम् आरोहन् . ते त्रयस्त्रिंशतं च त्रीणि च शतानि प्रथमे ऽहन्न् अददुः . तेनास्मिन् लोके ऽग्निर् अराध्नोत् . त्रयस्त्रिंशतं च त्रीणि च शतानि द्वितीये ऽहन्न् अददुः . तेनास्मिन् अन्तरिक्षे लोके वायुर् अराध्नोत् . त्रयस्त्रिंशतं च त्रीणि च शतानि तृतीये ऽहन्न् अददुः . तेनामुष्मिन् लोक आदित्यो ऽराध्नोत् .

sanskrit_iast: sā yā sahasratamy āsa vidyud dhaiva sā bhūtvā prajāpatiṃ viveśa . tad eṣābhyanūcyate ayaṃ sa śiṅkte yena gaur abhīvṛtā mimāti māyuṃ dhvasanāv adhi śritā sā cittibhir ni hi cakāra martyaṃ vidyud bhavantī prati vavrim auhata iti . imāṃ haiva gāṃ rūpaṃ pratyuhya vidyud eva bhūtvā punaḥ prajāpatiṃ praviveśa . saiṣā vidyut sā yad etat stanayati dadadadadadeti . dadāni dadānīti haiva tat prajābhyo vṛṣṭim annādyaṃ prayacchati .
sentences: sā yā sahasratamy āsa vidyud dʰaiva sā bʰūtvā prajāpatiṃ viveśa .
ayaṃ sa śiṅkte yena gaur abʰīvr̥tā mimāti māyuṃ dʰvasanāv adʰi śritā
sā cittibʰir ni hi cakāra martyaṃ vidyud bʰavantī prati vavrim auhata
imāṃ haiva gāṃ rūpaṃ pratyuhya vidyud eva bʰūtvā punaḥ prajāpatiṃ praviveśa .
saiṣā vidyut sā yad etat stanayati dadadadadadeti .
dadāni dadānīti haiva tat prajābʰyo vr̥ṣṭim annādyaṃ prayaccʰati .
text: That thousandth cow became lightning and entered Prajāpati. On this there is a verse recited: 'This one bellows, by which the cow, enveloped, lows its plaintive cry, resting upon the desolate; she, by her purposes, has overcome the mortal; becoming lightning, she carried away the covering.' Having taken back the form of this very cow, becoming lightning, she entered Prajāpati again. She is this lightning. When it thunders -- 'dadadadada' -- she is saying 'I give, I will give,' bestowing rain and food upon the creatures.
meaning: सा या सहस्रतम्य् आस विद्युद् धैव सा भूत्वा प्रजापतिं विवेश . तद् एषाभ्यनूच्यते अयं स शिङ्क्ते येन गौर् अभीवृता मिमाति मायुं ध्वसनाव् अधि श्रिता सा चित्तिभिर् नि हि चकार मर्त्यं विद्युद् भवन्ती प्रति वव्रिम् औहत इति . इमां हैव गां रूपं प्रत्युह्य विद्युद् एव भूत्वा पुनः प्रजापतिं प्रविवेश . सैषा विद्युत् सा यद् एतत् स्तनयति ददददददेति . ददानि ददानीति हैव तत् प्रजाभ्यो वृष्टिम् अन्नाद्यं प्रयच्छति .

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣo 'śvamedhaḥ . prajananakāmo haitena yajeta . prajāpatir vā akāmayata bahuḥ prajayā paśubhiḥ prajāyeya vīmān lokān āpnuyām avendriyaṃ vīryaṃ rundhīyeti . sa etaṃ yajñam apaśyat . tam āharat . tenāyajata . tato vai sa bahuḥ prajayā paśubhiḥ prājāyata vīmān lokān āpnod avendriyaṃ vīryam arunddha . sa yaḥ kāmayeta bahuḥ prajayā paśubhiḥ prajāyeya vīmān lokān āpnuyām avendriyaṃ vīryaṃ rundhīyeti sa etena yajeta . bahur eva prajayā paśubhiḥ prajāyate vīmān lokān āpnoty avendriyaṃ vīryaṃ runddhe . sa vā eṣa vīryam eva yajñaḥ . yarhi vā etena purejire sarvam eva vīryavad āsa ṛṣir ha sma mantrakṛd brāhmaṇa ājāyate 'tivyādhī rājanyaś śūraḥ poṣayiṣṇur vaiśyo rayimān utthātā śūdro dakṣaḥ karmakartā kalyāṇya striyaḥ pativratāḥ . akṛṣṭapacyaṃ ha sma dhānyaṃ pacyate . api ha smaiko vrīhipātraḥ pakvaḥ kulāyālaṃ bhavati . tathā payasvad dha tarhi sarvam evāsa . api ha smāraṇye vīryāṇy upajāyante 'ghalās siṃhā aghalāś śārdūlā aghalā ṛkṣā ṛkṣīkā aghalā ahayo 'jagarāḥ . puruṣavyāghrā ha smāraṇyeṣv ādadānās tiṣṭhanti . api ha smaikaḥ śiṃśumāro bahūni tīrthāni gopāyati .
sentences: prajāpatir vā akāmayata bahuḥ prajayā paśubʰiḥ prajāyeya vīmān lokān āpnuyām avendriyaṃ vīryaṃ rundʰīyeti .
tato vai sa bahuḥ prajayā paśubʰiḥ prājāyata vīmān lokān āpnod avendriyaṃ vīryam arunddʰa .
sa yaḥ kāmayeta bahuḥ prajayā paśubʰiḥ prajāyeya vīmān lokān āpnuyām avendriyaṃ vīryaṃ rundʰīyeti sa etena yajeta .
bahur eva prajayā paśubʰiḥ prajāyate vīmān lokān āpnoty avendriyaṃ vīryaṃ runddʰe .
sa vā eṣa vīryam eva yajñaḥ .

yarhi vā etena purejire sarvam eva vīryavad āsa r̥ṣir ha sma mantrakr̥d brāhmaṇa ājāyate 'tivyādʰī rājanyaś śūraḥ poṣayiṣṇur vaiśyo rayimān uttʰātā śūdro dakṣaḥ karmakartā kalyāṇya striyaḥ pativratāḥ .
api ha smaiko vrīhipātraḥ pakvaḥ kulāyālaṃ bʰavati .
tatʰā payasvad dʰa tarhi sarvam evāsa .
api ha smāraṇye vīryāṇy upajāyante 'gʰalās siṃhā agʰalāś śārdūlā agʰalā r̥kṣā r̥kṣīkā agʰalā ahayo 'jagarāḥ .
api ha smaikaḥ śiṃśumāro bahūni tīrtʰāni gopāyati .
text: Now this is the aśvamedha. One desiring offspring should sacrifice with this. Prajāpati desired: 'May I be abundant in offspring and cattle, may I attain these worlds, may I secure vigor and power.' He saw this sacrifice. He brought it. He sacrificed with it. Thereupon he became abundant in offspring and cattle, attained these worlds, and secured vigor and power. He who desires 'May I be abundant in offspring and cattle, may I attain these worlds, may I secure vigor and power' should sacrifice with this. He indeed becomes abundant in offspring and cattle, attains these worlds, and secures vigor and power. This is indeed a sacrifice of power. When in former times they sacrificed with this, everything was full of power. A brāhmaṇa was born as a ṛṣi, a mantra-composer; a rājanya as a supreme archer, a hero; a vaiśya as a prosperous, wealthy man; a śūdra as a capable worker; women were virtuous and devoted to their husbands. Grain ripened without cultivation. And a single cooked rice-dish was enough for an entire family. Likewise everything was full of milk at that time. And even in the wilderness, powerful creatures were born: fearless lions, fearless tigers, fearless bears and she-bears, fearless serpents and pythons. Man-tigers stood guard in the forests. And a single dolphin guarded many fords.
meaning: अथैषो ऽश्वमेधः . प्रजननकामो हैतेन यजेत . प्रजापतिर् वा अकामयत बहुः प्रजया पशुभिः प्रजायेय वीमान् लोकान् आप्नुयाम् अवेन्द्रियं वीर्यं रुन्धीयेति . स एतं यज्ञम् अपश्यत् . तम् आहरत् . तेनायजत . ततो वै स बहुः प्रजया पशुभिः प्राजायत वीमान् लोकान् आप्नोद् अवेन्द्रियं वीर्यम् अरुन्द्ध . स यः कामयेत बहुः प्रजया पशुभिः प्रजायेय वीमान् लोकान् आप्नुयाम् अवेन्द्रियं वीर्यं रुन्धीयेति स एतेन यजेत . बहुर् एव प्रजया पशुभिः प्रजायते वीमान् लोकान् आप्नोत्य् अवेन्द्रियं वीर्यं रुन्द्धे . स वा एष वीर्यम् एव यज्ञः . यर्हि वा एतेन पुरेजिरे सर्वम् एव वीर्यवद् आस ऋषिर् ह स्म मन्त्रकृद् ब्राह्मण आजायते ऽतिव्याधी राजन्यश् शूरः पोषयिष्णुर् वैश्यो रयिमान् उत्थाता शूद्रो दक्षः कर्मकर्ता कल्याण्य स्त्रियः पतिव्रताः . अकृष्टपच्यं ह स्म धान्यं पच्यते . अपि ह स्मैको व्रीहिपात्रः पक्वः कुलायालं भवति . तथा पयस्वद् ध तर्हि सर्वम् एवास . अपि ह स्मारण्ये वीर्याण्य् उपजायन्ते ऽघलास् सिंहा अघलाश् शार्दूला अघला ऋक्षा ऋक्षीका अघला अहयो ऽजगराः . पुरुषव्याघ्रा ह स्मारण्येष्व् आददानास् तिष्ठन्ति . अपि ह स्मैकः शिंशुमारो बहूनि तीर्थानि गोपायति .

sanskrit_iast: tad āhur yaḥkathaṃ sa (?) ālabhya iti . ya eva dūre śrutas sa ālabhya ity āhuḥ . vīryeṇa vai sa śrutaḥ . vīryam eṣa yajña iti . atho āhur ya eva yugyayor vahīyān sa ālabhya iti . vīryeṇa ha vai sa tayor vahīyān . vīryam eṣa yajña iti . tasmin ha śaunakaś ca kāpeyo 'bhipratāraṇaś ca samūdāte yaḥkathaṃrūpas sa ālabhya iti . tau ha kṛṣṇapiśaṅge saṃpādayāṃ cakratuḥ . yasya śvetasya sataḥ kṛṣṇam asti kṛṣṇasya vā sata śvetaṃ sa eva saḥ prajāpatinyaṅgaḥ . prajāpater akṣy aśvayat . tat parāpatat . tad apaḥ prāviśat . tato 'śvas samabhavat . yad aśvayat tasmād aśvaḥ . yac chvayathos samabhavat tasmāt pūtir yad apaḥ prāviśat tasmāc chvetanaḥ l . śvetavarṇaḥ ? śvetasya vā vai sato 'kṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇam asti kṛṣṇasya vā sata śvetam . sa eva sa prajāpatinyaṅgaḥ .
sentences: tad āhur yaḥkatʰaṃ sa (?) ālabʰya iti .
ya eva dūre śrutas sa ālabʰya ity āhuḥ .
atʰo āhur ya eva yugyayor vahīyān sa ālabʰya iti .
vīryeṇa ha vai sa tayor vahīyān .
tasmin ha śaunakaś ca kāpeyo 'bʰipratāraṇaś ca samūdāte yaḥkatʰaṃrūpas sa ālabʰya iti .
yasya śvetasya sataḥ kr̥ṣṇam asti kr̥ṣṇasya vā sata śvetaṃ sa eva saḥ prajāpatinyaṅgaḥ .
yac cʰvayatʰos samabʰavat tasmāt pūtir yad apaḥ prāviśat tasmāc cʰvetanaḥ l . śvetavarṇaḥ ?
śvetasya vā vai sato 'kṣṇaḥ kr̥ṣṇam asti kr̥ṣṇasya vā sata śvetam .
text: On this they say: 'Which one should be seized [for sacrifice]?' They say: 'The one that is famous from afar should be seized.' For he is famous by his vigor. This sacrifice is vigor. And they also say: 'Whichever of a yoked pair draws more, that one should be seized.' For by vigor indeed he draws more of the two. This sacrifice is vigor. On this, Saunaka Kapeya and Abhipratarina came to an agreement: 'What kind should be seized?' They determined upon a dark-tawny one. When a white one has something black, or a black one has something white -- that is the one marked by Prajapati. Prajapati's eye swelled. It flew away. It entered the waters. From that the horse came into being. Because it swelled (asvayat), therefore it is 'horse' (asva). Because it swelled (svayat) and came into being, therefore it putrefies. Because it entered the waters, therefore it is white (svetana). Of white color? Of a white one indeed, the eye has something black, or of a black one something white. That is the one marked by Prajapati.
meaning: तद् आहुर् यःकथं स (?) आलभ्य इति . य एव दूरे श्रुतस् स आलभ्य इत्य् आहुः . वीर्येण वै स श्रुतः . वीर्यम् एष यज्ञ इति . अथो आहुर् य एव युग्ययोर् वहीयान् स आलभ्य इति . वीर्येण ह वै स तयोर् वहीयान् . वीर्यम् एष यज्ञ इति . तस्मिन् ह शौनकश् च कापेयो ऽभिप्रतारणश् च समूदाते यःकथंरूपस् स आलभ्य इति . तौ ह कृष्णपिशङ्गे संपादयां चक्रतुः . यस्य श्वेतस्य सतः कृष्णम् अस्ति कृष्णस्य वा सत श्वेतं स एव सः प्रजापतिन्यङ्गः . प्रजापतेर् अक्ष्य् अश्वयत् . तत् परापतत् . तद् अपः प्राविशत् . ततो ऽश्वस् समभवत् . यद् अश्वयत् तस्माद् अश्वः . यच् छ्वयथोस् समभवत् तस्मात् पूतिर् यद् अपः प्राविशत् तस्माच् छ्वेतनः ल् . श्वेतवर्णः ? श्वेतस्य वा वै सतो ऽक्ष्णः कृष्णम् अस्ति कृष्णस्य वा सत श्वेतम् . स एव स प्रजापतिन्यङ्गः .

sanskrit_iast: tena haitena mauṇḍibha udanyur īja udanyūnāṃ rājā . tad dha yavakrīḥ saumastambir āstāvaṃ prati niṣasāda . tasya h āyaṃ pūṣā rayir bhaga ity etāḥ pratipadaś cakruḥ . sa hovāca chaṃbaṇ māsthā mauṇḍibhāpa prāṇān arātsīr iti . eṣa ha tarhy anuvyāhāra āsa . atha ha mauṇḍibha udanyus trayyai vidyāyai kassavita āsa . sa hovācasaṃvṛhata me sadohavirdhāne mṛdā me grahān saṃdihya nidhatta . yarhy ayaṃ brāhmaṇo 'nuvyāhārī martā tarhi yaṣṭāsa iti . tasya ha mṛdā grahān saṃdihya nidadhuḥ . atha ha yavakrīḥ saumastaṃbis tejasvī brahmavarcasy āsa . sa ha sma yām acchābrūte yā ha smainaṃ kāmayate mriyate ha sma . yo ha smainaṃ na kāmayate mriyata u eva . sa ha yajñavacaso rājastaṃbāyanasya jāyām acchoce . sā hekṣāṃ cakre yadi vā enaṃ kāmayiṣye yadi ca na mariṣyaty eva syā . hantainaṃ kāmayai . brāhmaṇasya cit syā priyaṃ kṛtvā mriyatād iti . taṃ hovācādas tiṣṭha .
sentences: tena haitena mauṇḍibʰa udanyur īja udanyūnāṃ rājā .
tad dʰa yavakrīḥ saumastambir āstāvaṃ prati niṣasāda .
tasya h āyaṃ pūṣā rayir bʰaga ity etāḥ pratipadaś cakruḥ .
sa hovāca cʰaṃbaṇ māstʰā mauṇḍibʰāpa prāṇān arātsīr iti .
atʰa ha mauṇḍibʰa udanyus trayyai vidyāyai kassavita āsa .
sa hovācasaṃvr̥hata me sadohavirdʰāne mr̥dā me grahān saṃdihya nidʰatta .
yarhy ayaṃ brāhmaṇo 'nuvyāhārī martā tarhi yaṣṭāsa iti .
tasya ha mr̥dā grahān saṃdihya nidadʰuḥ .
atʰa ha yavakrīḥ saumastaṃbis tejasvī brahmavarcasy āsa .
sa ha sma yām accʰābrūte yā ha smainaṃ kāmayate mriyate ha sma .
yo ha smainaṃ na kāmayate mriyata u eva .
sa ha yajñavacaso rājastaṃbāyanasya jāyām accʰoce .
sā hekṣāṃ cakre yadi vā enaṃ kāmayiṣye yadi ca na mariṣyaty eva syā .
brāhmaṇasya cit syā priyaṃ kr̥tvā mriyatād iti .
text: With this, Mundibha Udanyu sacrificed, the king of the Udanyus. Then Yavakri Saumastambi sat down opposite the place of praise. For him they made these opening verses: 'This Pusan, wealth, Bhaga.' He said: 'O Sambana, do not stand there! Mundibha has given away his vital breaths.' That was indeed his counter-utterance at that time. Now Mundibha Udanyu was versed in the threefold knowledge. He said: 'Sweep my offering-hall and havirdhana for me, smear my cups with clay and set them down. When this brahmana counter-speaker dies, then I shall sacrifice.' They smeared his cups with clay and set them down. Now Yavakri Saumastambi was powerful and full of brahman-splendor. Whatever woman he spoke to, whatever woman desired him -- she died. And whoever did not desire him also died. He spoke to the wife of Yajnavacas Rajastambhayana. She considered: 'Whether I desire him or not, I shall die anyway. Let me desire him then. Let me die having done a pleasing thing for a brahmana.' She said to him: 'Stand there.'
meaning: तेन हैतेन मौण्डिभ उदन्युर् ईज उदन्यूनां राजा . तद् ध यवक्रीः सौमस्तम्बिर् आस्तावं प्रति निषसाद . तस्य ह् आयं पूषा रयिर् भग इत्य् एताः प्रतिपदश् चक्रुः . स होवाच छंबण् मास्था मौण्डिभाप प्राणान् अरात्सीर् इति . एष ह तर्ह्य् अनुव्याहार आस . अथ ह मौण्डिभ उदन्युस् त्रय्यै विद्यायै कस्सवित आस . स होवाचसंवृहत मे सदोहविर्धाने मृदा मे ग्रहान् संदिह्य निधत्त . यर्ह्य् अयं ब्राह्मणो ऽनुव्याहारी मर्ता तर्हि यष्टास इति . तस्य ह मृदा ग्रहान् संदिह्य निदधुः . अथ ह यवक्रीः सौमस्तंबिस् तेजस्वी ब्रह्मवर्चस्य् आस . स ह स्म याम् अच्छाब्रूते या ह स्मैनं कामयते म्रियते ह स्म . यो ह स्मैनं न कामयते म्रियत उ एव . स ह यज्ञवचसो राजस्तंबायनस्य जायाम् अच्छोचे . सा हेक्षां चक्रे यदि वा एनं कामयिष्ये यदि च न मरिष्यत्य् एव स्या . हन्तैनं कामयै . ब्राह्मणस्य चित् स्या प्रियं कृत्वा म्रियताद् इति . तं होवाचादस् तिष्ठ .

sanskrit_iast: tāṃ hālaṃkurvāṇāṃ rudatīṃ patir ājagāma . tāṃ hovāca kim alaṃkuruṣe kiṃ rodiṣīti . sā hovāca mariṣyasi hīty ātmānam evaitat kṛpaye . yavakrīr vai tyām acchāvocateti . sa hovācājyam ata āharateti . tad dha pavitrābhyām utpūya juhavāṃ cakāra yā no adya trāyāti bhāradvājasya saṃskṛtā preṇīm agnipriyām agne tāṃ mahyam ā vaha svāhā iti . tasyai hāyaḥkūṭahastaṃ gandharvam īrṣyum utthāpayāṃ cakāra . tam hovācāsau te jāyā yavakriyam abhyagāt . tad ihīti . tasyai hāyatyā upatastāra . sā ha siṣmiye . sa hovāca nāha kila te strike smetavyam . atha smayasa iti . kathā heti . mariṣyasi hīti . sā ha pādaṃ pragṛhṇaty uvāca na khalu tvaṃ puruṣetthaṃpadīṃ striyaṃ peciṣa iti . lomaśau hāsyā adhastāt pādāv āsatuḥ . saṃnipannau vā hāsaṃnipannau vāsatuḥ . atha hedam evāyaḥkūṭahasto gandharvo 'bhivicakrame . sa hovāca namas te 'stu .
sentences: tāṃ hovāca kim alaṃkuruṣe kiṃ rodiṣīti .
sā hovāca mariṣyasi hīty ātmānam evaitat kr̥paye .
tad dʰa pavitrābʰyām utpūya juhavāṃ cakāra
yā no adya trāyāti bʰāradvājasya saṃskr̥tā
preṇīm agnipriyām agne tāṃ mahyam ā vaha svāhā
tasyai hāyaḥkūṭahastaṃ gandʰarvam īrṣyum uttʰāpayāṃ cakāra .
tam hovācāsau te jāyā yavakriyam abʰyagāt .
sa hovāca nāha kila te strike smetavyam .
sā ha pādaṃ pragr̥hṇaty uvāca na kʰalu tvaṃ puruṣettʰaṃpadīṃ striyaṃ peciṣa iti .
text: Her husband came upon her while she was adorning herself and weeping. He said to her: 'Why are you adorning yourself? Why do you weep?' She said: 'Because you will die' -- thus [she lamented] for her own self. 'Yavakri has spoken to her,' [she explained]. He said: 'Bring ghee from here.' He purified it with two strainers and made an offering: 'She who protects us today, the refined one of Bharadvaja, the fire-beloved fuel-stick, O Agni, bring her to me, svaha!' He raised up for her an iron-fisted gandharva, a jealous one. He said to him: 'Your wife has gone to Yavakri. Go there!' When he arrived, he spread himself before her. She laughed. He said: 'A woman should certainly not laugh before a stranger. Yet you laugh?' 'How so?' [she asked]. 'Because you will die,' [he replied]. She seized his foot and said: 'Surely you will not cook a woman who walks in the manner of humans.' For her feet were hairy underneath. They were either lying together or not lying together. Then the iron-fisted gandharva strode forth.
meaning: तां हालंकुर्वाणां रुदतीं पतिर् आजगाम . तां होवाच किम् अलंकुरुषे किं रोदिषीति . सा होवाच मरिष्यसि हीत्य् आत्मानम् एवैतत् कृपये . यवक्रीर् वै त्याम् अच्छावोचतेति . स होवाचाज्यम् अत आहरतेति . तद् ध पवित्राभ्याम् उत्पूय जुहवां चकार या नो अद्य त्रायाति भारद्वाजस्य संस्कृता प्रेणीम् अग्निप्रियाम् अग्ने तां मह्यम् आ वह स्वाहा इति . तस्यै हायःकूटहस्तं गन्धर्वम् ईर्ष्युम् उत्थापयां चकार . तम् होवाचासौ ते जाया यवक्रियम् अभ्यगात् . तद् इहीति . तस्यै हायत्या उपतस्तार . सा ह सिष्मिये . स होवाच नाह किल ते स्त्रिके स्मेतव्यम् . अथ स्मयस इति . कथा हेति . मरिष्यसि हीति . सा ह पादं प्रगृह्णत्य् उवाच न खलु त्वं पुरुषेत्थंपदीं स्त्रियं पेचिष इति . लोमशौ हास्या अधस्तात् पादाव् आसतुः . संनिपन्नौ वा हासंनिपन्नौ वासतुः . अथ हेदम् एवायःकूटहस्तो गन्धर्वो ऽभिविचक्रमे . स होवाच नमस् ते ऽस्तु .

sanskrit_iast: asti vā na veti hovāca . yad eva te kiṃ ca pitu svaṃ tasya sarvasya purā sūryasyodetoś śiraś chinddhi . sā vaiva sā vā neti . sa ha tathā chettum upacakrame . te hocur adṛpad yavakrīr vibadhnāmeti . neti ha pitovāca . deveṣito vai me putraḥ karoti . eṣa eva tad veda yad atra śreya iti . tad dha badhiro grāme takṣā pratiṣidhyamānaṃ na śuśrāva . tasya ha ghnan pareyāya . sa ha ko nu no janas tṛṇeḍhīti . sa evāsya prajaghānety eke . ghnantam evainaṃ sūryo 'bhyudiyāya . tasyodite sa eva gandharvaḥ prajaghānety eke . yathā ha tu mamāra tathāsa .
sentences: yad eva te kiṃ ca pitu svaṃ tasya sarvasya purā sūryasyodetoś śiraś cʰinddʰi .
eṣa eva tad veda yad atra śreya iti .
tad dʰa badʰiro grāme takṣā pratiṣidʰyamānaṃ na śuśrāva .
sa ha ko nu no janas tr̥ṇeḍʰīti .
tasyodite sa eva gandʰarvaḥ prajagʰānety eke .
text: 'Is there [anything] or not?' he said. 'Whatever paternal property you have, cut off all of it before sunrise. Whether she be that one or not.' He then undertook to cut in that manner. They said: 'Yavakri has gone mad! Let us bind him!' 'No,' said the father. 'My son acts as driven by the gods. He alone knows what is best in this.' Now a deaf carpenter in the village did not hear the one being restrained. He went past while striking. [Yavakri asked:] 'Who will be the one to rub us with grass?' He struck him down -- so say some. The sun rose upon him while he was still striking. When [the sun] had risen, that very gandharva struck him down -- so say others. However he died, so it was.
meaning: अस्ति वा न वेति होवाच . यद् एव ते किं च पितु स्वं तस्य सर्वस्य पुरा सूर्यस्योदेतोश् शिरश् छिन्द्धि . सा वैव सा वा नेति . स ह तथा छेत्तुम् उपचक्रमे . ते होचुर् अदृपद् यवक्रीर् विबध्नामेति . नेति ह पितोवाच . देवेषितो वै मे पुत्रः करोति . एष एव तद् वेद यद् अत्र श्रेय इति . तद् ध बधिरो ग्रामे तक्षा प्रतिषिध्यमानं न शुश्राव . तस्य ह घ्नन् परेयाय . स ह को नु नो जनस् तृणेढीति . स एवास्य प्रजघानेत्य् एके . घ्नन्तम् एवैनं सूर्यो ऽभ्युदियाय . तस्योदिते स एव गन्धर्वः प्रजघानेत्य् एके . यथा ह तु ममार तथास .

sanskrit_iast: tad u ha mauṇḍibho 'nubudhyovāca saṃminuta me sadohavidhāne yājayata mā brāhmaṇāḥ . amṛta ha vai sa brāhmaṇo 'nuvyāhārīti . tasya ha tathā cakruḥ . tad u ha saumastambir anubudhyājagāma . sa ha tathaivāstāvaṃ pratiniṣasāda . tasya h āyaṃ pūṣā rayir bhaga ity etā eva pratipadaś cakruḥ . sa hovāca na vai kilāyaṃ rājanyabandhur imaṃ yajñakratuṃ vidāṃ cakāra . na vai kila me 'nenoktena putram avadhīt . etāvad vāva kila tyasya putrasyāyur abhūd iti . taṃ ha tac chaśāpa mariṣyaty ahāyaṃ rājanyabandhuḥ paro ime mauṇḍibhā bhaviṣyantīti . ta ete parābhūtā gotamā bruvāṇāś caranti . tasya vā etasya tarat sa mandī dhāvatī ty eva pratipado bhavanti taradvatīḥ . tasmād aśvo 'dhvānaṃ tariṣṭaḥ . dhāvadvatīr bhavanti . tasmād aśvo 'dhvānaṃ dhāvan samaśnute . samayy ekaṃ padaṃ bhavati .
sentences: tad u ha mauṇḍibʰo 'nubudʰyovāca saṃminuta me sadohavidʰāne yājayata mā brāhmaṇāḥ .
tasya h āyaṃ pūṣā rayir bʰaga ity etā eva pratipadaś cakruḥ .
sa hovāca na vai kilāyaṃ rājanyabandʰur imaṃ yajñakratuṃ vidāṃ cakāra .
na vai kila me 'nenoktena putram avadʰīt .
etāvad vāva kila tyasya putrasyāyur abʰūd iti .
taṃ ha tac cʰaśāpa mariṣyaty ahāyaṃ rājanyabandʰuḥ paro ime mauṇḍibʰā bʰaviṣyantīti .
ta ete parābʰūtā gotamā bruvāṇāś caranti .
tasya vā etasya tarat sa mandī dʰāvatī ty eva pratipado bʰavanti taradvatīḥ .
text: Then Mundibha, having become aware, said: 'Break open my offering-hall and havirdhana! Let the brahmanas make me sacrifice! That brahmana counter-speaker is indeed dead.' They did so for him. Then the Saumastambi, having become aware, came. He sat down at the place of praise in the same way. They made for him the same opening verses: 'This Pusan, wealth, Bhaga.' He said: 'This princeling did not know this sacrificial rite. He certainly did not slay my son by what he said. Just so much was the lifespan of his son.' He cursed him thus: 'This princeling shall die! These Mundibhas shall be destroyed!' They indeed wander about as ruined ones, calling themselves Gotamas. The opening verses of this [rite] are those beginning with 'Tarat sa mandi dhavati' -- they contain [the word] 'tarad' (crossing). Therefore the horse is best at crossing a path. They contain [the word] 'dhavad' (running). Therefore the horse attains the path by running. The verse has one foot [more].
meaning: तद् उ ह मौण्डिभो ऽनुबुध्योवाच संमिनुत मे सदोहविधाने याजयत मा ब्राह्मणाः . अमृत ह वै स ब्राह्मणो ऽनुव्याहारीति . तस्य ह तथा चक्रुः . तद् उ ह सौमस्तम्बिर् अनुबुध्याजगाम . स ह तथैवास्तावं प्रतिनिषसाद . तस्य ह् आयं पूषा रयिर् भग इत्य् एता एव प्रतिपदश् चक्रुः . स होवाच न वै किलायं राजन्यबन्धुर् इमं यज्ञक्रतुं विदां चकार . न वै किल मे ऽनेनोक्तेन पुत्रम् अवधीत् . एतावद् वाव किल त्यस्य पुत्रस्यायुर् अभूद् इति . तं ह तच् छशाप मरिष्यत्य् अहायं राजन्यबन्धुः परो इमे मौण्डिभा भविष्यन्तीति . त एते पराभूता गोतमा ब्रुवाणाश् चरन्ति . तस्य वा एतस्य तरत् स मन्दी धावती त्य् एव प्रतिपदो भवन्ति तरद्वतीः . तस्माद् अश्वो ऽध्वानं तरिष्टः . धावद्वतीर् भवन्ति . तस्माद् अश्वो ऽध्वानं धावन् समश्नुते . समय्य् एकं पदं भवति .

sanskrit_iast: Die Parallele ist 2,173. tasya catasṛṣu bahiṣpavamānaṃ bhavati . catuṣpādā vā aśvāḥ santaś catuśśaphāḥ . te ye catuṣpādāḥ paśavaś catuśśaphās tān evaitenāvarunddhe . aṣṭāsv-aṣṭāsv ājyāni . aṣṭāśaphā vai paśavaḥ . te ye 'ṣṭāśaphāḥ paśavas tān evaitenāvarunddhe . dvādaśo mādhyaṃdinaḥ . dvādaśākṣarā vai jagatī . paśavo jagatī . yat kṣudraṃ paśūnāṃ taj jāgatam . tad evaitenāvarunddhe . saviṃśa ārbhavaḥ pavamānaḥ . dve vā ete daśadaśinyau virājau yad viṃśatiḥ . viṃśatipratiṣṭhānā vai paśavo vairājāḥ . te ye viṃśatipratiṣṭhānāḥ paśavo vairājās tān evaitenāvarunddhe . atha caturviṃśam agniṣṭomasāma . catuṣpādā vai paśavo vairājāḥ . te ye catuṣpādāḥ paśavo vairājās tān evaitenāvarunddhe .
sentences: Die Parallele ist 2,173. tasya catasr̥ṣu bahiṣpavamānaṃ bʰavati .
te ye catuṣpādāḥ paśavaś catuśśapʰās tān evaitenāvarunddʰe .
dve vā ete daśadaśinyau virājau yad viṃśatiḥ .
te ye viṃśatipratiṣṭʰānāḥ paśavo vairājās tān evaitenāvarunddʰe .
te ye catuṣpādāḥ paśavo vairājās tān evaitenāvarunddʰe .
text: [The parallel is 2.173.] Its bahispavamana consists of groups of four. Horses indeed have four feet and four hooves. Those animals that have four feet and four hooves -- those he secures by this. The ajya [chants] are in groups of eight. Animals indeed have eight hooves. Those animals that have eight hooves -- those he secures by this. The midday [pressing] is twelve-fold. The jagati indeed has twelve syllables. Animals are [of the nature of] jagati. Whatever is small among animals, that is of the jagati. That he secures by this. The arbhava pavamana is twenty-fold. These two are the ten-by-ten viraj meters that make twenty. Animals that have twenty supports are of the viraj. Those animals that have twenty supports and are of the viraj -- those he secures by this. Then the agnistoma-saman is twenty-four-fold. Animals that have four feet are of the viraj. Those animals that have four feet and are of the viraj -- those he secures by this.
meaning: Dइए Pअरल्लेले इस्त् २,१७३. तस्य चतसृषु बहिष्पवमानं भवति . चतुष्पादा वा अश्वाः सन्तश् चतुश्शफाः . ते ये चतुष्पादाः पशवश् चतुश्शफास् तान् एवैतेनावरुन्द्धे . अष्टास्व्-अष्टास्व् आज्यानि . अष्टाशफा वै पशवः . ते ये ऽष्टाशफाः पशवस् तान् एवैतेनावरुन्द्धे . द्वादशो माध्यंदिनः . द्वादशाक्षरा वै जगती . पशवो जगती . यत् क्षुद्रं पशूनां तज् जागतम् . तद् एवैतेनावरुन्द्धे . सविंश आर्भवः पवमानः . द्वे वा एते दशदशिन्यौ विराजौ यद् विंशतिः . विंशतिप्रतिष्ठाना वै पशवो वैराजाः . ते ये विंशतिप्रतिष्ठानाः पशवो वैराजास् तान् एवैतेनावरुन्द्धे . अथ चतुर्विंशम् अग्निष्टोमसाम . चतुष्पादा वै पशवो वैराजाः . ते ये चतुष्पादाः पशवो वैराजास् तान् एवैतेनावरुन्द्धे .

text: Having enclosed it, they make the offering on this second day. This second day is of the ekavimsa [stoma], of a single stoma. Twelve months, five seasons, three worlds, and yonder sun -- that is twenty-one. Just as a firmly driven post [stands firm], so among the stomas the ekavimsa -- just as one would drive in a firm post, so is this for the sake of non-falling. On that day they offer these animals: the elephant as the highest, the flea as the lowest. Having carried fire around some, they seize some and release others. The mahanamni verses form its prstha. For no other prstha than the mahanamnis is able to raise up these animals. They have seven feet, for there are seven domestic animals -- for the securing of domestic animals. There is one foot beyond the seventh -- for the securing of wild animals. Its brahma-saman is the Parthurasman, complete with the syllable 'atha.' For 'athag, athag' is how a horse runs. And indeed a broad rein is able to drive a horse. It is of five-fold [structure], for the brahma-saman of the mahanamnis is five-fold. Its sacrificial posts are twenty-one, each twenty-one forearms [in height]. For no fewer than twenty-one posts are able to raise up these animals. Six are of bilva wood, twelve of khadira, and those of putudru on both sides of the fire -- for putudru is the body of Agni. The rajjudala [makes] twenty-one. That is the agnistha. Prajapati among trees is the rajjudala. Its fruits are his phalluses. And the sap is his semen. Prajapati is the father, Aditya the son. The atiratra has all stomas, for conquering and surpassing all worlds. For all this is indeed the stomas.

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣa govinataś chandomapavamānaḥ . paśukāmo haitena yajeta . tasyobhaye stomā bhavanty ayujaś ca yugmantaś ca tad ye ha vā ayuja stomās tān grāmyāḥ paśavo 'nv atha ye yugmantas tān āraṇyāḥ . paśavo vai chandomāḥ . sa yo haivaṃ vidvāñ chandomapavamānena yajeta ubhayān eva paśūn avarunddhe ye ca grāmyā ye cāraṇyāḥ . athaitad ekaviṃśapṛṣṭhaṃ dvitīyam ahar bhavati . yaivāsāv ekaviṃśasya praśaṃsā na upāptāsad iti . tad evaitasya brāhmaṇam . tasminn etam aśvaṃ medhyam ālabhante . yad v evaitad ekaviṃśapṛṣṭhaṃ tasmād govinataḥ . trayastriṃśaṃ punarabhyāvarti tṛtīyasyāhno bhavati . trayastriṃsad vai devatās trayastriṃśad devalokāḥ . tān evaitad antata āptvābhyārohanti . atha yasyaitasya pañcadaśo 'gniṣṭomaḥ pañcadaśa ukthyaḥ pañcadaśo 'tirātra iti . kṣatrakāmo haitena yajeta . kṣatram aśvaḥ kṣatraṃ pañcadaśaḥ kṣatraṃ yajñaḥ . eṣa tat tatsalakṣma kriyate . tena haitenarṣabho yājñatura īje śvaitno rājaikarāṭkāmaḥ . sa heṣṭvaivaikarāḍ āsa śvitnānām . sa ya śrīkāma syāt sa etena yajeta . kṣatraṃ śrīḥ . kṣatrayajña eṣaḥ .

tena haitenarṣabʰo yājñatura īje śvaitno rājaikarāṭkāmaḥ .

text: Now this is the Govinata Chandomapavamana. One desiring cattle should sacrifice with this. Its stomas are of both kinds -- odd and even. Those stomas that are odd, domestic animals follow them; those that are even, wild animals. The chandomah [rite] is indeed animals. He who, knowing thus, sacrifices with the Chandomapavamana, secures both kinds of animals -- both domestic and wild. Then this second day has the ekavimsa prstha. The very praise of the ekavimsa that was given before -- 'let it not be unattained' -- that is the brahmana of this. On that they offer this sacrificial horse. Because this has the ekavimsa prstha, therefore it is Govinata. The third day has the trayastrimsa punarabhyavarti. Thirty-three are the deities, thirty-three the divine worlds. Having attained these finally, they ascend. Now, of this [rite], the agnistoma has fifteen, the ukthya has fifteen, the atiratra has fifteen. One desiring royal power should sacrifice with this. The horse is royal power, fifteen is royal power, the sacrifice is royal power. This is made to bear those marks. With this Rsabha Yajnatura sacrificed, the Svaitna king, desiring sole sovereignty. Having sacrificed, he became the sole sovereign of the Svaitnas. He who desires prosperity should sacrifice with this. Prosperity is royal power. This is a sacrifice of royal power.
meaning: अथैष गोविनतश् छन्दोमपवमानः . पशुकामो हैतेन यजेत . तस्योभये स्तोमा भवन्त्य् अयुजश् च युग्मन्तश् च तद् ये ह वा अयुज स्तोमास् तान् ग्राम्याः पशवो ऽन्व् अथ ये युग्मन्तस् तान् आरण्याः . पशवो वै छन्दोमाः . स यो हैवं विद्वाञ् छन्दोमपवमानेन यजेत उभयान् एव पशून् अवरुन्द्धे ये च ग्राम्या ये चारण्याः . अथैतद् एकविंशपृष्ठं द्वितीयम् अहर् भवति . यैवासाव् एकविंशस्य प्रशंसा न उपाप्तासद् इति . तद् एवैतस्य ब्राह्मणम् . तस्मिन्न् एतम् अश्वं मेध्यम् आलभन्ते . यद् व् एवैतद् एकविंशपृष्ठं तस्माद् गोविनतः . त्रयस्त्रिंशं पुनरभ्यावर्ति तृतीयस्याह्नो भवति . त्रयस्त्रिंसद् वै देवतास् त्रयस्त्रिंशद् देवलोकाः . तान् एवैतद् अन्तत आप्त्वाभ्यारोहन्ति . अथ यस्यैतस्य पञ्चदशो ऽग्निष्टोमः पञ्चदश उक्थ्यः पञ्चदशो ऽतिरात्र इति . क्षत्रकामो हैतेन यजेत . क्षत्रम् अश्वः क्षत्रं पञ्चदशः क्षत्रं यज्ञः . एष तत् तत्सलक्ष्म क्रियते . तेन हैतेनर्षभो याज्ञतुर ईजे श्वैत्नो राजैकराट्कामः . स हेष्ट्वैवैकराड् आस श्वित्नानाम् . स य श्रीकाम स्यात् स एतेन यजेत . क्षत्रं श्रीः . क्षत्रयज्ञ एषः .

text: Now of this [rite], the day has trivrt [stoma] and the night has pancadasi; the day has trivrt and the night has pancadasi; the day has trivrt and the night has pancadasi. One desiring heaven should sacrifice with this. Datva Sautemanasa and Mitravid Damstradyumna were the two brahmacari students of Pratidarsa Vaibhavata, the Svaitna king. Of the two, Mitravid Damstradyumna performed the teacher's work. He used to tend the cows. The other one only pursued his studies. Coming together in the evening, they would say to each other: 'Come, friend, let us place our hands upon what has been recited. Come, friend, let us place our hands upon what has been well-practiced.' Then the teacher instructed Datva Sautemanasa. Coming together in the evening, they said to each other: 'Come, friend, let us place our hands upon what has been recited. Come, friend, let us place our hands upon what has been well-practiced.' 'No,' he said. 'Either I have been released beyond you, or I am one instructed by the teacher.' He spent that night pierced by displeasure. The next day, he went out following the cows.
meaning: अथ यस्यैतस्य त्रिवृद् अहः पञ्चदशी रात्रिस् त्रिवृद् अहः पञ्चदशी रात्रिस् त्रिवृद् अहः पञ्चदशी रात्रि स्वर्गकामो हेइतेन यजेत . दत्वश् च ह सौतेमनसो मित्रविच् च दंष्ट्रद्युम्नस् तौ ह प्रतिदर्शस्य वैभावतस्य श्वैत्नस्य राज्ञो ब्रह्मचारिणाव् आसतुः . तयोर् ह मित्रविद् दंष्ट्रद्युम्न आचार्यकर्म चकार . गा ह स्म रक्षति . अथ हेतरो ऽध्यायम् एव चचार . तौ ह स्म सायं समागत्यान्योन्यम् आहतुर् आहर सोम्यानूक्ते हस्तं निधास्याव आहर सोम्य सुचरिते हस्तं निधास्याव इति . अथ ह दत्वं सौतेमनसम् आचार्यो ऽनुशशास . तौ ह सायं समागत्यान्योन्यम् आहतुर् आहर सोम्यानूक्ते हस्तं निधास्याव आहर सोम्य सुचरिते हस्तं निधास्याव इति . नेति होवाच . अति वा अहं त्वद् अमुक्ष्य् आचार्यप्रशिष्टो वा अहम् अस्मीति . स ह तां रात्रिम् अप्रियविद्ध उवास . श्वो ह भूते गा अन्वियाय .

sanskrit_iast: sā hovāca veda vai yat te 'priyam . mā te 'priyaṃ bhūt . ehy ahaṃ tubhyaṃ devayānaṃ panthānaṃ vakṣyāmīti . tatheti . taṃ hāsmā uvāca . tau ha sāyaṃ samājagmatuḥ . sa hovāca datvehīdam ācāryapraśiṣṭo brūṣe . paśyasi tvaṃ devayānaṃ panthānam iti . neti hovāca . atha vā ahaṃ paśyāmīti . taṃ vai me brūhīti . tatheti . taṃ hāsmā uvāca . tasmād u ha rājanyabandhur eva brāhmaṇāt suhṛdayataraḥ .
sentences: sā hovāca veda vai yat te 'priyam .
ehy ahaṃ tubʰyaṃ devayānaṃ pantʰānaṃ vakṣyāmīti .
tasmād u ha rājanyabandʰur eva brāhmaṇāt suhr̥dayataraḥ .
text: She [a cow/goddess] said: 'I know what displeases you. Let it not displease you. Come, I shall tell you the path leading to the gods.' 'So be it.' She told it to him. They came together in the evening. He said: 'Datva, come here! You who claim to be instructed by the teacher -- do you see the path leading to the gods?' 'No,' he said. 'But I see it,' [said Mitravid]. 'Tell it to me then.' 'So be it.' He told it to him. Therefore indeed a princeling is more tender-hearted than a brahmana.
meaning: सा होवाच वेद वै यत् ते ऽप्रियम् . मा ते ऽप्रियं भूत् . एह्य् अहं तुभ्यं देवयानं पन्थानं वक्ष्यामीति . तथेति . तं हास्मा उवाच . तौ ह सायं समाजग्मतुः . स होवाच दत्वेहीदम् आचार्यप्रशिष्टो ब्रूषे . पश्यसि त्वं देवयानं पन्थानम् इति . नेति होवाच . अथ वा अहं पश्यामीति . तं वै मे ब्रूहीति . तथेति . तं हास्मा उवाच . तस्माद् उ ह राजन्यबन्धुर् एव ब्राह्मणात् सुहृदयतरः .

sanskrit_iast: neti hovāca . dānena vā vai śrameṇa vaitaṃ prajānann eti . hanta nu dadāva vā śrāmyāva veti . sa ha mitravid daṃṣṭradyumno goāyurbhyām eva saṃvatsaram iyāya . sa hopariṣṭād eva saṃvatsarasya svargaṃ lokam iyāya . atha ha datvas sautemanasa etenaiva trirātreṇeṣṭvā svargaṃ lokam iyāya . tena haiteneṣṭvaiva svargaṃ lokam eti . eteno eva hiraṇyadan veda īje dvandvakāmaḥ . yad idam goaśvaṃ hastihiraṇyam ajāvikaṃ vrīhiyavās tilamāṣā iti tad dhāsya bahv āsa .
sentences: dānena vā vai śrameṇa vaitaṃ prajānann eti .
hanta nu dadāva vā śrāmyāva veti .
sa ha mitravid daṃṣṭradyumno goāyurbʰyām eva saṃvatsaram iyāya .
sa hopariṣṭād eva saṃvatsarasya svargaṃ lokam iyāya .
atʰa ha datvas sautemanasa etenaiva trirātreṇeṣṭvā svargaṃ lokam iyāya .
eteno eva hiraṇyadan veda īje dvandvakāmaḥ .
yad idam goaśvaṃ hastihiraṇyam ajāvikaṃ vrīhiyavās tilamāṣā iti tad dʰāsya bahv āsa .
text: 'No,' he said. 'Either by giving or by exertion does one go on this path, knowing it. Come, let us either give or exert ourselves.' Mitravid Damstradyumna went for a year with the Go-Ayus [rite]. He went to the heavenly world from above, at the end of the year. But Datva Sautemanasa, having sacrificed with just this three-night [rite], went to the heavenly world. By sacrificing with this, one goes to the heavenly world. With this, Hiranyada Veda sacrificed, desiring a pair. He had abundance of cattle and horses, elephants and gold, goats and sheep, rice and barley, sesame and beans.
meaning: नेति होवाच . दानेन वा वै श्रमेण वैतं प्रजानन्न् एति . हन्त नु ददाव वा श्राम्याव वेति . स ह मित्रविद् दंष्ट्रद्युम्नो गोआयुर्भ्याम् एव संवत्सरम् इयाय . स होपरिष्टाद् एव संवत्सरस्य स्वर्गं लोकम् इयाय . अथ ह दत्वस् सौतेमनस एतेनैव त्रिरात्रेणेष्ट्वा स्वर्गं लोकम् इयाय . तेन हैतेनेष्ट्वैव स्वर्गं लोकम् एति . एतेनो एव हिरण्यदन् वेद ईजे द्वन्द्वकामः . यद् इदम् गोअश्वं हस्तिहिरण्यम् अजाविकं व्रीहियवास् तिलमाषा इति तद् धास्य बह्व् आस .

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣo 'ntarvasuḥ . khaṇḍikaś ca haudbhāriḥ keśī ca dārbhyaḥ pāñcāleṣu paspṛdhāte . sa ha khaṇḍikaḥ keśinam abhibabhūva . sa ha keśī khaṇḍikena nibāḍha uccaiḥśravasaṃ kauvayeyaṃ jagāma kauravyaṃ rājānaṃ mātur bhrātaram . taṃ hovāca yajñaṃ me vidhehīti . tatheti hovāca . kathaṃ te vidhāsyāmi . yathāsmin loka ṛdhnotī3 yathāho amuṣmī3n iti . yathāsminn iti hovāca . sa hovācota nu sa yajñaṃ pṛcchati yo yajñassahayaṃ (?) na vedeti . kathā heti . amuṣmai hy eva lokāya yajño nāsmā iti . neti hovāca . khaṇḍiko vai tyam audbhārir abhyabhūt . sa yathā tam abhibhavāny evaṃ me vidhehīti . tasmā etam antarvasuṃ vidadhau . sarvastomo 'gniṣṭomaḥ . ita-ūrdhva-chandomavidhaṃ madhyamam ahaś caturviṃśaṃ prātassavanaṃ catuścatvāriṃśaṃ mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanam aṣṭācatvāriṃśaṃ tṛtīyasavanam . sarvastomo 'tirātraḥ parastāt pratyaṅ . brahma vai caturviṃśaḥ kṣatraṃ catuścatvāriṃśo viḍ aṣṭācatvāriṃśaḥ . saṃvatsaro vai sarvastomaḥ . etābhyām eva sarvastomābhyām etāṃ trayīṃ viśaṃ parigṛhyātman dadhe .
sentences: kʰaṇḍikaś ca haudbʰāriḥ keśī ca dārbʰyaḥ pāñcāleṣu paspr̥dʰāte .
sa ha keśī kʰaṇḍikena nibāḍʰa uccaiḥśravasaṃ kauvayeyaṃ jagāma kauravyaṃ rājānaṃ mātur bʰrātaram .
yatʰāsmin loka r̥dʰnotī3 yatʰāho amuṣmī3n iti .
sa hovācota nu sa yajñaṃ pr̥ccʰati yo yajñassahayaṃ (?) na vedeti .
amuṣmai hy eva lokāya yajño nāsmā iti .
sa yatʰā tam abʰibʰavāny evaṃ me vidʰehīti .
ita-ūrdʰva-cʰandomavidʰaṃ madʰyamam ahaś caturviṃśaṃ prātassavanaṃ catuścatvāriṃśaṃ mādʰyaṃdinaṃ savanam aṣṭācatvāriṃśaṃ tr̥tīyasavanam .
brahma vai caturviṃśaḥ kṣatraṃ catuścatvāriṃśo viḍ aṣṭācatvāriṃśaḥ .
etābʰyām eva sarvastomābʰyām etāṃ trayīṃ viśaṃ parigr̥hyātman dadʰe .
text: Now this is the Antarvasu. Khandika Haudbhari and Kesi Darbhya competed among the Pancalas. Khandika overcame Kesi. Kesi, defeated by Khandika, went to Uccaihsravas Kauvayeya, the Kauravya king, his mother's brother. He said to him: 'Arrange a sacrifice for me.' 'So be it,' he said. 'How shall I arrange it for you?' 'So that one prospers in this world and also in yonder [world].' 'So that in this [world],' he said. He said: 'Does he then ask about a sacrifice who does not know the companion of the sacrifice?' 'How so?' 'For it is for yonder world that the sacrifice [exists], not for this one.' 'No,' he said. 'Khandika Haudbhari has overcome me. Arrange [the sacrifice] for me so that I may overcome him.' He arranged for him this Antarvasu. The agnistoma has all stomas. From here upward the middle day has the chandoma arrangement: the twenty-four-fold for the morning pressing, forty-four-fold for the midday pressing, forty-eight-fold for the third pressing. The atiratra has all stomas, in the latter [position], in reverse. Twenty-four is brahman, forty-four is royal power, forty-eight is the people. By these two all-stoma [rites], having enclosed this threefold people, he placed it in himself.
meaning: अथैषो ऽन्तर्वसुः . खण्डिकश् च हौद्भारिः केशी च दार्भ्यः पाञ्चालेषु पस्पृधाते . स ह खण्डिकः केशिनम् अभिबभूव . स ह केशी खण्डिकेन निबाढ उच्चैःश्रवसं कौवयेयं जगाम कौरव्यं राजानं मातुर् भ्रातरम् . तं होवाच यज्ञं मे विधेहीति . तथेति होवाच . कथं ते विधास्यामि . यथास्मिन् लोक ऋध्नोती३ यथाहो अमुष्मी३न् इति . यथास्मिन्न् इति होवाच . स होवाचोत नु स यज्ञं पृच्छति यो यज्ञस्सहयं (?) न वेदेति . कथा हेति . अमुष्मै ह्य् एव लोकाय यज्ञो नास्मा इति . नेति होवाच . खण्डिको वै त्यम् औद्भारिर् अभ्यभूत् . स यथा तम् अभिभवान्य् एवं मे विधेहीति . तस्मा एतम् अन्तर्वसुं विदधौ . सर्वस्तोमो ऽग्निष्टोमः . इत-ऊर्ध्व-छन्दोमविधं मध्यमम् अहश् चतुर्विंशं प्रातस्सवनं चतुश्चत्वारिंशं माध्यंदिनं सवनम् अष्टाचत्वारिंशं तृतीयसवनम् . सर्वस्तोमो ऽतिरात्रः परस्तात् प्रत्यङ् . ब्रह्म वै चतुर्विंशः क्षत्रं चतुश्चत्वारिंशो विड् अष्टाचत्वारिंशः . संवत्सरो वै सर्वस्तोमः . एताभ्याम् एव सर्वस्तोमाभ्याम् एतां त्रयीं विशं परिगृह्यात्मन् दधे .

sanskrit_iast: tato vai sa khaṇḍikaṃ nissārayāṃ cakāra . tato vai keśī dārbhyo 'bhavat parā khaṇḍikaḥ . bhavaty ātmanā parāsya dviṣan bhrātṛvyo bhavati ya evaṃ veda . sa ya śrīkāma syāt sa etena yajeta . etābhyām eva sarvastomābhyām etāṃ trayīṃ viśaṃ parigṛhyātman dhatte . tasyai ha śriyaṃ gacchati . athaiṣa parākaḥ . svargakāmo haitena yajeta . tasya parāñcy eva stotrāṇi bhavanty paraāñci śastrāṇi parāñci pṛṣṭhāni parācīr viṣṭutayaḥ parāṅ eva sarvo bhavati . tena haitenoccaiḥśravāḥ kauveyāya īje sthaviro rājā kauravyaḥ . sa heṣṭvaiva svargaṃ lokam iyāya . tena haiteneṣṭvaiva svargaṃ lokam eti . atha yasyaitasya jyotir agniṣṭomo jyotir ukthyo jyotir atirātra iti brahmavarcasakāmo haitena yajeta . jyotir iva ha vai sa bhāti yo brahmavarcasam ṛdhnoti . ṛdhnoti hainena brahmavarcasaṃ brahmavarcasī bhavati . atha yasyaitasya saptadaśo 'gniṣṭomas saptadaśa ukthyas saptadaśo 'tirātra iti prajāpater aśvamedhaḥ . prajananakāmo haitena yajeta . atha yasyaitasyakaviṃśo 'gniṣṭoma ekaviṃśa ukthya ekaviṃśo 'tirātra ity ādityasyāśvamedhaḥ .
sentences: tato vai sa kʰaṇḍikaṃ nissārayāṃ cakāra .
tato vai keśī dārbʰyo 'bʰavat parā kʰaṇḍikaḥ .
bʰavaty ātmanā parāsya dviṣan bʰrātr̥vyo bʰavati ya evaṃ veda .
sa ya śrīkāma syāt sa etena yajeta .
etābʰyām eva sarvastomābʰyām etāṃ trayīṃ viśaṃ parigr̥hyātman dʰatte .
tasya parāñcy eva stotrāṇi bʰavanty paraāñci śastrāṇi parāñci pr̥ṣṭʰāni parācīr viṣṭutayaḥ parāṅ eva sarvo bʰavati .
tena haitenoccaiḥśravāḥ kauveyāya īje stʰaviro rājā kauravyaḥ .
atʰa yasyaitasya jyotir agniṣṭomo jyotir uktʰyo jyotir atirātra iti brahmavarcasakāmo haitena yajeta .
jyotir iva ha vai sa bʰāti yo brahmavarcasam r̥dʰnoti .
atʰa yasyaitasya saptadaśo 'gniṣṭomas saptadaśa uktʰyas saptadaśo 'tirātra iti prajāpater aśvamedʰaḥ .
atʰa yasyaitasyakaviṃśo 'gniṣṭoma ekaviṃśa uktʰya ekaviṃśo 'tirātra ity ādityasyāśvamedʰaḥ .
text: Thereupon he drove out Khandika. Then Kesi Darbhya prospered, and Khandika was destroyed. One prospers by oneself, and his rival enemy is destroyed, who knows thus. He who desires prosperity should sacrifice with this. By these two all-stoma [rites], having enclosed this threefold people, he places it in himself. He attains prosperity thereby. Now this is the Paraka. One desiring heaven should sacrifice with this. Its chants are directed away, its recitations are directed away, its prsthas are directed away, its hymn-arrangements are directed away -- everything is directed away. With this, Uccaihsravas Kauvayeya sacrificed, the aged Kauravya king. Having sacrificed, he went to the heavenly world. By sacrificing with this, one goes to the heavenly world. Now, of the [rite] whose agnistoma has jyotis, whose ukthya has jyotis, whose atiratra has jyotis -- one desiring splendor of brahman should sacrifice with this. He shines as if with light who attains splendor of brahman. One attains splendor of brahman by this and becomes possessed of brahman-splendor. Now, of the [rite] whose agnistoma has seventeen, whose ukthya has seventeen, whose atiratra has seventeen -- that is Prajapati's horse-sacrifice. One desiring progeny should sacrifice with this. Now, of the [rite] whose agnistoma has twenty-one, whose ukthya has twenty-one, whose atiratra has twenty-one -- that is Aditya's horse-sacrifice.
meaning: ततो वै स खण्डिकं निस्सारयां चकार . ततो वै केशी दार्भ्यो ऽभवत् परा खण्डिकः . भवत्य् आत्मना परास्य द्विषन् भ्रातृव्यो भवति य एवं वेद . स य श्रीकाम स्यात् स एतेन यजेत . एताभ्याम् एव सर्वस्तोमाभ्याम् एतां त्रयीं विशं परिगृह्यात्मन् धत्ते . तस्यै ह श्रियं गच्छति . अथैष पराकः . स्वर्गकामो हैतेन यजेत . तस्य पराञ्च्य् एव स्तोत्राणि भवन्त्य् परआञ्चि शस्त्राणि पराञ्चि पृष्ठानि पराचीर् विष्टुतयः पराङ् एव सर्वो भवति . तेन हैतेनोच्चैःश्रवाः कौवेयाय ईजे स्थविरो राजा कौरव्यः . स हेष्ट्वैव स्वर्गं लोकम् इयाय . तेन हैतेनेष्ट्वैव स्वर्गं लोकम् एति . अथ यस्यैतस्य ज्योतिर् अग्निष्टोमो ज्योतिर् उक्थ्यो ज्योतिर् अतिरात्र इति ब्रह्मवर्चसकामो हैतेन यजेत . ज्योतिर् इव ह वै स भाति यो ब्रह्मवर्चसम् ऋध्नोति . ऋध्नोति हैनेन ब्रह्मवर्चसं ब्रह्मवर्चसी भवति . अथ यस्यैतस्य सप्तदशो ऽग्निष्टोमस् सप्तदश उक्थ्यस् सप्तदशो ऽतिरात्र इति प्रजापतेर् अश्वमेधः . प्रजननकामो हैतेन यजेत . अथ यस्यैतस्यकविंशो ऽग्निष्टोम एकविंश उक्थ्य एकविंशो ऽतिरात्र इत्य् आदित्यस्याश्वमेधः .

sanskrit_iast: athaite catūrātrāḥ . atrir vā akāmayata catvāro me vīrā ājāyerann iti . sa etaṃ catūrātraṃ yajñam apaśyat . tam āharat . tenāyajata . tato vai tasya catvāro vīrā ājāyanta . asya catvāro vīrā ājāyante ya evaṃ veda . atryṛṣayo vā akāmayanta catvāraś catvāro no vīrā ājāyerann iti . ta etaṃ catūrātraṃ yajñam apaśyan . tam āharan . tenāyajanta . tato vai teṣāṃ catvāraś catvāro vīrā ājāyanta asya catvāraś catvāro vīrā ājāyante ya evaṃ veda . ā caturaṃ ha khalu vai mithunaṃ prajananaṃ mithunaṃ parācīnam . ekaś ca vā ekā ca dvau ca dve ca trayaś ca tisraś ca catvāraś ca catasraś ca etad vā ā caturaṃ mithunaṃ prajananam . na ha vai pañca ca pañca ceti nāma santi . tad yan mithunaṃ prajananaṃ tan mā prajanayād iti . tasya caturviṃśāḥ pavamānā bhavanti caturviṃśatyardhamāsas saṃvatsaraḥ . saṃvatsaraḥ prajananaṃ sa mā prajanayād iti . tasyobhe bṛhadrathantare sāmanī bhavataḥ . etad vai daivyaṃ mithunaṃ prajananaṃ yad ubhe bṛhadrathantare . tad yad daivyaṃ mithunaṃ prajananaṃ tan mā prajanayād iti . tasyobhaye stomā bhavanty ayujaś ca yugmantaś ca . etad vai daivyaṃ mithunaṃ prajananaṃ yad ubhaye stomāḥ .
sentences: atrir vā akāmayata catvāro me vīrā ājāyerann iti .
tato vai tasya catvāro vīrā ājāyanta .

tasyobʰaye stomā bʰavanty ayujaś ca yugmantaś ca .
