ete vā apahatapāpmānaḥ prāṇā yan mukʰyāḥ .
te ye 'pahatapāpmānaḥ prāṇās teṣāṃ mātrayā yajñaṃ tanavā iti .
text: Now these are the seven-night [rites]. Seven are the meters. The meters are all speech. He attains sovereignty and lordship over speech who attains prosperity. 'Let me attain sovereignty and lordship over speech.' Therefore one sacrifices with a seven-night [rite]. Seven are the vital breaths. By the vital breaths, offspring and cattle stand enclosed. 'By those vital breaths by which offspring and cattle stand enclosed, let offspring and cattle stand enclosed for me.' By the vital breaths the gods went to the heavenly world. 'By those vital breaths by which the gods went to the heavenly world, let me go to the heavenly world by those vital breaths.' Seven are the chief vital breaths. These vital breaths whose evils are driven away are the chief ones. 'By the measure of those vital breaths whose evils are driven away, let me extend the sacrifice.' The seven sages, desiring prosperity, performed austerities. They saw this seven-night sacrifice. They brought it forth.
meaning: अथैते सप्तरात्राः . सप्त वै छन्दांसि . छन्दांसि वै सर्वा वाक् . वाचस् स ऐश्वर्यम् आधिपत्यं गच्छति य श्रियम् अश्नुते . वाच ऐश्वर्यम् आधिपत्यं गच्छानीति . तस्मात् सप्तरात्रेण यजते . सप्त वै प्राणाः . प्राणैर् वै प्रजाः पशवः परिगृहीता उपतिष्ठन्ते . तद् यैः प्राणैः प्रजाः पशवः परिगृहीता उपतिष्ठन्ते तैर् मा प्राणैः प्रजाः पशवः परिगृहीता उपतिष्ठान्ता इति . प्राणैर् वै देवा स्वर्गं लोकम् आयन् . तद् यैः प्राणैर् देवा स्वर्गं लोकम् आयंस् तैः प्राणै स्वर्गं लोकम् अयानीति . सप्त वै मुख्याः प्राणाः . एते वा अपहतपाप्मानः प्राणा यन् मुख्याः . ते ये ऽपहतपाप्मानः प्राणास् तेषां मात्रया यज्ञं तनवा इति . सप्तर्षयो वा ऋद्धिकामास् तपो ऽतप्यन्त . त एतं सप्तरात्रं यज्ञम् अपश्यन् . तम् आहरन् .

sanskrit_iast: te 'harbhāja āsan . tato vai teṣām ahnaivaika ārdhnod ahnaiko 'hnaikaḥ . sā ha khalu vai śreṣṭharddhīnāṃ sa lokānāṃ puṇyatamo yam etena saptarṣaya ārdhnuvan . sā yā śreṣṭharddhīnāṃ yo lokānāṃ puṇyatamo yam etena saptarṣaya ārdhnuvaṃs tam ṛdhnavānīti . tasmāt saptarātreṇa yajate . saptaitāny ahāni bhavanti sapta stomāḥ . ahar eva stomo vahaty aha stomo 'ha stomaḥ . sā ha khalu vā ahnāṃ samṛddhir yad enāni nānā stomā vahanti . sā yaivāhnāṃ samṛddhis saivaiṣā kriyate . ta u sarve sapta saṃpadyaikaviṃśam evābhisaṃpadyante trivṛc ca trayastriṃśaś ca tau dvāv ekaviṃśau pañcadaśaś ca triṇavaś ca tau dvāv ekaviṃśau saptadaśaś ca pañcaviṃśaś ca tau dvāv ekaviṃśāv ekaviṃśa evaikaviṃśaḥ . dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavas traya ime lokā asāv āditya ekaviṃśaḥ . etasya vā ete salokatāṃ gacchanti ye saptarātrayājinaḥ . etam abhisaṃpanna eṣāṃ loka ṛdhnoti .
sentences: tato vai teṣām ahnaivaika ārdʰnod ahnaiko 'hnaikaḥ .
sā ha kʰalu vai śreṣṭʰarddʰīnāṃ sa lokānāṃ puṇyatamo yam etena saptarṣaya ārdʰnuvan .
sā yā śreṣṭʰarddʰīnāṃ yo lokānāṃ puṇyatamo yam etena saptarṣaya ārdʰnuvaṃs tam r̥dʰnavānīti .
ahar eva stomo vahaty aha stomo 'ha stomaḥ .
sā ha kʰalu vā ahnāṃ samr̥ddʰir yad enāni nānā stomā vahanti .

ta u sarve sapta saṃpadyaikaviṃśam evābʰisaṃpadyante trivr̥c ca trayastriṃśaś ca tau dvāv ekaviṃśau pañcadaśaś ca triṇavaś ca tau dvāv ekaviṃśau saptadaśaś ca pañcaviṃśaś ca tau dvāv ekaviṃśāv ekaviṃśa evaikaviṃśaḥ .
dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavas traya ime lokā asāv āditya ekaviṃśaḥ .
etasya vā ete salokatāṃ gaccʰanti ye saptarātrayājinaḥ .
text: They were day-sharers. Then for them, one prospered by a day, one by a day, one by a day. The most blessed of those who attain prosperity, the most meritorious of worlds, is that which the seven sages attained by this. 'That most blessed of those who attain prosperity, that most meritorious of worlds which the seven sages attained by this -- may I attain that.' Therefore one sacrifices with a seven-night [rite]. Seven are these days, seven the stomas. The day carries the stoma; a day, a stoma; a day, a stoma. This is the abundance of the days -- that different stomas carry them. That very abundance of the days is created. And all seven together correspond to twenty-one: trivrt and trayastrimsa -- those two [make] twenty-one; pancadasa and trinava -- those two [make] twenty-one; saptadasa and pancavimsa -- those two [make] twenty-one; ekavimsa itself is twenty-one. Twelve months, five seasons, three worlds, and yonder sun -- twenty-one. They who sacrifice with the seven-night [rite] attain the same world as this [sun]. One who has attained this -- his world prospers.
meaning: ते ऽहर्भाज आसन् . ततो वै तेषाम् अह्नैवैक आर्ध्नोद् अह्नैको ऽह्नैकः . सा ह खलु वै श्रेष्ठर्द्धीनां स लोकानां पुण्यतमो यम् एतेन सप्तर्षय आर्ध्नुवन् . सा या श्रेष्ठर्द्धीनां यो लोकानां पुण्यतमो यम् एतेन सप्तर्षय आर्ध्नुवंस् तम् ऋध्नवानीति . तस्मात् सप्तरात्रेण यजते . सप्तैतान्य् अहानि भवन्ति सप्त स्तोमाः . अहर् एव स्तोमो वहत्य् अह स्तोमो ऽह स्तोमः . सा ह खलु वा अह्नां समृद्धिर् यद् एनानि नाना स्तोमा वहन्ति . सा यैवाह्नां समृद्धिस् सैवैषा क्रियते . त उ सर्वे सप्त संपद्यैकविंशम् एवाभिसंपद्यन्ते त्रिवृच् च त्रयस्त्रिंशश् च तौ द्वाव् एकविंशौ पञ्चदशश् च त्रिणवश् च तौ द्वाव् एकविंशौ सप्तदशश् च पञ्चविंशश् च तौ द्वाव् एकविंशाव् एकविंश एवैकविंशः . द्वादश मासाः पञ्चर्तवस् त्रय इमे लोका असाव् आदित्य एकविंशः . एतस्य वा एते सलोकतां गच्छन्ति ये सप्तरात्रयाजिनः . एतम् अभिसंपन्न एषां लोक ऋध्नोति .

sanskrit_iast: tena haitena janako vaideha iyakṣāṃ cakre . taṃ ha sma yad brāhmaṇāḥ kurupāñcālā āhur anena tvā yajñena yājayāmānena tvā yajñena yājayāmeti . neti ha smāha . na sa yuṣmad brāhmaṇo brahmīyān āsīd yo mahyam etaṃ yajñakratuṃ vyadadhāt . etenaiva mā yājayateti . tatheti . tena hainaṃ yājayāṃ cakruḥ . sa vā eṣa pṛṣṭhya eva ṣaḍahaḥ pañcaviṃśaṃ mahāvratam . tata eva rātrim upayanti . śrīr vai varṣma pṛṣṭhāni . śriyam eva tad varṣma pṛṣṭhāny abhyārohati . annaṃ vai mahāvratam annādyasyaivāvaruddhyai . tad āhur na purā saṃvatsarān mahāvratam upetyam iti . tad yat pṛṣṭhyaṣ ṣaḍaho bhavaty ṛtavo vai pṛṣṭhāni . saṃvatsara ṛtavaḥ . saṃvatsaraḥ kṛtsnam annādyaṃ pacati saṃvatsarābhijitam eva tad annādyam upayanti .
sentences: tena haitena janako vaideha iyakṣāṃ cakre .
taṃ ha sma yad brāhmaṇāḥ kurupāñcālā āhur anena tvā yajñena yājayāmānena tvā yajñena yājayāmeti .
na sa yuṣmad brāhmaṇo brahmīyān āsīd yo mahyam etaṃ yajñakratuṃ vyadadʰāt .
sa vā eṣa pr̥ṣṭʰya eva ṣaḍahaḥ pañcaviṃśaṃ mahāvratam .
śriyam eva tad varṣma pr̥ṣṭʰāny abʰyārohati .
tad āhur na purā saṃvatsarān mahāvratam upetyam iti .
tad yat pr̥ṣṭʰyaṣ ṣaḍaho bʰavaty r̥tavo vai pr̥ṣṭʰāni .
saṃvatsaraḥ kr̥tsnam annādyaṃ pacati saṃvatsarābʰijitam eva tad annādyam upayanti .
text: With this, Janaka of Videha wished to sacrifice. When the brahmanas of Kuru-Pancala said to him: 'Let us make you sacrifice with this rite, let us make you sacrifice with that rite,' he would say: 'No. No brahmana among you was more learned in brahman than the one who arranged this sacrificial rite for me. Make me sacrifice with this alone.' 'So be it.' They made him sacrifice with it. This is indeed a prsthya six-day [rite] with the twenty-five-fold mahavrata. From that they approach the night. Prosperity, eminence, is the prsthas. One thereby ascends to prosperity, eminence, the prsthas. Food is the mahavrata -- for the securing of food. On this they say: 'The mahavrata should not be approached before a year.' Because the prsthya six-day [rite] occurs -- the prsthas are the seasons. The seasons are the year. The year cooks all food. They approach the food conquered through the year.
meaning: तेन हैतेन जनको वैदेह इयक्षां चक्रे . तं ह स्म यद् ब्राह्मणाः कुरुपाञ्चाला आहुर् अनेन त्वा यज्ञेन याजयामानेन त्वा यज्ञेन याजयामेति . नेति ह स्माह . न स युष्मद् ब्राह्मणो ब्रह्मीयान् आसीद् यो मह्यम् एतं यज्ञक्रतुं व्यदधात् . एतेनैव मा याजयतेति . तथेति . तेन हैनं याजयां चक्रुः . स वा एष पृष्ठ्य एव षडहः पञ्चविंशं महाव्रतम् . तत एव रात्रिम् उपयन्ति . श्रीर् वै वर्ष्म पृष्ठानि . श्रियम् एव तद् वर्ष्म पृष्ठान्य् अभ्यारोहति . अन्नं वै महाव्रतम् अन्नाद्यस्यैवावरुद्ध्यै . तद् आहुर् न पुरा संवत्सरान् महाव्रतम् उपेत्यम् इति . तद् यत् पृष्ठ्यष् षडहो भवत्य् ऋतवो वै पृष्ठानि . संवत्सर ऋतवः . संवत्सरः कृत्स्नम् अन्नाद्यं पचति संवत्सराभिजितम् एव तद् अन्नाद्यम् उपयन्ति .

sanskrit_iast: tad āhus tatsthānaṃ vā etad ahorātryā agniṣṭomo vā etad ahar iti . tad u vā āhus saṃvatsaro vā eṣa yad agniṣṭomaḥ So auch 2,202 (247,31). saṃvatsaraḥ prajāpatiḥ . prājāpatyaṃ mahāvratam evāgniṣṭomasāmnaḥ pañcaviṃśāni stotrāṇi syuḥ . athaikaviṃśair ukthyai rātrim upāvaroheyur iti . tathā haitau yajñakratū vyākriyete . atha yasyaitasya pṛṣṭhyasya ṣaḍahasya stomāḥ pañcame 'hani mahāvrataṃ viśvajit sarvapṛṣṭho 'tirātra eteno ha kratuḥ kārīrādir īje śrīkāmo 'nnādyakāmaḥ . ātmā vai pṛṣṭhyaṣ ṣaḍaho 'nnaṃ mahāvratam . sa madhyata evātmano 'nnādyaṃ dhāsye so 'nnāda śreṣṭha svānāṃ bhaviṣyāmīti . atho saṃvatsaro vai pṛṣṭhyaṣ ṣaḍahaḥ . tan mā saṃvatsareṇānnādyaṃ parigṛhītam upasthāsyata iti . viśvajit sarvapṛṣṭho 'tirātro bhavati . śrīr vai varṣma pṛṣṭhāni . tad u śriyaṃ varṣma pṛṣṭhāny abhyutkramiṣyāmīti . tam u ha brāhmaṇa uvāca yāvaj jīviṣyaty annāda eva śreṣṭha svānāṃ bhaviṣyati viśīrṣās tv eva marteti . śiro vā etad yajñasya yan mahāvratam . tad yathā śiraś chitvā tad upapakṣayor upagūhet tad vai na śliṣyati tādṛg akṛd iti hovāca . jānanta evāsya śiraś chettāra iti . tad dha tathaivāsa . yāvad dha kratuḥ kārīrādir jijīvānnāda eva śreṣṭha svānām āsa . viśīrṣās tv eva mamāra . jānanto ha tv evāsya śiraś cicchidur bhāryakāḥ .
sentences: tad āhus tatstʰānaṃ vā etad ahorātryā agniṣṭomo vā etad ahar iti .
tad u vā āhus saṃvatsaro vā eṣa yad agniṣṭomaḥ So auch 2,202 (247,31).
prājāpatyaṃ mahāvratam evāgniṣṭomasāmnaḥ pañcaviṃśāni stotrāṇi syuḥ .
atʰa yasyaitasya pr̥ṣṭʰyasya ṣaḍahasya stomāḥ pañcame 'hani mahāvrataṃ viśvajit sarvapr̥ṣṭʰo 'tirātra eteno ha kratuḥ kārīrādir īje śrīkāmo 'nnādyakāmaḥ .
sa madʰyata evātmano 'nnādyaṃ dʰāsye so 'nnāda śreṣṭʰa svānāṃ bʰaviṣyāmīti .
tan mā saṃvatsareṇānnādyaṃ parigr̥hītam upastʰāsyata iti .
tad u śriyaṃ varṣma pr̥ṣṭʰāny abʰyutkramiṣyāmīti .
tam u ha brāhmaṇa uvāca yāvaj jīviṣyaty annāda eva śreṣṭʰa svānāṃ bʰaviṣyati viśīrṣās tv eva marteti .
śiro vā etad yajñasya yan mahāvratam .
tad yatʰā śiraś cʰitvā tad upapakṣayor upagūhet tad vai na śliṣyati tādr̥g akr̥d iti hovāca .
yāvad dʰa kratuḥ kārīrādir jijīvānnāda eva śreṣṭʰa svānām āsa .
jānanto ha tv evāsya śiraś ciccʰidur bʰāryakāḥ .
text: On this they say: 'This is the equivalent of day-and-night: the agnistoma is this day.' And they also say: 'The agnistoma is the year. The year is Prajapati. The mahavrata is of Prajapati. The chants of the agnistoma-saman should be of the twenty-five-fold [type].' 'Then they should descend to the night with the twenty-one-fold ukthya.' Thus these two sacrificial rites are differentiated. Now, the [rite] whose prsthya six-day has [specific] stomas, with the mahavrata on the fifth day, [followed by] a visvajit-stoma atiratra with all prsthas -- with this Kratu Kariradri sacrificed, desiring prosperity and food. The self is the prsthya six-day; food is the mahavrata. 'I shall place food from the middle of the self; I shall be an eater of food, the foremost among my own.' And the year is the prsthya six-day. 'May food enclosed by the year stand by me.' The atiratra is a visvajit with all prsthas. Prosperity, eminence, is the prsthas. 'I shall ascend to prosperity, eminence, the prsthas.' But the brahmana told him: 'As long as he lives, he will be an eater of food, the foremost among his own. But he will die headless.' The head of the sacrifice is the mahavrata. 'Just as if one were to cut off a head and press it against the armpits -- it would not rejoin. Such is what he has done,' he said. 'Those who cut off his head will know.' And it was so. As long as Kratu Kariradri lived, he was an eater of food, the foremost among his own. But he died headless. Those who cut off his head were indeed the Bharyakas, who knew [what they were doing].
meaning: तद् आहुस् तत्स्थानं वा एतद् अहोरात्र्या अग्निष्टोमो वा एतद् अहर् इति . तद् उ वा आहुस् संवत्सरो वा एष यद् अग्निष्टोमः Sओ औछ् २,२०२ (२४७,३१). संवत्सरः प्रजापतिः . प्राजापत्यं महाव्रतम् एवाग्निष्टोमसाम्नः पञ्चविंशानि स्तोत्राणि स्युः . अथैकविंशैर् उक्थ्यै रात्रिम् उपावरोहेयुर् इति . तथा हैतौ यज्ञक्रतू व्याक्रियेते . अथ यस्यैतस्य पृष्ठ्यस्य षडहस्य स्तोमाः पञ्चमे ऽहनि महाव्रतं विश्वजित् सर्वपृष्ठो ऽतिरात्र एतेनो ह क्रतुः कारीरादिर् ईजे श्रीकामो ऽन्नाद्यकामः . आत्मा वै पृष्ठ्यष् षडहो ऽन्नं महाव्रतम् . स मध्यत एवात्मनो ऽन्नाद्यं धास्ये सो ऽन्नाद श्रेष्ठ स्वानां भविष्यामीति . अथो संवत्सरो वै पृष्ठ्यष् षडहः . तन् मा संवत्सरेणान्नाद्यं परिगृहीतम् उपस्थास्यत इति . विश्वजित् सर्वपृष्ठो ऽतिरात्रो भवति . श्रीर् वै वर्ष्म पृष्ठानि . तद् उ श्रियं वर्ष्म पृष्ठान्य् अभ्युत्क्रमिष्यामीति . तम् उ ह ब्राह्मण उवाच यावज् जीविष्यत्य् अन्नाद एव श्रेष्ठ स्वानां भविष्यति विशीर्षास् त्व् एव मर्तेति . शिरो वा एतद् यज्ञस्य यन् महाव्रतम् . तद् यथा शिरश् छित्वा तद् उपपक्षयोर् उपगूहेत् तद् वै न श्लिष्यति तादृग् अकृद् इति होवाच . जानन्त एवास्य शिरश् छेत्तार इति . तद् ध तथैवास . यावद् ध क्रतुः कारीरादिर् जिजीवान्नाद एव श्रेष्ठ स्वानाम् आस . विशीर्षास् त्व् एव ममार . जानन्तो ह त्व् एवास्य शिरश् चिच्छिदुर् भार्यकाः .

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣa babarasaptarātraḥ . tasya saptadaśam eva prathamam ahar atha trivṛd atha pañcadaśam athaikaviṃśam atha triṇavam atha trayastriṃśaṃ jyotir atirātraḥ . eteno ha sa īje śrīkāmo 'nnādyakāmaḥ . ātmā vai pṛṣṭhyaṣ ṣaḍaha iti . mukhaṃ trivṛd annaṃ saptadaśaḥ . sa prathamata eva mukhato 'nnādyaṃ dhāsye so 'nnāda śreṣṭha svānāṃ bhaviṣyāmīti . atho saṃvatsaro vai pṛṣṭhyaṣ ṣaḍahas tan mā saṃvatsarasya purastād annādyam avaruddham upasthāsyata iti . jyotir atirātraḥ . etad vai prajñātaṃ devatīrthaṃ yaj jyotir atirātraḥ .
sentences: tasya saptadaśam eva pratʰamam ahar atʰa trivr̥d atʰa pañcadaśam atʰaikaviṃśam atʰa triṇavam atʰa trayastriṃśaṃ jyotir atirātraḥ .
sa pratʰamata eva mukʰato 'nnādyaṃ dʰāsye so 'nnāda śreṣṭʰa svānāṃ bʰaviṣyāmīti .
atʰo saṃvatsaro vai pr̥ṣṭʰyaṣ ṣaḍahas tan mā saṃvatsarasya purastād annādyam avaruddʰam upastʰāsyata iti .
etad vai prajñātaṃ devatīrtʰaṃ yaj jyotir atirātraḥ .
text: Now this is the Babara-seven-night [rite]. Its first day has the saptadasa [stoma], then trivrt, then pancadasa, then ekavimsa, then trinava, then trayastrimsa, with a jyotis atiratra. With this he sacrificed, desiring prosperity and food. The self is the prsthya six-day. The mouth is trivrt; food is saptadasa. 'I shall first place food from the mouth; I shall be an eater of food, the foremost among my own.' And the year is the prsthya six-day. 'May food secured before the year stand by me.' The jyotis atiratra -- this is the well-known divine ford, the jyotis atiratra.
meaning: अथैष बबरसप्तरात्रः . तस्य सप्तदशम् एव प्रथमम् अहर् अथ त्रिवृद् अथ पञ्चदशम् अथैकविंशम् अथ त्रिणवम् अथ त्रयस्त्रिंशं ज्योतिर् अतिरात्रः . एतेनो ह स ईजे श्रीकामो ऽन्नाद्यकामः . आत्मा वै पृष्ठ्यष् षडह इति . मुखं त्रिवृद् अन्नं सप्तदशः . स प्रथमत एव मुखतो ऽन्नाद्यं धास्ये सो ऽन्नाद श्रेष्ठ स्वानां भविष्यामीति . अथो संवत्सरो वै पृष्ठ्यष् षडहस् तन् मा संवत्सरस्य पुरस्ताद् अन्नाद्यम् अवरुद्धम् उपस्थास्यत इति . ज्योतिर् अतिरात्रः . एतद् वै प्रज्ञातं देवतीर्थं यज् ज्योतिर् अतिरात्रः .

sanskrit_iast: - govarṇaḥ khālateyaḥ pāpīyān bhaviṣyati . prathamata eva mukhato 'nnādyam adhita . yadā vai mukham annaṃ prāpnoti tato vāva tat pūyati yadi pragirati pūyati yadi ṣṭhīvati pūyaty apūpuyad annādyaṃ pāpīyān bhaviṣyatīti . tad dha tathaivāsa . sa ha pāpīyān āsa . tasmai hocur yo vai te 'yaṃ sva evāntevāsī govarṇaḥ khālateyas sa vai tvānuvyāhārṣīd iti . taṃ hovāca sa vai mā tvam anena yajñena yājayeti . tatheti hovāca . taṃ vai tvā yathā rathaṃ vā riṣṭaṃ saṃskuryād ano vā evaṃ tvā saṃskariṣyāmīti . tasya ha trivṛd eva prathamam ahaś cakāra atha pañcadaśam athaikaviṃśam atha triṇavam atha trayastriṃśam atha saptadaśam atha saptadaśam . dve saptadaśe anūcī . eteno ha govarṇaḥ khālateya ācāryaṃ yājayāṃ cakāra . ātmā vai pṛṣṭhyaṣ ṣaḍaho 'nnaṃ saptadaśaḥ . sa ātmana evādhy ūrdhvo 'nnādyam abhyutkramiṣyate . tat tvopariṣṭād annādyam avaruddham upasthāsyate saptadaśāt saptadaśam annād annam .
sentences: yadā vai mukʰam annaṃ prāpnoti tato vāva tat pūyati yadi pragirati pūyati yadi ṣṭʰīvati pūyaty apūpuyad annādyaṃ pāpīyān bʰaviṣyatīti .
tasmai hocur yo vai te 'yaṃ sva evāntevāsī govarṇaḥ kʰālateyas sa vai tvānuvyāhārṣīd iti .
taṃ hovāca sa vai mā tvam anena yajñena yājayeti .
taṃ vai tvā yatʰā ratʰaṃ vā riṣṭaṃ saṃskuryād ano vā evaṃ tvā saṃskariṣyāmīti .
tasya ha trivr̥d eva pratʰamam ahaś cakāra atʰa pañcadaśam atʰaikaviṃśam atʰa triṇavam atʰa trayastriṃśam atʰa saptadaśam atʰa saptadaśam .
eteno ha govarṇaḥ kʰālateya ācāryaṃ yājayāṃ cakāra .
tat tvopariṣṭād annādyam avaruddʰam upastʰāsyate saptadaśāt saptadaśam annād annam .
text: [They said:] 'Govarna Khalateya will become worse. He has placed food first from the mouth. When food reaches the mouth, then indeed it putrefies: if he vomits, it putrefies; if he spits, it putrefies. Having putrefied the food, he will become worse.' And so it was. He became worse. They told him: 'Your own pupil Govarna Khalateya -- he it was who made the counter-utterance against you.' He said to him: 'You must make me sacrifice with this [rite].' 'So be it,' he said. 'I shall repair you as one would repair a broken chariot or wagon.' He made the trivrt the first day, then pancadasa, then ekavimsa, then trinava, then trayastrimsa, then saptadasa, then saptadasa. Two saptadasas in succession. With this, Govarna Khalateya made his teacher sacrifice. The self is the prsthya six-day; food is the saptadasa. 'Food will ascend upward from the self. That food, secured, will stand above you -- from saptadasa to saptadasa, from food to food.'
meaning: - गोवर्णः खालतेयः पापीयान् भविष्यति . प्रथमत एव मुखतो ऽन्नाद्यम् अधित . यदा वै मुखम् अन्नं प्राप्नोति ततो वाव तत् पूयति यदि प्रगिरति पूयति यदि ष्ठीवति पूयत्य् अपूपुयद् अन्नाद्यं पापीयान् भविष्यतीति . तद् ध तथैवास . स ह पापीयान् आस . तस्मै होचुर् यो वै ते ऽयं स्व एवान्तेवासी गोवर्णः खालतेयस् स वै त्वानुव्याहार्षीद् इति . तं होवाच स वै मा त्वम् अनेन यज्ञेन याजयेति . तथेति होवाच . तं वै त्वा यथा रथं वा रिष्टं संस्कुर्याद् अनो वा एवं त्वा संस्करिष्यामीति . तस्य ह त्रिवृद् एव प्रथमम् अहश् चकार अथ पञ्चदशम् अथैकविंशम् अथ त्रिणवम् अथ त्रयस्त्रिंशम् अथ सप्तदशम् अथ सप्तदशम् . द्वे सप्तदशे अनूची . एतेनो ह गोवर्णः खालतेय आचार्यं याजयां चकार . आत्मा वै पृष्ठ्यष् षडहो ऽन्नं सप्तदशः . स आत्मन एवाध्य् ऊर्ध्वो ऽन्नाद्यम् अभ्युत्क्रमिष्यते . तत् त्वोपरिष्टाद् अन्नाद्यम् अवरुद्धम् उपस्थास्यते सप्तदशात् सप्तदशम् अन्नाद् अन्नम् .

sanskrit_iast: ete bābarayaḥ kuruṣu paṇāyyā eva . sa ha sma tad devayajane paricaratīdam ayaja idam u nāyaja iti . atha yasyaitasya jyotir gaur āyur iti tryaho viśvajit sarvapṛṣṭhya ukthyaṣ ṣoḍaśimāñ chandomapavamānaḥ sarvastoma ukthyaḥ pañcaviṃśaṃ mahāvrataṃ jyotir atirātro yaḥ kāmayetopetyābhiplavam upetya pṛṣṭhāny upetya chandomān mahāvrataṃ ma upetaṃ syād iti sa etena yajeta . upetya haivābhiplavam upetya pṛṣṭhāny upetya chandomān mahāvratam asyopetaṃ bhavaty annaṃ vai mahāvratam annādyasyaivāvaruddhyai . tad āhur na purā saṃvatsarān mahāvratam upetyam iti . tad yat pṛṣṭhyaṣ ṣaḍaho bhavaty ṛtavo vai pṛṣṭhāni . saṃvatsara ṛtavaḥ . saṃvatsaraḥ kṛtsnam annādyaṃ pacati saṃvatsarābhijitam eva tad annādyam upayanti . pañcaviṃśaṃ mahāvratam annaṃ vai pañcaviṃśam annādyasyaivāvaruddhyai . jyotir atirātraḥ . etad vai prajñātaṃ devatīrthaṃ yaj jyotir atirātraḥ .
sentences: sa ha sma tad devayajane paricaratīdam ayaja idam u nāyaja iti .

atʰa yasyaitasya jyotir gaur āyur iti tryaho viśvajit sarvapr̥ṣṭʰya uktʰyaṣ ṣoḍaśimāñ cʰandomapavamānaḥ sarvastoma uktʰyaḥ pañcaviṃśaṃ mahāvrataṃ jyotir atirātro yaḥ kāmayetopetyābʰiplavam upetya pr̥ṣṭʰāny upetya cʰandomān mahāvrataṃ ma upetaṃ syād iti sa etena yajeta .
upetya haivābʰiplavam upetya pr̥ṣṭʰāny upetya cʰandomān mahāvratam asyopetaṃ bʰavaty annaṃ vai mahāvratam annādyasyaivāvaruddʰyai .
tad āhur na purā saṃvatsarān mahāvratam upetyam iti .
tad yat pr̥ṣṭʰyaṣ ṣaḍaho bʰavaty r̥tavo vai pr̥ṣṭʰāni .
saṃvatsaraḥ kr̥tsnam annādyaṃ pacati saṃvatsarābʰijitam eva tad annādyam upayanti .
pañcaviṃśaṃ mahāvratam annaṃ vai pañcaviṃśam annādyasyaivāvaruddʰyai .
etad vai prajñātaṃ devatīrtʰaṃ yaj jyotir atirātraḥ .
text: These Babaras among the Kurus are merely traders. He used to wander about at the divine place of sacrifice [saying]: 'This he sacrificed, this he did not sacrifice.' Now, the [rite] whose three-day [portion] has jyotis, go, and ayus, with a visvajit, all-prstha ukthya, a sodasi, a chandomapavamana, an all-stoma ukthya, a twenty-five-fold mahavrata, and a jyotis atiratra -- whoever desires 'having approached the abhiplava, having approached the prsthas, having approached the chandomas, may the mahavrata be approached for me' should sacrifice with this. Having approached the abhiplava, having approached the prsthas, having approached the chandomas, the mahavrata becomes approached for him. Food is the mahavrata -- for the securing of food. On this they say: 'The mahavrata should not be approached before a year.' Because the prsthya six-day occurs -- the prsthas are the seasons. The seasons are the year. The year cooks all food. They approach the food conquered through the year. The mahavrata is twenty-five-fold. Food is twenty-five-fold -- for the securing of food. The jyotis atiratra -- this is the well-known divine ford, the jyotis atiratra.
meaning: एते बाबरयः कुरुषु पणाय्या एव . स ह स्म तद् देवयजने परिचरतीदम् अयज इदम् उ नायज इति . अथ यस्यैतस्य ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुर् इति त्र्यहो विश्वजित् सर्वपृष्ठ्य उक्थ्यष् षोडशिमाञ् छन्दोमपवमानः सर्वस्तोम उक्थ्यः पञ्चविंशं महाव्रतं ज्योतिर् अतिरात्रो यः कामयेतोपेत्याभिप्लवम् उपेत्य पृष्ठान्य् उपेत्य छन्दोमान् महाव्रतं म उपेतं स्याद् इति स एतेन यजेत . उपेत्य हैवाभिप्लवम् उपेत्य पृष्ठान्य् उपेत्य छन्दोमान् महाव्रतम् अस्योपेतं भवत्य् अन्नं वै महाव्रतम् अन्नाद्यस्यैवावरुद्ध्यै . तद् आहुर् न पुरा संवत्सरान् महाव्रतम् उपेत्यम् इति . तद् यत् पृष्ठ्यष् षडहो भवत्य् ऋतवो वै पृष्ठानि . संवत्सर ऋतवः . संवत्सरः कृत्स्नम् अन्नाद्यं पचति संवत्सराभिजितम् एव तद् अन्नाद्यम् उपयन्ति . पञ्चविंशं महाव्रतम् अन्नं वै पञ्चविंशम् अन्नाद्यस्यैवावरुद्ध्यै . ज्योतिर् अतिरात्रः . एतद् वै प्रज्ञातं देवतीर्थं यज् ज्योतिर् अतिरात्रः .

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhyaṣ ṣaḍaho 'tha yat saptamam ahas tasya caturviṃśaṃ bahiṣpavamānaṃ trayastriṃśāny uttarāṇi stotrāṇi pañcaviṃśaṃ mahāvrataṃ catustriṃśam agniṣṭomasāma . āpyata iva vā etad yajño yad eṣa pṛṣṭhyaṣ ṣaḍaha āpyata iti . tad yat saptamasyāhnaś caturviṃśaṃ bahiṣpavamānaṃ bhavati caturviṃśatyardhamāsas saṃvatsaraḥ . saṃvatsaro yajño yajñam evaitad yajñamukha ārabhante . atho caturviṃśatyakṣarā vai gāyatrī . gāyatryo vā āptaṃ yajñakratuṃ punas tanvate . teno hy anyā gāyatryā āptaṃ yajñakratum udyantum arhati . trayastriṃśāny uttarāṇi stotrāṇi trayastriṃśad vai devatā devatānām evāptyai . pañcaviṃśaṃ mahāvratam annaṃ vai pañcaviṃśam annādyasyaivāvaruddhyai . catustriṃśam agniṣṭomasāma . trayastriṃśad vai devatāḥ . prajāpatiś catustriṃśaḥ . saprajāpatikāsv evaitad devatāsu yajñasyāntataḥ pratitiṣṭhati . pṛṣṭhya eva ṣaḍaho 'tha yat saptamam ahas tasya caturviṃśāḥ pavamānās trayastriṃśaṃ punarabhyāvarti pañcaviṃśaṃ mahāvrataṃ catustriṃśam agniṣṭomasāma . āpyata iva vā etad yajño yad eṣa pṛṣṭhyaṣ ṣaḍaha āpyata iti . tad yat saptamasyāhnaś caturviṃśāḥ pavamānā bhavanti savanamukhe savanamukhe no yajña ārabdho 'sad iti . trayastriṃśaṃ punarabhyāvarti trayastriṃśad vai devatā devatānām evāptyai . pañcaviṃśaṃ mahāvratam annaṃ vai pañcaviṃśam annādyasyaivāvaruddhyai . catustriṃśam agniṣṭomasāma . trayastriṃśad vai devatāḥ . prajāpatiś catustriṃśaḥ .
sentences: pr̥ṣṭʰyaṣ ṣaḍaho 'tʰa yat saptamam ahas tasya caturviṃśaṃ bahiṣpavamānaṃ trayastriṃśāny uttarāṇi stotrāṇi pañcaviṃśaṃ mahāvrataṃ catustriṃśam agniṣṭomasāma .
āpyata iva vā etad yajño yad eṣa pr̥ṣṭʰyaṣ ṣaḍaha āpyata iti .
tad yat saptamasyāhnaś caturviṃśaṃ bahiṣpavamānaṃ bʰavati caturviṃśatyardʰamāsas saṃvatsaraḥ .
saṃvatsaro yajño yajñam evaitad yajñamukʰa ārabʰante .
gāyatryo vā āptaṃ yajñakratuṃ punas tanvate .
teno hy anyā gāyatryā āptaṃ yajñakratum udyantum arhati .
trayastriṃśāny uttarāṇi stotrāṇi trayastriṃśad vai devatā devatānām evāptyai .
pañcaviṃśaṃ mahāvratam annaṃ vai pañcaviṃśam annādyasyaivāvaruddʰyai .
pr̥ṣṭʰya eva ṣaḍaho 'tʰa yat saptamam ahas tasya caturviṃśāḥ pavamānās trayastriṃśaṃ punarabʰyāvarti pañcaviṃśaṃ mahāvrataṃ catustriṃśam agniṣṭomasāma .
āpyata iva vā etad yajño yad eṣa pr̥ṣṭʰyaṣ ṣaḍaha āpyata iti .
tad yat saptamasyāhnaś caturviṃśāḥ pavamānā bʰavanti savanamukʰe savanamukʰe no yajña ārabdʰo 'sad iti .
trayastriṃśaṃ punarabʰyāvarti trayastriṃśad vai devatā devatānām evāptyai .
pañcaviṃśaṃ mahāvratam annaṃ vai pañcaviṃśam annādyasyaivāvaruddʰyai .
text: The prsthya six-day. Now, whatever is the seventh day: its bahispavamana is twenty-four-fold; the later chants are thirty-three-fold; the mahavrata is twenty-five-fold; the agnistoma-saman is thirty-four-fold. 'The sacrifice becomes as it were exhausted when this prsthya six-day is exhausted.' Because the bahispavamana of the seventh day is twenty-four-fold -- twenty-four half-months make a year. The year is the sacrifice. They thereby take hold of the sacrifice at the opening of the sacrifice. And the gayatri has twenty-four syllables. By gayatris one extends anew a sacrificial rite that has been attained. Therefore another gayatri is able to raise up an attained sacrificial rite. The later chants are thirty-three-fold. Thirty-three are the deities -- for the attainment of the deities. The mahavrata is twenty-five-fold. Food is twenty-five-fold -- for the securing of food. The agnistoma-saman is thirty-four-fold. Thirty-three are the deities. Prajapati is the thirty-fourth. In the deities together with Prajapati, one thereby finds establishment at the end of the sacrifice. Again, the prsthya six-day. Now whatever is the seventh day: its pavamanas are twenty-four-fold; the [stoma is] a thirty-three-fold punarabhyavarti; the mahavrata is twenty-five-fold; the agnistoma-saman is thirty-four-fold. 'The sacrifice becomes as it were exhausted when this prsthya six-day is exhausted.' Because the pavamanas of the seventh day are twenty-four-fold -- 'let the sacrifice be taken hold of at the opening of each pressing.' The punarabhyavarti is thirty-three-fold. Thirty-three are the deities -- for the attainment of the deities. The mahavrata is twenty-five-fold. Food is twenty-five-fold -- for the securing of food. The agnistoma-saman is thirty-four-fold. Thirty-three are the deities. Prajapati is the thirty-fourth.
meaning: पृष्ठ्यष् षडहो ऽथ यत् सप्तमम् अहस् तस्य चतुर्विंशं बहिष्पवमानं त्रयस्त्रिंशान्य् उत्तराणि स्तोत्राणि पञ्चविंशं महाव्रतं चतुस्त्रिंशम् अग्निष्टोमसाम . आप्यत इव वा एतद् यज्ञो यद् एष पृष्ठ्यष् षडह आप्यत इति . तद् यत् सप्तमस्याह्नश् चतुर्विंशं बहिष्पवमानं भवति चतुर्विंशत्यर्धमासस् संवत्सरः . संवत्सरो यज्ञो यज्ञम् एवैतद् यज्ञमुख आरभन्ते . अथो चतुर्विंशत्यक्षरा वै गायत्री . गायत्र्यो वा आप्तं यज्ञक्रतुं पुनस् तन्वते . तेनो ह्य् अन्या गायत्र्या आप्तं यज्ञक्रतुम् उद्यन्तुम् अर्हति . त्रयस्त्रिंशान्य् उत्तराणि स्तोत्राणि त्रयस्त्रिंशद् वै देवता देवतानाम् एवाप्त्यै . पञ्चविंशं महाव्रतम् अन्नं वै पञ्चविंशम् अन्नाद्यस्यैवावरुद्ध्यै . चतुस्त्रिंशम् अग्निष्टोमसाम . त्रयस्त्रिंशद् वै देवताः . प्रजापतिश् चतुस्त्रिंशः . सप्रजापतिकास्व् एवैतद् देवतासु यज्ञस्यान्ततः प्रतितिष्ठति . पृष्ठ्य एव षडहो ऽथ यत् सप्तमम् अहस् तस्य चतुर्विंशाः पवमानास् त्रयस्त्रिंशं पुनरभ्यावर्ति पञ्चविंशं महाव्रतं चतुस्त्रिंशम् अग्निष्टोमसाम . आप्यत इव वा एतद् यज्ञो यद् एष पृष्ठ्यष् षडह आप्यत इति . तद् यत् सप्तमस्याह्नश् चतुर्विंशाः पवमाना भवन्ति सवनमुखे सवनमुखे नो यज्ञ आरब्धो ऽसद् इति . त्रयस्त्रिंशं पुनरभ्यावर्ति त्रयस्त्रिंशद् वै देवता देवतानाम् एवाप्त्यै . पञ्चविंशं महाव्रतम् अन्नं वै पञ्चविंशम् अन्नाद्यस्यैवावरुद्ध्यै . चतुस्त्रिंशम् अग्निष्टोमसाम . त्रयस्त्रिंशद् वै देवताः . प्रजापतिश् चतुस्त्रिंशः .

sanskrit_iast: pṛṣṭhya eva ṣaḍaho 'tha yat saptamam ahas tat sarvam eva caturviṃśaṃ pañcaviṃśaṃ mahāvrataṃ catustriṃśam agniṣṭomasāma . āpyata iva vā etad yajño yad eṣa pṛṣṭhyaṣ ṣaḍaha āpyata iti . tad yat saptamam ahas sarvam eva caturviṃśaṃ bhavati sarveṇaivāhnā yajña ārabdho 'sad iti . pañcaviṃśaṃ mahāvratam annaṃ vai pañcaviṃśam annādyasyaivāvaruddhyai . catustriṃśam agniṣṭomasāma . trayastriṃśad vai devatāḥ . prajāpatiś catustriṃśaḥ . saprajāpatikāsv evaitad devatāsu yajñasyāntataḥ pratitiṣṭhati . pṛṣṭhya eva ṣaḍaho 'tha yat saptamam ahas tasya chandomāḥ pavamānāś catustriṃśaṃ punarabhyāvarti pañcaviṃśaṃ mahāvrataṃ trayastriṃśam agniṣṭomasāma . yaḥ kāmayetopetya pṛṣṭhāny upetya chandomān mahāvrataṃ ma upetaṃ syād iti sa etena yajeta . upetya haiva pṛṣṭhāny upetya chandomān mahāvratam asyopetaṃ bhavaty annaṃ vai mahāvratam annādyasyaivāvaruddhyai . catustriṃśaṃ punarabhyāvarti . trayastriṃśad vai devatāḥ . prajāpatiś catustriṃśaḥ . saprajāpatikāsv evaitad devatāsu pratitiṣṭhati . pañcaviṃśaṃ mahāvratam annaṃ vai pañcaviṃśam annādyasyaivāvaruddhyai .
sentences: pr̥ṣṭʰya eva ṣaḍaho 'tʰa yat saptamam ahas tat sarvam eva caturviṃśaṃ pañcaviṃśaṃ mahāvrataṃ catustriṃśam agniṣṭomasāma .
āpyata iva vā etad yajño yad eṣa pr̥ṣṭʰyaṣ ṣaḍaha āpyata iti .
tad yat saptamam ahas sarvam eva caturviṃśaṃ bʰavati sarveṇaivāhnā yajña ārabdʰo 'sad iti .
pañcaviṃśaṃ mahāvratam annaṃ vai pañcaviṃśam annādyasyaivāvaruddʰyai .
pr̥ṣṭʰya eva ṣaḍaho 'tʰa yat saptamam ahas tasya cʰandomāḥ pavamānāś catustriṃśaṃ punarabʰyāvarti pañcaviṃśaṃ mahāvrataṃ trayastriṃśam agniṣṭomasāma .
yaḥ kāmayetopetya pr̥ṣṭʰāny upetya cʰandomān mahāvrataṃ ma upetaṃ syād iti sa etena yajeta .
upetya haiva pr̥ṣṭʰāny upetya cʰandomān mahāvratam asyopetaṃ bʰavaty annaṃ vai mahāvratam annādyasyaivāvaruddʰyai .
pañcaviṃśaṃ mahāvratam annaṃ vai pañcaviṃśam annādyasyaivāvaruddʰyai .
text: Again, the prsthya six-day. Now whatever is the seventh day: it is entirely twenty-four-fold; the mahavrata is twenty-five-fold; the agnistoma-saman is thirty-four-fold. 'The sacrifice becomes as it were exhausted when this prsthya six-day is exhausted.' Because the seventh day is entirely twenty-four-fold -- 'let the sacrifice be taken hold of by the entire day.' The mahavrata is twenty-five-fold. Food is twenty-five-fold -- for the securing of food. The agnistoma-saman is thirty-four-fold. Thirty-three are the deities. Prajapati is the thirty-fourth. In the deities together with Prajapati, one thereby finds establishment at the end of the sacrifice. Again, the prsthya six-day. Now whatever is the seventh day: its pavamanas are chandoma rites; the punarabhyavarti is thirty-four-fold; the mahavrata is twenty-five-fold; the agnistoma-saman is thirty-three-fold. Whoever desires 'having approached the prsthas, having approached the chandomas, may the mahavrata be approached for me' should sacrifice with this. Having approached the prsthas, having approached the chandomas, the mahavrata becomes approached for him. Food is the mahavrata -- for the securing of food. The punarabhyavarti is thirty-four-fold. Thirty-three are the deities. Prajapati is the thirty-fourth. In the deities together with Prajapati, one thereby finds establishment. The mahavrata is twenty-five-fold. Food is twenty-five-fold -- for the securing of food.
meaning: पृष्ठ्य एव षडहो ऽथ यत् सप्तमम् अहस् तत् सर्वम् एव चतुर्विंशं पञ्चविंशं महाव्रतं चतुस्त्रिंशम् अग्निष्टोमसाम . आप्यत इव वा एतद् यज्ञो यद् एष पृष्ठ्यष् षडह आप्यत इति . तद् यत् सप्तमम् अहस् सर्वम् एव चतुर्विंशं भवति सर्वेणैवाह्ना यज्ञ आरब्धो ऽसद् इति . पञ्चविंशं महाव्रतम् अन्नं वै पञ्चविंशम् अन्नाद्यस्यैवावरुद्ध्यै . चतुस्त्रिंशम् अग्निष्टोमसाम . त्रयस्त्रिंशद् वै देवताः . प्रजापतिश् चतुस्त्रिंशः . सप्रजापतिकास्व् एवैतद् देवतासु यज्ञस्यान्ततः प्रतितिष्ठति . पृष्ठ्य एव षडहो ऽथ यत् सप्तमम् अहस् तस्य छन्दोमाः पवमानाश् चतुस्त्रिंशं पुनरभ्यावर्ति पञ्चविंशं महाव्रतं त्रयस्त्रिंशम् अग्निष्टोमसाम . यः कामयेतोपेत्य पृष्ठान्य् उपेत्य छन्दोमान् महाव्रतं म उपेतं स्याद् इति स एतेन यजेत . उपेत्य हैव पृष्ठान्य् उपेत्य छन्दोमान् महाव्रतम् अस्योपेतं भवत्य् अन्नं वै महाव्रतम् अन्नाद्यस्यैवावरुद्ध्यै . चतुस्त्रिंशं पुनरभ्यावर्ति . त्रयस्त्रिंशद् वै देवताः . प्रजापतिश् चतुस्त्रिंशः . सप्रजापतिकास्व् एवैतद् देवतासु प्रतितिष्ठति . पञ्चविंशं महाव्रतम् अन्नं वै पञ्चविंशम् अन्नाद्यस्यैवावरुद्ध्यै .

sanskrit_iast: athaitau saṃsaṅgyau . jamadagnir ha vai māhenānāṃ purohita āsa . tān ha vittenātyādadhau . ta u hainam upajihiṃsuḥ . sa hekṣāṃ cakre kathaṃ nv aham eṣāṃ sapta saptaikāhani grāmyāṇāṃ paśūnāṃ hanyām iti . sa etau yajñāv apaśyat . tāv āharata . tābhyām ayajata . tato vai sa teṣāṃ sapta-saptaikāhani grāmyāṇāṃ paśūnām ahan . sa vā eṣo 'chidro vajraḥ . tān ha smaitenaivāchidreṇa vajreṇopapravartayati . tad yathā matyena tilāṃs tṛṃhyād evaṃ ha smaivaināṃs tat tṛḍhān apoptān abhivyucchati . sa yo bhrātṛvyavān syād yo 'bhicared ya spardheta sa etābhyāṃ yajeta . etenaivāchidreṇa vajreṇa dviṣantaṃ pāpmānaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ stṛṇute . atho āhuḥ prajākāma evābhyāṃ yajeteti . stomo vā etat stomena saṃsakto bhavati saṃsaktād vai mithunāt prajāḥ paśavaḥ prajāyante prajātyā eva . athaitat saptadaśaṃ saptamam ahar bhavati . tasmin mahāvratam upayanti . prajāpatir vai saptadaśaḥ .
sentences: jamadagnir ha vai māhenānāṃ purohita āsa .
sa hekṣāṃ cakre katʰaṃ nv aham eṣāṃ sapta saptaikāhani grāmyāṇāṃ paśūnāṃ hanyām iti .
tato vai sa teṣāṃ sapta-saptaikāhani grāmyāṇāṃ paśūnām ahan .
tad yatʰā matyena tilāṃs tr̥ṃhyād evaṃ ha smaivaināṃs tat tr̥ḍʰān apoptān abʰivyuccʰati .
sa yo bʰrātr̥vyavān syād yo 'bʰicared ya spardʰeta sa etābʰyāṃ yajeta .
etenaivācʰidreṇa vajreṇa dviṣantaṃ pāpmānaṃ bʰrātr̥vyaṃ str̥ṇute .
stomo vā etat stomena saṃsakto bʰavati saṃsaktād vai mitʰunāt prajāḥ paśavaḥ prajāyante prajātyā eva .
text: Now these two are the Samsangyas (Interlocking rites). Jamadagni was the purohita of the Mahenas. He surpassed them in wealth. They then tried to harm him. He considered: 'How might I slay seven times seven of their domestic animals in a single day?' He saw these two sacrifices. He brought them forth. He sacrificed with them. Then he slew seven times seven of their domestic animals in a single day. This is an unbroken thunderbolt. He used to set them in motion with just this unbroken thunderbolt. Just as one crushes sesame seeds with a pressing-stone, so he used to see them crushed and scattered at dawn. He who has a rival, who practices sorcery, who competes -- let him sacrifice with these two. With this unbroken thunderbolt, one destroys the hated evil rival. And they say: 'One desiring offspring should sacrifice with these two.' For stoma is joined to stoma; from a joined pairing, offspring and cattle are born -- for the sake of procreation indeed. Now this seventh day has the saptadasa [stoma]. On that they approach the mahavrata. Prajapati is saptadasa.
meaning: अथैतौ संसङ्ग्यौ . जमदग्निर् ह वै माहेनानां पुरोहित आस . तान् ह वित्तेनात्यादधौ . त उ हैनम् उपजिहिंसुः . स हेक्षां चक्रे कथं न्व् अहम् एषां सप्त सप्तैकाहनि ग्राम्याणां पशूनां हन्याम् इति . स एतौ यज्ञाव् अपश्यत् . ताव् आहरत . ताभ्याम् अयजत . ततो वै स तेषां सप्त-सप्तैकाहनि ग्राम्याणां पशूनाम् अहन् . स वा एषो ऽछिद्रो वज्रः . तान् ह स्मैतेनैवाछिद्रेण वज्रेणोपप्रवर्तयति . तद् यथा मत्येन तिलांस् तृंह्याद् एवं ह स्मैवैनांस् तत् तृढान् अपोप्तान् अभिव्युच्छति . स यो भ्रातृव्यवान् स्याद् यो ऽभिचरेद् य स्पर्धेत स एताभ्यां यजेत . एतेनैवाछिद्रेण वज्रेण द्विषन्तं पाप्मानं भ्रातृव्यं स्तृणुते . अथो आहुः प्रजाकाम एवाभ्यां यजेतेति . स्तोमो वा एतत् स्तोमेन संसक्तो भवति संसक्ताद् वै मिथुनात् प्रजाः पशवः प्रजायन्ते प्रजात्या एव . अथैतत् सप्तदशं सप्तमम् अहर् भवति . तस्मिन् महाव्रतम् उपयन्ति . प्रजापतिर् वै सप्तदशः .

sanskrit_iast: athaite 'ṣṭarātrāh . bṛhaspatir vā akāmayata tejasvī brahmavarcasī syāṃ yaśo deveṣu gaccheyam iti . sa etam aṣṭarātraṃ yajñam apaśyat . tam āharat . tenāyajata . tato vai sa tejasvī brahmavarcasy abhavad yaśo deveṣv agacchat . yaśo hy eṣa tad agacchad yad eṣāṃ purodhām āśnuta . tejasvī brahmavarcasī bhavati yaśo deveṣu gacchati ya evaṃ veda . atho āhur āyuṣkāma evainena yajeteti . prāṇo vai gāyatrī . gāyatrīm eṣa yajño 'bhi saṃpannaḥ . tasmād u hainenāyuṣkāmo yajeta . atho āhuḥ paśukāma evainena yajeteti . aṣṭākṣarā vai gāyatrī . aṣṭāśaphāḥ paśavaḥ . paśavo gāyatrī . gāyatrīm eṣa yajño 'bhi saṃpannaḥ . tasmād u hainena paśukāmo yajeta . prajāpatir vā akāmayatāsmāl lokād amuṃ lokaṃ gaccheyam iti . sa etam aṣṭarātraṃ yajñam apaśyat . tam āharat . tenāyajata . tato vai so 'smāl lokād amuṃ lokam āṣṭa . yad asmāl lokād amuṃ lokam āṣṭa tad aṣṭarātrāṇām aṣṭarātratvam . aṣṭe hāsmāl lokād amuṃ lokaṃ ya evaṃ veda . tad āhuḥ kim anv aṣṭarātra iti . diśa iti brūyāt . diśo ha vā anv aṣṭarātraḥ . catasro diśaś catvāro 'vāntaradeṣāḥ . ūrdhvā diṅ navamī . aṣṭāv etāny ahāni bhavanti rātrir navamī .
sentences: br̥haspatir vā akāmayata tejasvī brahmavarcasī syāṃ yaśo deveṣu gaccʰeyam iti .
tato vai sa tejasvī brahmavarcasy abʰavad yaśo deveṣv agaccʰat .
yaśo hy eṣa tad agaccʰad yad eṣāṃ purodʰām āśnuta .
tejasvī brahmavarcasī bʰavati yaśo deveṣu gaccʰati ya evaṃ veda .
prajāpatir vā akāmayatāsmāl lokād amuṃ lokaṃ gaccʰeyam iti .
tato vai so 'smāl lokād amuṃ lokam āṣṭa .
yad asmāl lokād amuṃ lokam āṣṭa tad aṣṭarātrāṇām aṣṭarātratvam .
aṣṭe hāsmāl lokād amuṃ lokaṃ ya evaṃ veda .
tad āhuḥ kim anv aṣṭarātra iti .
aṣṭāv etāny ahāni bʰavanti rātrir navamī .
text: Now these are the eight-night [rites]. Brhaspati desired: 'May I be radiant, possessed of brahman-splendor; may I attain glory among the gods.' He saw this eight-night sacrifice. He brought it forth. He sacrificed with it. Then he became radiant, possessed of brahman-splendor, and attained glory among the gods. For he attained that glory when he obtained the office of purohita among them. One becomes radiant, possessed of brahman-splendor, and attains glory among the gods, who knows thus. And they say: 'One desiring long life should sacrifice with this.' Prana is the gayatri. This sacrifice corresponds to the gayatri. Therefore one desiring long life should sacrifice with this. And they say: 'One desiring cattle should sacrifice with this.' The gayatri has eight syllables. Animals have eight hooves. Animals are the gayatri. This sacrifice corresponds to the gayatri. Therefore one desiring cattle should sacrifice with this. Prajapati desired: 'May I go from this world to yonder world.' He saw this eight-night sacrifice. He brought it forth. He sacrificed with it. Then from this world he reached (asta) yonder world. Because he reached (asta) yonder world from this world, that is the eight-night-nature (astaratra) of the eight-night [rites]. One who knows thus reaches from this world to yonder world. On this they say: 'What does the eight-night [rite] follow?' One should answer: 'The directions.' The eight-night [rite] follows the directions. Four directions and four intermediate directions. The upward direction is the ninth. Eight are these days, the night is the ninth.
meaning: अथैते ऽष्टरात्राह् . बृहस्पतिर् वा अकामयत तेजस्वी ब्रह्मवर्चसी स्यां यशो देवेषु गच्छेयम् इति . स एतम् अष्टरात्रं यज्ञम् अपश्यत् . तम् आहरत् . तेनायजत . ततो वै स तेजस्वी ब्रह्मवर्चस्य् अभवद् यशो देवेष्व् अगच्छत् . यशो ह्य् एष तद् अगच्छद् यद् एषां पुरोधाम् आश्नुत . तेजस्वी ब्रह्मवर्चसी भवति यशो देवेषु गच्छति य एवं वेद . अथो आहुर् आयुष्काम एवैनेन यजेतेति . प्राणो वै गायत्री . गायत्रीम् एष यज्ञो ऽभि संपन्नः . तस्माद् उ हैनेनायुष्कामो यजेत . अथो आहुः पशुकाम एवैनेन यजेतेति . अष्टाक्षरा वै गायत्री . अष्टाशफाः पशवः . पशवो गायत्री . गायत्रीम् एष यज्ञो ऽभि संपन्नः . तस्माद् उ हैनेन पशुकामो यजेत . प्रजापतिर् वा अकामयतास्माल् लोकाद् अमुं लोकं गच्छेयम् इति . स एतम् अष्टरात्रं यज्ञम् अपश्यत् . तम् आहरत् . तेनायजत . ततो वै सो ऽस्माल् लोकाद् अमुं लोकम् आष्ट . यद् अस्माल् लोकाद् अमुं लोकम् आष्ट तद् अष्टरात्राणाम् अष्टरात्रत्वम् . अष्टे हास्माल् लोकाद् अमुं लोकं य एवं वेद . तद् आहुः किम् अन्व् अष्टरात्र इति . दिश इति ब्रूयात् . दिशो ह वा अन्व् अष्टरात्रः . चतस्रो दिशश् चत्वारो ऽवान्तरदेषाः . ऊर्ध्वा दिङ् नवमी . अष्टाव् एतान्य् अहानि भवन्ति रात्रिर् नवमी .

sanskrit_iast: atha yasyaitasya jyotir agniṣṭomaḥ pṛṣṭhyaṣ ṣaḍaho jyotir agniṣṭomo yaḥ kāmayeta tejasvī brahmavarcasy asmin loke syāṃ gaccheyaṃ svargaṃ lokaṃ tejasvī brahmavarcasy amuṣmin loke syām iti sa etena yajeta . tad yat purastāj jyotir agniṣṭomo bhavati tejo vai brahmavarcasaṃ jyotir agniṣṭomas tenaivāsmin loke tejasvī bramavarcasī bhavati . pṛṣṭhyaṣ ṣaḍaho bhavati svargo vai lokaḥ pṛṣṭhyaṣ ṣaḍaha svargam evaitena lokaṃ gacchati . jyotir agniṣṭoma upariṣṭād bhavati tejo vai brahmavarcasaṃ jyotir agniṣṭomas tenaivāmuṣmin loke brahmavarcasī bhavati . atha yasyaitasya jyotir atirātraḥ pṛṣṭhyaṣ ṣaḍaho jyotir atirātro yaḥ kāmayeta praty asmin loke tiṣṭheyaṃ gaccheyaṃ svargaṃ lokaṃ praty amuṣmin loke tiṣṭheyam iti sa etena yajeta . tad yat purastāj jyotir atirātro bhavaty eṣā vai kṛtsnā pratiṣṭhā yaj jyotir atirātras tenaivāsmin loke pratitiṣṭhati . pṛṣṭhyaṣ ṣaḍaho bhavati svargo vai lokaḥ pṛṣṭhyaṣ ṣaḍaha svargam evaitena lokaṃ gacchati .

text: Now, the [rite] whose jyotis agnistoma is [first], then the prsthya six-day, then the jyotis agnistoma -- whoever desires 'may I be radiant, possessed of brahman-splendor in this world; may I go to the heavenly world; may I be radiant, possessed of brahman-splendor in yonder world' should sacrifice with this. Because the jyotis agnistoma is in front -- radiance and brahman-splendor is the jyotis agnistoma -- thereby one becomes radiant, possessed of brahman-splendor in this world. The prsthya six-day occurs -- the heavenly world is the prsthya six-day; by this one goes to the heavenly world. The jyotis agnistoma is at the end -- radiance and brahman-splendor is the jyotis agnistoma -- thereby one becomes possessed of brahman-splendor in yonder world. Now, the [rite] whose jyotis atiratra is [first], then the prsthya six-day, then the jyotis atiratra -- whoever desires 'may I stand established in this world; may I go to the heavenly world; may I stand established in yonder world' should sacrifice with this. Because the jyotis atiratra is in front -- this is the complete establishment, the jyotis atiratra -- thereby one becomes established in this world. The prsthya six-day occurs -- the heavenly world is the prsthya six-day; by this one goes to the heavenly world.
meaning: अथ यस्यैतस्य ज्योतिर् अग्निष्टोमः पृष्ठ्यष् षडहो ज्योतिर् अग्निष्टोमो यः कामयेत तेजस्वी ब्रह्मवर्चस्य् अस्मिन् लोके स्यां गच्छेयं स्वर्गं लोकं तेजस्वी ब्रह्मवर्चस्य् अमुष्मिन् लोके स्याम् इति स एतेन यजेत . तद् यत् पुरस्ताज् ज्योतिर् अग्निष्टोमो भवति तेजो वै ब्रह्मवर्चसं ज्योतिर् अग्निष्टोमस् तेनैवास्मिन् लोके तेजस्वी ब्रमवर्चसी भवति . पृष्ठ्यष् षडहो भवति स्वर्गो वै लोकः पृष्ठ्यष् षडह स्वर्गम् एवैतेन लोकं गच्छति . ज्योतिर् अग्निष्टोम उपरिष्टाद् भवति तेजो वै ब्रह्मवर्चसं ज्योतिर् अग्निष्टोमस् तेनैवामुष्मिन् लोके ब्रह्मवर्चसी भवति . अथ यस्यैतस्य ज्योतिर् अतिरात्रः पृष्ठ्यष् षडहो ज्योतिर् अतिरात्रो यः कामयेत प्रत्य् अस्मिन् लोके तिष्ठेयं गच्छेयं स्वर्गं लोकं प्रत्य् अमुष्मिन् लोके तिष्ठेयम् इति स एतेन यजेत . तद् यत् पुरस्ताज् ज्योतिर् अतिरात्रो भवत्य् एषा वै कृत्स्ना प्रतिष्ठा यज् ज्योतिर् अतिरात्रस् तेनैवास्मिन् लोके प्रतितिष्ठति . पृष्ठ्यष् षडहो भवति स्वर्गो वै लोकः पृष्ठ्यष् षडह स्वर्गम् एवैतेन लोकं गच्छति .

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣa pṛṣṭhyaṣ ṣaḍahaḥ pañcaviṃśaṃ mahāvrataṃ sarvastomo 'tirātraḥ . annādyakāmo haitena yajeta . tad āhur na purā saṃvatsarān mahāvratam upetyam iti . tad yat pṛṣṭhyaṣ ṣaḍaho bhavaty ṛtavo vai pṛṣṭhāni . saṃvatsara ṛtavaḥ . saṃvatsaraḥ kṛtsnam annādyaṃ pacati saṃvatsarābhijitam eva tad annādyam upayanti . pañcaviṃśaṃ mahāvratam annaṃ vai pañcaviṃśam annādyasyaivāvaruddhyai . sarvastomo 'tirātro bhavati sarveṣāṃ lokānām abhijityā abhikrāntyai . sarvaṃ hīdaṃ stomā eva . atho yān imān ekaikān stomān upāgāma tān sārdham ṛddhvā teṣu pratiṣṭhāyodṛcam aśnavāmahā iti . atha yasyaitasya pṛṣṭhyasya ṣaḍahasya stomāś caturviṃśam ahar viśvajit sarvapṛṣṭho 'tirātro yaḥ kāmayeta parokṣopetaṃ me mahāvrataṃ syād iti sa etena yajeta . tad yac caturviṃśam ahar bhavati tenaivāsya parokṣopetaṃ mahāvrataṃ bhavati . yad v eva tatra hiṃkāro vā prastāvo vā pratihāro vā kiñcid bhavati tenaivāsya pañcaviṃśy upāptā bhavati . viśvajit sarvapṛṣṭho 'tirātro bhavati . śrīr vai varṣma pṛṣṭhāni .

text: Now this is the prsthya six-day [rite] with the twenty-five-fold mahavrata and an atiratra of all stomas. One desiring food should sacrifice with this. On this they say: 'The mahavrata should not be approached before a year.' Because the prsthya six-day occurs -- the prsthas are the seasons. The seasons are the year. The year cooks all food. They approach the food conquered through the year. The mahavrata is twenty-five-fold. Food is twenty-five-fold -- for the securing of food. The atiratra has all stomas, for conquering and surpassing all worlds. For all this is indeed the stomas. 'Those stomas which we have approached one by one, having attained them together and established in them, let us attain the surplus.' Now, the [rite] whose prsthya six-day has [specific] stomas, with a twenty-four-fold day, and a visvajit, all-prstha atiratra -- whoever desires 'let my mahavrata be approached indirectly' should sacrifice with this. Because a twenty-four-fold day occurs, thereby his mahavrata is approached indirectly. Whatever himkara, prastava, or pratihara occurs therein, by that his twenty-five-fold [nature] is attained. The atiratra is a visvajit with all prsthas. Prosperity, eminence, is the prsthas.
meaning: अथैष पृष्ठ्यष् षडहः पञ्चविंशं महाव्रतं सर्वस्तोमो ऽतिरात्रः . अन्नाद्यकामो हैतेन यजेत . तद् आहुर् न पुरा संवत्सरान् महाव्रतम् उपेत्यम् इति . तद् यत् पृष्ठ्यष् षडहो भवत्य् ऋतवो वै पृष्ठानि . संवत्सर ऋतवः . संवत्सरः कृत्स्नम् अन्नाद्यं पचति संवत्सराभिजितम् एव तद् अन्नाद्यम् उपयन्ति . पञ्चविंशं महाव्रतम् अन्नं वै पञ्चविंशम् अन्नाद्यस्यैवावरुद्ध्यै . सर्वस्तोमो ऽतिरात्रो भवति सर्वेषां लोकानाम् अभिजित्या अभिक्रान्त्यै . सर्वं हीदं स्तोमा एव . अथो यान् इमान् एकैकान् स्तोमान् उपागाम तान् सार्धम् ऋद्ध्वा तेषु प्रतिष्ठायोदृचम् अश्नवामहा इति . अथ यस्यैतस्य पृष्ठ्यस्य षडहस्य स्तोमाश् चतुर्विंशम् अहर् विश्वजित् सर्वपृष्ठो ऽतिरात्रो यः कामयेत परोक्षोपेतं मे महाव्रतं स्याद् इति स एतेन यजेत . तद् यच् चतुर्विंशम् अहर् भवति तेनैवास्य परोक्षोपेतं महाव्रतं भवति . यद् व् एव तत्र हिंकारो वा प्रस्तावो वा प्रतिहारो वा किञ्चिद् भवति तेनैवास्य पञ्चविंश्य् उपाप्ता भवति . विश्वजित् सर्वपृष्ठो ऽतिरात्रो भवति . श्रीर् वै वर्ष्म पृष्ठानि .

sanskrit_iast: atha yasyaitasya pṛṣṭhyasya ṣaḍahasya jyotir agniṣṭomo madhye bhavati jyotir atirātra upariṣṭād yaḥ kāmayetā me brahmavarcasī prajāyāṃ jāyeteti sa etena yajeta . ātma vai pṛṣṭhyaṣ ṣaḍahaḥ . tejo vai brahmavarcasaṃ jyotir agniṣṭomaḥ . madhyata u vā ātmanaḥ prajananam . tad yan madhye jyotir agniṣṭomo bhavati madhyata evaitad ātmano jyotir dhatta ā hāsya brahmavarcasī prajāyāṃ jāyate . jyotir atirātra upariṣṭād etad vai prajñātaṃ devatīrthaṃ yaj jyotir atirātraḥ prajñātena devatīrthenāriṣṭenāriṣṭā udṛcam aśnavāmahā iti . atha yasyaitasya viśvajidabhijitāv agniṣṭomāv abhito bhavata ubhayato jyotiṣ ṣaḍaho madhye paśukāmo haitena yajeta . catvāra ete madhya ukthyā bhavanti . paśavo vā ukthāni . teṣāṃ sahasraṃ stotriyāḥ . catvāra u vaite 'gniṣṭomā abhito bhavanti . brahma vai jyotir agniṣṭomaḥ . brahmaṇaiva tad ubhayataḥ paśūn parigṛhṇīte 'parāvāpāya . nāsya vittaṃ paropyate ya evaṃ veda . īśvaro ha tu yādṛśa eva san yajate tādṛṅ bhavitoḥ . sa yadaivāntagata iva śriyai manyetātha hainena yajeta .
sentences: atʰa yasyaitasya pr̥ṣṭʰyasya ṣaḍahasya jyotir agniṣṭomo madʰye bʰavati jyotir atirātra upariṣṭād yaḥ kāmayetā me brahmavarcasī prajāyāṃ jāyeteti sa etena yajeta .
tad yan madʰye jyotir agniṣṭomo bʰavati madʰyata evaitad ātmano jyotir dʰatta ā hāsya brahmavarcasī prajāyāṃ jāyate .
jyotir atirātra upariṣṭād etad vai prajñātaṃ devatīrtʰaṃ yaj jyotir atirātraḥ prajñātena devatīrtʰenāriṣṭenāriṣṭā udr̥cam aśnavāmahā iti .
atʰa yasyaitasya viśvajidabʰijitāv agniṣṭomāv abʰito bʰavata ubʰayato jyotiṣ ṣaḍaho madʰye paśukāmo haitena yajeta .
nāsya vittaṃ paropyate ya evaṃ veda .
īśvaro ha tu yādr̥śa eva san yajate tādr̥ṅ bʰavitoḥ .
sa yadaivāntagata iva śriyai manyetātʰa hainena yajeta .
text: Now, the [rite] whose prsthya six-day has a jyotis agnistoma in the middle and a jyotis atiratra at the end -- whoever desires 'may one possessed of brahman-splendor be born among my offspring' should sacrifice with this. The self is the prsthya six-day. Radiance, brahman-splendor, is the jyotis agnistoma. Procreation is from the middle of the self. Because the jyotis agnistoma is in the middle, one thereby places radiance in the middle of the self; one possessed of brahman-splendor is born among his offspring. The jyotis atiratra is at the end -- this is the well-known divine ford, the jyotis atiratra. 'By the well-known divine ford, unharmed, may we unharmed attain the surplus.' Now, the [rite] whose visvajit and abhijit agnistomas are on both sides, with a six-day [rite] having jyotis on both sides in the middle -- one desiring cattle should sacrifice with this. These four ukthyas are in the middle. The ukthyas are animals. Their chant-verses number a thousand. And these four agnistomas are on both sides. The jyotis agnistoma is brahman. By brahman on both sides one encloses cattle against loss. One whose wealth is not carried away knows thus. However, one might become just like what one is when one sacrifices. One should sacrifice with this when one considers oneself as if at the end of prosperity.
meaning: अथ यस्यैतस्य पृष्ठ्यस्य षडहस्य ज्योतिर् अग्निष्टोमो मध्ये भवति ज्योतिर् अतिरात्र उपरिष्टाद् यः कामयेता मे ब्रह्मवर्चसी प्रजायां जायेतेति स एतेन यजेत . आत्म वै पृष्ठ्यष् षडहः . तेजो वै ब्रह्मवर्चसं ज्योतिर् अग्निष्टोमः . मध्यत उ वा आत्मनः प्रजननम् . तद् यन् मध्ये ज्योतिर् अग्निष्टोमो भवति मध्यत एवैतद् आत्मनो ज्योतिर् धत्त आ हास्य ब्रह्मवर्चसी प्रजायां जायते . ज्योतिर् अतिरात्र उपरिष्टाद् एतद् वै प्रज्ञातं देवतीर्थं यज् ज्योतिर् अतिरात्रः प्रज्ञातेन देवतीर्थेनारिष्टेनारिष्टा उदृचम् अश्नवामहा इति . अथ यस्यैतस्य विश्वजिदभिजिताव् अग्निष्टोमाव् अभितो भवत उभयतो ज्योतिष् षडहो मध्ये पशुकामो हैतेन यजेत . चत्वार एते मध्य उक्थ्या भवन्ति . पशवो वा उक्थानि . तेषां सहस्रं स्तोत्रियाः . चत्वार उ वैते ऽग्निष्टोमा अभितो भवन्ति . ब्रह्म वै ज्योतिर् अग्निष्टोमः . ब्रह्मणैव तद् उभयतः पशून् परिगृह्णीते ऽपरावापाय . नास्य वित्तं परोप्यते य एवं वेद . ईश्वरो ह तु यादृश एव सन् यजते तादृङ् भवितोः . स यदैवान्तगत इव श्रियै मन्येताथ हैनेन यजेत .

sanskrit_iast: athaite navarātrāḥ . tejaskāmo haitena yajeta yan navarātraḥ . tejo vai trivṛt stomaḥ . trivṛtam eṣa stomaṃ yajño 'bhisaṃpannaḥ . tasmād u hainena tejaskāmo yajeta . atho āhur brahmavarcasakāma evainena yajeteti . brahma vai trivṛt stomaḥ . trivṛtam eṣa stomaṃ yajño 'bhisaṃpannaḥ . tasmād u hainena brahmavarcasakāmo yajeta . atho āhur āyuṣkāma evainena yajeteti . prāṇo vai trivṛt stomaḥ . navaitāny ahāni bhavanti rātrir daśamī . nava puruṣe prāṇā nābhir daśamī . prāṇān evaitenābhijayati prāṇān āpnoti . tad āhuḥ kim anu navarātra iti . diśa iti brūyāt . diśo ha vā anu navarātraḥ . catasro diśaś catvāro 'vāntaradeśā ūrdhvā diṅ navamy arvācī daśamī . diśa evaitenardhnoti .
sentences: tad āhuḥ kim anu navarātra iti .
catasro diśaś catvāro 'vāntaradeśā ūrdʰvā diṅ navamy arvācī daśamī .
text: Now these are the nine-night [rites]. One desiring radiance should sacrifice with this, the nine-night [rite]. The trivrt stoma is radiance. This sacrifice corresponds to the trivrt stoma. Therefore one desiring radiance should sacrifice with this. And they say: 'One desiring brahman-splendor should sacrifice with this.' The trivrt stoma is brahman. This sacrifice corresponds to the trivrt stoma. Therefore one desiring brahman-splendor should sacrifice with this. And they say: 'One desiring long life should sacrifice with this.' The trivrt stoma is prana. Nine are these days, the night is the tenth. Nine are the vital breaths in a person, the navel is the tenth. By this one conquers the vital breaths, one attains the vital breaths. On this they say: 'What does the nine-night [rite] follow?' One should answer: 'The directions.' The nine-night [rite] follows the directions. Four directions, four intermediate directions, the upward direction is the ninth, the downward the tenth. By this one prospers in the directions.
meaning: अथैते नवरात्राः . तेजस्कामो हैतेन यजेत यन् नवरात्रः . तेजो वै त्रिवृत् स्तोमः . त्रिवृतम् एष स्तोमं यज्ञो ऽभिसंपन्नः . तस्माद् उ हैनेन तेजस्कामो यजेत . अथो आहुर् ब्रह्मवर्चसकाम एवैनेन यजेतेति . ब्रह्म वै त्रिवृत् स्तोमः . त्रिवृतम् एष स्तोमं यज्ञो ऽभिसंपन्नः . तस्माद् उ हैनेन ब्रह्मवर्चसकामो यजेत . अथो आहुर् आयुष्काम एवैनेन यजेतेति . प्राणो वै त्रिवृत् स्तोमः . नवैतान्य् अहानि भवन्ति रात्रिर् दशमी . नव पुरुषे प्राणा नाभिर् दशमी . प्राणान् एवैतेनाभिजयति प्राणान् आप्नोति . तद् आहुः किम् अनु नवरात्र इति . दिश इति ब्रूयात् . दिशो ह वा अनु नवरात्रः . चतस्रो दिशश् चत्वारो ऽवान्तरदेशा ऊर्ध्वा दिङ् नवम्य् अर्वाची दशमी . दिश एवैतेनर्ध्नोति .

sanskrit_iast: atha yasyaitasya jyotir gaur āyur iti tryaho jyotir gaur āyur iti tryaho jyotir gaur āyur atirātro yaḥ kāmayeta anantarhitān imān lokān abhyāroheyam iti sa etena yajeta . tad yaj jyotir gaur āyur iti tryaho bhavaty ayaṃ vai loko jyotir ayaṃ gaur asāv āyur anantarhitān evaitenemān lokān abhyārohati . atirātrāv anuttamas tryaho bhavati . evaṃvidhā iva vā ime lokā agniṣṭoma ivāyaṃ loka ukthya ivāyam atirātra ivāsau . tad yathāvidhā ime lokā evam evainān etad abhyārohann eti . atha yasyaitasya jyotir gaur āyur atirātro jyotir gaur āyur atirātro jyotir gaur āyur atirātro ya u eva kāmayeta anantarhitān imān lokān abhyāroheyam iti sa etena yajeta . tad yaj jyotir gaur āyur atirātro bhavaty ayaṃ vai loko jyotir ayaṃ gaur asāv āyur anantarhitān evaitenemān lokān abhyārohati . atirātravantas tryahā bhavanti . atho evaṃvidhā iva vā ime lokā agniṣṭoma ivāyaṃ loka ukthya ivāyam atirātra ivāsau .
sentences: atʰa yasyaitasya jyotir gaur āyur iti tryaho jyotir gaur āyur iti tryaho jyotir gaur āyur atirātro yaḥ kāmayeta anantarhitān imān lokān abʰyāroheyam iti sa etena yajeta .
tad yaj jyotir gaur āyur iti tryaho bʰavaty ayaṃ vai loko jyotir ayaṃ gaur asāv āyur anantarhitān evaitenemān lokān abʰyārohati .
evaṃvidʰā iva vā ime lokā agniṣṭoma ivāyaṃ loka uktʰya ivāyam atirātra ivāsau .
tad yatʰāvidʰā ime lokā evam evainān etad abʰyārohann eti .
atʰa yasyaitasya jyotir gaur āyur atirātro jyotir gaur āyur atirātro jyotir gaur āyur atirātro ya u eva kāmayeta anantarhitān imān lokān abʰyāroheyam iti sa etena yajeta .
tad yaj jyotir gaur āyur atirātro bʰavaty ayaṃ vai loko jyotir ayaṃ gaur asāv āyur anantarhitān evaitenemān lokān abʰyārohati .
atʰo evaṃvidʰā iva vā ime lokā agniṣṭoma ivāyaṃ loka uktʰya ivāyam atirātra ivāsau .
text: Now, the [rite] whose [days are] jyotis, go, ayus as a three-day, jyotis, go, ayus as a three-day, jyotis, go, ayus with an atiratra -- whoever desires 'may I ascend these worlds without interruption' should sacrifice with this. Because the three-day has jyotis, go, and ayus -- this world is jyotis, this [middle world] is go, yonder is ayus -- one ascends these worlds without interruption by this. The three-day has an atiratra as the topmost. These worlds are indeed of this nature: this world is like an agnistoma, this [middle world] is like an ukthya, yonder is like an atiratra. Just as these worlds are of this nature, so one ascends them. Now, the [rite] whose [days are all] jyotis, go, ayus with atiratra; jyotis, go, ayus with atiratra; jyotis, go, ayus with atiratra -- whoever also desires 'may I ascend these worlds without interruption' should sacrifice with this. Because the [day] has jyotis, go, ayus with atiratra -- this world is jyotis, this [middle world] is go, yonder is ayus -- one ascends these worlds without interruption by this. The three-day periods end with atiratra. And these worlds are indeed of this nature: this world is like an agnistoma, this [middle world] is like an ukthya, yonder is like an atiratra.
meaning: अथ यस्यैतस्य ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुर् इति त्र्यहो ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुर् इति त्र्यहो ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुर् अतिरात्रो यः कामयेत अनन्तर्हितान् इमान् लोकान् अभ्यारोहेयम् इति स एतेन यजेत . तद् यज् ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुर् इति त्र्यहो भवत्य् अयं वै लोको ज्योतिर् अयं गौर् असाव् आयुर् अनन्तर्हितान् एवैतेनेमान् लोकान् अभ्यारोहति . अतिरात्राव् अनुत्तमस् त्र्यहो भवति . एवंविधा इव वा इमे लोका अग्निष्टोम इवायं लोक उक्थ्य इवायम् अतिरात्र इवासौ . तद् यथाविधा इमे लोका एवम् एवैनान् एतद् अभ्यारोहन्न् एति . अथ यस्यैतस्य ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुर् अतिरात्रो ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुर् अतिरात्रो ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुर् अतिरात्रो य उ एव कामयेत अनन्तर्हितान् इमान् लोकान् अभ्यारोहेयम् इति स एतेन यजेत . तद् यज् ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुर् अतिरात्रो भवत्य् अयं वै लोको ज्योतिर् अयं गौर् असाव् आयुर् अनन्तर्हितान् एवैतेनेमान् लोकान् अभ्यारोहति . अतिरात्रवन्तस् त्र्यहा भवन्ति . अथो एवंविधा इव वा इमे लोका अग्निष्टोम इवायं लोक उक्थ्य इवायम् अतिरात्र इवासौ .

sanskrit_iast: trayo ha vā eṣāṃ lokānāṃ viṣuvanto 'gnir vā asya lokasya viṣuvān vāyur antarikṣasya ādityo divaḥ . tān evaitenātitarati . tryanīko bhavaty aindro vijityai . tryanīkena vai devasadanena devā asurān ajayan . tasmād yā apy etarhi tryanīkā senā bhavati jayaty eva . tad yathā tryanīkayā senayā jeṣyantyopapreyād evam evaitena jeṣyan svargaṃ lokam upapraiti jayati svargaṃ lokaṃ ya evaṃ veda . atha yasyaitasya jyotir atirātraḥ pṛṣṭhyaṣ ṣaḍahaḥ pañcaviṃśaṃ mahāvrataṃ jyotir atirātro 'nnādyakāmo haitena yajeta . tad āhur na purā saṃvatsarān mahāvratam upetyam iti . tad yat pṛṣṭhyaṣ ṣaḍaho bhavaty ṛtavo vai pṛṣṭhāni . saṃvatsara ṛtavaḥ . saṃvatsaraḥ kṛtsnam annādyaṃ pacati saṃvatsarābhijitam eva tad annādyam upayanti . pañcaviṃśaṃ mahāvratam annaṃ vai pañcaviṃśam annādyasyaivāvaruddhyai . jyotir atirātra etad vai prajñātaṃ devatīrthaṃ yaj jyotir atirātraḥ .
sentences: trayo ha vā eṣāṃ lokānāṃ viṣuvanto 'gnir vā asya lokasya viṣuvān vāyur antarikṣasya ādityo divaḥ .
tryanīkena vai devasadanena devā asurān ajayan .
tasmād yā apy etarhi tryanīkā senā bʰavati jayaty eva .
tad yatʰā tryanīkayā senayā jeṣyantyopapreyād evam evaitena jeṣyan svargaṃ lokam upapraiti jayati svargaṃ lokaṃ ya evaṃ veda .
atʰa yasyaitasya jyotir atirātraḥ pr̥ṣṭʰyaṣ ṣaḍahaḥ pañcaviṃśaṃ mahāvrataṃ jyotir atirātro 'nnādyakāmo haitena yajeta .
tad āhur na purā saṃvatsarān mahāvratam upetyam iti .
tad yat pr̥ṣṭʰyaṣ ṣaḍaho bʰavaty r̥tavo vai pr̥ṣṭʰāni .
saṃvatsaraḥ kr̥tsnam annādyaṃ pacati saṃvatsarābʰijitam eva tad annādyam upayanti .
pañcaviṃśaṃ mahāvratam annaṃ vai pañcaviṃśam annādyasyaivāvaruddʰyai .
jyotir atirātra etad vai prajñātaṃ devatīrtʰaṃ yaj jyotir atirātraḥ .
text: There are three viṣuvants (solstices/equinoxes) of these worlds: Agni is the viṣuvant of this world, Vāyu of the atmosphere, Āditya of heaven. By this (sacrifice) one crosses beyond them. The Tryanīka is used, belonging to Indra, for the sake of victory. With the Tryanīka Devasadana the gods conquered the Asuras. Therefore even now, an army that is threefold in formation conquers. Just as one would advance with a threefold army to conquer, even so one advances to conquer the heavenly world by this — one conquers the heavenly world, he who knows thus. Now, of this (sacrifice), the Jyotis Atirātra, the Pṛṣṭhya Ṣaḍaha, the Pañcaviṃśa Mahāvrata, and the Jyotis Atirātra — one who desires food should sacrifice with this. They say the Mahāvrata should not be undertaken before the (completion of the) year. But because the Pṛṣṭhya Ṣaḍaha occurs, and the ṛtus (seasons) are indeed the Pṛṣṭhas, and the seasons are the year, and the year cooks all food — thereby they approach the food conquered through the year. The Pañcaviṃśa Mahāvrata — the Pañcaviṃśa is indeed food, for the obtaining of food. The Jyotis Atirātra — this is the well-known divine ford, the Jyotis Atirātra.
meaning: त्रयो ह वा एषां लोकानां विषुवन्तो ऽग्निर् वा अस्य लोकस्य विषुवान् वायुर् अन्तरिक्षस्य आदित्यो दिवः . तान् एवैतेनातितरति . त्र्यनीको भवत्य् ऐन्द्रो विजित्यै . त्र्यनीकेन वै देवसदनेन देवा असुरान् अजयन् . तस्माद् या अप्य् एतर्हि त्र्यनीका सेना भवति जयत्य् एव . तद् यथा त्र्यनीकया सेनया जेष्यन्त्योपप्रेयाद् एवम् एवैतेन जेष्यन् स्वर्गं लोकम् उपप्रैति जयति स्वर्गं लोकं य एवं वेद . अथ यस्यैतस्य ज्योतिर् अतिरात्रः पृष्ठ्यष् षडहः पञ्चविंशं महाव्रतं ज्योतिर् अतिरात्रो ऽन्नाद्यकामो हैतेन यजेत . तद् आहुर् न पुरा संवत्सरान् महाव्रतम् उपेत्यम् इति . तद् यत् पृष्ठ्यष् षडहो भवत्य् ऋतवो वै पृष्ठानि . संवत्सर ऋतवः . संवत्सरः कृत्स्नम् अन्नाद्यं पचति संवत्सराभिजितम् एव तद् अन्नाद्यम् उपयन्ति . पञ्चविंशं महाव्रतम् अन्नं वै पञ्चविंशम् अन्नाद्यस्यैवावरुद्ध्यै . ज्योतिर् अतिरात्र एतद् वै प्रज्ञातं देवतीर्थं यज् ज्योतिर् अतिरात्रः .

sanskrit_iast: tad v etasya paricakṣate yad enat satram eva manyante satraṃ ha smaitat puropayanti . anena ha tvāva satriyāś ca dakṣiṇāvantaś ca stomā vijñāyante . ubhayato 'tirātrā eva satriyā anyatarato 'tirātrā dakṣiṇāvantaḥ . sa ya enena dakṣiṇāvatā yajeta purastād agniṣṭomaṃ kṛtvā yajeta . atha yasyaitasya pṛṣṭhyasya ṣaḍahasya stomāḥ pañcame 'hani mahāvrataṃ viśvajitstomo 'tirātraḥ . iheva ca ha khalu vā eta iheva ca vācaṃ viprayuñjate ye yajante ye satram āsate . tāṃ daśamenaivāhnā saṃpādayanti . saṃpannāyai vāco 'vikṛṣṭāyai pratiṣṭhitāyai mahāvratam upetam asad iti . annaṃ vai mahāvratam . annādyasyaivāvaruddhyai . viśvajitstomo 'tirātro bhavati . parāṅ iva ha vā eṣaḥ . svargam eva lokam abhinirmṛṣṭo yad viśvajitstomo 'tirātraḥ . parāṅ evaitena svargaṃ lokam eti .
sentences: tad v etasya paricakṣate yad enat satram eva manyante satraṃ ha smaitat puropayanti .
anena ha tvāva satriyāś ca dakṣiṇāvantaś ca stomā vijñāyante .
sa ya enena dakṣiṇāvatā yajeta purastād agniṣṭomaṃ kr̥tvā yajeta .
atʰa yasyaitasya pr̥ṣṭʰyasya ṣaḍahasya stomāḥ pañcame 'hani mahāvrataṃ viśvajitstomo 'tirātraḥ .
iheva ca ha kʰalu vā eta iheva ca vācaṃ viprayuñjate ye yajante ye satram āsate .
saṃpannāyai vāco 'vikr̥ṣṭāyai pratiṣṭʰitāyai mahāvratam upetam asad iti .
svargam eva lokam abʰinirmr̥ṣṭo yad viśvajitstomo 'tirātraḥ .
text: Now, regarding this, they object that people consider it merely a sattra (communal session). People used to undertake this formerly as a sattra. But by this, both the satriya (session) and dakṣiṇāvant (with fees) stomas are distinguished. Those with atirātras on both sides are satriya; those with an atirātra on one side only are dakṣiṇāvant. He who would sacrifice with this as a dakṣiṇāvant rite should perform an Agniṣṭoma at the beginning. Now, of this Pṛṣṭhya Ṣaḍaha, the stomas are: on the fifth day the Mahāvrata, the Viśvajit-stoma Atirātra. Here and there people sever speech — both those who sacrifice and those who sit in a sattra. They reconnect it on the tenth day. 'Having reconnected speech, unsevered and firmly established, let the Mahāvrata be undertaken' — thus they think. The Mahāvrata is food — for the obtaining of food. The Viśvajit-stoma Atirātra occurs. This one tends, as it were, to go beyond. He is polished toward the heavenly world — that is the Viśvajit-stoma Atirātra. By this he goes beyond to the heavenly world.
meaning: तद् व् एतस्य परिचक्षते यद् एनत् सत्रम् एव मन्यन्ते सत्रं ह स्मैतत् पुरोपयन्ति . अनेन ह त्वाव सत्रियाश् च दक्षिणावन्तश् च स्तोमा विज्ञायन्ते . उभयतो ऽतिरात्रा एव सत्रिया अन्यतरतो ऽतिरात्रा दक्षिणावन्तः . स य एनेन दक्षिणावता यजेत पुरस्ताद् अग्निष्टोमं कृत्वा यजेत . अथ यस्यैतस्य पृष्ठ्यस्य षडहस्य स्तोमाः पञ्चमे ऽहनि महाव्रतं विश्वजित्स्तोमो ऽतिरात्रः . इहेव च ह खलु वा एत इहेव च वाचं विप्रयुञ्जते ये यजन्ते ये सत्रम् आसते . तां दशमेनैवाह्ना संपादयन्ति . संपन्नायै वाचो ऽविकृष्टायै प्रतिष्ठितायै महाव्रतम् उपेतम् असद् इति . अन्नं वै महाव्रतम् . अन्नाद्यस्यैवावरुद्ध्यै . विश्वजित्स्तोमो ऽतिरात्रो भवति . पराङ् इव ह वा एषः . स्वर्गम् एव लोकम् अभिनिर्मृष्टो यद् विश्वजित्स्तोमो ऽतिरात्रः . पराङ् एवैतेन स्वर्गं लोकम् एति .

sanskrit_iast: atha yasyaitasya pṛṣṭhyasya ṣaḍahasya jyotir gaur āyur iti madhye tryaho bhavati prajananakāmo haitena yajeta . ātmā vai pṛṣṭhyaṣ ṣaḍahaḥ . prajananam ete stomāḥ . tad yan madhye jyotir gaur āyur iti tryaho bhavati madhyata evaitad ātmanaḥ prajananaṃ dhatte bahur bhavati prajāyate . atha yasyaitasyordhvaṣ ṣaḍahaḥ pratyaṅ tryaho yaḥ kāmayeta gaccheyaṃ svargaṃ lokaṃ praty asmin loke tiṣṭheyam iti sa etena yajeta . ṣaḍahenaiveta ūrdhva svargaṃ lokaṃ gacchati praty evāmutas tryaheṇāvarohati . gacchati svargaṃ lokaṃ praty asmin loke tiṣṭhati . atho ha veda yo 'sāv āsaṃ so 'yam asmīti punar haivāsmin loka ājāyate . atha yasyaitasyordhvas tryahaḥ pratyaṅ ṣaḍaho ya u eva kāmayeta gaccheyaṃ svargaṃ lokaṃ praty asmin loke tiṣṭheyam iti sa etena yajeta . tryaheṇaiveta ūrdhva svargaṃ lokaṃ gacchati praty evāmutaṣ ṣaḍahenāvarohati . gacchati svargaṃ lokaṃ praty asmin loke tiṣṭhati . atho ha veda yo 'sāv āsaṃ so 'yam asmīti punar haivāsmin loka ājāyate . atha yasyaitasyordhvaṣ ṣaḍaha ūrdhvas tryaha svargakāmo haitena yajeta .

text: Now, of this Pṛṣṭhya Ṣaḍaha, when the three-day group Jyotis, Gaus, Āyus occurs in the middle — one who desires progeny should sacrifice with this. The Pṛṣṭhya Ṣaḍaha is the self. These stomas are progeny. Because the three-day group Jyotis, Gaus, Āyus occurs in the middle, one places the power of generation in the middle of the self — one becomes many, one is propagated. Now, of this (arrangement), when the ṣaḍaha is upward and the three-day group is reversed — he who desires 'May I go to the heavenly world and yet remain established in this world' should sacrifice with this. By the ṣaḍaha he goes upward to the heavenly world; by the three-day group he descends back from there. He goes to the heavenly world and remains established in this world. Moreover he knows, 'He who I was there, that same one I am here' — he is born again in this world. Now, of this (arrangement), when the three-day group is upward and the ṣaḍaha is reversed — he who likewise desires 'May I go to the heavenly world and yet remain established in this world' should sacrifice with this. By the three-day group he goes upward to the heavenly world; by the ṣaḍaha he descends back from there. He goes to the heavenly world and remains established in this world. Moreover he knows, 'He who I was there, that same one I am here' — he is born again in this world. Now, of this (arrangement), when the ṣaḍaha is upward and the three-day group is upward — one who desires heaven should sacrifice with this.
meaning: अथ यस्यैतस्य पृष्ठ्यस्य षडहस्य ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुर् इति मध्ये त्र्यहो भवति प्रजननकामो हैतेन यजेत . आत्मा वै पृष्ठ्यष् षडहः . प्रजननम् एते स्तोमाः . तद् यन् मध्ये ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुर् इति त्र्यहो भवति मध्यत एवैतद् आत्मनः प्रजननं धत्ते बहुर् भवति प्रजायते . अथ यस्यैतस्योर्ध्वष् षडहः प्रत्यङ् त्र्यहो यः कामयेत गच्छेयं स्वर्गं लोकं प्रत्य् अस्मिन् लोके तिष्ठेयम् इति स एतेन यजेत . षडहेनैवेत ऊर्ध्व स्वर्गं लोकं गच्छति प्रत्य् एवामुतस् त्र्यहेणावरोहति . गच्छति स्वर्गं लोकं प्रत्य् अस्मिन् लोके तिष्ठति . अथो ह वेद यो ऽसाव् आसं सो ऽयम् अस्मीति पुनर् हैवास्मिन् लोक आजायते . अथ यस्यैतस्योर्ध्वस् त्र्यहः प्रत्यङ् षडहो य उ एव कामयेत गच्छेयं स्वर्गं लोकं प्रत्य् अस्मिन् लोके तिष्ठेयम् इति स एतेन यजेत . त्र्यहेणैवेत ऊर्ध्व स्वर्गं लोकं गच्छति प्रत्य् एवामुतष् षडहेनावरोहति . गच्छति स्वर्गं लोकं प्रत्य् अस्मिन् लोके तिष्ठति . अथो ह वेद यो ऽसाव् आसं सो ऽयम् अस्मीति पुनर् हैवास्मिन् लोक आजायते . अथ यस्यैतस्योर्ध्वष् षडह ऊर्ध्वस् त्र्यह स्वर्गकामो हैतेन यजेत .

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣa vivadhaḥ . tasya jyotir agniṣṭomo gaur ukthya āyur ukthyo jyotir agniṣṭoma āyur atirātro jyotir agniṣṭomo gaur ukthya āyur ukthyo jyotir agniṣṭomaḥ . paśukāmo haitena yajeta . tasyaiṣo 'nyatassaṅgo goāyuṣī ukthyāv antarau bhavataḥ . paśavo vā ukthāni . tayoḥ pañca śatāni stotryāḥ . jyotiṣī agniṣṭomāv abhito bhavataḥ . brahma vai jyotir agniṣṭomaḥ . brahmaṇaiva tad ubhayataḥ paśūn parigṛhṇīte 'parāvāpāya . nāsya vittaṃ paropyate ya evaṃ veda . āyur atirātro madhye bhavati . tad yathā ha vai vivadhas tasya madhye pṛthv ivānavamardāya tādṛk tad . tasyaiṣa u evānyatassaṅgo So muß etwa zu lesen sein , da es sich um das Gegenstück dessen handelt , was man auf der einen Seite des Schulterjochs herabhängenläßt , was Zeile 13 tasyaiṣo 'nyatassaṅgo goāyuṣī usw . heißt . goāyuṣī ukthyāv antarau bhavataḥ . paśavo vā ukthāni . tayoḥ pañca śatāni stotriyāḥ . jyotiṣī agniṣṭomāv abhito bhavataḥ . brahma vai jyotir agniṣṭomaḥ . brahmaṇaiva tad ubhayataḥ paśūn parigṛhṇīte 'parāvāpāya .
sentences: tasya jyotir agniṣṭomo gaur uktʰya āyur uktʰyo jyotir agniṣṭoma āyur atirātro jyotir agniṣṭomo gaur uktʰya āyur uktʰyo jyotir agniṣṭomaḥ .
nāsya vittaṃ paropyate ya evaṃ veda .
tad yatʰā ha vai vivadʰas tasya madʰye pr̥tʰv ivānavamardāya tādr̥k tad .

tasyaiṣa u evānyatassaṅgo So muß etwa zu lesen sein , da es sich um das Gegenstück dessen handelt , was man auf der einen Seite des Schulterjochs herabhängenläßt , was Zeile 13 tasyaiṣo 'nyatassaṅgo goāyuṣī usw . heißt . goāyuṣī uktʰyāv antarau bʰavataḥ .
text: Now this is the Vivadha (shoulder-yoke sacrifice). Its (structure is): Jyotis Agniṣṭoma, Gaus Ukthya, Āyus Ukthya, Jyotis Agniṣṭoma, Āyus Atirātra, Jyotis Agniṣṭoma, Gaus Ukthya, Āyus Ukthya, Jyotis Agniṣṭoma. One desiring cattle should sacrifice with this. On one side of this (yoke), the Go- and Āyus-days are Ukthyas in the middle. Cattle are indeed the ukthās. Of those two, there are five hundred stotrīyā verses. The two Jyotis days are Agniṣṭomas on both sides. The Jyotis Agniṣṭoma is indeed brahman. By brahman one thereby encompasses cattle on both sides against loss. His wealth is not carried away, he who knows thus. The Āyus Atirātra is in the middle. Just as in a shoulder-yoke (vivadha) the broad part in the middle prevents crushing, such is this. On the other side of this (yoke) likewise, the Go- and Āyus-days are Ukthyas in the middle. Cattle are indeed the ukthās. Of those two, there are five hundred stotrīyā verses. The two Jyotis days are Agniṣṭomas on both sides. The Jyotis Agniṣṭoma is indeed brahman. By brahman one thereby encompasses cattle on both sides against loss.
meaning: अथैष विवधः . तस्य ज्योतिर् अग्निष्टोमो गौर् उक्थ्य आयुर् उक्थ्यो ज्योतिर् अग्निष्टोम आयुर् अतिरात्रो ज्योतिर् अग्निष्टोमो गौर् उक्थ्य आयुर् उक्थ्यो ज्योतिर् अग्निष्टोमः . पशुकामो हैतेन यजेत . तस्यैषो ऽन्यतस्सङ्गो गोआयुषी उक्थ्याव् अन्तरौ भवतः . पशवो वा उक्थानि . तयोः पञ्च शतानि स्तोत्र्याः . ज्योतिषी अग्निष्टोमाव् अभितो भवतः . ब्रह्म वै ज्योतिर् अग्निष्टोमः . ब्रह्मणैव तद् उभयतः पशून् परिगृह्णीते ऽपरावापाय . नास्य वित्तं परोप्यते य एवं वेद . आयुर् अतिरात्रो मध्ये भवति . तद् यथा ह वै विवधस् तस्य मध्ये पृथ्व् इवानवमर्दाय तादृक् तद् . तस्यैष उ एवान्यतस्सङ्गो Sओ मुß एत्wअ zउ लेसेन् सेइन् , द एस् सिछ् उम् दस् Gएगेन्स्त्üच्क् देस्सेन् हन्देल्त् , wअस् मन् औf देर् एइनेन् Sएइते देस् Sछुल्तेर्जोछ्स् हेरभ्äन्गेन्ल्äßत् , wअस् Zएइले १३ तस्यैषो ऽन्यतस्सङ्गो गोआयुषी उस्w . हेइßत् . गोआयुषी उक्थ्याव् अन्तरौ भवतः . पशवो वा उक्थानि . तयोः पञ्च शतानि स्तोत्रियाः . ज्योतिषी अग्निष्टोमाव् अभितो भवतः . ब्रह्म वै ज्योतिर् अग्निष्टोमः . ब्रह्मणैव तद् उभयतः पशून् परिगृह्णीते ऽपरावापाय .

sanskrit_iast: athaite daśarātrāḥ . abhicaryamāṇo haitena yajeta yad daśarātraḥ . daśaitāny ahāni bhavanti . daśa puruṣe prāṇāḥ . ahnaiva prāṇaṃ parigṛhṇīte 'hnā prāṇam ahnā prāṇaṃ na tatas tasya sa prāṇo 'tiśaye yam asyābhicaraṃs stṛṇvīta . atho āhur abhicarann evainena yajeteti . daśaitāny ahāni bhavanti . daśa puruṣe prāṇāḥ . ahnaiva parasya prāṇaṃ stṛṇute 'hnā prāṇam ahnā prāṇam . na tataḥ parasya sa prāṇaḥ pariśiṣyate yenābhicaryamāṇo jīvet . etad dha vai jyaiṣṭhyaṃ karmaṇāṃ yad eṣa saumyo 'dhvaro daśarātro vidhayā vidhīyate .
sentences: ahnaiva prāṇaṃ parigr̥hṇīte 'hnā prāṇam ahnā prāṇaṃ na tatas tasya sa prāṇo 'tiśaye yam asyābʰicaraṃs str̥ṇvīta .
ahnaiva parasya prāṇaṃ str̥ṇute 'hnā prāṇam ahnā prāṇam .
na tataḥ parasya sa prāṇaḥ pariśiṣyate yenābʰicaryamāṇo jīvet .
etad dʰa vai jyaiṣṭʰyaṃ karmaṇāṃ yad eṣa saumyo 'dʰvaro daśarātro vidʰayā vidʰīyate .
text: Now these are the Daśarātras (ten-night sacrifices). One who is being subjected to sorcery should sacrifice with the Daśarātra. These ten days occur. There are ten prāṇas in a person. Day by day one encompasses prāṇa — day by day, day by day — the prāṇa of that person whom one would cut off through sorcery does not survive beyond that. Also they say: 'One who is performing sorcery should sacrifice with this.' These ten days occur. There are ten prāṇas in a person. Day by day one cuts off the enemy's prāṇa — day by day, day by day. No prāṇa of the enemy remains by which, being sorcerized, he could live. This is indeed the highest among rituals — that this Soma rite, the Daśarātra, is arranged according to the vidhi (rule).
meaning: अथैते दशरात्राः . अभिचर्यमाणो हैतेन यजेत यद् दशरात्रः . दशैतान्य् अहानि भवन्ति . दश पुरुषे प्राणाः . अह्नैव प्राणं परिगृह्णीते ऽह्ना प्राणम् अह्ना प्राणं न ततस् तस्य स प्राणो ऽतिशये यम् अस्याभिचरंस् स्तृण्वीत . अथो आहुर् अभिचरन्न् एवैनेन यजेतेति . दशैतान्य् अहानि भवन्ति . दश पुरुषे प्राणाः . अह्नैव परस्य प्राणं स्तृणुते ऽह्ना प्राणम् अह्ना प्राणम् . न ततः परस्य स प्राणः परिशिष्यते येनाभिचर्यमाणो जीवेत् . एतद् ध वै ज्यैष्ठ्यं कर्मणां यद् एष सौम्यो ऽध्वरो दशरात्रो विधया विधीयते .

sanskrit_iast: etad dha vai paramaṃ vācaḥ krāntaṃ yad daśeti . etāvad dha paramaṃ vāk cakrame . tad yat paramaṃ vācaḥ krāntaṃ tat sarvam āpnavānīti . atho āhur annādyakāma evainena yajeteti . sarvo ha vā anyo virājam atiṣṭauti . eṣa ha vāva virājaṃ nātiṣṭauti yo daśabhi stute . daśākṣarā virāṭ . annaṃ virāṭ . ahnaiva virājam avarunddhe 'hnā virājam ahnā virājam sa daśamenaivāhnā sarvāṃ virājam annādyam avaruddhyāntata uttiṣṭhati . puruṣo ha vāva virājam atiśaye . daśaitāny ahāni bhavanti rātrir ekādaśī . daśa puruṣe prāṇā ātmaikādaśaḥ . puruṣo ha vā eṣa virājy adhyūḍho 'niṣpādāya . na ha vai gaur nāśvo nāśvataro virājam adhitiṣṭhati . puruṣo ha vāva virājam adhitiṣṭhati . tasmāt puruṣaḥ paśūnām attā .
sentences: etad dʰa vai paramaṃ vācaḥ krāntaṃ yad daśeti .
tad yat paramaṃ vācaḥ krāntaṃ tat sarvam āpnavānīti .
sarvo ha vā anyo virājam atiṣṭauti .
eṣa ha vāva virājaṃ nātiṣṭauti yo daśabʰi stute .
ahnaiva virājam avarunddʰe 'hnā virājam ahnā virājam sa daśamenaivāhnā sarvāṃ virājam annādyam avaruddʰyāntata uttiṣṭʰati .
puruṣo ha vā eṣa virājy adʰyūḍʰo 'niṣpādāya .
na ha vai gaur nāśvo nāśvataro virājam adʰitiṣṭʰati .
text: This 'ten' (daśa) is indeed the furthest extent of speech. Speech has reached its furthest with 'ten.' 'That which is the furthest extent of speech — may I attain all of that.' Also they say: 'One desiring food should sacrifice with this.' Every other (being) exceeds the Virāj. But he who chants in groups of ten does not exceed the Virāj. The Virāj has ten syllables. The Virāj is food. Day by day he obtains the Virāj — day by day, day by day. On the tenth day he rises, having obtained the entire Virāj, all food. A person indeed exceeds the Virāj. These ten days occur, with the night as the eleventh. There are ten prāṇas in a person, and the ātman is the eleventh. The person is indeed mounted upon the Virāj, never to be dislodged. Neither cow, nor horse, nor mule stands upon the Virāj. Only the person stands upon the Virāj. Therefore the person is the eater of cattle.
meaning: एतद् ध वै परमं वाचः क्रान्तं यद् दशेति . एतावद् ध परमं वाक् चक्रमे . तद् यत् परमं वाचः क्रान्तं तत् सर्वम् आप्नवानीति . अथो आहुर् अन्नाद्यकाम एवैनेन यजेतेति . सर्वो ह वा अन्यो विराजम् अतिष्टौति . एष ह वाव विराजं नातिष्टौति यो दशभि स्तुते . दशाक्षरा विराट् . अन्नं विराट् . अह्नैव विराजम् अवरुन्द्धे ऽह्ना विराजम् अह्ना विराजम् स दशमेनैवाह्ना सर्वां विराजम् अन्नाद्यम् अवरुद्ध्यान्तत उत्तिष्ठति . पुरुषो ह वाव विराजम् अतिशये . दशैतान्य् अहानि भवन्ति रात्रिर् एकादशी . दश पुरुषे प्राणा आत्मैकादशः . पुरुषो ह वा एष विराज्य् अध्यूढो ऽनिष्पादाय . न ह वै गौर् नाश्वो नाश्वतरो विराजम् अधितिष्ठति . पुरुषो ह वाव विराजम् अधितिष्ठति . तस्मात् पुरुषः पशूनाम् अत्ता .

sanskrit_iast: indro vṛtraṃ vajreṇādhyasya nāstṛṣīti manyamānas sa vyasmayata . sa harito vismito 'jarat . sa aikṣata kathaṃ nv aham asya harimṇaḥ pāpmano daśamīṃ nirdaśyaṃ gaccheyam iti . sa etaṃ daśarātraṃ yajñam apaśyat . tam āharat . tenāyajata . tato vai sa tasya harimṇaḥ pāpmano daśamīṃ nirdaśyam agacchat . gacchati ha harimṇaḥ pāpmano daśamīṃ nirdaśyaṃ ya evaṃ veda . tasmād uta viddhaṃ vā vijātaṃ vāvatīrṇinaṃ vā pṛcchanti nirdaśyo 'bhūd iti . tasya ha vāva te tad dharimṇaḥ pāpmano daśamīṃ nirdaśyaṃ gacchanti .
sentences: indro vr̥traṃ vajreṇādʰyasya nāstr̥ṣīti manyamānas sa vyasmayata .
sa aikṣata katʰaṃ nv aham asya harimṇaḥ pāpmano daśamīṃ nirdaśyaṃ gaccʰeyam iti .
tato vai sa tasya harimṇaḥ pāpmano daśamīṃ nirdaśyam agaccʰat .
gaccʰati ha harimṇaḥ pāpmano daśamīṃ nirdaśyaṃ ya evaṃ veda .
tasmād uta viddʰaṃ vā vijātaṃ vāvatīrṇinaṃ vā pr̥ccʰanti nirdaśyo 'bʰūd iti .
tasya ha vāva te tad dʰarimṇaḥ pāpmano daśamīṃ nirdaśyaṃ gaccʰanti .
text: Indra, having hurled his vajra at Vṛtra, thinking 'He is not destroyed,' was struck with wonder. He, thus astonished, turned yellow (jaundiced). He considered: 'How may I reach the tenth day of freedom from this yellowness, this evil?' He beheld this Daśarātra sacrifice. He brought it forth. He sacrificed with it. Thereby he reached the tenth day of freedom from that yellowness, that evil. He reaches the tenth day of freedom from yellowness, from evil — he who knows thus. Therefore when someone has been wounded, or has given birth, or has suffered a fall, they ask: 'Has the tenth day of freedom come?' Their reaching the tenth day of freedom from that yellowness and evil is indeed this.
meaning: इन्द्रो वृत्रं वज्रेणाध्यस्य नास्तृषीति मन्यमानस् स व्यस्मयत . स हरितो विस्मितो ऽजरत् . स ऐक्षत कथं न्व् अहम् अस्य हरिम्णः पाप्मनो दशमीं निर्दश्यं गच्छेयम् इति . स एतं दशरात्रं यज्ञम् अपश्यत् . तम् आहरत् . तेनायजत . ततो वै स तस्य हरिम्णः पाप्मनो दशमीं निर्दश्यम् अगच्छत् . गच्छति ह हरिम्णः पाप्मनो दशमीं निर्दश्यं य एवं वेद . तस्माद् उत विद्धं वा विजातं वावतीर्णिनं वा पृच्छन्ति निर्दश्यो ऽभूद् इति . तस्य ह वाव ते तद् धरिम्णः पाप्मनो दशमीं निर्दश्यं गच्छन्ति .

sanskrit_iast: athaiṣa trikakup . prajananakāmo haitena yajeta . trivṛtpañcadaśau stomau bhavataḥ . ūnātiriktau mithunau prajanī . ūnam anyasyātiriktam anyasya . ūnātiriktād vai mithunāt prajāḥ paśavaḥ prajāyante . tābhyāṃ trivṛtaṃ stomaṃ paryūhanti . tam eva tau prajanayataḥ . saptadaśaikaviṃśau stomau bhavataḥ . ūnātiriktau mithunau prajanī . ūnam anyasyātiriktam anyasya . ūnātiriktād vai mithunāt prajāḥ paśavaḥ prajāyante . tābhyāṃ saptadaśaṃ stomaṃ paryūhanti . tam eva tau prajanayataḥ . triṇavastrayastriṃśau stomau bhavataḥ . ūnātiriktau mithunau prajanī . ūnam anyasyātiriktam anyasya . ūnātiriktād vai mithunāt prajāḥ paśavaḥ prajāyante . tābhyāṃ triṇavaṃ stomaṃ paryūhanti . tam eva tau prajanayataḥ . tad āhur āpyante vā etat stomā āpyante chandāṃsy āpyante devatā āpyanta ṛtavo gṛhā (?) yad eṣa pṛṣṭhyaṣ ṣaḍaha āpyanta (?) iti . āgneyīṣv ayātayāmnīṣu saptame 'hani stuvīran . agnir vai devānām ayātayāmā . agnim eva tad devānām ayātayāmānaṃ paśyanto yajante . aindrīṣv ayātayāmnīṣv aṣṭame 'hani stuvīran . indro vai devānām ayātayāmā . indram eva tad devānāṃ ayātayāmānaṃ paśyanto yajante . vaiśvadevīṣv ayātayāmnīṣu navame 'hani stuvīran . viśve vai devā devānām ayātayāmānaḥ . viśvān eva devāṃs tad devānām ayātayāmnaḥ paśyanto yajante . sarvastomo 'tirātro bhavati sarveṣāṃ lokānām abhijityā abhikrāntyai . sarvaṃ hīdaṃ stomā eva .
sentences: ūnātiriktād vai mitʰunāt prajāḥ paśavaḥ prajāyante .
ūnātiriktād vai mitʰunāt prajāḥ paśavaḥ prajāyante .
ūnātiriktād vai mitʰunāt prajāḥ paśavaḥ prajāyante .
tad āhur āpyante vā etat stomā āpyante cʰandāṃsy āpyante devatā āpyanta r̥tavo gr̥hā (?) yad eṣa pr̥ṣṭʰyaṣ ṣaḍaha āpyanta (?) iti .
agnim eva tad devānām ayātayāmānaṃ paśyanto yajante .
indram eva tad devānāṃ ayātayāmānaṃ paśyanto yajante .
viśvān eva devāṃs tad devānām ayātayāmnaḥ paśyanto yajante .
sarvastomo 'tirātro bʰavati sarveṣāṃ lokānām abʰijityā abʰikrāntyai .
text: Now this is the Trikakubh. One desiring progeny should sacrifice with this. The Trivṛt and Pañcadaśa stomas occur. The deficient and the exceeding form a pair (mithuna), productive of offspring. One is deficient in one, the other exceeds in the other. From the deficient-and-exceeding pair, offspring and cattle are born. With these two they encompass the Trivṛt stoma. Those two generate it. The Saptadaśa and Ekaviṃśa stomas occur. The deficient and the exceeding form a pair, productive of offspring. One is deficient in one, the other exceeds in the other. From the deficient-and-exceeding pair, offspring and cattle are born. With these two they encompass the Saptadaśa stoma. Those two generate it. The Triṇava and Trayastriṃśa stomas occur. The deficient and the exceeding form a pair, productive of offspring.
