meaning: अथैते पृष्ठ्यस्य षडहस्य स्तोमा भवन्ति . श्रीर् वै पृष्ठानि वर्ष्म वै पृष्ठानि . तच् छ्रियं वर्ष्म पृष्ठानि रोहन्ति . तद् उ सत्रिणो भवन्ति . अथैतत् त्रयस्त्रिंशम् अहर् भवति . त्रयस्त्रिंशाद् एवाधि त्रयस्त्रिंशम् . स ह्य् अन्तः . कुतो ह्य् अन्यद् आहरेयुः . तस्य चतुस्त्रिंशं बहिष्पवमानं भवति . त्रयस्त्रिंशद् वै देवताः . प्रजापतिश् चतुस्त्रिंशः . षष्ठायतनो वै प्रजापतिर् देवतानाम् . अथ यत् सप्तमम् अह स्वाराज्यस् स लोकः . स्वाराज्यम् उ चतुस्त्रिंशी . तद् यत् सप्तमस्याह्नश् चतुस्त्रिंशं बहिष्पवमानं भवति तद् यावान् स्वाराज्यो लोकस् तावन्तं स्वाराज्यं लोकम् ऋध्नवामेति . त्रयाणाम् उ चैव त्रयस्त्रिंशानाम् अननूचीनतायै . प्रोष्ठस्य ह खलु वा एता रूपं रात्रयः . ऊर्ध्वो वा अयम् इतष् षडहस् तिर्यङ् मध्ये ऽर्वाङ् असाव् अमुतः . उपरिषद्यस्यो वा एता रूपं रात्रयः . उपरिषद्यं वै सो ऽश्नुते य श्रियम् अश्नुते . उपरिषद्यं ज्यैष्ठ्यं श्रैष्ठ्यं श्रियम् अश्नवामहा इति . तस्माद् एता रात्रीर् उपयन्ति . तद् आहु श्रेयांसं वा एते ऽभ्यारोहन्ति य एता रात्रीर् उपयन्तीति . तद् यत् परस्ताद् प्रत्यञ्चः पृष्ठ्यस्य षडहस्य स्तोमा भवन्ति निह्नवायैवानार्त्यै शिवत्वाय शान्त्यै . ज्योतिषो ऽध्य् अह्न उत्तिष्ठन्त्य् उक्तब्राह्मणात् . वैश्वानर उदयनीयो ऽतिरात्रो भवति .

sanskrit_iast: atha yasyaitasya sarvam eva catustriṃśam ahar bhavati sarveṇaivāhnā svārājyaṃ lokam ṛdhnavāmeti . trayāṇām u caiva trayastriṃśānām ananūcīnatāyai . atha ha smāha bhāllabeyo na purā saṃvatsarān mahāvratam upetyam . upo ced iyuś caturviṃśatyām evainad rātrīṣūpeyur iti . saṃvatsaro vā etā rātrayo yac caturviṃśatiḥ . caturviṃśatyardhamāsas saṃvatsaraḥ . saṃvatsara evaiṣa ubhayataḥ paryūḍhaḥ . tasya yan madhye saptadaśam ahas tasminn evopetyam iti . saptadaśo vai prajāpatiḥ . prājāpatyaṃ mahāvratam . madhyāyatano vai prajāpatir devatānām . tad yatrāyatanaḥ prajāpatir devatānāṃ tat prajāpatim ṛdhnavāmeti . madhyato vā annam aśitaṃ dhinoti . tad yad evam upayanti madhyata evaitad aśanayām apahatyottiṣṭhanti . tad āhu śreyāṃsaṃ vā ete 'bhyārohanti ya etā rātrīr upayantīti . tad yat parastād pratyañcaḥ pṛṣṭhyasya ṣaḍahasya stomā bhavanti nihnavāyaivānārtyai śivatvāya śāntyai . jyotiṣo 'dhy ahna uttiṣṭhanty uktabrāhmaṇāt . yad iti ha khalu vā etac chando yad gāyatrī . yad gāyatryā adhy uttiṣṭheyur īśvarā apratiṣṭhitāś caritoḥ . savitā yantraiḥ pṛthivīm aramṇād iti sāvitraṃ vaiśvadeve hotāram anuśaṃstavai brūyāt . tad u dṛḍhāt pratiṣṭhitād uttiṣṭhanti . vaiśvānara udayanīyo 'tirātro bhavati .
sentences: atʰa yasyaitasya sarvam eva catustriṃśam ahar bʰavati sarveṇaivāhnā svārājyaṃ lokam r̥dʰnavāmeti .
atʰa ha smāha bʰāllabeyo na purā saṃvatsarān mahāvratam upetyam .
upo ced iyuś caturviṃśatyām evainad rātrīṣūpeyur iti .
saṃvatsaro vā etā rātrayo yac caturviṃśatiḥ .
tasya yan madʰye saptadaśam ahas tasminn evopetyam iti .
tad yatrāyatanaḥ prajāpatir devatānāṃ tat prajāpatim r̥dʰnavāmeti .
tad yad evam upayanti madʰyata evaitad aśanayām apahatyottiṣṭʰanti .
tad āhu śreyāṃsaṃ vā ete 'bʰyārohanti ya etā rātrīr upayantīti .
tad yat parastād pratyañcaḥ pr̥ṣṭʰyasya ṣaḍahasya stomā bʰavanti nihnavāyaivānārtyai śivatvāya śāntyai .
yad iti ha kʰalu vā etac cʰando yad gāyatrī .
yad gāyatryā adʰy uttiṣṭʰeyur īśvarā apratiṣṭʰitāś caritoḥ .
savitā yantraiḥ pr̥tʰivīm aramṇād iti sāvitraṃ vaiśvadeve hotāram anuśaṃstavai brūyāt .
text: Now, of this (arrangement), when the entire day is the Catustriṃśa — 'By the entire day may we attain the world of sovereignty.' Also for the non-repetition of three Trayastriṃśa days in succession. Bhāllabeya used to say: 'The Mahāvrata should not be undertaken before (the completion of) the year. But if they do undertake it, let them undertake it within twenty-four nights.' These twenty-four nights are the year. Twenty-four half-months make the year. The year is encompassed on both sides. The Saptadaśa day that is in the middle — in that itself should it be undertaken. The Saptadaśa is Prajāpati. The Mahāvrata belongs to Prajāpati. Prajāpati is the middle abode among the deities. 'Where Prajāpati is the abode of the deities, there may we attain Prajāpati.' From the middle, food when eaten nourishes. Because they undertake it thus, they rise up from the middle, having overcome hunger. They say: 'Those who undertake these nights ascend to something higher.' Because the stomas of the Pṛṣṭhya Ṣaḍaha occur afterwards in reverse, it is for the descent, for the avoidance of harm, for auspiciousness, for peace. They rise from the Jyotis day — as stated in the Brāhmaṇa. Now the Gāyatrī is the metre called 'yat' (which). If they were to rise from the Gāyatrī, they would be liable to wander without a firm foundation. 'Savitā yantraiḥ pṛthivīm aramṇāt' — one should instruct the hotṛ to recite this Sāvitra verse during the Vaiśvadeva (recitation). Thereby they rise from a firm and established (foundation). The Vaiśvānara Udayanīya Atirātra occurs.
meaning: अथ यस्यैतस्य सर्वम् एव चतुस्त्रिंशम् अहर् भवति सर्वेणैवाह्ना स्वाराज्यं लोकम् ऋध्नवामेति . त्रयाणाम् उ चैव त्रयस्त्रिंशानाम् अननूचीनतायै . अथ ह स्माह भाल्लबेयो न पुरा संवत्सरान् महाव्रतम् उपेत्यम् . उपो चेद् इयुश् चतुर्विंशत्याम् एवैनद् रात्रीषूपेयुर् इति . संवत्सरो वा एता रात्रयो यच् चतुर्विंशतिः . चतुर्विंशत्यर्धमासस् संवत्सरः . संवत्सर एवैष उभयतः पर्यूढः . तस्य यन् मध्ये सप्तदशम् अहस् तस्मिन्न् एवोपेत्यम् इति . सप्तदशो वै प्रजापतिः . प्राजापत्यं महाव्रतम् . मध्यायतनो वै प्रजापतिर् देवतानाम् . तद् यत्रायतनः प्रजापतिर् देवतानां तत् प्रजापतिम् ऋध्नवामेति . मध्यतो वा अन्नम् अशितं धिनोति . तद् यद् एवम् उपयन्ति मध्यत एवैतद् अशनयाम् अपहत्योत्तिष्ठन्ति . तद् आहु श्रेयांसं वा एते ऽभ्यारोहन्ति य एता रात्रीर् उपयन्तीति . तद् यत् परस्ताद् प्रत्यञ्चः पृष्ठ्यस्य षडहस्य स्तोमा भवन्ति निह्नवायैवानार्त्यै शिवत्वाय शान्त्यै . ज्योतिषो ऽध्य् अह्न उत्तिष्ठन्त्य् उक्तब्राह्मणात् . यद् इति ह खलु वा एतच् छन्दो यद् गायत्री . यद् गायत्र्या अध्य् उत्तिष्ठेयुर् ईश्वरा अप्रतिष्ठिताश् चरितोः . सविता यन्त्रैः पृथिवीम् अरम्णाद् इति सावित्रं वैश्वदेवे होतारम् अनुशंस्तवै ब्रूयात् . तद् उ दृढात् प्रतिष्ठिताद् उत्तिष्ठन्ति . वैश्वानर उदयनीयो ऽतिरात्रो भवति .

sanskrit_iast: athaitās saṃsado bhavanti . etad dha vai saṃsadāṃ saṃsattvaṃ yad ete stomāś ca chandāṃsi ca madhyataḥ saṃsannāḥ . stomāś ca ha khalu vai chandāṃsi ca sarvā devatāḥ . devā vai mṛtyor abibhayur ya svarge loke . tasmāt te prajāpatim evopādhāvan . tān prajāpatir abravīn mā bibhīta . ahaṃ vas taṃ mṛtyum atineṣyāmi ya svarge loka iti . tān pṛṣṭhye ṣaḍahe samasādayat . ṛtavo vai pṛṣṭhāni . saṃvatsara ṛtavaḥ . saṃvatsaro mṛtyuḥ . mṛtyor vāvaināṃs tat pṛṣṭhe pratiṣṭhitas samasādayat . tān etenāniruktena trayastriṃśenātyanayat . sa aikṣata māniruktā bhūvann iti . tān niruktena nirabravīt . te stomāṃś ca chandāṃsi cākramamāṇā āyan .
sentences: etad dʰa vai saṃsadāṃ saṃsattvaṃ yad ete stomāś ca cʰandāṃsi ca madʰyataḥ saṃsannāḥ .
stomāś ca ha kʰalu vai cʰandāṃsi ca sarvā devatāḥ .
devā vai mr̥tyor abibʰayur ya svarge loke .
ahaṃ vas taṃ mr̥tyum atineṣyāmi ya svarge loka iti .
mr̥tyor vāvaināṃs tat pr̥ṣṭʰe pratiṣṭʰitas samasādayat .
te stomāṃś ca cʰandāṃsi cākramamāṇā āyan .
text: Now there are the assemblies (saṃsads). This is the assembled-nature of assemblies — that these stomas and metres are assembled together in the middle. The stomas and metres are all the deities. The gods feared Death who was in the heavenly world. Therefore they approached Prajāpati. Prajāpati said to them: 'Do not fear. I shall lead you past that Death which is in the heavenly world.' He seated them in the Pṛṣṭhya Ṣaḍaha. The ṛtus (seasons) are the Pṛṣṭhas. The seasons are the year. The year is Death. Being established on the back of Death, as it were, he seated them. He led them past with this unexpressed (anirukta) Trayastriṃśa. He considered: 'Let them not remain unexpressed.' He expressed them with the expressed (nirukta). They went on, stepping upon the stomas and metres.
meaning: अथैतास् संसदो भवन्ति . एतद् ध वै संसदां संसत्त्वं यद् एते स्तोमाश् च छन्दांसि च मध्यतः संसन्नाः . स्तोमाश् च ह खलु वै छन्दांसि च सर्वा देवताः . देवा वै मृत्योर् अबिभयुर् य स्वर्गे लोके . तस्मात् ते प्रजापतिम् एवोपाधावन् . तान् प्रजापतिर् अब्रवीन् मा बिभीत . अहं वस् तं मृत्युम् अतिनेष्यामि य स्वर्गे लोक इति . तान् पृष्ठ्ये षडहे समसादयत् . ऋतवो वै पृष्ठानि . संवत्सर ऋतवः . संवत्सरो मृत्युः . मृत्योर् वावैनांस् तत् पृष्ठे प्रतिष्ठितस् समसादयत् . तान् एतेनानिरुक्तेन त्रयस्त्रिंशेनात्यनयत् . स ऐक्षत मानिरुक्ता भूवन्न् इति . तान् निरुक्तेन निरब्रवीत् . ते स्तोमांश् च छन्दांसि चाक्रममाणा आयन् .

sanskrit_iast: yathā viṣūcī pade vinihite anenāgā3d anenā3 ity aprajānaṃs tiṣṭhed evam evaitan mṛtyoḥ padayopanaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavati pāpmano 'nanvavāyāya . na ha vā enaṃ punarmṛtyur anvety apa pāpmānaṃ hate gacchati svargaṃ lokam . te param antam itvā punar evābibhayuḥ . tān etenaivāniruktena trayastriṃśenātyanayan niruktena nirabravīt . tato vai te taṃ mṛtyum apājayan ya svarge loke . apa ha vai taṃ mṛtyuṃ jayati ya svarge loke ya evaṃ veda . saṃvatsaro vā etā rātrayas saṃvatsarasya garbhaḥ . saṃvatsarasya vai garbhaṃ prajāḥ paśava upajīvanti . garbhiṇīr u etā rātrayaḥ . yathā vā ajagaro gīrṇavān evam etā rātrayaḥ . yady u vā ajagaro gīrṇavān bhavaty ubhāv antāv aṇū sthūlaṃ madhyam . suhityasyo vā etā rūpaṃ rātrayaḥ . suhityaṃ vai so 'śnute ya śriyam aśnute .
sentences: yatʰā viṣūcī pade vinihite anenāgā3d anenā3 ity aprajānaṃs tiṣṭʰed evam evaitan mr̥tyoḥ padayopanaṃ kr̥taṃ bʰavati pāpmano 'nanvavāyāya .
na ha vā enaṃ punarmr̥tyur anvety apa pāpmānaṃ hate gaccʰati svargaṃ lokam .
te param antam itvā punar evābibʰayuḥ .
tato vai te taṃ mr̥tyum apājayan ya svarge loke .
apa ha vai taṃ mr̥tyuṃ jayati ya svarge loke ya evaṃ veda .
saṃvatsaro vā etā rātrayas saṃvatsarasya garbʰaḥ .
saṃvatsarasya vai garbʰaṃ prajāḥ paśava upajīvanti .
yatʰā vā ajagaro gīrṇavān evam etā rātrayaḥ .
yady u vā ajagaro gīrṇavān bʰavaty ubʰāv antāv aṇū stʰūlaṃ madʰyam .
suhityaṃ vai so 'śnute ya śriyam aśnute .
text: Just as when two diverging footprints are placed, one would stand not knowing 'He went this way, he went that way' — even so this becomes a confusing of the tracks for Death, for the non-pursuit of evil. For Death does not pursue him again; he removes evil and goes to the heavenly world. Having gone to the far end, they again became afraid. He led them past with this very unexpressed Trayastriṃśa and expressed them with the expressed. Thereby they conquered that Death which was in the heavenly world. He conquers that Death which is in the heavenly world — he who knows thus. These nights are the year, the embryo of the year. Offspring and cattle live upon the embryo of the year. These nights are pregnant. Just as a python that has swallowed (prey) — even so are these nights. If a python has swallowed (prey), both ends are thin and the middle is thick. These nights have the form of a suhitya (well-nourished one). He who attains prosperity attains a well-nourished state.
meaning: यथा विषूची पदे विनिहिते अनेनागा३द् अनेना३ इत्य् अप्रजानंस् तिष्ठेद् एवम् एवैतन् मृत्योः पदयोपनं कृतं भवति पाप्मनो ऽनन्ववायाय . न ह वा एनं पुनर्मृत्युर् अन्वेत्य् अप पाप्मानं हते गच्छति स्वर्गं लोकम् . ते परम् अन्तम् इत्वा पुनर् एवाबिभयुः . तान् एतेनैवानिरुक्तेन त्रयस्त्रिंशेनात्यनयन् निरुक्तेन निरब्रवीत् . ततो वै ते तं मृत्युम् अपाजयन् य स्वर्गे लोके . अप ह वै तं मृत्युं जयति य स्वर्गे लोके य एवं वेद . संवत्सरो वा एता रात्रयस् संवत्सरस्य गर्भः . संवत्सरस्य वै गर्भं प्रजाः पशव उपजीवन्ति . गर्भिणीर् उ एता रात्रयः . यथा वा अजगरो गीर्णवान् एवम् एता रात्रयः . यद्य् उ वा अजगरो गीर्णवान् भवत्य् उभाव् अन्ताव् अणू स्थूलं मध्यम् . सुहित्यस्यो वा एता रूपं रात्रयः . सुहित्यं वै सो ऽश्नुते य श्रियम् अश्नुते .

sanskrit_iast: atha ha smāhāṣāḍhas sāvayaso yādovaśyaṃ yasminn eva me saṃvatsare samānā dāsy udakaṃ caudanaṃ cāharat tasminn eva me saṃvatsare caturviṃśatiḥ pariṣkandā niṣkagrīvāḥ pariveṣaṇam anvāyan . no tān saṃpaśyāmo ye 'niṣkā āsann iti . tāvat tejasvinīs tāvad brahmavarcasinīs tāvad vīryāvatīr etā rātrayaḥ . tad āhu śreyāṃsaṃ vā ete 'bhyārohanti ya etā rātrīr upayantīti . tad yat parastād pratyañcaḥ pṛṣṭhyasya ṣaḍahasya stomā bhavanti nihnavāyaivānārtyai śivatvāya śāntyai . trivṛto 'dhy ahna uttiṣṭhanti . brahma vai trivṛt . brahmaṇy evaitat pratiṣṭhāyodṛcam aśnuvate . trivṛt trivṛto 'nucaro bhavati . tasmād brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇasyānucaro bhavati . vindate 'nucaritr̥̄n bahavo 'syānucarā bhavanti  . na ha khalu vā eṣā kṣamā ramate yad gāyatrī . ūrdhvā ha vā eṣā saha yajamānena svargaṃ lokam eti . ūrdhvā haivāsya kīrtir ūrdhvā śrīr ūrdha svargaṃ lokam eti ya evaṃ veda . vaiśvānara udayanīyo 'tirātro bhavati .
sentences: atʰa ha smāhāṣāḍʰas sāvayaso yādovaśyaṃ yasminn eva me saṃvatsare samānā dāsy udakaṃ caudanaṃ cāharat tasminn eva me saṃvatsare caturviṃśatiḥ pariṣkandā niṣkagrīvāḥ pariveṣaṇam anvāyan .
no tān saṃpaśyāmo ye 'niṣkā āsann iti .
tāvat tejasvinīs tāvad brahmavarcasinīs tāvad vīryāvatīr etā rātrayaḥ .
tad āhu śreyāṃsaṃ vā ete 'bʰyārohanti ya etā rātrīr upayantīti .
tad yat parastād pratyañcaḥ pr̥ṣṭʰyasya ṣaḍahasya stomā bʰavanti nihnavāyaivānārtyai śivatvāya śāntyai .
vindate 'nucaritr̥̄n bahavo 'syānucarā bʰavanti [ya etā rātrīr upaiti] .
na ha kʰalu vā eṣā kṣamā ramate yad gāyatrī .
ūrdʰvā ha vā eṣā saha yajamānena svargaṃ lokam eti .
ūrdʰvā haivāsya kīrtir ūrdʰvā śrīr ūrdʰa svargaṃ lokam eti ya evaṃ veda .
text: Āṣāḍha Sāvayasa used to say regarding Yādavaśya: 'In the very year in which a female companion brought me water and rice-gruel, in that very year twenty-four mounted attendants wearing gold necklaces came to serve. We do not see those who were without necklaces.' So brilliant, so full of brahman-lustre, so full of strength are these nights. They say: 'Those who undertake these nights ascend to something higher.' Because the stomas of the Pṛṣṭhya Ṣaḍaha occur afterwards in reverse, it is for the descent, for the avoidance of harm, for auspiciousness, for peace. They rise from the Trivṛt day. The Trivṛt is brahman. Being established in brahman, they attain abundance. The Trivṛt is an attendant of the Trivṛt. Therefore a brāhmaṇa is an attendant of a brāhmaṇa. One finds attendants; many become his attendants. The Gāyatrī does not stay still (on the ground). She goes upward together with the sacrificer to the heavenly world. Upward goes his fame, upward his prosperity, upward he goes to the heavenly world — he who knows thus. The Vaiśvānara Udayanīya Atirātra occurs.
meaning: अथ ह स्माहाषाढस् सावयसो यादोवश्यं यस्मिन्न् एव मे संवत्सरे समाना दास्य् उदकं चौदनं चाहरत् तस्मिन्न् एव मे संवत्सरे चतुर्विंशतिः परिष्कन्दा निष्कग्रीवाः परिवेषणम् अन्वायन् . नो तान् संपश्यामो ये ऽनिष्का आसन्न् इति . तावत् तेजस्विनीस् तावद् ब्रह्मवर्चसिनीस् तावद् वीर्यावतीर् एता रात्रयः . तद् आहु श्रेयांसं वा एते ऽभ्यारोहन्ति य एता रात्रीर् उपयन्तीति . तद् यत् परस्ताद् प्रत्यञ्चः पृष्ठ्यस्य षडहस्य स्तोमा भवन्ति निह्नवायैवानार्त्यै शिवत्वाय शान्त्यै . त्रिवृतो ऽध्य् अह्न उत्तिष्ठन्ति . ब्रह्म वै त्रिवृत् . ब्रह्मण्य् एवैतत् प्रतिष्ठायोदृचम् अश्नुवते . त्रिवृत् त्रिवृतो ऽनुचरो भवति . तस्माद् ब्राह्मणो ब्राह्मणस्यानुचरो भवति . विन्दते ऽनुचरित्र्̥̄न् बहवो ऽस्यानुचरा भवन्ति  . न ह खलु वा एषा क्षमा रमते यद् गायत्री . ऊर्ध्वा ह वा एषा सह यजमानेन स्वर्गं लोकम् एति . ऊर्ध्वा हैवास्य कीर्तिर् ऊर्ध्वा श्रीर् ऊर्ध स्वर्गं लोकम् एति य एवं वेद . वैश्वानर उदयनीयो ऽतिरात्रो भवति .

sanskrit_iast: dvimāsyaṃ vā etat satram . tena yarddhis saivarddhiḥ . yau ha khalu vai dvau māsāv ṛtos sarddhiḥ . ṛtur u pratyakṣaṃ saṃvatsarasyarddhiḥ . saṃvatsaraṃ vā etad īrtsanti saṃvatsaram īpsanti yad yajante yat satram āsate . na hi kiṃ cana bahis saṃvatsarād asti . svārājyaṃ vā etā rātrayo yat pañcaviṃśatir dvādaśa parastād ahāni dvādaśāvastāt . atha yan madhye ahas sa svarāṭ sa svargo lokaḥ . tad bradhnasya viṣṭapaṃ gacchanti tat svārājyaṃ gacchanti . tad anyasyānanuyānā bhavanti . tā vā etā rātrayas saṃpadyante jagatīm eva . paśavo vai jagatī . tenaitat satraṃ paśavyam . upo virājaṃ gacchanti . tad u virājo 'nnādyasyaiśvaryam ādhipatyaṃ gacchanti . ekonā virāḍ ūnaṃ tat striyai yatas sā prajāyate teno prajananam . gāyatrīm u dīkṣopasadbhiś ca sutyābhiś ca saṃpadyante . prāṇo vai gāyatrī tenainat satram āyuṣyam . tejo vai gāyatrī tat tejasvino brahmavarcasino bhavanti .
sentences: yau ha kʰalu vai dvau māsāv r̥tos sarddʰiḥ .
saṃvatsaraṃ vā etad īrtsanti saṃvatsaram īpsanti yad yajante yat satram āsate .
na hi kiṃ cana bahis saṃvatsarād asti .
svārājyaṃ vā etā rātrayo yat pañcaviṃśatir dvādaśa parastād ahāni dvādaśāvastāt .
atʰa yan madʰye ahas sa svarāṭ sa svargo lokaḥ .
tad bradʰnasya viṣṭapaṃ gaccʰanti tat svārājyaṃ gaccʰanti .
tā vā etā rātrayas saṃpadyante jagatīm eva .
ekonā virāḍ ūnaṃ tat striyai yatas sā prajāyate teno prajananam .
gāyatrīm u dīkṣopasadbʰiś ca sutyābʰiś ca saṃpadyante .
prāṇo vai gāyatrī tenainat satram āyuṣyam .
tejo vai gāyatrī tat tejasvino brahmavarcasino bʰavanti .
text: This sattra is of two months' duration. Whatever prosperity is attained by it, that is the prosperity. The two months that constitute a season are indeed half. And a season is manifestly half of the year. It is the year that they seek to reach, the year that they desire, when they sacrifice, when they sit in a sattra — for nothing exists outside the year. These nights, twenty-five in number, are sovereignty (svārājya) — twelve days on the far side, twelve on the near side. And the day that is in the middle — that is the sovereign ruler (svarāṭ), that is the heavenly world. They reach the seat of Bradhna; they reach sovereignty. Thereby they become such that none other follows after them. These nights equal the jagatī meter. Cattle are the jagatī. Therefore this sattra is rich in cattle. They approach the virāj. Thereby they attain the lordship and supremacy of the annādya (food) of virāj. The virāj is one less — that is the deficiency of the woman, from which she gives birth; thereby there is procreation. And through the dīkṣā, upasads, and pressing days, they equal the gāyatrī. The gāyatrī is the vital breath (prāṇa); therefore this sattra bestows long life. The gāyatrī is splendor (tejas); therefore they become radiant and possessed of brahmic luster.
meaning: द्विमास्यं वा एतत् सत्रम् . तेन यर्द्धिस् सैवर्द्धिः . यौ ह खलु वै द्वौ मासाव् ऋतोस् सर्द्धिः . ऋतुर् उ प्रत्यक्षं संवत्सरस्यर्द्धिः . संवत्सरं वा एतद् ईर्त्सन्ति संवत्सरम् ईप्सन्ति यद् यजन्ते यत् सत्रम् आसते . न हि किं चन बहिस् संवत्सराद् अस्ति . स्वाराज्यं वा एता रात्रयो यत् पञ्चविंशतिर् द्वादश परस्ताद् अहानि द्वादशावस्तात् . अथ यन् मध्ये अहस् स स्वराट् स स्वर्गो लोकः . तद् ब्रध्नस्य विष्टपं गच्छन्ति तत् स्वाराज्यं गच्छन्ति . तद् अन्यस्याननुयाना भवन्ति . ता वा एता रात्रयस् संपद्यन्ते जगतीम् एव . पशवो वै जगती . तेनैतत् सत्रं पशव्यम् . उपो विराजं गच्छन्ति . तद् उ विराजो ऽन्नाद्यस्यैश्वर्यम् आधिपत्यं गच्छन्ति . एकोना विराड् ऊनं तत् स्त्रियै यतस् सा प्रजायते तेनो प्रजननम् . गायत्रीम् उ दीक्षोपसद्भिश् च सुत्याभिश् च संपद्यन्ते . प्राणो वै गायत्री तेनैनत् सत्रम् आयुष्यम् . तेजो वै गायत्री तत् तेजस्विनो ब्रह्मवर्चसिनो भवन्ति .

sanskrit_iast: saṃvatsarasya ha khalu vā eṣa rasaḥ pravṛḍho yad eṣa pañcaviṃśatirātraḥ . etad dhi sarvaṃ saṃvatsararūpaṃ kriyate . etāv atirātrāv ete ārambhaṇīyamahāvratīye ahanī etau pṛṣṭhyāv etau viśvajidabhijitāv ete svarasāmāna eṣa viṣuvān . te ye kāmaṃkāmaṃ samārebhāṇā iva manyeraṃs ta etam eva pañcaviṃśatirātram upeyuḥ . āptvā haivaitat satram uttiṣṭhanti . puruṣasaṃmitaṃ ha khalu vā etat satraṃ yad eṣa pañcaviṃśatirātraḥ . daśa vai puruṣasya hastyā aṅgulayo daśa padyāś catvāri prāṅgāṇy ātmā pañcaviṃśaḥ . ṣaḍ imāni parvāṇi ṣaḍ imāni ṣaḍ imāni ṣaḍ imāny ātmā pañcaviṃśaḥ . dvādaśemāḥ pariśavo dvādaśemā ātmaiva pañcaviṃśaḥ . puruṣaṃ vāvaitena saṃskurvanti puruṣaṃ prajanayanti . tad āhu śreyāṃsaṃ vā ete 'bhyārohanti ya etaṃ pañcaviṃśatirātram upayantīti . tad yat parastād pratyaṅ pṛṣṭhyaṣ ṣaḍaho bhavati nihnavāyaivānārtyai śivatvāya śāntyai . mahāvratīyād adhy ahna uttiṣṭhanty annaṃ vai mahāvratam annādya evaitat pratiṣṭhāyodṛcam aśnuvate . vaiśvānara udayanīyo 'tirātro bhavati .
sentences: saṃvatsarasya ha kʰalu vā eṣa rasaḥ pravr̥ḍʰo yad eṣa pañcaviṃśatirātraḥ .
etāv atirātrāv ete ārambʰaṇīyamahāvratīye ahanī etau pr̥ṣṭʰyāv etau viśvajidabʰijitāv ete svarasāmāna eṣa viṣuvān .
te ye kāmaṃkāmaṃ samārebʰāṇā iva manyeraṃs ta etam eva pañcaviṃśatirātram upeyuḥ .
puruṣasaṃmitaṃ ha kʰalu vā etat satraṃ yad eṣa pañcaviṃśatirātraḥ .
daśa vai puruṣasya hastyā aṅgulayo daśa padyāś catvāri prāṅgāṇy ātmā pañcaviṃśaḥ .
ṣaḍ imāni parvāṇi ṣaḍ imāni ṣaḍ imāni ṣaḍ imāny ātmā pañcaviṃśaḥ .
tad āhu śreyāṃsaṃ vā ete 'bʰyārohanti ya etaṃ pañcaviṃśatirātram upayantīti .
tad yat parastād pratyaṅ pr̥ṣṭʰyaṣ ṣaḍaho bʰavati nihnavāyaivānārtyai śivatvāya śāntyai .
mahāvratīyād adʰy ahna uttiṣṭʰanty annaṃ vai mahāvratam annādya evaitat pratiṣṭʰāyodr̥cam aśnuvate .
text: This twenty-five-night rite is indeed the extracted essence of the year. For everything here is made in the form of the year — these two atirātras, these two days which are the ārambhaṇīya and mahāvratīya, these two pṛṣṭhya days, these two which are the viśvajit and abhijit, these svarasāmans, this viṣuvān. Those who might think they are undertaking whatever they wish — they should undertake this very twenty-five-night rite. Having completed this sattra, they rise up. This sattra, the twenty-five-night rite, is measured by the person (puruṣa). Ten are the fingers of a person's hands, ten of the feet, four are the limbs, and the self is the twenty-fifth. Six are these joints, six are these, six are these, six are these — the self is the twenty-fifth. Twelve are these ribs on one side, twelve on the other — the self is the twenty-fifth. Thus by this they perfect a person, they generate a person. Therefore they say: 'Those who undertake this twenty-five-night rite ascend to a higher state.' The pṛṣṭhya ṣaḍaha that follows on the far side serves for concealment, for averting misfortune, for auspiciousness, for peace. They rise up from the mahāvratīya day. The mahāvrata is food; thereby, having become established in annādya, they attain the surplus. The Vaiśvānara is the concluding atirātra.
meaning: संवत्सरस्य ह खलु वा एष रसः प्रवृढो यद् एष पञ्चविंशतिरात्रः . एतद् धि सर्वं संवत्सररूपं क्रियते . एताव् अतिरात्राव् एते आरम्भणीयमहाव्रतीये अहनी एतौ पृष्ठ्याव् एतौ विश्वजिदभिजिताव् एते स्वरसामान एष विषुवान् . ते ये कामंकामं समारेभाणा इव मन्येरंस् त एतम् एव पञ्चविंशतिरात्रम् उपेयुः . आप्त्वा हैवैतत् सत्रम् उत्तिष्ठन्ति . पुरुषसंमितं ह खलु वा एतत् सत्रं यद् एष पञ्चविंशतिरात्रः . दश वै पुरुषस्य हस्त्या अङ्गुलयो दश पद्याश् चत्वारि प्राङ्गाण्य् आत्मा पञ्चविंशः . षड् इमानि पर्वाणि षड् इमानि षड् इमानि षड् इमान्य् आत्मा पञ्चविंशः . द्वादशेमाः परिशवो द्वादशेमा आत्मैव पञ्चविंशः . पुरुषं वावैतेन संस्कुर्वन्ति पुरुषं प्रजनयन्ति . तद् आहु श्रेयांसं वा एते ऽभ्यारोहन्ति य एतं पञ्चविंशतिरात्रम् उपयन्तीति . तद् यत् परस्ताद् प्रत्यङ् पृष्ठ्यष् षडहो भवति निह्नवायैवानार्त्यै शिवत्वाय शान्त्यै . महाव्रतीयाद् अध्य् अह्न उत्तिष्ठन्त्य् अन्नं वै महाव्रतम् अन्नाद्य एवैतत् प्रतिष्ठायोदृचम् अश्नुवते . वैश्वानर उदयनीयो ऽतिरात्रो भवति .

sanskrit_iast: dvimāsyaṃ vā etat satram . tena yarddhis saivarddhiḥ . yau ha khalu vai dvau māsāv ṛtos sarddhiḥ . ṛtur u pratyakṣaṃ saṃvatsarasyarddhiḥ . saṃvatsaraṃ vā etad īrtsanti saṃvatsaram īpsanti yad yajante yat satram āsate . na hi kiṃ cana bahis saṃvatsarād asti . svārājyaṃ vā etā rātrayo yat trayastriṃśat ṣoḍaśa parastād ahāni ṣoḍaśāvastāt . atha yan madhye ahas sa svarāṭ sa svargo lokaḥ . tad bradhnasya viṣṭapaṃ gacchanti tat svārājyaṃ gacchanti . tad anyasyānanuyānā bhavanti . tā vā etā rātrayas saṃpadyante virājam eva . tad u virājo 'nnādyasyaiśvaryam ādhipatyaṃ gacchanti . tisraś ca virāṭ ca . tā yās tisro daivīr ācchadas tāsām eṣarddhir yāni trīṇi chandāṃsi yāni trīṇi savanāni ye trayaḥ prāṇāpānāvyānā ye traya ime lokāh . yat kiṃ ca tristris tasyaiṣā sarvasyarddhis tasyopāptiḥ . devasatraṃ ha khalu vā etad yad eṣa trayastriṃśadrātraḥ . trayastriṃśad vai devatāḥ . devatā vā ṛddhikāmās tapo 'tapyanta . tā etad ayanam apaśyan . tad upāyan . tato vai tāsām ahnaivaikārdhnod ahnaikāhnaikā . sā ha khalu vai śreṣṭharddhīnāṃ sa lokānāṃ puṇyatamo yam etena devatā ārdhnuvan . sā yā śreṣṭharddhīnāṃ yo lokānāṃ puṇyatamo yam etena devatā ārdhnuvaṃs tam ṛdhnavāmeti .
sentences: yau ha kʰalu vai dvau māsāv r̥tos sarddʰiḥ .
saṃvatsaraṃ vā etad īrtsanti saṃvatsaram īpsanti yad yajante yat satram āsate .
na hi kiṃ cana bahis saṃvatsarād asti .
svārājyaṃ vā etā rātrayo yat trayastriṃśat ṣoḍaśa parastād ahāni ṣoḍaśāvastāt .
atʰa yan madʰye ahas sa svarāṭ sa svargo lokaḥ .
tad bradʰnasya viṣṭapaṃ gaccʰanti tat svārājyaṃ gaccʰanti .
tā vā etā rātrayas saṃpadyante virājam eva .
tā yās tisro daivīr āccʰadas tāsām eṣarddʰir yāni trīṇi cʰandāṃsi yāni trīṇi savanāni ye trayaḥ prāṇāpānāvyānā ye traya ime lokāh .
yat kiṃ ca tristris tasyaiṣā sarvasyarddʰis tasyopāptiḥ .
devasatraṃ ha kʰalu vā etad yad eṣa trayastriṃśadrātraḥ .
sā ha kʰalu vai śreṣṭʰarddʰīnāṃ sa lokānāṃ puṇyatamo yam etena devatā ārdʰnuvan .
sā yā śreṣṭʰarddʰīnāṃ yo lokānāṃ puṇyatamo yam etena devatā ārdʰnuvaṃs tam r̥dʰnavāmeti .
text: This sattra is of two months' duration. Whatever prosperity is attained by it, that is the prosperity. The two months that constitute a season are indeed half. And a season is manifestly half of the year. It is the year that they seek to reach, the year that they desire, when they sacrifice, when they sit in a sattra — for nothing exists outside the year. These nights, thirty-three in number, are sovereignty (svārājya) — sixteen days on the far side, sixteen on the near side. And the day that is in the middle — that is the sovereign ruler, that is the heavenly world. They reach the seat of Bradhna; they reach sovereignty. Thereby they become such that none other follows after them. These nights equal the virāj itself. Thereby they attain the lordship and supremacy of the annādya of virāj. Three plus virāj — those three that are the divine coverings, of them this is the half: the three meters, the three pressings, the three vital breaths — prāṇa, apāna, vyāna — and these three worlds. Whatever is in groups of three, of all that this is the half and the attainment. This thirty-three-night rite is verily the sattra of the gods. Thirty-three are the deities. The deities, desiring prosperity, performed tapas. They beheld this course (ayana). They undertook it. Thereupon, day by day, one after another prospered. That which is the most meritorious among the worlds of highest prosperity, which the deities attained by this — 'Let us attain that most meritorious among the worlds of highest prosperity which the deities attained by this.'
meaning: द्विमास्यं वा एतत् सत्रम् . तेन यर्द्धिस् सैवर्द्धिः . यौ ह खलु वै द्वौ मासाव् ऋतोस् सर्द्धिः . ऋतुर् उ प्रत्यक्षं संवत्सरस्यर्द्धिः . संवत्सरं वा एतद् ईर्त्सन्ति संवत्सरम् ईप्सन्ति यद् यजन्ते यत् सत्रम् आसते . न हि किं चन बहिस् संवत्सराद् अस्ति . स्वाराज्यं वा एता रात्रयो यत् त्रयस्त्रिंशत् षोडश परस्ताद् अहानि षोडशावस्तात् . अथ यन् मध्ये अहस् स स्वराट् स स्वर्गो लोकः . तद् ब्रध्नस्य विष्टपं गच्छन्ति तत् स्वाराज्यं गच्छन्ति . तद् अन्यस्याननुयाना भवन्ति . ता वा एता रात्रयस् संपद्यन्ते विराजम् एव . तद् उ विराजो ऽन्नाद्यस्यैश्वर्यम् आधिपत्यं गच्छन्ति . तिस्रश् च विराट् च . ता यास् तिस्रो दैवीर् आच्छदस् तासाम् एषर्द्धिर् यानि त्रीणि छन्दांसि यानि त्रीणि सवनानि ये त्रयः प्राणापानाव्याना ये त्रय इमे लोकाह् . यत् किं च त्रिस्त्रिस् तस्यैषा सर्वस्यर्द्धिस् तस्योपाप्तिः . देवसत्रं ह खलु वा एतद् यद् एष त्रयस्त्रिंशद्रात्रः . त्रयस्त्रिंशद् वै देवताः . देवता वा ऋद्धिकामास् तपो ऽतप्यन्त . ता एतद् अयनम् अपश्यन् . तद् उपायन् . ततो वै तासाम् अह्नैवैकार्ध्नोद् अह्नैकाह्नैका . सा ह खलु वै श्रेष्ठर्द्धीनां स लोकानां पुण्यतमो यम् एतेन देवता आर्ध्नुवन् . सा या श्रेष्ठर्द्धीनां यो लोकानां पुण्यतमो यम् एतेन देवता आर्ध्नुवंस् तम् ऋध्नवामेति .

sanskrit_iast: athaite pañcāhā bhavanti pañca vai jayāḥ . pañcabhir vai vyāhṛtibhir idaṃ devā ajayaṃs tad yāvatedaṃ devā ajayaṃs tāvatā jayāmeti . pāṅkto yajñaḥ . yāvatī yajñasya mātrā tām āpnavāmeti . pāṅktāḥ paśavaḥ . yāvatī paśūnāṃ mātrā tāvatā naḥ paśavo 'varuddhā upatiṣṭhāntā iti . pāṅktam annādyaṃ yāvaty annādyasya mātrā tāvatā no 'nnādyam avaruddham upatiṣṭhātā iti . atha smāhuḥ kāpeyā anṛtau vā eṣa pratiṣṭhito yat ṣaḍahaḥ . pañcāho vā ṛtau pratiṣṭhita iti . vasanto vai prathama ṛtūnāṃ grīṣmo dvitīyo varṣās tṛtīyāś śarac caturthī hemantaḥ pañcamaś śiśiraṣ ṣaṣṭhaḥ . sa eṣa śreṣṭha ṛtūnāṃ yad dhemantaḥ pīvaguḥ pīvavatsaḥ . tam anu pañcāhaḥ pratitiṣṭhann eti . athaiṣa paricakṣyaiva yac chiśiraḥ kṛśaguḥ kṛśapuruṣaḥ . tam anu ṣaḍahaḥ pratitiṣṭhati . sa ya śreṣṭha ṛtūnāṃ hemantas tasya pratiṣṭhām anu pratitiṣṭhanto 'yāmeti . tasmād etat pañcāhavidham upayanti . vaiśvānaraḥ prāyaṇīyo 'tirātro bhavati .
sentences: atʰaite pañcāhā bʰavanti pañca vai jayāḥ .
pañcabʰir vai vyāhr̥tibʰir idaṃ devā ajayaṃs tad yāvatedaṃ devā ajayaṃs tāvatā jayāmeti .
yāvatī paśūnāṃ mātrā tāvatā naḥ paśavo 'varuddʰā upatiṣṭʰāntā iti .
pāṅktam annādyaṃ yāvaty annādyasya mātrā tāvatā no 'nnādyam avaruddʰam upatiṣṭʰātā iti .
atʰa smāhuḥ kāpeyā anr̥tau vā eṣa pratiṣṭʰito yat ṣaḍahaḥ .
vasanto vai pratʰama r̥tūnāṃ grīṣmo dvitīyo varṣās tr̥tīyāś śarac caturtʰī hemantaḥ pañcamaś śiśiraṣ ṣaṣṭʰaḥ .
sa eṣa śreṣṭʰa r̥tūnāṃ yad dʰemantaḥ pīvaguḥ pīvavatsaḥ .
atʰaiṣa paricakṣyaiva yac cʰiśiraḥ kr̥śaguḥ kr̥śapuruṣaḥ .
sa ya śreṣṭʰa r̥tūnāṃ hemantas tasya pratiṣṭʰām anu pratitiṣṭʰanto 'yāmeti .
text: Then there are five-day periods (pañcāhas). Five indeed are the conquests. With five utterances (vyāhṛtis) the gods conquered this world. 'We shall conquer as much as the gods conquered by this.' The sacrifice is fivefold (pāṅkta). 'We shall attain the full measure of the sacrifice.' Cattle are fivefold. 'May our cattle, confined in the full measure of cattle, attend upon us.' Food (annādya) is fivefold. 'May our food, confined in the full measure of food, attend upon us.' Now the Kāpeyas say: 'The ṣaḍaha is established in a non-season (anṛta). The pañcāha is established in a proper season (ṛta).' Spring is the first of the seasons, summer the second, the rains the third, autumn the fourth, winter the fifth, the cool season the sixth. That which is the best of seasons is winter — with fat cattle, with fat calves. The pañcāha is established following that. And the cool season (śiśira) is to be passed over — with lean cattle, with lean people. The ṣaḍaha is established following that. 'Following the establishment of winter, the best of seasons, let us go establishing ourselves.' Therefore they undertake this in the pañcāha form. The Vaiśvānara is the opening atirātra.
meaning: अथैते पञ्चाहा भवन्ति पञ्च वै जयाः . पञ्चभिर् वै व्याहृतिभिर् इदं देवा अजयंस् तद् यावतेदं देवा अजयंस् तावता जयामेति . पाङ्क्तो यज्ञः . यावती यज्ञस्य मात्रा ताम् आप्नवामेति . पाङ्क्ताः पशवः . यावती पशूनां मात्रा तावता नः पशवो ऽवरुद्धा उपतिष्ठान्ता इति . पाङ्क्तम् अन्नाद्यं यावत्य् अन्नाद्यस्य मात्रा तावता नो ऽन्नाद्यम् अवरुद्धम् उपतिष्ठाता इति . अथ स्माहुः कापेया अनृतौ वा एष प्रतिष्ठितो यत् षडहः . पञ्चाहो वा ऋतौ प्रतिष्ठित इति . वसन्तो वै प्रथम ऋतूनां ग्रीष्मो द्वितीयो वर्षास् तृतीयाश् शरच् चतुर्थी हेमन्तः पञ्चमश् शिशिरष् षष्ठः . स एष श्रेष्ठ ऋतूनां यद् धेमन्तः पीवगुः पीववत्सः . तम् अनु पञ्चाहः प्रतितिष्ठन्न् एति . अथैष परिचक्ष्यैव यच् छिशिरः कृशगुः कृशपुरुषः . तम् अनु षडहः प्रतितिष्ठति . स य श्रेष्ठ ऋतूनां हेमन्तस् तस्य प्रतिष्ठाम् अनु प्रतितिष्ठन्तो ऽयामेति . तस्माद् एतत् पञ्चाहविधम् उपयन्ति . वैश्वानरः प्रायणीयो ऽतिरात्रो भवति .

sanskrit_iast: athaite jyotir gaur āyur iti stomā bhavanti . ete ha vai śivāś śāntāḥ pathyā stomā ye jyotir gaur āyur iti . te ye śivāś śāntāḥ pathyā stomās tair na stutam asad iti . ta u virājaṃ saṃpannāḥ . tad u virājam annādyam ārabhante . tām āntaṃ nāvasṛjeyuḥ . bṛhadrathantare sāmanī bhavataḥ . sā hy ṛddhis sa panthāḥ . śyaitanaudhase brahmasāmanī bhavataḥ . praspaṣṭam ājim anu śūkaravāmeti . tad yat tṛtīye 'hani rathantaraṃ saṃpadyeta tad vairūpam upeyuḥ . idaṃ vai rathantaram ado bṛhad idam evāntarikṣaṃ vairūpam . etayor eva sāmnor asamade . atha ha vai niṣkaraṇīyā iti brāhmaṇāḥ pūrviṇas satraṃ niṣeduḥ . teṣāṃ ha sma vāsiṣṭhas sātyahavya āsadya somaṃ bhakṣayitvā pradhāvati . te hābhiśastiṃ cakrire kathaṃ nu no dīkṣitānām adīkṣitās somaṃ bhakṣayeyur iti . te haitad ekam ahar vairūpam upeyuḥ . sa ha punar āsadya tūṣṇīm evekṣamāṇo niṣasāda . taṃ hocuḥ kathaṃ na sarpasi kathaṃ na bhakṣayasīti . sa hovāca satriṇo vā abhūta dīrghasomo vāva vaḥ purābhūd iti . tad yat tṛtīye 'hani vairūpam upayanti satritāyā eva .
sentences: atʰaite jyotir gaur āyur iti stomā bʰavanti .
ete ha vai śivāś śāntāḥ patʰyā stomā ye jyotir gaur āyur iti .
te ye śivāś śāntāḥ patʰyā stomās tair na stutam asad iti .
tad yat tr̥tīye 'hani ratʰantaraṃ saṃpadyeta tad vairūpam upeyuḥ .
idaṃ vai ratʰantaram ado br̥had idam evāntarikṣaṃ vairūpam .
atʰa ha vai niṣkaraṇīyā iti brāhmaṇāḥ pūrviṇas satraṃ niṣeduḥ .
teṣāṃ ha sma vāsiṣṭʰas sātyahavya āsadya somaṃ bʰakṣayitvā pradʰāvati .
te hābʰiśastiṃ cakrire katʰaṃ nu no dīkṣitānām adīkṣitās somaṃ bʰakṣayeyur iti .
te haitad ekam ahar vairūpam upeyuḥ .
sa ha punar āsadya tūṣṇīm evekṣamāṇo niṣasāda .
taṃ hocuḥ katʰaṃ na sarpasi katʰaṃ na bʰakṣayasīti .
sa hovāca satriṇo vā abʰūta dīrgʰasomo vāva vaḥ purābʰūd iti .
tad yat tr̥tīye 'hani vairūpam upayanti satritāyā eva .
text: Then these stomas become jyotis, gaus, and āyus. These stomas that are jyotis, gaus, and āyus are indeed auspicious, peaceful, and salutary. 'Let it not be that we have praised with stomas that are not auspicious, peaceful, and salutary.' And they are equal to the virāj. Thereby they lay hold of the annādya of virāj. They should not release it to the end. The bṛhat and rathantara become the sāmans. For that is the prosperity, that is the path. The śyaita and naudhas become the brahma-sāmans. 'We pursue the race along a clearly visible course' — thus. If on the third day the rathantara happens to fall, they should undertake the vairūpa. This world is the rathantara, that world is the bṛhat, and this intermediate space is the vairūpa — for the non-conflict of these two sāmans. Now the ancient brāhmaṇas sat in sattra saying 'We shall settle things definitively.' Vāsiṣṭha Sātyahavya would sit down among them, drink the soma, and run away. They made a complaint: 'How can the uninitiated drink soma among us who are initiated?' They undertook the vairūpa for one day. He sat down again and sat silently, merely looking on. They said to him: 'Why do you not move about? Why do you not partake?' He replied: 'You have become sattrins; the long soma-pressing (dīrghasoma) was yours before.' Therefore they undertake the vairūpa on the third day — for the sake of sattrin-hood.
meaning: अथैते ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुर् इति स्तोमा भवन्ति . एते ह वै शिवाश् शान्ताः पथ्या स्तोमा ये ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुर् इति . ते ये शिवाश् शान्ताः पथ्या स्तोमास् तैर् न स्तुतम् असद् इति . त उ विराजं संपन्नाः . तद् उ विराजम् अन्नाद्यम् आरभन्ते . ताम् आन्तं नावसृजेयुः . बृहद्रथन्तरे सामनी भवतः . सा ह्य् ऋद्धिस् स पन्थाः . श्यैतनौधसे ब्रह्मसामनी भवतः . प्रस्पष्टम् आजिम् अनु शूकरवामेति . तद् यत् तृतीये ऽहनि रथन्तरं संपद्येत तद् वैरूपम् उपेयुः . इदं वै रथन्तरम् अदो बृहद् इदम् एवान्तरिक्षं वैरूपम् . एतयोर् एव साम्नोर् असमदे . अथ ह वै निष्करणीया इति ब्राह्मणाः पूर्विणस् सत्रं निषेदुः . तेषां ह स्म वासिष्ठस् सात्यहव्य आसद्य सोमं भक्षयित्वा प्रधावति . ते हाभिशस्तिं चक्रिरे कथं नु नो दीक्षितानाम् अदीक्षितास् सोमं भक्षयेयुर् इति . ते हैतद् एकम् अहर् वैरूपम् उपेयुः . स ह पुनर् आसद्य तूष्णीम् एवेक्षमाणो निषसाद . तं होचुः कथं न सर्पसि कथं न भक्षयसीति . स होवाच सत्रिणो वा अभूत दीर्घसोमो वाव वः पुराभूद् इति . तद् यत् तृतीये ऽहनि वैरूपम् उपयन्ति सत्रिताया एव .

sanskrit_iast: - tad dhotāraṃ brūyād ubhe rūpe saṃsa yac ca rāthantaraṃ yac ca bārhatam iti . yatrāyuṣi bṛhat saṃpadyeta tad dhotāraṃ brūyād ubhe rūpe śaṃsa yac ca bārhataṃ yac ca rāthantaram iti . yady ubhe rāthantare ahanī saṃpadyeyātām pūrvasyāhnas saubharam ukthyeṣu brahmasāma kuryur . yady ubhe bārhate ahanī saṃpadyeyātām uttarasyāhnaḥ kaṇvarathantaraṃ mādhyandine pavamāne proheyuḥ . prajā vā eṣā bṛhadrathantayor yad ete sāmanī . tad yad evam upayanty ajāmitāyā eva . athaiṣa viśvajit sarvapṛṣṭho 'tirātro bhavati prājāpatyam ahar ahorātre vai kṛtsnaḥ prajāpatiḥ kṛtsnaṃ prajāpatim ṛdhnavāma kṛtsno naḥ prajāpatir upeto 'sad iti . tad āhu śreyāṃsaṃ vā ete 'bhyārohanti ya etaṃ viśvajitam atirātram upayanti . prajāpatiṃ hy eva pratyakṣam upayantīti . tad yat parastād pratyañcaḥ trayaḥ pañcāhā bhavanti nihnavāyaivānārtyai śivatvāya śāntyai . vaiśvānara udayanīyo 'tirātro bhavati .
sentences: - tad dʰotāraṃ brūyād ubʰe rūpe saṃsa yac ca rātʰantaraṃ yac ca bārhatam iti .
yatrāyuṣi br̥hat saṃpadyeta tad dʰotāraṃ brūyād ubʰe rūpe śaṃsa yac ca bārhataṃ yac ca rātʰantaram iti .
yady ubʰe rātʰantare ahanī saṃpadyeyātām pūrvasyāhnas saubʰaram uktʰyeṣu brahmasāma kuryur .
yady ubʰe bārhate ahanī saṃpadyeyātām uttarasyāhnaḥ kaṇvaratʰantaraṃ mādʰyandine pavamāne proheyuḥ .
prajā vā eṣā br̥hadratʰantayor yad ete sāmanī .
tad yad evam upayanty ajāmitāyā eva .
atʰaiṣa viśvajit sarvapr̥ṣṭʰo 'tirātro bʰavati prājāpatyam ahar ahorātre vai kr̥tsnaḥ prajāpatiḥ kr̥tsnaṃ prajāpatim r̥dʰnavāma kr̥tsno naḥ prajāpatir upeto 'sad iti .
tad āhu śreyāṃsaṃ vā ete 'bʰyārohanti ya etaṃ viśvajitam atirātram upayanti .
tad yat parastād pratyañcaḥ trayaḥ pañcāhā bʰavanti nihnavāyaivānārtyai śivatvāya śāntyai .
text: One should tell the hotṛ: 'Recite both forms — that which is rāthantara and that which is bārhata.' Where the bṛhat falls on the āyus day, one should tell the hotṛ: 'Recite both forms — that which is bārhata and that which is rāthantara.' If both days turn out to be rāthantara, they should make the saubhara the brahmasāman in the ukthyas of the first day. If both days turn out to be bārhata, they should introduce the kaṇva-rathantara in the midday pavamāna of the latter day. The offspring of bṛhat and rathantara are these sāmans. By undertaking it thus, it is for the avoidance of incest (ajāmitā). Then this viśvajit with all pṛṣṭhas becomes an atirātra — a day belonging to Prajāpati. Day and night together are the complete Prajāpati. 'Let us attain the complete Prajāpati; let the complete Prajāpati be with us.' Therefore they say: 'Those who undertake this viśvajit atirātra ascend to a higher state, for they directly undertake Prajāpati himself.' The three pañcāhas that follow on the far side serve for concealment, for averting misfortune, for auspiciousness, for peace. The Vaiśvānara is the concluding atirātra.
meaning: - तद् धोतारं ब्रूयाद् उभे रूपे संस यच् च राथन्तरं यच् च बार्हतम् इति . यत्रायुषि बृहत् संपद्येत तद् धोतारं ब्रूयाद् उभे रूपे शंस यच् च बार्हतं यच् च राथन्तरम् इति . यद्य् उभे राथन्तरे अहनी संपद्येयाताम् पूर्वस्याह्नस् सौभरम् उक्थ्येषु ब्रह्मसाम कुर्युर् . यद्य् उभे बार्हते अहनी संपद्येयाताम् उत्तरस्याह्नः कण्वरथन्तरं माध्यन्दिने पवमाने प्रोहेयुः . प्रजा वा एषा बृहद्रथन्तयोर् यद् एते सामनी . तद् यद् एवम् उपयन्त्य् अजामिताया एव . अथैष विश्वजित् सर्वपृष्ठो ऽतिरात्रो भवति प्राजापत्यम् अहर् अहोरात्रे वै कृत्स्नः प्रजापतिः कृत्स्नं प्रजापतिम् ऋध्नवाम कृत्स्नो नः प्रजापतिर् उपेतो ऽसद् इति . तद् आहु श्रेयांसं वा एते ऽभ्यारोहन्ति य एतं विश्वजितम् अतिरात्रम् उपयन्ति . प्रजापतिं ह्य् एव प्रत्यक्षम् उपयन्तीति . तद् यत् परस्ताद् प्रत्यञ्चः त्रयः पञ्चाहा भवन्ति निह्नवायैवानार्त्यै शिवत्वाय शान्त्यै . वैश्वानर उदयनीयो ऽतिरात्रो भवति .

sanskrit_iast: athaitā dvādaśāhavatīr bhavanti yaivāsau dvādaśāhavatīnāṃ praśaṃsā sā na upāptāsad iti . idam iva tv atropādhīyate . tā vā tvai purastād upeyus tā vopariṣṭāt . yadi purastād upeyuḥ prāyaṇīyasyaivāhno 'chaṃbaṭkārāya . tad iva tv atra paricakṣate yad vācam ohuṣīṃ daśamenāhnāsaṃpādya tasyai vikṛṣṭāyai vāco 'pratiṣṭhitāyā udṛcam aśnuvate . yad eva tatra prāyaṇīyarūpaṃ manyeraṃs tad eva tatra kuryuḥ . pratnavat pretivat saṃpannāyai vāco 'vikṛṣṭāyai pratiṣṭhāyā udṛcam aśnavāmahā iti . athaiṣa viśvajit sarvapṛṣṭho 'tirātro bhavati prājāpatyam ahar ahorātre vai kṛtsnaḥ prajāpatiḥ kṛtsnaṃ prajāpatim ṛdhnavāma kṛtsno naḥ prajāpatir upeto 'sad iti . tad āhu śreyāṃsaṃ vā ete 'bhyārohanti ya etaṃ viśvajitam atirātram upayanti . prajāpatiṃ hy eva pratyakṣam upayantīti . tad yat parastād pratyaṅ pañcāho bhavati nihnavāyaivānārtyai śivatvāya śāntyai . vaiśvānara udayanīyo 'tirātro bhavati .
sentences: atʰaitā dvādaśāhavatīr bʰavanti yaivāsau dvādaśāhavatīnāṃ praśaṃsā sā na upāptāsad iti .
tā vā tvai purastād upeyus tā vopariṣṭāt .
tad iva tv atra paricakṣate yad vācam ohuṣīṃ daśamenāhnāsaṃpādya tasyai vikr̥ṣṭāyai vāco 'pratiṣṭʰitāyā udr̥cam aśnuvate .
yad eva tatra prāyaṇīyarūpaṃ manyeraṃs tad eva tatra kuryuḥ .
pratnavat pretivat saṃpannāyai vāco 'vikr̥ṣṭāyai pratiṣṭʰāyā udr̥cam aśnavāmahā iti .
atʰaiṣa viśvajit sarvapr̥ṣṭʰo 'tirātro bʰavati prājāpatyam ahar ahorātre vai kr̥tsnaḥ prajāpatiḥ kr̥tsnaṃ prajāpatim r̥dʰnavāma kr̥tsno naḥ prajāpatir upeto 'sad iti .
tad āhu śreyāṃsaṃ vā ete 'bʰyārohanti ya etaṃ viśvajitam atirātram upayanti .
tad yat parastād pratyaṅ pañcāho bʰavati nihnavāyaivānārtyai śivatvāya śāntyai .
text: Then there are twelve-day periods (dvādaśāhavatīs). 'Let the very praise that belongs to the dvādaśāhavatīs be attained by us.' But here something additional is introduced. They may undertake them at the beginning or at the end. If they undertake them at the beginning, it is for the chaṃbaṭkāra of the opening day. But this is disapproved of here: that, without completing speech (vāc) with the tenth day, they attain the surplus of speech that is drawn out and unestablished. Whatever they consider to be in the form of the opening rite (prāyaṇīya), that they should do there. 'Let us attain the surplus of speech that is completed in the ancient manner, in the traditional manner — of speech that is not drawn out, that is well established.' Then this viśvajit with all pṛṣṭhas becomes an atirātra — a day belonging to Prajāpati. Day and night together are the complete Prajāpati. 'Let us attain the complete Prajāpati; let the complete Prajāpati be with us.' Therefore they say: 'Those who undertake this viśvajit atirātra ascend to a higher state, for they directly undertake Prajāpati himself.' The pañcāha that follows on the far side serves for concealment, for averting misfortune, for auspiciousness, for peace. The Vaiśvānara is the concluding atirātra.
meaning: अथैता द्वादशाहवतीर् भवन्ति यैवासौ द्वादशाहवतीनां प्रशंसा सा न उपाप्तासद् इति . इदम् इव त्व् अत्रोपाधीयते . ता वा त्वै पुरस्ताद् उपेयुस् ता वोपरिष्टात् . यदि पुरस्ताद् उपेयुः प्रायणीयस्यैवाह्नो ऽछंबट्काराय . तद् इव त्व् अत्र परिचक्षते यद् वाचम् ओहुषीं दशमेनाह्नासंपाद्य तस्यै विकृष्टायै वाचो ऽप्रतिष्ठिताया उदृचम् अश्नुवते . यद् एव तत्र प्रायणीयरूपं मन्येरंस् तद् एव तत्र कुर्युः . प्रत्नवत् प्रेतिवत् संपन्नायै वाचो ऽविकृष्टायै प्रतिष्ठाया उदृचम् अश्नवामहा इति . अथैष विश्वजित् सर्वपृष्ठो ऽतिरात्रो भवति प्राजापत्यम् अहर् अहोरात्रे वै कृत्स्नः प्रजापतिः कृत्स्नं प्रजापतिम् ऋध्नवाम कृत्स्नो नः प्रजापतिर् उपेतो ऽसद् इति . तद् आहु श्रेयांसं वा एते ऽभ्यारोहन्ति य एतं विश्वजितम् अतिरात्रम् उपयन्ति . प्रजापतिं ह्य् एव प्रत्यक्षम् उपयन्तीति . तद् यत् परस्ताद् प्रत्यङ् पञ्चाहो भवति निह्नवायैवानार्त्यै शिवत्वाय शान्त्यै . वैश्वानर उदयनीयो ऽतिरात्रो भवति .

sanskrit_iast: athaitat tryahavidhaṃ bhavati . trayo ha vā ṛtavo 'nṛtavo 'nye . grīṣmo varṣā hemanta ete ha vā ṛddhā ṛtava upaśleṣagā ivānye . te ya ṛddhā ṛtavas te na upāptā asann iti . trīṇi vāva chandāṃsi trīṇi savanāni trayaḥ prāṇāpānāvyānās traya ime lokāh . yat kiṃ ca tristris tasyaiṣā sarvasyarddhis tasyopāptiḥ . pañcaite parastāt tryahā bhavanti pañcāvastāt . teno eva pañcāhavidhatāyai na yanti . athaiṣa viśvajit sarvapṛṣṭho 'tirātro bhavati prājāpatyam ahar ahorātre vai kṛtsnaḥ prajāpatiḥ kṛtsnaṃ prajāpatim ṛdhnavāma kṛtsno naḥ prajāpatir upeto 'sad iti . tad āhu śreyāṃsaṃ vā ete 'bhyārohanti ya etaṃ viśvajitam atirātram upayanti . prajāpatiṃ hy eva pratyakṣam upayantīti . tad yat parastād pratyañcaḥ pañca tryahā bhavanti nihnavāyaivānārtyai śivatvāya śāntyai . vaiśvānara udayanīyo 'tirātro bhavati .
sentences: grīṣmo varṣā hemanta ete ha vā r̥ddʰā r̥tava upaśleṣagā ivānye .
te ya r̥ddʰā r̥tavas te na upāptā asann iti .
trīṇi vāva cʰandāṃsi trīṇi savanāni trayaḥ prāṇāpānāvyānās traya ime lokāh .
yat kiṃ ca tristris tasyaiṣā sarvasyarddʰis tasyopāptiḥ .
atʰaiṣa viśvajit sarvapr̥ṣṭʰo 'tirātro bʰavati prājāpatyam ahar ahorātre vai kr̥tsnaḥ prajāpatiḥ kr̥tsnaṃ prajāpatim r̥dʰnavāma kr̥tsno naḥ prajāpatir upeto 'sad iti .
tad āhu śreyāṃsaṃ vā ete 'bʰyārohanti ya etaṃ viśvajitam atirātram upayanti .
tad yat parastād pratyañcaḥ pañca tryahā bʰavanti nihnavāyaivānārtyai śivatvāya śāntyai .
text: Then this is in the tryaha (three-day) form. Three indeed are the true seasons; the others are not true seasons. Summer, the rains, and winter — these are the prosperous seasons; the others are as if clinging to them. 'Let those prosperous seasons be attained by us.' Three indeed are the meters, three the pressings, three the vital breaths — prāṇa, apāna, and vyāna — three are these worlds. Whatever is in groups of three, of all that this is the half and the attainment. Five tryahas are on the far side, five on the near side. Thereby they do not depart from the pañcāha form. Then this viśvajit with all pṛṣṭhas becomes an atirātra — a day belonging to Prajāpati. Day and night together are the complete Prajāpati. 'Let us attain the complete Prajāpati; let the complete Prajāpati be with us.' Therefore they say: 'Those who undertake this viśvajit atirātra ascend to a higher state, for they directly undertake Prajāpati himself.' The five tryahas that follow on the far side serve for concealment, for averting misfortune, for auspiciousness, for peace. The Vaiśvānara is the concluding atirātra.
meaning: अथैतत् त्र्यहविधं भवति . त्रयो ह वा ऋतवो ऽनृतवो ऽन्ये . ग्रीष्मो वर्षा हेमन्त एते ह वा ऋद्धा ऋतव उपश्लेषगा इवान्ये . ते य ऋद्धा ऋतवस् ते न उपाप्ता असन्न् इति . त्रीणि वाव छन्दांसि त्रीणि सवनानि त्रयः प्राणापानाव्यानास् त्रय इमे लोकाह् . यत् किं च त्रिस्त्रिस् तस्यैषा सर्वस्यर्द्धिस् तस्योपाप्तिः . पञ्चैते परस्तात् त्र्यहा भवन्ति पञ्चावस्तात् . तेनो एव पञ्चाहविधतायै न यन्ति . अथैष विश्वजित् सर्वपृष्ठो ऽतिरात्रो भवति प्राजापत्यम् अहर् अहोरात्रे वै कृत्स्नः प्रजापतिः कृत्स्नं प्रजापतिम् ऋध्नवाम कृत्स्नो नः प्रजापतिर् उपेतो ऽसद् इति . तद् आहु श्रेयांसं वा एते ऽभ्यारोहन्ति य एतं विश्वजितम् अतिरात्रम् उपयन्ति . प्रजापतिं ह्य् एव प्रत्यक्षम् उपयन्तीति . तद् यत् परस्ताद् प्रत्यञ्चः पञ्च त्र्यहा भवन्ति निह्नवायैवानार्त्यै शिवत्वाय शान्त्यै . वैश्वानर उदयनीयो ऽतिरात्रो भवति .

sanskrit_iast: trimāsyaṃ vā etat satraṃ tena yarddhis saivarddhiḥ . yau ha khalu vai dvau māsāv ṛtos sarddhiḥ . ṛtur u pratyakṣaṃ saṃvatsarasyarddhiḥ . atha yas tṛtīyo māsas trayodaśasya sa māsasyarddhiḥ . saṃvatsaraṃ vā etad īrtsanti saṃvatsaram īpsanti yad yajante yat satram āsate . na hi kiṃ cana bahis saṃvatsarād asti . svārājyaṃ vā etā rātrayo yad ekānnapañcāśac caturviṃśatiḥ parastād ahāni caturviṃśatir avastāt . caturviṃśatyardhamāsas saṃvatsaraḥ . saṃvatsara evaiṣa ubhayataḥ paryūḍhaḥ . tasya yan madhye ahas sa svarāṭ sa svargo lokaḥ . tad bradhnasya viṣṭapaṃ gacchanti tat svārājyaṃ gacchanti . tad anyasyānanuyānā bhavanti . tā vā etā rātrayas saṃpadyante jagatīm eva . paśavo vai jagatī . tenaitat satraṃ paśavyam upo virājaṃ gacchanti . tad u virājo 'nnādyasyaiśvaryam ādhipatyaṃ gacchanti . ekonā virāḍ ūnaṃ tat striyai yatas sā prajāyate teno prajananam . gāyatrīm u dīkṣopasadbhiś ca sutyābhiś ca saṃpadyante . prāṇo vai gāyatrī tenaitat satram āyuṣyam . tejo vai gāyatrī tat tejasvino brahmavarcasino bhavanti .
sentences: trimāsyaṃ vā etat satraṃ tena yarddʰis saivarddʰiḥ .
yau ha kʰalu vai dvau māsāv r̥tos sarddʰiḥ .
atʰa yas tr̥tīyo māsas trayodaśasya sa māsasyarddʰiḥ .
saṃvatsaraṃ vā etad īrtsanti saṃvatsaram īpsanti yad yajante yat satram āsate .
na hi kiṃ cana bahis saṃvatsarād asti .
svārājyaṃ vā etā rātrayo yad ekānnapañcāśac caturviṃśatiḥ parastād ahāni caturviṃśatir avastāt .
tasya yan madʰye ahas sa svarāṭ sa svargo lokaḥ .
tad bradʰnasya viṣṭapaṃ gaccʰanti tat svārājyaṃ gaccʰanti .
tā vā etā rātrayas saṃpadyante jagatīm eva .
tenaitat satraṃ paśavyam upo virājaṃ gaccʰanti .
ekonā virāḍ ūnaṃ tat striyai yatas sā prajāyate teno prajananam .
gāyatrīm u dīkṣopasadbʰiś ca sutyābʰiś ca saṃpadyante .
prāṇo vai gāyatrī tenaitat satram āyuṣyam .
tejo vai gāyatrī tat tejasvino brahmavarcasino bʰavanti .
text: This sattra is of three months' duration. Whatever prosperity is attained by it, that is the prosperity. The two months that constitute a season are indeed half. And a season is manifestly half of the year. And the third month is the half of the thirteenth month. It is the year that they seek to reach, the year that they desire, when they sacrifice, when they sit in a sattra — for nothing exists outside the year. These nights, forty-nine in number, are sovereignty — twenty-four days on the far side, twenty-four on the near side. Twenty-four half-months make the year. The year is thus encompassed on both sides. The day that is in the middle — that is the sovereign ruler, that is the heavenly world. They reach the seat of Bradhna; they reach sovereignty. Thereby they become such that none other follows after them. These nights equal the jagatī meter. Cattle are the jagatī. Therefore this sattra is rich in cattle. They approach the virāj. Thereby they attain the lordship and supremacy of the annādya of virāj. The virāj is one less — that is the deficiency of the woman, from which she gives birth; thereby there is procreation. And through the dīkṣā, upasads, and pressing days, they equal the gāyatrī. The gāyatrī is the vital breath; therefore this sattra bestows long life. The gāyatrī is splendor; therefore they become radiant and possessed of brahmic luster.
meaning: त्रिमास्यं वा एतत् सत्रं तेन यर्द्धिस् सैवर्द्धिः . यौ ह खलु वै द्वौ मासाव् ऋतोस् सर्द्धिः . ऋतुर् उ प्रत्यक्षं संवत्सरस्यर्द्धिः . अथ यस् तृतीयो मासस् त्रयोदशस्य स मासस्यर्द्धिः . संवत्सरं वा एतद् ईर्त्सन्ति संवत्सरम् ईप्सन्ति यद् यजन्ते यत् सत्रम् आसते . न हि किं चन बहिस् संवत्सराद् अस्ति . स्वाराज्यं वा एता रात्रयो यद् एकान्नपञ्चाशच् चतुर्विंशतिः परस्ताद् अहानि चतुर्विंशतिर् अवस्तात् . चतुर्विंशत्यर्धमासस् संवत्सरः . संवत्सर एवैष उभयतः पर्यूढः . तस्य यन् मध्ये अहस् स स्वराट् स स्वर्गो लोकः . तद् ब्रध्नस्य विष्टपं गच्छन्ति तत् स्वाराज्यं गच्छन्ति . तद् अन्यस्याननुयाना भवन्ति . ता वा एता रात्रयस् संपद्यन्ते जगतीम् एव . पशवो वै जगती . तेनैतत् सत्रं पशव्यम् उपो विराजं गच्छन्ति . तद् उ विराजो ऽन्नाद्यस्यैश्वर्यम् आधिपत्यं गच्छन्ति . एकोना विराड् ऊनं तत् स्त्रियै यतस् सा प्रजायते तेनो प्रजननम् . गायत्रीम् उ दीक्षोपसद्भिश् च सुत्याभिश् च संपद्यन्ते . प्राणो वै गायत्री तेनैतत् सत्रम् आयुष्यम् . तेजो वै गायत्री तत् तेजस्विनो ब्रह्मवर्चसिनो भवन्ति .

sanskrit_iast: ādityāś ca vā aṅgirasaś ca svarge loke 'spardhanta . ta ādityā akāmayanta vayaṃ pūrve svargaṃ lokaṃ gacchemeti . ta etad ayanam apaśyan . tad upāyan . tato vā ādityāḥ pūrve svargaṃ lokam agacchann ahīyantāṅgirasaḥ . sā ha khalu vai śreṣṭharddhīnāṃ sa lokānāṃ puṇyatamo yam etenādityā agacchan . sā yā śreṣṭharddhīnāṃ yo lokānāṃ puṇyatamo yam etenādityā agacchaṃs taṃ gacchāmeti tasmād etā rātrīr upayanti . vaiśvānaraḥ prāyaṇīyo 'tirātro bhavati .
sentences: ādityāś ca vā aṅgirasaś ca svarge loke 'spardʰanta .
ta ādityā akāmayanta vayaṃ pūrve svargaṃ lokaṃ gaccʰemeti .
tato vā ādityāḥ pūrve svargaṃ lokam agaccʰann ahīyantāṅgirasaḥ .
sā ha kʰalu vai śreṣṭʰarddʰīnāṃ sa lokānāṃ puṇyatamo yam etenādityā agaccʰan .
sā yā śreṣṭʰarddʰīnāṃ yo lokānāṃ puṇyatamo yam etenādityā agaccʰaṃs taṃ gaccʰāmeti tasmād etā rātrīr upayanti .
text: The Ādityas and the Aṅgirasas competed in the heavenly world. The Ādityas desired: 'Let us go first to the heavenly world.' They beheld this course (ayana). They undertook it. Thereupon the Ādityas went first to the heavenly world; the Aṅgirasas were left behind. That which is the most meritorious among the worlds of highest prosperity, which the Ādityas reached by this — 'Let us reach that most meritorious among the worlds of highest prosperity which the Ādityas reached by this' — therefore they undertake these nights. The Vaiśvānara is the opening atirātra.
meaning: आदित्याश् च वा अङ्गिरसश् च स्वर्गे लोके ऽस्पर्धन्त . त आदित्या अकामयन्त वयं पूर्वे स्वर्गं लोकं गच्छेमेति . त एतद् अयनम् अपश्यन् . तद् उपायन् . ततो वा आदित्याः पूर्वे स्वर्गं लोकम् अगच्छन्न् अहीयन्ताङ्गिरसः . सा ह खलु वै श्रेष्ठर्द्धीनां स लोकानां पुण्यतमो यम् एतेनादित्या अगच्छन् . सा या श्रेष्ठर्द्धीनां यो लोकानां पुण्यतमो यम् एतेनादित्या अगच्छंस् तं गच्छामेति तस्माद् एता रात्रीर् उपयन्ति . वैश्वानरः प्रायणीयो ऽतिरात्रो भवति .

sanskrit_iast: athaite jyotir gaur āyur iti stomā bhavanti . ete ha vai śivāś śāntāḥ pathyā stomā ye jyotir gaur āyur iti . te ye śivāś śāntāḥ pathyā stomās tair na stutam asad iti . ta u virājaṃ saṃpannāḥ . tad u virājam annādyam ārabhante . bṛhadrathantare sāmanī bhavataḥ . sā hy ṛddhis sa panthāḥ . śyaitanaudhase brahmasāmanī bhavataḥ . praspaṣṭam ājim anu śūkaravāmeti . athaite ṣaḍ atirātrā bhavanti . ṣaḍ vai puruṣe pāpmānaṣ ṣaḍ viṣuvanta svapnaś ca tandrī ca manyuś cāśanayā cākṣakāmyā ca strīkāmyā ca . tān evaitair apaghnate tān atitaranti . athaite trayas tryahā bhavanti . navāhāni . nava vai puruṣe prāṇāḥ . prāṇānām evaiṣā saṃmā prāṇānām ṛddhiḥ . athaitad vairājapṛṣṭhaṃ daśamam ahar bhavati . nābhir ha sā tad vā etad ākṣit sad ahar eteṣv ahassu niyuktam . yasmād etad ākṣit sad ahar eteṣv ahassu niyuktaṃ tasmād ākṣit satī nābhiḥ prāṇesu niyuktā . prāṇato hy enām anūdanity apānato 'nvapāniti . tad eteṣām ahnāṃ daśamaṃ bhavati daśākṣarā virāṭ .
sentences: atʰaite jyotir gaur āyur iti stomā bʰavanti .
ete ha vai śivāś śāntāḥ patʰyā stomā ye jyotir gaur āyur iti .
te ye śivāś śāntāḥ patʰyā stomās tair na stutam asad iti .
ṣaḍ vai puruṣe pāpmānaṣ ṣaḍ viṣuvanta svapnaś ca tandrī ca manyuś cāśanayā cākṣakāmyā ca strīkāmyā ca .
nābʰir ha sā tad vā etad ākṣit sad ahar eteṣv ahassu niyuktam .
yasmād etad ākṣit sad ahar eteṣv ahassu niyuktaṃ tasmād ākṣit satī nābʰiḥ prāṇesu niyuktā .
tad eteṣām ahnāṃ daśamaṃ bʰavati daśākṣarā virāṭ .
text: Then these stomas become jyotis, gaus, and āyus. These stomas that are jyotis, gaus, and āyus are indeed auspicious, peaceful, and salutary. 'Let it not be that we have praised with stomas that are not auspicious, peaceful, and salutary.' And they are equal to the virāj. Thereby they lay hold of the annādya of virāj. The bṛhat and rathantara become the sāmans. For that is the prosperity, that is the path. The śyaita and naudhas become the brahma-sāmans. 'We pursue the race along a clearly visible course.' Then there are six atirātras. Six are the evils (pāpmans) in a person, six are like viṣuvantas: sleep and drowsiness, anger and hunger, desire for gambling and desire for women. By these they strike them down, they transcend them. Then there are three tryahas — nine days. Nine are the vital breaths in a person. This is the measure of the vital breaths, the prosperity of the vital breaths. Then the tenth day is the one with the vairāja pṛṣṭha. That is the navel. This day, being the axis (ākṣit), is yoked among these days. Just as the navel, being the axis, is yoked among the vital breaths — for from breathing it breathes along (anūdana), from breathing out it breathes along (anvapāna). That becomes the tenth of these days. The virāj has ten syllables.
meaning: अथैते ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुर् इति स्तोमा भवन्ति . एते ह वै शिवाश् शान्ताः पथ्या स्तोमा ये ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुर् इति . ते ये शिवाश् शान्ताः पथ्या स्तोमास् तैर् न स्तुतम् असद् इति . त उ विराजं संपन्नाः . तद् उ विराजम् अन्नाद्यम् आरभन्ते . बृहद्रथन्तरे सामनी भवतः . सा ह्य् ऋद्धिस् स पन्थाः . श्यैतनौधसे ब्रह्मसामनी भवतः . प्रस्पष्टम् आजिम् अनु शूकरवामेति . अथैते षड् अतिरात्रा भवन्ति . षड् वै पुरुषे पाप्मानष् षड् विषुवन्त स्वप्नश् च तन्द्री च मन्युश् चाशनया चाक्षकाम्या च स्त्रीकाम्या च . तान् एवैतैर् अपघ्नते तान् अतितरन्ति . अथैते त्रयस् त्र्यहा भवन्ति . नवाहानि . नव वै पुरुषे प्राणाः . प्राणानाम् एवैषा संमा प्राणानाम् ऋद्धिः . अथैतद् वैराजपृष्ठं दशमम् अहर् भवति . नाभिर् ह सा तद् वा एतद् आक्षित् सद् अहर् एतेष्व् अहस्सु नियुक्तम् . यस्माद् एतद् आक्षित् सद् अहर् एतेष्व् अहस्सु नियुक्तं तस्माद् आक्षित् सती नाभिः प्राणेसु नियुक्ता . प्राणतो ह्य् एनाम् अनूदनित्य् अपानतो ऽन्वपानिति . तद् एतेषाम् अह्नां दशमं भवति दशाक्षरा विराट् .

sanskrit_iast: tad vairājapṛṣṭhaṃ bhavaty annaṃ vai vairājam annādyasyaivāvaruddhyai . tad ukthyaṃ bhavati paśavo vā ukthāny annaṃ paśavo 'bhipūrvasyaivānnādyasyāvaruddhyai . tat ṣoḍaśimad bhavati vajro vai ṣoḍaśy annaṃ virāḍ vajreṇaivānnādyaṃ parigṛhṇanti . tad ekaviṃśaṃ bhavati dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavas traya ime lokā asāv āditya ekaviṃśaḥ . etad vai daivyaṃ kṣatram . kṣatriya u vā annādyasya pradātā . sa yo 'nnādyasya pradātā sa no 'nnādyaṃ prayacchād iti . athaite catvāras triyahā bhavanti dvādaśāhāni . dvādaśa vai saṃvatsarasya paurṇamāsyaḥ . paurṇamāsīnām evaiṣā saṃmā paurṇamāsīnām ṛddhiḥ . athaiṣa pṛṣṭhyaṣ ṣaḍaho bhavati . śrīr vai pṛṣṭhāni varṣma vai pṛṣṭhāni . tac chriyaṃ varṣma pṛṣṭhāni rohanti . tad u satriṇo bhavanti . athaite catvāra uttare tryahā bhavanti dvādaśo evāhāni . dvādaśa vai saṃvatsarasyāmāvāsyāḥ . amāvāsyānām evaiṣā saṃmāmāvāsyānām ṛddhiḥ . dvādaśaitāni parastāt pṛṣṭhyasya ṣaḍahasyāhāni bhavanti dvādaśāvastāt . tasmāt samāvatīs saṃvatsarasya paurṇamāsyaś cāmāvāsyāś ca . vaiśvanara udayanīyo 'tirātro bhavati .
sentences: tad vairājapr̥ṣṭʰaṃ bʰavaty annaṃ vai vairājam annādyasyaivāvaruddʰyai .
tad uktʰyaṃ bʰavati paśavo vā uktʰāny annaṃ paśavo 'bʰipūrvasyaivānnādyasyāvaruddʰyai .
tat ṣoḍaśimad bʰavati vajro vai ṣoḍaśy annaṃ virāḍ vajreṇaivānnādyaṃ parigr̥hṇanti .
tad ekaviṃśaṃ bʰavati dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavas traya ime lokā asāv āditya ekaviṃśaḥ .
sa yo 'nnādyasya pradātā sa no 'nnādyaṃ prayaccʰād iti .
śrīr vai pr̥ṣṭʰāni varṣma vai pr̥ṣṭʰāni .
atʰaite catvāra uttare tryahā bʰavanti dvādaśo evāhāni .
dvādaśaitāni parastāt pr̥ṣṭʰyasya ṣaḍahasyāhāni bʰavanti dvādaśāvastāt .
tasmāt samāvatīs saṃvatsarasya paurṇamāsyaś cāmāvāsyāś ca .
text: That day has the vairāja pṛṣṭha — for the securing of food (annādya), for the vairāja is food. It is an ukthya — for cattle are the ukthyas; food is cattle — for the securing of food from the beginning. It has a ṣoḍaśī — for the ṣoḍaśī is the thunderbolt (vajra), and food is the virāj; by the thunderbolt they grasp the food. It is ekaviṃśa (twenty-one-fold): twelve months, five seasons, three worlds, and yonder sun — the twenty-first. This is the divine ruling power (kṣatra). The kṣatriya is the giver of food. 'May he who is the giver of food bestow food upon us.' Then there are four tryahas — twelve days. Twelve are the full-moon days of the year. This is the measure of the full-moon days, the prosperity of the full-moon days. Then there is a pṛṣṭhya ṣaḍaha. The pṛṣṭhas are prosperity (śrī); the pṛṣṭhas are eminence (varṣman). Thereby they ascend to the prosperity and eminence of the pṛṣṭhas. And they become sattrins. Then there are four further tryahas — twelve days again. Twelve are the new-moon days of the year. This is the measure of the new-moon days, the prosperity of the new-moon days. Twelve days are on the far side of the pṛṣṭhya ṣaḍaha, twelve on the near side. Therefore the full-moon and new-moon days of the year are equal. The Vaiśvānara is the concluding atirātra.
meaning: तद् वैराजपृष्ठं भवत्य् अन्नं वै वैराजम् अन्नाद्यस्यैवावरुद्ध्यै . तद् उक्थ्यं भवति पशवो वा उक्थान्य् अन्नं पशवो ऽभिपूर्वस्यैवान्नाद्यस्यावरुद्ध्यै . तत् षोडशिमद् भवति वज्रो वै षोडश्य् अन्नं विराड् वज्रेणैवान्नाद्यं परिगृह्णन्ति . तद् एकविंशं भवति द्वादश मासाः पञ्चर्तवस् त्रय इमे लोका असाव् आदित्य एकविंशः . एतद् वै दैव्यं क्षत्रम् . क्षत्रिय उ वा अन्नाद्यस्य प्रदाता . स यो ऽन्नाद्यस्य प्रदाता स नो ऽन्नाद्यं प्रयच्छाद् इति . अथैते चत्वारस् त्रियहा भवन्ति द्वादशाहानि . द्वादश वै संवत्सरस्य पौर्णमास्यः . पौर्णमासीनाम् एवैषा संमा पौर्णमासीनाम् ऋद्धिः . अथैष पृष्ठ्यष् षडहो भवति . श्रीर् वै पृष्ठानि वर्ष्म वै पृष्ठानि . तच् छ्रियं वर्ष्म पृष्ठानि रोहन्ति . तद् उ सत्रिणो भवन्ति . अथैते चत्वार उत्तरे त्र्यहा भवन्ति द्वादशो एवाहानि . द्वादश वै संवत्सरस्यामावास्याः . अमावास्यानाम् एवैषा संमामावास्यानाम् ऋद्धिः . द्वादशैतानि परस्तात् पृष्ठ्यस्य षडहस्याहानि भवन्ति द्वादशावस्तात् . तस्मात् समावतीस् संवत्सरस्य पौर्णमास्यश् चामावास्याश् च . वैश्वनर उदयनीयो ऽतिरात्रो भवति .

sanskrit_iast: ādityāś ca vā aṅgirasaś ca svarge loke 'spardhanta . ta ādityāḥ pūrve svargaṃ lokam agacchan . te 'ṅgiraso 'kāmayanta vayam api taṃ lokaṃ gacchema yam ādityā agmann iti . te yena yenaivāyanenāyaṃs tatastata enān praty apānudanta . tān ha paraś catvāriṃśāni varṣāṇi praty eva nunudire . ta etad ayanam apaśyan . tad evāsīdan . yathāvidham iva tad upāyan . tato vā aṅgirasas taṃ lokam agacchan yam ādityāḥ . sā ha khalu vai śreṣṭharddhīnāṃ sa lokānāṃ puṇyatamo yam etenāṅgiraso 'gacchan .
sentences: ādityāś ca vā aṅgirasaś ca svarge loke 'spardʰanta .
ta ādityāḥ pūrve svargaṃ lokam agaccʰan .
te 'ṅgiraso 'kāmayanta vayam api taṃ lokaṃ gaccʰema yam ādityā agmann iti .
te yena yenaivāyanenāyaṃs tatastata enān praty apānudanta .
tān ha paraś catvāriṃśāni varṣāṇi praty eva nunudire .
tato vā aṅgirasas taṃ lokam agaccʰan yam ādityāḥ .
sā ha kʰalu vai śreṣṭʰarddʰīnāṃ sa lokānāṃ puṇyatamo yam etenāṅgiraso 'gaccʰan .
text: The Ādityas and the Aṅgirasas competed in the heavenly world. The Ādityas went first to the heavenly world. The Aṅgirasas desired: 'Let us too go to that world which the Ādityas reached.' By whatever course they went, from there they were pushed back. For more than forty years they were pushed back. They beheld this course. They sat down to it. They undertook it just as prescribed. Thereupon the Aṅgirasas reached that world which the Ādityas had reached. That which is the most meritorious among the worlds of highest prosperity, which the Aṅgirasas reached by this —
meaning: आदित्याश् च वा अङ्गिरसश् च स्वर्गे लोके ऽस्पर्धन्त . त आदित्याः पूर्वे स्वर्गं लोकम् अगच्छन् . ते ऽङ्गिरसो ऽकामयन्त वयम् अपि तं लोकं गच्छेम यम् आदित्या अग्मन्न् इति . ते येन येनैवायनेनायंस् ततस्तत एनान् प्रत्य् अपानुदन्त . तान् ह परश् चत्वारिंशानि वर्षाणि प्रत्य् एव नुनुदिरे . त एतद् अयनम् अपश्यन् . तद् एवासीदन् . यथाविधम् इव तद् उपायन् . ततो वा अङ्गिरसस् तं लोकम् अगच्छन् यम् आदित्याः . सा ह खलु वै श्रेष्ठर्द्धीनां स लोकानां पुण्यतमो यम् एतेनाङ्गिरसो ऽगच्छन् .

sanskrit_iast: tad ye ha vā eta ādityasyodañco raśmayas ta ādityā ye dakṣiṇās te 'ṅgirasaḥ . te haita ādityāś cāṅgirasaś ca salokāḥ . saloko ha vā ādityaiś cāṅgirobhiś ca bhavati ya evaṃ veda . athaitau dvau tryahau bhavataṣ ṣaḍ ahāni . ṣaḍ vā ṛtavaḥ . ṛtuṣv eva tat pratitiṣṭhanti . athaitau dvāv uttarau tryahau bhavataṣ ṣaḍ u evāhāni . abhipūrvam eva tad ṛtuṣu pratitiṣṭhanti . athaite ṣaḍ atirātrā bhavanty uktabrāhmaṇāḥ . athaite trayas tryahā bhavanty uktabrāhmaṇāḥ . athaite catvāras tryahā bhavanti dvādaśāhāni . dvādaśa māsās saṃvatsaraḥ .
sentences: tad ye ha vā eta ādityasyodañco raśmayas ta ādityā ye dakṣiṇās te 'ṅgirasaḥ .
te haita ādityāś cāṅgirasaś ca salokāḥ .
saloko ha vā ādityaiś cāṅgirobʰiś ca bʰavati ya evaṃ veda .
atʰaitau dvau tryahau bʰavataṣ ṣaḍ ahāni .
atʰaitau dvāv uttarau tryahau bʰavataṣ ṣaḍ u evāhāni .
text: Now those rays of the sun that go northward are the Ādityas; those that go southward are the Aṅgirasas. These Ādityas and Aṅgirasas share the same world. He who knows thus shares the same world with the Ādityas and the Aṅgirasas. Then there are two tryahas — six days. Six are the seasons. Thereby they become established in the seasons. Then there are two further tryahas — six days again. Thereby they become established in the seasons from the beginning. Then there are six atirātras, whose brāhmaṇa explanation has been stated. Then there are three tryahas, whose brāhmaṇa explanation has been stated. Then there are four tryahas — twelve days. Twelve months make the year.
meaning: तद् ये ह वा एत आदित्यस्योदञ्चो रश्मयस् त आदित्या ये दक्षिणास् ते ऽङ्गिरसः . ते हैत आदित्याश् चाङ्गिरसश् च सलोकाः . सलोको ह वा आदित्यैश् चाङ्गिरोभिश् च भवति य एवं वेद . अथैतौ द्वौ त्र्यहौ भवतष् षड् अहानि . षड् वा ऋतवः . ऋतुष्व् एव तत् प्रतितिष्ठन्ति . अथैतौ द्वाव् उत्तरौ त्र्यहौ भवतष् षड् उ एवाहानि . अभिपूर्वम् एव तद् ऋतुषु प्रतितिष्ठन्ति . अथैते षड् अतिरात्रा भवन्त्य् उक्तब्राह्मणाः . अथैते त्रयस् त्र्यहा भवन्त्य् उक्तब्राह्मणाः . अथैते चत्वारस् त्र्यहा भवन्ति द्वादशाहानि . द्वादश मासास् संवत्सरः .

sanskrit_iast: athaitā dvādaśāhavatīr bhavanti yaivāsau dvādaśāhavatīnāṃ praśaṃsā sā na upāptāsad iti . athaitāni caturuttarāṇi chandāṃsy upayanti . caturuttarā vai vāco rohāḥ . vācam evaite rohanti . atho catuṣpadā vai paśavaḥ . tad yad etāni caturuttarāṇi chandāṃsy upayanti catuṣpadām eva paśūnām avaruddhyai . athaitāni athaitāni dviyantarāṇy upāharanti . caturuttarāṇi dviyantarāṇi . na ha vai tāvac chriyam aśnute yāvad dvipadāṃ catuṣpadāṃ paśūnām aiśvaryam ādhipatyaṃ na gacchati . tad yad etāni dviyantarāṇy upāharanti caturuttaradviyantarāṇi dvipadāṃ catuṣpadāṃ paśūnām aiśvaryam ādhipatyaṃ gacchāmeti . athaitāny aṣṭāntarāṇy upāharanti caturuttaradviyantarāṇi sarvāṇi catasro diśaś catvāro 'vāntaradeśā diśāṃ sa upariṣṭāl loko yaḥ puṇyas sarvāsu dikṣu pratiṣṭhāya svargaṃ lokaṃ gacchāmeti . athaitāni pañca sandhiṣāmāni bhavanti rathantaraṃ jarābodhīyaṃ śrudhīyaṃ nānadagaurivīte iti .
sentences: atʰaitā dvādaśāhavatīr bʰavanti yaivāsau dvādaśāhavatīnāṃ praśaṃsā sā na upāptāsad iti .
tad yad etāni caturuttarāṇi cʰandāṃsy upayanti catuṣpadām eva paśūnām avaruddʰyai .
na ha vai tāvac cʰriyam aśnute yāvad dvipadāṃ catuṣpadāṃ paśūnām aiśvaryam ādʰipatyaṃ na gaccʰati .
tad yad etāni dviyantarāṇy upāharanti caturuttaradviyantarāṇi dvipadāṃ catuṣpadāṃ paśūnām aiśvaryam ādʰipatyaṃ gaccʰāmeti .
atʰaitāny aṣṭāntarāṇy upāharanti caturuttaradviyantarāṇi sarvāṇi catasro diśaś catvāro 'vāntaradeśā diśāṃ sa upariṣṭāl loko yaḥ puṇyas sarvāsu dikṣu pratiṣṭʰāya svargaṃ lokaṃ gaccʰāmeti .
atʰaitāni pañca sandʰiṣāmāni bʰavanti ratʰantaraṃ jarābodʰīyaṃ śrudʰīyaṃ nānadagaurivīte iti .
text: Then there are twelve-day periods (dvādaśāhavatīs). 'Let the very praise that belongs to the dvādaśāhavatīs be attained by us.' Then they undertake meters that increase by four (caturuttara). The growths of speech increase by four. Thereby they ascend to speech. And four-footed are the cattle. By undertaking these meters that increase by four, it is for the securing of four-footed cattle. Then they introduce meters with intervals of two (dviyantara) — increasing by four, with intervals of two. One does not attain full prosperity until one reaches the lordship and supremacy over two-footed and four-footed cattle. By introducing these dviyantara meters — caturuttara-dviyantara — 'Let us attain the lordship and supremacy over two-footed and four-footed cattle.' Then they introduce meters with intervals of eight (aṣṭāntara) — caturuttara-dviyantara, all of them: four directions, four intermediate directions, and the blessed world above the directions — 'Having established ourselves in all directions, let us go to the heavenly world.' Then there are five junction-sāmans (sandhiṣāmāni): rathantara, jarābodhīya, śrudhīya, nānada, and gaurivīta.
meaning: अथैता द्वादशाहवतीर् भवन्ति यैवासौ द्वादशाहवतीनां प्रशंसा सा न उपाप्तासद् इति . अथैतानि चतुरुत्तराणि छन्दांस्य् उपयन्ति . चतुरुत्तरा वै वाचो रोहाः . वाचम् एवैते रोहन्ति . अथो चतुष्पदा वै पशवः . तद् यद् एतानि चतुरुत्तराणि छन्दांस्य् उपयन्ति चतुष्पदाम् एव पशूनाम् अवरुद्ध्यै . अथैतानि अथैतानि द्वियन्तराण्य् उपाहरन्ति . चतुरुत्तराणि द्वियन्तराणि . न ह वै तावच् छ्रियम् अश्नुते यावद् द्विपदां चतुष्पदां पशूनाम् ऐश्वर्यम् आधिपत्यं न गच्छति . तद् यद् एतानि द्वियन्तराण्य् उपाहरन्ति चतुरुत्तरद्वियन्तराणि द्विपदां चतुष्पदां पशूनाम् ऐश्वर्यम् आधिपत्यं गच्छामेति . अथैतान्य् अष्टान्तराण्य् उपाहरन्ति चतुरुत्तरद्वियन्तराणि सर्वाणि चतस्रो दिशश् चत्वारो ऽवान्तरदेशा दिशां स उपरिष्टाल् लोको यः पुण्यस् सर्वासु दिक्षु प्रतिष्ठाय स्वर्गं लोकं गच्छामेति . अथैतानि पञ्च सन्धिषामानि भवन्ति रथन्तरं जराबोधीयं श्रुधीयं नानदगौरिवीते इति .

sanskrit_iast: - sandhiṣāma tena na stutam asad iti . atho vāg vai rathantaraṃ vāg āśvinaṃ vāg vai vācaṃ prati vibhavitum arhatīyaṃ vāg vācaṃ prati vibhavād iti . etad u ha vai dvitīyaṃ prajñātaṃ sandhiṣāma yaj jarābodhīyam . tad yad dvitīyaṃ prajñātaṃ sandhiṣāma tena na stutam asad iti . atha śrudhīyaṃ kīrtimat . sāmavṛktir u sandhiṣāmanī . tad yad ābhyāṃ sandhiṣāmabhyām avṛkṣmahi tan no 'sya lokavatas sāmnaḥ paśavo lokam anūpatiṣṭhāntā iti . atha nānadagaurivīte lokavatī sāmanī bhūyāṃsaṃ no lokam anūpatiṣṭhāntā iti . tad āhus trir evāśvinaṃ śastavyam iti triṣatyā vai vāk . traya ime lokāḥ . yad atirātre 'tirātra āśvinaṃ śaṃsed vikarṣas sa vācaḥ . hotāraṃ brūyād āśvinakratūn evānyeṣv atirātreṣv śaṃsa trir evāśvinaṃ śastavyam iti prāyaṇato madhyata udayanataḥ . etad dha vai samṛddham āśvinaṃ yad rathantareṇa saṃpadyate .
sentences: - sandʰiṣāma tena na stutam asad iti .
atʰo vāg vai ratʰantaraṃ vāg āśvinaṃ vāg vai vācaṃ prati vibʰavitum arhatīyaṃ vāg vācaṃ prati vibʰavād iti .
etad u ha vai dvitīyaṃ prajñātaṃ sandʰiṣāma yaj jarābodʰīyam .
tad yad dvitīyaṃ prajñātaṃ sandʰiṣāma tena na stutam asad iti .
tad yad ābʰyāṃ sandʰiṣāmabʰyām avr̥kṣmahi tan no 'sya lokavatas sāmnaḥ paśavo lokam anūpatiṣṭʰāntā iti .
atʰa nānadagaurivīte lokavatī sāmanī bʰūyāṃsaṃ no lokam anūpatiṣṭʰāntā iti .
tad āhus trir evāśvinaṃ śastavyam iti triṣatyā vai vāk .
yad atirātre 'tirātra āśvinaṃ śaṃsed vikarṣas sa vācaḥ .
hotāraṃ brūyād āśvinakratūn evānyeṣv atirātreṣv śaṃsa trir evāśvinaṃ śastavyam iti prāyaṇato madʰyata udayanataḥ .
etad dʰa vai samr̥ddʰam āśvinaṃ yad ratʰantareṇa saṃpadyate .
text: The sandhisama -- by that it would not have been chanted, they say. Moreover, speech (vac) is the rathantara, speech is the asvina, speech alone is able to pervade speech in return -- 'this speech pervades speech in return,' they say. This indeed is the second recognized sandhisama, namely the jarabodhiya. Since it is the second recognized sandhisama, by that it would not have been chanted, they say. Now the srudhiya is renowned. The samavrkti and the sandhisaman-songs [belong together]. Since we have plucked with these two sandhisaman-songs, 'may our cattle follow us to the world of the world-possessing saman,' they say. Now the nanadagaurivita songs are world-possessing saman-songs: 'may they follow us to a greater world,' they say. They say the asvina should be recited three times only. For speech consists of three hundred [syllables]. These are three worlds. If at an atiratra within an atiratra one were to recite the asvina, that would be a disruption of speech. One should instruct the hotr: 'Recite the asvina-kratus at other atiratras only; the asvina should be recited three times only' -- at the beginning, in the middle, and at the end. This indeed is the complete asvina -- that which corresponds with the rathantara.
meaning: - सन्धिषाम तेन न स्तुतम् असद् इति . अथो वाग् वै रथन्तरं वाग् आश्विनं वाग् वै वाचं प्रति विभवितुम् अर्हतीयं वाग् वाचं प्रति विभवाद् इति . एतद् उ ह वै द्वितीयं प्रज्ञातं सन्धिषाम यज् जराबोधीयम् . तद् यद् द्वितीयं प्रज्ञातं सन्धिषाम तेन न स्तुतम् असद् इति . अथ श्रुधीयं कीर्तिमत् . सामवृक्तिर् उ सन्धिषामनी . तद् यद् आभ्यां सन्धिषामभ्याम् अवृक्ष्महि तन् नो ऽस्य लोकवतस् साम्नः पशवो लोकम् अनूपतिष्ठान्ता इति . अथ नानदगौरिवीते लोकवती सामनी भूयांसं नो लोकम् अनूपतिष्ठान्ता इति . तद् आहुस् त्रिर् एवाश्विनं शस्तव्यम् इति त्रिषत्या वै वाक् . त्रय इमे लोकाः . यद् अतिरात्रे ऽतिरात्र आश्विनं शंसेद् विकर्षस् स वाचः . होतारं ब्रूयाद् आश्विनक्रतून् एवान्येष्व् अतिरात्रेष्व् शंस त्रिर् एवाश्विनं शस्तव्यम् इति प्रायणतो मध्यत उदयनतः . एतद् ध वै समृद्धम् आश्विनं यद् रथन्तरेण संपद्यते .

sanskrit_iast: athaitā eṇya ekakṛṣṇāḥ . eṇyo ha vai nāmaitā rātrayaḥ . tāsu kṛṣṇo 'pi mithunatvāya prajananāya . pra mithunena jāyate ya evaṃ veda . taṃ vā tvai purastād upeyus taṃ vopariṣṭāt . yadi purastād upeyuḥ puṃspraṇetrā asann iti . yady upariṣṭāt paścād vai pumān yoṣāyāṃ reto dadhāti retodheyāya . prajāpatir vāvedam agra eko 'sṛjyata nānyaṃ dvitīyaṃ paśyamānaḥ . sa aikṣatāhaṃ vāva prathamo 'janiṣy ahaṃ śreṣṭho 'smy asti svin mad ihānyā3 iti . sa vyaikṣata . so 'nyad ātmano 'dhy uttarato jyāyas tiṣṭhad apśyat . tad apṛcchat kim idam asi yad idam asīti . brahma vā asmīty abravīt . tad abravīt āvaṃ vāva prathamāv ajaniṣvahy āvaṃ śreṣṭhau svas saṃsṛjāvahai sahāsāveti . nety abravīt . pāpmagṛhīto vā asīti . sa me kva sa pāpmeti . eṣa te śīrṣann iti . taṃ vai me 'vajahīti . tatheti . tam avāhan . taṃ grīvāsv asināt . taṃ samapīḍayat . tad etat parigṛhītakam ivāvajahīti . tam avāhan . taṃ nīvyām asināt . taṃ samapīḍayat . tad etat parigṛhītakam ivāvajahīti . tam avāhan . taṃ kulphayor asināt . taṃ samapīḍayat . tad etat parigṛhītakam ivāvaiva jahīti . tam avāhan . padābhitiṣṭheti .
sentences: pra mitʰunena jāyate ya evaṃ veda .
taṃ vā tvai purastād upeyus taṃ vopariṣṭāt .
yadi purastād upeyuḥ puṃspraṇetrā asann iti .
yady upariṣṭāt paścād vai pumān yoṣāyāṃ reto dadʰāti retodʰeyāya .
prajāpatir vāvedam agra eko 'sr̥jyata nānyaṃ dvitīyaṃ paśyamānaḥ .
sa aikṣatāhaṃ vāva pratʰamo 'janiṣy ahaṃ śreṣṭʰo 'smy asti svin mad ihānyā3 iti .
so 'nyad ātmano 'dʰy uttarato jyāyas tiṣṭʰad apśyat .
tad apr̥ccʰat kim idam asi yad idam asīti .
tad abravīt āvaṃ vāva pratʰamāv ajaniṣvahy āvaṃ śreṣṭʰau svas saṃsr̥jāvahai sahāsāveti .
text: Now these are the enya [nights], the single black ones. These nights are indeed called enya. In them is the black one for the sake of pairing, for procreation. He who knows thus is born forth through pairing. They approached him from the front and from above. If they approached from the front, they would be led by a male, they say. If from above -- for from behind a male deposits seed in the female, for the depositing of seed. Prajapati indeed was at first created alone in this [world], seeing no other second. He considered: 'I indeed was born first; I am the best. Is there anyone else here besides me?' He looked about. He saw something standing above him to the north, greater than himself. He asked it: 'What are you, that you are this?' 'I am brahman,' it said. It said: 'We two indeed were born first; we two are the best. Let us unite together.' 'No,' it said. 'You are seized by evil (papman).' 'Where then is that evil of mine?' 'It is in your head.' 'Remove it from me.' 'So be it.' It removed it. It placed it on the neck. It pressed it together. That was like something gripped: 'Remove it.' It removed it. It placed it at the waist. It pressed it together. That was like something gripped: 'Remove it completely.' It removed it. It placed it at the ankles. It pressed it together. That was like something gripped: 'Remove it completely.' It removed it. 'Stand upon it with your feet.'
meaning: अथैता एण्य एककृष्णाः . एण्यो ह वै नामैता रात्रयः . तासु कृष्णो ऽपि मिथुनत्वाय प्रजननाय . प्र मिथुनेन जायते य एवं वेद . तं वा त्वै पुरस्ताद् उपेयुस् तं वोपरिष्टात् . यदि पुरस्ताद् उपेयुः पुंस्प्रणेत्रा असन्न् इति . यद्य् उपरिष्टात् पश्चाद् वै पुमान् योषायां रेतो दधाति रेतोधेयाय . प्रजापतिर् वावेदम् अग्र एको ऽसृज्यत नान्यं द्वितीयं पश्यमानः . स ऐक्षताहं वाव प्रथमो ऽजनिष्य् अहं श्रेष्ठो ऽस्म्य् अस्ति स्विन् मद् इहान्या३ इति . स व्यैक्षत . सो ऽन्यद् आत्मनो ऽध्य् उत्तरतो ज्यायस् तिष्ठद् अप्श्यत् . तद् अपृच्छत् किम् इदम् असि यद् इदम् असीति . ब्रह्म वा अस्मीत्य् अब्रवीत् . तद् अब्रवीत् आवं वाव प्रथमाव् अजनिष्वह्य् आवं श्रेष्ठौ स्वस् संसृजावहै सहासावेति . नेत्य् अब्रवीत् . पाप्मगृहीतो वा असीति . स मे क्व स पाप्मेति . एष ते शीर्षन्न् इति . तं वै मे ऽवजहीति . तथेति . तम् अवाहन् . तं ग्रीवास्व् असिनात् . तं समपीडयत् . तद् एतत् परिगृहीतकम् इवावजहीति . तम् अवाहन् . तं नीव्याम् असिनात् . तं समपीडयत् . तद् एतत् परिगृहीतकम् इवावजहीति . तम् अवाहन् . तं कुल्फयोर् असिनात् . तं समपीडयत् . तद् एतत् परिगृहीतकम् इवावैव जहीति . तम् अवाहन् . पदाभितिष्ठेति .

sanskrit_iast: sa evaiṣa pador ucchlaṅkhaḥ . tredhā vicchinddhīti . taṃ tredhā vyacchinat . saivāsya śrīr abhavad gaus tṛtīyaṃ svapnas tṛtīyaṃ chāyā tṛtīyam . tasmād etāni śreṣṭhasya bhūyiṣṭhāni . bhūyiṣṭhāḥ paśavo jyeṣṭhā chāyā svapiti . sa aikṣata yaṃ ma imaṃ pāpmānam avocad dhantemam apaiva chinadā iti . sa etad eva brahmāṣṭadhā vyauhat . aṣṭākṣarā gāyatrī . brahma gāyatrī . brahmaiva tad aṣṭadhā vyauhat . tam aṣṭābhis trivṛdbhiḥ parāñcam apauhat . tam aṣṭābhiḥ pañcadaśaiḥ parāñcam apauhat . tam aṣṭābhiḥ saptadaśaiḥ parāñcam apauhat . tam aṣṭābhir ekaviṃśaiḥ parāñcam apauhat . tam aṣṭābhis triṇavaiḥ parārdham agamayat . tam aṣṭābhis trayastriṃśair apaivāchinat . sa evaiṣa upariṣṭād atirātraḥ . pāpmā hāsyaiṣo 'poḍhaḥ . atho eṣa eva prajāpatir yo 'sau tapati . sa eṣo 'pahatapāpmā tapati . tasya chāyā nāsti . tasmād u chāyām abhi ca ṣṭhīved abhi ca mehet . pāpmānam eva tad dhate . suptvodakam ācāmet . pāpmānam eva tad dhate . gām upāṣṭāṃ hanīta . pāpmānam eva tad dhate . te ya evaṃ vidvāṃsa etā rātrīr upayanti sarvam eva pāpmānam apahatyottiṣṭhanti . īśvarā ha tv apaśavo bhavitoḥ paśavo vā ukthāni paśūn hi sa tatrāpy apauhat . te ye śrīkāmā syus ta etā rātrīr upeyuḥ . etā ha sma vai tat purā kurupāñcālānāṃ brāhmaṇā śrīkāmā upayanti . te hāgavo 'bhadrā āsuḥ . sajāteṣu haivaiṣāṃ paśava āsuḥ . tato ha smaiva goruhāyāgatāya gām upāñjanti . tato 'deyāya daduḥ . tad u hovāca śāṭyāyanir na tāṃ vaded yā paricakṣā . yadākāmīnā vai śriyāṃ paśavo yadākāmīnaṃ vittaṃ paśumantaś ca bhaviṣyāma śreṣṭhāś ca rātsyāmaś cety evaṃ manyamānā etā rātrīr upeyur iti . tathā haiva bhavati . vaiśvānara udayanīyo 'tirātro bhavati .
sentences: saivāsya śrīr abʰavad gaus tr̥tīyaṃ svapnas tr̥tīyaṃ cʰāyā tr̥tīyam .
sa aikṣata yaṃ ma imaṃ pāpmānam avocad dʰantemam apaiva cʰinadā iti .
atʰo eṣa eva prajāpatir yo 'sau tapati .
tasmād u cʰāyām abʰi ca ṣṭʰīved abʰi ca mehet .
te ya evaṃ vidvāṃsa etā rātrīr upayanti sarvam eva pāpmānam apahatyottiṣṭʰanti .
īśvarā ha tv apaśavo bʰavitoḥ paśavo vā uktʰāni paśūn hi sa tatrāpy apauhat .
te ye śrīkāmā syus ta etā rātrīr upeyuḥ .
etā ha sma vai tat purā kurupāñcālānāṃ brāhmaṇā śrīkāmā upayanti .
tato ha smaiva goruhāyāgatāya gām upāñjanti .
tad u hovāca śāṭyāyanir na tāṃ vaded yā paricakṣā .
yadākāmīnā vai śriyāṃ paśavo yadākāmīnaṃ vittaṃ paśumantaś ca bʰaviṣyāma śreṣṭʰāś ca rātsyāmaś cety evaṃ manyamānā etā rātrīr upeyur iti .
text: That is the protuberance (ucchlarikha) from the foot. 'Split it into three,' [brahman said]. He split it into three. His prosperity (sri) became thus: a third cattle, a third sleep, a third shadow. Therefore these are most abundant for the most excellent one -- most abundant cattle, greatest shadow, and he sleeps [most]. He considered: 'The evil that he told me of -- let me cut it off entirely.' He divided this very brahman eightfold. The gayatri has eight syllables. The gayatri is brahman. He divided brahman itself eightfold. With eight trivrt-[stomas] he drove it away. With eight pancadasa-[stomas] he drove it further away. With eight saptadasa-[stomas] he drove it further away. With eight ekavimsa-[stomas] he drove it further away. With eight trinava-[stomas] he sent it to the farthest end. With eight trayastrimsas he cut it off completely. This is the atiratra at the end. His evil is thus driven away. Moreover, this is Prajapati, he who shines yonder [the sun]. He shines with evil removed. He has no shadow. Therefore one should neither stand upon a shadow nor urinate upon it -- for that grasps evil. Having slept, one should sip water -- for that removes evil. One should kill an attended cow -- for that removes evil. Those who, knowing thus, undergo these nights rise up having removed all evil. They are, however, likely to become without cattle -- for cattle are the uktha-chants, for he drove away cattle there too. Those who desire prosperity should undergo these nights. Indeed formerly the brahmins of the Kuru-Pancalas, desiring prosperity, used to undergo these. But they were without cattle, unfortunate. Their cattle were among their kinsmen. Therefore when one returning from a cow-expedition arrived, they would anoint a cow for him. Thus they gave to one who should not be given to. Thereupon Satyayani said: 'One should not speak of that which is a censure. When one is unwilling, prosperity comes; when one is unwilling, cattle and wealth come. Thinking, we shall become possessors of cattle and shall be the best and shall obtain, they should undergo these nights.' So it is indeed. The vaisvanara is the concluding atiratra.
