meaning: स एवैष पदोर् उच्छ्लङ्खः . त्रेधा विच्छिन्द्धीति . तं त्रेधा व्यच्छिनत् . सैवास्य श्रीर् अभवद् गौस् तृतीयं स्वप्नस् तृतीयं छाया तृतीयम् . तस्माद् एतानि श्रेष्ठस्य भूयिष्ठानि . भूयिष्ठाः पशवो ज्येष्ठा छाया स्वपिति . स ऐक्षत यं म इमं पाप्मानम् अवोचद् धन्तेमम् अपैव छिनदा इति . स एतद् एव ब्रह्माष्टधा व्यौहत् . अष्टाक्षरा गायत्री . ब्रह्म गायत्री . ब्रह्मैव तद् अष्टधा व्यौहत् . तम् अष्टाभिस् त्रिवृद्भिः पराञ्चम् अपौहत् . तम् अष्टाभिः पञ्चदशैः पराञ्चम् अपौहत् . तम् अष्टाभिः सप्तदशैः पराञ्चम् अपौहत् . तम् अष्टाभिर् एकविंशैः पराञ्चम् अपौहत् . तम् अष्टाभिस् त्रिणवैः परार्धम् अगमयत् . तम् अष्टाभिस् त्रयस्त्रिंशैर् अपैवाछिनत् . स एवैष उपरिष्टाद् अतिरात्रः . पाप्मा हास्यैषो ऽपोढः . अथो एष एव प्रजापतिर् यो ऽसौ तपति . स एषो ऽपहतपाप्मा तपति . तस्य छाया नास्ति . तस्माद् उ छायाम् अभि च ष्ठीवेद् अभि च मेहेत् . पाप्मानम् एव तद् धते . सुप्त्वोदकम् आचामेत् . पाप्मानम् एव तद् धते . गाम् उपाष्टां हनीत . पाप्मानम् एव तद् धते . ते य एवं विद्वांस एता रात्रीर् उपयन्ति सर्वम् एव पाप्मानम् अपहत्योत्तिष्ठन्ति . ईश्वरा ह त्व् अपशवो भवितोः पशवो वा उक्थानि पशून् हि स तत्राप्य् अपौहत् . ते ये श्रीकामा स्युस् त एता रात्रीर् उपेयुः . एता ह स्म वै तत् पुरा कुरुपाञ्चालानां ब्राह्मणा श्रीकामा उपयन्ति . ते हागवो ऽभद्रा आसुः . सजातेषु हैवैषां पशव आसुः . ततो ह स्मैव गोरुहायागताय गाम् उपाञ्जन्ति . ततो ऽदेयाय ददुः . तद् उ होवाच शाट्यायनिर् न तां वदेद् या परिचक्षा . यदाकामीना वै श्रियां पशवो यदाकामीनं वित्तं पशुमन्तश् च भविष्याम श्रेष्ठाश् च रात्स्यामश् चेत्य् एवं मन्यमाना एता रात्रीर् उपेयुर् इति . तथा हैव भवति . वैश्वानर उदयनीयो ऽतिरात्रो भवति .

sanskrit_iast: sāvitraṃ pūrvedyuḥ paśum ālabhante . savitā vai devānāṃ prasavitā savitṛprasūtā evaitat saṃvatsaram ārabhante . ko hy etam arhaty aprasūta ārabham . prājāpatyaṃ śvo bhūta ālabhante . prajāpatiśreṣṭhā vai devāḥ . śreṣṭhata evaitad devatāḥ prīṇanti . yo vai śreṣṭham arādhayitvāthānyān īpsati sarve vāva tasya te 'rādhitā bhavanti . atha ya śreṣṭhaṃ rādhayitvāthāpy anyān ādriyate sarve vāva tasya te 'bhīṣṭhāḥ prītā bhavanti . prajāpatiśreṣṭhā vai devāḥ . śreṣṭhata evaitat sarvā devatāḥ prīṇanti . śveto lomaśas tūparo lapsugy anyatodañ catuṣpād . yac chveto lomaśas tad avīnāṃ rūpam . yat tūparas tad aśvānām . yal lapsugī tat pruṣāṇām . yad anyatodal̥s tad gavām . yad ajas tad ajānām . sarveṣāṃ vā eṣa paśūnāṃ mehdaḥ . sarveṣām evaitat paśūnāṃ medhena saṃvatsaraṃ pitaraṃ prajāpatiṃ prīṇanti . sa enān prītaḥ prīṇāti .
sentences: savitā vai devānāṃ prasavitā savitr̥prasūtā evaitat saṃvatsaram ārabʰante .
ko hy etam arhaty aprasūta ārabʰam .
yo vai śreṣṭʰam arādʰayitvātʰānyān īpsati sarve vāva tasya te 'rādʰitā bʰavanti .
atʰa ya śreṣṭʰaṃ rādʰayitvātʰāpy anyān ādriyate sarve vāva tasya te 'bʰīṣṭʰāḥ prītā bʰavanti .
śveto lomaśas tūparo lapsugy anyatodañ catuṣpād .
yac cʰveto lomaśas tad avīnāṃ rūpam .
sarveṣām evaitat paśūnāṃ medʰena saṃvatsaraṃ pitaraṃ prajāpatiṃ prīṇanti .
text: They offer an animal victim to Savitr on the day before. Savitr is the impeller of the gods. Impelled by Savitr, they thus undertake the year. For who is worthy to undertake this without being impelled? On the next day they offer one to Prajapati. The gods have Prajapati as the best. They thereby gratify the deities starting from the best. He who, having propitiated the best, then seeks the others -- all those are indeed propitiated for him. And he who, having propitiated the best, then also attends to the others -- all those become satisfied and pleased for him. The gods have Prajapati as the best. They thereby gratify all the deities starting from the best. [The animal is] white, hairy, a hornless steer, with a dewlap, with uneven legs on one side. That it is white and hairy -- that is the form of sheep. That it is a hornless steer -- that is the form of horses. That it has a dewlap -- that is the form of spotted [animals]. That it has uneven legs on one side -- that is the form of cattle. That it is a goat -- that is the form of goats. This is the sacrificial essence of all cattle. With the sacrificial essence of all cattle they thereby gratify Prajapati, the father, the year. He, gratified, gratifies them.
meaning: सावित्रं पूर्वेद्युः पशुम् आलभन्ते . सविता वै देवानां प्रसविता सवितृप्रसूता एवैतत् संवत्सरम् आरभन्ते . को ह्य् एतम् अर्हत्य् अप्रसूत आरभम् . प्राजापत्यं श्वो भूत आलभन्ते . प्रजापतिश्रेष्ठा वै देवाः . श्रेष्ठत एवैतद् देवताः प्रीणन्ति . यो वै श्रेष्ठम् अराधयित्वाथान्यान् ईप्सति सर्वे वाव तस्य ते ऽराधिता भवन्ति . अथ य श्रेष्ठं राधयित्वाथाप्य् अन्यान् आद्रियते सर्वे वाव तस्य ते ऽभीष्ठाः प्रीता भवन्ति . प्रजापतिश्रेष्ठा वै देवाः . श्रेष्ठत एवैतत् सर्वा देवताः प्रीणन्ति . श्वेतो लोमशस् तूपरो लप्सुग्य् अन्यतोदञ् चतुष्पाद् . यच् छ्वेतो लोमशस् तद् अवीनां रूपम् . यत् तूपरस् तद् अश्वानाम् . यल् लप्सुगी तत् प्रुषाणाम् . यद् अन्यतोदल्̥स् तद् गवाम् . यद् अजस् तद् अजानाम् . सर्वेषां वा एष पशूनां मेह्दः . सर्वेषाम् एवैतत् पशूनां मेधेन संवत्सरं पितरं प्रजापतिं प्रीणन्ति . स एनान् प्रीतः प्रीणाति .

sanskrit_iast: sa indra etām aṣṭakām apaśyat . tasyām adīkṣata . sa ekayāśnuta . yad ekayāśnuta tad ekāṣṭakāyā ekāṣṭakātvam . te ya evaṃ vidvāṃso dīkṣante sarva evāśnuvate sarve viṣuvanto bhavanti . viṣuvān hy eṣo 'bhavat . te yat purastād dīkṣeran pitṛloke dīkṣeran pramāyukāḥ syur . yad upariṣṭād dīkṣeran yathā pūrvaṃ palāyitum īpset taṃ vāpnuyāt taṃ vā na tādṛk tat . ta etasyām evāṣṭakāyāṃ dīkṣeran . tad yathā ratham upasthitam ātiṣṭhed dhastinaṃ vā niṣāditaṃ tathā . kadriyañcas satriṇa iti vai pṛcchanti . nārvāñco na parāñca iti brūyād yathāsāv āditya iti . na ha vā ete 'rvāñco na parāñcaḥ . tiryañco ha vā ete . no ha vā asāv ādityo 'rvāṅ na parāṅ tiryaṅ u ha vā eṣa . ṣaḍ vā eṣa māso dakṣiṇaiti ṣaḍ udaṅ .
sentences: te ya evaṃ vidvāṃso dīkṣante sarva evāśnuvate sarve viṣuvanto bʰavanti .
te yat purastād dīkṣeran pitr̥loke dīkṣeran pramāyukāḥ syur .
yad upariṣṭād dīkṣeran yatʰā pūrvaṃ palāyitum īpset taṃ vāpnuyāt taṃ vā na tādr̥k tat .
tad yatʰā ratʰam upastʰitam ātiṣṭʰed dʰastinaṃ vā niṣāditaṃ tatʰā .
nārvāñco na parāñca iti brūyād yatʰāsāv āditya iti .
na ha vā ete 'rvāñco na parāñcaḥ .
no ha vā asāv ādityo 'rvāṅ na parāṅ tiryaṅ u ha vā eṣa .
ṣaḍ vā eṣa māso dakṣiṇaiti ṣaḍ udaṅ .
text: Indra perceived this astaka [the eighth-day rite]. He consecrated himself for it. He attained it with a single one. Because he attained it with a single one, that is the ekastaka-nature of the ekastaka. Those who, knowing thus, consecrate themselves, attain everything; they all become equinoctial, for he became the visuvat [equinox]. If they were to consecrate themselves before [the proper time], they would consecrate themselves in the world of the ancestors and would be short-lived. If they were to consecrate themselves after, it would be as if one wished to flee and might or might not catch [the quarry] -- such is that. They should consecrate themselves on this very astaka. It would be like mounting a chariot that has been brought up, or like sitting upon a kneeling elephant. 'In what direction do the sattra-performers [go]?' they ask. One should say: 'Neither hither nor yonder -- like the sun yonder.' For these are neither hither nor yonder. They are crosswise. Nor is the sun yonder going hither or yonder -- he is crosswise. For six months he goes southward, for six northward.
meaning: स इन्द्र एताम् अष्टकाम् अपश्यत् . तस्याम् अदीक्षत . स एकयाश्नुत . यद् एकयाश्नुत तद् एकाष्टकाया एकाष्टकात्वम् . ते य एवं विद्वांसो दीक्षन्ते सर्व एवाश्नुवते सर्वे विषुवन्तो भवन्ति . विषुवान् ह्य् एषो ऽभवत् . ते यत् पुरस्ताद् दीक्षेरन् पितृलोके दीक्षेरन् प्रमायुकाः स्युर् . यद् उपरिष्टाद् दीक्षेरन् यथा पूर्वं पलायितुम् ईप्सेत् तं वाप्नुयात् तं वा न तादृक् तत् . त एतस्याम् एवाष्टकायां दीक्षेरन् . तद् यथा रथम् उपस्थितम् आतिष्ठेद् धस्तिनं वा निषादितं तथा . कद्रियञ्चस् सत्रिण इति वै पृच्छन्ति . नार्वाञ्चो न पराञ्च इति ब्रूयाद् यथासाव् आदित्य इति . न ह वा एते ऽर्वाञ्चो न पराञ्चः . तिर्यञ्चो ह वा एते . नो ह वा असाव् आदित्यो ऽर्वाङ् न पराङ् तिर्यङ् उ ह वा एष . षड् वा एष मासो दक्षिणैति षड् उदङ् .

sanskrit_iast: etaṃ vā eta ārabhya yantīndraṃ prajāpatiṃ vipraṃ padam ṛtupātraṃ viśvān devān svargaṃ lokam . etasya vā eta āvṛtam anvāvartanta . etasya vā eta āvṛtam anv āvartanta etasya vimuktim anu vimucyante . tasyaiṣā paricakṣā yad apakṣīyamāṇe sutyāṃ gacchanty apakṣīyamāṇa udṛcam aśnuvate . dvādaśa dīkṣāḥ kurvīraṃs tisra upasadaḥ . tenaitad ubhayam upāpnuvanti . tad u vā āhur upāhaivaitenaitad ubhayam āpnuvantīti . seva tu paricakṣā yad apo 'nabhinandantaś śiśire 'vabhṛtham ahbyavayanti . sam iva kopayati himaḥ . sa ya enāṃs tathā cakruṣo 'nuvyāhared iti veti vā bhaviṣyantīti tathā haiva syuḥ . yaivāsau phālgunasyāmāvāsyā tasyā upariṣṭāt pañcāha ṣaḍahe dīkṣeran .
sentences: etaṃ vā eta ārabʰya yantīndraṃ prajāpatiṃ vipraṃ padam r̥tupātraṃ viśvān devān svargaṃ lokam .
etasya vā eta āvr̥tam anv āvartanta etasya vimuktim anu vimucyante .
tasyaiṣā paricakṣā yad apakṣīyamāṇe sutyāṃ gaccʰanty apakṣīyamāṇa udr̥cam aśnuvate .
tad u vā āhur upāhaivaitenaitad ubʰayam āpnuvantīti .
seva tu paricakṣā yad apo 'nabʰinandantaś śiśire 'vabʰr̥tʰam ahbyavayanti .
sa ya enāṃs tatʰā cakruṣo 'nuvyāhared iti veti vā bʰaviṣyantīti tatʰā haiva syuḥ .
yaivāsau pʰālgunasyāmāvāsyā tasyā upariṣṭāt pañcāha ṣaḍahe dīkṣeran .
text: Having undertaken this, they go toward Indra, Prajapati, the inspired one, the station, the rtupatra [vessel of seasons], all the gods, and the heavenly world. They turn along the circuit of this one. They turn along the circuit of this one; they are released following its release. This is its censure: that they go to the pressing day during the waning [moon], they reach the culmination during the waning [period]. They should perform twelve consecrations (diksa) and three upasad days. By that they obtain both. But they say: 'By the upasad alone they obtain both.' But this is the censure: that they enter the concluding bath in the cold season without welcoming the waters. The frost, as it were, rouses anger. He who would pronounce a curse upon those who have done thus -- 'so indeed they shall be' -- so it would be. On the new-moon night of Phalguna, after that, they should consecrate themselves on the fifth or sixth day.
meaning: एतं वा एत आरभ्य यन्तीन्द्रं प्रजापतिं विप्रं पदम् ऋतुपात्रं विश्वान् देवान् स्वर्गं लोकम् . एतस्य वा एत आवृतम् अन्वावर्तन्त . एतस्य वा एत आवृतम् अन्व् आवर्तन्त एतस्य विमुक्तिम् अनु विमुच्यन्ते . तस्यैषा परिचक्षा यद् अपक्षीयमाणे सुत्यां गच्छन्त्य् अपक्षीयमाण उदृचम् अश्नुवते . द्वादश दीक्षाः कुर्वीरंस् तिस्र उपसदः . तेनैतद् उभयम् उपाप्नुवन्ति . तद् उ वा आहुर् उपाहैवैतेनैतद् उभयम् आप्नुवन्तीति . सेव तु परिचक्षा यद् अपो ऽनभिनन्दन्तश् शिशिरे ऽवभृथम् अह्ब्यवयन्ति . सम् इव कोपयति हिमः . स य एनांस् तथा चक्रुषो ऽनुव्याहरेद् इति वेति वा भविष्यन्तीति तथा हैव स्युः . यैवासौ फाल्गुनस्यामावास्या तस्या उपरिष्टात् पञ्चाह षडहे दीक्षेरन् .

sanskrit_iast: gāvo vā etad agre satram āsatānnādyam avarurutsamānāḥ . tā daśame māsy udatiṣṭhan sarvam annādyam avārutsmahīti manyamānāḥ . tā etā śṛṅgiṇīḥ . tāsāṃ tvā ivābruvan sarvān evaitān dvādaśa māsaḥ samāpayāmeti . tā atiprāyuñjata . tāsāṃ dvādaśe māsi śṛṅgāṇi prāvartanta . tā etās tūparāḥ . tasmāt satriṇo dvādaśe māsy api śikhāḥ pravapante . gavāṃ hi tarhy anurūpā bhavanti . tā udatiṣṭhann arātsmety āptvā satram āptvā sarvam annādyam . tasmād etās sarvān dvādaśa māsa uttiṣṭhanti pratvāpi vārṣikāv api śiśirau . satrābhijitaṃ hy āsām avaruddhaṃ hy āsām . te ya evaṃ vidvāṃso dvādaśa māsaḥ samāpayanti sarvam evānnādyam avarudhyottiṣṭhanti . ātmadakṣiṇaṃ ha khalu vai satram . lomaiva prathamābhyām upasadbhyāṃ spṛṇvate tvacaṃ dvitīyābhyāṃ māṃsaṃ tṛtīyābhyām asthi caturthībhyāṃ majjānaṃ pañcamībhyām . yad evaiṣāṃ tatra kiṃ cāspṛtaṃ bhavati tad eva ṣaṣṭhībhyāṃ spṛṇvate .
sentences: gāvo vā etad agre satram āsatānnādyam avarurutsamānāḥ .
tā daśame māsy udatiṣṭʰan sarvam annādyam avārutsmahīti manyamānāḥ .
tāsāṃ tvā ivābruvan sarvān evaitān dvādaśa māsaḥ samāpayāmeti .
tasmāt satriṇo dvādaśe māsy api śikʰāḥ pravapante .
tā udatiṣṭʰann arātsmety āptvā satram āptvā sarvam annādyam .
tasmād etās sarvān dvādaśa māsa uttiṣṭʰanti pratvāpi vārṣikāv api śiśirau .
satrābʰijitaṃ hy āsām avaruddʰaṃ hy āsām .
te ya evaṃ vidvāṃso dvādaśa māsaḥ samāpayanti sarvam evānnādyam avarudʰyottiṣṭʰanti .
lomaiva pratʰamābʰyām upasadbʰyāṃ spr̥ṇvate tvacaṃ dvitīyābʰyāṃ māṃsaṃ tr̥tīyābʰyām astʰi caturtʰībʰyāṃ majjānaṃ pañcamībʰyām .
yad evaiṣāṃ tatra kiṃ cāspr̥taṃ bʰavati tad eva ṣaṣṭʰībʰyāṃ spr̥ṇvate .
text: The cows indeed first sat in a sattra, seeking to obtain food. They rose on the tenth month, thinking: 'We have obtained all food.' These have horns. But their [companions] said, as it were: 'Let us complete all these twelve months.' They exceeded the duration. In the twelfth month, their horns fell off. These are the hornless ones. Therefore sattra-performers shave their topknots in the twelfth month, for at that time they become similar to the cows. They rose up, having obtained -- having completed the sattra, having completed all food. Therefore these [cows] rise in all twelve months, even in the rainy and winter seasons. For their sattra-conquest was secured, it was obtained for them. Those who, knowing thus, complete twelve months, rise up having obtained all food. The sattra is indeed its own daksina. By the first two upasad days they touch the hair, by the second two the skin, by the third the flesh, by the fourth the bone, by the fifth the marrow. Whatever of theirs remains untouched there, that they touch by the sixth.
meaning: गावो वा एतद् अग्रे सत्रम् आसतान्नाद्यम् अवरुरुत्समानाः . ता दशमे मास्य् उदतिष्ठन् सर्वम् अन्नाद्यम् अवारुत्स्महीति मन्यमानाः . ता एता शृङ्गिणीः . तासां त्वा इवाब्रुवन् सर्वान् एवैतान् द्वादश मासः समापयामेति . ता अतिप्रायुञ्जत . तासां द्वादशे मासि शृङ्गाणि प्रावर्तन्त . ता एतास् तूपराः . तस्मात् सत्रिणो द्वादशे मास्य् अपि शिखाः प्रवपन्ते . गवां हि तर्ह्य् अनुरूपा भवन्ति . ता उदतिष्ठन्न् अरात्स्मेत्य् आप्त्वा सत्रम् आप्त्वा सर्वम् अन्नाद्यम् . तस्माद् एतास् सर्वान् द्वादश मास उत्तिष्ठन्ति प्रत्वापि वार्षिकाव् अपि शिशिरौ . सत्राभिजितं ह्य् आसाम् अवरुद्धं ह्य् आसाम् . ते य एवं विद्वांसो द्वादश मासः समापयन्ति सर्वम् एवान्नाद्यम् अवरुध्योत्तिष्ठन्ति . आत्मदक्षिणं ह खलु वै सत्रम् . लोमैव प्रथमाभ्याम् उपसद्भ्यां स्पृण्वते त्वचं द्वितीयाभ्यां मांसं तृतीयाभ्याम् अस्थि चतुर्थीभ्यां मज्जानं पञ्चमीभ्याम् . यद् एवैषां तत्र किं चास्पृतं भवति तद् एव षष्ठीभ्यां स्पृण्वते .

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatir vāvedam agra āsīt . so 'kāmayata bahuḥ syāṃ prajāyeya bhūmānaṃ gaccheyam iti . sa tapo 'tapyata . sa etaṃ vaiśvānaraṃ prāyaṇīyam atirātram apaśyat . tasmād ahorātre prājanayat . ahorātrayoḥ pratyatiṣṭhat . tad yad eṣa vaiśvānaraḥ prāyaṇīyo 'tirātro bhavaty ahorātre evaitasmāt prajanayanty ahorātrayoḥ pratitiṣṭhanti . so 'kāmayata praiva jāyeyeti . sa etasmād eva vaiśvānarāt prāyaṇīyād atirātrāt tryahaṃ niramimīta agniṣṭomād eva jyotir niramimīta ukthyebhyo gāṃ rātryā āyuḥ . tasmāt tryahāt trīn ṛtūn prājanayat triṣv ṛtuṣu pratyatiṣṭhat . tad yad eṣa tryaho bhavati trīn evaitasmād ṛtūn prajanayanti triṣv ṛtuṣu pratitiṣṭhanti . so 'kāmayata praiva jāyeyeti . sa etam eva ṣaḍahaṃ parastāt paryauhat . tau dvau ṣaḍahāv abhavatām . tābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ ṣaḍahābhyāṃ dvādaśa māsaḥ prājanayad dvādaśasu māseṣu pratyatiṣṭhat . tad yad etau dvau ṣaḍahau bhavato dvādaśaivaitābhyāṃ māsaḥ prajanayanti dvādaśasu māseṣu pratitiṣṭhanti . so 'kāmayata praiva jāyeyeti . sa etāv eva ṣaḍahau parastāt paryauhat . te catvāraṣ ṣaḍahā abhavan . tebhyaś caturbhyaṣ ṣaḍahebhyaś caturviṃśatim ardhamāsān prājanayac caturviṃśatyām ardhamāseṣu pratyatiṣṭhat .
sentences: so 'kāmayata bahuḥ syāṃ prajāyeya bʰūmānaṃ gaccʰeyam iti .
sa etaṃ vaiśvānaraṃ prāyaṇīyam atirātram apaśyat .
tad yad eṣa vaiśvānaraḥ prāyaṇīyo 'tirātro bʰavaty ahorātre evaitasmāt prajanayanty ahorātrayoḥ pratitiṣṭʰanti .
sa etasmād eva vaiśvānarāt prāyaṇīyād atirātrāt tryahaṃ niramimīta agniṣṭomād eva jyotir niramimīta uktʰyebʰyo gāṃ rātryā āyuḥ .
tasmāt tryahāt trīn r̥tūn prājanayat triṣv r̥tuṣu pratyatiṣṭʰat .
tad yad eṣa tryaho bʰavati trīn evaitasmād r̥tūn prajanayanti triṣv r̥tuṣu pratitiṣṭʰanti .
sa etam eva ṣaḍahaṃ parastāt paryauhat .
tābʰyāṃ dvābʰyāṃ ṣaḍahābʰyāṃ dvādaśa māsaḥ prājanayad dvādaśasu māseṣu pratyatiṣṭʰat .
tad yad etau dvau ṣaḍahau bʰavato dvādaśaivaitābʰyāṃ māsaḥ prajanayanti dvādaśasu māseṣu pratitiṣṭʰanti .
sa etāv eva ṣaḍahau parastāt paryauhat .
tebʰyaś caturbʰyaṣ ṣaḍahebʰyaś caturviṃśatim ardʰamāsān prājanayac caturviṃśatyām ardʰamāseṣu pratyatiṣṭʰat .
text: Prajapati indeed was here at first. He desired: 'May I become many; may I be reproduced; may I attain abundance.' He performed tapas. He perceived this vaisvanara introductory atiratra. From that he generated day and night. He was established in day and night. Since this vaisvanara is the introductory atiratra, from that they generate day and night and are established in day and night. He desired: 'Let me be further reproduced.' From this very vaisvanara introductory atiratra he fashioned a three-day sequence -- from the agnistoma he fashioned jyotis [light], from the ukthya-days the cow, from the night ayus [life]. From that three-day sequence he generated the three seasons; he was established in the three seasons. Since this three-day sequence exists, from it they generate the three seasons and are established in the three seasons. He desired: 'Let me be further reproduced.' He extended this very sadaha [six-day period] beyond. There became two sadahas. From those two sadahas he generated twelve months; he was established in the twelve months. Since these two sadahas exist, from them they generate twelve months and are established in the twelve months. He desired: 'Let me be further reproduced.' He extended these very two sadahas beyond. There became four sadahas. From those four sadahas he generated twenty-four half-months; he was established in twenty-four half-months.
meaning: प्रजापतिर् वावेदम् अग्र आसीत् . सो ऽकामयत बहुः स्यां प्रजायेय भूमानं गच्छेयम् इति . स तपो ऽतप्यत . स एतं वैश्वानरं प्रायणीयम् अतिरात्रम् अपश्यत् . तस्माद् अहोरात्रे प्राजनयत् . अहोरात्रयोः प्रत्यतिष्ठत् . तद् यद् एष वैश्वानरः प्रायणीयो ऽतिरात्रो भवत्य् अहोरात्रे एवैतस्मात् प्रजनयन्त्य् अहोरात्रयोः प्रतितिष्ठन्ति . सो ऽकामयत प्रैव जायेयेति . स एतस्माद् एव वैश्वानरात् प्रायणीयाद् अतिरात्रात् त्र्यहं निरमिमीत अग्निष्टोमाद् एव ज्योतिर् निरमिमीत उक्थ्येभ्यो गां रात्र्या आयुः . तस्मात् त्र्यहात् त्रीन् ऋतून् प्राजनयत् त्रिष्व् ऋतुषु प्रत्यतिष्ठत् . तद् यद् एष त्र्यहो भवति त्रीन् एवैतस्माद् ऋतून् प्रजनयन्ति त्रिष्व् ऋतुषु प्रतितिष्ठन्ति . सो ऽकामयत प्रैव जायेयेति . स एतम् एव षडहं परस्तात् पर्यौहत् . तौ द्वौ षडहाव् अभवताम् . ताभ्यां द्वाभ्यां षडहाभ्यां द्वादश मासः प्राजनयद् द्वादशसु मासेषु प्रत्यतिष्ठत् . तद् यद् एतौ द्वौ षडहौ भवतो द्वादशैवैताभ्यां मासः प्रजनयन्ति द्वादशसु मासेषु प्रतितिष्ठन्ति . सो ऽकामयत प्रैव जायेयेति . स एताव् एव षडहौ परस्तात् पर्यौहत् . ते चत्वारष् षडहा अभवन् . तेभ्यश् चतुर्भ्यष् षडहेभ्यश् चतुर्विंशतिम् अर्धमासान् प्राजनयच् चतुर्विंशत्याम् अर्धमासेषु प्रत्यतिष्ठत् .

sanskrit_iast: sa idaṃ sarvaṃ bhuvanaṃ prajanya pṛṣṭhyena ṣaḍahenātmann adhatta . tad yad eṣa pṛṣṭhyaṣ ṣaḍaho bhavati sarvam evaitena bhuvanaṃ prajanyātmasu dadhate . varṣma vai pṛṣṭhāni . varṣmaṇy evaitat pratitiṣṭhanti . śrīr vai pṛṣṭhāni . śriyām evaitat pratitiṣṭhanti . jyaiṣṭhyaṃ vai pṛṣṭhāni . jyaiṣṭhya evaitat pratitiṣṭhanti . tejo vai pṛṣṭhāni tejasy evaitat pratitiṣṭhanti . paśavo ha khalu vā abhiplavaṣ ṣaḍaha ātmā pṛṣṭhyaḥ . yad abhiplavaṃ ṣaḍaham upetyātha pṛṣṭhyam upayanti puruṣam evaitat paśuṣv adhyūhanti . tasmāt puruṣa upariṣṭāt paśūn adhīva tiṣṭhati . mūlaṃ ha khalu vā abhiplavaṣ ṣaḍaho 'graṃ pṛṣṭhyaḥ . yad abhiplavaṃ ṣaḍaham upetyātha pṛṣṭhyam upayanti tasmād oṣadhayo mūlato jāyante 'grataḥ pacyante . pañcaite ṣaḍahā bhavanti . pāṅkto yajñaḥ . yāvatī yajñasya mātrā tasyām evaitat pratitiṣṭhanti . sa māsas saṃpadyate . saṃvatsaro vai māsaḥ . māsaśa eva tat saṃvatsaram āpnuvanti .
sentences: sa idaṃ sarvaṃ bʰuvanaṃ prajanya pr̥ṣṭʰyena ṣaḍahenātmann adʰatta .
tad yad eṣa pr̥ṣṭʰyaṣ ṣaḍaho bʰavati sarvam evaitena bʰuvanaṃ prajanyātmasu dadʰate .
tejo vai pr̥ṣṭʰāni tejasy evaitat pratitiṣṭʰanti .
paśavo ha kʰalu vā abʰiplavaṣ ṣaḍaha ātmā pr̥ṣṭʰyaḥ .
yad abʰiplavaṃ ṣaḍaham upetyātʰa pr̥ṣṭʰyam upayanti puruṣam evaitat paśuṣv adʰyūhanti .
tasmāt puruṣa upariṣṭāt paśūn adʰīva tiṣṭʰati .
mūlaṃ ha kʰalu vā abʰiplavaṣ ṣaḍaho 'graṃ pr̥ṣṭʰyaḥ .
yad abʰiplavaṃ ṣaḍaham upetyātʰa pr̥ṣṭʰyam upayanti tasmād oṣadʰayo mūlato jāyante 'grataḥ pacyante .
yāvatī yajñasya mātrā tasyām evaitat pratitiṣṭʰanti .
text: Having generated this entire world, he placed it upon himself by means of the prsthya sadaha. Since this prsthya sadaha exists, by means of it they generate the entire world and place it upon themselves. The prstha-chants are eminence. In eminence they are thereby established. The prstha-chants are prosperity (sri). In prosperity they are thereby established. The prstha-chants are preeminence. In preeminence they are thereby established. The prstha-chants are splendor (tejas). In splendor they are thereby established. The abhiplava sadaha is indeed the cattle; the prsthya [sadaha] is the self (atman). When, having performed the abhiplava sadaha, they then perform the prsthya, they place the person (purusa) over the cattle. Therefore the person stands above, as it were ruling over the cattle. The abhiplava sadaha is indeed the root; the prsthya is the tip. When, having performed the abhiplava sadaha, they then perform the prsthya -- therefore plants are born from the root and ripen from the tip. These five sadahas exist. The sacrifice is fivefold (pankta). In as much as is the measure of the sacrifice, in that they are established. That amounts to a month. The year is the month. Month by month they thereby attain the year.
meaning: स इदं सर्वं भुवनं प्रजन्य पृष्ठ्येन षडहेनात्मन्न् अधत्त . तद् यद् एष पृष्ठ्यष् षडहो भवति सर्वम् एवैतेन भुवनं प्रजन्यात्मसु दधते . वर्ष्म वै पृष्ठानि . वर्ष्मण्य् एवैतत् प्रतितिष्ठन्ति . श्रीर् वै पृष्ठानि . श्रियाम् एवैतत् प्रतितिष्ठन्ति . ज्यैष्ठ्यं वै पृष्ठानि . ज्यैष्ठ्य एवैतत् प्रतितिष्ठन्ति . तेजो वै पृष्ठानि तेजस्य् एवैतत् प्रतितिष्ठन्ति . पशवो ह खलु वा अभिप्लवष् षडह आत्मा पृष्ठ्यः . यद् अभिप्लवं षडहम् उपेत्याथ पृष्ठ्यम् उपयन्ति पुरुषम् एवैतत् पशुष्व् अध्यूहन्ति . तस्मात् पुरुष उपरिष्टात् पशून् अधीव तिष्ठति . मूलं ह खलु वा अभिप्लवष् षडहो ऽग्रं पृष्ठ्यः . यद् अभिप्लवं षडहम् उपेत्याथ पृष्ठ्यम् उपयन्ति तस्माद् ओषधयो मूलतो जायन्ते ऽग्रतः पच्यन्ते . पञ्चैते षडहा भवन्ति . पाङ्क्तो यज्ञः . यावती यज्ञस्य मात्रा तस्याम् एवैतत् प्रतितिष्ठन्ति . स मासस् संपद्यते . संवत्सरो वै मासः . मासश एव तत् संवत्सरम् आप्नुवन्ति .

sanskrit_iast: prāyaṇīyam ahar bhavati . prāyaṇīyena vā ahnā devā svargaṃ lokaṃ prāyan . yat prāyaṃs tat prāyaṇīyasya prāyaṇīyatvam . tad yat prāyaṇīyam ahar bhavati svargasyaiva lokasya samaṣṭyai . tasmād u haitasyāhna ṛtvijā bubhūṣitavyaṃ svargasya hy etal lokasya nediṣṭham . tac caturviṃśaṃ bhavati . caturviṃśatyardhamāso vai saṃvatsaraḥ . ardhamāsaśa eva tat saṃvatsaram āpnuvanti . etad u ha vā eke satriṇo 'har upetyottasthur āpāma saṃvatsaram iti vadantaḥ . te ye kāmaṃkāmaṃ samārebhāṇā iva syus ta etad evāhar upetyotiṣṭheyuḥ . āpto haiṣāṃ saṃvatsaro bhavati . tasya trīṇi ca śatāni stotriyā bhavanti ṣaṣṭiś ca . tāvatīs saṃvatsarasya rātrayaḥ . rātriśa eva tat saṃvatsaram āpnuvanti . tad āhur yat saṃvatsarasadas saṃvatsarasyāhāni sunvanta āsate 'tha kena rātrīr āpnuvantīti . sa brūyād yāvatīḥ prāyaṇīyasyāhna stotryās tāvatīs saṃvatsarasya rātrayaḥ . prāyaṇīyasyāhna eva stotryābhī rātrīr āptvā ahāni sunvanta āsata iti . tad ukthyaṃ bhavati paśavo vā ukthāni paśūnām evāvaruddhyai . tasya pañcadaśa stotrāṇi bhavanti . pañcadaśa vā ardhamāsasya rātrayaḥ . ardhamāsaśa eva tat saṃvatsaram āpnuvanti . triṃśat stutaśastrāṇi bhavanti . triṃśan māsasya rātrayaḥ .
sentences: prāyaṇīyena vā ahnā devā svargaṃ lokaṃ prāyan .
tad yat prāyaṇīyam ahar bʰavati svargasyaiva lokasya samaṣṭyai .
tasmād u haitasyāhna r̥tvijā bubʰūṣitavyaṃ svargasya hy etal lokasya nediṣṭʰam .
etad u ha vā eke satriṇo 'har upetyottastʰur āpāma saṃvatsaram iti vadantaḥ .
te ye kāmaṃkāmaṃ samārebʰāṇā iva syus ta etad evāhar upetyotiṣṭʰeyuḥ .
tasya trīṇi ca śatāni stotriyā bʰavanti ṣaṣṭiś ca .
tad āhur yat saṃvatsarasadas saṃvatsarasyāhāni sunvanta āsate 'tʰa kena rātrīr āpnuvantīti .
sa brūyād yāvatīḥ prāyaṇīyasyāhna stotryās tāvatīs saṃvatsarasya rātrayaḥ .
prāyaṇīyasyāhna eva stotryābʰī rātrīr āptvā ahāni sunvanta āsata iti .
tad uktʰyaṃ bʰavati paśavo vā uktʰāni paśūnām evāvaruddʰyai .
text: There is the introductory day (prayaniya). By the introductory day the gods went forth to the heavenly world. Because they went forth (prayan), that is the prayaniya-nature of the prayaniya. Since there is the introductory day, it is for the attainment of the heavenly world. Therefore the priest should desire to be [present] on this day, for it is nearest to the heavenly world. It is a caturvimsa [twenty-four-fold stoma]. Twenty-four half-months make the year. By half-months they thereby attain the year. Some sattra-performers, having performed this day alone, stood up saying: 'We have attained the year.' Those who would be like ones undertaking desire after desire should, having performed this day alone, rise up. Their year is indeed attained. Its laudatory verses (stotriya) number three hundred and sixty. That many are the nights of the year. Night by night they thereby attain the year. They say: 'If the year-long performers sit pressing soma for the days of the year, by what means do they attain the nights?' One should say: 'As many as are the stotriyas of the introductory day, that many are the nights of the year. By the stotriyas of the introductory day itself they attain the nights; then they sit pressing soma for the days.' It is an ukthya, for the uktha-chants are cattle -- for the securing of cattle. Its laudations (stotra) number fifteen. Fifteen are the nights of a half-month. By half-months they thereby attain the year. The stuta-sastras number thirty. Thirty are the nights of a month.
meaning: प्रायणीयम् अहर् भवति . प्रायणीयेन वा अह्ना देवा स्वर्गं लोकं प्रायन् . यत् प्रायंस् तत् प्रायणीयस्य प्रायणीयत्वम् . तद् यत् प्रायणीयम् अहर् भवति स्वर्गस्यैव लोकस्य समष्ट्यै . तस्माद् उ हैतस्याह्न ऋत्विजा बुभूषितव्यं स्वर्गस्य ह्य् एतल् लोकस्य नेदिष्ठम् . तच् चतुर्विंशं भवति . चतुर्विंशत्यर्धमासो वै संवत्सरः . अर्धमासश एव तत् संवत्सरम् आप्नुवन्ति . एतद् उ ह वा एके सत्रिणो ऽहर् उपेत्योत्तस्थुर् आपाम संवत्सरम् इति वदन्तः . ते ये कामंकामं समारेभाणा इव स्युस् त एतद् एवाहर् उपेत्योतिष्ठेयुः . आप्तो हैषां संवत्सरो भवति . तस्य त्रीणि च शतानि स्तोत्रिया भवन्ति षष्टिश् च . तावतीस् संवत्सरस्य रात्रयः . रात्रिश एव तत् संवत्सरम् आप्नुवन्ति . तद् आहुर् यत् संवत्सरसदस् संवत्सरस्याहानि सुन्वन्त आसते ऽथ केन रात्रीर् आप्नुवन्तीति . स ब्रूयाद् यावतीः प्रायणीयस्याह्न स्तोत्र्यास् तावतीस् संवत्सरस्य रात्रयः . प्रायणीयस्याह्न एव स्तोत्र्याभी रात्रीर् आप्त्वा अहानि सुन्वन्त आसत इति . तद् उक्थ्यं भवति पशवो वा उक्थानि पशूनाम् एवावरुद्ध्यै . तस्य पञ्चदश स्तोत्राणि भवन्ति . पञ्चदश वा अर्धमासस्य रात्रयः . अर्धमासश एव तत् संवत्सरम् आप्नुवन्ति . त्रिंशत् स्तुतशस्त्राणि भवन्ति . त्रिंशन् मासस्य रात्रयः .

sanskrit_iast: tad āhur īrma iva vā eṣā hotrāṇāṃ yad acchāvāko yad acchāvākam anusaṃtiṣṭheterma iva tuṣṭuvānā syur iti . tasya traikakubhaṃ brahmasāma bhavaty udvaṃśīyam acchāvākasāma . indriyaṃ vai vīryaṃ traikakubhaṃ sarvaṃ pṛṣṭharūpam udvaṃśīyam . indriye caiva tad vīrye sarvasmiṃś ca pṛṣṭharūpe 'ntataḥ pratitiṣṭhanti . tad vā enat tat prāśaṃsat . tad āhur agniṣṭoma eva kārya iti . tasya dvādaśa stotrāṇi bhavanti . dvādaśa māsās saṃvatsaraḥ . etad u ha vai saṃvatsarasya jyaiṣṭhyaṃ parva yan māsaḥ . tad yat saṃvatsarasya jyaiṣṭhyaṃ parva tena nas saṃvatsara ārabdho 'sad iti . īśvarā ha tv apaśavo bhavitoḥ paśavo vā ukthāni tebhyo hi yanti . tasya trīṇi stotrāṇy aṣṭācatvāriṃśāni kuryur ubhau pavamānau brahmasāma . tāvatīr ukthyasya stotryāḥ . āpnuvanti taṃ kāmaṃ ya ukthye no vā agniṣṭomād yanti . varṣma vā agniṣṭomo varṣma hotā varṣmaṇaiva tad varṣma saṃdadhati varṣmaṇā varṣman pratitiṣṭhanti .
sentences: tad āhur īrma iva vā eṣā hotrāṇāṃ yad accʰāvāko yad accʰāvākam anusaṃtiṣṭʰeterma iva tuṣṭuvānā syur iti .
tasya traikakubʰaṃ brahmasāma bʰavaty udvaṃśīyam accʰāvākasāma .
indriyaṃ vai vīryaṃ traikakubʰaṃ sarvaṃ pr̥ṣṭʰarūpam udvaṃśīyam .
indriye caiva tad vīrye sarvasmiṃś ca pr̥ṣṭʰarūpe 'ntataḥ pratitiṣṭʰanti .
tad āhur agniṣṭoma eva kārya iti .
etad u ha vai saṃvatsarasya jyaiṣṭʰyaṃ parva yan māsaḥ .
tad yat saṃvatsarasya jyaiṣṭʰyaṃ parva tena nas saṃvatsara ārabdʰo 'sad iti .
īśvarā ha tv apaśavo bʰavitoḥ paśavo vā uktʰāni tebʰyo hi yanti .
tasya trīṇi stotrāṇy aṣṭācatvāriṃśāni kuryur ubʰau pavamānau brahmasāma .
āpnuvanti taṃ kāmaṃ ya uktʰye no vā agniṣṭomād yanti .
varṣma vā agniṣṭomo varṣma hotā varṣmaṇaiva tad varṣma saṃdadʰati varṣmaṇā varṣman pratitiṣṭʰanti .
text: They say: 'The acchavaka is like a resting place of the hotra-chants. If they were to conclude with the acchavaka, they would be like ones who have chanted to a resting place.' Its brahmasaman is the traikakubha; the acchavaka-saman is the udvamsiya. The traikakubha is power and virility; the udvamsiya has the form of all prstha-chants. In power and virility and in the form of all prstha-chants they are established at the end. That indeed was praised. They say the agnistoma alone should be performed. Its laudations number twelve. Twelve months make the year. This is the most excellent portion (parvan) of the year -- the month. 'By the most excellent portion of the year may our year be commenced,' [they think]. They are, however, likely to become without cattle, for the uktha-chants are cattle, since they depart for them. They should make three laudations forty-eight-fold, both pavamana-chants and the brahmasaman. That many are the stotriyas of the ukthya. They obtain that desire which [comes] from the ukthya, or they do not depart from the agnistoma. The agnistoma is eminence; the hotr is eminence. With eminence they thereby join eminence; through eminence they are established in eminence.
meaning: तद् आहुर् ईर्म इव वा एषा होत्राणां यद् अच्छावाको यद् अच्छावाकम् अनुसंतिष्ठेतेर्म इव तुष्टुवाना स्युर् इति . तस्य त्रैककुभं ब्रह्मसाम भवत्य् उद्वंशीयम् अच्छावाकसाम . इन्द्रियं वै वीर्यं त्रैककुभं सर्वं पृष्ठरूपम् उद्वंशीयम् . इन्द्रिये चैव तद् वीर्ये सर्वस्मिंश् च पृष्ठरूपे ऽन्ततः प्रतितिष्ठन्ति . तद् वा एनत् तत् प्राशंसत् . तद् आहुर् अग्निष्टोम एव कार्य इति . तस्य द्वादश स्तोत्राणि भवन्ति . द्वादश मासास् संवत्सरः . एतद् उ ह वै संवत्सरस्य ज्यैष्ठ्यं पर्व यन् मासः . तद् यत् संवत्सरस्य ज्यैष्ठ्यं पर्व तेन नस् संवत्सर आरब्धो ऽसद् इति . ईश्वरा ह त्व् अपशवो भवितोः पशवो वा उक्थानि तेभ्यो हि यन्ति . तस्य त्रीणि स्तोत्राण्य् अष्टाचत्वारिंशानि कुर्युर् उभौ पवमानौ ब्रह्मसाम . तावतीर् उक्थ्यस्य स्तोत्र्याः . आप्नुवन्ति तं कामं य उक्थ्ये नो वा अग्निष्टोमाद् यन्ति . वर्ष्म वा अग्निष्टोमो वर्ष्म होता वर्ष्मणैव तद् वर्ष्म संदधति वर्ष्मणा वर्ष्मन् प्रतितिष्ठन्ति .

sanskrit_iast: tad āhuḥ plavam iva vā etac chando yaj jagatī na prāyaṇāya . tatsthānaṃ ṣaḍ eva ṣaṭtriṃśāni stotrāṇi kuryuṣ ṣaṭ caturviṃśānīti . ṣaṭtriṃśadakṣarā vai bṛhatī . bṛhatī svargo lokaḥ sāmrājyaṃ . bṛhatyām eva tat svarge loke sāmrājye pratitiṣṭhanto yanti . bṛhaty u ha vā imān sarvān lokān akṣarair vyāpnoti daśabhir evākṣarair imaṃ lokaṃ vyāpnoti daśabhir antarikṣaṃ daśabhir amuṃ caturbhir diśo dvābhyām ahorātre . sā yemāṃl lokān vyāpnoti tayemāṃl lokān vyāpnavāmeti . tasmāt ṣaḍ eva ṣaṭtriṃśāni stotrāṇi kuryuṣ ṣaṭ caturviṃśānīti . atho caturviṃśatyardhamāso vai saṃvatsaraḥ . ardhamāsaśa eva tat saṃvatsaram āpnuvanti . ete asṛgram indava iti bahurūpāṃ pratipadaṃ kurvīran . bahavo hy ete dīkṣante . tad u vā āhuḥ pavasva vāco agriya ity eva pratipat kāryā . eṣā vai bahurūpā . etasyāṃ vai sarvāṇirūpāṇi . ubhe pratipadau bhavata ubhe hy atra sāmanī kriyete . tarhi yathaujiṣṭhau baliṣṭhau vahiṣṭhau saṃpārayiṣṇū mahāntam adhvānaṃ saṃyujyopapreyāt tādṛk tat . sarvaṃ pṛṣṭharūpam anu samāvartayanti yathā pitre ca mātre ca vatsān anu samāvartayet tādṛk tathā . tad agne yuṅkṣvā hi ye tave ty etāsv agniṣṭomasāma kāryam āhuḥ . agnir vā eṣa vaiśvānaro yat saṃvatsaraḥ . tasyaiva yuktyā aśvāso deva sādhava iti siddhyai araṃ vahanty āśava iti samaṣṭyai . tad āhur yajñena vā ete yajñān abhiyanti ye yajñāyajñīyasyargbhyo 'dhi yajñāyajñīyaṃ cyāvayanti . athaite yajñena yajñe pratitiṣṭhanti ye yajñāyajñīyasyarkṣu yajñāyajñīyaṃ cyāvayanti .
sentences: tad āhuḥ plavam iva vā etac cʰando yaj jagatī na prāyaṇāya .
tatstʰānaṃ ṣaḍ eva ṣaṭtriṃśāni stotrāṇi kuryuṣ ṣaṭ caturviṃśānīti .
br̥hatyām eva tat svarge loke sāmrājye pratitiṣṭʰanto yanti .
br̥haty u ha vā imān sarvān lokān akṣarair vyāpnoti daśabʰir evākṣarair imaṃ lokaṃ vyāpnoti daśabʰir antarikṣaṃ daśabʰir amuṃ caturbʰir diśo dvābʰyām ahorātre .
sā yemāṃl lokān vyāpnoti tayemāṃl lokān vyāpnavāmeti .
tasmāt ṣaḍ eva ṣaṭtriṃśāni stotrāṇi kuryuṣ ṣaṭ caturviṃśānīti .
ete asr̥gram indava iti bahurūpāṃ pratipadaṃ kurvīran .
tad u vā āhuḥ pavasva vāco agriya ity eva pratipat kāryā .
ubʰe pratipadau bʰavata ubʰe hy atra sāmanī kriyete .
tarhi yatʰaujiṣṭʰau baliṣṭʰau vahiṣṭʰau saṃpārayiṣṇū mahāntam adʰvānaṃ saṃyujyopapreyāt tādr̥k tat .
sarvaṃ pr̥ṣṭʰarūpam anu samāvartayanti yatʰā pitre ca mātre ca vatsān anu samāvartayet tādr̥k tatʰā .
tad agne yuṅkṣvā hi ye tave ty etāsv agniṣṭomasāma kāryam āhuḥ .
agnir vā eṣa vaiśvānaro yat saṃvatsaraḥ .
tasyaiva yuktyā aśvāso deva sādʰava iti siddʰyai araṃ vahanty āśava iti samaṣṭyai .
tad āhur yajñena vā ete yajñān abʰiyanti ye yajñāyajñīyasyargbʰyo 'dʰi yajñāyajñīyaṃ cyāvayanti .
atʰaite yajñena yajñe pratitiṣṭʰanti ye yajñāyajñīyasyarkṣu yajñāyajñīyaṃ cyāvayanti .
text: They say: 'The jagati meter is like a raft -- not for the starting [of the sattra].' Instead, they should make six thirty-six-fold laudations and six twenty-four-fold ones. The brhati has thirty-six syllables. The brhati is the heavenly world, sovereign rule. In the brhati, in the heavenly world, in sovereign rule they are established as they go. The brhati pervades all these worlds with its syllables -- with ten syllables it pervades this world, with ten the midspace, with ten the yonder world, with four the directions, with two the day and night. 'May we pervade these worlds with that which pervades these worlds,' [they think]. Therefore they should make six thirty-six-fold laudations and six twenty-four-fold ones. Moreover, twenty-four half-months make the year. By half-months they thereby attain the year. 'These drops have flowed forth' (ete asrgram indavah) -- they should use a multi-form opening verse, for many are those who consecrate themselves. But they say: 'Pavasva vaco agriya alone should be the opening verse. That is the multi-form one. In it are all forms.' There are two opening verses, for two saman-melodies are composed here. It is as if one would harness two most powerful, strongest, most capable of conveyance, fit for completing a long journey. They arrange all prstha-forms in order, as one would arrange calves after their father and mother -- such is that. 'O Agni, harness those [horses] of yours' (tad agne yunksva hi ye tave) -- on these [verses] the agnistomasaman should be used, they say. For the vaisvanara fire is the year. 'For his yoking, O god, the steeds are good' -- for success. 'They draw swiftly' -- for completion. They say: 'Those who displace the yajnayajniya from the rk-verses of the yajnayajniya -- they approach sacrifices with sacrifice.' And those who cause the yajnayajniya to rest upon the rk-verses of the yajnayajniya -- they are established in sacrifice by means of sacrifice.
meaning: तद् आहुः प्लवम् इव वा एतच् छन्दो यज् जगती न प्रायणाय . तत्स्थानं षड् एव षट्त्रिंशानि स्तोत्राणि कुर्युष् षट् चतुर्विंशानीति . षट्त्रिंशदक्षरा वै बृहती . बृहती स्वर्गो लोकः साम्राज्यं . बृहत्याम् एव तत् स्वर्गे लोके साम्राज्ये प्रतितिष्ठन्तो यन्ति . बृहत्य् उ ह वा इमान् सर्वान् लोकान् अक्षरैर् व्याप्नोति दशभिर् एवाक्षरैर् इमं लोकं व्याप्नोति दशभिर् अन्तरिक्षं दशभिर् अमुं चतुर्भिर् दिशो द्वाभ्याम् अहोरात्रे . सा येमांल् लोकान् व्याप्नोति तयेमांल् लोकान् व्याप्नवामेति . तस्मात् षड् एव षट्त्रिंशानि स्तोत्राणि कुर्युष् षट् चतुर्विंशानीति . अथो चतुर्विंशत्यर्धमासो वै संवत्सरः . अर्धमासश एव तत् संवत्सरम् आप्नुवन्ति . एते असृग्रम् इन्दव इति बहुरूपां प्रतिपदं कुर्वीरन् . बहवो ह्य् एते दीक्षन्ते . तद् उ वा आहुः पवस्व वाचो अग्रिय इत्य् एव प्रतिपत् कार्या . एषा वै बहुरूपा . एतस्यां वै सर्वाणिरूपाणि . उभे प्रतिपदौ भवत उभे ह्य् अत्र सामनी क्रियेते . तर्हि यथौजिष्ठौ बलिष्ठौ वहिष्ठौ संपारयिष्णू महान्तम् अध्वानं संयुज्योपप्रेयात् तादृक् तत् . सर्वं पृष्ठरूपम् अनु समावर्तयन्ति यथा पित्रे च मात्रे च वत्सान् अनु समावर्तयेत् तादृक् तथा . तद् अग्ने युङ्क्ष्वा हि ये तवे त्य् एतास्व् अग्निष्टोमसाम कार्यम् आहुः . अग्निर् वा एष वैश्वानरो यत् संवत्सरः . तस्यैव युक्त्या अश्वासो देव साधव इति सिद्ध्यै अरं वहन्त्य् आशव इति समष्ट्यै . तद् आहुर् यज्ञेन वा एते यज्ञान् अभियन्ति ये यज्ञायज्ञीयस्यर्ग्भ्यो ऽधि यज्ञायज्ञीयं च्यावयन्ति . अथैते यज्ञेन यज्ञे प्रतितिष्ठन्ति ये यज्ञायज्ञीयस्यर्क्षु यज्ञायज्ञीयं च्यावयन्ति .

sanskrit_iast: abhīvarto brahmasāma bhavati . abhīvartena vai devā imān lokān abhya-vartanta . yad abhyavartanta tad abhīvartasyābhīvartatvam . tad yad abhīvarto brahmasāma bhavaty eṣām eva lokānām abhivṛtyai . prajāpatir vā abhīvartaḥ prajāś chandāṃsi . sa eṣa prajāpatiḥ prajāsu garbhaṃ dadhad eti . anyāsv anyāsv stuvanti samānena sāmnā . reta eva tat siñcanti . tasmād samāno bahvīṣv reto dadhāti . samānīḥ parastād ṛco bhavanty anyad anyat sāma . reta eva tat siktaṃ prajanayanti . tasmāt samānā bahūn sūte . anyāsv anyāsv stuvanti samānena sāmnā . anyad anyad dhi yantaḥ paśyanti . samānīḥ parastād ṛco bhavanty anyad anyat sāma . yān eveto lokān pragāthair abhyārohanto yanti tān amutas sāmabhiḥ pratyavarohanta āyanti . ṛg vā ayaṃ lokas sāmāsau . yad ito yantas sāmārabhya yanty amuṃ tal lokam ārabhya yanti . te yat purastād viṣuvata utsṛjerann avāmuṣmāl lokāc chidyeran . yad amuta āyanta ṛcam ārabhyāyantīmaṃ tal lokam ārabhyanti .
sentences: abʰīvartena vai devā imān lokān abʰya-vartanta .
tad yad abʰīvarto brahmasāma bʰavaty eṣām eva lokānām abʰivr̥tyai .
sa eṣa prajāpatiḥ prajāsu garbʰaṃ dadʰad eti .
samānīḥ parastād r̥co bʰavanty anyad anyat sāma .
samānīḥ parastād r̥co bʰavanty anyad anyat sāma .
yān eveto lokān pragātʰair abʰyārohanto yanti tān amutas sāmabʰiḥ pratyavarohanta āyanti .
yad ito yantas sāmārabʰya yanty amuṃ tal lokam ārabʰya yanti .
te yat purastād viṣuvata utsr̥jerann avāmuṣmāl lokāc cʰidyeran .
yad amuta āyanta r̥cam ārabʰyāyantīmaṃ tal lokam ārabʰyanti .
text: The abhivarta is the brahmasaman. By the abhivarta the gods prevailed over these worlds. Because they prevailed (abhyavartanta), that is the abhivarta-nature of the abhivarta. Since the abhivarta is the brahmasaman, it is for prevailing over these worlds. Prajapati is the abhivarta; the creatures are the meters. This Prajapati goes placing the embryo among the creatures. They chant on different [verses] with the same saman. That is the depositing of seed. Therefore the same [male] deposits seed in many [females]. The subsequent rk-verses are the same, but the saman differs. That is the bringing forth of seed deposited. Therefore the same [female] gives birth to many. They chant on different [verses] with the same saman, for they see different things as they go. The subsequent rk-verses are the same, but the saman differs. Those worlds which they ascend to by means of pragatha-chants going forth, from those they descend by means of saman-melodies coming back. This world is the rk; that yonder world is the saman. When those going from here proceed grasping the saman, they proceed grasping that yonder world. If they were to abandon [the chant] before the visuvat, they would be cut off from that yonder world. When those coming from yonder proceed grasping the rk, they proceed grasping this world.
meaning: अभीवर्तो ब्रह्मसाम भवति . अभीवर्तेन वै देवा इमान् लोकान् अभ्य-वर्तन्त . यद् अभ्यवर्तन्त तद् अभीवर्तस्याभीवर्तत्वम् . तद् यद् अभीवर्तो ब्रह्मसाम भवत्य् एषाम् एव लोकानाम् अभिवृत्यै . प्रजापतिर् वा अभीवर्तः प्रजाश् छन्दांसि . स एष प्रजापतिः प्रजासु गर्भं दधद् एति . अन्यास्व् अन्यास्व् स्तुवन्ति समानेन साम्ना . रेत एव तत् सिञ्चन्ति . तस्माद् समानो बह्वीष्व् रेतो दधाति . समानीः परस्ताद् ऋचो भवन्त्य् अन्यद् अन्यत् साम . रेत एव तत् सिक्तं प्रजनयन्ति . तस्मात् समाना बहून् सूते . अन्यास्व् अन्यास्व् स्तुवन्ति समानेन साम्ना . अन्यद् अन्यद् धि यन्तः पश्यन्ति . समानीः परस्ताद् ऋचो भवन्त्य् अन्यद् अन्यत् साम . यान् एवेतो लोकान् प्रगाथैर् अभ्यारोहन्तो यन्ति तान् अमुतस् सामभिः प्रत्यवरोहन्त आयन्ति . ऋग् वा अयं लोकस् सामासौ . यद् इतो यन्तस् सामारभ्य यन्त्य् अमुं तल् लोकम् आरभ्य यन्ति . ते यत् पुरस्ताद् विषुवत उत्सृजेरन्न् अवामुष्माल् लोकाच् छिद्येरन् . यद् अमुत आयन्त ऋचम् आरभ्यायन्तीमं तल् लोकम् आरभ्यन्ति .

sanskrit_iast: sakṛt parastād abhīvartaṃ paryasyanti . tasmād garbhā jāyamānāḥ paryāvartante . purā ha khalu vai pañcamān māso bārhatāḥ pragāthā āpyanta . uṣṇihaṃ ca triṣṭubhaṃ ca dve chandasī saṃyujya pañca māsas samāpayeyuḥ . anuṣṭubhaṃ ca paṅktiṃ ca dve chandasī saṃyujya ṣaṇ māsas samāpayeyur ekacchandaḥ pariśiṣya . jagatīṃ tad viṣuvaty upeyuḥ . jāgato vai viṣuvān . sva eva tad āyatane viṣuvantaṃ samardhayanti . chandāṃsi vai svargo lokaḥ . svargam eva tal lokaṃ rohanto yanti . tad āhur vīva vā etac chandāṃsi viśanti yad etāni dve dve saṃyujyanti . kva hy adyatanaṃ ca śvastanaṃ cāhanī saṃpatsyataḥ . sarvāṇy eva sapta caturuttarāṇy upetyānīti . gāyatrīm eva prathame 'hann upetyoṣṇihaṃ dvitīye 'nuṣṭubhaṃ tṛtīye bṛhatyā pañca māsas samāpayeyuḥ . paṅktim eva prathame 'hann upetya triṣṭubhā ṣaṇ māsas samāpayeyur ekacchandaḥ pariśiṣya . jagatīṃ tad viṣuvaty upeyuḥ . jāgato vai viṣuvān . sva eva tad āyatane viṣuvantaṃ samardhayanti . chandāṃsi vai svargo lokaḥ .
sentences: purā ha kʰalu vai pañcamān māso bārhatāḥ pragātʰā āpyanta .
uṣṇihaṃ ca triṣṭubʰaṃ ca dve cʰandasī saṃyujya pañca māsas samāpayeyuḥ .
anuṣṭubʰaṃ ca paṅktiṃ ca dve cʰandasī saṃyujya ṣaṇ māsas samāpayeyur ekaccʰandaḥ pariśiṣya .
sva eva tad āyatane viṣuvantaṃ samardʰayanti .
svargam eva tal lokaṃ rohanto yanti .
tad āhur vīva vā etac cʰandāṃsi viśanti yad etāni dve dve saṃyujyanti .
kva hy adyatanaṃ ca śvastanaṃ cāhanī saṃpatsyataḥ .
gāyatrīm eva pratʰame 'hann upetyoṣṇihaṃ dvitīye 'nuṣṭubʰaṃ tr̥tīye br̥hatyā pañca māsas samāpayeyuḥ .
paṅktim eva pratʰame 'hann upetya triṣṭubʰā ṣaṇ māsas samāpayeyur ekaccʰandaḥ pariśiṣya .
sva eva tad āyatane viṣuvantaṃ samardʰayanti .
text: Once on the far side they transpose the abhivarta. Therefore embryos are turned around as they are born. Formerly, indeed, by the fifth month the barhata pragatha-chants were completed. By combining the two meters usnih and tristubh, they could complete five months. By combining the two meters anustubh and pankti, they could complete six months, with one meter left over. Then they should use the jagati at the visuvat. For the visuvat is of the jagati. In its own seat they thus establish the visuvat. The meters are the heavenly world. They thereby ascend to the heavenly world. They say: 'But it is as though they cut up the meters when they join these two by two. Where will today's day and tomorrow's day come together? They should employ all seven with four additional ones.' They should use the gayatri on the first day, the usnih on the second, the anustubh on the third, and complete five months with the brhati. They should use the pankti on the first day and complete six months with the tristubh, with one meter left over. Then they should use the jagati at the visuvat. For the visuvat is of the jagati. In its own seat they thus establish the visuvat. The meters are the heavenly world.
meaning: सकृत् परस्ताद् अभीवर्तं पर्यस्यन्ति . तस्माद् गर्भा जायमानाः पर्यावर्तन्ते . पुरा ह खलु वै पञ्चमान् मासो बार्हताः प्रगाथा आप्यन्त . उष्णिहं च त्रिष्टुभं च द्वे छन्दसी संयुज्य पञ्च मासस् समापयेयुः . अनुष्टुभं च पङ्क्तिं च द्वे छन्दसी संयुज्य षण् मासस् समापयेयुर् एकच्छन्दः परिशिष्य . जगतीं तद् विषुवत्य् उपेयुः . जागतो वै विषुवान् . स्व एव तद् आयतने विषुवन्तं समर्धयन्ति . छन्दांसि वै स्वर्गो लोकः . स्वर्गम् एव तल् लोकं रोहन्तो यन्ति . तद् आहुर् वीव वा एतच् छन्दांसि विशन्ति यद् एतानि द्वे द्वे संयुज्यन्ति . क्व ह्य् अद्यतनं च श्वस्तनं चाहनी संपत्स्यतः . सर्वाण्य् एव सप्त चतुरुत्तराण्य् उपेत्यानीति . गायत्रीम् एव प्रथमे ऽहन्न् उपेत्योष्णिहं द्वितीये ऽनुष्टुभं तृतीये बृहत्या पञ्च मासस् समापयेयुः . पङ्क्तिम् एव प्रथमे ऽहन्न् उपेत्य त्रिष्टुभा षण् मासस् समापयेयुर् एकच्छन्दः परिशिष्य . जगतीं तद् विषुवत्य् उपेयुः . जागतो वै विषुवान् . स्व एव तद् आयतने विषुवन्तं समर्धयन्ति . छन्दांसि वै स्वर्गो लोकः .

sanskrit_iast: tad āhur ayātayāmānīva vā etac chandāṃsi yuñjati yad enāni yātayāmāni santi . tāni sarvāṇi punaḥ punaḥ prayuñjate . yān eva vīryavattamān pragāthān manyeraṃs tān praṇiścitya ṣaṭtriṃśad upeyur iti . ṣaṭtriṃśadakṣarā vai bṛhatī . bṛhatī svargo lokas sāmrājyam . bṛhatyām eva tat svarge loke sāmrājye pratitiṣṭhanto yanti . ṣaḍutsargaṃ triṃśatā punarabhyāvartam ayātayāmatāyai . atho āhus trayastriṃśad evopetyā iti . trayastriṃśad vai sarvā devatāḥ . sarvāsv evaitad devatāsu pratitiṣṭhanto yanti . trīn utsargaṃ triṃśatā punarabhyāvartam ayātayāmatāyai . atho āhus triṃśad evopetyā iti . triṃśadakṣarā virāḍ annaṃ virāṭ . virājy eva tad annādye pratitiṣṭhanto yanti . atho āhuś caturviṃśatir evopetyā iti . caturviṃśatyardhamāso vai saṃvatsaraḥ . ardhamāsaśa eva tat saṃvatsare pratitiṣṭhanto yanti . atho āhur dvādaśaivopetyā iti . dvādaśa māsās saṃvatsaraḥ . māsaśa eva tat saṃvatsare pratitiṣṭhanto yanti . atho āhuṣ ṣaḍ evopetyā iti . ṣaḍ vā ṛtavaḥ . ṛtuṣv eva tat pratitiṣṭhanto yanti . atho āhuś catvāra evopetyā iti . catasro diśaś catuṣpadāḥ paśavaḥ . dikṣu caitat paśuṣu ca pratitiṣṭhanto yanti . atho āhus traya evopetyā iti . trayo vā ime lokāḥ . eṣv eva tal lokeṣu pratitiṣṭhanto yanti . atho āhur dvāv evopetyāv iti śyaitanaudhasayor eva pragāthāv iti . śyaitanaudhasayor ha khalu vai pragāthau vīryavattamau .
sentences: tad āhur ayātayāmānīva vā etac cʰandāṃsi yuñjati yad enāni yātayāmāni santi .
yān eva vīryavattamān pragātʰān manyeraṃs tān praṇiścitya ṣaṭtriṃśad upeyur iti .
br̥hatyām eva tat svarge loke sāmrājye pratitiṣṭʰanto yanti .
virājy eva tad annādye pratitiṣṭʰanto yanti .
ardʰamāsaśa eva tat saṃvatsare pratitiṣṭʰanto yanti .
māsaśa eva tat saṃvatsare pratitiṣṭʰanto yanti .
dikṣu caitat paśuṣu ca pratitiṣṭʰanto yanti .
eṣv eva tal lokeṣu pratitiṣṭʰanto yanti .
atʰo āhur dvāv evopetyāv iti śyaitanaudʰasayor eva pragātʰāv iti .
śyaitanaudʰasayor ha kʰalu vai pragātʰau vīryavattamau .
text: They say: 'It is as though they yoke meters that are not worn out, since they are [already] worn out. They use them all again and again. They should determine which pragatha-chants they consider most potent and employ thirty-six.' The brhati has thirty-six syllables. The brhati is the heavenly world, sovereign rule. In the brhati, in the heavenly world, in sovereign rule they are established as they go. They release six, and recirculate with thirty, for the sake of freshness. But they say: 'Thirty-three alone should be employed.' Thirty-three are all the deities. In all the deities they are thereby established as they go. They release three, and recirculate with thirty, for the sake of freshness. But they say: 'Thirty alone should be employed.' The viraj has thirty syllables; food is the viraj. In the viraj, in food they are thereby established as they go. But they say: 'Twenty-four alone should be employed.' Twenty-four half-months make the year. By half-months they are thereby established in the year as they go. But they say: 'Twelve alone should be employed.' Twelve months make the year. By months they are thereby established in the year as they go. But they say: 'Six alone should be employed.' Six are the seasons. In the seasons they are thereby established as they go. But they say: 'Four alone should be employed.' Four are the directions; four-footed are the cattle. In the directions and in the cattle they are thereby established as they go. But they say: 'Three alone should be employed.' Three are these worlds. In these worlds they are thereby established as they go. But they say: 'Two alone should be employed -- the two pragatha-chants of the syaita and naudhasa.' For the pragatha-chants of the syaita and naudhasa are the most potent.
meaning: तद् आहुर् अयातयामानीव वा एतच् छन्दांसि युञ्जति यद् एनानि यातयामानि सन्ति . तानि सर्वाणि पुनः पुनः प्रयुञ्जते . यान् एव वीर्यवत्तमान् प्रगाथान् मन्येरंस् तान् प्रणिश्चित्य षट्त्रिंशद् उपेयुर् इति . षट्त्रिंशदक्षरा वै बृहती . बृहती स्वर्गो लोकस् साम्राज्यम् . बृहत्याम् एव तत् स्वर्गे लोके साम्राज्ये प्रतितिष्ठन्तो यन्ति . षडुत्सर्गं त्रिंशता पुनरभ्यावर्तम् अयातयामतायै . अथो आहुस् त्रयस्त्रिंशद् एवोपेत्या इति . त्रयस्त्रिंशद् वै सर्वा देवताः . सर्वास्व् एवैतद् देवतासु प्रतितिष्ठन्तो यन्ति . त्रीन् उत्सर्गं त्रिंशता पुनरभ्यावर्तम् अयातयामतायै . अथो आहुस् त्रिंशद् एवोपेत्या इति . त्रिंशदक्षरा विराड् अन्नं विराट् . विराज्य् एव तद् अन्नाद्ये प्रतितिष्ठन्तो यन्ति . अथो आहुश् चतुर्विंशतिर् एवोपेत्या इति . चतुर्विंशत्यर्धमासो वै संवत्सरः . अर्धमासश एव तत् संवत्सरे प्रतितिष्ठन्तो यन्ति . अथो आहुर् द्वादशैवोपेत्या इति . द्वादश मासास् संवत्सरः . मासश एव तत् संवत्सरे प्रतितिष्ठन्तो यन्ति . अथो आहुष् षड् एवोपेत्या इति . षड् वा ऋतवः . ऋतुष्व् एव तत् प्रतितिष्ठन्तो यन्ति . अथो आहुश् चत्वार एवोपेत्या इति . चतस्रो दिशश् चतुष्पदाः पशवः . दिक्षु चैतत् पशुषु च प्रतितिष्ठन्तो यन्ति . अथो आहुस् त्रय एवोपेत्या इति . त्रयो वा इमे लोकाः . एष्व् एव तल् लोकेषु प्रतितिष्ठन्तो यन्ति . अथो आहुर् द्वाव् एवोपेत्याव् इति श्यैतनौधसयोर् एव प्रगाथाव् इति . श्यैतनौधसयोर् ह खलु वै प्रगाथौ वीर्यवत्तमौ .

sanskrit_iast: yo vai punarnivṛttam adhvānam eti nainaṃ sa samaśnute . atha ya enam apunarnivṛttam eti sa evainaṃ samaśnute . punarnivṛttam ivaite yanti ye dvā upayanti . traiṣṭubhabārhatā evopetyā iti . traiṣṭubhabārhato vai mādhyandinaḥ . tad yad rāthantaram aha syāt tasmin bārhatam upeyur bārhate 'haṃs traiṣṭubham . naiṣāṃ traiṣṭubhāḥ pragāthā āpyante na bārhatāḥ . yathāyatanaṃ chandāṃsi yujyante 'yātayāmānam u saṃvatsaram āsate . tad u vā āhur dvāv evopetyau śyaitanaudhasayor eva pragāthāv iti . athā u ha vai vīryavattamāv etā u ha vai svargasya lokasya me panthāv añjasāyanau yad bṛhadrathantare . tayor ete 'ñjasāyane yac chyaitanaudhase . ahar ahar evaitad añjasā svargaṃ lokam upayanti . tasyaiṣa śloko mahāpathād viśvavayo yad udrudhyate puruṣaḥ tam eva sṛptvājiṃ śrāntaḥ punar abhyājigāṃsati iti . mahāpathe vā ete satyapathaṃ pratipadyante ye 'nyān pragāthān upayanti . athaite ahar-ahar evāñjasā svargaṃ lokam upayanti ye śyaitanaudhasayoḥ pragāthāv upayanti .
sentences: yo vai punarnivr̥ttam adʰvānam eti nainaṃ sa samaśnute .
atʰa ya enam apunarnivr̥ttam eti sa evainaṃ samaśnute .
punarnivr̥ttam ivaite yanti ye dvā upayanti .
tad yad rātʰantaram aha syāt tasmin bārhatam upeyur bārhate 'haṃs traiṣṭubʰam .
naiṣāṃ traiṣṭubʰāḥ pragātʰā āpyante na bārhatāḥ .
yatʰāyatanaṃ cʰandāṃsi yujyante 'yātayāmānam u saṃvatsaram āsate .
tad u vā āhur dvāv evopetyau śyaitanaudʰasayor eva pragātʰāv iti .
atʰā u ha vai vīryavattamāv etā u ha vai svargasya lokasya me pantʰāv añjasāyanau yad br̥hadratʰantare .
ahar ahar evaitad añjasā svargaṃ lokam upayanti .
tam eva sr̥ptvājiṃ śrāntaḥ punar abʰyājigāṃsati
mahāpatʰe vā ete satyapatʰaṃ pratipadyante ye 'nyān pragātʰān upayanti .
atʰaite ahar-ahar evāñjasā svargaṃ lokam upayanti ye śyaitanaudʰasayoḥ pragātʰāv upayanti .
text: He who travels a path that turns back does not reach [the goal]. But he who travels one that does not turn back -- he indeed reaches it. Those who employ two travel as though on a return path. 'Only the traistubha and barhata ones should be employed.' The traistubha and barhata belong to the midday pressing. On a day when there is the rathantara, they should use the barhata on it; on a barhata day, the traistubha. Neither their traistubha pragatha-chants are exhausted nor the barhata ones. The meters are yoked according to their proper places; they sit through the year without staleness. But they say: 'Two alone should be employed -- the two pragatha-chants of the syaita and naudhasa.' These are indeed the most potent. These are the two straight paths to the heavenly world -- the brhat and rathantara. Of these two, the straight paths are the syaita and naudhasa. Day after day they thereby go straight to the heavenly world. Of this there is the verse: 'When a person strays from the great path of universal course, he, having crawled, exhausted, wishes to reach the same course again.' Those who employ other pragatha-chants take a bypath from the great path. But those who employ the pragatha-chants of the syaita and naudhasa -- they go straight to the heavenly world day after day.
meaning: यो वै पुनर्निवृत्तम् अध्वानम् एति नैनं स समश्नुते . अथ य एनम् अपुनर्निवृत्तम् एति स एवैनं समश्नुते . पुनर्निवृत्तम् इवैते यन्ति ये द्वा उपयन्ति . त्रैष्टुभबार्हता एवोपेत्या इति . त्रैष्टुभबार्हतो वै माध्यन्दिनः . तद् यद् राथन्तरम् अह स्यात् तस्मिन् बार्हतम् उपेयुर् बार्हते ऽहंस् त्रैष्टुभम् . नैषां त्रैष्टुभाः प्रगाथा आप्यन्ते न बार्हताः . यथायतनं छन्दांसि युज्यन्ते ऽयातयामानम् उ संवत्सरम् आसते . तद् उ वा आहुर् द्वाव् एवोपेत्यौ श्यैतनौधसयोर् एव प्रगाथाव् इति . अथा उ ह वै वीर्यवत्तमाव् एता उ ह वै स्वर्गस्य लोकस्य मे पन्थाव् अञ्जसायनौ यद् बृहद्रथन्तरे . तयोर् एते ऽञ्जसायने यच् छ्यैतनौधसे . अहर् अहर् एवैतद् अञ्जसा स्वर्गं लोकम् उपयन्ति . तस्यैष श्लोको महापथाद् विश्ववयो यद् उद्रुध्यते पुरुषः तम् एव सृप्त्वाजिं श्रान्तः पुनर् अभ्याजिगांसति इति . महापथे वा एते सत्यपथं प्रतिपद्यन्ते ये ऽन्यान् प्रगाथान् उपयन्ति . अथैते अहर्-अहर् एवाञ्जसा स्वर्गं लोकम् उपयन्ति ये श्यैतनौधसयोः प्रगाथाव् उपयन्ति .

sanskrit_iast: anuṣṭubho vā anyāni sāmāny annam . anuṣṭub evānyeṣāṃ sāmnām annam . yāni vā abhikrāntyapakrāntāni sāmāni tāny anuṣṭubo 'nnam . tair enāṃ ye vyardhayanti tān eṣāvibhūṣitāprītājñātāsvā vāg abhivadaty alūlubhann ṛtūn aśraddadhānā ayakṣata nārātsur iti . atha ya enāṃ tais samardhayanti tān eṣā tṛptā prītā jñātā svā vāg abhivadaty acīkl̥pann ṛtūn śraddadhānā ayakṣatārātsur iti . anvahaṃ sujñānaṃ bhavati . sa ha vā udgātā satriṇas satrāya dīkṣayed (oder : dīkṣayann iyād) yadi ya enān devānāṃ devakṣetram abhyārohayet . na ha vai devānāṃ devakṣetram abhyāruhya bibheti nāśanāyati na pipāsati nārtim ārcchati . sujñānaṃ ha vāva devānāṃ devakṣetram . tad āhuḥ preva vā ete 'smāl lokāc cyavante ye 'nvahaṃ sujñānam upayantīti . tad yad rāthantaram aha syāt tasmin pauṣkalam upeyur bārhate 'han sujñānam . tad u vā āhus sujñāne vāvaitāni sarvāṇi rūpāṇīti .
sentences: yāni vā abʰikrāntyapakrāntāni sāmāni tāny anuṣṭubo 'nnam .
tair enāṃ ye vyardʰayanti tān eṣāvibʰūṣitāprītājñātāsvā vāg abʰivadaty alūlubʰann r̥tūn aśraddadʰānā ayakṣata nārātsur iti .
atʰa ya enāṃ tais samardʰayanti tān eṣā tr̥ptā prītā jñātā svā vāg abʰivadaty acīkl̥pann r̥tūn śraddadʰānā ayakṣatārātsur iti .
sa ha vā udgātā satriṇas satrāya dīkṣayed (oder : dīkṣayann iyād) yadi ya enān devānāṃ devakṣetram abʰyārohayet .
na ha vai devānāṃ devakṣetram abʰyāruhya bibʰeti nāśanāyati na pipāsati nārtim ārccʰati .
tad āhuḥ preva vā ete 'smāl lokāc cyavante ye 'nvahaṃ sujñānam upayantīti .
tad yad rātʰantaram aha syāt tasmin pauṣkalam upeyur bārhate 'han sujñānam .
tad u vā āhus sujñāne vāvaitāni sarvāṇi rūpāṇīti .
text: The other saman-chants of the anustubh are food. The anustubh is the food of the other saman-chants. Those saman-chants that have approach and departure [movements] are the food of the anustubh. Those who impair them -- to them this speech, unadorned, unsatisfied, unrecognized, speaks: 'Unharmonious, faithless, they sacrificed with the seasons -- they did not obtain.' But those who fulfill them -- to them this speech, satisfied, pleased, recognized, speaks: 'Harmonious, faithful, they sacrificed with the seasons -- they obtained.' The sujnana is performed daily. The udgatr should indeed consecrate the sattra-performers for the sattra, so that he may lead them to the divine realm of the gods. For one who has ascended to the divine realm of the gods does not fear, does not hunger, does not thirst, does not suffer distress. The sujnana is indeed the divine realm of the gods. They say: 'Those who perform the sujnana daily depart, as it were, from this world.' On a day when there is the rathantara, they should perform the pauskala on it; on a barhata day, the sujnana. But they say: 'In the sujnana indeed are all these forms.'
meaning: अनुष्टुभो वा अन्यानि सामान्य् अन्नम् . अनुष्टुब् एवान्येषां साम्नाम् अन्नम् . यानि वा अभिक्रान्त्यपक्रान्तानि सामानि तान्य् अनुष्टुबो ऽन्नम् . तैर् एनां ये व्यर्धयन्ति तान् एषाविभूषिताप्रीताज्ञातास्वा वाग् अभिवदत्य् अलूलुभन्न् ऋतून् अश्रद्दधाना अयक्षत नारात्सुर् इति . अथ य एनां तैस् समर्धयन्ति तान् एषा तृप्ता प्रीता ज्ञाता स्वा वाग् अभिवदत्य् अचीक्ल्̥पन्न् ऋतून् श्रद्दधाना अयक्षतारात्सुर् इति . अन्वहं सुज्ञानं भवति . स ह वा उद्गाता सत्रिणस् सत्राय दीक्षयेद् (ओदेर् : दीक्षयन्न् इयाद्) यदि य एनान् देवानां देवक्षेत्रम् अभ्यारोहयेत् . न ह वै देवानां देवक्षेत्रम् अभ्यारुह्य बिभेति नाशनायति न पिपासति नार्तिम् आर्च्छति . सुज्ञानं ह वाव देवानां देवक्षेत्रम् . तद् आहुः प्रेव वा एते ऽस्माल् लोकाच् च्यवन्ते ये ऽन्वहं सुज्ञानम् उपयन्तीति . तद् यद् राथन्तरम् अह स्यात् तस्मिन् पौष्कलम् उपेयुर् बार्हते ऽहन् सुज्ञानम् . तद् उ वा आहुस् सुज्ञाने वावैतानि सर्वाणि रूपाणीति .

sanskrit_iast: tat saptākṣaraṇidhanaṃ bhavati . sapta vai prāṇāḥ . prāṇair eva tat samṛdhyamānā yanti prāṇeṣu pratitiṣṭhantaḥ . anvahaṃ gaurivītaṃ bhavati . atiriktaṃ vā etad brahmaṇo yad gaurivītam . atiriktāny etāny ahāni yāny ahīnasya . atiriktā eva tad atiriktaṃ brahmaṇo rasaṃ dadhato yanti . anvahaṃ plavo bhavati svargasyaiva lokasya samaṣṭyai . e ity evāntarikṣam atiplavante . āti viśvāni duritā tarem eti yat kiṃ ca yajñasya duṣṭutaṃ duśśastaṃ vidhuraṃ tad atitaranti . tad dvādaśākṣaraṇidhanaṃ bhavati . dvādaśa māsās saṃvatsaraḥ . māseṣv eva tat saṃvatsare pratitiṣṭhanto yanti . tad āhuḥ preva vā ete 'smāl lokāc cyavante ya etān parācaṣ ṣaḍahān upayantīti . okonidhanaṃ ṣaṣṭhe 'hani kuryuḥ . ayaṃ vai lokaḥ puruṣasyaukaḥ . asminn evaital loke pratitiṣṭhanti . tad v evācakṣate prahitos saṃyojanam iti . ahorātre vai prahitau . prahite iva hy ete carataḥ . atha ha vā etat ṣaḍahā vīva chidyante yadā ṣaṣṭham ahar āgacchanti . sa yathāśvaṃ saṃyojanena saṃyujyād evam evaitena sāmnā ṣaḍahān saṃyuñjanto yanti . tad āhuḥ kāryam okonidhanaṃ pṛṣṭhye ṣaḍahā3 iti nā3 iti . neti brūyāt . etadagrā vai ṣaḍahā yat pṛṣṭhya etadantā . etaṃ vāvaitena prepsyanty etam abhīvartenaitaṃ plavenaitaṃ sujñānena . punaḥprayoga iva syād yad etad atra kuryuḥ .
sentences: prāṇair eva tat samr̥dʰyamānā yanti prāṇeṣu pratitiṣṭʰantaḥ .
atiriktaṃ vā etad brahmaṇo yad gaurivītam .
atiriktā eva tad atiriktaṃ brahmaṇo rasaṃ dadʰato yanti .
anvahaṃ plavo bʰavati svargasyaiva lokasya samaṣṭyai .
āti viśvāni duritā tarem eti yat kiṃ ca yajñasya duṣṭutaṃ duśśastaṃ vidʰuraṃ tad atitaranti .
māseṣv eva tat saṃvatsare pratitiṣṭʰanto yanti .
tad āhuḥ preva vā ete 'smāl lokāc cyavante ya etān parācaṣ ṣaḍahān upayantīti .
tad v evācakṣate prahitos saṃyojanam iti .
atʰa ha vā etat ṣaḍahā vīva cʰidyante yadā ṣaṣṭʰam ahar āgaccʰanti .
sa yatʰāśvaṃ saṃyojanena saṃyujyād evam evaitena sāmnā ṣaḍahān saṃyuñjanto yanti .
tad āhuḥ kāryam okonidʰanaṃ pr̥ṣṭʰye ṣaḍahā3 iti nā3 iti .
etadagrā vai ṣaḍahā yat pr̥ṣṭʰya etadantā .
etaṃ vāvaitena prepsyanty etam abʰīvartenaitaṃ plavenaitaṃ sujñānena .
punaḥprayoga iva syād yad etad atra kuryuḥ .
text: Its closing phrase (nidhana) has seven syllables. Seven are the vital breaths (prana). By the vital breaths they go forth prospering, being established in the vital breaths. The gaurivita is performed daily. The gaurivita is the surplus of brahman. These days of the ahina [multi-day rite] are surplus. By the surplus they thereby go placing the surplus essence of brahman. The plava is performed daily, for the attainment of the heavenly world. With 'e' they float over the midspace. 'May we cross over all misfortunes' -- whatever in the sacrifice is ill-chanted, ill-recited, or disordered, that they cross over. Its closing phrase has twelve syllables. Twelve months make the year. In the months, in the year, they are established as they go. They say: 'Those who perform these distant sadahas depart, as it were, from this world.' They should use the oka-ending on the sixth day. This world is a person's dwelling (oka). In this very world they are thereby established. They also call it 'the conjunction of the dispatched.' Day and night are the dispatched. For these two travel as though dispatched. And these sadahas are cut apart, as it were, when they reach the sixth day. Just as one would join a horse with a harness, so they join the sadahas by means of this saman as they go. They say: 'Should the oka-ending be used in the prsthya sadaha?' 'No,' one should say. For the sadahas begin with the prsthya and end with it. It is this very [goal] they seek to reach -- by the abhivarta, by the plava, by the sujnana. If they were to use it here, it would be like a repetition of the procedure.
meaning: तत् सप्ताक्षरणिधनं भवति . सप्त वै प्राणाः . प्राणैर् एव तत् समृध्यमाना यन्ति प्राणेषु प्रतितिष्ठन्तः . अन्वहं गौरिवीतं भवति . अतिरिक्तं वा एतद् ब्रह्मणो यद् गौरिवीतम् . अतिरिक्तान्य् एतान्य् अहानि यान्य् अहीनस्य . अतिरिक्ता एव तद् अतिरिक्तं ब्रह्मणो रसं दधतो यन्ति . अन्वहं प्लवो भवति स्वर्गस्यैव लोकस्य समष्ट्यै . ए इत्य् एवान्तरिक्षम् अतिप्लवन्ते . आति विश्वानि दुरिता तरेम् एति यत् किं च यज्ञस्य दुष्टुतं दुश्शस्तं विधुरं तद् अतितरन्ति . तद् द्वादशाक्षरणिधनं भवति . द्वादश मासास् संवत्सरः . मासेष्व् एव तत् संवत्सरे प्रतितिष्ठन्तो यन्ति . तद् आहुः प्रेव वा एते ऽस्माल् लोकाच् च्यवन्ते य एतान् पराचष् षडहान् उपयन्तीति . ओकोनिधनं षष्ठे ऽहनि कुर्युः . अयं वै लोकः पुरुषस्यौकः . अस्मिन्न् एवैतल् लोके प्रतितिष्ठन्ति . तद् व् एवाचक्षते प्रहितोस् संयोजनम् इति . अहोरात्रे वै प्रहितौ . प्रहिते इव ह्य् एते चरतः . अथ ह वा एतत् षडहा वीव छिद्यन्ते यदा षष्ठम् अहर् आगच्छन्ति . स यथाश्वं संयोजनेन संयुज्याद् एवम् एवैतेन साम्ना षडहान् संयुञ्जन्तो यन्ति . तद् आहुः कार्यम् ओकोनिधनं पृष्ठ्ये षडहा३ इति ना३ इति . नेति ब्रूयात् . एतदग्रा वै षडहा यत् पृष्ठ्य एतदन्ता . एतं वावैतेन प्रेप्स्यन्त्य् एतम् अभीवर्तेनैतं प्लवेनैतं सुज्ञानेन . पुनःप्रयोग इव स्याद् यद् एतद् अत्र कुर्युः .

sanskrit_iast: svarbhānur vā āsura ādityaṃtamasāvidhyat . taṃ devāś carṣayaś cābhiṣajyan . ta etāni svarāṇy apaśyan . tair enam aspṛṇvan . yad aspṛṇvaṃs tat svarāṇāṃ svaratvam . tad yad etāni svarāṇi bhavanty ādityam evaitai spṛṇvanti . yādṛg aha vai manuṣyo devebhyaḥ karoti tādṛg asmai devāḥ kurvanti . tad yad etāni svarāṇi bhavanty ātmānam evaitai spṛṇvate . saptadaśā svarasāmāno bhavanty ekaviṃśo viṣuvān . prajāpatir vai saptadaśo 'sāv āditya ekaviṃśaḥ . pitraiva tat putraṃ paryūhanti . pitā hi putrāya kantamaḥ putro hi pitre kantamaḥ . yad atrānyaṃ stomam avadadhyuḥ prāsau taṃ tejasā dahed agnir vaiśvānaraḥ prajā ādadīta . ṣaḍ ete svarasāmāno bhavanti . ṣaḍ ṛtavaḥ . ṛtuṣv evainaṃ tad adhyūhanti tasmād eṣas trīn ṛtūn dakṣiṇaiti trīn udaṅ . sa yathā putraḥ pitr̥̄n anusaṃcaret tādṛg evaitad ajāmitāyai . ajāmi hi putraḥ pitr̥̄n anusaṃcarati . athaitau viśvajidabhijitāv abhita stomānāṃ vīryam . vīryeṇa ha vā etau viṣuvantaṃ dādhartuḥ . tad āhu stomakṛntatram iva vā etat stomā yanti yat trayastriṃśāt saptadaśam upayantīti . purastād eva pṛṣṭhyasya ṣaḍahasyābhijitam upetya pṛṣṭhyasyaiva ṣaḍahasya yan madhye saptadaśam ahas tad upariṣṭāt trayastriṃśasya paryūheyuḥ .
sentences: tad yad etāni svarāṇi bʰavanty ādityam evaitai spr̥ṇvanti .
yādr̥g aha vai manuṣyo devebʰyaḥ karoti tādr̥g asmai devāḥ kurvanti .
tad yad etāni svarāṇi bʰavanty ātmānam evaitai spr̥ṇvate .
pitā hi putrāya kantamaḥ putro hi pitre kantamaḥ .
yad atrānyaṃ stomam avadadʰyuḥ prāsau taṃ tejasā dahed agnir vaiśvānaraḥ prajā ādadīta .
r̥tuṣv evainaṃ tad adʰyūhanti tasmād eṣas trīn r̥tūn dakṣiṇaiti trīn udaṅ .
sa yatʰā putraḥ pitr̥̄n anusaṃcaret tādr̥g evaitad ajāmitāyai .
vīryeṇa ha vā etau viṣuvantaṃ dādʰartuḥ .
tad āhu stomakr̥ntatram iva vā etat stomā yanti yat trayastriṃśāt saptadaśam upayantīti .
purastād eva pr̥ṣṭʰyasya ṣaḍahasyābʰijitam upetya pr̥ṣṭʰyasyaiva ṣaḍahasya yan madʰye saptadaśam ahas tad upariṣṭāt trayastriṃśasya paryūheyuḥ .
text: Svarbhanu the Asura struck the sun (Aditya) with darkness. The gods and the seers healed him. They perceived these svara-chants. With those they restored him. Because they restored him (asprnvan), that is the svara-nature of the svara-chants. Since these svara-chants exist, by them they restore the sun. Whatever a man does for the gods, the same the gods do for him. Since these svara-chants exist, by them they restore themselves. The svara-saman days have the saptadasa [seventeen-fold stoma]; the visuvat has the ekavimsa [twenty-one-fold]. Prajapati is the saptadasa; the sun yonder is the ekavimsa. Thereby they convey the son around the father. For the father is dearest to the son, and the son is dearest to the father. If one were to place another stoma there, yonder [sun] would burn him with its splendor; the vaisvanara fire would seize the offspring. These six svara-saman days exist. Six are the seasons. In the seasons they thereby convey him around; therefore he goes south for three seasons and north for three. Just as a son follows after his fathers -- so it is, for the sake of non-kinship-violation. For a son follows his fathers without kinship-violation. Now these two, the visvajit and abhijit, stand on both sides as the power of the stomas. By their power they support the visuvat. They say: 'It is as though it is a cutting of the stomas -- the stomas go from the trayastrimsa to the saptadasa.' Having employed the abhijit before the prsthya sadaha, whatever day in the middle of the prsthya sadaha is the saptadasa day, that they should arrange beyond the trayastrimsa.
meaning: स्वर्भानुर् वा आसुर आदित्यंतमसाविध्यत् . तं देवाश् चर्षयश् चाभिषज्यन् . त एतानि स्वराण्य् अपश्यन् . तैर् एनम् अस्पृण्वन् . यद् अस्पृण्वंस् तत् स्वराणां स्वरत्वम् . तद् यद् एतानि स्वराणि भवन्त्य् आदित्यम् एवैतै स्पृण्वन्ति . यादृग् अह वै मनुष्यो देवेभ्यः करोति तादृग् अस्मै देवाः कुर्वन्ति . तद् यद् एतानि स्वराणि भवन्त्य् आत्मानम् एवैतै स्पृण्वते . सप्तदशा स्वरसामानो भवन्त्य् एकविंशो विषुवान् . प्रजापतिर् वै सप्तदशो ऽसाव् आदित्य एकविंशः . पित्रैव तत् पुत्रं पर्यूहन्ति . पिता हि पुत्राय कन्तमः पुत्रो हि पित्रे कन्तमः . यद् अत्रान्यं स्तोमम् अवदध्युः प्रासौ तं तेजसा दहेद् अग्निर् वैश्वानरः प्रजा आददीत . षड् एते स्वरसामानो भवन्ति . षड् ऋतवः . ऋतुष्व् एवैनं तद् अध्यूहन्ति तस्माद् एषस् त्रीन् ऋतून् दक्षिणैति त्रीन् उदङ् . स यथा पुत्रः पित्र्̥̄न् अनुसंचरेत् तादृग् एवैतद् अजामितायै . अजामि हि पुत्रः पित्र्̥̄न् अनुसंचरति . अथैतौ विश्वजिदभिजिताव् अभित स्तोमानां वीर्यम् . वीर्येण ह वा एतौ विषुवन्तं दाधर्तुः . तद् आहु स्तोमकृन्तत्रम् इव वा एतत् स्तोमा यन्ति यत् त्रयस्त्रिंशात् सप्तदशम् उपयन्तीति . पुरस्ताद् एव पृष्ठ्यस्य षडहस्याभिजितम् उपेत्य पृष्ठ्यस्यैव षडहस्य यन् मध्ये सप्तदशम् अहस् तद् उपरिष्टात् त्रयस्त्रिंशस्य पर्यूहेयुः .

sanskrit_iast: tad āhur ātmā vai pṛṣṭhyaṣ ṣaḍaho 'nnaṃ saptadaśaḥ . yat pṛṣṭhyāt ṣaḍahāt saptadaśaṃ nirhareyur annādyaṃ bahirdhā kuryur aśanāyukā syuḥ . trayastriṃśād evopetyam iti . trayastriṃśad vai sarvā devatāḥ . sarvā u ha vai devatās saṃpadya prajāpatim ud vā āpnuvanti na vā . tat tat samād eva samam upayanti . varṣmaṇo vā varṣma . varṣma hi pitā . atho utkrāntir eva . pitā hi putrāc chreyān . ta ukthyā bhavanti paśavo vā ukthāni paśūnām evāvaruddhyai . tad āhur vilomeva vā etad yajñaḥ kriyate yadāgniṣṭomau viśvajidabhijitau bhavato 'gniṣṭomo viṣuvān ukthyā svarasāmānaḥ . sarva evāgniṣṭomāḥ kāryā iti . varṣma vā agniṣṭomo varṣma viṣuvān . varṣmaṇaiva tad varṣma saṃdadhati . varṣmaṇā varṣma rohanti . tejo vā agniṣṭomas tejo viṣuvāṃs tejasaiva tat tejas saṃdadhati tejasā tejo rohanti . atha ha kāmyakīyā iti satriṇo 'yasthūṇagṛhapatayas satraṃ niṣeduḥ . tān hendradyumno bhāllabeyo 'bhipradhāvayāṃ cakāra -putraṃ viṣuvatā stāvayiṣyāmīti . teṣāṃ ha pṛṣṭhyasya ṣaḍahasyaikenāhnāstutam ājagāma . sa hovāca sādhu haivākṛta yad astoḍhvam . yat tv aham ihābhaviṣyam anyathāto viṣuvantam akalpayiṣyam iti . kathaṃ bhagavo 'kalpayiṣya iti hainaṃ putra uvāca .
sentences: tad āhur ātmā vai pr̥ṣṭʰyaṣ ṣaḍaho 'nnaṃ saptadaśaḥ .
yat pr̥ṣṭʰyāt ṣaḍahāt saptadaśaṃ nirhareyur annādyaṃ bahirdʰā kuryur aśanāyukā syuḥ .
sarvā u ha vai devatās saṃpadya prajāpatim ud vā āpnuvanti na vā .
tat tat samād eva samam upayanti .
ta uktʰyā bʰavanti paśavo vā uktʰāni paśūnām evāvaruddʰyai .
tad āhur vilomeva vā etad yajñaḥ kriyate yadāgniṣṭomau viśvajidabʰijitau bʰavato 'gniṣṭomo viṣuvān uktʰyā svarasāmānaḥ .
tejo vā agniṣṭomas tejo viṣuvāṃs tejasaiva tat tejas saṃdadʰati tejasā tejo rohanti .
atʰa ha kāmyakīyā iti satriṇo 'yastʰūṇagr̥hapatayas satraṃ niṣeduḥ .
tān hendradyumno bʰāllabeyo 'bʰipradʰāvayāṃ cakāra -putraṃ viṣuvatā stāvayiṣyāmīti .
sa hovāca sādʰu haivākr̥ta yad astoḍʰvam .
yat tv aham ihābʰaviṣyam anyatʰāto viṣuvantam akalpayiṣyam iti .
katʰaṃ bʰagavo 'kalpayiṣya iti hainaṃ putra uvāca .
text: They say: 'The prsthya sadaha is the self (atman); the saptadasa is food. If they were to remove the saptadasa from the prsthya sadaha, they would place the food outside; they would become hungry.' It should be employed from the trayastrimsa only. Thirty-three are all the deities. All the deities, having united with Prajapati, may or may not attain [the goal]. Thus they go from the even to the even. It is eminence from eminence. For the father is eminence. Moreover, it is an ascent. For the father is greater than the son. They are ukthya-days -- the uktha-chants are cattle -- for the securing of cattle. They say: 'It is as though the sacrifice is performed in reverse when the visvajit and abhijit are agnistomas, the visuvat is an agnistoma, and the svara-saman days are ukthya.' All should be agnistomas, they say. The agnistoma is eminence; the visuvat is eminence. With eminence they thereby join eminence; through eminence they ascend to eminence. The agnistoma is splendor; the visuvat is splendor. With splendor they thereby join splendor; through splendor they ascend to splendor. Now, the Kamyakiyas -- sattra-performers who were householders without iron pillars -- sat for a sattra. Indradyumna Bhallabeya urged them on, [saying]: 'I will have my son chant at the visuvat.' He arrived when one day of their prsthya sadaha remained unchanted. He said: 'You have done well in that you have not yet chanted. But if I had been here, I would have arranged the visuvat differently.' 'How would you have arranged it, sir?' his son asked.
meaning: तद् आहुर् आत्मा वै पृष्ठ्यष् षडहो ऽन्नं सप्तदशः . यत् पृष्ठ्यात् षडहात् सप्तदशं निर्हरेयुर् अन्नाद्यं बहिर्धा कुर्युर् अशनायुका स्युः . त्रयस्त्रिंशाद् एवोपेत्यम् इति . त्रयस्त्रिंशद् वै सर्वा देवताः . सर्वा उ ह वै देवतास् संपद्य प्रजापतिम् उद् वा आप्नुवन्ति न वा . तत् तत् समाद् एव समम् उपयन्ति . वर्ष्मणो वा वर्ष्म . वर्ष्म हि पिता . अथो उत्क्रान्तिर् एव . पिता हि पुत्राच् छ्रेयान् . त उक्थ्या भवन्ति पशवो वा उक्थानि पशूनाम् एवावरुद्ध्यै . तद् आहुर् विलोमेव वा एतद् यज्ञः क्रियते यदाग्निष्टोमौ विश्वजिदभिजितौ भवतो ऽग्निष्टोमो विषुवान् उक्थ्या स्वरसामानः . सर्व एवाग्निष्टोमाः कार्या इति . वर्ष्म वा अग्निष्टोमो वर्ष्म विषुवान् . वर्ष्मणैव तद् वर्ष्म संदधति . वर्ष्मणा वर्ष्म रोहन्ति . तेजो वा अग्निष्टोमस् तेजो विषुवांस् तेजसैव तत् तेजस् संदधति तेजसा तेजो रोहन्ति . अथ ह काम्यकीया इति सत्रिणो ऽयस्थूणगृहपतयस् सत्रं निषेदुः . तान् हेन्द्रद्युम्नो भाल्लबेयो ऽभिप्रधावयां चकार -पुत्रं विषुवता स्तावयिष्यामीति . तेषां ह पृष्ठ्यस्य षडहस्यैकेनाह्नास्तुतम् आजगाम . स होवाच साधु हैवाकृत यद् अस्तोढ्वम् . यत् त्व् अहम् इहाभविष्यम् अन्यथातो विषुवन्तम् अकल्पयिष्यम् इति . कथं भगवो ऽकल्पयिष्य इति हैनं पुत्र उवाच .

sanskrit_iast: ātmā vai pṛṣṭhyaṣ ṣaḍahaḥ prajā svarasāmānaḥ . prajo vā asmat pareti . vāg vai vayam ime smaḥ . vāg asmat pareti . tad yad eṣo 'bhijid antareṇa bhavati prajananaṃ vā eṣa etad antardhāyaiva tiṣṭhati . taṃ yat purastāt pṛṣṭhyasya ṣaḍahasya paryūhanty anantarhitāt prajananāt prajāyāmahā iti . ta u vai saptadaśā bhavanti . prajāpatir vai saptadaśaḥ . prajāpatiḥ prajānāṃ prajanayitā . sa yaḥ prajānāṃ prajanayitā tena prajātāḥ prajāyāmahā iti . ta u vā ānuṣṭubhā bhavanti vāg vā anuṣṭub vāk prajananaṃ vācaḥ prajananāt prajāyāmahā iti . ta u vā ukthyā bhavanti paśavo vā ukthāny annaṃ paśavaḥ paśubhyo 'nnādyāt prajāṃ ned antarayāmeti . tad u hovāca śāṭyāyanir anādṛtya bhāllabeyasya vadanam abhijita evādhyupetyam . yo vā eṣa pṛṣṭhyaṣ ṣaḍahas sa evābhijit . āyatanena ye vā ete pṛṣṭhyasya ṣaḍahasya stomās ta evaite . eko vai pṛṣṭhye ṣaḍahe saptadaśaḥ . athaitasmiṃs trayas saptadaśāḥ . taṃ vāvaitad etaṃ stomaṃ kṛtvā prajanayanti . tad yat saptadaśād eva saptadaśaṃ prajanayanti saptadaśāt saptadaśaṃ saptadaśāt saptadaśam . parastād u vai viśvajiti trayas saptadaśāḥ . te vāvaitad ubhaye saṃpadya prajanayanti . teṣāṃ vā atra pratiṣṭhā .
sentences: ātmā vai pr̥ṣṭʰyaṣ ṣaḍahaḥ prajā svarasāmānaḥ .
tad yad eṣo 'bʰijid antareṇa bʰavati prajananaṃ vā eṣa etad antardʰāyaiva tiṣṭʰati .
taṃ yat purastāt pr̥ṣṭʰyasya ṣaḍahasya paryūhanty anantarhitāt prajananāt prajāyāmahā iti .
sa yaḥ prajānāṃ prajanayitā tena prajātāḥ prajāyāmahā iti .
ta u vā ānuṣṭubʰā bʰavanti vāg vā anuṣṭub vāk prajananaṃ vācaḥ prajananāt prajāyāmahā iti .
ta u vā uktʰyā bʰavanti paśavo vā uktʰāny annaṃ paśavaḥ paśubʰyo 'nnādyāt prajāṃ ned antarayāmeti .
tad u hovāca śāṭyāyanir anādr̥tya bʰāllabeyasya vadanam abʰijita evādʰyupetyam .
yo vā eṣa pr̥ṣṭʰyaṣ ṣaḍahas sa evābʰijit .
āyatanena ye vā ete pr̥ṣṭʰyasya ṣaḍahasya stomās ta evaite .
taṃ vāvaitad etaṃ stomaṃ kr̥tvā prajanayanti .
tad yat saptadaśād eva saptadaśaṃ prajanayanti saptadaśāt saptadaśaṃ saptadaśāt saptadaśam .
parastād u vai viśvajiti trayas saptadaśāḥ .
text: The prsthya sadaha is the self; the svara-saman days are the offspring. Offspring indeed goes forth from us. We are speech. Speech goes forth from us. Since this abhijit stands in between, it is as though the procreative power stands concealed. When they arrange it before the prsthya sadaha, [they think:] 'May we be reproduced from unconcealed procreation.' Those are saptadasa [seventeen-fold]. Prajapati is the saptadasa. Prajapati is the progenitor of offspring. 'By him who is the progenitor of offspring, may we be reproduced,' [they think]. Those are of the anustubh meter. Speech is the anustubh; speech is procreation. 'From the procreative power of speech may we be reproduced,' [they think]. Those are ukthya-days. The uktha-chants are cattle; food is cattle. 'By cattle, by food, may we not obstruct offspring,' [they think]. Thereupon Satyayani said, disregarding Bhallabeya's statement: 'It should be employed at the abhijit itself. This prsthya sadaha is itself the abhijit -- by its seat. Those stomas which belong to the prsthya sadaha are these very ones. In the prsthya sadaha there is one saptadasa. But in this [arrangement] there are three saptadasas. They thereby make this stoma and generate from it. Since they generate saptadasa from saptadasa, saptadasa from saptadasa, saptadasa from saptadasa -- and beyond the visvajit there are three saptadasas -- those two groups, having united, generate. There is their establishment.'
meaning: आत्मा वै पृष्ठ्यष् षडहः प्रजा स्वरसामानः . प्रजो वा अस्मत् परेति . वाग् वै वयम् इमे स्मः . वाग् अस्मत् परेति . तद् यद् एषो ऽभिजिद् अन्तरेण भवति प्रजननं वा एष एतद् अन्तर्धायैव तिष्ठति . तं यत् पुरस्तात् पृष्ठ्यस्य षडहस्य पर्यूहन्त्य् अनन्तर्हितात् प्रजननात् प्रजायामहा इति . त उ वै सप्तदशा भवन्ति . प्रजापतिर् वै सप्तदशः . प्रजापतिः प्रजानां प्रजनयिता . स यः प्रजानां प्रजनयिता तेन प्रजाताः प्रजायामहा इति . त उ वा आनुष्टुभा भवन्ति वाग् वा अनुष्टुब् वाक् प्रजननं वाचः प्रजननात् प्रजायामहा इति . त उ वा उक्थ्या भवन्ति पशवो वा उक्थान्य् अन्नं पशवः पशुभ्यो ऽन्नाद्यात् प्रजां नेद् अन्तरयामेति . तद् उ होवाच शाट्यायनिर् अनादृत्य भाल्लबेयस्य वदनम् अभिजित एवाध्युपेत्यम् . यो वा एष पृष्ठ्यष् षडहस् स एवाभिजित् . आयतनेन ये वा एते पृष्ठ्यस्य षडहस्य स्तोमास् त एवैते . एको वै पृष्ठ्ये षडहे सप्तदशः . अथैतस्मिंस् त्रयस् सप्तदशाः . तं वावैतद् एतं स्तोमं कृत्वा प्रजनयन्ति . तद् यत् सप्तदशाद् एव सप्तदशं प्रजनयन्ति सप्तदशात् सप्तदशं सप्तदशात् सप्तदशम् . परस्ताद् उ वै विश्वजिति त्रयस् सप्तदशाः . ते वावैतद् उभये संपद्य प्रजनयन्ति . तेषां वा अत्र प्रतिष्ठा .

sanskrit_iast: ekaviṃśo viṣuvān bhavati . ekaviṃśo vā asya bhuvanasya viṣuvān . dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavas traya ime lokā asāv āditya ekaviṃśaḥ . sarvasmin vā eṣo 'sminn adhi pratiṣṭhitaḥ . tad yasminn eṣa sarvasminn adhi pratiṣṭhitas tasmin sarvasminn adhi pratitiṣṭhāmeti . tasmād vāyavyānuṣṭup pratipad bhavati . vāk ca vai vāyuś caitaṃ devatānām ānaśānau . tau yāv etaṃ devatānām ānaśānau tābhyām enam aśnavāmahā iti . yad dha vai vāyur na paveta prāsāv idaṃ tejasā dahed agnir vaiśvānaraḥ prajā ādadīta.vāyavyā pratipad bhavaty agner eva vaiśvānarasya śāntyā apradāhāya . tad āhur vīva vā ete prāṇair ṛdhyante ye pāvamānībhiḥ pratipadyanta iti . tad yad eṣā vāyavyā pratipad bhavati prāṇo vai vāyuḥ prāṇair eva tat samṛdhyante . vāyo śukro ayāmi ta iti śukravatī bhavati . śukriyaṃ hy etad ahaḥ . madhvo agraṃ diviṣṭiṣv iti tad u madhavyā agryā brahmavarcasino bhavanti . ā yāhi somapītaya iti saumī tena pāvamānī kriyate . spārho deva niyutvate ty asyau vai spārho 'nnaṃ niyutvad etam eva tad annādyenābhyupayanti . yo vai śreyāṃsam āharann upaiti prati vai sa taṃ nandati . atha ya enam anāharann upaiti na vai sa taṃ pratinandati . tad yad eṣā vāyavyānuṣṭup pratipad bhavaty eṣa naḥ pratinandād etam ṛdhnavāmeti . tad u vā āhuḥ pavasva vāco agriya ity eva pratipat kāryeti . vāg vā iyaṃ vitatā yad ime lokāḥ . tasyā ado 'graṃ tapati yad asāv ādityaḥ . tad yad eṣā pavasva vāco agriya iti pratipad bhavaty etam evaitad etayā abhipratipadyante . sa yathātmanātmānam ārabhetaivam evainam etat svena rūpeṇārabhante .
sentences: dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavas traya ime lokā asāv āditya ekaviṃśaḥ .
tad yasminn eṣa sarvasminn adʰi pratiṣṭʰitas tasmin sarvasminn adʰi pratitiṣṭʰāmeti .
vāk ca vai vāyuś caitaṃ devatānām ānaśānau .
tau yāv etaṃ devatānām ānaśānau tābʰyām enam aśnavāmahā iti .
yad dʰa vai vāyur na paveta prāsāv idaṃ tejasā dahed agnir vaiśvānaraḥ prajā ādadīta.vāyavyā pratipad bʰavaty agner eva vaiśvānarasya śāntyā apradāhāya .
tad āhur vīva vā ete prāṇair r̥dʰyante ye pāvamānībʰiḥ pratipadyanta iti .
tad yad eṣā vāyavyā pratipad bʰavati prāṇo vai vāyuḥ prāṇair eva tat samr̥dʰyante .
vāyo śukro ayāmi ta iti śukravatī bʰavati .
madʰvo agraṃ diviṣṭiṣv iti tad u madʰavyā agryā brahmavarcasino bʰavanti .
ā yāhi somapītaya iti saumī tena pāvamānī kriyate .
spārho deva niyutvate ty asyau vai spārho 'nnaṃ niyutvad etam eva tad annādyenābʰyupayanti .
yo vai śreyāṃsam āharann upaiti prati vai sa taṃ nandati .
atʰa ya enam anāharann upaiti na vai sa taṃ pratinandati .
tad yad eṣā vāyavyānuṣṭup pratipad bʰavaty eṣa naḥ pratinandād etam r̥dʰnavāmeti .
tad u vā āhuḥ pavasva vāco agriya ity eva pratipat kāryeti .
vāg vā iyaṃ vitatā yad ime lokāḥ .
tasyā ado 'graṃ tapati yad asāv ādityaḥ .
tad yad eṣā pavasva vāco agriya iti pratipad bʰavaty etam evaitad etayā abʰipratipadyante .
sa yatʰātmanātmānam ārabʰetaivam evainam etat svena rūpeṇārabʰante .
text: The visuvat has the ekavimsa [twenty-one-fold stoma]. The ekavimsa is the visuvat of this universe. Twelve months, five seasons, three worlds, and the sun yonder -- [that is] twenty-one. In all of this he is established. 'May we be established in all of that in which he is established,' [they think]. Therefore the opening verse (pratipad) is a vayavya anustubh. Speech and wind -- these two are the ones who have consumed among the deities. 'By those two, who have consumed among the deities, may we consume him,' [they think]. If wind did not blow, yonder [sun] would burn this [world] with its splendor; the vaisvanara fire would seize the offspring. The opening verse is vayavya -- for the pacification of the vaisvanara fire, to prevent burning. They say: 'Those who begin with the pavamani verses are diminished, as it were, in vital breaths.' Since this opening verse is vayavya -- wind is breath (prana) -- by the vital breaths they thereby prosper. 'O Vayu, bright, I come to you' -- it contains the word 'bright' (sukra). For this is the bright day. 'The first of the divine libation' -- thereby those who are foremost become possessors of brahmanical splendor. 'Come to the soma-drinking' -- it is of Soma; thereby the pavamani is performed. 'Desirable, O god, with the Niyutvat team' -- yonder [sun] is desirable, food is the niyutvat; by food they thereby approach him.
