sanskrit_iast: tad vaiśvānarīyāsu bhavati . vaiśvānarasya hy etat stotram . aśītyakṣarāsu bhavaty aśnavāmahā iti . samudra ivākṣitam iva ha khalu vā etac chando yad aticchandās samudra ivākṣitās tuṣṭuvānā asāmeti . tat pakṣi bhavati . pakṣi hy etasyāhno vratam . e vratam ity āha - annaṃ vai vratam annādyasyaivāvaruddhyai . e suvar ity āha svargasyaiva lokasya samaṣṭyai . e śakunā ity āha vaya evaitac chakunā bhūtvā svargaṃ lokaṃ samaśnuvate . tad āhur vāravantīyam evaitasyāhno 'gniṣṭomasāma kāryam iti . prajāpatiḥ paśūn asṛjata . te 'smāt sṛṣṭā apākrāman . tān vāravantīyenaiva varaṇaśākhām ācchidyāvārayata . yad avārayata tad vāravantīyasya vāravantīyatvam . tasmād varaṇaṃ bhiṣajyam āhuḥ . tad yad etasyāhno vāravantīyam agniṣṭomasāma bhavati yad anena karmaṇāvārutsmahi tan no vāravantīyena vāritam antata upatiṣṭhātā iti . tad ehivad ihavad bhavaty antasya rūpam . anto hy etad ahaḥ . tad u vā āhur yad vāvānyā vāṅ nātivadati tad etasyāhno 'gniṣṭomasāma kāryam . yajñāyajñīyaṃ vāvānyā vāṅ nātivadati . vāg vai yajñāyajñīyam . kuto hi vāg vācam ativadiṣyati .
sentences: samudra ivākṣitam iva ha kʰalu vā etac cʰando yad aticcʰandās samudra ivākṣitās tuṣṭuvānā asāmeti .
e vratam ity āha - annaṃ vai vratam annādyasyaivāvaruddʰyai .
e suvar ity āha svargasyaiva lokasya samaṣṭyai .
e śakunā ity āha vaya evaitac cʰakunā bʰūtvā svargaṃ lokaṃ samaśnuvate .
tad āhur vāravantīyam evaitasyāhno 'gniṣṭomasāma kāryam iti .
tad yad etasyāhno vāravantīyam agniṣṭomasāma bʰavati yad anena karmaṇāvārutsmahi tan no vāravantīyena vāritam antata upatiṣṭʰātā iti .
tad ehivad ihavad bʰavaty antasya rūpam .
tad u vā āhur yad vāvānyā vāṅ nātivadati tad etasyāhno 'gniṣṭomasāma kāryam .
text: It occurs in the vaisvanariva [verses]. For this is the laudation of the vaisvanara. It occurs in eighty-syllable [verses] -- 'may we attain.' Like the ocean, inexhaustible, as it were, is this meter -- the atichanda: 'may we be like those who have chanted inexhaustibly, like the ocean.' It is in the paksin [bird] form. For the observance of this day is the bird. 'E -- the observance,' he says -- food is the observance -- for the securing of food. 'E svar,' he says -- for the attainment of the heavenly world. 'E sakuna,' he says -- becoming birds (sakuna), they thereby attain the heavenly world. They say: 'The varavantiya alone should be the agnistomasaman of this day.' Prajapati created cattle. They, once created, ran away from him. By the varavantiya, having broken off a branch of the varana tree, he blocked them. Because he blocked (avarayata) them, that is the varavantiya-nature of the varavantiya. Therefore they call the varana tree medicinal. Since the varavantiya is the agnistomasaman of this day -- 'whatever we have secured by this ritual, may the varavantiya keep it standing firm for us to the end.' It is ehivat and ihavat -- that is the form of the end. For this day is the end. But they say: 'Whatever speech no other speech surpasses -- that should be the agnistomasaman of this day. No other speech surpasses the yajnayajniya. The yajnayajniya is speech. For how could speech surpass speech?'
meaning: तद् वैश्वानरीयासु भवति . वैश्वानरस्य ह्य् एतत् स्तोत्रम् . अशीत्यक्षरासु भवत्य् अश्नवामहा इति . समुद्र इवाक्षितम् इव ह खलु वा एतच् छन्दो यद् अतिच्छन्दास् समुद्र इवाक्षितास् तुष्टुवाना असामेति . तत् पक्षि भवति . पक्षि ह्य् एतस्याह्नो व्रतम् . ए व्रतम् इत्य् आह - अन्नं वै व्रतम् अन्नाद्यस्यैवावरुद्ध्यै . ए सुवर् इत्य् आह स्वर्गस्यैव लोकस्य समष्ट्यै . ए शकुना इत्य् आह वय एवैतच् छकुना भूत्वा स्वर्गं लोकं समश्नुवते . तद् आहुर् वारवन्तीयम् एवैतस्याह्नो ऽग्निष्टोमसाम कार्यम् इति . प्रजापतिः पशून् असृजत . ते ऽस्मात् सृष्टा अपाक्रामन् . तान् वारवन्तीयेनैव वरणशाखाम् आच्छिद्यावारयत . यद् अवारयत तद् वारवन्तीयस्य वारवन्तीयत्वम् . तस्माद् वरणं भिषज्यम् आहुः . तद् यद् एतस्याह्नो वारवन्तीयम् अग्निष्टोमसाम भवति यद् अनेन कर्मणावारुत्स्महि तन् नो वारवन्तीयेन वारितम् अन्तत उपतिष्ठाता इति . तद् एहिवद् इहवद् भवत्य् अन्तस्य रूपम् . अन्तो ह्य् एतद् अहः . तद् उ वा आहुर् यद् वावान्या वाङ् नातिवदति तद् एतस्याह्नो ऽग्निष्टोमसाम कार्यम् . यज्ञायज्ञीयं वावान्या वाङ् नातिवदति . वाग् वै यज्ञायज्ञीयम् . कुतो हि वाग् वाचम् अतिवदिष्यति .

sanskrit_iast: asnnaṃ vai vrataṃ śrīr vai vratam . vratena vā annam adyate vratena śrīr āpyate . tad āhur upariṣṭād eva saṃvatsarasyopetyam . dūrūpaṃ vai tato vrataṃ vijñāyate yatropajāyata iti . tat pañcaviṃśaṃ bhavati . caturviṃśatyardhamāso vai saṃvatsaro 'nnādyaṃ pañcaviṃśaty annādyam evaitat pañcaviṃśyopadhīyate . pañcaviṃśo ha khalu vai puruṣaḥ . puruṣasyaitat stotram ity āhur daśa vai puruṣasya hastyā aṅgulayo daśa padyāś catvāri prāṅgāṇy ātmā pañcaviṃśaṣ ṣaḍ imāni parvāṇi ṣaḍ imāni ṣaḍ imāni ṣaḍ imāny ātmā pañcaviṃśo dvādaśemāḥ pariśavo dvādaśemā ātmaiva pañcaviṃśaḥ . puruṣaṃ vāvaitena saṃskurvanti puruṣaṃ prajanayanti . tad āhus sarvam evaitad ahaḥ pañcaviṃśam upetyam iti . pañcaviṃśam eva śira upeyuḥ pañcaviṃśam anyaṃ pakṣaṃ pañcaviṃśam anyaṃ pañcaviṃśaṃ pucchaṃ pañcaviṃśam ātmānam evaṃ vratasyopāptir aṅgenāṅgena vratam upāpnavāmeti . tasmād atha ha smāharjjiśvā vātavāta ekaṃ vāvaitat stotraṃ sat tat pañcadhā vihṛtya stuyuḥ pañcabhir eva śira stuyuḥ pañcabhir anyaṃ pakṣaṃ pañcabhir anyaṃ pañcabhiḥ pucchaṃ pañcabhir ātmānam . tathaikam eva pañcaviṃśaṃ nātiricyate .
sentences: asnnaṃ vai vrataṃ śrīr vai vratam .
vratena vā annam adyate vratena śrīr āpyate .
dūrūpaṃ vai tato vrataṃ vijñāyate yatropajāyata iti .
caturviṃśatyardʰamāso vai saṃvatsaro 'nnādyaṃ pañcaviṃśaty annādyam evaitat pañcaviṃśyopadʰīyate .

puruṣasyaitat stotram ity āhur daśa vai puruṣasya hastyā aṅgulayo daśa padyāś catvāri prāṅgāṇy ātmā pañcaviṃśaṣ ṣaḍ imāni parvāṇi ṣaḍ imāni ṣaḍ imāni ṣaḍ imāny ātmā pañcaviṃśo dvādaśemāḥ pariśavo dvādaśemā ātmaiva pañcaviṃśaḥ .
tad āhus sarvam evaitad ahaḥ pañcaviṃśam upetyam iti .
pañcaviṃśam eva śira upeyuḥ pañcaviṃśam anyaṃ pakṣaṃ pañcaviṃśam anyaṃ pañcaviṃśaṃ puccʰaṃ pañcaviṃśam ātmānam evaṃ vratasyopāptir aṅgenāṅgena vratam upāpnavāmeti .
tasmād atʰa ha smāharjjiśvā vātavāta ekaṃ vāvaitat stotraṃ sat tat pañcadʰā vihr̥tya stuyuḥ pañcabʰir eva śira stuyuḥ pañcabʰir anyaṃ pakṣaṃ pañcabʰir anyaṃ pañcabʰiḥ puccʰaṃ pañcabʰir ātmānam .
text: Food is the observance; prosperity is the observance. By the observance food is eaten; by the observance prosperity is attained. They say it should be performed at the end of the year. 'The observance is better recognized from where it arises,' [they say]. It has the pancavimsa [twenty-five-fold stoma]. Twenty-four half-months make the year; food is the twenty-fifth. Food is thereby placed upon the twenty-fifth. A person is indeed twenty-five-fold. 'This is the laudation of the person,' they say: ten fingers of the hands, ten toes of the feet, four foreparts, and the self -- twenty-five. Or: six joints here, six here, six here, six here, and the self -- twenty-five. Or: twelve ribs here, twelve here, and the self -- twenty-five. They thereby fashion and generate a person. They say: 'This entire day should be performed with the twenty-five-fold [stoma].' The head should employ the pancavimsa, one wing the pancavimsa, the other [wing] the pancavimsa, the tail the pancavimsa, the self the pancavimsa -- 'thus we attain the observance limb by limb.' Therefore Arjjisva Vatavata said: 'This being one single laudation, they should divide it fivefold and chant -- with five for the head, five for one wing, five for the other, five for the tail, five for the self.' Thus it is one and yet twenty-five-fold, without excess.
meaning: अस्न्नं वै व्रतं श्रीर् वै व्रतम् . व्रतेन वा अन्नम् अद्यते व्रतेन श्रीर् आप्यते . तद् आहुर् उपरिष्टाद् एव संवत्सरस्योपेत्यम् . दूरूपं वै ततो व्रतं विज्ञायते यत्रोपजायत इति . तत् पञ्चविंशं भवति . चतुर्विंशत्यर्धमासो वै संवत्सरो ऽन्नाद्यं पञ्चविंशत्य् अन्नाद्यम् एवैतत् पञ्चविंश्योपधीयते . पञ्चविंशो ह खलु वै पुरुषः . पुरुषस्यैतत् स्तोत्रम् इत्य् आहुर् दश वै पुरुषस्य हस्त्या अङ्गुलयो दश पद्याश् चत्वारि प्राङ्गाण्य् आत्मा पञ्चविंशष् षड् इमानि पर्वाणि षड् इमानि षड् इमानि षड् इमान्य् आत्मा पञ्चविंशो द्वादशेमाः परिशवो द्वादशेमा आत्मैव पञ्चविंशः . पुरुषं वावैतेन संस्कुर्वन्ति पुरुषं प्रजनयन्ति . तद् आहुस् सर्वम् एवैतद् अहः पञ्चविंशम् उपेत्यम् इति . पञ्चविंशम् एव शिर उपेयुः पञ्चविंशम् अन्यं पक्षं पञ्चविंशम् अन्यं पञ्चविंशं पुच्छं पञ्चविंशम् आत्मानम् एवं व्रतस्योपाप्तिर् अङ्गेनाङ्गेन व्रतम् उपाप्नवामेति . तस्माद् अथ ह स्माहर्ज्जिश्वा वातवात एकं वावैतत् स्तोत्रं सत् तत् पञ्चधा विहृत्य स्तुयुः पञ्चभिर् एव शिर स्तुयुः पञ्चभिर् अन्यं पक्षं पञ्चभिर् अन्यं पञ्चभिः पुच्छं पञ्चभिर् आत्मानम् . तथैकम् एव पञ्चविंशं नातिरिच्यते .

sanskrit_iast: atha ha smāhāruṇir na vā anyāny aṅgāny ātmanā samāni . no 'nyair aṅgair ātmā samaḥ . viṣameṇa vai puruṣaḥ kalpate viṣameṇa samaḥ . tad yathāvidham evaitad evam upetyam iti . brahma vai vratasya śiro dyāvāpṛthivī pakṣāv antarikṣam ātmā sāma puccham . gāyatraṃ vai vratasya śiras tad dhi brahma . bṛhadrathantare pakṣau te hi dyāvāpṛthivī . vāmadevyam ātmā tad dhy antarikṣam . yajñāyajñīyam pucchaṃ tad dhi sāma . navabhiś śira stuvanti . nava vai puruṣe prāṇāḥ . prāṇānām evaiṣā saṃmā prāṇānām ṛddhiḥ . tasmin gāyatrasāmādhyūhanti . prāṇo vai gāyatrasāma . prāṇam eva tac chīrṣan dadhati . tasmāc chīrṣan prāṇo hitaḥ . te pratyañco niḥsṛpyārkaśīrṣam iti tena stuvate . grīvā ha tās tad yad imān lokān anudākhyāyam iva gāyati . śirtaś caiva tad ātmānaṃ ca saṃdadhāti . tasmāc chiraś cātmā ca saṃhitau .
sentences: atʰa ha smāhāruṇir na vā anyāny aṅgāny ātmanā samāni .
viṣameṇa vai puruṣaḥ kalpate viṣameṇa samaḥ .
tad yatʰāvidʰam evaitad evam upetyam iti .
brahma vai vratasya śiro dyāvāpr̥tʰivī pakṣāv antarikṣam ātmā sāma puccʰam .
gāyatraṃ vai vratasya śiras tad dʰi brahma .
te pratyañco niḥsr̥pyārkaśīrṣam iti tena stuvate .
grīvā ha tās tad yad imān lokān anudākʰyāyam iva gāyati .
śirtaś caiva tad ātmānaṃ ca saṃdadʰāti .
text: Thereupon Aruni said: 'The other limbs are not equal to the self, nor is the self equal to the other limbs. A person is formed by the unequal; by the unequal he is made whole. Therefore this should be employed as it actually is.' Brahman is the head of the observance; heaven and earth are the wings; the midspace is the self; the saman is the tail. The gayatra is the head of the observance, for that is brahman. The brhat and rathantara are the wings, for those are heaven and earth. The vamadevya is the self, for that is the midspace. The yajnayajniya is the tail, for that is the saman. They chant the head with nine [verses]. Nine are the vital breaths of a person. This is the measure of the vital breaths, the prosperity of the vital breaths. On that they place the gayatrasaman. The prana is the gayatrasaman. They thereby place the prana in the head. Therefore the prana is established in the head. Moving backward, they chant with 'arkasirsa.' These are the neck -- as though singing while surveying these worlds. Thereby they join the head and the self. Therefore the head and the self are joined.
meaning: अथ ह स्माहारुणिर् न वा अन्यान्य् अङ्गान्य् आत्मना समानि . नो ऽन्यैर् अङ्गैर् आत्मा समः . विषमेण वै पुरुषः कल्पते विषमेण समः . तद् यथाविधम् एवैतद् एवम् उपेत्यम् इति . ब्रह्म वै व्रतस्य शिरो द्यावापृथिवी पक्षाव् अन्तरिक्षम् आत्मा साम पुच्छम् . गायत्रं वै व्रतस्य शिरस् तद् धि ब्रह्म . बृहद्रथन्तरे पक्षौ ते हि द्यावापृथिवी . वामदेव्यम् आत्मा तद् ध्य् अन्तरिक्षम् . यज्ञायज्ञीयम् पुच्छं तद् धि साम . नवभिश् शिर स्तुवन्ति . नव वै पुरुषे प्राणाः . प्राणानाम् एवैषा संमा प्राणानाम् ऋद्धिः . तस्मिन् गायत्रसामाध्यूहन्ति . प्राणो वै गायत्रसाम . प्राणम् एव तच् छीर्षन् दधति . तस्माच् छीर्षन् प्राणो हितः . ते प्रत्यञ्चो निःसृप्यार्कशीर्षम् इति तेन स्तुवते . ग्रीवा ह तास् तद् यद् इमान् लोकान् अनुदाख्यायम् इव गायति . शिर्तश् चैव तद् आत्मानं च संदधाति . तस्माच् छिरश् चात्मा च संहितौ .

sanskrit_iast: ta etena trivṛtā stomena rathantaram abhyāyanti . brahma vai trivṛd annaṃ rathantaram . brahmaṇaiva tad annādyaṃ spṛṇvanti . tasmin pañcadaśaṃ stomam adhyūhanti . vajro vai pañcadaśo 'nnaṃ rathantaram . vajreṇaiva tad annādyaṃ parigṛhṇanti . ta etena pañcadaśena saptadaśam abhyāyanti . vajro vai pañcadaśo viṭ saptadaśaḥ . vajreṇaiva tad viśaṃ spṛṇvanti . tasmin brahmasāmādhyūhanti . kṣatraṃ vai bṛhat . kṣatram eva tad viśy adhyūhanti . sa tasmāt kṣatriyo viśy adhyūḍhaḥ . tad āhur ito bṛhatā stotavyam ito rathantareṇeti . prāṇam iva vā idaṃ sarvaṃ pratyudyatyā iti . tad u ha smāha kījo vākāyanaḥ pṛṣṭhato vā ete 'nnādyaṃ kurvate ya ito bṛhatā stuvata ito rathantareṇa . annaṃ vai rathantaram . dakṣiṇato vā annādyam avaruddham upācarati . tasmād ita eva bṛhatā stuvata ito rathantareṇānnādyasyāvaruddhyā iti . ya u evaiṣa pañcadaśa stomas sa u pratyudyatyā iti . tasmād u savyaṃ pakṣaṃ vayāṃsy anu pariplavante . ta etena sarveṇaikaviṃśaṃ pratiṣṭhām āyanti . dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavas traya ime lokā asāv āditya ekaviṃśaḥ . sarvasmin vā eṣo 'sminn adhi pratiṣṭhitaḥ .
sentences: ta etena trivr̥tā stomena ratʰantaram abʰyāyanti .
tad āhur ito br̥hatā stotavyam ito ratʰantareṇeti .
prāṇam iva vā idaṃ sarvaṃ pratyudyatyā iti .
tad u ha smāha kījo vākāyanaḥ pr̥ṣṭʰato vā ete 'nnādyaṃ kurvate ya ito br̥hatā stuvata ito ratʰantareṇa .
tasmād ita eva br̥hatā stuvata ito ratʰantareṇānnādyasyāvaruddʰyā iti .
ya u evaiṣa pañcadaśa stomas sa u pratyudyatyā iti .
tasmād u savyaṃ pakṣaṃ vayāṃsy anu pariplavante .
dvādaśa māsāḥ pañcartavas traya ime lokā asāv āditya ekaviṃśaḥ .
text: With this trivrt stoma they proceed toward the rathantara. Brahman is the trivrt; food is the rathantara. By brahman they thereby sustain food. On that they place the pancadasa stoma. The pancadasa is the thunderbolt (vajra); food is the rathantara. With the thunderbolt they thereby seize the food. With this pancadasa they proceed toward the saptadasa. The pancadasa is the thunderbolt; the saptadasa is the vis [common people]. With the thunderbolt they thereby sustain the vis. On that they place the brahmasaman. The brhat is the ksatra [ruling power]. They thereby place the ksatra upon the vis. Therefore the ksatriya is placed upon the vis. They say: 'One should chant with the brhat from this side and the rathantara from that.' 'This entire [world] is, as it were, directed toward the prana,' [they say]. Thereupon Kija Vakayani said: 'Those who chant with the brhat from this side and the rathantara from that -- they place the food behind. For food, when obtained, approaches from the south. Therefore one should chant with the brhat from this side and the rathantara from that, for the securing of food.' Moreover, it is this pancadasa stoma that is directed [toward the prana]. Therefore birds circle following the left wing. With this entire [chant] they come to the ekavimsa as their foundation. Twelve months, five seasons, three worlds, the sun yonder -- twenty-one. In all of this he is established.
meaning: त एतेन त्रिवृता स्तोमेन रथन्तरम् अभ्यायन्ति . ब्रह्म वै त्रिवृद् अन्नं रथन्तरम् . ब्रह्मणैव तद् अन्नाद्यं स्पृण्वन्ति . तस्मिन् पञ्चदशं स्तोमम् अध्यूहन्ति . वज्रो वै पञ्चदशो ऽन्नं रथन्तरम् . वज्रेणैव तद् अन्नाद्यं परिगृह्णन्ति . त एतेन पञ्चदशेन सप्तदशम् अभ्यायन्ति . वज्रो वै पञ्चदशो विट् सप्तदशः . वज्रेणैव तद् विशं स्पृण्वन्ति . तस्मिन् ब्रह्मसामाध्यूहन्ति . क्षत्रं वै बृहत् . क्षत्रम् एव तद् विश्य् अध्यूहन्ति . स तस्मात् क्षत्रियो विश्य् अध्यूढः . तद् आहुर् इतो बृहता स्तोतव्यम् इतो रथन्तरेणेति . प्राणम् इव वा इदं सर्वं प्रत्युद्यत्या इति . तद् उ ह स्माह कीजो वाकायनः पृष्ठतो वा एते ऽन्नाद्यं कुर्वते य इतो बृहता स्तुवत इतो रथन्तरेण . अन्नं वै रथन्तरम् . दक्षिणतो वा अन्नाद्यम् अवरुद्धम् उपाचरति . तस्माद् इत एव बृहता स्तुवत इतो रथन्तरेणान्नाद्यस्यावरुद्ध्या इति . य उ एवैष पञ्चदश स्तोमस् स उ प्रत्युद्यत्या इति . तस्माद् उ सव्यं पक्षं वयांस्य् अनु परिप्लवन्ते . त एतेन सर्वेणैकविंशं प्रतिष्ठाम् आयन्ति . द्वादश मासाः पञ्चर्तवस् त्रय इमे लोका असाव् आदित्य एकविंशः . सर्वस्मिन् वा एषो ऽस्मिन्न् अधि प्रतिष्ठितः .

sanskrit_iast: tasmin bhadraṃ sāmādhyūhanti . prajā vai bhadram . pucchato vai prajāḥ prajāyante . pucchata evaitat prajanane prajāṃ dadhate prajātyai . tatrāpi śreyaḥ kāryam āhuḥ . prajā vai bhadraṃ prajāyai yā prajā sā śreyaḥ . api ha prajāyai prajāṃ paśyate ya evaṃ veda . tad āhus sakṛd eva sarveṇa stotavyaṃ vayaso 'nurūpaṃ kṛtveti . yad vai vayaḥ prapatati sarvāṇy aṅgāni nānāśo yuktvā prapatati . atha yad upaviśati sarvāṇy aṅgāny ātmānam upasamāhṛtyopaviśatīti . tad yat sakṛd eva sarveṇa stuvanti yathā vayaḥ prapatat sarvāṇy aṅgāni nānāśo yuktvā prapatet tādṛk tat . atha yad ekaikayā stutayopasamāyanti yathā vaya upaviśat sarvāṇy evāṅgāny ātmānam upasamāhṛtyopaviśet tādṛg u tat . atha ha smāha bhāllabeyo naitasminn ahann anya udgātus sāmnārtvijyaṃ kuryāt . śrīr vā etad ahaḥ śrīr udgātā . yad etasminn ahann anya udgātus sāmnārtvijyaṃ kuryād anavavaditainān avavaded anabhyāroḍhābhyārohet pāpavasyasaṃ syāt sa vaivānuparisarpaṃ saṃsthāpayet sa vaikaikayā stutayopasameyād iti . tad iva tv atra paricakṣate yan navaviṃśa stomas saṃpadyate . tad āhur navaviṃśa stomas saṃpadyate vāśyamānānupatet svaṃ yūthaṃ jānamejaya gaur gās sāhasrayājina śalakāṇḍāṇi vigacchatītīva vā etā yathāyatham apiyantīti . śira eva śīrṣann āpyeti pakṣau pakṣe pucchaṃ puccha ātmānam id ātmann āpyeti .
sentences: puccʰata evaitat prajanane prajāṃ dadʰate prajātyai .
prajā vai bʰadraṃ prajāyai yā prajā sā śreyaḥ .
api ha prajāyai prajāṃ paśyate ya evaṃ veda .
tad āhus sakr̥d eva sarveṇa stotavyaṃ vayaso 'nurūpaṃ kr̥tveti .
yad vai vayaḥ prapatati sarvāṇy aṅgāni nānāśo yuktvā prapatati .
atʰa yad upaviśati sarvāṇy aṅgāny ātmānam upasamāhr̥tyopaviśatīti .
tad yat sakr̥d eva sarveṇa stuvanti yatʰā vayaḥ prapatat sarvāṇy aṅgāni nānāśo yuktvā prapatet tādr̥k tat .
atʰa yad ekaikayā stutayopasamāyanti yatʰā vaya upaviśat sarvāṇy evāṅgāny ātmānam upasamāhr̥tyopaviśet tādr̥g u tat .
atʰa ha smāha bʰāllabeyo naitasminn ahann anya udgātus sāmnārtvijyaṃ kuryāt .
śrīr vā etad ahaḥ śrīr udgātā .
yad etasminn ahann anya udgātus sāmnārtvijyaṃ kuryād anavavaditainān avavaded anabʰyāroḍʰābʰyārohet pāpavasyasaṃ syāt sa vaivānuparisarpaṃ saṃstʰāpayet sa vaikaikayā stutayopasameyād iti .
tad iva tv atra paricakṣate yan navaviṃśa stomas saṃpadyate .
tad āhur navaviṃśa stomas saṃpadyate vāśyamānānupatet svaṃ yūtʰaṃ jānamejaya gaur gās sāhasrayājina śalakāṇḍāṇi vigaccʰatītīva vā etā yatʰāyatʰam apiyantīti .
śira eva śīrṣann āpyeti pakṣau pakṣe puccʰaṃ puccʰa ātmānam id ātmann āpyeti .
text: On that they place the bhadra saman. Offspring is the bhadra. Offspring is born from the tail [lower body]. From the tail they thereby place procreative power for the production of offspring. 'There too the sreyas should be used,' they say. Offspring is the bhadra; offspring is that which is sreyas [better]. He who knows thus sees offspring of offspring. They say: 'One should chant all at once with the entire [chant], making it in the likeness of a bird.' When a bird takes flight, it flies with all its limbs yoked in different directions. And when it alights, it draws all its limbs together into itself and alights. Since they chant all at once with the entire [chant], it is like a bird flying, yoking all limbs in different directions -- such is that. And since they come together with each individual chant-portion, it is like a bird alighting, drawing all its limbs together into itself -- such is that. Thereupon Bhallabeya said: 'On this day no one other than the udgatr should officiate with his saman-chant. This day is prosperity; the udgatr is prosperity. If on this day another were to officiate with the udgatr's saman-chant, he would censure the uncensured, he would ascend over one who should not be ascended over; it would be an evil seizure. He should have [the rite] concluded with the surrounding arrangement; he should come together with each individual chant-portion.' But here they note [the concern] that a twenty-nine-fold stoma results. They say: 'A twenty-nine-fold stoma results -- a lowing cow follows its own herd; O Janamejaya, the cows of the thousand-sacrificer separate into splinter-groups' -- it is as though these go to their respective places. The head goes to its place in the head, the wings to the wings, the tail to the tail, the self to the self.
meaning: तस्मिन् भद्रं सामाध्यूहन्ति . प्रजा वै भद्रम् . पुच्छतो वै प्रजाः प्रजायन्ते . पुच्छत एवैतत् प्रजनने प्रजां दधते प्रजात्यै . तत्रापि श्रेयः कार्यम् आहुः . प्रजा वै भद्रं प्रजायै या प्रजा सा श्रेयः . अपि ह प्रजायै प्रजां पश्यते य एवं वेद . तद् आहुस् सकृद् एव सर्वेण स्तोतव्यं वयसो ऽनुरूपं कृत्वेति . यद् वै वयः प्रपतति सर्वाण्य् अङ्गानि नानाशो युक्त्वा प्रपतति . अथ यद् उपविशति सर्वाण्य् अङ्गान्य् आत्मानम् उपसमाहृत्योपविशतीति . तद् यत् सकृद् एव सर्वेण स्तुवन्ति यथा वयः प्रपतत् सर्वाण्य् अङ्गानि नानाशो युक्त्वा प्रपतेत् तादृक् तत् . अथ यद् एकैकया स्तुतयोपसमायन्ति यथा वय उपविशत् सर्वाण्य् एवाङ्गान्य् आत्मानम् उपसमाहृत्योपविशेत् तादृग् उ तत् . अथ ह स्माह भाल्लबेयो नैतस्मिन्न् अहन्न् अन्य उद्गातुस् साम्नार्त्विज्यं कुर्यात् . श्रीर् वा एतद् अहः श्रीर् उद्गाता . यद् एतस्मिन्न् अहन्न् अन्य उद्गातुस् साम्नार्त्विज्यं कुर्याद् अनववदितैनान् अववदेद् अनभ्यारोढाभ्यारोहेत् पापवस्यसं स्यात् स वैवानुपरिसर्पं संस्थापयेत् स वैकैकया स्तुतयोपसमेयाद् इति . तद् इव त्व् अत्र परिचक्षते यन् नवविंश स्तोमस् संपद्यते . तद् आहुर् नवविंश स्तोमस् संपद्यते वाश्यमानानुपतेत् स्वं यूथं जानमेजय गौर् गास् साहस्रयाजिन शलकाण्डाणि विगच्छतीतीव वा एता यथायथम् अपियन्तीति . शिर एव शीर्षन्न् आप्येति पक्षौ पक्षे पुच्छं पुच्छ आत्मानम् इद् आत्मन्न् आप्येति .

sanskrit_iast: āsandīm udgātādhirhati pleṅkhaṃ hotā kūrcāv adhvaryū kūrcasada evānyā hotrā bhavanti . tad āhur na dīkṣitenāsandy adhiruhyeti . utthitā ha khalu vā etad ahar āgacchanti . yad vāvādo daśamam ahas tad evokthāni . iyam adhiruhyaivety āhuḥ . antarikṣasācy eva vai śrīḥ . evaṃ śriyā upāptir iti . vāṇaś śatatantrīr bhavati . śatāyur vai puruṣaś śatendriyaś śatavīryas tasyaivendriyasya vīryasyāvaruddhyai . tad āhur na vāṇaś śatatantrīḥ kāryo yarhi vā etasya brāhmaṇās santānam avidus sakṛt santato vā eṣa tarhi rājñāṃ sabhāsu praviśāmi bruvann aśayat taṃ kiṃ tat kuryur yas tathaitarhi na yathā pureti . tad u vā āhuḥ kiṃ khalu tathaitarhi yathā purā . ekasāmnā ha sma vai purā stutvā svargaṃ lokaṃ gacchanty atho avabhṛthād evodetya kāryaḥ . evaṃ vāṇaś śatatantrīr vācaḥ kṛtsnatvāyeti . tasyaiṣa santāno bhūr bhuva svar vadā vadā vadā vadī vadā vadoruḥ pṛthus sugas sugantuḥ karmaḥ karaṇaḥ karaḥ kariṣyann aindrīṃ vācaṃ bṛhatīṃ viśvarūpāṃ śatāyuṣaṃ pravada deva vāṇe ti .
sentences: āsandīm udgātādʰirhati pleṅkʰaṃ hotā kūrcāv adʰvaryū kūrcasada evānyā hotrā bʰavanti .
uttʰitā ha kʰalu vā etad ahar āgaccʰanti .
yad vāvādo daśamam ahas tad evoktʰāni .
śatāyur vai puruṣaś śatendriyaś śatavīryas tasyaivendriyasya vīryasyāvaruddʰyai .
tad āhur na vāṇaś śatatantrīḥ kāryo yarhi vā etasya brāhmaṇās santānam avidus sakr̥t santato vā eṣa tarhi rājñāṃ sabʰāsu praviśāmi bruvann aśayat taṃ kiṃ tat kuryur yas tatʰaitarhi na yatʰā pureti .
tad u vā āhuḥ kiṃ kʰalu tatʰaitarhi yatʰā purā .
ekasāmnā ha sma vai purā stutvā svargaṃ lokaṃ gaccʰanty atʰo avabʰr̥tʰād evodetya kāryaḥ .
tasyaiṣa santāno bʰūr bʰuva svar vadā vadā vadā vadī vadā vadoruḥ pr̥tʰus sugas sugantuḥ karmaḥ karaṇaḥ karaḥ kariṣyann aindrīṃ vācaṃ br̥hatīṃ viśvarūpāṃ śatāyuṣaṃ pravada deva vāṇe ti .
text: The udgātṛ mounts the throne (āsandī), the hotṛ the swing (pleṅkha), the two adhvaryus the grass bundles (kūrca); the other priests sit on grass seats. Now they say: 'The throne should not be mounted by one who is consecrated (dīkṣita).' But this day arrives when they have already risen. Whatever the tenth day is from yonder — that constitutes the ukthyas. 'This one should indeed be mounted' — so they say. 'For prosperity (śrī) is inclined toward the intermediate space. Thus is the attainment of prosperity.' The lute (vāṇa) has a hundred strings. A person lives a hundred years, has hundredfold powers, hundredfold strength — for the securing of that power and strength. Now they say: 'The hundred-stringed lute should not be made. When the brāhmaṇas do not know its continuation (santāna), the one who once had it strung, saying "I shall enter the assemblies of kings," lay without it. What would they do with one who now is not as before?' But others say: 'What difference is there now from before? In former times, having praised with a single sāman, they went to the heavenly world. And so it should be made after the concluding bath (avabhṛtha).' Thus the hundred-stringed lute is for the completeness of speech. Its continuation is: 'bhūr bhuvas svar — speak, speak, speak — O speaker, speak! O wide one, broad one, of good path, of good passage, O doer, instrument, maker, about to act — proclaim the speech of Indra, the bṛhatī, of all forms, bestowing a hundred years — O divine lute!'
meaning: आसन्दीम् उद्गाताधिर्हति प्लेङ्खं होता कूर्चाव् अध्वर्यू कूर्चसद एवान्या होत्रा भवन्ति . तद् आहुर् न दीक्षितेनासन्द्य् अधिरुह्येति . उत्थिता ह खलु वा एतद् अहर् आगच्छन्ति . यद् वावादो दशमम् अहस् तद् एवोक्थानि . इयम् अधिरुह्यैवेत्य् आहुः . अन्तरिक्षसाच्य् एव वै श्रीः . एवं श्रिया उपाप्तिर् इति . वाणश् शततन्त्रीर् भवति . शतायुर् वै पुरुषश् शतेन्द्रियश् शतवीर्यस् तस्यैवेन्द्रियस्य वीर्यस्यावरुद्ध्यै . तद् आहुर् न वाणश् शततन्त्रीः कार्यो यर्हि वा एतस्य ब्राह्मणास् सन्तानम् अविदुस् सकृत् सन्ततो वा एष तर्हि राज्ञां सभासु प्रविशामि ब्रुवन्न् अशयत् तं किं तत् कुर्युर् यस् तथैतर्हि न यथा पुरेति . तद् उ वा आहुः किं खलु तथैतर्हि यथा पुरा . एकसाम्ना ह स्म वै पुरा स्तुत्वा स्वर्गं लोकं गच्छन्त्य् अथो अवभृथाद् एवोदेत्य कार्यः . एवं वाणश् शततन्त्रीर् वाचः कृत्स्नत्वायेति . तस्यैष सन्तानो भूर् भुव स्वर् वदा वदा वदा वदी वदा वदोरुः पृथुस् सुगस् सुगन्तुः कर्मः करणः करः करिष्यन्न् ऐन्द्रीं वाचं बृहतीं विश्वरूपां शतायुषं प्रवद देव वाणे ति .

sanskrit_iast: ahīnasaṃ hāśvatthiṃ putrā upasametyocus satrāyāmo vai bhagavo 'nu naś śādhīti . sa hovāca maivaṃ vocata . durupadharṣo vai saṃvatsaraḥ . yathā vai rathanābhāv arāḥ pratiṣṭhitā evaṃ vai saṃvatsare sarve mṛtyavaḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ . athaitad evaṃ brūtheti . te hocus teṣāṃ vai tvam eva bhiṣag asi tvaṃ prāyaścittir anv eva naś śādhīti . tad dhāsya priyam āsa . sa hovācaivaṃ ced brūtha ṣaṭsu sma pratiṣṭhāsu pratitiṣṭhata . ṣaḍbhya sma haritmatībhyo meta . catuścakraṃ sma pārayiṣṇuṃ samārohata . svargasya sma lokasya patho 'ñjasāyanān meta . saṃvatsarasya sma vyāptam atiplavadhvam . daivyaṃ sma mithunam upeta . praspaṣṭāt sma sārthān mā hīyadhvam . acyutaṃ sma yajñasya mā cyāvayata . yajñasya sma śvastanam upeta . vācaṃ sma satyavatīm upeta . varṣiṣṭhān smājau yuṅgdhvam uttarāvatīṃ sma śriyam upeta . svarge sma loke pratitiṣṭhata . grāmāt smāraṇyaṃ meta . jñānāt smāvirbhavān meta . daivyāt sma vivāhān meta . yajñāt sma meteti . etāni hainān anuśaśāsa . te hocur anu na idam aśiṣaḥ parokṣeṇeva .
sentences: ahīnasaṃ hāśvattʰiṃ putrā upasametyocus satrāyāmo vai bʰagavo 'nu naś śādʰīti .
yatʰā vai ratʰanābʰāv arāḥ pratiṣṭʰitā evaṃ vai saṃvatsare sarve mr̥tyavaḥ pratiṣṭʰitāḥ .
te hocus teṣāṃ vai tvam eva bʰiṣag asi tvaṃ prāyaścittir anv eva naś śādʰīti .
sa hovācaivaṃ ced brūtʰa ṣaṭsu sma pratiṣṭʰāsu pratitiṣṭʰata .
varṣiṣṭʰān smājau yuṅgdʰvam uttarāvatīṃ sma śriyam upeta .
te hocur anu na idam aśiṣaḥ parokṣeṇeva .
text: The sons approached Ahīnasa Āśvatthi and said: 'We wish to undertake a sattra, O venerable one — guide us.' He said: 'Do not speak thus. The year is difficult to master. Just as spokes are fixed in the hub of a wheel, so all deaths are fixed in the year. Rather, speak thus.' They said: 'You alone are their physician, you are the expiation — guide us indeed.' That was pleasing to him. He said: 'If you speak thus — establish yourselves in six foundations. Set forth with six tawny mares (haritmatīs). Mount a four-wheeled vehicle that carries across. Set forth on the direct paths to the heavenly world. Cross over the expanse of the year. Approach the divine pair (mithuna). Do not fall behind from the clearly visible caravan. Do not dislodge what is firm in the sacrifice. Approach the morrow of the sacrifice. Approach speech that possesses truth. Yoke the tallest in the race. Approach prosperity that has an upper portion. Establish yourselves in the heavenly world. Set forth from the village to the forest. Set forth from knowledge to manifestation. Set forth from the divine wedding. Set forth from the sacrifice.' These were his instructions to them. They said: 'You have instructed us in these matters as if in a veiled manner.'
meaning: अहीनसं हाश्वत्थिं पुत्रा उपसमेत्योचुस् सत्रायामो वै भगवो ऽनु नश् शाधीति . स होवाच मैवं वोचत . दुरुपधर्षो वै संवत्सरः . यथा वै रथनाभाव् अराः प्रतिष्ठिता एवं वै संवत्सरे सर्वे मृत्यवः प्रतिष्ठिताः . अथैतद् एवं ब्रूथेति . ते होचुस् तेषां वै त्वम् एव भिषग् असि त्वं प्रायश्चित्तिर् अन्व् एव नश् शाधीति . तद् धास्य प्रियम् आस . स होवाचैवं चेद् ब्रूथ षट्सु स्म प्रतिष्ठासु प्रतितिष्ठत . षड्भ्य स्म हरित्मतीभ्यो मेत . चतुश्चक्रं स्म पारयिष्णुं समारोहत . स्वर्गस्य स्म लोकस्य पथो ऽञ्जसायनान् मेत . संवत्सरस्य स्म व्याप्तम् अतिप्लवध्वम् . दैव्यं स्म मिथुनम् उपेत . प्रस्पष्टात् स्म सार्थान् मा हीयध्वम् . अच्युतं स्म यज्ञस्य मा च्यावयत . यज्ञस्य स्म श्वस्तनम् उपेत . वाचं स्म सत्यवतीम् उपेत . वर्षिष्ठान् स्माजौ युङ्ग्ध्वम् उत्तरावतीं स्म श्रियम् उपेत . स्वर्गे स्म लोके प्रतितिष्ठत . ग्रामात् स्मारण्यं मेत . ज्ञानात् स्माविर्भवान् मेत . दैव्यात् स्म विवाहान् मेत . यज्ञात् स्म मेतेति . एतानि हैनान् अनुशशास . ते होचुर् अनु न इदम् अशिषः परोक्षेणेव .

sanskrit_iast: sa hovāca yad vo 'vocaṃ ṣaṭsu sma pratiṣṭhāsu pratitiṣṭheti nidhanavanti sma pavamānamukhebhyo mā cyāvayatety eva vas tad avocam iti . eṣā ha vai sāmnaḥ pratiṣṭhā yan nidhanam . ṣaḍ etāni nidhanavanti bhavanti ṣaḍ ṛtavas saṃvatsaraḥ . sa yathā vṛkṣam ākramaṇair ākramamāṇa iyād evam evaitais sāmanidhanai svargaṃ lokaṃ rohanto yanti . tasmān nidhanavanti pavamānamukhebhyo na cyāvayitavyāni . atha yad vo 'vācaṃ ṣaḍbhya sma haritmatībhyo metetīl̥āvibhaktir eva vas tad avocam il̥ābhi sma bṛhatīr ārabhadhvam ity eva vas tad avocam iti . tā etāṣ ṣaḍ ḍharitmatīḥ . sa yathā ṣaḍ ḍharitmatīr aśvatarīs saṃyujya yatra jigamiṣet tad gacched evam evaitābhir il̥āvibhaktibhi svargaṃ lokam abhyaśnuvate .
sentences: sa hovāca yad vo 'vocaṃ ṣaṭsu sma pratiṣṭʰāsu pratitiṣṭʰeti nidʰanavanti sma pavamānamukʰebʰyo mā cyāvayatety eva vas tad avocam iti .
eṣā ha vai sāmnaḥ pratiṣṭʰā yan nidʰanam .
ṣaḍ etāni nidʰanavanti bʰavanti ṣaḍ r̥tavas saṃvatsaraḥ .
sa yatʰā vr̥kṣam ākramaṇair ākramamāṇa iyād evam evaitais sāmanidʰanai svargaṃ lokaṃ rohanto yanti .
atʰa yad vo 'vācaṃ ṣaḍbʰya sma haritmatībʰyo metetīl̥āvibʰaktir eva vas tad avocam il̥ābʰi sma br̥hatīr ārabʰadʰvam ity eva vas tad avocam iti .
sa yatʰā ṣaḍ ḍʰaritmatīr aśvatarīs saṃyujya yatra jigamiṣet tad gaccʰed evam evaitābʰir il̥āvibʰaktibʰi svargaṃ lokam abʰyaśnuvate .
text: He said: 'When I told you "establish yourselves in six foundations," I told you: "Do not abandon the nidhanavat (chants with endings) from the openings of the pavamāna." For the nidhanam is the foundation of the sāman. There are six nidhanavat chants; six seasons make the year. Just as one would climb a tree by means of footholds, so by these sāma-nidhanas they go ascending to the heavenly world. Therefore the nidhanavat chants must not be abandoned from the pavamāna openings. And when I told you "set forth with six tawny mares" — I told you about the il̥ā-divisions: "Lay hold of the bṛhatīs through the il̥ā-divisions." These are the six haritmatīs. Just as one would yoke six tawny she-mules and go wherever one wished, so by these il̥ā-divisions they reach the heavenly world.
meaning: स होवाच यद् वो ऽवोचं षट्सु स्म प्रतिष्ठासु प्रतितिष्ठेति निधनवन्ति स्म पवमानमुखेभ्यो मा च्यावयतेत्य् एव वस् तद् अवोचम् इति . एषा ह वै साम्नः प्रतिष्ठा यन् निधनम् . षड् एतानि निधनवन्ति भवन्ति षड् ऋतवस् संवत्सरः . स यथा वृक्षम् आक्रमणैर् आक्रममाण इयाद् एवम् एवैतैस् सामनिधनै स्वर्गं लोकं रोहन्तो यन्ति . तस्मान् निधनवन्ति पवमानमुखेभ्यो न च्यावयितव्यानि . अथ यद् वो ऽवाचं षड्भ्य स्म हरित्मतीभ्यो मेतेतील्̥आविभक्तिर् एव वस् तद् अवोचम् इल्̥आभि स्म बृहतीर् आरभध्वम् इत्य् एव वस् तद् अवोचम् इति . ता एताष् षड् ढरित्मतीः . स यथा षड् ढरित्मतीर् अश्वतरीस् संयुज्य यत्र जिगमिषेत् तद् गच्छेद् एवम् एवैताभिर् इल्̥आविभक्तिभि स्वर्गं लोकम् अभ्यश्नुवते .

sanskrit_iast: atha yad vo 'vocaṃ catuścakraṃ sma pārayiṣṇuṃ samārohateti pra soma devavītaye parīto ṣiñcatā sutam abhi somāsa āyavaḥ punānas soma dhāraye ty etā eva vas tac catasro bṛhatīr avocam iti . eṣa ha vai catuścakraḥ pārayiṣṇur yad etā bṛhatyaḥ . sa yathā catuścakreṇa pārayiṣṇunā yatra jigamiṣet tad gacched evam evaitābhir bṛhatībhi svargaṃ lokaṃ gacchanti . atho eṣa vāva devarathaḥ . sa yathā devarathena suyuktena yatra jigamiṣet tad gacched evam evaitābhir bṛhatībhi svargaṃ lokaṃ gacchanti . tasmād etā eva bṛhatīḥ kāryāḥ . atha yad vo 'vocaṃ svargasya sma lokasya patho 'ñjasāyanān metety auśanakāve eva vas tad avocam iti . eṣa ha vai svargasya lokasya panthā añjasāyano yad auśankāve . auśanaṃ purastād bhavati kāvam upariṣṭāt . tāv etat pitāputrāv eva nāvam ajataḥ . sa yathā pitāputrau nāvam ajantau tām ariṣṭāṃ svasti pāraṃ gamayeyātām evam evaitad auśanakāvābhyāṃ svasty ariṣṭā udṛcam aśnuvate .
sentences: atʰa yad vo 'vocaṃ catuścakraṃ sma pārayiṣṇuṃ samārohateti pra soma devavītaye parīto ṣiñcatā sutam abʰi somāsa āyavaḥ punānas soma dʰāraye ty etā eva vas tac catasro br̥hatīr avocam iti .
eṣa ha vai catuścakraḥ pārayiṣṇur yad etā br̥hatyaḥ .
sa yatʰā catuścakreṇa pārayiṣṇunā yatra jigamiṣet tad gaccʰed evam evaitābʰir br̥hatībʰi svargaṃ lokaṃ gaccʰanti .
sa yatʰā devaratʰena suyuktena yatra jigamiṣet tad gaccʰed evam evaitābʰir br̥hatībʰi svargaṃ lokaṃ gaccʰanti .
atʰa yad vo 'vocaṃ svargasya sma lokasya patʰo 'ñjasāyanān metety auśanakāve eva vas tad avocam iti .
eṣa ha vai svargasya lokasya pantʰā añjasāyano yad auśankāve .
tāv etat pitāputrāv eva nāvam ajataḥ .
sa yatʰā pitāputrau nāvam ajantau tām ariṣṭāṃ svasti pāraṃ gamayeyātām evam evaitad auśanakāvābʰyāṃ svasty ariṣṭā udr̥cam aśnuvate .
text: And when I told you 'mount a four-wheeled vehicle that carries across' — I told you about these four bṛhatīs: 'pra soma devavītaye,' 'parīto ṣiñcatā sutam,' 'abhi somāsa āyavaḥ,' and 'punānas soma dhāraye.' This four-wheeled vehicle that carries across is these bṛhatīs. Just as with a four-wheeled vehicle that carries across one would go wherever one wished, so by these bṛhatīs they go to the heavenly world. And this is indeed the chariot of the gods. Just as with a well-yoked divine chariot one would go wherever one wished, so by these bṛhatīs they go to the heavenly world. Therefore these very bṛhatīs should be used. And when I told you 'set forth on the direct paths to the heavenly world' — I told you about the auśana and kāva. This is indeed the direct path to the heavenly world — the auśana and kāva. The auśana is in front, the kāva behind. These two, like father and son, propel the boat. Just as a father and son propelling a boat would bring it safely unharmed to the far shore, so by the auśana and kāva they safely reach the surplus unharmed.
meaning: अथ यद् वो ऽवोचं चतुश्चक्रं स्म पारयिष्णुं समारोहतेति प्र सोम देववीतये परीतो षिञ्चता सुतम् अभि सोमास आयवः पुनानस् सोम धारये त्य् एता एव वस् तच् चतस्रो बृहतीर् अवोचम् इति . एष ह वै चतुश्चक्रः पारयिष्णुर् यद् एता बृहत्यः . स यथा चतुश्चक्रेण पारयिष्णुना यत्र जिगमिषेत् तद् गच्छेद् एवम् एवैताभिर् बृहतीभि स्वर्गं लोकं गच्छन्ति . अथो एष वाव देवरथः . स यथा देवरथेन सुयुक्तेन यत्र जिगमिषेत् तद् गच्छेद् एवम् एवैताभिर् बृहतीभि स्वर्गं लोकं गच्छन्ति . तस्माद् एता एव बृहतीः कार्याः . अथ यद् वो ऽवोचं स्वर्गस्य स्म लोकस्य पथो ऽञ्जसायनान् मेतेत्य् औशनकावे एव वस् तद् अवोचम् इति . एष ह वै स्वर्गस्य लोकस्य पन्था अञ्जसायनो यद् औशन्कावे . औशनं पुरस्ताद् भवति कावम् उपरिष्टात् . ताव् एतत् पितापुत्राव् एव नावम् अजतः . स यथा पितापुत्रौ नावम् अजन्तौ ताम् अरिष्टां स्वस्ति पारं गमयेयाताम् एवम् एवैतद् औशनकावाभ्यां स्वस्त्य् अरिष्टा उदृचम् अश्नुवते .

sanskrit_iast: atha yad vo 'vocaṃ saṃvatsarasya sma vyāptam atiplavadhvam ity abhīvartaṃ vā sma pavamāne kurudhvaṃ plavaṃ vety eva vas tad avocam iti . etad dha vai saṃvatsarasya vyāptaṃ yad ṛtavo yan māsā yad ṛtusandhayaḥ . tad u vā āhur ya ṛtavo ye māsā ya ṛtusandhayo 'horātre vāva tad bhavataḥ . ahorātre vāva saṃvatsarasya vyāptam iti . tat plavaḥ kāryaḥ . ava vai gauḥ plavate 'va hasty ava puruṣaḥ plavo nāvaplavate . tad etena plavenānavaplāvinaitat saṃvatsarasya vyāptam atiplavāmahā iti . tad āhur asti paricakṣā plavātiplitā iti vai nindanti . yo vai jīyate yo hīyate tam āhur aploṣṭeti . abhīvarta eva kāryaḥ . tasyaikākṣaraṃ nidhanaṃ bhavati . ekākṣarā vai vāk . vāg u kṛtsnaṃ brahma . tad etena kṛtsnena brahmaṇā yathā carmaṇā kudīkaṇṭakān prāvṛtyātīyād evam evaitat saṃvatsarasya vyāptaṃ prāvṛtyātiyanti . atho yathā taptān pāṃsūn upānahy atīyāt tādṛk tat . tasmād abhīvarta eva kāryaḥ . atha yad vo 'vocaṃ daivyaṃ sma mithunam upetety uccā te jātam andhasā svādiṣṭhayā madi ṣṭhaye ty ete eva vas tad gāyatryāv avocam iti . etad vai daivyaṃ mithunaṃ yad ete gāyatryā uccā ta iti puṃso rūpaṃ svādiṣṭhaye ti striyai . tad etan mithunaṃ prajananaṃ kriyate . pra mithunena jāyate ya evaṃ veda .
sentences: atʰa yad vo 'vocaṃ saṃvatsarasya sma vyāptam atiplavadʰvam ity abʰīvartaṃ vā sma pavamāne kurudʰvaṃ plavaṃ vety eva vas tad avocam iti .
etad dʰa vai saṃvatsarasya vyāptaṃ yad r̥tavo yan māsā yad r̥tusandʰayaḥ .
tad u vā āhur ya r̥tavo ye māsā ya r̥tusandʰayo 'horātre vāva tad bʰavataḥ .
ava vai gauḥ plavate 'va hasty ava puruṣaḥ plavo nāvaplavate .
tad etena plavenānavaplāvinaitat saṃvatsarasya vyāptam atiplavāmahā iti .
tad āhur asti paricakṣā plavātiplitā iti vai nindanti .
yo vai jīyate yo hīyate tam āhur aploṣṭeti .
tad etena kr̥tsnena brahmaṇā yatʰā carmaṇā kudīkaṇṭakān prāvr̥tyātīyād evam evaitat saṃvatsarasya vyāptaṃ prāvr̥tyātiyanti .
atʰo yatʰā taptān pāṃsūn upānahy atīyāt tādr̥k tat .
atʰa yad vo 'vocaṃ daivyaṃ sma mitʰunam upetety uccā te jātam andʰasā svādiṣṭʰayā madi ṣṭʰaye ty ete eva vas tad gāyatryāv avocam iti .
etad vai daivyaṃ mitʰunaṃ yad ete gāyatryā uccā ta iti puṃso rūpaṃ svādiṣṭʰaye ti striyai .
pra mitʰunena jāyate ya evaṃ veda .
text: And when I told you 'cross over the expanse of the year' — I told you: 'Use the abhīvarta or the plava in the pavamāna.' The expanse of the year consists of the seasons, the months, and the junctions of the seasons. But others say: the seasons, the months, and the seasonal junctions — these are really just day and night. Day and night are indeed the expanse of the year. Therefore the plava should be used. A cow floats down, an elephant floats down, a person floats down — the plava (float) does not sink. 'With this plava, unsinking, let us cross over the expanse of the year.' But they say there is a deficiency: 'One who has floated over (plavātiplita),' they say disparagingly. He who is defeated, who falls behind — him they call 'one who has sunk (aploṣṭa).' Therefore the abhīvarta alone should be used. Its nidhanam consists of one syllable. Speech is one-syllabled. Speech is the complete brahman. Just as one would cover oneself with a leather hide and pass over thorns, so by this complete brahman they cover themselves and pass over the expanse of the year. Or as one would pass over hot sand with sandals — such is that. Therefore the abhīvarta alone should be used. And when I told you 'approach the divine pair' — I told you about these two gāyatrīs: 'uccā te jātam andhasā' and 'svādiṣṭhayā madiṣṭhaye.' This is the divine pair: 'uccā te' has the form of the male, 'svādiṣṭhaye' of the female. Thus a pairing for procreation is made. One who knows thus is born forth through pairing.
meaning: अथ यद् वो ऽवोचं संवत्सरस्य स्म व्याप्तम् अतिप्लवध्वम् इत्य् अभीवर्तं वा स्म पवमाने कुरुध्वं प्लवं वेत्य् एव वस् तद् अवोचम् इति . एतद् ध वै संवत्सरस्य व्याप्तं यद् ऋतवो यन् मासा यद् ऋतुसन्धयः . तद् उ वा आहुर् य ऋतवो ये मासा य ऋतुसन्धयो ऽहोरात्रे वाव तद् भवतः . अहोरात्रे वाव संवत्सरस्य व्याप्तम् इति . तत् प्लवः कार्यः . अव वै गौः प्लवते ऽव हस्त्य् अव पुरुषः प्लवो नावप्लवते . तद् एतेन प्लवेनानवप्लाविनैतत् संवत्सरस्य व्याप्तम् अतिप्लवामहा इति . तद् आहुर् अस्ति परिचक्षा प्लवातिप्लिता इति वै निन्दन्ति . यो वै जीयते यो हीयते तम् आहुर् अप्लोष्टेति . अभीवर्त एव कार्यः . तस्यैकाक्षरं निधनं भवति . एकाक्षरा वै वाक् . वाग् उ कृत्स्नं ब्रह्म . तद् एतेन कृत्स्नेन ब्रह्मणा यथा चर्मणा कुदीकण्टकान् प्रावृत्यातीयाद् एवम् एवैतत् संवत्सरस्य व्याप्तं प्रावृत्यातियन्ति . अथो यथा तप्तान् पांसून् उपानह्य् अतीयात् तादृक् तत् . तस्माद् अभीवर्त एव कार्यः . अथ यद् वो ऽवोचं दैव्यं स्म मिथुनम् उपेतेत्य् उच्चा ते जातम् अन्धसा स्वादिष्ठया मदि ष्ठये त्य् एते एव वस् तद् गायत्र्याव् अवोचम् इति . एतद् वै दैव्यं मिथुनं यद् एते गायत्र्या उच्चा त इति पुंसो रूपं स्वादिष्ठये ति स्त्रियै . तद् एतन् मिथुनं प्रजननं क्रियते . प्र मिथुनेन जायते य एवं वेद .

sanskrit_iast: atha yad vo 'vocaṃ praspaṣṭāt sma sārthān mā hīyadhvam iti bṛhadrathantare eva vas tad avocam iti . eṣa ha vai praspaṣṭaḥ sārtho yad bṛhadrathantare . ete ha vā etāny araṇyāny atinayato yāny etāni savanāraṇyāni . tad etad ṣaḍgrāmam iti trivṛt stomaḥ . asti parastarām iti pañcadaśaḥ . asti parastarām iti saptadaśaḥ . asty eva parastarām ity ekaviṃśaḥ . śrānta enad gacched iti triṇavaḥ . āsāyainad iti trayastriṃśaḥ . atha yathaikāṃ vā dve vāntaroṣyaiva tad yac chandomāḥ . kṣatraṃ vā ete sāmnāṃ yad bṛhadrathantare . kṣatriya u vā araṇyasyātinetā . tad yatra vai kṣatreṇāraṇyenaiti yo vai tatra taṃ dasyur jānāti yad yat syālvaṃ vā madhu vā bhavati tenāsmā āvirbhavati . atha ye 'nye naṃṣṭrāḥ paripanthinaḥ parāñcas te kakṣaṃ gahanāny abhyavayanti . sa yathā kṣatriyeṇa sahābibhyad araṇyam atīyād evam evaitad bṛhadrathantarābhyām atiyanti . atho eṣa vāva devayānaḥ panthā yat pṛṣṭhyaṣ ṣaḍahaḥ . te devā etena devayānena pathaitaṃ svargaṃ lokaṃ gatvānvāgamān manuṣyāṇām abibhayuḥ . te hocur upa taj jānīta yathā no manuṣyā nānvāgacchān iti . ta etān yajñamuho rakṣāṃsi pratyauhan . tad yad dīkṣito mīyate yad rudhyate ete haiva tat kurvanti . tad bṛhadrathantare evātinayataḥ . tān yān ete ghnanty anetrān haiva tān ghnanti ye bṛhadrathantare avasṛjanti .
sentences: atʰa yad vo 'vocaṃ praspaṣṭāt sma sārtʰān mā hīyadʰvam iti br̥hadratʰantare eva vas tad avocam iti .
eṣa ha vai praspaṣṭaḥ sārtʰo yad br̥hadratʰantare .
ete ha vā etāny araṇyāny atinayato yāny etāni savanāraṇyāni .
tad etad ṣaḍgrāmam iti trivr̥t stomaḥ .
atʰa yatʰaikāṃ vā dve vāntaroṣyaiva tad yac cʰandomāḥ .
kṣatraṃ vā ete sāmnāṃ yad br̥hadratʰantare .
tad yatra vai kṣatreṇāraṇyenaiti yo vai tatra taṃ dasyur jānāti yad yat syālvaṃ vā madʰu vā bʰavati tenāsmā āvirbʰavati .
atʰa ye 'nye naṃṣṭrāḥ paripantʰinaḥ parāñcas te kakṣaṃ gahanāny abʰyavayanti .
sa yatʰā kṣatriyeṇa sahābibʰyad araṇyam atīyād evam evaitad br̥hadratʰantarābʰyām atiyanti .
atʰo eṣa vāva devayānaḥ pantʰā yat pr̥ṣṭʰyaṣ ṣaḍahaḥ .
te devā etena devayānena patʰaitaṃ svargaṃ lokaṃ gatvānvāgamān manuṣyāṇām abibʰayuḥ .
te hocur upa taj jānīta yatʰā no manuṣyā nānvāgaccʰān iti .
tad yad dīkṣito mīyate yad rudʰyate ete haiva tat kurvanti .
tān yān ete gʰnanty anetrān haiva tān gʰnanti ye br̥hadratʰantare avasr̥janti .
text: And when I told you 'do not fall behind from the clearly visible caravan' — I told you about the bṛhat and rathantara. This clearly visible caravan is the bṛhat and rathantara. These are what lead through the wildernesses — the wildernesses between the pressings. The trivṛt stoma is like a settlement of six villages. 'There is farther still' — that is the pañcadaśa. 'There is farther still' — that is the saptadaśa. 'There is indeed farther still' — that is the ekaviṃśa. 'A weary one would reach it' — that is the triṇava. 'One would sit down there' — that is the trayastriṃśa. Just as one or two night-halts along the way — that is the chandomāḥ. The bṛhat and rathantara are the ruling power (kṣatra) among the sāmans. The kṣatriya is the one who leads through the wilderness. When one goes through the wilderness under the protection of a kṣatriya — whoever there recognizes him as a brigand, whatever honey or sweetness there is, by that he reveals himself to him. But the other robbers and highwaymen turn back and retreat into the thickets and dense growth. Just as one would pass through the wilderness fearlessly in the company of a kṣatriya, so by the bṛhat and rathantara they pass through. And this is indeed the path of the gods — the pṛṣṭhya ṣaḍaha. The gods, having gone by this divine path to the heavenly world, feared the pursuit of humans. They said: 'Find out how humans may not follow us.' They set up these rākṣasas at the openings of the sacrifice as obstacles. When a consecrated person dies, when he is obstructed — it is these very ones who do that. The bṛhat and rathantara lead past them. Those whom these strike down — they strike down only those who abandon the bṛhat and rathantara.
meaning: अथ यद् वो ऽवोचं प्रस्पष्टात् स्म सार्थान् मा हीयध्वम् इति बृहद्रथन्तरे एव वस् तद् अवोचम् इति . एष ह वै प्रस्पष्टः सार्थो यद् बृहद्रथन्तरे . एते ह वा एतान्य् अरण्यान्य् अतिनयतो यान्य् एतानि सवनारण्यानि . तद् एतद् षड्ग्रामम् इति त्रिवृत् स्तोमः . अस्ति परस्तराम् इति पञ्चदशः . अस्ति परस्तराम् इति सप्तदशः . अस्त्य् एव परस्तराम् इत्य् एकविंशः . श्रान्त एनद् गच्छेद् इति त्रिणवः . आसायैनद् इति त्रयस्त्रिंशः . अथ यथैकां वा द्वे वान्तरोष्यैव तद् यच् छन्दोमाः . क्षत्रं वा एते साम्नां यद् बृहद्रथन्तरे . क्षत्रिय उ वा अरण्यस्यातिनेता . तद् यत्र वै क्षत्रेणारण्येनैति यो वै तत्र तं दस्युर् जानाति यद् यत् स्याल्वं वा मधु वा भवति तेनास्मा आविर्भवति . अथ ये ऽन्ये नंष्ट्राः परिपन्थिनः पराञ्चस् ते कक्षं गहनान्य् अभ्यवयन्ति . स यथा क्षत्रियेण सहाबिभ्यद् अरण्यम् अतीयाद् एवम् एवैतद् बृहद्रथन्तराभ्याम् अतियन्ति . अथो एष वाव देवयानः पन्था यत् पृष्ठ्यष् षडहः . ते देवा एतेन देवयानेन पथैतं स्वर्गं लोकं गत्वान्वागमान् मनुष्याणाम् अबिभयुः . ते होचुर् उप तज् जानीत यथा नो मनुष्या नान्वागच्छान् इति . त एतान् यज्ञमुहो रक्षांसि प्रत्यौहन् . तद् यद् दीक्षितो मीयते यद् रुध्यते एते हैव तत् कुर्वन्ति . तद् बृहद्रथन्तरे एवातिनयतः . तान् यान् एते घ्नन्त्य् अनेत्रान् हैव तान् घ्नन्ति ये बृहद्रथन्तरे अवसृजन्ति .

sanskrit_iast: atha ha smāha nagarī jānaśruteyo vṛkasya caratas sarpaṇam iti . ko vṛka iti . prajāpatir iti . kaḥ prajāpatir iti . saṃvatsara iti . tasya kiṃ sarpaṇam iti . ahorātre iti . ke ahorātre iti . bṛhadrathantare iti . etābhyāṃ ha vā eṣa etat sarpati . tau prāṇāpānau tāv imau lokau yad daivyaṃ mithunam . tau haitat saṃvatsarasyaiva pādāv ārabhya yanti . te svasty ariṣṭā udṛcam aśnuvate . atha yad vo 'vocam acyutaṃ sma yajñasya mā cyāvayateti vāmadevyam eva vas tad avocam iti . etad dha vai yajñasyācyutaṃ yad vāmadevyam . prāṇo hi vāmadevyam . prāṇān ned avacchidyāmahā iti . atha yad vo 'vocaṃ yajñasya sma śvastanam upeti gaurivītam eva vas tad avocam iti . etad dha vai yajñasya śvastanaṃ yad gaurivītaṃ prajā śvastanaṃ paśava śvastanaṃ svargo loka śvastanam . sa yathā kṣetrajño grāmaṃ yāpayed adas sugaṃ tena yāsyāmo 'das sutīrthaṃ tena tariṣyāmo 'das suvasaṃ tad vatsyāma ity evam etau gaurivītasyodāsāv avasānadarśau carataḥ . atho yathā somapravākas somaṃ prāhaivam etau gaurivītasyodāsau devebhyas somaṃ prāhatuḥ . proktasomo ha sa tāṃ rātriṃ vasati yasmin ahani gaurivītaṃ bhavati . atho hainaṃ devā īkṣante dhāvata śvo yaṣṭeti .
sentences: atʰa ha smāha nagarī jānaśruteyo vr̥kasya caratas sarpaṇam iti .
etābʰyāṃ ha vā eṣa etat sarpati .
tau prāṇāpānau tāv imau lokau yad daivyaṃ mitʰunam .
tau haitat saṃvatsarasyaiva pādāv ārabʰya yanti .
atʰa yad vo 'vocam acyutaṃ sma yajñasya mā cyāvayateti vāmadevyam eva vas tad avocam iti .
etad dʰa vai yajñasyācyutaṃ yad vāmadevyam .
atʰa yad vo 'vocaṃ yajñasya sma śvastanam upeti gaurivītam eva vas tad avocam iti .
etad dʰa vai yajñasya śvastanaṃ yad gaurivītaṃ prajā śvastanaṃ paśava śvastanaṃ svargo loka śvastanam .
sa yatʰā kṣetrajño grāmaṃ yāpayed adas sugaṃ tena yāsyāmo 'das sutīrtʰaṃ tena tariṣyāmo 'das suvasaṃ tad vatsyāma ity evam etau gaurivītasyodāsāv avasānadarśau carataḥ .
atʰo yatʰā somapravākas somaṃ prāhaivam etau gaurivītasyodāsau devebʰyas somaṃ prāhatuḥ .
proktasomo ha sa tāṃ rātriṃ vasati yasmin ahani gaurivītaṃ bʰavati .
atʰo hainaṃ devā īkṣante dʰāvata śvo yaṣṭeti .
text: Now Nagarī Jānaśruteya used to say: 'The creeping of a wolf on the prowl.' 'Who is the wolf?' 'Prajāpati.' 'Who is Prajāpati?' 'The year.' 'What is its creeping?' 'Day and night.' 'What are day and night?' 'The bṛhat and rathantara.' By these two the year creeps along. They are prāṇa and apāna; they are these two worlds; they are the divine pair. Grasping the two feet of the year, they go. They reach the surplus safely and unharmed. And when I told you 'do not dislodge what is firm in the sacrifice' — I told you about the vāmadevya. The vāmadevya is indeed the unshakable foundation of the sacrifice. For the vāmadevya is the vital breath (prāṇa). 'Let us not cut off the vital breaths.' And when I told you 'approach the morrow of the sacrifice' — I told you about the gaurivīta. The gaurivīta is indeed the morrow of the sacrifice — offspring is the morrow, cattle are the morrow, the heavenly world is the morrow. Just as one who knows the land would guide a village: 'That is a good path — we shall go by it; that is a good ford — we shall cross by it; that is a good resting place — we shall stay there' — so these two movements of the gaurivīta, the rising and the settling, go about. And just as soma-announcers announce the soma, so these two movements of the gaurivīta announced the soma to the gods. He in whose day the gaurivīta occurs dwells that night with the soma announced. And the gods regard him, saying: 'Run! Tomorrow he will sacrifice.'
meaning: अथ ह स्माह नगरी जानश्रुतेयो वृकस्य चरतस् सर्पणम् इति . को वृक इति . प्रजापतिर् इति . कः प्रजापतिर् इति . संवत्सर इति . तस्य किं सर्पणम् इति . अहोरात्रे इति . के अहोरात्रे इति . बृहद्रथन्तरे इति . एताभ्यां ह वा एष एतत् सर्पति . तौ प्राणापानौ ताव् इमौ लोकौ यद् दैव्यं मिथुनम् . तौ हैतत् संवत्सरस्यैव पादाव् आरभ्य यन्ति . ते स्वस्त्य् अरिष्टा उदृचम् अश्नुवते . अथ यद् वो ऽवोचम् अच्युतं स्म यज्ञस्य मा च्यावयतेति वामदेव्यम् एव वस् तद् अवोचम् इति . एतद् ध वै यज्ञस्याच्युतं यद् वामदेव्यम् . प्राणो हि वामदेव्यम् . प्राणान् नेद् अवच्छिद्यामहा इति . अथ यद् वो ऽवोचं यज्ञस्य स्म श्वस्तनम् उपेति गौरिवीतम् एव वस् तद् अवोचम् इति . एतद् ध वै यज्ञस्य श्वस्तनं यद् गौरिवीतं प्रजा श्वस्तनं पशव श्वस्तनं स्वर्गो लोक श्वस्तनम् . स यथा क्षेत्रज्ञो ग्रामं यापयेद् अदस् सुगं तेन यास्यामो ऽदस् सुतीर्थं तेन तरिष्यामो ऽदस् सुवसं तद् वत्स्याम इत्य् एवम् एतौ गौरिवीतस्योदासाव् अवसानदर्शौ चरतः . अथो यथा सोमप्रवाकस् सोमं प्राहैवम् एतौ गौरिवीतस्योदासौ देवेभ्यस् सोमं प्राहतुः . प्रोक्तसोमो ह स तां रात्रिं वसति यस्मिन् अहनि गौरिवीतं भवति . अथो हैनं देवा ईक्षन्ते धावत श्वो यष्टेति .

sanskrit_iast: atha yad vo 'vocaṃ vācaṃ sma satyavatīm upeteti purojitī vo andhasa ity etām eva vas tad anuṣṭubham avocam iti . eṣā vai vāk satyavatī yad eṣānuṣṭup . anuṣṭup pūrvā bhavati gāyatryā uttare . vāg vā anuṣṭup prāṇo gāyatrī . etad vai vācas satyaṃ yat prāṇaḥ . saiṣā vāk satyavatī . atho yathānyau navatarau cakrāv upāsyed evam evaitām anuṣṭubhaṃ tryahamukheṣu paryāharanti svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai . tasmād eṣaivānuṣṭup kāryā . atha yad vo 'vocaṃ varṣiṣṭhān smājau yuṅgdhvam ity agniṣṭomasāmāny eva vas tad avocam iti . ete ha vai varṣiṣṭhā ājau yujyante yad agniṣṭomasāmāni yāni vai tāny akṣyantyahāni . atha yad vo 'vocam uttarāvatīṃ sma śriyam upeteti pṛṣṭhāny eva vas tad avocam iti . eṣā ha vā uttarāvatī śrīr yat pṛṣṭhāni trivṛt pañcadaśam saptadaśam ekaviṃśaṃ triṇavam ity ā trayastriṃśād utkrāmanti . atha yad vo 'vocaṃ svarge sma loke pratitiṣṭhateti yajñāyajñīyaṃ sma vo 'gniṣṭomasāmāstv ity eva vas tad avocam iti . eṣa ha vai svargo loko yad yajñāyajñīyam asāv āditya ekaviṃśaḥ .
sentences: atʰa yad vo 'vocaṃ vācaṃ sma satyavatīm upeteti purojitī vo andʰasa ity etām eva vas tad anuṣṭubʰam avocam iti .
eṣā vai vāk satyavatī yad eṣānuṣṭup .
etad vai vācas satyaṃ yat prāṇaḥ .
atʰo yatʰānyau navatarau cakrāv upāsyed evam evaitām anuṣṭubʰaṃ tryahamukʰeṣu paryāharanti svargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai .
atʰa yad vo 'vocaṃ varṣiṣṭʰān smājau yuṅgdʰvam ity agniṣṭomasāmāny eva vas tad avocam iti .
ete ha vai varṣiṣṭʰā ājau yujyante yad agniṣṭomasāmāni yāni vai tāny akṣyantyahāni .
atʰa yad vo 'vocam uttarāvatīṃ sma śriyam upeteti pr̥ṣṭʰāny eva vas tad avocam iti .
eṣā ha vā uttarāvatī śrīr yat pr̥ṣṭʰāni trivr̥t pañcadaśam saptadaśam ekaviṃśaṃ triṇavam ity ā trayastriṃśād utkrāmanti .
atʰa yad vo 'vocaṃ svarge sma loke pratitiṣṭʰateti yajñāyajñīyaṃ sma vo 'gniṣṭomasāmāstv ity eva vas tad avocam iti .
eṣa ha vai svargo loko yad yajñāyajñīyam asāv āditya ekaviṃśaḥ .
text: And when I told you 'approach speech that possesses truth' — I told you about this anuṣṭubh: 'purojitī vo andhasaḥ.' This is speech that possesses truth — this anuṣṭubh. The anuṣṭubh comes first, the gāyatrī after. Speech is the anuṣṭubh, breath is the gāyatrī. The truth of speech is breath. This is speech that possesses truth. Just as one would set two newer wheels — so they bring this anuṣṭubh around at the beginnings of the tryahas, for the completeness of the heavenly world. Therefore this very anuṣṭubh should be used. And when I told you 'yoke the tallest in the race' — I told you about the agniṣṭoma-sāmans. These tallest ones are yoked in the race — the agniṣṭoma-sāmans — on those days that do not decay. And when I told you 'approach prosperity that has an upper portion' — I told you about the pṛṣṭhas. This is the prosperity with an upper portion — the pṛṣṭhas: they ascend from trivṛt, pañcadaśa, saptadaśa, ekaviṃśa, triṇava up to trayastriṃśa. And when I told you 'establish yourselves in the heavenly world' — I told you: 'Let the yajñāyajñīya be your agniṣṭoma-sāman.' This heavenly world is the yajñāyajñīya — yonder sun, the twenty-first.
meaning: अथ यद् वो ऽवोचं वाचं स्म सत्यवतीम् उपेतेति पुरोजिती वो अन्धस इत्य् एताम् एव वस् तद् अनुष्टुभम् अवोचम् इति . एषा वै वाक् सत्यवती यद् एषानुष्टुप् . अनुष्टुप् पूर्वा भवति गायत्र्या उत्तरे . वाग् वा अनुष्टुप् प्राणो गायत्री . एतद् वै वाचस् सत्यं यत् प्राणः . सैषा वाक् सत्यवती . अथो यथान्यौ नवतरौ चक्राव् उपास्येद् एवम् एवैताम् अनुष्टुभं त्र्यहमुखेषु पर्याहरन्ति स्वर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै . तस्माद् एषैवानुष्टुप् कार्या . अथ यद् वो ऽवोचं वर्षिष्ठान् स्माजौ युङ्ग्ध्वम् इत्य् अग्निष्टोमसामान्य् एव वस् तद् अवोचम् इति . एते ह वै वर्षिष्ठा आजौ युज्यन्ते यद् अग्निष्टोमसामानि यानि वै तान्य् अक्ष्यन्त्यहानि . अथ यद् वो ऽवोचम् उत्तरावतीं स्म श्रियम् उपेतेति पृष्ठान्य् एव वस् तद् अवोचम् इति . एषा ह वा उत्तरावती श्रीर् यत् पृष्ठानि त्रिवृत् पञ्चदशम् सप्तदशम् एकविंशं त्रिणवम् इत्य् आ त्रयस्त्रिंशाद् उत्क्रामन्ति . अथ यद् वो ऽवोचं स्वर्गे स्म लोके प्रतितिष्ठतेति यज्ञायज्ञीयं स्म वो ऽग्निष्टोमसामास्त्व् इत्य् एव वस् तद् अवोचम् इति . एष ह वै स्वर्गो लोको यद् यज्ञायज्ञीयम् असाव् आदित्य एकविंशः .

sanskrit_iast: atha yad vo 'vocaṃ grāmāt smāraṇyaṃ metety āhāryāṇi sma sāmāni mābhidhyāyatety eva vas tad avocam iti . sa yathā grāmād grāmaṃ saṃvrajed abibhyad evaṃ tad yad agniṣṭomasāmāni . atha yathāraṇyād araṇyaṃ yan sa kaṇṭakena vā śalākayā vā paritṛṇṇa āgacched atho iyato no 'vyātsur iyanto vi vidhyamānānām amukṣmahīty evaṃ tad yad āhāryāṇi sāmāni . tasmād āhāryāṇāṃ sāmnāṃ nāśayitavyāni . atha yad vo 'vocaṃ jñānāt smāvirbhavān meteti sujñānam eva vas tad avocam iti . atha yad vo 'vocaṃ daivyāt sma vivāhān meteti śyaitanaudhase eva vas tad avocam iti . atha yad vo 'vocaṃ yajñāt sma meteti śraddhā sma vo mā vyaid ity eva vas tad avocam iti . eṣā ha vai devānāṃ rājñi yac chraddhā . saiṣā prātar upakramya tiṣṭhati . tāṃ devā upatiṣṭhante yādrīcy eṣyati tadryañca eṣyāma iti . tasyai sarve devā anuvartmānas sāyaṃ juṣante . tam āviśati sa juhoti sa yajate . tad devā upajīvanti . etāṃ haibhyas tat saṃvatsare 'riṣṭim uvāca .
sentences: atʰa yad vo 'vocaṃ grāmāt smāraṇyaṃ metety āhāryāṇi sma sāmāni mābʰidʰyāyatety eva vas tad avocam iti .
sa yatʰā grāmād grāmaṃ saṃvrajed abibʰyad evaṃ tad yad agniṣṭomasāmāni .
atʰa yatʰāraṇyād araṇyaṃ yan sa kaṇṭakena vā śalākayā vā paritr̥ṇṇa āgaccʰed atʰo iyato no 'vyātsur iyanto vi vidʰyamānānām amukṣmahīty evaṃ tad yad āhāryāṇi sāmāni .
atʰa yad vo 'vocaṃ jñānāt smāvirbʰavān meteti sujñānam eva vas tad avocam iti .
atʰa yad vo 'vocaṃ daivyāt sma vivāhān meteti śyaitanaudʰase eva vas tad avocam iti .
atʰa yad vo 'vocaṃ yajñāt sma meteti śraddʰā sma vo mā vyaid ity eva vas tad avocam iti .
eṣā ha vai devānāṃ rājñi yac cʰraddʰā .
tāṃ devā upatiṣṭʰante yādrīcy eṣyati tadryañca eṣyāma iti .
tasyai sarve devā anuvartmānas sāyaṃ juṣante .
tam āviśati sa juhoti sa yajate .
text: And when I told you 'set forth from the village to the forest' — I told you: 'Do not brood upon the āhārya sāmans.' Just as one would travel from village to village without fear — such is it when the agniṣṭoma-sāmans are used. But as one going from one wilderness to another might arrive pierced by a thorn or a splinter, thinking 'So many came at us, so many struck at us, and from so many being struck we freed ourselves' — such is it when the āhārya sāmans are used. Therefore one must not lose track of the āhārya sāmans. And when I told you 'set forth from knowledge to manifestation' — I told you about the sujñāna (right knowledge). And when I told you 'set forth from the divine wedding' — I told you about the śyaita and naudhas. And when I told you 'set forth from the sacrifice' — I told you: 'Let not your faith (śraddhā) be split.' For faith is the queen of the gods. She stands forth approaching in the morning. The gods attend upon her: 'In whatever direction she will go, in that direction we shall go.' All the gods follow in her track; in the evening they are pleased. She enters him — he offers, he sacrifices. The gods live upon that. This he spoke to them as their safeguard for the year.
meaning: अथ यद् वो ऽवोचं ग्रामात् स्मारण्यं मेतेत्य् आहार्याणि स्म सामानि माभिध्यायतेत्य् एव वस् तद् अवोचम् इति . स यथा ग्रामाद् ग्रामं संव्रजेद् अबिभ्यद् एवं तद् यद् अग्निष्टोमसामानि . अथ यथारण्याद् अरण्यं यन् स कण्टकेन वा शलाकया वा परितृण्ण आगच्छेद् अथो इयतो नो ऽव्यात्सुर् इयन्तो वि विध्यमानानाम् अमुक्ष्महीत्य् एवं तद् यद् आहार्याणि सामानि . तस्माद् आहार्याणां साम्नां नाशयितव्यानि . अथ यद् वो ऽवोचं ज्ञानात् स्माविर्भवान् मेतेति सुज्ञानम् एव वस् तद् अवोचम् इति . अथ यद् वो ऽवोचं दैव्यात् स्म विवाहान् मेतेति श्यैतनौधसे एव वस् तद् अवोचम् इति . अथ यद् वो ऽवोचं यज्ञात् स्म मेतेति श्रद्धा स्म वो मा व्यैद् इत्य् एव वस् तद् अवोचम् इति . एषा ह वै देवानां राज्ञि यच् छ्रद्धा . सैषा प्रातर् उपक्रम्य तिष्ठति . तां देवा उपतिष्ठन्ते याद्रीच्य् एष्यति तद्र्यञ्च एष्याम इति . तस्यै सर्वे देवा अनुवर्त्मानस् सायं जुषन्ते . तम् आविशति स जुहोति स यजते . तद् देवा उपजीवन्ति . एतां हैभ्यस् तत् संवत्सरे ऽरिष्टिम् उवाच .

sanskrit_iast: puruṣaṃ vāvaitad āsate yat saṃvatsaram . puruṣo vai prajāpatiḥ prajāpatis saṃvatsaraḥ . tam evaitad īpsanta āsata ātmānaṃ yajñaṃ kṛtvā . tasya pādāv eva prāyaṇīyo 'tirātraḥ . tayor yad adhastāc chuklaṃ tad ahno rūpaṃ yad upariṣṭāt kṛṣṇaṃ tad rātrer nakhāny eva nakṣatrāṇām imāny eva catvāry ūrvaṣṭhīvāni ārambhaṇīyam ahar ayam abhiplavo 'yaṃ pṛṣṭhyo 'yam ito 'rvācīno 'bhijid ayaṃ viśvajid ime traya svarasāmāna ime trayo 'yaṃ viṣuvān idaṃ mahāvratīyam ahar ayam udayanīyo 'tirātraḥ . idam ahno rūpam idaṃ rātrer nakhāny eva nakṣatrāṇām .
sentences: tam evaitad īpsanta āsata ātmānaṃ yajñaṃ kr̥tvā .

tayor yad adʰastāc cʰuklaṃ tad ahno rūpaṃ yad upariṣṭāt kr̥ṣṇaṃ tad rātrer nakʰāny eva nakṣatrāṇām imāny eva catvāry ūrvaṣṭʰīvāni ārambʰaṇīyam ahar ayam abʰiplavo 'yaṃ pr̥ṣṭʰyo 'yam ito 'rvācīno 'bʰijid ayaṃ viśvajid ime traya svarasāmāna ime trayo 'yaṃ viṣuvān idaṃ mahāvratīyam ahar ayam udayanīyo 'tirātraḥ .
idam ahno rūpam idaṃ rātrer nakʰāny eva nakṣatrāṇām .
text: It is a person (puruṣa) that they sit as when they sit for the year. The person is Prajāpati; Prajāpati is the year. It is him they desire to attain when they sit, having made themselves the sacrifice. The opening atirātra constitutes his two feet. Of these, what is white below is the form of day, what is dark above is the form of night; the nails are the stars. These four — the thighs and knees — are the ārambhaṇīya day, this is the abhiplava, this the pṛṣṭhya, this from here onward is the abhijit, this is the viśvajit, these three are the svarasāmans, these three, this is the viṣuvān, this is the mahāvratīya day, this is the concluding atirātra. This is the form of day, this of night; the nails are the stars.
meaning: पुरुषं वावैतद् आसते यत् संवत्सरम् . पुरुषो वै प्रजापतिः प्रजापतिस् संवत्सरः . तम् एवैतद् ईप्सन्त आसत आत्मानं यज्ञं कृत्वा . तस्य पादाव् एव प्रायणीयो ऽतिरात्रः . तयोर् यद् अधस्ताच् छुक्लं तद् अह्नो रूपं यद् उपरिष्टात् कृष्णं तद् रात्रेर् नखान्य् एव नक्षत्राणाम् इमान्य् एव चत्वार्य् ऊर्वष्ठीवानि आरम्भणीयम् अहर् अयम् अभिप्लवो ऽयं पृष्ठ्यो ऽयम् इतो ऽर्वाचीनो ऽभिजिद् अयं विश्वजिद् इमे त्रय स्वरसामान इमे त्रयो ऽयं विषुवान् इदं महाव्रतीयम् अहर् अयम् उदयनीयो ऽतिरात्रः . इदम् अह्नो रूपम् इदं रात्रेर् नखान्य् एव नक्षत्राणाम् .

sanskrit_iast: te manomayāḥ prāṇamayāś cakṣurmayāḥ śrotramayā vāṅmayā ṛṅmayā yajurmayās sāmamayā brahmamayā hiraṇmayā amṛtās saṃbhavanti . devāsurā aspardhanta . te devāḥ prajāpatim upādhāvan jayāmāsurān iti . so 'bravīn na vai māṃ yūyaṃ vittha nāsurāḥ . yad vai māṃ yūyaṃ vidyāta tato vai yūyam eva syāta parāsurā bhaveyur iti . tad vai brūhīty abruvan . so 'bravīt puruṣaḥ prajāpatis saṃvatsara iti mopāddhvam . tato vai yūyam eva bhaviṣyatha parāsurā bhaviṣyantīti . taṃ puruṣaḥ prajāpatis saṃvatsara ity upāsata tato vai devā abhavan parāsurāḥ .
sentences: te manomayāḥ prāṇamayāś cakṣurmayāḥ śrotramayā vāṅmayā r̥ṅmayā yajurmayās sāmamayā brahmamayā hiraṇmayā amr̥tās saṃbʰavanti .
te devāḥ prajāpatim upādʰāvan jayāmāsurān iti .
so 'bravīn na vai māṃ yūyaṃ vittʰa nāsurāḥ .
yad vai māṃ yūyaṃ vidyāta tato vai yūyam eva syāta parāsurā bʰaveyur iti .
so 'bravīt puruṣaḥ prajāpatis saṃvatsara iti mopāddʰvam .
tato vai yūyam eva bʰaviṣyatʰa parāsurā bʰaviṣyantīti .
taṃ puruṣaḥ prajāpatis saṃvatsara ity upāsata tato vai devā abʰavan parāsurāḥ .
text: They become mind-made, breath-made, eye-made, ear-made, speech-made, ṛc-made, yajus-made, sāman-made, brahman-made, gold-made — they become immortal. The gods and asuras competed. The gods ran to Prajāpati: 'Let us conquer the asuras.' He said: 'Neither you know me nor do the asuras. If you knew me, then you alone would prevail and the asuras would perish.' 'Then tell us,' they said. He said: 'The person is Prajāpati, the year — worship me thus. Then you alone will prevail and the asuras will perish.' They worshipped him as 'the person is Prajāpati, the year.' Thereupon the gods prevailed and the asuras perished.
meaning: ते मनोमयाः प्राणमयाश् चक्षुर्मयाः श्रोत्रमया वाङ्मया ऋङ्मया यजुर्मयास् साममया ब्रह्ममया हिरण्मया अमृतास् संभवन्ति . देवासुरा अस्पर्धन्त . ते देवाः प्रजापतिम् उपाधावन् जयामासुरान् इति . सो ऽब्रवीन् न वै मां यूयं वित्थ नासुराः . यद् वै मां यूयं विद्यात ततो वै यूयम् एव स्यात परासुरा भवेयुर् इति . तद् वै ब्रूहीत्य् अब्रुवन् . सो ऽब्रवीत् पुरुषः प्रजापतिस् संवत्सर इति मोपाद्ध्वम् . ततो वै यूयम् एव भविष्यथ परासुरा भविष्यन्तीति . तं पुरुषः प्रजापतिस् संवत्सर इत्य् उपासत ततो वै देवा अभवन् परासुराः .

sanskrit_iast: athādhidaivatam . ayam eva lokaḥ prāyaṇīyo 'tirātraḥ . tasya yac chuklaṃ tad ahno rūpaṃ yat kṛṣṇaṃ tad rātreś citrāṇy eva nakṣatrāṇām . saṃvatsara eva svargo loka ārambhaṇīyam ahar brahmābhiplavaḥ kṣatraṃ pṛṣṭhyo 'gnir abhijit viśve devā svarasāmāna ādityo viṣuvān indro viśvajid ahorātre eva goāyuṣī lokā eva dvādaśāhasyāhāni prajāpatir eva mahāvratīyam ahar asāv eva loka udayanīyo 'tirātraḥ .
sentences: tasya yac cʰuklaṃ tad ahno rūpaṃ yat kr̥ṣṇaṃ tad rātreś citrāṇy eva nakṣatrāṇām .

saṃvatsara eva svargo loka ārambʰaṇīyam ahar brahmābʰiplavaḥ kṣatraṃ pr̥ṣṭʰyo 'gnir abʰijit viśve devā svarasāmāna ādityo viṣuvān indro viśvajid ahorātre eva goāyuṣī lokā eva dvādaśāhasyāhāni prajāpatir eva mahāvratīyam ahar asāv eva loka udayanīyo 'tirātraḥ .
text: Now regarding the deities (adhidaivatam). This very world is the opening atirātra. Its white part is the form of day, its dark part the form of night; the bright ones are the stars. The year itself is the heavenly world. The ārambhaṇīya day is brahman, the abhiplava is kṣatra, the pṛṣṭhya is Agni, the abhijit is the Viśvedevas, the svarasāmans are Āditya, the viṣuvān is Indra, the viśvajit is day and night — the go and āyus days, the days of the dvādaśāha are the worlds, the mahāvratīya day is Prajāpati himself, and that world yonder is the concluding atirātra.
meaning: अथाधिदैवतम् . अयम् एव लोकः प्रायणीयो ऽतिरात्रः . तस्य यच् छुक्लं तद् अह्नो रूपं यत् कृष्णं तद् रात्रेश् चित्राण्य् एव नक्षत्राणाम् . संवत्सर एव स्वर्गो लोक आरम्भणीयम् अहर् ब्रह्माभिप्लवः क्षत्रं पृष्ठ्यो ऽग्निर् अभिजित् विश्वे देवा स्वरसामान आदित्यो विषुवान् इन्द्रो विश्वजिद् अहोरात्रे एव गोआयुषी लोका एव द्वादशाहस्याहानि प्रजापतिर् एव महाव्रतीयम् अहर् असाव् एव लोक उदयनीयो ऽतिरात्रः .

text: Some are truly seated (satisadas) and others are merely sattra-sitters (satrasadas). When they dwell having undertaken the opening atirātra, they dwell in this very world. Whatever food there is in this world, that they secure thereby. And they know: 'We are now in this world; no misfortune befalls us.' When they dwell having undertaken the ārambhaṇīya day, they dwell in the year, in the heavenly world. Whatever food there is in the year, in the heavenly world, that they secure thereby. And they know: 'We are now in the year, in the heavenly world; no misfortune befalls us.' When they dwell having undertaken the abhiplava, they dwell in brahman. Whatever food there is in brahman, that they secure thereby. And they know: 'We are now in brahman; no misfortune befalls us.' When they dwell having undertaken the pṛṣṭhya, they dwell in kṣatra. Whatever food there is in kṣatra, that they secure thereby. And they know: 'We are now in kṣatra; no misfortune befalls us.' When they dwell having undertaken the abhijit, they dwell in Agni. Whatever food there is in Agni, that they secure thereby. And they know: 'We are now in Agni; no misfortune befalls us.' When they dwell having undertaken the svarasāmans, they dwell among the Viśvedevas. Whatever food there is among the Viśvedevas, that they secure thereby. And they know: 'We are now among the Viśvedevas; no misfortune befalls us.' When they dwell having undertaken the viṣuvān, they dwell in Āditya. Whatever food there is in Āditya, that they secure thereby. And they know: 'We are now in Āditya; no misfortune befalls us.' When they dwell having undertaken the viśvajit, they dwell in Indra. Whatever food there is in Indra, that they secure thereby. And they know: 'We are now in Indra; no misfortune befalls us.' When they dwell having undertaken the go and āyus days, they dwell in day and night. Whatever food there is in day and night, that they secure thereby. And they know: 'We are now in day and night; no misfortune befalls us.' When they dwell having undertaken the days of the dvādaśāha, they dwell in the worlds. Whatever food there is in the worlds, that they secure thereby. And they know: 'We are now in the worlds; no misfortune befalls us.' When they dwell having undertaken the mahāvratīya day, they dwell in Prajāpati. Whatever food there is in Prajāpati, that they secure thereby. And they know: 'We are now in Prajāpati; no misfortune befalls us.' When they dwell having undertaken the concluding atirātra, they dwell in that world yonder. Whatever food there is in that world, that they secure thereby.
meaning: ते सतिसदो ह वा अन्ये सत्रसदो ऽन्ये . ते यां प्रायणीयम् अतिरात्रम् उपेत्य वसन्त्य् अस्मिन्न् एव तां लोके वसन्ति . तद् यद् अस्मिन् लोके ऽन्नाद्यं तद् एव तेनावरुन्धते . अथो ह विद्युर् अस्मिन्न् text: Some are truly seated (satisadas) and others are merely sattra-sitters. Some truly sit (sati sīdanti), others merely sit in a sattra. Those who are truly seated are those who are consecrated with such knowledge. For they go seated among these deities. They strike down all evil. But those who shave their topknots and wrap themselves about seeking to crawl in — they are merely sattra-sitters. He who speaks against one who knows thus — it is as if he would drive the deity out of its season; for he speaks against one who is committed to these deities, one who dwells among them. No misfortune befalls one who knows thus. He who speaks against him — it is he who incurs misfortune. These are indeed only ten days of the year: the two atirātras, the ārambhaṇīya and mahāvratīya days, the pṛṣṭhya and abhiplava, the viśvajit and abhijit, and the svarasāmans and the viṣuvān. Pravati Kauśānteya was a student of Kusurbinda Auddālaki. He said to him: 'O dear one, son of a charioteer, how many days of the year did your father consider?' 'Ten,' he said. 'Ten indeed,' he said. 'The virāj has ten syllables. Food is the virāj. The sacrifice is vairāja. How many else did he consider?' 'Nine,' he said. 'Nine indeed. Nine are the vital breaths in a person. The sacrifice is woven by the vital breaths. How many else?' 'Eight.' 'Eight indeed. The gāyatrī has eight syllables. The sacrifice is gāyatra. How many else?' 'Seven.' 'Seven indeed. Seven are the meters. The sacrifice is woven by the meters. How many else?' 'Six.' 'Six indeed. Six are the seasons; the year is the seasons. The year is the sacrifice. How many else?' 'Five.' 'Five indeed. The sacrifice is fivefold. Cattle are fivefold. Cattle are the sacrifice. How many else?' 'Four.' 'Four indeed. Four are the directions, four-footed are the cattle, four are the yajña-bearing meters: gāyatrī, triṣṭubh, jagatī, anuṣṭubh. How many else?' 'Three.' 'Three indeed. The sacrifice has three pressings. Three are the vital breaths — prāṇa, apāna, vyāna. Three are these worlds. How many else?' 'Two.' 'Two indeed. Day and night only. These two worlds are as if pervaded. Two are prāṇa and apāna. Two-footed is the person. How many else?' 'One.' 'One indeed. Day only. This very day has been; day it will be tomorrow. Therefore it is called "day after day." This is the foundation of the year — the day. He who knows this foundation becomes established. This is its oneness. He who knows this oneness — prosperity accompanies him, having become one with him.' They say: 'bhūtam — has been; bhūyāḥ — may it increase; bhaviṣyāt — may it come to be.' One should say: 'What has been will indeed increase and come to be.' These worlds have been, this Agni, Vāyu, yonder Āditya, Indra, Candramās have been. These rule over what has been and what will be.
meaning: ते सतिसदो ह वा अन्ये सत्रसदो ऽन्ये . सत्येवान्ये सीदन्ति सत्रम् अन्य आसते . ते हैव सतिसदो य एवं विद्वांसो दीक्षन्ते . एतासु हि देवतासु सति सीदन्तो यन्ति . ते ह ते सर्वं पाप्मानम् अपघ्नते . अथ य एते शिखाच्छिन्नाः प्रसर्पम् इच्छमाना आवेष्टन्ते ते हैव सत्रसदः . य एवं विद्वांसम् उपवदति यथैता देवता ऋत्वानीयाद् एवं नेत्य् एतासु ह्य् एवैनं देवतासु प्रपन्नम् एतासु वसन्तम् उपवदति तस्य हैतस्य नैव का चनार्तिर् अस्ति य एवं वेद . य एवैनम् उपवदति स आर्तिम् आर्च्छति . तानि वा एतानि संवत्सरस्य दशैवाहान्य् अतिरात्राव् आरम्भणीयमहाव्रतीये अहनी पृष्ठ्याभिप्लवौ विश्वजिदभिजितौ स्वरसामानश् च विषुवांश् च . प्रवतिर् ह कौशान्तेयः कुसुर्बिन्दस्यौद्दालकेर् ब्रह्मचार्य् आस . तं होवाच सोम्य सूतपुत्र कति ते पिता संवत्सरस्याहान्य् अमन्यतेति . दशेति होवाच . दश वावेति होवाच दशाक्षरा विराड् अन्नं विराड् वैराजो यज्ञः . कत्य् एवामन्यतेति . नवेति होवाच . नव वावेति होवाच . नव वै पुरुषे प्राणाः . प्राणैर् उ यज्ञस् तायते . कत्य् एवामन्यतेति . आष्टाव् इति होवाच . अष्टौ वावेति होवाच . अष्टाक्षरा गायत्री . गायत्रो यज्ञः . कत्य् एवामन्यतेति . सप्तेति होवाच . सप्त वावेति होवाच . सप्त वै छन्दांसि छन्दोभिर् यज्ञस् तायते . कत्य् एवामन्यतेति . षड् इति होवाच . षड् वावेति होवाच . षड् वा ऋतवस् संवत्सरः . संवत्सरो यज्ञः . कत्य् एवामन्यतेति . पञ्चेति होवाच . पञ्च वावेति होवाच . पाङ्क्तो यज्ञः . पाङ्क्ताः पशवः . पशवो यज्ञः . कत्य् एवामन्यतेति . चत्वारीति होवाच . चत्वारि वावेति होवाच . चतस्रो दिशश् चतुष्पदाः पशवश् चत्वारि छन्दांसि यज्ञवाहो गायत्री त्रिष्टुब् जगत्य् अनुष्टुप् . कत्य् एवामन्यतेति . त्रीणीति होवाच . त्रीणि वावेति होवाच . त्रिषवणो यज्ञस् त्रयः प्राणापानव्यानास् त्रय इमे लोकाः . कत्य् एवामन्यतेति . द्वे इति होवाच . द्वे वावेति होवाच . अहोरात्राव् एवेति . द्वाव् इमौ लोकाव् आविष्टमाव् इव द्वौ प्राणापानौ द्विपात् पुरुषः . कत्य् एवामन्यतेति . एकम् इति होवाच . एकं वावेति होवाच . अहर् एवेति . तद् इदम् अहर् अभूद् अह श्वो भविता . तद् एतद् अहर् अहर् इत्य् एव प्रोच्यते . सा हैषा संवत्सरस्य प्रतिष्ठा यद् अहः . स यो हास्यतां प्रतिष्ठां वेद प्रतितिष्ठति . एषो एवास्यैकता . स यो हास्यैताम् एकतां वेदैकधा हैनं भूत्वा श्रीस् सचते . तद् आहुर् भूतं भूया३ भविष्या३द् इति . भूतम् एव भूयो भविष्यत इति ब्रूयात् . भूता इमे लोका भूतो ऽयम् अग्निर् वायुर् असाव् आदित्य इन्द्रश् चन्द्रमाः . एते वै भूतस्य भविष्यतश् चेशते .
