sanskrit_iast: tā abruvan vatsān ha no vettha / tān naḥ prayaccha , yair vayaṃ vatsinīr asāma / vatsī sa brāhmaṇo 'sad yo 'smā vedeti / tābhyo vatsān prāyacchat / agnim evāsyai prāyacchad , vāyum antarikṣāyādityam amuṣyai / ete ha vā āsāṃ vatsāḥ / tās saṃvatsaram uṣitvāpaivākrāman / so 'bravīt kathāpākramiṣṭeti / tā abruvann ṛṣabhān ha no vettha / tān naḥ prayaccha , yair vayam ṛṣabhiṇīr asāma / ṛṣabhī sa brāhmaṇo 'sad yo 'smān vedeti / tābhya ṛṣabhān prāyacchad etān athakārān / ete ha vā āsām ṛṣabhāḥ / tās saṃvatsaram uṣitvāpaivākrāman /
sentences: tā abruvan vatsān ha no vettʰa /
tān naḥ prayaccʰa , yair vayaṃ vatsinīr asāma /
agnim evāsyai prāyaccʰad , vāyum antarikṣāyādityam amuṣyai /
tā abruvann r̥ṣabʰān ha no vettʰa /
tān naḥ prayaccʰa , yair vayam r̥ṣabʰiṇīr asāma /
text: They said: 'You know our calves. Give them to us, by which we may have calves. That brāhmaṇa who knows us will have calves.' He gave them calves. To this one he gave Agni; to the one of the atmosphere, Vāyu; to the other, Āditya. These are their calves. They stayed for a year and again departed. He said: 'Why have you departed?' They said: 'You know our bulls. Give them to us, by which we may have bulls. That brāhmaṇa who knows us will have bulls.' He gave them these bulls — the athakāras. These are their bulls. They stayed for a year and again departed.
meaning: ता अब्रुवन् वत्सान् ह नो वेत्थ / तान् नः प्रयच्छ , यैर् वयं वत्सिनीर् असाम / वत्सी स ब्राह्मणो ऽसद् यो ऽस्मा वेदेति / ताभ्यो वत्सान् प्रायच्छत् / अग्निम् एवास्यै प्रायच्छद् , वायुम् अन्तरिक्षायादित्यम् अमुष्यै / एते ह वा आसां वत्साः / तास् संवत्सरम् उषित्वापैवाक्रामन् / सो ऽब्रवीत् कथापाक्रमिष्टेति / ता अब्रुवन्न् ऋषभान् ह नो वेत्थ / तान् नः प्रयच्छ , यैर् वयम् ऋषभिणीर् असाम / ऋषभी स ब्राह्मणो ऽसद् यो ऽस्मान् वेदेति / ताभ्य ऋषभान् प्रायच्छद् एतान् अथकारान् / एते ह वा आसाम् ऋषभाः / तास् संवत्सरम् उषित्वापैवाक्रामन् /

sanskrit_iast: tā abruvann ekaṃ ha no rūpaṃ vettha / tan naḥ prayaccha , yena vayaṃ rūpiṇīr asāma / rūpī sa brāhmaṇo 'sad yo 'smā vedeti / tābhya etad ekaṃ rūpaṃ prāyacchad āpa iti / etad dha vā āsām ekaṃ rūpaṃ yad āpaḥ / tās saṃvatsaram uṣitvāpaivākrāman / so 'bravīt kathāpākramiṣṭeti / tā abruvann ekaṃ ha no nāma vettha / tan naḥ prayaccha , yena vayaṃ nāminīr asāma / nāmī sa brāhmaṇo 'sad yo 'smā vedeti / tābhya etad ekaṃ nāma prāyacchad indrā iti / etad dha vā āsām ekaṃ nāma yad indrāḥ / tās saṃvatsaram uṣitvāpaivākrāman /
sentences: tā abruvann ekaṃ ha no rūpaṃ vettʰa /
tan naḥ prayaccʰa , yena vayaṃ rūpiṇīr asāma /
tābʰya etad ekaṃ rūpaṃ prāyaccʰad āpa iti /
etad dʰa vā āsām ekaṃ rūpaṃ yad āpaḥ /
tā abruvann ekaṃ ha no nāma vettʰa /
tan naḥ prayaccʰa , yena vayaṃ nāminīr asāma /
tābʰya etad ekaṃ nāma prāyaccʰad indrā iti /
etad dʰa vā āsām ekaṃ nāma yad indrāḥ /
text: They said: 'You know our one form. Give it to us, by which we may be endowed with form. That brāhmaṇa who knows us will be endowed with form.' He gave them this one form: 'Waters' (āpaḥ). This is their one form — the waters. They stayed for a year and again departed. He said: 'Why have you departed?' They said: 'You know our one name. Give it to us, by which we may be named. That brāhmaṇa who knows us will be named.' He gave them this one name: 'Indrā.' This is their one name — Indrā. They stayed for a year and again departed.
meaning: ता अब्रुवन्न् एकं ह नो रूपं वेत्थ / तन् नः प्रयच्छ , येन वयं रूपिणीर् असाम / रूपी स ब्राह्मणो ऽसद् यो ऽस्मा वेदेति / ताभ्य एतद् एकं रूपं प्रायच्छद् आप इति / एतद् ध वा आसाम् एकं रूपं यद् आपः / तास् संवत्सरम् उषित्वापैवाक्रामन् / सो ऽब्रवीत् कथापाक्रमिष्टेति / ता अब्रुवन्न् एकं ह नो नाम वेत्थ / तन् नः प्रयच्छ , येन वयं नामिनीर् असाम / नामी स ब्राह्मणो ऽसद् यो ऽस्मा वेदेति / ताभ्य एतद् एकं नाम प्रायच्छद् इन्द्रा इति / एतद् ध वा आसाम् एकं नाम यद् इन्द्राः / तास् संवत्सरम् उषित्वापैवाक्रामन् /

sanskrit_iast: tā abruvaṃs tṛptīr ha no vettha / tā naḥ prayaccha , yābhir vayaṃ tṛpyāma / tṛpyāt sa brāhmaṇaḥ prajayā paśubhir yo 'smā vedeti / tābhya etās tṛptīḥ prāyacchad etān ekārān / ete ha vā āsāṃ tṛptayaḥ / tās saṃvatsaram uṣitvāpaivākrāman / so 'bravīt kathāpākramiṣṭeti / tā abruvan āvapanān ha no vettha , palyān ha no vettha , goṣṭhān ha no vettha / tān naḥ prayaccha , yair vayam āvapanavatīḥ palyavatīr goṣṭhinīr asāma / āvapanavān palyavān goṣṭhī sa brāhmaṇo 'sad yo 'smā vedeti / tābhyo vācaṃ prāyacchat / vācaṃ vāvedaṃ sarvaṃ nātiricyate / evā hy evā ity eṣāṃ vāg , evā hy agnā iti gavyāḥ paśava , evā hīndrā ity aśvyāḥ paśavaḥ / evā hi pūṣann ity ajāvikam evaitat /
sentences: tā abruvaṃs tr̥ptīr ha no vettʰa /
tā naḥ prayaccʰa , yābʰir vayaṃ tr̥pyāma /
tr̥pyāt sa brāhmaṇaḥ prajayā paśubʰir yo 'smā vedeti /
tābʰya etās tr̥ptīḥ prāyaccʰad etān ekārān /
tā abruvan āvapanān ha no vettʰa , palyān ha no vettʰa , goṣṭʰān ha no vettʰa /
tān naḥ prayaccʰa , yair vayam āvapanavatīḥ palyavatīr goṣṭʰinīr asāma /
āvapanavān palyavān goṣṭʰī sa brāhmaṇo 'sad yo 'smā vedeti /
evā hy evā ity eṣāṃ vāg , evā hy agnā iti gavyāḥ paśava , evā hīndrā ity aśvyāḥ paśavaḥ /
evā hi pūṣann ity ajāvikam evaitat /
text: They said: 'You know our satisfactions (tṛpti). Give them to us, by which we may be satisfied. That brāhmaṇa who knows us will be satisfied with progeny and cattle.' He gave them these satisfactions — the ekāra syllables. These are their satisfactions. They stayed for a year and again departed. He said: 'Why have you departed?' They said: 'You know our resting-places, our pens, our cow-stalls. Give them to us, by which we may have resting-places, pens, and cow-stalls. That brāhmaṇa who knows us will have resting-places, pens, and cow-stalls.' He gave them speech. Nothing surpasses speech. 'Evā hy evā' — that is their speech. 'Evā hy agnā' — that pertains to bovine cattle. 'Evā hy indrā' — that pertains to equine cattle. 'Evā hi pūṣan' — that pertains to goats and sheep.
meaning: ता अब्रुवंस् तृप्तीर् ह नो वेत्थ / ता नः प्रयच्छ , याभिर् वयं तृप्याम / तृप्यात् स ब्राह्मणः प्रजया पशुभिर् यो ऽस्मा वेदेति / ताभ्य एतास् तृप्तीः प्रायच्छद् एतान् एकारान् / एते ह वा आसां तृप्तयः / तास् संवत्सरम् उषित्वापैवाक्रामन् / सो ऽब्रवीत् कथापाक्रमिष्टेति / ता अब्रुवन् आवपनान् ह नो वेत्थ , पल्यान् ह नो वेत्थ , गोष्ठान् ह नो वेत्थ / तान् नः प्रयच्छ , यैर् वयम् आवपनवतीः पल्यवतीर् गोष्ठिनीर् असाम / आवपनवान् पल्यवान् गोष्ठी स ब्राह्मणो ऽसद् यो ऽस्मा वेदेति / ताभ्यो वाचं प्रायच्छत् / वाचं वावेदं सर्वं नातिरिच्यते / एवा ह्य् एवा इत्य् एषां वाग् , एवा ह्य् अग्ना इति गव्याः पशव , एवा हीन्द्रा इत्य् अश्व्याः पशवः / एवा हि पूषन्न् इत्य् अजाविकम् एवैतत् /

sanskrit_iast: atha mahānāmnayaḥ / prāṇā vā agre sapta / tebhya etāṃ saptapadāṃ śakvarīṃ niramimīta / prāṇān eva sarvam āyur eti ya evaṃ veda / saptapadāyai ṣaṭpadām ṣtūn saṃvatsaram / ṛtubhya ātmānaṃ paridatte ya evaṃ veda / ṣaṭpadāyai pañcapadāṃ paśūn paṃktim / paśumān bhavati ya evaṃ veda / pañcapadāyai catuṣpadāṃ vācam anuṣṭubhaṃ pratiṣṭhitim / vācā vadati ya evaṃ veda / catuṣpadāyai tripadāṃ tejo brāhmavarcasaṃ gāyatrīm / tejasvī brahmavarcasī bhavati ya evaṃ veda / tripadāyai dvipadāṃ puruṣam / nainaṃ pauruṣo vadho hanti ya evaṃ veda / dvipadāyā ekapadāṃ puruṣam eva / anvañcāv iva vai puruṣau / tasmāt puruṣaḥ puruṣaṃ parivedeṣṭi , puruṣaḥ puruṣasyānucaro bhavati , vindate 'nucaritr̥̄n /
sentences: prāṇān eva sarvam āyur eti ya evaṃ veda /
r̥tubʰya ātmānaṃ paridatte ya evaṃ veda /
tejasvī brahmavarcasī bʰavati ya evaṃ veda /
nainaṃ pauruṣo vadʰo hanti ya evaṃ veda /
tasmāt puruṣaḥ puruṣaṃ parivedeṣṭi , puruṣaḥ puruṣasyānucaro bʰavati , vindate 'nucaritr̥̄n /
text: Now the mahānāmnīs. In the beginning there were seven vital breaths. From them he fashioned this seven-footed śakvarī. He who knows thus lives out his full lifespan through the vital breaths. From the seven-footed he made the six-footed — the seasons, the year. He who knows thus offers himself to the seasons. From the six-footed he made the five-footed — cattle, the paṅkti metre. He who knows thus becomes rich in cattle. From the five-footed he made the four-footed — speech, the anuṣṭubh, firm standing. He who knows thus speaks with speech. From the four-footed he made the three-footed — splendor, brahmavarcas, the gāyatrī. He who knows thus becomes radiant and endowed with brahmavarcas. From the three-footed he made the two-footed — the person. He who knows thus is not struck by human violence. From the two-footed he made the one-footed — the person alone. Two persons are as if following one another. Therefore a person accompanies a person, a person becomes the attendant of a person; one finds attendants.
meaning: अथ महानाम्नयः / प्राणा वा अग्रे सप्त / तेभ्य एतां सप्तपदां शक्वरीं निरमिमीत / प्राणान् एव सर्वम् आयुर् एति य एवं वेद / सप्तपदायै षट्पदाम् ष्तून् संवत्सरम् / ऋतुभ्य आत्मानं परिदत्ते य एवं वेद / षट्पदायै पञ्चपदां पशून् पंक्तिम् / पशुमान् भवति य एवं वेद / पञ्चपदायै चतुष्पदां वाचम् अनुष्टुभं प्रतिष्ठितिम् / वाचा वदति य एवं वेद / चतुष्पदायै त्रिपदां तेजो ब्राह्मवर्चसं गायत्रीम् / तेजस्वी ब्रह्मवर्चसी भवति य एवं वेद / त्रिपदायै द्विपदां पुरुषम् / नैनं पौरुषो वधो हन्ति य एवं वेद / द्विपदाया एकपदां पुरुषम् एव / अन्वञ्चाव् इव वै पुरुषौ / तस्मात् पुरुषः पुरुषं परिवेदेष्टि , पुरुषः पुरुषस्यानुचरो भवति , विन्दते ऽनुचरित्र्̥̄न् /

sanskrit_iast: tāni sarvāṇi chandāṃsi saṃbhṛtya tair indro vṛtram ahan / yan mahāntam ahaṃs tasmān mahānāmnayaḥ / yad aśaknot tasmāc chakvaryaḥ / yan maṭviyam akarot tasmān maṭvīḥ / yat sīmānam abhinat tasmāt simāḥ / atho hainās sīmata eva samṛje / sima iti vai śreṣṭham ācakṣate / sima śreṣṭha svānāṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda / tā ha vā etā indrā eva nāma / indro vai yatra mahānāmnīṣu mithunatvam aicchata , tā enam abruvan -- sa vai naḥ prayaccheti / kim iti / yat ta etan nāmeti / tābhyas tat prāyacchat / tasmād etā indrā nāma / etad dha vā āsāṃ priyaṃ guhyaṃ nāma yad indrāḥ / sa yo hāsām etad vidvān pariharata , āgāmukam enaṃ priyaṃ bhavati paśyate priyam /
sentences: tāni sarvāṇi cʰandāṃsi saṃbʰr̥tya tair indro vr̥tram ahan /
sima śreṣṭʰa svānāṃ bʰavati ya evaṃ veda /
tā ha vā etā indrā eva nāma /
indro vai yatra mahānāmnīṣu mitʰunatvam aiccʰata , tā enam abruvan -- sa vai naḥ prayaccʰeti /
etad dʰa vā āsāṃ priyaṃ guhyaṃ nāma yad indrāḥ /
sa yo hāsām etad vidvān pariharata , āgāmukam enaṃ priyaṃ bʰavati paśyate priyam /
text: Having gathered together all those metres, with them Indra slew Vṛtra. Because he slew the great one (mahāntam), therefore they are the mahānāmnī verses. Because he was able (aśaknot), therefore they are the śakvarī verses. Because he made [it] crumble (maṭvīyam akarot), therefore they are the maṭvī verses. Because he broke through the boundary (sīmānam abhinat), therefore they are the simā verses. And indeed he wiped them from the boundary itself. 'Sima' they declare to be the most excellent. He who knows thus becomes the most excellent (sima) among his own people. These are indeed named 'indrā.' When Indra desired sexual union with the mahānāmnī verses, they said to him: 'Give us that.' 'What?' 'That name of yours.' He gave that to them. Therefore they are named indrā. This is their dear, secret name — indrā. He who, knowing this, recites them — it becomes dear to him, approaching like a cow to the stable; he sees what is dear.
meaning: तानि सर्वाणि छन्दांसि संभृत्य तैर् इन्द्रो वृत्रम् अहन् / यन् महान्तम् अहंस् तस्मान् महानाम्नयः / यद् अशक्नोत् तस्माच् छक्वर्यः / यन् मट्वियम् अकरोत् तस्मान् मट्वीः / यत् सीमानम् अभिनत् तस्मात् सिमाः / अथो हैनास् सीमत एव समृजे / सिम इति वै श्रेष्ठम् आचक्षते / सिम श्रेष्ठ स्वानां भवति य एवं वेद / ता ह वा एता इन्द्रा एव नाम / इन्द्रो वै यत्र महानाम्नीषु मिथुनत्वम् ऐच्छत , ता एनम् अब्रुवन् -- स वै नः प्रयच्छेति / किम् इति / यत् त एतन् नामेति / ताभ्यस् तत् प्रायच्छत् / तस्माद् एता इन्द्रा नाम / एतद् ध वा आसां प्रियं गुह्यं नाम यद् इन्द्राः / स यो हासाम् एतद् विद्वान् परिहरत , आगामुकम् एनं प्रियं भवति पश्यते प्रियम् /

sanskrit_iast: asā u āva mahān / tasyaitāḥ pratināmnayaḥ / tasyo evaitan nāma parihanati / sā yaiṣā purastād dvipadopadhīyate puruṣa eva saḥ / atha yāny uttarāṇi trīṇi padāni paśavas te / bhasat prathamā sakthyau dva / parāñcaḥ paśavas saṃbhavanti / tasmād bhasat prathamākhyāyate / atha yāny uttarāṇi trīṇi padāni vatsaḥ prathamo 'thodho 'tha puruṣaḥ / atha yāny uttarāṇi trīṇi padānīmau dvau śirogrīvam , ekam atha yad uttamaṃ padam upaśa eva saḥ / paśceva dvitīya āgacchat tasmād uttamā dvyupaśaivaṃ priyasya kuryāt / etad dha vā āsāṃ prattam adhītam upajīvanīyam / yad vatsaḥ prathamo bhavaty athodho 'tha puruṣaḥ , prattaṃ haivāsyādhītam upajīvanīyaṃ bhavati /
sentences: sā yaiṣā purastād dvipadopadʰīyate puruṣa eva saḥ /
atʰa yāny uttarāṇi trīṇi padāni paśavas te /
atʰa yāny uttarāṇi trīṇi padāni vatsaḥ pratʰamo 'tʰodʰo 'tʰa puruṣaḥ /
atʰa yāny uttarāṇi trīṇi padānīmau dvau śirogrīvam , ekam atʰa yad uttamaṃ padam upaśa eva saḥ /
paśceva dvitīya āgaccʰat tasmād uttamā dvyupaśaivaṃ priyasya kuryāt /
etad dʰa vā āsāṃ prattam adʰītam upajīvanīyam /
yad vatsaḥ pratʰamo bʰavaty atʰodʰo 'tʰa puruṣaḥ , prattaṃ haivāsyādʰītam upajīvanīyaṃ bʰavati /
text: He [the hymn] is indeed great. These are its corresponding names (pratināmnayaḥ). One thus recites that name of it. Now, that which is the two-footed [verse] placed at the beginning — that is the puruṣa (man) himself. And the next three feet are the paśu (cattle). The bhasat (rump) is the first, the two thighs the second. Cattle are born facing away; therefore the rump is named first. And the next three feet: the calf first, then the udder, then the man. And the next three feet: these two are the head-and-neck, one; and the last foot is the upaśa (attendant verse). The second [mahānāmnī] arrives from behind, as it were; therefore the last is the dvy-upaśa. Thus one should arrange the dear [verses]. This is their established, learned, and life-sustaining [arrangement]. When the calf is first, then the udder, then the man — his learning becomes established and life-sustaining.
meaning: असा उ आव महान् / तस्यैताः प्रतिनाम्नयः / तस्यो एवैतन् नाम परिहनति / सा यैषा पुरस्ताद् द्विपदोपधीयते पुरुष एव सः / अथ यान्य् उत्तराणि त्रीणि पदानि पशवस् ते / भसत् प्रथमा सक्थ्यौ द्व / पराञ्चः पशवस् संभवन्ति / तस्माद् भसत् प्रथमाख्यायते / अथ यान्य् उत्तराणि त्रीणि पदानि वत्सः प्रथमो ऽथोधो ऽथ पुरुषः / अथ यान्य् उत्तराणि त्रीणि पदानीमौ द्वौ शिरोग्रीवम् , एकम् अथ यद् उत्तमं पदम् उपश एव सः / पश्चेव द्वितीय आगच्छत् तस्माद् उत्तमा द्व्युपशैवं प्रियस्य कुर्यात् / एतद् ध वा आसां प्रत्तम् अधीतम् उपजीवनीयम् / यद् वत्सः प्रथमो भवत्य् अथोधो ऽथ पुरुषः , प्रत्तं हैवास्याधीतम् उपजीवनीयं भवति /

sanskrit_iast: -- ūdhaḥ prathamaṃ kuryād atha vatsam atha puruṣam / dhītaṃ haivāsyāprattam anupajīvanīyaṃ bhavati / atha yaṃ kāmayetāpaśu syād iti vatsam asyāntariyāt / paśavo vai vatsaḥ / paśūn evāsyāntareti / atha yaṃ kāmayeta rudro 'sya paśūñ chamayed ity antarā vatsaṃ codhaś ca puruṣam avadadhyāt / rudro vai puruṣaḥ / rudram evāsya tad goṣṭhe 'vadadhāti / saiṣā mīmāṃsā / atha yathaivāsām idaṃ prajñātaṃ stotraṃ tayaiva stotavyam / iyaṃ vai prathamā mahānāmnī , tasyā agnir upaśaḥ / iyaṃ dvitīyā , tasyai vāyur upaśaḥ / asau tṛtīyā , tasyai sūryācandram asāv upaśau / tāsāṃ yo hṛdāvakino veda trir vilā hāsya gṛhā bhavanti tṛptā ivārūkṣā antarataḥ / ekārā ha vā āsāṃ hṛdāvakinaḥ / tasmād dhṛda ekāram upāvasedhaṃ paśūṃs tarpayanti / atha ya āsām alaṃkārān vedālaṃkurvanto 'syāsate gṛheṣv aṃśuṃ rukmaṃ niṣkaṃ hastinam aśvatarīratham aśvaratham / stomā ha vā āsām alaṃkārāḥ / tā alaṃkurvann iva śobhayann iva gāyet /
sentences: -- ūdʰaḥ pratʰamaṃ kuryād atʰa vatsam atʰa puruṣam /
atʰa yaṃ kāmayetāpaśu syād iti vatsam asyāntariyāt /
atʰa yaṃ kāmayeta rudro 'sya paśūñ cʰamayed ity antarā vatsaṃ codʰaś ca puruṣam avadadʰyāt /
atʰa yatʰaivāsām idaṃ prajñātaṃ stotraṃ tayaiva stotavyam /
iyaṃ vai pratʰamā mahānāmnī , tasyā agnir upaśaḥ /
asau tr̥tīyā , tasyai sūryācandram asāv upaśau /
tāsāṃ yo hr̥dāvakino veda trir vilā hāsya gr̥hā bʰavanti tr̥ptā ivārūkṣā antarataḥ /
tasmād dʰr̥da ekāram upāvasedʰaṃ paśūṃs tarpayanti /
atʰa ya āsām alaṃkārān vedālaṃkurvanto 'syāsate gr̥heṣv aṃśuṃ rukmaṃ niṣkaṃ hastinam aśvatarīratʰam aśvaratʰam /
tā alaṃkurvann iva śobʰayann iva gāyet /
text: One should place the udder first, then the calf, then the man. [Then] his learning becomes unestablished, not life-sustaining. Now, for him whom one desires — 'may he be without cattle' — one should omit the calf from his [recitation]. The calf is cattle; one thus removes his cattle. And for him whom one desires — 'may Rudra destroy his cattle' — one should place the man between the calf and the udder. The man is Rudra; one thus places Rudra in his cattle-pen. This is the deliberation (mīmāṃsā) on this. Now, the stotra should be chanted with that arrangement by which it is traditionally known. This earth is the first mahānāmnī; its upaśa is Agni. This [atmosphere] is the second; its upaśa is Vāyu. That [sky] is the third; its upaśa-s are Sūrya and Candra. He who knows their heart-contents (hṛdāvakin) — his houses become thrice overflowing, satiated and unblemished within. The single syllable 'ā' is their heart-content. Therefore when one approaches the heart [of the chant] with a single 'ā,' the cattle are satiated. And he who knows their ornaments — those who ornament [the chant] sit in his houses [enjoying] a gold thread, a gold disc, a niṣka necklace, an elephant, a mule-chariot, and a horse-chariot. The stoma-s are their ornaments. One should chant as if ornamenting, as if beautifying [them].
meaning: -- ऊधः प्रथमं कुर्याद् अथ वत्सम् अथ पुरुषम् / धीतं हैवास्याप्रत्तम् अनुपजीवनीयं भवति / अथ यं कामयेतापशु स्याद् इति वत्सम् अस्यान्तरियात् / पशवो वै वत्सः / पशून् एवास्यान्तरेति / अथ यं कामयेत रुद्रो ऽस्य पशूञ् छमयेद् इत्य् अन्तरा वत्सं चोधश् च पुरुषम् अवदध्यात् / रुद्रो वै पुरुषः / रुद्रम् एवास्य तद् गोष्ठे ऽवदधाति / सैषा मीमांसा / अथ यथैवासाम् इदं प्रज्ञातं स्तोत्रं तयैव स्तोतव्यम् / इयं वै प्रथमा महानाम्नी , तस्या अग्निर् उपशः / इयं द्वितीया , तस्यै वायुर् उपशः / असौ तृतीया , तस्यै सूर्याचन्द्रम् असाव् उपशौ / तासां यो हृदावकिनो वेद त्रिर् विला हास्य गृहा भवन्ति तृप्ता इवारूक्षा अन्तरतः / एकारा ह वा आसां हृदावकिनः / तस्माद् धृद एकारम् उपावसेधं पशूंस् तर्पयन्ति / अथ य आसाम् अलंकारान् वेदालंकुर्वन्तो ऽस्यासते गृहेष्व् अंशुं रुक्मं निष्कं हस्तिनम् अश्वतरीरथम् अश्वरथम् / स्तोमा ह वा आसाम् अलंकाराः / ता अलंकुर्वन्न् इव शोभयन्न् इव गायेत् /

sanskrit_iast: āpo vai mahānāmnayaḥ / tāsām āditya eva vatsaḥ / tad yā ha vai prācīr āpo dhāvanty etam eva tā udyantam abhīpsantīr dhāvanti / atha yāḥ pratīcīr dhāvanty etam eva tā astaṃ yantam abhīpsantīr dhāvanti / tad yat pṛccheyur yā imā āpo 'harahar dhāvanti kam etā abhīpsantīr dhāvantīti / etam ity eva tatra prativacanam / atho āhur vāyur vai mahānāmnīnāṃ vatsaḥ / eṣa hīmān lokān imā diśaḥ pratāpayata iti / ima u lokā mahānāmnayaḥ / tasmāt purovāte vāti , vṛṣṭyām āśāsante / yathā ha prattā na duhīta tādṛk tad yat purovāte vāty atha na varṣati / paśavo vai mahānāmnayaḥ / goṣṭha eva purīṣam / tad āhuḥ purīṣeṇāgre stotavyam atha mahānāmnībhiḥ / āyatanaṃ vā agre 'tha paśavaḥ / āyatanaṃ hi paśavo 'bhisamāyantīti / tad u vā āhuḥ paśūnāṃ vai purīṣaṃ bhavati / yad vai paśavo na syur na purīṣaṃ syāt / yado vai puruṣaḥ paśūn vindate 'tha sa goṣṭhaṃ paryasyate guptyai /
sentences: tad yā ha vai prācīr āpo dʰāvanty etam eva tā udyantam abʰīpsantīr dʰāvanti /
atʰa yāḥ pratīcīr dʰāvanty etam eva tā astaṃ yantam abʰīpsantīr dʰāvanti /
tad yat pr̥ccʰeyur yā imā āpo 'harahar dʰāvanti kam etā abʰīpsantīr dʰāvantīti /
atʰo āhur vāyur vai mahānāmnīnāṃ vatsaḥ /
eṣa hīmān lokān imā diśaḥ pratāpayata iti /
yatʰā ha prattā na duhīta tādr̥k tad yat purovāte vāty atʰa na varṣati /
tad āhuḥ purīṣeṇāgre stotavyam atʰa mahānāmnībʰiḥ /
tad u vā āhuḥ paśūnāṃ vai purīṣaṃ bʰavati /
yad vai paśavo na syur na purīṣaṃ syāt /
yado vai puruṣaḥ paśūn vindate 'tʰa sa goṣṭʰaṃ paryasyate guptyai /
text: The waters are the mahānāmnī verses. Their calf is the sun (āditya). Those waters that flow eastward — they flow desiring him as he rises. And those that flow westward — they flow desiring him as he sets. If one were to ask, 'These waters that flow day after day — whom do they flow desiring?' — 'Him [the sun]' is the answer to that. Others say: 'Vāyu is the calf of the mahānāmnī verses, for he warms these worlds and these quarters.' These worlds themselves are the mahānāmnī verses. Therefore when the wind blows from the east, they hope for rain. Just as [a cow that has been] milked does not yield milk — such is the case when the wind blows from the east but it does not rain. Cattle are the mahānāmnī verses. The cattle-pen is purīṣa (dung/fertile soil). They say: 'One should chant first with the purīṣa, then with the mahānāmnī verses.' First the dwelling-place, then the cattle — for cattle come together to their dwelling-place. But others say: 'Purīṣa belongs to cattle. If there were no cattle, there would be no purīṣa. When a man obtains cattle, then he constructs a cattle-pen for their protection.'
meaning: आपो वै महानाम्नयः / तासाम् आदित्य एव वत्सः / तद् या ह वै प्राचीर् आपो धावन्त्य् एतम् एव ता उद्यन्तम् अभीप्सन्तीर् धावन्ति / अथ याः प्रतीचीर् धावन्त्य् एतम् एव ता अस्तं यन्तम् अभीप्सन्तीर् धावन्ति / तद् यत् पृच्छेयुर् या इमा आपो ऽहरहर् धावन्ति कम् एता अभीप्सन्तीर् धावन्तीति / एतम् इत्य् एव तत्र प्रतिवचनम् / अथो आहुर् वायुर् वै महानाम्नीनां वत्सः / एष हीमान् लोकान् इमा दिशः प्रतापयत इति / इम उ लोका महानाम्नयः / तस्मात् पुरोवाते वाति , वृष्ट्याम् आशासन्ते / यथा ह प्रत्ता न दुहीत तादृक् तद् यत् पुरोवाते वात्य् अथ न वर्षति / पशवो वै महानाम्नयः / गोष्ठ एव पुरीषम् / तद् आहुः पुरीषेणाग्रे स्तोतव्यम् अथ महानाम्नीभिः / आयतनं वा अग्रे ऽथ पशवः / आयतनं हि पशवो ऽभिसमायन्तीति / तद् उ वा आहुः पशूनां वै पुरीषं भवति / यद् वै पशवो न स्युर् न पुरीषं स्यात् / यदो वै पुरुषः पशून् विन्दते ऽथ स गोष्ठं पर्यस्यते गुप्त्यै /

sanskrit_iast: tad āhus sakṛd eva saṃstutāsūpariṣṭāt purīṣeṇa stotavyam uta vai bahutayāḥ paśavo nānātyās samānam eva goṣṭham abhisamāyantīti / yad dvayīr u ha tathā prajā bhavanti / anuparyāyam eva purīṣeṇa stotavyam / tathā ha sarvā vrajavatīr bhavanti / ail̥āni purīṣāṇi bhavanti / anuparyāyam eva purīṣeṇa stotavyam / tathā ha sarvā vrajavatīr bhavanti / ail̥āni purīṣāṇi bhavanti / paśavo vā il̥ā , āyatanaṃ purīṣam / āyatana eva tad etān paśūn pratiṣṭhāpayanti / apa upanidhāya stuvanti sāmnas sarvatvāya / etad vai mahānāmnīnāṃ sarvaṃ rūpaṃ yad āpaḥ / tā udiṃgayeyū rūpasamṛddhatāyai / tad āhuḥ kvemā ninayed iti / tāsām eṣā mīmāṃsā -- vasatīvarīṣv avanīya somam abhiṣutya bhakṣayeyur iti / mathitam iva ha tv eṣāṃ bhavati yātayāma / yātayāmnīr ayātayāmnīṣv avanayanti / atho āhus tṛtīyasavanīyān evābhiḥ puroḍāśān upasṛjeyur iti / yajamāno vai puroḍāśo , 'nnam āpaḥ / annenaiva tad yajamānaṃ samanakti / īśvaro ha tu yajamānam uttaravayase śvaḥ pāmā vetthoḥ / kaṇḍūyitā iva hi bhavanti / atho āhuś cātvāla eva ninayed iti / yonir vai yajñasya cātvālaṃ , reta āpo , yonyām evaitad retaḥ pratiṣṭhāpayati /
sentences: tad āhus sakr̥d eva saṃstutāsūpariṣṭāt purīṣeṇa stotavyam uta vai bahutayāḥ paśavo nānātyās samānam eva goṣṭʰam abʰisamāyantīti /
yad dvayīr u ha tatʰā prajā bʰavanti /
āyatana eva tad etān paśūn pratiṣṭʰāpayanti /
etad vai mahānāmnīnāṃ sarvaṃ rūpaṃ yad āpaḥ /
tāsām eṣā mīmāṃsā -- vasatīvarīṣv avanīya somam abʰiṣutya bʰakṣayeyur iti /
matʰitam iva ha tv eṣāṃ bʰavati yātayāma /
atʰo āhus tr̥tīyasavanīyān evābʰiḥ puroḍāśān upasr̥jeyur iti /
īśvaro ha tu yajamānam uttaravayase śvaḥ pāmā vettʰoḥ /
atʰo āhuś cātvāla eva ninayed iti /
yonir vai yajñasya cātvālaṃ , reta āpo , yonyām evaitad retaḥ pratiṣṭʰāpayati /
text: They say: 'When the [mahānāmnī verses] have been chanted once together, one should chant with the purīṣa on top. Indeed cattle of many kinds, of various breeds, come together to the same cattle-pen.' If [arranged] in two groups, the offspring become twofold. One should chant with the purīṣa in regular succession. Then all [cows] become stall-going. The purīṣa-s are ilā-verses. One should chant with the purīṣa in regular succession. Then all become stall-going. The purīṣa-s are ilā-verses. Cattle are ilā; the dwelling-place is the purīṣa. In the dwelling-place they thus establish these cattle. They chant having placed water nearby, for the completeness of the sāman. This is the complete form of the mahānāmnī verses — namely, the waters. They should raise them up [the water-vessels], for the fullness of form. They say: 'Where should one pour these out?' This is the deliberation on them: 'Having placed [them] in the vasatīvarī waters, having pressed the soma, they should drink.' But it becomes as if churned for them — stale (yātayāma). They pour the stale into the unstale. Others say: 'One should pour them upon the third-pressing puroḍāśa cakes.' The puroḍāśa is the sacrificer; the waters are food. With food one thus anoints the sacrificer. But the sacrificer is liable the next day to [get] skin disease or itch. For they become as if causing itching. Others say: 'One should pour [them] into the cātvāla pit.' The cātvāla is the womb of the sacrifice; the waters are seed. In the womb one thus establishes the seed.
meaning: तद् आहुस् सकृद् एव संस्तुतासूपरिष्टात् पुरीषेण स्तोतव्यम् उत वै बहुतयाः पशवो नानात्यास् समानम् एव गोष्ठम् अभिसमायन्तीति / यद् द्वयीर् उ ह तथा प्रजा भवन्ति / अनुपर्यायम् एव पुरीषेण स्तोतव्यम् / तथा ह सर्वा व्रजवतीर् भवन्ति / ऐल्̥आनि पुरीषाणि भवन्ति / अनुपर्यायम् एव पुरीषेण स्तोतव्यम् / तथा ह सर्वा व्रजवतीर् भवन्ति / ऐल्̥आनि पुरीषाणि भवन्ति / पशवो वा इल्̥आ , आयतनं पुरीषम् / आयतन एव तद् एतान् पशून् प्रतिष्ठापयन्ति / अप उपनिधाय स्तुवन्ति साम्नस् सर्वत्वाय / एतद् वै महानाम्नीनां सर्वं रूपं यद् आपः / ता उदिंगयेयू रूपसमृद्धतायै / तद् आहुः क्वेमा निनयेद् इति / तासाम् एषा मीमांसा -- वसतीवरीष्व् अवनीय सोमम् अभिषुत्य भक्षयेयुर् इति / मथितम् इव ह त्व् एषां भवति यातयाम / यातयाम्नीर् अयातयाम्नीष्व् अवनयन्ति / अथो आहुस् तृतीयसवनीयान् एवाभिः पुरोडाशान् उपसृजेयुर् इति / यजमानो वै पुरोडाशो , ऽन्नम् आपः / अन्नेनैव तद् यजमानं समनक्ति / ईश्वरो ह तु यजमानम् उत्तरवयसे श्वः पामा वेत्थोः / कण्डूयिता इव हि भवन्ति / अथो आहुश् चात्वाल एव निनयेद् इति / योनिर् वै यज्ञस्य चात्वालं , रेत आपो , योन्याम् एवैतद् रेतः प्रतिष्ठापयति /

sanskrit_iast: tad āhur vihṛtā agnayo bhavanti , vāstu pariśiṣyate , garbhā anuśoṣukā syur , yac cātvāle ninayet / āstāve ninayed iti / eṣa ha vā udgātuś ca yajamānasya ca dhiṣṇyo yad āstāvaḥ / āyatanam āstāvaḥ / āyatana eva tad etān kāmān pratiṣṭhāpayanti / tāsām atra yāvatkāmaṃ ninīya , athāntaḥparidhi ninayet / tathā haiṣāṃ tā hutāś cāhutāś ca bhavanti / yathā ha vā idaṃ vidāvan prāṇāv aniruktāv evam etau dhiṣṇyau santāv anavagatau /
sentences: tad āhur vihr̥tā agnayo bʰavanti , vāstu pariśiṣyate , garbʰā anuśoṣukā syur , yac cātvāle ninayet /
eṣa ha vā udgātuś ca yajamānasya ca dʰiṣṇyo yad āstāvaḥ /
āyatana eva tad etān kāmān pratiṣṭʰāpayanti /
tāsām atra yāvatkāmaṃ ninīya , atʰāntaḥparidʰi ninayet /
tatʰā haiṣāṃ tā hutāś cāhutāś ca bʰavanti /
yatʰā ha vā idaṃ vidāvan prāṇāv aniruktāv evam etau dʰiṣṇyau santāv anavagatau /
text: They say: 'The fires would be scattered, the homestead would be left over, and the embryos would dry up, if one were to pour [them] into the cātvāla.' 'One should pour [them] onto the āstāva (the chanting-place).' This dhiṣṇya-hearth belongs to both the udgātṛ and the sacrificer — namely, the āstāva. The āstāva is the dwelling-place. In the dwelling-place one thus establishes these desires. Having poured as much as one wishes there, one should then pour [the remainder] inside the enclosing-sticks (paridhi). Thus they become both offered and unoffered. Just as two breaths here are undefined (aniruktau), so these two dhiṣṇya hearths, though existing, remain unrecognized.
meaning: तद् आहुर् विहृता अग्नयो भवन्ति , वास्तु परिशिष्यते , गर्भा अनुशोषुका स्युर् , यच् चात्वाले निनयेत् / आस्तावे निनयेद् इति / एष ह वा उद्गातुश् च यजमानस्य च धिष्ण्यो यद् आस्तावः / आयतनम् आस्तावः / आयतन एव तद् एतान् कामान् प्रतिष्ठापयन्ति / तासाम् अत्र यावत्कामं निनीय , अथान्तःपरिधि निनयेत् / तथा हैषां ता हुताश् चाहुताश् च भवन्ति / यथा ह वा इदं विदावन् प्राणाव् अनिरुक्ताव् एवम् एतौ धिष्ण्यौ सन्ताव् अनवगतौ /

sanskrit_iast: asurāṇāṃ ha vā agra ime lokā āsuḥ / upajīvina iva hi devā āsus tapa eva śraddhām anvāyattāḥ / te 'rcantas tāmyantas tejo balam indriyaṃ vīryam ātmasv adadhata / tad eṣām asurā āditsanta / tad āditsyamānam apsu prāveśayan , ned idam asurā vināntā iti / tasmād idam apy etarhy amitreṣv āyatsu vittam upagūhanti , ned idam amitrā vindāntā iti / tad apaiva devebhyo 'krāman , nāsurān prāpnot / te devā etaṃ saṃvatsaraśramam apaśyan / tenainad abhyāśrāmyan / tad ūrdhvam upaśrayata / d divi spṛṣṭam atiṣṭhat / yad divi spṛṣṭam atiṣṭhat , tat spṛṣṭānāṃ spṛṣṭatvam / spṛṣṭāni ha vai nāmaitāni / tāni pṛṣṭhānīti parokṣam ākhyāyante / sarvān kāmān spṛśati ya evaṃ veda / sa yatkāma syāt saṃvatsaraṃ śrāmyed , ava haivainad runddhe /
sentences: asurāṇāṃ ha vā agra ime lokā āsuḥ /
upajīvina iva hi devā āsus tapa eva śraddʰām anvāyattāḥ /
te 'rcantas tāmyantas tejo balam indriyaṃ vīryam ātmasv adadʰata /
tad āditsyamānam apsu prāveśayan , ned idam asurā vināntā iti /
tasmād idam apy etarhy amitreṣv āyatsu vittam upagūhanti , ned idam amitrā vindāntā iti /
yad divi spr̥ṣṭam atiṣṭʰat , tat spr̥ṣṭānāṃ spr̥ṣṭatvam /
sarvān kāmān spr̥śati ya evaṃ veda /
sa yatkāma syāt saṃvatsaraṃ śrāmyed , ava haivainad runddʰe /
text: These worlds formerly belonged to the asura-s. The deva-s lived as dependents, as it were, relying upon tapas and śraddhā alone. Worshipping and toiling, they placed tejas, bala, indriya, and vīrya in themselves. The asura-s wished to seize that from them. [The deva-s,] having that which was being seized, concealed it in the waters — 'Lest the asura-s destroy this.' Therefore even now, when enemies approach, people hide their wealth — 'Lest the enemies find this.' It departed from the asura-s toward the deva-s; it did not reach the asura-s. The deva-s perceived this year-long exertion (saṃvatsaraśrama). With that they labored toward it. It rose upward. It stood touching heaven. Because it stood touching heaven (divi spṛṣṭam), that is the 'touched-ness' (spṛṣṭatva) of the spṛṣṭa-s. These are indeed called spṛṣṭa. They are called pṛṣṭha-s in veiled speech (parokṣam). He who knows thus touches all desires. Whatever desire one may have, one should exert for a year — one surely obtains it.
meaning: असुराणां ह वा अग्र इमे लोका आसुः / उपजीविन इव हि देवा आसुस् तप एव श्रद्धाम् अन्वायत्ताः / ते ऽर्चन्तस् ताम्यन्तस् तेजो बलम् इन्द्रियं वीर्यम् आत्मस्व् अदधत / तद् एषाम् असुरा आदित्सन्त / तद् आदित्स्यमानम् अप्सु प्रावेशयन् , नेद् इदम् असुरा विनान्ता इति / तस्माद् इदम् अप्य् एतर्ह्य् अमित्रेष्व् आयत्सु वित्तम् उपगूहन्ति , नेद् इदम् अमित्रा विन्दान्ता इति / तद् अपैव देवेभ्यो ऽक्रामन् , नासुरान् प्राप्नोत् / ते देवा एतं संवत्सरश्रमम् अपश्यन् / तेनैनद् अभ्याश्राम्यन् / तद् ऊर्ध्वम् उपश्रयत / द् दिवि स्पृष्टम् अतिष्ठत् / यद् दिवि स्पृष्टम् अतिष्ठत् , तत् स्पृष्टानां स्पृष्टत्वम् / स्पृष्टानि ह वै नामैतानि / तानि पृष्ठानीति परोक्षम् आख्यायन्ते / सर्वान् कामान् स्पृशति य एवं वेद / स यत्काम स्यात् संवत्सरं श्राम्येद् , अव हैवैनद् रुन्द्धे /

sanskrit_iast: āpo vai devānāṃ patnaya āsan / tā mithunam aicchanta / tāsāṃ vāyuḥ pṛṣṭhe vyavartata / tā garbham adadhata / tā devā abruvan sṛjadhvam iti / tā rathanaraṃ prathame 'hann asṛjanta / tad rathaghoṣo 'nvasṛjyata / tasmād rathantarasya stotre rathaghoṣaṃ kurvanti / tā abruvan -- sṛjadhvam eveti / tā bṛhad dvitīye 'hann asṛjanta / tat parjanyasya ghoṣo 'nvasṛjyata / tasmād bṛhata stotre dundubhīn udvādayanti / varṣukaḥ parjanyo bhavati / tā abruvan sṛjadhvam eveti / tā vairūpaṃ tṛtīye 'hann asṛjanta / tad grāmaghoṣo 'nvasṛjyata / tasmād vairūpasya stotre grāmaghoṣaṃ kurvanti / tā abruvan sṛjadhvam eveti / tā vairājaṃ caturthe 'hann asṛjanta / tad agner ghoṣo 'nvasṛjyata / tasmād vairājasya stotre 'gniṃ manthanti / tā abruvan sṛjadhvam eveti / tāś śākvaraṃ pañcame 'hann asṛjanta / tad apāṃ ghoṣo 'nyasṛjyata / tasmāc chākvarasya stotre 'pa upanidhāya stuvanti / tā abruvan sṛjadhvam eveti / tā raivataṃ ṣaṣṭhe 'hann asṛjanta / tat paśughoṣo 'nvasṛjyata / tasmād raivatasya stotre paśughoṣaṃ kurvanti , vatsān mātṛbhis saṃvāśayanti / tā abruvan sṛjadhvam eveti / etāvad vāvety abruvan / tad ete ha vā āsām aindrā ghoṣā vadanti / asminn aindrā ghoṣās sarvā asmin puṇyā vāco vadanti ya evaṃ veda / te devā vāmadevyam eva yoniṃ parigṛhyordhvā udāgāhanta / tad etasya pṛṣṭhyasya ṣaḍahasya madhye ha māyaṃ nyadadhuḥ / tad yāni ha vai stutāni sāmāni paścātvaṃ teṣāṃ vāmadevyam , atha yāny astutāni purastvaṃ teṣām / yo vai grāmasya śreṣṭhī baliṣṭho bhavati tena paścātvena tena purastvena yanti / ariṣṭena yajñena yajate ya evaṃ veda / etasmād dha vā idaṃ yugyau na samavahanau vahato , 'nyatara eva vahīyān bhavati / tasmād vāmadevyaṃ pṛṣṭham / pṛṣṭhaṃ hi prativahatīti / kl̥ptir vā eṣā śāntir vā eṣā pratiṣṭhā vā eṣaiṣa vāva yajño yad vāmadevyam /
sentences: tasmād raivatasya stotre paśugʰoṣaṃ kurvanti , vatsān mātr̥bʰis saṃvāśayanti /
tad ete ha vā āsām aindrā gʰoṣā vadanti /
asminn aindrā gʰoṣās sarvā asmin puṇyā vāco vadanti ya evaṃ veda /
te devā vāmadevyam eva yoniṃ parigr̥hyordʰvā udāgāhanta /
tad etasya pr̥ṣṭʰyasya ṣaḍahasya madʰye ha māyaṃ nyadadʰuḥ /
tad yāni ha vai stutāni sāmāni paścātvaṃ teṣāṃ vāmadevyam , atʰa yāny astutāni purastvaṃ teṣām /
yo vai grāmasya śreṣṭʰī baliṣṭʰo bʰavati tena paścātvena tena purastvena yanti /
ariṣṭena yajñena yajate ya evaṃ veda /
etasmād dʰa vā idaṃ yugyau na samavahanau vahato , 'nyatara eva vahīyān bʰavati /
kl̥ptir vā eṣā śāntir vā eṣā pratiṣṭʰā vā eṣaiṣa vāva yajño yad vāmadevyam /
text: The waters were the wives of the deva-s. They desired sexual union. Vāyu turned upon their backs. They conceived a womb. The deva-s said to them: 'Give birth!' On the first day they gave birth to the rathantara. The sound of a chariot (rathaghoṣa) accompanied it. Therefore at the stotra of the rathantara they make chariot-sounds. They said: 'Give birth again!' On the second day they gave birth to the bṛhat. The sound of the rain-cloud (parjanya) accompanied it. Therefore at the stotra of the bṛhat they beat drums. The rain-god (parjanya) becomes a rain-giver. They said: 'Give birth again!' On the third day they gave birth to the vairūpa. The sound of the village (grāmaghoṣa) accompanied it. Therefore at the stotra of the vairūpa they make village-sounds. They said: 'Give birth again!' On the fourth day they gave birth to the vairāja. The sound of fire (agni) accompanied it. Therefore at the stotra of the vairāja they churn fire. They said: 'Give birth again!' On the fifth day they gave birth to the śakvara. The sound of waters accompanied it. Therefore at the stotra of the śakvara they chant having placed water nearby. They said: 'Give birth again!' On the sixth day they gave birth to the raivata. The sound of cattle (paśughoṣa) accompanied it. Therefore at the stotra of the raivata they make cattle-sounds, letting calves cry together with their mothers. They said: 'Give birth again!' 'This much indeed suffices,' they said. These are the aindrā sounds that are uttered for them. In him the aindrā sounds, in him all auspicious words are uttered — he who knows thus. The deva-s, having grasped the vāmadevya as the womb, rose upward. In the middle of this pṛṣṭhya ṣaḍaha they placed a support (māyā). Of the sāman-s that have been chanted, the vāmadevya is the rear-most; of those unchanted, it is the foremost. He who is the headman of a village, the strongest — by that rear-position, by that front-position they go. He who knows thus sacrifices with an unimpaired sacrifice. From this indeed, among a yoked pair, the two do not pull equally; one is always the stronger puller. Therefore the vāmadevya is the pṛṣṭha, for the pṛṣṭha pulls back in support. This [vāmadevya] is the kl̥pti (arrangement), the śānti (peace), the pratiṣṭhā (foundation). This indeed is the sacrifice — the vāmadevya.
meaning: आपो वै देवानां पत्नय आसन् / ता मिथुनम् ऐच्छन्त / तासां वायुः पृष्ठे व्यवर्तत / ता गर्भम् अदधत / ता देवा अब्रुवन् सृजध्वम् इति / ता रथनरं प्रथमे ऽहन्न् असृजन्त / तद् रथघोषो ऽन्वसृज्यत / तस्माद् रथन्तरस्य स्तोत्रे रथघोषं कुर्वन्ति / ता अब्रुवन् -- सृजध्वम् एवेति / ता बृहद् द्वितीये ऽहन्न् असृजन्त / तत् पर्जन्यस्य घोषो ऽन्वसृज्यत / तस्माद् बृहत स्तोत्रे दुन्दुभीन् उद्वादयन्ति / वर्षुकः पर्जन्यो भवति / ता अब्रुवन् सृजध्वम् एवेति / ता वैरूपं तृतीये ऽहन्न् असृजन्त / तद् ग्रामघोषो ऽन्वसृज्यत / तस्माद् वैरूपस्य स्तोत्रे ग्रामघोषं कुर्वन्ति / ता अब्रुवन् सृजध्वम् एवेति / ता वैराजं चतुर्थे ऽहन्न् असृजन्त / तद् अग्नेर् घोषो ऽन्वसृज्यत / तस्माद् वैराजस्य स्तोत्रे ऽग्निं मन्थन्ति / ता अब्रुवन् सृजध्वम् एवेति / ताश् शाक्वरं पञ्चमे ऽहन्न् असृजन्त / तद् अपां घोषो ऽन्यसृज्यत / तस्माच् छाक्वरस्य स्तोत्रे ऽप उपनिधाय स्तुवन्ति / ता अब्रुवन् सृजध्वम् एवेति / ता रैवतं षष्ठे ऽहन्न् असृजन्त / तत् पशुघोषो ऽन्वसृज्यत / तस्माद् रैवतस्य स्तोत्रे पशुघोषं कुर्वन्ति , वत्सान् मातृभिस् संवाशयन्ति / ता अब्रुवन् सृजध्वम् एवेति / एतावद् वावेत्य् अब्रुवन् / तद् एते ह वा आसाम् ऐन्द्रा घोषा वदन्ति / अस्मिन्न् ऐन्द्रा घोषास् सर्वा अस्मिन् पुण्या वाचो वदन्ति य एवं वेद / ते देवा वामदेव्यम् एव योनिं परिगृह्योर्ध्वा उदागाहन्त / तद् एतस्य पृष्ठ्यस्य षडहस्य मध्ये ह मायं न्यदधुः / तद् यानि ह वै स्तुतानि सामानि पश्चात्वं तेषां वामदेव्यम् , अथ यान्य् अस्तुतानि पुरस्त्वं तेषाम् / यो वै ग्रामस्य श्रेष्ठी बलिष्ठो भवति तेन पश्चात्वेन तेन पुरस्त्वेन यन्ति / अरिष्टेन यज्ञेन यजते य एवं वेद / एतस्माद् ध वा इदं युग्यौ न समवहनौ वहतो , ऽन्यतर एव वहीयान् भवति / तस्माद् वामदेव्यं पृष्ठम् / पृष्ठं हि प्रतिवहतीति / क्ल्̥प्तिर् वा एषा शान्तिर् वा एषा प्रतिष्ठा वा एषैष वाव यज्ञो यद् वामदेव्यम् /

sanskrit_iast: "asāvy aṃśur madāye " ty asāvīti simānāṃ rūpam / "apsu dakṣo giriṣṭhāḥ / śyeno na yonim āsadat // śubhram andho devavātam apsu dhautaṃ nṛbhis sutam /" ity apsumatīr bhavanti / āpo hy etad ahaḥ / "svadanti gāvaḥ payobhiḥ // ād īm aśvaṃ na hetāram aśūśubhann amṛtāya /" iti gomatīḥ paśumatīr bhavanti paśūnām evāvaruddhyai / paśavo hy etad ahaḥ / "madho rasaṃ sadhamāda " iti madvatīr bhavanti / raso vai madaḥ / dhītam ivaitad yat tṛtīyasavanam / tad yad etā madvatīr bhavanti rasam evāsminn etad dadhati / aivainad etena pyāyayanti / tāsu gāyatram uktabrāhmaṇam / atha santani / vāg vā eṣā pratatā yad dvādaśāhaḥ / tāṃ santaninaiva saṃtanvanti / prāṇā ha khalu vai santanayaḥ / prāṇair vāk santatā / tad yat santani bhavati prāṇānām eva santatyai , vācaṃ prāṇais santanavāmeti / ime vai lokās santanaya , ima u lokā mahānāmnayaḥ / tad yat santani bhavaty eṣām eva lokānāṃ santatyai / sam asmā ime lokās tāyante ya evaṃ veda / "abhi dyumnaṃ bṛhad yaśa " ity abhīti bhavati rathantarasya rūpam / rāthantaram etad ahaḥ / "jinvan gaviṣṭaye dhiya " it gomatīḥ paśumatīr bhavanti paśūnām evāvaruddhyai /
sentences: "asāvy aṃśur madāye " ty asāvīti simānāṃ rūpam /
śubʰram andʰo devavātam apsu dʰautaṃ nr̥bʰis sutam /"
ād īm aśvaṃ na hetāram aśūśubʰann amr̥tāya /"
iti gomatīḥ paśumatīr bʰavanti paśūnām evāvaruddʰyai /
tad yad etā madvatīr bʰavanti rasam evāsminn etad dadʰati /
vāg vā eṣā pratatā yad dvādaśāhaḥ /
tad yat santani bʰavati prāṇānām eva santatyai , vācaṃ prāṇais santanavāmeti /
ime vai lokās santanaya , ima u lokā mahānāmnayaḥ /
tad yat santani bʰavaty eṣām eva lokānāṃ santatyai /
sam asmā ime lokās tāyante ya evaṃ veda /
"abʰi dyumnaṃ br̥had yaśa " ity abʰīti bʰavati ratʰantarasya rūpam /
"jinvan gaviṣṭaye dʰiya " it gomatīḥ paśumatīr bʰavanti paśūnām evāvaruddʰyai /
text: 'That pressed drop [goes] for exhilaration' — asāv-iti is the form of the simā verses. 'Skilled in the waters, dwelling on the mountain. Like a falcon he has settled upon the nest. The bright draught, desired by the gods, washed in the waters, pressed by men' — they contain [references to] water. For this day belongs to waters. 'The cows sweeten with their milk.' 'Like a swift horse, the driver, they have adorned him for immortality' — they contain [references to] cows and cattle, for the securing of cattle. For this day belongs to cattle. 'The taste of the sweet drink at the common feast' — they contain [references to] intoxication (mada). Taste (rasa) is intoxication. The third pressing is like what has been milked. Because they contain mada-references, they place rasa in this [pressing]; they cause it to swell thereby. In these the gāyatra has its brāhmaṇa stated. Now the santani. Speech is this stretched-out [thing] that is the dvādaśāha (twelve-day rite). With the santani they extend it. The prāṇa-s (vital breaths) are the santani-s. Speech is extended by the prāṇa-s. That the santani occurs is for the extension of the prāṇa-s — 'let us extend speech with the prāṇa-s.' These worlds are the santani-s; these worlds are the mahānāmnī verses. That the santani occurs is for the extension of these worlds. These worlds are woven together for him who knows thus. 'Toward bright glory, great renown' — it has abhi, which is the form of the rathantara. This day is rāthantara. 'Stirring thoughts for the winning of cows' — they contain cow-references and cattle-references, for the securing of cattle.
meaning: "असाव्य् अंशुर् मदाये " त्य् असावीति सिमानां रूपम् / "अप्सु दक्षो गिरिष्ठाः / श्येनो न योनिम् आसदत् // शुभ्रम् अन्धो देववातम् अप्सु धौतं नृभिस् सुतम् /" इत्य् अप्सुमतीर् भवन्ति / आपो ह्य् एतद् अहः / "स्वदन्ति गावः पयोभिः // आद् ईम् अश्वं न हेतारम् अशूशुभन्न् अमृताय /" इति गोमतीः पशुमतीर् भवन्ति पशूनाम् एवावरुद्ध्यै / पशवो ह्य् एतद् अहः / "मधो रसं सधमाद " इति मद्वतीर् भवन्ति / रसो वै मदः / धीतम् इवैतद् यत् तृतीयसवनम् / तद् यद् एता मद्वतीर् भवन्ति रसम् एवास्मिन्न् एतद् दधति / ऐवैनद् एतेन प्याययन्ति / तासु गायत्रम् उक्तब्राह्मणम् / अथ सन्तनि / वाग् वा एषा प्रतता यद् द्वादशाहः / तां सन्तनिनैव संतन्वन्ति / प्राणा ह खलु वै सन्तनयः / प्राणैर् वाक् सन्तता / तद् यत् सन्तनि भवति प्राणानाम् एव सन्तत्यै , वाचं प्राणैस् सन्तनवामेति / इमे वै लोकास् सन्तनय , इम उ लोका महानाम्नयः / तद् यत् सन्तनि भवत्य् एषाम् एव लोकानां सन्तत्यै / सम् अस्मा इमे लोकास् तायन्ते य एवं वेद / "अभि द्युम्नं बृहद् यश " इत्य् अभीति भवति रथन्तरस्य रूपम् / राथन्तरम् एतद् अहः / "जिन्वन् गविष्टये धिय " इत् गोमतीः पशुमतीर् भवन्ति पशूनाम् एवावरुद्ध्यै /

sanskrit_iast: tāsu cyāvanam / cyavano vai bhārgavo vāstupasya brāhmaṇam avet / sa putrān abravīd vāstupasya vai brāhmaṇaṃ veda / taṃ mā vāstau nidhāya triḥ punaḥprayāṇaṃ prayāteti / te 'bruvan na śakṣyāma , ākrośanavanto bhaviṣyāmaḥ / pitaram ahāsiṣur iti no vakṣyantīti / neti hovāca , tena vai yūyaṃ vasīyāṃso bhaviṣyatha , teno eva mama punaryuvatāyā āśā / hitvaiva mā prayāteti tān ajñāpayat / taṃ sarasvatyai śaiśave nidhāya triḥ punaḥprayāṇaṃ prāyan / so 'kāmayata vāstau hīnaḥ -- punar yuvā syāṃ , kumārīṃ jāyāṃ vindeya , sahasreṇa yajeyeti / sa etat sāmāpaśyat /
sentences: cyavano vai bʰārgavo vāstupasya brāhmaṇam avet /
sa putrān abravīd vāstupasya vai brāhmaṇaṃ veda /
taṃ mā vāstau nidʰāya triḥ punaḥprayāṇaṃ prayāteti /
neti hovāca , tena vai yūyaṃ vasīyāṃso bʰaviṣyatʰa , teno eva mama punaryuvatāyā āśā /
taṃ sarasvatyai śaiśave nidʰāya triḥ punaḥprayāṇaṃ prāyan /
so 'kāmayata vāstau hīnaḥ -- punar yuvā syāṃ , kumārīṃ jāyāṃ vindeya , sahasreṇa yajeyeti /
text: In these [is] the cyāvana [sāman]. Cyavana Bhārgava knew the brāhmaṇa of vāstupa. He said to his sons: 'I know the brāhmaṇa of vāstupa. Having placed me at the homestead, depart three times and return.' They said: 'We cannot; we will be reviled. They will say we abandoned our father.' 'No,' he said, 'by that you will become more prosperous, and thereby is my hope for renewed youth. Leave me and depart.' He commanded them. Having placed him at the Sarasvatī in his childhood place, they departed three times and returned. He desired, having been left at the homestead: 'May I become young again, may I find a maiden as wife, may I sacrifice with a thousand.' He perceived this sāman.
meaning: तासु च्यावनम् / च्यवनो वै भार्गवो वास्तुपस्य ब्राह्मणम् अवेत् / स पुत्रान् अब्रवीद् वास्तुपस्य वै ब्राह्मणं वेद / तं मा वास्तौ निधाय त्रिः पुनःप्रयाणं प्रयातेति / ते ऽब्रुवन् न शक्ष्याम , आक्रोशनवन्तो भविष्यामः / पितरम् अहासिषुर् इति नो वक्ष्यन्तीति / नेति होवाच , तेन वै यूयं वसीयांसो भविष्यथ , तेनो एव मम पुनर्युवताया आशा / हित्वैव मा प्रयातेति तान् अज्ञापयत् / तं सरस्वत्यै शैशवे निधाय त्रिः पुनःप्रयाणं प्रायन् / सो ऽकामयत वास्तौ हीनः -- पुनर् युवा स्यां , कुमारीं जायां विन्देय , सहस्रेण यजेयेति / स एतत् सामापश्यत् /

sanskrit_iast: taṃ tuṣṭuvānaṃ śaryāto mānavo grāmeṇādhyavāsyat / taṃ kumārā gopālā avipālā mṛdā śakṛtpiṇḍair āsapāṃsubhir adihan / so 'saṃjñāṃ śāryātyebhyo 'karot / tan na mātā putram ajānān , na putro mātaram / so 'bravīc charyāto mānavaḥ -- kim ihābhitaḥ kiṃ cid adrāṣṭa , yata idam ittham abhūd iti / tasmai hocur na nu tato 'nyat -- sthavira evāyaṃ niṣṭhāvaś śete / tam adya kumārā gopālā avipālā mṛdā śakṛtpiṇḍair āsapāṃsubhir adhikṣan /
sentences: taṃ kumārā gopālā avipālā mr̥dā śakr̥tpiṇḍair āsapāṃsubʰir adihan /
tan na mātā putram ajānān , na putro mātaram /
so 'bravīc cʰaryāto mānavaḥ -- kim ihābʰitaḥ kiṃ cid adrāṣṭa , yata idam ittʰam abʰūd iti /
tasmai hocur na nu tato 'nyat -- stʰavira evāyaṃ niṣṭʰāvaś śete /
tam adya kumārā gopālā avipālā mr̥dā śakr̥tpiṇḍair āsapāṃsubʰir adʰikṣan /
text: As he was praising [with this sāman], Śaryāta Mānava settled near him with his village. Young cowherds and goatherds struck him with clods of earth, balls of dung, and handfuls of dust. He caused confusion among the Śāryāta people — no mother recognized her son, no son his mother. Śaryāta Mānava said: 'What has been seen here that this has happened thus?' They told him: 'Nothing else — only this old man lying in exhaustion. Today the young cowherds and goatherds pelted him with clods, dung-balls, and handfuls of dust.'
meaning: तं तुष्टुवानं शर्यातो मानवो ग्रामेणाध्यवास्यत् / तं कुमारा गोपाला अविपाला मृदा शकृत्पिण्डैर् आसपांसुभिर् अदिहन् / सो ऽसंज्ञां शार्यात्येभ्यो ऽकरोत् / तन् न माता पुत्रम् अजानान् , न पुत्रो मातरम् / सो ऽब्रवीच् छर्यातो मानवः -- किम् इहाभितः किं चिद् अद्राष्ट , यत इदम् इत्थम् अभूद् इति / तस्मै होचुर् न नु ततो ऽन्यत् -- स्थविर एवायं निष्ठावश् शेते / तम् अद्य कुमारा गोपाला अविपाला मृदा शकृत्पिण्डैर् आसपांसुभिर् अधिक्षन् /

sanskrit_iast: sa hovāca -- cyavano vai sa bhārgavo 'bhūt / sa vāstupasya brāhmaṇaṃ veda / taṃ nūnaṃ putrā vāstau hitvā prāyāsiṣur iti / tam ādrutyābravīd ṛṣe , namas te 'stu / śāryātyabhyo bhago mṛl̥eti / atha ha sukanyā śāryātyā kalyāṇy āsa / sa hovāca -- sa vai me sukanyāṃ dehīti / neti hovāca / anyad dhanaṃ brūṣveti / neti hovāca / vāstupasya vai brāhmaṇaṃ veda / tāṃ ma ihopanidhāyāsāyam evādya grāmeṇa yātād iti / te vai tvā mantrayitvā pratibravāmeti / te hocur mantrayitvā -- ekaṃ vai dve trīṇi paramam anayā dhanāni labhemahy , athainayeha sarvam eva lapsyāmahe / hantāsmā imā dadāmeti / tāṃ hāsmai daduḥ / tāṃ hocuḥ -- kumāri , sthaviro vā ayaṃ niṣṭhāvo nālam anusaraṇāya / yadaiva vayaṃ yunajāmahā , athānvādhāvatād iti / sā heyaṃ yuktaṃ grāmam anusariṣyanty anūttasthau / sā hovācāhe paridhāva sakhāyaṃ jīvahāyinam iti /
sentences: sa hovāca -- cyavano vai sa bʰārgavo 'bʰūt /
taṃ nūnaṃ putrā vāstau hitvā prāyāsiṣur iti /
atʰa ha sukanyā śāryātyā kalyāṇy āsa /
sa hovāca -- sa vai me sukanyāṃ dehīti /
tāṃ ma ihopanidʰāyāsāyam evādya grāmeṇa yātād iti /
te hocur mantrayitvā -- ekaṃ vai dve trīṇi paramam anayā dʰanāni labʰemahy , atʰainayeha sarvam eva lapsyāmahe /
tāṃ hocuḥ -- kumāri , stʰaviro vā ayaṃ niṣṭʰāvo nālam anusaraṇāya /
sā heyaṃ yuktaṃ grāmam anusariṣyanty anūttastʰau /
sā hovācāhe paridʰāva sakʰāyaṃ jīvahāyinam iti /
text: He said: 'That was Cyavana Bhārgava. He knows the brāhmaṇa of vāstupa. His sons must have left him at the homestead and departed.' He rushed to him and said: 'O sage, homage to you! May there be mercy for the Śāryāta people.' Then Sukanyā, daughter of Śaryāta, was beautiful. He said: 'Give me Sukanyā.' 'No,' he said. 'Name another gift.' 'No,' he said. 'I know the brāhmaṇa of vāstupa. Having placed her here for me, let him depart this very day with his village.' 'Having deliberated, we shall answer you.' Having deliberated, they said: 'With her [married elsewhere] we would obtain at most one, two, or three gifts; but with her here we shall obtain everything. Come, let us give her to him.' They gave her to him. They said to her: 'Maiden, this man is old and feeble, not fit to be followed. When we yoke [the carts], then run after us.' She stood up to follow the yoked village. But she said: 'Alas, I shall attend my companion, my life-partner.'
meaning: स होवाच -- च्यवनो वै स भार्गवो ऽभूत् / स वास्तुपस्य ब्राह्मणं वेद / तं नूनं पुत्रा वास्तौ हित्वा प्रायासिषुर् इति / तम् आद्रुत्याब्रवीद् ऋषे , नमस् ते ऽस्तु / शार्यात्यभ्यो भगो मृल्̥एति / अथ ह सुकन्या शार्यात्या कल्याण्य् आस / स होवाच -- स वै मे सुकन्यां देहीति / नेति होवाच / अन्यद् धनं ब्रूष्वेति / नेति होवाच / वास्तुपस्य वै ब्राह्मणं वेद / तां म इहोपनिधायासायम् एवाद्य ग्रामेण याताद् इति / ते वै त्वा मन्त्रयित्वा प्रतिब्रवामेति / ते होचुर् मन्त्रयित्वा -- एकं वै द्वे त्रीणि परमम् अनया धनानि लभेमह्य् , अथैनयेह सर्वम् एव लप्स्यामहे / हन्तास्मा इमा ददामेति / तां हास्मै ददुः / तां होचुः -- कुमारि , स्थविरो वा अयं निष्ठावो नालम् अनुसरणाय / यदैव वयं युनजामहा , अथान्वाधावताद् इति / सा हेयं युक्तं ग्रामम् अनुसरिष्यन्त्य् अनूत्तस्थौ / सा होवाचाहे परिधाव सखायं जीवहायिनम् इति /

sanskrit_iast: -- kṛṣṇasarpa u haivaināṃ pratyuttasthau / sā ha tad eva nirvidyopaviveśa / atha hāśvinau darvihomiṇau bhiṣajyantāv idaṃ ceratur anapisomau / tau hainām etyocatuḥ -- kumāri , sthaviro vā ayam asarvo nālaṃ patitvanāyāvayor jāyaidhīti / neti hovāca / yasmā eva mā pitādāt , tasya jāyā bhaviṣyāmīti / tad dhāyam ājughoṣa / atha hemau preyatuḥ / sa hovāca -- kumāri , ko nv eṣa ghoṣo 'bhūd iti / puruṣau memāv upāgātāṃ yat kalyāṇatamaṃ rūpāṇāṃ tena rūpeṇeti / tau tvā kim avocatām iti / kumāri , sthaviro vā ayam asarvo nālaṃ patitvanāyāvayor jāyaidhīti / sā tvaṃ kim avoca iti /
sentences: atʰa hāśvinau darvihomiṇau bʰiṣajyantāv idaṃ ceratur anapisomau /
tau hainām etyocatuḥ -- kumāri , stʰaviro vā ayam asarvo nālaṃ patitvanāyāvayor jāyaidʰīti /
yasmā eva mā pitādāt , tasya jāyā bʰaviṣyāmīti /
sa hovāca -- kumāri , ko nv eṣa gʰoṣo 'bʰūd iti /
puruṣau memāv upāgātāṃ yat kalyāṇatamaṃ rūpāṇāṃ tena rūpeṇeti /
kumāri , stʰaviro vā ayam asarvo nālaṃ patitvanāyāvayor jāyaidʰīti /
text: A black serpent stood in her way. Despairing at that, she sat down. Then the two Aśvin-s, offering darvī-oblations and practicing medicine, wandered about here, excluded from the soma. They came to her and said: 'Maiden, this man is old and incomplete — he is not fit for husbandhood. Become the wife of us two.' 'No,' she said. 'I shall be the wife of him to whom my father gave me.' He [Cyavana] heard this call. Then the two departed. He said: 'Maiden, what was that sound?' 'Two men approached me, of the most beautiful form among forms.' 'What did they say to you?' 'Maiden, this old man is incomplete, not fit for husbandhood — become the wife of us two.' 'And what did you say?'
meaning: -- कृष्णसर्प उ हैवैनां प्रत्युत्तस्थौ / सा ह तद् एव निर्विद्योपविवेश / अथ हाश्विनौ दर्विहोमिणौ भिषज्यन्ताव् इदं चेरतुर् अनपिसोमौ / तौ हैनाम् एत्योचतुः -- कुमारि , स्थविरो वा अयम् असर्वो नालं पतित्वनायावयोर् जायैधीति / नेति होवाच / यस्मा एव मा पितादात् , तस्य जाया भविष्यामीति / तद् धायम् आजुघोष / अथ हेमौ प्रेयतुः / स होवाच -- कुमारि , को न्व् एष घोषो ऽभूद् इति / पुरुषौ मेमाव् उपागातां यत् कल्याणतमं रूपाणां तेन रूपेणेति / तौ त्वा किम् अवोचताम् इति / कुमारि , स्थविरो वा अयम् असर्वो नालं पतित्वनायावयोर् जायैधीति / सा त्वं किम् अवोच इति /

sanskrit_iast: tad dhāsya priyam āsa / sa sahocāśvinau vai tau darvihomiṇau bhiṣajyantāv idaṃ carato 'napisomau / tau tvaitad evāgatya śvo vaktārau / tau tvaṃ brūtād -- yuvaṃ vā asarvau stho , yau devau santāv asomapau sthaḥ / sarvo vai mama patir yas somapa iti / tau vai tvā vaktārau -- kas tasyeśe yad āvam apisomau syāveti / ayaṃ mama patir iti brūtāt / teno eva me punaryuvatāyā āśati / tau haināṃ śvo bhūta etyaitad evocatuḥ / sā hovāca -- yuvaṃ vā asarvau stho , yau devau santāv asomapau sthaḥ / sarvo vai mama patir yas somapa iti / tau hocatuḥ kas tasyeśe yad āvam apisomau syāveti /
sentences: sa sahocāśvinau vai tau darvihomiṇau bʰiṣajyantāv idaṃ carato 'napisomau /
tau tvaṃ brūtād -- yuvaṃ vā asarvau stʰo , yau devau santāv asomapau stʰaḥ /
sarvo vai mama patir yas somapa iti /
tau vai tvā vaktārau -- kas tasyeśe yad āvam apisomau syāveti /
tau haināṃ śvo bʰūta etyaitad evocatuḥ /
sā hovāca -- yuvaṃ vā asarvau stʰo , yau devau santāv asomapau stʰaḥ /
sarvo vai mama patir yas somapa iti /
tau hocatuḥ kas tasyeśe yad āvam apisomau syāveti /
text: That was pleasing to him. He said at once: 'Those are the two Aśvin-s, offering darvī-oblations, practicing medicine, wandering here, excluded from the soma. They will come again tomorrow and say the same thing. You should tell them: You two are also incomplete, since though you are gods, you have no soma. My husband is complete — he is a soma-drinker. They will then say: Who can make it so that we become soma-drinkers? Say: This is my husband. [And then say:] Thereby is my hope for renewed youth.' The next day, they came and said exactly that. She said: 'You two are incomplete, since though you are gods, you have no soma. My husband is complete — he is a soma-drinker.' They said: 'Who can make it so that we become soma-drinkers?'
meaning: तद् धास्य प्रियम् आस / स सहोचाश्विनौ वै तौ दर्विहोमिणौ भिषज्यन्ताव् इदं चरतो ऽनपिसोमौ / तौ त्वैतद् एवागत्य श्वो वक्तारौ / तौ त्वं ब्रूताद् -- युवं वा असर्वौ स्थो , यौ देवौ सन्ताव् असोमपौ स्थः / सर्वो वै मम पतिर् यस् सोमप इति / तौ वै त्वा वक्तारौ -- कस् तस्येशे यद् आवम् अपिसोमौ स्यावेति / अयं मम पतिर् इति ब्रूतात् / तेनो एव मे पुनर्युवताया आशति / तौ हैनां श्वो भूत एत्यैतद् एवोचतुः / सा होवाच -- युवं वा असर्वौ स्थो , यौ देवौ सन्ताव् असोमपौ स्थः / सर्वो वै मम पतिर् यस् सोमप इति / तौ होचतुः कस् तस्येशे यद् आवम् अपिसोमौ स्यावेति /

sanskrit_iast: taṃ hocatur -- ṛṣe 'pisomau nau bhagavaḥ kurv iti / tatheti hovāca / tau vai nu mā yuvaṃ punaryuvānaṃ kurutam iti / taṃ ha sarasvatyai śaiśavam abhyavacakṛṣatuḥ / sa hovāca -- kumāri , sarve vai sadṛśā udeṣyāmo , 'nena mā lakṣmakeṇa jānītād iti / te ha sarva eva sadṛśā udeyur yat kalyāṇatamaṃ rūpāṇāṃ tena rūpeṇa / taṃ heyaṃ jñātvāvabibhede -- ayaṃ mama patir iti / taṃ hocatur , ṛṣe 'kurvāvaṃ tava taṃ kāmaṃ yas tava kāmo 'bhūt / punaryuvābhūḥ /
sentences: taṃ hocatur -- r̥ṣe 'pisomau nau bʰagavaḥ kurv iti /
tau vai nu mā yuvaṃ punaryuvānaṃ kurutam iti /
sa hovāca -- kumāri , sarve vai sadr̥śā udeṣyāmo , 'nena mā lakṣmakeṇa jānītād iti /
te ha sarva eva sadr̥śā udeyur yat kalyāṇatamaṃ rūpāṇāṃ tena rūpeṇa /
taṃ heyaṃ jñātvāvabibʰede -- ayaṃ mama patir iti /
taṃ hocatur , r̥ṣe 'kurvāvaṃ tava taṃ kāmaṃ yas tava kāmo 'bʰūt /
text: They said to him: 'O sage, make us soma-drinkers, sir.' 'So be it,' he said. 'But you two must make me young again.' They plunged him into the pool (śaiśava) of the Sarasvatī. He said: 'Maiden, we shall all emerge looking alike. Recognize me by this mark.' They all emerged looking alike, in the most beautiful of forms. She, recognizing him, chose: 'This is my husband.' They said to him: 'O sage, we have fulfilled that desire of yours. You have become young again.'
meaning: तं होचतुर् -- ऋषे ऽपिसोमौ नौ भगवः कुर्व् इति / तथेति होवाच / तौ वै नु मा युवं पुनर्युवानं कुरुतम् इति / तं ह सरस्वत्यै शैशवम् अभ्यवचकृषतुः / स होवाच -- कुमारि , सर्वे वै सदृशा उदेष्यामो , ऽनेन मा लक्ष्मकेण जानीताद् इति / ते ह सर्व एव सदृशा उदेयुर् यत् कल्याणतमं रूपाणां तेन रूपेण / तं हेयं ज्ञात्वावबिभेदे -- अयं मम पतिर् इति / तं होचतुर् , ऋषे ऽकुर्वावं तव तं कामं यस् तव कामो ऽभूत् / पुनर्युवाभूः /

sanskrit_iast: sa hovāca -- devā vā ete kurukṣetre 'paśīṛṣṇā yajñena yajamānā āsate / te taṃ kāmaṃ nāpnuvanti yo yajñe kāmaḥ / tad yajñasya śiro 'chidyata / tad yad dadhyaṅ ātharvaṇo 'nvapaśyat taṃ tad gacchatam / sa vāṃ tad anuvakṣyati / tato 'pisomau bhaviṣyatha iti / tad yat tad yajñasya śiro 'chidyateti , so 'sāv ādityaḥ / sa u eva pravargyaḥ / tau ha dadhyañcam ātharvaṇam ājagmatuḥ / taṃ hocatur , ṛṣe upa tvāyāveti / kasmai kāmāyeti / etad yajñasya śiro 'nuvakṣyāvahā iti / neti hovāca / indro vai tad apy apaśyat / sa mābravīd -- yadi vā idam anyasmai brūyāś śiras te chindyām iti / tasmād bibhemīti / sa vai nāv anenāśvasya śīrṣṇānubrūhīti / tatheti hovāca / sa vai nu vāṃ saṃvadamānau paśyānīti / tau hemau svaṃ śiro nidhāyedam aśvasya śiraḥ pratisaṃdhāya tena ha sma saṃvadamānāv āsāte sāma gāyamānāv ṛcaṃ yajur abhivyāharantau /
sentences: sa hovāca -- devā vā ete kurukṣetre 'paśīr̥ṣṇā yajñena yajamānā āsate /
te taṃ kāmaṃ nāpnuvanti yo yajñe kāmaḥ /
tad yad dadʰyaṅ ātʰarvaṇo 'nvapaśyat taṃ tad gaccʰatam /
tad yat tad yajñasya śiro 'cʰidyateti , so 'sāv ādityaḥ /
sa mābravīd -- yadi vā idam anyasmai brūyāś śiras te cʰindyām iti /
sa vai nu vāṃ saṃvadamānau paśyānīti /
tau hemau svaṃ śiro nidʰāyedam aśvasya śiraḥ pratisaṃdʰāya tena ha sma saṃvadamānāv āsāte sāma gāyamānāv r̥caṃ yajur abʰivyāharantau /
text: He (Tvaṣṭṛ) said: 'The gods are sitting at Kurukṣetra, performing the sacrifice without its head. They do not attain the desire that is in the sacrifice. The head of the sacrifice was cut off. That which Dadhyañc Ātharvaṇa perceived — go to him. He will teach it to you. Then you two will also become soma-drinkers.' Now, as to what is said 'the head of the sacrifice was cut off' — that is yonder sun (āditya). And that is indeed the pravargya. The two (Aśvins) went to Dadhyañc Ātharvaṇa. They said to him: 'O ṛṣi, we have come to you.' 'For what desire?' 'We wish you to teach us the head of the sacrifice.' 'No,' he said. 'Indra also perceived that. He told me: if you tell this to another, I will cut off your head. Therefore I am afraid.' 'Then teach it to us by means of a horse's head.' 'So be it,' he said. 'But let me see you two conversing.' The two set aside their own head and fastened on the horse's head, and they sat conversing, singing a sāman, reciting an ṛc and pronouncing a yajus.
meaning: स होवाच -- देवा वा एते कुरुक्षेत्रे ऽपशीऋष्णा यज्ञेन यजमाना आसते / ते तं कामं नाप्नुवन्ति यो यज्ञे कामः / तद् यज्ञस्य शिरो ऽछिद्यत / तद् यद् दध्यङ् आथर्वणो ऽन्वपश्यत् तं तद् गच्छतम् / स वां तद् अनुवक्ष्यति / ततो ऽपिसोमौ भविष्यथ इति / तद् यत् तद् यज्ञस्य शिरो ऽछिद्यतेति , सो ऽसाव् आदित्यः / स उ एव प्रवर्ग्यः / तौ ह दध्यञ्चम् आथर्वणम् आजग्मतुः / तं होचतुर् , ऋषे उप त्वायावेति / कस्मै कामायेति / एतद् यज्ञस्य शिरो ऽनुवक्ष्यावहा इति / नेति होवाच / इन्द्रो वै तद् अप्य् अपश्यत् / स माब्रवीद् -- यदि वा इदम् अन्यस्मै ब्रूयाश् शिरस् ते छिन्द्याम् इति / तस्माद् बिभेमीति / स वै नाव् अनेनाश्वस्य शीर्ष्णानुब्रूहीति / तथेति होवाच / स वै नु वां संवदमानौ पश्यानीति / तौ हेमौ स्वं शिरो निधायेदम् अश्वस्य शिरः प्रतिसंधाय तेन ह स्म संवदमानाव् आसाते साम गायमानाव् ऋचं यजुर् अभिव्याहरन्तौ /

sanskrit_iast: tad indro 'nvabudhyata -- pra hābhyām avocad iti / tasyādrutya śiraḥ prācchinad idam aśvaśīrṣam / atha yad asya svaṃ śira āsīt tad imau manīṣiṇau pratisamadhattām / tau ha devān ājagmatur apaśīrṣṇā yajñena yajamānān / tān hocatur apaśīrṣṇā vai yajñena yajamānā ādhve / te taṃ kāmaṃ nāpnutha yo yajñe kāma iti / kas tad yajñasya śiro vedeti / āvam iti / tad vai pratisaṃdhattam iti / tābhyāṃ vai nau grahaṃ gṛhṇīteti / tābhyām etam āśvinaṃ graham agṛhṇan / tāv abruvan yuvam evādhvaryū sthas , tau tat prajānantāv etad yajñasya śiraḥ pratisandhāsyatha iti / tatheti / tāv adhvaryū āstām /
sentences: tad indro 'nvabudʰyata -- pra hābʰyām avocad iti /
atʰa yad asya svaṃ śira āsīt tad imau manīṣiṇau pratisamadʰattām /
tau ha devān ājagmatur apaśīrṣṇā yajñena yajamānān /
tān hocatur apaśīrṣṇā vai yajñena yajamānā ādʰve /
te taṃ kāmaṃ nāpnutʰa yo yajñe kāma iti /
tāv abruvan yuvam evādʰvaryū stʰas , tau tat prajānantāv etad yajñasya śiraḥ pratisandʰāsyatʰa iti /
text: Indra became aware of this — 'He has told them.' He rushed up and cut off this horse-head. Then what was his own head, these two Aśvins (the manīṣins) refitted. They came to the gods who were performing the sacrifice without a head. They said to them: 'You are performing the sacrifice without a head. You do not attain the desire that is in the sacrifice.' 'Who knows the head of the sacrifice?' 'We do.' 'Then refit it.' 'Take a graha for us two.' They drew the āśvina graha for them. They said: 'You two are the adhvaryus; you two, knowing this, shall refit the head of the sacrifice.' 'So be it.' The two became the adhvaryus.
meaning: तद् इन्द्रो ऽन्वबुध्यत -- प्र हाभ्याम् अवोचद् इति / तस्याद्रुत्य शिरः प्राच्छिनद् इदम् अश्वशीर्षम् / अथ यद् अस्य स्वं शिर आसीत् तद् इमौ मनीषिणौ प्रतिसमधत्ताम् / तौ ह देवान् आजग्मतुर् अपशीर्ष्णा यज्ञेन यजमानान् / तान् होचतुर् अपशीर्ष्णा वै यज्ञेन यजमाना आध्वे / ते तं कामं नाप्नुथ यो यज्ञे काम इति / कस् तद् यज्ञस्य शिरो वेदेति / आवम् इति / तद् वै प्रतिसंधत्तम् इति / ताभ्यां वै नौ ग्रहं गृह्णीतेति / ताभ्याम् एतम् आश्विनं ग्रहम् अगृह्णन् / ताव् अब्रुवन् युवम् एवाध्वर्यू स्थस् , तौ तत् प्रजानन्ताव् एतद् यज्ञस्य शिरः प्रतिसन्धास्यथ इति / तथेति / ताव् अध्वर्यू आस्ताम् /

sanskrit_iast: atha ha cyavano bhārgavaḥ punaryuvā bhūtvāgacchac charyātaṃ mānavam / taṃ prācyāṃ sthalyām ayājayat / tad asmai sahasram adadāt / tenāyajata / etad vai tac cyavano bhārgava etena sāmnā stutvā punaryuvābhavat , kumārīṃ jāyām avindata , sahasreṇāyajata / ete vā etasmin sāman kāmā , etān eva kāmān avarunddhe / yatkāma evaitena sāmnā stute , sam asmai sa kāma ṛdhyate / atho ha smaitenaiva sāmnā cyavano bhārgavo yad yad aśanaṃ cakame tat tad dha sma sarasvatyai śaiśavād udacati / tad v annādyasyāvaruddhissāma / avānnādyaṃ runddhe 'nnāda śreṣṭha svānāṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda / yad u cyavano bhārgavo 'paśyat tasmāc cyāvanam ity ākhyāyate / "prāṇā śiśur mahīnām " iti paśurūpam evaitad upāgacchanti / paśūnāṃ vai śiśur bhavati / tāsu krośaṃ , bhrātṛvyahā sendraṃ sāma / hanti dviṣantaṃ bhrātṛvyam āsyendro havaṃ gacchati ya evaṃ veda / tad ail̥aṃ bhavati -- paśavo vā il̥ā /
sentences: atʰa ha cyavano bʰārgavaḥ punaryuvā bʰūtvāgaccʰac cʰaryātaṃ mānavam /
etad vai tac cyavano bʰārgava etena sāmnā stutvā punaryuvābʰavat , kumārīṃ jāyām avindata , sahasreṇāyajata /
ete vā etasmin sāman kāmā , etān eva kāmān avarunddʰe /
yatkāma evaitena sāmnā stute , sam asmai sa kāma r̥dʰyate /
atʰo ha smaitenaiva sāmnā cyavano bʰārgavo yad yad aśanaṃ cakame tat tad dʰa sma sarasvatyai śaiśavād udacati /
avānnādyaṃ runddʰe 'nnāda śreṣṭʰa svānāṃ bʰavati ya evaṃ veda /
yad u cyavano bʰārgavo 'paśyat tasmāc cyāvanam ity ākʰyāyate /
"prāṇā śiśur mahīnām " iti paśurūpam evaitad upāgaccʰanti /
hanti dviṣantaṃ bʰrātr̥vyam āsyendro havaṃ gaccʰati ya evaṃ veda /
tad ail̥aṃ bʰavati -- paśavo vā il̥ā /
text: Now Cyavana Bhārgava, having become young again, came to Śaryāta Mānava. He had him perform a sacrifice in the eastern region. He (Śaryāta) gave him a thousand (cows). With that he performed the sacrifice. This indeed is what Cyavana Bhārgava, having praised with this sāman, became young again, obtained a young woman as wife, and sacrificed with a thousand. These are the desires in this sāman; one attains these very desires. Whatever desire one has when one praises with this sāman, that desire is fulfilled for him. And also, with this very sāman Cyavana Bhārgava — whatever food he desired, that arose for him from the spring of Sarasvatī. This is therefore the sāman for the attainment of food. One obtains food, one becomes the foremost food-eater among one's own people — he who knows thus. Now, because Cyavana Bhārgava perceived it, it is called cyāvana. 'The child, the prāṇa of the great ones' — with this they approach the form of cattle. For the young one belongs to the cattle. In those (verses), the krośa (sāman), the bhrātṛvya-slaying sāman with Indra. One slays the hostile rival; Indra comes to his invocation — he who knows thus. It has the form of aila — for cattle are ilā.
meaning: अथ ह च्यवनो भार्गवः पुनर्युवा भूत्वागच्छच् छर्यातं मानवम् / तं प्राच्यां स्थल्याम् अयाजयत् / तद् अस्मै सहस्रम् अददात् / तेनायजत / एतद् वै तच् च्यवनो भार्गव एतेन साम्ना स्तुत्वा पुनर्युवाभवत् , कुमारीं जायाम् अविन्दत , सहस्रेणायजत / एते वा एतस्मिन् सामन् कामा , एतान् एव कामान् अवरुन्द्धे / यत्काम एवैतेन साम्ना स्तुते , सम् अस्मै स काम ऋध्यते / अथो ह स्मैतेनैव साम्ना च्यवनो भार्गवो यद् यद् अशनं चकमे तत् तद् ध स्म सरस्वत्यै शैशवाद् उदचति / तद् व् अन्नाद्यस्यावरुद्धिस्साम / अवान्नाद्यं रुन्द्धे ऽन्नाद श्रेष्ठ स्वानां भवति य एवं वेद / यद् उ च्यवनो भार्गवो ऽपश्यत् तस्माच् च्यावनम् इत्य् आख्यायते / "प्राणा शिशुर् महीनाम् " इति पशुरूपम् एवैतद् उपागच्छन्ति / पशूनां वै शिशुर् भवति / तासु क्रोशं , भ्रातृव्यहा सेन्द्रं साम / हन्ति द्विषन्तं भ्रातृव्यम् आस्येन्द्रो हवं गच्छति य एवं वेद / तद् ऐल्̥अं भवति -- पशवो वा इल्̥आ /

sanskrit_iast: "pavasva vājasātaya " iti vājavatīr anuṣṭubho bhavanty -- annaṃ vai vājo -- 'nnādyasyaivāvaruddhyai / "pavitre dhārayā sutaḥ / indrāya soma viṣṇave devebhyo madhumattamaḥ //" iti vaiṣṇavyo bhavanti -- yajño vai viṣṇur -- yajñasyaivārambhāya / tāsu gaurivītam uktabrāhmaṇam / athāṣṭel̥aḥ padastobha il̥ānām ayātayāmāvarudhyate / teno hāsmā ekaśaphāḥ paśavas tiṣṭhante / prajāpatiṃ prajās samṛjānaṃ śīrṣataḥ pāpmāgṛhṇāt / so 'kāmayatāpa pāpmānaṃ hanīyeti / sa etān padastobhān apaśyat / tair astuta / taiḥ pāpmānam apāhata / tān apaveṣṭayann iva gāyet / apaveṣṭayann iva vai sa tac chīrṣato 'gre pāpmānam apajaghne /
sentences: "pavasva vājasātaya " iti vājavatīr anuṣṭubʰo bʰavanty -- annaṃ vai vājo -- 'nnādyasyaivāvaruddʰyai /
iti vaiṣṇavyo bʰavanti -- yajño vai viṣṇur -- yajñasyaivārambʰāya /
apaveṣṭayann iva vai sa tac cʰīrṣato 'gre pāpmānam apajagʰne /
text: 'Purify yourself for the winning of nourishment' — these are anuṣṭubh verses containing the word vāja — for vāja is food — for the attainment of food. 'Pressed through the filter, for Indra, O Soma, for Viṣṇu, sweetest for the gods' — these are vaiṣṇava verses — for the sacrifice is Viṣṇu — for the undertaking of the sacrifice. In those, the gaurivīta has its brāhmaṇa stated elsewhere. Now the eight-ilā pada-stobha obtains the fresh portion of the ilā verses. Through it, single-hoofed animals stand (remain) for him. Prajāpati, while ruling over creatures, was seized by evil (pāpman) from the head. He desired: 'May I drive away the evil.' He perceived these pada-stobhas. He praised with them. With them he drove away the evil. One should sing them as if casting off. For casting off, as it were, he drove away the evil from the head first.
meaning: "पवस्व वाजसातय " इति वाजवतीर् अनुष्टुभो भवन्त्य् -- अन्नं वै वाजो -- ऽन्नाद्यस्यैवावरुद्ध्यै / "पवित्रे धारया सुतः / इन्द्राय सोम विष्णवे देवेभ्यो मधुमत्तमः //" इति वैष्णव्यो भवन्ति -- यज्ञो वै विष्णुर् -- यज्ञस्यैवारम्भाय / तासु गौरिवीतम् उक्तब्राह्मणम् / अथाष्टेल्̥अः पदस्तोभ इल्̥आनाम् अयातयामावरुध्यते / तेनो हास्मा एकशफाः पशवस् तिष्ठन्ते / प्रजापतिं प्रजास् समृजानं शीर्षतः पाप्मागृह्णात् / सो ऽकामयताप पाप्मानं हनीयेति / स एतान् पदस्तोभान् अपश्यत् / तैर् अस्तुत / तैः पाप्मानम् अपाहत / तान् अपवेष्टयन्न् इव गायेत् / अपवेष्टयन्न् इव वै स तच् छीर्षतो ऽग्रे पाप्मानम् अपजघ्ने /

sanskrit_iast: ṛṣīṇāṃ vā agre mantraś caiva prajā cāsīn na paśavaḥ / te 'kāmayantāva paśūn rundhīmahīti / te saṃvatsare paśūn paryapaśyan / tān etenāṣṭel̥ena padastobhenodasṛjanta / te 'bruvann asti nvā iti / tān ṣaḍil̥enodasṛjanta / te 'bruvann asti nvā iti / tāṃś caturil̥enodasṛjanta / te 'bruvann asti nvāveti / tān dvīlenodasṛjanta / te vā ete paśava eva yat padastobhāḥ / paśava etad ahaḥ / paśumān bhavati ya evaṃ veda / ta u sarve jāgatā bhavanti / paśavo vai jagatī / teno haivāsmiṃs tad apy ekaśaphāḥ paśavas tiṣṭhante yat sarve jāgatā bhavanti /
sentences: r̥ṣīṇāṃ vā agre mantraś caiva prajā cāsīn na paśavaḥ /
te vā ete paśava eva yat padastobʰāḥ /
teno haivāsmiṃs tad apy ekaśapʰāḥ paśavas tiṣṭʰante yat sarve jāgatā bʰavanti /
text: In the beginning, the ṛṣis had mantras and progeny but not cattle. They desired: 'May we obtain cattle.' They perceived cattle in the course of a year. They released them with this eight-ilā pada-stobha. They said: 'There is still more.' They released them with the six-ilā. They said: 'There is still more.' They released them with the four-ilā. They said: 'There is still indeed more.' They released them with the two-ilā. These pada-stobhas are indeed cattle. Cattle are this day. One who knows thus becomes rich in cattle. And all of them are in the jagatī metre. Cattle are the jagatī. Therefore, through this, single-hoofed animals also stand (remain) for him, because all are in the jagatī.
meaning: ऋषीणां वा अग्रे मन्त्रश् चैव प्रजा चासीन् न पशवः / ते ऽकामयन्ताव पशून् रुन्धीमहीति / ते संवत्सरे पशून् पर्यपश्यन् / तान् एतेनाष्टेल्̥एन पदस्तोभेनोदसृजन्त / ते ऽब्रुवन्न् अस्ति न्वा इति / तान् षडिल्̥एनोदसृजन्त / ते ऽब्रुवन्न् अस्ति न्वा इति / तांश् चतुरिल्̥एनोदसृजन्त / ते ऽब्रुवन्न् अस्ति न्वावेति / तान् द्वीलेनोदसृजन्त / ते वा एते पशव एव यत् पदस्तोभाः / पशव एतद् अहः / पशुमान् भवति य एवं वेद / त उ सर्वे जागता भवन्ति / पशवो वै जगती / तेनो हैवास्मिंस् तद् अप्य् एकशफाः पशवस् तिष्ठन्ते यत् सर्वे जागता भवन्ति /

sanskrit_iast: atha pārthaṃ dviyabhyāsaṃ dvitīyasyāhno rūpam / dvitīyaṃ hy etad ahar āyatanena / atha ṛṣabhaś śākvaraḥ / paśavo vai simāḥ , paśavo revatayaḥ , paśava ṛṣabhaḥ / ṛṣabham evaitat paśuṣv apisṛjanti mithunatvāya prajananāya / pra mithunena jāyate ya evaṃ veda / sa u dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ devatābhyāṃ pratitiṣṭhati / tasmād ṛṣabha skandan dvipād bhavati / tā etāś caturakṣarā devatā bhavanti / tasmād dvipāt skandati / catuṣpadaḥ prajanayati / pra prajayā paśubhir jāyate ya evaṃ veda / sa u pāṃktaḥ / pāṃkte 'hani kriyate rūpasamṛddhatāyai / "indur vājī pavate gonyoghā " iti gomatīḥ paśumatīr bhavanti paśūnām evāvaruddhyai / paśavo hy etad ahaḥ / tāsu dāśaspatyam uktabrāhmaṇam / atha yajñāyajñīyam uktabrāhmaṇam / "ā te agna edhīmahī " ty āvatīr bhavanti / apacchidyeva vā etad yajñakāṇḍaṃ yad ukthāni /
sentences: paśavo vai simāḥ , paśavo revatayaḥ , paśava r̥ṣabʰaḥ /
r̥ṣabʰam evaitat paśuṣv apisr̥janti mitʰunatvāya prajananāya /
pra mitʰunena jāyate ya evaṃ veda /
sa u dvābʰyāṃ dvābʰyāṃ devatābʰyāṃ pratitiṣṭʰati /
pra prajayā paśubʰir jāyate ya evaṃ veda /
"indur vājī pavate gonyogʰā " iti gomatīḥ paśumatīr bʰavanti paśūnām evāvaruddʰyai /
"ā te agna edʰīmahī " ty āvatīr bʰavanti /
apaccʰidyeva vā etad yajñakāṇḍaṃ yad uktʰāni /
text: Now the pārtha with double repetition is the form of the second day, for this is the second day by its foundation. Now the ṛṣabha is in the śakvarī metre. Cattle are the simā verses, cattle are the revatī verses, cattle are the ṛṣabha. They release the bull among the cattle for pairing, for procreation. One who knows thus is born through pairing. And it is supported by two deities each. Therefore the bull, when mounting, is two-footed. These deities have four syllables each. Therefore it mounts with two feet and generates four-footed ones. One who knows thus is born forth with progeny and cattle. It is also in the pāṅkta metre. It is performed on the pāṅkta day for the completeness of form. 'The drop, the prize-winner, purifies itself, rich in cattle' — these are rich in cattle, having the form of cattle, for the attainment of cattle. For cattle are this day. In those, the dāśaspatya has its brāhmaṇa stated elsewhere. And the yajñāyajñīya has its brāhmaṇa stated elsewhere. 'O Agni, may we thrive' — these are verses with ā (āvatī). This sacrificial section (the uktha) is cut off, as it were, from the main body of the sacrifice.
meaning: अथ पार्थं द्वियभ्यासं द्वितीयस्याह्नो रूपम् / द्वितीयं ह्य् एतद् अहर् आयतनेन / अथ ऋषभश् शाक्वरः / पशवो वै सिमाः , पशवो रेवतयः , पशव ऋषभः / ऋषभम् एवैतत् पशुष्व् अपिसृजन्ति मिथुनत्वाय प्रजननाय / प्र मिथुनेन जायते य एवं वेद / स उ द्वाभ्यां द्वाभ्यां देवताभ्यां प्रतितिष्ठति / तस्माद् ऋषभ स्कन्दन् द्विपाद् भवति / ता एताश् चतुरक्षरा देवता भवन्ति / तस्माद् द्विपात् स्कन्दति / चतुष्पदः प्रजनयति / प्र प्रजया पशुभिर् जायते य एवं वेद / स उ पांक्तः / पांक्ते ऽहनि क्रियते रूपसमृद्धतायै / "इन्दुर् वाजी पवते गोन्योघा " इति गोमतीः पशुमतीर् भवन्ति पशूनाम् एवावरुद्ध्यै / पशवो ह्य् एतद् अहः / तासु दाशस्पत्यम् उक्तब्राह्मणम् / अथ यज्ञायज्ञीयम् उक्तब्राह्मणम् / "आ ते अग्न एधीमही " त्य् आवतीर् भवन्ति / अपच्छिद्येव वा एतद् यज्ञकाण्डं यद् उक्थानि /

sanskrit_iast: tāsu saṃjayam / devāsurā vā eṣu lokeṣv aspardhanta / asmin bhuvane te devā akāmayanta sam imān lokān jayema jayemāsurān spardhāṃ bhrātṛvyān iti / ta etat sāmāpaśyan / tenāstuvata / tenemān lokān samajayann , ajayan spardhāṃ bhrātṛvyān asurān / tad yad imān lokān samajayaṃs tat saṃjayasya saṃjayatvam / sam imān lokāñ jayati , jayati spardhāṃ dviṣantaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ , ya evaṃ veda / tad u pāṃktaṃ , pāṃkte 'han kriyate -- pāṃktā vai paśavaḥ / paśava etad ahaḥ -- paśūnām evāvaruddhyai / tad v evācakṣate dvihiṃkāraṃ vāmadevyam iti / paśavo vai simāḥ , paśavo revatayaḥ , paśavo dvihiṃkāraṃ vāmadevyam / paśumanta eva bhavanty enena tuṣṭuvānāḥ / atho yad evaitasminn ahann ūrdhvaṃ śakvarībhyaḥ krūram iva kriyate tad evaitābhyāṃ hiṃkārābhyāṃ śamayanti / atha saumitraṃ bhrātṛvyahā sendraṃ sāma /
sentences: asmin bʰuvane te devā akāmayanta sam imān lokān jayema jayemāsurān spardʰāṃ bʰrātr̥vyān iti /
tenemān lokān samajayann , ajayan spardʰāṃ bʰrātr̥vyān asurān /
tad yad imān lokān samajayaṃs tat saṃjayasya saṃjayatvam /
sam imān lokāñ jayati , jayati spardʰāṃ dviṣantaṃ bʰrātr̥vyaṃ , ya evaṃ veda /
tad u pāṃktaṃ , pāṃkte 'han kriyate -- pāṃktā vai paśavaḥ /
tad v evācakṣate dvihiṃkāraṃ vāmadevyam iti /
paśavo vai simāḥ , paśavo revatayaḥ , paśavo dvihiṃkāraṃ vāmadevyam /
atʰo yad evaitasminn ahann ūrdʰvaṃ śakvarībʰyaḥ krūram iva kriyate tad evaitābʰyāṃ hiṃkārābʰyāṃ śamayanti /
text: In those (verses), the saṃjaya sāman. The gods and asuras contended for these worlds. In this world, the gods desired: 'May we win these worlds together, may we conquer the asuras, the rivals in the contest.' They perceived this sāman. They praised with it. With it they won these worlds together; they conquered the rivals, the asuras, in the contest. Because they won these worlds together (sam-ajayan), that is the saṃjaya-ness of saṃjaya. One wins these worlds together, one conquers the hostile rival in the contest — he who knows thus. It is in the pāṅkta metre; it is performed on the pāṅkta day — for cattle are pāṅkta. Cattle are this day — for the attainment of cattle. They also call it 'the vāmadevya with a double hiṃkāra.' Cattle are the simā verses, cattle are the revatī verses, cattle are the vāmadevya with a double hiṃkāra. Those who have praised with this become rich in cattle. And also, whatever seems harsh (krūra) on this day beyond the śakvarī verses, that they pacify with these two hiṃkāras. Now the saumitra is a bhrātṛvya-slaying sāman with Indra.
meaning: तासु संजयम् / देवासुरा वा एषु लोकेष्व् अस्पर्धन्त / अस्मिन् भुवने ते देवा अकामयन्त सम् इमान् लोकान् जयेम जयेमासुरान् स्पर्धां भ्रातृव्यान् इति / त एतत् सामापश्यन् / तेनास्तुवत / तेनेमान् लोकान् समजयन्न् , अजयन् स्पर्धां भ्रातृव्यान् असुरान् / तद् यद् इमान् लोकान् समजयंस् तत् संजयस्य संजयत्वम् / सम् इमान् लोकाञ् जयति , जयति स्पर्धां द्विषन्तं भ्रातृव्यं , य एवं वेद / तद् उ पांक्तं , पांक्ते ऽहन् क्रियते -- पांक्ता वै पशवः / पशव एतद् अहः -- पशूनाम् एवावरुद्ध्यै / तद् व् एवाचक्षते द्विहिंकारं वामदेव्यम् इति / पशवो वै सिमाः , पशवो रेवतयः , पशवो द्विहिंकारं वामदेव्यम् / पशुमन्त एव भवन्त्य् एनेन तुष्टुवानाः / अथो यद् एवैतस्मिन्न् अहन्न् ऊर्ध्वं शक्वरीभ्यः क्रूरम् इव क्रियते तद् एवैताभ्यां हिंकाराभ्यां शमयन्ति / अथ सौमित्रं भ्रातृव्यहा सेन्द्रं साम /

sanskrit_iast: trayo brahmāpaśyan , nodhās tṛtīyaṃ , sumitras tṛtīyaṃ , bṛhadukthas tṛtīyam / tad yat prathame triyahe naudhasaṃ kriyate , tena prathamas triyaho brahmaṇvān kriyate / atha yat tṛtīye triyahe bārhadukthaṃ kriyate tenaiva tṛtīyas triyaho brahmaṇvān kriyate / etair ha vai sāmabhir ete triyahā brahmaṇvantaḥ kriyante / tat pañcākṣaraṇidhanaṃ bhavati pañcamasyāhno rūpaṃ pañcarātrasya santatyā avyavacchedāya /
sentences: trayo brahmāpaśyan , nodʰās tr̥tīyaṃ , sumitras tr̥tīyaṃ , br̥haduktʰas tr̥tīyam /
tad yat pratʰame triyahe naudʰasaṃ kriyate , tena pratʰamas triyaho brahmaṇvān kriyate /
atʰa yat tr̥tīye triyahe bārhaduktʰaṃ kriyate tenaiva tr̥tīyas triyaho brahmaṇvān kriyate /
etair ha vai sāmabʰir ete triyahā brahmaṇvantaḥ kriyante /
tat pañcākṣaraṇidʰanaṃ bʰavati pañcamasyāhno rūpaṃ pañcarātrasya santatyā avyavaccʰedāya /
text: Three (ṛṣis) perceived the sacred formulation (brahman): Nodhas one third, Sumitra one third, Bṛhadukhta one third. Because the naudhasaṃ is performed in the first triad of days (triyaha), thereby the first triad of days is made endowed with brahman. And because the bārhadukthaṃ is performed in the third triad of days, thereby the third triad of days is made endowed with brahman. By these sāmans, these triads of days are made endowed with brahman. It has a five-syllable nidhana, being the form of the fifth day, for the continuity and non-interruption of the five-night period.
meaning: त्रयो ब्रह्मापश्यन् , नोधास् तृतीयं , सुमित्रस् तृतीयं , बृहदुक्थस् तृतीयम् / तद् यत् प्रथमे त्रियहे नौधसं क्रियते , तेन प्रथमस् त्रियहो ब्रह्मण्वान् क्रियते / अथ यत् तृतीये त्रियहे बार्हदुक्थं क्रियते तेनैव तृतीयस् त्रियहो ब्रह्मण्वान् क्रियते / एतैर् ह वै सामभिर् एते त्रियहा ब्रह्मण्वन्तः क्रियन्ते / तत् पञ्चाक्षरणिधनं भवति पञ्चमस्याह्नो रूपं पञ्चरात्रस्य सन्तत्या अव्यवच्छेदाय /

sanskrit_iast: tāsu mahāvaiśvāmitram / etena vai viśvāmitro mahimānaṃ bhūmānam abhipūrvaṃ paśūnām avārunddha / tad etat paśavyaṃ sāma / mahimānam eva bhūmānam abhipūrvaṃ paśūnām avarunddhe ya evaṃ veda / indro vai vṛtram ajighāṃsat / sa viśvāmitram upādhāvad -- ṛṣa upa tvā dhāvāma , iha no 'dhibrūhīti / sa etad viśvāmitras sāmāpaśyat / tenāstuta / tato vā indro vṛtram ahan / so 'bravīn mahad vā idaṃ viśvāmitrasyābhūd iti / tad eva mahāvaiśvāmitrasya mahāvaiśvāmitratvam / tad u bhrātṛvyahā / hanti dviṣantaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ ya evaṃ veda / tat trīl̥aṃ bhavati -- paśavo vā il̥ā / paśava etad ahar -- abhipūrvāṇām eva paśūnām avaruddhyai / bheṣajaṃ ha khalu vai tisra il̥āḥ / etad dha vai śivaṃ śāntaṃ vāco yat tisra il̥āḥ / tad yat trīl̥aṃ pañcame 'hani bhavati tenaiva triṇavaṃ ca stomaṃ śamayanti / simāś cādityād ṛtava udakrāman / so 'kāmayata na mad ṛtava utkrāmeyur abhi mā varterann iti / sa etat sāmāpaśyat / tenāstuta / hehayā o hā o hā iti hayā ha vā asyaite yathāśvā syur evam / tato vai tasmād ṛtavo nodakrāman / tata enam upāvartanta / taṃ prāviśan / tān abhyārohat / sa eṣa ṛtuṣu ca saṃvatsare caitasyāṃ śriyām adhyūḍhas tapati / yad u viśvāmitro 'paśyat tasmān mahāvaiśvāmitram ity ākhyāyate / tad ail̥am acchāvākasāma bhavati / paśavo vā il̥ā /
sentences: etena vai viśvāmitro mahimānaṃ bʰūmānam abʰipūrvaṃ paśūnām avārunddʰa /
mahimānam eva bʰūmānam abʰipūrvaṃ paśūnām avarunddʰe ya evaṃ veda /
sa viśvāmitram upādʰāvad -- r̥ṣa upa tvā dʰāvāma , iha no 'dʰibrūhīti /
so 'bravīn mahad vā idaṃ viśvāmitrasyābʰūd iti /
hanti dviṣantaṃ bʰrātr̥vyaṃ ya evaṃ veda /
tat trīl̥aṃ bʰavati -- paśavo vā il̥ā /
paśava etad ahar -- abʰipūrvāṇām eva paśūnām avaruddʰyai /
bʰeṣajaṃ ha kʰalu vai tisra il̥āḥ /
etad dʰa vai śivaṃ śāntaṃ vāco yat tisra il̥āḥ /
tad yat trīl̥aṃ pañcame 'hani bʰavati tenaiva triṇavaṃ ca stomaṃ śamayanti /
so 'kāmayata na mad r̥tava utkrāmeyur abʰi mā varterann iti /
hehayā o hā o hā iti hayā ha vā asyaite yatʰāśvā syur evam /
sa eṣa r̥tuṣu ca saṃvatsare caitasyāṃ śriyām adʰyūḍʰas tapati /
yad u viśvāmitro 'paśyat tasmān mahāvaiśvāmitram ity ākʰyāyate /
text: In those (verses), the mahāvaiśvāmitra. With this, Viśvāmitra obtained greatness, abundance, and supremacy over cattle. This is the sāman pertaining to cattle. One obtains greatness, abundance, and supremacy over cattle — he who knows thus. Indra wished to slay Vṛtra. He ran to Viśvāmitra: 'O ṛṣi, I run to you; instruct us here.' Viśvāmitra perceived this sāman. He praised with it. Then Indra slew Vṛtra. He said: 'Great indeed was this of Viśvāmitra.' That is the mahāvaiśvāmitra-ness of mahāvaiśvāmitra. It is also a bhrātṛvya-slayer. One slays the hostile rival — he who knows thus. It has three ilā — for cattle are ilā. Cattle are this day — for the attainment of supremacy over cattle. Three ilā are indeed a healing remedy. This is the auspicious and peaceful aspect of speech: three ilā. Because the three-ilā is on the fifth day, by that they pacify both the triṇava stoma (and the day). The seasons (ṛtus) departed from the sun (āditya). He desired: 'May the seasons not depart from me; may they revolve around me.' He perceived this sāman. He praised with it. 'Hehayā o hā o hā' — these are like his horses (hayā), as it were. Then the seasons did not depart from him. Then they returned to him. They entered him. He mounted upon them. He, mounted upon the seasons and the year, shines in this glory.
