sanskrit_iast: trivṛtā gāyatry akalpata , pañcadaśena triṣṭup , saptadaśena jagaty , ekaviṃśenānuṣṭup , triṇavena paṃktis , trayastriṃśena virāṭ , pañcaviṃśena bṛhaty , aṣṭādaśanavadaśābhyām uṣṇikkakubhau / tā yā nava gāyatryaś caturviṃśatis te trivṛtaḥ / atha yā pañcadaśa triṣṭubhaś catuścatvāriṃśat te pañcadaśāḥ / atha yās saptadaśa jagatyo 'ṣṭācatvāriṃśat te saptadaśāḥ / atha yā ekaviṃśatir anuṣṭubho dvātriṃśat ta ekaviṃśāḥ / atha yās saptaviṃśatiḥ paṃktyaś catvāriṃśat te triṇavāḥ / atha yās trayastriṃśad virājas triṃśat te trayastriṃśāḥ / atha yāḥ pañcaviṃśatir bṛhatyaṣ ṣaṭtriṃśat te pañcaviṃśāḥ /
sentences: trivr̥tā gāyatry akalpata , pañcadaśena triṣṭup , saptadaśena jagaty , ekaviṃśenānuṣṭup , triṇavena paṃktis , trayastriṃśena virāṭ , pañcaviṃśena br̥haty , aṣṭādaśanavadaśābʰyām uṣṇikkakubʰau /
tā yā nava gāyatryaś caturviṃśatis te trivr̥taḥ /
atʰa yā pañcadaśa triṣṭubʰaś catuścatvāriṃśat te pañcadaśāḥ /
atʰa yās saptadaśa jagatyo 'ṣṭācatvāriṃśat te saptadaśāḥ /
atʰa yā ekaviṃśatir anuṣṭubʰo dvātriṃśat ta ekaviṃśāḥ /
atʰa yās saptaviṃśatiḥ paṃktyaś catvāriṃśat te triṇavāḥ /
atʰa yās trayastriṃśad virājas triṃśat te trayastriṃśāḥ /
atʰa yāḥ pañcaviṃśatir br̥hatyaṣ ṣaṭtriṃśat te pañcaviṃśāḥ /
text: The gāyatrī was fashioned with the trivṛt, the triṣṭubh with the pañcadaśa, the jagatī with the saptadaśa, the anuṣṭubh with the ekaviṃśa, the paṅkti with the triṇava, the virāj with the trayastriṃśa, the bṛhatī with the pañcaviṃśa, the uṣṇih and kakubh with the aṣṭādaśa and navadaśa. The nine gāyatrīs are twenty-four — those are the trivṛts. The fifteen triṣṭubhs are forty-four — those are the pañcadaśas. The seventeen jagatīs are forty-eight — those are the saptadaśas. The twenty-one anuṣṭubhs are thirty-two — those are the ekaviṃśas. The twenty-seven paṅktis are forty — those are the triṇavas. The thirty-three virājs are thirty — those are the trayastriṃśas. The twenty-five bṛhatīs are thirty-six — those are the pañcaviṃśas.
meaning: त्रिवृता गायत्र्य् अकल्पत , पञ्चदशेन त्रिष्टुप् , सप्तदशेन जगत्य् , एकविंशेनानुष्टुप् , त्रिणवेन पंक्तिस् , त्रयस्त्रिंशेन विराट् , पञ्चविंशेन बृहत्य् , अष्टादशनवदशाभ्याम् उष्णिक्ककुभौ / ता या नव गायत्र्यश् चतुर्विंशतिस् ते त्रिवृतः / अथ या पञ्चदश त्रिष्टुभश् चतुश्चत्वारिंशत् ते पञ्चदशाः / अथ यास् सप्तदश जगत्यो ऽष्टाचत्वारिंशत् ते सप्तदशाः / अथ या एकविंशतिर् अनुष्टुभो द्वात्रिंशत् त एकविंशाः / अथ यास् सप्तविंशतिः पंक्त्यश् चत्वारिंशत् ते त्रिणवाः / अथ यास् त्रयस्त्रिंशद् विराजस् त्रिंशत् ते त्रयस्त्रिंशाः / अथ याः पञ्चविंशतिर् बृहत्यष् षट्त्रिंशत् ते पञ्चविंशाः /

sanskrit_iast: ekaṃ vāvedam agre 'kṣaram āsīd vāg eva / sākāmayata -- bahvy asāni , prajāyeya , bhūmānaṃ gacchāni , yajñaṃ tanavā iti / sā svāhā svāhā svāhety eva dvādaśakṛtvo 'juhot / sā triṃśatam triṃśatam evāsinot / triṃśadakṣaro evātmanābhavat / tasyai paścevākṣare upodasarpatām / saivaiṣānuṣṭub abhavat / tasmād etad yoṣitaḥ paśceva stanāv upotsarpataḥ / saiṣā virāḍ eva staninī / sā yat tad dvādaśakṛtvo 'juhod etān eva tad dvādaśa māso 'sṛjata / tāny evaitāni dvādaśāhasya dvādaśāhāny abhavaṃs , ta eva caturviṃśatir ardhamāsā abhavaṃs tāny eva sapta ca śatāni viṃśatiṃ cāhorātrāṇy abhavan / saitaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ yajñam asṛjata / eṣa ha vāva yajño yas saṃvatsaraḥ / sā nāved -- yajñaṃ vā asṛkṣīti / kim u cid asṛkṣīty evāmanyata / tāṃ modaḥ pratyāgacchat / tato 'ved -- yajñaṃ vā asṛkṣīti /
sentences: ekaṃ vāvedam agre 'kṣaram āsīd vāg eva /
sākāmayata -- bahvy asāni , prajāyeya , bʰūmānaṃ gaccʰāni , yajñaṃ tanavā iti /
sā svāhā svāhā svāhety eva dvādaśakr̥tvo 'juhot /
tasmād etad yoṣitaḥ paśceva stanāv upotsarpataḥ /
sā yat tad dvādaśakr̥tvo 'juhod etān eva tad dvādaśa māso 'sr̥jata /
tāny evaitāni dvādaśāhasya dvādaśāhāny abʰavaṃs , ta eva caturviṃśatir ardʰamāsā abʰavaṃs tāny eva sapta ca śatāni viṃśatiṃ cāhorātrāṇy abʰavan /
eṣa ha vāva yajño yas saṃvatsaraḥ /
text: In the beginning, there was verily one syllable — Vāc (Speech) alone. She desired: 'May I become many, may I be born forth, may I attain abundance, may I extend the sacrifice.' She offered twelve times, saying 'svāhā, svāhā, svāhā.' She produced thirty and thirty [syllables]. She herself became [a metre] of thirty syllables. Two syllables crept up behind her, as it were. That became this anuṣṭubh. Therefore, a woman's breasts swell forth from behind, as it were. This virāj is indeed the one with breasts. When she offered twelve times, she thereby created the twelve months. These became the twelve days of the dvādaśāha; they became the twenty-four half-months; they became the seven hundred and twenty day-and-nights. She created the year as the sacrifice. This sacrifice is verily the year. She did not know: 'I have created the sacrifice.' She thought only: 'What indeed have I created?' Joy came upon her. Then she knew: 'I have indeed created the sacrifice.'
meaning: एकं वावेदम् अग्रे ऽक्षरम् आसीद् वाग् एव / साकामयत -- बह्व्य् असानि , प्रजायेय , भूमानं गच्छानि , यज्ञं तनवा इति / सा स्वाहा स्वाहा स्वाहेत्य् एव द्वादशकृत्वो ऽजुहोत् / सा त्रिंशतम् त्रिंशतम् एवासिनोत् / त्रिंशदक्षरो एवात्मनाभवत् / तस्यै पश्चेवाक्षरे उपोदसर्पताम् / सैवैषानुष्टुब् अभवत् / तस्माद् एतद् योषितः पश्चेव स्तनाव् उपोत्सर्पतः / सैषा विराड् एव स्तनिनी / सा यत् तद् द्वादशकृत्वो ऽजुहोद् एतान् एव तद् द्वादश मासो ऽसृजत / तान्य् एवैतानि द्वादशाहस्य द्वादशाहान्य् अभवंस् , त एव चतुर्विंशतिर् अर्धमासा अभवंस् तान्य् एव सप्त च शतानि विंशतिं चाहोरात्राण्य् अभवन् / सैतं संवत्सरं यज्ञम् असृजत / एष ह वाव यज्ञो यस् संवत्सरः / सा नावेद् -- यज्ञं वा असृक्षीति / किम् उ चिद् असृक्षीत्य् एवामन्यत / तां मोदः प्रत्यागच्छत् / ततो ऽवेद् -- यज्ञं वा असृक्षीति /

sanskrit_iast: sāṣṭābhir evākṣaraiḥ prathamam ahar atanuta , ekādaśabhir dvitīyaṃ , dvādaśabhis tṛtīyam / akṣaram eva tryakṣaraṃ paryaśiṣyata / tad evottaraṃ tryaham anuvyadadhāt / saitaṃ pṛṣṭhyaṃ ṣaḍaham atanuta / saitaṃ pṛṣṭhyaṃṣaḍahaṃ tatvaikṣata kena nv imaṃ tṛtīyaṃ tryahaṃ tanviyeti / svātmānam evāpaśyad , yo nvāva me 'sāv ātmā so 'yam / hantainam ātmana evādhi tanavā iti / sāṣṭābhir evākṣarais saptamam ahar atanutaikādaśabhir aṣṭamaṃ , dvādaśabhir navamam / atha yad akṣaraṃ paryaśiṣyata tad evaitad dvādaśāhasya daśamam ahar abhavat / saiṣā śrāntā vikṛṣṭāśaye vāg yajñam ūhiṣī kālilimattā yathā siṃhī vā vijātā syād vyāghrī vā śiṃśumārī vaivam / tāṃ yad etarhi pratyakṣam ālabheran vyāptam asyā āpadyeran / yady u vā sā iyur etasmāt sarvasmād iyuḥ /
sentences: sāṣṭābʰir evākṣaraiḥ pratʰamam ahar atanuta , ekādaśabʰir dvitīyaṃ , dvādaśabʰis tr̥tīyam /
saitaṃ pr̥ṣṭʰyaṃṣaḍahaṃ tatvaikṣata kena nv imaṃ tr̥tīyaṃ tryahaṃ tanviyeti /
svātmānam evāpaśyad , yo nvāva me 'sāv ātmā so 'yam /
sāṣṭābʰir evākṣarais saptamam ahar atanutaikādaśabʰir aṣṭamaṃ , dvādaśabʰir navamam /
atʰa yad akṣaraṃ paryaśiṣyata tad evaitad dvādaśāhasya daśamam ahar abʰavat /
saiṣā śrāntā vikr̥ṣṭāśaye vāg yajñam ūhiṣī kālilimattā yatʰā siṃhī vā vijātā syād vyāgʰrī vā śiṃśumārī vaivam /
tāṃ yad etarhi pratyakṣam ālabʰeran vyāptam asyā āpadyeran /
yady u vā sā iyur etasmāt sarvasmād iyuḥ /
text: With eight syllables she fashioned the first day, with eleven the second, with twelve the third. A single three-syllabled syllable-group remained over. She distributed that over the latter three days. Thus she fashioned this pṛṣṭhya ṣaḍaha (six-day sequence of pṛṣṭha chants). Having fashioned this pṛṣṭhya ṣaḍaha, she considered: 'By what means shall I fashion this third three-day period?' She saw only her own self: 'That self of mine which was there is this one here. Come, let me fashion it upon the self itself.' With eight syllables she fashioned the seventh day, with eleven the eighth, with twelve the ninth. Then the syllable-group that remained over — that became the tenth day of the dvādaśāha. This Vāc, exhausted, having drawn out the sacrifice, like a lioness who has just given birth, or a tigress, or a crocodile, lay stretched out in her lair, weary and feeble. If one were to seize her directly now, one would come to grief. And if one were to go beyond her, one would go beyond all this.
meaning: साष्टाभिर् एवाक्षरैः प्रथमम् अहर् अतनुत , एकादशभिर् द्वितीयं , द्वादशभिस् तृतीयम् / अक्षरम् एव त्र्यक्षरं पर्यशिष्यत / तद् एवोत्तरं त्र्यहम् अनुव्यदधात् / सैतं पृष्ठ्यं षडहम् अतनुत / सैतं पृष्ठ्यंषडहं तत्वैक्षत केन न्व् इमं तृतीयं त्र्यहं तन्वियेति / स्वात्मानम् एवापश्यद् , यो न्वाव मे ऽसाव् आत्मा सो ऽयम् / हन्तैनम् आत्मन एवाधि तनवा इति / साष्टाभिर् एवाक्षरैस् सप्तमम् अहर् अतनुतैकादशभिर् अष्टमं , द्वादशभिर् नवमम् / अथ यद् अक्षरं पर्यशिष्यत तद् एवैतद् द्वादशाहस्य दशमम् अहर् अभवत् / सैषा श्रान्ता विकृष्टाशये वाग् यज्ञम् ऊहिषी कालिलिमत्ता यथा सिंही वा विजाता स्याद् व्याघ्री वा शिंशुमारी वैवम् / तां यद् एतर्हि प्रत्यक्षम् आलभेरन् व्याप्तम् अस्या आपद्येरन् / यद्य् उ वा सा इयुर् एतस्मात् सर्वस्माद् इयुः /

sanskrit_iast: na hotā canānuṣṭubhaś śaṃsati , virāja eva sa śaṃsati / te devā abruvann iyam iyaṃ yajñam asṛṣṭaitānana yajāmahā iti / te bṛhatīm abruvann idaṃ nas tvaṃ tṛtīyam ahar vaha / abhijitaṃ vai nas sat tad avyāptam iti / sad dha vai bṛhatī bhavati yat sā pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati / saitad bṛhatī tṛtīyam ahar ūḍhvā nākāmayata voḍhum / ta iyam eva lokaṃ rathantareṇājayann antarikṣaṃ bṛhatyāmuṃ bṛhatā / ta etena tryaheṇa vyajayanta / tad yathā vijitena yanti saindhavān ajanti hastinaṃ vahanti dhūrgṛhītaṃ rathaṃ yāti hulubhyāṃ yāti vicchidvahābhyām evaṃ gardabharathena /
sentences: na hotā canānuṣṭubʰaś śaṃsati , virāja eva sa śaṃsati /
te devā abruvann iyam iyaṃ yajñam asr̥ṣṭaitānana yajāmahā iti /
te br̥hatīm abruvann idaṃ nas tvaṃ tr̥tīyam ahar vaha /
abʰijitaṃ vai nas sat tad avyāptam iti /
sad dʰa vai br̥hatī bʰavati yat sā pr̥ṣṭʰaṃ bʰavati /
saitad br̥hatī tr̥tīyam ahar ūḍʰvā nākāmayata voḍʰum /
ta iyam eva lokaṃ ratʰantareṇājayann antarikṣaṃ br̥hatyāmuṃ br̥hatā /
tad yatʰā vijitena yanti saindʰavān ajanti hastinaṃ vahanti dʰūrgr̥hītaṃ ratʰaṃ yāti hulubʰyāṃ yāti viccʰidvahābʰyām evaṃ gardabʰaratʰena /
text: The hotṛ does not recite from the anuṣṭubh; he recites from the virāj alone. The gods said: 'This one [Vāc] has created the sacrifice; let us sacrifice with these.' They said to the bṛhatī: 'You carry for us this third day. Our abhijit is indeed unaccomplished.' The bṛhatī is indeed of six [syllables] when it serves as the pṛṣṭha. Having carried this third day, the bṛhatī did not wish to carry further. With the rathantara they conquered this world, with the bṛhatī the mid-region, and with the bṛhat the yonder world. With this three-day period they conquered. Just as one goes with a conquered [army], driving Sindhu horses, carrying an elephant, riding a chariot seized by the pole, going with two hulubhya-horses, going with split-yoke horses — even so with a donkey-chariot.
meaning: न होता चनानुष्टुभश् शंसति , विराज एव स शंसति / ते देवा अब्रुवन्न् इयम् इयं यज्ञम् असृष्टैतानन यजामहा इति / ते बृहतीम् अब्रुवन्न् इदं नस् त्वं तृतीयम् अहर् वह / अभिजितं वै नस् सत् तद् अव्याप्तम् इति / सद् ध वै बृहती भवति यत् सा पृष्ठं भवति / सैतद् बृहती तृतीयम् अहर् ऊढ्वा नाकामयत वोढुम् / त इयम् एव लोकं रथन्तरेणाजयन्न् अन्तरिक्षं बृहत्यामुं बृहता / त एतेन त्र्यहेण व्यजयन्त / तद् यथा विजितेन यन्ति सैन्धवान् अजन्ति हस्तिनं वहन्ति धूर्गृहीतं रथं याति हुलुभ्यां याति विच्छिद्वहाभ्याम् एवं गर्दभरथेन /

sanskrit_iast: te bṛhadrathantare etāni rūpāṇi pratyauhatāṃ vairūpaṃ vairājaṃ mahānāmnī revatīr iti / atha bṛhatī pratyauhad virājaṃ śakvarīṃ revatīm iti / tānīmāny atyāyan / tāni devā anvapaśyan yathā matsyam ūrmyā yantam anupaśyed evam / tāni saptame 'han samudamajjan yathā matsyās samunmajjayur evam / tāny etāni chandomeṣu sarvāṇi saṃsṛjyante / etad bṛhatyāṃ bṛhad bhavati , bṛhatyāṃ rathantaram / sa yathogragādhe saṃrabhyātīyād evam evaitaṃ tṛtīyaṃ triyahaṃ devā atyāyan / ta etaṃ svargaṃ lokam āgacchann etad daśamam ahaḥ / eṣa vāva svargo loko yad daśamam ahaḥ / tac caturviṃśaṃ bhavati / tato yā viṃśatir virāṭ sā / atha yāś catasras tad eva bradhnasya viṣṭapam / tasminn etad devās sarvān kāmān duhre / "upasṛjan dharuṇaṃ mātre mātaraṃ dharuṇo dhayan rāyas poṣam iṣam ūrjam asmāsu dīdharat svāhe " ti juhoti / sa yaṃ kāmaṃ kāmayeta taṃ dhyāyet / etasyāṃ hutāyāṃ sa haivāsmai kāmas samṛdhyata evaṃvide /
sentences: te br̥hadratʰantare etāni rūpāṇi pratyauhatāṃ vairūpaṃ vairājaṃ mahānāmnī revatīr iti /
atʰa br̥hatī pratyauhad virājaṃ śakvarīṃ revatīm iti /
tāni devā anvapaśyan yatʰā matsyam ūrmyā yantam anupaśyed evam /
tāni saptame 'han samudamajjan yatʰā matsyās samunmajjayur evam /
etad br̥hatyāṃ br̥had bʰavati , br̥hatyāṃ ratʰantaram /
sa yatʰogragādʰe saṃrabʰyātīyād evam evaitaṃ tr̥tīyaṃ triyahaṃ devā atyāyan /
ta etaṃ svargaṃ lokam āgaccʰann etad daśamam ahaḥ /
eṣa vāva svargo loko yad daśamam ahaḥ /
atʰa yāś catasras tad eva bradʰnasya viṣṭapam /
tasminn etad devās sarvān kāmān duhre /
"upasr̥jan dʰaruṇaṃ mātre mātaraṃ dʰaruṇo dʰayan rāyas poṣam iṣam ūrjam asmāsu dīdʰarat svāhe " ti juhoti /
sa yaṃ kāmaṃ kāmayeta taṃ dʰyāyet /
etasyāṃ hutāyāṃ sa haivāsmai kāmas samr̥dʰyata evaṃvide /
text: The bṛhadrathantare took back these forms: the vairūpa, the vairāja, the mahānāmnī, and the revatī. And the bṛhatī took back the virāja, the śakvarī, and the revatī. These [forms] passed beyond them. The gods perceived them as one might see a fish moving with a wave. On the seventh day they rose to the surface, as fishes might rise up. All these are combined in the chandomas. The bṛhat is in the bṛhatī, the rathantara is in the bṛhatī. Just as one might cross a deep ford by holding on, even so the gods crossed this third three-day period. They reached the svarga loka — that is the tenth day. The tenth day is verily the svarga loka. That [day] is of twenty-four [stomas]. Of those, the twenty constitute the virāj, and the four are the seat of Bradhna. There the gods milked all desires. One offers with [the formula]: 'Releasing the support to the mother, the support suckles the mother; may he bestow upon us wealth, nourishment, food, and vigor — svāhā.' Whatever desire one desires, one should meditate upon it. When this [oblation] is offered, that desire is fulfilled for one who knows thus.
meaning: ते बृहद्रथन्तरे एतानि रूपाणि प्रत्यौहतां वैरूपं वैराजं महानाम्नी रेवतीर् इति / अथ बृहती प्रत्यौहद् विराजं शक्वरीं रेवतीम् इति / तानीमान्य् अत्यायन् / तानि देवा अन्वपश्यन् यथा मत्स्यम् ऊर्म्या यन्तम् अनुपश्येद् एवम् / तानि सप्तमे ऽहन् समुदमज्जन् यथा मत्स्यास् समुन्मज्जयुर् एवम् / तान्य् एतानि छन्दोमेषु सर्वाणि संसृज्यन्ते / एतद् बृहत्यां बृहद् भवति , बृहत्यां रथन्तरम् / स यथोग्रगाधे संरभ्यातीयाद् एवम् एवैतं तृतीयं त्रियहं देवा अत्यायन् / त एतं स्वर्गं लोकम् आगच्छन्न् एतद् दशमम् अहः / एष वाव स्वर्गो लोको यद् दशमम् अहः / तच् चतुर्विंशं भवति / ततो या विंशतिर् विराट् सा / अथ याश् चतस्रस् तद् एव ब्रध्नस्य विष्टपम् / तस्मिन्न् एतद् देवास् सर्वान् कामान् दुह्रे / "उपसृजन् धरुणं मात्रे मातरं धरुणो धयन् रायस् पोषम् इषम् ऊर्जम् अस्मासु दीधरत् स्वाहे " ति जुहोति / स यं कामं कामयेत तं ध्यायेत् / एतस्यां हुतायां स हैवास्मै कामस् समृध्यत एवंविदे /

sanskrit_iast: eti prety āśumad vītīmad rukmavat tejasvad yuñjānaṃ prathamasyāhno rūpaṃ , trivṛta stomasya , gāyatryai chandaso , rathantarasya sāmnaḥ / vṛṣavad vṛtrahavad rayimad viśvavad upasthitaṃ dvitīyasyāhno rūpaṃ , pañcadaśasya stomasya , triṣṭubhaś chandaso , bṛhatas sāmnaḥ / udvat trivad digvad gatavat purāṇavat tṛtīyasyāhno rūpaṃ , saptadaśasya stomasya , jagatyai chandaso , vairūpasya sāmnaḥ / rājanvaj janadvad virāṭsūryavac caturthasyāhno rūpam , ekaviṃśasya stomasya , anuṣṭubhaś chandaso , vairājasya sāmnaḥ / citravac chiśumat paṃktyaś śakvaryo vyūnākṣarā gomad vṛṣabhavad vajryabhimat pañcamasyāhno rūpaṃ , triṇavasya stomasya , paṃkteś chandasaś , śākvarasya sāmnaḥ /
sentences: eti prety āśumad vītīmad rukmavat tejasvad yuñjānaṃ pratʰamasyāhno rūpaṃ , trivr̥ta stomasya , gāyatryai cʰandaso , ratʰantarasya sāmnaḥ /
vr̥ṣavad vr̥trahavad rayimad viśvavad upastʰitaṃ dvitīyasyāhno rūpaṃ , pañcadaśasya stomasya , triṣṭubʰaś cʰandaso , br̥hatas sāmnaḥ /
udvat trivad digvad gatavat purāṇavat tr̥tīyasyāhno rūpaṃ , saptadaśasya stomasya , jagatyai cʰandaso , vairūpasya sāmnaḥ /
rājanvaj janadvad virāṭsūryavac caturtʰasyāhno rūpam , ekaviṃśasya stomasya , anuṣṭubʰaś cʰandaso , vairājasya sāmnaḥ /
citravac cʰiśumat paṃktyaś śakvaryo vyūnākṣarā gomad vr̥ṣabʰavad vajryabʰimat pañcamasyāhno rūpaṃ , triṇavasya stomasya , paṃkteś cʰandasaś , śākvarasya sāmnaḥ /
text: Going forward, going back, swift, extended, golden, lustrous, being yoked — this is the form of the first day, of the trivṛt stoma, of the gāyatrī metre, of the rathantara sāman. Bull-like, Vṛtra-slaying, wealth-bearing, all-pervading, established — this is the form of the second day, of the pañcadaśa stoma, of the triṣṭubh metre, of the bṛhat sāman. Upward-going, threefold, directional, going forth, ancient — this is the form of the third day, of the saptadaśa stoma, of the jagatī metre, of the vairūpa sāman. Kingly, generating people, sovereign, solar — this is the form of the fourth day, of the ekaviṃśa stoma, of the anuṣṭubh metre, of the vairāja sāman. Brilliant, with offspring, of paṅkti and śakvarī [metres], with extended syllables, rich in cattle, bull-like, thunderbolt-bearing, mighty — this is the form of the fifth day, of the triṇava stoma, of the paṅkti metre, of the śākvara sāman.
meaning: एति प्रेत्य् आशुमद् वीतीमद् रुक्मवत् तेजस्वद् युञ्जानं प्रथमस्याह्नो रूपं , त्रिवृत स्तोमस्य , गायत्र्यै छन्दसो , रथन्तरस्य साम्नः / वृषवद् वृत्रहवद् रयिमद् विश्ववद् उपस्थितं द्वितीयस्याह्नो रूपं , पञ्चदशस्य स्तोमस्य , त्रिष्टुभश् छन्दसो , बृहतस् साम्नः / उद्वत् त्रिवद् दिग्वद् गतवत् पुराणवत् तृतीयस्याह्नो रूपं , सप्तदशस्य स्तोमस्य , जगत्यै छन्दसो , वैरूपस्य साम्नः / राजन्वज् जनद्वद् विराट्सूर्यवच् चतुर्थस्याह्नो रूपम् , एकविंशस्य स्तोमस्य , अनुष्टुभश् छन्दसो , वैराजस्य साम्नः / चित्रवच् छिशुमत् पंक्त्यश् शक्वर्यो व्यूनाक्षरा गोमद् वृषभवद् वज्र्यभिमत् पञ्चमस्याह्नो रूपं , त्रिणवस्य स्तोमस्य , पंक्तेश् छन्दसश् , शाक्वरस्य साम्नः /

sanskrit_iast: yasmād eṣā samānā satī ṣaḍahavibhaktir atha nānā bhavati , tasmān nānārūpas saṃvatsaro nānārūpam enam anu prajāyate / agna iti prathamasyāhno vibhaktir , agnim iti dvitīyasyāgnineti tṛtīyasyāgnir iti caturthasyāgner iti pañcamasyāgna ity eva punaṣ ṣaṣṭhasya / tāv etāv antau saṃdhatta / etad anv anantas saṃvatsaraḥ / tasyaitāv antau yad dhemantaś ca vasantaś ca / etad anu grāmasyāntau sameta , etad anu niṣkasyāntau sameta , etad anv ahir bhogān paryāhṛtya śaye / tad etad annam / taṃ devacakram akṣitaṃ punarnavam ā ca parā ca parivartate / sa ya etad evaṃ vedaitām evānantatām etām akṣitim etāṃ punarnavatām jayati / "agna ā yāhi vītaya " iti hvayanty evainam etena , "agniṃ dūtaṃ vṛṇīmaha " iti vṛṇata evainam etena / "agnināgnis sam idhyata " iti sam evainam etad indhate / "agnir vṛtrāṇi jaṃghanad " iti vy evaitenaitaj jayante / "tava śriyo carṣyasyeva vidyuta " iti śriyam evāsminn etad dadhati / yo vai ṣaṣṭhasyāhno vibhaktiṃ veda sarvam āyur eti / jātavedasa iti vai ṣaṣṭhasyāhno vibhaktir agna iti ca /
sentences: yasmād eṣā samānā satī ṣaḍahavibʰaktir atʰa nānā bʰavati , tasmān nānārūpas saṃvatsaro nānārūpam enam anu prajāyate /
agna iti pratʰamasyāhno vibʰaktir , agnim iti dvitīyasyāgnineti tr̥tīyasyāgnir iti caturtʰasyāgner iti pañcamasyāgna ity eva punaṣ ṣaṣṭʰasya /
tasyaitāv antau yad dʰemantaś ca vasantaś ca /
etad anu grāmasyāntau sameta , etad anu niṣkasyāntau sameta , etad anv ahir bʰogān paryāhr̥tya śaye /
taṃ devacakram akṣitaṃ punarnavam ā ca parā ca parivartate /
sa ya etad evaṃ vedaitām evānantatām etām akṣitim etāṃ punarnavatām jayati /
"agna ā yāhi vītaya " iti hvayanty evainam etena , "agniṃ dūtaṃ vr̥ṇīmaha " iti vr̥ṇata evainam etena /
"agnināgnis sam idʰyata " iti sam evainam etad indʰate /
"agnir vr̥trāṇi jaṃgʰanad " iti vy evaitenaitaj jayante /
"tava śriyo carṣyasyeva vidyuta " iti śriyam evāsminn etad dadʰati /
yo vai ṣaṣṭʰasyāhno vibʰaktiṃ veda sarvam āyur eti /
jātavedasa iti vai ṣaṣṭʰasyāhno vibʰaktir agna iti ca /
text: Because this [agni-vibhakti], though being the same, is divided across the ṣaḍaha and yet becomes different [in each day], therefore the year is of varied forms, and what is born from it is of varied forms. 'Agna' is the vibhakti of the first day, 'agnim' of the second, 'agninā' of the third, 'agnir' of the fourth, 'agner' of the fifth, and 'agna' again of the sixth. These two ends are joined together. Following this, the year is endless. Its two ends are hemanta (winter) and vasanta (spring). Following this, the two ends of a village meet; following this, the two ends of a gold necklace meet; following this, a serpent lies with its coils encircled. This is food. That divine wheel, imperishable and ever-renewed, revolves back and forth. He who knows this thus wins this very endlessness, this imperishability, this ever-renewal. With 'Agna ā yāhi vītaye' they summon him. With 'Agniṃ dūtaṃ vṛṇīmahe' they choose him. With 'Agninā agnis sam idhyate' they kindle him. With 'Agnir vṛtrāṇi jaṅghanad' they conquer by this. With 'Tava śriyo carṣasyeva vidyutaḥ' they place splendour in him. He who knows the vibhakti of the sixth day lives a full life. 'Jātavedas' is verily the vibhakti of the sixth day, and 'agna' also.
meaning: यस्माद् एषा समाना सती षडहविभक्तिर् अथ नाना भवति , तस्मान् नानारूपस् संवत्सरो नानारूपम् एनम् अनु प्रजायते / अग्न इति प्रथमस्याह्नो विभक्तिर् , अग्निम् इति द्वितीयस्याग्निनेति तृतीयस्याग्निर् इति चतुर्थस्याग्नेर् इति पञ्चमस्याग्न इत्य् एव पुनष् षष्ठस्य / ताव् एताव् अन्तौ संधत्त / एतद् अन्व् अनन्तस् संवत्सरः / तस्यैताव् अन्तौ यद् धेमन्तश् च वसन्तश् च / एतद् अनु ग्रामस्यान्तौ समेत , एतद् अनु निष्कस्यान्तौ समेत , एतद् अन्व् अहिर् भोगान् पर्याहृत्य शये / तद् एतद् अन्नम् / तं देवचक्रम् अक्षितं पुनर्नवम् आ च परा च परिवर्तते / स य एतद् एवं वेदैताम् एवानन्तताम् एताम् अक्षितिम् एतां पुनर्नवताम् जयति / "अग्न आ याहि वीतय " इति ह्वयन्त्य् एवैनम् एतेन , "अग्निं दूतं वृणीमह " इति वृणत एवैनम् एतेन / "अग्निनाग्निस् सम् इध्यत " इति सम् एवैनम् एतद् इन्धते / "अग्निर् वृत्राणि जंघनद् " इति व्य् एवैतेनैतज् जयन्ते / "तव श्रियो चर्ष्यस्येव विद्युत " इति श्रियम् एवास्मिन्न् एतद् दधति / यो वै षष्ठस्याह्नो विभक्तिं वेद सर्वम् आयुर् एति / जातवेदस इति वै षष्ठस्याह्नो विभक्तिर् अग्न इति च /

sanskrit_iast: devā vai pṛṣṭhye ṣaḍahe śriyam aicchan / tām agna iti prathame 'han nānvavindan / tām agnim iti dvitīya 'han nānvavindan / tām agnineti tṛtīye 'han nānvavindan / tām agnir ity eva caturthe 'hann anvavindan / bhūtam evottare 'nvavadatām / yasmād eṣā samānā saty agnivibhaktir atha nānā bhavati ya ete praviṣṭāḥ / atho hāmyaitair evāgnibhis sarva ṛtavo 'gnimanto bhavanti / prasṛtel̥ā prathamasyāhna , ūrdhvel̥aṃ dvitīyaṃ , pariṣṭubdhel̥aṃ tṛtīyam , il̥ābhir il̥aṃ caturtham , adhyardhel̥aṃ pañcamam , ihakāreṇābhyastel̥aṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ ca / atho ha vāsyasko naimiśīyān papraccha -- kiṃ prathamenāhnā kurudhvam iti / praimeti / kiṃ dvitīyeneti / avasaṃ kurmahā iti / kiṃ tṛtīyeneti / pari vā plavāmahā iti / kiṃ caturtheneti / satā sad apyadadhmeti / kiṃ pañcameneti / paśūn vicchindanta aimeti / kiṃ ṣaṣṭhenati / āgacchāmeti hocuḥ / atho tebhya eaitat paśubhyo bhiṣajyāmeti / tad yat praimeti prava vā etat sāryate yat praiti /
sentences: devā vai pr̥ṣṭʰye ṣaḍahe śriyam aiccʰan /
tām agnir ity eva caturtʰe 'hann anvavindan /
yasmād eṣā samānā saty agnivibʰaktir atʰa nānā bʰavati ya ete praviṣṭāḥ /
atʰo hāmyaitair evāgnibʰis sarva r̥tavo 'gnimanto bʰavanti /
prasr̥tel̥ā pratʰamasyāhna , ūrdʰvel̥aṃ dvitīyaṃ , pariṣṭubdʰel̥aṃ tr̥tīyam , il̥ābʰir il̥aṃ caturtʰam , adʰyardʰel̥aṃ pañcamam , ihakāreṇābʰyastel̥aṃ ṣaṣṭʰaṃ ca /
atʰo ha vāsyasko naimiśīyān papraccʰa -- kiṃ pratʰamenāhnā kurudʰvam iti /
tad yat praimeti prava vā etat sāryate yat praiti /
text: The gods sought splendour in the pṛṣṭhya ṣaḍaha. They did not find it with 'agna' on the first day. They did not find it with 'agnim' on the second day. They did not find it with 'agninā' on the third day. They found it with 'agnir' on the fourth day. What had come into being they spoke forth on the latter [days]. Because this agni-vibhakti, though being the same, becomes different — these [fires] are entered into it. Moreover, by means of these agnis, all the seasons become possessed of fire. The iḷā of the first day has a flowing forth; the second has an upward [iḷā]; the third has an enclosed [iḷā]; the fourth has iḷā upon iḷā; the fifth has a half-extra [iḷā]; the sixth has one intensified with the iha-sound. And Vāsyaska asked the Naimiśīyas: 'What do you accomplish with the first day?' 'We go forth,' [they said]. 'What with the second?' 'We make a resting place.' 'What with the third?' 'We swim around.' 'What with the fourth?' 'We place reality upon reality.' 'What with the fifth?' 'We go forth, separating the cattle.' 'What with the sixth?' 'We arrive,' they said. 'And we heal those cattle.'  That which [they said] 'We go forth' — that is indeed being driven forward, for one goes forward when one sets out.
meaning: देवा वै पृष्ठ्ये षडहे श्रियम् ऐच्छन् / ताम् अग्न इति प्रथमे ऽहन् नान्वविन्दन् / ताम् अग्निम् इति द्वितीय ऽहन् नान्वविन्दन् / ताम् अग्निनेति तृतीये ऽहन् नान्वविन्दन् / ताम् अग्निर् इत्य् एव चतुर्थे ऽहन्न् अन्वविन्दन् / भूतम् एवोत्तरे ऽन्ववदताम् / यस्माद् एषा समाना सत्य् अग्निविभक्तिर् अथ नाना भवति य एते प्रविष्टाः / अथो हाम्यैतैर् एवाग्निभिस् सर्व ऋतवो ऽग्निमन्तो भवन्ति / प्रसृतेल्̥आ प्रथमस्याह्न , ऊर्ध्वेल्̥अं द्वितीयं , परिष्टुब्धेल्̥अं तृतीयम् , इल्̥आभिर् इल्̥अं चतुर्थम् , अध्यर्धेल्̥अं पञ्चमम् , इहकारेणाभ्यस्तेल्̥अं षष्ठं च / अथो ह वास्यस्को नैमिशीयान् पप्रच्छ -- किं प्रथमेनाह्ना कुरुध्वम् इति / प्रैमेति / किं द्वितीयेनेति / अवसं कुर्महा इति / किं तृतीयेनेति / परि वा प्लवामहा इति / किं चतुर्थेनेति / सता सद् अप्यदध्मेति / किं पञ्चमेनेति / पशून् विच्छिन्दन्त ऐमेति / किं षष्ठेनति / आगच्छामेति होचुः / अथो तेभ्य एऐतत् पशुभ्यो भिषज्यामेति / तद् यत् प्रैमेति प्रव वा एतत् सार्यते यत् प्रैति /

sanskrit_iast: atha yad avasaṃ kurma ity uparatyeva vā upavimucyevāvasaṃ kurvate / uparatyeva hi dvitīyasyāhna il̥ā nidhanaṃ gacchati / atha yat pari vā plavāmahā iti pariplutyeva hi tṛtīyasyāhna il̥ānidhanaṃ gacchati / atha yat satā sad apyadadhmetīl̥ābhir il̥āḥ paśubhiḥ paśūṃs tat / tad etat satā sad apihitam / atha yat paśūn vicchindanta aimeti vicchinneva vā eṣā yad adhyardhel̥ānnakṛtā / paśavo vā il̥ā / tasmāt paśūn vicchedaṃ vikāraṃ bhuñjate / atha yad āgacchāmetīhetyasyām evaitat pratyatiṣṭhan / atho tebhya evaitat paśubhyo bhiṣajitam / yajmād eṣā samānā satīl̥āvibhaktir atha nānā bhavati , tasmān nānārūpāḥ paśavaḥ / nānārūpam enān anu prajāyate / yad ṛcārabhate tat prathamasyāhno rūpam / pariṣṭubdhaṃ dvitīyasyobhayataḥpariṣṭubdhaṃ tṛtīyasyānutunnaṃ caturthasyābhyastaṃ pañcamasyehakāreṇābhyastaṃ ṣaṣṭhasya / yasmād eṣā samānā satī svaravibhaktir atha nānā bhavati tasmād ayaṃ vāyur yathartu pavata -- śīto hemantam , uṣṇo grīṣmam / indreti prathamasyāhno vibhaktir indram iti dvitīyasyendreṇeti tṛtīyasyendra iti caturthasyendrād iti pañcamasyendra ity eva punaṣ ṣaṣṭhasya /
sentences: atʰa yad avasaṃ kurma ity uparatyeva vā upavimucyevāvasaṃ kurvate /
uparatyeva hi dvitīyasyāhna il̥ā nidʰanaṃ gaccʰati /
atʰa yat pari vā plavāmahā iti pariplutyeva hi tr̥tīyasyāhna il̥ānidʰanaṃ gaccʰati /
atʰa yat satā sad apyadadʰmetīl̥ābʰir il̥āḥ paśubʰiḥ paśūṃs tat /
atʰa yat paśūn viccʰindanta aimeti viccʰinneva vā eṣā yad adʰyardʰel̥ānnakr̥tā /
yajmād eṣā samānā satīl̥āvibʰaktir atʰa nānā bʰavati , tasmān nānārūpāḥ paśavaḥ /
pariṣṭubdʰaṃ dvitīyasyobʰayataḥpariṣṭubdʰaṃ tr̥tīyasyānutunnaṃ caturtʰasyābʰyastaṃ pañcamasyehakāreṇābʰyastaṃ ṣaṣṭʰasya /
yasmād eṣā samānā satī svaravibʰaktir atʰa nānā bʰavati tasmād ayaṃ vāyur yatʰartu pavata -- śīto hemantam , uṣṇo grīṣmam /
indreti pratʰamasyāhno vibʰaktir indram iti dvitīyasyendreṇeti tr̥tīyasyendra iti caturtʰasyendrād iti pañcamasyendra ity eva punaṣ ṣaṣṭʰasya /
text: As for their saying 'We make a resting place' — one rests indeed, as if unyoking; one makes a halt. For the iḷā of the second day reaches its end in a resting. As for 'We swim around' — one swims around, as it were, for the iḷā of the third day reaches its end by flowing around. As for 'We place reality upon reality' — that is iḷās upon iḷās, cattle upon cattle. That is reality placed upon reality. As for 'We go forth, separating the cattle' — the half-extra iḷā is indeed cut off, being made into food. Cattle are indeed the iḷā. Therefore cattle are enjoyed through cutting and transformation. As for 'We arrive' — with 'iha' (here) they established themselves in this very [world]. And thereby those cattle were healed. Because this iḷā-vibhakti, though being the same, becomes different, therefore cattle are of varied forms. What is born from them is of varied forms. What begins with ṛc is the form of the first day. The enclosed [form] is of the second; the doubly-enclosed is of the third; the connected is of the fourth; the intensified is of the fifth; the one intensified with iha-sound is of the sixth. Because this svara-vibhakti, though being the same, becomes different, therefore this wind (vāyu) blows according to the season — cold in winter, hot in summer. 'Indra' is the vibhakti of the first day, 'indram' of the second, 'indreṇa' of the third, 'indra' [nominative] of the fourth, 'indrād' of the fifth, and 'indra' again of the sixth.
meaning: अथ यद् अवसं कुर्म इत्य् उपरत्येव वा उपविमुच्येवावसं कुर्वते / उपरत्येव हि द्वितीयस्याह्न इल्̥आ निधनं गच्छति / अथ यत् परि वा प्लवामहा इति परिप्लुत्येव हि तृतीयस्याह्न इल्̥आनिधनं गच्छति / अथ यत् सता सद् अप्यदध्मेतील्̥आभिर् इल्̥आः पशुभिः पशूंस् तत् / तद् एतत् सता सद् अपिहितम् / अथ यत् पशून् विच्छिन्दन्त ऐमेति विच्छिन्नेव वा एषा यद् अध्यर्धेल्̥आन्नकृता / पशवो वा इल्̥आ / तस्मात् पशून् विच्छेदं विकारं भुञ्जते / अथ यद् आगच्छामेतीहेत्यस्याम् एवैतत् प्रत्यतिष्ठन् / अथो तेभ्य एवैतत् पशुभ्यो भिषजितम् / यज्माद् एषा समाना सतील्̥आविभक्तिर् अथ नाना भवति , तस्मान् नानारूपाः पशवः / नानारूपम् एनान् अनु प्रजायते / यद् ऋचारभते तत् प्रथमस्याह्नो रूपम् / परिष्टुब्धं द्वितीयस्योभयतःपरिष्टुब्धं तृतीयस्यानुतुन्नं चतुर्थस्याभ्यस्तं पञ्चमस्येहकारेणाभ्यस्तं षष्ठस्य / यस्माद् एषा समाना सती स्वरविभक्तिर् अथ नाना भवति तस्माद् अयं वायुर् यथर्तु पवत -- शीतो हेमन्तम् , उष्णो ग्रीष्मम् / इन्द्रेति प्रथमस्याह्नो विभक्तिर् इन्द्रम् इति द्वितीयस्येन्द्रेणेति तृतीयस्येन्द्र इति चतुर्थस्येन्द्राद् इति पञ्चमस्येन्द्र इत्य् एव पुनष् षष्ठस्य /

sanskrit_iast: iti haivedam agra āsa / tad akāmayata  syāṃ prajāyeya bhūmānaṃ gaccheyam iti / tan mano 'manuta / tasya dvitīyaṃ vitvāvitarāhvayam ait / tasmād dvitīyaṃ vitvāvitarāhvayam eti / tad anena manasā sahātapyata / mano ha vāva tapaḥ / tat tapyamānaṃ vācam asṛjata / tābhyām astuta sto me sto ma iti / yat sto ma ity abravīt tat stomasya stomatvam / stuvata enena svā ayaṃ na śreṣṭha iti ya evaṃ veda / tāv evaitau stomāv abhavatāṃ parāṅ ca pūrvāṅ ca / tau prāṇāpānau , te 'horātre , tau pūrvapakṣāparapakṣau , tāv imau lokau , tāv indrāgnī , tau mitrāvaruṇau , tāv aśvinau , tad daivyaṃ mithunaṃ , yad idaṃ kiṃ ca dvandvaṃ tad abhavatām / tau ha sma prajāpatāv evāntas saṃbhavataḥ / tad idaṃ mano vācam askandat / sa hiraṇmayo garbho 'dhīyatāmṛtaḥ / eṣa vai mṛtyur yad agniḥ / tasmin yad dhiraṇyaṃ prāsyanti kalyāṇataraṃ bhavati / so 'yaṃ garbho 'jāyata /
sentences: tad akāmayata [bahu] syāṃ prajāyeya bʰūmānaṃ gaccʰeyam iti /
tābʰyām astuta sto me sto ma iti /
yat sto ma ity abravīt tat stomasya stomatvam /
stuvata enena svā ayaṃ na śreṣṭʰa iti ya evaṃ veda /
tāv evaitau stomāv abʰavatāṃ parāṅ ca pūrvāṅ ca /
tau prāṇāpānau , te 'horātre , tau pūrvapakṣāparapakṣau , tāv imau lokau , tāv indrāgnī , tau mitrāvaruṇau , tāv aśvinau , tad daivyaṃ mitʰunaṃ , yad idaṃ kiṃ ca dvandvaṃ tad abʰavatām /
tau ha sma prajāpatāv evāntas saṃbʰavataḥ /
tasmin yad dʰiraṇyaṃ prāsyanti kalyāṇataraṃ bʰavati /
text: Thus indeed was this [universe] in the beginning. It desired: 'May I come into being, may I be born forth, may I attain abundance.' It conceived with mind. Going a second time, it called upon another. Therefore one goes a second time and calls upon another. With this mind it performed tapas. Mind is verily tapas. While performing tapas, it created speech. With these two it praised: 'sto me, sto ma.' When it said 'sto ma,' that is the stoma-nature of the stoma. 'By praising with this, this one of ours is the best' — [thus knows] he who knows this. These two stomas came into being — the outward and the inward. They are prāṇa and apāna; they are day and night; they are the waxing and waning fortnights; they are these two worlds; they are Indra and Agni; they are Mitra and Varuṇa; they are the Aśvins; they are the divine couple; whatever pair exists, that they became. These two used to come together within Prajāpati. Then this mind sprang upon speech. That golden embryo was conceived — immortal. This fire (agni) is verily death. When gold is cast into it, it becomes more beautiful. This embryo was born.
meaning: इति हैवेदम् अग्र आस / तद् अकामयत  स्यां प्रजायेय भूमानं गच्छेयम् इति / तन् मनो ऽमनुत / तस्य द्वितीयं वित्वावितराह्वयम् ऐत् / तस्माद् द्वितीयं वित्वावितराह्वयम् एति / तद् अनेन मनसा सहातप्यत / मनो ह वाव तपः / तत् तप्यमानं वाचम् असृजत / ताभ्याम् अस्तुत स्तो मे स्तो म इति / यत् स्तो म इत्य् अब्रवीत् तत् स्तोमस्य स्तोमत्वम् / स्तुवत एनेन स्वा अयं न श्रेष्ठ इति य एवं वेद / ताव् एवैतौ स्तोमाव् अभवतां पराङ् च पूर्वाङ् च / तौ प्राणापानौ , ते ऽहोरात्रे , तौ पूर्वपक्षापरपक्षौ , ताव् इमौ लोकौ , ताव् इन्द्राग्नी , तौ मित्रावरुणौ , ताव् अश्विनौ , तद् दैव्यं मिथुनं , यद् इदं किं च द्वन्द्वं तद् अभवताम् / तौ ह स्म प्रजापताव् एवान्तस् संभवतः / तद् इदं मनो वाचम् अस्कन्दत् / स हिरण्मयो गर्भो ऽधीयतामृतः / एष वै मृत्युर् यद् अग्निः / तस्मिन् यद् धिरण्यं प्रास्यन्ति कल्याणतरं भवति / सो ऽयं गर्भो ऽजायत /

sanskrit_iast: tasya yat prathamam ulbam apālumpaṃs tat kṛṣṇāyas samabhavat / yad dvitīyam ulbam apālumpaṃs tad rajatam abhavat / yat tṛtīyam ulbam apālumpaṃs tad dharitam abhavat / tasmāt tat tviṣimattamam / tat tad dhy asyādhyātmam āsīd atha yaj jarāyu nāḍyām āsīt / tal loham abhavat / tasmāt tad durgandhitamam / tāni saptadaśaivākṣarāṇy ajāyanta / tāni dvedhā vyauhan navānyāny aṣṭāv anyāni / sa eva trivṛc ca stomo 'bhavat gāyatrī ca chandaḥ / sa aikṣatāyaṃ stoma idaṃ chanda imau vāva tasmā alaṃ yat prajanayetām / hantaimāv eva prajanayatam iti bravāṇīti / sa trivṛtā stutvābravīd gāyatrīṃ -- vibhava , yāvaty asi tāvaty edhīti / sāṣṭākṣarā saty akṣarāṇi tryakṣarāṇy akuruta / tāni caturviṃśatir abhavan /
sentences: tasya yat pratʰamam ulbam apālumpaṃs tat kr̥ṣṇāyas samabʰavat /
yad dvitīyam ulbam apālumpaṃs tad rajatam abʰavat /
yat tr̥tīyam ulbam apālumpaṃs tad dʰaritam abʰavat /
tat tad dʰy asyādʰyātmam āsīd atʰa yaj jarāyu nāḍyām āsīt /
tāni dvedʰā vyauhan navānyāny aṣṭāv anyāni /
sa eva trivr̥c ca stomo 'bʰavat gāyatrī ca cʰandaḥ /
sa aikṣatāyaṃ stoma idaṃ cʰanda imau vāva tasmā alaṃ yat prajanayetām /
sa trivr̥tā stutvābravīd gāyatrīṃ -- vibʰava , yāvaty asi tāvaty edʰīti /
text: When they stripped off its first membrane, that became black iron. When they stripped off its second membrane, that became silver. When they stripped off its third membrane, that became gold. Therefore that [gold] is the most lustrous, for it was its innermost layer. And the afterbirth that was in the channel became copper. Therefore that is the most foul-smelling. Seventeen syllables were born. They divided them in two — nine on one side, eight on the other. That became the trivṛt stoma and the gāyatrī metre. He considered: 'This stoma, this metre — these two are sufficient for him to generate. Come, let me tell these two to generate.' Having praised with the trivṛt, he said to the gāyatrī: 'Expand! Grow to your full extent!' She, being of eight syllables, made the syllables into groups of three. They became twenty-four.
meaning: तस्य यत् प्रथमम् उल्बम् अपालुम्पंस् तत् कृष्णायस् समभवत् / यद् द्वितीयम् उल्बम् अपालुम्पंस् तद् रजतम् अभवत् / यत् तृतीयम् उल्बम् अपालुम्पंस् तद् धरितम् अभवत् / तस्मात् तत् त्विषिमत्तमम् / तत् तद् ध्य् अस्याध्यात्मम् आसीद् अथ यज् जरायु नाड्याम् आसीत् / तल् लोहम् अभवत् / तस्मात् तद् दुर्गन्धितमम् / तानि सप्तदशैवाक्षराण्य् अजायन्त / तानि द्वेधा व्यौहन् नवान्यान्य् अष्टाव् अन्यानि / स एव त्रिवृच् च स्तोमो ऽभवत् गायत्री च छन्दः / स ऐक्षतायं स्तोम इदं छन्द इमौ वाव तस्मा अलं यत् प्रजनयेताम् / हन्तैमाव् एव प्रजनयतम् इति ब्रवाणीति / स त्रिवृता स्तुत्वाब्रवीद् गायत्रीं -- विभव , यावत्य् असि तावत्य् एधीति / साष्टाक्षरा सत्य् अक्षराणि त्र्यक्षराण्य् अकुरुत / तानि चतुर्विंशतिर् अभवन् /

sanskrit_iast: sa pañcadaśa stomo 'bhavat / apare dve ādatta / sa saptadaśa stomo 'bhavat / aparāṇi catvāry ādatta / sa ekaviṃśa stomo 'bhavat / tad ardhena gāyatrī viṣuvantam agacchat / aparāṇi ṣaḍ ādatta / sa triṇava stomo 'bhavat / aparāṇi ṣaḍ ādatta sa trayastriṃśa stomo 'bhavat / so 'taḥ parācīnaṃ na prāvindat /
sentences: aparāṇi ṣaḍ ādatta sa trayastriṃśa stomo 'bʰavat /
text: That became the pañcadaśa (fifteen-fold) stoma. He took two more. That became the saptadaśa (seventeen-fold) stoma. He took four more. That became the ekaviṃśa (twenty-one-fold) stoma. With half [of its expansion] the gāyatrī reached the viṣuvant (solstice). He took six more. That became the triṇava (twenty-seven-fold) stoma. He took six more. That became the trayastriṃśa (thirty-three-fold) stoma. Beyond that he did not find [anything further].
meaning: स पञ्चदश स्तोमो ऽभवत् / अपरे द्वे आदत्त / स सप्तदश स्तोमो ऽभवत् / अपराणि चत्वार्य् आदत्त / स एकविंश स्तोमो ऽभवत् / तद् अर्धेन गायत्री विषुवन्तम् अगच्छत् / अपराणि षड् आदत्त / स त्रिणव स्तोमो ऽभवत् / अपराणि षड् आदत्त स त्रयस्त्रिंश स्तोमो ऽभवत् / सो ऽतः पराचीनं न प्राविन्दत् /

sanskrit_iast: sa trivṛc ca pañcadaśaṃ ca samāsyat / tad eva caturviṃśaṃ saptamam ahar abhavat gāyatrī chandasām / tasmād atrobhe bṛhadrathantare kriyete / ubho hy etau bārhatarāthantarau stomau / rathantaraṃ vai mātrāyām atra syād , atha bṛhat pṛṣṭhaṃ kriyate / saptadaśaṃ ca triṇavaṃ ca samāsyat / tad eva catuścaatvāriṃśam aṣṭamam ahar abhavat triṣṭup chandasām / tasmād atra rathantaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ kriyate / ekaviṃśaṃ ca trayastriṃśaṃ ca samāsyat / tataṣ ṣaḍ akṣarāṇy atyaricyanta / atha yāny aṣṭācatvāriṃśat paryaśiṣyanta tad eāṣṭācatvāriṃśaṃ navamam ahar abhavat , jagatī chandasām / tasmād atra bṛhat pṛṣṭhaṃ kriyate /
sentences: sa trivr̥c ca pañcadaśaṃ ca samāsyat /
tad eva caturviṃśaṃ saptamam ahar abʰavat gāyatrī cʰandasām /
ratʰantaraṃ vai mātrāyām atra syād , atʰa br̥hat pr̥ṣṭʰaṃ kriyate /
tad eva catuścaatvāriṃśam aṣṭamam ahar abʰavat triṣṭup cʰandasām /
atʰa yāny aṣṭācatvāriṃśat paryaśiṣyanta tad eāṣṭācatvāriṃśaṃ navamam ahar abʰavat , jagatī cʰandasām /
text: He combined the trivṛt and the pañcadaśa. That became the twenty-four-fold seventh day, with gāyatrī as its metre. Therefore both bṛhadrathantare are performed there, for both these stomas belong to the bṛhat and rathantara. The rathantara should properly be there in the mother's [role], but the bṛhat is made the pṛṣṭha. He combined the saptadaśa and the triṇava. That became the forty-four-fold eighth day, with triṣṭubh as its metre. Therefore the rathantara is made the pṛṣṭha there. He combined the ekaviṃśa and the trayastriṃśa. From that, six syllables were left over. And the forty-eight that remained — that became the forty-eight-fold ninth day, with jagatī as its metre. Therefore the bṛhat is made the pṛṣṭha there.
meaning: स त्रिवृच् च पञ्चदशं च समास्यत् / तद् एव चतुर्विंशं सप्तमम् अहर् अभवत् गायत्री छन्दसाम् / तस्माद् अत्रोभे बृहद्रथन्तरे क्रियेते / उभो ह्य् एतौ बार्हतराथन्तरौ स्तोमौ / रथन्तरं वै मात्रायाम् अत्र स्याद् , अथ बृहत् पृष्ठं क्रियते / सप्तदशं च त्रिणवं च समास्यत् / तद् एव चतुश्चअत्वारिंशम् अष्टमम् अहर् अभवत् त्रिष्टुप् छन्दसाम् / तस्माद् अत्र रथन्तरं पृष्ठं क्रियते / एकविंशं च त्रयस्त्रिंशं च समास्यत् / ततष् षड् अक्षराण्य् अत्यरिच्यन्त / अथ यान्य् अष्टाचत्वारिंशत् पर्यशिष्यन्त तद् एआष्टाचत्वारिंशं नवमम् अहर् अभवत् , जगती छन्दसाम् / तस्माद् अत्र बृहत् पृष्ठं क्रियते /

sanskrit_iast: tānīmāni ṣaḍakṣarāṇy abhihiṃṅakarot / tataṣ ṣaṇ ṇiramimīta / tāni dvācaśābhavan / tāni punar evābhihiṃṅakarot / tataṣ ṣaṇ ṇiramimīta / tāny aṣṭādaśābhavan / tāni punar evābhihiṃṅakarot / tataṣ ṣaṇ ṇiramimīta / tāni caturviṃśatir abhavan / tad eva caturviṃśaṃ daśamam ahar abhavad anuṣṭup chandasām / tasmād u trihiṃkṛtaṃ sāma / tad āhur ati trivṛtaṃ stomā yanti , na gāyatrīṃ chandāṃsīti / nāhaiva trivṛtaṃ stomā atiyantīti brūyān no gāyatrīṃ chandāṃsīti / triprāyaṇā hi stomās trimadhyās tryudayāḥ / etad u gāyatrīṃ sarvāṇi chandāṃsi nātiyanti / tad etad trivṛtaś caiva stomasya puṣṭaṃ gāyatryai chandaso yad eṣa dvādaśāḥaḥ / tad brahma vai gāyatrī / kṣatraṃ trivṛt / yat sa vajras tena kṣatram / tad etat brahma ca kṣatraṃ caiṣa dvādaśāhaḥ / tad u vā āhur brahma vai trivṛd , brahma gāyatrī , brahmaiṣa dvādaśāho , brahmaivaiṣa sarvo dvādaśāha ity eva veditavyam / tasyaitau ślokau -- "catvāro 'gre pra vahanti yuktās te ṣaḍ bhavanti parame vyoman / te dvau dvau bhūtvā pra patanti pakṣais te 'smin kasmin pratitiṣṭhanti gatvā // dvau stomau gāyatrīṃ vasāte dvau triṣṭubhaṃ jagatīṃ dvau vasāte /
sentences: tad eva caturviṃśaṃ daśamam ahar abʰavad anuṣṭup cʰandasām /
tad āhur ati trivr̥taṃ stomā yanti , na gāyatrīṃ cʰandāṃsīti /
nāhaiva trivr̥taṃ stomā atiyantīti brūyān no gāyatrīṃ cʰandāṃsīti /
etad u gāyatrīṃ sarvāṇi cʰandāṃsi nātiyanti /
tad etad trivr̥taś caiva stomasya puṣṭaṃ gāyatryai cʰandaso yad eṣa dvādaśāḥaḥ /
tad etat brahma ca kṣatraṃ caiṣa dvādaśāhaḥ /
tad u vā āhur brahma vai trivr̥d , brahma gāyatrī , brahmaiṣa dvādaśāho , brahmaivaiṣa sarvo dvādaśāha ity eva veditavyam /
"catvāro 'gre pra vahanti yuktās te ṣaḍ bʰavanti parame vyoman /
te dvau dvau bʰūtvā pra patanti pakṣais te 'smin kasmin pratitiṣṭʰanti gatvā //
dvau stomau gāyatrīṃ vasāte dvau triṣṭubʰaṃ jagatīṃ dvau vasāte /
text: He uttered hiṅkāra over those six syllables. From that he measured out six more. They became twelve. He uttered hiṅkāra over them again. From that he measured out six more. They became eighteen. He uttered hiṅkāra over them again. From that he measured out six more. They became twenty-four. That became the twenty-four-fold tenth day, with anuṣṭubh as its metre. Therefore a sāman with triple hiṅkāra [is used]. They say: 'The stomas go beyond the trivṛt, but the metres do not go beyond the gāyatrī.' One should say: 'The stomas do not go beyond the trivṛt, nor do the metres go beyond the gāyatrī.' For the stomas have three beginnings, three middles, and three endings. And all metres do not go beyond the gāyatrī. This dvādaśāha is the fullness of both the trivṛt stoma and the gāyatrī metre. The gāyatrī is verily brahman. The trivṛt is kṣatra. That which is the vajra (thunderbolt) — by that is kṣatra. This dvādaśāha is both brahman and kṣatra. But they also say: 'The trivṛt is brahman, the gāyatrī is brahman; this dvādaśāha is brahman. This entire dvādaśāha is to be known as brahman alone.' Of this there are these two verses: 'Four go forth yoked in the beginning; they become six in the highest space. Becoming two by two, they fly on wings; having gone, they are established in this very one. Two stomas clothe the gāyatrī; two clothe the triṣṭubh; two clothe the jagatī.'
meaning: तानीमानि षडक्षराण्य् अभिहिंङकरोत् / ततष् षण् णिरमिमीत / तानि द्वाचशाभवन् / तानि पुनर् एवाभिहिंङकरोत् / ततष् षण् णिरमिमीत / तान्य् अष्टादशाभवन् / तानि पुनर् एवाभिहिंङकरोत् / ततष् षण् णिरमिमीत / तानि चतुर्विंशतिर् अभवन् / तद् एव चतुर्विंशं दशमम् अहर् अभवद् अनुष्टुप् छन्दसाम् / तस्माद् उ त्रिहिंकृतं साम / तद् आहुर् अति त्रिवृतं स्तोमा यन्ति , न गायत्रीं छन्दांसीति / नाहैव त्रिवृतं स्तोमा अतियन्तीति ब्रूयान् नो गायत्रीं छन्दांसीति / त्रिप्रायणा हि स्तोमास् त्रिमध्यास् त्र्युदयाः / एतद् उ गायत्रीं सर्वाणि छन्दांसि नातियन्ति / तद् एतद् त्रिवृतश् चैव स्तोमस्य पुष्टं गायत्र्यै छन्दसो यद् एष द्वादशाःअः / तद् ब्रह्म वै गायत्री / क्षत्रं त्रिवृत् / यत् स वज्रस् तेन क्षत्रम् / तद् एतत् ब्रह्म च क्षत्रं चैष द्वादशाहः / तद् उ वा आहुर् ब्रह्म वै त्रिवृद् , ब्रह्म गायत्री , ब्रह्मैष द्वादशाहो , ब्रह्मैवैष सर्वो द्वादशाह इत्य् एव वेदितव्यम् / तस्यैतौ श्लोकौ -- "चत्वारो ऽग्रे प्र वहन्ति युक्तास् ते षड् भवन्ति परमे व्योमन् / ते द्वौ द्वौ भूत्वा प्र पतन्ति पक्षैस् ते ऽस्मिन् कस्मिन् प्रतितिष्ठन्ति गत्वा // द्वौ स्तोमौ गायत्रीं वसाते द्वौ त्रिष्टुभं जगतीं द्वौ वसाते /

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatir vāvedam agra āsīt / so 'kāmayata bahu syāṃ prajāyeya bhūmānaṃ gaccheyam iti / sa tapo 'tapyata / sa etaṃ vyūḍhachandasaṃ dvādaśāhaṃ yajñam apaśyat / tam āharat / tenāyajata / taṃ vyauhat / yad vyauhad aṅgāny eva tad vyauhat / tasya yāni śarīrāṇy āsaṃs tā evemā martyaḥ prajā abhavan / athātmā manomayas samabhavat / tasya manaś śarīraṃ prāṇā abhi samaviśan / sa vyūḍha ivāsīt / sa devān abravīt śarīraṃ ma icchateti / kathaṃ ta icchāma iti / samūḍhachandasā dvādaśāhena yājayateti / tatheti / taṃ samūḍhachandasā dvādaśāhanāyājayan /
sentences: so 'kāmayata bahu syāṃ prajāyeya bʰūmānaṃ gaccʰeyam iti /
sa etaṃ vyūḍʰacʰandasaṃ dvādaśāhaṃ yajñam apaśyat /
yad vyauhad aṅgāny eva tad vyauhat /
tasya yāni śarīrāṇy āsaṃs tā evemā martyaḥ prajā abʰavan /
tasya manaś śarīraṃ prāṇā abʰi samaviśan /
sa devān abravīt śarīraṃ ma iccʰateti /
text: Prajāpati verily was this [universe] in the beginning. He desired: 'May I become many, may I be born forth, may I attain abundance.' He performed tapas. He saw this dvādaśāha sacrifice with extended metres. He brought it forth. He sacrificed with it. He extended it. When he extended it, he extended his own limbs. Those bodies that were his — they became these mortal creatures. But his self became mind-made. Mind was his body; the vital breaths entered into him. He was as if disjointed. He said to the gods: 'Seek a body for me.' 'How shall we seek it for you?' 'Cause me to sacrifice with the dvādaśāha of combined metres.' 'So be it.' They caused him to sacrifice with the dvādaśāha of combined metres.
meaning: प्रजापतिर् वावेदम् अग्र आसीत् / सो ऽकामयत बहु स्यां प्रजायेय भूमानं गच्छेयम् इति / स तपो ऽतप्यत / स एतं व्यूढछन्दसं द्वादशाहं यज्ञम् अपश्यत् / तम् आहरत् / तेनायजत / तं व्यौहत् / यद् व्यौहद् अङ्गान्य् एव तद् व्यौहत् / तस्य यानि शरीराण्य् आसंस् ता एवेमा मर्त्यः प्रजा अभवन् / अथात्मा मनोमयस् समभवत् / तस्य मनश् शरीरं प्राणा अभि समविशन् / स व्यूढ इवासीत् / स देवान् अब्रवीत् शरीरं म इच्छतेति / कथं त इच्छाम इति / समूढछन्दसा द्वादशाहेन याजयतेति / तथेति / तं समूढछन्दसा द्वादशाहनायाजयन् /

sanskrit_iast: sa manomayaḥ prāṇamayaś cakṣurmaya śrotramayo vāṅmaya ṛṅmayo yajurmayas sāmamayo brahmamayo hiraṇmayo 'mṛtaḥ prajāpatis samabhavat / eṣaiva vidyut / sa eṣa eva trayo vedaḥ / yordhvā vidyut tāni sāmāni , yā tiraścī tā ṛco , yad abhīkṣṇaṃ manmalāyati tad yajuḥ / sa ya etad evaṃ vedaiṣaiva devatā bhavati / eṣā ha vai devatā saṃstuto yajño bhavati / tad yat pṛccheyuḥ kā devatā saṃstuto yajño bhavatīti , vidyud iti ha brūyāt / eṣā ha vai devatā saṃstuto yajño bhavati / tasmād yadi vyūḍhachandasā dvādaśāhena yajeta / yajeto eva samūḍhachandasā /
sentences: sa manomayaḥ prāṇamayaś cakṣurmaya śrotramayo vāṅmaya r̥ṅmayo yajurmayas sāmamayo brahmamayo hiraṇmayo 'mr̥taḥ prajāpatis samabʰavat /
yordʰvā vidyut tāni sāmāni , yā tiraścī tā r̥co , yad abʰīkṣṇaṃ manmalāyati tad yajuḥ /
sa ya etad evaṃ vedaiṣaiva devatā bʰavati /
eṣā ha vai devatā saṃstuto yajño bʰavati /
tad yat pr̥ccʰeyuḥ kā devatā saṃstuto yajño bʰavatīti , vidyud iti ha brūyāt /
eṣā ha vai devatā saṃstuto yajño bʰavati /
text: Prajāpati became mind-made, prāṇa-made, sight-made, hearing-made, speech-made, ṛc-made, yajus-made, sāman-made, brahman-made, golden, immortal. That is this very lightning. And that is the threefold Veda. The upward [flashes of] lightning are the sāmans; the horizontal ones are the ṛcs; the frequent flickering is the yajus. He who knows this thus becomes this very deity. This deity, when praised, becomes the sacrifice. If they should ask: 'What deity becomes the sacrifice when praised?' — one should say: 'Lightning.' This deity indeed becomes the sacrifice when praised. Therefore, if one should sacrifice with the dvādaśāha of extended metres, one should indeed sacrifice with the dvādaśāha of combined metres.
meaning: स मनोमयः प्राणमयश् चक्षुर्मय श्रोत्रमयो वाङ्मय ऋङ्मयो यजुर्मयस् साममयो ब्रह्ममयो हिरण्मयो ऽमृतः प्रजापतिस् समभवत् / एषैव विद्युत् / स एष एव त्रयो वेदः / योर्ध्वा विद्युत् तानि सामानि , या तिरश्ची ता ऋचो , यद् अभीक्ष्णं मन्मलायति तद् यजुः / स य एतद् एवं वेदैषैव देवता भवति / एषा ह वै देवता संस्तुतो यज्ञो भवति / तद् यत् पृच्छेयुः का देवता संस्तुतो यज्ञो भवतीति , विद्युद् इति ह ब्रूयात् / एषा ह वै देवता संस्तुतो यज्ञो भवति / तस्माद् यदि व्यूढछन्दसा द्वादशाहेन यजेत / यजेतो एव समूढछन्दसा /

sanskrit_iast: ekā ha vāva devatā svayaṃbhūḥ prajāpatir eva / so 'kāmayata bahu syāṃ prajāyeyeti / so 'smin loke trivṛtā stomena devān asṛjata vasūn / tam abhi samapatan / svādu svādur iti tam ādan / tam adhayan yathā vatso jāto mātaraṃ dhayed evam / sa aikṣata yadi vā iha bhaviṣyāmi kṣeṣyanti mā , hantordhva utkrāmāṇīti / sa u vā aikṣata hanto nu saṃsṛjeya yaṃ māṃ manyamānā yaṃ paśyantīr imā ihoparamerann iti /
sentences: ekā ha vāva devatā svayaṃbʰūḥ prajāpatir eva /
so 'smin loke trivr̥tā stomena devān asr̥jata vasūn /
tam adʰayan yatʰā vatso jāto mātaraṃ dʰayed evam /
sa aikṣata yadi vā iha bʰaviṣyāmi kṣeṣyanti mā , hantordʰva utkrāmāṇīti /
sa u vā aikṣata hanto nu saṃsr̥jeya yaṃ māṃ manyamānā yaṃ paśyantīr imā ihoparamerann iti /
text: There was verily one self-existent deity — Prajāpati alone. He desired: 'May I become many, may I be born forth.' In this world, with the trivṛt stoma, he created the gods, the Vasus. They rushed upon him. 'Sweet, sweet!' — they ate him. They suckled him, as a new-born calf suckles its mother. He thought: 'If I remain here, they will consume me. Come, let me ascend upward.' He also thought: 'Come, let me create a substitute, so that thinking it is me, seeing it, they will remain here content.'
meaning: एका ह वाव देवता स्वयंभूः प्रजापतिर् एव / सो ऽकामयत बहु स्यां प्रजायेयेति / सो ऽस्मिन् लोके त्रिवृता स्तोमेन देवान् असृजत वसून् / तम् अभि समपतन् / स्वादु स्वादुर् इति तम् आदन् / तम् अधयन् यथा वत्सो जातो मातरं धयेद् एवम् / स ऐक्षत यदि वा इह भविष्यामि क्षेष्यन्ति मा , हन्तोर्ध्व उत्क्रामाणीति / स उ वा ऐक्षत हन्तो नु संसृजेय यं मां मन्यमाना यं पश्यन्तीर् इमा इहोपरमेरन्न् इति /

sanskrit_iast: tam asmin loke pratinidhāya pañcadaśenordhva udakrāmat / so 'gacchad yatraiṣa vāyuḥ / tat tad v asṛjato eva rudrān / anv ime samagacchann abhy abhī samapatan / tam attum evādhriyanta / sa aikṣata hantordhva evotkrāmāṇīti / sa vāyum evaitasmin loke pratinidhāya saptadaśenordhva udakrāmat / so 'gacchad yatraiṣa candramāḥ / tat tad v asṛjato evādityān / anv ime samagacchann abhy amī samapatan / tam attum evādhriyanta /
sentences: tam asmin loke pratinidʰāya pañcadaśenordʰva udakrāmat /
tat tad v asr̥jato eva rudrān /
anv ime samagaccʰann abʰy abʰī samapatan /
sa vāyum evaitasmin loke pratinidʰāya saptadaśenordʰva udakrāmat /
anv ime samagaccʰann abʰy amī samapatan /
text: Having established that [substitute] in this world, he ascended upward with the pañcadaśa [stoma]. He reached the place where this wind (Vāyu) is. There he also created the Rudras. These approached him; they rushed upon him. They were intent on devouring him. He thought: 'Come, let me ascend upward.' Having established Vāyu in this world, he ascended upward with the saptadaśa [stoma]. He reached the place where this moon is. There he also created the Ādityas. These approached him; those rushed upon him. They were intent on devouring him.
meaning: तम् अस्मिन् लोके प्रतिनिधाय पञ्चदशेनोर्ध्व उदक्रामत् / सो ऽगच्छद् यत्रैष वायुः / तत् तद् व् असृजतो एव रुद्रान् / अन्व् इमे समगच्छन्न् अभ्य् अभी समपतन् / तम् अत्तुम् एवाध्रियन्त / स ऐक्षत हन्तोर्ध्व एवोत्क्रामाणीति / स वायुम् एवैतस्मिन् लोके प्रतिनिधाय सप्तदशेनोर्ध्व उदक्रामत् / सो ऽगच्छद् यत्रैष चन्द्रमाः / तत् तद् व् असृजतो एवादित्यान् / अन्व् इमे समगच्छन्न् अभ्य् अमी समपतन् / तम् अत्तुम् एवाध्रियन्त /

sanskrit_iast: sa candramasam evaitasmin loke pratinidhāya ekaviṃśenordhva udakrāmat / so 'gacchad yatraiṣa ādityaḥ / tat tad v asṛjato eva viśvān devān / tad antam asṛjatānv ime samagacchann abhy amī samapatan / tam attum evādhriyanta / sa aikṣata hantordhva evotkrāmāṇīti / sa ādityam evaitasmin loke pratinidhāya triṇavenordhva udakrāmat / so 'gacchad yatraiṣa varuṇaḥ / tet tan nāsṛjata / tam anv evāgacchan / tam attum evādhriyanta /
sentences: sa candramasam evaitasmin loke pratinidʰāya ekaviṃśenordʰva udakrāmat /
tat tad v asr̥jato eva viśvān devān /
tad antam asr̥jatānv ime samagaccʰann abʰy amī samapatan /
sa ādityam evaitasmin loke pratinidʰāya triṇavenordʰva udakrāmat /
text: Having established the moon in this world, he ascended upward with the ekaviṃśa [stoma]. He reached the place where this sun (Āditya) is. There he also created the Viśve Devāḥ. He created that as the limit. These approached him; those rushed upon him. They were intent on devouring him. He thought: 'Come, let me ascend upward.' Having established the sun in this world, he ascended upward with the triṇava [stoma]. He reached the place where Varuṇa is. There he did not create [anything]. They followed him still. They were intent on devouring him.
meaning: स चन्द्रमसम् एवैतस्मिन् लोके प्रतिनिधाय एकविंशेनोर्ध्व उदक्रामत् / सो ऽगच्छद् यत्रैष आदित्यः / तत् तद् व् असृजतो एव विश्वान् देवान् / तद् अन्तम् असृजतान्व् इमे समगच्छन्न् अभ्य् अमी समपतन् / तम् अत्तुम् एवाध्रियन्त / स ऐक्षत हन्तोर्ध्व एवोत्क्रामाणीति / स आदित्यम् एवैतस्मिन् लोके प्रतिनिधाय त्रिणवेनोर्ध्व उदक्रामत् / सो ऽगच्छद् यत्रैष वरुणः / तेत् तन् नासृजत / तम् अन्व् एवागच्छन् / तम् अत्तुम् एवाध्रियन्त /

sanskrit_iast: sa varuṇam evaitasmin loke pratinidhāya trayastriṃśenordhva udakrāmat / so 'gacchad yatraiṣa mṛtyuḥ / tat tan mṛtyur abhavat / tad aṅgāni mukham akuruta / taṃ mṛtyuṃ sarvatomukhaṃ bhūtam anvāgatyopekṣamāṇā evāsata , anabhidhṛṣṇuvatīḥ / nainaṃ tatrādan / sa aikṣata pāpmā vā asmi yo mṛtyur 'smi / hantordhva evotkrāmāṇīti / sa mṛtyum evaitasmin loke pratinidhāya caturviṃśanordhva udakrāmat / so 'gacchad yatraiṣa rocano nāma lokaḥ / tat tad aśanayābhavat / tam aśanāyāṃ bhūtaṃ bibhyatīr nānvāyan / anvīkṣamāṇā evātiṣṭhann asau rocate 'sau rocateti / sāsya rocanatā / sa aikṣata pāpmā vā asmi yo 'śanayā asmi / hantordhva evotkrāmāṇīti / sa mṛtyum evaitasmin loke pratinidhāya caturviśanordhva udakrāmat / so 'gacchad yatraiṣa rocano nāma lokaḥ / tat tad aśanayābhavat / tam aśanāyāṃ bhūtaṃ bibhyatīr nānvāyan / anvīkṣamāṇā evātiṣṭhann asau rocate 'sau rocateti / sāsya rocanatā / sa aikṣata pāpmā vā asmi yo 'śanayā asmi / hantordhva evotkrāmāṇīti / so 'horātre pratinyadadhāt / te eva pipāsā cāśanāyā cābhavatām / ahar ha pipāsā , rātrir aśanāyā / tad yathā dvāraphalake pratinihite syātām evam evaite 'horātre pratinihite anatyayanāya /
sentences: sa varuṇam evaitasmin loke pratinidʰāya trayastriṃśenordʰva udakrāmat /
taṃ mr̥tyuṃ sarvatomukʰaṃ bʰūtam anvāgatyopekṣamāṇā evāsata , anabʰidʰr̥ṣṇuvatīḥ /
sa aikṣata pāpmā vā asmi yo mr̥tyur 'smi /
sa mr̥tyum evaitasmin loke pratinidʰāya caturviṃśanordʰva udakrāmat /
sa aikṣata pāpmā vā asmi yo 'śanayā asmi /
sa mr̥tyum evaitasmin loke pratinidʰāya caturviśanordʰva udakrāmat /
sa aikṣata pāpmā vā asmi yo 'śanayā asmi /
tad yatʰā dvārapʰalake pratinihite syātām evam evaite 'horātre pratinihite anatyayanāya /
text: Having established Varuṇa in this world, he ascended upward with the trayastriṃśa [stoma]. He reached the place where Mṛtyu (Death) is. There he became Death. He made his limbs into a face. Having come upon Death who had become all-faced, they just sat watching, unable to overpower him. They did not eat him there. He thought: 'I am verily pāpman (evil), since I am Death. Come, let me ascend upward.' Having established Death in this world, he ascended upward with the caturviṃśa [stoma]. He reached the world called Rocana (the Shining). There he became hunger (aśanāyā). Those [creatures], fearing him who had become hunger, did not follow him. They just stood watching: 'That one shines, that one shines.' That is his luminosity. He thought: 'I am verily evil, since I am hunger. Come, let me ascend upward.' He established day and night. These two became thirst and hunger — day is thirst, night is hunger. Just as two door-panels would be set up, even so these day and night were set up, so that none may pass beyond.
meaning: स वरुणम् एवैतस्मिन् लोके प्रतिनिधाय त्रयस्त्रिंशेनोर्ध्व उदक्रामत् / सो ऽगच्छद् यत्रैष मृत्युः / तत् तन् मृत्युर् अभवत् / तद् अङ्गानि मुखम् अकुरुत / तं मृत्युं सर्वतोमुखं भूतम् अन्वागत्योपेक्षमाणा एवासत , अनभिधृष्णुवतीः / नैनं तत्रादन् / स ऐक्षत पाप्मा वा अस्मि यो मृत्युर् ऽस्मि / हन्तोर्ध्व एवोत्क्रामाणीति / स मृत्युम् एवैतस्मिन् लोके प्रतिनिधाय चतुर्विंशनोर्ध्व उदक्रामत् / सो ऽगच्छद् यत्रैष रोचनो नाम लोकः / तत् तद् अशनयाभवत् / तम् अशनायां भूतं बिभ्यतीर् नान्वायन् / अन्वीक्षमाणा एवातिष्ठन्न् असौ रोचते ऽसौ रोचतेति / सास्य रोचनता / स ऐक्षत पाप्मा वा अस्मि यो ऽशनया अस्मि / हन्तोर्ध्व एवोत्क्रामाणीति / स मृत्युम् एवैतस्मिन् लोके प्रतिनिधाय चतुर्विशनोर्ध्व उदक्रामत् / सो ऽगच्छद् यत्रैष रोचनो नाम लोकः / तत् तद् अशनयाभवत् / तम् अशनायां भूतं बिभ्यतीर् नान्वायन् / अन्वीक्षमाणा एवातिष्ठन्न् असौ रोचते ऽसौ रोचतेति / सास्य रोचनता / स ऐक्षत पाप्मा वा अस्मि यो ऽशनया अस्मि / हन्तोर्ध्व एवोत्क्रामाणीति / सो ऽहोरात्रे प्रतिन्यदधात् / ते एव पिपासा चाशनाया चाभवताम् / अहर् ह पिपासा , रात्रिर् अशनाया / तद् यथा द्वारफलके प्रतिनिहिते स्याताम् एवम् एवैते ऽहोरात्रे प्रतिनिहिते अनत्ययनाय /

sanskrit_iast: so 'horātre evaitasmin loke pratinidhāya catuścatvāriṃśenordhva udakrāmat / so 'gacchad yatraiṣa kāmo nāma lokaḥ / tat tacchandannādyā antareṇa nadīr asṛjataitasya pāpmano 'nanvāgamāya / tā u eva kāmadughā akuruta / sa aikṣata hantordhva evotkrāmāṇīti / so 'ṣṭācatvāriṃśenordhva udakrāmat / so 'gacchad yatraiṣa suvar nāma lokaḥ / tat tasmin jyog aramata bahv asya svaṃ bhavatīti / sāsya suvatā / sa aikṣata hantebhyo lokebhya ekaṃ lokaṃ saṃbharāṇīti / sa ebhyo lokebhya ekaṃ lokaṃ samabharat / tad evaitad dvādaśāhasya daśamam ahar abhavat / so 'bravīn na vai ma idam akam abhūd iti / yad abravīn na vai ma idam akam abhūd iti tan nākasya nākatvam /
sentences: so 'horātre evaitasmin loke pratinidʰāya catuścatvāriṃśenordʰva udakrāmat /
tat taccʰandannādyā antareṇa nadīr asr̥jataitasya pāpmano 'nanvāgamāya /
tat tasmin jyog aramata bahv asya svaṃ bʰavatīti /
sa aikṣata hantebʰyo lokebʰya ekaṃ lokaṃ saṃbʰarāṇīti /
sa ebʰyo lokebʰya ekaṃ lokaṃ samabʰarat /
tad evaitad dvādaśāhasya daśamam ahar abʰavat /
so 'bravīn na vai ma idam akam abʰūd iti /
yad abravīn na vai ma idam akam abʰūd iti tan nākasya nākatvam /
text: Having established day and night in this world, he ascended upward with the catuścatvāriṃśa (forty-four-fold) [stoma]. He reached the world called Kāma (Desire). There, to prevent this evil from following, he created rivers of food between himself and it, with coverings of delight. And he made them wish-fulfilling. He thought: 'Come, let me ascend upward.' He ascended with the aṣṭācatvāriṃśa (forty-eight-fold) [stoma]. He reached the world called Suvar (Light). There he rested for a long time: 'Much that is my own exists here.' That is its suvar-nature. He thought: 'Come, let me gather from these worlds into one world.' He gathered from these worlds into one world. That became the tenth day of the dvādaśāha. He said: 'This was not for nothing.' Because he said 'this was not for nothing (na akam),' that is the nāka-nature of nāka (heaven).
meaning: सो ऽहोरात्रे एवैतस्मिन् लोके प्रतिनिधाय चतुश्चत्वारिंशेनोर्ध्व उदक्रामत् / सो ऽगच्छद् यत्रैष कामो नाम लोकः / तत् तच्छन्दन्नाद्या अन्तरेण नदीर् असृजतैतस्य पाप्मनो ऽनन्वागमाय / ता उ एव कामदुघा अकुरुत / स ऐक्षत हन्तोर्ध्व एवोत्क्रामाणीति / सो ऽष्टाचत्वारिंशेनोर्ध्व उदक्रामत् / सो ऽगच्छद् यत्रैष सुवर् नाम लोकः / तत् तस्मिन् ज्योग् अरमत बह्व् अस्य स्वं भवतीति / सास्य सुवता / स ऐक्षत हन्तेभ्यो लोकेभ्य एकं लोकं संभराणीति / स एभ्यो लोकेभ्य एकं लोकं समभरत् / तद् एवैतद् द्वादशाहस्य दशमम् अहर् अभवत् / सो ऽब्रवीन् न वै म इदम् अकम् अभूद् इति / यद् अब्रवीन् न वै म इदम् अकम् अभूद् इति तन् नाकस्य नाकत्वम् /

sanskrit_iast: tad yathā vṛkṣaṃ vā giriṃ vādhiruhya vyavekṣetaivam evaitasmāl lokād anyān lokān vyavekṣate / sa imāḥ prajā aśanāyantīḥ pratyavaikṣata / tā dvābhyāṃ rūpābhyāṃ pratyādravan nīlena ca suvarṇena ca / tad yat parjanyasya varṣiṣyataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ tan nīlam / atha yad apsv antar vidyotate tat suvarṇam / tābhyo 'varṣat / tata odano 'jāyata / tam aśitvodānan / sa udano 'bhavat / tad udanasyodanatvam / udano ha vai nāmaiṣa / tam odana iti parokṣam ācakṣate / dvitīyaṃ jyāyo 'nnādyam ajāyata / tad abhisaṃpadya vyamathnata / sa mantho 'bhavat / tan manthasya manthatvam / tad etad dvayam evānnādyasya rūpaṃ yac caivāśnāti yac ca pibati / yad aśnāty odanasya tad rūpaṃ , yat pibati manthasya tat / ubhayaṃ hāsyaitad gṛhe 'dhigamyate ya evaṃ veda / tau haitau prajāpater eva stanau yad vrīhiś ca yavaś ca /
sentences: tad yatʰā vr̥kṣaṃ vā giriṃ vādʰiruhya vyavekṣetaivam evaitasmāl lokād anyān lokān vyavekṣate /
tā dvābʰyāṃ rūpābʰyāṃ pratyādravan nīlena ca suvarṇena ca /
tad yat parjanyasya varṣiṣyataḥ kr̥ṣṇaṃ tan nīlam /
atʰa yad apsv antar vidyotate tat suvarṇam /
tad etad dvayam evānnādyasya rūpaṃ yac caivāśnāti yac ca pibati /
yad aśnāty odanasya tad rūpaṃ , yat pibati mantʰasya tat /
ubʰayaṃ hāsyaitad gr̥he 'dʰigamyate ya evaṃ veda /
tau haitau prajāpater eva stanau yad vrīhiś ca yavaś ca /
text: Just as one might climb a tree or a mountain and look around, even so from that world he surveys the other worlds. He looked upon these creatures suffering from hunger. They ran towards him in two forms — dark blue and golden. The dark [form] is the black of the rain-cloud about to rain. The golden is that which flashes within the waters. He rained upon them. From that, cooked rice (odana) was born. Having eaten the cooked rice, it became udana. That is the udana-nature of udana. Its name is verily udana; they call it odana indirectly. A second, greater food was born. Having come together, he churned it. That became the mantha (stirred drink). That is the mantha-nature of mantha. These are the two forms of food — what one eats and what one drinks. What one eats is the form of odana; what one drinks is that of mantha. Both of these are found in one's house for one who knows thus. These two — rice and barley — are verily the two breasts of Prajāpati.
meaning: तद् यथा वृक्षं वा गिरिं वाधिरुह्य व्यवेक्षेतैवम् एवैतस्माल् लोकाद् अन्यान् लोकान् व्यवेक्षते / स इमाः प्रजा अशनायन्तीः प्रत्यवैक्षत / ता द्वाभ्यां रूपाभ्यां प्रत्याद्रवन् नीलेन च सुवर्णेन च / तद् यत् पर्जन्यस्य वर्षिष्यतः कृष्णं तन् नीलम् / अथ यद् अप्स्व् अन्तर् विद्योतते तत् सुवर्णम् / ताभ्यो ऽवर्षत् / तत ओदनो ऽजायत / तम् अशित्वोदानन् / स उदनो ऽभवत् / तद् उदनस्योदनत्वम् / उदनो ह वै नामैष / तम् ओदन इति परोक्षम् आचक्षते / द्वितीयं ज्यायो ऽन्नाद्यम् अजायत / तद् अभिसंपद्य व्यमथ्नत / स मन्थो ऽभवत् / तन् मन्थस्य मन्थत्वम् / तद् एतद् द्वयम् एवान्नाद्यस्य रूपं यच् चैवाश्नाति यच् च पिबति / यद् अश्नात्य् ओदनस्य तद् रूपं , यत् पिबति मन्थस्य तत् / उभयं हास्यैतद् गृहे ऽधिगम्यते य एवं वेद / तौ हैतौ प्रजापतेर् एव स्तनौ यद् व्रीहिश् च यवश् च /

sanskrit_iast: sa upodako nāma loko yasminn ayam agniḥ / athartadhāmā yasmin vāyuḥ / atha śivo yasmiṃś candramāḥ / athāparājito yasminn ādityaḥ / athādhidyur yasmin varuṇaḥ / atha pradyur yasmin mṛtyuḥ / atha rocano yasminn aśanāyā / ato ha parācīnam ahorātre nānvitas sakṛd viṣṭā haivātaḥ parācīnaṃ yathā vidyutovarūpaṃ syād dārvācitānāṃ vā samiddhānām evam / atha haite prajāpatilokā evāta ūrdhvāḥ / kāmo 'ṣṭamas , suvar navamo , nāka eva daśamam ahaḥ / idam evaṃ prāyaṇam ada udayanam / te haite lokā evaitāni dvādaśāhasyāhāni /
sentences: sa upodako nāma loko yasminn ayam agniḥ /
ato ha parācīnam ahorātre nānvitas sakr̥d viṣṭā haivātaḥ parācīnaṃ yatʰā vidyutovarūpaṃ syād dārvācitānāṃ vā samiddʰānām evam /
kāmo 'ṣṭamas , suvar navamo , nāka eva daśamam ahaḥ /
text: Upodaka ('near the waters') is the name of the world in which this fire (Agni) dwells. Ṛtadhāman ('abode of cosmic order') is that in which Vāyu dwells. Śiva ('the auspicious') is that in which the moon dwells. Aparājita ('the unconquered') is that in which the sun (Āditya) dwells. Adhidyu ('above the sky') is that in which Varuṇa dwells. Pradyu ('the forth-shining') is that in which Mṛtyu dwells. Rocana ('the luminous') is that in which hunger dwells. Beyond this, day and night do not follow; they are established only once from here downward — like the appearance of lightning, or like stacked or kindled logs. But from here upward, these are the worlds of Prajāpati. Kāma is the eighth, Suvar the ninth, and Nāka is the tenth day. This [world] is the prāyaṇīya (opening); that [world] is the udayanīya (closing). These worlds are indeed the days of the dvādaśāha.
meaning: स उपोदको नाम लोको यस्मिन्न् अयम् अग्निः / अथर्तधामा यस्मिन् वायुः / अथ शिवो यस्मिंश् चन्द्रमाः / अथापराजितो यस्मिन्न् आदित्यः / अथाधिद्युर् यस्मिन् वरुणः / अथ प्रद्युर् यस्मिन् मृत्युः / अथ रोचनो यस्मिन्न् अशनाया / अतो ह पराचीनम् अहोरात्रे नान्वितस् सकृद् विष्टा हैवातः पराचीनं यथा विद्युतोवरूपं स्याद् दार्वाचितानां वा समिद्धानाम् एवम् / अथ हैते प्रजापतिलोका एवात ऊर्ध्वाः / कामो ऽष्टमस् , सुवर् नवमो , नाक एव दशमम् अहः / इदम् एवं प्रायणम् अद उदयनम् / ते हैते लोका एवैतानि द्वादशाहस्याहानि /

sanskrit_iast: upodako nāma loko 'nne viṣṭo , manuṣyā goptāro , agnir adhipatir , yad arciṣo rūpaṃ tad rūpam , apsu pratiṣṭhitaḥ / ṛtadhāmā nāma loko vayobhir viṣṭo , gandharvāpsaraso goptāro , vāyur adhipati , śvetaṃ rūpaṃ , prāṇe pratiṣṭhitaḥ / aparājito nāma loko nakṣatrair viṣṭaś , candramā goptā , ādityo 'dhipatir , yad udyataś ca sūryasya rūpam astaṃ ca yatas tad rūpaṃ , manasi pratiṣṭhitaḥ / adhidyur nāma loko yajñe viṣṭa , ādityā goptāro , varuṇo 'dhipatir , nīlaṃ rūpaṃ yat parjanyasya varṣiṣyataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ tan nīlaṃ , yad vā kārtasvarasya maṇer , anṛte pratiṣṭhitaḥ / pradyur nāma loko 'mṛte viṣṭo , rudrā goptāro , mṛtyur adhipatir , lohitaṃ rūpaṃ yad gauravacchadāyai yad vā māhārohaṇasya vāsasa , ṛte pratiṣṭhito yan nārcchati tasmin / rocano nāma lokas tapasi viṣṭo , vasavo goptāras -- te hi prathame devānām iyus tasmāt te parārdhyā --, yajño 'dhipatir , yat suvarṇasya hiraṇyasya rūpaṃ tad rūpaṃ , satye pratiṣṭhitaḥ / ete vai lokā , ete goptāra , ete 'dhipatayaḥ /
sentences: upodako nāma loko 'nne viṣṭo , manuṣyā goptāro , agnir adʰipatir , yad arciṣo rūpaṃ tad rūpam , apsu pratiṣṭʰitaḥ /
r̥tadʰāmā nāma loko vayobʰir viṣṭo , gandʰarvāpsaraso goptāro , vāyur adʰipati , śvetaṃ rūpaṃ , prāṇe pratiṣṭʰitaḥ /
aparājito nāma loko nakṣatrair viṣṭaś , candramā goptā , ādityo 'dʰipatir , yad udyataś ca sūryasya rūpam astaṃ ca yatas tad rūpaṃ , manasi pratiṣṭʰitaḥ /
adʰidyur nāma loko yajñe viṣṭa , ādityā goptāro , varuṇo 'dʰipatir , nīlaṃ rūpaṃ yat parjanyasya varṣiṣyataḥ kr̥ṣṇaṃ tan nīlaṃ , yad vā kārtasvarasya maṇer , anr̥te pratiṣṭʰitaḥ /
pradyur nāma loko 'mr̥te viṣṭo , rudrā goptāro , mr̥tyur adʰipatir , lohitaṃ rūpaṃ yad gauravaccʰadāyai yad vā māhārohaṇasya vāsasa , r̥te pratiṣṭʰito yan nārccʰati tasmin /
rocano nāma lokas tapasi viṣṭo , vasavo goptāras -- te hi pratʰame devānām iyus tasmāt te parārdʰyā --, yajño 'dʰipatir , yat suvarṇasya hiraṇyasya rūpaṃ tad rūpaṃ , satye pratiṣṭʰitaḥ /
ete vai lokā , ete goptāra , ete 'dʰipatayaḥ /
text: Upodaka is the name of the world established in food; humans are its guardians; Agni is its overlord; the form of flames is its form; it is established in the waters. Ṛtadhāman is the name of the world established among birds; the Gandharvas and Apsarases are its guardians; Vāyu is its overlord; white is its form; it is established in prāṇa. Aparājita is the name of the world established among the stars; the moon is its guardian; Āditya is its overlord; the form of the rising and setting sun is its form; it is established in the mind. Adhidyu is the name of the world established in sacrifice; the Ādityas are its guardians; Varuṇa is its overlord; dark blue is its form — the dark of the rain-cloud about to rain, or of a kārtasvara gem; it is established in untruth. Pradyu is the name of the world established in immortality; the Rudras are its guardians; Mṛtyu is its overlord; red is its form — like the colour of the gaura-cow's hide, or of a great crimson garment; it is established in ṛta, which one does not reach. Rocana is the name of the world established in tapas; the Vasus are its guardians — for they went first among the gods, therefore they are supreme; Yajña is its overlord; the form of golden gold is its form; it is established in satya (truth). These are the worlds, these are the guardians, these are the overlords.
meaning: उपोदको नाम लोको ऽन्ने विष्टो , मनुष्या गोप्तारो , अग्निर् अधिपतिर् , यद् अर्चिषो रूपं तद् रूपम् , अप्सु प्रतिष्ठितः / ऋतधामा नाम लोको वयोभिर् विष्टो , गन्धर्वाप्सरसो गोप्तारो , वायुर् अधिपति , श्वेतं रूपं , प्राणे प्रतिष्ठितः / अपराजितो नाम लोको नक्षत्रैर् विष्टश् , चन्द्रमा गोप्ता , आदित्यो ऽधिपतिर् , यद् उद्यतश् च सूर्यस्य रूपम् अस्तं च यतस् तद् रूपं , मनसि प्रतिष्ठितः / अधिद्युर् नाम लोको यज्ञे विष्ट , आदित्या गोप्तारो , वरुणो ऽधिपतिर् , नीलं रूपं यत् पर्जन्यस्य वर्षिष्यतः कृष्णं तन् नीलं , यद् वा कार्तस्वरस्य मणेर् , अनृते प्रतिष्ठितः / प्रद्युर् नाम लोको ऽमृते विष्टो , रुद्रा गोप्तारो , मृत्युर् अधिपतिर् , लोहितं रूपं यद् गौरवच्छदायै यद् वा माहारोहणस्य वासस , ऋते प्रतिष्ठितो यन् नार्च्छति तस्मिन् / रोचनो नाम लोकस् तपसि विष्टो , वसवो गोप्तारस् -- ते हि प्रथमे देवानाम् इयुस् तस्मात् ते परार्ध्या --, यज्ञो ऽधिपतिर् , यत् सुवर्णस्य हिरण्यस्य रूपं तद् रूपं , सत्ये प्रतिष्ठितः / एते वै लोका , एते गोप्तार , एते ऽधिपतयः /

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatir devān asṛjata / saha śriyā vācā ca vā enāṃs tat sahāsṛjatānnena ca sahādbhiḥ / te devā annaṃ śriyaṃ vāvidānānā vācā yat sadhamādam ivaivāsann -- annaṃ hi śrīs -- so 'śocat / sa aikṣata kathaṃ nv aham eṣām imā śriyas saṃvṛñjīyeti / tān mano bhūtvānuprāviśat / teṣāṃ sarvāṃ śriyaṃ niracinod yathā badarāṇi niścinuyād evam / teṣāṃ manasā vācam agṛhṇāt / saiṣā manasā vāg gṛhītāpy adya / yad dhy eva manasā kāmayate tad vācā vadati / sa aikṣata kena nv eṣāṃ rūpeṇa vācam ādadīyeti / sa puruṣarūpam akuruta / teṣāṃ puruṣarūpeṇa vācam ādatta / tasmāt puruṣas sarvā vāco vadati / sa imā apas saṃgṛhyordhva udakrāmat / so 'gacchad yatraiṣa ṛṣabho nāmānnalokaḥ / tad annaṃ vā ṛṣabhaḥ / yadā vā aśnāty atharṣabhyati / sa aikṣata kiṃ nu tad rūpaṃ kurvīya yan me 'nyo nābhyārohed iti / so 'jaḥ pṛśnir abhavat / tasmād ajaṃ pṛśniṃ nādhigacchāma / tad yās tā apo 'harad yā etā upary āpa , etā eva tāḥ / atha yāṃ tāṃ vācam aharad , ya eṣa upari stanayitnur , eṣaiva sā vāg atha yo 'psv antar vidyotate /
sentences: saha śriyā vācā ca vā enāṃs tat sahāsr̥jatānnena ca sahādbʰiḥ /
te devā annaṃ śriyaṃ vāvidānānā vācā yat sadʰamādam ivaivāsann -- annaṃ hi śrīs -- so 'śocat /
sa aikṣata katʰaṃ nv aham eṣām imā śriyas saṃvr̥ñjīyeti /
teṣāṃ sarvāṃ śriyaṃ niracinod yatʰā badarāṇi niścinuyād evam /
yad dʰy eva manasā kāmayate tad vācā vadati /
sa aikṣata kena nv eṣāṃ rūpeṇa vācam ādadīyeti /
sa aikṣata kiṃ nu tad rūpaṃ kurvīya yan me 'nyo nābʰyārohed iti /
tad yās tā apo 'harad yā etā upary āpa , etā eva tāḥ /
atʰa yāṃ tāṃ vācam aharad , ya eṣa upari stanayitnur , eṣaiva sā vāg atʰa yo 'psv antar vidyotate /
text: Prajāpati created the gods. Together with śrī and speech he created them — together with food, together with the waters. The gods, not knowing food, śrī, and speech, were as if at a feast without [sustenance] — for food is śrī. He grieved. He thought: 'How shall I take away their splendours?' Becoming mind, he entered into them. He stripped away all their splendour, as one might pick off jujube berries. With mind he seized their speech. This speech is seized by mind even to this day, for whatever one desires with the mind, that one speaks with speech. He thought: 'In what form shall I take away their speech?' He made a human form. In human form he took away their speech. Therefore a human speaks all speeches. Having gathered up these waters, he ascended upward. He reached the world called Ṛṣabha ('the bull'), which is the world of food. Food is verily the bull; when one eats, one becomes bull-like. He thought: 'What form shall I take so that no other may assail me?' He became a speckled goat. Therefore we cannot find a speckled goat. Those waters that he carried off — they are these upper waters. And that speech he carried off — that is the thunder above. And that which flashes within the waters [is also that].
meaning: प्रजापतिर् देवान् असृजत / सह श्रिया वाचा च वा एनांस् तत् सहासृजतान्नेन च सहाद्भिः / ते देवा अन्नं श्रियं वाविदानाना वाचा यत् सधमादम् इवैवासन्न् -- अन्नं हि श्रीस् -- सो ऽशोचत् / स ऐक्षत कथं न्व् अहम् एषाम् इमा श्रियस् संवृञ्जीयेति / तान् मनो भूत्वानुप्राविशत् / तेषां सर्वां श्रियं निरचिनोद् यथा बदराणि निश्चिनुयाद् एवम् / तेषां मनसा वाचम् अगृह्णात् / सैषा मनसा वाग् गृहीताप्य् अद्य / यद् ध्य् एव मनसा कामयते तद् वाचा वदति / स ऐक्षत केन न्व् एषां रूपेण वाचम् आददीयेति / स पुरुषरूपम् अकुरुत / तेषां पुरुषरूपेण वाचम् आदत्त / तस्मात् पुरुषस् सर्वा वाचो वदति / स इमा अपस् संगृह्योर्ध्व उदक्रामत् / सो ऽगच्छद् यत्रैष ऋषभो नामान्नलोकः / तद् अन्नं वा ऋषभः / यदा वा अश्नात्य् अथर्षभ्यति / स ऐक्षत किं नु तद् रूपं कुर्वीय यन् मे ऽन्यो नाभ्यारोहेद् इति / सो ऽजः पृश्निर् अभवत् / तस्माद् अजं पृश्निं नाधिगच्छाम / तद् यास् ता अपो ऽहरद् या एता उपर्य् आप , एता एव ताः / अथ यां तां वाचम् अहरद् , य एष उपरि स्तनयित्नुर् , एषैव सा वाग् अथ यो ऽप्स्व् अन्तर् विद्योतते /

sanskrit_iast: -- andhe tamasi jalpantīḥ / so 'syai vāca ekam akṣaram avacchidya vāg iti vyasṛjata / tam patitvaiṣāṃ lokānāṃ madhye vyaramata / tad etan maṇḍalam abhavat / tad anvānait / sa prāṇo 'bhavat / tābhyo vyaucchat / aśanāyaṃs tv eva sa āsām apām ekaṃ stokaṃ prāścyotayat kiyat svid ābhyo 'laṃ bhaviṣyatīti / sa daśadhābhavac chatadhā sahasradhā yāvatīyaṃ pṛthivī tāvān abhavat / tad abhisaṃpadya vyamathnata / sa mantho 'bhavat / tan manthasya manthatvam / tam aśitvodānan / sa udano 'bhavat / tad udanasyodanatvam / tad etad dvayam evānnasya rūpaṃ yac caiva pibati yac cāśnāti / yat pibati manthasya tad rūpaṃ , yad aśnāty odanasya tat / ubhayaṃ hāsyaitad gṛhe 'dhigamyate yac caiva pibati yac cāśnāti ya evaṃ veda / tad āhus -- traya stokā āgacchantīty udastoko ghṛtastoko madhustokaḥ / tato ya udastoka imāṃ sa praviśaty , oṣadhīr ghṛtastoko , vanaspatīn madhustokaḥ / tad dhaitaṃ mīmāṃsāṃcakrur āmalaka akūpayeyo 'hīnā āśvatthiḥ keśī dārbhyaḥ -- kiṃ stokaṃ tvam āgacchantaṃ manyase , kiṃ stokaṃ tvaṃ , kiṃ stokaṃ tvam iti / sa hovāca keśī -- ghṛtastokam ahaṃ manya iti / atha hovācāhīnā -- madhustokam ahaṃ manya iti / atha hovācāmalaka -- udastokam ahaṃ manya iti / tasminn u haiva saṃpādayāṃcakruḥ / udakādhy evedaṃ sarvaṃ jāyate / tad yāṃ tāṃ vācaṃ vyasṛjata so 'gniḥ / atha yaṃ taṃ prāṇam anvānait sa indraḥ /
sentences: so 'syai vāca ekam akṣaram avaccʰidya vāg iti vyasr̥jata /
aśanāyaṃs tv eva sa āsām apām ekaṃ stokaṃ prāścyotayat kiyat svid ābʰyo 'laṃ bʰaviṣyatīti /
sa daśadʰābʰavac cʰatadʰā sahasradʰā yāvatīyaṃ pr̥tʰivī tāvān abʰavat /
tad etad dvayam evānnasya rūpaṃ yac caiva pibati yac cāśnāti /
yat pibati mantʰasya tad rūpaṃ , yad aśnāty odanasya tat /
ubʰayaṃ hāsyaitad gr̥he 'dʰigamyate yac caiva pibati yac cāśnāti ya evaṃ veda /
tad āhus -- traya stokā āgaccʰantīty udastoko gʰr̥tastoko madʰustokaḥ /
tato ya udastoka imāṃ sa praviśaty , oṣadʰīr gʰr̥tastoko , vanaspatīn madʰustokaḥ /
tad dʰaitaṃ mīmāṃsāṃcakrur āmalaka akūpayeyo 'hīnā āśvattʰiḥ keśī dārbʰyaḥ -- kiṃ stokaṃ tvam āgaccʰantaṃ manyase , kiṃ stokaṃ tvaṃ , kiṃ stokaṃ tvam iti /
sa hovāca keśī -- gʰr̥tastokam ahaṃ manya iti /
atʰa hovācāhīnā -- madʰustokam ahaṃ manya iti /
atʰa hovācāmalaka -- udastokam ahaṃ manya iti /
tad yāṃ tāṃ vācaṃ vyasr̥jata so 'gniḥ /
atʰa yaṃ taṃ prāṇam anvānait sa indraḥ /
text: [The creatures were] babbling in blind darkness. Having cut off one syllable from this speech, he released it as 'vāk' (speech). Having fallen, it stopped in the middle of these worlds. That became this [solar] disc. He followed it. He became prāṇa. Dawn broke for them. Though hungry, he let fall one drop from these waters, [wondering:] 'How much will be enough for them?' It became tenfold, hundredfold, thousandfold — as vast as this earth, so vast it became. Having come together, he churned it. That became the mantha (stirred drink). That is the mantha-nature of mantha. Having eaten the cooked rice, it became udana. That is the udana-nature of udana. These are the two forms of food — what one drinks and what one eats. What one drinks is the form of mantha; what one eats is that of odana. Both are found in one's house — both what one drinks and what one eats — for one who knows thus. They say: 'Three drops come down — a water-drop, a ghee-drop, and a honey-drop.' Of these, the water-drop enters this [earth]; the ghee-drop enters the plants; the honey-drop enters the trees. Thereupon Āmalaka Akūpayeya, Ahīnā Āśvatthī, and Keśī Dārbhya deliberated on this: 'Which drop do you consider to be coming? Which drop do you? Which drop do you?' Keśī said: 'I consider it to be the ghee-drop.' Ahīnā said: 'I consider it to be the honey-drop.' Āmalaka said: 'I consider it to be the water-drop.' They agreed upon that one. For everything here is born from water. That speech which he released — that is Agni. And that prāṇa which he followed — that is Indra.
meaning: -- अन्धे तमसि जल्पन्तीः / सो ऽस्यै वाच एकम् अक्षरम् अवच्छिद्य वाग् इति व्यसृजत / तम् पतित्वैषां लोकानां मध्ये व्यरमत / तद् एतन् मण्डलम् अभवत् / तद् अन्वानैत् / स प्राणो ऽभवत् / ताभ्यो व्यौच्छत् / अशनायंस् त्व् एव स आसाम् अपाम् एकं स्तोकं प्राश्च्योतयत् कियत् स्विद् आभ्यो ऽलं भविष्यतीति / स दशधाभवच् छतधा सहस्रधा यावतीयं पृथिवी तावान् अभवत् / तद् अभिसंपद्य व्यमथ्नत / स मन्थो ऽभवत् / तन् मन्थस्य मन्थत्वम् / तम् अशित्वोदानन् / स उदनो ऽभवत् / तद् उदनस्योदनत्वम् / तद् एतद् द्वयम् एवान्नस्य रूपं यच् चैव पिबति यच् चाश्नाति / यत् पिबति मन्थस्य तद् रूपं , यद् अश्नात्य् ओदनस्य तत् / उभयं हास्यैतद् गृहे ऽधिगम्यते यच् चैव पिबति यच् चाश्नाति य एवं वेद / तद् आहुस् -- त्रय स्तोका आगच्छन्तीत्य् उदस्तोको घृतस्तोको मधुस्तोकः / ततो य उदस्तोक इमां स प्रविशत्य् , ओषधीर् घृतस्तोको , वनस्पतीन् मधुस्तोकः / तद् धैतं मीमांसांचक्रुर् आमलक अकूपयेयो ऽहीना आश्वत्थिः केशी दार्भ्यः -- किं स्तोकं त्वम् आगच्छन्तं मन्यसे , किं स्तोकं त्वं , किं स्तोकं त्वम् इति / स होवाच केशी -- घृतस्तोकम् अहं मन्य इति / अथ होवाचाहीना -- मधुस्तोकम् अहं मन्य इति / अथ होवाचामलक -- उदस्तोकम् अहं मन्य इति / तस्मिन्न् उ हैव संपादयांचक्रुः / उदकाध्य् एवेदं सर्वं जायते / तद् यां तां वाचं व्यसृजत सो ऽग्निः / अथ यं तं प्राणम् अन्वानैत् स इन्द्रः /

sanskrit_iast: -- candramā haiva saḥ / sa u heva prajāpatiḥ / tad etat parastād arvāk tejo nirmitaṃ dīpyamānaṃ tiṣṭhaty agniś cendraś ca / tad idam adhyātmam / yā sā vāg iyaṃ sā vāk tām ayaṃ prāṇa upariṣṭād adhyāste / atha yas sa prajānāṃ janayita ṛṣabhe 'nnaloke 'psv antar ayaṃ sa puruṣaḥ / tā etā samānīr devatā iha cāmutra ca / tā eha gacchanti , gacchanty amutra / yā imās tā amūr , yā amūs tā imāḥ / tā ha yo 'dhyātmam upāste sa hānidevo bhavati / teṣāṃ haiteṣ.eṃ devānāṃ prajāpatāv ātmānas saṃnihitāḥ / atha haiṣāṃ prāṇānām asmin puruṣa ātmānas saṃnihitāḥ / tam etaṃ puruṣaṃ parigṛhya gopāyanti / tasyaiṣa śloka -- "ṛṣabho loko mahad eva yakṣaṃ naivāsmāt pūrvaṃ na paraṃ babhūva / yaṃ devaṃ devāḥ prāṇāḥ puruṣaṃ parigṛhya jāgrati sa veda lokaṃ puruṣaṃ mahāntam //" iti / imaṃ ha vāva taṃ devaṃ devāḥ prāṇāḥ puruṣaṃ parigṛhya jāgrati / yo 'yam akṣann anta sa haiṣa vāmanaḥ / sa yo haitaṃ vāmana ity upāste vāmaṃ vāmaṃ haivainam eṣā devatābhinenīyate / etasmād dha vā idaṃ rājanyabandhavo vāmanaṃ kena cid avakāṃkṣanti / etasyai ha devatāyai nāmno 'ntikam enaṃ viduḥ / sa haiṣa na jīryati / samāvān haivaiṣa yūnaś ca jarasaś ca / sa haiṣa prāṇān saṃgṛhyāvadhūya śarīraṃ prāṇais sahordhva utkrāmati / etena ha vai pratyūḍhāni mṛtyuś śarīrāṇi harati / tasyai haitasyai devatāyai yathā mṛtpiṇḍa iṣīke 'dhihate syātām evam eva hṛdaye pādāv adhihatau / tau yad ācchinaty atha mriyate / tad idam apy avidvāṃsa āhur ācched dhy asyeti /
sentences: tad etat parastād arvāk tejo nirmitaṃ dīpyamānaṃ tiṣṭʰaty agniś cendraś ca /
yā sā vāg iyaṃ sā vāk tām ayaṃ prāṇa upariṣṭād adʰyāste /
atʰa yas sa prajānāṃ janayita r̥ṣabʰe 'nnaloke 'psv antar ayaṃ sa puruṣaḥ /
tā etā samānīr devatā iha cāmutra ca /
yā imās tā amūr , yā amūs tā imāḥ /
tā ha yo 'dʰyātmam upāste sa hānidevo bʰavati /
teṣāṃ haiteṣ.eṃ devānāṃ prajāpatāv ātmānas saṃnihitāḥ /
atʰa haiṣāṃ prāṇānām asmin puruṣa ātmānas saṃnihitāḥ /
"r̥ṣabʰo loko mahad eva yakṣaṃ naivāsmāt pūrvaṃ na paraṃ babʰūva /
yaṃ devaṃ devāḥ prāṇāḥ puruṣaṃ parigr̥hya jāgrati sa veda lokaṃ puruṣaṃ mahāntam //"
imaṃ ha vāva taṃ devaṃ devāḥ prāṇāḥ puruṣaṃ parigr̥hya jāgrati /
yo 'yam akṣann anta sa haiṣa vāmanaḥ /
sa yo haitaṃ vāmana ity upāste vāmaṃ vāmaṃ haivainam eṣā devatābʰinenīyate /
etasmād dʰa vā idaṃ rājanyabandʰavo vāmanaṃ kena cid avakāṃkṣanti /
