etasyai ha devatāyai nāmno 'ntikam enaṃ viduḥ /
samāvān haivaiṣa yūnaś ca jarasaś ca /
sa haiṣa prāṇān saṃgr̥hyāvadʰūya śarīraṃ prāṇais sahordʰva utkrāmati /
etena ha vai pratyūḍʰāni mr̥tyuś śarīrāṇi harati /
tasyai haitasyai devatāyai yatʰā mr̥tpiṇḍa iṣīke 'dʰihate syātām evam eva hr̥daye pādāv adʰihatau /
tad idam apy avidvāṃsa āhur āccʰed dʰy asyeti /
text: He is indeed the moon. And he is verily Prajāpati. This radiance stands fashioned, shining, from beyond [down] to here — Agni and Indra. This is [its correspondence] in the self: that speech — this is that speech; this prāṇa sits above her. And that generator of creatures, in the bull-world of food, within the waters — this is that person. These same deities [exist] here and there. They go here, they go there. Those that are here are those yonder; those yonder are these. He who meditates on them in the self becomes one who does not lack the divine. The selves of these gods are deposited in Prajāpati. And the selves of these prāṇas are deposited in this person. Surrounding this person, they guard him. Of this there is this verse: 'The bull is the world, a great being; nothing existed before it nor after. The gods who are the prāṇas surround and guard this person — the god. He who knows this knows the great world, the great person.' These divine prāṇas indeed guard this divine person by surrounding him — this one who is within the eye. He is the vāmana (the lovely one). He who meditates on him as vāmana — this deity brings him to one lovely thing after another. It is for this reason that men of the warrior class look at a dwarf with some [curious] expectation. They know him to be near to the name of this deity. He does not decay. He is the same for both youth and old age. Gathering up the prāṇas and shaking off the body, he ascends upward together with the prāṇas. With this [the deity] carries away the bodies that are cast off; Mṛtyu carries away [dead] bodies. For this deity, [its two feet are] like two lumps of clay placed upon two reeds fixed in the heart. When one cuts those off, then one dies. Even the unlearned say regarding this: 'It has been cut off indeed.'
meaning: -- चन्द्रमा हैव सः / स उ हेव प्रजापतिः / तद् एतत् परस्ताद् अर्वाक् तेजो निर्मितं दीप्यमानं तिष्ठत्य् अग्निश् चेन्द्रश् च / तद् इदम् अध्यात्मम् / या सा वाग् इयं सा वाक् ताम् अयं प्राण उपरिष्टाद् अध्यास्ते / अथ यस् स प्रजानां जनयित ऋषभे ऽन्नलोके ऽप्स्व् अन्तर् अयं स पुरुषः / ता एता समानीर् देवता इह चामुत्र च / ता एह गच्छन्ति , गच्छन्त्य् अमुत्र / या इमास् ता अमूर् , या अमूस् ता इमाः / ता ह यो ऽध्यात्मम् उपास्ते स हानिदेवो भवति / तेषां हैतेष्.एं देवानां प्रजापताव् आत्मानस् संनिहिताः / अथ हैषां प्राणानाम् अस्मिन् पुरुष आत्मानस् संनिहिताः / तम् एतं पुरुषं परिगृह्य गोपायन्ति / तस्यैष श्लोक -- "ऋषभो लोको महद् एव यक्षं नैवास्मात् पूर्वं न परं बभूव / यं देवं देवाः प्राणाः पुरुषं परिगृह्य जाग्रति स वेद लोकं पुरुषं महान्तम् //" इति / इमं ह वाव तं देवं देवाः प्राणाः पुरुषं परिगृह्य जाग्रति / यो ऽयम् अक्षन्न् अन्त स हैष वामनः / स यो हैतं वामन इत्य् उपास्ते वामं वामं हैवैनम् एषा देवताभिनेनीयते / एतस्माद् ध वा इदं राजन्यबन्धवो वामनं केन चिद् अवकांक्षन्ति / एतस्यै ह देवतायै नाम्नो ऽन्तिकम् एनं विदुः / स हैष न जीर्यति / समावान् हैवैष यूनश् च जरसश् च / स हैष प्राणान् संगृह्यावधूय शरीरं प्राणैस् सहोर्ध्व उत्क्रामति / एतेन ह वै प्रत्यूढानि मृत्युश् शरीराणि हरति / तस्यै हैतस्यै देवतायै यथा मृत्पिण्ड इषीके ऽधिहते स्याताम् एवम् एव हृदये पादाव् अधिहतौ / तौ यद् आच्छिनत्य् अथ म्रियते / तद् इदम् अप्य् अविद्वांस आहुर् आच्छेद् ध्य् अस्येति /

sanskrit_iast: devā vai śrameṇa tapasā vtaracaryeṇāsurān rakṣāṃsy abhyabhavan / te 'surā viditvait parā vai te bhavantīti , strīrūpāṇy akurvata prathamottanakāś caṇḍātakavāsinīr yat kalyāṇatamaṃ rūpāṇāṃ tat / tā devān pratyākramanta / tā devā upanyapādayanta / na hi kasya cana striyo 'priyāḥ / teṣu yad eṣāṃ teja indriyaṃ vīryaṃ śramābhijitam āsīt tad asiṃcan / te 'surā viditvaitad iyad vā eṣāṃ teja indriyaṃ vīryam abhūd ity ādāya prādravan / teṣāṃ ha devānām apriyam āsīt / riricānā ivāmanyanta / te 'bruvan kathaṃ nv idaṃ teja indriyaṃ vīryaṃ punar ādadīmahīti /
sentences: devā vai śrameṇa tapasā vtaracaryeṇāsurān rakṣāṃsy abʰyabʰavan /
te 'surā viditvait parā vai te bʰavantīti , strīrūpāṇy akurvata pratʰamottanakāś caṇḍātakavāsinīr yat kalyāṇatamaṃ rūpāṇāṃ tat /
teṣu yad eṣāṃ teja indriyaṃ vīryaṃ śramābʰijitam āsīt tad asiṃcan /
te 'surā viditvaitad iyad vā eṣāṃ teja indriyaṃ vīryam abʰūd ity ādāya prādravan /
te 'bruvan katʰaṃ nv idaṃ teja indriyaṃ vīryaṃ punar ādadīmahīti /
text: The gods overcame the asuras and rākṣasas through exertion, tapas, and brahmacarya. The asuras, having learned 'They are prevailing,' assumed the forms of women — adorned, wearing fine garments, of the most beautiful appearance. They approached the gods. The gods welcomed them, for women are not displeasing to anyone. Into them [the women], whatever tejas (brilliance), indriya (vital power), and vīrya (heroic strength) the gods had won through exertion — that they discharged. The asuras, having realized 'This much was their tejas, indriya, and vīrya,' seized it and ran away. The gods were displeased. They felt as if they had been diminished. They said: 'How shall we take back this tejas, indriya, and vīrya?'
meaning: देवा वै श्रमेण तपसा व्तरचर्येणासुरान् रक्षांस्य् अभ्यभवन् / ते ऽसुरा विदित्वैत् परा वै ते भवन्तीति , स्त्रीरूपाण्य् अकुर्वत प्रथमोत्तनकाश् चण्डातकवासिनीर् यत् कल्याणतमं रूपाणां तत् / ता देवान् प्रत्याक्रमन्त / ता देवा उपन्यपादयन्त / न हि कस्य चन स्त्रियो ऽप्रियाः / तेषु यद् एषां तेज इन्द्रियं वीर्यं श्रमाभिजितम् आसीत् तद् असिंचन् / ते ऽसुरा विदित्वैतद् इयद् वा एषां तेज इन्द्रियं वीर्यम् अभूद् इत्य् आदाय प्राद्रवन् / तेषां ह देवानाम् अप्रियम् आसीत् / रिरिचाना इवामन्यन्त / ते ऽब्रुवन् कथं न्व् इदं तेज इन्द्रियं वीर्यं पुनर् आददीमहीति /

sanskrit_iast: tam ety ekākṣareṇa rathantaram ādadata / tasmāt tat prathame 'han kriyate / prameti dvyakṣareṇa bṛhad ādadata / tasmāt tad dvitīye 'han kriyate / pratimeti tryakṣareṇavairūpam ādadata / tasmāt tat tṛtīye 'han kriyate / srīvag iti caturakṣareṇa vairājam ādadata / tasmāt tac caturthe 'han kriyate / sirikamasīti pañcākṣareṇa śākvaram ādadata / tasmāt tat pañcame 'han kriyate / chardirindriyāvad iti ṣaḍakṣareṇa raivatam ādadata / tasmāt tat ṣaṣṭhe 'han kriyate / "ā gayaṃ vīryaṃ yonim ā dadhvaṃ vidvaj janasya chāye " ti vāmadevyam ādadata / tasmāt tan madhyato yajñasya kriyate / yat paro yonim atiścyutitam abhūt tad "ā dadhvaṃ vasv " iti yajñāyajñīyam ādadata /
sentences: "ā gayaṃ vīryaṃ yonim ā dadʰvaṃ vidvaj janasya cʰāye " ti vāmadevyam ādadata /
yat paro yonim atiścyutitam abʰūt tad "ā dadʰvaṃ vasv " iti yajñāyajñīyam ādadata /
text: With 'et' — one syllable — they took back the rathantara. Therefore it is performed on the first day. With 'pramet' — two syllables — they took back the bṛhat. Therefore it is performed on the second day. With 'pratimet' — three syllables — they took back the vairūpa. Therefore it is performed on the third day. With 'srīvak' — four syllables — they took back the vairāja. Therefore it is performed on the fourth day. With 'sirikamasi' — five syllables — they took back the śākvara. Therefore it is performed on the fifth day. With 'chardirindriyāvat' — six syllables — they took back the raivata. Therefore it is performed on the sixth day. With 'ā gayaṃ vīryaṃ yonim ā dadhvaṃ vidvaj janasya chāye' they took back the vāmadevya. Therefore it is performed in the middle of the sacrifice. Whatever tejas had been spilled beyond the source, that they took back with 'ā dadhvaṃ vasu' — the yajñāyajñīya.
meaning: तम् एत्य् एकाक्षरेण रथन्तरम् आददत / तस्मात् तत् प्रथमे ऽहन् क्रियते / प्रमेति द्व्यक्षरेण बृहद् आददत / तस्मात् तद् द्वितीये ऽहन् क्रियते / प्रतिमेति त्र्यक्षरेणवैरूपम् आददत / तस्मात् तत् तृतीये ऽहन् क्रियते / स्रीवग् इति चतुरक्षरेण वैराजम् आददत / तस्मात् तच् चतुर्थे ऽहन् क्रियते / सिरिकमसीति पञ्चाक्षरेण शाक्वरम् आददत / तस्मात् तत् पञ्चमे ऽहन् क्रियते / छर्दिरिन्द्रियावद् इति षडक्षरेण रैवतम् आददत / तस्मात् तत् षष्ठे ऽहन् क्रियते / "आ गयं वीर्यं योनिम् आ दध्वं विद्वज् जनस्य छाये " ति वामदेव्यम् आददत / तस्मात् तन् मध्यतो यज्ञस्य क्रियते / यत् परो योनिम् अतिश्च्युतितम् अभूत् तद् "आ दध्वं वस्व् " इति यज्ञायज्ञीयम् आददत /

sanskrit_iast: atho āhur -- apahatapāpmāno vai devāḥ / te na svapanti / ta u śramasya bhūmnā samamīlayan / teṣām u svapatāṃ pramattānām asūrās teja indriyaṃ vīryam ādāyāpsv anvabhyavānayan / tad viṣṇur anvapaśyat / teṣāṃ ha devānāṃ prabubudhānānām apriyam āsīt / tān viṣṇur abravīn -- mā vo 'priyaṃ bhūt / ahaṃ vai tad anvakhyam iti / tān apsv anv abhyavānayat / tad apsv antaḥ paryapaśyan yathā pṛṣṭhāt kud udīṣitā syād evam / tad etābhir etābhir eva vyāhṛtibhir ādāya viṣṇave prāyacchan / tad idaṃ viṣṇus teja indriyaṃ vīryaṃ dhārayan samaiṣat / tasmād dhrasvo viṣṇuḥ / tasmād u hrasvaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ gām ālabhante / sa yatra dhārayan parākramata tad eva .viṣṇupadam abhavat / tasmād yo viṣṇupadīyaḥ kaikeyas sa yajña āttaraḥ / etaṃ hy asmin yajñam anvavindan /
sentences: teṣām u svapatāṃ pramattānām asūrās teja indriyaṃ vīryam ādāyāpsv anvabʰyavānayan /
teṣāṃ ha devānāṃ prabubudʰānānām apriyam āsīt /
tān viṣṇur abravīn -- mā vo 'priyaṃ bʰūt /
tad apsv antaḥ paryapaśyan yatʰā pr̥ṣṭʰāt [ka]kud udīṣitā syād evam /
tad etābʰir etābʰir eva vyāhr̥tibʰir ādāya viṣṇave prāyaccʰan /
tad idaṃ viṣṇus teja indriyaṃ vīryaṃ dʰārayan samaiṣat /
tasmād u hrasvaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ gām ālabʰante /
sa yatra dʰārayan parākramata tad eva .viṣṇupadam abʰavat /
tasmād yo viṣṇupadīyaḥ kaikeyas sa yajña āttaraḥ /
text: Others say: The gods were indeed free of evil. They did not sleep. But from the abundance of exertion, they closed their eyes. While they slept heedlessly, the asuras took their tejas, indriya, and vīrya and submerged them in the waters. Viṣṇu perceived this. When the gods awoke, they were displeased. Viṣṇu said to them: 'Let there be no displeasure for you. I have indeed seen it.' He led them to the waters. They saw it within the waters, as a hump might be seen rising from a back. Having taken it out with these very vyāhṛtis, they gave it to Viṣṇu. Viṣṇu bore this tejas, indriya, and vīrya, and he contracted. Therefore Viṣṇu is short. Therefore they sacrifice a short [animal] consecrated to Viṣṇu. Where he strode while bearing [it], that became the step of Viṣṇu. Therefore the Viṣṇupadīya Kaikeya is preeminent in the sacrifice, for they found this sacrifice in him.
meaning: अथो आहुर् -- अपहतपाप्मानो वै देवाः / ते न स्वपन्ति / त उ श्रमस्य भूम्ना सममीलयन् / तेषाम् उ स्वपतां प्रमत्तानाम् असूरास् तेज इन्द्रियं वीर्यम् आदायाप्स्व् अन्वभ्यवानयन् / तद् विष्णुर् अन्वपश्यत् / तेषां ह देवानां प्रबुबुधानानाम् अप्रियम् आसीत् / तान् विष्णुर् अब्रवीन् -- मा वो ऽप्रियं भूत् / अहं वै तद् अन्वख्यम् इति / तान् अप्स्व् अन्व् अभ्यवानयत् / तद् अप्स्व् अन्तः पर्यपश्यन् यथा पृष्ठात् कुद् उदीषिता स्याद् एवम् / तद् एताभिर् एताभिर् एव व्याहृतिभिर् आदाय विष्णवे प्रायच्छन् / तद् इदं विष्णुस् तेज इन्द्रियं वीर्यं धारयन् समैषत् / तस्माद् ध्रस्वो विष्णुः / तस्माद् उ ह्रस्वं वैष्णवं गाम् आलभन्ते / स यत्र धारयन् पराक्रमत तद् एव .विष्णुपदम् अभवत् / तस्माद् यो विष्णुपदीयः कैकेयस् स यज्ञ आत्तरः / एतं ह्य् अस्मिन् यज्ञम् अन्वविन्दन् /

sanskrit_iast: prajāpatir vā imān lokān imā diśo 'sṛjata / tān sṛṣṭvobhayān devān asurān asṛjata / tān samad avindat / te prajāpatau brahma saṃnyadadhata / tat prajātir nodayacchat / tad apsu prāveśayat / te devā asurān ajayan / te jitvā punar etyābruvan prajāpate yan nas tvayi brahma tan naḥ prayacchati / so 'bravīn na vā ahaṃ tad udayaccham / tad apsu prāveśayam iti / tān apsv anv abhyavānayat / tad apsv antaḥ paryapaśyan yathā pṛṣṭhāt kakud udīṣitā syād evam / te 'bruvan sṛjāmahā ita iti /
sentences: prajāpatir vā imān lokān imā diśo 'sr̥jata /
te jitvā punar etyābruvan prajāpate yan nas tvayi brahma tan naḥ prayaccʰati /
so 'bravīn na vā ahaṃ tad udayaccʰam /
tad apsv antaḥ paryapaśyan yatʰā pr̥ṣṭʰāt kakud udīṣitā syād evam /
text: Prajāpati created these worlds and these directions. Having created them, he created both gods and asuras. Conflict found them. They deposited brahman in Prajāpati. Prajāpati did not lift it up. He made it enter the waters. The gods conquered the asuras. Having conquered, they returned and said: 'Prajāpati, give us that brahman which [we deposited] in you.' He said: 'I did not lift it up. I made it enter the waters.' He led them to the waters. They saw it within the waters, as a hump might be seen rising from a back. They said: 'Let us bring it forth from here.'
meaning: प्रजापतिर् वा इमान् लोकान् इमा दिशो ऽसृजत / तान् सृष्ट्वोभयान् देवान् असुरान् असृजत / तान् समद् अविन्दत् / ते प्रजापतौ ब्रह्म संन्यदधत / तत् प्रजातिर् नोदयच्छत् / तद् अप्सु प्रावेशयत् / ते देवा असुरान् अजयन् / ते जित्वा पुनर् एत्याब्रुवन् प्रजापते यन् नस् त्वयि ब्रह्म तन् नः प्रयच्छति / सो ऽब्रवीन् न वा अहं तद् उदयच्छम् / तद् अप्सु प्रावेशयम् इति / तान् अप्स्व् अन्व् अभ्यवानयत् / तद् अप्स्व् अन्तः पर्यपश्यन् यथा पृष्ठात् ककुद् उदीषिता स्याद् एवम् / ते ऽब्रुवन् सृजामहा इत इति /

sanskrit_iast: -- prācyai diśo rathantaraṃ bhā asṛjanta / tad agner ghoṣo 'nvasṛjyata / tasmād rathantarasya stotrā agnīn manthanti / ta om ity etenaivākṣareṇāsyai dakṣiṇāyai diśo bṛhad bhā asṛjanta / tat parjanyasya ghoṣo 'nvasṛjyata / tasmād bṛhata stotre dundubhīn udvādayanti / varṣukaḥ parjanyo bhavati / ta om ity etenaivākṣareṇāsyai pratīcyai diśo vairūpaṃ bhā asṛjanta / tad vāyor ghoṣo 'nvasṛjyata / tasmād vairūpasya stotra ādhavair ādhūnvanti / adhovāta āgāmukaḥ / ta om ity etenaivākṣareṇāsyā udīcyai diśo vairājaṃ bhā asṛjanta / tad vayasāṃ ghoṣo 'nvasṛjyata / tasmād yathā vayāṃsi punar ādāyaṃ vācaṃ vadanty evaṃ vairājena punar ādāyam iva stuvate / ta om ity etenaivākṣareṇāsyā ūrdhvāyai diśaś śākvaraṃ bhā asṛjanta / tad apāṃ ghoṣo 'nvasṛjyata / tasmāc chākvarasya stotre 'pa upanidhāya stuvanti / ta om ity etenaivākṣareṇāsyai diśo raivataṃ bhā asṛjanta / tat paśughoṣo 'nvasṛjyata / tasmād raivatasya stotra paśughoṣaṃ kurvanti , vatsān mātṛbhis saṃvāśayanti / te 'bruvaṃs tad vedāma yata ime 'sṛkṣmahīti / te 'psv eva vāmadevyaṃ paryapaśyan / tad ādadata / tat sarvā vāco 'nvasṛjyantaikaiketarāṇi pṛṣṭhāni / tānīmāni pṛṣṭhāni sṛṣṭāni digbhya ātapan / etāni ha tarhy āteṣuḥ / ātapati svebhya , ātapatīty enam āhur ya evaṃ veda / nīyaṃ devatābhyadhyāyat / yeyaṃ purastād uccarati puruṣākṛtir hy eṣā tarhy āsa / sā trivṛtā stomana gāyatryā chandasā rathantarasya bhā ādatta / tad ito 'dhatta / pañcadaśena stomena triṣṭubhā chandasā bṛhato bhā ādatta / tad ito 'dhatta / saptadaśena stomena jagatyā chanasā vairūpasya bhā ādatta / tad ito 'dhatta / ekaviṃśena stomenānuṣṭubhā chandasā vairājasya bhā ādatta / tad ito 'dhatta / triṇavena stomena paṃktyā chandasā śākvarasya bhā ādatta / tad ito 'dhatta / trayastriṃśena stomenāticchandasā raivatasya bhā ādatta / tad ito 'dhatta / tasmāt sarvāṇi bhūtāny apsv antataḥ pratiṣṭhitāni / tam ādada nam āditāditeti vāco 'vadan / tad ādityasyādityatvam /
sentences: ta om ity etenaivākṣareṇāsyai dakṣiṇāyai diśo br̥had bʰā asr̥janta /
ta om ity etenaivākṣareṇāsyai pratīcyai diśo vairūpaṃ bʰā asr̥janta /
ta om ity etenaivākṣareṇāsyā udīcyai diśo vairājaṃ bʰā asr̥janta /
tasmād yatʰā vayāṃsi punar ādāyaṃ vācaṃ vadanty evaṃ vairājena punar ādāyam iva stuvate /
ta om ity etenaivākṣareṇāsyā ūrdʰvāyai diśaś śākvaraṃ bʰā asr̥janta /
ta om ity etenaivākṣareṇāsyai diśo raivataṃ bʰā asr̥janta /
tasmād raivatasya stotra paśugʰoṣaṃ kurvanti , vatsān mātr̥bʰis saṃvāśayanti /
ātapati svebʰya , ātapatīty enam āhur ya evaṃ veda /
yeyaṃ purastād uccarati puruṣākr̥tir hy eṣā tarhy āsa /
sā trivr̥tā stomana gāyatryā cʰandasā ratʰantarasya bʰā ādatta /
pañcadaśena stomena triṣṭubʰā cʰandasā br̥hato bʰā ādatta /
saptadaśena stomena jagatyā cʰanasā vairūpasya bʰā ādatta /
ekaviṃśena stomenānuṣṭubʰā cʰandasā vairājasya bʰā ādatta /
triṇavena stomena paṃktyā cʰandasā śākvarasya bʰā ādatta /
tasmāt sarvāṇi bʰūtāny apsv antataḥ pratiṣṭʰitāni /
text: From the eastern direction they brought forth the rathantara as radiance. The sound of Agni followed it. Therefore, at the recitation of the rathantara, they kindle the fires. With 'om' — this very syllable — from this southern direction they brought forth the bṛhat as radiance. The sound of Parjanya (rain-cloud) followed it. Therefore, at the recitation of the bṛhat, they sound the drums. Parjanya becomes a rain-giver. With 'om' — this very syllable — from this western direction they brought forth the vairūpa as radiance. The sound of Vāyu followed it. Therefore, at the recitation of the vairūpa, they shake with fans. The wind blows downward and approaches. With 'om' — this very syllable — from this northern direction they brought forth the vairāja as radiance. The sound of birds followed it. Therefore, just as birds repeat their call, so with the vairāja one praises as if repeating. With 'om' — this very syllable — from this upward direction they brought forth the śākvara as radiance. The sound of waters followed it. Therefore, at the recitation of the śākvara, they place water nearby and praise. With 'om' — this very syllable — from this [last] direction they brought forth the raivata as radiance. The sound of cattle followed it. Therefore, at the recitation of the raivata, they make the sound of cattle and let the calves join their mothers. They said: 'We know whence we have brought these forth.' They found the vāmadevya in the waters themselves. They took it. All speeches followed it — each pṛṣṭha separately. These pṛṣṭhas, once created, shone from the directions. They have been shining ever since. 'He shines for his own; he shines!' — thus people say of one who knows this. This deity meditated upon [them]. That which rises in the east — for it was then in human form. With the trivṛt stoma and the gāyatrī metre, it took the radiance of the rathantara. It placed it here. With the pañcadaśa stoma and the triṣṭubh metre, it took the radiance of the bṛhat. It placed it here. With the saptadaśa stoma and the jagatī metre, it took the radiance of the vairūpa. It placed it here. With the ekaviṃśa stoma and the anuṣṭubh metre, it took the radiance of the vairāja. It placed it here. With the triṇava stoma and the paṅkti metre, it took the radiance of the śākvara. It placed it here. With the trayastriṃśa stoma and the atichandas metre, it took the radiance of the raivata. It placed it here. Therefore all beings are ultimately established in the waters. As it took [the radiance], beings spoke: 'ādā, ādā' (he takes, he takes). That is the āditya-nature of Āditya.
meaning: -- प्राच्यै दिशो रथन्तरं भा असृजन्त / तद् अग्नेर् घोषो ऽन्वसृज्यत / तस्माद् रथन्तरस्य स्तोत्रा अग्नीन् मन्थन्ति / त ओम् इत्य् एतेनैवाक्षरेणास्यै दक्षिणायै दिशो बृहद् भा असृजन्त / तत् पर्जन्यस्य घोषो ऽन्वसृज्यत / तस्माद् बृहत स्तोत्रे दुन्दुभीन् उद्वादयन्ति / वर्षुकः पर्जन्यो भवति / त ओम् इत्य् एतेनैवाक्षरेणास्यै प्रतीच्यै दिशो वैरूपं भा असृजन्त / तद् वायोर् घोषो ऽन्वसृज्यत / तस्माद् वैरूपस्य स्तोत्र आधवैर् आधून्वन्ति / अधोवात आगामुकः / त ओम् इत्य् एतेनैवाक्षरेणास्या उदीच्यै दिशो वैराजं भा असृजन्त / तद् वयसां घोषो ऽन्वसृज्यत / तस्माद् यथा वयांसि पुनर् आदायं वाचं वदन्त्य् एवं वैराजेन पुनर् आदायम् इव स्तुवते / त ओम् इत्य् एतेनैवाक्षरेणास्या ऊर्ध्वायै दिशश् शाक्वरं भा असृजन्त / तद् अपां घोषो ऽन्वसृज्यत / तस्माच् छाक्वरस्य स्तोत्रे ऽप उपनिधाय स्तुवन्ति / त ओम् इत्य् एतेनैवाक्षरेणास्यै दिशो रैवतं भा असृजन्त / तत् पशुघोषो ऽन्वसृज्यत / तस्माद् रैवतस्य स्तोत्र पशुघोषं कुर्वन्ति , वत्सान् मातृभिस् संवाशयन्ति / ते ऽब्रुवंस् तद् वेदाम यत इमे ऽसृक्ष्महीति / ते ऽप्स्व् एव वामदेव्यं पर्यपश्यन् / तद् आददत / तत् सर्वा वाचो ऽन्वसृज्यन्तैकैकेतराणि पृष्ठानि / तानीमानि पृष्ठानि सृष्टानि दिग्भ्य आतपन् / एतानि ह तर्ह्य् आतेषुः / आतपति स्वेभ्य , आतपतीत्य् एनम् आहुर् य एवं वेद / नीयं देवताभ्यध्यायत् / येयं पुरस्ताद् उच्चरति पुरुषाकृतिर् ह्य् एषा तर्ह्य् आस / सा त्रिवृता स्तोमन गायत्र्या छन्दसा रथन्तरस्य भा आदत्त / तद् इतो ऽधत्त / पञ्चदशेन स्तोमेन त्रिष्टुभा छन्दसा बृहतो भा आदत्त / तद् इतो ऽधत्त / सप्तदशेन स्तोमेन जगत्या छनसा वैरूपस्य भा आदत्त / तद् इतो ऽधत्त / एकविंशेन स्तोमेनानुष्टुभा छन्दसा वैराजस्य भा आदत्त / तद् इतो ऽधत्त / त्रिणवेन स्तोमेन पंक्त्या छन्दसा शाक्वरस्य भा आदत्त / तद् इतो ऽधत्त / त्रयस्त्रिंशेन स्तोमेनातिच्छन्दसा रैवतस्य भा आदत्त / तद् इतो ऽधत्त / तस्मात् सर्वाणि भूतान्य् अप्स्व् अन्ततः प्रतिष्ठितानि / तम् आदद नम् आदितादितेति वाचो ऽवदन् / तद् आदित्यस्यादित्यत्वम् /

sanskrit_iast: taṃ sarvāṇi bhūtāni so 'ryas so 'rya ity āyan / tat soryasya soryatvam / soryo ha vai nāmaiṣa / taṃ sūrya iti parokṣam ācakṣate / aryo no 'si bhartā no 'sīti hainaṃ svāś cāraṇāś copāsate ya evaṃ veda / sa yat pratyaṃṅ ādāya svarayan vai tat soryasya soryatvam / tad vāva svarasya svaratvaṃ yat svarayan vait / te devā abruvan na hārṣīd vā ayam iti / tad ahar abhavat / rātaṃ vā asmā abhūd iti so eva rātrir abhavat / etad dha vā ahorātrayor janma / sa ya em etad ahorātrayor janma vedāpnoty ahorātre , naianm ete atītaḥ / sarvaṃ ha vā idam anyat paryantavat / ete ha vā aparyante yad ahorātre / ye te vā idaṃ parivartamāne sarvam āpnutaḥ / tad yathā rathopasthe tiṣṭhan pakṣasi pratyavekṣetaivam evaite 'horātre ādityaloke tiṣṭhan pratyavekṣate / sa pitaraṃ prajāpatim avravīt -- tata yat ta idaṃ teja indriyaṃ vīryaṃ mahyam idaṃ prayaccheti / tatheti / tad asmai prāyacchat /
sentences: taṃ sarvāṇi bʰūtāni so 'ryas so 'rya ity āyan /
aryo no 'si bʰartā no 'sīti hainaṃ svāś cāraṇāś copāsate ya evaṃ veda /
sa yat pratyaṃṅ ādāya svarayan vai[t] tat soryasya soryatvam /
tad vāva svarasya svaratvaṃ yat svarayan vait /
te devā abruvan na hārṣīd vā ayam iti /
rātaṃ vā asmā abʰūd iti so eva rātrir abʰavat /
sa ya e[va]m etad ahorātrayor janma vedāpnoty ahorātre , naianm ete atītaḥ /
sarvaṃ ha vā idam anyat paryantavat /
ete ha vā aparyante yad ahorātre /
ye te vā idaṃ parivartamāne sarvam āpnutaḥ /
tad yatʰā ratʰopastʰe tiṣṭʰan pakṣasi pratyavekṣetaivam evaite 'horātre ādityaloke tiṣṭʰan pratyavekṣate /
sa pitaraṃ prajāpatim avravīt -- tata yat ta idaṃ teja indriyaṃ vīryaṃ mahyam idaṃ prayaccʰeti /
text: All beings came to him [saying]: 'He is arya (noble), he is arya!' That is the sūrya-nature of Sūrya. His name is verily Sorya; they call him Sūrya indirectly. 'You are our arya, you are our sustainer' — thus his own [people] and his followers worship him who knows thus. When he goes westward, taking [the radiance] and sounding forth — that verily is the sūrya-nature of Sūrya. That indeed is the svara-nature of svara — that he sounds forth. The gods said: 'He has taken it indeed!' That became the day (ahar). 'It has been given to him' — that became the night (rātri). That is the birth of day and night. He who knows this birth of day and night attains day and night; they do not pass beyond him. Everything else indeed has an end. But day and night have no end. Revolving, they attain everything. Just as one standing on the seat of a chariot might look at both sides, even so these day and night, standing in the world of Āditya, look both ways. He said to his father Prajāpati: 'Father, that tejas, indriya, and vīrya of yours — give it to me.' 'So be it.' He gave it to him.
meaning: तं सर्वाणि भूतानि सो ऽर्यस् सो ऽर्य इत्य् आयन् / तत् सोर्यस्य सोर्यत्वम् / सोर्यो ह वै नामैष / तं सूर्य इति परोक्षम् आचक्षते / अर्यो नो ऽसि भर्ता नो ऽसीति हैनं स्वाश् चारणाश् चोपासते य एवं वेद / स यत् प्रत्यंङ् आदाय स्वरयन् वै तत् सोर्यस्य सोर्यत्वम् / तद् वाव स्वरस्य स्वरत्वं यत् स्वरयन् वैत् / ते देवा अब्रुवन् न हार्षीद् वा अयम् इति / तद् अहर् अभवत् / रातं वा अस्मा अभूद् इति सो एव रात्रिर् अभवत् / एतद् ध वा अहोरात्रयोर् जन्म / स य एम् एतद् अहोरात्रयोर् जन्म वेदाप्नोत्य् अहोरात्रे , नैअन्म् एते अतीतः / सर्वं ह वा इदम् अन्यत् पर्यन्तवत् / एते ह वा अपर्यन्ते यद् अहोरात्रे / ये ते वा इदं परिवर्तमाने सर्वम् आप्नुतः / तद् यथा रथोपस्थे तिष्ठन् पक्षसि प्रत्यवेक्षेतैवम् एवैते ऽहोरात्रे आदित्यलोके तिष्ठन् प्रत्यवेक्षते / स पितरं प्रजापतिम् अव्रवीत् -- तत यत् त इदं तेज इन्द्रियं वीर्यं मह्यम् इदं प्रयच्छेति / तथेति / तद् अस्मै प्रायच्छत् /

sanskrit_iast: sa vaśam eva diva ādatta , kṣatraṃ nakṣatrāṇām , ātmānam antarikṣasya , rūpaṃ vāyor , ājñāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ , cakṣuḥ paśūnām , ūrjam apāṃ , rasam oṣadhīnāṃ , carathaṃ vanaspatīnāṃ , śiśnaṃ vayasām , arcim agner , hṛdayaṃ pṛthivyai , gandhaṃ hiraṇyasya , stanayitnuṃ vācas , saṃgamaṃ pitr̥̄ṇāṃ , bhāṃ candramasaḥ / tad yad eteṣāṃ bhūtānām ādatta tad ādityasyādityatvam / ādatte tejo dviṣato bhrātṛvyasya ya evaṃ veda / sā haiṣā devatā dīkṣitā keśavādhi kṛṣṇājinā / tasyai ye 'rvāñco raśmayas tāni śmaśrūṇi , ya ūrdhvās te keśāḥ / ahorātre eva kṛṣṇājine / tad yad divikṣayam akuruta tasmād dīkṣitā / divi ha vā eṣa kṣayaṃ kuruta yo yajate /
sentences: sa vaśam eva diva ādatta , kṣatraṃ nakṣatrāṇām , ātmānam antarikṣasya , rūpaṃ vāyor , ājñāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ , cakṣuḥ paśūnām , ūrjam apāṃ , rasam oṣadʰīnāṃ , caratʰaṃ vanaspatīnāṃ , śiśnaṃ vayasām , arcim agner , hr̥dayaṃ pr̥tʰivyai , gandʰaṃ hiraṇyasya , stanayitnuṃ vācas , saṃgamaṃ pitr̥̄ṇāṃ , bʰāṃ candramasaḥ /
tad yad eteṣāṃ bʰūtānām ādatta tad ādityasyādityatvam /
ādatte tejo dviṣato bʰrātr̥vyasya ya evaṃ veda /
sā haiṣā devatā dīkṣitā keśavādʰi kr̥ṣṇājinā /
tasyai ye 'rvāñco raśmayas tāni śmaśrūṇi , ya ūrdʰvās te keśāḥ /
tad yad divikṣayam akuruta tasmād dīkṣitā /
divi ha vā eṣa kṣayaṃ kuruta yo yajate /
text: He took dominion from heaven, sovereignty from the stars, selfhood from the mid-region, form from Vāyu, command over humans, sight from cattle, vigor from the waters, essence from the plants, movement from the trees, the reproductive organ from the birds, the flame from Agni, the heart from the earth, fragrance from gold, thunder from speech, the gathering-place from the ancestors, and radiance from the moon. Because he took (ādatta) from these beings, that is the āditya-nature of Āditya. He who knows this takes the tejas of his hateful rival. This deity is indeed one who has undergone dīkṣā (consecration) — with matted hair and wearing a black antelope skin. Its downward rays are the beard; the upward ones are the head-hair. Day and night are the two black antelope skins. Because it made its dwelling in heaven, therefore it is 'consecrated' (dīkṣita). For he who sacrifices indeed makes his dwelling in heaven.
meaning: स वशम् एव दिव आदत्त , क्षत्रं नक्षत्राणाम् , आत्मानम् अन्तरिक्षस्य , रूपं वायोर् , आज्ञां मनुष्याणां , चक्षुः पशूनाम् , ऊर्जम् अपां , रसम् ओषधीनां , चरथं वनस्पतीनां , शिश्नं वयसाम् , अर्चिम् अग्नेर् , हृदयं पृथिव्यै , गन्धं हिरण्यस्य , स्तनयित्नुं वाचस् , संगमं पित्र्̥̄णां , भां चन्द्रमसः / तद् यद् एतेषां भूतानाम् आदत्त तद् आदित्यस्यादित्यत्वम् / आदत्ते तेजो द्विषतो भ्रातृव्यस्य य एवं वेद / सा हैषा देवता दीक्षिता केशवाधि कृष्णाजिना / तस्यै ये ऽर्वाञ्चो रश्मयस् तानि श्मश्रूणि , य ऊर्ध्वास् ते केशाः / अहोरात्रे एव कृष्णाजिने / तद् यद् दिविक्षयम् अकुरुत तस्माद् दीक्षिता / दिवि ह वा एष क्षयं कुरुत यो यजते /

sanskrit_iast: tasyoṣasyeva patnī candramās somapīthaḥ / tasmāt sapatnīko dīkṣata / sā haiṣā devatā dīkṣamāṇasya teja indriyaṃ vīryaṃ yaśa ādatte / sa dīkṣiṣyamāṇa ādityam upatiṣṭheta -- "tvaṃ devatā dīkṣitāsi / sā dakṣimāṇasya teja indriyaṃ vīryaṃ yaśa ādatse / mā me teja indriyaṃ vīryaṃ yaśa ādithāḥ / tava dīkṣaṃ anu dakṣi " iti / tasyaiṣā devatā dīkṣamāṇasya teja indriyaṃ vīryaṃ yaśo nādatte / tad etad ukthasyaiva stombhaḥ / te ye 'rvāñco raśmayas tair asyeme lokā stabdhā ya etasmād arvāñco , 'tha yat kiṃ ca prāṇabhṛt saśārīram / atha ya ūrdhvās tair u asya te lokā stabdhā ya etasmāt parāñco , 'tha yat kiṃ cābhṛtam aśarīram / tad yad eṣā devatobhayān devāsurān antarā stavadhvā tiṣṭhati tasmād etat stambhaḥ / sa ha vai stabdhas sastabheta / atho ya enaṃ stabhasyopamīmāṃseta taṃ brūyād yā stabdhā devatā tasyai tvā vṛścyāmīmām ārtiṃ nyeṣyasīti / tāṃ daivārtiṃ nyeti / te ye 'rvāñco raśmaya ete hāvaśā mṛtyor annavantaḥ / atha ya ūrdhvās ta u hāmṛtalokāḥ / te ye 'rvāñco raśmaya ete horayo nāma yathā nal̥o vāsuśira syādve arvā / atha ya ūrdhvās ta uparīyāṃso nāma / sa yathā hastī hastenādāya pṛṣṭhye 'dhyasyetaivam evaiṣā devataitad vidvāṃsam urubhī raśmibhir ādāyāvarīyasv adhyasyate /
sentences: sā haiṣā devatā dīkṣamāṇasya teja indriyaṃ vīryaṃ yaśa ādatte /
sa dīkṣiṣyamāṇa ādityam upatiṣṭʰeta -- "tvaṃ devatā dīkṣitāsi /
sā dakṣimāṇasya teja indriyaṃ vīryaṃ yaśa ādatse /
mā me teja indriyaṃ vīryaṃ yaśa āditʰāḥ /
tasyaiṣā devatā dīkṣamāṇasya teja indriyaṃ vīryaṃ yaśo nādatte /
te ye 'rvāñco raśmayas tair asyeme lokā stabdʰā ya etasmād arvāñco , 'tʰa yat kiṃ ca prāṇabʰr̥t saśārīram /
atʰa ya ūrdʰvās tair u asya te lokā stabdʰā ya etasmāt parāñco , 'tʰa yat kiṃ cābʰr̥tam aśarīram /
tad yad eṣā devatobʰayān devāsurān antarā stavadʰvā tiṣṭʰati tasmād etat stambʰaḥ /
atʰo ya enaṃ stabʰasyopamīmāṃseta taṃ brūyād yā stabdʰā devatā tasyai tvā vr̥ścyāmīmām ārtiṃ nyeṣyasīti /
te ye 'rvāñco raśmaya ete hāvaśā mr̥tyor annavantaḥ /
atʰa ya ūrdʰvās ta u hāmr̥talokāḥ /
te ye 'rvāñco raśmaya ete horayo nāma yatʰā nal̥o vāsuśira syādve arvā /
atʰa ya ūrdʰvās ta uparīyāṃso nāma /
sa yatʰā hastī hastenādāya pr̥ṣṭʰye 'dʰyasyetaivam evaiṣā devataitad vidvāṃsam urubʰī raśmibʰir ādāyāvarīyasv adʰyasyate /
text: Uṣas (Dawn) is its wife; the moon is its soma-draught. Therefore one who is consecrated has a wife. This deity takes away the tejas, indriya, vīrya, and fame of one who is being consecrated. One about to undergo dīkṣā should worship the sun [with this mantra]: 'You are the deity who has undergone dīkṣā. You take the tejas, indriya, vīrya, and fame of one being consecrated. Do not take my tejas, indriya, vīrya, and fame. I undergo my dīkṣā following your dīkṣā.' Then this deity does not take away the tejas, indriya, vīrya, and fame of one being consecrated. This is the pillar of the uktha. With its downward rays, these worlds that are below it are supported, as well as everything that has breath and body. With its upward rays, those worlds that are beyond it are supported, as well as everything that is unembodied. Because this deity stands propping up both gods and asuras between [the worlds], therefore this is the 'pillar' (stambha). He who is propped up should [remain] firm. And if someone should criticize him who meditates on this pillar, one should say to him: 'I cut you off from the deity that is the pillar; you shall fall into this misery.' He falls into divine misery. Its downward rays — these are involuntary, mortal, food-bearing. Its upward rays — these are indeed immortal worlds. The downward rays are called horayas — like a hollow reed, or a horse running forward. The upward ones are called uparīyāṃsas. Just as an elephant picks up [something] with its trunk and places it on its back, even so this deity, taking up with its rays the one who knows this, places him in the farther [worlds].
meaning: तस्योषस्येव पत्नी चन्द्रमास् सोमपीथः / तस्मात् सपत्नीको दीक्षत / सा हैषा देवता दीक्षमाणस्य तेज इन्द्रियं वीर्यं यश आदत्ते / स दीक्षिष्यमाण आदित्यम् उपतिष्ठेत -- "त्वं देवता दीक्षितासि / सा दक्षिमाणस्य तेज इन्द्रियं वीर्यं यश आदत्से / मा मे तेज इन्द्रियं वीर्यं यश आदिथाः / तव दीक्षं अनु दक्षि " इति / तस्यैषा देवता दीक्षमाणस्य तेज इन्द्रियं वीर्यं यशो नादत्ते / तद् एतद् उक्थस्यैव स्तोम्भः / ते ये ऽर्वाञ्चो रश्मयस् तैर् अस्येमे लोका स्तब्धा य एतस्माद् अर्वाञ्चो , ऽथ यत् किं च प्राणभृत् सशारीरम् / अथ य ऊर्ध्वास् तैर् उ अस्य ते लोका स्तब्धा य एतस्मात् पराञ्चो , ऽथ यत् किं चाभृतम् अशरीरम् / तद् यद् एषा देवतोभयान् देवासुरान् अन्तरा स्तवध्वा तिष्ठति तस्माद् एतत् स्तम्भः / स ह वै स्तब्धस् सस्तभेत / अथो य एनं स्तभस्योपमीमांसेत तं ब्रूयाद् या स्तब्धा देवता तस्यै त्वा वृश्च्यामीमाम् आर्तिं न्येष्यसीति / तां दैवार्तिं न्येति / ते ये ऽर्वाञ्चो रश्मय एते हावशा मृत्योर् अन्नवन्तः / अथ य ऊर्ध्वास् त उ हामृतलोकाः / ते ये ऽर्वाञ्चो रश्मय एते होरयो नाम यथा नल्̥ओ वासुशिर स्याद्वे अर्वा / अथ य ऊर्ध्वास् त उपरीयांसो नाम / स यथा हस्ती हस्तेनादाय पृष्ठ्ये ऽध्यस्येतैवम् एवैषा देवतैतद् विद्वांसम् उरुभी रश्मिभिर् आदायावरीयस्व् अध्यस्यते /

sanskrit_iast: "nāsad āsīn no sad āsīt tadānīṃ nāsīd rajo no vyomā paro yat / kim āvarīvaḥ kuha kasya śarmann ambhaḥ kim āsīd gahanaṃ gabhīram //" iti / tasminn asati sati na kasmiṃś cana saty ṛtaṃ jyotiṣmad udaplavata , satyaṃ jyotiṣmad udaplavata , tapo jyotiṣmad udaplavata / tad yad ṛtam iti vāk sā , yat satyam iti prāṇas so , yat tapa iti manas tat / teṣām annam eva jyotir āsīt / tāny ekam abhavan / tad ekaṃ bhūtvaitenānnena jyotiṣāpyāyata / tad abhavad yathā madhvaṣṭhī lāvāsv āsiktā syād ṛtir naivam / tad aikṣata -- hantādhastāt prāṇaṃ karavā iti / tad adhastāt prāṇamakuruta , yathaiṣa striyā adhastād ākāśa evam / tasmād āpo 'sṛjyanta balavalabality etayā vācā / tad idam āpo mahat salilam āsīt / yad dha vā idam āhur -- āpo vā idam agre mahat salilam āsīd ity etās tā āpaḥ / ta ūrmayas sa māsyanta phā3lphāśliti ? /
sentences: "nāsad āsīn no sad āsīt tadānīṃ nāsīd rajo no vyomā paro yat /
kim āvarīvaḥ kuha kasya śarmann ambʰaḥ kim āsīd gahanaṃ gabʰīram //"
tasminn asati sati na kasmiṃś cana saty r̥taṃ jyotiṣmad udaplavata , satyaṃ jyotiṣmad udaplavata , tapo jyotiṣmad udaplavata /
tad yad r̥tam iti vāk sā , yat satyam iti prāṇas so , yat tapa iti manas tat /
tad abʰavad yatʰā madʰvaṣṭʰī lāvāsv āsiktā syād r̥tir naivam /
tad aikṣata -- hantādʰastāt prāṇaṃ karavā iti /
tad adʰastāt prāṇamakuruta , yatʰaiṣa striyā adʰastād ākāśa evam /
tad idam āpo mahat salilam āsīt /
yad dʰa vā idam āhur -- āpo vā idam agre mahat salilam āsīd ity etās tā āpaḥ /
text: 'There was not the non-existent, nor was there the existent at that time. There was not the atmosphere, nor the sky beyond. What enveloped? Where? In whose shelter? Was there water, a deep abyss?' In that [state], when there was neither non-existence nor existence, when there was nothing at all, ṛta (cosmic order) floated up, full of light; satya (truth) floated up, full of light; tapas (creative heat) floated up, full of light. That which is ṛta — that is Vāc (Speech). That which is satya — that is Prāṇa. That which is tapas — that is Manas (Mind). Their light was food. These became one. Having become one, it nourished itself with this food-as-light. It came into being like a mass of honey poured into ladles. It considered: 'Come, let me make an opening (prāṇa) below.' It made an opening below, just as a woman has an opening below. From that, waters were created, with the sound 'balavalabali.' This was the great flood of water. What they say — 'In the beginning there was a great flood of waters' — these are those waters. Waves formed, with the sound 'phālphāśli.'
meaning: "नासद् आसीन् नो सद् आसीत् तदानीं नासीद् रजो नो व्योमा परो यत् / किम् आवरीवः कुह कस्य शर्मन्न् अम्भः किम् आसीद् गहनं गभीरम् //" इति / तस्मिन्न् असति सति न कस्मिंश् चन सत्य् ऋतं ज्योतिष्मद् उदप्लवत , सत्यं ज्योतिष्मद् उदप्लवत , तपो ज्योतिष्मद् उदप्लवत / तद् यद् ऋतम् इति वाक् सा , यत् सत्यम् इति प्राणस् सो , यत् तप इति मनस् तत् / तेषाम् अन्नम् एव ज्योतिर् आसीत् / तान्य् एकम् अभवन् / तद् एकं भूत्वैतेनान्नेन ज्योतिषाप्यायत / तद् अभवद् यथा मध्वष्ठी लावास्व् आसिक्ता स्याद् ऋतिर् नैवम् / तद् ऐक्षत -- हन्ताधस्तात् प्राणं करवा इति / तद् अधस्तात् प्राणमकुरुत , यथैष स्त्रिया अधस्ताद् आकाश एवम् / तस्माद् आपो ऽसृज्यन्त बलवलबलित्य् एतया वाचा / तद् इदम् आपो महत् सलिलम् आसीत् / यद् ध वा इदम् आहुर् -- आपो वा इदम् अग्रे महत् सलिलम् आसीद् इत्य् एतास् ता आपः / त ऊर्मयस् स मास्यन्त फा३ल्फाश्लिति ? /

sanskrit_iast: tasya haritam adharaṃ kapālam āsīd rajatam uttaram / tac chataṃ devasaṃvatsarāñ chayitvā nirbhidyam abhavat sahasraṃ vā dyumnān / dyumnā ha nāma tarhy apy āsuḥ / yāvān eṣa saṃvatsaras , tāvantas saṃvatsarasya pratimāḥ / dyumnair ha sma saṃvatsaraṃ vijānanti / atha ha tataḥ purāhorātre saṃśliṣṭe evāsatur avyākṛte / te u sma saṃvatsaraṃ vijānanti / atha ha tataḥ purāhorātre saṃśliṣṭe evāsatur avyākṛte / te u agnihotreṇaiva vyākṛte / tad etayā vācā nirabhidyata sruvasthe saraṇe sanyau kapāle vijihāthām / kaṃ lokam abhi jāyā iti / phal̥ ity evadam āṇḍaṃ nirabhidyata / tasya yad adharaṃ kapālam āsīt , seyaṃ pṛthivy abhavat / atha yad uttaram āsīt , sāsau dyaur abhavat / atha yad antar āsīt , tad idam antarikṣam abhavat / sa yāṃ jāyamāno vācam avadat , sa eva trayo vedo 'bhavat / yad dhaivaiṣāgre kiṃ ca devatā jāyamānovāda tad u ha brahmaiva babhūva / sa aikṣata -- mahatīṃ vā imāṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ asṛkṣīmān lokān / yad vā atas srakṣye vetsyate vai tat pratiṣṭhām / hanta sṛjā iti / sa manasātmānam adhyait /
sentences: tasya haritam adʰaraṃ kapālam āsīd rajatam uttaram /
tac cʰataṃ devasaṃvatsarāñ cʰayitvā nirbʰidyam abʰavat sahasraṃ vā dyumnān /
dyumnā ha nāma tarhy apy āsuḥ /
yāvān eṣa saṃvatsaras , tāvantas saṃvatsarasya pratimāḥ /
atʰa ha tataḥ purāhorātre saṃśliṣṭe evāsatur avyākr̥te /
atʰa ha tataḥ purāhorātre saṃśliṣṭe evāsatur avyākr̥te /
tad etayā vācā nirabʰidyata sruvastʰe saraṇe sanyau kapāle vijihātʰām /
tasya yad adʰaraṃ kapālam āsīt , seyaṃ pr̥tʰivy abʰavat /
atʰa yad uttaram āsīt , sāsau dyaur abʰavat /
atʰa yad antar āsīt , tad idam antarikṣam abʰavat /
sa yāṃ jāyamāno vācam avadat , sa eva trayo vedo 'bʰavat /
yad dʰaivaiṣāgre kiṃ ca devatā jāyamānovāda tad u ha brahmaiva babʰūva /
sa aikṣata -- mahatīṃ vā imāṃ pratiṣṭʰāṃ asr̥kṣīmān lokān /
yad vā atas srakṣye vetsyate vai tat pratiṣṭʰām /
text: Its lower shell was green; its upper shell was silver. Having lain for a hundred divine years, it was about to burst open — or a thousand dyumnas. For dyumnas were the [units of time] then. As long as this year is, that many are the equivalents of the year. They used to reckon the year by dyumnas. Before that, day and night were merged together, undifferentiated. They were differentiated by the agnihotra. It burst open with this sound: 'The ladle-rests, the channels, the two sides — the shells are splitting apart! Toward what world is [this embryo] being born?' With the sound 'phal' it burst — this egg. Its lower shell became this earth. Its upper shell became that sky. What was in between became this mid-space. The speech that he spoke while being born — that became the threefold Veda. Whatever speech this deity spoke while being born, that became brahman itself. He considered: 'I have created a great foundation, these worlds. Whatever I shall create hereafter will indeed know [this] foundation. Come, let me create.' With mind he meditated upon himself.
meaning: तस्य हरितम् अधरं कपालम् आसीद् रजतम् उत्तरम् / तच् छतं देवसंवत्सराञ् छयित्वा निर्भिद्यम् अभवत् सहस्रं वा द्युम्नान् / द्युम्ना ह नाम तर्ह्य् अप्य् आसुः / यावान् एष संवत्सरस् , तावन्तस् संवत्सरस्य प्रतिमाः / द्युम्नैर् ह स्म संवत्सरं विजानन्ति / अथ ह ततः पुराहोरात्रे संश्लिष्टे एवासतुर् अव्याकृते / ते उ स्म संवत्सरं विजानन्ति / अथ ह ततः पुराहोरात्रे संश्लिष्टे एवासतुर् अव्याकृते / ते उ अग्निहोत्रेणैव व्याकृते / तद् एतया वाचा निरभिद्यत स्रुवस्थे सरणे सन्यौ कपाले विजिहाथाम् / कं लोकम् अभि जाया इति / फल्̥ इत्य् एवदम् आण्डं निरभिद्यत / तस्य यद् अधरं कपालम् आसीत् , सेयं पृथिव्य् अभवत् / अथ यद् उत्तरम् आसीत् , सासौ द्यौर् अभवत् / अथ यद् अन्तर् आसीत् , तद् इदम् अन्तरिक्षम् अभवत् / स यां जायमानो वाचम् अवदत् , स एव त्रयो वेदो ऽभवत् / यद् धैवैषाग्रे किं च देवता जायमानोवाद तद् उ ह ब्रह्मैव बभूव / स ऐक्षत -- महतीं वा इमां प्रतिष्ठां असृक्षीमान् लोकान् / यद् वा अतस् स्रक्ष्ये वेत्स्यते वै तत् प्रतिष्ठाम् / हन्त सृजा इति / स मनसात्मानम् अध्यैत् /

sanskrit_iast: tāv abravīt sṛjyethām iti / kāṃ diśaṃ tateti / imām iti / tāv om ity etayā vācāsṛjyata / tayos tad evānnam āsīt , taj jyotis , tad ābhyām ātapat / tatas tau rāṣṭram abhavatām / rāṣṭraṃ ha vai bhavati ya evaṃ veda / sa manasaiva punar ātmānam adhyait / tasmin dvau drapsau samabhavatāṃ graiṣmau māsau / tāv abravīt sṛjyethām iti / kāṃ diśaṃ tateti / imām iti / tāv om ity etayaiva text: He said to them [the two drops]: 'Create!' 'In which direction?' 'In this one.' With 'om' — this very sound — they created. That itself was their food, that their light; it shone upon them. Thereby the two became a kingdom. One who knows this verily attains a kingdom. With mind he again meditated upon himself. In him two drops formed — the two months of summer. He said to them: 'Create!' 'In which direction?' 'In this one.' With 'om' — this very sound — they created. Having fallen in that direction, they established themselves. The bṛhat radiance followed them. That itself was their food, that their light; it shone upon them. Thereby the two became a kingdom. One who knows this verily attains a kingdom. [He repeated this process:] With mind he again meditated upon himself. In him two drops formed — the two months of the rains. He said to them: 'Create!' 'In which direction?' 'In this one.' With 'om' they created. Having fallen in that direction, they established themselves. The vairūpa radiance followed them. That was their food, that their light; it shone upon them. Thereby the two became a kingdom. One who knows this verily attains a kingdom. In him two drops formed — the two months of autumn. He said: 'Create!' With 'om' they created. They established themselves. The vairāja radiance followed them. That was their food and light. Thereby the two became a kingdom. In him two drops formed — the two months of early winter. He said: 'Create!' With 'om' they created. They established themselves. The śākvara radiance followed them. That was their food and light. Thereby the two became a kingdom. In him two drops formed — the two months of late winter. He said: 'Create!' 'In which direction?' 'In this one.' With 'om' they created. They established themselves. The raivata radiance followed them. That was their food, that their light; it shone upon them. Thereby the two became a kingdom.

sanskrit_iast: atha jyṛgbhyām ārcchat / tasmāt paśavaḥ śaiśira ṛtau jyṛgbhyām ṛcchanti / sa aikṣata yam imaṃ trayaṃ cedam asṛkṣi hantāsmāt sṛjā iti / sa trivṛtā stomena gāyatrīm adhyait / tato vasūn asṛjata / ta imāṃ diśam anvāyan / pañcadaśena stomena triṣṭubham adhyait / tato rudrān asṛjata / ta imāṃ diśam anvāyan / sa saptadaśena stomena jagatīm adhyait / tata ādityān asṛjata / ta imāṃ diśam anvāyan / ekaviṃśena jagatīm adhyait / tata ādityān asṛjata / ta imāṃ diśam anvāyan / ekaviṃśena stomenānuṣṭubham adhyait / tato viśvān devān asṛjata / ta imāṃ diśam anvāyan / triṇavena stomena paṃktim adhyait / tato maruto 'sṛjata / ta imāṃ diśam anvāyan / trayastriṃśena stomenāticchandasam adhyait / tatas sādhyāṃś cāptyāṃś cāsṛjata /
sentences: tasmāt paśavaḥ śaiśira r̥tau jyr̥gbʰyām r̥ccʰanti /
sa aikṣata yam imaṃ trayaṃ cedam asr̥kṣi hantāsmāt sr̥jā iti /
text: Then he trembled in his two jaws. Therefore cattle tremble in their jaws during the śiśira (late winter) season. He considered: 'Having created this threefold [universe], come, let me create from it.' With the trivṛt stoma he meditated upon the gāyatrī. From that he created the Vasus. They went toward this direction. With the pañcadaśa stoma he meditated upon the triṣṭubh. From that he created the Rudras. They went toward this direction. With the saptadaśa stoma he meditated upon the jagatī. From that he created the Ādityas. They went toward this direction. With the ekaviṃśa stoma he meditated upon the anuṣṭubh. From that he created the Viśve Devāḥ. They went toward this direction. With the triṇava stoma he meditated upon the paṅkti. From that he created the Maruts. They went toward this direction. With the trayastriṃśa stoma he meditated upon the atichandas. From that he created the Sādhyas and the Āptyas.
meaning: अथ ज्यृग्भ्याम् आर्च्छत् / तस्मात् पशवः शैशिर ऋतौ ज्यृग्भ्याम् ऋच्छन्ति / स ऐक्षत यम् इमं त्रयं चेदम् असृक्षि हन्तास्मात् सृजा इति / स त्रिवृता स्तोमेन गायत्रीम् अध्यैत् / ततो वसून् असृजत / त इमां दिशम् अन्वायन् / पञ्चदशेन स्तोमेन त्रिष्टुभम् अध्यैत् / ततो रुद्रान् असृजत / त इमां दिशम् अन्वायन् / स सप्तदशेन स्तोमेन जगतीम् अध्यैत् / तत आदित्यान् असृजत / त इमां दिशम् अन्वायन् / एकविंशेन जगतीम् अध्यैत् / तत आदित्यान् असृजत / त इमां दिशम् अन्वायन् / एकविंशेन स्तोमेनानुष्टुभम् अध्यैत् / ततो विश्वान् देवान् असृजत / त इमां दिशम् अन्वायन् / त्रिणवेन स्तोमेन पंक्तिम् अध्यैत् / ततो मरुतो ऽसृजत / त इमां दिशम् अन्वायन् / त्रयस्त्रिंशेन स्तोमेनातिच्छन्दसम् अध्यैत् / ततस् साध्यांश् चाप्त्यांश् चासृजत /

sanskrit_iast: tā etā devatā sṛṣṭā stomā chandāṃsy ṛtavo grahāḥ / pṛthag evaiṣām imā śriyo dīpyamānā atiṣṭhan , nānyonyasya śreṣṭhatāyā atiṣṭhanta / te 'bruvan na vā anyo 'nyasya śreṣṭhatāyai tiṣṭhāmahai / eta tam icchāmahai yo na īśātā iti / te prajāpatim eva janayitāram etyābruvan na vā anyo 'nyasya śreṣṭhatāyai tiṣṭhāmahai / tan nas sṛjasva yo na īśātā iti / sa prajāpatir abravīd etāvad vāva tyasmiṃs teja indriyaṃ vīryam abhūd yad yuṣmān asṛkṣi / te vai saṃvatsaraṃ tapyadhvam / te mā saṃvatsaraṃ taptvopasameta yad eko 'dhigacchati yad eko yad eka iti / te saṃvatsaram atapyanta / taṃ saṃvatsaraṃ taptvopasamāyan / yad eko 'dhyagacchad yad eko yad ekas tad asya manyau yonāv asiñcan / tata indras saṃbhavat / tad eṣābhyanūcyate -- "aśvād iyāyeti yad vadanty ojaso jātam uta manya enam / manyor iyāya harmyeṣū tasthau yataḥ prajajña indro asya veda //" iti / manyor iyāyeti yad asya manyau yonāv asiñcan / "harmyeṣu tasthāv " iti hṛdayāny u vai harmyāṇi / hṛdayo ha vai krudhyati /

text: These deities, once created — stomas, metres, seasons, cups (graha) — their separate splendours stood shining; they did not submit to one another's supremacy. They said: 'We do not submit to one another's supremacy. Let us seek the one who would rule over us.' Approaching Prajāpati, their progenitor, they said: 'We do not submit to one another's supremacy. Create for us one who would rule over us.' Prajāpati said: 'All my tejas, indriya, and vīrya was spent when I created you. Perform tapas for a year. Having performed tapas for a year, come to me — whatever one finds, whatever another, whatever yet another.' They performed tapas for a year. Having performed tapas for a year, they came to him. Whatever one found, whatever another, whatever yet another — that they poured into his manyau (wrath-vessel), into his womb. From that, Indra came into being. Regarding this, this verse is recited: 'They say he came from a horse; they say he was born from strength — but I consider him born from wrath. From wrath he came, in the chambers he stood; whence he was born, Indra alone knows.' 'From wrath he came' — because they poured into his wrath-vessel, into his womb. 'In the chambers he stood' — the chambers are verily the hearts. For one becomes wrathful in the heart.
meaning: ता एता देवता सृष्टा स्तोमा छन्दांस्य् ऋतवो ग्रहाः / पृथग् एवैषाम् इमा श्रियो दीप्यमाना अतिष्ठन् , नान्योन्यस्य श्रेष्ठताया अतिष्ठन्त / ते ऽब्रुवन् न वा अन्यो ऽन्यस्य श्रेष्ठतायै तिष्ठामहै / एत तम् इच्छामहै यो न ईशाता इति / ते प्रजापतिम् एव जनयितारम् एत्याब्रुवन् न वा अन्यो ऽन्यस्य श्रेष्ठतायै तिष्ठामहै / तन् नस् सृजस्व यो न ईशाता इति / स प्रजापतिर् अब्रवीद् एतावद् वाव त्यस्मिंस् तेज इन्द्रियं वीर्यम् अभूद् यद् युष्मान् असृक्षि / ते वै संवत्सरं तप्यध्वम् / ते मा संवत्सरं तप्त्वोपसमेत यद् एको ऽधिगच्छति यद् एको यद् एक इति / ते संवत्सरम् अतप्यन्त / तं संवत्सरं तप्त्वोपसमायन् / यद् एको ऽध्यगच्छद् यद् एको यद् एकस् तद् अस्य मन्यौ योनाव् असिञ्चन् / तत इन्द्रस् संभवत् / तद् एषाभ्यनूच्यते -- "अश्वाद् इयायेति यद् वदन्त्य् ओजसो जातम् उत मन्य एनम् / मन्योर् इयाय हर्म्येषू तस्थौ यतः प्रजज्ञ इन्द्रो अस्य वेद //" इति / मन्योर् इयायेति यद् अस्य मन्यौ योनाव् असिञ्चन् / "हर्म्येषु तस्थाव् " इति हृदयान्य् उ वै हर्म्याणि / हृदयो ह वै क्रुध्यति /

sanskrit_iast: gaurvītaṃ ha papracchus -- tvaṃ ha vai dadarśithendraṃ jāyamānam iti / sa haitad uvāca -- "aśvād iyāyeti yad vadanty ojaso jātam uta manya enam / manyor iyāya harmyeṣu tasthau yataḥ prajajña indro asya veda //" ity ojaso 'nvāhaṃ jātaṃ manya iti hovāca / indras tveva tad veda yatas sa jāta iti / sa śiro nirhṛtya vyaikṣata / sa idam eṣāṃ sarvaṃ spṛtam apaśyat / so 'bravīd yad idam eṣāṃ sarvaṃ spṛtaṃ , kaṃ lokam abhi jāyai sa vai nu me prayaccha /
sentences: gaurvītaṃ ha papraccʰus -- tvaṃ ha vai dadarśitʰendraṃ jāyamānam iti /
"aśvād iyāyeti yad vadanty ojaso jātam uta manya enam /
manyor iyāya harmyeṣu tastʰau yataḥ prajajña indro asya veda //"
ity ojaso 'nvāhaṃ jātaṃ manya iti hovāca /
indras tveva tad veda yatas sa jāta iti /
sa idam eṣāṃ sarvaṃ spr̥tam apaśyat /
so 'bravīd yad idam eṣāṃ sarvaṃ spr̥taṃ , kaṃ lokam abʰi jāyai sa vai nu me prayaccʰa /
text: Gaurvīta asked him: 'You have indeed seen Indra being born.' He spoke this [verse]: 'They say he came from a horse; they say he was born from strength — but I consider him born from wrath. From wrath he came, in the chambers he stood; whence he was born, Indra alone knows.' 'I consider him born from strength,' he said. 'But Indra alone knows whence he was born.' Having thrust out his head, he looked around. He saw all this of theirs as contested. He said: 'Since all this of theirs is contested, in what world shall I be born? Give that to me.'
meaning: गौर्वीतं ह पप्रच्छुस् -- त्वं ह वै ददर्शिथेन्द्रं जायमानम् इति / स हैतद् उवाच -- "अश्वाद् इयायेति यद् वदन्त्य् ओजसो जातम् उत मन्य एनम् / मन्योर् इयाय हर्म्येषु तस्थौ यतः प्रजज्ञ इन्द्रो अस्य वेद //" इत्य् ओजसो ऽन्वाहं जातं मन्य इति होवाच / इन्द्रस् त्वेव तद् वेद यतस् स जात इति / स शिरो निर्हृत्य व्यैक्षत / स इदम् एषां सर्वं स्पृतम् अपश्यत् / सो ऽब्रवीद् यद् इदम् एषां सर्वं स्पृतं , कं लोकम् अभि जायै स वै नु मे प्रयच्छ /

sanskrit_iast: -- vāsantikau māsau prayaccheti / etau te prayacchānīty annam annam iti patitvāsyai prācyai diśau rathantaraṃ bhā ādatta / tad ito 'dhatta / aiko dvayor vīryaṃ datte ya evaṃ veda / taṃ punar eva prāviśat / tam abravīj jāyasvaiveti / so 'bravīt sa vai nu me prayacchemau nu me graiṣmau māsau prayaccheti / etau te prayacchānīty annam annam ity eva patitvāsyai dakṣiṇāyai diśo bṛhad bhā ādatta / tad ito 'dhatta / aikaś caturṇāṃ vīryaṃ datte ya evaṃ veda / taṃ punar eva prāviśat / tam abravīj jāyasvaiveti / so 'bravīt sa vai nu me prayacchamau nu me vārṣikau māsau prayaccheti / etau te prayacchānīty annam annam ity eva patitvāsyai pratīcyai diśo vairūpaṃ bhā ādatta / tad ito adhatta / aikaṣ ṣaṇṇāṃ vīryaṃ datte ya evaṃ veda / taṃ punar eva prāviśat / tam abravīj jāyamvaiveti / so 'bravīt sa vai nu me prayacchemau nu me śāradau māsau prayacchati / etau te prayacchānīty annam annam ity eva patitvāsyā udīcyai diśo vairājaṃ bhā ādatta / tad ito 'dhatta / aiko 'ṣṭānāṃ vīryaṃ datte ya evaṃ veda / tam punar eva prāviśat / tam abravīj jāyasvaivati / so 'bavīt sa vai nu me prayacchemau nu me haimantikau māsau prayacchati / etau te prayacchānīty annam annam ity eva patitvāsyā ūrdhvāyai diśaś śākvaraṃ bhā ādatta / tad ito 'dhatta / aiko daśānāṃ vīryaṃ datte ya evaṃ veda / taṃ punar eva prāviśat / tam abravīj jāyasvaiveti / so 'bravīt sa vai nu me prayacchemau nu me śaiśirau māsau prayaccheti / etau te prayacchānīty annam annam ity eva patitvāsyai diśo raivataṃ bhā ādatta / tad ito 'dhatta / aiko dvādaśānāṃ vīryaṃ datte ya evaṃ veda /
